papers.title: Moore, Escher, Penrose: A Conformal Golden Braid
papers.abstract_en: I don't think I have ever done anything as peculiar in my life. Among other things, it shows a young man looking with interest at a print on the wall of an exhibition that features himself. How can this be? Perhaps I am not far removed from Einstein's curved universe.'' So wrote M.C. Escher about his 1956 lithograph Print Gallery. Nearly half a century later, a mathematical analysis related its geometry to an untwisted source image through a conformal power map $z \mapsto z^α$, $α\in \mathbb{C}$. Building on this construction, we use a frozen text-to-image diffusion model to generate new self-referential scenes. Prompting alone does not enforce the recursion, while a post-hoc transformation can leave structures poorly connected. Applying the transformation during sampling is also insufficient: the denoiser may "repair" the intended distortion or drift out of the prescribed geometry. We construct a generalized inverse $T^\dagger$ of the non-invertible image transformation $T$, adapted to its recursive constraint. In the idealized formulation, the Penrose identity $TT^\dagger T = T$ makes $TT^\dagger$ an idempotent projection onto geometrically admissible images. Yet denoising only the transformed image remains an out-of-distribution task, even with projection. We therefore braid denoising steps with $T$ and $T^\dagger$: source-space steps develop the untwisted scene, while transformed-space steps refine its appearance and connections in the final geometry. We generate Print Gallery-like compositions and explore further transformations. Rather than distorting a finished image, we let the scene and its distortion develop together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Escher《Print Gallery》的共形幂映射 z→z^α（α∈ℂ）搬进冻结的文生图扩散模型，构造非可逆图像变换 T 的广义逆 T†，使 Penrose 恒等式 TT†T=T 成为对几何可容许图像的幂等投影，并把去噪步与 T、T† 编成“辫子”：源空间步生成未扭曲场景，变换空间步修整最终几何下的外观与连接。核心论断是仅靠 prompt、事后变换或在采样中施加变换都不够——去噪器会“修复”畸变或漂出指定几何，而让场景与畸变同步发育才能得到 Print Gallery 式自指构图。
Motivation: Escher Print Gallery 的自指几何需要图像与其共形畸变同时成立，而 prompt 无法强制递归、事后变换会让结构断裂、采样中施加变换又会被去噪器修复或漂移。
Method: 基于 z↦z^α 共形幂映射的图像变换 T，构造适配递归约束的广义逆 T†，用 Penrose 恒等式 TT†T=T 得到幂等投影 TT†；在冻结的 text-to-image diffusion 采样中把去噪步与 T、T† 交替编织，源空间步发展未扭曲场景、变换空间步精修最终几何。
Result: 生成了 Print Gallery 式自指构图并探索了进一步的变换；摘要给出的对照是定性的：prompt 单独不强制递归、事后变换导致结构连接不良、仅在采样中施加变换时去噪器会修复畸变或漂出指定几何，即便加上投影，去噪变换后图像仍是 out-of-distribution 任务。
Conclusion: 自指共形构图应让场景与畸变在采样过程中共同发育，而不是对成品图像做事后扭曲；该结论建立在理想化表述的 Penrose 幂等投影之上。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Sphere Encoder 2
papers.abstract_en: Sphere Encoder is an autoencoder that generates images by decoding random points from a high-dimensional latent sphere. We identify two limitations of the original formulation that reduce its generation quality. First, random points concentrate near the equator relative to the pole on an encoded latent, but the training rotation never reaches this region, leaving a gap that limits one-step generation. Second, training for generation with pixel-wise reconstruction loss encourages the decoder to average over plausible images, producing blurry images that lack high-frequency details. We present Sphere Encoder 2 to address both limitations, substantially improving image generation quality while maintaining the speed and simplicity of a autoencoder. Models are released at \href{https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2}{github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2}.
papers.comment: Code will be available at https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sphere Encoder 2 修正了原版 Sphere Encoder 的两个生成缺陷：随机点在编码后的 latent 球面上集中于赤道附近而训练旋转到不了该区域，以及逐像素重建损失促使解码器对多个合理图像取平均导致画面模糊。修正后图像生成质量显著提升，同时保持自编码器的速度与简洁性。
Motivation: 原版 Sphere Encoder 从高维 latent 球面随机点解码生成图像时，训练旋转覆盖不到随机点聚集的赤道区域，且逐像素重建损失造成解码器平均化，生成图像模糊、缺少高频细节，限制了一步生成质量。
Method: 针对两个缺陷改进 Sphere Encoder：一是让训练旋转覆盖随机点实际聚集的赤道区域，弥补 latent 球面上的覆盖空缺；二是替换逐像素重建损失以避免解码器对多个合理图像取平均。整体仍保持自编码器形式与一步生成的速度和简洁性。
Result: 在保持自编码器速度与简洁性的前提下，图像生成质量获得显著提升（substantially improving），具体指标与对比基线见论文正文。
Conclusion: Sphere Encoder 通过补齐 latent 球面的训练覆盖并改掉逐像素重建导致的平均化，可以在不牺牲自编码器速度的前提下明显改善一步图像生成质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Basis to Animate Them All: Gaussian Blendshape Distillation for Real-Time Avatars
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian avatars support fast rendering, however, their real-time animation is often challenged by the costly neural inference. We address this bottleneck and show that the animation of pretrained avatar models can be closely approximated by a linear combination of identity-independent blendshapes. Building on this finding, we introduce GALA (Gaussian Animation via Linear Approximation), a distillation method that replaces per-frame heavy neural decoding with a shallow coefficient predictor and a linear blend. To improve fidelity and reduce memory requirements, we propose to construct the basis using block-local PCA under a rendering-aware metric and a memory budget. Our method learns a shallow MLP network to predict blendshape coefficients and applies to various animation architectures without retraining original models. We validate GALA by accelerating the inference of three distinct avatar models for 3D animation of facial expressions and full-bodies with clothing dynamics. Across these models, our distillation generalizes to held-out identities and reduces CPU animation cost by up to three orders of magnitude while preserving most of the rendering quality. Excellent results of our method confirm the shared linear structure of learned avatar representations and enable highly efficient and accurate animation at frame rates reaching up to 60fps on mobile devices. Project page: https://ramazan793.github.io/gala/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GALA 用蒸馏把 3D Gaussian avatar 的逐帧神经解码替换成浅层 MLP 预测的线性 blendshape 系数加线性混合，在不重训原模型的前提下把 CPU 动画开销降低最多三个数量级，移动端可达 60fps，且能泛化到未见过的身份。
Motivation: 3D Gaussian avatar 渲染快，但实时动画被逐帧昂贵的神经推理卡住，需要在保留渲染质量的同时把动画开销降下来。
Method: 先验证预训练 avatar 的动画可由身份无关的 blendshape 线性组合近似，再蒸馏出 GALA：用 block-local PCA 在 rendering-aware 度量与内存预算下构造基，训练浅层 MLP 预测 blendshape 系数并做线性混合，替换原模型的重解码器且无需重训原模型。
Result: 在三个不同的 avatar 模型（面部表情与含衣物动力学的全身）上验证，蒸馏可泛化到 held-out 身份，CPU 动画开销最多降低三个数量级，同时保留大部分渲染质量，移动端帧率可达 60fps。
Conclusion: 学习到的 avatar 表示共享线性结构，因此用浅层系数预测器加线性基即可替代逐帧神经解码，实现高效且准确的动画。

papers.title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. KaliBench is constructed via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, enabling precise and reproducible assessment of tool selection and argument construction. To ensure both semantic correctness and practical executability, we develop a multi-stage verification pipeline that combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement. Building on these fine-grained, deterministic signals, KaliBench further enables runtime-free verifiable rewards for training. Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints. We further show that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model and achieve performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://risys-lab.github.io/KaliBench/ | Github: https://github.com/RISys-Lab/KaliBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KaliBench 是面向 Kali Linux 自然语言到 CLI 翻译的细粒度基准，含 8,504 条 query–command 对、覆盖 1,642 个工具、23 个能力维度与 5 个安全阶段，用确定性规范化与别名感知评测给出可复现的工具选择与参数构造信号。在无限制设置下，24 个配置的通用与安全专用开源模型无一超过 42% exact-command accuracy；用其可验证奖励做 SFT 与 RL 能显著提升一个 8B 模型，达到与 685B MoE 相当的水平。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 网络安全评测偏知识问答或端到端 agentic 任务，不直接度量模型为真实安全工具生成可执行命令的能力，而 CLI 中语法、flag–value 绑定或参数顺序的微小错误就会使执行失效。
Method: 以 manuscript-grounded 流水线构建数据集，配确定性规范化 (deterministic canonicalization) 与别名感知评测；正确性判定用多阶段验证流水线，结合 LLM-based validation、沙箱终端执行与 human-in-the-loop refinement；再把细粒度确定性信号转成 runtime-free verifiable rewards 用于训练。
Result: 数据集 8,504 条 query–command 对、1,642 个工具、23 个能力维度、5 个安全阶段；在 3 种评测模式与 24 个配置（通用与安全专用开源权重模型）下，无限制设置中没有任何开源模型 exact-command accuracy 超过 42%；基于 KaliBench 奖励的 SFT 与 RL 显著提升一个 8B 模型，性能与 685B MoE 相当。
Conclusion: 在无显式工具提示下准确做 CLI 级网络安全工具调用对当前开源模型仍然很难，而细粒度可验证奖励足以把 8B 模型训练到接近 685B MoE 的水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies?
papers.abstract_en: Programmable world models separate executable dynamics from visual generation, offering a promising foundation for next-generation game engines. However, their visual adherence to explicit rules and interactions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing benchmarks assess visual quality, controllability, and instruction or physical adherence, but rarely test fidelity to fine-grained, program-specified world events. We introduce PROWBench, comprising 170 programmatically constructed episodes and 600 proxy videos covering diverse scenes and interactions. PROWBench logs entity states and timestamped events, including those outside the camera's field of view, as replayable world records, from which it renders synchronized views and proxy representations. This enables generated videos to be checked against the observable consequences of program execution. An extensible framework constructs scenes, controls behaviors, and can render each camera view in different representations, such as coarse 3D, and bounding boxes. The benchmark covers first- and third-person perspectives, with synchronized multi-view observations available for a subset of episodes. Grounded in these records, PROWBench evaluates entity control, long-horizon memory, and, with two VLM-based metrics, Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate, adherence to the prescribed timeline and the visual realization of timestamped engine-recorded events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PROWBench（标题称 ROWBench）用可执行程序生成 170 个 episode、600 段 proxy 视频，把实体状态与含视野外事件的时间戳事件记录为可回放世界记录，据此渲染同步多视角与 proxy 表示，用两个 VLM 指标（Logic-Render Alignment、Interaction Success Rate）检验可编程世界模型是否真的渲染出程序规定的事件与时间线。
Motivation: 可编程世界模型把可执行动力学与视觉生成分离，但其对显式规则与交互的视觉依从性缺乏细粒度评测：现有基准只测画质、可控性、指令或物理依从，很少检验程序指定的世界事件是否被忠实渲染。
Method: 以程序化构造的 170 个 episode 和 600 段 proxy 视频构建 PROWBench，记录实体状态与时间戳事件（含相机视野外事件）为可回放世界记录，并从中渲染同步视角与 proxy 表示（如 coarse 3D、bounding boxes）；提供可扩展框架构建场景、控制行为、按不同表示渲染每个相机视角，覆盖第一/第三人称视角，部分 episode 有同步多视角；用两个 VLM 指标 Logic-Render Alignment 与 Interaction Success Rate 评估实体控制、长时程记忆以及对规定时间线与时间戳引擎事件视觉实现的依从。
Result: 基准规模为 170 个程序化 episode、600 段 proxy 视频，覆盖多样场景与交互、第一与第三人称视角，部分 episode 提供同步多视角；评测输出为 Logic-Render Alignment 与 Interaction Success Rate 两个 VLM 指标下的实体控制、长时程记忆与时间线依从结果。
Conclusion: 把程序执行的可观测后果（含视野外事件）作为可回放记录来核对生成视频，可把世界模型评测从画质与指令依从推进到对程序指定事件与时间线的忠实渲染检验。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: PROWBench（标题称 ROWBench）用可执行程序生成 170 个 episode、600 段 proxy 视频，把实体状态与含视野外事件的时间戳事件记录为可回放世界记录，据此渲染同步多视角与 proxy 表示，用两个 VLM 指标（Logic-Render Alignment、Interaction Success Rate）检验可编程世界模型是否真的渲染出程序规定的事件与时间线。

summary_sections.method: 以程序化构造的 170 个 episode 和 600 段 proxy 视频构建 PROWBench，记录实体状态与时间戳事件（含相机视野外事件）为可回放世界记录，并从中渲染同步视角与 proxy 表示（如 coarse 3D、bounding boxes）；提供可扩展框架构建场景、控制行为、按不同表示渲染每个相机视角，覆盖第一/第三人称视角，部分 episode 有同步多视角；用两个 VLM 指标 Logic-Render Alignment 与 Interaction Success Rate 评估实体控制、长时程记忆以及对规定时间线与时间戳引擎事件视觉实现的依从。
summary_sections.result: 基准规模为 170 个程序化 episode、600 段 proxy 视频，覆盖多样场景与交互、第一与第三人称视角，部分 episode 提供同步多视角；评测输出为 Logic-Render Alignment 与 Interaction Success Rate 两个 VLM 指标下的实体控制、长时程记忆与时间线依从结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把程序执行的可观测后果（含视野外事件）作为可回放记录来核对生成视频，可把世界模型评测从画质与指令依从推进到对程序指定事件与时间线的忠实渲染检验。

papers.title: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Building reliable robot capabilities across diverse tasks requires substantial human effort to develop and maintain skills, design rewards, and integrate perception with control. We present Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real (RPG), a framework for autonomous improvement of robot execution systems without updating model weights. RPG identifies manipulation capabilities in an offline dataset and constructs related practice tasks in simulation. During practice, RPG uses execution feedback, privileged simulator state, and available dataset videos to diagnose failures. It develops new reusable symbolic skills, refines existing skills, and revises the system prompt based on these diagnoses. Cross-task evaluation tests individual candidate changes and merged revisions before they are retained for reuse. At test time, a multimodal LLM uses the resulting system prompt and skill library to coordinate perception and robot control. On held-out initializations of 22 manipulation tasks, RPG improves task success from 28.6% after the first practice round to 95.0% after 15 rounds, outperforming all evaluated baselines, including ASPIRE (75.5%) and CaP-Agent0 powered by GPT-6 Astra Pro (60.0%). After a common calibration and hardware-adaptation procedure, the frozen system succeeds in all 30 physical trials, with ten trials on each of three tasks. Project Website: https://rpg-robot.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RPG 框架让机器人执行系统在不更新模型权重的前提下自主改进：从离线数据集识别操作能力并在仿真中构造练习任务，用执行反馈、特权仿真状态和数据集视频诊断失败，进而生成可复用符号技能、精化现有技能并修订 system prompt，再经跨任务评测筛选保留。在 22 项操作任务的 held-out 初始化上，成功率从第 1 轮练习后的 28.6% 升到 15 轮后的 95.0%，超过全部被评估基线（ASPIRE 75.5%、GPT-6 Astra Pro 驱动的 CaP-Agent0 60.0%），经统一校准与硬件适配后在 30 次实体试验中全部成功。
Motivation: 让机器人具备可靠操作能力需要大量人工开发与维护技能、设计奖励、并把感知与控制整合起来，人力成本高且难以随任务扩展。
Method: RPG 先从离线数据集识别操作能力并在仿真中构造相关练习任务；练习阶段用执行反馈、特权仿真状态 (privileged simulator state) 与数据集视频诊断失败，产出新的可复用符号技能、精化已有技能并修订 system prompt；跨任务评测逐项检验候选改动与合并修订，通过者才保留复用。测试时由多模态 LLM 依据 system prompt 与技能库协调感知与机器人控制，全程不更新模型权重。
Result: 在 22 项操作任务的 held-out 初始化上，任务成功率从第 1 轮练习后的 28.6% 提升到 15 轮后的 95.0%，高于全部被评估基线，包括 ASPIRE 的 75.5% 和由 GPT-6 Astra Pro 驱动的 CaP-Agent0 的 60.0%。经统一的校准与硬件适配流程后，冻结系统在 30 次实体试验中全部成功（3 项任务各 10 次）。
Conclusion: 不更新权重、仅靠仿真练习加符号技能与 prompt 修订的闭环，就能把机器人操作成功率推到接近饱和并迁移到实体硬件，说明技能库与 system prompt 本身可作为自主改进的载体。

papers.title: Embedding Prediction Helps Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: In diffusion transformers, a class label or a text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step. We ask whether predicted embeddings can serve as this condition instead. Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression (NEPA) trains a Transformer to predict the next continuous embedding in a sequence. In generation, the clean image follows the noisy image, so its embeddings are the next embeddings after the condition and the noisy image. We train a NEPA model to predict them all at once with Multi-Embedding Prediction, and in Embedding Conditioned Generation, a DiT generator is conditioned on these predictions, recomputed at every denoising step, so the conditioning signal adapts to the current noisy state. Experiments on class-conditional ImageNet $256\times256$ study the condition of the generator, the design of Multi-Embedding Prediction, and the scaling of both models. The NEPA model adds a second network to every sampling step; with it, and combined with REPA, our final model, NEPA-DiT-XL, reaches an FID of 1.32 using about a third of the training compute of REPA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在扩散 Transformer 里把一次性嵌入的条件换成每步重算的预测嵌入：NEPA 用自回归 Transformer 预测条件与噪声图像之后的干净图像嵌入，DiT 每个去噪步都以这些预测为条件，使条件随当前噪声状态自适应。在 class-conditional ImageNet 256×256 上，NEPA-DiT-XL 结合 REPA 达到 FID 1.32，只用约 REPA 三分之一的训练算力。
Motivation: 扩散 Transformer 中类别标签或文本提示只嵌入一次并在所有去噪步复用，条件信号无法随噪声状态变化；作者要检验预测出的嵌入能否直接充当这一条件。
Method: 提出 Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression (NEPA)：训练 Transformer 在序列中预测下一个连续嵌入，用 Multi-Embedding Prediction 一次性预测条件与噪声图像之后的全部干净图像嵌入；Embedding Conditioned Generation 让 DiT 生成器以这些预测为条件并在每个去噪步重算。实验在 class-conditional ImageNet 256×256 上研究生成器条件、Multi-Embedding Prediction 的设计以及两个模型的 scaling。
Result: 在 class-conditional ImageNet 256×256 上，NEPA-DiT-XL 结合 REPA 达到 FID 1.32，训练算力约为 REPA 的三分之一；NEPA 模型为每个采样步增加第二个网络。
Conclusion: 用逐步重算的预测嵌入替代静态条件，可以在 ImageNet 256×256 上以约三分之一训练算力达到 FID 1.32，代价是每步多跑一个网络。

papers.title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research
papers.abstract_en: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ScholarCatalyst 是一个「检索能启发新研究的论文」的基准：由 184 位第一作者对 207 篇近期 CS 论文标注哪些候选文献真正推进了自己的项目并给出理由，任务限定在项目开始时已存在的文献。结果是 agentic search 的 Recall@20 只有 0.42，反而低于直接 embedding 检索的 0.48；即使可能在训练中见过成品论文的 Claude Fable 5.1 智能体也只到 0.51 R@20。
Motivation: AI 已能在开放问题上推进，但科学家在「从海量文献中嗅出新问题需要哪个旧想法」上仍远超模型；现有检索基准缺少作者本人给出的、关于何种文献真正推进项目的判断。
Method: 用自动化流水线让作者标注可规模化：184 位第一作者为 207 篇近期 CS 论文标注哪些候选文献已或可能推进其项目并附详细理由；据此定义检索任务——给定初始研究问题，只在项目启动时可得的文献中检索，并对比 agentic search、embedding 检索与 Claude Fable 5.1 智能体。
Result: agentic search Recall@20 为 0.42，embedding 检索为 0.48，即智能体调用同一检索器作为工具反而更差；基于 Claude Fable 5.1 的智能体（可能在训练中见过这些成品论文）仅达 0.51 R@20。
Conclusion: 现有 agentic 检索在「找到能启发新研究的论文」上并不优于朴素 embedding 检索，作者据此主张需要新的训练配方，让模型具备在大规模语料上搜索的专家直觉。

papers.title: SILSA: Sliding-Window Slice Latents for Topology-Preserving High-Resolution 3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution 3D generation increasingly relies on voxel latents and multi-stage pipelines that first predict active structure and then synthesize local geometry. While effective, this design fragments continuous surfaces into many local tokens, inflates generation cost, and often weakens topological consistency for thin or highly connected shapes. We introduce SILSA, a topology-aware 3D generation framework that represents shapes with compact sliding-window slice latents. Instead of generating expensive voxel tokens, SILSA uses a fixed set of overlapping slices along the three canonical axes, where each token summarizes a local depth window to preserve cross-sectional continuity and support single-stage rectified-flow generation. A Slice VAE encodes oriented surface samples into multi-axis slice latents and reconstructs them with a sparse volumetric decoder, while a Volumetric Anchor Lattice coordinates directional slice streams through a shared 3D workspace. To preserve structural correctness, we introduce slice-level topology supervision that matches persistence diagrams and aligns Betti transitions across neighboring slices. Experiments show that SILSA improves structural fidelity while substantially reducing generation cost. SILSA improves PSNR by $8.7\%$, coverage by $5.96$ absolute points, and Betti error by $9.2\%$ over the strongest baseline, while using $70.0\%$ fewer tokens than the next-most compact baseline and over $98\%$ fewer tokens than sparse or hierarchical tokenizers, effectively reducing training memory by $40.4\%$ and inference time by $58.5\%$. Qualitative results further show improved preservation of thin structures, repeated components, and long-range connectivity.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project link: https://plan-lab.github.io/silsa
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SILSA 用沿三个正交轴的固定重叠切片 latent（每个 token 概括一个局部深度窗）替代体素 token，配合 Slice VAE、Volumetric Anchor Lattice 与切片级拓扑监督（匹配 persistence diagram、对齐相邻切片的 Betti 变化）做单阶段 rectified-flow 生成。相对最强基线 PSNR 提升 8.7%、coverage 提升 5.96 个绝对点、Betti error 降低 9.2%，token 数比次紧凑基线少 70.0%、比稀疏或分层 tokenizer 少 98% 以上，训练显存降 40.4%、推理时间降 58.5%。
Motivation: 高分辨率 3D 生成依赖体素 latent 与多阶段流水线，把连续曲面切碎成大量局部 token，推高生成成本，并削弱细长或强连通形状的拓扑一致性。
Method: 以三个正交轴上固定数量的重叠切片 latent 表示形状，每个 token 汇总局部深度窗以保持截面连续性；Slice VAE 将有向表面采样编码为多轴切片 latent 并用稀疏体解码器重建，Volumetric Anchor Lattice 在共享 3D 工作空间中协调各方向切片流；切片级拓扑监督匹配 persistence diagram 并对齐相邻切片的 Betti 转变，支撑单阶段 rectified-flow 生成。
Result: 相对最强基线：PSNR 提升 8.7%，coverage 提升 5.96 个绝对点，Betti error 降低 9.2%；token 数比次紧凑基线少 70.0%，比稀疏或分层 tokenizer 少 98% 以上；训练显存降低 40.4%，推理时间降低 58.5%。定性上细结构、重复部件与长程连通性保持更好。
Conclusion: 用紧凑的多轴切片 latent 加显式拓扑监督，可以在单阶段生成中同时提高结构保真度并大幅削减 token 数、显存与推理时间。

papers.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
papers.abstract_en: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0's Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. VISTA's simple design also allows it to extend naturally to diverse visual environments with minimal adaptation. Across three additional benchmarks covering a diverse range of visual games and puzzles, it substantially outperforms baselines using the same underlying model with minimal harnesses. Our results highlight VISTA's potential as a general-purpose visual harness for advancing multimodal agents in complex visual environments.

papers.title: TACO: Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse Optimizer for LLM Fine-Tuning
authors: Aritra Dutta (1) ((1) University of Central Florida
papers.abstract_en: Full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial optimizer state memory overhead, limiting the model sizes that fit on modern GPUs. Existing approaches either compress optimizer state, abandon first-order gradients, or change the update geometry while retaining dense state. The recently introduced Muon optimizer reduces optimizer memory through matrix-valued updates. Still, its geometry differs from AdamW and can lead to performance degradation when fine-tuning AdamW-pretrained models. To reduce optimizer memory without sacrificing accuracy or computational efficiency in LLM fine-tuning, we propose Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse optimizer, or TACO, which follows Muon's operator-norm steepest-descent view but takes the geometric route further. TACO computes the exact steepest-descent direction under a dimension-normalized $1\to1$ operator norm by selecting the sign of the largest magnitude entry in each column of two-dimensional weight matrices. This retains first-order gradients while making optimizer state memory nearly negligible. Our practical TACO optimizer maintains only a small set of low precision gradient components per column, reducing persistent optimizer state by $174\times$ relative to AdamW8bit (from 27.7 GB to 0.16 GB) and peak training memory by $2.9\times$ (from 80.6 GB to 27.5 GB) on OPT-13B, while achieving comparable accuracy and runtime. TACO further enables full-parameter fine-tuning of 30-32B-parameter models on a single 80 GB H100 GPU across multiple model families and tasks.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Jichao2357/TACO_optimizer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TACO 在 Muon 的算子范数最速下降视角下，改用维度归一化的 1→1 算子范数，按列取绝对值最大元素的符号作为更新方向，从而只保留每列极少量低精度梯度分量。在 OPT-13B 上持久优化器状态比 AdamW8bit 减少 174×（27.7 GB→0.16 GB）、峰值训练显存减少 2.9×（80.6 GB→27.5 GB），精度与运行时间相当，并使 30–32B 模型可在单张 80 GB H100 上做全参数微调。
Motivation: LLM 全参数微调的优化器状态显存开销挤占了可放入 GPU 的模型规模；现有做法要么压缩优化器状态、要么放弃一阶梯度、要么改变更新几何但仍保留稠密状态，而 Muon 的几何与 AdamW 不同，微调 AdamW 预训练模型时可能掉点。
Method: TACO 沿用 Muon 的算子范数最速下降框架，但在维度归一化的 1→1 算子范数下求精确最速下降方向：对二维权重矩阵的每一列，取幅值最大元素的符号。实现上每列只维护少量低精度梯度分量，保留一阶梯度信息。
Result: 在 OPT-13B 上，持久优化器状态相对 AdamW8bit 减少 174×（27.7 GB→0.16 GB），峰值训练显存减少 2.9×（80.6 GB→27.5 GB），同时精度与运行时间相当；该配置支持在单张 80 GB H100 上对多个模型家族与任务的 30–32B 参数模型做全参数微调。
Conclusion: 把更新几何推到维度归一化的 1→1 算子范数并按列做 one-sparse 符号更新，可以在不牺牲精度与计算效率的前提下把 LLM 微调的优化器状态压到近乎可忽略，从而突破单卡可微调的模型规模。

papers.title: FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Several state-of-the-art methods for online reinforcement learning in continuous control improve policies using action gradients of a learned critic. However, critics are typically trained to predict returns, and accurate value predictions do not necessarily yield accurate action derivatives, potentially leading to unreliable policy updates. We propose Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization (FERPO), an on-policy maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm that performs policy improvement using critic values without differentiating the critic with respect to actions. FERPO derives an optimal target action distribution from a policy-improvement objective regularized by entropy and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. We then fit the actor to this target by minimizing a forward-KL objective, estimated using self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS) with actions drawn from the rollout policy. By limiting the target distribution's deviation from the rollout policy, the KL regularization helps keep these importance weights well behaved. In contrast to reverse-KL objectives, which can favor a subset of the target distribution's modes, the forward-KL objective encourages coverage of multiple high-value modes and thereby promotes exploration. Experiments and ablations on MuJoCo Playground and ManiSkill show competitive performance and sample-efficiency gains. Computational benchmarks also demonstrate faster actor updates than Relative Entropy Pathwise Policy Optimization (REPPO).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FERPO 是面向连续控制在线强化学习的 on-policy 最大熵 RL 算法：不通过对动作求导的 critic 梯度改进策略，而是从带熵与 KL 正则的策略改进目标推出目标动作分布，再用前向 KL 加自归一化重要性采样 (SNIS) 拟合 actor。在 MuJoCo Playground 与 ManiSkill 上表现具竞争力、样本效率提升，且 actor 更新比 REPPO 更快。
Motivation: 在线 RL 中基于 critic 动作梯度改进策略的方法依赖值函数对动作的导数精度，而 critic 训练目标是预测回报，值准不等于动作导数准，会导致不可靠的策略更新。
Method: FERPO 从带熵正则与 KL 正则的策略改进目标推导最优目标动作分布，完全使用 critic 的值而不对动作求导；actor 通过最小化前向 KL 目标拟合该分布，重要性权重由 rollout 策略采样的动作经 SNIS 估计，KL 正则限制目标分布偏离 rollout 策略以稳定权重。
Result: 在 MuJoCo Playground 与 ManiSkill 上的实验和消融显示性能具竞争力并带来样本效率增益；计算基准显示 actor 更新速度快于 REPPO (Relative Entropy Pathwise Policy Optimization)。
Conclusion: 不依赖 critic 动作梯度、改用值驱动的目标分布加前向 KL 拟合，可在连续控制在线 RL 中取得有竞争力的性能与更快的策略更新；前向 KL 相对 reverse-KL 更利于覆盖多个高价值众数、促进探索。

papers.title: HiPhy: Hierarchical Alignment for Physically-Plausible Multi-Principle Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video generation models have achieved remarkable visual fidelity and have strong potential to become general-purpose world simulators. Despite this progress, they still fail to generate videos which adhere to laws of physics. The problem becomes even more apparent in realistic settings where multiple physical principles must work together within the same video; for example, "a balloon floating upward while steam rises from a pot" requires buoyancy and fluid dynamics to unfold coherently and simultaneously. Yet existing methods largely ignore multi-principle interactions, focusing on a single principle per video. We propose HiPhy (Hierarchical Physical Alignment), a reinforcement learning framework that grounds video generation in physical laws through a dual-level objective: locally enforcing the temporal dynamics of individual physical principles, and globally ensuring the physical and semantic coherence of the entire scene. To support multi-principle generation, we construct a 50K-prompt dataset and introduce a prompt benchmark MultiPhyBench, spanning a diverse range of co-occurring physical events. Our experiments show that HiPhy significantly outperforms prior methods and baselines, improving physical commonsense and semantic alignment significantly across various benchmarks, with the largest gains on scenes involving multiple concurrent physical principles where competing methods degrade most sharply.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HiPhy 用强化学习把视频生成对齐到物理定律，采用双层目标：局部约束单个物理原理的时间演化，全局保证整场景的物理与语义一致。配套构建 50K prompt 数据集与 MultiPhyBench 基准，覆盖共现物理事件；实验显示其在物理常识与语义对齐上显著优于已有方法，多原理并发场景提升最大。
Motivation: 视频生成模型视觉保真度高却常违反物理定律，且现有方法多只处理单一物理原理，无法让浮力、流体动力学等多原理在同一视频中协同展开。
Method: 提出 HiPhy (Hierarchical Physical Alignment)：强化学习框架，双层目标分别在局部强制单个物理原理的时序动力学、在全局保证整场景物理与语义一致；并构建 50K prompt 数据集与 MultiPhyBench 基准，覆盖多样共现物理事件。
Result: 实验显示 HiPhy 在多个基准上显著提升物理常识与语义对齐，显著优于先前方法与基线；在多物理原理并发的场景上增益最大，而对比方法在此类场景退化最剧烈。
Conclusion: 多原理交互需要局部与全局双层物理对齐才能同时约束，单原理方法在并发物理事件场景下会明显失效。

papers.title: InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: We study test-time evolution for humanoid loco-manipulation: solving tasks that a controller was never trained for by repurposing its existing skills, improving from its own attempts, and retaining what it learns, without retraining. Our key insight is that a broad controller already holds much of the competence a new task needs, and that this competence becomes accessible through an interface between planning and control that is expressive enough to specify contact-rich, multi-stage interactions, yet executable and measurable enough that execution feedback can guide planning from experience. InterEvolve realizes this interface with two components. First, we develop an object-aware forward-backward (FB) behavioral foundation model, whose object residuals on a frozen body prior turn a new reward about the body or objects into loco-manipulation behavior at test time. Second, we specify tasks as reward programs: staged rewards with completion conditions and tunable constants. A large language model (LLM) agent revises the program structure in context, drawing on execution feedback and a skill library of verified programs, while a numerical optimizer tunes its constants. With every candidate verified across parallel simulation scenarios, the program explores new ways to induce, repurpose, and compose the controller's existing motor competence for the task at hand, and thus improves over iterations. Experiments show that human-designed rewards leave much of the FB model's loco-manipulation competence untapped, whereas the programs InterEvolve evolves release it, sometimes through novel strategies. It further produces behaviors for diverse tasks, complex scenes, and long-horizon compositions in simulation, and evolved skills run autonomously on a physical Unitree G1 from egocentric onboard perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InterEvolve 在测试时把人形 loco-manipulation 任务写成带完成条件与可调常数的 reward program，由 LLM agent 依据执行反馈与已验证技能库改写程序结构、数值优化器调常数，从而在不重训控制器的前提下逐轮改进。演化出的程序释放了 object-aware forward-backward 行为基础模型中人类手写 reward 未触及的能力，并可驱动实体 Unitree G1 从自我中心感知自主执行。
Motivation: 控制器只在既定技能上训练，遇到未训练的接触密集、多阶段任务时无法重训；人类手写的 reward 无法充分表达任务结构，也压不出模型已有的运动能力。
Method: 两个组件：object-aware forward-backward (FB) 行为基础模型，用物体残差挂在冻结的 body prior 上，把新的 body/物体 reward 在测试时变成 loco-manipulation 行为；任务以 reward program 表示（分阶段 reward、完成条件、可调常数），LLM agent 在上下文中依据执行反馈与已验证程序技能库改写程序结构，数值优化器调常数，每个候选在并行仿真场景中验证。
Result: 实验显示人类设计的 reward 留下 FB 模型大量 loco-manipulation 能力未被使用，而 InterEvolve 演化的 program 能释放这些能力，有时产生新策略；在仿真中覆盖多样任务、复杂场景与长时程组合，演化技能在实体 Unitree G1 上凭机载自我中心感知自主运行。
Conclusion: 把任务写成可由 LLM 改写、数值优化调参的 reward program，是在不重训的前提下让既有控制器在测试时持续改进并迁移到新任务的可行路径。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 把任务写成可由 LLM 改写、数值优化调参的 reward program，是在不重训的前提下让既有控制器在测试时持续改进并迁移到新任务的可行路径。

papers.title: Cost-augmented Schrödinger bridges on graphs are exactly solvable: a Feynman-Kac tilt replaces learned control
papers.abstract_en: The generalized Schrödinger bridge on a graph moves mass between two distributions while charging a cost for the states visited. It has been approached by learning the rates of a controlled continuous-time Markov chain, with a temporal-difference penalty that restores the cost. A state cost folds into the reference process as a Feynman-Kac tilt. The cost-augmented bridge is then a plain bridge against the tilted reference, and the penalty is unnecessary. The bridge is computed exactly by alternating two endpoint rescalings, each one sparse matrix-exponential application; nothing is discretized in time or learned. The alternation converges at a rate set by the endpoint coupling alone. For a quadratic congestion cost on time-averaged occupancies, damped best response around the exact bridge is gradient descent on a strongly convex function, and its residual bounds its error. On a protein-folding model, a free-energy cost lowers the expected barrier of the folding paths. On the learned approach's road network, roll-outs of the exact bridge match the target within sampling error, and on networks with millions of intersections its memory grows linearly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 图上的带状态代价 Schrödinger bridge 可被 Feynman-Kac 倾斜吸收进参考过程，从而无需学习控制率：用两端点重缩放交替（每次一次稀疏矩阵指数）精确求解，不作时间离散也不训练。在二次拥堵代价下，精确桥附近的阻尼 best response 是强凸函数上的梯度下降，残差即误差界；蛋白折叠模型上自由能代价降低折叠路径的期望势垒，路网上 roll-out 与目标在采样误差内一致，百万级路口网络内存线性增长。
Motivation: 图上广义 Schrödinger bridge 此前靠学习受控连续时间 Markov 链的速率并加 temporal-difference 惩罚来回填状态代价，代价项必须进学习目标，且在大规模路网上内存与训练成本高。
Method: 把状态代价以 Feynman-Kac 倾斜折入参考过程，带代价的 bridge 化为对倾斜参考的普通 bridge，从而去掉 TD 惩罚；求解用两端点重缩放交替，每步为一次稀疏矩阵指数作用，无时间离散、无学习。对时间平均占用的二次拥堵代价，证明精确桥附近阻尼 best response 是强凸函数上的梯度下降，其残差界定误差。
Result: 交替收敛速率仅由端点耦合决定；蛋白折叠模型上，加入自由能代价降低了折叠路径的期望势垒；在原 learned 方法使用的路网上，精确 bridge 的 roll-out 与目标分布一致到采样误差以内；在数百万路口的网络上内存随规模线性增长。
Conclusion: 状态代价应通过 Feynman-Kac 倾斜并入参考过程而非靠学习控制补偿，这样 bridge 可精确求解且在大图上内存可扩展。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B. Project page: https://hc-dlm.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分层连续扩散语言模型 HC-DLM，把离散 token 生成与连续隐变量轨迹耦合进同一个去噪过程：隐变量是唯一持久的生成状态，每步从中读出 token 并回灌作为下一步隐变量更新的脚手架。在 Sudoku、Countdown 与 LM1B 上，同模型规模下 HC-DLM 在前两者的解题准确率与 LM1B 的生成困惑度上均优于离散与连续扩散基线。
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型并行解码时每个 token 独立从边缘分布采样，切断了同批 token 间的统计依赖；连续扩散模型的去噪器只看连续状态，直到最终解码前都没有任何约束把它绑到合法 token 配置上。
Method: HC-DLM 将离散 token 生成与连续隐变量轨迹耦合进单一去噪过程，训练目标由 token 似然的变分下界 (variational bound) 推导而来；与把连续上下文挂到自洽离散链上的近期方法不同，隐变量作为唯一持久生成状态，每步从中读出 token 并反馈为下一次隐变量更新的脚手架。
Result: 在结构推理 Sudoku、数学规划 Countdown 和语言建模 LM1B 上，同模型规模下 HC-DLM 相对离散与连续扩散基线，在 Sudoku 与 Countdown 的 puzzle accuracy 以及 LM1B 的 generative perplexity 上均取得提升。
Conclusion: 让连续隐变量充当唯一持久生成状态并逐步回读离散 token，可以在同一去噪过程中同时保住双向推理能力与 token 配置的一致性，从而在结构化推理和语言建模上超过两类扩散基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Missing Primitive: Diagnosing and Repairing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated striking capabilities on frontier mathematical problems, it remains unclear whether they possess the structural mathematical understanding underlying their solutions. In this paper, we take a first step toward systematically studying mathematical understanding in LLMs, from diagnosing its distinct capabilities to leveraging these findings to improve post-training. First, we introduce the notion of Mathematical Primitive to probe structural mathematical understanding and propose \hlei{}, a novel benchmark that evaluates mathematical reasoning along four distinct dimensions: Discovery, Generation, Digestion, and Execution. Second, our systematic diagnosis shows that solution accuracy masks distinct capability profiles, primitives unlock substantial latent execution capacity, and Discovery is the dominant bottleneck in mathematical reasoning. Our post-training analysis further shows that discovery-limited failures are particularly amenable to repair. Finally, building on these findings, we introduce \abs{}, a primitive-privileged self-distillation framework that selectively transfers primitive-guided reasoning into the student model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \abs{} consistently improves mathematical reasoning over baselines across model scales and challenging benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Mathematical Primitive 概念与四维基准 HLEI（Discovery、Generation、Digestion、Execution）诊断 LLM 的结构性数学理解，发现准确率掩盖了能力剖面、Discovery 是数学推理的主导瓶颈，且 discovery-limited 失败特别容易修复；据此提出 primitive-privileged 自蒸馏框架 ABS，选择性地把 primitive 引导的推理迁移给学生模型，在多个模型规模与困难基准上一致优于基线。
Motivation: LLM 能解前沿数学题，但是否具备支撑解答的结构性数学理解仍不清楚，且单一 solution accuracy 无法区分具体是哪种能力缺失。
Method: 定义 Mathematical Primitive 作为探针，构建 HLEI 基准沿 Discovery、Generation、Digestion、Execution 四个维度评测；基于诊断结果提出 ABS 框架，做 primitive-privileged self-distillation，选择性地把 primitive 引导的推理迁移到学生模型。
Result: 系统诊断显示 solution accuracy 掩盖了不同的能力剖面，primitives 解锁大量潜在执行能力，Discovery 是数学推理的主导瓶颈；post-training 分析显示 discovery-limited 失败尤其易于修复；ABS 在多个模型规模和困难基准上持续优于基线。
Conclusion: 数学推理的关键缺口在 Discovery 而非执行，且这类失败可通过针对 primitive 的自蒸馏修复，因此按 primitive 分维度诊断再做选择性蒸馏是有效的后训练路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trust the Direction, Search the Step: Zero-and-First-Order Methods for LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Step-size selection remains a central challenge in large-scale neural network optimization; conservative steps slow convergence, while aggressive steps can destabilize it. We combine \textbf{Z}ero-and-\textbf{F}irst-\textbf{O}rder optimization~(ZFO) and propose a lightweight framework that decouples direction selection from step-size. ZFO uses a trusted first-order optimizer to determine the direction and performs zeroth-order evaluations only along this one-dimensional subspace to choose how far to move. Using the current {gradient information} and two additional objective function evaluations, ZFO instances construct a local model of the objective function along the proposed direction and select a curvature-aware step within a bounded search interval. This yields an adaptive step-selection mechanism that costs less than a full line search. We provide theoretical guarantees to show that shared-sample evaluations produce reliable finite-difference curvature estimates, that the induced local model selects a near-optimal step along the search interval, and that ZFO converges to a neighborhood of a stationary point. Across the evaluated settings, language models and datasets, ZFO frequently improves optimization and final performance relative to fixed-step first-order baselines, with the magnitude and preferred local model depending on the objective. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/nizswan/Zeroth-First-Order-Framework.
papers.comment: Accepted to 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Code: https://github.com/nizswan/Zeroth-First-Order-Framework
papers.journal_ref: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ZFO（Zero-and-First-Order）轻量框架，把 LLM 微调中的方向选择与步长选择解耦：用可信的一阶优化器给方向，再沿该一维子空间做零阶评估建局部模型，在有界搜索区间内选曲率感知步长。理论上给出共享样本有限差分曲率估计可靠、局部模型近最优、收敛到驻点邻域的保证；在所评测的语言模型与数据集上，ZFO 相对固定步长一阶基线常能改善优化过程与最终性能，且最优局部模型的量级随目标而变。
Motivation: 大规模神经网络优化中步长选择仍是核心难题：保守步长收敛慢，激进步长会破坏稳定性，固定步长的一阶基线难以兼顾两者。
Method: ZFO 将方向与步长解耦：一阶优化器给出搜索方向，仅沿这一维子空间做零阶评估，用当前梯度信息加两次额外目标函数评估构建沿该方向的局部模型，并在有界搜索区间内选取曲率感知步长，代价低于完整 line search。
Result: 在所评测的语言模型与数据集设置上，ZFO 相对固定步长一阶基线频繁改善优化与最终性能，改进幅度与偏好的局部模型取决于具体目标；理论结果覆盖共享样本评估给出可靠有限差分曲率估计、所诱导局部模型在搜索区间内近最优步长、以及 ZFO 收敛到驻点邻域。
Conclusion: 把方向交给一阶方法、把步长交给零阶一维搜索，可以在低于完整 line search 的代价下获得自适应步长并带来优化与最终性能提升，但效果大小与所用局部模型依目标而定。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Generative modeling of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features
papers.abstract_en: Intrinsically disordered protein regions (IDRs) play central roles in cellular processes such as transcriptional regulation, signal transduction, and subcellular localization, yet their functional design remains challenging. Structure-based design methods do not readily apply to IDRs, and existing protein language models are trained on full-length protein sequences, thus learning a prior that is biased towards folded domains. Here, we present IDiom, an autoregressive protein language model trained on IDiom-DB, a dataset of 54 million predicted IDRs curated from the AlphaFold Database. IDiom generates diverse sequences that recapitulate the composition, patterning, motifs, and predicted disorder of natural IDRs. To control function-associated sequence patterns, we also introduce reinforcement learning with sparse autoencoder features (RL-SAE), a post-training method that rewards the generation of sequences that activate specified feature sets. Across eight IDR design tasks, RL-SAE sequences activate, on average, 90% of 30 targeted features, compared to 24% for activation steering. We demonstrate that RL-SAE improves the predicted subcellular localization and transcriptional activity of generated IDRs compared to steering and supervised fine-tuning, and enables features associated with distinct biological functions to be combined within individual sequences. Thus, IDiom and RL-SAE enable interpretable and composable IDR design through explicit control of function-associated sequence features. More broadly, RL-SAE could extend to other protein design settings where interpretable features provide useful design targets. Code is available at https://github.com/rotskoff-group/idiom.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 IDiom：在 AlphaFold Database 精选的 5400 万条预测内在无序蛋白区 (IDR) 上训练的自回归蛋白语言模型，并配套后训练方法 RL-SAE，用稀疏自编码器 (sparse autoencoder) 特征作为强化学习奖励来定向生成。在 8 个 IDR 设计任务上，RL-SAE 序列平均激活 30 个目标特征中的 90%，而 activation steering 仅 24%。
Motivation: 结构导向设计方法不适用于缺乏稳定结构的 IDR，而现有蛋白语言模型在全长序列上训练，先验偏向折叠结构域，难以生成与功能相关的无序区序列模式。
Method: IDiom 为自回归蛋白语言模型，训练集 IDiom-DB 含 5400 万条从 AlphaFold Database 整理的预测 IDR；后训练用 RL-SAE，以强化学习奖励能激活指定稀疏自编码器特征集的生成序列，并与 activation steering、监督微调对比。
Result: 在 8 个 IDR 设计任务上，RL-SAE 序列平均激活 30 个目标特征中的 90%，activation steering 为 24%；生成 IDR 的亚细胞定位与转录活性预测优于 steering 和监督微调，且可在单条序列中组合不同生物学功能相关特征。
Conclusion: 用可解释的 SAE 特征作为奖励目标，可实现可解释、可组合的 IDR 设计；作者认为 RL-SAE 可推广到其他以可解释特征为设计目标的蛋白设计场景。

papers.title: DMAD: Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation for Fast Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) trains a few-step student from the difference between separately estimated target and student scores, so it must keep an auxiliary diffusion model fitted to the student's evolving distribution at extra memory and computation cost. We introduce DMAD, Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation, which recasts distribution matching as classification and learns the required log-density ratios directly. Two discriminator heads on a shared backbone distinguish real data and teacher samples from the student's, and linear losses on their logits train the student without auxiliary score fitting. We prove that at the discriminator optimum these losses recover the distribution-matching gradient underlying DMD, through the classical identity linking discriminator logits to log-density ratios. We further introduce gap-based reweighting, which adapts teacher supervision across noise levels from the real-data head's empirical logit gap between real and teacher samples. DMAD reaches a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 1.04 with one-step generation on ImageNet-64x64, 14.47 with four-step SDXL on COCO-10K, and a VBench total score of 85.15 with four-step Wan2.1-T2V-14B, the best values among the compared few-step methods and the multi-step teachers. On MiniMax-H3-33B, our four-step student achieves overall human preference rates of 79.1% over DMD2 and 84.6% over rCM for joint audio-video generation, excluding ties. Our code, models and demos are available at https://yzmblog.github.io/projects/DMAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DMAD 把分布匹配蒸馏改写成对抗判别：共享 backbone 上两个判别头区分真实数据与教师样本对学生的样本，对 logits 用线性损失直接学 log-density 比值，从而去掉 DMD 必需的辅助 score 拟合。单步 ImageNet-64x64 FID 达 1.04，四步 SDXL 在 COCO-10K 上 FID 14.47，四步 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 的 VBench 总分 85.15，均为所比较少步方法与多步教师中的最优值。
Motivation: DMD 需要为学生不断演化的分布单独拟合一个辅助扩散模型，带来额外显存与计算开销；作者要把分布匹配所需的 log-density 比值直接学出来。
Method: 共享 backbone 上挂两个判别头，分别区分真实数据与教师样本对学生的样本，对 logits 施加线性损失训练学生，无需辅助 score 拟合；证明在判别器最优处这些损失经由 logits 与 log-density 比值的经典恒等式恢复 DMD 的分布匹配梯度。另提出 gap-based reweighting，用真实数据头在真实与教师样本间的经验 logit gap 跨噪声水平自适应调整教师监督。
Result: ImageNet-64x64 单步生成 FID 1.04；COCO-10K 上四步 SDXL FID 14.47；四步 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 的 VBench 总分 85.15，均为所比较少步方法与多步教师中的最佳值。在 MiniMax-H3-33B 上，四步学生在音视频联合生成中对 DMD2 的整体人类偏好率为 79.1%，对 rCM 为 84.6%（不含平局）。
Conclusion: 把分布匹配当作分类问题直接学 log-density 比值，可以在去掉辅助 score 拟合的同时保持 DMD 的分布匹配梯度，并在少步图像与视频生成上取得所比较方法中的最优质量与人类偏好。

papers.title: Higher-Order Molecular Grammars for Generative and Foundation Models in Chemistry
papers.abstract_en: Molecular learning models are strongly shaped by their underlying representations. Yet standard sequential and graph formalisms struggle to explicitly encode higher-order topology, such as ring systems and recurring motifs. Existing higher-order representations can capture these structures directly, but they are often computationally demanding and difficult to decode into valid molecules. Here, we introduce Higher-order Grammar Representation (HGR), a principled, topology-aware framework that lifts molecules to combinatorial complexes and parses each complex into a compact sequence of production rules under a context-free higher-order grammar. By serialising higher-order topology into rule sequences, HGR makes these structures directly compatible with standard sequence models, avoiding the computational overhead of explicit higher-order encodings while preserving topological expressiveness. To reduce benchmark bias towards simple ring systems, we construct RingDiv, a ring-enriched benchmark containing 1.18 million molecules, including the curated RingDiv300k subset, and introduce the ring diversity index (RDI) to quantify ring-system coverage. In molecular generation, HGR-based models uniquely combine 100% validity by construction with leading distributional alignment, ranking first in FCD on all five generation benchmarks. In representation learning, HGR-FM achieves the highest mean AUC across seven MoleculeNet benchmarks under both transfer protocols, improving on the strongest baseline by 8.3 and 3.3 AUC points under probing and full fine-tuning, respectively. Collectively, these results establish HGR as an efficient higher-order representation for molecular generation and transferable representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Higher-order Grammar Representation (HGR)，把分子提升为组合复形并用上下文无关高阶文法解析成产生式规则序列，使环系等高阶拓扑可直接喂给标准序列模型。在五个生成基准上 FCD 排名第一且构造上保证 100% 有效性；HGR-FM 在七个 MoleculeNet 基准上 probing 与 full fine-tuning 两种协议下平均 AUC 均最高，较最强基线分别高 8.3 与 3.3 AUC 点。
Motivation: 序列与图表示难以显式编码环系、重复基元等高阶拓扑，而现有高阶表示计算开销大且难解码为合法分子；同时现有基准偏向简单环系，掩盖了环多样性差异。
Method: HGR 将分子提升为 combinatorial complexes，按 context-free higher-order grammar 解析为紧凑的产生式规则序列，序列化后兼容标准序列模型；为消除基准偏差构建 RingDiv（118 万分子，含 RingDiv300k 子集）并提出 ring diversity index (RDI) 度量环系覆盖。
Result: 生成任务中 HGR 模型构造上即 100% validity，并在全部五个生成基准上 FCD 排名第一；表示学习中 HGR-FM 在七个 MoleculeNet 基准、两种迁移协议下平均 AUC 最高，probing 提升 8.3 AUC 点、full fine-tuning 提升 3.3 AUC 点（相对最强基线）。
Conclusion: HGR 以序列化方式保留高阶拓扑表达力同时避开显式高阶编码的开销，是分子生成与可迁移表示学习的高效表示；RingDiv 与 RDI 用于纠正基准对简单环系的偏向。

papers.title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared block across recurrent loops. Each loop yields an intermediate representation decodable for the same next token, yet standard decoding discards earlier states. Because earlier loops embody less computation, recurrence inherently supplies aligned weak-and-strong prediction pairs without auxiliary models or external training. We introduce LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that guides token selection by contrasting the final prediction with an earlier recurrent pass, operating either in logit space with one extra output pass (LoopCD-Logits) or in hidden-state space with zero output overhead (LoopCD-Hidden). Across four looped Transformer families, LoopCD delivers substantial, consistent gains at full recurrent depth: LoopCD-Logits raises Ouro-2.6B-Thinking's AIME 2024 pass@1 from 61.88% to 73.33%, while LoopCD-Hidden lifts Huginn's HumanEval pass@1 from 22.56% to 31.71%. Crucially, these performance gains enable halving the number of recurrent loops while still matching or exceeding full-depth unguided baselines, reducing forward FLOPs by 22.5% to 48.2%. By transforming intermediate recurrent states into effective guidance signals, LoopCD achieves superior decoding quality while substantially reducing inference compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoopCD 是面向 looped transformer 的免训练对比解码框架：用最后一次循环的预测与更早一次循环的弱预测做对比来选 token，分 Logits 版（多一次输出前向）与 Hidden 版（零额外输出开销）。在四个 looped Transformer 家族上，Ouro-2.6B-Thinking 的 AIME 2024 pass@1 从 61.88% 升到 73.33%，Huginn 的 HumanEval pass@1 从 22.56% 升到 31.71%；收益还允许把循环数减半仍追平或超过全深度无引导基线，前向 FLOPs 降低 22.5% 到 48.2%。
Motivation: Looped transformer 靠共享块反复执行换参数效率，但标准解码只取最后一次循环的输出，丢掉中间状态；每个中间状态其实都能解码同一个 next token，且天然构成计算量弱-强对齐的预测对，此前未被用作解码信号。
Method: LoopCD 是免训练的对比解码 (contrastive decoding)：把最终预测与更早一次循环的预测对比来引导 token 选择。LoopCD-Logits 在 logit 空间操作、需一次额外输出前向；LoopCD-Hidden 在 hidden-state 空间操作、零输出开销；引导信号直接来自中间循环状态，不需辅助模型或外部训练。
Result: 四个 looped Transformer 家族上全循环深度均有一致增益：LoopCD-Logits 使 Ouro-2.6B-Thinking 的 AIME 2024 pass@1 从 61.88% 升至 73.33%，LoopCD-Hidden 使 Huginn 的 HumanEval pass@1 从 22.56% 升至 31.71%。增益允许循环数减半仍匹配或超过全深度无引导基线，前向 FLOPs 减少 22.5% 到 48.2%。
Conclusion: 中间循环状态本身即可充当解码引导信号，在提升解码质量的同时把推理计算量大幅压低；循环数可以减半而不损失相对全深度基线的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SoftServe: A Scalable Quasi-Newton Method for Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Quasi-Newton (QN) methods have long been among the most effective methods for large-scale unconstrained convex optimization. Two obstacles have limited their use in deep learning: non-convexity and enormous parameter sizes. We introduce SoftServe, a family of QN methods designed to overcome these obstacles without line searches or ad hoc curvature corrections. SoftServe derives positivedefinite curvature estimates from the variational objective of Berglund et al. (2025), even in the presence of negative curvature. We develop diagonal and Kroneckerfactored variants that preserve positive definiteness by construction and scale to massive neural networks. Finally, SoftServe relies on the stable coupled Newton-Schulz iteration for the required matrix operations, replacing costly matrix decompositions with GPU-friendly matrix multiplications. SoftServe excels on problems that are severely ill-conditioned, including tasks such as recurrent networks, deep autoencoders, physics-informed neural networks, and a 136M-parameter physics-informed diffusion model, often achieving lower losses than established baselines including Adam, Muon, and SOAP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SoftServe 是面向深度学习的大规模拟牛顿 (quasi-Newton) 方法族：从 Berglund et al. (2025) 的变分目标导出正定曲率估计，即使出现负曲率也保持正定，无需线搜索或临时曲率修正。提供对角与 Kronecker 分解两个变体，并用稳定的耦合 Newton-Schulz 迭代替代矩阵分解，在严重病态问题上常取得低于 Adam、Muon、SOAP 的损失。
Motivation: 拟牛顿法在大规模无约束凸优化中长期高效，但深度学习的非凸性与巨大参数量限制了其应用。
Method: 从 Berglund et al. (2025) 的变分目标导出正定曲率估计（含负曲率情形），构造按构造即正定的对角变体与 Kronecker-factored 变体以扩展到超大网络；所需矩阵运算用稳定的耦合 Newton-Schulz 迭代完成，以 GPU 友好的矩阵乘法替代代价高的矩阵分解，全程不用线搜索。
Result: 在严重病态问题上表现突出，涵盖循环网络、深度自编码器、物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 与一个 136M 参数的物理信息扩散模型，常取得低于 Adam、Muon、SOAP 等既有基线的损失。
Conclusion: 不依赖线搜索与曲率修正、按构造保持正定的拟牛顿法可以在深度学习的非凸与超大参数规模下工作，并在病态任务上胜过主流优化器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We present OmniSeek, an agentic framework that transforms an Omni Large Language Model (Omni-LLM) into an active, multi-turn reasoning agent with native tool use. Rather than passively processing an entire audio-visual sequence in a single forward pass, OmniSeek makes evidence acquisition part of the reasoning process: it dynamically decides whether to look or listen, and over which temporal window, to retrieve sparse but critical evidence across different modalities within long contexts. Through an iterative multi-turn protocol, the retrieved raw audio or visual segments are appended back into the context to support subsequent reasoning. To cold-start this capability, we build a data engine that synthesizes OmniTraj-170K, a corpus of multi-hop Chain-of-Thought trajectories with interleaved audio and visual evidence. We first supervise the model on these trajectories to instill multi-turn tool-use behavior, and then further optimize the policy via a two-stage reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Moreover, we introduce an Audio-Visual Necessity objective that explicitly rewards successful trajectories whose reasoning depends on both modalities, discouraging single-modality shortcuts. Extensive experiments across a wide range of benchmarks demonstrate that OmniSeek learns adaptive cross-modal evidence seeking and consistently improves audio-visual reasoning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniSeek 把 Omni-LLM 改造成主动多轮音视频推理 agent：由模型自行决定看还是听、取哪个时间窗，把检索到的原始音视频片段回填上下文继续推理。冷启动用合成的 OmniTraj-170K 多跳 CoT 轨迹做监督，再经两阶段可验证奖励强化学习与 Audio-Visual Necessity 目标优化，实验显示其学会自适应跨模态取证并一致提升音视频推理表现。
Motivation: 长音视频序列若一次性前向处理，稀疏但关键的跨模态证据难以被取到；单模态捷径也让模型回避真正需要视听结合的推理。
Method: OmniSeek 以多轮协议让模型动态选择 look/listen 与时间窗，检索到的原始音视频段追加回上下文；用数据引擎合成 OmniTraj-170K（多跳 Chain-of-Thought 轨迹，音视频证据交错）做监督冷启动，随后两阶段 RL with verifiable rewards 优化策略，并加入 Audio-Visual Necessity 目标奖励真正依赖双模态的成功轨迹。
Result: 在范围广泛的多组音视频推理 benchmark 上，OmniSeek 学会自适应跨模态证据获取，并一致提升音视频推理性能；摘要未给出具体分数或基线数值。
Conclusion: 把证据获取纳入推理循环、并用双模态必要性奖励抑制单模态捷径，是让 Omni-LLM 在长上下文中做跨模态推理的有效路径。

papers.title: Generative Cinematographer: Composing Camera and Object Motion in 3D
papers.abstract_en: Current controllable video generation systems often rely on 2D motion trajectories or sparse drag signals for object motion. These controls are ambiguous because the same 2D trajectory can correspond to different 3D motions, especially when the camera and objects move simultaneously. We present Generative Cinematographer (GenCine), a system that lifts a single image into an editable 3D scene scaffold where artists jointly author camera and foreground motion. Artists specify a camera path and move selected foreground regions using local 3D motion handles. Several handles can move different parts of a subject independently, providing a piecewise-rigid approximation to non-rigid motion without a physics simulator or category-specific prior. To communicate these controls to a pretrained video model, we project them into guidance maps. These maps record where the controlled regions appear in each frame, assign each handle a fixed color across frames and encode the current 3D positions of its controlled points in the same world coordinate system as the background. This lets us describe object motion relative to the scene even as the camera moves. For training, we recover controls from the motion observed in real videos and use ground-truth geometry and trajectories from synthetic videos. We train a lightweight guidance branch and LoRA adapters on a pretrained Wan model to follow these controls. Our experiments show consistent camera-relative motion, improved geometric consistency under viewpoint changes, and strong controllability across diverse real-world scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenCine 把单张图片抬升为可编辑的 3D 场景脚手架，让作者用相机路径加局部 3D motion handles 同时编排相机与前景运动，再投影成带固定颜色与世界坐标编码的 guidance maps 喂给预训练 Wan 模型。实验显示相机相对运动一致、视角变化下几何一致性改善，且在多样真实场景上可控性强。
Motivation: 现有可控视频生成用 2D 轨迹或稀疏拖拽信号控制物体运动，同一 2D 轨迹可对应不同 3D 运动，相机与物体同时运动时控制存在歧义。
Method: 单图抬升为 3D 场景脚手架，作者指定相机路径并用多个局部 3D handles 独立移动主体不同部位，形成分段刚体近似（无需物理模拟器或类别先验）；控制被投影为 guidance maps，逐帧记录受控区域位置、为每个 handle 分配固定颜色、并在与背景同一世界坐标系编码 3D 位置。训练时从真实视频恢复控制、用合成视频的真值几何与轨迹，在预训练 Wan 上训练轻量 guidance 分支与 LoRA adapters。
Result: 实验展示相机相对运动一致、视角变化下几何一致性改善，以及在多样真实场景上的强可控性。
Conclusion: 把控制从 2D 轨迹抬到 3D 世界坐标并以 guidance maps 传递，可在相机与物体同时运动时保持可控且几何一致的视频生成。

papers.title: From Gradients to Capabilities: Understanding Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) aims to combine the strengths of RL-trained teachers in a single student, but how teacher signals affect parameter changes remains underexplored. We study Qwen3-1.7B with four domain teachers trained with RL from the same initialization as the student, comparing gradients, optimizer updates, and task learning curves, with additional SmolLM3-3B diagnostics. We find that several factors influence teacher signals. First, loss averaging implicitly weights responses: token averaging favors longer responses, and equalizing domain contributions retains this weighting within domains. Second, Adam's first moment reduces differences in parameter updates: the cosine similarity is 0.83 between teachers and 0.96 between averaging rules, despite differences in raw gradients. Third, BF16 rounding hides small changes: about 97\% of FP32 master weights differ from initialization, but only 7--11\% of BF16 weights do. Finally, the top-64 intersection KL gradient closely matches Qwen's full-vocabulary gradient, but the effect on task performance depends on averaging: mathematics accuracy is 2.6 points higher than with sampled-token policy-gradient (PG) under response averaging and 2.1 points lower under global token averaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多教师在策略蒸馏 (MOPD) 中，教师信号对参数的实际影响被三重机制稀释：token 平均隐式加权长回复、Adam 一阶矩把不同教师的参数更新余弦相似度拉到 0.83、BF16 舍入让只有 7–11% 的权重相对初始化发生变化。top-64 交集 KL 梯度已接近 Qwen 全词表梯度，但其对任务表现的方向取决于平均方式：response averaging 下数学准确率比 sampled-token policy-gradient 高 2.6 分，global token averaging 下反而低 2.1 分。
Motivation: RL 训练出的多教师能力如何真正传给单个学生尚不清楚：原始梯度差异很大，但优化器与精度层会改写这些差异，导致教师信号与最终任务表现之间的关系被掩盖。
Method: 在与学生同初始化、用 RL 训练的四个领域教师上研究 Qwen3-1.7B，对比原始梯度、优化器更新与任务学习曲线，并以 SmolLM3-3B 做补充诊断；比较 token 平均与按领域均衡两种平均规则，以及 top-64 交集 KL 梯度与全词表梯度、sampled-token PG。
Result: 教师间参数更新余弦相似度 0.83，两种平均规则之间 0.96；约 97% 的 FP32 master 权重相对初始化有变化，而 BF16 权重仅 7–11% 有变化；top-64 交集 KL 梯度与 Qwen 全词表梯度高度一致；数学准确率在 response averaging 下比 sampled-token PG 高 2.6 分，在 global token averaging 下低 2.1 分。
Conclusion: 教师信号对参数的作用被损失平均方式、Adam 一阶矩与 BF16 舍入共同调制，因此 top-k 截断 KL 梯度对任务表现的收益方向取决于所选的平均规则，而非梯度本身是否接近全词表。

papers.title: Effective Resistance and Graph Neural Network Reliability in Tissue-Specific Interactomes
papers.abstract_en: Protein function annotation needs to know which predictions to distrust, not only what a model predicts. We ask whether tissue-specific interaction structure carries that information. Our candidate signal is effective resistance, used previously to relieve over-squashing by rewiring. Across 24 tissue-specific interactomes it is dominated by inverse degree, and the degeneration deepens as the co-expression filtered network grows, with a Spearman correlation of -0.955. The residual departure from that limit exceeds degree-preserving null graphs in all 24 networks. Controlling for predictive entropy, degree, annotation cardinality, local structure and feature-only difficulty, the residual explains additional per-node loss in 19 of 24 held-out networks once a permutation floor is subtracted, at every depth, and the effect strengthens monotonically with depth. The increment reaches 0.37% of the variance the controls leave unexplained, 5.6 times a permutation floor, against 1.5 times when the model is retrained in a degree-preserving null world. Selective prediction improves negligibly. The signal is reproducible; degree degeneration bounds it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 24 个组织特异互作组 (tissue-specific interactomes) 上检验 effective resistance 能否作为 GNN 蛋白功能注释的不可靠性信号：它被逆度 (inverse degree) 主导，Spearman 相关达 -0.955，且网络越大退化越深。扣除置换下限后，其残差在 24 个留出网络中的 19 个、每一深度上都解释了额外的 per-node loss，增量达对照未解释方差的 0.37%、为置换下限的 5.6 倍（度保持零世界重训时仅 1.5 倍），但选择性预测几乎不改善。
Motivation: 蛋白功能注释需要知道哪些预测该被怀疑，而不只是模型输出什么；候选信号 effective resistance 此前用于通过重连缓解 over-squashing，但其是否携带与可靠性相关的信息、以及是否被度数退化吞掉，尚不清楚。
Method: 在 24 个组织特异互作组上计算 effective resistance，检验其与度数的退化关系（含随共表达过滤网络增长的趋势），并用度保持零模型 (degree-preserving null graphs) 构造残差基线；在控制预测熵、度、注释基数、局部结构与仅特征难度后，扣除置换下限，回归到留出网络的 per-node loss，并按深度分层、与度保持零世界重训的模型对照。
Result: effective resistance 与逆度的 Spearman 相关为 -0.955，且随共表达过滤网络增大退化加深；残差超出度保持零图的程度在全部 24 个网络中成立。控制各项混淆后，残差在 24 个留出网络中的 19 个、每一深度上解释额外 per-node loss，效应随深度单调增强；增量达对照未解释方差的 0.37%，为置换下限的 5.6 倍，而度保持零世界重训时仅 1.5 倍。选择性预测 (selective prediction) 改善可忽略。
Conclusion: effective resistance 携带可复现的可靠性信号，但该信号被度数退化所限定 (degree degeneration bounds it)，且对选择性预测的实际收益极小。

papers.title: Every Ablation Is a Dose: Counterweights and the Semblance of Self-Repair
papers.abstract_en: Ablate a component of a language model, and other components often appear to adjust and compensate. This phenomenon, termed self-repair, has been observed repeatedly, but its mechanism remains unclear. The most systematic study to date concluded that self-repair is noisy and unlikely to have a single explanation. We argue that it has one: a gain already present before any ablation. Any intervention on a causally important component can be viewed as a point on a coordinate axis $λ$, the signed strength of a counterfactual contrast. Hence, conventional ablation methods are uncalibrated points on this axis. We show that the causal repair response for a fine-grained unit $r$ is governed by an affine law, $E_r(λ)=\mathrm{own}_r+γ_rλ$. The slope $γ_r$ is a fixed coefficient that consistently influences the model, with or without ablation, and its sign determines whether the unit counteracts or reinforces the removed signal. On a factual-verdict task across four models from distinct families (Gemma, Qwen, LLaMA, and Mistral), we identify components including MLP neurons, OV neurons, and singular directions that follow this affine law, 68 of 81 downstream directions in all. Moreover, we can anticipate the magnitude of $γ_r$ from the fixed weights. On the IOI circuit of GPT-2 Small, seven of the ten heads the intervention can reach follow the law, and all seven are counterweights. From this perspective, what may appear as self-repair is a counterweight performing its usual operation when the contrastive signal emerges at the core.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张语言模型的 self-repair 不是噪声，而是消融前就存在的 counterweight 增益在起作用：把任意干预映射到反事实对比强度 λ 轴上，细粒度单元的因果修复响应服从仿射律 E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ，γ_r 的符号决定该单元抵消还是强化被移除信号。在 Gemma、Qwen、LLaMA、Mistral 四个模型的事实判定任务上，81 个下游方向中 68 个服从该律；GPT-2 Small 的 IOI 电路中干预可达的 10 个头有 7 个服从且全部是 counterweight。
Motivation: self-repair 现象被反复观察但机制不明，迄今最系统的结论是它噪声大、不太可能有单一解释；作者认为缺的是一个统一坐标（λ 轴）来标定各种消融方法。
Method: 把对因果重要组件的任何干预视为反事实对比有符号强度 λ 轴上的一个点，从而把常规消融方法视为未标定的点；对细粒度单元 r 拟合仿射律 E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ，并尝试从固定权重预测 γ_r 的量级。
Result: 在事实判定任务、四个不同家族模型（Gemma、Qwen、LLaMA、Mistral）上识别出服从仿射律的 MLP neurons、OV neurons 与 singular directions，81 个下游方向中 68 个服从；γ_r 的量级可从固定权重预期。在 GPT-2 Small 的 IOI 电路上，干预可达的 10 个头中 7 个服从该律，且这 7 个全部是 counterweight。
Conclusion: 看似 self-repair 的现象可解释为 counterweight 在对比信号于核心出现时执行其常规操作，即单一的仿射增益机制而非噪声化的多重解释。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Watch, Infer, Coordinate: Inferring Robot Partner Constraints for Zero-Shot Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Robots operating in the physical world will increasingly need to coordinate with other robots, particularly in manipulation tasks where an object may be too large or heavy for a single robot to carry alone. Physical limitations caused by hardware degradation or actuator faults can restrict the actions a robot can reliably execute, yet these limitations may be unknown to its partner. We study whether a helper can infer a robot partner's physical constraints from observing it coordinate with another robot, then use the inferred capability to coordinate with the same partner on a new task. This is difficult because a demonstration shows what the constrained robot did, but not what it could have done. In physically coupled tasks, the other robot may also compensate for its limitations, making those limitations difficult to identify from the constrained robot's behavior alone. Our key insight is that these constraints shape the joint behavior of the team, making the actions of both robots informative about the constrained partner's capability. We introduce Watch, Infer, Coordinate, a benchmark spanning three physically coupled manipulation settings, together with an inference approach that scores candidate constraints using observed joint behavior. Across all three settings, our method substantially improves constraint inference and zero-shot coordination, approaching an oracle with access to the true constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Watch, Infer, Coordinate：helper 通过观察受限机器人与另一机器人的联合行为，为候选物理约束打分以推断其能力，再用推断出的能力在新任务上做零样本协调 (zero-shot coordination)。在覆盖三个物理耦合操作场景的该基准上，方法显著提升约束推断与零样本协调表现，接近可访问真实约束的 oracle。
Motivation: 硬件退化或执行器故障会限制机器人可可靠执行的动作，而其协调伙伴并不知情；演示只展示受限机器人做了什么、没展示它本可以做什么，且物理耦合任务中另一机器人还会代偿，使限制难以从单方行为识别。
Method: 发布 Watch, Infer, Coordinate 基准，含三个物理耦合操作场景；推断方法对候选约束按观测到的联合行为打分，利用双方动作共同约束受限伙伴的能力，再将推断能力用于新任务上的零样本协调。
Result: 在全部三个场景中，该方法显著改善约束推断与零样本协调，表现接近拥有真实约束的 oracle。
Conclusion: 受限机器人的物理约束会塑造团队联合行为，因此双方动作都可用于推断其能力，并支撑跨任务的零样本协调。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: World Observer: Joint Actor-Observer Generation for Persistent World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: How can a world model continuously observe regions beyond the actor's current view? Video world models simulate how an environment evolves from an agent's actions, yet remain actor-centric. Once an object leaves the actor's view, they lose direct evidence of its evolution, often failing to preserve its state and dynamics upon re-entry. To address this, we introduce World Observer, which decouples observing from acting by jointly generating a perspective actor for the agent-centric view with one or more panoramic observers that watch selected world regions. This allows objects that leave the actor's view to remain visually evolving in an observer, so their updated states are reflected when they re-enter. We ground the actor and observers by warping from a shared panoramic source for explicit geometric correspondence, and introduce an Observer Sink of high-resolution perspective references to restore fine appearance upon re-entry. Since the observers are decoupled from the actor, they can be placed freely across the scene, extended to multiple locations for broader coverage, and driven by control signals to steer out-of-view evolution. To evaluate out-of-view evolution, we further introduce world-space metrics and a benchmark spanning real and synthetic scenes. World Observer substantially improves out-of-view dynamics while remaining competitive in visual fidelity, camera control, and 3D adherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: World Observer 把视频世界模型的 actor 视角与观测解耦，联合生成一个透视 actor 和若干全景 observer 持续监视视野外区域，使离开视野的物体在 observer 中继续演化并在重入时恢复状态。用共享全景源做 warp 以建立显式几何对应，并引入高分辨率透视参考的 Observer Sink 恢复重入时的细节外观。在覆盖真实与合成场景的基准上，视野外动态显著改善，同时在视觉保真、相机控制与 3D 一致性上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型以 actor 为中心，物体一旦离开当前视野就失去直接演化证据，重入时难以保持其状态与动力学。
Method: 联合生成透视 actor 与一个或多个全景 observer，二者由共享全景源 warp 得到显式几何对应；引入高分辨率透视参考库 Observer Sink 在物体重入时恢复细节外观；observer 与 actor 解耦，可放置在场景任意位置、扩展到多处并由控制信号驱动视野外演化。另提出 world-space 指标与覆盖真实和合成场景的基准来评估视野外演化。
Result: 在所提出的含真实与合成场景的基准上，视野外动态 (out-of-view dynamics) 得到显著改善，同时在视觉保真、相机控制与 3D 一致性上保持竞争力；评估使用论文新提出的 world-space 指标。
Conclusion: 把观测与行动解耦、让独立 observer 持续追踪视野外区域，是让视频世界模型保持物体持久状态的可行路径，且不牺牲视角控制与几何一致性。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: DuoMind: Enabling Distributed Multi-Robot Coordination with Semantic Communication
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs) have recently driven rapid progress in general-purpose robots, yet most progress has focused on single-robot settings. Extending these capabilities to multi-robot systems remains challenging because robots must coordinate long-horizon behaviors while maintaining reliable, fine-grained execution. We introduce DuoMind, a distributed hierarchical framework for multi-robot coordination through semantic communication. Each robot uses a VLA-based action model for low-level execution and a VLM-based orchestrator for high-level reasoning and inter-agent coordination. At each planning step, the orchestrator at each robot reasons over the task instruction, local observations, and messages received from other robots. It then generates low-level instructions for the action model and semantic messages for peer robots. This architecture exploits the complementary strengths of pretrained models by combining the semantic reasoning capabilities of VLMs with the precise action-generation capabilities of VLAs. To address the scarcity of benchmarks for multi-robot coordination, we further develop RoboPoly, a benchmark comprising long-horizon manipulation tasks that require coordinated, closed-loop execution under distributed control. Experiments on RoboPoly and RoboTwin demonstrate that DuoMind improves multi-robot task performance, while ablation studies confirm the contributions of hierarchical orchestration and semantic communication. More details are available on our project page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuoMind 用语义通信把多机器人长程操作拆成两层：每台机器人的 VLM orchestrator 负责高层推理与生成对同伴的语义消息，VLA action model 负责底层执行。在自建的 RoboPoly 与 RoboTwin 上实验显示多机器人任务性能提升，消融确认分层编排与语义通信各自有贡献。
Motivation: VLM/VLA 的进展集中在单机器人，多机器人系统既要协调长程行为又要保证细粒度执行，且缺少覆盖分布式闭环协调的基准。
Method: 分布式分层框架：每台机器人配 VLA 动作模型做底层执行、VLM orchestrator 做高层推理；每个规划步 orchestrator 综合任务指令、本地观测与其他机器人消息，产出给动作模型的低层指令和给同伴的语义消息。同时构建含长程操作任务的 RoboPoly 基准。
Result: 在 RoboPoly 与 RoboTwin 上的实验表明 DuoMind 提升多机器人任务性能；消融研究确认分层编排 (hierarchical orchestration) 与语义通信 (semantic communication) 各自的贡献。
Conclusion: 把预训练模型的语义推理与精确动作生成分层组合、并以语义消息在机器人间协调，是多机器人长程协同操作的一条可行路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: 4Director: Controlling Video World Models with Rigid 3D Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Precise control over camera and object motion is essential for professional video production. Existing methods control objects only coarsely, through image-plane cues that are ambiguous in depth and rotation or through 3D tracks and blobs that lack complete geometry and lose consistency across viewpoint changes. We introduce 4Director, a video world model conditioned on an explicit 4D scene representation: each object is reconstructed once from the input image as a canonical mesh and moved by one prescribed rigid transformation per frame. This representation provides an intuitive 3D control interface and prevents unobserved geometry from being regenerated independently in every frame. We render the controlled scene as a depth video and introduce a Motion Adapter that transforms this geometric scaffold into video while synthesizing view-consistent appearance, illumination, and non-rigid dynamics. For training, we construct RealCOD-Rigid, a new dataset of 20,774 clips annotated with rigid 3D scenes by our automatic pipeline. We further introduce Identity-Gated IoU (IG-IoU), which jointly evaluates adherence to prescribed object motion and preservation of object identity. Experiments demonstrate that 4Director consistently outperforms prior methods in visual quality and in camera and object control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 4Director 把视频世界模型条件在显式 4D 场景表示上：每个物体从输入图重建为 canonical mesh，每帧只给一个刚体变换，再用 Motion Adapter 把渲染出的深度视频转成带视角一致外观、光照与非刚体动态的成片。在自建 RealCOD-Rigid（20,774 段带刚体 3D 场景标注的片段）上，用新指标 IG-IoU 联合衡量运动遵循与身份保持，实验显示其在视觉质量与相机/物体控制上一致优于既有方法。
Motivation: 现有视频控制要么用图像平面线索，深度与旋转有歧义，要么用 3D 轨迹或 blob，几何不完整且跨视角会失去一致性，难以满足专业视频制作对相机与物体运动的精确控制。
Method: 以显式 4D 场景表示为条件：输入图中每个物体一次性重建为 canonical mesh，每帧施加一个规定的刚体变换；先渲染受控场景得到深度视频，再由 Motion Adapter 将该几何骨架转为视频，合成视角一致的外观、光照与非刚体动态。训练数据为自动管线构建的 RealCOD-Rigid，含 20,774 段标注刚体 3D 场景的片段；评测用新提出的 Identity-Gated IoU (IG-IoU)，联合打分规定运动的遵循度与物体身份保持。
Result: 实验显示 4Director 在视觉质量以及相机与物体控制两方面一致优于先前方法；评测基于 IG-IoU（联合评估运动遵循与身份保持），训练数据为 20,774 段片段的 RealCOD-Rigid。
Conclusion: 用一次性重建的刚体 mesh 加逐帧规定变换作为控制接口，可以避免未观测几何在每帧被重新生成，从而同时拿到直观 3D 控制与跨视角一致的视频生成。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Do Intrinsic Rewards Lead to Exploration?
papers.abstract_en: Intrinsic rewards are designed to guide exploration in reinforcement learning by assigning value to an agent's experience, for example through prediction error or learning progress. However, maximizing these rewards need not produce the most informative experience available. We propose a formal criterion for exploration that compares policies by the counterfactual information they acquire: how well their histories can substitute for experience under alternative policies. We construct a single, simple environment in which specified count-based, prediction-error, empowerment, and information-gain objectives have maximizing policies that are Pareto-suboptimal at acquiring counterfactual information. We explain these failures and establish conditions under which existing intrinsic rewards successfully encourage optimal exploration. We also construct an objective that assigns a higher value whenever exploration strictly improves under our criterion.

papers.title: Muon meets Tamed Langevin: Momentum Preconditioning beyond Convex and gradient-Lipschitz Potentials
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of sampling from Gibbs distributions on matrix spaces whose potential energies are neither convex nor globally gradient-Lipschitz. We introduce a family of non-quadratic kinetic energies that lead to a new underdamped Langevin system with momentum preconditioning, in which the gradient of the kinetic energy acts as a smooth spectral taming of the momentum. We prove that, under these relaxed assumptions on the potential, the resulting dynamics leaves the target Gibbs measure invariant, and we establish exponential convergence to equilibrium in a weighted total variation distance. Finally, we show that the corresponding Euler-Maruyama discretization admits moment bounds that are uniform in time, without any modification of the potential gradient, which ensures the stability of the resulting sampling algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在矩阵空间 Gibbs 分布采样中，势能既非凸也不满足全局梯度 Lipschitz 时，提出一族非二次动能，使新欠阻尼 Langevin 系统的动能梯度对动量起平滑的谱 taming 作用（momentum preconditioning）。证明该动力学保持目标 Gibbs 测度不变，并在加权全变差距离下指数收敛到平衡；Euler-Maruyama 离散化给出时间一致的矩界，无需修改势能梯度，从而保证采样算法稳定。
Motivation: 矩阵空间上的 Gibbs 采样常要求势能凸或梯度全局 Lipschitz，这类假设在实际模型中过强，导致 Langevin 动力学的不变性、收敛与数值稳定性难以同时保证。
Method: 构造非二次动能族，其梯度作为动量的平滑谱 taming，导出新的欠阻尼 Langevin 系统（momentum preconditioning）；在放宽的势能假设下证明不变测度与加权全变差距离的指数收敛，再分析未修改梯度的 Euler-Maruyama 离散化。
Result: 证明了动力学保持目标 Gibbs 测度不变，并在加权全变差距离下指数收敛到平衡；Euler-Maruyama 离散化具有时间一致的矩界，且无需修改势能梯度，保证采样算法稳定。
Conclusion: 用动能梯度做谱 taming 的动量预条件，可在势能非凸且非全局梯度 Lipschitz 的条件下同时获得不变性、指数收敛与离散稳定性。

papers.title: MosaiChunk: Compositing Spatio-Temporal Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon autoregressive video generation is limited by a finite context window. When an object or scene falls out of context, its fine-grained visual details may be lost and difficult to recover upon reappearance. To retain access to such visual details, we introduce MosaiChunk, a spatio-temporal memory mechanism that composes a mosaic of selected historical key-value (KV) entries across space and time. Our approach is motivated by the observation that a frozen video generator can directly consume such non-contiguous historical KV and recover the corresponding visual content. We therefore keep the generator fixed and learn only a lightweight router that determines which historical sections to include in the mosaic under a fixed active-memory budget. We further introduce RememBench, a benchmark of long-horizon revisits with prompt-driven text-to-video (T2V) and camera-driven image-to-video (I2V) splits. Our experiments show that MosaiChunk consistently improves revisit consistency over both sliding-window inference and whole-chunk retrieval under matched memory budgets, across both T2V and I2V settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MosaiChunk 用跨时空拼贴的历史 KV 检索解决长时程自回归视频生成中物体离开上下文后细节丢失的问题：生成器保持冻结，只训练一个轻量 router 在固定 active-memory 预算下决定把哪些历史片段拼进 mosaic。在匹配内存预算下，其 revisit 一致性在 T2V 与 I2V 两种设定中均稳定优于滑窗推理与 whole-chunk 检索。
Motivation: 长时程自回归视频生成受有限上下文窗口限制，物体或场景一旦离开上下文，其细粒度视觉细节会丢失且重现时难以恢复。
Method: 提出时空记忆机制 MosaiChunk：跨空间与时间选取历史 key-value (KV) 条目拼成 mosaic；冻结视频生成器，仅学习一个轻量 router，在固定 active-memory 预算下决定纳入 mosaic 的历史片段。配套提出 Remembench，含 prompt 驱动的 T2V 与 camera 驱动的 I2V 两个 split 的长时程 revisit 基准。
Result: 在匹配内存预算下，MosaiChunk 的 revisit 一致性在 T2V 与 I2V 两种设定中均一致优于 sliding-window inference 与 whole-chunk retrieval 两个基线。
Conclusion: 冻结的视频生成器可直接消费非连续历史 KV 并恢复对应视觉内容，因此只学一个轻量检索 router 即可维持长时程重现一致性。
