papers.title: From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn, which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. Self-Directed Source Learning identifies what remains incompletely understood and adaptively revisits the source, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses downstream experience to reveal local representational gaps and recurring needs in how source knowledge should be organized. In both cases, learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn achieves the best performance in 13 of 15 settings, with gains of up to 22.6 points over Hybrid RAG and substantial overall improvements over static source representations and experience-based memory baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SourceLearn 让 LLM agent 对持久权威来源做「源学习」而非重复检索：用持久 source model 表示对来源结构、解读与应用的可复用理解，由 Self-Directed 与 Task-Guided 两个机制分别定位未理解之处和下游暴露的表征缺口，再从原始来源重建更新。在五个 benchmark、三种 LLM 后端的 15 个设置中 13 个取得最佳，较 Hybrid RAG 最高提升 22.6 分。
Motivation: 现有方法只改进来源内容的访问与组织，agent memory 只沉淀历史交互中的可复用知识，同一来源被反复使用仍被当作重复访问，而不是逐步加深理解的机会。
Method: 以持久 source model 编码对来源的结构化理解；Self-Directed Source Learning 识别尚未理解完全的部分并自适应回访来源，Task-Guided Source Learning 借下游任务暴露局部表征缺口与组织需求；学习信号决定重看什么，持久更新始终从权威来源重建。
Result: 在五个 benchmark、三个 LLM 后端共 15 个设置中，SourceLearn 在 13 个设置上取得最佳表现，较 Hybrid RAG 最高提升 22.6 分，并相对静态来源表示与基于经验的 memory 基线有整体提升。
Conclusion: 把同一来源的重复使用当作逐步构建源专属能力 (source-specific competence) 的机会，比静态来源表示和经验式记忆更能提升知识密集任务表现。

papers.title: Omni-Embed-Mini: Binding Modalities Without Forgetting via Dense Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Extending a text embedding model to new modalities typically degrades text retrieval quality, and existing omni-modal embedders compensate with multi-billion parameters. We present Omni-Embed-Mini, a 0.9B-parameter model that maps text, speech, audio, images, video, and visually-rich documents into a single shared cosine space without updating any text-side parameter. Our key insight is that the teacher signal requires no separate embedding model: each media sample is paired with a dense cascaded caption, and the teacher target is simply the frozen backbone's own embedding of that caption. Because teacher and student share the same backbone weights, they inhabit byte-identical geometry, and lightweight projectors plus phased LoRA adapters on the modality encoders suffice for alignment. Training combines a Matryoshka SigLIP contrastive loss with an online hybrid hard-negative miner whose negatives sharpen as the encoder improves. The recipe carries over to a 2.3B variant by swapping in a native vision-language backbone. Omni-Embed-Mini-0.9B keeps its text weights bit-identical to the backbone, so training cannot regress text retrieval (49.57 nDCG@10 on MTEB-v2 BEIR-8), while extending it to five additional modalities, and is ~2.7x to 9.5x smaller than every open omni embedder we compare against. The 2.3B variant is competitive with the closed gemini-embedding-2, edging ahead of it on the overall-modality average. Models, code, data and evaluation harness are on our project page: https://omniembed.cvmbzuai.com
papers.comment: Findings of EMNLP 2026. 26 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://omniembed.cvmbzuai.com
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Omni-Embed-Mini 用稠密蒸馏 (dense distillation) 把文本嵌入模型扩展到语音、音频、图像、视频和视觉文档五种模态，且完全不更新文本侧参数：教师目标就是冻结骨干对稠密级联描述 (dense cascaded caption) 自身的嵌入。因教师与学生共享骨干权重、几何逐字节一致，只需轻量投影器加分阶段 LoRA 即可对齐，0.9B 版本文本检索保持 49.57 nDCG@10 不回退，且比所比较的每个开源 omni embedder 小约 2.7 至 9.5 倍。
Motivation: 把文本嵌入模型扩展到新模态通常会损害文本检索质量，现有 omni-modal embedder 因此堆到数十亿参数；需要一条不牺牲文本侧、也不依赖独立教师嵌入模型的扩展路径。
Method: 每个媒体样本配一条稠密级联 caption，教师目标取冻结骨干对该 caption 的嵌入；师生共享骨干权重，模态编码器上只加轻量 projector 与分阶段 LoRA adapter。训练用 Matryoshka SigLIP 对比损失加在线混合难负例挖掘 (online hybrid hard-negative miner)，负例随编码器变强而收紧；配方换用原生视觉-语言骨干后迁移到 2.3B 版本。
Result: Omni-Embed-Mini-0.9B 文本权重与骨干逐位一致，MTEB-v2 BEIR-8 上 nDCG@10 为 49.57，同时扩展到五种额外模态，体积比所比较的每个开源 omni embedder 小约 2.7 至 9.5 倍；2.3B 变体与闭源 gemini-embedding-2 相当，在全模态平均上略胜。
Conclusion: 不更新文本侧参数即可保证文本检索不回退，稠密 caption 自蒸馏足以把嵌入空间对齐到多模态；该配方可随骨干替换迁移到更大规模。

papers.title: Faynt: Scaling and Optimizing Policies for Competitive Melee
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Faynt, a family of 10M- and 75M-parameter Transformer policies for Super Smash Bros. Melee, each controlling all 26 characters with a single checkpoint. After reinforcement learning (RL), the 10M wins 240 of 244 same-character games (98.4%) against fourteen specialist and multi-character releases on their supported rosters, with a winning record against every release. These opponents retain 21- or 24-frame action delays; Faynt uses no added delay, and we have not isolated the effect of this difference. In a separate evaluation against a privately supplied zero-delay Slippi-AI model, the 10M wins all 68 games across two conditioning settings. We study architecture, optimization, scaling, and hyperparameter transfer to guide pretraining on approximately 840,000 human replays. Post-training combines rank- and outcome-based curricula, 75M-to-10M distillation, and RL restricted to Fox mirror matches. On the initial 152-game benchmark, the supervised 10M wins 69.7% of games, compared with 45.4% for the pretrained 75M, despite higher overall held-out controller-prediction loss. The weighted validation loss used for supervised checkpoint selection agrees with the win-rate ordering of all four pretrained and supervised policies. After supervised post-training, both models take less damage per minute, build larger early leads, and win more often after losing the first life. Optimized inference on recorded game states averages 5.2 ms per decision for the 10M and 8.7 ms for the 75M on an NVIDIA T4, excluding emulator execution and communication. We open-source the weights, both benchmark suites, and a platform for automated model tournaments.

papers.title: Finetuning with Sampling: SFT Learns Better Than You Think
papers.abstract_en: Introducing new capabilities to frontier models has long been the goal of posttraining, which predominantly employs supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to this end. Conventional wisdom dictates that RL enables strong generalization on new tasks without losing existing capabilities, while SFT is prone to weak generalization and catastrophic forgetting. At the same time, SFT can learn from off-policy expert data, whereas RL must rely on a model's ability to find successful trajectories with repeated sampling. In our work, we seek to leverage the strength of on-policy learning while utilizing the privileged information contained in off-policy data. However, rather than modifying the learning objective to accommodate this data, we instead tailor the data distribution to better suit the learner. We introduce a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling algorithm that progressively transforms off-policy traces to be more on-policy given a reference model for finetuning. Across tasks like scientific skill acquisition, mathematical reasoning, and open-ended expertise, our sampling algorithm enables SFT to rival prevailing posttraining techniques, often generalizing better and forgetting less than strong on-policy baselines. In addition, the resulting finetuned models exhibit strong distributional performance and are capable of learning beyond sharpening the base model distribution. At a higher level, our approach presents sampling as a model-native operator that shapes data for learnability, offering broader utility as a general-purpose primitive throughout the posttraining stack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用 MCMC 采样把 off-policy 轨迹逐步改写成更 on-policy 的形式，再直接做 SFT，使 SFT 在科学技能、数学推理与开放域专长任务上追平 RL 等主流后训练方法，且泛化更好、遗忘更少。
Motivation: 后训练中 SFT 可用 off-policy 专家数据但泛化弱、易灾难性遗忘，RL 泛化强却只能靠模型反复采样找成功轨迹；本文想同时拿到 off-policy 数据的特权信息与 on-policy 学习的收益。
Method: 不改学习目标，而是改造数据分布：引入一个 Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) 采样算法，以待微调的 reference model 为参照，把 off-policy 轨迹逐步变换为更 on-policy 的形式，再用这些轨迹做 SFT。
Result: 在 scientific skill acquisition、mathematical reasoning、open-ended expertise 等任务上，该采样算法使 SFT 与主流后训练技术（含强 on-policy 基线）相当，且往往泛化更好、遗忘更少；微调后模型表现出强分布性能，能学到超出锐化 base model 分布的内容。
Conclusion: 采样可视为一种 model-native 算子，通过塑造数据的可学习性发挥作用，可作为贯穿后训练栈的通用原语。

papers.title: MIRTO: a registration-gated, multiverse-tested evaluation protocol for unsupervised anomaly segmentation in brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) methods for brain MRI are ranked by a single score, yet that score rests on choices that are rarely reported: how each anomaly map is aligned with the reference, how and on which data the threshold is set, and which false-positive budget, metric, aggregation and lesion definition are used. We present MIRTO, an evaluation protocol that makes these choices explicit and measures their effect. It gates the geometry of every comparison with a registration check and label-free diagnostics of known power, sets thresholds on validation data alone and reports the false-positive volume actually realised on test, repeats each comparison over 15,552 defensible evaluation pipelines, and attaches paired subject-bootstrap intervals with multiplicity control. Applied to four UAD methods trained on the same healthy data and tested on 312 BraTS 2020 subjects, MIRTO showed that an axis-order mismatch between stored maps and the reference lowered a diffusion model's voxel AUROC from 0.873 to 0.583 whilst barely moving its slice-level AUROC. Within each metric, the method explained at least 0.95 of the variance in voxel AUROC and AUPRC and 0.77 in Dice, but only 0.14 in lesion sensitivity, where the lesion definition and hit criterion dominated. A Dice advantage that was significant at validation thresholds vanished at equal realised false-positive burden, and an exact identity attributes it to threshold transfer. A training-free change to REFLECT's latent aggregation raised Dice at equal burden by 0.052. Nine hypotheses were tested against explicit criteria; because the same cohort served to develop the protocol, all inference is exploratory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIRTO 把脑 MRI 无监督异常分割 (UAD) 评测中默认隐藏的选择——配准、阈值、假阳性预算、指标与病灶定义——显式化并量化其影响：在 312 名 BraTS 2020 受试者、四个 UAD 方法、15,552 条可辩护评测流水线上，轴序错配把扩散模型体素 AUROC 从 0.873 拉到 0.583，而切片级 AUROC 几乎不动；在同等实际假阳性负担下，验证阈值处显著的 Dice 优势消失。
Motivation: UAD 方法常按单一分数排名，但该分数依赖配准方式、阈值设定数据、假阳性预算、指标与病灶定义等极少被报告的选择，排名因此不可复现也不可解释。
Method: MIRTO 是一套评测协议：用配准检查与 label-free 已知功效诊断把每次比较的几何关系卡住；阈值只在验证集上设定，并在测试集报告实际实现的假阳性体积；每条比较在 15,552 条可辩护评测流水线上重复，并附带受试者级配对 bootstrap 区间与多重性控制。
Result: 在 312 名 BraTS 2020 受试者上评测四个用同一健康数据训练的 UAD 方法：存储图与参考之间的轴序错配使扩散模型体素 AUROC 从 0.873 降到 0.583，切片级 AUROC 几乎不变；方法在每个指标内解释了体素 AUROC 与 AUPRC 至少 0.95 的方差、Dice 0.77，但病灶敏感度仅 0.14（由病灶定义与命中判据主导）；验证阈值下显著的 Dice 优势在同等实际假阳性负担下消失，可由阈值迁移的精确恒等式归因；对 REFLECT 潜表示聚合的免训练改动在同等负担下把 Dice 提高 0.052。
Conclusion: UAD 排名对配准、阈值与病灶定义高度敏感，应在同等实际假阳性负担下比较；九条假设因同一队列既用于开发协议而全部属探索性推断。

papers.title: Linear Programming Representations and Strongly Polynomial Algorithms for Robust Markov Decision Processes
papers.abstract_en: We study linear programming (LP) representations and strongly polynomial algorithms for robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) with rational polyhedral state-action rectangular uncertainty in rewards and transitions. By encoding a finite sequence of robust policy-iteration steps, we construct a single LP whose optimal solutions recover the robust optimal value and all optimal stationary randomized policies. At fixed discount, the LP has polynomial dimension and encoding length and can be constructed in strongly polynomial time. We also develop a general complexity analysis of robust policy iteration that combines the cost of minimizing over uncertainty sets with the number of iterations needed to evaluate a policy. For a fixed discount factor, we use this analysis to improve the known complexity bounds for $\ell_1$ and $\ell_\infty$ RMDPs and establish new strongly polynomial bounds for general interval, weighted $\ell_1$, and Wasserstein RMDPs, as well as turn-based stochastic games with these uncertainty sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把有限步鲁棒策略迭代 (robust policy iteration) 编码进单一线性规划，其最优解同时恢复鲁棒最优值与全部最优平稳随机策略；在固定折扣因子下该 LP 维数与编码长度均为多项式且可强多项式时间构造。由此改进了 ℓ1 与 ℓ∞ RMDP 的已知复杂度界，并为区间、加权 ℓ1、Wasserstein 不确定集及相应回合制随机博弈建立新的强多项式界。
Motivation: 鲁棒 MDP 在多面体矩形不确定集下缺少统一的 LP 表示与强多项式算法，策略迭代的复杂度（不确定集上求最小的开销 × 评估策略所需迭代数）也缺少通用分析框架。
Method: 将有限序列的鲁棒策略迭代步骤编码为单个 LP，最优解可恢复鲁棒最优值与全部最优平稳随机策略；并给出鲁棒策略迭代的一般复杂度分析，把不确定集上最小化成本与策略评估迭代次数结合起来。
Result: 固定折扣下 LP 具有多项式维数与编码长度，可强多项式时间构造；据此改进 ℓ1 与 ℓ∞ RMDP 的已知复杂度界，并对一般 interval、weighted ℓ1、Wasserstein RMDP 及带这些不确定集的 turn-based stochastic games 建立新的强多项式界。
Conclusion: 鲁棒策略迭代的有限步轨迹可以被压缩成一个 LP，从而把鲁棒 MDP 的求解与复杂度分析统一到强多项式框架内，适用范围覆盖多类矩形不确定集与随机博弈。

papers.title: Sample complexity bounds for categorical Markov random fields via Discrete Diffusions
papers.abstract_en: Many applications in statistics, economics, and physics require sampling from high-dimensional categorical distributions with local dependence structures. Examples include finite memory language models, Ising and Potts systems in statistical physics and protein folding, etc. In modern machine learning, discrete diffusions have emerged as a flexible approach for sampling such data, with strong empirical performance. Motivated by this, we develop learning methods with end-to-end sample complexity bounds for discrete diffusion with uniform noising under local dependence, which we model through low order Markov random fields (MRFs). Our main technical insight is a new \emph{pinning decomposition} of the discrete score. It shows that unlike in continuous diffusions, the score decomposes into components where the dependence on time separates multiplicatively from the dependence on the target. Building on this decomposition, we propose a \emph{weight-sharing neural score learner} and combine it with $τ$-leaping to obtain an end-to-end sampling procedure. Rather than treating score-learning error as a black-box input, as is common in existing sampling analyses, we study the score learning error from finite data and derive optimal sampling guarantees with explicit dependence on the vocabulary size, the interaction order of the MRF, and the sample size. Moreover, our strategy trains a single score network across uniform noise levels while leaving the sampling discretization to be chosen at inference-time. This allows the same trained model to trade accuracy for computational cost as inference-time budgets vary. Numerical experiments on Potts, Ising, and tree-structured models show that weight-sharing score networks outperform fully connected ones for sampling long sequences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为局部依赖（低阶 Markov 随机场）下的离散扩散 (discrete diffusion) 给出端到端样本复杂度界：用新的 pinning decomposition 把离散 score 分解成时间与目标乘性分离的分量，据此提出 weight-sharing 神经 score 学习器并结合 τ-leaping 得到完整采样流程。界显式依赖词表大小、MRF 交互阶数与样本量；Potts、Ising 与树结构模型实验中，weight-sharing score 网络在长序列采样上优于全连接网络。
Motivation: 现有离散扩散采样分析把 score 学习误差当作黑箱输入，无法从有限数据出发给出端到端保证；而高维类别分布（有限记忆语言模型、Ising/Potts、蛋白折叠）的局部依赖结构在连续扩散的 score 分解中并不成立。
Method: 在 uniform noising 下用低阶 Markov 随机场 (MRF) 建模局部依赖，提出离散 score 的 pinning decomposition，使时间依赖与目标依赖乘性分离；基于此训练一个跨全部 uniform noise level 共享权重的 score 网络 (weight-sharing neural score learner)，再与 τ-leaping 结合成端到端采样，采样离散化留到推理时选择。
Result: 推导出显式依赖词表大小、MRF 交互阶数与样本量的最优采样保证，并把 score 学习误差从有限数据本身而非黑箱输入来分析；Potts、Ising 与树结构模型的数值实验显示 weight-sharing score 网络在长序列采样上优于全连接网络。

papers.title: Local Support Learning
papers.abstract_en: We explore catastrophic forgetting in the context of large pre-trained models. By considering forgetting as a geometric problem in the input space of each weight matrix, we uncover a natural retention objective under which updates produced by gradient-based optimizers are suboptimal. Following this observation, we propose Local Support Learning (LSL), a general-purpose framework that augments gradient-based training for retention of prior capabilities without access to prior data. During a new learning phase, LSL pairs two components with distinct roles: a standard weight adapter, trained as usual to minimize the loss, and a gating function that enables the adapter only on input activations from its own training distribution, making the update local to that distribution. The key challenge is that this gate must route data from all learning phases while training only on data from the current one. We address this with a gate based on a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), whose likelihood decays rapidly away from its training data, giving it a natural tendency to stay closed on data from prior phases. We show that this post-training approach can resolve forgetting in LLMs of up to 7 billion parameters, retaining both pretrained and finetuned capabilities across multiple training phases, while being efficient in memory and compute, robust to hyperparameter choice, and showing scaling potential.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把灾难遗忘当作每个权重矩阵输入空间上的几何问题，提出 Local Support Learning (LSL)：训练时配一个常规 weight adapter 和一个基于 GMM 似然的 gating function，只在当前训练分布的激活上打开 adapter，使更新局部化。无需访问历史数据即可在多达 70 亿参数的 LLM 上跨多个训练阶段同时保留预训练与微调能力。
Motivation: 在大预训练模型上做持续学习时，历史数据不可得，而梯度式优化器产生的更新在保留先验能力的几何目标下是次优的，导致灾难遗忘。
Method: LSL 在新学习阶段并行两个组件：按常规最小化损失训练的 weight adapter，以及一个 gating function，仅在属于当前训练分布的输入激活上启用该 adapter。门控需在只接触当前阶段数据的条件下路由所有阶段的数据，作者用 Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) 的似然实现——其似然在远离训练数据处迅速衰减，因而对先前阶段的数据自然保持关闭。
Result: 该 post-training 方法在参数量多达 70 亿 (7B) 的 LLM 上解决了遗忘问题，跨多个训练阶段同时保留预训练与微调能力；摘要还给出其在内存与计算上高效、对超参数选择鲁棒、并具 scaling 潜力的定性结论。
Conclusion: 把更新限制在自身分布的局部支持上，可在不访问历史数据的前提下化解 LLM 的灾难遗忘，且该路径可扩展到 7B 规模。

papers.title: Harnessing Domain Specialists in Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity through sparse computation, routing each token through only a small subset of experts. In this work, we explore whether this sparsity gives rise to emergent intrinsic organization in multimodal MoEs. We find that experts develop strong semantic specialization across modalities and domains despite not being explicitly trained for modularity. Building on this structure, we introduce ExpertLens, a data-free method that identifies domain-specialized experts directly from pretrained model weights by decoding router weights into semantically meaningful vocabulary tokens. We leverage this specialization for efficient multimodal adaptation by selectively fine-tuning experts relevant to a target domain. Across math, medical, and remote sensing tasks, ExpertLens matches or surpasses full fine-tuning while updating only 21.7 - 47.0% of model parameters and achieving a 4.0x average training speedup, and outperforms LoRA in both adaptation performance and training efficiency. These results show that sparsity introduced for efficiency can give rise to semantic modularity that is directly useful for efficient adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ExpertLens 用数据无关的方法从预训练多模态 MoE 权重中把 router 权重解码成语义词表 token，直接识别领域专家，只微调与目标领域相关的专家。在 math、medical、remote sensing 任务上，它匹配或超过全量微调，却只更新 21.7–47.0% 的参数，平均训练加速 4.0x，并在适配性能与训练效率上都优于 LoRA。
Motivation: 多模态 MoE 的稀疏路由是否自发形成可利用的语义专家结构尚不清楚；全量微调与 LoRA 在多领域适配上参数与训练开销大，缺少直接从权重定位领域专家的手段。
Method: ExpertLens 是 data-free 方法：先观察到专家在模态与领域上自发语义特化，再把 router 权重解码为有语义的 vocabulary token 来识别领域专家，随后只对目标领域相关的专家做选择性微调。
Result: 在 math、medical、remote sensing 任务上，ExpertLens 匹配或超过 full fine-tuning，仅更新 21.7–47.0% 的模型参数，平均训练加速 4.0x；在适配性能与训练效率两方面均优于 LoRA。
Conclusion: 为效率引入的稀疏性会催生可直接用于高效适配的语义模块化，按领域挑专家微调即可在少更新参数下达到全量微调水平。

papers.title: Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. We export this world to an ERP warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, modeled on the Oracle E-Business Suite schema. The simulator's ground-truth state is withheld from the warehouse the agent sees, so tasks require reconstructing facts by navigating the warehouse before acting on them. Argo-Bench goes beyond text-to-SQL: the agent files actions such as banning fraudulent accounts, allocating courier incentive budgets, or issuing back pay, and the grader scores each by its consequences in the simulator. Every task has an executable reference solution that demonstrates solvability using only the warehouse. The strongest of 14 frontier and open-weight models scores 95 or higher on only 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. We hope Argo-Bench drives progress toward agents that understand, navigate, and act within real data environments.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables. Code: https://github.com/TextQLLabs/Argo-Bench. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/textql/Argo-Bench. Website: https://argo-bench.com
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Argo-Bench 是一个含 210 项数据科学与分析任务的企业级数据 agent 评测框架：模拟纽约外卖平台（2024 年 8100 万订单），导出为 235 表、75 亿行的 Oracle E-Business Suite 风格 ERP 仓库，ground truth 对 agent 隐藏，agent 必须先在仓库中导航重建事实再执行动作（封禁欺诈账户、分配骑手激励预算、补发欠薪），评分按其在模拟器中的后果。14 个前沿与开放权重模型中最强者仅在 34.8% 的任务上得分 ≥95，平均 59.5 分。
Motivation: 现有 text-to-SQL 基准只考查询生成，且审计发现答案键常错；真实企业仓库因敏感无法公开，公开数据集里一个业务事件往往落在单表内，无法覆盖跨数十张表推理、统计分析并据结果行动的真实工作流。
Method: 基于公开数据、同行评审行业文献与监管申报构建纽约外卖平台模拟器，导出为 235 表、75 亿行的 ERP 仓库（参照 Oracle E-Business Suite schema），模拟器 ground-truth 状态对 agent 所见仓库隐藏；任务要求先导航重建事实再提交动作，grader 按模拟器中的后果打分，每题配可执行参考解以证明仅凭仓库即可解。
Result: 14 个前沿与开放权重模型中最强者仅在 34.8% 的任务上得分达到 95 或更高，平均分 59.5；模拟世界含 2024 年 8100 万订单、235 张表、75 亿行，共 210 项任务。
Conclusion: 跨表导航加后果式行动评分能拉开当前数据 agent 与真实企业工作流要求的差距，最强模型平均 59.5 分说明理解、导航并作用于真实数据环境仍是未解问题。

papers.title: Where-OPD: Spatially Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation of MLLMs with Synthetic Scenes
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation has recently emerged as an effective approach for improving language-model reasoning by supervising students with a frozen or EMA version of themselves that receives privileged information. Its application to multimodal large language models (MLLMs), however, remains largely unexplored. Recent approaches use privileged visual information, such as image crops corresponding to a question, to improve fine-grained perception, but their gains are confined to tasks that benefit from such visual zooming and require either human-annotated grounding data or external teacher models. We introduce a different form of on-policy self-distillation for MLLMs that provides the teacher with textual, spatially grounded guidance identifying the visual elements relevant to a query. We use procedurally generated scenes with automatically available object identities and spatial coordinates, enabling scalable and annotation-free post-training. The teacher uses this spatial guidance to locate and integrate evidence from multiple relevant image regions, while the student learns to reproduce the resulting behavior from the image and question alone. Our approach consistently improves performance on counting, document and chart understanding benchmarks across multiple models. Importantly, although post-training uses only synthetic scenes, the resulting improvements transfer to real-world perception benchmarks, yielding a 3.23-point gain in average performance across CVBench, V*, ZoomBench, BLINK, HR-Bench, and MME-RealWorld. These results show that spatially grounded privileged information can induce broader perceptual capabilities through on-policy self-distillation, enabling substantial synthetic-to-real transfer beyond the task and data distribution used for post-training. Project page: https://github.com/sirkosophia/Where-OPD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Where-OPD 给 on-policy 自蒸馏的教师提供文本形式的空间定位引导（问题相关的视觉元素坐标与身份），学生只从图像和问题复现该行为，训练数据用程序化生成的合成场景、无需人工标注。仅在合成场景上后训练后，跨 CVBench、V*、ZoomBench、BLINK、HR-Bench、MME-RealWorld 平均提升 3.23 点，说明空间化特权信息能把能力迁移到真实感知基准。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM on-policy 自蒸馏依赖图像裁剪这类特权视觉信息，收益局限于需要视觉放大的任务，且需要人工标注的 grounding 数据或外部教师模型。
Method: 教师接收文本形式、空间定位的引导（指出与查询相关的视觉元素），在图像上定位并整合多个区域的证据；学生仅凭图像与问题学习复现该行为。训练用程序化生成的场景，自带物体身份与空间坐标，实现可扩展、免标注的后训练。
Result: 在多个模型上一致改善计数、文档与图表理解基准；仅用合成场景后训练，在 CVBench、V*、ZoomBench、BLINK、HR-Bench、MME-RealWorld 上平均性能提升 3.23 点。
Conclusion: 空间化的特权信息可通过 on-policy 自蒸馏诱导更广的感知能力，实现超出后训练任务与数据分布的合成到真实迁移。

papers.title: A Comparative Explainability Framework for DeBERTa-v3 in Zero-Shot Medical Abstract Classification
papers.abstract_en: A comparative explainability framework is presented to audit DeBERTa-v3 under zero-shot classification of medical abstracts. The work addresses the disagreement problem in Explainable Artificial Intelligence, where different attribution methods produce divergent explanations for the same input and prediction. A natural language inference engine is implemented over the Medical Abstracts corpus with five enriched hypotheses per diagnostic category and a balanced sample of one thousand texts per class. Five explanation methods are compared: SHAP and LIME as model-agnostic approaches, occlusion and Input x Gradient as deep-learning-specific approaches, and Attention x Gradient as a transformer-specific approach. Explanations are standardized through top-token attribution, and pairwise agreement is quantified using the Jaccard index. High predictive accuracy is achieved across well-defined clinical domains, whereas performance degrades under high semantic ambiguity. Explanatory stability directly mirrors predictive certainty, exhibiting strong convergence in univalent categories and a marked drop under diagnostic uncertainty. Furthermore, qualitative error auditing uncovers three systemic failure mechanisms: lexical hypersensitivity, semantic overlap, and loss of attribution coherence. The results support the combined use of several explanation methods and quantitative agreement metrics when auditing transformer-based models in medical text classification, and suggest prioritizing specific clinical ontologies over broad diagnostic labels.

papers.title: Surface-volume self-supervised representation learning of brain MRI for genetic discovery
papers.abstract_en: Existing genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of brain imaging provide predefined or deep-learning-derived imaging phenotypes, yet these phenotypes come from either volumetric scans or cortical surface meshes, so each captures only part of the heritable variation in brain anatomy. Here we introduce MEVA (Mesh-Enhanced Volumetric Autoencoder), a self-supervised framework that encodes voxel-level image intensity together with cortical mesh geometry, including curvature and cortical thickness at each surface vertex, into one shared set of imaging features. Combining the mesh and volumetric inputs in MEVA yields modest performance gains in age and sex prediction over models that use either input alone. When these features serve as phenotypes for GWAS in the UK Biobank, they reveal more genome-wide significant loci than features learned from volumes alone or from meshes alone. These results suggest that adding cortical surface geometry to volumetric self-supervised learning captures additional heritable variation and so increases the number of loci detected.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MEVA (Mesh-Enhanced Volumetric Autoencoder) 把体素强度与皮层网格几何（每个表面顶点的曲率、皮层厚度）编码进同一组自监督影像特征，用于 UK Biobank 的 GWAS。混用网格与体素输入在年龄、性别预测上仅带来温和增益，但作为影像表型时比单用体素或单用网格发现更多全基因组显著位点。
Motivation: 现有脑影像 GWAS 的表型要么来自体素扫描、要么来自皮层表面网格，各自只覆盖脑解剖可遗传变异的一部分，会漏掉位点。
Method: 提出自编码器 MEVA：编码器同时吃体素级图像强度与皮层网格几何（曲率、皮层厚度），输出共享影像特征；先做年龄与性别预测，再把这些特征作为表型在 UK Biobank 上做 GWAS。
Result: 网格与体素输入合用在年龄、性别预测上相对任一单独输入有温和性能提升；这些特征作为 GWAS 表型时，比仅用体素或仅用网格学到的特征揭示更多全基因组显著位点。
Conclusion: 把皮层表面几何加入体素自监督学习能捕获额外的可遗传变异，从而增加检出的 GWAS 位点数。

papers.title: Are We Recovering Mechanisms? Objective-Level Recovery Gaps in Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability aims to recover the internal computations responsible for model behavior. Progress in automated circuit discovery is often framed as a search problem: better attribution or optimization should identify better mechanisms. This assumes that the evaluation objective can recognize a better circuit once it is found. We show that intervention-defined faithfulness can instead prefer an equally sized circuit that reproduces the model's behavior less well, creating an objective-level recovery gap. Across four human-reference tasks and InterpBench, we compare validation faithfulness with behavior on held-out prompts under fixed ordinary resampling. The behavioral criterion is agreement with the intact model, including its mistakes, except on Greater-Than, where we use semantic accuracy. Controlled reference edits reveal misranking without any discovery algorithm, and outputs of EAP, EAP-IG, ACDC, and Edge-SP exhibit the same failure. Under resampling, KL misranks 9.4%-41.2% of candidate pairs across these methods on the human-reference tasks. We investigate context distortion as an explanation: replacing excluded signals changes the inputs on which retained components operate. Restoring selected signals from the recipient's intact-model execution repairs 96 of 100 persistent KL misrankings from the discovery pool on both validation and held-out prompts. The circuits and their original behavioral scores remain unchanged. These findings show why better discovery alone is insufficient when its objective rewards the wrong candidate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 机制可解释性中，基于干预的 faithfulness 目标会把行为复现更差的等大电路排在前面，形成目标层面的恢复缺口 (objective-level recovery gap)。在四个 human-reference 任务与 InterpBench 上，固定 ordinary resampling 下 KL 在 EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC、Edge-SP 上错排 9.4%–41.2% 的候选对；把被剔除信号从接收组件的 intact-model 执行中还原，可在验证与 held-out prompt 上修复 100 个持续 KL 错排中的 96 个，而电路与其原始行为分数不变。
Motivation: 自动电路发现被当作搜索问题：更好的 attribution 或优化就应找到更好的机制。但这默认评估目标能在电路被找到后认出它更好；若目标本身错排候选，只改进发现算法无法恢复真实机制。
Method: 在四个 human-reference 任务与 InterpBench 上，比较 validation faithfulness 与 held-out prompts 下的行为一致性（标准为与 intact model 一致、包括其错误，Greater-Than 用 semantic accuracy），采用固定 ordinary resampling；用受控 reference edits 在不引入任何发现算法的情况下制造错排，并检查 EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC、Edge-SP 的输出；再以 context distortion 为解释做信号还原实验。
Result: resampling 下 KL 在 human-reference 任务上对这些方法错排 9.4%–41.2% 的候选对；受控 reference edits 在无发现算法时即显现错排。从接收组件的 intact-model 执行还原被选信号，在验证与 held-out prompts 上修复了发现池中 100 个持续 KL 错排里的 96 个，电路及其原始行为分数保持不变。
Conclusion: 当目标奖励错误候选时，单靠改进发现算法不足以恢复机制；错排可由 context distortion 解释——被剔除信号的替换改变了保留组件所运行的输入，而还原这些信号即可修复排序。

papers.title: Scalable, Transferable Meta-network for Data Selection Requires a Different Loss (and Why the Obvious Choice is Problematic)
papers.abstract_en: Data selection is critical for training large language models on massive and heterogeneous corpora. Meta-learning for Training-data Selection offers a principled alternative to heuristic scoring by learning data weights from a target validation objective, but existing methods face a trade-off between fine-grained valuation and transferability to unseen data. A natural solution is to replace per-sample weights with a selection network. However, we find that directly incorporating such a network into existing MTS objectives leads to unstable optimization and poor generalization, caused by weight suppression and persistent reliance on easy-to-learn features. To address these issues, we propose Transferable Example Scoring and Selection (TESS), a scalable data-selection framework built on a Pointwise Value Matching objective (PVM). Experiments on LLM safety and targeted instruction tuning demonstrate strong transfer across datasets, from subsets to full corpora, and from smaller to larger models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TESS 用 Pointwise Value Matching (PVM) 目标把逐样本权重换成可迁移的选样网络，解决元学习训练数据选择 (MTS) 中细粒度估值与迁移性不可兼得的问题。直接把选样网络塞进现有 MTS 目标会因权重抑制 (weight suppression) 与持续依赖易学特征导致优化不稳、泛化差；改用 PVM 后在 LLM 安全与定向指令微调上实现跨数据集、从子集到全语料、从小模型到大模型的强迁移。
Motivation: 大规模异构语料上为 LLM 选训练数据时，元学习方法在细粒度估值与对未见数据的迁移性之间存在权衡；把逐样本权重换成选样网络这一自然做法反而带来优化不稳与泛化差。
Method: 提出 Transferable Example Scoring and Selection (TESS)，以 Pointwise Value Matching (PVM) 目标训练一个可扩展的选样网络，替代逐样本权重；针对直接嵌入现有 MTS 目标时出现的 weight suppression 与持续依赖易学特征两个问题重新设计损失。
Result: 在 LLM 安全与定向指令微调 (targeted instruction tuning) 两类实验中展示强迁移：跨数据集、从子集到全语料、从小模型到更大模型均可迁移。
Conclusion: 可迁移的元网络做数据选择需要换掉现有 MTS 目标，PVM 是作者给出的替代方案，且该框架在规模与分布变化下仍保持迁移能力。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: GeoLatent: Geometry-Guided Latent Structuring with Routed Optimization for 3D Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Despite progress in vision-language models, 3D spatial reasoning from 2D images remains challenging. Text-based methods describe intermediate geometry with discrete tokens, limiting fidelity for continuous spatial relations. Continuous latents offer richer representations, but a single latent type does not explicitly separate the cues needed across spatial tasks. Decomposed spatial latents address this by representing position, direction, and global geometry separately under geometric supervision. Yet the geometry representation can still collapse toward one dominant direction, and unrestricted attention can leave the latents underused during answer learning. We introduce GeoLatent, combining Common--Residual Geometry Alignment (CR-GEO) with routed optimization to structure the geometry states while promoting latent-mediated answer learning. CR-GEO separates shared from residual teacher geometry; routed optimization jointly trains geometry and language, temporarily directs visual answer learning through the latents, and restores full attention with geometry supervision. In controlled comparisons, CR-GEO raises geometry effective rank from 1.00 to 3.87, while blocking latent readout at the bottleneck lowers direction accuracy from 89.1% to 25.8% on 128 fixed questions. After recovery, the differentiated geometry representation and latent-mediated visual route remain available alongside direct image access. GeoLatent achieves 73.0% on SPAR-Bench and 72.1% on SPBench, outperforming previously reported methods on both.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoLatent 针对 2D 图像的 3D 空间推理，用 Common-Residual Geometry Alignment (CR-GEO) 把教师几何拆成共享与残差部分，再用 routed optimization 让视觉答案学习暂时经由 latent 通路、随后恢复全注意力并加几何监督。CR-GEO 把几何表征的有效秩 (effective rank) 从 1.00 提到 3.87；在瓶颈处阻断 latent 读出后，方向准确率从 89.1% 降到 25.8%（128 道固定问题），说明答案确实依赖 latent 通路。
Motivation: 文本式方法用离散 token 描述中间几何，连续空间关系保真度受限；而单一 latent 类型无法分离不同空间任务所需的线索，几何表征还容易坍缩到某一主导方向。
Method: CR-GEO 将教师几何分解为共享与残差两部分并施加几何监督，结构化几何状态；routed optimization 联合训练几何与语言，阶段性把视觉答案学习导向 latent，之后恢复直接图像注意力并叠加几何监督，形成 latent-mediated answer learning。
Result: CR-GEO 将几何 effective rank 从 1.00 提升至 3.87；在瓶颈处阻断 latent 读出使方向准确率从 89.1% 降至 25.8%（128 道固定问题）。在 SPAR-Bench 上达到 73.0%，SPBench 上达到 72.1%，均超过此前报告的方法。
Conclusion: 分离共享与残差几何并强制答案经由 latent 通路，可避免几何表征坍缩并让 latent 在答案学习中真正被使用；恢复全注意力后分化几何与 latent 视觉通路仍与直接图像访问并存。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HumanoidToolBench: Benchmarking Humanoid Tool Use from Selection to Mobile Execution
papers.abstract_en: As robotic hardware and learning methods advance, humanoids need tools to perform tasks beyond their inherent physical limits. Successful tool use requires selecting a suitable tool and coordinating manipulation and, when needed, locomotion to complete the task. Existing benchmarks do not jointly evaluate these capabilities on a humanoid. We introduce HumanoidToolBench, an 18-task benchmark spanning three scenarios, three execution levels, and two tool-set modes, together with ToolBook, a dataset of 3.1k demonstrations collected in simulation and on a real Unitree G1. Evaluation of seven policies in simulation and three on the real robot reveals substantial gaps between selecting a suitable tool and completing the task. Focused GR00T N1.7 probes show reduced selection accuracy on unseen tools and continued task execution under unrelated instructions. Code and data are available at https://snu-pi.github.io/HumanoidToolBench/.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Free-Boundary Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: We study free-boundary problems within a physics-informed framework using Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) approximations. The proposed approach incorporates obstacle constraints, partial differential equation (PDE) inequalities, complementarity conditions, and boundary conditions through residual-based loss functions. We consider a linear elliptic obstacle problem, a nonlinear $p$-Laplacian obstacle problem, and a time-dependent one-phase Stefan problem. The proposed KAN solver is compared with physics-informed neural network (PINN) and residual-network baselines. Numerical experiments show that KANs achieve low relative $L^2$ and $L^\infty$ errors while accurately resolving contact regions and moving interfaces. The results indicate that KAN representations provide an effective alternative for solving free-boundary PDEs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) 求解自由边界 PDE，把障碍约束、PDE 不等式、互补条件与边界条件全部写进基于残差的损失函数。在三个算例（线性椭圆障碍问题、非线性 p-Laplacian 障碍问题、含时一相 Stefan 问题）上，KAN 相对 L2 与 L∞ 误差低，能准确刻画接触区域与移动界面，并与 PINN、residual-network 基线对比。
Motivation: 自由边界问题含不等式约束与移动界面，物理信息神经网络类方法在接触区与界面捕捉上仍需更有效的表示形式。
Method: 以 KAN 作为逼近器，通过残差型损失函数同时纳入障碍约束、PDE 不等式、互补条件与边界条件；在三个自由边界算例上与 PINN 和 residual-network 基线对比。
Result: 数值实验覆盖线性椭圆障碍问题、非线性 p-Laplacian 障碍问题与含时一相 Stefan 问题；KAN 取得低的相对 L2 与 L∞ 误差，并准确解析接触区域与移动界面，对比对象为 PINN 与 residual-network 基线。
Conclusion: KAN 表示是求解自由边界 PDE 的有效替代方案，尤其在接触区域与移动界面的刻画上。

papers.title: Wasserstein Gradient Flows and Forward-Only Diffusion Are Not Enough for Multimodal Sampling
papers.abstract_en: There has been a proliferation of sampling algorithms based on Wasserstein gradient flows (WGF) and forward-only diffusion processes (FODP), often accompanied by theoretical guarantees of exponentially fast convergence to the target distribution. These guarantees are frequently interpreted as evidence that such methods can efficiently sample complex multimodal distributions, often supported by empirical results. In this work, we argue that this interpretation is fundamentally misleading. By invoking the Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) scheme and Otto calculus, we establish that the canonical WGF sampling dynamics and overdamped forward diffusion share the same density evolution and therefore inherit the same metastability and slow-mixing phenomena long understood in nonequilibrium statistical physics. We analyze this family of samplers using two complementary tools -- spectral analysis and mean first-passage time (MFPT) analysis -- and show that well-separated multimodality can induce exponentially long mixing times associated with small spectral gaps and rare inter-mode transitions. For the commonly adopted log-linear annealing schedule studied here, we find that introducing intermediate distributions does not remove the exponential scaling of the total transport time. The limitation is structural rather than implementation-specific: purely local, gradient-driven transport mechanisms can require exponentially long times to transport probability mass across well-separated modes. We argue that this represents a fundamental limitation of WGF- and FODP-based sampling in their standard forms, and motivates future development of fundamentally nonlocal mechanisms for efficient multimodal sampling.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Position Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论证基于 Wasserstein 梯度流 (WGF) 与前向扩散 (FODP) 的采样器在 well-separated 多峰分布上存在结构性指数慢混合：用 JKO 格式与 Otto calculus 证明二者密度演化相同，继承亚稳性；对所研究的 log-linear 退火调度，加入中间分布并不消除总传输时间的指数标度。作者主张这类纯局部、梯度驱动机制需被根本性的非局部机制取代。
Motivation: WGF/FODP 采样器常附带指数快收敛保证，被解读为能高效采样复杂多峰分布；作者认为该解读具有误导性，因为这些保证未反映跨峰输运的亚稳与慢混合。
Method: 以 Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) 格式与 Otto calculus 建立 WGF 采样动力学与过阻尼前向扩散共享同一密度演化；再用谱分析与平均首达时间 (MFPT) 两个互补工具刻画该族采样器，针对常用的 log-linear 退火调度分析总输运时间。
Result: well-separated 多峰性导致指数级长混合时间，对应小谱隙与稀有跨模态跃迁；在所研究的 log-linear 退火调度下，引入中间分布不消除总输运时间的指数标度。
Conclusion: WGF 与 FODP 标准形式的局限是结构性而非实现层面的：纯局部、梯度驱动输运跨 well-separated 模态需指数长时，因此需要发展根本性的非局部机制来做高效多峰采样。

papers.title: Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Privacy-preserving machine learning presents significant deployment challenges on the cloud for intelligent systems with confidential data. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a compelling solution for secure computation, preserving data confidentiality of cloud computations. However, applying FHE to reinforcement learning (RL) requires replacing non-linear operations with polynomial approximations, which diverge catastrophically due to a unique recursive error phenomenon known as the Bellman drift. This article introduces the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO), a stabilization framework designed to prevent polynomial approximation divergence in FHE-based deep RL. HAO adapts the zero-mean centering projection from advantage-based value estimation directly to temporal-difference (TD) targets. This linear projection annihilates the uniform state-value baseline that drives the Bellman drift, maintaining per-state action rankings while requiring zero additional non-linear multiplicative depth and avoiding expensive ciphertext bootstrapping. The proposed HAO framework was evaluated using a three-tier experimental methodology, including a tabular Markov Decision Process (MDP), an encrypted CartPole environment using real CKKS cryptographic operations, and a 20-node logistics routing benchmark with dense continuous features. The results demonstrate that the proposed HAO strictly bounds network pre-activations within the safe polynomial approximation domain. The proposed HAO RL agents achieved 0% boundary breaches across all random seeds used, whereas regularization alone (L2 weight decay and gradient clipping) breached the bound on 3 of 5 seeds and the unstabilized baseline did so in 83.8% of episodes. Finally, HAO agents improve optimal policy accuracy by 18.0 percentage points in tabular domains and remain stable when DP-SGD-style Gaussian noise is added to the clipped gradients.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 同态加密下的深度强化学习必须用多项式近似替代非线性，会因 Bellman drift 发散。HAO 把 advantage 估计的零均值中心化投影直接搬到 TD target 上，线性投影消掉驱动漂移的统一体价值基线，且不增加非线性乘法深度、不触发 bootstrapping。在 CKKS 加密 CartPole、表格 MDP 与 20 节点物流路由上，HAO 的网络前激活越界率为 0%（正则化基线 5 个种子中 3 个越界，未稳定基线 83.8% 的 episode 越界），表格域最优策略准确率提升 18.0 个百分点。
Motivation: FHE 部署 RL 时非线性只能用多项式近似，递归的 TD 更新会把近似误差放大成 Bellman drift，导致网络发散；仅靠 L2 与梯度裁剪无法稳定约束。
Method: HAO 将 advantage-based value estimation 的零均值中心化投影 (zero-mean centering projection) 施加到 temporal-difference (TD) target 上：该线性投影移除统一的 state-value 基线，保持每个状态下的动作排序，不增加非线性乘法深度，也避免 ciphertext bootstrapping。评测分三层：表格 MDP、使用真实 CKKS 密码运算的加密 CartPole、含稠密连续特征的 20 节点物流路由基准。
Result: HAO 将网络前激活严格限制在安全多项式近似域内，全部随机种子上边界越界率 0%；仅用 L2 weight decay 与 gradient clipping 的正则化在 5 个种子中 3 个越界，未稳定基线在 83.8% 的 episode 中越界。表格域最优策略准确率提升 18.0 个百分点；在裁剪梯度上加入 DP-SGD 式高斯噪声后仍保持稳定。
Conclusion: 把 advantage 的零均值中心化投影搬到 TD target 上即可在不增加乘法深度的前提下消除 Bellman drift，使 FHE 加密的深度 RL 在表格、CartPole 与物流路由三类设定下稳定并提高策略准确率，且对 DP-SGD 噪声鲁棒。

papers.title: PyPottery: an AI-powered end-to-end suite for pottery processing and publication
papers.abstract_en: The study of ceramic materials constitutes a cornerstone of archaeological research, yet the post-production workflow for pottery documentation remains labor-intensive and creates significant publication bottlenecks. This paper presents PyPottery, an open-source, AI-powered suite designed to semi-automate the complete ceramic documentation pipeline. The suite comprises four integrated modules: PyPotteryScan for automated image extraction and handwriting recognition; PyPotteryInk for automatic inking of pencil drawings; PyPotteryTrace for semantically-aware vectorization; and PyPotteryLayout for automated layout generation. Evaluated on 50 hand-drawn sheets containing 240 pottery drawings from the Terramara di Montale (Italy), the framework achieved substantial time savings confirmed by usability study participants, who reported a median perceived speedup of 40$\times$ over traditional workflows (range: 17.5$\times$--120$\times$). These results highlight the potential of AI-assisted tools in archaeological documentation, while the paper addresses the strategic redistribution of cognitive labor toward augmentation rather than automation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PyPottery 把陶器绘图到出版的流水线拆成四个模块半自动化：PyPotteryScan 做图像提取与手写识别，PyPotteryInk 自动上墨铅笔线稿，PyPotteryTrace 做语义感知矢量化，PyPotteryLayout 自动生成排版。在意大利 Terramara di Montale 的 50 张手绘稿（含 240 件陶器图）上，可用性研究参与者报告相对传统流程的感知加速中位数为 40×（范围 17.5×–120×）。

Method: 开源套件含四个集成模块：PyPotteryScan（自动图像提取与 handwriting recognition）、PyPotteryInk（铅笔线稿自动上墨）、PyPotteryTrace（语义感知矢量化）、PyPotteryLayout（自动排版生成）；在 50 张手绘稿、240 件陶器图上评测并做可用性研究。

papers.title: Causal Memory Policy: Making Memory Utility Identifiable by Intervening on Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented large language models must decide which memories to retain, and recent systems do so by estimating each memory's effect on task performance. However, these estimates rely entirely on retrieved memories. When a memory is never retrieved, store-level interventions produce identical outcomes, leaving its utility unidentified. This is a retrieval-level positivity violation, invisible to diagnostics that examine only memory operations. We introduce Causal Memory Policy (CMP), a causal framework that restores identification by intervening on retrieval itself, reserving a fixed number of context slots for memories sampled with known propensities. CMP estimates memory utility by self-normalized inverse propensity weighting under a balanced assignment design. We prove the causal factorization of memory utility through retrieval, the unbiasedness and exact variance of the estimator, and the optimal decision rule under irreversible operations. Empirically, identification fails for 54% of required memories on LongMemEval and 67% on LoCoMo, and the failure persists in a deployed memory system. CMP improves discrimination between required and non-required memories from 0.54 to 0.66 AUC. Finally, we show that identified memory utility alone is insufficient for retention decisions: per-query utility reaches 0.78 AUC on the query for which it is estimated, yet no aggregation available to a retention policy predicts a memory's value on unseen queries. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cmp-release-D0C3/.

TL;DR: 记忆增强 LLM 的记忆效用估计只依赖被检索到的记忆，从未被检索的记忆其 store 级干预结果完全相同，导致效用不可识别（retrieval-level positivity violation）。Causal Memory Policy (CMP) 直接干预检索本身，为按已知倾向采样的记忆保留固定数量上下文槽位，用平衡分配设计下的自归一化逆倾向加权 (self-normalized IPW) 估计效用。LongMemEval 上 54%、LoCoMo 上 67% 的必需记忆识别失败，CMP 把必需/非必需记忆判别 AUC 从 0.54 提到 0.66。
Motivation: 现有系统靠检索到的记忆估计其对任务表现的影响，但未被检索的记忆在 store 级干预下结果相同，效用无法识别；只检查记忆操作的诊断看不到这一 positivity violation。
Method: CMP 干预检索层，为按已知 propensities 采样的记忆保留固定数量 context slots，在平衡分配设计下用自归一化逆倾向加权估计记忆效用；证明效用经检索的因果分解、估计量的无偏性与精确方差，以及不可逆操作下的最优决策规则。
Result: 识别失败占必需记忆的 54%（LongMemEval）与 67%（LoCoMo），且在已部署的记忆系统中持续存在；CMP 将必需与非必需记忆的判别 AUC 从 0.54 提升到 0.66；单查询效用在被估计的那个查询上达 0.78 AUC，但任何可供保留策略使用的聚合方式都无法预测记忆在未见查询上的价值。
Conclusion: 检索层干预能恢复记忆效用的可识别性并提高判别力，但仅靠已识别的效用不足以做保留决策，因为按查询估计的效用无法外推到未见查询。

papers.title: AI Emulation of Stochastic Sudden Stratospheric Warming with Interpretable Latent Structure
papers.abstract_en: Rare weather regime transitions pose a challenge for data-driven modeling due to class imbalance. In this study, we develop a probabilistic deep learning emulator for a prototypical system with regime transitions, the stochastic Holton--Mass model of stratospheric variability, and analyze the structure of its learned latent space. The Holton--Mass model exhibits two metastable regimes, a strong and a weak polar vortex, maintained by nonlinear wave--mean flow interactions, with weak stochastic forcing intermittently triggering rare transitions between these regimes that qualitatively represent SSW events. We employ a ResNet-inspired Conditional Variational Autoencoder with six-layer encoder and decoder layers and explicit current-state conditioning to model the distribution of the system's state at the next time step (one day). The emulator accurately reproduces short-term dynamics, steady-state probability distributions, regime persistence statistics, rare transition rates, the transition committor function, and the transition expected lead time of the physical model. Beyond emulation fidelity, we interrogate the learned latent representation to understand how the model internalizes the underlying metastable structure of the dynamics. Principal Component Analysis of the 32-dimensional latent space reveals a clear and unsupervised separation into four physically interpretable clusters corresponding to strong versus weak vortex regimes and stable versus transition-prone configurations. Such emergent regime separation in latent space is hard to identify for deep generative models applied to high-dimensional stochastic systems. Our results show that carefully designed probabilistic emulators can uncover physically meaningful manifolds governing extreme-event dynamics, potentially aiding the development of improved operational advanced warning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对平流层爆发性增温 (SSW) 这类类别极不平衡的稀有天气 regime 跃迁，用带显式当前状态条件的 ResNet 式 CVAE（编码器/解码器各六层）逐步（1 天）模拟随机 Holton--Mass 模型。模型复现了短期动力学、稳态分布、regime 持续性、稀有跃迁率、committor 函数与期望提前期；32 维 latent 经 PCA 无监督分成四个可物理诠释的簇，对应强/弱极地涡旋与稳定/跃迁易发构型。
Motivation: 稀有 regime 跃迁在数据中类别极不平衡，数据驱动建模难以同时抓住稳态统计与稀有跃迁；高维随机系统中深度生成模型学到的 latent 结构也难以显式呈现亚稳态。
Method: 以随机 Holton--Mass 模型（两个亚稳态：强/弱极地涡旋，由非线性波-平均流相互作用维持，弱随机强迫触发跃迁）为原型系统，训练 ResNet-inspired Conditional VARIATIONAL Autoencoder：六层编码器与解码器，显式当前状态条件化，预测下一时刻（1 天）状态分布；再对 32 维 latent 做 PCA 检验其结构。
Result: 模拟器准确复现物理模型的短期动力学、稳态概率分布、regime 持续性统计、稀有跃迁率、跃迁 committor 函数与跃迁期望提前期；32 维 latent 的 PCA 呈现清晰的无监督四簇分离，分别对应强/弱涡旋与稳定/跃迁易发构型。
Conclusion: 精心设计的概率模拟器能在 latent 空间中显式揭示支配极端事件动力学的物理流形，这类结构在高维随机系统的深度生成模型中难以识别，并可能支撑改进的先进预警系统。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: Sequential Capacity of Quantum Processes with Finite Memory
papers.abstract_en: How complex can the responses of a quantum device become as it runs longer with a fixed internal memory? We quantify this complexity through sequential response capacity: how many adaptive testing stages, each using a fresh run, can continue to separate possible processes by a prescribed gap in response probabilities. For fixed system and memory sizes, we establish a tight law relating this capacity to run length and probability resolution. At fixed resolution, the capacity grows on the order of $K\log K$, where $K$ is the number of time steps in each run. Our construction attains this growth using time-dependent phase rotations on a single visible qubit with no additional internal memory; its tests give response probabilities exactly zero or one. Under the same tests, classical stochastic processes that measure in a fixed basis at every step have only linear capacity at fixed sizes and resolution. For phase sequences selected by a stored classical label, we then quantify how known independent Pauli noise changes this logarithmic enhancement. With ideal controls and weak residual phase noise after correction, we prove matching capacity bounds at a fixed small probability gap. These bounds identify the inverse residual phase-flip probability as the coherence timescale that limits the extra logarithmic growth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定系统与内存尺寸下，量子过程的序贯响应容量（能用多少个自适应测试阶段、每阶段一次新运行，仍以规定概率间隔区分过程）随单次运行步数 K 呈 K log K 增长，而固定基测量的经典随机过程在同尺寸同分辨率下只有线性容量。构造只需单个可见量子比特上的时依赖相位旋转、无需额外内部内存，测试响应概率恰为 0 或 1；在存储经典标签选择的相位序列下，独立 Pauli 噪声削弱该对数增强，弱残余相位翻转噪声下界由残余相位翻转概率的倒数给出，即限制额外对数增长的相干时间尺度。
Motivation: 固定内部记忆的量子设备随运行变长，其响应复杂度能增长多快缺少定量刻画；需要一个可测的容量指标来区分量子与经典过程在同尺寸、同概率分辨率下的极限。
Method: 定义序贯响应容量为可用自适应测试阶段数（每阶段一次新运行，仍以规定响应概率间隔区分过程），对固定系统与内存尺寸推导容量与运行长度 K、概率分辨率的紧致标度律；给出用单可见量子比特时依赖相位旋转的构造（响应概率恰为 0 或 1），并分析存储经典标签选择的相位序列在独立 Pauli 噪声下的容量界。
Result: 固定分辨率下容量按 K log K 增长（K 为单次运行步数），该构造在单量子比特、无额外内存下达到此增长；同测试下固定基测量的经典随机过程在固定尺寸与分辨率下只有线性容量；弱残余相位噪声、理想控制下在固定小概率间隔处证明匹配的容量界，界由残余相位翻转概率的倒数作为相干时间尺度。
Conclusion: 量子相位控制带来的额外容量是对数级的，且该对数增强被残余相位翻转噪声限制，其倒数量给出限制额外增长的相干时间尺度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learn the Directions, Normalize the Gains: Post-Training Normalization for LoRA
papers.abstract_en: While Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient task specialization, its learned updates can compromise capabilities beyond the target task. We identify \textbf{adaptation imbalance}: a few singular directions dominate the trained update, leaving its performance sensitive to how gains are allocated. We argue that \textbf{learning where to adapt does not ensure that adaptation gains are well balanced}. This motivates \textbf{LoRA-Norm}, a post-training normalization method that retains learned directions while rebalancing their gains. LoRA-Norm combines spectral rebalancing, a fixed nonlinear transformation of singular values, with nuclear-norm restoration, which preserves the original total spectral mass. It requires no calibration data or additional training and introduces no inference overhead. Across two backbones and three adaptation tasks, LoRA-Norm improves average specialization and capability retention, outperforming the evaluated post-hoc spectral pruning and gradient-guided editing configurations on both measures. Stronger functional equalization brings no consistent additional gains, revealing that balancing adapter gains and equalizing their responses are distinct objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoRA 微调会出现 adaptation imbalance：少数奇异方向主导训练后的更新，使增益分配敏感并损害目标任务之外的能力。LoRA-Norm 作为免训练、免校准数据的后处理，用谱重平衡（对奇异值做固定非线性变换）保留学到的方向，再用 nuclear-norm restoration 恢复原始总谱质量；在两个 backbone、三项适配任务上同时提升平均专化能力与能力保持，并在两项指标上超过所评估的后验谱剪枝与梯度引导编辑配置。
Motivation: LoRA 的低秩更新虽然高效，但学到的更新会损害目标任务之外的能力；问题在于增益集中在少数奇异方向上，性能对增益如何分配过于敏感。
Method: 提出 LoRA-Norm：一种训练后归一化方法，保留学到的奇异方向而重新平衡其增益。它组合谱重平衡（对奇异值的固定非线性变换）与 nuclear-norm restoration（保持原始总谱质量），不需要校准数据或额外训练，也不引入推理开销。
Result: 在两个 backbone 和三项适配任务上，LoRA-Norm 同时改善平均专化 (specialization) 与能力保持 (capability retention)，并在两项指标上均超过所评估的后验谱剪枝 (post-hoc spectral pruning) 与梯度引导编辑 (gradient-guided editing) 配置；更强的功能均等化 (functional equalization) 没有一致的额外收益。
Conclusion: 平衡 adapter 的增益与均等化它们的响应是两个不同目标，更强的均等化不带来一致收益；保留方向、只重配增益的后处理即可同时改善专化与能力保持。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: External Observers May See More Clearly: Cross-Model Span-Level Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models via Hidden State Probing
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as foundational reasoning engines, their tendency to hallucinate remains a critical vulnerability. While recent internal state probes offer a promising alternative to slow external retrieval systems, they largely reduce hallucination detection to a token-wise binary classification task, failing to capture the structured, sequential boundaries of semantic drift. Here, we introduce an internal hidden state framework for fine-grained, span-level hallucination detection. By inspecting layer-wise activation patterns, we attempt to detect the exact hallucination onset and continuation tokens in an LLM generation. Our experiments show that this approach successfully isolates hallucination onsets, achieving substantial improvements in Precision-Recall AUC over random baselines despite extreme class imbalance. Ultimately, we propose a novel cross-model detection framework in which one model observes the internal representations elicited by another model's generation. We find that an external observer can match or exceed a generator's self-detection of its own hallucination onsets, including when the observer is the smaller model, suggesting that self-detection is not the ceiling for onset localisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出跨模型 span 级幻觉检测框架：用一个模型的隐藏状态探针去观察另一个模型生成时的内部表示，定位幻觉的起始与延续 token，而非做逐 token 二分类。实验显示该方法在极端类别不平衡下相对随机基线取得显著的 Precision-Recall AUC 提升，且外部观察者（包括更小的模型）能匹配甚至超过生成模型对自身幻觉起点的自检。
Motivation: 现有内部状态探针把幻觉检测简化为 token 级二分类，无法刻画语义漂移的结构化、序列性边界，也难以定位幻觉的准确起点。
Method: 构建内部隐藏状态框架做 span 级检测：逐层检查 (layer-wise) 激活模式，尝试定位生成中幻觉的 onset 与 continuation token；再提出跨模型检测框架，由一个模型观察另一模型生成所激发的内部表示。
Result: 该方法在定位幻觉 onset 上相对随机基线取得显著的 Precision-Recall AUC 提升，尽管类别极端不平衡；外部观察者对自身幻觉 onset 的检测可匹配或超过生成模型的自检，观察者为更小模型时亦然。
Conclusion: 自检不是 onset 定位的性能上限，让外部模型探查生成模型的内部表示是一条可行的细粒度幻觉检测路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Foundations without Fundamentals: Zero-Shot Blind Spots in Time Series FMs
papers.abstract_en: Despite the success of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) on broad benchmarks, their ability to internalize basic temporal logic, especially in settings supported by exogenous covariates, remains under-examined. We introduce SimpleTimeBench, a diagnostic univariate and multivariate "unit test" suite for primitives such as monotonic trends, periodic signals and leading indicator covariates, scenarios where near-perfect forecasts should be trivial. Surprisingly, prominent multivariate TSFMs (Chronos-2, Moirai and Toto) frequently produce suboptimal zero-shot forecasts for these inputs. While fine-tuning Chronos-2 improves its behaviour on specific tasks, we show that this adaptation degrades performance on other fundamental patterns rather than enhancing its generalizable foundational capabilities. This reveals a gap between pre-training scale and basic temporal reasoning, suggesting that current TSFMs could potentially lack the inductive biases needed to capture simple predictable functions. We further demonstrate that these failures are not merely synthetic curiosities: they persist in real-world sensor forecasting, where TSFMs consistently underutilize leading indicators available in observed covariates. This inability to capture simple relationships limits the practical utility and reliability of current multivariate models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimpleTimeBench 用单调趋势、周期信号、领先指标协变量等本应 trivial 的单元测试，检验多变量时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 的零样本时序逻辑。Chronos-2、Moirai、Toto 在这些输入上零样本预测明显次优；微调 Chronos-2 虽改善特定任务，却损害其他基础模式，且在真实传感器预报中持续不利用观测协变量里的领先指标。
Motivation: TSFM 在宽基准上表现好，但是否内化了最基本的时序逻辑（含外生协变量场景）缺乏检验；若连单调趋势、周期信号都预测不好，其在真实传感器预报中的可靠性存疑。
Method: 提出 SimpleTimeBench：一套单变量与多变量的诊断性单元测试套件，覆盖单调趋势、周期信号、领先指标协变量等近完美预测应属平凡的原语；对 Chronos-2、Moirai、Toto 做零样本评测，并对 Chronos-2 做微调以检验其是否提升可泛化能力，再在真实传感器预报上检验领先指标的利用情况。
Result: 三个主流多变量 TSFM（Chronos-2、Moirai、Toto）在这些平凡输入上频繁给出次优零样本预测；微调 Chronos-2 改善特定任务却在其他基础模式上降低性能；在真实传感器预报中 TSFM 一致地未充分利用观测协变量中可用的领先指标。
Conclusion: 预训练规模与基础时序推理之间存在鸿沟，当前 TSFM 可能缺少捕捉简单可预测函数所需的归纳偏置，这限制了多变量模型的实用性与可靠性。

papers.title: Learning from Failure: Leveraging Unreliable Predictions in Semi-Supervised Real-World Adverse Weather Removal
papers.abstract_en: Adverse weather image restoration aims to recover images degraded by rain, haze, snow, and other weather-induced artifacts, thereby improving the robustness of outdoor vision systems. Existing unified restoration models exhibit limited generalization to real-world scenes due to their reliance on synthetic supervision and insufficient semantic constraints. In this paper, we propose a novel student--teacher semi-supervised framework that addresses both challenges. Specifically, we introduce an unreliable database that preserves failed teacher predictions as informative negative samples for contrastive learning, while a reliable database stores high-quality teacher predictions as positive samples. By jointly exploiting reliable pseudo-ground truths and unreliable teacher outputs, the proposed framework learns to enhance desirable restoration characteristics while avoiding common failures. We further propose a phase spectrum-based semantic constraint that replaces computationally expensive text-based supervision with an efficient and naturally aligned semantic prior. An adaptive phase consistency loss is also designed to dynamically balance supervision between the degraded input and teacher pseudo-ground truths according to degradation severity. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in restoration quality and perceptual fidelity while exhibiting stronger generalization to real-world adverse weather conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出学生-教师半监督恶劣天气图像复原框架：把教师失败预测存入 unreliable database 作为对比学习负样本、高质量预测存入 reliable database 作为正样本，再加相位谱语义约束与按退化程度自适应的相位一致性损失。在真实天气基准上复原质量与感知保真度一致超过现有 SOTA，并对真实恶劣天气表现出更强泛化。
Motivation: 统一复原模型依赖合成监督、语义约束不足，导致在真实雨、雾、雪场景上泛化受限；教师预测中的失败样本通常被丢弃，浪费了可学的负信号。
Method: 学生-教师半监督框架：unreliable database 保存失败的教师预测作为对比学习负样本，reliable database 保存高质量教师预测作为正样本；用相位谱语义约束替代计算昂贵的文本监督；自适应相位一致性损失按退化严重度在退化输入与教师伪真值之间动态分配监督权重。
Result: 在真实世界基准上的实验显示，该方法在复原质量与感知保真度上一致优于现有 SOTA 方法，并对真实恶劣天气条件表现出更强的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 把教师的失败预测当作负样本而非噪声丢弃，配合相位域语义先验，可以在半监督设定下同时提升真实恶劣天气复原的质量与泛化。

papers.title: HydroJEV: A one-second, training-free screen for cyber-attack and fault attribution in water distribution networks
papers.abstract_en: When a SCADA alarm is raised in a water distribution network, operators must decide quickly whether it reflects a cyberattack, a physical fault, a normal transient or a faulty sensor. Supervised classifiers need labelled incidents that utilities rarely have, and frontier large language models (LLMs) take tens of seconds per decision. We tested whether Jev, a training-free model that returns class probabilities in about one second, can serve as the first tier of this triage. On a four-class cause-attribution benchmark built on the C-Town network in EPANET, Jev was compared with a hand-written rule tree, a supervised classifier and seven cloud LLMs on identical evidence in four sealed, pre-registered rounds. With only a label-free prior correction, Jev matched the rule tree (macro-F1 0.62-0.64 against 0.56-0.61 in distribution) and exceeded the supervised classifier by 0.36-0.42 on event subtypes absent from its labels, in all four rounds, and it outperformed the classifier whenever fewer than about four labelled events per class were available. Jev also decided 20-40 times faster than frontier LLMs. Accepting only benign Jev verdicts confirmed by the rule tree spared an LLM reviewer 35-38% of windows on fresh sealed sets without loss of macro-F1. Transferred unchanged to two further networks, this gated cascade stayed within the non-inferiority margin of its reviewer on all four sets. A fast, training-free screen can therefore take over about a third of the review load in SCADA anomaly triage while preserving the accuracy of deliberate review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HydroJEV 用免训练、约 1 秒输出类别概率的模型 Jev 做供水网络 SCADA 告警四类归因（网络攻击/物理故障/正常瞬态/传感器故障）的首层筛查，再用规则树门控决定是否交 LLM 复核。在 EPANET C-Town 基准上 Jev 达到 macro-F1 0.62–0.64，比监督分类器在未见事件子类上高 0.36–0.42，且比前沿 LLM 快 20–40 倍。
Motivation: 供水公司缺少带标签的事故数据，监督分类器难训；前沿 LLM 每次决策需数十秒，无法承担 SCADA 告警的实时首层分诊。
Method: 在 EPANET C-Town 网络上构建四类归因基准，四个密封预注册轮次中以相同证据对比 Jev、手写规则树、监督分类器与七个云 LLM；Jev 仅加无标签先验校正，再用规则树确认的良性判定作为门控级联，把剩余窗口交给 LLM 复核，并原样迁移到另外两个网络。
Result: Jev macro-F1 0.62–0.64（规则树 0.56–0.61，分布内），四轮全部在监督分类器标签未覆盖的事件子类上高出 0.36–0.42；每类标注事件少于约 4 个时 Jev 优于分类器；决策比前沿 LLM 快 20–40 倍；门控级联在新鲜密封集上省去 LLM 复核 35–38% 的窗口且 macro-F1 不降，在另外两个网络的全部四个集合上保持在复核器的非劣界限内。
Conclusion: 免训练的快速筛查可以接管 SCADA 异常分诊约三分之一的复核工作量，同时保持审慎复核的准确度。

papers.title: Form and Void: Entangled Composition through an Autonomous AI Agent
papers.abstract_en: Positive and negative space is a fundamental principle in visual composition, supporting visually coherent forms and layered semantic relationships. Generating such compositions is challenging because it requires coordinated control over two semantic concepts that share a common boundary. Although recent text-to-image models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance in image generation and visual understanding, positive-negative space generation remains difficult, particularly under direct single-pass prompting. In this work, we present the \textbf{F}orm \textbf{a}nd \textbf{V}oid \textbf{A}gent (\textbf{FaV-A}), a multimodal agent designed for staged positive-negative space generation. FaV-A follows a progressive workflow: it first generates a base object, then analyzes its shape and spatial structure to identify candidate negative-space semantics, and finally produces compositional instructions for the final image generation stage. Experimental results and ablation analyses suggest that FaV-A provides a more effective framework than direct zero-shot MLLM baselines for producing visually coherent and semantically aligned positive-negative space compositions.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) Workshops, 2026, pp. 8987-8995
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Form and Void Agent (FaV-A)，一个分阶段生成正负空间 (positive-negative space) 组合的多模态智能体：先生成基础物体，再分析其形状与空间结构以找出候选负空间语义，最后产出组合指令驱动最终图像生成。实验与消融显示 FaV-A 比直接单次 zero-shot 的 MLLM 基线更能生成视觉连贯、语义对齐的正负空间构图。
Motivation: 正负空间构图要求两个共享边界的语义概念被协同控制，直接单次 prompting 的文生图模型与 MLLM 难以做到，生成质量不稳定。
Method: FaV-A 采用渐进式工作流：第一步生成 base object，第二步分析该物体的形状与空间结构以识别候选 negative-space semantics，第三步产出组合指令交给最终图像生成阶段；对照直接 zero-shot MLLM 基线并做 ablation 分析。
Result: 实验与消融分析表明 FaV-A 在生成视觉连贯、语义对齐的正负空间构图上比直接 zero-shot MLLM 基线更有效；摘要以定性结论呈现，未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 正负空间生成应拆成物体生成、形状分析、指令合成的多阶段智能体流程，而非依赖单次端到端 prompting。

papers.title: DiDE:Direct Injection with Color-Texture DEcoupling for 3D Stylization
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in rectified flow-based image-to-3D generative models have enabled high-fidelity 3D asset generation. Building on this, a growing line of work has exploited these strong 3D priors for training-free stylization, transferring visual attributes from a reference image onto a generated 3D asset. However, existing methods enforce an all-or-nothing paradigm: color and texture are transferred jointly, with no mechanism to control them independently -- a limitation we formalize as Disentangled 3D Stylization(Disen3D). To address this, we propose DiDE, the first training-free framework for Disen3D. Key to our approach is the observation that the structured latent space of image-to-3D models is overcomplete with respect to texture: texture information occupies only a small subset of the style-significant channels, leaving a free subspace available for independent color encoding. DiDE exploits this via a channel partition mechanism that processes a content image, a texture reference, and a color reference through dedicated branches and composes both style signals interference-free at every self-attention layer, preserving content geometry throughout. Experiments on Disen3D-Bench, our newly collected multi-reference benchmark, show that DiDE consistently outperforms 2D and 3D stylization baselines in color fidelity, texture transfer, and content preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiDE 把 3D 风格化中颜色与纹理的联合迁移拆开，利用 image-to-3D 模型结构化 latent 对纹理过完备、纹理只占少数风格显著通道的特点，做通道划分并让颜色与纹理分支在每个 self-attention 层无干扰合成。在自建多参考基准 Disen3D-Bench 上，其颜色保真、纹理迁移与内容保持均稳定超过 2D 与 3D 风格化基线。
Motivation: 基于 rectified flow 的 image-to-3D 先验已能做 training-free 风格迁移，但现有方法把颜色和纹理捆绑传输、无法独立控制，作者将这一缺口形式化为 Disen3D 问题。
Method: 提出首个 training-free 的 Disen3D 框架 DiDE：核心是通道划分机制，把内容图、纹理参考、颜色参考分别送入专用分支，利用 latent 中纹理只占少数风格显著通道、其余为空闲子空间这一点独立编码颜色，并在每个 self-attention 层无干扰合成两路风格信号，全程保持内容几何。
Result: 在自建多参考基准 Disen3D-Bench 上，DiDE 在颜色保真 (color fidelity)、纹理迁移 (texture transfer) 与内容保持 (content preservation) 三项指标上持续优于 2D 与 3D 风格化基线。
Conclusion: 颜色与纹理可以借助 image-to-3D latent 的过完备通道结构在 training-free 条件下独立控制，无需联合迁移。

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge
papers.abstract_en: Schrödinger bridge (SB) learns stochastic transport between prescribed initial and target distributions. When the initial distribution shifts at test time, the learned dynamics can fail to recover the target distribution. We introduce the Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge (DRSB), which learns a single controller that accounts for uncertainty in the initial distribution. The DRSB objective consists of control energy and a KL penalty between the resulting terminal distribution and the target distribution. DRSB seeks a single controller that minimizes the worst-case value of this objective as the initial distribution varies within an ambiguity set around the nominal distribution. We derive an exact variational formulation of this objective and connect its fixed-terminal-cost subproblem to stochastic optimal control and distributionally robust optimization. This formulation motivates an alternating algorithm that updates the adversarial initial distribution, estimates the terminal log-density ratio, and trains the controller. We develop Wasserstein and Sinkhorn variants using stochastic control optimality conditions to approximate the gradients required for adversarial updates. Experiments on two-dimensional transport tasks and image-to-image translation show improved robustness to input perturbations relative to standard SB, with a tradeoff in nominal performance. On Gaussian mixture transport, Sinkhorn DRSB also achieves lower mean sliced Wasserstein distance than fixed-level noise augmentation at both tested unseen noise levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge (DRSB)，在初始分布测试时偏移下学习单一控制器，最小化控制能量与终端分布 KL 惩罚在模糊集内的最坏情况值。二维传输与图像翻译实验显示相对标准 SB 抗输入扰动更强但名义性能有折中；Gaussian mixture 传输上 Sinkhorn DRSB 在两个测试的未见噪声水平下 sliced Wasserstein 均值均低于固定强度噪声增强。
Motivation: Schrödinger bridge 学到的随机传输依赖指定的初始分布，测试时初始分布一旦偏移，学到的动力学可能无法恢复目标分布。
Method: DRSB 目标由控制能量与终端分布对目标的 KL 惩罚组成，并在名义分布周围的模糊集上最小化最坏情况值；作者推导该目标的精确变分形式，把固定终端代价子问题联系到随机最优控制与分布鲁棒优化，导出交替算法：更新对抗初始分布、估计终端 log-density 比值、训练控制器，并基于随机控制最优性条件构造 Wasserstein 与 Sinkhorn 两个变体近似对抗更新所需梯度。
Result: 在二维传输任务与图像到图像翻译上，DRSB 相对标准 SB 对输入扰动的鲁棒性提升，但名义性能有折中；在 Gaussian mixture 传输上，Sinkhorn DRSB 在两个测试的未见噪声水平下 sliced Wasserstein 距离均值均低于固定水平的噪声增强 (fixed-level noise augmentation)。
Conclusion: 把初始分布不确定性写进 Schrödinger bridge 的最坏情况目标，可以用单一控制器换取对输入扰动的鲁棒性，代价是名义分布上的性能下降。

papers.title: CARM: Cancellation-Aware Response Masking for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed the rapid adoption of reinforcement learning (RL) in large language model (LLM) post-training, with substantial gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation. In practical systems, however, policy updates and differences between rollout and training engines can make sampled responses off-policy. Sequence-level masking addresses this mismatch by deciding whether an entire response should contribute to optimization. A common masking rule uses the length-normalized geometric mean of sampled token probability ratios. Its signed log-ratios can cancel across positions, concealing substantial bidirectional policy drift. We propose \emph{Cancellation-Aware Response Masking} (CARM), a sequence-level mask that takes the absolute value of each token log-ratio before averaging, preventing opposing probability changes from canceling. We prove that accepted responses satisfy a joint bound on the fraction of sampled-token ratios outside a prescribed band and their mean log-distance beyond its boundaries. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that CARM improves mean@16 averaged over AIME 2024/2025/2026 and BeyondAIME by up to $3.13$ percentage points over geometric-mean masking, and increases average pass@1 across four code benchmarks by $2.88$ points over the strongest evaluated baseline. These findings support CARM as a theoretically grounded and effective method for response-level off-policy control in LLM reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARM 把序列级掩码中各 token 的带符号 log-ratio 先取绝对值再平均，阻止正负概率漂移在序列内相互抵消，从而更严格地识别 off-policy 响应。在数学推理与代码生成上，CARM 相对几何均值掩码把 AIME 2024/2025/2026 与 BeyondAIME 的 mean@16 平均提高最多 3.13 个百分点，四个代码基准的平均 pass@1 比最强基线高 2.88 点。
Motivation: LLM 的 RL 后训练中，rollout 引擎与训练引擎不一致及策略更新会使采样响应 off-policy；常用的长度归一化几何均值掩码其带符号 log-ratio 会在不同位置间相互抵消，掩盖双向策略漂移。
Method: 提出 Cancellation-Aware Response Masking (CARM)：对每个 token 的 log-ratio 取绝对值后再平均作为序列级掩码判据；并证明被接受的响应满足一个联合界，约束采样 token 比率落在给定区间外的比例及其超出边界的平均 log 距离。
Result: 在数学推理上，CARM 相对几何均值掩码把 AIME 2024/2025/2026 与 BeyondAIME 平均的 mean@16 最多提高 3.13 个百分点；在代码生成上，四个代码基准的平均 pass@1 比最强评估基线高 2.88 点。
Conclusion: 取绝对值的序列级掩码是理论上可证、且在数学推理与代码生成上有效的响应级 off-policy 控制方法，优于几何均值掩码。

papers.title: Mimir: Physics-Grounded LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Irrigation Control
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly combine reasoning, tool use, and action, but most evidence comes from episodic tasks with relatively immediate feedback and reset failures. Long-running physical control operates in a different regime: actions alter future states, errors compound across decisions, and an agent must improve from experience without being allowed to rewrite the physical rules that make execution safe. We study this regime through irrigation, where daily decisions interact with soil-water dynamics over entire growing seasons. We present Mimir, a physics-grounded LLM agent organized around two repair timescales. At the fast timescale, a structured physical interface and deterministic simulator turn an LLM output into a proposal that we numerically check, revise, and subject to bounded deterministic action selection before execution. At the slow timescale, recurrent failure patterns are consolidated into persistent contextual principles that condition future proposals, while the physical model, evaluator, and execution constraints remain immutable. Under a common retrospective evaluator across multiple sites, crops, and years, Mimir attains the lowest reported aggregate control cost among the evaluated references and uses about 51% less irrigation than the historical schedule replay. The ablation study show higher control cost when forward simulation, verified revision, or persistent context is removed; model-scale and model-family studies show no monotonic gain from increasing LLM size. The resulting lesson show that persistent physical agents can combine semantic reasoning with bounded, evidence-driven self-improvement while reserving physical truth and actuator authority for explicit numerical mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mimir 是面向整季灌溉控制的物理约束 LLM 智能体：快时间尺度用结构化物理接口与确定性模拟器对 LLM 输出做数值校验、修订和有界确定性动作选择，慢时间尺度把反复出现的失败模式固化为持久上下文原则，而物理模型、评估器与执行约束保持不可改。在多站点、多作物、多年份的统一回溯评估下，Mimir 取得所评估参考中最低的聚合控制成本，比历史灌溉制度回放少用约 51% 灌溉水量；移除前向模拟、校验修订或持久上下文都会抬高控制成本，增大 LLM 规模无单调收益。
Motivation: LLM 智能体的证据多来自反馈即时、失败可重置的片段式任务；长时程物理控制中动作改变未来状态、误差跨决策累积，且不允许智能体改写保证执行安全的物理规则。
Method: 双时间尺度修复结构：快尺度以结构化物理接口加确定性模拟器把 LLM 输出转成提案，做数值校验、修订，再经有界确定性动作选择后执行；慢尺度把复发失败模式固化为持久上下文原则来约束后续提案，物理模型、评估器与执行约束保持不可变。评估用统一回溯评估器，覆盖多个站点、作物与年份，并做消融与模型规模/家族研究。
Result: 在统一回溯评估器下，Mimir 取得所评估参考中最低的聚合控制成本，比历史灌溉制度回放少用约 51% 灌溉水；消融显示去掉前向模拟、校验修订或持久上下文都会使控制成本升高；模型规模与模型家族研究显示增大 LLM 规模没有单调收益。
Conclusion: 持久物理智能体可以结合语义推理与有界、证据驱动的自我改进，同时把物理真相与执行器权限保留给显式数值机制；单纯堆大模型不带来稳定收益。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Global Coherence: When Every Agent Is Right and the Team Is Still Wrong - A Local-to-Global Semantic Foundation for Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: AI agents can each make locally valid decisions yet jointly produce an invalid result. We call this the global coherence problem: a failure of shared state, not merely of model intelligence. Our Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem gives the exact boundary. A policy can guarantee a valid action exactly when all worlds producing the same observation share an admissible action. If k indistinguishable worlds require pairwise-disjoint actions, the best randomized worst-case success is 1/k; more reasoning, roles, messages, or samples cannot recover the missing distinction. A stronger model can reason better within its context, but it cannot see beyond it. We then give local-to-global runtime semantics X = (H, C, G, F; D): topology H records overlapping scopes; category C governs state-changing actions; groupoid G retains reversible translations; sheaf F tests whether local views glue into one world; and minimal history D keeps only distinctions that alter legal futures. Models propose; the harness owns shared state and governs commit. Nine studies test both the failure and its boundary. On a controlled revision benchmark, the same frontier model scores 40/40 when the deciding event is visible; when it is hidden, tested arms score 12--17/40, consistent with chance (1/3); restoring one authoritative fact returns 40/40. On TeamBench, ordinary teams exceed a shared budget in 5/5 runs, a visible live count leaves 4/5 violations, and commit enforcement leaves 0/5. In tau2-bench Telecom, current-state checks score 0.07 after silent reverts, while the harness scores 1.00. Where a conventional solver already owns the complete relevant state, it ties the harness as predicted. The counterintuitive conclusion is that local intelligence cannot substitute for missing global state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把多智能体各自局部正确但整体失败定义为全局一致性问题，并给出观测混叠不可能性定理：当 k 个不可区分世界要求两两不相交的动作时，随机策略最坏成功率上限为 1/k，更多推理、角色、消息或采样都无法弥补。九项研究验证该边界：决定性事件被隐藏时同一前沿模型在受控修订基准上只得 12–17/40（可见时 40/40），恢复一条权威事实即回到 40/40。
Motivation: 多智能体系统中每个 agent 的决策在局部都成立，合起来却产生无效结果；作者指出这是共享状态的失效而非模型智能不足，需要一个精确的可保证边界。
Method: 提出 Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem，刻画策略能保证合法动作的充要条件（所有产生相同观测的世界共享一个可接受动作）；再给出 local-to-global 运行时语义 X = (H, C, G, F; D)：拓扑 H 记录重叠作用域、范畴 C 管辖状态变更、groupoid G 保留可逆翻译、sheaf F 检验局部视图能否粘合、最小历史 D 只保留改变合法未来的区分，由 harness 持有共享状态并管辖 commit。
Result: 九项研究：受控修订基准上决定性事件可见时同一前沿模型 40/40，隐藏时各测试臂 12–17/40（与随机 1/3 一致），恢复一条权威事实回到 40/40；TeamBench 上普通团队 5/5 次超出共享预算，可见实时计数降至 4/5，commit 强制后 0/5；tau2-bench Telecom 中静默回退后 current-state checks 得 0.07，harness 得 1.00；当传统求解器本就拥有完整相关状态时与 harness 打平。
Conclusion: 局部智能无法替代缺失的全局状态：更强的模型只能在既有上下文内推理得更好，看不到上下文之外；共享状态与 commit 治理必须由 harness 而非模型承担。
Relevance: 2
