summary_sections.conclusion: 局部智能无法替代缺失的全局状态：更强的模型只能在既有上下文内推理得更好，看不到上下文之外；共享状态与 commit 治理必须由 harness 而非模型承担。

papers.title: Relative Transitions, Not Absolute Destinations: A Transfer-and-Ground Framework for Target-Trajectory-Free Human Mobility Generation
papers.abstract_en: Individual mobility trajectories support urban analysis and location-based services, yet most trajectory generators require observations from their deployment city. This assumption excludes precisely the cities where trajectories are unavailable even though points of interest (POIs) and their attributes can be obtained from public maps. We study target-trajectory-free generation: learning from POIs and trajectories in source cities while utilizing only POI coordinates and categories in a target city, with no target trajectory or trajectory-derived statistic available for training, model selection, or generation. Existing trajectory generators typically predict absolute destinations, entangling reusable movement behavior with city-specific POI identities and spatial layouts. Our core insight is to replace this city-bound output with context-conditioned relative transitions. We propose Nomad, a transfer-and-ground framework that separates learning how people move from determining where those movements are realized. Specifically, a history-conditioned flow-matching model learns from source trajectories a transition prior over semantic displacement between POI contexts, geographic displacement, and elapsed time; at inference, a behavior graph and an exploration--return walk ground sampled transitions onto the target POI map. This factorization enables a direct test of representation level transferability without assuming invariance of the full mobility distribution. Extensive experiments across ten cities and 14 transfers show that Nomad outperforms adaptation baselines in trajectory fidelity and downstream utility, lowering the average error over the best baseline of each metric by about 15% in distributional fidelity and about 3% in downstream utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Nomad 做目标城市零轨迹的人类移动轨迹生成：用历史条件 flow-matching 在源城市学 POI 语境间的相对位移先验，推理时靠行为图与探索-返回游走把采样位移落到目标城市 POI 图上。跨 10 个城市 14 次迁移实验中，分布保真度相对各指标最优基线平均误差降约 15%，下游效用降约 3%。
Motivation: 现有轨迹生成器都要部署城市的观测轨迹，而恰恰是缺轨迹的城市只有公开地图 POI；且它们预测绝对目的地，把可迁移的移动行为与城市特有的 POI 身份和空间布局纠缠在一起。
Method: Nomad 框架分两步：历史条件 flow-matching 模型从源城市轨迹学习语义位移（POI 语境间）、地理位移与耗时的转移先验；推理时用行为图 (behavior graph) 与探索-返回游走 (exploration-return walk) 把采样到的相对转移 ground 到目标城市 POI 图，训练与选型完全不用目标轨迹或其统计量。
Result: 在 10 个城市、14 次迁移的实验中，Nomad 在轨迹保真度与下游效用上超过 adaptation 基线：相对每个指标的最优基线，分布保真度平均误差降低约 15%，下游效用平均误差降低约 3%。
Conclusion: 把输出从绝对目的地换成上下文条件的相对转移，可在不假设完整移动分布不变的前提下直接检验表示层的可迁移性，使无目标轨迹的城市也能生成可用轨迹。

papers.title: SPHERE: Adaptive VR Indoor Scene Generation via LLM-Enhanced Spatial Preference Learning and Human-in-the-Loop RL
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) advance 3D indoor scene synthesis, current pipelines fail to retain user-specific preferences across sessions, making immersive authoring a repetitive and physically fatiguing process. We present SPHERE, an adaptive VR generation framework that transforms isolated synthesis into continuous human-AI co-creation. SPHERE extracts persistent spatial preferences from natural multimodal interactions (speech and controller edits). To ensure geometric resilience against spatial distortions, it abstracts these raw edits into hierarchical constraints modeling both local functional and global topological contexts. Furthermore, a human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning mechanism dynamically updates retrieval policies based on the user's final edited scenes. A mixed-design user study ($N=42$) and an offline ablation demonstrate that SPHERE significantly reduces corrective edits and physical demand, preventing bias toward shallow object-level traits to yield geometrically resilient, profile-aligned layouts. Ultimately, SPHERE demonstrates how capturing demonstrated spatial logic enables controlled spatial adaptation, establishing a reliable, governed human-AI collaboration framework for immersive authoring. Project page and source code will be available at: https://github.com/hyeonmin11/SPHERE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPHERE 把 VR 室内场景生成从一次性合成变为人机持续共创：从语音与手柄编辑中抽取持久空间偏好，抽象成分层约束（局部功能 + 全局拓扑），再用 human-in-the-loop RL 依据用户最终编辑场景动态更新检索策略。N=42 的混合设计用户研究与离线消融显示，该框架显著减少纠正性编辑与身体负担，并避免偏向浅层物体级特征，得到几何上稳健、贴合用户画像的布局。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 驱动的 3D 室内场景合成管线无法跨会话保留用户个人偏好，导致沉浸式创作沦为重复且身体疲劳的操作。
Method: 从自然多模态交互（语音与手柄编辑）中抽取持久空间偏好；将原始编辑抽象为分层约束，同时建模局部功能语境与全局拓扑语境，以获得对空间畸变的几何稳健性；再用 human-in-the-loop 强化学习依据用户最终编辑场景动态更新检索策略。
Result: 混合设计用户研究（N=42）与离线消融显示 SPHERE 显著减少纠正性编辑与身体需求，并防止偏向浅层物体级特征，产出几何稳健、贴合用户画像的布局。
Conclusion: 把用户演示的空间逻辑捕获为受控的空间适配，可以建立可靠的、可治理的沉浸式创作人机协作框架。

papers.title: Task-Adaptive Grounded 3D-Programmers Using 2D VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit remarkable generalization and reasoning abilities, yet 3D understanding in these models is limited by data scale, training diversity, and reasoning capacity. Instead of naively extending these models into 3D, we take a different approach: we enable powerful 2D VLMs to operate reliably in 3D by introducing 3D grounding and iterative feedback loops with two novel concepts: Canonical Coordinate Framing (CCF) and Task-Adaptive Feedback (TAF). CCF serves as a unified visual representation that anchors both inputs and outputs to a shared Euclidean coordinate system, solving common challenges in 3D grounding such as axis ambiguity, inconsistent metric scale, and floating references. Complementary to this structured framing of the 3D inputs, TAF closes the reasoning loop with task-adaptive dynamic feedback that enables 2D VLMs to perform varied open-vocabulary tasks within their native visual context. Building on this foundation, we introduce 3D-Prog, a 3D understanding, reasoning, and generation framework that jointly employs the capabilities of CCF and TAF together with powerful VLMs. Without requiring any retraining, 3D-Prog performs open-vocabulary 3D understanding, manipulation, and generation across both object-level and scene-level tasks. Our experiments show that the joint use of CCF and TAF transforms 2D VLMs into geometry-aware 3D programmers, achieving consistent, interpretable, and high-quality results across diverse 3D tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3D-Prog 不重训 2D VLM，而是用 Canonical Coordinate Framing (CCF) 把输入输出锚到统一欧氏坐标系，再用 Task-Adaptive Feedback (TAF) 闭合推理回路，使模型在原生视觉语境下做开放词汇的 3D 理解、操作与生成。作者称 CCF 与 TAF 联合使用把 2D VLM 变成几何感知的 3D programmer，在物体级与场景级任务上给出一致、可解释、高质量的结果。
Motivation: 2D VLM 的 3D 能力受数据规模、训练多样性与推理能力限制，直接外推到 3D 会遇到轴向歧义、度量尺度不一致与浮动指代等 3D grounding 通病。
Method: 提出 CCF 作为统一视觉表示，把输入与输出锚定到共享欧氏坐标系；TAF 提供任务自适应的动态反馈以闭合推理回路。二者与强 VLM 结合构成 3D-Prog 框架，全程无需重训练即可执行开放词汇的 3D 理解、操作与生成。
Result: 实验显示 CCF 与 TAF 联合使用使 2D VLM 成为几何感知的 3D programmer，在多样 3D 任务上取得一致、可解释、高质量的结果；论文含 9 幅图与 11 张表，摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 不改模型权重、只加坐标框架与任务自适应反馈，就足以让 2D VLM 可靠地在物体级与场景级 3D 任务中工作。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Controllable Multi-label Video Safety Detection via Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of video-based social media has increased users' exposure to harmful content, creating a need for reliable automated video safety detection. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show strong video understanding capabilities, existing harmful video detection systems face two key limitations: they typically reduce safety detection to binary classification, overlooking the inherently multi-label nature of unsafe videos, and they rely on static training objectives that do not support controllable precision-recall trade-offs, though the desired operating point may vary across moderation pipelines and unsafe categories. To address these gaps, we propose Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization (ATPO), a reinforcement learning framework for Multi-label Video Safety Detection (Multi-VSD). ATPO introduces the Adaptive Tversky Reward (ATR), which dynamically adjusts false-positive and false-negative penalties during training to enable controllable precision-recall trade-offs. Experiments on SafeWatch-Bench and XD-Violence show that ATPO substantially improves multi-label performance, increasing the Jaccard Index from 40.66 to 75.44 on SafeWatch-Bench-Real. Moreover, ATR enables reliable steering of the precision-recall operating point, supporting deployment scenarios with heterogeneous policy requirements. Code and checkpoints are provided at https://bruceyg.github.io/ATPO-project-page/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把视频安全检测从二分类改成多标签问题，用强化学习框架 Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization (ATPO) 训练，其 Adaptive Tversky Reward (ATR) 在训练中动态调节假阳与假阴惩罚，从而可控地拨动 precision-recall 工作点。在 SafeWatch-Bench 与 XD-Violence 上，SafeWatch-Bench-Real 的 Jaccard Index 从 40.66 提到 75.44，ATR 还能可靠地把工作点推向不同审核策略要求的位置。
Motivation: 现有有害视频检测把安全判定压成二分类，忽略了不安全视频本身是多标签的；训练目标又是静态的，无法按不同审核管线和不安全类别所需的 precision-recall 工作点做调整。
Method: 提出 ATPO：以 Tversky 类奖励作为强化学习目标的多标签视频安全检测 (Multi-VSD) 框架，其中 ATR 在训练过程中动态调整 false-positive 与 false-negative 的惩罚权重，实现可控的 precision-recall 权衡；基于 Vision-Language Model 做视频理解，并公开代码与 checkpoints。
Result: 在 SafeWatch-Bench 与 XD-Violence 上实验：SafeWatch-Bench-Real 的 Jaccard Index 由 40.66 提升至 75.44；ATR 能可靠地引导 precision-recall 工作点，适配异质策略要求的部署场景。
Conclusion: 多标签目标加自适应 Tversky 奖励，可同时抬高视频安全检测的多标签性能并让 precision-recall 工作点可调，从而覆盖不同审核策略的部署需求。

papers.title: On Language Drift during RLVR Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in LLM reasoning models---driven primarily by the paradigm of post-training via reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR)---have enabled them to accomplish impressively complex tasks. However, in parallel with their rising capabilities, LLMs have increasingly displayed signs of language drift in their chains of thought (CoTs): unusual, non-standard, and seemingly nonsensical language use. Although it is well-documented---and can potentially impair CoT monitorability---the causes of language drift are thus far poorly understood. In this paper, we identify the conditions under which language drift occurs: we prove theoretically that RLVR optimization pressure permits unbounded language drift, while supervised fine-tuning does not. We then show empirically that language drift specifically arises during RLVR on novel reasoning tasks---i.e. when the target behavior cannot be drawn out of the base model. Finally, we prove that it is not possible to constrain language drift without constraining expected reward, suggesting that CoT monitorability cannot be improved without harming performance during RLVR post-training at the frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明 RLVR 后训练的优化压力允许思维链语言漂移 (language drift) 无界增长，而监督微调 (SFT) 不会；实证上语言漂移特异地出现在对基座模型无法产生的新推理任务做 RLVR 时。进一步证明：在前沿 RLVR 后训练中，无法在不约束期望奖励的前提下约束语言漂移，即 CoT 可监控性与性能不可兼得。
Motivation: RLVR 推高 LLM 推理能力的同时，CoT 中出现异常、非规范的语言使用，已知会损害 CoT 可监控性，但其成因此前缺乏理解。
Method: 先从理论上刻画 RLVR 与 SFT 的优化压力对语言漂移的约束差异，再实证定位漂移出现的任务条件（新推理任务，目标行为无法由基座模型给出），最后给出约束语言漂移必然约束期望奖励的不可能性证明。
Result: 理论结果一：RLVR 优化压力允许无界语言漂移，SFT 不允许；实证结果：语言漂移在新推理任务的 RLVR 中产生；理论结果二：约束语言漂移必然约束期望奖励，因此 RLVR 后训练中 CoT 可监控性无法在不损害性能的前提下提升。
Conclusion: 在前沿 RLVR 后训练中，CoT 语言可监控性与期望奖励存在根本权衡，不能靠额外约束同时保住两者；漂移的根源是 RLVR 试图引出基座模型本身不具备的行为。

summary_sections.motivation: RLVR 推高 LLM 推理能力的同时，CoT 中出现异常、非规范的语言使用，已知会损害 CoT 可监控性，但其成因此前缺乏理解。
summary_sections.method: 先从理论上刻画 RLVR 与 SFT 的优化压力对语言漂移的约束差异，再实证定位漂移出现的任务条件（新推理任务，目标行为无法由基座模型给出），最后给出约束语言漂移必然约束期望奖励的不可能性证明。
summary_sections.result: 理论结果一：RLVR 优化压力允许无界语言漂移，SFT 不允许；实证结果：语言漂移在新推理任务的 RLVR 中产生；理论结果二：约束语言漂移必然约束期望奖励，因此 RLVR 后训练中 CoT 可监控性无法在不损害性能的前提下提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在前沿 RLVR 后训练中，CoT 语言可监控性与期望奖励存在根本权衡，不能靠额外约束同时保住两者；漂移的根源是 RLVR 试图引出基座模型本身不具备的行为。

papers.title: Atoms to Processes: The Role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Chemical Engineering
papers.abstract_en: The rapid maturation of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) has catalyzed a profound shift in how chemical engineering problems are formulated, analyzed, and solved. Advances in computing, data availability, and learning algorithms have enabled AI/ML methods to impact applications spanning atomic-scale simulations, materials and catalyst discovery, transport and thermodynamics, separations, process systems engineering, and industrial operations. This article provides a perspective on recent methodological developments and representative applications, emphasizing how AI/ML tools are being integrated with first-principles models to address challenges of predictive accuracy, data scarcity, extrapolation, interpretability, and model lifecycle management. Across domains, a unifying trend is the move away from purely black-box approaches toward hybrid and physics-informed frameworks that explicitly respect conservation laws, thermodynamic consistency, and known structural constraints. These approaches not only improve robustness and reliability, but also enable meaningful human-AI collaboration by providing information at an appropriate level of abstraction for the task and decision context. We conclude that AI and ML are not replacing the core principles of chemical engineering; rather, they are amplifying them. As the field advances toward increasingly autonomous, adaptive, and sustainable systems, the thoughtful integration of AI/ML with first-principles understanding and domain expertise will be essential to realizing their full potential across both research and industrial practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇化工领域 AI/ML 综述性 perspective，核心论断是：从纯黑箱模型转向与第一性原理结合的混合、物理信息 (physics-informed) 框架，显式遵守守恒律、热力学一致性与已知结构约束，可同时提升鲁棒性与可靠性，并支撑按任务与决策情境分层的人机协作。作者结论是 AI/ML 并未取代化工核心原理，而是在放大它们。
Motivation: AI/ML 在化工中面临预测精度不足、数据稀缺、外推失效、可解释性差与模型生命周期管理等共性障碍，纯黑箱方法在这些环节上不可靠，需要把领域知识与结构约束重新引入建模流程。
Method: 作为 perspective 文章，综述原子尺度模拟、材料与催化剂发现、传递与热力学、分离、过程系统工程与工业运营等方向的方法学进展，重点讨论 AI/ML 与第一性原理模型的集成方式，以及混合与物理信息框架如何显式嵌入守恒律、热力学一致性和结构约束。
Result: 文章给出定性论断：跨领域统一趋势是从纯黑箱转向混合与物理信息框架，这类方法提升鲁棒性与可靠性，并通过按任务与决策情境提供适当抽象层级的信息来支撑有意义的人机协作；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: AI/ML 不会取代化工核心原理，而是在放大它们；随着系统走向自主、自适应与可持续，AI/ML 与第一性原理理解及领域专长的审慎整合是释放其潜力的必要条件。

papers.title: BranchIP: Learning Adaptive Equivariant Computation for Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract_en: Equivariant machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have revolutionized atomistic modeling, but accurate treatment of complex materials and molecular systems demands expensive models. This limits simulation length- and time-scales, with tensor products a key computational bottleneck. The recent emergence of foundation-scale MLIPs further exacerbates this challenge. We present Branch Interatomic Potential (BranchIP), a single-model framework for learned adaptive tensor product computation, trained with a novel distillation loss. In our experiments on two systems of physical interest, a heterogeneous catalysis system and a proton-conducting solid acid electrolyte, BranchIP accelerates MLIPs across model sizes by up to $2.4\times$ while reducing memory usage by up to $2.6\times$. This is achieved while maintaining physical fidelity. Furthermore, the learned adaptive computation provides model interpretability by revealing which interactions demand deeper computation and showing how computational depth relates to chemical complexity and dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BranchIP 用可学习的自适应张量积计算替代等变 MLIP 中固定深度的昂贵张量积，并用新的蒸馏损失训练单模型框架。在异质催化体系与质子导电固体酸电解质两个体系上，跨模型规模最高加速 2.4×、内存最多降至 1/2.6，同时保持物理保真度；自适应计算还揭示哪些相互作用需要更深计算。
Motivation: 等变 MLIP 处理复杂材料与分子体系需要昂贵模型，张量积是主要计算瓶颈，限制了模拟的长度与时标；foundation 级 MLIP 的出现进一步加剧这一开销。
Method: 提出 Branch Interatomic Potential (BranchIP)：单模型框架，学习对张量积计算做自适应分支/深度选择，用一种新的蒸馏损失 (distillation loss) 训练，使轻量计算路径逼近完整计算。
Result: 在两个物理体系（异质催化体系、质子导电固体酸电解质）上，跨模型规模最高加速 2.4×，内存使用最多降低 2.6×，同时保持物理保真度；自适应计算给出可解释性，显示哪些相互作用需要更深计算以及计算深度与化学复杂度、动力学的关系。
Conclusion: 把张量积深度做成可学习的自适应量，可以在不牺牲物理保真度的前提下同时压缩 MLIP 的时间与内存开销，并顺带提供关于相互作用复杂度的可解释信息。

papers.title: Bellman Meets Lyapunov: Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning via Mastering Chaos
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful paradigm for training agents, yet its success rests on domain expertise of human engineers who design informative reward signals for every new task. Unsupervised RL aims to reduce this engineering with intrinsic motivation (IM): reward signals that emerge from the agent environment interaction itself. Existing IM objectives, however, involve the selection of information variables, which re-introduces domain expertise the field has sought to eliminate. We introduce Forward CIP (F-CIP), an RL-native formulation of the Controllable Information Production (CIP) objective, which is defined by the system's dynamics alone and requires no such selection. We prove that F-CIP is compatible with RL and demonstrate its effectiveness with existing algorithms. Training agents with F-CIP results in unsupervised discovery of primitive behaviors such as balancing and maintaining controllability, which are essential for more complex robot behaviors. Paired with a simple forward-velocity reward, our method produces coordinated gaits such as hopping and running which otherwise require reward engineering to learn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Forward CIP (F-CIP)，把 Controllable Information Production 目标改写为只由系统动力学定义的 RL 原生形式，无需人工挑选信息变量。证明其与 RL 兼容并可直接套用现有算法，训练中无监督发现平衡、保持可控性等原语行为，配合简单前向速度奖励即可学出跳跃与奔跑等协调步态。
Motivation: 内在动机 (IM) 目标需要人工选择信息变量，等于把无监督 RL 想消除的领域专家经验又引入回来。
Method: 给出 CIP 目标的 RL 原生表述 F-CIP，其定义只依赖系统动力学、不含需人工挑选的信息变量；证明与 RL 兼容，并用既有 RL 算法训练智能体，再叠加一个简单的前向速度奖励。
Result: 训练中无监督发现平衡与保持可控性等原语行为；配以前向速度奖励后产生跳跃、奔跑等协调步态，而这些步态通常需要奖励工程才能学到。
Conclusion: 把 IM 目标建立在动力学本身之上，可以去掉信息变量选择这一步人工设计，同时仍能用现成 RL 算法学出复杂机器人行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exploring Weaknesses of Generative Image Watermarks against Latent Frequency Masking
papers.abstract_en: Invisible watermarking has become a central tool for tracing AI-generated images, but its robustness against adaptive removal attacks remains an open security question. We introduce Latent Frequency Masking, an attack that erases watermark evidence by replacing selected Fourier coefficients in the latent representation of a watermarked image. The replacement can be sampled from Gaussian noise for efficiency or derived from diffusion regeneration for improved image preservation. We provide a theoretical distortion bound relating the change between the reconstructed adversarial image and the masked latent-frequency perturbation. We evaluate the proposed attack against six diffusion watermarking methods on images generated from DiffusionDB and MS-COCO prompts. Latent Frequency Masking removes or substantially weakens several watermarks while preserving perceptual quality and achieving favorable runtime compared with existing attacks. These results identify latent-frequency manipulation as a practical attack surface and highlight the need to include such attacks in robustness evaluations of generative image watermarking.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted for publication at IEEE ICDM 2026 conference. The final published version will be available via IEEE Xplore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出针对生成图像隐水印的攻击 Latent Frequency Masking：在带水印图像的 latent 表示中替换选定的 Fourier 系数，替换值可取高斯噪声（省时）或由 diffusion 再生成（保图像质量）。在 DiffusionDB 与 MS-COCO 提示生成的图像上对六种 diffusion 水印方法测试，该攻击在保持感知质量与较优运行时间的同时移除或显著削弱多个水印。
Motivation: 隐水印用于追溯 AI 生成图像，但面对自适应移除攻击的鲁棒性仍是未解的安全问题，现有攻击在图像质量与运行时间上代价较高。
Method: Latent Frequency Masking 在带水印图像的 latent 表示中替换选定 Fourier 系数以抹除水印证据；替换值可从 Gaussian noise 采样以求效率，或由 diffusion 再生成以更好保留图像；并给出一个把重建对抗图像变化与 masked latent-frequency 扰动联系起来的失真理论界。
Result: 在 DiffusionDB 与 MS-COCO 提示生成的图像上对六种 diffusion 水印方法评估：Latent Frequency Masking 移除或显著削弱其中若干水印，同时保持感知质量，运行时间相对已有攻击更有优势。
Conclusion: latent 频域操纵是生成图像水印的一个实际攻击面，鲁棒性评测必须纳入此类攻击。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Counting Moves, Weighing Voices: Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation for Calibrated Multi-LLM Councils under Persistent Adversaries
papers.abstract_en: A multi-LLM \emph{council} lets several large language models (LLMs) deliberate on a question and return an answer together with a confidence estimate. As these systems become increasingly used for reasoning, that confidence should represent a calibrated \emph{probability of being correct}, and the decision should remain robust when some agents are persistently unreliable. Existing \emph{council aggregation} methods fail on both fronts: their confidence estimates measure decisiveness rather than correctness, and they cannot identify or discount persistently unreliable agents. We introduce Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation (BDA), which treats the council's \emph{typed} moves---who proposed, challenged, or conceded which answer---as observations of a classical annotator model with \emph{per-agent} reliabilities. This formulation recasts multi-agent deliberation as a reliability estimation problem, using the deliberation trace to infer agent reliability under persistent adversarial behavior. By weighting evidence according to inferred agent reliability, BDA yields calibrated posterior probabilities over candidate answers while allowing persistently unreliable agents to be inverted rather than merely outvoted. Across binary and multi-class benchmarks, BDA achieves the best calibration among zero-cost council aggregation methods, requiring no additional LLM calls, and improves robustness under persistent adversarial coalitions while remaining competitive in clean settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation (BDA)，把多 LLM 议会中带类型的发言（提出/质疑/让步）当作经典标注者模型的观测，逐 agent 推断可靠性并据此加权，得到校准的候选答案后验概率，使持续不可靠的 agent 被反向计权而非仅被多数票压过。在二分类与多分类基准上，BDA 在零额外 LLM 调用的议会聚合方法中校准最好，并在持续对抗联盟下提升鲁棒性。
Motivation: 多 LLM 议会的置信度实际度量的是果断性而非正确性，且现有聚合方法无法识别并降权持续不可靠的 agent，系统在对抗性成员存在时决策失准。
Method: BDA 把议会议程轨迹（谁提出、质疑、让步了哪个答案）建模为带 per-agent 可靠性的经典标注者模型观测，将多 agent 议事重写为可靠性估计问题，按推断出的可靠性对证据加权，输出候选答案的校准后验概率；聚合过程不增加额外 LLM 调用。
Result: 在二分类与多分类基准上，BDA 在零成本 (zero-cost) 议会聚合方法中取得最好的校准表现；在持续对抗联盟 (persistent adversarial coalitions) 下鲁棒性提升，同时在干净设定下保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 把议事轨迹当作可靠性观测来做贝叶斯推断，可以在不增加 LLM 调用的前提下同时改善校准与对抗鲁棒性，且持续不可靠的 agent 应被反向计权而非仅被多数票淘汰。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把议事轨迹当作可靠性观测来做贝叶斯推断，可以在不增加 LLM 调用的前提下同时改善校准与对抗鲁棒性，且持续不可靠的 agent 应被反向计权而非仅被多数票淘汰。

papers.title: Mem++: Non-Destructive Memory for Long-Term Organizational LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents now take part in organizational work, where many authors record decisions across documents over months. Because a revised decision arrives as a new document rather than an edit, answering a question requires knowing which version held at a given time. However, most memory systems compress the record at write time. By distilling each document into facts, notes or graph edges, these methods fix what can be answered before any question is asked. To address this, we propose Mem++, a non-destructive memory framework shifting from write-time distillation to read-time selection. Mem++ stores every document whole with its date and author, and it calls no generative model at write time. At read time, it retrieves only documents dated up to the time a question asks about and fuses lexical and semantic rankings. Unlike systems that overwrite older versions, Mem++ keeps them and leaves the choice to the answering model. Evaluations on the organizational benchmark OrgMemBench demonstrate that Mem++ surpasses the strongest memory system baseline by 8.0 to 13.1 points across two answering models. With gpt-4.1-mini, it also achieves the best overall score, 2.6 points above RAG. In addition, Mem++ achieves the best average LLM-judge score on LoCoMo and ranks second on LongMemEval-S, behind only its entity-graph variant. Code for benchmark evaluation is available at https://github.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mem++ 把组织级 LLM agent 的记忆从写入时蒸馏改为读取时选择：整篇存档每份文档及其日期与作者，写入阶段不调用任何生成模型，读取时只检索时间不晚于提问时刻的文档并融合词法与语义排序。在 OrgMemBench 上比最强记忆系统基线高 8.0–13.1 分（跨两个答题模型），gpt-4.1-mini 下以 2.6 分超过 RAG 拿到总分第一。
Motivation: 组织文档里决策被反复修订，新版本以新文档而非编辑形式出现，回答“某时刻生效的是哪一版”需要时间感知；而写入时把文档压成事实、笔记或图边的记忆系统在提问前就锁死了可回答范围。
Method: 非破坏性记忆框架 Mem++：写入阶段整篇保留文档、附日期与作者、不调用生成模型；读取阶段按提问时间截断检索集合，再融合 lexical 与 semantic 两种排序，把版本取舍留给答题模型，不覆盖旧版本。
Result: 在 OrgMemBench 上比最强记忆系统基线高 8.0 至 13.1 分，覆盖两个答题模型；配 gpt-4.1-mini 时总分最佳，比 RAG 高 2.6 分；在 LoCoMo 上取得最佳平均 LLM-judge 分数，在 LongMemEval-S 上排名第二，仅落后于自身的 entity-graph 变体。
Conclusion: 把压缩从写入时推迟到读取时，能同时保住历史版本与时间条件下的可答性，作者据此主张非破坏性存档优于写入时蒸馏。

papers.title: Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Small open-weight models (2-9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama whose ten mechanisms compensate point-by-point for small-model failure forms, three of them representative: a byte-level net-zero prefill budget, a finish gate that re-reads the task before accepting completion, and signature-level loop detection. On LRAB, a controlled comparison holding machine, models, budgets, and scoring fixed (4 harnesses $\times$ 4 open models (2B-35B) $\times$ 18 real tasks, deterministic artifact scoring), Mingbird reaches 0.886 overall against 0.631 (goose), 0.479 (opencode), and 0.405 (agent-mini), with all 288 cells published; on $τ^2$-bench (278 tasks, three arms, one protocol) it totals 0.856 against 0.791 and 0.737; and a frontier-model probe on the same 18 tasks spans 0.997 to 0.478 across harnesses, with well-formed scaffolds staying within 0.072 of each other. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation is reported as directional only: same-night replications of the same arm move its mean by up to 0.069, the size of every nominal single-trial delta, and the one batch-matched comparison (full mechanism stack versus text re-read alone) gives the executable completion guards a paired +0.10 across three replications. The evidence carries stated limits: a self-built benchmark, a single machine, and single-trial scoring.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 9 figures. Code, benchmark protocol, scoring code, and all 288 per-cell results: https://github.com/Mingbird/Mingbird-agent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mingbird 是面向 Windows 与 Ollama 的本地优先 agent harness，用十项机制逐条补偿 2-9B 小开放模型的真实任务失败形态（上下文溢出、自我纠错发散、工具示范循环、静默弃任务），代表机制包括字节级净零 prefill 预算、重读任务的 finish gate、签名级循环检测。在 LRAB 受控对比（4 harness × 4 开放模型 × 18 任务，288 格）中总分 0.886，高于 goose 0.631、opencode 0.479、agent-mini 0.405；τ²-bench 278 任务上 0.856 对 0.791 与 0.737。
Motivation: 小开放权重模型可在普通笔记本运行，但在云端规模的 agent harness 下很少真正完成任务：工具 prefill 撑爆上下文、自我纠错发散、工具示范循环、任务被静默放弃。作者认为相当一部分失败来自 harness 而非模型本身。
Method: Mingbird 为 Windows + Ollama 的本地优先 harness，含十项针对小模型失败形态的机制，摘要列举三项：字节级净零 prefill 预算、在接受完成前重读任务的 finish gate、签名级循环检测。评测为单机受控对比加一个第三方基准：LRAB 上固定机器、模型、预算与打分，4 个 harness × 4 个开放模型（2B-35B）× 18 个真实任务，确定性 artifact 打分；另有前沿模型探针与 leave-one-mechanism-out 消融。
Result: LRAB 总分 Mingbird 0.886，对比 goose 0.631、opencode 0.479、agent-mini 0.405，全部 288 格公开。τ²-bench（278 任务、三臂、同一协议）Mingbird 0.856 对 0.791 与 0.737。同一 18 任务上前沿模型跨 harness 得分跨度 0.997 至 0.478，结构良好的 scaffold 彼此差距在 0.072 以内。消融仅作方向性报告：同夜同臂重复实验使均值移动最多 0.069，与所有单次名义 delta 同量级；唯一批次配对比较（完整机制栈 vs 仅文本重读）给出可执行完成护栏配对 +0.10，跨三次重复。
Conclusion: 小模型完成真实任务的失败在很大程度上是 harness 问题，逐点补偿的机制栈能显著抬高完成率；但作者自陈证据限于自建基准、单机与单次打分，消融只作方向性参考。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Weather-Aware Domain Adaptation for Street-View Weather Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Adverse conditions such as rain, snow, fog, and dust remain challenging for camera-based perception in autonomous driving. We study multi-class weather recognition from street-view images under domain shift, where most available training data come from non-street-view sources that differ markedly from real driving scenes. We propose Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA), which conditions the domain discriminator on predicted weather to promote features that are both domain-invariant and weather-sensitive. We also assemble a multi-dataset benchmark by unifying diverse non-street-view weather collections as sources and real street-view images as targets, and define a standardized evaluation protocol with macro accuracy as the primary metric. Across backbones (ResNet-50, EfficientNet, VGG, DenseNet), WA-ADDA consistently improves street-view performance and yields strong per-class recalls in challenging conditions while preserving clear-weather accuracy. These findings highlight the feasibility of domain-adapted weather recognition and the value of our benchmark for advancing robust, on-board perception.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Published in the 2026 IEEE Conference on Technologies for Sustainability (SusTech)
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE Conference on Technologies for Sustainability (SusTech), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADA)，把域判别器以预测的天气类别为条件，使特征同时域不变且天气敏感，用于街景图像的多类别天气识别。在由非街景天气数据集作源域、真实街景作目标域的多数据集基准上，ResNet-50、EfficientNet、VGG、DenseNet 四种骨干下街景性能一致提升，恶劣天气类别召回强且晴天精度保持。
Motivation: 自动驾驶相机感知在雨、雪、雾、尘等恶劣条件下仍不可靠，而可用训练数据多来自与真实驾驶场景差异显著的非街景来源，域偏移使多类别天气识别难以直接迁移。
Method: 提出 WA-ADDA：在 Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation 框架上，将域判别器以模型预测的天气类别为条件，推动学习同时域不变且天气敏感的特征；同时构建多数据集基准，统一多个非街景天气数据集为源域、真实街景图像为目标域，并定义以 macro accuracy 为主指标的标准化评测协议。
Result: 在 ResNet-50、EfficientNet、VGG、DenseNet 四种骨干上 WA-ADDA 均一致提升街景目标域性能，在困难天气条件下取得强的逐类召回，同时保持晴天精度；主指标为 macro accuracy。
Conclusion: 域自适应的天气识别在非街景到街景的迁移下可行，天气条件化的域判别是提升车载感知鲁棒性的有效路径，配套基准可用于推进该方向。

papers.title: From Reasoning Failures to Composable Video Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning benchmarks evaluate vision-language models across diverse tasks, but task-level scores do not reveal which underlying capabilities account for success or failure. Each task requires recovering spatial evidence, representing geometry, and reasoning over it. We disentangle these capabilities by comparing predicted and ground-truth spatial context under a shared schema and coordinate contract. This comparison reveals four recurring sources of error: inaccurate perception, missing information in the spatial context, selection of the wrong measurement, and errors in reference frames or in tracking position and orientation. Guided by this diagnosis, we develop CROSS, a training-free library of typed geometric operators and spatial skills that function over available evidence to support reliable video spatial reasoning. The resulting library supplies verified context to non-coding VLMs or callable skills to a SpatialClaw agent. We evaluate \methodname{} on five benchmarks. \methodname{} raises the average score from 55.9\% to 60.2\% on ReVSI and improves the SpatialClaw result from 62.8\% to 66.3\% on DSI-Bench. These gains demonstrate that explicit handling of spatial conventions can repair systematic reasoning failures without additional training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CROSS 是一个免训练的类型化几何算子与空间技能库，把视频空间推理拆成感知、几何表示、推理三层，在共享 schema 与坐标约定下比对预测与真值空间上下文，定位出四类系统性错误（感知不准、上下文缺信息、选错度量、参考系与位姿跟踪错误）。在五个基准上评测：ReVSI 平均分从 55.9% 提到 60.2%，SpatialClaw 在 DSI-Bench 上从 62.8% 提到 66.3%。
Motivation: 空间推理基准只给任务级分数，无法区分失败来自感知、几何表示还是推理；VLM 在参考系、度量选择与位姿跟踪上存在可复现的系统性错误，且不靠训练难以修复。
Method: 先在共享 schema 与坐标约定 (coordinate contract) 下比对预测与真值空间上下文，诊断出四类错误源；据此构建免训练 (training-free) 的类型化几何算子与空间技能库 CROSS，向非编码 VLM 提供已校验上下文，或向 SpatialClaw agent 提供可调用技能。
Result: 在五个基准上评测：CROSS 使 ReVSI 平均分从 55.9% 升至 60.2%，并把 SpatialClaw 在 DSI-Bench 上的结果从 62.8% 提升到 66.3%。
Conclusion: 显式处理空间约定（参考系、度量、位姿）即可修复视频空间推理的系统性失败，无需额外训练。

papers.title: Can AI Oversight Be Zero Knowledge?
papers.abstract_en: AI systems increasingly produce outputs from confidential data, such as a fitness-for-duty assessment from medical records or the predicted properties of a drug candidate from its secret structure. It is important to verify that such outputs are correct without revealing the underlying data. A recent line of work studies verification of AI outputs via interactive proofs and debate for oracle-aided computation, where correctness may depend on an oracle such as human judgment, a physical experiment, or the web. These works focus on verification by a verifier that runs much faster than the computation. However, such efficient verification is impossible for general oracle-aided computation, and these works therefore rely on additional assumptions. We focus instead on privacy: allowing the verifier to run in time polynomial in the computation, we ask whether interactive arguments for oracle-aided computation can be zero knowledge, so that the verifier learns nothing about the confidential data beyond the correctness of the output. We prove that, in general, they cannot. In the random oracle model, there are no zero-knowledge proofs for all oracle-aided computations, even if both the prover and the verifier are allowed to run much longer than the computation itself. The impossibility extends to debate, a canonical model for scalable oversight. On the positive side, we show that if the oracle attaches a cryptographic signature to each of its answers, then every oracle-aided computation can be verified in zero knowledge with an efficient prover and verifier, assuming only collision-resistant hash functions. Beyond privacy, this also gives an alternative approach to scalable oversight that relies neither on an honest opponent, as in debate, nor on the robustness of the computation, as in prior single-prover protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在随机预言机模型下证明：对一般 oracle-aided 计算不存在零知识证明，即便证明者与验证者运行时间都远超计算本身；该不可能性同样覆盖 debate 这一可扩展监督的典型模型。正面结果是：若 oracle 对每个回答附上密码学签名，则在仅假设抗碰撞哈希函数下，每个 oracle-aided 计算都可被零知识地验证，且证明者与验证者都高效。
Motivation: AI 输出依赖机密数据（如医疗记录、药物秘密结构）时，需要在不泄露数据的前提下验证正确性。已有基于交互式证明与 debate 的工作追求远快于计算的高效验证，但对一般 oracle-aided 计算这不可能，只能附加额外假设。
Method: 在随机 oracle 模型中分析 oracle-aided 计算的交互式论证 (interactive arguments) 的零知识性，允许验证者运行时间与计算规模多项式相关；先给出一般不可能性证明，再构造带 oracle 签名的正面协议，仅依赖抗碰撞哈希函数 (collision-resistant hash functions)。
Result: 证明一般情形下不存在零知识证明：即使证明者与验证者都被允许远超计算本身的运行时间，随机 oracle 模型中仍不存在覆盖所有 oracle-aided 计算的零知识证明，且该不可能性扩展到 debate。正面结果：oracle 对每个回答签名时，所有 oracle-aided 计算均可零知识验证，证明者与验证者高效，仅需抗碰撞哈希函数。
Conclusion: 零知识的可扩展监督在无签名 oracle 时对一般 oracle-aided 计算不可得，签名把问题转为可高效零知识验证；该路径既不依赖 debate 中的诚实对手，也不依赖先前单证明者协议所要求的计算鲁棒性。

papers.title: Comparing a gradient boosting algorithm to the GOES FDC for wildfire detection
papers.abstract_en: Wildfires pose severe risks to human life, ecosystems, and property. This study presents a machine learning approach for wildfire detection from GOES ABI imagery. A CatBoost model was trained on a large dataset with thousands of ABI images and over 300,000 matching VIIRS fire detections. An evaluation on a separate dataset across five regions showed that the learned CatBoost model outperformed the operational GOES Fire Detection and Characterization (FDC) product. It achieved higher precision, recall, and F1 scores both within and outside the training area. The CatBoost model achieved F1 scores that were 0.16 to 0.38 higher than the GOES FDC in all regions. In addition, out of 51 historical fire events, the CatBoost detected 26 fires before both VIIRS and GOES FDC, compared to only six earlier detections by the GOES FDC. Importantly, the CatBoost model achieved accurate wildfire detection also during nighttime, whereas the GOES FDC obtained very low recall values, around 0.03. This study demonstrates that machine learning models may offer significant improvements over existing geostationary fire products, including higher accuracy, fewer false alarms, and earlier detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 CatBoost 直接从 GOES ABI 图像做野火检测，在五个区域的独立测试集上 F1 比业务化的 GOES FDC 产品高 0.16–0.38，且训练区外同样有效。51 起历史火灾中它比 VIIRS 和 GOES FDC 都早发现 26 起（GOES FDC 仅 6 起），夜间 GOES FDC recall 仅约 0.03 而该模型仍能准确检测。
Motivation: 业务化的静止卫星野火产品 GOES FDC 在夜间 recall 极低、漏检多且发现时间晚，需要在训练区外也可靠的替代检测方案。
Method: 以数千张 GOES ABI 图像和超过 300,000 条匹配的 VIIRS 火点检测为标签训练 CatBoost 梯度提升模型，直接从 ABI 影像判别火点；在独立数据集、五个区域上评估，并与 GOES FDC 对比精度、召回、F1 及历史火灾的发现时间。
Result: CatBoost 在全部五个区域的 F1 比 GOES FDC 高 0.16–0.38，训练区内外均取得更高 precision、recall 与 F1；51 起历史火灾中 CatBoost 有 26 起早于 VIIRS 与 GOES FDC 被检出，GOES FDC 仅 6 起更早；夜间 GOES FDC recall 约 0.03，CatBoost 仍保持准确检测。
Conclusion: 机器学习模型可在静止卫星数据上显著改进现有野火产品：精度更高、虚警更少、发现更早，且夜间与训练区外均可用。

papers.title: Continual Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models by Suppressing Cross-Edit Interference
papers.abstract_en: Concept erasure removes copyright-protected, privacy-sensitive, or otherwise undesirable concepts from pretrained text-to-image diffusion models to support content governance and compliance. As erasure requests arrive over time, models must remove new targets without undoing prior erasures. Existing methods do not constrain interference across edits: residual perturbations outside the retain set interact and accumulate, degrading unrelated generations and sometimes collapsing previously erased targets into noise. We propose CEASE (Continual Erasure via Adaptive Subspace Editing), a training-free method that imposes two subspace constraints on a closed-form solver. CEASE adds the token representation of the shared replacement to the solver's invariance matrix and, when interference is detected, projects the current update onto the orthogonal complement of dominant output directions extracted from cumulative past updates. A closed-form decomposition attributes the accumulated interference to repeated activation of the shared replacement and overlap between successive update directions, showing that the two constraints suppress these respective sources. Across continual erasure of celebrities, artistic styles, and instances, CEASE achieves the most consistent erase-preserve trade-off, while existing methods either degrade general generation or insufficiently erase targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CEASE 用两个子空间约束约束闭式求解器，抑制连续概念擦除中各次编辑之间的相互干扰：把共享替换词的 token 表示加入不变性矩阵，并在检测到干扰时把当前更新投影到由历史累积更新主方向张成的正交补上。闭式分解把累积干扰归因于共享替换词的重复激活与相邻更新方向的重叠，两条约束分别压制这两个来源；在名人、艺术风格与实例的连续擦除上给出最一致的擦除-保留权衡。
Motivation: 连续擦除请求到来时，新擦除不能撤销旧擦除，但现有方法不约束跨编辑干扰：保留集之外的残余扰动会相互作用并累积，使无关生成退化，有时让已擦除目标塌成噪声。
Method: CEASE（Continual Erasure via Adaptive Subspace Editing）是 training-free 方法，对闭式求解器加两个子空间约束：把共享替换词的 token 表示并入求解器的 invariance matrix；检测到干扰时，从累积历史更新中提取主输出方向，把当前更新投影到其正交补。另给出闭式分解，把累积干扰归因于共享替换词的重复激活与连续更新方向的重叠。
Result: 在名人、艺术风格与实例三类目标的 continual erasure 上，CEASE 取得最一致的 erase-preserve 权衡，而现有方法要么退化整体生成质量、要么擦除不充分。
Conclusion: 连续概念擦除的干扰可分解为共享替换词重复激活与更新方向重叠两个来源，用对应的两个子空间约束即可同时压制，从而在不训练的前提下维持擦除与保留的平衡。

papers.title: Universal Byte-Level Encoding: UTF-8/UTF-16 Routing to Reduce Cross-Script Token-Budget Disparities
papers.abstract_en: Byte-level byte-pair encoding (BBPE) tokenizers are attractive for multilingual large language models (LLMs) because they cover all Unicode text. In UTF-8-based BBPE, however, many scripts start from a higher fallback cost than English: when no learned merges can be applied, a multibyte character requires multiple byte-derived symbols. We call this worst-case pre-merge cost the encoding floor. A higher floor can increase token counts and per-request cost and shrink usable context. Changing the text encoding can reduce this gap, but a single global encoding can make already-efficient English spans more expensive in mixed-script text. We propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet tokenizer that keeps 1-2-byte UTF-8 characters on the UTF-8 path while routing 3-4-byte UTF-8 characters through UTF-16. This lowers the encoding floor for 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) characters in scripts with high token premiums (token counts relative to English) without raising it for already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. UBE changes only the byte representation presented to byte-pair encoding (BPE); the merge rule remains standard, and exact decoding is preserved. UBE also composes with alternative boundary policies and morphology-based representations. In a Unicode 17 audit, UBE exactly round-trips all Unicode scalar values and all inputs in the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Across intrinsic evaluations, UBE lowers dispersion in English-normalized token-count ratios, reducing cross-lingual token-budget disparity. In multilingual language model (LM) experiments, UBE matches BBPE's LM quality. In the main multilingual settings, UBE reduces token counts most for high-premium scripts and slightly lowers English token counts, yielding more usable context under fixed token budgets and faster prompt processing in content-matched benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE)：保留 1–2 字节 UTF-8 字符走 UTF-8 路径，把 3–4 字节字符改走 UTF-16，从而压低高 token 溢价文字的 encoding floor，且不抬高混合文本中已高效的英文开销。Unicode 17 审计中 UBE 对全部 Unicode 标量值与官方 normalization、grapheme-break、emoji 测试集输入精确往返；跨语言 token-count 比值离散度下降，多语 LM 质量与 BBPE 持平，同时高溢价文字 token 数下降、英文略降。
Motivation: UTF-8 基 BBPE 中许多文字在无可用 merge 时需多个 byte 符号表示一个多字节字符，起始 fallback 成本高于英文，抬高 token 数、按请求计费与可用上下文；单一全局换编码又会让混合文本里本已高效的英文变贵。
Method: UBE 是双字母表 tokenizer：1–2 字节 UTF-8 字符留在 UTF-8 路径，3–4 字节 UTF-8 字符路由到 UTF-16，只改变呈现给 BPE 的字节表示，merge 规则保持标准并保留精确解码；可与替代边界策略和基于形态的表示组合。
Result: Unicode 17 审计中 UBE 精确往返全部 Unicode 标量值以及官方 normalization、grapheme-break、emoji 测试套件的所有输入；内在评测中 English-normalized token-count 比值的离散度下降；多语 LM 实验中 UBE 与 BBPE 的 LM 质量持平；主多语设置下高溢价文字 token 数降幅最大、英文 token 数略降，在内容匹配 benchmark 上带来固定 token 预算下更多可用上下文与更快 prompt 处理。
Conclusion: 只改字节表示、不动 merge 规则，就能在不牺牲英文效率与 LM 质量的前提下缩小跨文字 token-budget 差距，把省出的 token 换成可用上下文。

papers.title: Universal interpolation for deep residual self-attention networks
papers.abstract_en: Universal approximation is a necessary qualitative property of learning architectures to benefit from scaling laws. While it is generically verified on a variety of neural architectures and random feature models, it typically involves infinite width limits. In this work, we focus on deep self-attention models and consider instead the `dual' regime, where approximation power is enabled entirely by depth, and featuring strong parameter sharing across layers, motivated by recent models such as the Looped Transformers. More specifically, we ask whether one can find a predefined finite set of parameters, each defining an attention block, such that the resulting finite set of transformations can map any collection of $N$ sequences of $n$ tokens to any other collection of $N$ sequences of $n$ tokens. Crucially, these transformations are \emph{fixed independently of the input and output} collections: only the order in which the blocks are applied, their signs, and their durations depend on the particular interpolation task. Our main result establishes it for residual softmax attention using only two frozen single-head blocks with Gaussian-initialized projection matrices. The result holds at both continuous and finite depth. We also characterize the restrictions imposed by causal masking and establish corresponding universal interpolation guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明深度残差 softmax 自注意力在纯深度（dual regime）下即可实现通用插值：存在两个冻结的单头注意力块（高斯初始化投影矩阵），其参数与输入输出无关，仅靠块的施加顺序、符号和持续时间就能把任意 N 条 n-token 序列映射到任意目标序列，且在连续深度与有限深度下均成立。因果掩码 (causal masking) 下的限制被刻画，并给出对应的通用插值保证。
Motivation: 通用逼近通常是深度学习架构受益于 scaling law 的必要定性性质，但现有结论多依赖无限宽极限；本文转向由深度而非宽度提供逼近能力、且跨层强参数共享的 regime（受 Looped Transformers 启发），追问有限固定参数集能否完成任意序列到序列的插值。
Method: 研究对象是深度残差自注意力模型的 dual regime：寻找一组预先固定、每个定义一个 attention block 的有限参数，使这些变换与输入/输出集合无关，仅由块的顺序、符号、持续时间随插值任务变化；主结果针对 residual softmax attention，用两个高斯初始化投影矩阵的冻结单头块构造，并分析因果掩码带来的限制。
Result: 主结果：仅用两个冻结单头块即可对任意 N 条 n-token 序列实现通用插值，变换与输入输出无关，结论在连续深度与有限深度两种情形都成立；对因果掩码刻画了其施加的限制并建立相应的通用插值保证。
Conclusion: 深度加参数共享本身足以提供通用逼近能力，无需无限宽极限；逼近能力可由有限的冻结注意力块库配合调度（顺序、符号、时长）实现，因果掩码只限制而非取消这一性质。

summary_sections.motivation: 通用逼近通常是深度学习架构受益于 scaling law 的必要定性性质，但现有结论多依赖无限宽极限；本文转向由深度而非宽度提供逼近能力、且跨层强参数共享的 regime（受 Looped Transformers 启发），追问有限固定参数集能否完成任意序列到序列的插值。
summary_sections.method: 研究对象是深度残差自注意力模型的 dual regime：寻找一组预先固定、每个定义一个 attention block 的有限参数，使这些变换与输入/输出集合无关，仅由块的顺序、符号、持续时间随插值任务变化；主结果针对 residual softmax attention，用两个高斯初始化投影矩阵的冻结单头块构造，并分析因果掩码带来的限制。

summary_sections.conclusion: 深度加参数共享本身足以提供通用逼近能力，无需无限宽极限；逼近能力可由有限的冻结注意力块库配合调度（顺序、符号、时长）实现，因果掩码只限制而非取消这一性质。

papers.title: The Curvature of Regret in Contextual Linear Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Decision-focused learning for linear optimization is complicated by the discontinuity of the optimizer, where small cost errors may leave the decision unchanged or move it to a different vertex. We show that this non-smooth pointwise behavior becomes locally quadratic after averaging over the data distribution, and we derive the curvature in closed form, specifically, a matrix-valued measure supported on the walls of the normal fan. This measure depends only on the feasible set, with the data distribution entering only as a weight. We then offer a tractable approximation for this curvature, computable with just one projection to the feasible set. We prove that the approximation weakly converges to the true population curvature. We offer one application of our findings, a decision-aware scenario generation method for expected-cost linear optimization. Our experiments test the quadratic and weak convergence laws and show a 30.8% regret improvement over uniform allocation on battery arbitrage.
papers.comment: 4 pages main body plus appendix, 3 figures. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on MLxOR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性优化的 decision-focused learning 中，优化器的不连续性在数据分布上平均后变成局部二次型，曲率有闭式解：一个支撑在 normal fan 墙上的矩阵值测度，只依赖可行集，数据分布仅作权重。给出只需一次到可行集投影即可计算的近似，并证明其弱收敛到真实总体曲率；据此提出面向决策的场景生成方法，在电池套利 (battery arbitrage) 上 regret 相对均匀分配改善 30.8%。
Motivation: 线性优化的优化器不连续，小的成本误差要么不改变决策、要么跳到另一顶点，使 decision-focused learning 的损失呈非光滑点态行为，难以刻画与优化。
Method: 先证明点态非光滑性在数据分布上平均后局部二次，并闭式推导曲率——支撑在 normal fan 墙上的矩阵值测度，仅依赖可行集、数据分布只作权重；再给出一次投影即可计算的近似并证明其弱收敛到总体曲率，最后构造面向决策的场景生成方法用于期望成本线性优化。
Result: 实验检验了二次律与弱收敛律；在电池套利任务上，所提场景生成方法相对均匀分配 (uniform allocation) 的 regret 改善 30.8%。
Conclusion: 线性优化中优化器的不连续在分布平均意义下是良态二次的，曲率由可行集的 normal fan 决定，可用单次投影近似并保持弱收敛，进而支撑决策感知的场景生成。

papers.title: Sim+Real: Joint Simulation - Experiment Training Improves Balanced Prediction in Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Simulation and experimental measurements provide complementary data for learning spatiotemporal physical systems, but standard simulation-to-experiment fine-tuning optimizes only the experimental objective after transfer and can degrade simulation performance. We formulate simulation--experiment prediction as a multi-objective learning problem with domain-specific simulation and experimental risks. On four fluid systems from RealPDEBench and two model capacities, we compare Simulation only, Experiment only, Sim$\rightarrow$Exp, and Joint training, evaluating every final model on both held-out domains. Sim$\rightarrow$Exp tends to specialize more strongly to experimental data at the cost of simulation-domain forgetting. Joint training consistently achieves the best balanced performance over a broad range of simulation--experiment evaluation weightings, while substantially improving simulation retention over Sim$\rightarrow$Exp. Joint also better preserves simulation-only fields absent from experimental measurements. Project page: https://mahindrautela.github.io/morph.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把仿真到实验的迁移重写为多目标学习：同时优化仿真风险与实验风险，而不是先在仿真上预训练再只按实验目标微调。在 RealPDEBench 的四个流体系统、两种模型容量上，Sim→Exp 明显向实验域特化并遗忘仿真域，Joint training 在很宽的仿真-实验评估权重范围内都取得最好的均衡表现，且更好地保住了实验测量中缺失的仿真-only 场。
Motivation: 标准的 sim-to-experiment 微调在迁移后只优化实验目标，会牺牲仿真域性能；而实验测量往往缺少部分物理场，需要一个同时兼顾两个域的训练框架。
Method: 把仿真-实验预测形式化为带域特定仿真风险与实验风险的多目标学习问题；在 RealPDEBench 的四个流体系统、两种模型容量上对比 Simulation only、Experiment only、Sim→Exp 与 Joint training 四种训练方式，并在两个 held-out 域上评测每个最终模型。
Result: Sim→Exp 倾向于更强地特化到实验数据，代价是仿真域遗忘；Joint training 在很宽的仿真-实验评估权重范围内一致取得最佳均衡表现，并相对 Sim→Exp 显著提升仿真保持 (simulation retention)；Joint 还更好地保住了实验测量中不存在的仿真-only 场。评测覆盖 RealPDEBench 四个流体系统与两种模型容量。
Conclusion: 仿真与实验应作为两个并列风险联合优化，而非迁移后单边微调；这样才能在不遗忘仿真的前提下利用实验数据，并保留实验测不到的物理场。

papers.title: Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for video generation usually assigns one scalar reward to an entire sampled video. Yet a video is not uniformly flawed: some visual tokens may already satisfy the prompt, whereas others require correction. A scalar reward cannot localize errors, causing optimization to perturb satisfactory tokens while under-targeting the tokens that actually need to change. We introduce Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning, TVRL, a framework that derives token-level credit from the reward being optimized. Our key insight is that the answer likelihood of a frozen vision-language model provides both signals: its outputs contribute to the video-level reward, while magnitudes of its video-input gradients reveal which generated video tokens most affect that score. We instantiate TVRL in Group Relative Policy Optimization by averaging prompt-derived question rewards into one group-relative advantage and using detached, question-conditioned token-credit maps to reweight dense denoising-transition log-probabilities inside the clipped policy ratio. On VBench-2.0, TVRL achieves an Overall score of 57.69, outperforming the base model by 3.60 points. TVRL also improves matched GRPO baselines across three SDE samplers (SAGE, Flow, and Dance) by 2.68--3.15 points and across four reward models (VideoAlign, VideoScore2, UnifiedReward2, and Qwen3.5-9B) by 1.33--3.15 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TVRL 把视频生成 RL 的整段标量奖励拆成 token 级 credit：用冻结 VLM 的答案似然同时给出视频级奖励与其视频输入梯度幅值，定位哪些视觉 token 最影响分数，再以 detached、按问题条件化的 token-credit 图重加权 GRPO 中裁剪策略比内的稠密去噪转移对数概率。在 VBench-2.0 上 Overall 57.69，比基座模型高 3.60 分。
Motivation: 视频生成 RL 通常给整段采样视频一个标量奖励，无法定位错误：本已满足 prompt 的 token 被扰动，真正需要改的 token 反而欠优化。
Method: 从被优化的奖励中派生 token 级 credit：冻结 VLM 的输出构成视频级奖励，其视频输入梯度幅值揭示哪些生成 token 最影响该分数；在 GRPO 中把由 prompt 派生的问题奖励平均成组相对优势，并用 detached、question-conditioned 的 token-credit 图重加权裁剪策略比内的稠密去噪转移对数概率。
Result: VBench-2.0 Overall 57.69，高于基座模型 3.60 分；在 SAGE、Flow、Dance 三种 SDE 采样器上比匹配的 GRPO 基线高 2.68–3.15 分；在 VideoAlign、VideoScore2、UnifiedReward2、Qwen3.5-9B 四种奖励模型上高 1.33–3.15 分。
Conclusion: 标量奖励不足以指导视频生成 RL，用 VLM 梯度幅值把奖励分解到 token 级并重加权去噪转移概率，可在多种采样器与奖励模型上稳定抬升 VBench-2.0 分数。

papers.title: RASteer: Retain-Aware Activation Steering for Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Concept erasure aims to remove a target concept, such as a copyrighted style, a recognizable character, or unsafe content, from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model while preserving its ability to generate other content. Existing activation steering methods build an erasure direction mainly from the target concept and adjust model activations along it at inference time. However, target and retained concepts often overlap in the model's representation space, so this direction also contains shared components that retained concepts rely on. Steering directly along this direction can therefore suppress retained concepts and harm the generation of non-target content. To address this issue, we propose Retain-aware Activation Steering (RASteer), a training-free method. RASteer first builds a retain subspace from the concepts to preserve. Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) then removes components aligned with this subspace from the erasure direction, making steering more specific to the target. Since fully removing the shared components can weaken erasure, we further introduce Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC). At each layer and denoising step, OAC uses the overlap between the erasure direction and the retain subspace to control how much of each shared component is removed, balancing target erasure and concept preservation. Experiments on unsafe-content, instance, and artistic-style erasure across multiple backbones and benchmarks show that RASteer matches or outperforms the activation steering and weight editing baselines we evaluate, achieving a better balance between erasure and preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RASteer 是一种免训练的扩散模型概念擦除方法：先从要保留的概念构造 retain 子空间，用 Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) 从擦除方向中去掉与之对齐的分量，再用 Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC) 按每层每去噪步的重叠程度自适应控制共享分量的去除量。在不安全内容、实例与艺术风格三类擦除任务、多个 backbone 与 benchmark 上，其擦除与保留的平衡达到或超过所评估的 activation steering 与 weight editing 基线。
Motivation: 现有 activation steering 只用目标概念构造擦除方向，而目标概念与保留概念在表示空间中重叠，沿该方向直接干预会连带压制保留概念，损害非目标内容的生成。
Method: RASteer 免训练：先由待保留概念构建 retain 子空间；ROS 从擦除方向中剔除与该子空间对齐的分量，使干预更针对目标；OAC 在每个去噪层与每一步用擦除方向和 retain 子空间的重叠量，控制每个共享分量被移除的比例，以在擦除强度与概念保留之间折中。
Result: 在不安全内容、instance、artistic-style 三类概念擦除上，跨多个 backbone 与 benchmark，RASteer 与所评估的 activation steering 和 weight editing 基线持平或更优，取得擦除与保留之间更好的平衡。
Conclusion: 把保留概念的子空间显式引入激活干预并按重叠度自适应校准，可以在不损伤非目标生成的前提下完成概念擦除；完全移除共享分量会削弱擦除效果，因此需要逐层逐步的折中控制。

papers.title: FastCI: Efficient GPU-Intensive CI for LLM Training Frameworks
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) keep growing in size and complexity, their training frameworks evolve at a rapid pace as well. Therefore, continuous integration (CI) is critical for maintaining the quality and stability of these frameworks. However, unlike traditional software, CI for LLM training frameworks relies on GPU-intensive tests, which usually involve complete model training or evaluation. This leads CI itself to become a new bottleneck for fast-paced development. In this paper, we introduce FastCI, a framework that improves the efficiency of CI for LLM training frameworks. FastCI leverages runtime evidence to select affected tests and prune tests that execute changed code in equivalent contexts. Then FastCI prioritizes high-risk tests to expose potential failures earlier, and optimizes test workloads along dimensions outside the intended validation scope of each test. Evaluated on the CI workload of our LLM training framework, FastCI reduces the CI latency by 77.5% and the GPU resource usage by 63.9%, while improving the modified code coverage retention by 3.2%, compared with the currently deployed CI pipelines. FastCI has now been integrated into the CI pipelines of our LLM training framework at ByteDance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FastCI 用运行时证据挑选受影响测试、剪掉在等价上下文中执行变更代码的测试，再按风险排序并裁剪超出各测试验证目标的工作负载，把 LLM 训练框架的 GPU 密集型 CI 变快。在字节跳动自家 LLM 训练框架的 CI 负载上，CI 延迟降 77.5%、GPU 资源占用降 63.9%，修改代码覆盖率保留率反而提高 3.2%，现已接入其 CI 流水线。
Motivation: LLM 训练框架迭代快，但其 CI 依赖完整模型训练或评估这类 GPU 密集测试，CI 本身成了快速开发的瓶颈。
Method: FastCI 分四步：用运行时证据选择受影响测试；剪除在等价上下文中执行变更代码的测试；按风险对测试排序以更早暴露失败；在各测试既定验证范围之外的维度上裁剪测试工作负载。

papers.title: Counterfactual Auditing of Bias in Open-Source Large Language Models for Clinical Triage
papers.abstract_en: Emergency department (ED) triage is a high-stakes prioritization task in which demographic, socioeconomic, and system-context information may improperly influence acuity assignment. Although open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for local and privacy-preserving clinical decision support, it remains unclear how counterfactual bias varies across model families, sizes, medical-domain models, and domain-adapted models. We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric Emergency Severity Index (ESI) prediction. Starting from real and handbook-style clinical vignettes, we construct paired counterfactual variants that change only one injected demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context variable while holding the clinical presentation fixed. Models include Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a QLoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, MedGemma variants, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B. We measure any counterfactual shift, undertriage, overtriage, shifts greater than one ESI level, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Counterfactual sensitivity varied substantially and did not consistently decrease with larger model size or medical-domain pretraining. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B showed the lowest overall sensitivity, with a 5.27% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.0534, versus 16.02% and 0.1706 for the base model. Several larger or medical-domain models showed more significant shifts. Stratified and correlation analyses further revealed clinically important directionality and shared failure patterns hidden by aggregate rates. These findings support counterfactual auditing as a lightweight, clinically interpretable framework for comparing fairness risks in open-source LLMs before clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 10 个开源 LLM 做儿科急诊 ESI 分诊的反事实偏见审计：只改一个注入的人口学/社会经济/系统情境变量、固定临床表现，测 ESI 分级偏移。QLoRA 微调的 Qwen2.5-7B 敏感度最低（any-shift 5.27%，平均绝对偏移 0.0534），基线 Qwen2.5-7B 为 16.02% 与 0.1706；偏移不随模型变大或医学域预训练一致下降。
Motivation: 急诊分诊中人口学与系统情境信息可能不当影响 ESI 分级；开源 LLM 用于本地隐私保护的临床决策支持时，反事实偏见在不同模型家族、规模、医学域模型间如何变化尚不清楚。
Method: 从真实与手册式临床 vignette 出发构造配对反事实样本，每次只改一个注入变量（人口学、社会经济、医疗可及、行为、社会或系统情境）而固定临床表现；审计 10 个模型，含 Qwen2.5-7B/14B-Instruct、QLoRA 微调 Qwen2.5-7B、MedGemma 变体、MedLLaMA2-7B、GPT-OSS-20B、GPT-OSS-120B，指标为 any-shift、undertriage、overtriage、超过一个 ESI 级的偏移、平均偏移与平均绝对偏移，并做分层与相关性分析。
Result: QLoRA 微调 Qwen2.5-7B 的 any-shift 率 5.27%、平均绝对偏移 0.0534，基线 Qwen2.5-7B 分别为 16.02% 与 0.1706；反事实敏感度在模型间差异显著，且不随模型规模增大或医学域预训练一致下降，若干更大或医学域模型出现更多显著偏移；分层与相关分析揭示聚合比率掩盖的方向性与共享失效模式。
Conclusion: 反事实审计可作为轻量、临床可解释的框架，在部署前比较开源 LLM 的公平性风险；模型规模与医学域预训练本身不能保证更低的反事实敏感度。

papers.title: SIEVE: Selective attention-value Suppression for Vision-Language Models Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: The ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to associate visual identities with biographical information creates a need for selective unlearning of personally identifiable information (PII) while preserving permitted knowledge about the same individual. This setting is challenging because both sensitive and retained information can share the same visual inputs and intermediate representations. We introduce SIEVE, a simple and effective framework for selective VLM unlearning. SIEVE directly regularizes attention-value representations while also controlling model outputs. SIEVE suppresses attention values for forget examples toward a constant zero, while preserving retain-example representations by matching them to a frozen reference model. These objectives are combined with sequence-level forget and retain supervision, enabling targeted forgetting without largely affecting retained knowledge. Extensive experiments show that SIEVE achieves state-of-the-art performance on unlearning with multiple model-modality settings, while maintaining competitive retained utility. Ablation studies further show that value suppression and negative cross-entropy contribute complementary forgetting signals, while reference-based value matching substantially reduces utility degradation. These results demonstrate that attention values provide an effective intervention point for selective multimodal unlearning when sensitive and retained knowledge are closely related.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIEVE 针对视觉-语言模型中敏感与保留知识共享同一图像输入的场景，直接正则化 attention value：把 forget 样本的 attention value 压到常数零，同时用冻结参考模型匹配 retain 样本的表示，并叠加序列级 forget/retain 监督。消融显示 value suppression 与 negative cross-entropy 提供互补的遗忘信号，reference-based value matching 显著降低保留效用损失。
Motivation: VLM 能把人脸等视觉身份与传记信息绑定，删除 PII 时敏感内容与需保留的同人知识共享相同视觉输入和中间表示，常规遗忘方法难以只删其一。
Method: SIEVE 同时正则化 attention value 与模型输出：对 forget 样本把 attention value 抑制到常数零，对 retain 样本用冻结参考模型做 value matching 保持表示，再与序列级 forget/retain 监督（含 negative cross-entropy）组合训练。
Result: 在多种模型-模态设置上达到 state-of-the-art 的遗忘性能，同时保持有竞争力的保留效用；消融表明 value suppression 与 negative cross-entropy 贡献互补的遗忘信号，reference-based value matching 显著减少效用退化。
Conclusion: 当敏感知识与保留知识高度相关时，attention value 是有效的选择性多模态遗忘干预点，且需配合参考模型匹配来守住保留效用。

papers.title: Training-Free Diffusion Planning with Analytical Local Scores
papers.abstract_en: Path finding and multi-robot motion planning require trajectories that are smooth, goal-directed, and collision-free in environments with complex geometric constraints. Recent diffusion-based planners have shown that trajectory generation can be cast as iterative denoising which has opened the doors to learning-based approaches that can handle multi-modal trajectory distributions and refine entire trajectories. However, a key limitation is that diffusion planners require training on large collections of feasible trajectories, rendering them map-specific, and difficult to deploy when high-quality demonstrations are unavailable. This paper introduces a training-free diffusion-based motion planner that replaces learned global trajectory scores with analytical local scores derived from obstacle, smoothness, velocity, and inter-agent feasibility terms. The proposed idea relies on a key observation: the score of a trajectory can be reconstructed by considering only local interactions between neighboring waypoints and nearby constraints. This structure exploitation yields a decomposed denoising procedure that retains the optimization structure of classical trajectory methods while inheriting the iterative refinement behavior of diffusion models. Experiments on a large collection of complex environments and large multi-agent planning tasks show that the proposed analytical score produces smooth and feasible trajectories within limited computational costs, for example in generating feasible paths for 300+ agents in environments containing 100+ obstacles in under 6 seconds on a GPU, outperforming strong learning-based and optimization baselines, while avoiding the data requirements of learned diffusion planners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的扩散式运动规划器，用障碍、平滑、速度与智能体间可行性项构成的解析局部分数替代需要大量轨迹数据训练的全局 score，把去噪分解为相邻路标点的局部交互。在含 100+ 障碍的环境中为 300+ 智能体生成可行路径耗时不到 6 秒（GPU），并优于强学习式与优化基线。
Motivation: 扩散规划器需在大量可行轨迹上训练，导致模型绑定特定地图，且在缺乏高质量示范时难以部署。
Method: 以解析局部分数替换学习到的全局轨迹分数，分数由 obstacle、smoothness、velocity、inter-agent feasibility 四项构成；关键观察是轨迹分数可仅由相邻路标点与邻近约束的局部交互重建，从而得到保留经典轨迹优化结构、同时继承扩散迭代精化行为的分解式去噪过程。
Result: 在大量复杂环境与大规模多智能体规划任务上，解析分数在有限计算开销内生成平滑可行轨迹：含 100+ 障碍的环境中为 300+ 智能体生成可行路径在 GPU 上耗时不到 6 秒，优于强学习式与优化基线，且不需要学习式扩散规划器的数据。
Conclusion: 轨迹分数可由局部约束解析重构，因此扩散式规划能免训练部署并同时保住优化结构与迭代精化能力，摆脱对大规模可行轨迹数据集的依赖。

papers.title: EndoLive: Real-Time Style Transfer for Endoscopic Endonasal Skull Base Surgical Video
papers.abstract_en: Complex surgical procedures around critical anatomy, such as the endoscopic endonasal skull base surgery, requires significant practice and training on the part of the surgeon before they are allowed to perform the operation on a live patient. This training in typically done in cadaveric specimens, due to them containing the same critical structures as a living human. However, cadavers are not a perfect 1-to-1 substitute for a living patient. The dead and preserved tissues of a cadaver are colored completely differently than a living human, and -- without complex and expensive pumping systems -- do not bleed in the same way. As a result, identifying the critical pieces of anatomy that make this procedure so complex can be quite different in a live case than in a surgeon's cadaveric practice. This paper presents EndoLive, a framework for real-time style transfer between cadaveric endoscopic video and living human endoscopic video. Our method combines the ConStructS GAN model for realistic style transfer for surgical applications, with the HyPER-GAN model that can learn complex translations and perform them in real-time. We train EndoLive on unpaired cadaveric and live images taken from an endoscope, and test the trained model with cadaveric video, on a variety of devices. Experimental results demonstrate that EndoLive can perform cadaveric-to-live translation at speeds well above the minimum necessary for real-time, while maintaining semantic consistency of critical anatomical structures. Our source code is available at https://github.com/griffhurt/endolive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EndoLive 把尸体标本的内镜视频实时风格迁移到活体观感，用 ConStructS GAN 的手术风格迁移能力加上 HyPER-GAN 的实时复杂翻译能力，在非配对尸体/活体图像上训练。实验显示其尸体到活体翻译速度远高于实时所需下限，同时保持关键解剖结构的语义一致性。
Motivation: 内镜经鼻颅底手术只能在尸体标本上练习，但尸体组织颜色与活体完全不同、且不会自然出血，导致术中识别关键解剖结构与尸练时差异很大。
Method: 结合 ConStructS GAN（手术场景风格迁移）与 HyPER-GAN（可学习复杂翻译并实时执行），在内镜拍摄的非配对尸体与活体图像上训练，再用多种设备上的尸体视频测试。
Result: 实验表明 EndoLive 的尸体到活体翻译速度远高于实时所需的最低速度，同时保持关键解剖结构的语义一致性；源码发布于 github.com/griffhurt/endolive。
Conclusion: 实时风格迁移可以在不牺牲解剖语义的前提下把尸练视频改造成接近活体的观感，从而缩小尸体练习与真实手术之间的视觉差距。

papers.title: Do Your Own Research: Learning to Forecast by Learning to Search
papers.abstract_en: Outcome-based reinforcement learning can train language models to forecast real-world events, but prior forecasting work either freezes research context before training or deploys agentic research only at test time, so the skill of gathering evidence is never shaped by the reward. We introduce an agentic forecasting environment, dataset, and harness built from 2,100+ resolved Polymarket questions; the agent acquires its own context at rollout time (web search, page reading, and financial time series, all restricted by layered leak filtering to information published before each question's cutoff), and we train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (3B active parameters) on it with single-epoch GRPO under a Brier-score reward. Training changes how the agent interacts with information: calibration improves 30-40%, and search attempts fall from 3.8 to 2.25 per rollout as evidence discipline is learned. Evaluated in an identical harness against four frontier models, the trained policy also finishes ahead of every frontier model tested at evidence-based forecasting, including Claude Opus 4.5 (soft-Brier 0.254 vs. 0.256, n=265), at about 5% of the inference cost, and its margin is widest on the hardest questions, the ones the crowd itself had not decided. We release the environment, dataset, and per-rollout records as a reusable harness for temporal forecasting agents.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建基于 2,100+ 已结算 Polymarket 问题的智能体预测环境，让 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（3B 激活参数）在 rollout 时自行搜集证据（网页搜索、页面阅读、金融时间序列，经分层泄漏过滤限制在题目截止时间之前），并用 GRPO 以 Brier 分数为奖励单轮训练。训练后校准提升 30-40%，每次 rollout 搜索次数从 3.8 降到 2.25；在相同 harness 下对四个前沿模型的证据式预测中领先，soft-Brier 0.254 对 Claude Opus 4.5 的 0.256（n=265），推理成本约为其 5%，且在人群尚未形成共识的最难问题上优势最大。
Motivation: 既有基于结果奖励的事件预测工作要么在训练前冻结研究上下文，要么只在测试时启用智能体研究，搜集证据的能力从未被奖励塑造。
Method: 提出 agentic forecasting 环境、数据集与 harness，由 2,100+ 已结算 Polymarket 问题构成；agent 在 rollout 时自主获取上下文（web search、页面阅读、金融时间序列），并用分层泄漏过滤 (leak filtering) 限定为题目截止前发布的信息。以单轮 GRPO 训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（3B 激活参数），奖励为 Brier 分数。
Result: 校准提升 30-40%，每次 rollout 搜索次数从 3.8 降至 2.25。在相同 harness 下对四个前沿模型评测，训练后策略在证据式预测上领先全部受测前沿模型：soft-Brier 0.254 vs Claude Opus 4.5 的 0.256（n=265），推理成本约为其 5%，在人群尚未决定的最难问题上差距最大。
Conclusion: 让预测智能体在训练中就学会搜集证据，可以同时改善校准、减少冗余搜索，并以约 5% 的推理成本在事件预测上超过前沿模型；环境、数据集与逐 rollout 记录作为可复用的 temporal forecasting harness 发布。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Sharp Non-Asymptotic Analysis of the Penalized Challenger in $β$-EB-TCI for Bernoulli Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Top-two algorithms are simple and effective for fixed-confidence best-arm identification, but their sharp non-asymptotic behavior is still not well understood. We study this problem for Bernoulli bandits through $β$-EB-TCI, the empirical-best top-two rule of Jourdan et al., whose challenger is chosen using a Bernoulli transportation cost with a logarithmic count penalty. We prove that, after the empirical leader has become the true best arm and its sampling fraction stays close to $β$, the stopping time is $T_β^{\star}(μ)\log(1/δ)$ up to lower-order concentration terms. We also show that, in this regime, every challenger is sampled linearly often. Thus, for the original algorithm without forced exploration, the main remaining difficulty is to control when the empirical leader becomes permanently correct. These results imply a non-asymptotic high-probability bound for all Bernoulli instances with a unique best arm. If the algorithm satisfies a finite-mean sufficient-exploration condition, the bound further yields the sharp expected sample complexity. In particular, this gives the sharp expectation result for the unguarded Bernoulli rule when all arm means are pairwise distinct, using the sufficient-exploration result of Jourdan et al. Finally, if we add a mild forced-exploration rule that contributes only $O(\sqrt{Kt})$ pulls up to time $t$, we obtain a self-contained expected sample-complexity theorem for any number of arms under the unique-best-arm assumption. We also identify a limitation of proof strategies that try to handle equal suboptimal means through a single index-comparison argument.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Bernoulli bandit 的经验最优 Top-two 算法 β-EB-TCI 给出尖锐非渐近分析：一旦经验领先者成为真最优臂且采样份额稳定在 β，停止时间在低阶集中项之外等于 T*_β(μ)log(1/δ)，且每个 challenger 都被线性次数采样。加上仅贡献 O(√(Kt)) 次拉动的温和强制探索后，可在任意臂数、唯一最优臂假设下得到自足的期望样本复杂度定理。
Motivation: Top-two 算法在固定置信度最优臂识别 (best-arm identification) 中简单有效，但其尖锐非渐近行为仍不清楚；原算法无强制探索时，核心难点在于控制经验领先者何时永久正确。
Method: 研究 Jourdan et al. 的经验最优 Top-two 规则 β-EB-TCI，其 challenger 由带对数计数惩罚的 Bernoulli transportation cost 选取；在经验领先者已正确且采样份额接近 β 的体制下分析停止时间，并引入仅贡献 O(√(Kt)) 拉动的强制探索规则。
Result: 停止时间为 T*_β(μ)log(1/δ)（至低阶集中项），体制内每个 challenger 被线性采样；对所有唯一最优臂的 Bernoulli 实例给出非渐近高概率界；在有限均值充分探索条件下进一步得到尖锐期望样本复杂度，包括臂均值两两互异时无保护 Bernoulli 规则的尖锐期望结果；并指出用单一 index-comparison 论证处理等值次优臂的证明策略存在局限。
Conclusion: β-EB-TCI 的主要剩余困难是经验领先者永久正确的时间点，配合 O(√(Kt)) 强制探索即可在任意臂数下自足地得到尖锐期望样本复杂度；等值次优均值需要新的证明思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Hybrid Approach to Malware Detection: Integrating Few-Shot Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning with Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Ransomware has emerged as a major cybersecurity threat, with incidents increasing in frequency and impact across critical sectors. These attacks are typically launched through phishing emails, malicious downloads, or exploitation of software vulnerabilities to gain system access. Once inside, the malware encrypts files and demands a ransom, often in cryptocurrency, for the decryption key. Conventional detection methods often struggle with novel or scarce samples, leaving systems vulnerable. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid deep learning framework that combines an Autoencoder Feature Extractor (AFE) with a Model Agnostic Meta Learning (MAML) classifier for few shot malware detection. The AFE generates compact latent features that reduce noise and dimensionality, while the MAML classifier rapidly adapts to new threats using limited labeled data. Experiments conducted on the Ransomware Dataset 2024 demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework in binary classification tasks. Across one to fifty shot settings, the proposed model consistently achieves high accuracy, F1 score, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient values, maintaining reliable classification even under extreme scarcity. These results highlight the model's robustness and effectiveness in adapting to limited data scenarios, demonstrating the potential of combining feature extraction with meta learning to enhance resilience against malware, particularly in sectors such as healthcare, manufacturing, and public infrastructure, where cyberattacks can cause significant operational and financial disruption.
papers.comment: Accepted at 2025 Cyber Awareness and Research Symposium (CARS). This is the author's accepted manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AFE+MAML 混合框架做少样本勒索软件检测：Autoencoder Feature Extractor 先把原始特征压成低噪紧凑隐表示，MAML 分类器再在 1–50 shot 的少量标注下快速适配新威胁。在 Ransomware Dataset 2024 的二分类任务上，从 1 shot 到 50 shot 全程保持高 accuracy、F1 与 MCC，极端稀缺标注下仍可靠。
Motivation: 勒索软件通过钓鱼邮件、恶意下载和漏洞利用进入系统，新型或样本稀缺的恶意软件让传统检测方法失效，医疗、制造、公共基础设施等关键部门因此暴露在运营与财务风险中。
Method: 混合深度学习框架：Autoencoder Feature Extractor (AFE) 生成紧凑隐特征以降噪降维，Model Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) 分类器在有限标注上快速适应新威胁；在 Ransomware Dataset 2024 上做 1 到 50 shot 的二分类实验。
Result: 在 Ransomware Dataset 2024 二分类任务上，1 至 50 shot 设置下模型持续取得高 accuracy、F1 score 与 Matthews Correlation Coufficient (MCC)，在极端标注稀缺条件下仍保持可靠分类表现。
Conclusion: 特征提取与元学习结合能在极少标注下支撑勒索软件检测，对医疗、制造、公共基础设施等关键部门的抗攻击韧性有直接价值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Latent JEPA: Abstract Future Prediction for Latent Reasoning in Chemistry
papers.abstract_en: Large language models offer a promising foundation for chemical reasoning, bringing together chemical knowledge and multistep problem solving. Chemical intuition can provide an initial sense of plausible outcomes before the details of a solution are fully worked out. Inspired by how such expectations complement explicit analysis, we study how continuous latent thoughts can be trained to anticipate informative aspects of future solutions without verbalizing every intermediate step. We introduce Latent JEPA, a framework that combines autoregressive learning with joint-embedding prediction of one or more future views. For chemical reasoning, we develop textual and molecular prediction objectives that connect latent thoughts to both subsequent reasoning and molecular outcomes. Experiments on ChemCoTBench show gains in molecular optimization and on several editing and reaction metrics. Representation analyses show that future prediction makes latent thoughts more informative about molecular outcomes and strengthens their correspondence with chemical structure. These findings support abstract future prediction as a learning principle for connecting continuous latent reasoning with scientific outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Latent JEPA 把自回归学习与联合嵌入预测 (joint-embedding prediction) 结合，让连续 latent thought 在不逐字写出中间步骤的情况下预判未来解的多个视图，并配文本与分子两类预测目标。在 ChemCoTBench 上，该框架在分子优化以及若干编辑与反应指标上取得增益，表征分析显示未来预测使 latent thought 更能反映分子结果并与化学结构更对应。
Motivation: 化学推理需要多步求解，逐步用文字写出中间推理既冗长又难以把隐式化学直觉与最终分子结果对齐；作者要让连续 latent thought 直接预判未来解中有信息量的部分。
Method: 提出 Latent JEPA 框架，将自回归学习与对一个或多个未来视图的联合嵌入预测结合；针对化学推理设计文本预测目标与分子预测目标，把 latent thought 同时连到后续推理与分子结果，并辅以表征分析检验 latent thought 与分子结果、化学结构的对应关系。
Result: 在 ChemCoTBench 上，Latent JEPA 在分子优化以及若干编辑 (editing) 与反应 (reaction) 指标上取得增益；表征分析显示未来预测让 latent thought 对分子结果更具信息量，并强化其与化学结构的对应。
Conclusion: 抽象未来预测 (abstract future prediction) 可作为把连续 latent 推理与科学结果相连的学习原则，在化学推理上同时改善生成指标与表征质量。

papers.title: Anti-Persona: Disrupting Unauthorized Identity Binding and Recognition in Personalized Vision--Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot personalization enables large vision--language models (LVLMs) to learn user-specific visual concepts for applications such as personalized retrieval and subject-aware querying. However, it also creates a privacy risk: an adversary can bind a target identity from a few reference images and subsequently detect that identity in new images through natural-language queries. We introduce Anti-Persona, an image-level defense against unauthorized identity binding and recognition in personalized LVLMs. Our key insight is that identity personalization relies on visual features shared across multiple reference images. We aggregate these features into an identity prototype and optimize visually subtle perturbations that disrupt prototype alignment in the vision-encoder space. Spatial smoothing and low-frequency preservation further promote visual fidelity and practical resilience to image compression. The resulting protection does not depend on a specific prompt and supports both proactive anti-personalization and reactive image protection. Experiments on two representative personalized LVLMs demonstrate protection rates of up to $95.0\%$ while preserving visual fidelity. The method remains stable across prompt variations and evaluated identity-query tasks, and improves black-box transfer under encoder mismatch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Anti-Persona 是针对个性化视觉-语言模型 (LVLM) 的图像级防御：把多张参考图共享的视觉特征聚合成 identity prototype，再优化视觉上细微的扰动破坏 vision-encoder 空间中的原型对齐，并用空间平滑与低频保持维持视觉保真和对压缩的鲁棒性。在两个代表性个性化 LVLM 上保护率最高达 95.0%，且不依赖特定 prompt，可同时支持主动反个性化与被动图像保护。
Motivation: 少样本个性化让 LVLM 学到用户特定视觉概念，但也带来隐私风险：攻击者只需少量参考图即可绑定目标身份，并用自然语言查询在新图中检出该身份，现有个性化流程缺少图像侧防御。
Method: 在图像层面注入优化得到的细微扰动：先将多张参考图共享的视觉特征聚合为 identity prototype，再以破坏 vision-encoder 空间中的原型对齐为目标做扰动优化；加入空间平滑与低频保持约束以维持视觉保真并抵抗图像压缩。
Result: 在两个代表性个性化 LVLM 上，保护率最高达 95.0%，同时保持视觉保真；方法在不同 prompt 变化与所评测的身份查询任务上表现稳定，并在 encoder 不匹配时改善黑盒迁移。
Conclusion: 身份个性化依赖跨参考图共享的视觉特征，破坏原型对齐即可在不绑定特定 prompt 的前提下同时支持主动反个性化与被动图像保护，并具备跨 encoder 的黑盒迁移能力。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 在两个代表性个性化 LVLM 上，保护率最高达 95.0%，同时保持视觉保真；方法在不同 prompt 变化与所评测的身份查询任务上表现稳定，并在 encoder 不匹配时改善黑盒迁移。
summary_sections.conclusion: 身份个性化依赖跨参考图共享的视觉特征，破坏原型对齐即可在不绑定特定 prompt 的前提下同时支持主动反个性化与被动图像保护，并具备跨 encoder 的黑盒迁移能力。

papers.title: Latent-Foresight: End-to-End Learning Predictable Representations for Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the future evolution of a scene is a fundamental capability for world modeling. Recent work has shown that operating in the feature space of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) yields semantically rich representations that support diverse future scene understanding tasks. However, existing approaches rely on two-stage pipelines, where VFM features are first compressed using fixed dimensionality reduction (e.g., PCA) or independently trained autoencoders, and a separate predictor is trained on top of the resulting frozen latent space. This decoupling between representation learning and temporal prediction, as well as approaches that apply predictors directly on raw VFM features, provides no guarantee that the latent space is structured for predictable dynamics. In this work, we propose Latent-Foresight, an end-to-end framework that jointly learns a latent tokenizer and a flow-based generative dynamics model, explicitly shaping the representation to support temporal predictability. To enable stable joint optimization, we introduce several key design choices that prevent latent collapse and align reconstruction with generative objectives. Extensive experiments show that our approach learns more temporally coherent latent representations and consistently outperforms two-stage baselines across multiple future scene understanding tasks and prediction horizons, while eliminating separate training stages, including during high-resolution adaptation. We provide the implementation code and model weights at https://github.com/Sta8is/Latent-Foresight
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Latent-Foresight 把 VFM 特征压缩与未来预测拆成两阶段的做法改为端到端联合学习：同时训练 latent tokenizer 与 flow-based 生成式动力学模型，用防 latent collapse 的设计把表示直接塑造成可预测的。在多个未来场景理解任务与不同预测时程上，其表示时间一致性更强并持续优于两阶段基线，且省去独立训练阶段，高分辨率适配时同样成立。
Motivation: 现有方法先用固定降维 (PCA) 或独立训练的 autoencoder 压缩 VFM 特征，再在冻结 latent 空间上另训 predictor，表示学习与时间预测解耦，latent 空间没有被保证适合可预测动力学；直接在原始 VFM 特征上跑 predictor 也无此保证。
Method: 端到端联合学习一个 latent tokenizer 和一个 flow-based 生成式动力学模型，显式塑造表示以支持时间可预测性；引入若干设计选择保证联合优化稳定，防止 latent collapse 并让重建目标与生成目标对齐。
Result: 在多个未来场景理解任务与多个预测时程上，学到的 latent 表示时间一致性更强，并持续优于两阶段基线，同时消除独立训练阶段，高分辨率适配阶段同样如此；实现代码与模型权重在 github.com/Sta8is/Latent-Foresight 公开。
Conclusion: 表示学习与时间预测应当联合优化而非解耦，把 latent 空间直接塑造成可预测的即可在不增加训练阶段的前提下超过冻结 latent 的两阶段管线。
Relevance: 36
