papers.title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PyRUA-Lean 用交互式代码执行替代工具调用：让 GPT-6 Astra 把经典机器人原语与 VLA 策略组合成带条件判断和局部重试的 Python cell，并只返回显式请求的图像与状态反馈。在 700 个 LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365 仿真任务上，同等 LLM 调用预算下总成功率从 63.1% 升到 71.7%，双方都解出的实例上少用 49% LLM 调用与 65% 输入 token。
Motivation: VLM 机器人智能体靠视觉反馈与动作原语闭环控制，但反复调用模型和冗余观测带来大量 token 开销，同等预算下成功率受限。
Method: 提出交互式代码执行框架 PyRUA-Lean：反馈驱动的原语组合 (feedback-driven primitive composition) 加选择性观测 (selective observation)，智能体把经典机器人原语与学习到的 vision-language-action (VLA) 策略写成 Python cell，内含条件检查与局部重试，只回传显式请求的图像和状态反馈供重规划；对照组是同一 GPT-6 Astra planner 与同一底层原语的 tool-calling 基线。
Result: 在 700 个仿真任务实例（LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365）上，同等 LLM 调用预算下总成功率由 63.1% 提升至 71.7%；在两个智能体都解出的实例上，PyRUA-Lean 少用 49% 的 LLM 调用与 65% 的输入 token。
Conclusion: 把条件逻辑与重试下沉到可执行代码、并只取需要的观测，能在相同 LLM 调用预算下同时提高机器人任务成功率并大幅削减 token 与调用开销。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A rubric landscape for evaluating clinical reasoning in large language models: what exists, what is missing, and what needs to be combined
papers.abstract_en: Exam-style accuracy does not establish whether large language models (LLMs) reason well over clinical records. We define clinical reasoning as integrating and updating evidence across time and sources to form, revise and justify a patient's problem representation and a defensible plan. This structured narrative review maps three literatures: medical education assessment instruments, clinical LLM benchmarks published from 2023 onwards, and general-domain methods for evaluating long-form generation. We examine six dimensions: problem representation, temporal synthesis, differential and management reasoning, counterfactual reasoning, calibrated uncertainty, and reasoning faithfulness. Preprints are included and flagged. No single instrument covers all six dimensions. Problem representation and differential or management reasoning are reasonably covered, although reliability varies by instrument and setting. TIMER-Eval targets temporal synthesis, and ER-Reason assesses sequential diagnostic belief updating. Dedicated uncertainty and counterfactual evaluations are emerging, but their applicability to longitudinal free-text reasoning remains limited. Factual completeness is well theorised in general-domain evaluation, with early clinical evidence of important omissions. Faithfulness remains the weakest dimension, with one identified clinical causal-ablation study on multiple-choice questions. Existing tools should be combined through binary rubric items, separate completeness and correctness scores, case-specific importance weighting with non-compensable safety caps, temporal order-consistency checks, and chance-corrected reliability reporting. Further design work is needed for calibrated uncertainty, counterfactual reasoning and faithfulness over longitudinal free-text records. This review provides a design rationale, not a validated instrument.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇结构化叙述性综述，把医学教育评估量表、2023 年起的临床 LLM benchmark 与通用长文本生成评测三条文献线映射到临床推理的六个维度（问题表征、时间综合、鉴别与管理推理、反事实、校准不确定性、推理忠实性），结论是没有任何单一工具覆盖全部六维。作者主张把现有工具组合成二元评分项、分离完整性与正确性分数、按病例重要性加权并设不可补偿的安全上限、加时序一致性检查与机会校正信度报告；校准不确定性、反事实与纵向自由文本忠实性仍需设计工作。
Motivation: 考试式准确率不能证明 LLM 能在跨时间、跨来源的临床记录上整合与更新证据；现有临床 LLM 评测工具分散在三条文献里，各自只覆盖部分维度，无法支撑对纵向病历推理的完整判断。
Method: 结构化叙述性综述，映射三类文献：医学教育评估工具、2023 年起发表的临床 LLM benchmark（含预印本并标注）、通用长文本生成评测方法；按六个维度逐一盘点覆盖与信度，并提出组合设计原则（二元 rubric 项、完整性/正确性分列、病例级重要性加权与不可补偿安全上限、时序一致性检查、机会校正信度）。
Result: 无单一工具覆盖全部六维；问题表征与鉴别/管理推理覆盖尚可但信度随工具与场景波动；TIMER-Eval 针对时间综合，ER-Reason 评估序贯诊断信念更新；不确定性与反事实评测尚在萌生且对纵向自由文本适用性有限；忠实性最弱，仅识别出一项针对多选题的临床因果消融研究；通用域事实完整性理论成熟，临床已有重要遗漏的早期证据。
Conclusion: 作者明确给出的是设计依据 (design rationale) 而非经过验证的量表；校准不确定性、反事实与纵向自由文本上的忠实性是需要进一步设计工作的三个缺口。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Graph Representation via Elements of Discrete Morse and Cobordism Theories
papers.abstract_en: Topology is, by its nature and design, suited to structure that is nonlinear, multiscale, and nonstationary - however, within machine learning, its use remains largely confined to topological data analysis. We advocate that tools from low-dimensional topology which have remained almost exclusively contained within the domain of pure mathematics (such as Morse theory) offer a strong, complementary, and yet virtually unexplored perspective on the hidden structure of data-generating processes and learning tasks built upon them. Here we introduce concepts from cobordism theory and harness tools from discrete Morse theory to improve the performance of graph diffusion models through our pipeline MG-Diff. Further, we derive theoretical guarantees and sufficient conditions so that under a positive decision-gap, the Morse-theoretic tools and their application for induced diffusion guidance are stable under small perturbations. Finally, we illustrate the utility of discrete Morse theory in application to graph diffusion models for spatio-temporal graph forecasting and graph regeneration, and argue that these applications are only a small window into the part of what low-dimensional topology can offer to the field of machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MG-Diff 管线，把配边理论 (cobordism) 与离散 Morse 理论 (discrete Morse theory) 引入图扩散模型，用 Morse 结构引导扩散过程以改进图生成质量。在正的 decision-gap 下，作者推导出 Morse 工具及其诱导的扩散引导对小扰动保持稳定的充分条件与理论保证。该方法在时空图预报 (spatio-temporal graph forecasting) 与图再生任务上得到演示。
Motivation: 拓扑在机器学习中的应用基本局限于 TDA，低维拓扑中的 Morse 理论等工具几乎未被用于刻画数据生成过程与学习任务的隐藏结构，图扩散模型缺少这类结构性引导。
Method: 构建 MG-Diff 管线：引入配边理论概念、用离散 Morse 理论工具对图扩散模型施加诱导式扩散引导 (induced diffusion guidance)；同时推导理论保证，给出在正 decision-gap 下 Morse 工具与引导对小扰动稳定的充分条件。
Result: 在时空图预报与图再生任务上演示了离散 Morse 理论对图扩散模型的效用；并证明在正 decision-gap 条件下 Morse 理论工具及其诱导扩散引导对小扰动稳定。
Conclusion: 低维拓扑（Morse 与配边理论）可作为 TDA 之外的互补视角改进图扩散模型，且其引导机制在正 decision-gap 下具备扰动稳定性；作者认为这些应用只是低维拓扑对机器学习潜力的一小部分。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Mapping the RAG Landscape: A Four Axis Taxonomy of Efficiency, Defense, Interactivity, and Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable fluency across many tasks but remain limited by their static, parameter bound knowledge and their susceptibility to hallucinating information. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses these issues by incorporating external retrieval into the generation process, grounding model outputs in verifiable and up to date sources. While prior surveys primarily focus on core RAG architectures and standard pipelines, recent research explores broader challenges and capabilities that extend beyond these foundational designs. This survey provides a consolidated and structured examination of contemporary RAG developments, organizing the field into a four axis taxonomy: improving retrieval efficiency, strengthening robustness and security, supporting user driven and interactive workflows, and enabling multi step or complex reasoning. We formalize key components of the RAG framework and review methods spanning dense and sparse retrieval, fusion strategies, embedding optimizations, and reinforcement learning based retrieval policies, highlighting how these advances influence practical deployment and system design. We also synthesize evaluation practices, domain specific applications, and architectural variants such as Naive, Advanced, and Modular RAG. Finally, we outline persistent challenges related to retrieval quality, reliability, domain adaptation, scalability, and explainability, and identify opportunities for building RAG systems that are more reliable, adaptable, and transparent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 RAG 综述，把检索增强生成整理成四轴分类法：检索效率、鲁棒性与安全、用户驱动的交互式工作流、多步复杂推理。综述形式化了 RAG 框架的关键组件，覆盖稠密与稀疏检索、融合策略、embedding 优化和基于强化学习的检索策略，并综合评估实践、领域应用与 Naive/Advanced/Modular RAG 架构变体。
Motivation: 既有 RAG 综述多聚焦核心架构与标准流水线，而检索效率、安全性、交互性与复杂推理这些超出基础设计的挑战缺少统一的结构化梳理。
Method: 提出四轴分类法并形式化 RAG 框架关键组件；按轴综述稠密/稀疏检索、fusion 策略、embedding 优化、基于 RL 的检索策略，以及 Naive、Advanced、Modular RAG 等架构变体，同时综合评估实践与领域应用。
Result: 给出四轴分类法与 RAG 组件的形式化，归纳检索质量、可靠性、领域适配、可扩展性、可解释性等持续挑战，并指出构建更可靠、可适配、更透明的 RAG 系统的机会；摘要未含实验数字。
Conclusion: RAG 的进展应按效率、防御、交互、推理四条轴组织，而非只看核心检索-生成流水线。

papers.title: Pragmatic DML with AI-Learned Representations
papers.abstract_en: Text, images, and other rich covariates are increasingly compressed into AI-learned representations and then used as controls in causal analysis. We study when this approach is valid and develop a practical framework for causal inference with learned representations. For a broad class of estimands, an imperfect representation distorts the target causal parameter by the product of two representation errors: one in the outcome regression and one in the balancing weight (or Riesz representer). This yields three constructive results. First, cross-fitted double machine learning (DML) provides valid Wald inference for the representation-dependent target. When representation errors are small, the same interval covers the causal parameter, and it can even attain the semiparametric efficiency bound. Second, fold-wise representation learning (or fine-tuning) is compatible with DML inference for the causal parameter. To this end, we develop convex- and star-aggregation pipelines for learning and combining representations. Third, when representation errors are substantial, we can provide interpretable sensitivity regions and root-$n$ inference for their endpoints. In a multi-modal demand application, seven representation-specific estimates and their star aggregate all imply a negative near-unit elasticity for rank-based price response, and the result remains robust over the reported sensitivity grid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 AI 学到的表示当因果控制变量时，目标参数的偏移等于结果回归误差与平衡权重（Riesz representer）误差之积；交叉拟合 DML 对表示依赖的目标给出有效 Wald 推断，表示误差小时区间同时覆盖真实因果参数并可达半参数效率界。多模态需求应用中七个表示特定估计及其 star 聚合一致给出秩价格响应的近单位负弹性，且在所报告的敏感性网格上稳健。
Motivation: 文本、图像等富协变量被压缩成 AI 表示后直接进入因果分析，但表示不完美何时使因果推断失效、如何给出可解释的推断区间尚无框架。
Method: 对一大类估计量把表示误差分解为结果回归与平衡权重两部分；用交叉拟合 DML 对表示依赖目标做 Wald 推断，并提出 convex-aggregation 与 star-aggregation 两条管线来学习并合并折间表示（fold-wise representation learning / fine-tuning）；表示误差大时构造可解释的敏感性区域并对端点做 root-n 推断。
Result: 多模态需求应用中，七个表示特定估计与 star 聚合结果一致指向秩价格响应的近单位负弹性（near-unit negative elasticity），并在报告的敏感性网格上保持稳健；理论上给出误差乘积结构、效率界可达性与端点 root-n 推断三条结论。
Conclusion: 表示误差可乘性分解意味着 DML 能在表示不完美时仍给出有效推断，误差大时改用敏感性区域而非点区间。

papers.title: Learning to Predict Distributions over Weight Updates for Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Hypernetworks have recently shown success in dynamically adapting the parameters of Large Language Models (LLMs) at runtime based on signals such as task descriptions or additional demostrations. Here we ask: how much adaptation signal can be obtained using only the input query to an LLM?. To answer this, we study query-conditioned Hypernetworks for LoRA estimation. Further, we introduce distributional Hypernetworks, able to produce not only point estimates of parameter adaptors, but also a distribution over possible LoRAs. For this we propose a simple end-to-end loss using a differentiable Monte Carlo approximation and explore multiple distribution parametrizations including regression and convex combination variants. Results show that even using the mean of the learned distribution can outperform deterministic hypernetworks. Crucially, the learned distribution enables a different form of test-time scaling: instead of spending additional compute only by sampling more token sequences from a fixed model, we sample weight updates, yielding multiple adapted models for the same query. Performance improves as more weight samples are considered and remains stronger than corresponding token-sampling adaptation baselines. Finally, we find that generated updates can transfer across queries, suggesting that the hypernetwork learns reusable structure in how the model should adapt. Together, these results show that query-conditioned distributions over weight updates can support both adaptation and test-time scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 LoRA 估计的 query-conditioned distributional hypernetwork：只用输入 query 作为适配信号，输出权重适配器的分布而非点估计，用可微 Monte Carlo 近似的端到端损失训练。仅用学到分布的均值即已超过确定性 hypernetwork；按权重更新采样做 test-time scaling 时，性能随采样权重数增加而提升，并强于对应的 token 采样适配基线，且生成的更新可跨 query 迁移。
Motivation: hypernetwork 已能按任务描述或示例在运行时改写 LLM 参数，但仅凭单条输入 query 能榨出多少适配信号尚不清楚；同时确定性适配器只给点估计，无法像 token 采样那样通过增加计算换取性能。
Method: 训练 query-conditioned hypernetwork 估计 LoRA 适配器，并扩展为 distributional hypernetwork，输出可能的 LoRA 分布；提出基于可微 Monte Carlo 近似的简单端到端损失，比较回归与凸组合 (convex combination) 等多种分布参数化。
Result: 仅用学到分布的均值即超过确定性 hypernetwork；采样权重更新得到同一 query 的多个适配模型，性能随权重采样数增加而提升，且持续强于对应的 token 采样适配基线；生成的权重更新可跨 query 迁移。
Conclusion: query 条件下的权重更新分布可同时支撑模型适配与 test-time scaling，把额外计算从采样 token 转向采样权重更新是一条有效的扩展路径，且学到的适配结构具有可复用性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Error-Corrected Inference-Time Scaling for Imperfect Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time scaling adapts pretrained diffusion models to new sampling tasks without additional training. Existing methods rely primarily on Monte Carlo sampling with more particles, yet are premised on the pretrained model being exact. In practice, data and training limitations make the model imperfect, and these methods inherit its error. More particles reduce Monte Carlo error but cannot remove the mismatch between the endpoint and the desired target or the error in tracking the prescribed probability path. We introduce the Energy-based Feynman-Kac Corrector (EBFKC), a framework for energy-based diffusion models that corrects these errors on the fly given a reference energy. We first derive Feynman-Kac dynamics that track a prescribed path exactly in the continuous-time population limit even when the model is imperfect, and approximate these dynamics using sequential Monte Carlo with variance-controlling guidance. To remove the endpoint mismatch, we use the pretrained energy as a surrogate along the diffusion path and progressively incorporate the discrepancy between the learned and target terminal energies. Experiments on Gaussian mixture models, particle systems, alanine dipeptide, and alanine tetrapeptide show that our method closely matches target distributions and molecular free-energy profiles under annealing and reward tilting, whereas standard inference-time scaling baselines retain substantial sampling errors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对预训练扩散模型不完美时推理时扩展 (inference-time scaling) 仍继承模型误差的问题，提出基于能量的 Feynman-Kac 校正器 (EBFKC)：在连续时间总体极限下沿规定概率路径精确跟踪，并用预训练能量作代理、逐步吸收学到的与目标终端能量之差来消除端点失配。在高斯混合、粒子体系、alanine 二肽与四肽上，EBFKC 在退火与奖励倾斜下紧密匹配目标分布与分子自由能剖面，而标准推理时扩展基线保留显著采样误差。
Motivation: 现有推理时扩展主要靠增加粒子数做 Monte Carlo 采样，前提是预训练模型精确；模型不完美时，更多粒子只压 Monte Carlo 误差，无法消除端点与目标分布的失配以及跟踪规定概率路径的误差。
Method: EBFKC 面向基于能量的扩散模型：先推导在连续时间总体极限下即使模型不完美也精确跟踪规定路径的 Feynman-Kac 动力学，再用带方差控制引导 (variance-controlling guidance) 的序贯 Monte Carlo (sequential Monte Carlo) 近似该动力学；端点失配则以预训练能量沿扩散路径作代理，并逐步并入学到的与目标终端能量之差。
Result: 在高斯混合模型、粒子体系、alanine dipeptide 与 alanine tetrapeptide 上，于退火 (annealing) 与奖励倾斜 (reward tilting) 两种设定中，EBFKC 得到的样本紧密匹配目标分布与分子自由能剖面，而标准推理时扩展基线保留 substantial 采样误差。
Conclusion: 推理时扩展要处理不完美的预训练扩散模型，必须同时校正路径跟踪误差与端点失配，仅靠增加粒子数不够；EBFKC 通过参考能量在线校正即可在分子体系上逼近目标分布。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: CLoSeR: Closing the Loop for Long-Context Streaming Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Feedforward foundation models have recently shown remarkable 3D reconstruction capabilities. However, existing models exhibit large tracking drift in long-context streaming reconstruction due to error accumulation. In this paper, we revisit loop closure with streaming reconstruction foundation models to enable accurate, drift-free, kilometer-scale reconstruction. Specifically, our method detects loop candidates through global descriptor retrieval, and constructs loop-conditioned windows to estimate the relative poses between looped frames. Given the observation that our adopted streaming reconstruction backbone produces a globally consistent scale, we optimize all frame poses on the SE(3) manifold with sequential and loop closure constraints, avoiding the pose graph optimization on the Sim(3) or higher-dimensional SL(4) manifolds employed in prior works. Extensive experiments show that our method reduces drift and produces consistent geometry on kilometer-scale sequences, significantly outperforming the state of the art. Code is available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/CLoSeR.git.
papers.comment: Authors contributed equally to this work. Author order is interchangeable
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLoSeR 把回环检测接进流式 3D 重建基础模型：用全局描述子检索回环候选、构建回环条件窗口估计相对位姿，再在 SE(3) 流形上联合优化全部帧位姿（顺序约束 + 回环约束），避免先前工作在 Sim(3) 或 SL(4) 上做位姿图优化。在公里级序列上显著优于现有方法，漂移更小、几何一致。
Motivation: 前馈式重建基础模型在长上下文流式重建中因误差累积产生严重跟踪漂移，限制了公里级尺度的精确、无漂移重建。
Method: 通过全局描述子检索检测回环候选，构建回环条件窗口估计回环帧间相对位姿；利用流式重建骨干本身给出全局一致尺度这一观察，在 SE(3) 流形上用顺序约束与回环约束联合优化所有帧位姿，取代 Sim(3) 或 SL(4) 流形上的位姿图优化。
Result: 在公里级序列上显著超越 state of the art，漂移减小且几何一致；代码已开源。
Conclusion: 在全局一致尺度成立时，把回环约束放进 SE(3) 联合优化即可消除流式重建的累积漂移，无需升维到 Sim(3)/SL(4)。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: LAST: Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Increasing depth of transformer models improves recognition, but it comes at a substantial cost. Each additional layer requires more parameters, which makes the process computationally inefficient. We ask whether additional processing can focus on integrating features already computed. Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer (LAST) first processes all tokens, then reuses the same blocks to refine only the class token over fixed audio features, thereby making later passes inexpensive. On AudioSet, ten-pass LAST achieves 0.345 mean average precision, exceeding a twelve-layer sequential transformer by 2.1% relative with 49.4% fewer parameters, 42% fewer multiply-accumulate operations, and 9.8% higher measured throughput. Across separately trained models, increasing the pass count from two to ten improves accuracy while adding only 1.2% computation. Further evaluations show improved robustness to temporal masking and various other auditory augmentations, with better generalization on classification tasks with music, environmental, and event sounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAST (Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer) 先正常处理全部 token，再复用同一批 block 只对 class token 在固定音频特征上反复精化，使后续 pass 几乎不增加开销。在 AudioSet 上十遍 LAST 达到 mAP 0.345，比十二层顺序 Transformer 高 2.1%（相对），参数少 49.4%、乘加运算少 42%、实测吞吐高 9.8%。
Motivation: 加深 Transformer 提升识别但每层都要新增参数，计算成本高；作者要问额外计算能否用于整合已算出的特征而不是继续堆层。
Method: LAST 先对所有 token 做一次完整处理，随后复用相同 block 只精化 class token、输入为固定的音频特征（spectrogram），使后续 pass 便宜；对比对象是十二层顺序 Transformer，并单独训练不同 pass 数（2 到 10）的模型。
Result: AudioSet 上十遍 LAST mAP 0.345，相对十二层顺序 Transformer 高 2.1%，参数少 49.4%，乘加运算 (MACs) 少 42%，实测吞吐高 9.8%；pass 数从 2 增到 10 只增加 1.2% 计算量而准确率提升；另在时间掩码与多种听觉增强下更稳健，并在含音乐、环境声、事件声的分类任务上泛化更好。
Conclusion: 把额外深度换成对 class token 的循环精化，可以在更少参数和运算下超过更深的顺序 Transformer，并提升对时间掩码等增强的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Cross-Lingual Alignment for Decoder-Only Models using MoE Routers
papers.abstract_en: Cross-lingual contrastive learning has been a core component of multilingual encoder training, but the ability to explicitly align representations is not possible in decoder-only LLMs because of varying multilingual tokenization. However, a growing amount of research suggests that even in LLMs, higher cross-lingual representational alignment leads to improved cross-lingual transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reimagine cross-lingual contrastive learning given the architectural constraints of modern LLMs. Rather than applying an auxiliary alignment loss on hidden states, we propose using the outputs of the mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers as the target for alignment. Router outputs lend themselves better to pooling over many tokens, enabling more reliable cross-lingual comparisons at the sequence-level. Controlled continual pre-training experiments on four open-source MoEs show that incorporating this routing loss also aligns the underlying hidden representations across languages. Most importantly, this loss improves multilingual performance on our diverse evaluation suite, demonstrating the potential of cross-lingual MoE router alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 decoder-only MoE LLM 上把跨语言对比学习的目标从隐状态换成 MoE router 输出，因为 router 输出可在 token 序列上池化，绕开多语言分词不一致导致的对齐困难。在四个开源 MoE 上的受控 continual pre-training 中，加入 routing loss 同时对齐了跨语言隐表示，并在多语言评测集上提升整体表现。
Motivation: 多语言 encoder 可用跨语言对比损失显式对齐表示，但 decoder-only LLM 因各语言分词不同，无法在隐状态上直接做序列级对齐；而既有研究又显示对齐程度越高跨语言迁移越好。
Method: 不加辅助隐状态对齐损失，改以 MoE router 输出作为对齐目标，利用其可在大量 token 上池化的特点做序列级跨语言比较；在四个开源 MoE 模型上做受控 continual pre-training 实验，并检验 routing loss 是否连带对齐底层隐表示。
Result: 四个开源 MoE 上的受控 continual pre-training 显示，加入 routing loss 后跨语言隐表示被对齐，且在作者的多语言评测套件 (evaluation suite) 上多语言性能提升；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: MoE router 输出是 decoder-only LLM 中可行的跨语言对齐目标，routing loss 既能对齐隐表示也能带来多语言性能收益，说明跨语言 MoE router 对齐具备实用潜力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MoLE: Mixture of Latent Experts for Complementary Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Latent visual reasoning equips vision--language models with continuous intermediate states that can process visual evidence without explicit textual reasoning traces or repeated image operations. However, existing methods often allow multiple latent tokens to access the same visual evidence through shared value projections, providing no mechanism for them to extract complementary visual information; simply increasing the latent budget can therefore yield redundant latent representations. We argue that effective latent reasoning should encourage different latent tokens to extract complementary visual information, and thereby act as specialized visual experts. Based on this insight, we propose MoLE, a Mixture of Latent Experts framework that controls both what visual evidence each latent visual expert observes and how it transforms that evidence. MoLE isolates latent visual experts during evidence extraction and uses dedicated latent summary experts to aggregate the complementary representations of latent visual experts. A two-stage training pipeline first forces visual evidence through this latent pathway and then restores direct visual access, requiring neither predefined expert roles nor intermediate visual targets. Across five visual reasoning benchmarks, MoLE achieves an average score of 78.6, outperforming data-matched supervised fine-tuning by 4.9 and the strongest evaluated latent visual reasoning baseline at the same latent budget by 3.6. Representation analyses show lower latent-state similarity and more diverse visual attention, while masking the latent pathway reduces average performance by 9.2. These results demonstrate that specializing latent computation is more effective than merely increasing the number of latent tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoLE 用 Mixture of Latent Experts 让不同 latent token 各自独占地提取视觉证据，再由 latent summary experts 汇总互补表示，避免共享 value projection 造成的冗余。在五个视觉推理基准上平均分 78.6，比数据对齐的 SFT 高 4.9、比同 latent budget 的最强 latent 视觉推理基线高 3.6；遮掉 latent pathway 掉 9.2 分。
Motivation: 现有 latent 视觉推理让多个 latent token 通过共享 value projection 看同一份视觉证据，无法提取互补信息，单纯加大 latent budget 只会得到冗余表示。
Method: MoLE 在证据提取阶段隔离各 latent visual expert，控制每个 expert 看到什么证据以及如何变换，再用专门的 latent summary expert 聚合互补表示；两阶段训练先强制视觉证据走 latent pathway，随后恢复直接视觉访问，不需要预定义专家角色或中间视觉目标。
Result: 五个视觉推理基准平均分 78.6，比数据对齐的监督微调 (data-matched SFT) 高 4.9，比同 latent budget 下最强的 latent 视觉推理基线高 3.6；遮蔽 latent pathway 使平均性能下降 9.2。表示分析显示 latent 状态相似度更低、视觉注意力更多样。
Conclusion: 让 latent 计算分工专门化比单纯增加 latent token 数量更有效，latent pathway 本身对性能有实质贡献。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: DecomVoxel: Harnessing 3D-Native Priors with Guided In-situ Denoising Optimization for Decompositional Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Decompositional scene reconstruction aims to reconstruct high-quality objects and background, yet existing methods still struggle with the level of quality under heavy occlusions. While generative priors offer a potential solution, 2D image-based priors often suffer from multi-view inconsistency due to a lack of 3D awareness. Conversely, 3D-native priors provide stronger structural inductive biases but frequently lead to spatial drift and misalignment within complex scenes. To address these issues, we propose DecomVoxel, formulating object completion as a guided in-situ denoising optimization that bridges 3D-native priors with neural scene reconstruction. Our framework introduces a reformulated epsilon-based distillation loss to ensure stable latent refinement, alongside adaptive spatial guidance that utilizes occupied and vacant anchors with temporal annealing to suppress generative hallucinations and mitigate spatial drift. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ show that DecomVoxel significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods while faithfully preserving the original spatial layout, structural fidelity, and style-consistent texture. Our method pushes the boundary of decompositional reconstruction by delivering high-quality textured meshes with clean topology, geometry, and appearance, providing a robust solution for the decompositional reconstruction of complex real-world scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/DecomVoxel/DecomVoxel.
papers.comment: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 - Journal Track (TOG). Project page: https://decomvoxel.github.io/DecomVoxel-Webpage/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DecomVoxel 把分解式场景重建中的物体补全表述为引导式原位去噪优化 (guided in-situ denoising)，把 3D-native 先验接入神经场景重建，用重公式化的 ε-based 蒸馏损失与自适应空间引导（占用/空闲锚点加时间退火）抑制生成幻觉和空间漂移。在 Replica 与 ScanNet++ 上显著优于 SOTA，同时保持原有空间布局、结构保真与风格一致纹理，输出拓扑干净的高质量纹理网格。
Motivation: 重遮挡下分解式重建质量不足；2D 图像先验缺 3D 意识导致多视不一致，3D-native 先验结构先验强却在复杂场景中产生空间漂移与错位。
Method: 将物体补全建模为引导式原位去噪优化，桥接 3D-native 先验与神经场景重建；引入重公式化的 ε-based 蒸馏损失保证 latent 稳定精修，并用占用与空闲锚点构成的自适应空间引导配合时间退火 (temporal annealing) 抑制幻觉与漂移。
Result: 在 Replica 与 ScanNet++ 上显著优于 SOTA 方法，并忠实保留原始空间布局、结构保真与风格一致纹理；产出拓扑干净的高质量纹理网格。
Conclusion: 把 3D-native 先验用引导式去噪与空间锚点约束接入神经重建，可在重遮挡复杂真实场景中同时拿到补全质量与布局保真。

papers.title: Same Reward, Different Skills: When Multimodal RL Learns to Look
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves vision-language benchmark scores even without visual information during training. With images at test, blind-trained models recover roughly half of the real-image gain at 3B and nearly four fifths at 7B. Prolonged real-image training can erode grounding while benchmark gains persist. Both findings expose the same gap: an image in the prompt is not an image in the learning signal. Our design rule, visual resolvability, asks that visual evidence be necessary for a correct answer and that the task remain learnable. We test it on counterfactual coordinate scenes in which the question stays fixed and the target is never named, so a correct answer requires finding the target in the image. With standard GRPO and correctness-and-format rewards, a 7B model raises its accuracy at finding the target (discovery) from 0.425 to 0.875 on held-out scenes denser than any it trained on, and it improves on question types it never trained on. Two controls locate the source of the gain. Replacing test images with gray canvases drops discovery to zero; training on gray canvases instead, at matched step 30 and in each of four seeds, yields essentially none of the gain even when the model is then tested with real images. The learned skill carries over to grounding tasks built independently of the training corpus. A caption that answers the training question, added to the same images, reward and budget, cuts the gain by nearly two thirds. Changing what reward requires changes what RL learns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLVR 训练时即使完全不给图像，3B 模型测试时也能恢复约一半的真实图像增益、7B 恢复近五分之四，说明提示里的图像不等于学习信号里的图像。作者提出 visual resolvability 设计规则——视觉证据必须是答对的必要条件且任务仍可学——在反事实坐标场景上用 GRPO 与正确性+格式奖励把 7B 的目标发现 (discovery) 准确率从 0.425 提到 0.875；灰画布对照与「答案式 caption」对照分别把增益归零和砍掉近三分之二。
Motivation: 多模态 RLVR 能在训练时无视觉信息的情况下仍提升基准分数，而长时间真实图像训练反而可能侵蚀 grounding，二者共同暴露同一缺口：prompt 中有图像不等于学习信号中有图像。
Method: 设计规则 visual resolvability 要求视觉证据对答对题是必要且任务可学；测试载体是反事实坐标场景（问题固定、目标从不被点名，答对必须在图中找到目标），训练用标准 GRPO 加正确性与格式奖励。两个对照：把测试图换成灰画布，以及在同图像、同奖励、同预算下加入能直接回答训练问题的 caption。
Result: 7B 模型在比训练更密集的 held-out 场景上 discovery 准确率 0.425 → 0.875，并在未训练过的问题类型上提升；测试图换成灰画布后 discovery 降至 0，改用灰画布训练（step 30 对齐、四个种子）几乎得不到增益；加入答案式 caption 使增益被砍掉近三分之二。无图训练的模型测试时恢复约一半（3B）到近五分之四（7B）的真实图像增益。
Conclusion: 改变奖励所要求的内容就改变了 RL 学到的技能：只有当视觉证据对正确答案不可替代时，RL 才学到可迁移到独立构建的 grounding 任务的视觉技能。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: MapLightning: Online Vectorized HD Map Construction with 1D Map Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Online vectorized HD map construction is essential for scaling safe autonomous driving and requires accurate, real-time inference. Prior methods typically rely on dense bird's-eye-view (BEV) grids as the intermediate representation. We propose \textit{MapLightning}, which replaces the dense BEV grid with a compact set of 1D learnable map tokens. To construct map tokens from image features, we choose self-attention over vanilla cross-attention because it enables joint interactions and contextual aggregation among image and map tokens. Our transformer-based mapper concatenates map and image tokens, applies full self-attention, discards the image tokens, and retains the updated map tokens for decoding. This design offers three advantages. First, our representation is efficient, using fewer tokens, consuming less memory, and running faster. Second, the lightweight design allows the map decoder to use full rather than deformable cross-attention for better global context. Third, unlike BEV-based methods, our network does not use camera projection parameters, making it robust to camera-extrinsic perturbations. MapLightning uses up to 16.7$\times$ fewer intermediate tokens than dense BEV-based methods and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on nuScenes and Argoverse~2. Its lightweight variant surpasses MapTRv2 by +10.1 mAP on nuScenes and +16.2 mAP on Argoverse~2, while delivering 1.73$\times$ faster inference (40+ FPS) with 53\% less memory. We further show improvements on uncertainty-aware map construction and downstream trajectory prediction. Code and models will be released.

papers.title: Higher-Order Positional Encodings for Graph Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world systems exhibit higher-order interactions among groups of entities that cannot be captured by pairwise relationships alone. Graph Transformers and Graph Neural Networks increasingly rely on positional encodings to enrich graph representations, yet existing positional encodings are computed solely from the original graph and therefore cannot directly capture observed higher-order interactions. Topological Deep Learning addresses this limitation by lifting graphs to simplicial complexes, but typically requires performing message passing or attention on higher-order neural network representations. We introduce a representation learning paradigm that enriches graph representations with higher-order topology through positional encodings, enabling standard graph learning models to exploit lifted incidence structure without modifying the backbone. We derive a theoretical characterization of the expressivity of higher-order positional encodings, proving that node-level operators induced by higher-order lifts can mix graph Laplacian frequencies in ways that scalar graph spectral filters cannot. Guided by this theory, we instantiate higher-order positional encodings using Hodge Laplacians derived from clique complexes. Experiments with Graph Transformers on ZINC and controlled synthetic benchmarks demonstrate improvements in predictive performance, while a fixed-1-skeleton experiment shows that the pipeline can transmit higher-order information when cells are supplied independently of the graph. Together, our results establish higher-order positional encodings as a principled bridge between graph positional encodings and topological deep learning.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Fifth Learning on Graphs Conference (LoG 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出高阶位置编码 (higher-order positional encodings)：把图提升到 clique complex 上的单纯复形，用 Hodge Laplacian 生成位置编码注入 Graph Transformer 等标准骨干，无需改动骨干本身。理论上证明高阶提升诱导的节点算子能以标量图谱滤波器无法做到的方式混合图 Laplacian 频率；在 ZINC 与受控合成基准上预测性能有提升。
Motivation: 现有位置编码只从原图计算，无法直接表达观测到的高阶交互；拓扑深度学习虽能提升到单纯复形，却要求在高阶表示上做消息传递或注意力，代价高且需替换骨干。
Method: 以 clique complex 的 Hodge Laplacian 实例化高阶位置编码，注入 Graph Transformer 等标准图学习模型；配套给出表达力的理论刻画，说明高阶提升的节点算子可混合图 Laplacian 频率，而标量图谱滤波器不能。
Result: 在 ZINC 与受控合成基准上，Graph Transformer 加入高阶位置编码后预测性能提升；另有一个 fixed-1-skeleton 实验表明，当 cells 独立于图提供时，该管线仍能传递高阶信息。
Conclusion: 高阶位置编码是连接图位置编码与拓扑深度学习的原则性桥梁，可在不改骨干的前提下让标准模型利用提升后的关联结构。

papers.title: Asynchronous LLM Post-Training: Group-Mass Capping and Convergence Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves the efficiency of large language model post-training but introduces stale rollouts generated by earlier policies. Theoretical understanding of how this staleness affects convergence and how to mitigate its impact remains limited. We derive a convergence bound for GRPO-style algorithms that explicitly characterizes the tradeoff between the gradient estimator's second moment and bias. For trajectory-level importance-weighted estimators, our analysis shows that once the second moment is uniformly controlled, delay enters the bound through the bias introduced by clipping or rescaling. Guided by this insight, we propose a novel group mass capping GRPO (GMC-GRPO) method, which minimizes a ratio-based bias bound within a class of weighted estimators sharing a common second-moment guarantee. We establish convergence guarantees for asynchronous GMC-GRPO and show that, compared with TIC-GRPO, it improves the threshold dependence of the fourth-order delay term from $O(ε^{-4})$ to $O(ε^{-2})$ as $ε\to0$, where $1+ε$ is the ratio threshold. Under local policy overlap, the delay-dependent term decreases as $G^{-2/5}$ after tuning the step size, where $G$ is the group size. For fixed behavior and current policies, the bias introduced by group rescaling also vanishes as $G\to\infty$, whereas the bias from trajectory-wise clipping can persist. Experiments across Qwen3 models and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate improved robustness to stale rollouts, with GMC-GRPO achieving the best performance among stable baselines under large rollout delays.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 异步 LLM 后训练中过期 rollout（stale rollouts）带来的偏差是收敛瓶颈：提出 GMC-GRPO，在共享二阶矩保证的加权估计器类里最小化比值型偏差上界。相比 TIC-GRPO，四阶延迟项的阈值依赖从 O(ε⁻⁴) 降到 O(ε⁻²)，组大小 G 增大时延迟项按 G^{-2/5} 下降；大延迟下在 Qwen3 推理基准上最稳。
Motivation: 异步 RL 提升 LLM 后训练效率，但早期策略产生的过期 rollout 会污染梯度估计，其对收敛的影响与缓解手段都缺乏理论刻画。
Method: 为 GRPO 类算法推导收敛界，显式刻画梯度估计器二阶矩与偏差的权衡；在轨迹级重要性加权估计器中，二阶矩被一致控制后，延迟只通过 clipping/rescaling 引入的偏差进入界。据此提出 GMC-GRPO，并给出异步 GMC-GRPO 的收敛保证。
Result: 四阶延迟项阈值依赖由 TIC-GRPO 的 O(ε⁻⁴) 改进为 O(ε⁻²)（ε→0，1+ε 为比值阈值）；局部策略重叠下，调步长后延迟项按 G^{-2/5} 下降；固定行为与当前策略时，组重缩放偏差随 G→∞ 消失，而逐轨迹 clipping 的偏差可持续存在。Qwen3 模型与推理基准实验中，大 rollout 延迟下 GMC-GRPO 在稳定基线里性能最好。
Conclusion: 在二阶矩受控后，异步 GRPO 的延迟影响可归结为可最小化的偏差项，组质量截断比逐轨迹 clipping 更能压住大延迟下的偏差。

papers.title: A foundation for systematic analysis of transformers and RNNs for tractography
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a promising approach for improving diffusion MRI (dMRI) tractography, a task that remains limited by the intrinsic tension between local diffusion information and global anatomical plausibility. In this work, we systematically evaluate recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and Transformer models for iterative tractography, with particular attention to training strategies, input representations (including convolutional neural network (CNN)-based embeddings and end-of-sequence (EOS) tokens), and hyperparameter selection. We introduce a generation-validation phase enabling supervision at the streamline level during training, allowing supervision despite the mismatch between local loss functions and global streamline quality. Using the ISMRM2015 tractography challenge dataset, our models achieve the highest reported performance to date. Through controlled experiments, we quantify the impact of missing bundles, noisy or imperfect training streamlines, and invalid fibers in the training set. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of our best-performing models for in vivo data from the Tractoinferno database. Overall, our results highlight both the potential and the limits of sequence-based deep learning models such as Transformers and RNNs for tractography, and emphasize the need for improved phantoms and evaluation methods for in vivo validation. We provide takeaways and recommendations for future researchers training and validating sequence-based supervised methods for tractography.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 RNN 与 Transformer 做迭代式纤维束成像 (tractography)，提出 generation-validation 阶段，使训练中能在 streamline 层面监督，从而弥合局部损失与全局纤维质量的错配。在 ISMRM2015 挑战数据集上取得迄今报告的最高性能，并量化了缺失 bundle、含噪/不完美训练 streamline 与无效纤维的影响。
Motivation: dMRI tractography 受局部扩散信息与全局解剖合理性之间固有张力限制；序列式深度学习用局部损失训练时无法直接监督全局 streamline 质量。
Method: 系统评估 RNN 与 Transformer 做迭代 tractography，比较训练策略、输入表示（含 CNN-based embeddings 与 end-of-sequence (EOS) token）与超参选择；引入 generation-validation 阶段实现 streamline 级监督，并用受控实验量化训练集中缺失 bundle、含噪/不完美 streamline 与无效纤维的影响。
Result: 在 ISMRM2015 tractography challenge 数据集上取得迄今报告的最高性能；受控实验量化了缺失 bundle、噪声或不完美训练 streamline、无效纤维对训练的影响；最佳模型在 Tractoinferno 数据库的 in vivo 数据上展示可用性。
Conclusion: 序列式 Transformer/RNN 在 tractography 上有潜力也有边界，未来研究者需要更好的 phantom 与 in vivo 评估方法来训练和验证此类监督式序列方法。

papers.title: A Structured State Space Sequence Model for Multi-Class Classification of Malware
papers.abstract_en: By 2030, Internet of Things (IoT) devices are projected to reach 40 billion, with fast-paced technological advancements in fields such as industry, healthcare, agriculture, automobiles, and building/home automation systems. This expansion has created a large attack surface for cybercrime, as the majority of these devices open the door for cybercriminals to exploit vulnerabilities, as they lack adequate built-in security. Cybercriminals launch malware attacks to compromise systems or steal sensitive data, and once a system is compromised, a ransom is typically demanded for its release. Current cybersecurity measures in place are being outpaced by the rapid growth of the IoT, which is accompanied by a subsequent growth in malware variants being created per day. Recognizing this pitfall, this research examines and proposes a novel approach to malware detection and classification to safeguard devices from further attacks and make IoT systems more robust and secure. The framework proposed utilizes a Structured State Space Sequence (S4) model, which discretizes sequences of malware samples in a sequence and captures long-range dependencies, essentially identifying the "cause" and "effect" hidden within malware execution flow. This study presents two novel contributions: the first empirical application of the S4 model for malware analysis, and a comprehensive comparison of its performance against other deep learning architectures, laying the stepping stone for future research in this new paradigm.
papers.comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE World AI IoT Congress (AIIoT). This is the author's accepted manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用结构化状态空间序列模型 (S4) 对恶意软件做多类分类：把恶意软件样本序列离散化后建模，捕捉执行流中的长程依赖与因果关系。这是 S4 首次用于恶意软件分析，并与多种深度学习架构做了性能对比。
Motivation: IoT 设备到 2030 年预计达 400 亿，多数缺乏内置安全，恶意软件变体每日增长，现有网络安全手段跟不上，需要新的检测与分类方法。
Method: 用 S4 模型将恶意软件样本序列离散化并建模长程依赖，识别执行流中的因果关系；同时与其他深度学习架构做综合性能对比。
Result: 摘要给出的数字为：IoT 设备到 2030 年预计 400 亿；贡献为 S4 在恶意软件分析上的首次实证应用，以及与多种深度学习架构的综合对比。
Conclusion: S4 可作为恶意软件多类分类的新范式起点，为后续研究奠定对比基础。

papers.title: Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents commonly generate free-form reasoning before each action. For small models, limited model capacity can result in lengthy reasoning that provides little useful guidance for action generation while incurring substantial inference cost. To address this challenge, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as selection instead of open-ended generation. SSR represents recurring high-level reasoning as pre-specified, reusable natural-language candidates. At each turn, the model selects from these reasoning candidates based on their likelihoods given the current context, without requiring an auxiliary task head. Using pre-specified reasoning traces enables parallel scoring, where teacher-forced prefilling computes token likelihoods concurrently within and across candidates using a shared context KV cache. We evaluate SSR on seven multimodal search benchmarks using 2B and 4B models. Across multiple reinforcement learning objectives and supervised fine-tuning, SSR delivers significant efficiency gains without sacrificing task performance. SSR achieves an average success rate competitive with leading search agents of the same scale, while reducing per-turn reasoning latency by over 90% and total per-question model inference latency by 28-54%. Project page: https://zfy0314.github.io/ssr-webpage/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSR 把多模态搜索 agent 的自由生成式推理改成从预置可复用的自然语言推理候选中做选择，用共享 KV cache 的 teacher-forced prefilling 并行打分，无需额外任务头。在七个多模态搜索 benchmark、2B 与 4B 模型上，配合多种 RL 目标与 SFT，任务表现与同规模领先 search agent 相当，同时每轮推理延迟降低 90% 以上、每题总推理延迟降低 28–54%。
Motivation: 小模型容量有限，自由形式的长推理既对动作生成帮助有限，又带来很高的推理开销。
Method: SSR 将反复出现的高层推理预置为可复用的自然语言候选，每轮依据当前上下文对候选的似然做选择；借助预置推理轨迹，用共享上下文 KV cache 在候选内与候选间并行做 teacher-forced prefilling 计算 token 似然，训练覆盖多种强化学习目标与监督微调。
Result: 在七个多模态搜索 benchmark、2B 与 4B 模型上，SSR 平均成功率与同规模领先 search agent 相当，每轮推理延迟降低超过 90%，每题总模型推理延迟降低 28–54%，且任务性能未见损失。
Conclusion: 对小模型多模态搜索 agent，把推理从开放式生成改为结构化候选选择，可以在保持任务表现的同时大幅压缩推理延迟。

papers.title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Enhanced Radiometer Image Precipitation Estimation using Conditional Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Deep generative networks have recently achieved unprecedented performance in precise image and video editing using sophisticated textual prompts. However, the effectiveness of such models heavily depends on access to very large supervised and annotated image datasets, which can be very difficult to obtain. This is particularly true for satellite instruments, which very rarely overlap with labelled data, and suffer from domain shifts in the rare occasions they do. In this paper, we investigate the potential of flow matching models for unsupervised domain adaptation of satellite radiometer images. Our main contribution is a novel unsupervised method that achieves precise domain alignment by leveraging parts of the deterministic ordinary differential equations in flow matching models, conditioned on different satellite instruments. A key strength of our approach is its ability to preserve essential information while adapting across any domains since the perturbations are in theory bijective. Extensive experiments conducted on the GPM-Core constellation show the benefit of our conditional domain adaptation, particularly in improving rain precipitation estimation from radiometer imagery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 的无监督域适应方法，用确定性 ODE 的一部分对不同卫星辐射计图像做精确域对齐，理论上扰动双射因而保留关键信息。在 GPM-Core 星座上的实验显示该条件域适应提升了从辐射计图像估计降雨降水的精度。
Motivation: 卫星辐射计与标注数据极少重叠，偶有重叠时又存在域偏移，使依赖大规模标注的深度生成模型难以直接用于跨仪器的降水估计。
Method: 以流匹配模型的确定性常微分方程部件构造无监督域对齐，按不同卫星仪器作条件，扰动在理论上为双射以保留信息；在 GPM-Core 星座数据上做实验。
Result: 在 GPM-Core 星座上的大量实验显示条件域适应带来收益，尤其改善了由辐射计图像进行的雨降水估计。
Conclusion: 用条件流匹配的双射式域对齐可以在无标注条件下跨卫星仪器迁移，从而改善辐射计图像的降水估计。

papers.title: Stochastic Rounding in Low-Precision Transformer Inference: A Variable-Precision Emulation Study of a Small GPT-2
authors: Pablo de Oliveira Castro (2) ((1) Krembil Centre for Neuroinformatics
papers.abstract_en: Should low-precision transformer inference use stochastic rounding (SR) or round-to-nearest (RN)? The answer depends on where in the network you look. We isolate this effect by holding the numerical format fixed and varying only the rounding rule at individual operation sites. To enable experiments at freely chosen precisions, we extend the PRISM vectorized rounding library to arbitrary virtual precision via a variable-precision stochastic rounding (VPSR) algorithm, proving that the rounding decision is evaluated exactly in hardware floating point. We develop two analyses providing complementary insight into this site-level trade-off. First, a probabilistic forward-error bound for linear projections shows that SR's error envelope grows as $O(\sqrt{n} u)$ in reduction length $n$, versus $O(n u)$ for RN, a gap that widens rapidly at low precision and is most pronounced in the long multilayer perceptron (MLP) down-projection. Second, a second-order decomposition of expected cross-entropy loss change at the output softmax into signed drift, drift curvature, and a Fisher-weighted variance penalty reveals why the two sites behave oppositely: MLP noise is predominantly a uniform logit shift to which softmax is invariant, so SR's variance is largely discounted; head noise is non-uniform across the vocabulary and is not. On DistilGPT-2 at $t=6$ significand bits, observations match theory: SR in the MLP raises perplexity to 1.15x the full-precision reference, versus 2.21x for RN. At the language-model head, the ordering reverses because SR introduces non-uniform variance, whereas deterministic RN carries none. In a mixed-precision configuration (MLP output at $t=6$), assigning SR to the MLP and RN to the head brings perplexity within 1.10x of the full-precision reference, a 28% reduction over matched-bit RN.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Code and evaluation pipeline available at https://github.com/big-data-lab-team/fuzzy-llm and archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23066028
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 DistilGPT-2 上固定数值格式、只在单个算子位点切换舍入规则，发现 SR 与 RN 的优劣随位点反转：MLP 降投影用 SR 使困惑度升到全精度的 1.15x（RN 为 2.21x），语言模型头则因 SR 引入非均匀方差而 RN 更优；混合配置（MLP 用 SR、头用 RN）把困惑度压到 1.10x，比同位数 RN 降低 28%。
Motivation: 低精度推理中 SR 与 RN 的选择被当作全局决定，但不同网络位点的误差如何经 softmax 放大或抵消缺少理论刻画，导致无法按位点配置舍入规则。
Method: 扩展 PRISM 向量舍入库为任意虚拟精度的 variable-precision stochastic rounding (VPSR) 算法并证明舍入决策在硬件浮点中精确执行；给出线性投影的随机前向误差界（SR 为 O(√n·u)，RN 为 O(n·u)），并对输出 softmax 的期望交叉熵损失变化做二阶分解为 signed drift、drift curvature 与 Fisher-weighted variance penalty。
Result: DistilGPT-2 在 t=6 有效位下：MLP 用 SR 困惑度为全精度参考的 1.15x，RN 为 2.21x；语言模型头处次序反转（SR 引入非均匀方差，RN 无确定性方差）；混合配置（MLP 输出 t=6，MLP 用 SR、头用 RN）困惑度 1.10x，比匹配位数 RN 降低 28%。误差界显示 SR 随归约长度 n 增长为 O(√n·u) 而 RN 为 O(n·u)，差距在长 MLP down-projection 最显著。
Conclusion: 舍入规则应按位点选择而非全局统一：MLP 噪声近似为 softmax 不变的均匀 logit 平移故 SR 方差被大幅折价，头噪声跨词表非均匀故应改用 RN。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TRACE: Tackling Real-World Resource Assignment Problems via Agentic Heuristic Design
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic resource assignment, the real-time allocation of task streams to heterogeneous processing nodes, is the backbone of modern computing infrastructure. While learning-based schedulers excel in research, industrial deployments still rely on hand-written rules that operators can read, audit, and execute within tight latency budgets. LLM-based Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) promises to automate writing such rules. However, existing AHD frameworks were developed for combinatorial problems fully specified to the LLM, and they learn only from a scalar fitness score. In real systems, the behaviour that determines a good heuristic, such as processor speeds or power consumption, is unknown a priori: the score reveals which heuristic performs better, but not why. This missing information is recorded in the system logs that every evaluation produces. Exploiting it is non-trivial: logs are massive and noisy, the relevant signals depend on the objective, and their content and format vary across hardware and software stacks, so they can neither be fed to an LLM as is nor processed by a fixed parser. We propose TRACE, which couples an evolutionary AHD loop with an agentic knowledge-extraction workflow. A Reasoner agent analyzes the log schema in light of the objective and formulates hypotheses about the system dynamics; a Coder agent writes and executes schema-specific code to test them, producing insights or executable tools for the evolved heuristics. We evaluate TRACE on a synthetic cloud benchmark and a 5G vRAN scenario built from industrial testbed measurements and operational traffic traces. TRACE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art AHD methods in resource assignment problems and yields more auditable heuristics at under 2% overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 把进化式自动启发式设计 (AHD) 与智能体知识抽取工作流耦合：Reasoner agent 依据目标分析日志 schema 并提出系统动态假设，Coder agent 写代码验证并产出可执行工具供演化中的启发式使用。在合成云基准与基于工业测试床测量和真实流量 trace 的 5G vRAN 场景上，它持续优于现有 AHD 方法，启发式更可审计，开销低于 2%。
Motivation: 工业资源分配仍靠人工规则，因为可读、可审计且延迟可控；现有 LLM-AHD 只面向完全已知的组合问题、只吃标量 fitness，无法利用评估日志中记录的系统动态信息。
Method: TRACE 将进化 AHD 循环与 agentic 知识抽取结合：Reasoner agent 结合目标分析日志 schema 并形成关于系统动态的假设，Coder agent 编写并执行 schema 专用代码检验假设，产出 insight 或可执行工具供演化启发式调用。
Result: 在合成云 benchmark 与由工业 testbed 测量和运营流量 trace 构建的 5G vRAN 场景上，TRACE 在资源分配问题中持续优于 state-of-the-art AHD 方法，产出更可审计的启发式，开销低于 2%。
Conclusion: 把系统日志当作可检验假设的来源而非原始输入，能让 LLM-AHD 在真实资源分配系统中学到既高性能又可审计的规则，且开销控制在 2% 以内。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Memory-Guided B-Roll Generation from User Video Collections
papers.abstract_en: We introduce an approach for collection-grounded B-roll sequence generation. Given a user's video collection, a directive given in natural language, and a target duration, the goal is to produce a multi-shot sequence that complements the user's primary footage (A-roll) while preserving the collection's characters, settings, objects, and style. This task is challenging as one must choose the visual evidence from hours of captured footage that should guide the generation of each shot in the sequence. We address this challenge with MemComposer, a three-stage system that turns raw footage into a structured memory with visual references (characters, settings, objects, and style) and uses it to plan, retrieve, and generate grounded B-roll sequences. First, in a one-time offline stage, MemComposer constructs an entity-centric memory from raw video. Second, it uses the memory and user directive to plan a grounded sequence and retrieve conditioning frames for each shot. Third, it iteratively generates and critiques the sequence to enforce identity, setting, and sequence-level consistency. We evaluate MemComposer in a user preference study along two dimensions: prompt adherence and visual alignment to the user's collection. Against an ungrounded text-to-video planner, MemComposer wins 60.0\% of prompt-adherence and 92.8\% of visual-alignment comparisons, showing the grounding benefit of collection memory and reference retrieval. Against retrieval-only sequences assembled from captured footage, MemComposer wins 94.5\% of prompt-adherence comparisons, showing the value of generating missing shots, while retrieval-only sequences are preferred for visual alignment in 58.2\% of comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemComposer 把用户视频素材离线压成以实体为中心的记忆（角色、场景、物体、风格），再据此规划、检索条件帧并迭代生成与自评，产出与主镜头互补的多镜头 B-roll。用户偏好研究中，对比无接地的文生视频规划器，它在 prompt 遵循上赢 60.0%、在与素材的视觉对齐上赢 92.8%；对比纯检索拼接，prompt 遵循赢 94.5%，但视觉对齐输（纯检索 58.2%）。
Motivation: 从数小时素材里为每个镜头挑出恰当视觉证据很难：既要遵循自然语言指令与时长，又要保住素材中的角色、场景、物体与风格，通用文生视频规划器没有素材接地。
Method: 三阶段系统 MemComposer：离线构建实体中心记忆；用记忆加用户指令规划接地序列并为每镜头检索条件帧；迭代生成与批评以强制身份、场景和序列级一致性。
Result: 用户偏好研究按 prompt 遵循与视觉对齐两维评测：对比无接地文生视频规划器，prompt 遵循胜率 60.0%、视觉对齐 92.8%；对比纯检索序列，prompt 遆循胜率 94.5%，而视觉对齐方面纯检索在 58.2% 的比较中更受偏好。
Conclusion: 素材接地的记忆与参考帧检索带来 prompt 遵循与视觉对齐的双重收益，生成缺失镜头能补上纯检索的指令遵循短板；纯检索在视觉对齐上仍略占优，说明生成与检索各有取舍。

papers.title: Flowing Faster to Coordinate: One-Step Online Multi-Agent Flow Policies
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a powerful framework for learning coordinated behaviors through interactions with the environment. Developing MARL policies requires balancing expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions with efficient training and execution. Generative policies, particularly diffusionbased policies, can faithfully capture complex and multimodal behaviors, but costly iterative sampling hinders their scalability in online multi-agent settings. We propose an Online MARL framework via one-step Flow model (OMAF) that combines expressive generative policies with efficient one-step action generation. OMAF employs a Transformer-based flow policy to capture complex coordination behaviors, while its approximate path score surrogate provides a principled route to synchronized flow policy optimization. To enable stable and sampleefficient learning, we further develop a joint optimization scheme coupling softmax Q-value estimation with a joint flow policy objective for coordinated policy learning. By eliminating iterative sampling, OMAF dramatically reduces training overhead without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across 10 standard tasks from MPE and MAMuJoCo show that OMAF consistently achieves superior performance, with up to 3.4x higher returns and 10.5x sample efficiency improvement compared with baseline methods. These results validate the effectiveness of OMAF as an expressive and computationally efficient one-step flow policy paradigm for online MARL.

papers.title: EvenSplat: Coupled 2D-3D Decomposition for Gaussian Splatting under Exposure and Illumination Variation
papers.abstract_en: A surface photographed under even light presents nearly the same appearance from every angle; the same surface under uneven light does not. Exposure changes between views, illumination varies within a single image, and locally strong light sources leave one region bright and its neighbor in shadow. Multi-view reconstruction methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting treat these lighting artifacts as if they were properties of the scene, entangling capture-specific illumination with the geometry and color they recover. We present EvenSplat, a framework that separates the two. EvenSplat couples an image-space illumination decomposition with an illumination field carried by the Gaussians, so that the same explanation of the lighting is shared between the two-dimensional and three-dimensional views of the scene; a camera-response network and a local exposure-compensation module absorb the global and residual differences that remain across training images. Through extensive experiments across multiple datasets and diverse forms of uneven illumination (cross-view exposure, spatial illumination variation, and high-contrast lighting) on both real-world captured and simulated benchmarks, EvenSplat generally outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under high-contrast illumination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvenSplat 把 3D Gaussian Splatting 中纠缠在一起的场景几何颜色与拍摄光照分离开：图像空间光照分解与高斯携带的光照场共享同一套光照解释，再用 camera-response 网络和局部曝光补偿模块吸收跨视角的全局与残余曝光差异。在真实采集与仿真基准上的多组不均匀光照实验中，该方法总体优于现有方法，高对比度光照下优势最明显。
Motivation: 3DGS 等多视图重建方法把曝光差异、图内光照变化和强局部光源造成的明暗伪影当作场景属性，导致捕获特有的光照与几何、颜色纠缠，重建失真。
Method: 耦合图像空间光照分解与由高斯携带的 illumination field，使二维与三维视角共享同一光照解释；配合 camera-response network 建模全局曝光、local exposure-compensation module 处理残余差异，在训练图像上联合优化。
Result: 在多个数据集、覆盖跨视角曝光、空间光照变化与高对比度光照三类不均匀光照的真实与仿真基准上，EvenSplat 总体优于 state-of-the-art 方法，在高对比度光照条件下优势尤其明显。
Conclusion: 把光照作为二维与三维共享的显式变量来联合分解，可以减少 3DGS 中捕获特有光照与几何颜色的纠缠，且在高对比度场景收益最大。

papers.title: From Network Intrusion Detection to Blockchain-Backed Endpoint Detection and Response: Mapping the Landscape of Decentralized Detection-and-Response Architectures
papers.abstract_en: While the literature on blockchain-assisted intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS) for Internet of Things (IoT) and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) networks is mature, existing systematic reviews suffer from two critical limitations: they overlook the structural shift toward modern Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Extended Detection and Response (XDR) architectures, and they conflate blockchain's distinct functional roles into a single monolithic category. This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) addresses these gaps by proposing a three-axis taxonomy that classifies proposals by detection-system class (NIDS, HIDS, EDR/XDR), blockchain functional role, and response-automation maturity. Synthesizing research published in high-impact venues between 2019 and 2026, we provide a rigorous gap analysis exposing why a genuine per-endpoint blockchain-anchored response loop remains nearly nonexistent due to latency, deployment, and community mismatches. Furthermore, we evaluate structural, cross-cutting challenges persisting across the literature, including consensus latency on constrained devices, post-quantum cryptographic vulnerability, smart-contract attack surfaces, and the adversarial vulnerability of evolving LLM-based detection engines. Finally, we outline a comprehensive research agenda centered on hybrid on-chain/off-chain orchestration to bridge the gap between decentralized trust and rapid response automation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 SoK：把区块链辅助的 IoT/IIoT 入侵检测文献按检测系统类别（NIDS、HIDS、EDR/XDR）、区块链功能角色、响应自动化成熟度三轴重新分类，覆盖 2019–2026 年高水平 venue 的工作。核心论断是：真正的逐端点、区块链锚定的响应闭环至今几乎不存在，原因是延迟、部署与社区不匹配；作者主张用混合链上/链下编排来弥合去信任与快速响应自动化之间的缺口。
Motivation: 现有系统综述忽略了向 EDR/XDR 架构的结构性转变，并把区块链的不同功能角色混为一谈，导致无法解释为何逐端点响应闭环难以落地。
Method: 提出三轴 taxonomy（检测系统类别 × 区块链功能角色 × 响应自动化成熟度），综合 2019–2026 年高水平 venue 的文献做 gap 分析，并系统评估跨文献的结构性挑战：受限设备上的共识延迟、后量子密码脆弱性、智能合约攻击面、以及演化中的 LLM 检测引擎的对抗脆弱性。
Result: 给出逐端点区块链锚定响应环几乎不存在的 gap 结论，归因于 latency、deployment、community 三重不匹配；识别出四类持续存在的横切挑战（共识延迟、后量子密码、智能合约攻击面、LLM 检测引擎对抗脆弱性），并给出以混合链上/链下编排为核心的研究议程。
Conclusion: 去中心化信任与快速响应自动化之间的落差只能靠混合链上/链下编排弥合，而按功能角色而非单一类别区分区块链的作用是做这一判断的前提。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Walking the Embedding Space: Datastore Extraction from Multimodal RAG
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has emerged as a reliable and cost-effective technique of grounding the generative capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into relevant, up-to-date, external knowledge. Despite presenting several benefits, such as reducing hallucinatory behavior, they also introduce new attack surfaces, including leakage of private information and vulnerabilities against data extraction attacks. In this paper, we introduce $\immrag$, an adaptive and automatic data extraction attack procedure operating in a black box setting against \emph{image-returning} MRAG, a configuration in which the retrieved visual artifact is itself the response. Each query blends an attacker-held shadow image with an image already recovered from the system, and relevance-weighted resampling steers subsequent queries towards regions of the embedding space that still yield novel retrievals. Unlike current extraction attacks that aim to persuade the model towards data leakage by placing a malicious query as a textual prompt, $\immrag$ embeds the malicious instructions inside a user-given input image. We evaluate $\immrag$ on three plausible and distinct real-world scenarios: medical assistant, document-focused helper and general purpose tool. The experiments involve the study of the effectiveness of the attack on multiple CLIP-family retrievers, as well as the impact of various generators. A single 2500-query run reconstructs up to 611 distinct radiology images, 566 document scans and 416 general-purpose images under local-feature correspondence, and reaches up to $5.6\times$ as many distinct datastore items as a non-adaptive baseline. Our results show the urgent need for safeguards specifically designed for multimodal data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出针对图像返回型多模态 RAG 的黑盒自适应数据提取攻击 I^2MRAG：把恶意指令藏在攻击者给出的输入图像里，用已恢复图像与影子图像混合查询，并以相关性加权重采样把后续查询推向嵌入空间中尚未覆盖的区域。单次 2500 查询在医学、文档、通用三个场景中分别重建多达 611 张放射影像、566 张文档扫描件和 416 张通用图像，非自适应基线的去重数据存储条目数最高只有其 1/5.6。
Motivation: 多模态 RAG 用外部知识抑制幻觉，却引入私有信息泄露与数据提取攻击面；现有提取攻击靠文本提示诱导泄露，对检索结果本身就是图像的 image-returning MRAG 无效。
Method: I^2MRAG 在黑盒设定下运行：每次查询混合攻击者持有的影子图像与已从系统恢复的图像，恶意指令嵌在用户输入图像而非文本提示中；相关性加权重采样 (relevance-weighted resampling) 引导后续查询进入嵌入空间中仍产生新检索的区域。
Result: 在医疗助手、文档助手、通用工具三个场景、多个 CLIP 系列检索器与不同生成器上评测：单次 2500 查询在局部特征对应 (local-feature correspondence) 下重建多达 611 张放射影像、566 张文档扫描、416 张通用图像；去重数据存储条目数最高达非自适应基线的 5.6 倍。
Conclusion: 自适应、图像内嵌指令的黑盒提取足以大规模重建 MRAG 数据存储，说明需要专门针对多模态数据设计防护。

papers.title: From Pixels to Policy: A Multi-Agent System for Intervention and Geo-Spatial Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Urban environments are shaped by design choices with long-term implications for health, safety, and quality of life, yet evaluating proposed interventions remains costly, time-consuming, and often impractical. Existing geospatial vision methods largely focus on monitoring urban indicators from aerial and street-view imagery, rather than proposing interventions and estimating their effects on such indicators. Moving beyond recognition, we introduce the problem of discovering interventions that improve target indicators for a given aerial or street-view image. We argue that a black-box indicator model, combined with a generative editing model, can serve as an implicit digital twin for testing intervention hypotheses. We present VIDA-Geo , a multi-agent system that explores this intervention space by coordinating segmentation, diffusion-based inpainting, and indicator scoring models to produce interventions that are both perceptually realistic and aligned with real-world policies. We evaluate our system on 8 indicators across aerial and street-view imagery, measuring changes in factors such as perceived safety and greenery. Our approach outperforms existing baselines in many cases, achieving up to 2X higher perceptual quality and policy alignment scores. Finally, our model provides users with multiple candidate interventions, supporting an expert city-planner-in-the-loop workflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIDA-Geo 把「给定航拍或街景图像，自动发现能改善目标指标的城市干预」形式化为新问题，用多智能体系统协调分割、扩散式 inpainting 与指标打分模型，把黑盒指标模型加生成式编辑当作隐式数字孪生来检验干预假设。在 8 个指标（含 perceived safety、greenery）上评测，多数情形超过现有基线，感知质量与政策一致性分数最高达 2 倍，并输出多个候选干预供城市规划专家在环筛选。
Motivation: 现有地理空间视觉方法主要从航拍与街景影像监测城市指标，而不提出干预并估计其对指标的因果效应；真实评估干预方案成本高、耗时长且常常不可行。
Method: 提出多智能体系统 VIDA-Geo：协调 segmentation、diffusion-based inpainting 与 indicator scoring 三类模型在干预空间中搜索，以黑盒指标模型加生成式编辑模型充当隐式数字 twin，生成既视觉真实又贴合现实政策的干预编辑。
Result: 在航拍与街景影像共 8 个指标上评测，测量 perceived safety、greenery 等因子的变化；多数情形优于现有基线，感知质量与政策一致性分数最高达到基线的 2 倍。
Conclusion: 生成式编辑加指标打分的隐式数字孪生可用于发现并排序城市干预方案，且输出多候选方案支持专家在环的城市规划决策流程。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: From Isolated Feature to Orbits: Discovering Music Concepts via Multi-SAE Alignment
papers.abstract_en: How can we understand what a music foundation model has learned \textit{internally}? Most interpretability approaches, such as probing and Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), focus on identifying individual features with minimal structural assumptions. We argue that many concepts are better understood as \textit{structured relations} rather than isolated features. This is especially prominent in music, where tonal structures are organized in the space of pitch and time. For example, concepts such as chords or keys are naturally expressed as structured sets (e.g., the 12 transpositions of a chord or the diatonic system within a key), rather than isolated features. In this study, \textbf{we shift from feature identification to structure-based analysis}, asking whether the learned inner representations of music foundation model emerge as organized structures over features. To this end, we introduce a framework that uses pitch transposition as an inductive bias to induce ordered orbits via multi-view SAE alignment. Concretely, we generate pitch-shifted input pairs and align their SAE representations to discover structured groups of pitch-related features. Experimental results show that this approach recovers orbit structures corresponding to chords, keys, and melodic patterns across two state-of-the-art music foundation models, while requiring only minimal grounding (e.g., a few anchor examples) to interpret entire concept families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把音乐基础模型的可解释性从孤立特征识别转向结构化关系发现：用音高移调作为归纳偏置，生成移调输入对并对齐多个 SAE 表示，诱导出有序 orbit 结构。在两个 SOTA 音乐基础模型上恢复出对应和弦、调式与旋律模式的 orbit，只需少量 anchor 样本即可解释整个概念族。
Motivation: probing 与 Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) 默认概念是孤立特征、结构假设最小，但音乐中的音高与时间概念（和弦的 12 个移调、调内的自然音体系）天然是结构化集合，逐特征识别无法表达这类关系。
Method: 提出 multi-view SAE alignment 框架：以音高移调 (pitch transposition) 为归纳偏置，生成移调输入对，对齐它们的 SAE 表示以发现音高相关特征的有序 orbit 分组；解释时只需少量 anchor 样本作为 grounding。
Result: 在两个 state-of-the-art 音乐基础模型上，该方法恢复出对应和弦、调 (keys) 与旋律模式的 orbit 结构，并以极少 anchor 示例覆盖整个概念族。
Conclusion: 音乐概念应按结构化关系而非孤立特征来理解，移调对齐 SAE 表示足以从少量 grounding 中归纳出完整的概念族结构。

papers.title: LiteReality-Agent: An Agentic System for Interactable 3D Indoor Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We present LiteReality-Agent, an agentic system for reconstructing real indoor environments as realistic, articulated, and simulation-ready 3D scenes from RGB-D scans. At its core, LiteReality-Agent formulates 3D reconstruction as a coding problem, in which a coding agent gathers evidence using specialised tools and iteratively edits a Python script, Room.py, which can be executed to produce a 3D digital twin of the room. With this formulation, we develop a robust observe-edit-verify harness that supports evidence gathering, measurement, verification, layout optimisation, simulation readiness, and quality control throughout the reconstruction process. LiteReality-Agent produces high-quality reconstructions suitable for simulation and downstream embodied AI tasks. Furthermore, as agent capabilities continue to improve rapidly, the system introduced by LiteReality-Agent remains a strong orchestration framework for future agents: it equips them with specialised tools, structured workflows, and robust verification mechanisms that substantially improve reconstruction quality and reliability. We demonstrate that LiteReality-Agent produces reconstructions that are more geometrically accurate, visually realistic, and simulation-compatible than those generated by recent frontier models, such as Astra and Fable. We therefore view LiteReality-Agent as a practical and important building block for robust real-to-sim systems. Both the source code and the data-capture application are publicly available. Code:https://github.com/LiteReality/LiteReality-Agent/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiteReality-Agent 把室内 RGB-D 重建形式化为写代码问题：智能体用专用工具收集证据并反复编辑可执行的 Room.py，生成带铰接、可直接进仿真的 3D 房间数字孪生。其 observe-edit-verify 流程在几何精度、视觉真实感与仿真兼容性上优于 Astra、Fable 等前沿模型的输出。
Motivation: 真实室内环境的 real-to-sim 重建需要几何准确、可动、可仿真，而直接让前沿大模型端到端生成难以保证测量、布局与仿真就绪性。
Method: 核心是把 3D 重建写成编码问题：智能体通过专用工具收集证据，迭代编辑可执行脚本 Room.py 生成房间数字孪生；配套 observe-edit-verify harness 覆盖证据收集、测量、验证、布局优化、仿真就绪与质量控制。
Result: 生成的重建在几何精度、视觉真实感与仿真兼容性上优于近期前沿模型 Astra 与 Fable 的输出；源码与数据采集应用公开。
Conclusion: 把重建交给带结构化工作流与验证机制的编码智能体，是构建稳健 real-to-sim 系统的实用基础模块，且随智能体能力提升仍可作为编排框架复用。

papers.title: AVSD-Scenes: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Description of Urban Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Natural language descriptions can provide rich semantic representations of audio-visual urban scenes, yet datasets that jointly describe both auditory and visual information remain limited. In this paper, we introduce AVSD-Scenes, a paired audio-visual scene description dataset for urban environments. The dataset contains 12,291 audio-visual scene descriptions generated from the TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes dataset. To construct the dataset, we first generate audio- and visual-based descriptions using Qwen2-Audio-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, respectively. These modality-specific descriptions are then combined using large language models, namely Qwen3-14B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, and Gemma-3-27B-it, to produce multimodal descriptions that capture complementary information from both modalities. We benchmark AVSD-Scenes using semantic alignment, cross-modal retrieval, scene classification, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human subjective assessment. Results show that multimodal descriptions improve semantic alignment and cross-modal retrieval performance compared with modality-specific descriptions while preserving strong scene-discriminative information. The generated descriptions achieve up to 94.5% accuracy in urban scene classification, while combining audio, visual, and description embeddings further improves accuracy to 95.4%. Furthermore, the descriptions remain highly scene-discriminative even when scene labels are removed from the prompting instructions, indicating that they capture semantic information derived from the audio-visual content rather than merely reflecting label information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AVSD-Scenes 是一个由 TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes 生成的城市场景音视描述数据集，含 12,291 条配对描述：先用 Qwen2-Audio-7B 与 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 分别生成音频、视觉描述，再由 Qwen3-14B、Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506、Gemma-3-27B-it 融合成多模态描述。多模态描述在语义对齐与跨模态检索上优于单模态描述，场景分类准确率最高 94.5%，融合音视与描述嵌入后达 95.4%。
Motivation: 同时描述听觉与视觉信息的场景描述数据集稀缺，城市环境的音视语义联合表示缺少可用的配对语料与基准。
Method: 从 TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes 出发，用 Qwen2-Audio-7B 生成音频描述、Qwen2.5-VL-7B 生成视觉描述，再用 Qwen3-14B、Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506、Gemma-3-27B-it 三个 LLM 将两路描述合并为多模态描述；基准评测涵盖语义对齐、跨模态检索、场景分类、LLM-as-a-judge 与人类主观评估。
Result: 数据集含 12,291 条音视场景描述；多模态描述相比单模态描述提升语义对齐与跨模态检索表现，同时保持强场景判别信息；城市场景分类准确率最高 94.5%，融合音频、视觉与描述嵌入后进一步升至 95.4%；即使从提示中移除场景标签，描述仍高度可判别场景。
Conclusion: 多模态描述携带的是来自音视内容本身的语义信息而非标签泄漏，因此可用于提升语义对齐、跨模态检索并保留场景判别力。

papers.title: Detecting Inconsistencies in Model Specifications with LLM-as-Verifier Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Model specifications define how large language models (LLMs) should behave, guiding alignment training, inference-time behavior, and evaluation. Yet these specifications may themselves contain defects: two individually reasonable principles may prescribe incompatible behavior when applied to the same situation, leaving no response that satisfies both. Detecting such inconsistencies is challenging. Formalizing natural-language specifications risks losing subtle distinctions, while behavior-based testing cannot reliably distinguish specification defects from differences in model behavior. We introduce VeriSpec, the first approach to directly detect inconsistencies in model specifications by auditing the specification text itself. Our key insight is to preserve the specification in natural language while using an LLM as a verifier. VeriSpec extracts structured, context-aware rules, constructs a topic-guided graph to cluster behaviorally related rules at the same authority level, and applies LLM-as-verifier reasoning to detect inconsistencies. Applying VeriSpec to the OpenAI Model Spec, we extract 405 rules and manually validate five inconsistencies, all reported to its developers, who responded positively and have initiated internal discussions. Compared with five baselines, VeriSpec identifies the most validated inconsistencies, achieves the highest precision (38.5%), and incurs the lowest cost per validated inconsistency ($11.12). These results establish direct specification auditing as a practical complement to behavioral alignment evaluation, catching defects at the source before they shape any model. The code is available at https://github.com/HIPREL-Group/VeriSpec.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VeriSpec 直接审计模型规范文本本身：抽取结构化规则、按主题与权威层级建图聚类，再用 LLM-as-verifier 推理找互相冲突的条款。在 OpenAI Model Spec 上抽出 405 条规则，人工确认 5 处不一致，精确率 38.5%，每个已验证不一致成本 $11.12，均为五个基线中最好。
Motivation: 模型规范本身可能自相冲突——两条各自合理的原则在同一情境下给出互斥要求，形式化会丢失细微语义差别，行为测试又分不清规范缺陷与模型行为差异。
Method: 保留规范的自然语言形式，用 LLM 抽取带上下文的结构化规则，构建 topic-guided graph 把同一权威层级上行为相关的规则聚在一起，再以 LLM-as-verifier 推理判定规则间是否矛盾。
Result: 在 OpenAI Model Spec 上抽取 405 条规则，人工验证出 5 处不一致（全部已报告给开发者并获积极回应）；对比五个基线，VeriSpec 找到的已验证不一致最多，精确率 38.5% 最高，每个已验证不一致成本 $11.12 最低。
Conclusion: 直接审计规范文本可作为行为对齐评估的实用补充，在缺陷影响模型之前于源头捕获它；代码已开源。

papers.title: Beyond Decodability: Do Acoustic Factors Drive Predictions in Speech-Based Alzheimer's Assessment?
papers.abstract_en: Speech-based Alzheimer's disease (AD) assessments increasingly rely on pretrained self-supervised learning (SSL) models that learn acoustic representations directly from raw audio, exposing the model to recording factors. We ask whether such factors are merely encoded in SSL representations or can systematically alter predictions. Using ADReSSo and three large SSL backbones, we apply controlled noise and reverberation interventions to participant-speech-only, non-speech, and full-recording audio. We combine layer-wise linear decoding, input- and representation-space interventions, and geometric alignment analysis to distinguish acoustic decodability from influence on AD prediction. Our results show that controlled acoustic interventions alter AD predictions across all three SSL backbones. Noise, despite showing no significant diagnostic-group difference in the original data, produces the strongest intervention effects. Importantly, these effects are systematically structured relative to the classifier's decision direction, replicate on the held-out test set and reverse when the representation-space intervention direction is reversed. Together, these findings show that high predictive performance and the absence of a significant diagnostic-group difference in a measured acoustic factor are not sufficient for robustness. We argue that intervention-based robustness tests should become standard for trustworthy clinical speech models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ADReSSo 阿尔茨海默病语音诊断上，对三个大型 SSL backbone 施加受控噪声与混响干预（仅被试语音、非语音、完整录音），发现声学因素不只是被编码，而是系统性改变 AD 预测：原始数据中无显著诊断组差异的噪声反而产生最强干预效应，且效应相对分类器决策方向呈结构化，在留出测试集复现、反转干预方向后随之反转。作者据此主张干预式鲁棒性测试应成为临床语音模型的标准流程。
Motivation: SSL 语音模型直接从原始音频学表征，会吸收录音条件；但“某声学因素可被解码”与“该因素真正影响预测”是两回事，仅凭高预测性能和该因素无显著组间差异不足以保证临床鲁棒性。
Method: 在 ADReSSo 上用三个大型 SSL backbone，对仅被试语音、非语音与完整录音施加受控噪声和混响干预；组合 layer-wise linear decoding、输入空间与表征空间干预，以及几何对齐分析 (geometric alignment analysis)，区分可解码性与对 AD 预测的实际影响。
Result: 受控声学干预在全部三个 SSL backbone 上均改变 AD 预测；噪声在原始数据中无显著诊断组差异，却产生最强干预效应；效应相对分类器决策方向系统性组织，在留出测试集复现，且表征空间干预方向反转时效应随之反转。
Conclusion: 高预测性能加上某声学因素无显著诊断组差异，并不能保证模型鲁棒；干预式鲁棒性测试应成为可信临床语音模型的标准环节。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.conclusion: 高预测性能加上某声学因素无显著诊断组差异，并不能保证模型鲁棒；干预式鲁棒性测试应成为可信临床语音模型的标准环节。

papers.title: Temporal-Difference Learning for Dragonchess
papers.abstract_en: Our research investigates how two adaptive AI methods, evolutionary transfer learning and TD(lambda), perform in the three-dimensional chess environment Dragonchess. The game challenges players with its unique board structure and computational load, making it an ideal setting to study how adaptive methods can update evaluation heuristics in novel environments. In this work we re-implement the Dragonchess engine, changing it from a PyGame engine to C++. This enables faster gameplay, allowing us to run 10,000 games with confidence intervals and significance tests, rather than a single small tournament. Both adaptive methods outperform all other agents in the round-robin tournament. Our results showed that there is no significant difference in the performance between the evolved and learned evaluations. This research establishes the efficacy of adaptive methods in structurally complex, novel game domains.

papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Optimal Stochastic Bilevel Optimization with First-Order Oracles
papers.abstract_en: We study nonconvex--strongly-convex bilevel optimization under a stochastic first-order oracle. We introduce MRT-FD, a single-loop first-order method that simultaneously tracks the upper-level variable, the lower-level solution, and the auxiliary response arising from implicit differentiation of the hyperobjective. MRT-FD performs one update of each variable per iteration and approximates the second-order derivative actions using order-$p$ finite differences. For any fixed finite smoothness order $p\ge1$ in the lower-level variable, MRT-FD finds an $\varepsilon$-stationary point using $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-4-2/p})$ stochastic gradient queries. We also prove a matching $Ω(\varepsilon^{-4-2/p})$ oracle lower bound. The lower-bound construction starts from a hard nonconvex minimization chain with a stronger stochastic oracle, and lifts it to a bilevel problem through a sinusoidal coupling with a scalar lower-level variable. Consequently, the dependence on $\varepsilon$ is optimal for every fixed finite $p$, closing the upper--lower complexity gap in this stochastic first-order oracle setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出单循环一阶方法 MRT-FD，同时跟踪上层变量、下层解与隐式微分带来的辅助响应，用 order-p 有限差分近似二阶导数作用。对任意固定有限光滑阶 p≥1，找到 ε-驻点需 O(ε^{-4-2/p}) 次随机梯度查询，并证明匹配的 Ω(ε^{-4-2/p}) 下界，从而在该随机一阶 oracle 设定下闭合上下复杂度差距。
Motivation: 非凸-强凸双层优化在随机一阶 oracle 下，二阶导数作用无法直接计算，且 ε 依赖的上下复杂度差距此前未闭合。
Method: MRT-FD 每次迭代对上层变量、下层解、隐式微分辅助响应各做一次更新（单循环），用 order-p 有限差分近似二阶导数作用；下界从更强随机 oracle 下的困难非凸极小化链出发，经正弦耦合与标量下层变量提升为双层问题。
Result: 对任意固定有限 p≥1，MRT-FD 以 O(ε^{-4-2/p}) 次随机梯度查询达到 ε-驻点，并证明匹配的 Ω(ε^{-4-2/p}) oracle 下界，ε 依赖对每个固定有限 p 均最优。
Conclusion: 在随机一阶 oracle 的非凸-强凸双层优化中，order-p 有限差分单循环方法的 ε 复杂度上下界匹配，复杂度差距被闭合。
