papers.title: On the Divergence of Accuracy and Mechanism Consistency in Time Series World Models
papers.abstract_en: A time series world model (TSWM) predicts a controlled system's state from its observed history and planned actions and exogenous inputs. Current approaches build forecasters with actions as covariates, trained and evaluated on prediction error under the executed plan. Yet world models compare unexecuted plans, but their responses to changed plans remain untested. We ask which design choices matter and whether accurate forecasters respond to changed plans as real systems do. We address both with a formalization and benchmark. The formalization separates state, actions and exogenous inputs, distinguishes continuous, mode and event actions, and introduces mechanism consistency, a metric built on declared action-state relations with known directions, such as a vasopressor raising blood pressure: it checks whether shifting an action moves the forecast in the declared direction. The benchmark consolidates eight public datasets with real actions from engineered infrastructure and clinical care, varying prediction space, plan fusion and plan encoding across seven backbones and five seeds. First, a frozen latent prediction space lowers MAE by 9.9% over observation space and gated output fusion lowers it by 12.7% over input concatenation on average, with both improving all eight datasets; temporal plan encoding changes average MAE by at most 2.2%. Second, prediction error and mechanism consistency diverge: the lowest-error configuration is at or below chance in consistency on four of five datasets with declared mechanisms, and no design choice avoids this. Finally, directional supervision, a loss penalizing the wrong-signed part of the response to a shifted action, significantly raises consistency on penalized mechanisms with no change in MAE. Together they give TSWMs a recipe: a frozen latent space and output-side fusion for accuracy, and a training objective for mechanism consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 时间序列世界模型 (TSWM) 只按预测误差训练和评测，但模型要比较未执行的计划，其对计划改变的响应从未被检验。作者提出机制一致性 (mechanism consistency) 指标：在声明的动作-状态方向关系上，检查平移动作后预测是否朝声明方向移动。八个真实动作数据集上，最低 MAE 的配置在五个有声明机制的数据集中的四个上一致性处于或低于随机水平，且没有任何设计选择能避免；方向监督损失可显著提升被惩罚机制的一致性且 MAE 不变。
Motivation: 世界模型要比较未执行的计划，但现有 TSWM 只在执行计划下的预测误差上训练评测，对计划改变的响应方向是否与真实系统一致完全没有检验，准确的预报器可能机制上是错的。
Method: 形式化上分离状态、动作与外生输入，区分连续、模式与事件动作，并提出基于声明动作-状态方向关系的机制一致性指标。基准整合八个含真实动作的公开数据集（工程基础设施与临床照护），在七个骨干网络、五种随机种子上变化预测空间、计划融合与计划编码；另引入方向监督损失，惩罚动作平移响应中符号错误的部分。
Result: 冻结隐空间预测比观测空间平均降低 MAE 9.9%，门控输出融合比输入拼接平均降低 12.7%，两者在全部八个数据集上均改善；时序计划编码对平均 MAE 影响至多 2.2%。预测误差与机制一致性发散：最低误差配置在五个有声明机制的数据集中的四个上一致性处于或低于随机水平，且无设计选择可避免。方向监督在被惩罚机制上显著提升一致性，MAE 无变化。
Conclusion: 精度与机制一致性是两个需要分别优化的目标：精度靠冻结隐空间加输出侧融合，机制一致性靠训练目标（方向监督损失），二者不能互相替代。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Varda-single-1.0: deterministic data-driven weather forecasting at 1 km resolution over Switzerland's complex topography
papers.abstract_en: We present Varda-single-1.0, a medium-range data-driven weather prediction system built for the Alpine domain. It provides hourly deterministic regional forecasts on a mesh of 1 km resolution and global forecasts on a 31 km mesh. The system comprises two independently trained stretched-grid Graph Transformer models with encoder-processor-decoder architecture, developed in the Anemoi framework: a 6-hourly autoregressive forecaster and a temporal downscaler reconstructing hourly forecasts between the forecaster's steps. Its training curriculum includes pre-training on ERA5 reanalysis data, followed by training on a 20-year kilometre-scale regional reanalysis, and finally fine-tuning on operational kilometre-scale analyses. Verified over one year against operational analyses and surface station observations, Varda-single is competitive with or improves on MeteoSwiss' operational numerical weather prediction baselines for most headline scores and variables. It broadly matches the skill of the high-resolution 1 km ICON-CH1-EPS control at lead times up to +33 h and generally outperforms the 2 km ICON-CH2-EPS control at lead times up to +120 h. Despite competitive aggregate scores, Varda-single underestimates some local wind maxima and produces overly smooth convective precipitation fields, consistent with the smoothing associated with squared-error training. To gain insight into the model's behaviour, we investigate three case studies beyond the aggregated headline scores, and find particular weaknesses in Varda-single's representation of local winds over complex terrain. Varda-single represents an important step in the development of high-resolution ML forecasting over complex terrain, in complementing the operational regional numerical weather prediction models of MeteoSwiss with data-driven models and in providing a pretrained model for researchers and user-specific applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Varda-single-1.0 是面向阿尔卑斯区域的数据驱动天气预报系统：两个独立训练的 stretched-grid Graph Transformer（6 小时自回归预报器 + 逐小时时间降尺度器）在 1 km 阿尔卑斯网格和 31 km 全球网格上给出确定性逐小时预报。用 ERA5 预训练、20 年公里级区域再分析继续训练、再在业务分析上微调后，一年检验中多数头部评分与变量持平或优于 MeteoSwiss 业务 NWP 基线，但对流降水场偏平滑、局地风极大值被低估。
Motivation: 复杂地形上的高分辨率 ML 天气预报缺少可与区域业务 NWP 直接对比的确定性系统；阿尔卑斯 1 km 尺度的局地风与对流降水正是现有数据驱动模型的薄弱处。
Method: 在 Anemoi 框架中构建两个独立训练的 stretched-grid Graph Transformer，均为 encoder-processor-decoder：6 小时步长的自回归预报器，加上在预报器步间重建逐小时场的时间降尺度器。训练课程为 ERA5 预训练 → 20 年公里级区域再分析训练 → 业务公里级分析微调；输出 1 km 阿尔卑斯网格与 31 km 全球网格的确定性预报。
Result: 在一年期、对照业务分析与地面站观测的检验中，多数头部评分与变量上持平或优于 MeteoSwiss 业务 NWP 基线：在 +33 h 以内大体追平 1 km ICON-CH1-EPS 控制预报的技巧，在 +120 h 以内通常优于 2 km ICON-CH2-EPS 控制预报。同时低估部分局地风极大值，对流降水场过度平滑，与平方误差训练带来的平滑一致；三个个例分析显示复杂地形局地风表征是明显弱点。
Conclusion: 数据驱动模型可在复杂地形上作为区域业务 NWP 的补充并提供可复用的预训练权重，但平方误差训练会抹平对流降水与局地风极值，这类高分辨率量需要针对性处理。
Relevance: 78

papers.title: Code Owns the Simulation, Jev Owns the Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Judgment models such as \jev{} return, in a single call and without reasoning text, a probability for each described option. This makes them attractive as an agent's action-selection layer, but it is unclear which decisions they can be trusted with. We test \jev{} on reflection tests, one-shot matrix games, the text game ALFWorld and robot control, and find a sharp boundary. \jev{} succeeds when the right option can be judged from what the input describes, which we call \emph{evaluation}. Specifically, it solves 99\% of the counterintuitive Cognitive Reflection Test questions. However, it fails when the right option depends on \emph{simulation} (i.e., predicting something not in the input), such as the opponent's action or the subgoal that must come first. In games, \jev{} plays suboptimally as if its rational opponent acted at random, because the opponent's action is not given. In ALFWorld, \jev{} favors commands that mention an object or place named in the task description. For example, given the task ``put a clean knife in the drawer'', \jev{} carries an unwashed knife straight to the drawer instead of first washing it at the sink. Surprisingly, many of these failures are not due to a lack of knowledge. Asked separately what the opponent will do, \jev{} usually answers correctly, and it responds well given the opponent's action. It fails when one call must both perform the simulation and evaluate based on it. This suggests letting code make the prediction or simulation. When code supplies it, such as a lookahead in ALFWorld and physics simulation in robot control, \jev{} becomes an expert controller through its general evaluation ability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对判断模型 Jev（单次调用直接输出各选项概率、不产生推理文本）在反射测试、单次矩阵博弈、ALFWorld 文本游戏与机器人控制上划定边界：凡是正确选项可由输入内容直接判定（evaluation），Jev 表现强，如 99% 解出反直觉 Cognitive Reflection Test；凡正确选项依赖 simulation（预测输入中不存在的信息，如对手动作、必须先做的子目标），Jev 就失败，在博弈中表现得仿佛理性对手随机行动。作者的结论是把预测/仿真交给代码：代码提供前瞻 (lookahead) 或物理仿真后，Jev 凭其通用评估能力成为专家控制器。
Motivation: 判断模型被当作智能体的动作选择层很有吸引力，但哪些决策可以托付给它并不清楚：失败究竟源于知识不足，还是源于单次调用无法同时完成仿真与评估。
Method: 在四类环境上测试 Jev：反射测试 (reflection tests)、单次矩阵博弈 (one-shot matrix games)、ALFWorld 文本游戏与机器人控制；对照条件是把对手动作等预测信息单独提供给 Jev，以及由代码注入 lookahead 与物理仿真。

papers.title: Continuous Process-Level Evaluation for Evolving Enterprise AI Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise AI agent skills evolve as tool APIs, models, and specifications change, yet final-output evaluation can miss process-level behavioral drift. We present a continuous evaluation framework combining outcome-level and process-level checks, applied to Revenue and Productivity variants of a Business Value Determination skill in an enterprise Value Aware Resiliency system. The framework independently computes per-run ground truth, materializes reusable template tests, and evaluates tool selection, arguments, execution order, and database integrity through programmatic checks and a narrowly scoped LLM judge. We evaluate 240 trials across two skills, two specification variants, two agent harnesses, and three models. Of 175 trials passing all applicable final numerical checks, 162 (92.6 percent; Wilson 95 percent CI: 87.7-95.6 percent) contained another evaluator-detected deviation. Under a broader seven-check final-state definition, 151 of 164 passing runs (92.1 percent; 95 percent CI: 86.9-95.3 percent) still violated a trajectory check. Dependency attribution reduced a mean of 6.34 failed checks per run to 2.65 roots. Specification sensitivity varied by model and harness, with exploratory bootstrap interaction intervals excluding zero for all three Revenue comparisons and one of three Productivity comparisons. Runtime-resolved templates provided reusable regression coverage across the evaluated configurations; longitudinal validation under actual API evolution remains future work.
papers.comment: Accepted to Workshop on Continual Learning for Enterprise AI Agents (CLEA), NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出企业 AI agent 技能的持续过程级评估框架，把结果级检查与轨迹级检查（工具选择、参数、执行顺序、数据库完整性）结合，并独立计算每次运行的 ground truth。240 次试验中，通过全部最终数值检查的 175 次里有 162 次（92.6%，Wilson 95% CI 87.7–95.6%）仍被评估器检出偏差；依赖归因把每次运行平均 6.34 个失败检查收敛到 2.65 个根因。
Motivation: 企业 agent 的工具 API、模型与规格持续变化，只看最终输出的评估会漏掉过程级行为漂移，规格敏感性也难以定位到具体根因。
Method: 框架对每次运行独立计算 ground truth，物化可复用模板测试，用程序化检查加一个窄作用域 LLM judge 评估工具选择、参数、执行顺序与数据库完整性；再用依赖归因把失败检查归到根因，并以 bootstrap 交互区间检验规格敏感性。
Result: 共 240 次试验，覆盖 2 个 skill（Revenue 与 Productivity 变体）、2 种规格变体、2 个 agent harness、3 个模型。175 次通过全部适用最终数值检查的试验中 162 次（92.6%，Wilson 95% CI 87.7–95.6%）存在另一评估器检出的偏差；按更宽的七项最终状态定义，164 次通过中 151 次（92.1%，95% CI 86.9–95.3%）仍违反轨迹检查。依赖归因将每次运行平均 6.34 个失败检查降到 2.65 个根因；bootstrap 交互区间在三项 Revenue 比较与三项 Productivity 比较中的一项排除零。
Conclusion: 最终输出通过不等于过程无漂移：绝大多数通过最终检查的运行仍带过程级偏差，过程级检查加依赖归因可把失败收敛到少数根因；实际 API 演化下的纵向验证仍是未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pooling Helps, Learned Weighting Hurts In-Context: Decomposing Group Attention
papers.abstract_en: Group attention, introduced by the time series forecasting model Chronos-2, attends over the variates of a group at a fixed patch index and serves both multivariate (MV) and in-context learning (ICL) forecasting. Rather than evaluating this cross-variate attention design as a whole, we ask which part of the mechanism earns the benefit and probe its applicability to both MV and ICL regimes. By editing the attention matrix $α$ at inference we separate the two pathways a head comprises: V/O, which projects a weighted summary of the group, and Q/K, which decides the weights. Uniform pooling (V/O without any Q/K weighting) is positive on 18 of our 20 sensor-network configurations, while the learned weighting (Q/K) splits by group type: its contribution is positive or negligible for MV, but materially degrades 8 of the 10 sensor-network ICL configurations, leaving 4 of them worse than univariate inference. By isolating the impact of different layers, we find that uniforming $α$ in the first block alone improves every ICL configuration we test.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Chronos-2 的 group attention 做推理期注意力矩阵编辑，把跨变量注意力拆成 V/O（对组内变量做加权汇总）与 Q/K（决定权重）两条通路。均匀池化（只留 V/O、去掉 Q/K 加权）在 20 个传感器网络配置中 18 个为正；学习到的 Q/K 加权在多变量 (MV) 场景正向或可忽略，却在 10 个传感器网络 ICL 配置中的 8 个明显变差、其中 4 个比单变量推理还差，仅把第一层 block 的 α 置为均匀即可改善全部 ICL 配置。
Motivation: Chronos-2 的 group attention 同时服务多变量与 in-context learning 两种预报机制，但整体评估无法区分收益来自跨变量汇总本身还是 Q/K 学到的权重，导致 ICL 场景下该设计是否该保留并不清楚。
Method: 在推理阶段直接编辑注意力矩阵 α，把一个 head 拆成 V/O 通路（对组内变量的加权汇总）与 Q/K 通路（决定权重）分别消融：令 α 均匀以移除学习权重，逐层定位贡献，并在 20 个传感器网络配置上对比 MV 与 ICL 两种预报 regime。
Result: 均匀池化在 20 个传感器网络配置中 18 个为正；Q/K 学习权重在 MV 上正向或可忽略，但在 10 个传感器网络 ICL 配置中 8 个显著变差，其中 4 个劣于单变量推理；仅在第一个 block 中把 α 置为均匀即可改善测试的每一个 ICL 配置。
Conclusion: group attention 的收益来自 V/O 的组内汇总而非 Q/K 学到的权重；在 ICL 传感器网络预报中应去掉（至少首层去掉）Q/K 加权，改用均匀池化。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Scientific Discovery under Validation Congestion via Multi-Fidelity Pairwise Rankings
papers.abstract_en: Modern computational methods can now propose candidate molecules, materials, and other scientific designs at an unprecedented scale, creating a validation congestion where candidates are abundant, but experimental capacity to physically evaluate them remains scarce. Discovering novel scientific designs has therefore become increasingly dependent on curation: selecting a small set of promising designs for slow and costly experiments. Existing curation methods typically rely on data-driven regression models that predict absolute scores, but training these models requires substantial experimental data to begin with. Yet, useful curation signals do not have to take the form of absolute measurements, as scientific design discovery is often comparative in nature. Here, we propose that curation can instead be primarily driven by expert pairwise rankings, which are substantially easier to gather. The expertise can come from computational tools or human input of multiple levels of fidelity, ranging from empirical rules of thumb to agentic workflows and experienced scientists. We introduce PRISMS, a framework that uses pairwise rankings from one or more experts, potentially spanning multiple levels of expertise, to identify the most promising candidates without relying on data-hungry regressors. When experts differ in fidelity and cost, PRISMS escalates pairwise queries from lower- to higher-fidelity rankers based on a Fisher-information criterion. In iterative screening that selects designs from fixed drug discovery libraries, PRISMS achieves 50% top-10 discovery recall in ~42% fewer rounds than regression-only active learning, and in ~15% fewer rounds than the ranking-based method with no selective escalation. In optimization that generates new designs without restriction to a predefined library, PRISMS achieves ~18.8% higher hypervolume than the Bayesian optimization baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISMS 用专家成对排序 (pairwise rankings) 取代需要大量实验数据训练的绝对分数回归器来筛选候选分子/材料，并按 Fisher 信息准则把查询从低保真排序器升级到高保真排序器。在固定药物发现库的迭代筛选中，达到 50% top-10 discovery recall 所需轮数比仅用回归的主动学习少约 42%，比不做选择性升级的排序法少约 15%；在无预定义库的优化任务上比 Bayesian optimization 基线高约 18.8% hypervolume。
Motivation: 计算方法能大规模生成候选设计，但实验验证能力稀缺，形成 validation congestion；现有筛选依赖需要大量实验数据训练的绝对分数回归模型，而数据本身正是瓶颈。
Method: PRISMS 框架接受一个或多个、可跨不同保真度与成本的专家成对排序（来源可为经验规则、agentic workflows 到资深科学家），不依赖数据饥渴的回归器；当专家保真度与成本不同时，依据 Fisher-information criterion 决定何时把成对查询从低保真升级到高保真排序器，用于迭代筛选与生成式优化。
Result: 在固定药物发现库的迭代筛选中，PRISMS 用约 42% 更少的轮数达到 50% top-10 discovery recall（相对 regression-only active learning），用约 15% 更少的轮数（相对无选择性升级的排序方法）；在不限于预定义库的优化任务中，hypervolume 比 Bayesian optimization 基线高约 18.8%。
Conclusion: 科学设计筛选可以主要由易收集的专家成对排序驱动，配合基于 Fisher 信息的保真度升级即可在验证拥堵下更省实验轮数地找到高价值候选。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Token Communication-Assisted Collaborative Embodied Artificial Intelligence: Concepts, Framework, and Opportunities
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative embodied artificial intelligence (CEAI) enables multiple physical agents to perceive, reason, and act cooperatively in dynamic environments. Effective communication is essential for CEAI, yet CEAI agents must exchange not only large multimodal observations but also task-relevant insights, intents, and interactive information over long horizons. This article investigates token communication (TokCom) as a native intelligence interface for CEAI, in which tokens serve jointly as compact semantic carriers for communication and fundamental inference units for generative foundation models (GFMs). We first discuss how TokCom supports insight sharing, intent alignment, and interactive control among embodied agents. We then propose a TokCom-assisted CEAI framework driven by a task-adaptive communication protocol. Comprising a compact codebook, syntax rules, and contextual examples, this protocol guides GFM-based transceivers to distill messages into compact tokens and reconstruct them after wireless transmission. A case study on collaborative object transport demonstrates that the proposed TokCom framework substantially reduces the source payload bit consumption while preserving task efficiency and showing robustness under noisy channels. Finally, we outline future research directions.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以 token 为统一语义载体与推理单元的 TokCom 协作具身 AI 框架：任务自适应通信协议（codebook、语法规则、上下文示例）引导 GFM 收发端把多模态观测与意图蒸馏成紧凑 token，无线传输后再重建。协作搬运物体案例显示源端比特开销大幅下降，同时保持任务效率并在含噪信道下表现稳健。
Motivation: CEAI 中多物理智能体需在长时程内交换多模态观测、任务洞察与意图，原始数据比特开销大且对无线链路噪声敏感，通信本身应成为智能接口而非透明管道。
Method: 提出 TokCom-assisted CEAI 框架，核心是任务自适应通信协议：由紧凑 codebook、语法规则和上下文示例构成，指导基于生成式基础模型 (GFM) 的收发端将消息蒸馏为紧凑 token，并在无线传输后重建；讨论其在洞察共享、意图对齐与交互控制中的作用。
Result: 在协作物体搬运 (collaborative object transport) 案例中，TokCom 框架显著降低源端 payload 比特消耗，同时保持任务效率，并在含噪信道下展现稳健性。

papers.title: Generalized Engression Models
papers.abstract_en: We consider estimating the conditional distribution of a multivariate outcome given covariates when its coordinates may be continuous, binary, categorical, ordinal or rankings, and are conditionally dependent on one another. Different statistical methods have been developed for each outcome type, and most of them target a summary of the conditional distribution, such as the mean of each coordinate, rather than the joint distribution of the outcome vector. We develop generalized engression models, a unified nonparametric distributional regression framework for outcomes of any type. The proposed method builds upon engression, a scoring-rule-based deep generative model, and introduces a data-type-specific link function and a stochastic perturbation that smooths the loss, enabling gradient-based training even with discontinuous links. We establish universal representation results for continuous, discrete and mixed outcomes. In simulations and in two applications, 242 species in a community ecology benchmark and a 17-dimensional mixed-type health outcome, the method matches type-specific models on marginal scores, improves on them on the joint distribution, and matches or exceeds purpose-built state-of-the-art joint species distribution models. Software is available in Python.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 generalized engression：把基于评分规则的深度生成模型 engression 推广到连续、二元、分类、序数与排序等任意结局类型，用类型特定 link 函数和随机扰动平滑损失，使不连续 link 也能做梯度训练，并给出连续、离散与混合结局的通用表示结果。在 242 物种群落生态基准与 17 维混合类型健康结局上，边缘评分与各类型专用模型持平，联合分布更优，并持平或超过专用的联合物种分布模型 (JSDM)。
Motivation: 现有方法按结局类型各自为政，且多数只估计条件分布的摘要（如各坐标均值）而非整个联合分布；连续、离散、序数、排序混杂且坐标间条件相关时没有统一框架。
Method: 以 scoring-rule-based 深度生成模型 engression 为基础，加入数据类型特定的 link 函数与平滑损失的随机扰动 (stochastic perturbation)，使梯度训练在不连续 link 下仍可行；建立连续、离散与混合结局的通用表示 (universal representation) 结果，软件以 Python 提供。
Result: 在模拟与两个应用中——242 个物种的群落生态基准、17 维混合类型健康结局——该方法在边缘评分 (marginal scores) 上与各类型专用模型持平，在联合分布上优于它们，并持平或超过专门设计的 SOTA 联合物种分布模型 (JSDM)。
Conclusion: 一个带类型特定 link 与损失平滑的统一非参数分布回归框架，可以在不牺牲边缘拟合的前提下改善条件联合分布估计，覆盖任意结局类型。

papers.title: Beyond Linear Concepts: Discovering and Aligning Non-Linear Concept Manifolds in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Understanding information processing in large language models (LLMs) requires dissecting the geometric organization of their internal token representations. While existing mechanistic interpretability (MI) methods seek to extract concepts, they are constrained by a strong linearity assumption challenged by evidence of non-linear feature manifolds. We move beyond linear concepts by adapting Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) from computer vision to token-level LLM activations, modeling concepts as low-dimensional manifolds. To compare concept manifolds across layers and models, we introduce a concept-based alignment (CBA) score, a generalized Rand index that measures geometric proximity without explicit feature matching. Our analysis yields six key findings: (i) a neighboring-layer sanity check shows CBA is more sensitive than PCA- or CKA-based linear baselines; (ii) layer-by-layer alignment matrices reveal two block structures in intermediate and late layers, consistent across models and obscured by linear metrics; (iii) concept composition remains syntax-dominated through most of the network before giving way to increasingly mixed syntactic-semantic concepts in later layers, with increasing output-orientation toward the final layers; (iv) multilingual concept sharing between English and Mandarin is training-dependent rather than universal, strongest in Qwen, weaker in Llama, and absent in GPT-2; (v) inter-model alignment mirrors this structure, with strong correspondence between same-family Qwen models of different scale but weak alignment across model families; and (vi) across Tulu-3 training stages, alignment is highest between adjacent stages, with the largest shift between the base model and SFT, while subsequent preference-alignment stages (DPO, RLVR) leave early layers largely unchanged and RLVR mostly preserves DPO's concepts in late layers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把计算机视觉的非线性概念发现方法 NLMCD 迁移到 LLM token 级激活上，把概念建模为低维流形，并提出基于概念的对齐分数 CBA（广义 Rand 指数）度量跨层跨模型的几何邻近。CBA 比 PCA/CKA 线性基线更敏感，能显出中间层与后期层的两个块结构；概念组合在前段以句法为主、后期转为句法-语义混合，跨模型与跨训练阶段的对齐随家族与阶段变化。
Motivation: 现有机制可解释性 (MI) 方法普遍假设概念是线性的，而证据表明特征以非线性流形存在，导致跨层跨模型的概念对齐被线性指标掩盖。
Method: 将 Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) 从计算机视觉适配到 LLM token 级激活，把概念表示为低维流形；提出 concept-based alignment (CBA) 分数，作为无需显式特征匹配的广义 Rand 指数，用于比较不同层与不同模型间的概念流形，并在 Qwen、Llama、GPT-2 及 Tulu-3 各训练阶段上做逐层对齐矩阵分析。
Result: 六项发现：邻层敏感性检验中 CBA 比 PCA、CKA 线性基线更敏感；逐层对齐矩阵在中间层与后期层呈现两个块结构，跨模型一致且被线性指标掩盖；概念组合在大部分网络中以句法为主，后期转为句法-语义混合并趋向输出导向；英中多语概念共享是训练依赖的，Qwen 最强、Llama 较弱、GPT-2 缺失；同家族不同规模 Qwen 对齐强、跨家族弱；Tulu-3 各阶段间相邻阶段对齐最高，base 与 SFT 之间位移最大，DPO 与 RLVR 基本不改早期层、RLVR 在后期层大体保留 DPO 概念。
Conclusion: 概念应按非线性流形而非线性方向来建模与对齐，CBA 能揭示线性指标看不到的层级与训练阶段结构；概念表征的跨模型与多语共享由训练决定而非普遍规律。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MECHVAR: Variance-Guided Mechanism Discrimination for Autonomous Machine Learning Experiment Selection
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark gains are often mechanism-ambiguous: reproducing an improvement does not by itself identify why it occurs. We study finite-library mechanism discrimination, where posterior-weighted candidate mechanisms, executable probes, and a limited experimental budget define a sequential experiment-selection problem. MECHVAR selects the next probe by maximizing the posterior-weighted variance of its predicted responses. Under a shared-Gaussian predictive model, this score is exactly proportional to the classical Box--Hill posterior-weighted pairwise-KL criterion, yet it admits O(KE) vectorized rescoring and a transparent additive audit over mechanism pairs. A local expansion further links the score to expected information gain (EIG) when predicted response separations are small. In a 25-block stress audit, MECHVAR outperforms confirmation-first in several moderate misspecification regimes, while its primary comparisons with EIG remain statistically unresolved. In a held-out Digits loop, normalized mechanism-identification AUC is 0.8975 for MECHVAR, 0.7825 for a score-greedy policy, and 0.9092 for EIG. At K = 100, E = 200, median single-thread full-library scoring is 10.36 microseconds for MECHVAR versus 57.69 ms for six-node quadrature EIG in the recorded environment. MECHVAR therefore provides a lightweight, auditable acquisition rule for finite-library experiment selection when a shared predictive scale is a defensible approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MECHVAR 用后验加权的预测响应方差作为采集分数，在共享高斯预测模型下与经典 Box–Hill 后验加权成对 KL 准则成正比，从而把有限库机制判别 (finite-library mechanism discrimination) 的下一实验选择变成可审计的 O(KE) 向量化打分。在 held-out Digits 循环上其归一化机制识别 AUC 为 0.8975，高于 score-greedy 的 0.7825、略低于 EIG 的 0.9092；K=100、E=200 时单线程全库打分中位耗时 10.36 微秒，对比六节点求积 EIG 的 57.69 毫秒。
Motivation: 基准上的增益常是机制歧义的：复现一个改进并不能说明改进为何发生。要在有限实验预算下从后验加权的候选机制库中选出最有判别力的探针，需要比 EIG 更轻、可审计的采集规则。
Method: 把问题形式化为有限库机制判别：后验加权候选机制、可执行探针与有限预算构成序贯实验选择。MECHVAR 选择使预测响应后验加权方差最大的探针；共享高斯预测模型下该分数与 Box–Hill 后验加权成对 KL 准则精确成正比，支持 O(KE) 向量化重打分与跨机制对的可加性审计；另给出在预测响应间隔较小时与期望信息增益 (EIG) 相联系的局部展开。
Result: 25-block 压力审计中，MECHVAR 在若干中等误设 (moderate misspecification) 区制优于 confirmation-first，而与 EIG 的主对比在统计上未分出高下。held-out Digits 循环上归一化机制识别 AUC：MECHVAR 0.8975，score-greedy 0.7825，EIG 0.9092。K=100、E=200 时单线程全库打分中位耗时 MECHVAR 10.36 微秒，六节点求积 EIG 57.69 毫秒。
Conclusion: 当共享预测尺度是可辩护的近似时，方差引导的采集规则能以远低于求积 EIG 的成本给出轻量、可审计的有限库实验选择，精度上与 EIG 大体相当而非全面占优。

papers.title: Debias Anything: Fairness with Diversity without Supervision in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Although diffusion models produce high-quality images, they also reproduce and amplify demographic imbalances in their training data. Debiasing their generation process post-training w.r.t. some sensitive attribute usually relies on classifier guidance or explicit text extra-conditioning, but this reduces methods' applicability and output diversity. Conversely, methods promoting diversity alone do not ensure fair attribute representation. In this paper, we propose a method tackling fairness and diversity jointly that is generally applicable to any diffusion model and any sensitive attribute. To this end, an adapter connects the frozen diffusion model to a pretrained vision-language embedding space, enabling fairness and diversity guidance without sensitive-attribute annotations. For fairness, pairs of text prompts define attribute directions which guide batch composition towards specific proportions. For diversity, we introduce a score measuring disagreement between the semantic estimates derived from this representation. The formulation supports unconditional and text-conditional diffusion models, while requiring no prior knowledge or data of sensitive attribute. Experiments confirm that our method improves quality and diversity scores at comparable fairness levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出通用去偏适配器 (adapter)，把冻结的扩散模型接到预训练视觉-语言嵌入空间，用文本提示对定义属性方向来约束批次构成比例，并用语义估计分歧度量多样性，无需敏感属性标注。实验显示在相当的公平水平下，生成质量与多样性分数同时提升。
Motivation: 扩散模型会复制并放大训练数据中的人口统计失衡；现有后训练去偏依赖分类器引导或显式文本条件，牺牲适用范围与输出多样性，而单纯促进多样性又无法保证属性表示公平。
Method: 训练一个 adapter 连接冻结的扩散模型与预训练视觉-语言嵌入空间：公平侧用成对文本提示定义属性方向，引导批次构成趋向指定比例；多样性侧引入衡量该表示下语义估计分歧的分数；整体无需敏感属性标注，兼容无条件与文本条件扩散模型。
Result: 实验确认该方法在相当的公平水平下同时改善质量与多样性分数，且适用于任意扩散模型与任意敏感属性。
Conclusion: 公平与多样性可以联合优化而非取舍，且无需敏感属性标注即可在无条件和文本条件扩散模型上通用。

summary_sections.method: 训练一个 adapter 连接冻结的扩散模型与预训练视觉-语言嵌入空间：公平侧用成对文本提示定义属性方向，引导批次构成趋向指定比例；多样性侧引入衡量该表示下语义估计分歧的分数；整体无需敏感属性标注，兼容无条件与文本条件扩散模型。
summary_sections.result: 实验确认该方法在相当的公平水平下同时改善质量与多样性分数，且适用于任意扩散模型与任意敏感属性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 公平与多样性可以联合优化而非取舍，且无需敏感属性标注即可在无条件和文本条件扩散模型上通用。

papers.title: AI-assisted mitotic counting improves reproducibility and efficiency across multiple tumour types
papers.abstract_en: Mitotic counting is an important component of tumour grading, diagnosis and prognostic assessment across several tumour types, but manual assessment is time-consuming and subject to inter-pathologist variability. To help address these challenges, we developed MitPro, an AI tool designed to improve consistency and efficiency by directing pathologists towards regions with the highest predicted mitotic activity and highlighting mitotic figures for review, while retaining pathologist control over region selection and the final count. We evaluated its effect on the reproducibility and efficiency of mitotic counting in a retrospective, non-interventional, paired reader study comprising 385 whole-slide images from 3 centres in 3 countries and 7 tumour types using 3 different scanners. 13 pathologists participated, with each slide assessed independently by 3 pathologists without AI assistance and again with AI assistance after a minimum 2 week washout period. Across all slides, AI-assisted counting increased the intraclass correlation coefficient from 0.589 to 0.949. Mean pathologist-level median assessment time decreased from 286.4 to 127.8 seconds, corresponding to an average saving of 151.8 seconds per assessment. Improvements in agreement and efficiency were also observed in supporting analyses using HALO AP and Sectra image management systems and in 2 additional tumour types outside the main study population. AI-assisted assessment was associated with a subtle shift towards higher mitotic counts and scores, consistent with identification of more active mitotic hotspots and fewer missed mitotic figures. The frequency of score change between unassisted and AI-assisted assessment was comparable with inter-pathologist variation during routine counting. These findings support the use of MitPro as an assistive tool for more consistent and efficient mitotic assessment in routine practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MitPro 把病理医生的有丝分裂计数从盲读变成 AI 引导的热点区域复核，保留医生对区域选择与最终计数的控制。在 385 张全切片、13 位病理医生的配对阅片研究中，AI 辅助使组内相关系数 (ICC) 从 0.589 升到 0.949，单次评估中位耗时从 286.4 秒降到 127.8 秒。
Motivation: 有丝分裂计数是肿瘤分级、诊断与预后评估的关键环节，但人工判读耗时且不同病理医生之间结果不一致，影响常规实践中的可重复性。
Method: 开发 AI 工具 MitPro，预测有丝分裂活性最高的区域并高亮候选有丝分裂图像供医生复核，区域选择与最终计数仍由医生决定；采用回顾性、非干预、配对阅片设计，3 个国家 3 中心的 385 张全切片、7 种肿瘤、3 种扫描仪，13 位病理医生先无 AI 独立判读，间隔至少 2 周洗脱期后再带 AI 判读，每张片由 3 位医生读。
Result: AI 辅助下组内相关系数 (ICC) 由 0.589 升至 0.949；病理医生层面中位评估时间由 286.4 秒降至 127.8 秒，平均每次节省 151.8 秒。在 HALO AP 与 Sectra 图像管理系统上的支持性分析、以及主研究人群之外的 2 种额外肿瘤类型中，一致性和效率同样改善；计数与分级出现轻微上移，提示识别出更多活跃热点、漏检更少，而无辅助与有辅助之间的评分改变频率与常规阅片的病理医生间差异相当。
Conclusion: MitPro 可作为常规实践中提升有丝分裂评估一致性与效率的辅助工具，且其引起的评分改变幅度并未超出日常阅片的医生间变异。

papers.title: PhaseAT: Fourier Phase Adversarial Training for Medical Image Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Reliable clinical deployment of deep medical image models is hindered by distribution shifts across scanners, sites, and acquisition protocols. Existing domain generalization (DG) methods often focus on style or intensity diversification, but they can still leave networks dependent on domain-specific texture correlations. Inspired by evidence that Fourier phase encodes semantic structure, we introduce PhaseAT, a phase-aware adversarial training framework for medical DG. PhaseAT forms phase-perturbed training views in the Fourier domain by iteratively updating a bounded phase perturbation while keeping the amplitude spectrum unchanged, thereby stressing spatial organization under matched appearance statistics. Perturbations are applied only to the luminance channel in YCbCr color space to avoid chromatic artifacts. Additionally, a simple phase-saliency mask concentrates updates on the most influential frequencies. The model is trained with a weighted combination of losses on clean and phase-perturbed samples, supporting both single-source and multi-source DG. We validate our method on two challenging medical datasets and demonstrate that PhaseAT achieves over 20% improvement in single-source domain generalization, outperforming several state-of-the-art DG methods. The code implementation is available at: https://github.com/ahmed-sharshar/PhaseAT.
papers.comment: The paper is accepted in MICCAI 2026
papers.journal_ref: Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention - MICCAI 2026, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 16881, pp. 413-423, Springer, 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhaseAT 在 Fourier 域对训练图像做有界相位扰动、保持幅度谱不变，逼网络不再依赖域相关的纹理相关性，转而学习相位编码的空间结构。扰动只加在 YCbCr 的亮度通道并用相位显著性掩码聚焦关键频率，在两个医学数据集上单源域泛化 (single-source DG) 提升超过 20%，优于多个 SOTA DG 方法。
Motivation: 跨扫描仪、站点和采集协议的分布偏移使深度医学影像模型难以可靠部署；现有 DG 方法多做风格或强度多样化，网络仍可能依赖域特有的纹理相关性。
Method: PhaseAT 在 Fourier 域迭代更新一个有界相位扰动生成 phase-perturbed 训练视图，幅度谱保持不变；扰动仅作用于 YCbCr 颜色空间的亮度通道以避免色度伪影，并用 phase-saliency mask 把更新集中在最有影响的频率上；训练损失是干净样本与相位扰动样本的加权组合，同时支持单源与多源 DG。
Result: 在两个医学数据集上验证，单源域泛化提升超过 20%，优于多个 state-of-the-art DG 方法。
Conclusion: 在匹配外观统计的条件下只扰动相位，就能把医学影像 DG 的性能推过现有 SOTA，说明纹理之外的相位结构是可利用的泛化来源。

papers.title: A Safe Prototype Is Not a Safety Direction: Reference Dependence and Prompt Confounds in Response-Safety Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Can response safety be scored by cosine similarity to the mean embedding of known-safe responses? A recent sleeper-agent detector proposes exactly this score, yet the raw positive-centroid rule is not identified: positive observations locate the safe class relative to an encoder origin, but do not determine which direction separates safe from unsafe responses. We audit the rule on two prompt-controlled, human-labeled corpora and one auxiliary jury-labeled source control, using four frozen encoders and prompt-grouped splits. On the human-labeled corpora the safe prototype reaches ROC-AUC 0.457-0.545, with two cells significantly below chance and one above, while an explicit safe-minus-unsafe reference reaches 0.588-0.738 on the same embeddings; on the jury control the prototype is inverted (0.358-0.405) and the reference reaches 0.754-0.793. At validation-calibrated 5% false-safe thresholds, the reference accepts more safe responses on PKU-SafeRLHF (0.153-0.263 versus 0.039-0.061 across encoders) and Aegis (0.189-0.291 versus 0.004-0.045), but not reliably on BeaverTails. A fully unlabeled held-out reference recovers part to most of the referenced ranking, much less when only 5% of the pool is unsafe, whereas 80-634 labeled unsafe responses recover most of it. Prompt-only ablations show that prompt-label composition can inflate uncontrolled evaluations. This is a bounded result about a raw positive centroid, not all one-class methods or safety-specialized guards. A class mean is a location, not necessarily a safety direction; a declared reference with enough unsafe mass identifies orientation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Language Model Security (FLMSec). 15 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Code, results, and a verifier are in the ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用已知安全响应的平均嵌入做余弦打分这一 sleeper-agent 检测规则不可辨识：正类质心只给出安全类相对编码器原点的位置，不决定区分安全与不安全的方向。在两份人工标注语料上该原型 ROC-AUC 仅 0.457–0.545（两格显著低于随机、一格高于），而显式 safe-minus-unsafe 参考方向达 0.588–0.738；jury 控制集上原型反转为 0.358–0.405，参考方向 0.754–0.793。结论是类均值是位置而非安全方向，声明参考方向并保有足够不安全样本才能定出朝向。
Motivation: 近期有 sleeper-agent 检测器直接用与安全响应均值嵌入的余弦相似度给响应安全性打分，但仅靠正类观测无法辨识区分安全与不安全的方向，导致评估结论可能被 prompt 构成混淆。
Method: 在两份 prompt 受控、人工标注的语料加一份 jury 标注的辅助控制集上审计该规则，用四个冻结编码器与按 prompt 分组的划分；对比原始正类质心与显式 safe-minus-unsafe 参考方向，并做 prompt-only 消融与未标注/部分标注参考的对照。
Result: 人工标注语料上原型 ROC-AUC 0.457–0.545（两格显著低于随机、一格高于），参考方向 0.588–0.738；jury 控制集原型 0.358–0.405（反转），参考 0.754–0.793。在验证集校准的 5% false-safe 阈值下，参考方向在 PKU-SafeRLHF 接受更多安全响应（0.153–0.263 对 0.039–0.061），Aegis 上 0.189–0.291 对 0.004–0.045，BeaverTails 上不稳健。完全未标注的留出参考可部分到大部分复现参考排序，但当池中仅 5% 不安全时恢复明显变差；80–634 条标注不安全响应可恢复大部分。
Conclusion: 类均值是位置而非安全方向，声明的参考方向需足够不安全样本才能定出朝向；该结论限于原始正类质心，不涵盖全部 one-class 方法或安全专用 guard，且 prompt-标签构成会虚高不受控评估。

papers.title: LineupRL: Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Time Series Captioning via Caption-to-Series Identification
papers.abstract_en: Time series captioning is a fundamental step in time series understanding and can also serve as the bridge between signal and natural language. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) relies on a larger model's captions and cannot exceed their quality. Reinforcement learning (RL) can, but its rewards were designed for other modalities and other tasks, and they transfer poorly to open-ended generation in the time series domain. We address this by proposing LineupRL, a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) pipeline whose reward is caption-to-series identification. The reward model is a frozen large language model (LLM) verifier that reads the generated caption and the candidate time series as raw values, never the chart, and must pick the described time series from multiple distractors. Matching is a far lighter demand on the verifier than writing questions or judging a caption, so an off-the-shelf LLM can supply the reward. Across two captioning benchmarks, and on forecasting and reconstruction where the predictor sees only the caption, LineupRL outperforms SFT and RL baselines on every metric. The 3B vision language model (VLM) trained by LineupRL also outperforms, at 1/24 of the parameters, the 72B VLM whose captions the SFT baseline is distilled from. Our case study shows that LineupRL resists reward hacking, and that the captioner it trains both traces the trend and names the values at key points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LineupRL 用「caption-to-series 识别」作为可验证奖励做时间序列描述生成的强化学习：冻结的 LLM 验证器只读生成的 caption 与候选序列原始数值（不看图），从多个干扰项中挑出被描述的那条序列。在两个 captioning 基准以及预测、重建任务上，它在全部指标上超过 SFT 与 RL 基线；3B VLM 以 72B 的 1/24 参数量反超蒸馏来源的 72B 模型。
Motivation: SFT 只能继承大模型 caption 的质量上限，而现有 RL 奖励是为其他模态和任务设计的，迁移到时间序列开放式生成上效果差。
Method: 提出 RLVR 流水线 LineupRL，奖励模型为冻结 LLM 验证器：输入生成的 caption 与候选时间序列的原始数值（非图表），在多个 distractor 中做匹配识别；匹配比出题或直接评判 caption 更轻量，可直接用现成 LLM 供给奖励。
Result: 在两个 captioning 基准上，以及 predictor 只看 caption 的 forecasting 与 reconstruction 任务上，LineupRL 在每一项指标上都超过 SFT 与 RL 基线；训练出的 3B VLM 以 72B 模型 1/24 的参数量超过 SFT 基线所蒸馏的 72B VLM。案例研究显示该方法能抵抗 reward hacking，且生成的 caption 既追踪趋势又给出关键点数值。
Conclusion: 把奖励换成可验证的 caption-to-series 识别，就能让 RL 在时间序列描述上突破 SFT 的教师质量上限，同时用小得多的模型超过被蒸馏的大模型。

papers.title: SkillEvoLean: Mutation-enhanced skill evolution for Lean provers
papers.abstract_en: Skill evolution offers a promising way to improve large language model agents without updating their parameters, but its use in formal theorem proving remains underexplored. Existing methods mainly target natural-language reasoning, improving skills by analyzing successful and failed trajectories and incrementally revising solving strategies. Although the Lean verifier provides reliable execution feedback, when all sampled trajectories fail, existing skill evolution methods lack successful trajectories from which to infer effective update directions. Furthermore, these methods also focus mainly on the root instruction file, thus underexploring the evolution of reference knowledge including mathematical concepts and proving techniques. To address these limitations, we propose a mutation-enhanced skill self-evolution framework for building skill-augmented Lean provers. The framework jointly evolves a high-level solving policy and its reference knowledge through progressive and mutation-based updates. Progressive evolution derives local improvements from successful and failed trajectories, while mutation is triggered when no complete proof can be generated, sampling mathematical concepts to produce and select new skill candidates under verifier feedback. We evaluate our method on MiniF2F, PutnamBench, the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO 2025), and the 2026 USA Mathematical Olympiad (USAMO 2026). Under the same backbone model, trajectorysampling budget, and test-time compute, our method achieves proof success rates of 100.0%, 90.6%, 4/6, and 4/6, respectively, with GPT-5.5, outperforming the baseline methods. Further analysis shows that concept-guided mutation outperforms random-text-guided mutation by 6.9 and 8.2 percentage points on MiniF2F and PutnamBench, respectively, while solving one additional problem on both IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026.

papers.title: Continuous Conditioning of VLAs with Augmenting EMG and Visual Task Descriptors
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely strongly on language for describing task information, despite having multimodal inputs. We hypothesize that other modalities in the state space may present opportunities for supplemental task conditioning, which may be particularly relevant in cluttered or otherwise ambiguous scenes. We introduce two tuned models to test this hypothesis: (1) an electrophysiology-conditioned VLA (EC-VLA) that incorporates 8-channel electromyography envelopes as continuous conditioning input concatenated to the proprioceptive vector, and (2) a visually-annotated VLA (VA-VLA) that incorporates visual segmentation annotations to the image inputs. On a cube-selection task evaluated across three participants, EC-VLA matches a language-prompted baseline in uncluttered, in-distribution conditions and substantially outperforms it in cluttered, out-of-distribution scenes. Similarly, VA-VLA shows modest improvements over a language-prompted baseline in in-distribution scenes with substantial improvement in cluttered, out-of-distribution trials. Together, these results provide strong evidence for the potential benefit of task-conditioning beyond language.
papers.comment: Presented at IROS WORLDS Workshop 2026. Four main pages double-column format plus references and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在语言提示之外，把 8 通道 EMG 包络连续拼接到本体感觉向量（EC-VLA）、或把视觉分割标注并入图像输入（VA-VLA），可增强 VLA 的任务条件化。在三人立方体选择任务中，两种模型在无杂乱的分布内场景与语言基线持平或仅小幅提升，而在杂乱、分布外场景均显著超过语言提示基线。
Motivation: VLA 模型虽有多模态输入却高度依赖语言描述任务，在杂乱或歧义场景中语言不足以区分目标，状态空间中的其他模态可能提供补充条件化信号。
Method: 提出两个调优模型：EC-VLA 将 8 通道肌电 (EMG) 包络作为连续条件输入拼接到本体感觉向量；VA-VLA 把视觉分割标注并入图像输入；均与语言提示基线在立方体选择任务上对比，覆盖三名参与者。
Result: 立方体选择任务、三名参与者：EC-VLA 在无杂乱分布内条件与语言基线持平，在杂乱分布外场景大幅超过基线；VA-VLA 在分布内场景仅有小幅提升，在杂乱分布外试次同样大幅改善。
Conclusion: 超越语言的任务条件化（连续 EMG 或视觉分割标注）对 VLA 有益，且收益在杂乱、分布外场景中最为明显。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learnt Attacks on Quantum Key Distribution under Channel Noise and Device Drift
papers.abstract_en: Quantum key distribution (QKD) links are provisioned from security analyses of stationary channels, whereas the devices that determine the channel drift between recalibrations. Whether an eavesdropper who cannot alter the channel's own noise gains by following that drift has not been quantified. Adaptive eavesdropping is posed here as a constrained Markov decision process in which the attacker selects one circuit per round while the noise level follows an Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process and the abort condition is a budget over each block of rounds. The value of adaptation is bounded by the best fixed circuit and a dynamic-programming upper bound. The actions are learnt attacks. Whereas Decker et al. trained a parametrised circuit on a fixed gate template against a fixed channel, here the gate structure and rotation angles are searched jointly. This yields circuits compact enough to form a discrete action set, extending the construction to noise models lacking a known template, including the amplitude damping channel. On device-independent E91 under bilateral depolarising noise, a reinforcement-learning attacker raises her Holevo information from $0.135$ for the best fixed circuit to $0.348$ at zero detection, $98\%$ of the upper bound. On BB84 under a drifting bit-flip channel, she exceeds a conservative noise-indexed rule by $0.024$ in fidelity, reaching $99\%$ of the upper bound. Under stationary noise, the attacker's gain from basis asymmetry changes sign between an averaged and a per-basis error-rate constraint. The search, started from random gate sequences, recovers the analytical cloners and the collective-attack key rate, and meets the lower bound of the Winick--Lütkenhaus--Coles objective from above.
papers.comment: Presented as submission 202 at QCrypt 2026 qcrypt.net/2026/technical/accepted-papers/. A parallel work exploring the machine-learning aspects of this approach, titled "Sparsity for Free: A Budget-Induced Equilibrium in Joint Topology-Parameter Search'', has been accepted for NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 QKD 自适应窃听建模为带噪声漂移的约束 MDP，用强化学习联合搜索门结构与旋转角度得到离散动作集的 learnt attacks。在 E91 双边退极化噪声下，RL 攻击者 Holevo 信息从最优固定电路的 0.135 提到 0.348（零探测，达上界 98%）；BB84 漂移 bit-flip 通道下保真度超保守噪声索引规则 0.024，达上界 99%。
Motivation: QKD 安全性分析基于静态信道，而设备漂移决定两次重标定之间的实际信道；窃听者跟随漂移能否获益此前未被量化。
Method: 将自适应窃听表述为约束 Markov 决策过程：噪声按 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 过程演化，攻击者每轮选一个电路，abort 条件为每块轮次的预算；用最优固定电路与动态规划上界界定 adaptation 价值。相对 Decker et al. 的固定门模板参数化电路，这里门结构与旋转角度联合搜索，得到足够紧凑的电路构成离散动作集，并扩展到无已知模板的噪声模型（含 amplitude damping channel）。
Result: E91（device-independent，双边 depolarizing 噪声、零探测）：RL 攻击者 Holevo 信息 0.135（最优固定电路）→ 0.348，为动态规划上界的 98%。BB84（漂移 bit-flip 通道）：保真度超保守 noise-indexed rule 0.024，达上界 99%。平稳噪声下，basis asymmetry 的收益在 averaged 与 per-basis error-rate 约束之间变号。从随机门序列出发的搜索可复现解析 cloner 与 collective-attack key rate，并从上方逼近 Winick–Lütkenhaus–Coles 目标的下界。
Conclusion: 信道漂移确实让自适应 learnt attacks 相对固定电路与规则策略取得实质增益，且联合拓扑-参数搜索能在无模板噪声模型上恢复已知解析结果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: iADD: Improving Alignment and Diversity in Diffusion Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning based post training of diffusion models, such as Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO), optimizes a reverse diffusion process under a reward function. However, current approaches to reward optimizations do so at the cost of diversity and quality. In this paper, we provide better tradeoffs through careful theoretical considerations and method design. We analyze the theoretical framework and mathematically demonstrate that \emph{only-latter timestep} updates of diffusion model may be harmful for diversity contrary to the conclusions presented in a previous work. Additionally, we propose an incremental Feynman-Kac training based on strong theoretical foundations in order to achieve the best-yet alignment-diversity tradeoffs. We perform extensive experiments and compare our method against related diffusion policy optimization approaches in three different tasks and also provide strong ablations for each component, thus validating strong performance gains in both alignment and diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: iADD 针对扩散模型的 RL 后训练 (DDPO 类) 中对齐与多样性的权衡，从理论上证明只更新后段 timestep (only-latter timestep) 会损害多样性，与先前工作结论相反；并提出基于 Feynman-Kac 的增量训练 (incremental Feynman-Kac training) 来改善这一权衡。在三个任务上与相关扩散策略优化方法对比并做组件消融，对齐与多样性均取得性能提升。
Motivation: 基于奖励的扩散后训练在提升对齐 (alignment) 的同时牺牲多样性与质量，且既有理论对 timestep 更新方式的结论存疑，需要更好的权衡机制。
Method: 先对 DDPO 类反向扩散奖励优化框架做理论分析，数学论证 only-latter timestep 更新对多样性的危害；再提出建立在 Feynman-Kac 过程上的增量训练方法，并对每个组件做消融。
Result: 在三个不同任务上与相关 diffusion policy optimization 方法比较，并给出各组件的强消融，显示对齐与多样性两方面均有显著性能增益；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 只更新后段 timestep 的做法会损害扩散模型多样性，改用基于 Feynman-Kac 理论的增量训练可取得更好的对齐-多样性权衡。

papers.title: SAGE: Similarity-Based Cleaning of Poisoned Training Data from Verified Examples
papers.abstract_en: As machine learning increasingly relies on public, untrusted data sources, data poisoning attacks, which inject malicious examples into training data to induce misclassification of a chosen target, pose a growing threat. Existing defenses either assume zero ground-truth information about which examples are poisoned, or they assume access to a large set of examples verified to be clean. Satisfying the latter assumption incurs significant cost since reliable verification can be very resource- or labor-intensive. This cost is particularly high for clean-label attacks, where poisoned examples are visually indistinguishable from clean data. Since requiring a large set of verified examples is impractical, we propose relying on a small set of verified examples including both clean and poisoned ones, i.e., each example verified either to be clean or poisoned through inspection by a forensic expert. The challenge is then to detect poisons based on a set of verified examples that is so small that most classification models would overfit. To address this challenge, we propose Similarity-based Approach for Ground-truth-driven Exclusion (SAGE), which trains a generic feature extractor on a separate dataset and then flags poisoned training examples using a non-parametric, similarity-weighted prediction based on the verified set. On standard benchmarks against seven clean-label attack methods, we demonstrate that having access to even a handful of verified poisoned examples provides a substantial advantage. We also find that the distribution of verified clean examples across classes matters more than the number of verified examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 用少量经取证专家核实的样本（同时含干净与中毒样本）做数据投毒清洗：在独立数据集上训练通用特征提取器，再对训练样本做基于相似度加权的非参数预测并标记中毒样本。在标准基准上对七种 clean-label 攻击方法检验，即使只有极少数已核实的中毒样本也带来显著优势，且已核实干净样本在类别间的分布比其总数更重要。
Motivation: 现有投毒防御要么假设完全没有中毒标签，要么假设拥有大量已验证干净样本，而后者验证成本高；clean-label 攻击中毒样本与干净数据在视觉上难以区分，使大规模验证尤其昂贵。
Method: 提出 SAGE（Similarity-based Approach for Ground-truth-driven Exclusion）：先在独立数据集上训练通用特征提取器，再基于一个同时含干净与中毒样本的极小已核实集合，做非参数的相似度加权预测来标记训练集中的中毒样本。
Result: 在标准基准上针对七种 clean-label 攻击方法进行检验，结果显示即便只有极少数已核实的中毒样本也能带来显著优势；已核实干净样本在各类别上的分布比已核实样本总数更关键。
Conclusion: 少量、含中毒样本的已核实集合足以驱动相似度加权的投毒检测，且核实资源应优先用于保证各类别覆盖，而非单纯增加核实数量。

summary_sections.method: 提出 SAGE（Similarity-based Approach for Ground-truth-driven Exclusion）：先在独立数据集上训练通用特征提取器，再基于一个同时含干净与中毒样本的极小已核实集合，做非参数的相似度加权预测来标记训练集中的中毒样本。
summary_sections.result: 在标准基准上针对七种 clean-label 攻击方法进行检验，结果显示即便只有极少数已核实的中毒样本也能带来显著优势；已核实干净样本在各类别上的分布比已核实样本总数更关键。
summary_sections.conclusion: 少量、含中毒样本的已核实集合足以驱动相似度加权的投毒检测，且核实资源应优先用于保证各类别覆盖，而非单纯增加核实数量。

papers.title: Not All Experience Belongs in the Weights: Component Routing for Self-Improving GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving GUI agents keep the trajectories they produce and return them to the agent, by fine-tuning or by retrieval into the prompt, and studies that compare the two destinations disagree. We attribute this to the unit of experience: a trajectory bundles items with different properties, so a conclusion about the bundle depends on its mix. To address this, (i) we introduce component routing, which splits the experience into locators, procedures, state facts and lessons and sends each component to the context or to the weights, compared on the same items across three backbone families, two environments and three seeds. One pool has two destinations: locators and lessons win in the weights, procedures and state facts in the context. (ii) We fit a rule in two properties measured before any training, recurrence and state-conditionality; it recovers the destination of a held-out backbone family in 24 of 24 cells, two interventions move a component toward the boundary, and routing by the rule beats every whole-trajectory baseline and, by +3.5 points on average, the better single destination of each backbone. (iii) We identify how training and producer-consumer differences change the value of the two destinations: note readout decreases after the same component is written into the weights, most for the items that recur most, context gains increase with the information gap, and weights gains decrease with the policy gap. Code and data will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUI agent 的自改进经验不应整条轨迹只进一个去处：把轨迹拆成 locators、procedures、state facts、lessons 四类组件分别路由，同一经验池中 locators 与 lessons 进权重更优，procedures 与 state facts 进上下文更优。用训练前可测的两个属性（recurrence、state-conditionality）拟合的规则在留出 backbone 家族上 24/24 格命中目标去处，按该规则路由优于所有整轨迹基线，并比每个 backbone 更好的单一去处平均高 +3.5 分。
Motivation: 自改进 GUI agent 把轨迹微调进权重还是检索进 prompt，已有研究结论互相矛盾；根因是轨迹把性质不同的条目捆成一包，整包结论取决于包内成分构成。
Method: 提出 component routing：把经验拆为 locators、procedures、state facts、lessons 四类组件，逐类决定送 context 还是 weights，在三个 backbone 家族、两个环境、三个 seed 上用相同条目对比；再用训练前可测的 recurrence 与 state-conditionality 两个属性拟合去处判定规则，并做两个干预实验移动组件相对边界的位置。
Result: 同一经验池中 locators 与 lessons 在权重中胜出，procedures 与 state facts 在上下文中胜出；拟合规则在留出 backbone 家族的 24/24 个格子中恢复出正确去处；按规则路由胜过所有整轨迹基线，并比各 backbone 更好的单一去处平均高 +3.5 分。同一组件写入权重后其 note readout 下降，recurrence 最高的条目下降最多；context 增益随 information gap 增大，weights 增益随 policy gap 增大而减小。
Conclusion: 经验的正确去处由组件级属性而非轨迹整体决定，训练前测得的 recurrence 与 state-conditionality 足以在未见 backbone 上判定该去处；代码与数据将发布。

papers.title: Inferring Multi-Timescale Neural Dynamics with Switching Linear Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Neural activity often exhibits multiple timescales that can vary with behavioral states and task conditions. Identifying these timescales from neural recordings is important for better understanding neural computation and function. However, traditional approaches based on autocorrelation fitting are difficult to scale to high-dimensional population recordings and can become unreliable when neural dynamics change with behavior. State-space models have been a powerful framework for modeling high-dimensional neural population activity through latent dynamical systems, but standard formulations and inference methods do not explicitly account for multiple timescales and therefore do not guarantee accurate recovery of the underlying temporal structure. Motivated by these questions, we introduce the Multi-Timescale Switching Linear Dynamical System (MTS-SLDS), a framework for identifying regime-specific latent timescales from continuous or spiking neural observations. MTS-SLDS combines a multi-lag moment initialization, which captures temporal structure across multiple observation lags, with \textit{regime-conditioned} Laplace-EM inference, which reduces mixing of dynamical statistics across uncertain regimes. Characteristic timescales can then be extracted directly from the eigenvalues of the learned latent transition matrices. In synthetic and neural experiments with Gaussian and Poisson spike observations, MTS-SLDS accurately recovers timescales and switching structure over multiple datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MTS-SLDS（Multi-Timescale Switching Linear Dynamical System），用多滞后矩初始化加按状态条件化的 Laplace-EM 推断，从连续或脉冲神经观测中恢复各状态专属的潜在时间尺度与切换结构，时间尺度直接由学到的潜在转移矩阵特征值给出。在合成与神经实验（高斯与 Poisson 脉冲观测）上，MTS-SLDS 在多个数据集上准确恢复时间尺度与切换结构。
Motivation: 自相关拟合难以扩展到高维群体记录，且在神经动力学随行为变化时不可靠；标准状态空间模型与推断方法不显式建模多时间尺度，无法保证恢复真实时间结构。
Method: MTS-SLDS 结合多滞后矩初始化（multi-lag moment initialization，跨多个观测滞后捕捉时间结构）与 regime-conditioned Laplace-EM 推断（减少不确定状态间动力学统计的混合），从学到的潜在转移矩阵特征值直接提取特征时间尺度；观测模型覆盖连续与 Poisson 脉冲。
Result: 在合成与神经实验、高斯与 Poisson 脉冲观测下，MTS-SLDS 在多个数据集上准确恢复时间尺度与切换结构；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把多时间尺度与状态切换显式写进状态空间模型并按状态条件化推断，可以从高维神经群体记录中可靠识别状态专属时间尺度。

papers.title: VETO: Video Efficient Token Optimization for Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Processing long videos with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of visual tokens, making long-form inference prohibitively expensive. While single-axis compression methods mitigate this, they hit a hard efficiency floor because they treat spatial and temporal redundancy independently. We present VETO (Video Efficient Token Optimization for Vision-Language Models), a training-optional plug-in that eliminates this bottleneck through dual-axis compression: (i) an intra-frame compressor that merges semantically similar tokens within each frame via optimal-transport inspired matching, and (ii) an inter-frame compressor that identifies and merges temporally redundant frames. The key design insight is hierarchical ordering: by first compressing spatial dimensions, VETO drastically reduces the cost of subsequent global temporal matching, bypassing the efficiency wall of single-axis approaches, with an advantage that grows with modern fully-fused attention infrastructure. Empirically, VETO achieves up to 45% faster inference (e.g., on LLaVA-OneVision-7B) while preserving or improving accuracy. Under extreme token starvation (10% budget), VETO outperforms VFlowOpt (54.9%), VisionZip (52.6%), and FastV (47.9%) with 55.7% accuracy. We demonstrate universal applicability across LLaVA-OneVision, InternVL-2.5, and LongVA, with zero-shot accuracy preserved or improved in all cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VETO 用先空间后时间的双轴视觉 token 压缩为长视频 VLM 推理解耦二次方成本：帧内用 optimal-transport 式匹配合并语义相近 token，帧间再合并时间冗余帧，先压空间使后续全局时间匹配大幅变便宜。在 10% token 预算下准确率 55.7%，高于 VFlowOpt 54.9%、VisionZip 52.6%、FastV 47.9%，LLaVA-OneVision-7B 上推理最高提速 45% 且精度保持或提升。
Motivation: 长视频输入让 VLM 的视觉 token 成本按二次方增长，推理贵到难以承受；已有单轴压缩把空间与时间冗余分开处理，因此撞上固定的效率下限。
Method: VETO 是可选训练的即插即用模块，含两级压缩：帧内压缩器用 optimal-transport 启发的匹配合并同帧语义相近 token，帧间压缩器识别并合并时间冗余帧；层级顺序上先压空间再做全局时间匹配，以绕开单轴方法的效率墙，并在 fully-fused attention 基础设施上放大优势。
Result: 推理最高提速 45%（如 LLaVA-OneVision-7B）且精度保持或提升；极端 token 饥饿（10% 预算）下 VETO 55.7%，对比 VFlowOpt 54.9%、VisionZip 52.6%、FastV 47.9%；在 LLaVA-OneVision、InternVL-2.5、LongVA 上零样本精度均保持或提升。
Conclusion: 先空间后时间的层级双轴压缩能突破单轴视觉 token 压缩的效率下限，在极低 token 预算下仍保住甚至提高零样本精度，且对多种 VLM 通用。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Q-Learning for Reachability in MEC-Free MDPs
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for reachability specifications is fundamental to sequential decision-making. Prior work establishes asymptotic convergence to optimal policies, but only through model-based methods that must explicitly estimate the transition probabilities of the underlying Markov Decision Process (MDP). We present Quasar, the first model-free algorithm with asymptotic guarantees for reachability on the fragment of MDPs free of non-terminal maximal end components (MECs), a building block to which every MDP reduces by the standard MEC quotient. Our algorithm follows the classical Q-learning approach, using temporal-difference updates to converge to an optimal policy without ever learning the transition probabilities. The resulting learner reduces the memory footprint from the O(|S|^2|A|) that model-based methods require to O(|S||A|). On the standardized Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set, our algorithm converges to the optimal policy with orders of magnitude fewer samples than the previous model-based state-of-the-art. Together these results are a concrete step toward the practical deployment of reachability learning and, with it, of specification-guided RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Quasar 是首个在无非终止最大端分量 (MEC-free) MDP 片段上对 reachability 规格给出渐近最优保证的免模型算法，用经典 Q-learning 的时序差分更新直接收敛到最优策略而不估计转移概率。内存占用从 model-based 方法的 O(|S|^2|A|) 降到 O(|S||A|)，在 Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set 上以比此前 model-based 最优方法少若干数量级的样本收敛到最优策略。
Motivation: reachability 的既有渐近收敛保证都依赖 model-based 方法，必须显式估计 MDP 转移概率，内存与样本开销大，阻碍规格引导 RL 的实际部署。
Method: 沿用经典 Q-learning，用 temporal-difference 更新在 MEC-free MDP 片段上学习 reachability 最优策略，全程不估计转移概率；该片段是标准 MEC quotient 下每个 MDP 都可归约到的基本构件。
Result: 内存足迹由 model-based 所需的 O(|S|^2|A|) 降至 O(|S||A|)；在标准化 Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set 上收敛到最优策略所需样本比此前 model-based state-of-the-art 少若干数量级 (orders of magnitude)。
Conclusion: 在 MEC-free 片段上，免模型 Q-learning 可以在不学转移概率的前提下保住 reachability 的渐近最优保证，是走向 reachability 学习与规格引导 RL 实用部署的具体一步。

papers.title: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations
papers.abstract_en: A companion that talks with a person for months should come to understand them. It should remember what they said, infer who they are, and know when the past bears on the message in front of it. Testing this requires a real person's record, and such records are private, so benchmarks generate the person and the questions and settle in advance what matters. We release \bench, ten real relationships with an AI companion: 27,218 messages over up to 120 days, released as the conversation and four files derived from it, a profile, a persona, a chat ground truth and a question set, each citing the messages it rests on. Every chat label carries the reasoning trace that produced it, checked stage by stage against the conversation. Three findings follow. First, the past is rarely needed and far away. Pooled measures mislead: a recency window finds the required message for 95.9\% of probes and 2.2\% of those that need memory, and at the natural rate 96\% of the gain from supplying recorded evidence comes from messages that need none. Second, no detector we tried can tell when memory is needed on real messages, authored questions over the same histories leak the cue, and labeling the same messages as memories raises their use by ten to fourteen points. Third, three agent systems reconstruct the persona with the same F1 at a 31-fold difference in cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RealCompanion 发布 10 段人与 AI 陪伴的真实关系、27,218 条消息、最长 120 天，附 profile、persona、chat ground truth 与问题集，每条标签带逐阶段核对的推理链。三个发现：recency window 在 95.9% 的探针上就能找到所需消息，自然比例下 96% 的证据增益来自本不需要记忆的消息；没有任何检测器能在真实消息上判断何时需要记忆，把同批消息标成 memory 会使其使用率抬高 10–14 个百分点；三个 agent 系统以相同 persona F1 重建画像，成本相差 31 倍。
Motivation: 长期陪伴助手需要判断过去何时与当前消息相关，但真实个人对话记录是私有的，现有 benchmark 只能自行生成人物与问题并预先设定何为重要，无法检验真实时间跨度上的记忆需求。
Method: 发布 RealCompanion：10 段真实关系、27,218 条消息、最长 120 天，拆成对话本体与四个派生文件（profile、persona、chat ground truth、question set），每条标签附带逐阶段对照对话核验的推理链；用 recency window 定位所需消息，测试记忆需求检测器，并比较三个 agent 系统的 persona 重建。
Result: recency window 在 95.9% 的探针上找到所需消息，仅覆盖 2.2% 真正需要记忆的探针；自然比例下 96% 的证据增益来自不需要记忆的消息。所有测试的检测器都无法在真实消息上判断记忆需求，作者自撰问题在同一历史上泄漏线索，把同批消息标为 memory 使其使用率提高 10–14 个百分点。三个 agent 系统以相同 F1 重建 persona，成本相差 31 倍。
Conclusion: 长期对话中的记忆需求既稀少又难以从消息本身探测， pooled 指标会误导；在真实消息上，提供记录证据的收益主要来自本不需要记忆的上下文，而 persona 重建的代价差异远大于质量差异。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GIFTBench: Diagnosing Generalization in Image Forgery Localization and Informing Model Design
papers.abstract_en: Reliable evaluation of image forgery localization (IFL) requires assessing models under diverse distribution changes, yet existing benchmarks often cover limited manipulation conditions or entangle multiple factors in cross-dataset evaluation. Consequently, aggregate performance provides an incomplete view of localization generalization. We introduce GIFTBench, a multi-axis benchmark of 115,013 manipulated images with pixel-level annotations spanning manipulation source, semantic target, editing operation, and composition complexity. GIFTBench supports axis-specific transfer analysis and evaluation on twelve external datasets. Its diagnostic studies reveal asymmetric cross-source transfer, recall-dominated failures, and heterogeneous degradation across semantic, operational, and compositional changes. Beyond diagnosis, the scale and diversity of GIFTBench provide a substantially broader training distribution than conventional IFL datasets. Training representative localizers on GIFTBench consistently improves their aggregate transfer to external datasets, showing that the benchmark serves not only as an evaluation tool but also as an effective training resource for cross-domain localization. Guided by the diagnostic findings, we further develop ForenScope, a detection and localization framework combining classification-adapted representations with multi-depth, multi-scale spatial features, learned layer fusion, and selective coarse-scale conditioning. Experiments show improved cross-dataset localization while retaining image-level detection capability. The GIFTBench dataset showcase page is available at https://giftbench-preview.doudoudouya337.chatgpt.site.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GIFTBench 是面向图像伪造定位 (IFL) 的多轴基准，含 115,013 张带像素级标注的篡改图像，按篡改来源、语义目标、编辑操作与合成复杂度分轴，支持轴向迁移分析并在 12 个外部数据集上评测。诊断揭示跨来源迁移不对称、以召回为主的失败以及各轴异质退化；在其上训练代表性定位器可一致提升对外部数据集的总体迁移，据此提出的 ForenScope 框架改善跨数据集定位并保留图像级检测能力。
Motivation: 现有 IFL 基准覆盖的篡改条件有限，或在跨数据集评测中把多个因素纠缠在一起，聚合指标无法反映定位泛化的真正来源。
Method: 构建多轴基准 GIFTBench：115,013 张篡改图像、像素级标注，四个轴为 manipulation source、semantic target、editing operation、composition complexity，支持轴向迁移分析与 12 个外部数据集评测；再据诊断结论设计 ForenScope，结合分类适配表征与多深度多尺度空间特征、学习式层融合及选择性粗尺度条件化。
Result: GIFTBench 含 115,013 张图像、覆盖 12 个外部数据集；诊断发现跨来源迁移不对称、失败以召回为主、语义/操作/合成变化下退化异质；在其上训练代表性定位器一致提升对外部数据集的总体迁移；ForenScope 实验显示跨数据集定位改善并保留图像级检测能力。
Conclusion: GIFTBench 既是评测工具也是有效的跨域定位训练资源，诊断结论可直接指导模型设计，ForenScope 即按此设计并取得跨数据集定位提升。

papers.title: CODesign: Consistency from Data to Trajectory in All-Atom Protein Binder Co-Design
papers.abstract_en: The central challenge in de novo protein design is generating plausible, mutually compatible structures and sequences, such that each designed sequence folds into its intended structure and the structure accommodates that sequence. Compared to typical two-stage design methods, which decouple the modeling of the interdependent modalities, co-design models improve the cross-modal consistency by jointly generating sequences and structures. However, naively generating sequences and structures simultaneously does not ensure their consistency. To address this challenge, we propose CODesign framework. We improve data consistency by generating approximately 105,000 consistency-distilled dimers. We further promote consistency through a multimodal joint flow model that captures the joint distribution of sequences, backbone structures, and local atomic configurations, together with a consistency-aware joint resampling strategy that iteratively refines sequences and side chains. Experiments show that CODesign achieves state-of-the-art performance with the highest in silico success rates on both protein- and ligand-target binder design. Ablation studies also demonstrate our distilled dataset increases performance by 70.9%, which can be further improved by our proposed resampling mechanism with negligible additional computational cost. Code, model weights and the new dataset will be completely open-source.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CODesign 用一致性蒸馏的约 105,000 个二聚体数据与多模态联合流模型，联合生成蛋白 binder 的序列、骨架结构和局部原子构型，并用一致性感知的联合重采样迭代精修序列与侧链。在蛋白靶点与配体靶点 binder 设计上取得最高 in silico 成功率，蒸馏数据集带来 70.9% 的性能提升，重采样在此基础上进一步提升且额外计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: de novo 蛋白设计需要序列与结构互相兼容，两阶段方法把两个模态解耦建模，而简单的同时生成序列与结构并不能保证二者一致。
Method: CODesign 框架包含三部分：一致性蒸馏生成约 105,000 个 consistency-distilled dimers 以提升数据一致性；多模态联合流模型 (multimodal joint flow model) 捕获序列、骨架结构与局部原子构型的联合分布；一致性感知的联合重采样策略 (consistency-aware joint resampling) 迭代精修序列与侧链。
Result: 在蛋白靶点与配体靶点 binder 设计上均取得 state-of-the-art 的最高 in silico 成功率；消融实验显示蒸馏数据集使性能提升 70.9%，叠加所提重采样机制后进一步提升，且额外计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 跨模态一致性要靠数据层面的一致性蒸馏与生成过程中的联合重采样共同保证，代码、模型权重与新数据集将完全开源。

papers.title: The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching
papers.abstract_en: With the increasing capabilities of Large-Language-Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents, users are increasingly using them to solve everyday problems, such as answering e-mails or providing programming support. Existing work has extensively investigated security and privacy risks, such as prompt injections and the disclosure of sensitive data to chatbot providers. While various solutions were developed to address these risks, including input structuring to prevent prompt injections or deploying local LLMs to avoid sharing confidential data with chatbot operators, LLMs also pose the risk of leaking confidential data to third parties. In this paper, we demonstrate with LLMLeak a novel attack vector where malicious software that runs locally but cannot communicate directly with the internet abuses LLMs to establish a covert channel. While inputs that instruct the LLM to send data directly via generated code are easy to detect and network libraries are typically restricted, LLMLeak relies only on the LLM's tool to fetch websites for further information. A malicious software component on the client side embeds a secret into a URL. It presents the referenced website as providing information required for a benign task, such as migrating a software library. When the LLM accesses the URL, the attacker receives the encoded secret through an attacker-controlled DNS or web server. We perform an extensive evaluation on eleven open-parameter models, observe an attack success rate of 79.7%, and also conduct a case study on real-world chatbots, demonstrating the relevance of LLMLeak.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LLMLeak：本地恶意软件把机密编码进 URL，借 LLM 的网页抓取工具访问该地址，使攻击者从自己控制的 DNS 或 web 服务器收到密钥，从而把 LLM 变成外泄隐蔽信道。在 11 个开放参数模型上攻击成功率 79.7%，真实聊天机器人案例研究亦成立。
Motivation: 现有防护针对 prompt injection 与向聊天机器人运营方泄露数据，但无法阻止本地受限软件借 LLM 的合法工具向第三方外泄机密。
Method: 恶意组件把机密编码进 URL，并把该网站伪装成完成良性任务（如迁移软件库）所需的信息；LLM 调用网页抓取工具访问后，密钥经攻击者控制的 DNS 或 web 服务器回收。
Result: 在 11 个开放参数模型上评估，攻击成功率 79.7%；另在真实聊天机器人上做案例研究。
Conclusion: 仅依赖 LLM 网页抓取工具即可建立可用的隐蔽外泄信道，现有输入结构化与本地部署防护覆盖不到这条路径。

papers.title: VideoEvolve: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Video temporal grounding aims to localize events in videos from natural-language queries. For agents built around frozen video-language models, the harness determines how queries guide temporal predictions and how those predictions are refined. Manually refining these harnesses requires diagnosing grounding failures and coordinating changes to both agent workflows and instructions. We introduce VideoEvolve, a framework that automatically evolves agent harnesses for video temporal grounding. VideoEvolve uses a Cloze-Structured Harness Representation that preserves stage interfaces while leaving agent workflows and instructions open to evolution. Branch-Guided Harness Evolution preserves promising code branches for continued refinement, using execution feedback to guide local edits and validation to determine which improvements are carried forward. Experiments demonstrate improved grounding performance across multiple benchmarks. Component analyses identify instruction refinement as a consistent source of gains, while the benefits of evolved code vary across evaluation settings. Together, these results support automated harness evolution as an effective approach to improving video temporal grounding. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/VideoEvolve .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoEvolve 自动演化视频时序定位 (video temporal grounding) 的 agent harness：用 Cloze-Structured Harness Representation 保留阶段接口、开放工作流与指令供演化，再用 Branch-Guided Harness Evolution 靠执行反馈做局部编辑、靠验证决定保留哪些改进。在多个基准上定位性能提升，组件分析显示指令演化是稳定增益来源，而演化代码的收益随评测设置而变。
Motivation: 围绕冻结 video-language model 的 agent，其 harness 决定查询如何引导时序预测与细化；手工修 harness 需要诊断 grounding 失败并同时协调工作流与指令的改动，成本高。
Method: 提出 VideoEvolve：Cloze-Structured Harness Representation 把 harness 表示为保留阶段接口、工作流与指令可演化的形式；Branch-Guided Harness Evolution 保留有希望的代码分支继续细化，用执行反馈指导局部编辑、用验证决定哪些改进被保留。
Result: 在多个 video temporal grounding 基准上定位性能提升；组件分析表明指令演化 (instruction refinement) 是一致的增益来源，演化代码的收益则随评测设置不同而变化。
Conclusion: 自动化 harness 演化是改进 video temporal grounding 的有效途径，其中指令层面的演化比代码层面的演化更稳定地带来收益。

papers.title: Physics-Refined Spatiotemporal Forecasting on Open-Boundary Hydrologic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Spatiotemporal forecasting on hydrologic graphs is especially prone to instability in open-boundary systems, where the forecast domain exchanges fluxes with an unobserved exterior. In such systems, boundary nodes receive external forcing, e.g., upstream inflows in rivers or tidal signals in coastal regions, that is typically unavailable at prediction time. The absence of this information can compound errors as forecasts unfold in an autoregressive fashion, leading to inferior long-horizon performance. This paper dissects this instability issue by exploring two questions. 1) What boundary forcing enters the forecast domain when information beyond the boundary is missing? 2) How should this forcing propagate through the domain without incurring error amplification under autoregressive rollout? To address both, we propose a new computing framework comprising two key components. First, to compensate for the boundary forcing, our framework learns ghost node proxies from the boundary and interior nodes, striving to approximate unobserved external inputs. Second, to control error accumulation from these learned proxies, we leverage two physics refiners. In particular, one refiner enforces local consistency by aligning ghost proxies with their two-hop neighbors (i.e., boundary nodes and their immediate interiors). The other refiner enhances global stability by correcting the model forecasts through a physics-guided graph neural operator, reducing long-horizon numerical drift. Two real-world hydrologic graphs are employed for empirical evaluation. Comparative results show that our proposal enjoys higher prediction accuracy and long-horizon stability over both learning-based and physics-informed model competitors.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 开放边界水文图上的自回归预报会因边界外 forcing 缺失而误差累积，提出 ghost node proxy 学习未观测外部输入，再用两个 physics refiner 控制误差放大：局部一致性 refiner 对齐 ghost proxy 与其两跳邻居，全局稳定性 refiner 用 physics-guided graph neural operator 校正预报以压低长时程数值漂移。在两个真实水文图上，该框架在预测精度和长时程稳定性上均优于学习类与 physics-informed 竞争方法。
Motivation: 开放边界系统中预报域与未观测外界交换通量，边界节点的外部 forcing（上游来流、潮汐信号）在预测时不可得，自回归展开时误差不断复合，长时程性能劣化。
Method: 框架含两部分：从边界与内部节点学习 ghost node proxy 以近似未观测外部输入；再用两个 physics refiner——一个将 ghost proxy 与其两跳邻居（边界节点及其紧邻内部节点）对齐以保证局部一致性，另一个用 physics-guided graph neural operator 校正模型预报以提升全局稳定性、抑制长时程数值漂移。
Result: 在两个真实水文图 (hydrologic graphs) 上做对比评估，该方法在预测精度与长时程稳定性上均高于学习类和 physics-informed 的竞争模型。
Conclusion: 把边界 forcing 的缺失显式建模为可学习的 ghost node proxy，并用局部一致性与物理引导的全局校正双重 refiner 约束其传播，可以在开放边界水文图上同时提高精度并抑制自回归长时程漂移。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: TopK-Guided: Adaptive, Budget-Aware Activation Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Activation sparsity speeds up large language model (LLM) inference by setting unimportant activations to zero so that the corresponding computations can be skipped. Existing training-free methods, however, make different trade-offs: threshold-based methods such as TEAL adapt the sparsity level to each token but do not tightly control the realised sparsity, while TopK-based methods such as WINA enforce a fixed sparsity level but use the same sparsity budget for every token. Both also apply the same budget across transformer blocks, despite large differences in block sensitivity. We introduce TopK-Guided, a training-free method that addresses both limitations by combining bounded token-level sparsity adaptation with sensitivity-aware block-level budget allocation. Across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, TopK-Guided consistently improves perplexity and downstream accuracy over TEAL and WINA while preserving essentially the same sparsitydependent projection compute as WINA, with the largest gains at high sparsity. Ablations show that both components provide complementary improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopK-Guided 是一种免训练的 LLM 激活稀疏化方法，把 TEAL 的逐 token 自适应稀疏度加上硬上界约束，并按 transformer block 敏感度分配稀疏预算，取代 WINA 全局固定预算。在 Llama-2 与 Llama-3 上，它在与 WINA 基本相同的投影计算量下同时提升困惑度与下游准确率，高稀疏度时增益最大，且两个组件的贡献互补。
Motivation: 现有免训练激活稀疏化方法各有缺陷：阈值法（TEAL）逐 token 自适应却无法约束实际稀疏度，TopK 法（WINA）固定稀疏度却对所有 token 用同一预算，且两者都对所有 transformer block 施加相同预算，忽略 block 间敏感度的巨大差异。
Method: TopK-Guided 结合有界的逐 token 稀疏度自适应与敏感度感知的 block 级预算分配，全程免训练；对照基线为 TEAL 与 WINA，在 Llama-2 和 Llama-3 上检验，并做消融实验分离两个组件的作用。
Result: 在 Llama-2 与 Llama-3 上，TopK-Guided 的困惑度与下游准确率一致优于 TEAL 和 WINA，同时保持与 WINA 基本相同的稀疏度相关投影计算量，高稀疏度下增益最大；消融显示两个组件带来互补改进。
Conclusion: 把逐 token 稀疏度约束与 block 级敏感度预算同时纳入，可在不增加投影计算量的前提下提升免训练激活稀疏化的质量，且在高稀疏度区间收益最明显。

papers.title: OneStreamer: Unifying Perception, Memory, and Proactive Response in Streaming Video Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video LLMs must retain evidence before its relevance to future tasks is known and respond when sufficient evidence becomes available. The challenge is to form reusable factual memory without compromising real-time perception. We introduce OneStreamer, which jointly learns query-independent evidence recording and task response through a shared proactive generation process. Its Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory (PHCM) produces time-grounded local-detail captions and summaries of completed events. Streaming caption targets supervise the interpretation of observed video prefixes during training. At inference, model-generated records complement a recent visual window, providing reusable factual context without revisiting historical visual features. Proactive State Transition Learning (PSTL) reduces the dominance of repeated waiting states by preserving supervision at all output anchors and selecting representative state-change and state-persistence tokens. We further develop a streaming data synthesis pipeline that aligns output content and timing with available evidence. Combining the resulting streaming captions and QA with cleaned open-source data yields OneStreamer-1M, a broad-coverage streaming video interaction dataset with over one million records spanning diverse tasks. Our 4B model achieves the best results among the compared methods across all eight evaluated streaming video understanding benchmarks. Ablations show that retaining generated captions improves historical QA without degrading real-time perception. PSTL also outperforms dense state supervision while supervising only 27.5% of annotated state tokens. Together, these results support proactive generation as a shared learning interface connecting perception, memory formation, and timely response in streaming video interaction.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 12 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://mcg-nju.github.io/OneStreamer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OneStreamer 把流式视频 LLM 的感知、记忆与主动响应统一为一个主动生成过程：PHCM 生成带时间锚点的局部细节 caption 与已完成事件摘要作为可复用事实记忆，PSTL 通过保留全部输出锚点的监督并只选状态变化/状态保持 token 来抑制重复等待状态的主导。4B 模型在八个流式视频理解基准上取得被比较方法中的最好结果，PSTL 只监督 27.5% 的标注状态 token 仍优于稠密状态监督。
Motivation: 流式视频 LLM 必须在尚未知道证据对未来任务是否有用时就保留证据，并在证据充分时及时响应；难点在于形成可复用的事实记忆同时不牺牲实时感知。
Method: PHCM 产生时间对齐的局部细节 caption 与事件摘要，训练时用 streaming caption 目标监督对视频前缀的解读，推理时模型自产记录补充近期视觉窗口而不回看历史视觉特征；PSTL 在所有输出锚点保留监督并挑选代表性状态变化与状态保持 token；另配一条对齐输出内容与时机的流式数据合成流水线，与清洗后的开源数据合并成 OneStreamer-1M。
Result: OneStreamer-1M 超过一百万条记录、覆盖多样任务；4B 模型在全部八个被评估的流式视频理解基准上取得被比较方法中的最佳结果；消融显示保留生成的 caption 提升历史 QA 且不损害实时感知；PSTL 只监督 27.5% 的标注状态 token 却优于稠密状态监督。
Conclusion: 主动生成可以作为连接感知、记忆形成与及时响应的共享学习接口，在流式视频交互中同时保住历史 QA 与实时感知。

papers.title: PhysDEM: Physics-Defined Energy-Matching Diffusion for Spatiotemporal Field Generation under Scarce Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Generating and predicting spatiotemporal physical fields from scarce measurements is challenging, as observations are insufficient to characterize a distribution over complete fields. This limits conventional data-driven diffusion models that rely on full-field datasets. We introduce PhysDEM, a physics-defined diffusion framework that combines governing equations with spatially sparse observations to generate multiple plausible fields. First, we construct a Gibbs target by reweighting a measurement-conditioned Gaussian reference with PDE residual energy. Second, we derive an exact conditional-mean identity that reduces denoising to supervised learning of the standardized energy-induced mean correction. Third, a physics-displacement probability flow cancels Gaussian reference terms and enables amortized sampling with changing measurements through Gaussian conditioning, without retraining. Experiments on synthetic PDE systems and real-world-informed applications demonstrate that PhysDEM supports coherent field recovery and efficient sampling while maintaining stable diagnostics under tested noise levels, illustrating its practical value for field assessment. To our knowledge, PhysDEM is the first physics-defined diffusion model enabling amortized spatiotemporal field inference without preassembled full-field datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysDEM 把 PDE 残差能量作为权重加到测量条件高斯参考分布上构造 Gibbs 目标，使扩散模型在只有空间稀疏观测、没有完整场数据集的条件下也能生成多个合理的时空物理场。其物理位移概率流消去高斯参考项，靠高斯条件化即可在测量变化时做摊销采样 (amortized sampling) 而无需重训练。
Motivation: 稀疏测量不足以刻画完整场的分布，而常规数据驱动扩散模型依赖全场数据集，这限制了其在观测稀缺场景下的场生成与预测。
Method: 三步：用 PDE 残差能量对测量条件高斯参考重加权构造 Gibbs 目标；推导精确的条件均值恒等式，把去噪化简为对标准化能量诱导均值修正的监督学习；用物理位移概率流 (physics-displacement probability flow) 消去高斯参考项，经高斯条件化实现换测量不重训的摊销采样。
Result: 在合成 PDE 系统与真实世界启发的应用上，PhysDEM 实现了连贯的场恢复与高效采样，并在所测试的噪声水平下保持稳定的诊断量；据作者所知是首个无需预先组装全场数据集即可做摊销时空场推断的物理定义扩散模型。
Conclusion: 把控制方程直接写进扩散目标，可以在观测稀缺时替代全场数据集完成时空场推断，且换测量无需重训练。
Relevance: 38
