papers.title: Towards a Cloud Fog Edge System for Smart Building
papers.abstract_en: In this article, we present our vision and recent advancements toward creating a decentralized system capable of learning from real-time data within buildings to support sustainable and privacy-preserving smart environments. Our approach promotes the concept of the building itself as the data center, aligning with the principles of edge computing to safeguard confidentiality and reduce reliance on external cloud infrastructure. This is particularly valuable in humanitarian contexts, where data sovereignty, energy efficiency, and infrastructure constraints are critical. We detail a lightweight, "Kubernetes-like" orchestration framework for deploying AI services within such environments and demonstrate our progress in implementing AI algorithms on low-power, cost-effective microcontrollers such as those in the Arduino ecosystem. By enabling in-situ learning directly on sensors or microcontrollers, our work aims to bring intelligent services to resource-limited settings, fostering autonomy, resilience, and sustainable development in vulnerable or underserved communities. The contributions in this article are related, firstly, to our project "Online Machine Learning Algorithms for Embedded Systems" and the evaluation of two new online algorithms. Secondly, we envision a cloud-fog-edge architecture based on the KOptim and FIWARE components, and we propose a methodology for coupling them. Experimental results of the online algorithms are also presented, showcasing real-world traces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把建筑本身当数据中心的 cloud-fog-edge 架构，用轻量级 Kubernetes-like 编排框架在 Arduino 级低功耗微控制器上部署 AI 服务并做在线学习，减少对外部云的依赖。架构基于 KOptim 与 FIWARE 耦合，两个新在线算法在真实轨迹上给出实验结果。
Motivation: 人道主义与资源受限场景下，数据主权、能效与基础设施约束使把数据送往外部云的方案不可行，需要在传感器与微控制器本地完成学习以保护隐私并保持自主。
Method: 设计轻量级 Kubernetes-like 编排框架在建筑内环境部署 AI 服务；提出基于 KOptim 与 FIWARE 组件的 cloud-fog-edge 架构及二者耦合方法学；在 Arduino 生态低功耗微控制器上实现 AI 算法，并评测项目 Online Machine Learning Algorithms for Embedded Systems 中的两个新在线学习算法。
Result: 给出两个新在线算法的实验结果并展示真实轨迹 (real-world traces)；架构与编排框架的实现进展被详细描述。
Conclusion: 把建筑当作数据中心、在传感器与微控制器上做 in-situ 在线学习，是资源受限与人道主义场景下兼顾隐私、能效与自主性的可行路径。

papers.title: Beyond Demographic Balance: Multi-Metric and Intersectional Evaluation of Fairness in MIMIC-IV Mortality Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Fairness conclusions in clinical prediction can depend strongly on both the metrics reported and the demographic resolution at which performance is evaluated. We revisit these evaluation choices for ICU mortality prediction on MIMIC-IV, comparing predictive-utility and subgroup-error metrics across several fairness interventions. As a complementary case study, we introduce a lightweight adaptation strategy that jointly balances ethnicity--gender--insurance representation without conditioning on mortality outcomes, allowing demographic representation balancing to be examined separately from outcome-conditioned or direct error-rate interventions. We evaluate its behavior at both marginal and corresponding three-way intersectional subgroup levels, while accounting for the statistical support of finer-grained estimates. The results show that interventions can receive substantially different assessments across accuracy/AUROC, sensitivity, and false-positive rate, and that marginal demographic summaries can conceal heterogeneous error profiles within their constituent intersections, including among larger subgroups. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating fairness interventions at both complementary metric and subgroup resolutions, while accounting for the intervention target and the reliability of subgroup estimates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MIMIC-IV ICU 死亡率预测上重做公平性评估，发现同一干预在 accuracy/AUROC、sensitivity、false-positive rate 三种指标下会得到截然不同的评价，且边际人口统计汇总会掩盖其内部三元交叉子群（ethnicity×gender×insurance）的异质误差，即使在较小子群中也如此。结论是公平性干预必须同时在互补指标和交叉子群两个分辨率上评估，并考虑子群估计的统计可靠性。
Motivation: 临床预测的公平性结论强烈依赖所报告的指标与评估的人口统计分辨率：只看边际子群和单一指标会掩盖交叉子群内部的异质误差，从而误判干预效果。
Method: 在 MIMIC-IV ICU 死亡率预测上比较多种公平性干预的 predictive-utility 与 subgroup-error 指标；另提出一个轻量适配策略，联合平衡 ethnicity–gender–insurance 三元表示且不以死亡结局为条件，从而把表示平衡与结局条件化或直接误差率干预分开考察；在边际与三元交叉子群两个层级评估，并计入细分估计的统计支持度。
Result: 干预在 accuracy/AUROC、sensitivity 与 false-positive rate 上得到显著不同的评价；边际人口统计汇总掩盖了其构成交叉子群内部的异质误差分布，且这种情况出现在较小子群中。
Conclusion: 公平性干预的评估必须同时覆盖互补指标与子群分辨率，并结合干预目标与子群估计的可靠性来解读，单一指标或边际汇总会给出误导性结论。

papers.title: MCIR: A Feature Dependence-Aware Explainability Method with Reliability Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine-learning models often contain strongly dependent or redundant features, making feature attribution difficult because shared predictive information can be distributed across correlated predictors. Existing methods such as SHAP, LIME, HSIC, MI/CMI, and SAGE may therefore produce unstable rankings under multicollinearity or near-duplicate predictors. We propose the Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio Method (MCIR-M), a dependence-aware global feature-importance approach that quantifies the unique predictive information contributed by each feature beyond a selected dependence neighbourhood. MCIR-M introduces the Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio (MCIR), which conditions each feature on strongly dependent neighbours and computes a normalized ratio of conditional to block-level information. The population score lies in [0,1] and equals zero under exact conditional redundancy. We also introduce a lightweight estimation procedure that computes MCIR using a fraction of the available data and evaluates agreement with full-data explanations. Across controlled synthetic redundancy experiments and the UCI HAR benchmark, MCIR shows dependence-aware ranking behaviour, with its clearest advantage under injected near-duplicate predictors. Comparisons with independent and conditional SHAP, SAGE, HSIC, MI-based scores, and CIR-family baselines are mixed across real-data criteria. Reduced explanation samples lower computational burden in the evaluated configurations, while agreement with full-data explanations is assessed separately through ranking, head-set, and faithfulness diagnostics. Overall, MCIR-M provides a practical dependence-aware diagnostic for global explanation under strong feature dependence.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MCIR-M：对每个特征先取其强依赖邻域做条件化，再算条件信息与块级信息的归一化比值，得到 [0,1] 的全局特征重要性分数，精确条件冗余时为 0。在受控合成冗余实验与 UCI HAR 上，MCIR 在注入近重复预测子时排序优势最明显，与 SHAP/SAGE/HSIC/MI/CIR 系基线在真实数据准则上互有胜负；用少量样本估计即可降低计算量，同时与全数据解释的排序、头部集合与忠实性分开评估。
Motivation: 特征间强依赖或冗余会把共享预测信息分散到相关预测子上，使 SHAP、LIME、HSIC、MI/CMI、SAGE 在多重共线或近重复特征下给出不稳定的排序。
Method: MCIR-M 定义 Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio：把每个特征对其强依赖邻居条件化，计算条件信息与块级信息的归一化比值，总体分数落在 [0,1]，精确条件冗余时为 0；另配一个轻量估计流程，只用可用数据的一小部分计算 MCIR，并单独评估其与全数据解释的一致性。
Result: 在受控合成冗余实验与 UCI HAR 基准上，MCIR 表现出依赖感知的排序行为，最清晰的优势出现在注入近重复预测子时；与独立/条件 SHAP、SAGE、HSIC、MI 类分数及 CIR 系基线的比较在真实数据准则上结果混合；减少解释样本在所评估配置下降低计算负担，与全数据解释的一致性通过排序、head-set 与 faithfulness 诊断单独评估。
Conclusion: MCIR-M 被定位为强特征依赖下全局解释的实用依赖感知诊断工具，其优势集中在近重复预测子场景，真实数据上相对现有归因方法并非全面占优。

papers.title: Not All Error Yields to Scale: Where Scaling Stops in Vision-Language Inference
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) face a fixed-budget trade-off between processing more visual information for fine-grained perception and using a larger language backbone for complex reasoning. Existing studies do not tell us which combination of backbone size and input resolution to deploy, especially in high-resolution deployments. To address this gap, we propose the Separable Law that describes how VLM performance changes with language backbone size and visual token count. We fit the law to measurements from 26 InternVL and QwenVL models, with language backbone sizes from 1B to 72B, on four high-resolution benchmarks with image sizes from 224 pixels to 8K. We find that the questions responding to scaling can be predicted from the skill they require, while a substantial fraction never responds at all. We also find that the two model families gain similarly from a larger backbone, while their gains from more visual tokens differ sharply. Combined with a cost law, the Separable Law gives a closed-form rule for allocating compute between backbone size and visual tokens. When deployment is limited to available configurations, the law identifies model and image sizes that perform close to the best feasible choice under the same budget. We hope our work offers a principled way to decide how much a model should be allowed to see at high resolution, given what it must reason about.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Separable Law，刻画 VLM 性能随语言 backbone 规模与 visual token 数的可分离变化规律：在 26 个 InternVL 与 QwenVL 模型（1B–72B）、四套高分辨率基准（224 像素到 8K）上拟合，发现可被 scaling 提升的问题可由其所需技能预测，而相当一部分问题完全不响应 scaling；两个模型家族从更大 backbone 获益相近，但从更多 visual token 获益差异显著。结合 cost law 可给出在 backbone 与 visual token 之间分配算力的闭式规则。
Motivation: 固定算力预算下，VLM 部署要在「吃进更多视觉信息做细粒度感知」与「用更大语言 backbone 做复杂推理」之间取舍，而现有研究无法回答该部署哪一种 backbone 尺寸与输入分辨率的组合，尤其在高分辨率场景。
Method: 提出 Separable Law 描述性能随 language backbone size 与 visual token count 的变化，用 26 个 InternVL 和 QwenVL 模型（backbone 1B–72B）在四套高分辨率基准（图像 224 像素至 8K）上的测量拟合该律；再与一条 cost law 结合，导出算力分配的闭式规则。
Result: 在 26 个模型、backbone 1B–72B、图像 224 像素至 8K 的四套高分辨率基准上拟合出 Separable Law；可响应 scaling 的问题比例可由所需技能预测，另有相当一部分问题完全不响应；InternVL 与 QwenVL 从更大 backbone 的增益相近，从更多 visual token 的增益差异显著；在受限于可用配置的部署下，该律能选出接近同预算下最优可行选择的模型与图像尺寸。
Conclusion: VLM 的 scaling 收益可按「backbone 规模」与「visual token 数」两轴分离刻画，并据此在固定预算下闭式分配算力；能否被 scaling 提升取决于问题所需技能，而非所有误差都能靠放大解决。

summary_sections.result: 在 26 个模型、backbone 1B–72B、图像 224 像素至 8K 的四套高分辨率基准上拟合出 Separable Law；可响应 scaling 的问题比例可由所需技能预测，另有相当一部分问题完全不响应；InternVL 与 QwenVL 从更大 backbone 的增益相近，从更多 visual token 的增益差异显著；在受限于可用配置的部署下，该律能选出接近同预算下最优可行选择的模型与图像尺寸。
summary_sections.conclusion: VLM 的 scaling 收益可按「backbone 规模」与「visual token 数」两轴分离刻画，并据此在固定预算下闭式分配算力；能否被 scaling 提升取决于问题所需技能，而非所有误差都能靠放大解决。

papers.title: FedSAP: Federated Learning with Structured Adaptive Partitioning for Multi-Domain Heterogeneous Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) on heterogeneous edge devices must jointly accommodate unequal resource budgets and domain-shifted local data. Existing resource-adaptive methods decide how much of a model each client trains but not where retained capacity should reside or how it should be shared, whereas federated domain-generalization methods usually assume a shared full architecture. Uniform compression can therefore discard high-utility channels, and a single aggregation path can mix transferable features with domain-sensitive updates. We propose FedSAP, a domain-aware heterogeneous FL framework that casts structured pruning as budget-constrained tri-state channel allocation. FedSAP converts each keep ratio into non-uniform layer budgets, assigns stable channels to a Global pool, useful domain-sensitive channels to pseudo-domain-specific Private pools, and low-utility channels to a Dropped state. This partition lets broadly useful features benefit from cross-client pooling while isolating domain-sensitive updates from incompatible clients. Domain-Guided Assignment infers pseudo-domains from shallow-gradient similarity, while Type-Matched Aggregation restricts each channel to its intended sharing scope. Across three random seeds, FedSAP reaches 76.00% and 72.67% mean global accuracy on Digits and Office-Caltech, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.70 and 4.92 percentage points while supporting client pruning ratios of up to 80% across heterogeneous clients.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedSAP 把异构边缘设备上的联邦学习结构化剪枝建模为预算约束的三态通道分配：稳定通道进 Global 池、域敏感通道进伪域 Private 池、低效通道丢弃，配合浅层梯度相似度推断伪域与按类型限定共享范围的聚合。三个随机种子下 Digits 与 Office-Caltech 平均全局准确率 76.00% 与 72.67%，超最强基线 1.70 与 4.92 个百分点，且支持异构客户端最高 80% 剪枝率。
Motivation: 资源自适应方法只决定客户端训练模型的多少，不决定保留容量放在哪里、如何共享；联邦域泛化方法又假设共享完整架构。均匀压缩会丢掉高价值通道，单一聚合路径会把可迁移特征与域敏感更新混在一起。
Method: FedSAP 将结构化剪枝表述为预算约束的三态通道分配：把每个 keep ratio 转成非均匀层预算，通道分入 Global 池、伪域 Private 池或 Dropped 态；Domain-Guided Assignment 用浅层梯度相似度推断伪域，Type-Matched Aggregation 限制每个通道只在预定共享范围内聚合。
Result: 三个随机种子下，FedSAP 在 Digits 上平均全局准确率 76.00%，Office-Caltech 上 72.67%，分别超最强基线 1.70 和 4.92 个百分点；在异构客户端上支持最高 80% 的客户端剪枝率。
Conclusion: 把保留容量按全局可迁移与域敏感两类分开并限制各自共享范围，可在高剪枝率下同时保住跨客户端迁移收益并隔离不兼容的域更新。

papers.title: Fusing Visual and Textual Representations via Multi-layer Fusing Transformers for Vietnamese Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: In recent decades, artificial intelligence has made significant progress in understanding and interacting with images. One of the important applications of this technology is Visual Question Answering (VQA), a research field that requires computers to understand and answer questions about images in a natural manner. Despite extensive research and development in VQA for English, there have been very few similar efforts made for other languages, especially Vietnamese. This gap presents a significant challenge and opportunity for the advancement of VQA technology in the Vietnamese language context. By bridging this gap, the field of Vietnamese VQA not only enriches the diversity of research in artificial intelligence but also enables practical applications in various domains, such as education, healthcare, and entertainment, catering to Vietnamese-speaking populations worldwide. Thus, the exploration and development of Vietnamese VQA systems hold immense potential for advancing both research and practical applications in the intersection of computer vision and natural language processing. In this paper, we propose a Multi-layer Fusing Transformer model utilizing a cross attention module to combine multiple modality features of images and texts from different layers in an aggregated representation. Our architecture allows us extract information from low level to high level. Through detailed experiments and ablation studies, our model achieves promising results against the competitive baselines in ViVQA dataset for Vietnamese language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对越南语视觉问答 (Vietnamese VQA) 提出 Multi-layer Fusing Transformer，用 cross attention 模块在多个层级上融合图像与文本的多模态特征，形成聚合表示，从而从低层到高层逐级抽取信息。在 ViVQA 数据集上，该模型通过实验与消融研究取得相对竞争基线有竞争力的结果。
Motivation: VQA 在英文上研究充分，但越南语等其他语言的工作极少，制约了越南语场景下教育、医疗、娱乐等实际应用。
Method: 提出 Multi-layer Fusing Transformer：以 cross attention 模块在不同层级上融合图像与文本的多模态特征，输出聚合表示，使模型能从低层特征一路抽取到高层语义；训练与检验在越南语 ViVQA 数据集上完成，并做消融研究。
Result: 在越南语 ViVQA 数据集上，模型相对竞争基线取得有竞争力的结果，消融研究用于验证各组件作用；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 多层级 cross attention 融合视觉与文本表示是提升越南语 VQA 可行且有效的架构路径，填补该语言上 VQA 研究的空白。

papers.title: Generalization in Neural Networks Through the Lens of Magnitude Potential
papers.abstract_en: Explaining generalization and training dynamics in neural networks remains a challenge, and various approaches have been developed to study different aspects of these phenomena. In this paper, we introduce the idea of {\em magnitude potential} -- a quantity based on the theory of metric magnitude -- that reflects how well an arbitrary point is represented by a given set. We find that this basic quantity can be applied to examine various features in neural generalization. The ratio between the magnitude potential with respect to a class and with respect to the entire data, computed at the logit layer, is informative of the representation of the point. In experiments, these ratios for individual training points are found to be correlated with the Feldman memorization scores. Magnitude potential ratios aggregated across points detect structural changes in the decision boundaries and provide a geometric indicator of grokking in modular arithmetic. Although the magnitude potential ratio and neural collapse are both closely associated with intra-class and inter-class geometric structure, the magnitude potential ratio remains informative even when neural collapse is explicitly suppressed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 metric magnitude 理论的 magnitude potential，衡量单点被给定集合代表的程度，并在 logit 层取「类内 magnitude potential 与全体数据 magnitude potential 之比」作为表征几何指标。该比值在训练点上与 Feldman memorization 分数相关，跨点聚合后能检测决策边界的结构变化，并在 modular arithmetic 中给出 grokking 的几何指示；即使显式抑制 neural collapse，该比值仍保有信息。
Motivation: 神经网络泛化与训练动力学的解释仍缺乏能同时刻画单点记忆、决策边界结构变化与 grokking 的统一几何量。
Method: 引入 magnitude potential（源自 metric magnitude 理论），在 logit 层计算类相对全体数据的比值；用该比值分析单点表征、聚合后追踪决策边界结构变化，并在 modular arithmetic 上检验其与 grokking 的关系，同时在抑制 neural collapse 的条件下验证其独立信息。
Result: 单点的 magnitude potential 比值与 Feldman memorization 分数相关；跨点聚合的比值可检测决策边界结构变化，并作为 modular arithmetic 中 grokking 的几何指示；在 neural collapse 被显式抑制后该比值仍保持信息量。
Conclusion: magnitude potential 比值是一个与 neural collapse 相关但不依赖它的泛化几何探针，可同时用于刻画记忆、决策边界结构与 grokking。

papers.title: What Makes Something Hard(er)? Explaining Question Difficulty in Natural Language
papers.abstract_en: Difficulty is one of the most fundamental properties of a question: it determines whether the question can meaningfully discriminate between models of differing ability. Although a variety of methods can now estimate or predict difficulty automatically, they yield only a single descriptive number, with no account of the underlying factors that make a question difficult in the first place. In this work, we propose a data-driven approach that automatically generates and validates natural-language hypotheses explaining what makes one question harder than another. We first estimate each item's difficulty from the responses of a large pool of LLMs using Item Response Theory. We then sample contrasting sets of easy and hard questions and prompt an LLM to propose candidate explanations of the difference, which are subsequently validated and selected on held-out questions. Experimental results across three datasets spanning mathematical, logical, and commonsense reasoning show that our method produces interpretable and predictive hypotheses. On their own, they predict the difficulty of unseen questions competitively with, or better than, advanced black-box difficulty regressors; used as additional features, they further improve those regressors, implying that they discover difficulty signals that existing models fail to capture. Moreover, we demonstrate that editing questions according to a hypothesis can shift their measured difficulty in the expected direction, indicating that the discovered hypotheses are causally valid difficulty factors rather than post-hoc descriptions. Our approach thus turns a purely descriptive difficulty score into actionable statements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把题目难度从单一分数变成可检验的自然语言假设：先用 IRT 从大量 LLM 作答估计每题难度，再对比易/难题让 LLM 生成候选解释并在留出题上验证筛选。在数学、逻辑、常识推理三个数据集上，这些假设单独预测未见题难度即可与或优于黑盒难度回归器，作为附加特征还能进一步提升回归器，且按假设编辑题目能把实测难度推向预期方向。
Motivation: 现有自动难度估计只输出一个描述性数字，不说明究竟是什么因素让某道题更难，因而无法指导题目改写或能力区分。
Method: 先用项目反应理论 (Item Response Theory, IRT) 从大规模 LLM 池的作答估计每题难度；再采样成对的易题与难题，提示 LLM 提出解释差异的候选假设，并在留出题目上验证与筛选。
Result: 在覆盖数学、逻辑与常识推理的三个数据集上，生成的假设既可解释又具预测力：单独使用时预测未见题难度与先进黑盒难度回归器相当或更好，作为附加特征还能进一步改进这些回归器；按假设编辑题目可使实测难度朝预期方向移动。
Conclusion: 自然语言难度假设能捕捉现有黑盒回归器遗漏的难度信号，且具有因果效度，可把纯描述性难度分数转成可操作的题目改写陈述。

papers.title: Measuring the Stability Assumption Behind Action Chunking
papers.abstract_en: Action chunking improves the performance of policies learned by behavioural cloning, and several mechanisms have been proposed to explain why, including temporal consistency, horizon reduction, representation learning, and reduced error compounding. We instead study what happens to an action error once it enters the system. At each state, we inject a small action error and measure how fast it grows or shrinks under two execution regimes: open-loop, where the rest of the chunk is replayed without replanning, and closed-loop, where the policy replans after the perturbation. The fitted rate labels each state as contracting, expanding, or unresolved. Across twelve manipulation tasks from three benchmark suites, we find that confidently stable states are rare, while error amplification is common among states whose propagation rate can be resolved. We further find that the measured propagation rate depends strongly on the fitting horizon: amplification is typically front-loaded, so short windows can overestimate longer-horizon propagation. Finally, we train predictors on these labels and find that a state's open-loop regime can be recovered from camera frames and proprioception alone, while its closed-loop propagation is only partially recoverable because it also depends on how the policy acts after the perturbation. These results suggest that error-compounding arguments alone do not provide a complete account of action chunking: neither passive open-loop dynamics nor policy replanning consistently contracts an injected error, and replanning rarely turns open-loop amplification into confident contraction. This suggests that closed-loop reactivity should be trained explicitly, using perturbation- and tree-coverage-oriented training to expose policies to deviations they must recover from, rather than expected to emerge reliably from standard imitation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在行为克隆的动作分块 (action chunking) 中直接测量注入动作误差的传播速率：在开环回放与闭环重规划两种执行方式下拟合误差增长/收缩率，发现可确信判定为收缩的状态很少，可解算的状态中误差放大占多数，且放大集中在拟合窗口前段。作者据此主张闭环反应性应靠面向扰动与树覆盖的训练显式获得，而不是指望标准模仿学习自发涌现。
Motivation: 动作分块为何有效常被归因于时间一致性、缩短时域、表征学习或减缓误差复合，但这些解释没有回答一个动作误差进入系统后究竟如何演化。
Method: 在每个状态注入小的动作误差，分别在开环（回放分块剩余部分、不重规划）与闭环（扰动后策略重规划）两种执行方式下拟合误差增长或收缩速率，并把状态标为 contracting、expanding 或 unresolved；再用相机帧与本体感觉训练预测器来恢复这些标签。
Result: 在三个基准套件的十二个操作任务上，可确信稳定的状态很少，而在传播速率可解算的状态中误差放大常见；测得的速率强烈依赖拟合时域，放大通常前置，短窗口会高估长时域传播；开环状态可仅凭相机帧与本体感觉恢复，闭环传播只能部分恢复，因为其还取决于扰动后策略的行为。
Conclusion: 仅靠误差复合论证不足以解释动作分块：开环动力学与策略重规划都不会一致地收缩注入误差，重规划也很少把开环放大转为确信收缩，因此应以扰动与树覆盖导向的训练显式训练闭环反应性。

summary_sections.motivation: 动作分块为何有效常被归因于时间一致性、缩短时域、表征学习或减缓误差复合，但这些解释没有回答一个动作误差进入系统后究竟如何演化。
summary_sections.method: 在每个状态注入小的动作误差，分别在开环（回放分块剩余部分、不重规划）与闭环（扰动后策略重规划）两种执行方式下拟合误差增长或收缩速率，并把状态标为 contracting、expanding 或 unresolved；再用相机帧与本体感觉训练预测器来恢复这些标签。
summary_sections.result: 在三个基准套件的十二个操作任务上，可确信稳定的状态很少，而在传播速率可解算的状态中误差放大常见；测得的速率强烈依赖拟合时域，放大通常前置，短窗口会高估长时域传播；开环状态可仅凭相机帧与本体感觉恢复，闭环传播只能部分恢复，因为其还取决于扰动后策略的行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: 仅靠误差复合论证不足以解释动作分块：开环动力学与策略重规划都不会一致地收缩注入误差，重规划也很少把开环放大转为确信收缩，因此应以扰动与树覆盖导向的训练显式训练闭环反应性。

papers.title: Beyond Domain-Level Adaptation: Margin-Oriented Semantic-Appearance Interaction Correction for Personalized Federated Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables distributed clients to adapt pretrained vision-language models without sharing raw data or updating the full backbone. Its effectiveness, however, is limited by domain heterogeneity across clients. Existing personalized methods separate globally shared knowledge from client-specific style, but they largely treat each domain as a class-agnostic transformation. We show that this abstraction is insufficient: the cross-domain displacement associated with a fixed domain varies across semantic classes, and only a subset of these class-domain residuals damages the image-text decision margin. We therefore propose Margin-Oriented Semantic-Appearance Interaction Correction (MOSAIC), which first constructs a decision-aware harmfulness score that measures whether a training-derived class-domain residual favors a competing text prototype over the true class. It then models fine-grained class-domain interactions with a low-rank residual adapter whose class factors and residual basis are globally shared while domain factors remain client-private. An image-conditioned gate further controls candidate-wise correction, and harmful-pair-aware reweighting prioritizes decision-relevant residuals during local optimization. Extensive experiments on Office31, OfficeHome, and DomainNet100 demonstrate that MOSAIC consistently improves macro-client top-1 accuracy across all evaluated domain-shift and joint domain-label-shift settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOSAIC 指出个性化联邦视觉-语言模型把每个域当成类无关变换是错的：固定域的跨域位移随语义类变化，且只有部分类-域残差会损害图文决策间隔。它用决策感知有害性分数筛出这些残差，再用低秩残差适配器加图像条件门控做选择性校正，在 Office31、OfficeHome、DomainNet100 上所有域偏移与联合域标签偏移设置中一致提升宏客户端 top-1 准确率。
Motivation: 联邦参数高效微调受客户端间域异质性限制；现有个性化方法把全局知识与客户端风格分开，却把每个域当作类无关变换，忽略了类相关的域位移中只有一部分真正破坏决策间隔。
Method: MOSAIC 三部分：构造决策感知有害性分数，判断训练得到的类-域残差是否让竞争文本原型胜过真实类；低秩残差适配器中类因子与残差基全局共享、域因子保留为客户端私有；再加图像条件门控控制逐候选校正，以及有害对重加权在本地优化中优先处理决策相关残差。
Result: 在 Office31、OfficeHome、DomainNet100 上，MOSAIC 在所有被评估的域偏移 (domain shift) 与联合域标签偏移 (joint domain-label shift) 设置中一致提高宏客户端 top-1 准确率。
Conclusion: 把域偏移建模为类相关的残差并只校正损害决策间隔的那部分，比类无关的域变换抽象更有效，且在多数据集多种偏移设置下稳定成立。

papers.title: FedLore: Communication and Memory Efficient Federated Learning via Shared Gradient Low-Rank Projection
papers.abstract_en: Federated training of foundation models is constrained by client memory and communication costs. LoRA-based methods reduce these costs through low-rank adapters, but their fixed rank budget can limit adaptation. Gradient low-rank optimization offers greater flexibility, yet independently chosen client subspaces create a problem we term \emph{subspace fragmentation}: local projections interact with data heterogeneity to bias aggregated directions, while aggregation can increase update rank and communication cost. Thus, accurate local gradient compression need not preserve global descent. We propose \texttt{FedLore}, which shares a low-rank optimization basis within each round and refreshes it across rounds. The shared basis enables exact aggregation in low-rank coordinates and eliminates the identified projection bias. Subspace refresh allows the accumulated model update to exceed the per-round rank budget. We characterize the aggregation bias and establish an $O(T^{-1/2})$ stationarity bound for the projected-SGD variant under a global-gradient coverage condition and standard smoothness and variance assumptions, with bounded gradient heterogeneity. Experiments on vision and language tasks, including federated pre-training, show that \texttt{FedLore} outperforms the evaluated low-rank adapter baselines and matches or exceeds full-parameter training, while reducing communication and optimizer-state memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedLore 在联邦低秩优化中每轮共享同一个低秩基并跨轮刷新，使聚合能在低秩坐标内精确进行、消除各客户端独立子空间造成的投影偏置，且累积更新可突破单轮秩预算。在视觉与语言任务（含联邦预训练）上超过所评估的低秩 adapter 基线，达到或超过全参数训练，同时降低通信量与优化器状态内存。
Motivation: 联邦训练基础模型受客户端内存与通信成本制约；LoRA 类方法固定秩预算限制适配能力，而各客户端独立选子空间会与数据异质性交互、偏置聚合方向，并抬高更新秩与通信开销，即所谓子空间碎片化 (subspace fragmentation)。
Method: 每轮内共享一个低秩优化基、跨轮刷新该基：共享基使低秩坐标内的聚合精确并消除投影偏置，刷新让累积更新超出单轮秩预算。理论上对 projected-SGD 变体在全局梯度覆盖条件、标准光滑性与方差假设、梯度异质性有界下给出 O(T^{-1/2}) 平稳性界。
Result: 在视觉与语言任务（含联邦预训练）上，FedLore 超出所评估的低秩 adapter 基线，并达到或超过全参数训练，同时降低通信与优化器状态内存；理论给出 projected-SGD 变体的 O(T^{-1/2}) 平稳性界。
Conclusion: 准确的局部梯度压缩并不保证全局下降方向，共享并刷新低秩基才能同时保住聚合精度、突破秩预算并省通信与内存。

papers.title: Exposing the Cost of Deep Learning Audio Development
papers.abstract_en: The environmental impact of deep learning has attracted increasing attention over the past decade. Existing studies mainly focus on the energy and carbon emissions of model training and inference, while the whole development phase is often overlooked. Yet, architecture prototyping and intensive experiments are conducted during this stage, which is highly energy-demanding. In this article, we propose a methodology to estimate these costs, based on activity logs from the Grid5000 shared computing platform used by the LORIA laboratory. As a case-study, we focus on audio projects developed in the Multispeech research team. We evaluate the overall energy cost of four projects, and we compare them to those of training the reported models. Our results show that the energy required for the development phase is 3 to 256 times greater than that required to train the best-performing model alone. These results advocate for a more systematic reporting of energy consumption across the entire life cycle of deep learning-based audio projects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 基于 Grid5000 共享计算平台的活动日志，提出估算深度学习音频项目开发阶段（架构原型与大量实验）能耗的方法，并对 Multispeech 团队四个项目做案例研究。开发阶段能耗是单独训练最优模型的 3 到 256 倍，作者据此主张系统性报告深度学习音频项目全生命周期的能耗。
Motivation: 现有深度学习环境影响研究只统计训练与推理的能耗与碳排，而架构原型和密集实验所在的开发阶段能耗被忽略，但这一阶段同样高耗能。
Method: 以 Grid5000 共享计算平台的活动日志为基础，提出估算开发阶段能耗的方法学；案例研究对象为 Multispeech 研究团队开发的音频项目，将项目整体能耗与论文所报告模型的训练能耗对比。
Result: 评估了四个音频项目的整体能耗：开发阶段所需能耗是单独训练最佳性能模型的 3 到 256 倍。
Conclusion: 开发阶段才是深度学习音频项目能耗的大头，应把能耗报告扩展到项目全生命周期而非只报训练与推理。

papers.title: Agents Are Systems, Not Models: Rethinking Agentic Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Agent evaluations increasingly go beyond a single success rate, reporting metrics such as cost, consistency, and robustness. Yet they typically treat the agent itself as fixed. In practice, an agent is a configurable system: users decide what to tell it, how long to let it run, and which model to use, and each of these choices can change how well and how consistently it performs. We study these choices on a new benchmark of four scientific tasks, where a coding agent must find and correctly operate a published specialist model. We investigate five parts of the agent's configuration: task information, reasoning, self-verification, time budget, and backbone model. We find substantial run-to-run variability, with approximately 54% of the outcome variance coming from repeating the same configuration rather than changing it. Across configurations, the information provided to the agent has the largest effect, exceeding both time budget and model size, while also reducing cost and improving calibration. Configuration choices also interact: additional time helps only when the agent has sufficient information or a capable enough model to use it. Finally, a trajectory-based taxonomy of agent behavior reveals that prompting an agent to verify its answer has little effect on its verification behavior, whereas providing a dedicated verification tool changes that behavior substantially. These results suggest that agents should be evaluated as configurable systems themselves, and that some desired behaviors are more effectively implemented in the system than requested through prompting. We release the benchmark and more than 18,000 agent trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张 agent 评测应把 agent 当作可配置系统而非固定模型：在含四个科学任务的新基准上考察任务信息、推理、自我验证、时间预算、骨干模型五项配置，发现同一配置重复运行即带来约 54% 的结果方差，而提供给 agent 的信息影响最大，超过时间预算与模型规模，且同时降低成本、改善校准。配置之间还会交互：只有信息足够或模型够强时，额外时间才起作用；要求 agent 自查几乎不改变其验证行为，而给一个专用验证工具会显著改变该行为。
Motivation: 现有 agent 评测多报成功率、成本、一致性、稳健性等指标，却把 agent 本身当作固定不变的对象，忽略了用户可选的提示内容、运行时长与骨干模型这些配置项本身就会改变性能与一致性。
Method: 构建一个含四项科学任务的新基准，任务是让 coding agent 找到并正确操作一个已发表的专家模型；系统考察五类配置（任务信息、推理、自我验证、时间预算、骨干模型），并用基于轨迹的 agent 行为分类法 (trajectory-based taxonomy) 归纳行为差异。
Result: 同一配置重复运行而非更换配置带来约 54% 的结果方差；跨配置比较中信息提供的影响最大，超过时间预算与模型规模，同时降低成本并改善校准；时间预算的收益依赖信息是否充分或模型是否够强；提示 agent 验证答案对其验证行为影响很小，而提供专用验证工具会显著改变该行为。
Conclusion: agent 应被当作可配置系统来评测，且部分期望行为放进系统里实现（如专用验证工具）比在提示里要求更有效。

papers.title: Can LLMs Reliably Annotate Bioassay Metadata to Improve Data Readiness?
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of foundation models for molecular property prediction requires a high degree of AI data readiness, including reliable metadata annotation. However, both public repositories and industrial screening databases suffer from missing, inconsistent, or conflated assay annotations. In this work, we quantify the extent of missing annotations in PubChem for the BioAssay Ontology (BAO) assay format and physical detection method fields and investigate whether open-source and proprietary large language models (LLMs) can reliably predict and audit metadata annotations directly from the assay text. In our assessment, we found that the annotation coverage across PubChem's $\sim$2 million bioassays is critically sparse, 36\% lacking an assay format, 89\% a BioAssay type, and >99.9\% any BAO-mapped assay format or detection technology term. This motivates the need for automated test-metadata curation. Using evaluation sets derived from PubChem and ChEMBL, we assess the agreement of seven open-source and proprietary LLMs with existing silver labels. Recall is at least 0.96 for biochemical and cell-based assay formats, with a similar pattern for detection technology, although disagreements increase on under-represented classes. Manual inspection shows that many of these disagreements trace back to inconsistencies between silver sources rather than to LLM error. Moreover, in a qualitative study with a senior industrial curator, LLM-generated evidence prompted the expert to revise some of their own labels, showing LLMs can flag potentially mislabeled assays. Across the study, performance differences between proprietary and open-source models were small. Together, these results suggest LLMs can support the large-scale annotation and auditing of assay metadata, though per-class reliability estimates and targeted human review remain necessary before such labels enter downstream ML pipelines.
papers.comment: Accepted to the AIDaR workshop at NeurIPS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用七个开源与闭源 LLM 直接从 PubChem 生物测定文本预测并审计 BAO 元数据，发现 PubChem 约 200 万条 bioassay 中 36% 缺 assay format、89% 缺 BioAssay type、>99.9% 缺 BAO 映射的格式或检测技术术语。在由 PubChem 与 ChEMBL 构建的评测集上，生化与细胞测定格式的 recall 至少 0.96，且多数分歧源自 silver label 来源之间的不一致而非 LLM 错误。
Motivation: 分子性质预测的基础模型需要高 AI 数据就绪度，但公共库与工业筛选库的 assay 注释缺失、不一致或混同，PubChem 的 BAO 格式与检测方法字段覆盖严重稀疏，阻碍下游 ML 管线使用。
Method: 先量化 PubChem 中 BAO assay format 与 physical detection method 字段的缺失程度，再用源自 PubChem 与 ChEMBL 的评测集，评估七个开源与专有 LLM 直接从 assay 文本预测注释与既有 silver label 的一致性，并由一位资深工业策展人做人工检查与定性研究。
Result: PubChem 约 200 万条 bioassay 中 36% 缺 assay format、89% 缺 BioAssay type、>99.9% 缺任何 BAO 映射的 assay format 或 detection technology 术语；生化与细胞测定格式 recall 至少 0.96，检测技术呈类似模式但在代表性不足的类别上分歧增大；人工检查显示许多分歧源于 silver 来源不一致而非 LLM 错误；专有与开源模型性能差异很小。
Conclusion: LLM 可支撑大规模 assay 元数据标注与审计并能标出疑似错标，但标签进入下游 ML 管线前仍需按类可靠性估计与针对性人工复核。

papers.title: Oneira: From Open-Ended Generation to Open-World Interaction in Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative video world models can now synthesize open-ended environments that agents can navigate and interact with in simple ways. Yet open-ended generation does not imply full interaction: as a generated world expands, newly created content through navigation should expand what the agent can act upon, and as the agent changes the world, those changes should become persistent parts of the environment rather than transient visual effects. We characterize these two requirements as Open-World Interactivity, where newly generated or encountered entities are incorporated into the actionable world, and Persistent State, where interaction outcomes are committed to the world state and continue to influence subsequent observations and interactions. We present Oneira, an interactive video world model that closes the loop between generation and interaction through an explicit, extensible world state managed by a coding agent. Given the current observation and an action or high-level goal, the agent reads the world state, grounds the relevant entities, plans the interaction, and writes its outcome back into a world state table. When exploration reveals new objects, the agent incorporates them from generated observations, allowing the interaction space to expand with the generated world. Meanwhile, previously induced state changes are carried across video segments, making the consequences of interaction persistent parts of subsequent world evolution. The updated world state is rendered along the camera action trajectory into a coarse conditioning video, from which a video generator fills in the appearance, motion, and interaction details not represented in the state. Experiments show that Oneira enables direct and consistent interaction with newly generated objects, while preserving the effects of prior interactions over long horizons. Project page: https://madaoer.github.io/projects/oneira
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Oneira 用一个由 coding agent 管理的显式世界状态表，把视频世界模型的生成与交互闭环：agent 读状态、定位实体、规划动作并把结果写回状态表，探索到的新物体从生成观测中并入状态，状态变化跨视频片段延续，再沿相机轨迹渲染成粗条件视频交给视频生成器补全外观与运动。实验显示它能对新生成物体做直接且一致的交互，并在长时程上保持先前交互的效果。
Motivation: 开放式视频生成不等于可交互：导航新生成的内容未必进入 agent 的可作用集合，agent 改动的世界也往往只是瞬时视觉效果而不会沉淀为环境状态。
Method: 以显式、可扩展的世界状态表为核心，coding agent 在给定观测与动作/高层目标后读取状态、ground 相关实体、规划交互并把结果写回；新物体由生成观测并入状态表，状态变化跨视频片段传递，更新后的状态沿相机动作轨迹渲染为粗条件视频，再由视频生成器补全状态未表示的外观、运动与交互细节。
Result: 实验表明 Oneira 能对新生成的物体实现直接且一致的交互，并在长时程上保持先前交互的效果；摘要未给出数值指标。
Conclusion: 把交互结果显式写入可扩展世界状态并作为视频生成的条件，是让开放世界生成同时具备 Open-World Interactivity 与 Persistent State 的可行路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Hob-VL: A Benchmark for Visually Grounded Boolean Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reliable visual reasoning requires composing multiple visual observations and returning consistent answers to logically equivalent questions. We introduce Hob-VL, a benchmark for visually grounded Boolean reasoning. Hob-VL comprises two tasks: (1) evaluating whether a Boolean rule holds in an image, and (2) identifying the (unique) object satisfying a Boolean description. Hob-VL contains 6,000 human-verified balanced Yes/No questions, each defined by a Boolean combination of ten visual statements, across 1,000 generated scenes and 46 diverse labeled photographs, along with 1,000 object-identification questions over the same photographs. Our question families are deliberately constructed to challenge reasoning through misleading local cues and nested logical operations, and include symbolic and structured natural-language presentations. Across eight model configurations with thinking disabled or minimized, Boolean accuracy ranges from 48.52% to 50.57%, while the identification accuracy reaches at most 43.0%. A thinking-enabled GLM configuration achieves uneven gains while retaining substantial errors and inconsistencies. Hob-VL exposes these failures through executable reference answers and matched evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hob-VL 是视觉接地布尔推理基准：6,000 道人工核验的平衡 Yes/No 题，每题由十条视觉陈述做布尔组合，故意用误导性局部线索和嵌套逻辑构造。八个关闭或最小化 thinking 的模型配置上布尔准确率仅 48.52%–50.57%，物体识别准确率最高 43.0%，开启 thinking 的 GLM 配置收益不均且仍保留大量错误与不一致。
Motivation: 可靠视觉推理要求组合多个视觉观察，并对逻辑等价的问题给出一致答案；现有模型在嵌套逻辑与误导性局部线索下做不到这一点，缺少能暴露该失败的可执行参考答案基准。
Method: Hob-VL 含两个任务：判断图像中布尔规则是否成立，以及找出满足布尔描述的唯一物体。数据为 6,000 道人工核验的平衡 Yes/No 题（每题由十条视觉陈述布尔组合而成），覆盖 1,000 个生成场景与 46 张多样标注照片，另有同一照片上的 1,000 道物体识别题；题族含符号与结构化自然语言两种表述，评测用可执行参考答案与配对评估。
Result: 八个关闭或最小化 thinking 的模型配置上，布尔准确率区间为 48.52%–50.57%；物体识别准确率最高 43.0%。开启 thinking 的 GLM 配置收益不均，仍保留大量错误与不一致。
Conclusion: 当前多模态模型在视觉接地布尔推理上接近随机水平且逻辑不一致，开启 thinking 只带来不均匀的改善；Hob-VL 用可执行参考答案把这类失败暴露出来。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Permutation-Robust Decision Modeling with Candidate-Independent Block-Causal Attention
papers.abstract_en: Decision models often score a variable-sized set of candidate actions encoded in a single sequence. This setting is increasingly relevant for System 1 components inside generative systems, where candidates may be proposed or ordered differently across runs. Standard causal cross-encoding is expressive, but it can make a candidate's score depend on serialization order rather than on the underlying decision problem. We introduce candidate-independent block-causal attention, which preserves causal computation within the shared context and each candidate while blocking cross-candidate information flow and resetting candidate positions. We compare this architecture with standard causal attention and complementary invariant baselines across Gemma 3 1B, Qwen3 1.7B, and Qwen3 4B backbones. Candidate-independent attention consistently reduces permutation sensitivity while retaining competitive decision quality; ablations indicate that candidate isolation is the primary source of the effect, with position resetting completing the intended symmetry. A larger Qwen3-4B study further examines the behavior of the proposed architecture with substantially more training data. Code is available at the \href{https://github.com/guyAmit/ci-decision-models}{\textcolor{blue}{project repository}}, and the \href{https://huggingface.co/Guy-Amit/qwen3-4b-ci-decision-4096-poc}{\textcolor{blue}{Qwen3-4B model artifact}} is available on Hugging Face.
papers.comment: Technical Report, will not be submitted to a conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出候选无关块因果注意力 (candidate-independent block-causal attention)：在共享上下文与单个候选内部保持因果计算，同时阻断候选间信息流并重置候选位置，使打分不再依赖候选的序列化顺序。在 Gemma 3 1B、Qwen3 1.7B、Qwen3 4B 上与标准因果注意力及不变性基线对比，该架构持续降低排列敏感性且决策质量保持竞争力；消融显示候选隔离是效果主因，位置重置补全对称性。
Motivation: 生成系统的 System 1 组件要对变长候选动作集合打分，而候选在不同运行中可能被不同地提出或排序；标准因果 cross-encoding 会让候选得分依赖序列化顺序，而非决策问题本身。
Method: 设计块因果注意力掩码：共享上下文与各候选内部保留因果计算，候选之间禁止信息流并重置候选位置；与标准因果注意力及若干不变性基线在 Gemma 3 1B、Qwen3 1.7B、Qwen3 4B 三个骨干上对比，并做消融拆分候选隔离与位置重置的贡献，另在 Qwen3-4B 上用多得多的训练数据做更大规模研究。
Result: 候选无关注意力在三个骨干上一致降低排列敏感性，同时决策质量保持竞争力；消融表明候选隔离是效果的主要来源，位置重置补全预期的对称性；Qwen3-4B 大规模研究在显著更多训练数据下检验该架构行为。
Conclusion: 把候选间隔离与位置重置一起做进注意力结构，可以在不牺牲决策质量的前提下让候选打分对排列鲁棒；代码与 Qwen3-4B 模型权重已公开。

papers.title: Convergence Analysis of STORM Under Different Geometries
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic recursive momentum (STORM) achieves fast convergence for nonconvex optimization via the variance reduction effect, but existing analyses rely on the strong average smoothness assumption. In this paper, we study the convergence of STORM for different objectives without average smoothness. We first revisit the results under average smoothness, obtaining the $O(T^{-1/3})$ bound for nonconvex objectives and the $O(σ^2/(μT))$ bound for last-iterate output under the $μ$-Polyak--Łojasiewicz~(PL) condition. Without average smoothness, we design an auxiliary sequence and compare the STORM update with it in the analysis. With the help of this sequence, we prove that STORM still attains an $O(T^{-1/4})$ rate for nonconvex objectives, which is optimal under standard smoothness. For convex and $λ$-strongly convex objectives, we further prove averaged and last-iterate bounds with optimal rates of $O(σR/\sqrt T)$ and $O(σ^2/(λT))$, respectively. All the obtained results use the same STORM recursion with different hyperparameter choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STORM（stochastic recursive momentum）在去掉强 average smoothness 假设后仍能收敛：作者构造辅助序列与 STORM 更新对比，证明非凸目标下速率为 O(T^{-1/4})（标准 smoothness 下最优），λ-强凸下平均输出与 last-iterate 分别达到 O(σR/√T) 与 O(σ²/(λT)) 的最优速率，且全部结果共用同一 STORM 递推、仅换超参数。
Motivation: STORM 的快速收敛依赖 variance reduction，但既有分析都建立在较强的 average smoothness 假设上，该假设在许多实际目标上不成立，导致非凸、凸与强凸情形下的收敛速率缺少保证。
Method: 先在 average smoothness 下复现已有结果（非凸 O(T^{-1/3})、μ-PL 条件下 last-iterate O(σ²/(μT))）；去掉该假设后设计一个辅助序列，把 STORM 更新与该序列逐项比较，据此对非凸、凸、λ-强凸目标分别推导平均与 last-iterate 界，超参数按目标类别选择。
Result: 复现界：非凸 O(T^{-1/3})，μ-PL 下 last-iterate O(σ²/(μT))。新结果：无 average smoothness 时非凸 O(T^{-1/4})（标准 smoothness 下最优），凸与 λ-强凸下平均界 O(σR/√T)、last-iterate 界 O(σ²/(λT))，均为最优速率。
Conclusion: average smoothness 不是 STORM 收敛的必要条件，换一个分析用的辅助序列即可在标准 smoothness 下保住最优速率，且无需改动 STORM 递推本身。

summary_sections.conclusion: average smoothness 不是 STORM 收敛的必要条件，换一个分析用的辅助序列即可在标准 smoothness 下保住最优速率，且无需改动 STORM 递推本身。

papers.title: Before It Fades: Reinforcing Temporal Representations at Inference Time in VideoLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) receive frames in sequential order and interpret how visual content evolves along the temporal axis, yet temporal reasoning remains a persistent weakness across architectures. Reversing the frame order of a video, a transformation that should invert temporal answers, often leaves the final prediction unchanged. We investigate where this failure originates by defining the temporal divergence vector $τ_l$, the layer-wise representational difference induced by reversing temporal order. Tracking its magnitude across layers reveals a consistent temporal divergence profile where the divergence peaks at intermediate layers and progressively diminishes toward the output. We confirm this peak is specific to temporal reasoning and functionally critical for predictions, establishing that VideoLLMs acquire temporal information at intermediate layers but fail to maintain it to the output. This progressive fading motivates our method, Temporal Activation Injection (TAI), which extracts $τ_l$ at the peak of the profile for each input and reinjects it into subsequent layers following the measured decay. TAI requires no training and consistently improves temporal reasoning across three VideoLLMs and four benchmarks with negligible impact on non-temporal tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/Youngwoo-git/Before-It-Fades.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoLLM 的时序信息在中间层达到峰值后向输出层逐步衰减，导致反转帧序这类本应翻转答案的操作不改变预测。作者定义逐层时序分歧向量 τ_l 定位该峰值，并提出免训练的 Temporal Activation Injection (TAI)：抽取每条输入在峰值处的 τ_l，按实测衰减规律重新注入后续层，在三个 VideoLLM、四个基准上一致改善时序推理，且对非时序任务影响可忽略。
Motivation: VideoLLM 按帧序输入并建模视觉内容的时间演化，但时序推理是跨架构的持续弱点：反转帧序本应反转时序类答案，预测却常常不变，其表征来源与失效位置此前不清楚。
Method: 定义时序分歧向量 τ_l（反转帧序引起的逐层表征差异），跨层追踪其幅值得到先升后降的 temporal divergence profile，确认峰值特异于时序推理且对预测有功能性作用；据此提出免训练的 Temporal Activation Injection (TAI)，对每条输入抽取峰值处的 τ_l 并按实测衰减在后续层重新注入。
Result: 分歧幅值在中间层达到峰值、向输出层逐步递减；TAI 在三个 VideoLLM 和四个基准上一致改善时序推理，对非时序任务影响可忽略。
Conclusion: VideoLLM 在中间层获得时序信息却无法保持到输出，因此在推理时按衰减曲线补回峰值处的时序表征即可提升时序推理，且无需训练。

papers.title: Which LLM to pick? Online Active Model Selection for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to process streaming data, with practitioners relying on benchmarks to select the best model even though these signals only approximate real performance. While oracle annotations can provide reliable feedback, they are often costly and difficult to obtain at scale. To address this challenge, we propose ONLINE LLM PICKER, the first framework for active model selection for LLMs in online settings. Given an arbitrary stream of queries and a limited annotation budget, ONLINE LLM PICKER selects the most informative prompts for annotation to identify the best LLM among candidate models. Across multiple tasks including 10 datasets, for over 130 language models, we show that ONLINE LLM PICKER saves annotation cost by up to 71.67% while reliably identifying the best or near-best model for the stream. We also show that using the returned model for sequential generation on unannotated prompts across the stream reduces regret by up to a factor of 2.51x, indicating that ONLINE LLM PICKER can identify the best or near-best model well before processing all streaming prompts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ONLINE LLM PICKER：在查询流上用有限标注预算挑选最有信息量的 prompt 去标注，从而在线选出候选 LLM 中最好的一个。跨 10 个数据集、130+ 个语言模型，标注成本最多省 71.67%，并可靠锁定最优或近最优模型；用返回模型在未标注 prompt 上续做序列生成，regret 最多降低 2.51 倍。
Motivation: 实践中靠 benchmark 给流式数据选 LLM，但 benchmark 只是真实性能的近似；oracle 标注可靠却昂贵、难以规模化，需要在预算内在线确定最优模型。
Method: 在线主动模型选择框架 ONLINE LLM PICKER：给定任意查询流与有限标注预算，主动挑选信息量最大的 prompt 送标注，用这些反馈在候选模型中识别最优者，并把选出的模型用于后续未标注 prompt 的序列生成。
Result: 在含 10 个数据集的多任务评估、覆盖 130 多个语言模型上，标注成本最多节省 71.67%，同时可靠识别出最优或近最优模型；在流上未标注 prompt 用返回模型做序列生成，regret 最多降低 2.51 倍。
Conclusion: 在线主动选择能在远未处理完流式 prompt 之前就定位最优或近最优 LLM，从而把昂贵的 oracle 标注压缩到小预算内。

papers.title: Two Routes to the Middle: Placement Search and Brain Readouts Converge on Where Continual Learners Should Specialize
papers.abstract_en: Continual learners that keep a task-specific adapter in every block of a pre-trained vision transformer accumulate storage linearly with the number of tasks; keeping task-specific adapters in only a few blocks curbs this growth but raises the question of where to place them. We investigate this question from two perspectives. Algorithmically, training all contiguous four-block placements yields an inverted U: final accuracy peaks at intermediate depth and varies by up to 3.5 percentage points (pp), while inexpensive criteria based on weight spectra or activation statistics favor the deepest blocks. From neuroscience, the hierarchical organization and intermediate-stage plasticity of the visual cortex motivate us to ask whether a measurement taken outside the learner can guide layer specialization without placement search. LS-B observes the first tasks through a frozen fMRI encoding model of twelve human visual areas and commits task-specific capacity once to the blocks whose readouts vary most across tasks relative to their stable structure. Across three ViT-B/16 backbones, LS-B yields stable, backbone-specific allocations. On the two backbones with placement search, AugReg and iBOT, the selected blocks overlap the intermediate-depth region identified by search. Under matched storage and observation budgets, the selected blocks outperform the shallowest and deepest four-block configurations. On Split ImageNet-R, LS-B uses 60% of full-BiLoRA adapter storage while remaining within 1.5 pp of its final accuracy. The allocation requires no labels or backpropagation, adds under 0.6% runtime, and exhibits backbone-specific cortical signatures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在预训练 ViT 中为持续学习选任务适配器放置位置时，穷举所有连续四块放置呈倒 U 形：最终精度在中等深度最高、跨度达 3.5 个百分点，而基于权重谱或激活统计的廉价准则反而偏向最深块。用冻结的 fMRI 编码模型读出十二个人类视觉区、按跨任务读数相对稳定结构的变化一次性定块的 LS-B，在 AugReg 与 iBOT 上选中的块与搜索得到的中等深度区重合，且在匹配存储与观测预算下优于最浅与最深的四块配置。
Motivation: 每个块都放任务适配器会让存储随任务数线性增长，只放少数块虽能抑制增长，但放置位置缺乏可靠判据：权重谱与激活统计这类廉价准则指向最深块，与穷举搜索的中等深度最优相矛盾。
Method: 两条路线对照：一是训练全部连续四块放置并比较最终精度，同时测试基于权重谱与激活统计的廉价准则；二是 LS-B，用冻结的 fMRI 编码模型（十二个人类视觉区）观察首批任务，按读数跨任务变化相对其稳定结构的大小一次性把任务容量分配给相应块，全程无需标签与反向传播。
Result: 穷举连续四块放置呈倒 U 形，最终精度在中等深度达峰、跨度达 3.5 pp；廉价准则偏好最深块。LS-B 在三个 ViT-B/16 backbone 上给出稳定的、backbone 特异的分配，在有放置搜索的 AugReg 与 iBOT 上选中块与搜索识别的中等深度区重合，且在匹配存储与观测预算下胜过最浅与最深的四块配置。Split ImageNet-R 上 LS-B 只用 full-BiLoRA 适配器存储的 60%，最终精度差距在 1.5 pp 以内，运行时开销低于 0.6%。
Conclusion: 放置搜索与脑读出两条独立路线都指向中等深度块，说明无需标签或反向传播的外部读出即可替代放置搜索来指导层特化，且分配呈 backbone 特异的皮层特征。

papers.title: PAGER: Partial-to-global Alignment via Geometric and Relational Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained 3D encoders are typically developed on globally reconstructed scenes expressed in a consistent world coordinate frame, whereas embodied systems must reason from partial, viewpoint-dependent observations in camera coordinates. We show that this shift from globally learned 3D feature spaces to realistic partial observations exposes a severe representation mismatch, which we find consistently across representative state-of-the-art encoders, including Sonata and Concerto. A frozen Sonata encoder with a global linear probe achieves 72.47 mIoU on full ScanNet scenes, but 2.57 mIoU on single-frame camera-coordinate inputs. Training-free gravity alignment recovers performance to 41.64 mIoU, showing that coordinate-frame mismatch is a dominant source of degradation but cannot be fully resolved through canonicalization alone. We introduce PAGER, a label-free adaptation method that aligns partial-view features with a frozen global 3D semantic space using only paired partial/global geometry. It learns lightweight adaptation modules while keeping the pretrained encoder and global segmentation probe frozen. Matched-point feature alignment anchors partial features to their global counterparts, while relational supervision preserves their similarity structure with respect to the global representation. Global geometry provides supervision only during training. Inference operates directly on the partial observation. Without partial-view labels, PAGER outperforms label-supervised PEFT on both Sonata and Concerto, and in zero-shot ScanNet$\rightarrow$ScanNet++ transfer surpasses fully fine-tuned Sonata ($53.93$ vs.\ $48.09$ mIoU), suggesting that preserving the frozen global representation can improve cross-dataset transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAGER 用配对的局部/全局几何做无标签蒸馏，把部分视角 3D 特征对齐到冻结的全局语义空间：匹配点特征对齐锚定对应关系，关系蒸馏保持相似度结构，全局几何只在训练期提供监督。冻结 Sonata 在 ScanNet 全场景线性探针 72.47 mIoU，单帧相机坐标输入骤降到 2.57 mIoU；PAGER 无标签即超过标签监督 PEFT，ScanNet→ScanNet++ 零样本迁移 53.93 vs 全微调 48.09 mIoU。
Motivation: 预训练 3D 编码器在全局世界坐标重建场景上学特征，具身系统却只能拿到相机坐标下的部分视角观测，表征错配使性能崩塌，且在 Sonata、Concerto 等 SOTA 编码器上一致出现。
Method: PAGER 是无标签适配方法：只用配对的局部/全局几何，学习轻量适配模块，同时冻结预训练编码器与全局分割探针；损失由匹配点特征对齐（matched-point feature alignment）与关系监督（relational distillation）组成，全局几何仅在训练期提供监督，推理直接吃部分观测。
Result: 冻结 Sonata + 全局线性探针在完整 ScanNet 场景 72.47 mIoU，单帧相机坐标输入仅 2.57 mIoU；免训练重力对齐 (gravity alignment) 恢复到 41.64 mIoU。PAGER 在无部分视角标签时于 Sonata 与 Concerto 上均超过标签监督 PEFT；ScanNet→ScanNet++ 零样本迁移 53.93 mIoU，高于全微调 Sonata 的 48.09 mIoU。
Conclusion: 坐标系错配是部分观测性能退化的主导来源，但单靠规范化无法完全解决；保留冻结的全局表征比全微调更能改善跨数据集迁移。

papers.title: Continual Reinforcement Learning with Neuroevolution
papers.abstract_en: Despite many studies about causes and remedies of plasticity loss in Reinforcement Learning (RL) under continual task changes, no RL method has yet consistently achieved a good balance between adaptation and forgetting. Here we turn to an alternative optimization paradigm, neuroevolution (NE): algorithms that search directly in weight space through mutation and selection over a population of neural networks. Across a wide array of environments and environmental changes, with policies ranging from a few hundred parameters to million-parameter networks, we compare evolution strategies (ES) and genetic algorithms (GAs) against state-of-the-art continual RL variants and population-based RL. ES most consistently achieves a good stability-plasticity trade-off, while the GA is the most plastic method but forgets more than ES. To explain this, we study the return landscape around each method's solutions. ES finds the widest neighborhoods, i.e.\ regions of weight space in which perturbed policies still solve the task, and the size of the overlap between the neighborhoods of consecutive tasks correlates with a method's stability-plasticity trade-off. Rewarding behavioral diversity in a GA through novelty search makes the population even more plastic, at the cost of forgetting. Finally, symptoms of plasticity loss commonly reported in RL do not transfer to NE. Overall, these results establish NE as a competitive alternative to RL under continual task changes, and suggest that training under perturbations in weight space may be a useful mechanism for continual learning more broadly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在持续任务变化下，进化策略 (ES) 比遗传算法 (GA) 和持续 RL 变体更稳定地兼顾适应与遗忘：ES 找到的权重邻域最宽，且相邻任务邻域重叠大小与稳定性-可塑性权衡相关。novelty search 让 GA 更可塑但遗忘更多；RL 中常见的可塑性丧失症状在神经进化 (NE) 中不出现。
Motivation: 持续 RL 中 plasticity loss 的成因与对策虽被广泛研究，但尚无方法能稳定兼顾适应新任务与抑制遗忘，作者转而检验权重空间直接搜索的神经进化范式。
Method: 在从数百参数到百万参数网络的多种环境与环境变化上，比较 evolution strategies (ES) 与 genetic algorithms (GAs) 对照 SOTA 持续 RL 变体和 population-based RL；并分析各方法解周围的 return landscape、相邻任务可解权重邻域的重叠，以及在 GA 中加入 novelty search 奖励行为多样性。
Result: ES 最稳定地取得良好 stability-plasticity 权衡；GA 可塑性最强但比 ES 遗忘更多；邻域重叠大小与权衡表现相关；novelty search 使 GA 更可塑、代价是更多遗忘；RL 中常报告的可塑性丧失症状不迁移到 NE。
Conclusion: 神经进化是持续任务变化下与 RL 竞争的替代方案，权重空间扰动下的训练可能是更广泛的持续学习机制。

papers.title: Evaluating Physical Consistency and Plausibility in Generative Scenario Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI models are increasingly used for scenario generation in autonomous driving. While they can generate realistic-looking scenarios, they often provide limited transparency into learned representations and consistency with real-world vehicle dynamics. This lack of formal assurance limits their use in safety-critical validation and certification workflows. To address this aspect, we introduce a layered evaluation protocol that complements existing methods by assessing models across five layers. The first four layers inspect internal representations and network layers through kinematic alignment, statistical baseline comparison, latent controllability, and activation analysis. The fifth layer evaluates model outputs against vehicle dynamics constraints such as lateral jerk thresholds. We demonstrate the protocol on a Variational Autoencoder (VAE)-based scenario generator. Although standard output-level metrics and visualizations suggest that the generated scenarios are realistic, our protocol provides deeper insight into the extent to which the model's latent space aligns with kinematic features and whether visually plausible trajectories satisfy vehicle-dynamics constraints. We further apply the protocol to additional generative models, demonstrating its applicability beyond the VAE architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出五层评估协议，把自动驾驶生成式场景模型的内部表征与输出分开检验：前四层看运动学对齐、统计基线对比、latent 可控性与激活分析，第五层用横向 jerk 阈值等车辆动力学约束卡输出。在 VAE 场景生成器上，标准输出指标与可视化显示场景逼真，但协议进一步揭示 latent 空间与运动学特征的对齐程度，以及视觉上合理的轨迹是否真的满足车辆动力学约束。
Motivation: 生成式场景模型看起来逼真，但对学到的表征和真实车辆动力学的一致性缺乏透明度，缺少形式化保证，因而难以进入安全关键的验证与认证流程。
Method: 分五层的评估协议：第一层运动学对齐 (kinematic alignment)，第二层与统计基线对比，第三层 latent 可控性 (latent controllability)，第四层激活分析 (activation analysis)，第五层按车辆动力学约束（如横向 jerk 阈值）检验输出；先在基于 VAE 的场景生成器上演示，再施加到其他生成模型。
Result: 标准输出级指标与可视化显示生成场景是逼真的，而协议给出更深的判断：模型 latent 空间在多大程度上与运动学特征对齐、视觉上合理的轨迹是否满足车辆动力学约束；协议在 VAE 之外的额外生成模型上同样适用。
Conclusion: 只看输出级指标和可视化不足以支撑自动驾驶场景生成的安全认证，需要连同内部表征与动力学约束一起分层评估，且该协议可跨生成架构复用。

papers.title: Beyond Pointwise Error: A Multi-Metric Evaluation of Spatial Climate Downscaling
papers.abstract_en: Climate downscaling aims to reconstruct fine scale spatial fields from coarse resolution inputs. Evaluating the quality of these reconstructions is challenging: low pointwise error can come at the cost of fine scale variability, while realistic spatial variability can be achieved with inaccurate local structures. The evaluation metric can therefore change which method appears to perform best. This work presents a multi metric benchmark comparing five spatial downscaling methods on ERA5 temperature, wind, and precipitation fields. Five criteria assess complementary properties: pointwise error, structural similarity, distribution error, spectral error, and gradient error. The results reveal a systematic trade off between spatial fidelity and fine scale variability. Some methods perform best on pointwise and spatially aligned metrics, but lose high frequency content, while others preserve substantially more spectral variability at the cost of less accurately positioned local structures. Consequently, method rankings change across metrics and variables. These results show that there is no single best downscaling method. Multi metric evaluation is therefore essential for assessing which properties of a climate field are preserved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ERA5 的温度、风、降水场上，用五个互补指标（逐点误差、结构相似性、分布误差、谱误差、梯度误差）对五种空间降尺度方法做基准比较，发现空间保真度与细尺度变率之间存在系统性权衡：逐点指标领先的方法丢失高频内容，而保住更多谱变率的方法局部结构位置不准，排名随指标和变量改变，因此不存在单一最优降尺度方法。
Motivation: 降尺度重建的评价本身不可靠：逐点误差低可能牺牲细尺度变率，空间变率真实又可能局部结构错位，选哪个指标会直接改变哪种方法看起来最好。
Method: 提出多指标基准，对五种空间降尺度方法在 ERA5 温度、风、降水场上统一评测，用五类准则覆盖互补性质：逐点误差、结构相似性、分布误差、谱误差与梯度误差。
Result: 结果显示空间保真度与细尺度变率之间存在系统性权衡：部分方法在逐点与空间对齐指标上最好但丢失高频内容，另一些方法保留明显更多谱变率但局部结构定位较差；方法排名随指标与变量变化。
Conclusion: 不存在单一最优的降尺度方法，评估气候场降尺度必须用多指标来判定哪些性质被保留。

papers.title: The hidden advantage of mask resampling: a theory of masked autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Why can masked prediction learn useful representations that unmasked reconstruction misses? We study this question in a high-dimensional model of a masked autoencoder (MAE) trained on data with shared latent structure and heterogeneous noise. We prove that masked linear reconstruction can recover the latent feature at linear sample complexity in regimes where unmasked linear reconstruction, equivalent to PCA, fails. The analysis also quantifies the statistical advantage of mask resampling, an established ingredient of masked pretraining. By introducing a fixed collection of $K$ masks per sample, we characterize its effect on feature recovery and downstream performance, identifying regimes where greater mask diversity lowers sample complexity. Guided by this prediction, we find that random cropping and flipping in standard image-training pipelines can obscure the advantage of mask resampling by renewing the prediction task even when the patch mask is fixed. Removing these transformations reveals a downstream advantage for dynamic over static masking in CNN autoencoders and vision transformers. A complementary BERT pilot finds benefits from greater mask diversity on downstream language tasks. Our results separate the benefit of the masked prediction objective from that of mask diversity, and show how a tractable theory can guide experiments that uncover advantages hidden by standard training practices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带共享潜结构与异质噪声的高维 MAE 模型中，证明掩码线性重建能在无掩码线性重建（等价 PCA）失败的机制下以线性样本复杂度恢复潜特征，并量化掩码重采样 (mask resampling) 的统计优势：固定每样本 K 个掩码时，掩码多样性越高样本复杂度越低。据此去掉随机裁剪与翻转后，动态掩码在 CNN 自编码器与 vision transformer 的下游任务上优于静态掩码。
Motivation: 掩码预测能学到无掩码重建学不到的表示，但掩码目标本身与掩码多样性各自的贡献一直纠缠不清；标准图像训练里的随机裁剪和翻转会不断刷新预测任务，掩盖动态掩码的真实收益。
Method: 在数据具有共享潜结构与异质噪声的高维掩码自编码器模型上做理论分析，比较掩码线性重建与无掩码线性重建（即 PCA）的样本复杂度；引入每样本固定 K 个掩码刻画其对特征恢复与下游表现的影响，并据此设计去除随机裁剪/翻转的对照实验，另有一个 BERT 试点。
Result: 证明掩码线性重建在 PCA 失败的机制下以线性样本复杂度恢复潜特征；识别出掩码多样性更高可降低样本复杂度的机制；去掉随机裁剪与翻转后，动态掩码在 CNN 自编码器与 vision transformer 上显现下游优势，BERT 试点在下游语言任务上也见掩码多样性收益。
Conclusion: 掩码预测目标的收益与掩码多样性的收益可以分开，且可解的理论能指出被标准训练实践掩盖的动态掩码优势——做 MAE 类实验时应先移除随机裁剪与翻转这类会刷新预测任务的增广。

papers.title: Optimal Momentum Methods for Stochastic Multilevel Compositional Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates stochastic multi-level optimization where the objective is a nested composition of several smooth non-convex functions. We assume that only stochastic estimates of the gradient and function values for each level are accessible. Consequently, obtaining an accurate estimate of the overall gradient is challenging due to the nested structure. To address this, we employ a momentum-based estimator with mini-batches to track the function values of each level, which are subsequently used to construct momentum gradient estimators. We establish an optimal sample complexity of $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-4})$ for finding an $ε$-stationary point, avoiding the stronger average smoothness assumption commonly relied upon in prior literature. Furthermore, by employing a normalization technique, we attain the same rate without requiring problem-dependent constants to set hyperparameters. To achieve the optimal rate without mini-batches, we further develop a batch-free method that incorporates a first-order approximation and a clipping technique for function value estimation. Finally, we validate the effectiveness of our proposed methods through experiments on risk-averse portfolio optimization and hierarchical tilted empirical risk minimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对嵌套复合的随机多层非凸优化，用动量估计器加 mini-batch 逐层跟踪函数值，再构造动量梯度估计，得到求 ε-驻点的最优样本复杂度 O(ε^-4)，且不依赖更强的 average smoothness 假设。归一化版本无需按问题常数设超参；另有免 mini-batch 的 batch-free 方法，用一阶近似与函数值裁剪达到同一速率。
Motivation: 多层复合结构下各层只有随机梯度与函数值，整体梯度难以准确估计；已有文献通常要额外假设 average smoothness 并依赖问题相关常数设置超参数。
Method: 动量估计器配合 mini-batch 逐层跟踪函数值，据此构造动量梯度估计；再用 normalization 技术去掉问题相关常数；为免 mini-batch，加入函数值的一阶近似与 clipping，得到 batch-free 方法。
Result: 求 ε-驻点的最优样本复杂度为 O(ε^-4)，无需 average smoothness 假设；归一化方法在不设问题相关常数下达到同一速率；batch-free 方法在无 mini-batch 时也达到该速率。实验在 risk-averse portfolio optimization 与 hierarchical tilted empirical risk minimization 上验证方法有效性。
Conclusion: 动量加归一化可在较弱光滑性假设下达到随机多层复合优化的最优 O(ε^-4) 速率，且超参不依赖问题常数；mini-batch 可由一阶近似加裁剪替代。

papers.title: Managing Context and Communication in Distributed Agentic UAV Swarms
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms increasingly rely on language-model agents to provide adaptive mission-level reasoning in uncertain environments. Fully distributed control, in which each UAV hosts an independent Small Language Model (SLM), removes reliance on a centralized coordinator but introduces an information-management problem: long-running interaction histories can degrade the reasoning context, while indiscriminate information dissemination increases communication and inference overhead. We address these challenges with a distributed UAV-agent architecture that enables continuous local SLM control through an event-driven reason-act-observe lifecycle. Runtime knowledge is represented as structured atomic notes and organized into core, local, and peer-specific memory. A deterministic interest-aware gossip engine selectively disseminates these notes according to recipient-specific semantic novelty and recency. We evaluate the architecture using ten UAVs in a simulated search-and-rescue mission. Our approach completes all experimental runs, whereas unrestricted flooding messages completes only 70-85\%, and delegating forwarding decisions to the SLM prevents mission completion in every run. Compared with unrestricted flooding, our approach approximately halves inference-token consumption, reduces transmitted data, and achieves lower survivor-count error.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 分布式 UAV 集群中每架飞机自带 SLM 时，用事件驱动的 reason-act-observe 生命周期加结构化原子笔记记忆（core/local/peer 三层），并由确定性的 interest-aware gossip 按语义新颖度与新近度选择性转发。10 架 UAV 的模拟搜救任务中该方案全部跑完，而无限制 flooding 只完成 70-85%、把转发决策交给 SLM 则每次都不完成；推理 token 消耗约为 flooding 的一半，幸存者计数误差也更低。
Motivation: 去中心化 UAV 集群里每个 SLM 独立控制，长交互历史会污染推理上下文，而无差别泛洪又推高通信与推理开销；把转发决策交给 SLM 又会让任务失败。
Method: 提出分布式 UAV-agent 架构：事件驱动的 reason-act-observe 循环支撑本地 SLM 持续控制；运行时知识表示为结构化 atomic notes，分为 core、local、peer-specific 三层记忆；deterministic interest-aware gossip engine 按接收方的语义新颖度与新近度选择性扩散笔记。
Result: 在 10 架 UAV 的模拟搜救任务中，本方法完成全部实验轮次，unrestricted flooding 仅完成 70-85%，把转发决策委托给 SLM 则每轮都未能完成任务；相比 flooding，推理 token 消耗约减半，传输数据量下降，幸存者计数误差更低。
Conclusion: 在完全分布式的 UAV-SLM 控制里，确定性的、基于兴趣的选择性 gossip 加分层笔记记忆，比无限制泛洪或让 LLM 决定转发更能保住任务完成率并压低开销。

papers.title: Towards Optimal Policy Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Practical Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms learn to solve Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) through iterative policy improvement in the presence of approximate evaluation. We study policy improvement from first principles, defining optimal policy improvement as producing the best policy attainable in a single update under specified constraints. We show that optimal improvement restricted to a set of states is equivalent to solving an induced MDP, characterizing planning with an explicit or implicit model as a path towards optimal policy improvement. Because practical methods commonly solve such induced problems through iterative improvement in the form of greedification, we take steps towards optimal greedification under the central practical constraint of approximate evaluation. We formulate greedification under this constraint as probabilistic decision-making under uncertainty and derive a novel operator that is optimal with respect to the resulting objective. Empirically, the operator and its practical gradient-based approximations improve aggregate performance across GumbelAlphaZero, SAC, ReBRAC and Generalized Policy Iteration, in experiments spanning discrete and continuous actions, model-based and model-free, online and offline RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从第一性原理定义「单步约束下的最优策略改进」，证明其等价于求解一个诱导 MDP，并在近似评估这一核心约束下把 greedification 形式化为不确定性下的概率决策，导出对该目标最优的新算子。其基于梯度的实用近似在 GumbelAlphaZero、SAC、ReBRAC 与 Generalized Policy Iteration 上提升了聚合性能，覆盖离散/连续动作、有模型/无模型、在线/离线 RL。
Motivation: 实用 RL 算法在评估不精确的条件下做迭代策略改进，缺少对「一次更新内能拿到的最好策略」的严格定义，也缺少在近似评估约束下仍保持最优的改进形式。
Method: 先定义受限于状态集合的最优策略改进并证明其等价于求解诱导 MDP，从而把带显式或隐式模型的规划刻画为通向最优改进的路径；再把近似评估下的 greedification 写成不确定性下的概率决策问题，导出针对该目标最优的算子，并给出其基于梯度的实用近似。
Result: 该算子及其梯度近似在 GumbelAlphaZero、SAC、ReBRAC 和 Generalized Policy Iteration 上提升了聚合性能，实验横跨离散与连续动作、有模型与无模型、在线与离线 RL 设置。
Conclusion: 在近似评估约束下，把 greedification 当作不确定性下的概率决策来求最优，可以在多类主流 RL 算法上带来一致的聚合性能改进。

papers.title: Chaining Skills to Hijack LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents use skills to improve performance on specialized tasks. To complete a user request, an agent may invoke several skills in sequence, allowing information produced under one skill to guide the next. Because skills may come from open-source repositories, this handoff can also carry attacker-controlled claims into later decisions. In this paper, we introduce APEX, which constructs and refines adversarial skill chains tailored to a user task and an attacker-selected action. The key insight is that an agent-written record of genuine task progress can carry a false claim of user approval across skills: an upstream skill induces the agent to create the record, and a downstream skill uses it to direct the attacker-selected action. Across four targeted-action families and six models on SkillsBench, the chains induce the selected action in 512 of 690 attempts (74.2%). On GPT-5.4, the full chain succeeds in 84.3% of attempts, compared with 17.4% when the workflow is merged into one skill. We further evaluate a prompting defense that asks the agent to check skill-produced files against the original request. On GPT-5.4, it lowers targeted-action success from 84.3% to 59.1%, while the verifier test-pass rate across 72 benign native-skill tasks falls from 86.7% to 56.3%. These results highlight the need for defenses that prevent attacker-directed actions while preserving legitimate task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: APEX 针对 LLM agent 的技能链劫持：上游技能诱导 agent 写下含虚假“用户已批准”声明的任务进度记录，下游技能据此执行攻击者选定的动作。在 SkillsBench 的四类目标动作、六个模型上，690 次尝试中 512 次成功（74.2%）；GPT-5.4 上完整链成功率 84.3%，而合并为单技能仅 17.4%。提示型防御把 84.3% 压到 59.1%，但 72 项良性原生技能任务的 verifier 通过率也从 86.7% 跌到 56.3%。
Motivation: 技能可来自开源仓库，跨技能的信息交接会把攻击者控制的声明带进后续决策；现有 agent 缺少区分真实进度记录与伪造批准的机制。
Method: APEX 针对给定用户任务与攻击者选定动作来构造并精化对抗技能链：上游技能让 agent 生成记录真实进展的文件并写入虚假批准声明，下游技能读取该文件驱动目标动作；评测用 SkillsBench，覆盖四类目标动作与六个模型，并测试一种要求 agent 核对技能产出文件与原始请求的提示防御。
Result: 四类目标动作、六个模型上 690 次尝试中 512 次诱导出选定动作（74.2%）；GPT-5.4 上完整链成功率 84.3%，工作流合并为单技能时 17.4%；提示防御使 GPT-5.4 目标动作成功率从 84.3% 降至 59.1%，同时 72 项良性原生技能任务的 verifier test-pass 率从 86.7% 降至 56.3%。
Conclusion: 跨技能传递的进度记录足以承载虚假批准并驱动攻击者选定动作，而当前提示型核对防御在压制攻击的同时大幅损害合法任务完成率，需要既阻断攻击动作又保住正常性能的防御。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AURAL: Adaptive Latent Reasoning with Joint Chunk for Speech Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Model intelligence and fast response jointly shape the quality of interaction with speech language models, yet remain difficult to achieve together. Explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) improves reasoning and audio understanding, but generating intermediate reasoning tokens delays responses. Describing fine-grained acoustic cues further lengthens CoT and increases latency. Latent reasoning can reduce this overhead, yet existing methods often trail CoT and remain limited by single-path supervision and reasoning budgets that do not adapt to problem difficulty. We introduce AURAL, which models a distribution over multiple plausible reasoning continuations in latent space and jointly predicts chunks of future states to reduce sequential forward passes and reasoning latency. To provide initial supervision for latent reasoning, we construct AuralReason-683K: 683K bilingual speech utterances (about 1,000 hours) with concise CoT for emotion recognition, empathetic dialogue, and general reasoning. AURAL-RL then explores beyond these traces, rewarding concise reasoning that yields high-quality answers and adapting reasoning effort to each problem. Across two backbones, AURAL-RL achieves performance comparable to CoT-RL, with larger gains over the respective supervised checkpoints on most metrics. Analysis further shows that harder questions elicit more latent reasoning steps. On Qwen2.5-Omni, it reduces time to the first answer token by 11.8x, from 1.22 to 0.10 s, versus 0.05 s for direct answering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AURAL 在潜空间对多条合理推理延续建模，并联合预测未来状态 chunk 以减少前向次数；配套构建 AuralReason-683K（683K 双语语音语句、约 1000 小时简洁 CoT）做初始监督，再用 AURAL-RL 按题目难度自适应分配推理强度。在两个 backbone 上达到与 CoT-RL 相当的性能，Qwen2.5-Omni 上首 token 延迟从 1.22 s 降到 0.10 s（11.8×），且难题触发更多潜推理步。
Motivation: 显式 CoT 提升语音模型的推理与音频理解，但中间推理 token 与细粒度声学描述拉长输出、抬高延迟；已有潜推理方法受单路径监督和固定推理预算限制，常落后于 CoT。
Method: 在潜空间对多条合理推理延续建模，联合预测未来状态 chunk 以减少顺序前向次数；用 AuralReason-683K（683K 双语语句、约 1000 小时简洁 CoT，覆盖情感识别、共情对话与通用推理）提供初始监督，再由 AURAL-RL 在这些轨迹之外探索，奖励产出高质量答案的简洁推理并按题目自适应调整推理投入。
Result: 在两个 backbone 上 AURAL-RL 性能达到与 CoT-RL 相当的水平，且在多数指标上相对各自监督检查点提升更大；分析显示更难的问题触发更多潜推理步；在 Qwen2.5-Omni 上首答案 token 延迟降低 11.8×，从 1.22 s 降至 0.10 s（直接回答为 0.05 s）。
Conclusion: 潜推理配合按难度自适应的推理预算，可以在语音语言模型上以接近 CoT-RL 的质量把首 token 延迟压到接近直接回答的量级。

papers.title: Completion Aware Guidance for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) predict visual futures and robot actions, yet they remain susceptible to task-incomplete imagination, where plausible, action-consistent predictions omit the transition needed for task completion. In this paper, we show that this failure is not inherent to the world model backbone, but emerges when adapted for short-chunk control, which can repeatedly favor plausible local continuations over task-completing transitions. To address this, we introduce Completion Aware Guidance (CAG), a training-free sampling method that guides generation toward task completion. Across representative WAMs, CAG improves success from 64% to 70% on a RoboTwin 2.0 subset and from 69% to 75% in zero-shot simulation, while reducing task-incomplete imagination from 79% to 40%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 世界行动模型 (WAM) 在短片段控制微调后会偏向局部合理延续而漏掉完成任务所需的转变，产生任务未完成想象。提出免训练的 Completion Aware Guidance (CAG) 在采样阶段把生成引向任务完成，RoboTwin 2.0 子集成功率 64%→70%，零样本仿真 69%→75%，任务未完成想象 79%→40%。
Motivation: WAM 预测视觉未来与机器人动作时会出现任务未完成想象：预测合理且与动作一致，却缺少完成任务所需的状态转变；该失败源于为短片段控制做适配，而非世界模型骨干本身。
Method: 提出 Completion Aware Guidance (CAG)，一种免训练 (training-free) 的采样期引导方法，在生成过程中把轨迹引向任务完成；在多个代表性 WAM 上验证。
Result: RoboTwin 2.0 子集成功率从 64% 提升到 70%，零样本仿真成功率从 69% 提升到 75%，任务未完成想象比例从 79% 降到 40%。
Conclusion: 任务未完成想象是短片段控制适配带来的采样偏好问题，可在不重训骨干的情况下通过完成感知引导缓解。

papers.title: QK-Wanda: Coupling Queries and Keys for Unstructured Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Wanda (Sun et al., 2024) prunes large language models by scoring weights independently within each linear projection, although queries and keys interact through dot products. We introduce QK-Wanda, which scores query and key weights by their individual deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective. It augments Wanda scores with information from the opposite projection (keys for query weights, and queries for key weights), allowing both projections to share a pruning budget. Its closed-form scores require no gradients or weight updates; full pruning takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200 with the calibration used in our main experiments. We evaluate QK-only pruning across 15 models from TinyLlama, Llama 2, Llama 3, and Qwen2.5, spanning 0.5B-72B parameters. Relative to Wanda, QK-Wanda reduces QK reconstruction error by an average of 60% at 50% sparsity and 45% at 80%. Downstream gains depend on the model. At 80% sparsity on Llama 2 70B, WikiText-2 and C4 perplexity decrease by 20.3% and 13.5%, while mean zero-shot accuracy rises by 5.94 percentage points. Qwen2.5-72B also improves, but Llama-3.1-70B has substantially higher perplexity despite lower reconstruction error. These results show both the promise of coupled pruning criteria and the limits of local reconstruction as a predictor of model quality.

papers.title: Range-GRPO: Policy Optimization via Pairwise Relations among Reward Intervals
papers.abstract_en: As the use of large language models (LLMs) expands, post-training has become increasingly important for adapting them to downstream tasks. However, obtaining reliable supervision remains costly, especially in domains without reference answers or executable verifiers. LLM-as-a-Judge provides scalable pseudo-rewards for unlabeled responses, but a single point score does not explicitly represent reward uncertainty. This motivates representing pseudo-rewards as conformally calibrated reward ranges. We propose Range-GRPO, a semi-supervised post-training framework that combines limited labeled data with unlabeled prompts. In Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), learning signals depend on relative reward comparisons within each rollout group. The proposed objective compares reward ranges pairwise rather than reducing them to point rewards, allowing interval uncertainty to affect both the magnitude and direction of these signals. Our theoretical analysis characterizes this distinction and shows that the proposed objective recovers the Dr.GRPO advantage when all reward ranges collapse to points. Empirically, Range-GRPO achieves the highest in-distribution and out-of-distribution average performance among the evaluated semi-supervised methods while requiring fewer training resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Range-GRPO 把 LLM-as-a-Judge 的伪奖励用 conformal 校准成奖励区间 (reward ranges)，在 GRPO 中按区间成对比较而非压成点分数，使区间不确定性同时影响学习信号的幅度与方向。理论分析表明所有区间退化为点时该目标恢复 Dr.GRPO 的 advantage；实验中在所评估的半监督方法里取得最高的分布内与分布外平均性能，且训练资源更省。
Motivation: 无参考答案或可执行验证器的领域里，可靠监督获取成本高；LLM-as-a-Judge 给出的单点分数无法显式表达奖励不确定性。
Method: 半监督后训练框架：结合少量标注数据与无标注 prompt；用 conformal 校准把伪奖励表示为区间，在 GRPO 的 rollout 组内做区间成对比较构造学习信号；理论刻画与点奖励目标的区别。
Result: 在所评估的半监督方法中取得最高的 in-distribution 与 out-of-distribution 平均性能，同时所需训练资源更少；理论证明奖励区间全部退化为点时目标恢复 Dr.GRPO advantage。
Conclusion: 把伪奖励保留为经 conformal 校准的区间并在 GRPO 中成对比较，可在半监督后训练中同时利用区间不确定性并降低训练资源开销。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning to Accelerate Primal-Dual Hybrid Gradient for Linear Programming
papers.abstract_en: Primal-dual hybrid gradient (PDHG) methods solve large-scale linear programs (LPs) using GPU-friendly matrix-vector products and projections, but their practical performance depends on coordinating algorithm parameters, acceleration, and restarts. We introduce GALLOP, which uses reinforcement learning to jointly learn continuous algorithm parameters and discrete restart decisions without differentiating through the solver. Its generalized accelerated PDHG update combines separate primal and dual extrapolation, history corrections, and restart anchoring with independently adjustable coefficients. We train a dimension-agnostic feedback policy using a groupwise proximal policy optimization objective that clips likelihood ratios separately for different control groups and excludes inactive acceleration controls on restart transitions. We evaluate GALLOP on six LP families and a public item-placement benchmark. On the main evaluation settings across the six families, GALLOP reduces iteration counts by factors of $1.9$-$5.6$ and achieves up to a $16.0\times$ speedup in algorithm wall-clock time over MPAX. With one policy trained per family, the learned policies generalize without retraining to within-family LPs $3\times$-$400\times$ larger than the largest training instances, including Transport LPs with $10.24$ million variables.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GALLOP 用强化学习联合调 PDHG 的连续算法参数与离散 restart 决策，无需对求解器微分。在六类 LP 与公开 item-placement 基准上，相对 MPAX 迭代次数降 1.9–5.6 倍、算法墙钟时间最高加速 16.0×；每类训一个策略即可零重训泛化到比最大训练实例大 3×–400× 的同类 LP，含 1024 万变量的 Transport LP。
Motivation: PDHG 解大规模线性规划依赖算法参数、加速与 restart 的协调，手工调参在不同 LP 规模与结构间难以迁移。
Method: 提出广义加速 PDHG 更新：分离 primal/dual 外推、history corrections 与 restart anchoring，各系数独立可调；用 groupwise proximal policy optimization 目标训练维度无关的反馈策略，按控制组分别裁剪 likelihood ratio，并在 restart 转移时排除非激活的加速控制。
Result: 在六类 LP 主评估设置上，相对 MPAX 迭代次数减少 1.9–5.6 倍，算法墙钟时间最高 16.0× 加速；每类单独训练的策略零重训泛化到比最大训练实例大 3×–400× 的同类 LP，包括 1024 万变量的 Transport LP。
Conclusion: 把 PDHG 的参数与 restart 决策交给维度无关的 RL 策略，可在不微分求解器的前提下同时拿到迭代数与墙钟加速，并跨规模泛化。
