papers.title: Revisiting Cross-Reconstruction for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Existing image forgery detectors often suffer from generalization to unseen manipulation methods due to the limited ability to capture transferable forensic cues. Recent cross-reconstruction based methods attempt to improve generalization through semantic-artifact disentanglement, but typically align heterogeneous artifacts across generators and exclude artifact representations during reconstruction, which may overlook the inherent diversity and visual cues of manipulation artifacts. In this work, we revisit cross-reconstruction and introduce an artifact-oriented disentanglement framework for robust image forgery detection. We argue that \textbf{artifact diversity}, i.e., the intrinsic variations of manipulation artifacts introduced by different generation processes, contains complementary forensic cues rather than undesirable domain variations. Instead of enforcing explicit artifact alignment, our framework preserves diverse artifact characteristics through semantically aligned cross-generator reconstruction. Furthermore, we incorporate artifact representations into the reconstruction process and introduce a masked frequency-aware reconstruction strategy to emphasize manipulation-related residuals while reducing semantic interference. This design enables the model to learn transferable forensic representations from diverse artifacts. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate improvements under both cross-dataset and cross-generator evaluation settings. Further analysis and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of artifact diversity preservation and artifact-aware cross-reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对伪造图像检测器在未见生成器上泛化差的问题，重新审视 cross-reconstruction：把不同生成过程带来的 artifact 多样性当作互补取证线索而非需要对齐的域差异，在重建中保留并显式引入 artifact 表征，再用掩码频率感知重建 (masked frequency-aware reconstruction) 突出操纵相关残差、抑制语义干扰。多基准数据集上，跨数据集与跨生成器两种评测设置均带来提升，消融验证了 artifact 多样性保留与 artifact-aware cross-reconstruction 的有效性。
Motivation: 现有图像伪造检测器难以泛化到未见操纵方法，因为可迁移取证线索提取能力有限；既有 cross-reconstruction 方法跨生成器对齐异质 artifact 并在重建中丢弃 artifact 表征，忽略了操纵伪影本身的多样性与视觉线索。
Method: 提出面向 artifact 的解耦框架：不做显式 artifact 对齐，而是通过语义对齐的跨生成器重建保留多样 artifact 特征；把 artifact 表征纳入重建过程，并加入掩码频率感知重建策略，强调操纵相关残差、减少语义干扰，从而学到可迁移的取证表征。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验显示，跨数据集 (cross-dataset) 与跨生成器 (cross-generator) 两种评测设置下均有提升；进一步分析与消融研究验证了 artifact 多样性保留和 artifact-aware cross-reconstruction 的有效性。
Conclusion: 操纵 artifact 的多样性是互补取证信号而非有害域变化，保留它并让 artifact 参与重建即可提升伪造检测对未见生成器的泛化。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Synthetic training for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation in data-scarce settings
papers.abstract_en: Cerebral microbleeds (CMBs) and cortical superficial siderosis (cSS) are imaging markers of cerebral small vessel disease, but their automated segmentation is limited by the scarcity of positive cases and voxel-level annotations. We propose a synthetic training framework for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation that requires no real lesion annotations for training and leverages radiological description of the lesions. Starting from anatomical brain parcellations, the framework applies spatial augmentation and voxel resampling, procedurally inserts cSS and CMB labels using clinical priors on lesion location and morphology, and synthesises images through randomised intensity assignment, blurring, and Rician noise simulation. Models were trained on dynamically generated image-label pairs and evaluated against manual delineations in 10 cSS cases and 13 CMB cases. The proposed configurations outperformed classical filter baselines. For cSS, the hypointensity constrained model achieved higher AUPRC and AUROC than the Frangi filter (AUPRC: 0.284 vs 0.083; AUROC: 0.907 vs 0.731). For CMBs, explicit synthesis of blood vessels as lesion mimics improved performance over the classical baseline (AUPRC: 0.538 vs 0.004; AUROC: 0.999 vs 0.968). These results support our proposal as a feasible strategy for data-scarce haemorrhagic lesion segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种长尾出血灶分割的合成训练框架：无需真实病灶标注，仅凭病灶的放射学描述，从脑解剖分区出发做空间增强与体素重采样，按临床先验程序化插入 cSS/CMB 标签，再用随机强度赋值、模糊与 Rician 噪声合成图像。在 10 例 cSS 与 13 例 CMB 的手工勾画上，cSS 的 hypointensity constrained 模型 AUPRC 0.284 vs Frangi 滤波 0.083、AUROC 0.907 vs 0.731；CMB 显式合成血管作为病灶模拟物后 AUPRC 0.538 vs 0.004、AUROC 0.999 vs 0.968。
Motivation: 脑小血管病影像标志物 cSS 与 CMB 的自动分割受阳性病例稀缺和体素级标注不足限制，长尾病灶难以获得足够监督信号。
Method: 从解剖脑分区出发，施加空间增强与体素重采样，依据病灶位置和形态的临床先验程序化插入 cSS 与 CMB 标签，并通过随机强度赋值、模糊和 Rician 噪声模拟合成图像；模型在动态生成的图像-标签对上训练，训练过程不使用真实病灶标注。
Result: 在 10 例 cSS 和 13 例 CMB 的手工勾画上评测：cSS 任务中 hypointensity constrained 模型 AUPRC 0.284、AUROC 0.907，对比 Frangi 滤波的 0.083 与 0.731；CMB 任务中显式合成血管作为病灶模拟物的配置 AUPRC 0.538、AUROC 0.999，对比经典基线的 0.004 与 0.968。
Conclusion: 合成训练是数据稀缺条件下长尾出血灶分割的可行策略，且对 CMB 而言显式合成血管模拟物是关键设计选择。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator: A Framework to Support Technical Assessment in AI Regulatory Sandboxes
papers.abstract_en: The EU's Artificial Intelligence Act requires all Member States to establish AI Regulatory Sandboxes (AIRS) by August 2027: supervised environments bringing together national Competent Authorities, technical experts, and the organisations under assessment. When AIRS engagements include structured technical testing, running such testing at scale demands dedicated infrastructure, yet the tooling ecosystem remains structurally fragmented, with heterogeneous tools producing outputs that are difficult to compare, trace, and reuse. From the procedural conditions of AIRS engagements and the AI Act obligations for high-risk systems, we derive 11 architectural and governance requirements for the infrastructure that operationalises technical testing within an AIRS. In response to these requirements, we introduce the AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator, an open-source framework combining a curated Catalogue of tests and controls accessed through a stable plug-in API, a shared data model that harmonises heterogeneous outputs, role-specific dashboards for multi-disciplinary interpretation, and audience-segmented reporting. We describe the architecture and current release, and report an early-stage pilot that exercised the harmonisation and reporting layers within a live AIRS engagement and contributed to an official Exit Report. We discuss the roadmap, the governance questions raised by the Catalogue's tiered contribution model, and the institutional pathways through which an open-source assessment ecosystem could emerge across Member States.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为满足欧盟 AI 法案要求的 AI 监管沙盒 (AIRS) 技术评估，提出开源框架 AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator：以测试与控制目录 (Catalogue)、稳定插件 API、统一数据模型和分角色仪表盘/分受众报告，把异构工具输出变得可比较、可追溯、可复用。早期试点已在一次真实 AIRS 评估中运行其统一与报告层，并写入正式 Exit Report。
Motivation: AIRS 要求在 2027 年 8 月前由各成员国建立，规模化技术测试缺乏专用基础设施：工具生态碎片化，异构工具的输出难以比较、追溯与复用。
Method: 从 AIRS 参与的程序性条件与 AI 法案对高风险系统的义务出发，推导出 11 条架构与治理需求；据此实现开源框架，含带策展的测试与控制 Catalogue（经稳定 plug-in API 访问）、统一异构输出的共享数据模型、面向多学科解读的角色仪表盘，以及分受众报告。
Result: 推导出 11 条架构与治理需求；在一次真实 AIRS 参与中运行了统一层与报告层的早期试点，并为一份官方 Exit Report 做出贡献。
Conclusion: AIRS 的技术评估需要专门的开源基础设施来统一异构工具输出；Catalogue 的分级贡献模式带来治理问题，跨成员国的开放评估生态仍需制度路径。

papers.title: FedFit: Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs via Vector-Bank Parameterization and Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the massive communication overhead remains a critical bottleneck. Furthermore, applying Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) in FL faces a fundamental "aggregation dilemma" between the accurate Sum-of-Products (SoP) and the communication-efficient Product-of-Sums (PoS) implementations. To tackle these challenges, we propose FedFit. First, to significantly reduce communication overhead, we introduce a disjoint shared vector-bank parameterization that reconstructs high-dimensional adapter matrices from two compact and disjoint global vector banks. Second, to address the aggregation dilemma, we devise an alternating optimization schedule. By cycling between decoupled single-bank updates (which allow for accurate aggregation) and joint updates corrected by a Residual Spectral Aggregation mechanism, we resolve the conflict between SoP and PoS. Additionally, we integrate blockwise quantization with client-side error feedback to further compress the transmitted vectors. Furthermore, we establish theoretical convergence guarantees for the proposed algorithm. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5 models demonstrate that FedFit achieves perplexity performance comparable to standard federated LoRA methods, while providing compression ratios up to 100x higher.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedFit 用不相交共享向量库 (disjoint shared vector-bank) 参数化把 LoRA 适配器矩阵从两个紧凑全局向量库重构，并用交替优化调度（单库解耦更新与带残差谱聚合 Residual Spectral Aggregation 的联合更新轮换）解决联邦 LoRA 中 Sum-of-Products 与 Product-of-Sums 的聚合两难。在 Qwen2.5 上，困惑度与标准联邦 LoRA 相当，压缩比最高达 100 倍。
Motivation: 联邦学习微调 LLM 时通信开销是主要瓶颈，而 LoRA 在 FL 中存在精确的 SoP 与通信高效的 PoS 两种聚合实现之间的根本性两难。
Method: 提出 FedFit：不相交共享向量库参数化，从两个紧凑且不相交的全局向量库重构高维适配器矩阵；交替优化调度在解耦单库更新（可精确聚合）与经 Residual Spectral Aggregation 校正的联合更新之间循环；再叠加分块量化 (blockwise quantization) 与客户端误差反馈压缩传输向量，并给出算法收敛性保证。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5 模型上的实验中，FedFit 困惑度与标准联邦 LoRA 方法相当，压缩比最高提高 100 倍。
Conclusion: 向量库参数化加交替聚合与量化误差反馈，可以在不损失困惑度的前提下大幅压缩联邦 LLM 微调的通信量，并有收敛性保证支撑。

papers.title: False Floors: LLM Safety Routing Evaluations Break Under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Safety routers send each request to one of several models and are judged against the best single model. A major routing benchmark picks that comparator on the evaluation data. In the benchmark's own setting this is harmless, but under distribution shift it is not. On HELM Safety the selection cost is 0.003-0.030 of harm under random splits and 0.045-0.113 under held-out categories, comparable to the whole deficit attributed to routing, with its direction holding under either published judge alone. It rises seven- to ninefold on AgentDojo when suites are held out. Across seven safety corpora chosen by rules fixed in advance, three meet a registered interval test and four beat a later permutation null, and three of the four interval misses are corpora where some models have zero observed harm. Prior work proves the direction of this bias. We size it on harm and accuracy, show that it is larger under the held-out splits we measure, and bound it by optimism plus a shift-dependent regret. Scored honestly under shift, routing buys little on these benchmarks. In most pool cells the nested router serves the honest baseline's model, and on the nearly saturated AgentDojo corpus a perfect pre-dispatch router is worth at most two points of harm. We also find a model's expressed recognition of a late injection steerable. On held-out reruns an attacker who knows which model it faces lowers GPT-5.4's judged recognition by 19.6 points, confirmed by an independent label. In an offline counterfactual composition into a controller, the same attack raises or lowers estimated harm depending on the fallback model. Safety routing should be evaluated under shift, against a baseline chosen without the test labels, and recognition-based defences should be scored on harm against an attacker who chooses what the model sees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 安全路由基准在评测数据上挑选对照模型，分布偏移下这种选择偏差的量级与归因给路由的全部差距相当：HELM Safety 上选择成本为 0.003–0.030（随机划分）与 0.045–0.113（留出类别），AgentDojo 留出套件时升至七到九倍。作者据此主张路由评测必须在偏移下、用不看测试标签的基线来做，识别类防御要在攻击者选择输入的条件下按 harm 计分。
Motivation: 安全路由 (safety router) 把请求分派给多个模型并以最优单模型为对照，而主流基准在评测数据上选这个对照；在原设定下无害，但分布偏移下会把路由的真实收益算错，甚至与归因给路由的全部差距同量级。
Method: 在 HELM Safety 与 AgentDojo 上量化选择成本，用随机划分与留出类别/套件两种划分对比；跨七个事先定规则选取的安全语料做注册区间检验与后续置换零假设 (permutation null)，并用 optimism 加依赖偏移的 regret 给偏差定界；另在离线反事实组合进控制器的设定下测 late injection 识别攻击。
Result: HELM Safety 上选择成本占 harm 的 0.003–0.030（随机划分）、0.045–0.113（留出类别），方向在两个已发布 judge 下各自成立；AgentDojo 留出套件时升至七到九倍。七个语料中三个通过注册区间检验、四个胜过后续置换零假设，四个区间未过中有三个是部分模型观测 harm 为零的语料。AgentDojo 近饱和语料上完美预分派路由器最多值两点 harm；攻击者知道面对哪个模型时 GPT-5.4 的判定识别下降 19.6 点，并由独立标签确认。
Conclusion: 在偏移下诚实计分时，路由在这些基准上收益很小；评测应使用不看测试标签选出的基线，识别类防御要在攻击者选择所见输入的条件下按 harm 评分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neither Black nor White: Balancing Semantic and Collaborative Signals with Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS)
papers.abstract_en: Existing work on Semantic IDs (SIDs) for generative recommendation treats SID construction as a representation learning problem: encode items into a quantised latent space and read off codes. We argue this view is incidental. SID construction is, at heart, a recursive clustering problem, and once stated this way the natural object to cluster is a graph whose nodes carry semantic content and whose edges carry collaborative signal; SID assignment becomes a hierarchical graph partition. This reframing yields a unified framework, Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS), that subsumes prior approaches rather than displacing them. RQ-VAE and RQ-KMeans are recovered as the special case where the graph is empty, exposing content-only quantisation as one corner of a larger design space along two so-far-collapsed axes: graph construction and recursive partition algorithm. We explore two contrasting instantiations: RecDMoN, which performs hierarchical assignment via differentiable graph pooling, and RQ-GAE, which extends RQ-VAE with graph-aware item representations and a graph reconstruction objective. On multiple real-world datasets, GrIS consistently improves over CF-aware SOTA, with gains of up to +52\% Hit@10. Because graph construction and partition are explicit, separately configurable components, improvements on either axis can be combined and evaluated systematically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把生成式推荐的 Semantic ID 构造重述为图上的递归聚类：节点带语义、边带协同信号，SID 分配即层次图划分。GrIS 框架涵盖 RQ-VAE/RQ-KMeans（空图特例）并给出 RecDMoN（可微图池化）与 RQ-GAE（图感知表示+图重建目标）两种实例，在多个真实数据集上相对 CF-aware SOTA 的 Hit@10 提升最高达 +52%。
Motivation: 现有 SID 构造被当作表示学习问题（量化潜空间再读出码），把图构建与划分算法这两条本可独立设计的轴压成了一条，限制了协同信号的利用。
Method: GrIS 将 SID 构造表述为层次图划分：图节点承载语义内容、边承载协同信号。两个实例化为 RecDMoN（用可微图池化做层次分配）和 RQ-GAE（在 RQ-VAE 上加入图感知 item 表示与图重建目标）；RQ-VAE 与 RQ-KMeans 是图为空的特例。
Result: 在多个真实世界数据集上，GrIS 相对 CF-aware SOTA 持续改进，Hit@10 提升最高达 +52%。
Conclusion: 把图构建与递归划分作为显式、可分别配置的组件，两个轴上的改进可以组合并系统评估；内容-only 量化只是更大设计空间的一个角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Reliable Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language models (VLMs) are increasingly being explored in autonomous driving for tasks such as scene understanding, driving reasoning, decision-making, and end-to-end driving. As their role becomes more prominent, ensuring their robustness and reliability is increasingly important. In real-world conditions, visual inputs may be degraded by sensor imperfections and environmental conditions, potentially affecting both model predictions and their associated confidence. Such degradation is especially concerning in autonomous driving, where safety-critical decisions require models to make accurate predictions and recognize when their predictions may be unreliable. In this work, we evaluate five VLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-E4B, LLaVA-OneVision-7B, DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B, and NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B) across four driving-related QA datasets with different visual input settings, including single-frame, multi-view, multi-frame, and monocular inputs. Our results show that the effects of visual corruption vary across models, datasets, and input settings, with changes in accuracy and confidence reliability and also differing across conditions. We then apply Visual Evidence Augmentation ($\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$), a recent inference-time method to examine whether it can improve model reliability under degraded visual conditions. We find that $\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$ improves performance for some models and datasets, although the gains are not consistent across all settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自动驾驶场景下评测 5 个 VLM（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-E4B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B、DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B、NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B）在视觉退化条件下的预测与置信度可靠性，并测试推理时方法 Visual Evidence Augmentation (VEA)。视觉损坏的影响随模型、数据集与输入设置（单帧/多视/多帧/单目）而变，准确率与置信度可靠性均发生改变；VEA 只在部分模型与数据集上提升性能，增益并不跨设置一致。
Motivation: 自动驾驶中的安全关键决策要求模型既预测准确又能识别自身预测何时不可靠，而传感器缺陷与环境条件造成的视觉退化会同时损害预测与置信度。
Method: 在 4 个驾驶相关 QA 数据集上、按单帧、多视、多帧、单目四种视觉输入设置评测 5 个 VLM；随后在退化视觉条件下应用推理时方法 Visual Evidence Augmentation (VEA)，检验其能否提升可靠性。
Result: 视觉损坏的影响因模型、数据集和输入设置而异，准确率与置信度可靠性在不同条件下呈现不同变化；VEA 在部分模型与数据集上改善性能，但增益在所有设置上并不一致。
Conclusion: 视觉退化对 VLM 可靠性的影响是条件依赖的，推理时增强方法 VEA 无法在全部设置上稳定带来收益。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: 在 4 个驾驶相关 QA 数据集上、按单帧、多视、多帧、单目四种视觉输入设置评测 5 个 VLM；随后在退化视觉条件下应用推理时方法 Visual Evidence Augmentation (VEA)，检验其能否提升可靠性。
summary_sections.result: 视觉损坏的影响因模型、数据集和输入设置而异，准确率与置信度可靠性在不同条件下呈现不同变化；VEA 在部分模型与数据集上改善性能，但增益在所有设置上并不一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 视觉退化对 VLM 可靠性的影响是条件依赖的，推理时增强方法 VEA 无法在全部设置上稳定带来收益。

papers.title: Calibrating Prediction Timeliness Through Multi-Objective Hyperparameter Optimization for Remaining Useful Life Prediction
papers.abstract_en: In predictive maintenance, early and late RUL prediction errors carry asymmetric consequences, yet hyperparameter optimization typically targets a single accuracy metric that treats both directions equally. This study treats the optimization objective itself as a design variable. Five architectures (MLP, LSTM, XGBoost, TCN, and Transformer) are evaluated under three regimes: single-objective maximization of $R^2$, single-objective minimization of the NASA scoring function, and a multi-objective formulation that jointly optimizes both criteria. The multi-objective search employs NSGA-II with Entropy-CRITIC weighting for Pareto selection. Seventy-five model-dataset-strategy combinations are assessed on the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan and BackBlaze hard-disk drive benchmarks. On C-MAPSS, all strategies achieve comparable accuracy ($R^2 \approx 0.89$), yet multi-objective optimization reduces directional imbalance by approximately 33%, improving calibration of early versus late predictions. Model rankings prove configuration-dependent, with simpler architectures frequently outperforming deeper temporal models. On BackBlaze, the objectives shift from complementary to conflicting, producing divergent Entropy-CRITIC weights and a substantial generalization gap (best $R^2 \approx 0.34$). These results demonstrate that the optimization objective materially shapes prognostic behavior and that multi-objective search provides a practical mechanism for calibrating prediction timeliness in RUL modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 RUL（剩余寿命）预测中把优化目标本身当作设计变量：用 NSGA-II 联合优化 R² 与 NASA scoring function，并以 Entropy-CRITIC 权重选 Pareto 解。在 NASA C-MAPSS 上各策略精度相当（R²≈0.89），但多目标搜索把早晚预测的方向性失衡降低约 33%；在 BackBlaze 上两目标由互补转为冲突，最佳 R² 仅约 0.34。
Motivation: 预测性维护中早期与晚期 RUL 误差后果不对称，而常规超参优化只用单一精度指标、对两个方向等权处理，无法校准预测时效性。
Method: 比较五种架构（MLP、LSTM、XGBoost、TCN、Transformer）在三种优化体制下的表现：单目标最大化 R²、单目标最小化 NASA scoring function、以及联合两者的多目标形式；多目标搜索用 NSGA-II 生成 Pareto 前沿，再用 Entropy-CRITIC 权重做选择，共评估 75 个模型-数据集-策略组合。
Result: 在 C-MAPSS 涡扇发动机基准上所有策略精度相当（R²≈0.89），多目标优化将方向性失衡（directional imbalance）降低约 33%，改善早期与晚期预测的校准；模型排名依赖配置，简单架构常优于更深的时序模型。在 BackBlaze 硬盘基准上两目标由互补转为冲突，Entropy-CRITIC 权重出现分歧，泛化差距显著，最佳 R²≈0.34。
Conclusion: 优化目标本身实质塑造 RUL 模型的预报行为，多目标搜索是校准预测时效性的实用机制；但目标间关系随数据集变化，在 BackBlaze 上存在明显泛化差距。

papers.title: Exact Distinguishability in Non-Markovian Decision Processes
papers.abstract_en: Non-Markovian environments are often modeled as Regular Decision Processes (RDPs), where dynamics depend on the interaction history through a finite automaton. Existing offline guarantees for RDPs rely on a distinguishability assumption on the behaviour policy but provide no means of verifying it. When the assumption is violated, distinct models may explain the data equally well. We study when data collected under a fixed behaviour policy can distinguish two candidate RDPs. We prove that the posterior odds between observationally equivalent candidates remain equal to the prior odds at every sample size, even when the policy visits every automaton state, and verify both results formally in Lean 4. We then characterize this equivalence exactly and derive PEC, an algorithm that decides it in time linear in the size of the product automaton. The distinguishability assumption of prior work fails on three of our four test environments, and the experiment identified by PEC restores it in each case.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 7 figures. Code and Lean 4 proofs: https://github.com/Kcbir/pec
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对正则决策过程 (RDP) 离线保证中无法验证的可区分性假设，证明在固定行为策略下观测等价的两个候选 RDP 的后验几率在任何样本量下都等于先验几率（即使策略访问了自动机的每个状态），并用 Lean 4 形式化验证。给出精确刻画等价性的 PEC 算法，按乘积自动机大小线性时间判定；在四个测试环境中该假设有三个失效，PEC 识别出的实验在每种情况下都恢复了假设。
Motivation: 非马尔可夫环境常用 RDP 建模，已有离线保证依赖行为策略的可区分性假设，却没有任何验证手段；假设一旦违反，不同模型对数据的解释力相同，离线保证随之失效。
Method: 先证明观测等价候选间的后验几率恒等于先验几率（策略遍历每个自动机状态也成立），并在 Lean 4 中形式化两个结果；再精确刻画该等价关系，据此导出 PEC 算法，用乘积自动机判定等价性。
Result: 后验几率在所有样本量下等于先验几率，且策略访问每个自动机状态时仍成立；PEC 判定时间对乘积自动机大小为线性；四个测试环境中先前工作的可区分性假设有三个失效，PEC 识别出的实验在每种情况下都恢复了该假设。
Conclusion: 固定行为策略下观测等价的 RDP 在统计上不可区分，可区分性假设必须先被检验；PEC 提供了线性时间的判定与实验恢复手段。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning: Replacing Target Samples by Black-Box Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Many scientific and machine learning systems, from molecular dynamics to diffusion models and beyond, are governed by stochastic dynamics with low-dimensional structure, evolving on slow timescales. However, target trajectories, used to identify and interpret such dynamics, are often inaccessible: only biased or static samples that explore the underlying manifold are available. We introduce Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning (LITL), a framework for recovering target Langevin dynamics from biased source samples using only black-box feedback. LITL learns the leading spectral structure of the target infinitesimal generator and the projected drift through Dirichlet representation learning, enabling kinetic reconstruction in spectral form and slow-manifold gradient field estimation. We further introduce a spherical variant well suited to steering normalized latent representations commonly used in learning systems toward desired objectives. We establish finite-sample guarantees for eigenvalue, eigenfunction, and projected drift estimation in Sobolev norms, thereby ensuring generalization of these quantities and their first-order derivatives. Empirically, LITL recovers physical transition timescales from biased molecular simulations, builds kinetic structure from static samples of generative models, reconstructs spherical symmetries of physical systems, and enables post-hoc latent steering of trained neural networks under black-box feedback. Together, these results position spectral operator learning as a practical framework for recovering stochastic dynamics under distribution shift and unlock applications across machine learning and the physical sciences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LITL (Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning) 在只有有偏源样本、目标轨迹不可得时，用黑箱反馈学习目标无穷小生成元的主谱结构与投影漂移，从而重建 Langevin 动力学。它给出特征值、特征函数与投影漂移在 Sobolev 范数下的有限样本保证，并在分子模拟、生成模型静态样本与神经网络潜变量操控上做经验验证。
Motivation: 分子动力学与扩散模型等系统的慢时间尺度动力学需要目标轨迹来辨识，但实际常只能拿到有偏样本或不探索动力学的静态样本，目标 Langevin 动力学无法直接恢复。
Method: 通过 Dirichlet 表示学习 (Dirichlet representation learning) 从有偏源样本估计目标无穷小生成元的主特征结构与投影漂移，实现谱形式的动力学重建与慢流形梯度场估计；另给出球面变体以操控学习系统中的归一化潜表示，并对特征值、特征函数、投影漂移建立 Sobolev 范数下的有限样本保证，覆盖这些量及其一阶导数。
Result: 经验上从有偏分子模拟中恢复物理跃迁时间尺度，从生成模型的静态样本构建动力学结构，重建物理系统的球面对称性，并在黑箱反馈下对已训练神经网络做事后潜变量 (post-hoc) 操控；同时给出特征值、特征函数与投影漂移估计的有限样本泛化保证。
Conclusion: 谱算子学习 (spectral operator learning) 可作为分布偏移下恢复随机动力学的实用框架，把目标样本替换为黑箱反馈即可在机器学习与物理科学中重建慢时间尺度动力学。

papers.title: Auto-Formalizing Neuro-Symbolic Predictors
papers.abstract_en: Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) predictors incorporate prior knowledge into the prediction process of neural networks, ensuring that outputs satisfy specified constraints, making them particularly suitable for high-stakes applications where compliance with domain knowledge is essential. A key bottleneck in this paradigm is the acquisition of symbolic constraints: encoding domain knowledge into logical formulas remains a manual and expert-intensive process. In this work, we investigate the extent to which auto-formalization via LLMs can systematically translate textual knowledge into symbolic knowledge that can be plugged into NeSy predictors. To this end, we introduce auto-nesy-bench, a new benchmark for evaluating constraint formalization and its impact on downstream accuracy of NeSy predictors. Through an extensive evaluation across several domains, we find that LLMs can formalize constraints to a meaningful extent, generating formulas that are often similar to those provided by human experts. Moreover, when the generated formulas are syntactically valid, they can lead to high-quality downstream predictions. The code and benchmark are available at https://unitn-sml.github.io/auto-nesy-bench/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 auto-nesy-bench，评测 LLM 能否把文本领域知识自动形式化为可直接插入神经符号预测器 (NeSy predictors) 的逻辑约束，并衡量形式化质量对下游预测精度的影响。跨多个领域的评测显示 LLM 能在相当程度上形式化约束，生成公式常与专家给出的相似；公式语法有效时可带来高质量下游预测。
Motivation: NeSy 预测器靠符号约束保证输出符合领域知识，但约束获取仍是人工、专家密集的瓶颈，缺少衡量自动形式化质量及其下游影响的评测基准。
Method: 引入 auto-nesy-bench 基准，评测 LLM 将文本知识翻译为可插入 NeSy 预测器的符号公式这一 auto-formalization 流程，并考察形式化结果对下游预测精度的影响；在多个领域上做评测，代码与基准已公开。
Result: 跨多个领域的评测发现：LLM 能在有意义的程度上形式化约束，生成的公式常与人类专家提供的公式相似；当生成公式语法有效时，可带来高质量的下游预测。
Conclusion: LLM 驱动的自动形式化足以在相当程度上替代人工约束编码，且公式语法有效性是下游 NeSy 预测质量的关键前提。

papers.title: SuperMotion: Source-Preserving Denoising for Text-Driven Human Motion Editing
papers.abstract_en: Text-driven human motion editing aims to realize a requested change while preserving compatible source content. Existing diffusion editors rely largely on learned conditioning for preservation of the unedited part, yet their outputs can lose temporal detail as denoising proceeds. We propose the \textbf{Source-Preserving Denoising framework (SuperMotion)}, which explicitly reuses the source at each reverse step for source preservation. We first align the source motion to the output timeline and predict a preservation gate that controls reuse across frames and feature dimensions. A clean-space source anchor then utilizes the learned preservation gate to blend the predicted clean motion with the aligned source and passes the corrected estimate directly to the sampling posterior. Because the aligned source is a realized motion rather than a regression output, the anchor injects sample-level temporal detail that a reconstruction-trained denoiser tends to smooth away. To learn effective source reuse, we supervise the anchored estimate against the editing target and match its second temporal differences through a temporal high-frequency loss. These objectives require no explicit edit masks. Extensive experiments show that SuperMotion improves editing accuracy, reaching 33.20\% full-pool R@1 on MotionFix, while reducing temporal-detail attenuation and preserving motion dynamics as it realizes the requested changes. Ablations confirm that the learned preservation gate is responsible for the gain and that it reuses the source to retain the unedited content properly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SuperMotion 在文本驱动人体动作编辑的每一步反演中显式复用源动作：先对齐源动作到输出时间线并预测逐帧逐维的 preservation gate，再在 clean space 用该门把预测的干净动作与对齐源动作混合，直接送入采样后验。在 MotionFix 上达到 33.20% full-pool R@1，消融显示增益来自学到的 preservation gate。
Motivation: 现有扩散式动作编辑器靠学习到的条件化来保留未编辑部分，但去噪推进过程中输出会丢失时间细节，源内容的保持不可控。
Method: Source-Preserving Denoising：把源动作对齐到输出时间线，预测跨帧与跨特征维的 preservation gate；clean-space source anchor 用该门混合预测的干净动作与对齐源动作，并把修正后的估计直接传给采样后验。监督信号是对编辑目标的 anchored 估计损失加上二阶时间差匹配的 temporal high-frequency loss，不需要显式编辑掩码。
Result: 在 MotionFix 上 full-pool R@1 达到 33.20%；编辑精度提升的同时减弱时间细节衰减并保持动作动态。消融确认增益由学到的 preservation gate 负责，且它正确复用源动作保留未编辑内容。
Conclusion: 把源动作作为已实现的样本在每个反演步骤重新注入，比仅靠条件化更能保留未编辑内容与时间细节；关键部件是学到的 preservation gate。

papers.title: FedMIX-P: Mixing Local and Global Preconditioners for Federated Vision and Language Model Training
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive preconditioners accelerate model training, but heterogeneous client geometries can bias federated updates even when gradients are evaluated at the same model. Round-start synchronization alone cannot prevent this mismatch from reappearing during local training. We propose \texttt{FedMIX-P}, which mixes shared and local preconditioners at every local step, retaining local adaptation while reducing mean-squared operator mismatch by a factor of $λ^2$. For smooth nonconvex objectives with stochastic gradients and partial participation, we establish an $O(R^{-1/2})$ stationarity bound using suitable stepsizes and a horizon-dependent mixing weight, without requiring local preconditioners to converge to one another. A two-client counterexample shows that fixed positive mixing can preserve a nonstationary fixed point. The theory covers bounded linear symmetric positive-definite preconditioners. Experiments with SOAP, Sophia, and Muon variants across vision and language tasks show improvements over corresponding local optimizers, including accuracy gains of up to $19.47$ percentage points and lower validation loss for 60M--350M language models. Full nonlinear and momentum-based updates require separate analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedMIX-P 在联邦训练的每个本地步把共享预条件器与本地预条件器按随时间变化的权重混合，把算子失配的均方误差压到原来的 1/λ²，同时保留本地自适应。对光滑非凸目标、随机梯度与部分参与，配合合适步长可得 O(R^{-1/2}) 驻留性界，且不要求各客户端预条件器彼此收敛；固定正混合权重会保留非驻留不动点，故混合权重必须随 horizon 调整。
Motivation: 联邦场景下各客户端的预条件器几何不同，即使梯度在同一模型处计算，本地自适应优化器也会把更新拉偏；仅在每轮开始做一次同步无法阻止这种失配在本地训练中重新出现。
Method: 在每个本地步将共享（全局）预条件器与本地预条件器按 horizon 相关的混合权重线性混合，理论分析限定在有界的线性对称正定 (SPD) 预条件器、光滑非凸目标、随机梯度与部分参与；用两客户端反例说明固定正混合会保留非驻留不动点；实验用 SOAP、Sophia、Muon 的变体在视觉与语言任务上对比对应的本地优化器。
Result: 算子失配的均方误差按因子 λ² 缩小；在合适步长与 horizon 相关混合权重下得到 O(R^{-1/2}) 驻留性界，且不要求本地预条件器相互收敛。实验中相对对应本地优化器精度提升最高达 19.47 个百分点，60M–350M 语言模型验证损失更低。
Conclusion: 逐步混合全局与本地预条件器能在保留本地自适应的同时抑制联邦几何失配，但混合权重不能固定为正常数，且现有理论只覆盖有界线性 SPD 预条件器，全非线性与带动量的更新需另行分析。

papers.title: Decision Titan: Test-Time Training for Long-Term Memory in Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-term dependencies remain a major challenge for sequential decision-making in the field of AI: RNNs suffer from vanishing gradients and the limited expressivity of vector-based hidden states, whilst Transformer-based models are limited by the quadratic scaling of attention. Recent work has proposed tackling this problem with the Test-Time Training (TTT) framework, which stores episodic memories in the parameters of a neural network through gradient descent at both train and test-time. This approach has seen success in the domain of Natural Language Processing, however, to the best of our knowledge it has not yet been applied to the domain of Reinforcement Learning (RL), nor has there been a study analysing how this memory practically functions. In this paper, we study the potential of the TTT framework for offline RL by augmenting a Decision Transformer with TTT layers, dubbed the Decision Titan. We analyse performance and properties of the model in the X-Maze environment, an extension of T-Maze designed to test sequential memory, and investigate how the memory mechanism learns by visualising gate values over time. Our key findings are that Decision Titan can learn long-term dependencies with ranges 20x longer than the context window, generalises to lengths 1.7x the training data, but crucially temporal generalisation depends on the time embeddings used, and the ability to learn long-term dependencies depends on how the relevant information is encoded.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Test-Time Training (TTT) 层加到 Decision Transformer 上得到 Decision Titan，在训练与测试时都用梯度下降把 episodic memory 写进网络参数，用于离线 RL 的长期依赖。在 X-Maze（T-Maze 的序列记忆扩展）上，它能学到比 context window 长 20 倍的依赖，并泛化到训练数据 1.7 倍的长度；但时间泛化取决于所用的 time embedding，长期依赖能否学到取决于相关信息如何被编码。
Motivation: 序列决策中的长期依赖受限于 RNN 的梯度消失与向量隐状态表达力、以及 Transformer 注意力的二次复杂度；TTT 在 NLP 已见效，但尚未被用于 RL，其记忆机制如何实际运作也缺少分析。
Method: 在 Decision Transformer 中插入 TTT 层，使 episodic memory 通过梯度下降存储于网络参数（训练与测试时均更新）；在 X-Maze 环境上分析性能与记忆特性，并通过随时间可视化 gate 值来考察记忆机制如何学习。
Result: Decision Titan 可学习比 context window 长 20 倍的长期依赖，并泛化到训练数据 1.7 倍的长度；时间泛化取决于所用的 time embedding，而学习长期依赖的能力取决于相关信息的编码方式。
Conclusion: 把 episodic memory 写入参数的 TTT 框架可迁移到离线 RL 并支撑超 context window 的记忆，但其有效性由 time embedding 与信息编码方式共同决定。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VoxelSynth3D: Interpretable Volumetric Image-Domain Metal Artifact Reduction with a Paired Synthetic CLINIC-Metal Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Metal artifacts in postoperative musculoskeletal CT obscure bone-implant and adjacent soft-tissue interfaces. Many metal artifact reduction (MAR) methods require unavailable raw projections or learned models that may shift across scanners and implants. We present VoxelSynth3D, a training-free 3D image-domain framework for reconstructed CT. The framework combines support masking, normalized tissue synthesis, deviation gating, and restricted edge refinement. Detected implant voxels are preserved in the output, while correction targets metal-induced artifacts in the surrounding tissue. We also construct Synthetic CLINIC-Metal, a controlled paired synthetic evaluation resource, from no-metal CTPelvic1K volumes with clean targets, metal/artifact masks, fixed seeds, and patient-level splits; 75 unpaired real metal cases receive qualitative/no-reference evaluation only. The operating point was fixed in a near-flat validation basin. With exact-mask oracle localization, all methods share a metal-excluded tissue ROI. On 40 held-out cases, VoxelSynth3D reduced RMSE from 801.48 to 786.18 HU (paired gain 15.30 HU, 95% CI 11.68-19.23), improving every case and exceeding the evaluated 3D Gaussian smoother by 13.58 HU. Clean-edge agreement decreased next to metal but exceeded input beyond 5 mm. Thus, VoxelSynth3D provides case-consistent within-distribution tissue-error reduction with a localized structural tradeoff. Spacing-aware sensitivity retained aggregate broad-region improvement and identified near-metal calibration as a target.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication at BHI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VoxelSynth3D 是一个免训练的 3D 图像域金属伪影抑制 (MAR) 框架，用支撑掩膜、归一化组织合成、偏差门控与受限边缘细化，在保留植入体体素的同时只修正周围组织的伪影。在 40 例留出合成配对病例上 RMSE 从 801.48 降到 786.18 HU（配对增益 15.30 HU，95% CI 11.68–19.23），逐例均改善并比所评估的 3D Gaussian smoother 多降 13.58 HU。
Motivation: 术后肌肉骨骼 CT 的金属伪影遮蔽骨-植入体与邻近软组织界面；现有 MAR 方法依赖不可得的原始投影，或学习模型在不同扫描仪与植入体间发生漂移。
Method: 免训练的 3D 图像域流程，组合 support masking、normalized tissue synthesis、deviation gating 与 restricted edge refinement，保留检出的植入体体素、只修正周围组织。评测资源 Synthetic CLINIC-Metal 由无金属 CTPelvic1K 体数据构造，含干净目标、金属/伪影掩膜、固定种子与患者级划分；定位用 exact-mask oracle，所有方法共享排除金属的组织 ROI，工作点固定在近平坦验证盆地。
Result: 40 例留出病例上 RMSE 801.48 → 786.18 HU，配对增益 15.30 HU（95% CI 11.68–19.23），逐例全部改善，超出所评估 3D Gaussian smoother 13.58 HU；金属旁 clean-edge 一致性下降但超过输入在 5 mm 以外。75 例非配对真实金属病例仅做定性/无参考评价，spacing-aware 敏感性保留了大范围区域的整体改善。
Conclusion: 免训练图像域修正能在分布内逐例一致地降低组织误差，代价是金属邻近处的局部结构权衡；近金属区域的校准是后续目标。

papers.title: FedCKA: Representation-Guided Layer Personalization for Federated 3D Perception Across Driving Domains
papers.abstract_en: Robust perception in intelligent vehicles demands 3D object detectors that remain dependable under domain shifts, such as changes in time of day, location, or weather. However, due to costly annotation and rare shifts, some environments lack sufficient data to train a standalone detector. Federated learning offers a privacy-preserving framework for collaborative model training, enabling clients to benefit from shared learning across diverse environments. Yet, this framework traditionally relies on a single global consensus model, which struggles to perform across heterogeneous local data distributions. Local conditions are better captured by adapting a subset of the model, but many personalization approaches rely on predefined layer partitions or fixed personalization ratios, thereby limiting adaptation to client-specific divergence. To reduce this rigidity, we propose FedCKA, a Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA)-based strategy that dynamically handles the personalization-globalization trade-off. Specifically, FedCKA computes layer-wise feature similarities between local client models and the global consensus model during training. By converting layer-wise similarity scores into client-specific aggregation masks, FedCKA selectively shares representation-consistent layers. Evaluation on a unified multi-domain benchmark based on nuScenes shows that FedCKA outperforms established federated baselines, including FedBN, FedRep, and FedSelect, improving average NDS by 7 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The findings offer both a comparative benchmark and a promising direction for robust federated 3D perception across shifts in location, weather, and illumination. Code is available at https://github.com/j-verhoog/FedCKA.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedCKA 用 CKA 逐层度量本地客户端模型与全局共识模型的特征相似度，把相似度转成客户端专属聚合掩码，只共享表征一致的层，从而动态权衡个性化与全局化。在基于 nuScenes 的统一多域基准上，平均 NDS 比最强联邦基线高 7 个百分点。
Motivation: 跨时间、地点、天气的域偏移下部分环境缺乏足够标注数据训练独立检测器；联邦学习依赖单一全局模型难以适配异构本地分布，而现有个性化方法依赖预设层划分或固定个性化比例，无法随客户端差异调整。
Method: 训练中计算本地客户端模型与全局共识模型的逐层特征相似度（Centered Kernel Alignment, CKA），将逐层相似度分数转换为客户端专属聚合掩码，选择性共享表征一致的层，替代固定层划分与固定个性化比例。
Result: 在基于 nuScenes 的统一多域基准上，FedCKA 平均 NDS 比最强基线提高 7 个百分点，超过 FedBN、FedRep、FedSelect 等既有联邦基线。
Conclusion: 以逐层表征相似度驱动的动态个性化可在地点、天气、光照偏移下提升联邦 3D 目标检测的稳健性，并附带一个可比较的多域联邦基准。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Sharpening Tax in Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: An emerging hypothesis about reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models (LLMs) is that it merely sharpens existing behaviors of a base model, improving single-shot accuracy at the cost of solution coverage. Although this trade-off has been observed in math and coding tasks, it need not extend to agentic tasks, where multi-turn tool use and interaction may require capabilities newly acquired during post-training. Our surprising finding is that pre-trained LLMs, equipped with a light inference harness, can serve as capable agents. Despite far lower accuracy (pass@1), they often surpass their post-trained counterparts in solution coverage (pass@K) given a sufficient test-time budget. We further analyze the underlying mechanism and show that post-training pushes tasks toward two extremes, always solved or never solved, and thereby improves sampling efficiency and consistency at the cost of solution coverage. To measure this cost, we propose Sharpening Tax, a diagnostic metric that quantifies the loss in test-time scalability after post-training. Across 14 base/post-trained model pairs from four families and three agentic benchmarks (42 cases in total), the tax is prevalent in most settings, can be estimated from a few rollouts, and correlates well with other metrics. Finally, we present posterior-tempered group sampling (PTGS), a simple plug-and-play Bayesian sampler that adapts the sampling temperature per prompt to its estimated difficulty. Applied during RL training in two agentic environments, PTGS pays a smaller tax than the fixed-temperature baseline, solving more tasks under repeated sampling while also improving single-shot accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RL 后训练把 LLM 的任务解推向「总能解出」或「永远解不出」两个极端，从而提升 pass@1 与采样一致性，却牺牲 pass@K 覆盖度。作者提出诊断指标 Sharpening Tax 度量这一测试时可扩展性损失，并提出按提示难度自适应温度的 PTGS 采样器，在两个 agentic 环境的 RL 训练中比固定温度基线付出更小的 tax。
Motivation: 「RL 后训练只是锐化基座模型已有行为」这一假设在数学与代码任务上成立，但 agentic 任务需要多轮工具使用，后训练可能真的带来新能力，因此该权衡是否延续、代价如何度量尚不清楚。
Method: 提出 Sharpening Tax 指标，量化后训练造成的测试时可扩展性损失，仅需少量 rollouts 即可估计；并提出 posterior-tempered group sampling (PTGS)，一个即插即用的贝叶斯采样器，按每个 prompt 估计的难度自适应调节采样温度，直接用于 RL 训练过程。
Result: 在四个模型家族的 14 组基座/后训练模型对、三个 agentic benchmark 共 42 个案例中，Sharpening Tax 在多数设置下普遍存在，且能由少量 rollouts 估计、与其他指标相关性良好。配备轻量推理框架的预训练模型 pass@1 远低，但在足够测试时预算下 pass@K 覆盖度常超过后训练版本。PTGS 在两个 agentic 环境的 RL 训练中比固定温度基线 tax 更小，重复采样解出更多任务，同时提升单次准确率。
Conclusion: 后训练以牺牲解的覆盖度换取采样效率与一致性，这一代价可用 Sharpening Tax 从少量 rollouts 中诊断；按 prompt 难度自适应温度可在 RL 训练中同时缓解该 tax 并保住 pass@1。

papers.title: MCRI: A Four-Dimensional Framework for Analyzing and Evaluating Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: As agents evolve from single-tool systems into modular, composite architectures, skills are becoming an important mechanism for capability development and distribution. However, the academic community lacks a structured framework for systematically analyzing and evaluating skills. Drawing on information gain and behavioral constraint, we propose the four-dimensional MCRI Framework and operationalize it as MCRI-Eval, a large language model-based evaluation method. We evaluate MCRI-Eval using 63,812 public skills from the OpenClaw skill Hub, with 58,275 skill-conditioned model executions across BigCodeBench, BFCL-Fundamental, and Mind2Web. MCRI-Eval scores are positively associated with community popularity signals and achieve the highest downstream ranking agreement among the evaluated methods. MCRI-Eval also improves top-1 skill selection across all three benchmarks: compared with the strongest baseline on each benchmark, the skills selected by MCRI-Eval advance by 17.7, 22.8, and 19.6 percentile points in downstream performance rank on BigCodeBench, BFCL-Fundamental, and Mind2Web, respectively. These results indicate that MCRI-Eval provides a useful pre-execution signal for prioritizing promising skills before costly execution-based evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出四维 MCRI 框架并落地为基于 LLM 的 MCRI-Eval，用信息增益与行为约束在执行前给 agent skill 打分。在 OpenClaw Skill Hub 的 63,812 个公开 skill、58,275 次 skill 条件模型执行上，其分数与社区热度信号正相关，且相对各基准最强基线，选出的 skill 在 BigCodeBench、BFCL-Fundamental、Mind2Web 的下游排名分别前进 17.7、22.8、19.6 个百分点。
Motivation: agent skill 正成为能力开发与分发的机制，但学界缺少结构化框架来系统分析与评估 skill，昂贵的执行式评估之前也没有可靠的优先级信号。
Method: 提出四维 MCRI Framework（基于 information gain 与 behavioral constraint），并实现为 MCRI-Eval：用 LLM 对 skill 打分，再以社区热度信号与下游排名一致性检验，覆盖 BigCodeBench、BFCL-Fundamental、Mind2Web 三个基准的 skill 条件模型执行。
Result: 数据规模为 OpenClaw Skill Hub 63,812 个公开 skill、58,275 次 skill 条件执行；MCRI-Eval 分数与社区热度信号正相关，并在被评估方法中取得最高的下游排名一致性；相对各基准最强基线，其选出的 skill 在下游性能排名上分别前进 17.7（BigCodeBench）、22.8（BFCL-Fundamental）、19.6（Mind2Web）个百分点。
Conclusion: MCRI-Eval 可作为昂贵执行式评估之前的预执行信号，用于优先筛选有潜力的 skill。

papers.title: Learned End-to-End Guidance Schedules for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are a powerful generative paradigm used across multimedia and scientific applications. Guided diffusion methods impose requirements on the generation by adding the gradient of a differentiable loss (the guidance function) as a drift term during inference. The weight of this drift (the guidance scale) is critical for the trade-off between data quality and requirement satisfaction. To achieve both of these goals, guided diffusion must resort to small guidance scales and lengthy sampling, incurring high computational costs. This work proposes learned end-to-end guidance schedules (LEEGS) to achieve these objectives with fewer sampling steps. LEEGS trains a time-dependent schedule by minimizing the guidance function over a small set of examples using stochastic gradient descent. Backpropagating through guided sampling is computationally expensive, so LEEGS uses an approximation of the gradient that cuts training time by a factor of 4. We evaluate LEEGS on diverse guidance tasks, including (a) image inpainting, (b) noisy image inverse problems, (c) face-ID-guided generation, and (d) forward and inverse PDE problems, outperforming baselines at equal budget (50 or 100 NFEs), or matching constant guidance with only 10% of the steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LEEGS：用 SGD 端到端学习随时间变化的 guidance scale 调度，使引导扩散在更少采样步数下同时保住数据质量与约束满足度。梯度用近似计算，训练时间缩短 4 倍；在图像补全、含噪反问题、face-ID 引导生成与 PDE 正/反问题上，等预算（50 或 100 NFEs）优于基线，或只用 10% 步数即可匹配恒定 guidance。
Motivation: 引导扩散靠在推理时加入可微损失的梯度漂移项来满足约束，但 guidance scale 必须取小值并配合长采样才能兼顾质量与约束满足，导致计算代价高。
Method: LEEGS 用 SGD 在少量样本上最小化 guidance function，直接训练一个随时间变化的调度（schedule）；由于对引导采样反向传播代价高，采用梯度近似，训练时间缩短 4 倍。
Result: 在四类引导任务上评测：图像补全、含噪图像反问题、face-ID 引导生成、PDE 正/反问题。等预算 50 或 100 NFEs 时优于基线；或只用 10% 的采样步数即可匹配恒定 guidance 的效果；梯度近似使训练时间降低 4 倍。
Conclusion: 引导扩散的 guidance scale 不必恒定，可学习的时间调度能在大幅减少采样步数的同时维持质量与约束满足，从而降低采样与训练开销。

papers.title: VTR-Bench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent video generation models can produce highly realistic videos from natural language instructions, with visual quality approaching cinematic standards. Existing evaluation benchmarks, however, predominantly assess visual quality, aesthetic appeal and physical plausibility, while paying limited attention to text, an essential medium for conveying information in everyday scenes. A generated video may appear visually compelling and feature lifelike subjects, yet still render the text within the scene incorrectly. To address this overlooked dimension, we introduce \textbf{VTR-Bench}, a systematic benchmark for evaluating the \textbf{V}isual \textbf{T}ext \textbf{R}endering capabilities of video generation models. VTR-Bench situates text within concrete application scenarios, such as advertisements and scientific videos, with 300 carefully constructed prompts spanning five scenario categories. We develop an automated evaluation pipeline with human alignments that separately assesses text fidelity through carrier-specific transcription and scene and motion requirements through a prompt-specific chain of query. Beyond evaluation, we introduce a \textbf{Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework} in which a Director agent coordinates image and video generation with visual evaluation, guiding iterative refinement and candidate selection through visual feedback. Experiments on 11 state-of-the-art models reveal widespread difficulties in accurately rendering scene text, with the best-performing model recording an overall word error rate (WER) of 0.250. We further analyze text rendering failures to characterize the challenges faced by current video generation models. These findings highlight visual text rendering as a key challenge for video generation and demonstrate a practical path toward improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/hardenyu21/VTR-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VTR-Bench 把场景文字渲染作为视频生成的独立评测维度：300 条覆盖广告、科学视频等五类场景的 prompt，配自动评测流水线与 Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework（Director agent 协调图像/视频生成并按视觉反馈迭代精修）。在 11 个最先进模型上，最佳模型的整体词错误率 (WER) 仍达 0.250，说明场景文字渲染是当前视频生成的普遍短板。
Motivation: 现有视频生成基准只评视觉质量、美学与物理合理性，忽略场景文字这一日常信息载体：画面逼真但文字渲染错误的视频无法被现有指标识别。
Method: VTR-Bench 将文字置于广告、科学视频等具体应用场景，构建 300 条 prompt、覆盖五个场景类别；评测流水线用载体特定的转录 (carrier-specific transcription) 单独评文字保真度，用 prompt 特定的链式查询 (chain of query) 评场景与运动要求，并对齐人工判断。另提出 Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework，由 Director agent 协调图像与视频生成及视觉评估，通过视觉反馈驱动迭代精修与候选选择。
Result: 在 11 个最先进视频生成模型上，场景文字渲染普遍困难，最佳模型的整体词错误率 (WER) 为 0.250；并进一步分析文字渲染失败模式以刻画当前模型面临的挑战。
Conclusion: 视觉文字渲染是视频生成的关键挑战，Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework 提供了一条借助视觉反馈迭代改进的可行路径；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OpenMTB-Audit: Exposing Over-Refusal and Clinical Expert Perspectives in LLM-Based Molecular Tumor Board Safety Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Molecular tumor boards integrate genomic findings, clinical context, and therapeutic evidence to support precision oncology. As AI enters this workflow, a key safety challenge is distinguishing truly unsupported recommendations from evidence-supported options that still require oncologist review because of incomplete information, poor ECOG performance status, or other clinical caveats. We introduce OpenMTB-Audit, an open-source benchmark of 500 synthetic non-small cell lung cancer cases spanning five adversarial error categories and four safety labels: Supported, Partially Supported, Unsupported, and Insufficient Information. Across eight large language model configurations, we identify pervasive over-refusal: all LLM configurations failed to retain the Partially Supported label in 83.3-100% of true Partially Supported cases, achieving high aggregate safety scores through label collapse rather than clinically calibrated reasoning. To address this limitation, we developed MTB-AuditAgent, a deterministic seven-module framework separating evidence verification, missing-information detection, safety classification, and abstention. It reduces over-refusal to 6.7% and achieves 91.2% accuracy (95% CI: 88.6-93.6%). A two-oncologist annotation study found disagreement concentrated at the boundary between information sufficiency and treatment optimization, underscoring the need to preserve clinically meaningful distinctions.
papers.comment: Accepted for oral presentation and publication at the Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing (PSB) 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenMTB-Audit 是一个含 500 例合成非小细胞肺癌 (NSCLC) 病例的开源基准，带五类对抗性错误与四档安全标签。八个 LLM 配置在 83.3–100% 的真实 Partially Supported 病例上丢失该标签，靠标签坍缩换取高安全分；确定性七模块框架 MTB-AuditAgent 把过度拒答降到 6.7%，准确率 91.2% (95% CI 88.6–93.6%)。
Motivation: 分子肿瘤委员会 (MTB) 工作流中，LLM 难以区分真正无依据的推荐与证据支持但因信息不全、ECOG 差等原因仍需肿瘤医生复核的选项，安全评测因此失真。
Method: 构建开源基准 OpenMTB-Audit：500 例合成 NSCLC 病例，五类对抗性错误，四档标签 (Supported / Partially Supported / Unsupported / Insufficient Information)，在八个 LLM 配置上评测；再提出确定性七模块框架 MTB-AuditAgent，把证据核验、缺失信息检测、安全分类与弃答 (abstention) 分开处理，并做双肿瘤医生标注研究。
Result: 八个 LLM 配置在 83.3–100% 的真实 Partially Supported 病例上未能保留该标签，聚合安全分靠标签坍缩取得；MTB-AuditAgent 将过度拒答降至 6.7%，准确率 91.2% (95% CI 88.6–93.6%)；双医生标注分歧集中在信息充分性与治疗优化的边界。
Conclusion: 高安全分不等于临床校准的推理，需用保留 Partially Supported 的基准与分模块 agent 来暴露并修复过度拒答。

summary_sections.method: 构建开源基准 OpenMTB-Audit：500 例合成 NSCLC 病例，五类对抗性错误，四档标签 (Supported / Partially Supported / Unsupported / Insufficient Information)，在八个 LLM 配置上评测；再提出确定性七模块框架 MTB-AuditAgent，把证据核验、缺失信息检测、安全分类与弃答 (abstention) 分开处理，并做双肿瘤医生标注研究。
summary_sections.result: 八个 LLM 配置在 83.3–100% 的真实 Partially Supported 病例上未能保留该标签，聚合安全分靠标签坍缩取得；MTB-AuditAgent 将过度拒答降至 6.7%，准确率 91.2% (95% CI 88.6–93.6%)；双医生标注分歧集中在信息充分性与治疗优化的边界。
summary_sections.conclusion: 高安全分不等于临床校准的推理，需用保留 Partially Supported 的基准与分模块 agent 来暴露并修复过度拒答。

papers.title: SALD: Self-Referenced Advantage Learning for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on language-model adaptation has shown that single models can obtain informative training signals by evaluating their behavior in demonstrationor feedback-augmented contexts, with the help of a teacher network, which is driven by the student's learned parameters. Inspired by this internal-reference principle, we investigate how diffusion models can identify self-referenced training signals without external demonstrations or teacher networks. We introduce SALD, a self-referenced training framework that evaluates each image-caption pair at two noise levels using the same model. The easier, lower-noise path is evaluated without gradient tracking to provide a reference, while the harder, higher-noise path provides the training gradient. Rather than directly distilling the easy-path prediction, SALD uses the difference between two path errors to adapt the hardpath objective. The proposed Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) converts this relative error into a differentiable sample-level weight. Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM) accumulates relative difficulty across training and adapts the future gap between the two noise levels. Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) further compares the residual power spectra of the two paths and constructs a differentiable, frequency-derived latent-element weight. All components share a single set of model parameters, requiring neither an external teacher network nor additional trainable parameters during training or inference, and no modification to the inference procedure. Experiments across multiple architectures and datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in generation quality, while component-wise ablations quantify the contributions of the proposed components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SALD 让扩散模型用自身在两个噪声水平下的误差差作为优势信号做自参照训练：低噪声路径不追踪梯度只作参照，高噪声路径提供训练梯度，由 AGD、TAM、SAD 三个组件把相对误差转成可微权重。全部组件共享同一套模型参数，无需外部 teacher 网络与额外可训练参数，推理过程不改动，跨多种架构与数据集的实验显示生成质量一致提升。
Motivation: 语言模型适配中用演示或反馈上下文加 teacher 网络可产生内部参照训练信号，但扩散模型缺少这种不依赖外部演示与 teacher 的自参照信号获取方式。
Method: 对每个 image-caption 对在同一模型上评估两个噪声水平：低噪声路径不追踪梯度作参照，高噪声路径给训练梯度。Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) 把两路径误差差转成样本级可微权重；Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM) 累积相对难度并调整后续两噪声水平的间隔；Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) 比较两路径残差功率谱，构造频率导出的 latent-element 权重。
Result: 跨多种架构与数据集的实验显示生成质量一致提升，组件消融量化了各组件的贡献。
Conclusion: 扩散模型可在不引入外部 teacher、不增加可训练参数、不修改推理流程的前提下，用自身双噪声路径的相对误差获得有效训练信号。

papers.title: Auditing Routing Entropy as an Uncertainty Signal in Attention-Residual Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic architectures leave a per-example routing trace beside each prediction, and diffuse routing is easy to read as a sign that the prediction is unreliable. We audit that reading for routing entropy in Attention-Residual (AR) variants of Swin-Tiny and DeiT-Small, trained from scratch on CIFAR-10/100 with a soft-binned calibration auxiliary loss, asking whether the trace carries information about correctness beyond what the model's own confidence already reveals. Three checks probe this increment: does a routing signal appear at fixed confidence, does it replicate across training seeds, and can a held-out predictor exploit it against output-only and shuffled-trace controls? A sensitivity audit then injects effects of known size and measures the fraction of each that the probes recover. No test in the fixed 30-test binned family survives multiplicity correction, and neither the nominal hit nor a borderline result recurs in its sibling seeds. Across 24 paired runs a scalar routing probe yields no pooled improvement in routing-stratified calibration, and an entropy-profile probe predicts correctness better than the same probe given shuffled profiles yet worse than a confidence-only predictor in both binary log-loss and Brier score: a gain over shuffled traces does not become a gain over the output. Conditioning on the complete logit vector leaves the corresponding comparison unresolved. The audit bounds how far these non-detections can be read: at an injected effect of 0.010 nats the profile probe recovers 24-59% of the oracle gain, and a reference-preserving correction probe recovers 8% and 23% in the two CIFAR-100 settings, below the threshold we fixed for applying it to real labels. The results establish control-dependent gains and incomplete estimator recovery, not the absence of conditional routing information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CIFAR-10/100 上从头训练的 Swin-Tiny 与 DeiT-Small 的 Attention-Residual 变体中，路由熵 (routing entropy) 作为预测不确定性的信号未通过审计：固定置信度下的检验无一通过多重比较校正，跨随机种子不复现，24 组配对运行中路由探针相对仅输出的置信度预测器在 log-loss 与 Brier 上均更差。作者据此主张这些结果是控制依赖的非检出与估计器恢复不完全，而非路由条件信息不存在。
Motivation: 动态架构的每样本路由轨迹常被直接读作预测不可靠的迹象，但需要检验该轨迹是否携带超出模型自身置信度的正确性信息，以及非检出结论能被推到多远。
Method: 在 AR 版 Swin-Tiny 与 DeiT-Small 上从头训练 CIFAR-10/100，配合 soft-binned 校准辅助损失；用三类探针（固定置信度下的路由信号、跨训练种子复现、留出预测器对比 output-only 与 shuffled-trace 控制）检验增量信息，并做敏感性审计：注入已知大小的效应，测量各探针恢复的比例。
Result: 固定 30-test binned 检验族无一通过多重比较校正，名义命中与边缘结果在兄弟种子中不复现；24 组配对运行中标量路由探针在 routing-stratified calibration 上无池化改进；熵剖面探针优于 shuffled profile 但劣于仅置信度预测器（binary log-loss 与 Brier 均如此）；注入 0.010 nats 效应时剖面探针恢复 oracle 增益的 24–59%，CIFAR-100 两种设定下参考保持校正探针分别恢复 8% 与 23%，低于预设的应用阈值。
Conclusion: 路由熵相对模型自身置信度的增益是控制依赖的，且当前估计器恢复不完全；这些非检出不能读作路由条件信息不存在。

papers.title: Let the Heads Talk: Beyond Diagonal Graph Attention
papers.abstract_en: Sheaf Neural Networks generalize scalar-weighted message passing by replacing scalar edge weights with linear transport maps between local feature spaces. Yet the role of this matrix-valued transport is entangled with the broader sheaf-diffusion construction. We isolate the transport primitive through quiver representations and establish a direct connection with multi-head attention. Treating attention heads as coordinates of a local transport space reveals that standard multi-head attention implements diagonal edge maps: along each directed interaction, a source head can contribute only to the corresponding receiver head. Allowing off-diagonal entries instead enables edge-conditioned communication across heads before neighborhood aggregation. We show that this operation cannot, in general, be absorbed into a single shared linear map applied after aggregation. Building on this characterization, we introduce Topological Attention (Top-A), a multi-head attention that learns edge-dependent off-diagonal routes while preserving the original same-head paths and exactly recovering vanilla attention when the additional routing vanishes. We evaluate Top-A on relational reasoning, heterogeneous graph learning, and algorithmic reasoning, including out-of-distribution generalization, with heterophilic node classification as a contrast setting. The results show that cross-head transport is most useful when the task benefits from interaction-dependent transformations, while heterophily alone provides no systematic advantage. These findings identify edge-conditioned cross-head communication as a distinct computational primitive of matrix-valued transport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Sheaf Neural Networks 的矩阵值传输原语从 sheaf-diffusion 中剥离出来，指出标准多头注意力等价于对角边映射（源 head 只能汇入同号接收 head），并提出允许边依赖非对角路由的 Topological Attention (Top-A)。在关系推理、异构图学习与算法推理（含分布外泛化）上，跨 head 传输在任务受益于交互依赖变换时最有用，而单纯异构性（heterophily）不带来系统性优势。
Motivation: Sheaf Neural Networks 中矩阵值传输的作用与整体 sheaf-diffusion 构造纠缠在一起，且标准多头注意力沿每条有向交互只允许同号 head 贡献，限制了边上的跨 head 通信。
Method: 用 quiver representations 隔离传输原语并建立其与多头注意力的直接联系；把注意力 head 视为局部传输空间坐标，允许边映射的非对角元在邻域聚合前做跨 head 通信，并证明该操作一般不能被聚合后的单个共享线性映射吸收。Top-A 学习边依赖的非对角路由，同时保留原有同 head 路径，路由项消失时精确退化为 vanilla attention。
Result: 在关系推理、异构图学习、算法推理（含分布外泛化）以及作为对照设置的 heterophilic 节点分类上评估：跨 head 传输在任务受益于交互依赖变换时最有用，而仅凭 heterophily 不提供系统性优势。
Conclusion: 边条件化的跨 head 通信是矩阵值传输的一个独立计算原语，其收益取决于任务是否需要交互依赖的变换，而非图的异构程度。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: No Model Required: Text Entropy Rate Filtering Mitigates Iterative Fine-Tuning Collapse
papers.abstract_en: Iterative fine-tuning on synthetic data causes \emph{model collapse}: output diversity narrows as rare patterns are progressively lost, a signature most visible as phrase-level repetition. Existing mitigations either require model log-probabilities, an external oracle, or continued access to real human data. Here we develop a new approach grounded in mathematical information theory: the non-parametric Kontoyiannis entropy rate estimator $h_k$, computed entirely from raw text via match-length statistics, with no model of any kind. We show that this is in fact a \emph{superior} training-data filter on text-diversity metrics in a fully-synthetic, single-lineage fine-tuning setting. In a six-generation QLoRA collapse experiment on Llama-3.1-8B, logprob-based filtering (the most established model-access-requiring baseline) provides no significant text-diversity benefit on any metric ($p > 0.23$), whereas $h_k$-filtering yields $+42\%$ unique trigrams, $+30\%$ vocabulary, and $-19\%$ repetition (all $p < 0.001$). We validate $h_k$ as a cross-domain entropy proxy ($β= 0.924$, $R^2 = 0.746$) and collapse detector ($ρ= +0.454$, $p < 0.0001$) across 4~domains, 2~temperatures, 2~generator--scorer model pairs, and 1{,}520 generated documents. Our results demonstrate that information theoretic approaches to collapse mitigation are efficient, and suggest new approaches for maintaining multi-agent diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用非参数 Kontoyiannis 熵率估计 h_k 直接从原始文本算训练数据多样性，无需任何模型，在六代 QLoRA 合成数据微调中把 Llama-3.1-8B 的 unique trigrams 提高 42%、词表扩大 30%、重复率降 19%（均 p<0.001），而依赖 log-prob 的过滤基线在任一指标上都无显著收益（p>0.23）。
Motivation: 合成数据迭代微调导致 model collapse，输出多样性收窄、稀有模式逐步丢失，表现为短语级重复；现有缓解手段要么需要模型 log-probabilities、外部 oracle，要么需要持续获取真实人类数据。
Method: 用基于 match-length 统计的非参数 Kontoyiannis 熵率估计 h_k 作为训练数据过滤器，完全从原始文本计算、不含任何模型；在 Llama-3.1-8B 上做六代 QLoRA 单谱系全合成微调实验，与 logprob 过滤基线对比，并在 4 个领域、2 个温度、2 组 generator–scorer 模型对、共 1,520 篇生成文档上验证 h_k 作为跨领域熵代理与 collapse 检测器。
Result: h_k 过滤使 unique trigrams +42%、vocabulary +30%、repetition −19%（均 p<0.001）；logprob 过滤在任一文本多样性指标上均无显著收益（p>0.23）。h_k 作为跨领域熵代理 β=0.924、R²=0.746，作为 collapse 检测器 ρ=+0.454（p<0.0001），验证覆盖 4 领域、2 温度、2 generator–scorer 模型对、1,520 篇生成文档。
Conclusion: 基于信息论的无模型文本熵率过滤是高效的 collapse 缓解手段，比需要模型访问的 logprob 过滤更有效，并提示了维持 multi-agent 多样性的新路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Multi-Party Backchannel Prediction: a Diagnosis, a Benchmark, and a Ceiling
papers.abstract_en: Backchannel prediction has been studied almost entirely in dyadic conversation. We introduce a multi-party benchmark based on the AMI corpus, comprising 682 masked-listener views from 171 meetings, 190 speakers, and 18,697 backchannel events, with a person-disjoint held-out split. A state-of-the-art dyadic model applied zero-shot to meeting audio performs at chance (AUROC 0.499); nevertheless, its frozen acoustic features remain informative: a linear probe reaches 0.704, and retraining the predictor raises performance to 0.751. Retraining reveals a second limitation. Listener conditioning improves prediction for listeners seen during training but not for unseen listeners, and the gap remains under capacity reduction, listener-adversarial training, per-listener adaptation, and oracle lexical conditioning. Adversarial training removes only part of the speaker-identity information, while stronger removal hurts prediction, suggesting that identity is entangled with cues that are useful for backchanneling. A within-model control helps explain this pattern: with the same features and data splits, turn-onset prediction transfers to unseen listeners, while backchannel prediction does not. Backchannel rates also vary about twice as much across individuals as turn-onset rates. Since backchannels occupy only about 1% of frames, frame-level F1 is strongly affected by the base rate. We therefore report AUROC alongside event-F1 on listener-active regions. We release the benchmark and evaluation tools at https://github.com/HafsatiMohammed/bc_multiparty_release.

TL;DR: 把后通道 (backchannel) 预测从二人对话搬到多人会议场景后，SOTA 二人模型零样本在 AMI 会议音频上只有 AUROC 0.499（等同随机），重训后升到 0.751，线性探针 0.704。但听众条件化只对训练中见过的听众有效，容量削减、听众对抗训练、逐听众适配和 oracle 词法条件化都无法消除对未见听众的差距；同模型对照显示轮次起始 (turn-onset) 预测能迁移到未见听众，后通道预测不能。作者据此建议同时报告 listener-active 区域上的 event-F1 与 AUROC，因为后通道只占约 1% 帧、帧级 F1 强受基率影响。

papers.title: FiVOS: A Fish Segmentation Algorithm Based on Interactive Video Object Segmentation and Filter Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: With the continuous expansion of aquaculture, precise and efficient monitoring of fish behavior has become increasingly critical for improving farming efficiency and reducing economic losses. In particular, with the ongoing enhancement of computational capabilities in deep learning models, vision-based fish segmentation methods are garnering growing attention. By analyzing video segmentation results, fish behavior can be effectively tracked, thereby providing reliable data support for the precise regulation of aquaculture environments. However, existing deep learning-based video segmentation methods for aquaculture scenarios often overlook the dynamic correlations between video frames. In contrast, Interactive Video Object Segmentation (IVOS) employs an interaction-propagation scheme to achieve high-precision segmentation while minimizing user effort, thereby enhancing monitoring efficiency. Yet, IVOS applications in aquaculture remain limited due to data scarcity, and are susceptible to error accumulation and mask loss over long sequence propagation due to high intra-class similarity. In response, this paper proposes an improved interactive video object segmentation method (FiVOS) and constructs two fish-specific datasets. FiVOS utilizes a mask block filter to enable early detection and correction of erroneous propagated mask blocks, enhancing filtering accuracy through a rule-based thresholding approach. Additionally, it serializes noise filters to further eliminate erroneous mask noise, thereby improving model robustness. Experimental results demonstrate that FiVOS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in fish video segmentation tasks, providing robust technical support for fish behavior research.
papers.journal_ref: Comput. Electron. Agric. 237 (2025) 110438
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FiVOS 面向水产养殖鱼类视频分割提出改进的交互式视频目标分割 (IVOS) 方法：用 mask block filter 依据规则阈值早期检测并纠正传播中的错误 mask 块，再串接噪声滤波器进一步清除 mask 噪声，以抑制长序列传播中的误差累积与 mask 丢失。作者同时构建两个鱼类专用数据集，实验显示 FiVOS 在鱼类视频分割任务上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 水产养殖场景中现有深度学习视频分割方法忽略帧间动态关联；IVOS 虽能以低用户代价获得高精度分割，但受数据稀缺限制，且类内相似度高导致长序列传播时误差累积、mask 丢失。
Method: 在 IVOS 的 interaction-propagation 框架上加入 mask block filter，用规则阈值法早期检测并纠正错误传播的 mask 块；随后串行化噪声滤波器进一步去除 mask 噪声以提升鲁棒性；并构建两个鱼类专用数据集支撑训练与评测。
Result: 实验结果表明 FiVOS 在鱼类视频分割任务上取得 state-of-the-art (SOTA) 表现；同时产出两个鱼类专用数据集。
Conclusion: 通过规则阈值的 mask 块过滤加串行噪声滤波，交互式视频目标分割可在水产养殖长序列上缓解误差累积与 mask 丢失，为鱼类行为研究提供分割支持。

papers.title: ALFRED: Requirement-driven development of an open-source mobile manipulator for long-term plant monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Tracking seasonal change in crops and forests requires observing the same plants repeatedly. Ground robots can do this at close range, and a manipulator gives their sensors more viewpoints. Yet the robots behind long-term field datasets are rarely released with their design files, and how a robot's own structure limits arm reach and occludes its sensors is seldom compared between builds. We present ALFRED, an open-source mobile manipulator built from commercially available components. It carries a six-degree-of-freedom arm, LiDAR, RGB-D cameras, RTK GNSS and an IMU on an Ackermann-steered base, all mounted on a reconfigurable aluminium strut frame, and runs containerised ROS software. It was developed through four builds against six requirements for repeated outdoor deployment: durability, modularity, repairability, sensing reach, endurance and reproducibility. Model-based analysis of the last three builds shows the usable share of the arm's reachable poses rising from 34.0% to 60.0% and then 66.1%, and ray casting shows that only the final build keeps the frame-mounted LiDAR's horizontal view clear both forwards and backwards. ALFRED completed a year of monthly forest surveys (528 traversals) without missing a scheduled collection. This was despite battery degradation, reconfiguration for another researcher's study, and the parallel development of ALFRED 2.0 for autonomous crop-row operation, with each switch between builds taking about six hours. The deployment also showed that mechanical modularity is only as dependable as the robot description that tracks it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ALFRED 是一台开源移动操作机器人，用四轮迭代和六条部署需求约束设计，模型分析显示最后三版中机械臂可达位姿的可用占比从 34.0% 升到 60.0% 再到 66.1%，且只有最终版让框架安装的 LiDAR 前后水平视野都不被遮挡。它完成了为期一年、每月一次的森林巡测共 528 次遍历，无一次漏掉计划采集。
Motivation: 长期野外植被数据集背后的机器人很少公开设计文件，且机器人自身结构如何限制机械臂可达范围、遮挡传感器，几乎没有跨构建的量化对比。
Method: 基于商用件搭建六自由度机械臂 + LiDAR + RGB-D + RTK GNSS + IMU 的 Ackermann 底盘移动操作平台，配可重构铝型材框架与容器化 ROS 软件；按耐久性、模块化、可维修性、感知可达性、续航、可复现性六条需求做四轮构建，对最后三版做基于模型的可达位姿分析与 ray casting 视野遮挡分析。
Result: 最后三版机械臂可达位姿可用占比 34.0% → 60.0% → 66.1%；ray casting 显示仅最终版在前后两个方向都保持框架安装 LiDAR 水平视野通畅；一年内每月森林巡测完成 528 次遍历、无漏采，其间经历电池退化、为他人研究重构、以及 ALFRED 2.0 并行开发，每次版本切换约 6 小时。
Conclusion: 机械模块化的可靠性取决于与之同步的机器人描述文件（robot description），跨构建的可达性与遮挡必须用模型分析显式对比，而不是靠装配经验。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Zero Flux: Flow-Based Comparison of High-Dimensional Discrete Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Comparing two high-dimensional discrete distributions has always been a challenging task due to the exponentially growing state space and complex changes in interactions. A recent work suggests comparing distributions through a vector field trained using flow matching between two continuous distributions. The resulting vector field at mid-point vanishes if and only if two distributions identical. However, such a flow-based criterion does not naturally apply to discrete distributions. We extend this principle to the discrete domain and introduce the \emph{Zero Flux} criterion, a discrepancy based on local probability fluxes. Under independent coupling, we show that all local probability fluxes vanish at the midpoint if and only if two distributions are the same. This discrepancy decomposes the joint distributional difference into smaller, local contributions and can be efficiently estimated from samples. We establish finite sample error bounds for our estimator. Experiments on synthetic and real categorical data demonstrate reliable recovery of sparse dependence signals and stable tracking of distribution shifts in high dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Zero Flux 把连续域 flow matching 的中点向量场判据搬到离散分布比较上：在独立耦合下，两个高维离散分布相同当且仅当中点处所有局部概率通量 (local probability flux) 为零。该差异可分解为局部贡献、从样本高效估计，并给出有限样本误差界；在合成与真实类别数据上能可靠恢复稀疏依赖信号并稳定跟踪高维分布漂移。
Motivation: 高维离散分布的比较受指数增长的状态空间与交互结构变化所困，而既有的 flow-based 判据只在连续分布上定义，无法直接用于离散域。
Method: 将连续域「中点向量场为零当且仅当两分布相同」的原理推广到离散情形，提出基于局部概率通量的 Zero Flux 判据；在独立耦合 (independent coupling) 下证明中点所有局部通量同时为零等价于两分布相同，并把联合分布差异分解为局部项，给出估计量的有限样本误差界。
Result: 在合成与真实类别数据 (categorical data) 上，该估计能可靠恢复稀疏依赖信号，并在高维设定下稳定跟踪分布漂移；理论上建立了估计量的有限样本误差界。
Conclusion: 离散分布比较可以借局部概率通量在中点的消失来判定等同性，且该判据可分解、可估计并带有限样本保证，适用于高维类别数据的依赖检测与漂移跟踪。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: When Does a Second Model Help? Cross-Model Review in LLM Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models now generate code, documentation, and analyses, and are increasingly used to review such output. We ask when a second review by a different model helps. Building on the author's earlier preprints, which varied context, repetition, and role structure within one model, we test model independence in a controlled experiment: 30 artifacts with 150 planted errors, 10 review conditions, and 900 review sessions with three reviewer models from two developers. In this experiment, (1) a top-tier cross-model reviewer is not significantly different in F1 from same-model review in a fresh session (CCR), which does not establish equivalence; (2) the two find partly different errors (Jaccard 41.2%); and (3) at two review calls, one CCR plus one cross-model review matches more planted errors than two CCR reviews (56.7% vs. 42.7%; Holm-adjusted p=.006), but not significantly more than two reviews by the top-tier cross-model reviewer, so model difference and reviewer capability are not separated. A lightweight cross-model reviewer scores no higher than same-model review. Withholding requirements from the reviewer raises F1 for the two lower tiers but not the top tier, in untested point estimates whose pattern depends on how failed sessions are scored. Before analysis we audited all session records, excluding one baseline run of uncertain provenance and 14 failed calls; results with all sessions are also reported. A partial check on public detector outputs from another benchmark neither replicates nor contradicts the main comparison. Records, artifacts, and scripts are available from the author on request.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Follow-up to arXiv:2603.12123 and arXiv:2603.21454
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 30 个工件、150 个植入错误、10 种审查条件、900 次审查会话的受控实验中，顶级跨模型审查 (CCR) 与同模型新会话审查的 F1 无显著差异，但两者只部分重叠（Jaccard 41.2%）。两次审查调用时，一次 CCR 加一次跨模型审查比两次 CCR 多命中植入错误（56.7% vs 42.7%，Holm 校正 p=.006），但与两次顶级跨模型审查无显著差异，说明模型差异与审查能力未被分离。
Motivation: LLM 已被用于审查代码与文档输出，但第二个不同模型的复审何时真正有增益、增益来自模型独立性还是审查器能力本身，此前未被受控分离。
Method: 在受控实验中设置 30 个工件、150 个植入错误、10 种审查条件、900 次审查会话，覆盖来自两家开发者的三个审查模型；分析前审计全部会话记录，剔除 1 个来源存疑的基线运行与 14 次失败调用，并同时报告含全部会话的结果；另对另一基准的公开检测器输出做部分核对。
Result: 顶级跨模型审查与同模型新会话审查 (CCR) 的 F1 无显著差异（不构成等价性证明）；两者命中错误的 Jaccard 重叠为 41.2%；两次调用时一次 CCR 加一次跨模型审查命中 56.7% 的植入错误，对比两次 CCR 的 42.7%（Holm 校正 p=.006），但与两次顶级跨模型审查无显著差异；轻量级跨模型审查得分不高于同模型审查；对两个较低层级，向审查器隐去需求会提高 F1，顶级层级则不然。
Conclusion: 跨模型复审的收益在两次调用配置下成立，但无法归因于模型独立性而非审查器能力；轻量级跨模型审查不带来增益，且隐去需求的效果依赖层级与失败会话的计分方式。

papers.title: LESS: Lightweight Evolutionary Supernet Search in Minutes
papers.abstract_en: Low-cost NAS must both explore high-performing architectures and identify them reliably, yet reducing evaluation cost often weakens the fidelity of candidate comparisons. Training-free methods reduce evaluation cost by replacing learned task feedback with proxy signals measured at initialization. We introduce LESS (Lightweight Evolutionary Supernet Search), a data-driven method that combines a brief fair hard-path warm-up with discrete search under a single CMA-ES distribution. Each proposal is evaluated as its decoded hard genotype after six candidate-conditioned supernet updates. On NAS-Bench-201, LESS achieves \(93.189\pm0.467\%\) CIFAR-10 test accuracy in 409.1 seconds, coming within 0.04 percentage points of FairNAS using approximately \(1/24\) of its source-reported search time. Matched controls show that calibration improves selected validation accuracy by \(0.577\) percentage points while changing best-visited accuracy by only \(0.054\) points, indicating that its primary effect is to reduce selection regret. The frozen configuration transfers without tuning to CIFAR-100 and ImageNet16-120 with \(69.615\pm1.139\%\) and \(43.720\pm1.697\%\) accuracy. Applied without tuning to the larger DARTS space, LESS achieves \(96.95\pm0.14\%\) on CIFAR-10 and \(82.43\pm0.80\%\) on CIFAR-100, with each search completing in approximately 43.5 minutes on a single GPU. Together, these results show that short, balanced, data-dependent updates enable competitive neural architecture search across datasets and search spaces within minutes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LESS 用短暂公平 hard-path 预热加单一 CMA-ES 分布下的离散搜索，每个候选以解码后的 hard genotype 经六次候选条件 supernet 更新来评估。在 NAS-Bench-201 上 409.1 秒内达到 93.189±0.467% CIFAR-10 测试精度，与 FairNAS 差 0.04 个百分点而搜索时间约为其 1/24；冻结配置不调参迁移到 CIFAR-100、ImageNet16-120 及 DARTS 空间仍保持竞争力。
Motivation: 低成本 NAS 需要既探索高性能架构又可靠识别它们，但降低评估成本常削弱候选比较的保真度；training-free 代理信号又缺少学习到的任务反馈。
Method: LESS 结合短暂公平 hard-path 预热与单一 CMA-ES 分布下的离散搜索，每个提案按其解码后的 hard genotype 评估，做六次候选条件 supernet 更新；另有 matched controls 检验 calibration 的作用。
Result: NAS-Bench-201 上 CIFAR-10 测试精度 93.189±0.467%，用时 409.1 秒，距 FairNAS 仅 0.04 个百分点而搜索时间约为其 1/24；calibration 使所选验证精度提高 0.577 个百分点，而 best-visited 精度仅变 0.054 个百分点；冻结配置迁移至 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet16-120 分别为 69.615±1.139% 与 43.720±1.697%；DARTS 空间不调参达 CIFAR-10 96.95±0.14%、CIFAR-100 82.43±0.80%，单次搜索约 43.5 分钟（单 GPU）。
Conclusion: 短促、均衡、依赖数据的更新即可在数分钟内跨数据集与搜索空间完成有竞争力的 NAS，calibration 的主要作用是降低 selection regret 而非抬高 best-visited 精度。

papers.title: NextMe-800: Anticipating Personal Behavior from Months of Egocentric Video
papers.abstract_en: We often plan ambitiously yet act habitually and wonder, in retrospect, whether we would have planned differently had we known what we would actually do. Hindsight offers a valuable perspective on past decisions, although we often wish we could have simulated hindsight at the moment of choosing. If a system could generate plausible trajectories from one's personal history, such previews might help people formulate more realistic plans and make better informed decisions. We introduce NextMe-800, an approximately 800-hour first-person dataset from one volunteer over 126 days with 1 Hz images, gaze, and audio, captioned at five hierarchical abstraction levels from atomic actions to major activities. We formulate personalized action anticipation as open-vocabulary K-step sequence prediction and construct NextAct, a 1,500-point benchmark combining NextMe-800 with the multi-person EgoLife dataset. Using an embedding-based soft edit distance as the metric, we evaluate how well different models can anticipate personal behavior across abstraction levels and prediction horizons. NextMe-800 and NextAct provide a months-long resource and evaluation framework for studying how far ahead personal behavior can be anticipated from egocentric observation.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. Dataset and benchmark: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mmm8383/NextMe-800 ; project page: https://kkkkawayi.github.io/nextme-800/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NextMe-800 把个人行为预判 (personalized action anticipation) 形式化为开放词表的 K 步序列预测：用单个志愿者 126 天、约 800 小时的第一人称视频（1 Hz 图像、注视、音频，按五个抽象层级从原子动作到主要活动打标注），并构建 1,500 点的 NextAct 基准，跨抽象层级与预测时距评估各模型能提前多久预判个人行为。
Motivation: 人在做决定时无法模拟“事后才知道自己实际会怎么做”的后见之明；若系统能从个人历史生成合理的行为轨迹，可帮助人制定更现实的计划。现有资源缺少跨越数月的第一人称个人历史与分层标注来支撑这一问题。
Method: 发布 NextMe-800：单个志愿者 126 天、约 800 小时第一人称数据，含 1 Hz 图像、gaze 与音频，并在五个层级（从原子动作到主要活动）打 caption。将个性化行为预判定义为开放词表 K 步序列预测，构建 1,500 点的 NextAct 基准，合并 NextMe-800 与多人的 EgoLife 数据集，用基于 embedding 的 soft edit distance 作为评测指标。
Result: 数据集规模约 800 小时、126 天、1 Hz 多模态流、五个抽象层级；NextAct 基准 1,500 点，评测维度为抽象层级与预测时距 (prediction horizon)，指标为 embedding-based soft edit distance。
Conclusion: 数月级的第一人称个人历史配合分层标注与 soft edit distance 评测，可以量化“个人行为能被提前多久预判”这一问题。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Tight Transition Time Bounds for Separable Logistic Regression at the Edge of Stability
papers.abstract_en: We study logistic regression on linearly separable data under gradient descent with a large constant stepsize $η$. Such dynamics may exhibit a characteristic Edge of Stability phenomenon, in which the loss initially oscillates before transitioning to a stable phase of monotone decrease. Existing work provides a tight $Θ(1)$ bound in dimension $d=2$ as $η\to \infty$ and conjectures a bound independent of $η$ in arbitrary dimensions $d\geq 2$. In this paper, we disprove this conjecture by showing that, for every fixed sample size $n\geq 2$ and sufficiently small margin $γ$, the worst-case transition time is $$Θ\!\left((\logη)^{\min\{n-2,d-2\}}\right)$$ uniformly over $d\geq2$. The key challenge in establishing a tight bound is that the sample contributing most strongly to the gradient can change repeatedly across iterations. To address this issue, we control such changes by induction on dimension and sample size, and construct matching hard instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性可分数据的 logistic 回归上，大常数步长 η 的梯度下降会出现 Edge of Stability：损失先振荡再转入单调下降。本文推翻了「过渡时间上界与 η 无关」的猜想，证明对任意固定样本数 n≥2 且 margin γ 足够小，最坏情形过渡时间为 Θ((logη)^{min{n-2,d-2}})，且对所有 d≥2 一致成立。
Motivation: 已有工作只在 d=2、η→∞ 时给出紧的 Θ(1) 界，并猜想任意维度 d≥2 下过渡时间与 η 无关；该猜想若成立会把 Edge of Stability 的过渡时长视为与步长解耦的常数。
Method: 核心难点是贡献梯度最大的样本会随迭代反复更换；作者用对维度和样本数的双重归纳控制这种更换，并构造与上界匹配的困难实例 (matching hard instances)。
Result: 对每个固定 n≥2 与足够小的 margin γ，最坏情形过渡时间为 Θ((logη)^{min{n-2,d-2}})，在所有 d≥2 上一致；该结果否定 η 无关的猜想，并将 d=2 的已知 Θ(1) 界纳入 min{n-2,d-2}=0 的情形。
Conclusion: 过渡时间的 η 依赖不可去除，其对数指数由样本数与维度中较小者决定；紧界必须同时处理梯度主导样本的切换并配以匹配的困难构造。
