papers.title: Rethinking Probability-Based Reinforcement Learning From Posterior Concentration
papers.abstract_en: Verifier-free reinforcement learning with probability-based rewards offers a promising way to train LLMs on general reasoning tasks where external verifiers are unavailable. Yet the reliability of these rewards, especially in long-horizon reasoning, remains underexplored. This work identifies a length-dependent failure mode of probability rewards, which we call the Posterior Concentration Phenomenon (PCP). We show that the probability of a reference answer conditioned on a reasoning trace often collapses to a low-variance interval as the trace becomes lengthy. This phenomenon results in nearly indistinguishable rewards, which, under GRPO-based settings, makes probability-based policy optimization unstable and inefficient. Motivated by this, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Concentration-aware Posterior Rewards (RLCPR), a verifier-free RL framework to explicitly account for PCP for better optimization stability and token efficiency. It has two components: uncertainty-aware data sampling, which reduces concentration-prone rollouts before generation, and concentration-aware regularization, which penalizes unnecessarily long traces when posterior rewards collapse. Extensive experiments show that, alongside higher token efficiency, RLCPR outperforms the state-of-the-art verifier-free RL baseline by up to 4.0% on six of seven benchmarks, including general-domain and mathematical reasoning challenges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 概率奖励在长推理轨迹上会出现后验集中现象 (Posterior Concentration Phenomenon, PCP)：参考答案在给定轨迹下的概率塌缩到低方差区间，奖励几乎不可区分，使 GRPO 类策略优化不稳且费 token。据此提出 verifier-free 框架 RLCPR，用不确定性感知采样剔除易集中轨迹、用集中感知正则惩罚过长轨迹，在七个基准中的六个上比 SOTA verifier-free RL 基线最高提升 4.0%。
Motivation: 无外部 verifier 时用概率作为奖励训练 LLM 推理是可行路径，但长程推理下这种奖励的可靠性研究不足，奖励不可区分会直接破坏 GRPO 优化的稳定性与 token 效率。
Method: RLCPR 含两个组件：uncertainty-aware data sampling 在生成前剔除易发生后验集中的 rollout；concentration-aware regularization 在后验奖励塌缩时惩罚不必要的长轨迹，以改善优化稳定性与 token 效率。
Result: 在七个基准（含通用域与数学推理）中的六个上，RLCPR 相对 SOTA verifier-free RL 基线最高提升 4.0%，同时 token 效率更高。
Conclusion: 概率奖励的长度依赖失效（PCP）是 verifier-free RL 的真实瓶颈，显式建模后验集中可以同时改善奖励可分性、优化稳定性与 token 效率。

papers.title: Streaming algorithms for robust max-min diversification
papers.abstract_en: Given a set of $n$ points $X$ in a metric space and an integer $k$, max-min diversification aims to select $k$ points of $X$ maximizing their minimum pairwise distance. This objective function is however highly vulnerable to noisy points. In[Amagata, AAAI23], a robust formulation is proposed which addresses this vulnerability by excluding solutions containing any of $z$ outliers, defined as the $z$ points in $X$ with the largest nearest-neighbor distances. That paper also presents a coreset-based streaming algorithm for the new formulation, based on a suitable inlier-outlier separation assumption. However, we identify three shortcomings in the algorithm by [Amagata, AAAI23]: its coreset construction requires an offline computation over $X$, which needs memory linear in $n$, in stark contrast with the typical goals of stream processing; the one-pass procedure used to extract the solution from the coreset may return fewer than $k$ points (hence, an unfeasible solution) because it permanently discards points too far from the current solution; and its outlier-exclusion guarantee is only probabilistic and weakens as the coreset size shrinks. In contrast, we present a deterministic coreset-based algorithm that, under a natural inlier-outlier separation assumption (similar to the one used in [Amagata, AAAI23]), returns exactly $k$ inliers which are a $(2+\varepsilon)$-approximate solution, for any $\varepsilon>0$, thus only $\varepsilon$ above the best polynomial-time sequential approximation, even without outliers. Its one-pass streaming implementation adapts obliviously to the dataset's doubling dimension $D$ and, for wide ranges of $k$, $z$, $\varepsilon$, and $D$, it uses memory independent of $n$. For sufficiently long streams, its amortized update time is proportional to the coreset size, thus also independent of $n$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对带 z 个离群点的 max-min 多样化流式选择问题，提出确定性 coreset 算法：在 inlier-outlier 分离假设下，单遍流式返回恰好 k 个 inlier 且为 (2+ε)-近似解，仅比无离群点时最好的多项式时间顺序近似高 ε。对宽范围的 k、z、ε 和 doubling dimension D，内存与 n 无关，长流的摊还更新时间正比于 coreset 大小。
Motivation: [Amagata, AAAI23] 的鲁棒化流式算法有三处缺陷：coreset 构造需对 X 做离线计算、内存随 n 线性增长；单遍抽取可能返回少于 k 个点的不可行解；离群点排除保证只是概率性的且随 coreset 缩小而变弱。
Method: 在与 Amagata AAAI23 类似的 inlier-outlier 分离假设下构造确定性 coreset，单遍流式抽取恰好 k 个 inlier 作为解；实现按数据集 doubling dimension D 自适应，摊还更新时间与 coreset 大小成正比。
Result: 返回恰好 k 个 inlier 且为 (2+ε)-近似（任意 ε>0），仅比无离群点时最好的多项式时间顺序近似高 ε；对宽范围的 k、z、ε、D 内存与 n 无关，长流摊还更新时间也与 n 无关。
Conclusion: 确定性 coreset 可以在单遍流式下同时保证可行解、逼近比与离群点排除，且内存开销摆脱对流长度 n 的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Repurposing Obsolete Representations for Post-Deployment Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks are increasingly deployed in long-lived systems, where task requirements may change after training. In such settings, part of the original output space may become obsolete: a class, prediction region, or learned behaviour may no longer be valid. Existing approaches either leave the obsolete behaviour intact or require fine-tuning, which can be expensive. We propose Deep Repurposing (DR), a post-hoc framework for adapting models under task obsolescence. DR estimates the latent geometry of obsolete and retained regions, removes obsolete-supporting components, and reallocates retained-compatible evidence through an analytic repair map without gradient updates. This yields repaired predictions and representations in which obsolete regions no longer act as valid outputs, while useful obsolete structure can support the retained task. Across multiple task settings, DR removes obsolete behaviour while preserving retained utility. More importantly, across classification benchmarks, DR matches or exceeds competing unlearning and editing baselines in retained accuracy, eliminates obsolete predictions, and adapts up to $60\times$ faster than competing unlearning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Deep Repurposing (DR)：在任务部署后部分输出空间失效时，估计失效区与保留区的潜空间几何，移除支撑失效输出的成分，再用解析修复映射把保留兼容证据重新分配，全程无梯度更新。在多个分类基准上，DR 保留精度匹配或超过遗忘与编辑基线，消除失效预测，且比竞争遗忘方法快至多 60 倍。
Motivation: 长期部署的深度网络在训练后任务需求会变，原输出空间中的类别、预测区域或行为可能失效；现有做法要么保留失效行为，要么依赖代价高昂的微调。
Method: DR 是一个 post-hoc 框架：估计失效区与保留区的潜空间几何 (latent geometry)，移除支撑失效输出的成分，再通过解析修复映射 (analytic repair map) 重新分配保留兼容证据，无需梯度更新，同时产出修复后的预测与表示。
Result: 在多个任务设置上，DR 移除失效行为同时保留保留任务效用；在多个分类基准上，DR 的保留精度匹配或超过竞争的遗忘 (unlearning) 与编辑 (editing) 基线，消除失效预测，并比竞争遗忘方法快至多 60 倍。
Conclusion: 任务失效可以在不微调的前提下用解析式潜空间修复处理：失效输出被清除，其有用结构仍可支撑保留任务，速度上比梯度式遗忘方法有数量级优势。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Guided Handshake: Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Refinement for Surgical-Grade Glioma Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: While state-of-the-art automated models for medical image segmentation achieve high mean performance, they frequently suffer from localized, catastrophic failures that preclude safe clinical deployment, particularly in neuro-oncology. Interactive segmentation frameworks mitigate this by incorporating human oversight, but traditionally impose prohibitive cognitive and temporal workloads by requiring clinicians to manually search for errors. In this project, we present an efficient, Hybrid Structural-Aleatoric Human-in-the-Loop framework for glioma segmentation that bridges the gap between automated baseline performance and surgical-grade precision, achieving sub-2.0 mm HD95 on curated benchmarks while providing safety-net routing for structural failures across real-world clinical data. By extracting voxel-wise Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) uncertainty and applying hierarchical topological filtering, our method proactively isolates high-risk structural anomalies. We comprehensively evaluated our approach on a challenging out-of-distribution clinical stress-test cohort (N = 362). Operating under a simulated Human Oracle, the framework improved the Whole Tumor (WT) Dice score from 0.891 to 0.914 and reduced the 95th percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95) from 5.82 mm to 4.76 mm. Critically for surgical safety, the system rescued severe boundary failures in the Tumor Core, reducing mean HD95 from 17.96 mm to 14.83 mm (improving absolute TC Dice to 0.356). These spatial rescues were achieved while demanding a median interactive workload of just 11.3% of the target volume. Acknowledging this as a simulated upper bound lacking real-world cognitive friction, the framework nevertheless demonstrates a highly Pareto-efficient pathway for safely deploying clinical AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向胶质瘤分割的 Hybrid Structural-Aleatoric Human-in-the-Loop 框架：用体素级 Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) 不确定度加层次拓扑过滤主动定位高风险结构异常，再路由给临床医生修正。在 N=362 的分布外临床压力测试队列、模拟 Human Oracle 下，Whole Tumor Dice 从 0.891 升到 0.914，HD95 从 5.82 mm 降到 4.76 mm，Tumor Core 平均 HD95 从 17.96 mm 降到 14.83 mm，中位交互工作量仅占目标体积的 11.3%。
Motivation: 自动分割模型平均性能高但会出现局部灾难性失败，传统交互式分割又要求医生手动搜寻错误，认知与时间成本过高，阻碍神经肿瘤学的安全部署。
Method: 提取体素级 TTA 不确定度，经层次拓扑过滤 (hierarchical topological filtering) 隔离高风险结构异常，把结构失败路由给人工修正（safety-net routing）；在模拟 Human Oracle 下评测，覆盖 curated benchmarks 与分布外临床压力测试队列。
Result: 在 N=362 的分布外临床压力测试队列、模拟 Human Oracle 下：Whole Tumor Dice 0.891 → 0.914，HD95 5.82 mm → 4.76 mm；Tumor Core 平均 HD95 17.96 mm → 14.83 mm，TC Dice 提升到 0.356；中位交互工作量为目标体积的 11.3%；curated benchmarks 上达到 sub-2.0 mm HD95。
Conclusion: 不确定度引导的人机协同可在极低交互工作量下把自动分割拉回手术级精度，是临床 AI 安全部署的高 Pareto 效率路径；作者明确该 Human Oracle 结果是缺少真实认知摩擦的模拟上界。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Personalized Health Checkup Interpretation and Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Personalized interpretation of health checkup results requires reasoning across longitudinal records, medical knowledge, lifestyle guidance, and healthcare navigation. We present a multi-agent large language model (LLM) system that identifies multiple intents, maps each to a task-specific agent, executes them in parallel, and synthesizes their outputs. We compared answers generated in Single Agent and Multi Agent settings on 120 Korean compound queries combining two to four requirements, using synthetic health checkup records. The Multi Agent improved the weighted LLM-judge score from 1.695 to 1.797 (p = 0.027), and three additional LLM judges showed consistent improvements ($Δ$ = +0.111 to +0.186, all p < 0.05). The gains came from usefulness, consistency, and the handling of every requirement in compound queries, whereas numerical accuracy and grounding improved significantly under only one of the four judges and medical safety did not differ, and critical failures occurred at similar rates (Single Agent 15.0% vs. Multi Agent 13.3%). Two human evaluators preferred Multi Agent in 66.7% and 68.3% of pairwise comparisons. Multi Agent execution increased latency and cost by 1.31$\times$ and 2.02$\times$, respectively. In exploratory subgroup analyses, the improvement was concentrated in queries involving personal-record lookup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多智能体 LLM 体检解读框架：先识别复合查询中的多个意图，各自路由到专用 agent 并行执行，再综合输出。在 120 条韩语复合查询上，加权 LLM-judge 分数由 1.695 升至 1.797（p=0.027），但代价是延迟 1.31×、成本 2.02×，且医疗安全与严重失败率无显著差异。
Motivation: 个性化体检解读需同时跨纵向记录、医学知识、生活方式与就医导航推理，单一 agent 处理含 2–4 项要求的复合查询时容易漏掉其中某些要求。
Method: 多智能体 LLM 系统：多意图识别后按任务映射到专用 agent，并行执行再综合；在 120 条含 2–4 项要求的韩语复合查询与合成体检记录上，对比 Single Agent 与 Multi Agent，用 4 个 LLM judge 加权评分并做 2 人 pairwise 人评。
Result: 加权 LLM-judge 分数 1.695 → 1.797（p=0.027）；另 3 个 judge 一致提升（Δ=+0.111 至 +0.186，均 p<0.05）。提升集中在有用性、一致性与复合查询各项要求的覆盖；数值准确性与 grounding 仅 1/4 个 judge 显著改善，医疗安全无差异；严重失败率 15.0% vs 13.3%。人评偏好 Multi Agent 66.7% 与 68.3%；延迟 1.31×、成本 2.02×；增益集中于涉及个人记录检索的查询。
Conclusion: 多智能体分工能显著提升复合体检查询的覆盖与有用性，但需以约 2 倍成本与 1.3 倍延迟换取，且医疗安全与严重失败未见改善。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: On skew-symmetric distributions and their use in Monte Carlo sampling algorithms: coordinate-free, Gibbs-style and manifold versions of the Barker proposal
papers.abstract_en: Skew-symmetric probability distributions provide a principled mechanism for incorporating gradient information into Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms. Here we review the (preconditioned) Barker proposal, a Metropolis--Hastings algorithm built on skew-symmetric distributions, and motivate its design. We then introduce three natural extensions. First, we propose coordinate-free variants of the Barker algorithm. Second, we introduce a Gibbs-style Barker algorithm that re-evaluates the gradient at each partially updated coordinate. Third, we derive a simplified manifold Barker algorithm, producing a manifold sampler with enhanced robustness compared to natural comparators. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the Gibbs-style variant improves raw sampling efficiency on correlated targets, that the coordinate-free variants offer limited practical advantage over the standard Barker proposal once computational costs are accounted for, and that the simplified manifold Barker algorithm can achieve significant advantages over simplified manifold MALA when the local geometric structure of the target is irregular or unreliable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统整理基于偏对称分布 (skew-symmetric distribution) 的 Barker proposal，并提出三种扩展：无坐标 (coordinate-free) 变体、每更新一个坐标就重算梯度的 Gibbs-style Barker、以及简化版 manifold Barker。数值实验显示 Gibbs-style 变体在相关目标上提升原始采样效率；无坐标变体计入计算开销后优势有限；简化 manifold Barker 在局部几何不规则或不可靠时显著优于简化 manifold MALA。
Motivation: Barker proposal 及其流形变体在目标分布局部几何不规则时的稳健性与效率尚不清楚，且现有形式依赖坐标选择。
Method: 回顾 (preconditioned) Barker proposal 这一基于偏对称分布的 Metropolis--Hastings 算法，提出无坐标变体、每坐标部分更新后重算梯度的 Gibbs-style Barker，以及简化 manifold Barker 采样器，并与自然比较对象做数值对比。
Result: 数值实验表明：Gibbs-style 变体在相关目标上提高原始采样效率；无坐标变体在计入计算开销后相对标准 Barker proposal 实用优势有限；简化 manifold Barker 在目标局部几何结构不规则或不可靠时，相比简化 manifold MALA 取得显著优势。
Conclusion: 偏对称 Barker 框架可自然扩展到无坐标、Gibbs 式与流形版本；其中 Gibbs-style 与简化 manifold 版本在各自适用条件下带来实际收益，而无坐标化在算上开销后不划算。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 偏对称 Barker 框架可自然扩展到无坐标、Gibbs 式与流形版本；其中 Gibbs-style 与简化 manifold 版本在各自适用条件下带来实际收益，而无坐标化在算上开销后不划算。

papers.title: ibUMAP: Coherent and Scalable Field Evaluation for UMAP Optimization
papers.abstract_en: UMAP achieves scalable layout optimization through stochastic negative sampling. However, this stochasticity can lead to unstable embeddings across reruns and downstream reuse, as the estimated repulsive forces depend on the ordering of sampling events. We present ibUMAP, a coherent field-based alternative that evaluates attraction and repulsion from a shared embedding snapshot and applies them synchronously. Its degree-weighted repulsive field is motivated by the conditional expectation of negative sampling for a fixed embedding and represented by three scalar moments, which are evaluated efficiently on CPUs and GPUs using an interpolation-based FFT scheme. This formulation avoids explicit all-pairs computations while inducing optimization dynamics that differ from those of standard online UMAP. Controlled experiments show that synchrony and kernel capping alter the local-global fidelity trade-off, whereas FFT evaluation produces small average changes in final quality. End-to-end benchmarks show median speedups of 3.29x unseeded and 5.79x seeded over umap-learn on CPU, and 1.44x over cuML on million-scale datasets under unseeded GPU execution. These gains accompany greater run-to-run stability and measurable fidelity trade-offs.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 11 figures, 18 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027. Code: https://github.com/Bachery/ibUMAP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ibUMAP 把 UMAP 的随机负采样换成基于同一嵌入快照同步评估吸引与排斥的场式目标，度数加权排斥场用三个标量矩表示并经插值 FFT 在 CPU/GPU 上求值，避免显式全对计算。在百万级数据集上相对 umap-learn 中位加速 3.29x（未设种子）与 5.79x（设种子），相对 cuML 1.44x，同时提升重复运行稳定性，但同步性与核截断会改变局部-全局保真度权衡。
Motivation: UMAP 的随机负采样使排斥力依赖采样事件顺序，导致重复运行与下游复用时嵌入不稳定，且全对计算在大规模数据上代价高。
Method: ibUMAP 在固定嵌入快照上同步评估吸引与排斥；度数加权排斥场源自固定嵌入下负采样的条件期望，表示为三个标量矩，用基于插值的 FFT 方案在 CPU 与 GPU 上高效求值，避免显式全对计算，其优化动力学不同于标准在线 UMAP。
Result: 端到端基准中位加速：相对 umap-learn 在 CPU 上未设种子 3.29x、设种子 5.79x；百万级数据集在未设种子 GPU 执行下相对 cuML 1.44x。受控实验显示同步性与核截断 (kernel capping) 改变局部-全局保真度权衡，FFT 求值只带来最终质量的微小平均变化；加速同时伴随更好的重复运行稳定性与可测的保真度权衡。
Conclusion: 用共享快照的同步场式评估加 FFT 求值可以在保持可接受质量的同时大幅加速 UMAP 并提高重跑稳定性，代价是局部-全局保真度权衡被同步性与核截断改变。

papers.title: DRelay: Global Draft Context for Prefix-Aware Parallel Speculative Decoding Repair
papers.abstract_en: Parallel drafting reduces the drafting overhead of speculative decoding for large language models (LLMs), but its gains remain limited by the accepted prefix length. Even when the correct token is present in the candidate pool, a single early selection error prevents subsequent predictions from being used. We propose DRelay, which uses global information from the entire draft block to perform prefix-aware selective repair of candidate selections before target-model verification. DRelay bases its decisions on candidate correlations and the selected path: a global reader extracts predictive information across positions for each candidate. While a causal selector combines candidate-level information extracted by the global read with the tokens selected at preceding positions to determine whether the native choice at the current position is consistent with the global evidence and the selected prefix. It then decides whether to retain or replace the token, thereby repairing early errors and extending the accepted prefix. We further jointly train the draft backbone and the selector, combining candidate-support learning with a repair objective, while weighting the repair loss according to each block position's potential contribution to the consecutive accepted prefix. Across eight diverse benchmarks on an H800 GPU, DRelay consistently improves both average acceptance length and end-to-end decoding performance over DFlash, Domino, and DSpark. Under SGLang serving, DRelay improves average end-to-end speedup over DFlash, Domino, and DSpark by 14.7%-16.8%, 8.7%-9.3%, and 8.1%-9.3%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRelay 针对并行投机解码 (speculative decoding) 中接受前缀被早期选错 token 截断的问题，在目标模型验证前用全局草稿块信息做前缀感知的选择性修复：global reader 跨位置提取候选预测信息，causal selector 结合前缀已选 token 判断当前原生选择是否与全局证据一致，决定保留或替换。在 H800 上八个 benchmark 中，相对 DFlash 端到端加速提升 14.7%-16.8%，相对 Domino 提升 8.7%-9.3%，相对 DSpark 提升 8.1%-9.3%。
Motivation: 并行 drafting 降低了投机解码的起草开销，但收益受可接受前缀长度限制：即使正确 token 已在候选池中，一次早期选择错误也会让后续预测全部作废。
Method: global reader 对每个候选跨草稿块位置提取预测信息；causal selector 融合该全局信息与前序位置已选 token，判断当前原生选择是否与全局证据和已选前缀一致，从而保留或替换 token。草稿主干与 selector 联合训练，损失为 candidate-support 学习加修复目标，并按各块位置对连续接受前缀的潜在贡献加权修复损失。
Result: 在 H800 GPU 上的八个多样 benchmark 中，DRelay 在平均接受长度与端到端解码性能上均稳定优于 DFlash、Domino、DSpark；SGLang 服务下端到端平均加速相对 DFlash 提升 14.7%-16.8%，相对 Domino 提升 8.7%-9.3%，相对 DSpark 提升 8.1%-9.3%。
Conclusion: 用整个草稿块的全局证据在验证前修复早期选择错误，可以延长连续接受前缀，从而在并行投机解码上取得稳定的端到端加速。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Impact of Processing Parameters on High-Accuracy Measurements in UAV Photogrammetry
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry is increasingly used in applications requiring high accuracy, such as determining ground surface changes caused by landslides, mining, or microrelief transformation. While acquisition strategies have been widely studied, the influence of the processing workflow-particularly Bundle Block Adjustment parameter settings-remains insufficiently explored. This study addresses this gap through a systematic, full-factorial evaluation of 768 processing variants applied to ten UAV datasets collected over 1.5 years in a 220 ha study area. Eight key parameters were analysed. The results show substantial variability in final 3D accuracy: the best performing variant achieved a root mean square error (RMSE) of 16 mm, whereas the weakest reached 303 mm. The most influential factors were the number of ground control points, the application of additional camera calibration corrections, and the use of the Post-Processing Kinematic GNSS method for determining camera projection center coordinates. The study also evaluates how workflow optimization affects the accuracy of displacement, tilt changes, and horizontal strain determination. While random displacement errors remained stable (RMSE of ~6-7 mm), systematic errors were significantly reduced by over half in all axes, with vertical median absolute error decreasing from 14 mm to 7 mm in the optimized configuration compared to the baseline previously used by the authors. This study provides the first large-scale, practice-oriented assessment of how processing parameter selection shapes the accuracy of both photogrammetric products and deformation indices determination. The results offer actionable guidance for developing more robust and repeatable UAV photogrammetry workflows tailored to high-precision monitoring.
papers.journal_ref: Measurement, Volume 265, 2026, 120315, ISSN 0263-2241
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 UAV 摄影测量处理流程做 768 种全因子组合评测，发现 Bundle Block Adjustment 参数选择使最终 3D 精度从 RMSE 16 mm 拉到 303 mm；影响最大的三个因素是地面控制点数量、附加相机标定改正、以及用 Post-Processing Kinematic GNSS 确定投影中心坐标。按此优化后形变指标的系统误差在所有轴上减半以上，垂直中位绝对误差从 14 mm 降到 7 mm。
Motivation: UAV 摄影测量已用于滑坡、采矿和微地貌变化监测，但采集策略研究充分、处理流程尤其 BBA 参数设置的影响仍不清晰，导致高精度监测工作流难以复现。
Method: 对 10 组、跨越 1.5 年、覆盖 220 ha 研究区的 UAV 数据集做全因子实验，共 768 种处理变体，系统分析 8 个关键参数；除 3D 精度外还评估位移、倾斜变化与水平应变等形变指标的确定精度。
Result: 最优变体 RMSE 16 mm，最差 303 mm；最关键因素为地面控制点数量、附加相机标定改正与 PPK GNSS。随机位移误差保持稳定（RMSE 约 6–7 mm），而系统误差在所有轴上降低超过一半，垂直中位绝对误差由基线的 14 mm 降至优化配置的 7 mm。
Conclusion: 处理参数选择而非仅采集策略决定 UAV 摄影测量产品与形变指标的精度，按该评测结果配置工作流可获得更稳健、可复现的高精度监测流程。

papers.title: A Deterministic and Auditable AI Security Risk Assessment Framework with ATLAS Aligned Executable Rules and Formal Verification
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence systems are increasingly deployed in high impact and safety critical settings, yet security assessment remains difficult to reproduce and defend under audit. Existing approaches often rely on narrative checklists or assessor driven scoring, and they lack an explicit, machine evaluable mapping from observable engineering artefacts to stable technique level outcomes. We present an evidence driven AI security assessment framework that operationalises assessment as a deterministic decision function. The framework normalises heterogeneous artefacts into a project independent Control ID taxonomy scored on a bounded four level ordinal scale, compiles technique level predicates from a pinned MITRE ATLAS snapshot via an explicit mitigation to control mapping, and outputs technique indexed feasibility and impact levels with traceable links back to the triggering evidence. We package all normative choices as a versioned assessment policy object to support repeatable reassessment across snapshots. To ensure semantic correctness, we formally verify boundedness, totality, ordered semantic consistency, and monotonicity of the compiled evaluator over the full declared score domain. We evaluate the framework on five public open source AI projects pinned to explicit repository snapshots, quantify before and after changes under a unified hardening intervention, and validate responsiveness to real engineering changes through fork based implementations of Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation and Continuous integration (CI) security scanning gates. Results show consistent downward shifts in feasibility profiles under strengthened observable controls, while worst case residual feasibility persists when technique specific core controls remain absent from the evidence scope.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把 AI 安全评估写成确定性决策函数的框架：把异构工程证据归一到项目无关的 Control ID 分类与四级有序评分，从固定的 MITRE ATLAS 快照编译技术级谓词，并形式化验证评估器的有界性、全定义性、有序语义一致性与单调性。在五个固定快照的开源 AI 项目上做统一加固干预，feasibility 分布一致下移，但当技术核心控制不在证据范围内时最坏残余 feasibility 依然存在。
Motivation: 现有 AI 安全评估依赖叙述性清单或评估者主观打分，缺少从可观测工程证据到稳定技术级结论的机器可判定映射，难以复现和通过审计。
Method: 把异构证据归一到项目无关的 Control ID 分类，用有界四级有序量表打分；从 pinned MITRE ATLAS 快照经显式 mitigation-to-control 映射编译技术级谓词，输出带证据回溯的 feasibility/impact 级别；所有规范性选择打包成版本化 assessment policy object，并对编译后的评估器在完整声明分数域上形式化验证 boundedness、totality、ordered semantic consistency 与 monotonicity。
Result: 在五个固定仓库快照的公开开源 AI 项目上评估，统一加固干预后 feasibility 分布一致下移；用 SBOM 生成与 CI 安全扫描门的 fork 实现检验对真实工程变更的响应性；当技术特定核心控制不在证据范围时，最坏残余 feasibility 持续存在。
Conclusion: 把评估固化为可版本化、可形式化验证的确定性函数，能在加固后稳定降低 feasibility，但结论受证据覆盖范围约束：核心控制缺失时残余风险不会消失。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distillation of Tabular Foundation Models into Efficient Predictors
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve strong predictive performance through in-context learning, yet repeatedly conditioning on labeled data makes inference expensive. Knowledge distillation can reduce this cost by transferring their predictive ability to lightweight, dataset-specific students. However, the dependence of TFM predictions on both a labeled context and a query introduces two design questions: how to construct teacher supervision and whether expanding query coverage improves distillation. We examine these questions across two TFMs and both neural and tree-based students, and derive an effective distillation recipe. The recipe uses the full labeled training set as teacher context and trains students solely on teacher predictions for observed and synthetic queries. On TabArena, the resulting students outperform their supervised trained tuned-and-ensembled counterparts by 57-98 Elo points. Applied unchanged to TALENT, the same recipe improves matched default students on 236-258 of 300 datasets and reduces median primary error by 4.0-6.4%. The distilled students also achieve median inference speedups of 3.0-21.6 times over their teachers, offering a practical trade-off between predictive performance and repeated inference cost. Code is available at https://github.com/nums-ai/TFM_Distillation .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 表格基础模型 (TFM) 推理需反复以带标签上下文为条件，成本高；本文给出蒸馏配方：用全部训练集作 teacher 上下文，仅以 teacher 对真实与合成 query 的预测训练学生。在 TabArena 上学生比监督训练并调参集成的对照高 57–98 Elo；原样迁到 TALENT，在 300 个数据集中的 236–258 个上改进默认学生，中位主误差降 4.0–6.4%，中位推理加速 3.0–21.6 倍。
Motivation: TFM 的 in-context learning 依赖反复以带标签数据为条件，推理昂贵；而 teacher 预测同时依赖 labeled context 与 query，使蒸馏的监督构造与 query 覆盖两个设计问题悬而未决。
Method: 在两个 TFM 与神经、树两类学生上系统检验两个设计问题并归纳配方：teacher 上下文取完整带标签训练集，学生只用 teacher 对观测 query 与合成 query 的预测训练；代码见 github.com/nums-ai/TFM_Distillation。
Result: TabArena 上蒸馏学生比监督训练的 tuned-and-ensembled 对照高 57–98 Elo；同一配方原样用于 TALENT，在 300 个数据集中的 236–258 个上改进 matched default 学生，中位主误差降低 4.0–6.4%；相对 teacher 中位推理加速 3.0–21.6 倍。
Conclusion: 以完整训练集为上下文、只用 teacher 预测（含合成 query）训练学生，是跨 TFM 与学生类型的通用蒸馏配方，可在提升预测表现的同时把重复推理成本降一个量级。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MWOP: Modality-aware Width-wise Operation Pruning for Efficient MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial inference costs when processing long visual-textual sequences. While existing operation compression methods exploit modality-level redundancy, they largely treat computation within attention heads and shared feed-forward network (FFN) channels as unified units, leaving finer-grained redundancy underexplored. We find that redundancy varies both across modality-interaction paths within the same attention head and across visual and textual executions of the same FFN channel. Based on these findings, we propose Modality-aware Width-wise Operation Pruning (MWOP), which independently prunes visual-to-visual (V2V), text-to-visual (T2V), and text-to-text (T2T) attention paths within each layer, and separately selects FFN channels for visual and textual inputs. A first-order Taylor criterion guides the pruning process, with FFN importance re-evaluated after attention pruning and LoRA-based recovery training. To translate the resulting fine-grained sparsity into practical acceleration, we further develop path-sparse Triton attention kernels and compact visual-side FFN execution. MWOP preserves the token sequence while reducing attention and FFN computation, making it complementary to token compression and enabling simultaneous reduction of sequence length and per-token computation. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B, MWOP alone achieves a $1.6\times$ prefill speedup with 99.7\% average performance retention across 12 benchmarks. Combined with two representative token compression methods, it further increases their prefill speedups from $2.0\times$ and $1.9\times$ to $2.9\times$ and $2.7\times$, respectively. Results on Qwen2.5-VL-7B further demonstrate its applicability across architectures. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/MWOP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MWOP 在 MLLM 的注意力与 FFN 内部按模态路径做细粒度宽度剪枝：同一注意力头内独立剪掉 V2V、T2V、T2T 路径，同一 FFN 通道对视觉与文本分别选留，用一阶 Taylor 准则定重要性并配 LoRA 恢复训练。在 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 上单独使用即取得 1.6× prefill 加速、12 个 benchmark 平均性能保留 99.7%；与两种 token 压缩方法叠加后 prefill 加速从 2.0×/1.9× 提到 2.9×/2.7×。
Motivation: 现有操作压缩方法只利用模态级冗余，把注意力头内部计算和共享 FFN 通道当作统一单元处理，同一头内不同模态交互路径、同一通道在视觉与文本执行上的差异性冗余未被利用。
Method: MWOP 在每层独立剪枝 visual-to-visual、text-to-visual、text-to-text 三条注意力路径，并为视觉与文本输入分别选择 FFN 通道；重要性由一阶 Taylor 判据给出，注意力剪枝后重新评估 FFN 重要性，再做 LoRA-based recovery training。为把细粒度稀疏转成实际加速，另配 path-sparse Triton attention kernels 与紧凑的视觉侧 FFN 执行，且保留 token 序列以与 token 压缩互补。
Result: LLaVA-OneVision-7B 上 MWOP 单独取得 1.6× prefill 加速、12 个 benchmark 平均性能保留 99.7%；与两种代表性 token 压缩方法组合后，其 prefill 加速分别由 2.0× 和 1.9× 提升到 2.9× 和 2.7×。Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上的结果进一步显示该方法跨架构适用。
Conclusion: 注意力路径与 FFN 通道层面的模态感知宽度剪枝能把序列长度压缩之外的每 token 计算也降下来，与 token 压缩正交叠加可同时缩短序列与减少单 token 开销。

papers.title: Learning ab initio phase-field models
papers.abstract_en: Simulating microstructure evolution requires quantum-mechanical accuracy and mesoscopic reach in length and time scales, a combination that no current method achieves. Classical phase-field models provide this reach, but their accuracy is limited by phenomenological free energies and mobilities. Here we develop a framework for learning ab initio phase-field models, where the mesoscopic equation is not postulated but derived from a Mori-Zwanzig projection of molecular dynamics onto species-density fields under explicit assumptions. The nonlocal free energy and mobility left unspecified by this equation are parametrized by neural networks and learned from short molecular dynamics trajectories generated with machine-learning interatomic potentials of ab initio accuracy. We demonstrate the framework on an iron-boron melt and on hydrogen-helium mixtures under planetary conditions. For iron-boron, the model shows that the melt at the FeB$_4$ composition is spinodally unstable at ambient pressure but stabilized at 10 GPa, offering a thermodynamic rationale for why FeB$_4$ has been synthesized only under high pressure. For hydrogen-helium, the model predicts the immiscibility boundary and captures droplet nucleation and growth in helium-rain simulations of a column corresponding to 2.2 million atoms, far beyond the scale of atomistic modeling at comparable accuracy. Trained across compositions and conditions, such models could provide a mesoscopic counterpart to ab initio molecular dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Mori-Zwanzig 投影把分子动力学约化到物种密度场，推导出非局部相场方程，再用神经网络参数化其中未定的自由能与迁移率，并从机器学习势 (MLIP) 生成的短 MD 轨迹中学习。在 FeB4 熔体中模型显示常压下自旋odal不稳定、10 GPa 下被稳定；在氢氦混合物中给出不互溶边界，并在含 220 万原子的氦雨柱中捕捉液滴成核与生长。
Motivation: 经典相场模型有介观尺度的 reach，但自由能与迁移率是唯象的，精度受限；现有方法无法同时做到量子精度与介观时空尺度。
Method: 在显式假设下对分子动力学做 Mori-Zwanzig 投影到物种密度场，得到介观方程；方程中未定的非局部自由能与迁移率用神经网络参数化，从 MLIP 生成的 ab initio 精度短 MD 轨迹中学习，在 FeB4 熔体与行星条件氢氦混合物上示范。
Result: FeB4 组成的熔体在常压自旋odal不稳定、10 G FeB4 ... (truncated)
Conclusion: 介观方程可以从 MD 推导而非假设，未定项用 ab initio 精度 MD 学习；跨组分与条件训练后可作为 ab initio MD 的介观对应物。

papers.title: Generalization Is Stability, Not Accuracy: Multi-Axis Evaluation of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Generalization in large language models (LLMs) is the ability to produce consistent and semantically stable outputs when the same input is expressed in different ways. Existing work typically evaluates generalization through aggregate accuracy on a single prompt format, task, or set of variations, which conflates robustness with overall benchmark performance. In this work, we show generalization evaluation at the level of individual examples, across multiple input variants, and across different aspects of model behavior, focusing on variability rather than reducing performance to a score that can be improved through narrow training or other ways that obfuscate generalization evaluation. Following this view, we introduce the Stability-Aware Generalization Objective (SAGO), a framework that measures how much model behavior changes for the same input under different variations and benchmarks, capturing variability across several dimensions including generation consistency, internal activations, confidence, and response mirroring. We show that many commonly used models exhibit statistically significant and consistent generalization instability: no model generalizes uniformly, behavioral axes capture independent failure modes, and cross-dataset variation can reverse model rankings.
papers.comment: Accepted at the TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop: Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SAGO（Stability-Aware Generalization Objective），在单个样本层面、跨多种输入变体与多个行为轴（生成一致性、内部激活、置信度、响应镜像）度量同一输入的输出稳定性，而非聚合准确率。发现常用模型普遍存在统计显著且一致的泛化不稳定：没有模型均匀泛化，各行为轴捕捉相互独立的失败模式，跨数据集差异可逆转模型排名。
Motivation: 现有泛化评测用单一提示格式、任务或变体集合上的聚合准确率，把鲁棒性与基准整体表现混为一谈，且可被窄域训练抬高而掩盖真实泛化。
Method: SAGO 框架在单个样本层面度量同一输入在不同变体与基准下的行为变化，覆盖生成一致性、内部激活、置信度、响应镜像等多个维度，强调变异性而非可被刷分的总分。
Result: 常用模型表现出统计显著且一致的泛化不稳定；没有模型能均匀泛化；不同行为轴捕捉到相互独立的失败模式；跨数据集差异足以逆转模型排名。
Conclusion: 泛化应被当作稳定性而非准确率来评：单一聚合分数会掩盖失败模式，多轴、样本级的变异性评测才能给出可比较的模型排序。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Least-time Gradient Flow
papers.abstract_en: Prescribing the speed of gradient flow on the risk itself, by the dynamics $\dot w=-u(E(w))\nabla E(w)/\abs{\nabla E(w)}^{2}$, makes the risk $e(t)=E(w(t))$ obey $\dot e=-u(e)$ exactly, whatever the landscape~$E$; the time needed to reach zero risk from $e_0$ is $\int_0^{e_0}\dd e/u(e)$. Minimizing this time alone is ill posed, and we study the regularized problem $\inf\{\int_0^{e_0}(\tfrac\lambda2\abs{u'}^{2}+1/u)\,\dd e:\ u\in H^{1}(0,e_0),\ u\ge0,\ u(0)=0\}$, $λ>0$. We prove that the minimizer exists, is unique, and is a linearly scaled cycloid, and we show that the optimal rate behaves like $u^{*}(e)\sim(9/(2λ))^{1/3}e^{2/3}$ near zero risk: the exponent $2/3$ is the one found in \cite{betti2026holder} by a power-law ansatz, and it lies in the Hölder window $(\tfrac12,1)$ where the arrival is in finite time with vanishing weight speed. The proof follows the classical route: existence by the direct method, uniqueness by strict convexity, positivity of the minimizer away from the origin, and the explicit integration of the Euler-Lagrange equation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把梯度流速度直接定义在风险值上，使风险演化严格满足 ė=-u(e)，与损失曲面 E 的形状无关；对正则化目标 inf∫(λ/2|u'|²+1/u)de 证明最优速率存在唯一且为线性缩放的 cycloid，零风险附近 u*(e)~(9/(2λ))^{1/3}e^{2/3}，指数 2/3 落在 Hölder 窗口 (1/2,1) 内，保证有限时间到达且权重速度趋零。
Motivation: 直接最小化到达零风险的时间是不适定问题，需要在时间最优与速率平滑之间引入正则化并求解最优控制。
Method: 令 ẇ=-u(E(w))∇E(w)/|∇E(w)|²，把风险轨迹方程化为 ė=-u(e)；在 H¹(0,e₀)、u≥0、u(0)=0 约束下最小化 ∫(λ/2|u'|²+1/u)de，用直接法证存在性、严格凸性证唯一性、排除原点外非正解并显式积分 Euler-Lagrange 方程。
Result: 最优速率存在且唯一，形状为线性缩放 cycloid；零风险附近 u*(e)~(9/(2λ))^{1/3}e^{2/3}，指数 2/3 与 power-law ansatz 结果一致并落在 Hölder 窗口 (1/2,1)，到达零风险时间有限且权重速度趋零。
Conclusion: 风险空间上正则化的 least-time 梯度流给出良定的最优收敛速率，其 2/3 指数由变分问题而非猜测得到。

papers.title: Why Does Train-Validation Separation Emerge? Update-Pressure Density Dynamics in Pretrained Backbones
papers.abstract_en: Train-validation separation is the evolving difference between performance on observed training examples and a finite held-out validation set. We propose a dynamic structural account of how this gap develops during adaptation of pretrained models: continued fitting can shift update demand from broadly reusable support toward narrower support with weaker held-out transfer. A conditional local model links this shift to increasing heterogeneity in gradient allocation and train-validation separation. Fixed training probes make this structural evolution observable without validation examples entering the readouts; held-out performance is used separately to evaluate its relation to the gap. In a constructed hierarchy implemented with a residual multilayer perceptron (ResMLP), increasing the target share of example-private features from $p=.3$ to $.5$ to $.7$, while preserving the relative mixture $1{:}2{:}3{:}4$ among the four shared feature levels, increases the final mean accuracy gap from $.185$ to $.331$ to $.527$ across five runs per condition. Masked-input losses measured separately on training and validation examples expose the corresponding transfer asymmetry. The natural language processing (NLP) analysis uses 10-epoch runs of RoBERTa, DeBERTa, and Qwen on six datasets (90 runs): the training-probe-weighted within-class and overall dispersion readouts each have positive raw and smoothed level correlations with the accuracy gap in all 90 runs. Raw changes paired at approximately one-epoch intervals remain positively associated in 86/90 and 87/90 runs, respectively. A 40-epoch ResNet-18 study tests both readouts on three vision datasets. Together, controlled simulation, NLP, and vision support the dynamic structural account across settings, with real-model evidence testing its observable predictions under the specified monitors.

TL;DR: 该文提出预训练模型适配中 train-validation gap 的动态结构解释：持续拟合会把更新需求从可复用支撑转向更窄、对 held-out 迁移更弱的支撑，从而拉大训练与验证性能差。在 ResMLP 构造层级中把 example-private 特征占比从 p=.3 提到 .5 再到 .7（四层共享特征比例保持 1:2:3:4），五次运行的最终平均准确率差距从 .185 升到 .331 再到 .527。
Motivation: train-validation 差距的成因缺少可检验的机制性解释：现有描述多停留在现象层面，无法说明适配过程中支撑结构如何演化并把 held-out 迁移削弱。
Method: 提出条件局部模型 (conditional local model)，把更新需求的转移与梯度分配异质性上升、train-validation 分离联系起来；用固定训练探针 (fixed training probes) 在不引入验证样本的前提下观测结构演化，held-out 表现单独用于评估其与差距的关系。实验分三块：ResMLP 构造层级、10-epoch 的 RoBERTa/DeBERTa/Qwen 六数据集共 90 次 NLP 运行、40-epoch ResNet-18 三个视觉数据集。
Result: ResMLP 中 example-private 特征占比 p=.3→.5→.7 时最终平均准确率差距 .185→.331→.527（每条件五次运行）。NLP 部分 90/90 次运行中，训练探针加权的类内与总体离散度读出与准确率差距的原始及平滑水平相关均为正；按约一 epoch 间隔配对的原始变化在 86/90 与 87/90 次运行中保持正相关。另有 40-epoch ResNet-18 在三个视觉数据集上检验这两个读出。
Conclusion: 受控模拟、NLP 与视觉三类设置共同支持这一动态结构解释：train-validation 差距源于更新需求向弱 held-out 迁移的窄支撑转移，训练探针读出可在验证样本不进入读出的情况下追踪该演化。

papers.title: SpikeMoE: Brain-Inspired Competitive Routing for Flexible Spiking Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) enable event-driven computation through biologically inspired dynamics at the neuronal scale, while Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) perform conditional computation through expert selection at the model scale. Integrating their strengths offers potential for flexible neural architectures. A key challenge, however, lies in designing an expert selection mechanism based on spiking activity. To address this, we introduce a spike-based k-WTA Router inspired by competition-inhibition observed in the hippocampal CA1 region. The router incorporates lateral inhibition and refractory period to select Top-K experts according to discrete spike counts. Building on this, we present SpikeMoE, a framework that integrates neuronal-scale spiking dynamics with model-scale expert selection. To address incomplete multisensory inputs in multimodal tasks, we further equip SpikeMoE with a two-stage missing-modality modeling module that combines empirical prototypes from an observed-modality pool with modality-specific learnable embeddings to construct missing-modality representations. Experiments on vision, language, and multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that SpikeMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance among the SNN baselines, matches or exceeds the performance of ANN counterparts, and maintains robustness across diverse missing-modality conditions. These results demonstrate a favorable trade-off between performance and energy efficiency, validating the integration of spiking dynamics with sparse expert computation and highlighting SpikeMoE as a promising approach to energy-efficient brain-inspired computing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpikeMoE 把 SNN 的神经元级脉冲动力学与 MoE 的模型级专家选择接在一起，用受海马 CA1 竞争抑制启发的 spike-based k-WTA Router，依据离散脉冲计数经侧向抑制与不应期选出 Top-K 专家。在视觉、语言与多模态基准上达到 SNN 基线中的 state-of-the-art，并在缺失模态条件下保持稳健。
Motivation: SNN 的事件驱动计算与 MoE 的条件计算分属神经元尺度和模型尺度，缺少基于脉冲活动的专家选择机制；多模态任务中输入模态不完整也使专家路由与表示构造同时失效。
Method: 提出 spike-based k-WTA Router，借侧向抑制与 refractory period 按离散脉冲计数做 Top-K 专家选择；SpikeMoE 框架将神经元级脉冲动力学与模型级专家选择整合；另加两阶段 missing-modality 模块，用 observed-modality pool 的经验原型 (empirical prototypes) 与模态专属可学习嵌入构造缺失模态表示。
Result: 在 vision、language、multimodal 基准上，SpikeMoE 取得 SNN 基线中的 state-of-the-art 性能，达到或超过 ANN 对应模型，并在多种缺失模态条件下保持稳健；摘要给出定性结论为性能与能效的有利权衡，未列具体数值。
Conclusion: 把脉冲动力学与稀疏专家计算结合可同时保住 SNN 的能效与 MoE 的表达力，缺失模态场景下靠原型加可学习嵌入即可维持稳健，SpikeMoE 被定位为节能类脑计算的可行路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Memory: Harnessing Long-Horizon Agents with Explicit Belief States
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can now undertake increasingly complex tasks, but the way they organize interaction history into memory does not ensure a coherent understanding of the current world. We introduce PoS, an inference-time framework that constructs and continually maintains explicit belief states as the agent's decision context. Each belief combines an estimate of the current world state with unresolved task requirements, making explicit what the agent still needs to learn and accomplish. To keep this belief reliable and actionable, PoS validates its consistency and monitors task progress to detect Belief Trapping, where the agent continues to act without making meaningful progress toward the goal. Recovery is then tailored to both the trapping pattern and the type of unresolved task requirement. Experiments on four benchmarks spanning execution and diagnosis show that PoS achieves the highest overall performance on every benchmark with all three LLM backbones. Ablations demonstrate the importance of consistency validation and recovery, while context-scaling experiments show resilience to context growth. Together, these results support belief construction and continual maintenance as a foundation for long-horizon context management beyond history retention and compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PoS 是一个推理时框架，为 LLM agent 显式构建并持续维护 belief state（当前世界状态估计 + 未解决的任务需求）作为决策上下文，而非依赖交互历史记忆。它通过一致性校验与任务进度监控检测 Belief Trapping（agent 持续行动却无实质进展），再按 trapping 模式与未解决需求类型定制恢复。在覆盖执行与诊断的四个基准上，PoS 在三种 LLM backbone 下均取得最高总体性能。
Motivation: LLM agent 把交互历史组织成记忆的方式无法保证对当前世界状态的连贯理解，长时程任务中容易在无进展的情况下继续行动。
Method: PoS 在推理时构建并持续维护显式 belief state，每个 belief 结合当前世界状态估计与未解决任务需求；用一致性校验和任务进度监控检测 Belief Trapping，并依据 trapping 模式与未解决需求类型定制恢复策略。
Result: 在覆盖执行与诊断的四个基准上，PoS 在全部四个基准、三种 LLM backbone 下均取得最高总体性能；消融实验显示一致性校验与恢复机制的重要性，context-scaling 实验显示其对上下文增长的韧性。
Conclusion: belief 的构建与持续维护可以作为长时程上下文管理的基础，超越单纯的历史保留与压缩。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Optimal Transport Meets Reinforcement Learning: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms frequently compare probability distributions, such as state visitation distributions induced by policies and experts, action distributions from learned policies and offline datasets, or transition distributions from learned models and environments. However, commonly used divergences may become ineffective when these distributions overlap weakly, which is frequently encountered in imitation learning, offline RL, and deployment under distribution shift. Optimal transport (OT) offers an alternative by measuring the cost of \emph{moving} probability mass from one distribution to another under a ground cost that encodes task geometry. This survey covers how OT is used inside RL objectives and algorithms. For each method, we identify: the role OT plays, the distributions compared, the OT formulation used, and the treatment of temporal structure. Beyond categorising existing methods, we discuss the motivations behind different OT choices, practical considerations such as cost design and computational challenges, and highlight open problems including scalable trajectory-level transport, principled handling of mass mismatch, and theoretical analysis for OT-regularised RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于最优传输 (OT) 如何进入强化学习目标与算法的综述：RL 中频繁比较状态访问分布、动作分布与转移分布，而常用散度在分布弱重叠时失效，OT 改用带任务几何的 ground cost 度量搬运概率质量的成本。综述按每个方法的 OT 角色、被比较的分布、OT 形式与时序结构处理方式分类，并指出可扩展的轨迹级传输、质量不匹配的有原则处理、OT 正则化 RL 的理论分析三个开放问题。
Motivation: 模仿学习、离线 RL 与分布偏移部署中，策略/专家状态访问分布、学习策略与离线数据集的动作分布往往弱重叠，此时常用散度失去梯度信号，需要一种按任务几何度量分布间搬运成本的替代。
Method: 综述性工作：对每种方法抽取四个维度——OT 在算法中的角色、被比较的分布、所用 OT 形式、时序结构的处理方式——建立分类框架；并讨论 ground cost 设计与计算开销等实践考量，以及轨迹级传输、质量不匹配、OT 正则化 RL 理论等开放问题。
Result: 作为综述给出分类与讨论而非实验数字：指出 OT 可替代在弱重叠分布上失效的散度，用于模仿学习、离线 RL 与分布偏移部署；列出三个开放问题——可扩展的轨迹级传输、有原则的质量不匹配处理、OT 正则化 RL 的理论分析。
Conclusion: OT 在 RL 中的价值取决于 cost 设计与时序结构处理，其规模化与理论保证仍是未解决问题。

papers.title: Localisation-Aware Uncertainty for Pretrained Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying object detectors when distribution/covariate shift and adversarial attacks may occur. Existing approaches often require detector retraining, architectural modification, or repeated inference, which may be infeasible or incur significant overheads. We introduce a lightweight post-hoc evidential meta-model that learns when object localisations should be considered uncertain while keeping the base detector frozen. Our approach automatically identifies localisation-relevant features and uses saliency-guided modification to construct an increasingly challenging curriculum. Detection-level targets combine localisation error, modification level, and prediction instability to guide an evidential meta-model to estimate uncertainty for each predicted bounding box. Our approach requires no changes to the detector and preserves its original localisation outputs. Across adversarial attacks and evaluated strengths, GRACE improves TP-FP AUROC by 22% relative to the strongest comparator in some cases while maintaining in-distribution detection performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GRACE：一种冻结检测器的后验 evidential 元模型，用显著性引导 (saliency-guided) 的渐进难化课程学习每个检测框何时应被判为不确定，无需重训或改结构。在对抗攻击与所评测强度下，GRACE 的 TP-FP AUROC 相对最强比较方法最高提升 22%，同时保持分布内检测性能。
Motivation: 分布/协变量偏移与对抗攻击下需要可靠的不确定性估计，但现有方法往往要求重训检测器、改结构或重复推理，开销大或不可行。
Method: 冻结基检测器，训练一个轻量后验 evidential 元模型：自动挑选与定位相关的特征，用显著性引导修改构造逐步升级的难化课程；检测级目标融合定位误差、修改强度与预测不稳定性，为每个预测框估计不确定性，且不改动检测器、保留原始定位输出。
Result: 在对抗攻击及所评测的攻击强度下，GRACE 相对最强比较方法在部分情形将 TP-FP AUROC 提升 22%，同时维持分布内 (in-distribution) 检测性能。
Conclusion: 不改检测器的后验 evidential 元模型即可在对抗条件下显著改善框级不确定性判别，且不牺牲原有检测表现。

papers.title: Smoother Flow Matching via Contrastive Trajectory Repulsion
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory crossing remains a critical bottleneck in Flow Matching (FM), and previous works typically view these crossings from a theoretical optimization perspective causing velocity averaging. They attempt to address it indirectly by post-hoc distillation or endpoint coupling, without explicitly regulating the intermediate trajectories. In this paper, we introduce a new network learning perspective: crossing points inherently induce large local Lipschitz constants in the target velocity field, leading to two drawbacks. First, high Lipschitz constants correspond to high-frequency signals in the velocity field that neural networks struggle to fit due to spectral bias. Second, they also imply drastic velocity variations, leading to severe numerical integration errors in few-step inference. To alleviate this, we propose CoFlow, a framework that introduces the contrastive learning paradigm into FM to explicitly repel trajectories during training, thereby lowering the local Lipschitz constants of the velocity field. Specifically, we formulate CoFlow from a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) perspective by injecting a repulsive drift term. This drift actively guides the forward process of positive samples away from negative trajectories, effectively reducing the local Lipschitz constant. Furthermore, we derive an equivalent stochastic interpolant formulation from this SDE, providing a simple and tractable design space to control the influence of negative samples. Extensive experiments on ImageNet 256x256 demonstrate that CoFlow significantly reduces FID compared to standard FM in few-step inference (e.g., 20 steps), with no added training overhead. The code can be accessed at: https://github.com/HKUST-LongGroup/CoFlow
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoFlow 把对比学习引入 Flow Matching，在训练中显式排斥交叉轨迹，从而压低速度场的局部 Lipschitz 常数。交叉点会带来大 Lipschitz 常数，既产生神经网络因 spectral bias 难以拟合的高频速度信号，又导致少步推理时剧烈的速度变化与数值积分误差；CoFlow 从 SDE 视角注入排斥漂移项，把正样本前向过程推离负轨迹。在 ImageNet 256x256 上，20 步少步推理的 FID 相对标准 FM 显著下降，且不增加训练开销。
Motivation: Flow Matching 中的轨迹交叉被既有工作从优化视角归因为 velocity averaging，只能靠事后蒸馏或 endpoint coupling 间接缓解，中间轨迹本身没有被显式调控；而交叉点造成的高 Lipschitz 常数同时损害少步推理的可拟合性与积分精度。
Method: 提出 CoFlow：把对比学习范式引入 FM，训练时显式排斥轨迹。具体从 SDE 视角构造带排斥漂移项 (repulsive drift) 的形式，使正样本的前向过程远离负轨迹以降低局部 Lipschitz 常数；并推导等价的 stochastic interpolant 形式，作为控制负样本影响强弱的设计空间。
Result: 在 ImageNet 256x256 上，CoFlow 在少步推理（如 20 步）时 FID 相比标准 FM 显著降低，且不引入额外训练开销。
Conclusion: 轨迹交叉可从网络学习视角重述为速度场局部 Lipschitz 常数过大，通过对比式轨迹排斥在训练中直接压低该常数，即可改善少步推理质量且不增加训练成本。

papers.title: Contrastive Attention Mitigates Spectral Bias in Spiking Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Transformers merge the energy-efficiency of spiking neural networks (SNNs) with the representational power of self-attention, creating a promising architecture for high-performance, energy-efficient computation. However, a performance gap persists versus its counterparts in artificial neural networks (ANNs). Unlike prior works attributing this to binary activations, we reveal that both spiking neurons and spiking self-attention (SSA) act as low-pass filters through multiscale spectral analysis. This characteristic leads to the dissipation of high-frequency components. To address this issue, we propose the Spiking Contrastive Attention (SCA) paradigm, which draw inspiration from the edge-detection and differential sensing properties of biological visual system. By extracting contrast prototypes via global contrastive aggregation and applying local differential refinement, SCA effectively enhances high-frequency information. Extensive experiments show that SCA is a general module that consistently boosts Spiking Transformers across image classification, semantic segmentation, and event-based tracking. Furthermore, it achieves lower complexity, offering superior efficiency over original SSA. These results establish its potential as a fundamental building block for energy-efficient Spiking Transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spiking Transformer 与 ANN 的性能差距源于脉冲神经元和 spiking self-attention (SSA) 都充当低通滤波器、耗散高频成分，而非此前归因的二值激活。提出的 Spiking Contrastive Attention (SCA) 用全局对比聚合提取对比原型、再做局部差分细化来增强高频信息，在图像分类、语义分割与事件跟踪上一致提升 Spiking Transformer，且复杂度低于原 SSA。
Motivation: Spiking Transformer 兼具 SNN 能效与自注意力表达力，但性能仍落后于 ANN；既有工作把差距归因于二值激活，本文认为真正机制是多尺度谱分析下神经元与 SSA 的低通特性导致高频信息耗散。
Method: 通过多尺度谱分析刻画脉冲神经元与 SSA 的低通行为；提出 Spiking Contrastive Attention (SCA)，借鉴生物视觉系统的边缘检测与差分感知，先做全局对比聚合 (global contrastive aggregation) 提取对比原型，再做局部差分细化 (local differential refinement) 补回高频，并作为通用模块接入 Spiking Transformer。
Result: SCA 作为通用模块在图像分类、语义分割、事件跟踪三类任务上一致提升 Spiking Transformer，且复杂度低于原始 SSA、效率更优；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 高频耗散是 Spiking Transformer 性能差距的根因，用对比注意力恢复高频即可跨任务提升并降低复杂度，SCA 可作为节能 Spiking Transformer 的基础构件。

papers.title: Reusing Past Samples in Proximal Policy Optimization: When and How Does It Help?
papers.abstract_en: Among on-policy deep reinforcement learning methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has become the de facto standard, due to its consistently strong empirical performance across diverse application domains. However, on-policy methods are inherently sample inefficient: fresh data collected under the current policy is used for just a few updates before being discarded. Off-policy methods avoid this inefficiency via experience replay, achieving notable sample efficiency gains, but at the cost of training instabilities or extensive tuning. This motivated the rise of hybrid strategies that augment PPO with off-policy data reuse. Existing sample-reuse variants of PPO demonstrated improved sample efficiency over vanilla PPO, yet a systematic study of when reuse helps, in which scenarios, and to what extent remains missing. In this work, we study the effectiveness of sample reuse in PPO by instantiating two variants within a multiple importance weighting framework. Both retain the core PPO mechanics, reusing only samples from a window of recent iterations, thereby isolating the effect of data reuse from other factors. The variants, termed wPPO-U and wPPO-BH, employ vanilla importance weights or balance-heuristic-corrected ones, respectively. For both, we derive policy improvement lower bounds providing theoretical grounding for their respective losses. We use them to empirically study when and how data reuse improves sample efficiency or final performance of PPO across continuous control tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多重重要性加权 (multiple importance weighting) 框架下实例化两个 PPO 样本复用变体 wPPO-U 与 wPPO-BH，只复用最近若干次迭代窗口内的样本，从而把数据复用本身的作用与其他因素隔离。两者都推导出策略改进下界作为损失的理论依据，并在连续控制任务上实证考察复用何时、在何种程度上提升 PPO 的样本效率或最终性能。
Motivation: PPO 作为 on-policy 方法样本效率低，数据用几次即丢；现有复用变体虽优于 vanilla PPO，但缺少关于复用何时有效、在哪些场景、幅度多大的系统研究。
Method: 在多重重要性加权框架下构造 wPPO-U（原始重要性权重）与 wPPO-BH（balance heuristic 校正权重）两个变体，保留 PPO 核心机制，仅复用最近迭代窗口内样本；并为两者损失推导策略改进下界 (policy improvement lower bounds)。
Result: 在连续控制任务上实证研究数据复用对 PPO 样本效率与最终性能的影响；摘要给出的是研究设计与理论下界，未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 样本复用对 PPO 的收益可在隔离复用效应的框架下、配合策略改进下界来系统刻画，其效果取决于复用窗口与权重校正方式。

papers.title: AF-Muon: An AdamW-Free Muon Optimizer for Tied-Embedding Models
papers.abstract_en: Muon improves large-scale training by applying a spectral-norm steepest-descent update to matrix parameters, but practical models also contain parameter blocks that do not fit dense-matrix geometry. One important case is the tied vocabulary table, which appears in language models and other token generators and can receive multiple structurally different gradient sources, from sparse input lookups to dense output-classifier updates. In the reference recipe these blocks are handed to an auxiliary AdamW optimizer, which restores second-moment state and updates the aliased table as a generic tensor. We propose AF-Muon, an AdamW-free extension of Muon that keeps the Muon matrix update for hidden weight matrices while using a support-aware finite-cap linear minimization oracle for tied vocabulary tables and an RMS-normalized update for one-dimensional auxiliary parameters. AF-Muon therefore trains every parameter class with a single first-moment buffer and no second-moment state, saving around 20% optimizer-state memory relative to Hybrid Muon in our benchmark. Across nine tied-token settings - decoder-only language models from 124M to 1B parameters, a fully shared T5-style encoder-decoder, and ImageGPT-style image-token, protein, and sparse-MoE variants, spanning text, image, and protein-sequence data - AF-Muon improves mean validation loss and perplexity over both Hybrid Muon and a SCION-style Sign endpoint. Long-horizon runs and hyperparameter sensitivity studies confirm the gain is robust, and identical-momentum diagnostics attribute it to the finite cap, which preserves more within-row magnitude than Sign while bounding the coordinate concentration of row-RMS. These results identify tied vocabulary tables as a distinct optimizer geometry and yield a robust AdamW-free Muon variant across models, modalities, and architectures, with about 1% step-time overhead in matched training.
papers.comment: 63 pages, 19 figures. An earlier, shorter version of this work was accepted as a poster at the OPT 2026 workshop (Optimization for Machine Learning) at NeurIPS 2026; this is the complete version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AF-Muon 用 support-aware finite-cap 线性最小化 oracle 处理 tied vocabulary table、用 RMS 归一化更新一维辅助参数，从而在不引入 AdamW 的情况下训练全部参数类。在九个 tied-token 设置（124M–1B decoder-only LM、共享 T5 式 encoder-decoder、ImageGPT 式图像/蛋白/sparse-MoE 变体）上，其平均验证损失与困惑度均优于 Hybrid Muon 和 SCION 式 Sign 端点，优化器状态内存省约 20%，步时开销约 1%。
Motivation: Muon 的谱范数最速下降只适用于稠密矩阵参数，而 tied vocabulary table 同时接收稀疏输入查表与稠密输出分类器两类结构不同的梯度，参考配方只能把它交给辅助 AdamW，重新引入二阶矩状态。
Method: 隐藏权重矩阵保留 Muon 矩阵更新；tied vocabulary table 改用 support-aware finite-cap 线性最小化 oracle (LMO)；一维辅助参数用 RMS 归一化更新。全部参数类只用一个一阶矩缓冲、无二阶矩状态，并与 Hybrid Muon 及 SCION 式 Sign 端点在相同动量下做诊断对比。
Result: 在九个 tied-token 设置（124M 到 1B 参数 decoder-only LM、完全共享的 T5 式 encoder-decoder、ImageGPT 式图像 token、蛋白与 sparse-MoE 变体，覆盖文本、图像与蛋白序列数据）上，AF-Muon 的平均验证损失与困惑度均优于 Hybrid Muon 和 Sign 端点；相对 Hybrid Muon 节省约 20% 优化器状态内存，匹配训练下步时开销约 1%。长程训练与超参敏感性研究确认增益稳健，identical-momentum 诊断把增益归因于 finite cap：比 Sign 保留更多行内幅度，同时约束 row-RMS 的坐标集中度。
Conclusion: tied vocabulary table 应被视为一种独立的优化器几何，用 finite-cap LMO 加 RMS 更新即可在跨模型、模态与架构的场景下稳健地摆脱 AdamW。

papers.title: LLM-Assisted Discovery of Typed Semantic Links for Ontology Network Construction
papers.abstract_en: Constructing typed, justified semantic links between ontologies is essential for enabling interoperability across heterogeneous and interdisciplinary knowledge domains. However, manually curating such links is difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end framework for ontology network construction that automates the discovery and generation of both intra-domain and inter-domain relationships. Our approach combines domain-adapted DistilBERT embeddings for dense contextual representation, clustering-based pre-filtering to reduce the candidate search space, and GPT-4o-driven relationship generation via iterative prompt engineering to produce semantically rich, interpretable links. Applied to ReproduceMeON - a network of 33 ontologies spanning machine learning, microscopy, computational science, and experimental workflow - the pipeline reduces approximately 800k raw concept pairs to 95k high-quality candidates. Human expert validation of 429 generated relationships by two independent annotators yields an overall precision of 80.19% (91.49% on high-certainty annotations) and an F1 of 0.890, with substantial inter-annotator agreement. Comparative experiments against five similarity-based baselines, including Sentence-BERT, show a substantial performance gap (best baseline F1 = 0.581), while an ablation study demonstrates that similarity-based methods alone fail to discriminate valid from invalid relationships (AUC approx 0.5) on the filtered candidate set. These findings highlight the necessity of LLM-based reasoning over concept roles and domain semantics for accurate relationship construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出端到端本体网络构建框架：用领域适配的 DistilBERT 嵌入加聚类预筛压缩候选空间，再由 GPT-4o 迭代提示生成有类型、可解释的语义关系。在 ReproduceMeON（33 个本体）上把约 80 万概念对压到 9.5 万候选，429 条关系的人工验证精度 80.19%、F1 0.890，而五个相似度基线最佳 F1 仅 0.581。
Motivation: 异构与跨学科本体之间的类型化、有依据语义链接靠人工梳理无法规模化，而单纯相似度方法难以区分有效与无效关系。
Method: 流水线组合三部分：领域适配 DistilBERT 嵌入做稠密上下文表示，聚类预筛缩小候选搜索空间，GPT-4o 经迭代提示工程生成关系；在 ReproduceMeON 上运行，并与含 Sentence-BERT 在内的五个相似度基线对比、做消融。

papers.title: AiSearch: Interactive Multi-Modal Search with VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Modern retrieval systems must both be automated and interactive, allowing users to search and refine results in real time. We present AiSearch, a flexible multimodal retrieval framework that leverages the zero shot capabilities of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for natural language search over images and videos. AiSearch supports interactive search refinement through user feedback to tailor results to the user's intent, and allows visual benchmarking across multiple VLMs, enabling users to select the most suitable model for their task.
papers.comment: The demo paper with 1 page main paper, 7 pages supplementary material accepted and presented in ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AiSearch 是一个用 Vision Language Model (VLM) 零样本能力做图像与视频自然语言检索的多模态搜索框架，支持用户通过反馈交互式细化检索结果，并可在多个 VLM 之间做可视化基准对比以挑选适配任务的模型。
Motivation: 现代检索系统需要同时做到自动化与可交互，用户要在实时检索中不断细化意图，而单一 VLM 难以适配不同任务。
Method: 利用 VLM 的零样本能力对图像和视频做自然语言搜索；通过用户反馈支持交互式检索细化以贴合用户意图；提供跨多个 VLM 的可视化基准对比，让用户选择最合适的模型。
Result: 摘要给出的是系统能力而非定量指标：支持零样本自然语言图像/视频检索、基于用户反馈的交互式细化，以及多 VLM 的可视化基准对比。
Conclusion: 把零样本 VLM 检索、交互式反馈细化和多模型基准对比整合进一个框架，可让用户按任务挑选最合适的 VLM。

papers.title: Supervising Sound Localization by In-the-wild Egomotion
papers.abstract_en: We present a method for learning binaural sound localization using egomotion as a supervisory signal. Over the course of a video, the cameras direction to a sound source will change as the camera moves. We train an audio model to predict sound directions that are consistent with visual estimates of camera motion, which we obtain using traditional methods from multi-view geometry. This provides a weak but plentiful form of supervision that we combine with traditional binaural cues. To evaluate this method, we propose a dataset of real-world audio-visual videos with egomotion. We show that our model can successfully learn from real-world data and that it performs well on sound localization tasks
papers.comment: CVPR 2025 Highlight (IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition)
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用视频中相机自身运动 (egomotion) 作为弱监督信号学习双耳声源定位：随相机移动，声源在画面中的方向会变化，模型预测的声向需与多视几何估计的相机运动一致。该信号与传统双耳线索结合，可在真实世界音视频数据上学会声源定位。
Motivation: 双耳声源定位缺少廉价、大规模的监督标签；真实录制中声源方向难以标注，需要一种不依赖人工标注的监督形式。
Method: 训练音频模型预测声源方向，使其与用传统多视几何 (multi-view geometry) 方法从视频得到的相机运动估计一致，作为弱但量大的监督，再与传统双耳线索 (binaural cues) 联合使用；并提出一个含真实世界带 egomotion 音视频的数据集用于评测。
Result: 模型能够从真实世界数据中学习，并在声源定位任务上表现良好；评测基于作者提出的含 egomotion 的真实音视频数据集。
Conclusion: 相机 egomotion 可作为双耳声源定位的有效弱监督来源，与传统双耳线索结合即可在真实数据上训练出可用的定位模型。

papers.title: Is it Possible to Generate Irreversible PolyProtected Templates from Face Embeddings using System-Specific Keys?
papers.abstract_en: This work aims to answer the question of whether it is possible to generate irreversible protected templates when the PolyProtect biometric template protection method is applied to face embeddings using system-specific keys (i.e., the same C and E parameters, which define the transform, are applied to all subjects' face embeddings), instead of the traditional subject-specific keys (i.e., each subject has their own C and E parameters). This is important for determining whether we can perform de-duplication of face identities in the PolyProtected domain, which is not possible in the subject-specific key scenario due to the clash with PolyProtect's unlinkability property (i.e., one could generate multiple protected templates belonging to the same identity, using different C and E parameters, such that those templates cannot be linked to each other). We present experiments (reproducible using our open-source code) to prove that there exist at least three ways of systematically selecting system-specific keys that produce irreversible PolyProtected templates: (i) from pre-selected subject-specific keys, (ii) by applying a previously proposed key selection algorithm to random vectors, and (iii) by approximating a "good" C/E pair distribution from which system-specific keys can be constructed. Our findings thus point to the conclusion that it is, indeed, possible to safely operate PolyProtect in the system-specific key scenario without degrading the template protection potential. This opens up the possibility for identity de-duplication in the PolyProtected domain.
papers.comment: Submitted to TIFS journal on 12 May 2026 (under review). Consists of: 13 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文回答生物特征模板保护中的一个可判定问题：PolyProtect 用于人脸 embedding 时，把原本逐人不同的 C/E 变换密钥换成全体受试者共用的 system-specific 密钥，能否仍生成不可逆的受保护模板。实验给出至少三种系统性选密钥的途径（由预选 subject-specific 密钥导出、对随机向量跑既有密钥选择算法、逼近“好”的 C/E 对分布），证明可以，从而在不削弱保护潜能的前提下让 PolyProtected 域内的人脸身份去重成为可能。
Motivation: PolyProtect 的不可链接性 (unlinkability) 与身份去重直接冲突：subject-specific 密钥下同一身份可用不同 C/E 生成多份互不可关联的模板，导致无法在受保护域内查重。需要判断换成 system-specific 密钥后模板是否仍不可逆。
Method: 在人脸 embedding 上应用 PolyProtect，将定义变换的 C、E 参数改为对所有受试者统一；给出三种选密钥方案：(i) 从预选的 subject-specific 密钥中选取，(ii) 对随机向量运行先前提出的密钥选择算法，(iii) 逼近一个“good” C/E 对分布再据此构造 system-specific 密钥。实验可用其开源代码复现。
Result: 实验表明至少存在三种系统性选取 system-specific 密钥的方式能产生不可逆的 PolyProtected 模板，对应上述 (i)(ii)(iii) 三条途径；结论是 system-specific 密钥场景下 PolyProtect 可安全运行且不劣化模板保护潜能。
Conclusion: PolyProtect 可以在 system-specific 密钥设置下保持不可逆保护，因此身份去重能够在 PolyProtected 域内实现，而不必牺牲模板保护属性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Robust Evidential Learning Through Latent Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for deploying deep learning models in high-stakes settings, where out-of-distribution and adversarial inputs can induce confident but unreliable predictions. Evidential Deep Learning provides efficient uncertainty estimates in a single forward pass, but can still assign high evidential strength to inputs that are poorly supported by the learned representation, such as adversarial inputs. We introduce CLEAR, a lightweight, task-agnostic post-hoc method that improves evidential robustness without retraining or altering the base prediction. Using held-out calibration data, CLEAR characterises the group-conditioned geometry of the model's latent space. At inference, it efficiently generates perturbation views directly in the latent space and measures their conflict relative to the calibrated geometry of the predicted group. High latent conflict indicates unsupported evidence, which CLEAR uses to selectively reduce evidential strength while retaining evidence for latent-consistent inputs. On ImageNet$\rightarrow$CUB, CLEAR improves OOD and adversarial AUROC by $+8.29$ and $+5.01$ while running 17.4$\times$ faster than competing post-hoc methods while preserving predictive performance across classification, regression, and object detection benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLEAR 是一种免重训的后验 (post-hoc) 方法：用留出校准数据刻画模型潜空间的分组条件几何，在推理时直接在潜空间生成扰动视图并度量其与预测组几何的冲突，冲突高即判定证据无支撑，选择性下调 evidential strength。在 ImageNet→CUB 上 OOD 与对抗 AUROC 分别提升 +8.29 与 +5.01，比同类后验方法快 17.4×，且在分类、回归、目标检测基准上保持预测性能。
Motivation: Evidential Deep Learning 单次前向就能给出不确定性，但对分布外与对抗输入仍会给出高 evidential strength 的自信错误预测，高风险部署中不可靠。
Method: CLEAR 为轻量、任务无关的后验方法，不重训也不改动基础预测：用留出校准数据刻画潜空间的 group-conditioned geometry，推理时在潜空间生成 perturbation views，度量其相对预测组已校准几何的 conflict，高冲突下调 evidential strength、对潜空间一致的输入保留证据。
Result: ImageNet→CUB 上 OOD AUROC +8.29、对抗 AUROC +5.01；比竞争的后验方法快 17.4×；在分类、回归、目标检测基准上保持预测性能。
Conclusion: 潜空间冲突度量可以在不重训、不改基础预测的前提下提升 evidential 鲁棒性，且后验开销低于同类方法。

papers.title: PRISM: A Category-Theoretic Framework for Measuring and Refining Multimodal Analogies
papers.abstract_en: Analogical reasoning involves identifying and preserving relational structures across domains. However, existing approaches to AI-driven multimodal analogy generation lack an interpretable measure of whether this structure is understood and maintained in the generated output. We address this gap with Pullback Refinement via Interpretable Structural Mapping (PRISM), a modality-agnostic framework for measuring and improving relational alignment in multimodal analogies, evaluated on visual metaphor generation. PRISM represents analogies as explicit relational mappings grounded in category theory and uses VLMs to instantiate these structures across modalities. Its first component, the pullback score, quantifies relational alignment from the resulting graph representation. On the AnaloBench benchmark, selecting the correct analogy purely by pullback score achieves 82.5% accuracy, demonstrating that the score captures meaningful relational information. PRISM's second component is an iterative refinement loop that uses the pullback score as an in-context feedback signal to iteratively revise the generated image towards greater relational depth. VLM-as-a-judge and human evaluations show that PRISM consistently improves metaphor consistency and analogy appropriateness over zero- shot generation, with human participants preferring the refined output in 57.65% of pairwise comparisons. However, a qualitative analysis reveals that refinement can favour visually crowded compositions rather than genuinely deeper relational correspondences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM 用范畴论把多模态类比表示成显式关系映射，pullback score 从图结构量化关系对齐，并作为 in-context 反馈信号驱动迭代改写。在 AnaloBench 上仅按 pullback score 选正确类比达 82.5% 准确率；人评在 57.65% 的成对比较中偏好精炼后的图像。但精炼可能偏向视觉拥挤的构图而非更深的关系对应。
Motivation: AI 多模态类比生成缺少可解释的度量来判断关系结构是否被理解并在输出中保持，无法定位生成结果在何处丢失关系对应。
Method: PRISM（Pullback Refinement via Interpretable Structural Mapping）是模态无关框架：用范畴论把类比表示为显式关系映射，由 VLM 在各模态实例化该结构；第一组件 pullback score 从图表示量化关系对齐，第二组件以该分数为 in-context 反馈信号迭代改写生成图像，评测任务为视觉隐喻生成。
Result: 在 AnaloBench 上仅凭 pullback score 选取正确类比达到 82.5% 准确率；VLM-as-a-judge 与人类评测显示 PRISM 相对 zero-shot 生成持续提升隐喻一致性与类比恰当性，人类受试者在 57.65% 的成对比较中偏好精炼输出。
Conclusion: pullback score 携带可用于排序选择的关系信息，迭代精炼能提升隐喻一致性；但精炼可能奖励视觉拥挤的构图而非真正更深的关系对应。

summary_sections.result: 在 AnaloBench 上仅凭 pullback score 选取正确类比达到 82.5% 准确率；VLM-as-a-judge 与人类评测显示 PRISM 相对 zero-shot 生成持续提升隐喻一致性与类比恰当性，人类受试者在 57.65% 的成对比较中偏好精炼输出。
summary_sections.conclusion: pullback score 携带可用于排序选择的关系信息，迭代精炼能提升隐喻一致性；但精炼可能奖励视觉拥挤的构图而非真正更深的关系对应。

papers.title: Gacha Decoding: Eliciting Diverse Generations Through Instruction Following
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Gacha Decoding, an inference-time method for eliciting diverse language model generations that scales with model capability. Across open-ended domains (in-the-wild chat, creative writing, planning for image generation, and protein design), Gacha Decoding significantly outperforms existing generation diversity approaches at equal quality (up to 2.4x Vendi over the next-best prior approach), reaching the same number of high-quality modes with over an order of magnitude fewer samples (11.0x) and discovering novel modes that no other approach surfaces. Our key insight is to treat diversity as an instruction-following problem: rather than relying on the LM's token entropy, we combine its instruction-following capability with randomness from an external RNG tool to scalably identify and realize distinct modes of the response space. This approach of "planning with dice" enables Gacha to invert the long-observed tension between diversity and model capability. As the underlying LM becomes a better instruction follower, diversity under Gacha Decoding consistently improves--even as its token entropy and diversity under prior approaches decline. Together, our results highlight that instruction following, rather than token entropy alone, can drive generation diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Gacha Decoding 是一种推理时多样性采样方法，把多样性当作指令遵循问题：结合模型的 instruction-following 能力与外部 RNG 工具的随机性来识别并实现响应空间的不同 mode，而非依赖 token 熵。在 in-the-wild chat、创意写作、图像生成规划与蛋白质设计上，同等质量下 Vendi 多样性最高达到次优方法的 2.4 倍，达到相同高质量 mode 数所需样本少 11.0 倍，并发现其他方法都未浮现的新 mode。
Motivation: 现有生成多样性方法依赖 token 熵，模型能力越强熵越低，多样性与能力之间长期存在此消彼长的张力。
Method: 推理时方法：不看 token 熵，而是把模型的指令遵循能力与外部 RNG 工具的随机性结合，通过“掷骰子式规划 (planning with dice)”在响应空间中逐个指定并实现不同 mode。
Result: 在四个开放域任务（in-the-wild chat、creative writing、planning for image generation、protein design）上，同等质量下 Vendi 多样性最高为次优既有方法的 2.4 倍；达到相同数量的高质量 mode 所需样本少一个数量级（11.0 倍）；发现其他方法均未浮现的新 mode。随底层 LM 指令遵循能力提升，Gacha 下的多样性持续上升，而其 token 熵与既有方法下的多样性反而下降。
Conclusion: 驱动生成多样性的是指令遵循能力而非 token 熵 alone，因此多样性与模型能力的长期张力可以被反转：模型越会听指令，Gacha Decoding 的多样性越高。

papers.title: SupraTITO: Transferable Generative Molecular Dynamics for Supramolecular Systems
papers.abstract_en: Peptide sequence governs both the structures formed through supramolecular assembly and the dynamics by which they emerge, but predicting either requires resolving slow collective processes among many interacting molecules. Molecular dynamics (MD) provides microscopic insight into these processes, yet the long timescales of assembly and the vast peptide sequence space make systematic exploration computationally demanding. We introduce SupraTITO, a transferable generative molecular dynamics (GenMD) framework for supramolecular systems, demonstrated through peptide self-assembly. SupraTITO learns transferable implicit transfer operators (TITO) conditioned on peptide sequence, molecular topology, and periodic geometry, allowing configurations to be propagated over physical intervals much longer than an MD integration step. On a comprehensive dipeptide benchmark, SupraTITO generalizes to held-out sequences and reproduces sequence-dependent structures and dynamics while maintaining molecular integrity over long rollouts. Compared with direct ensemble prediction trained on the same trajectory data, SupraTITO more accurately reproduces assembly structures while also resolving their temporal evolution. The learned dynamics generalize across peptide concentrations, including dilute conditions not represented during training. These results extend transferable GenMD to collective dynamics in periodic supramolecular systems and provide a foundation for modeling related processes beyond peptide assembly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SupraTITO 是面向超分子体系的可迁移生成式分子动力学 (transferable GenMD) 框架，以肽序列、分子拓扑与周期性几何为条件学习隐式迁移算子 (TITO)，把构型推进到远长于 MD 积分步的物理时间。在二肽基准上它泛化到留出序列、长 rollout 保持分子完整性，比同轨迹数据训练的直接集合预测更准地复现组装结构及其时间演化，并跨浓度（含训练未见的稀释条件）泛化。
Motivation: 肽自组装等超分子过程涉及多分子慢集体过程，MD 计算代价高，而肽序列空间巨大，难以系统探索；直接预测模型难以同时给出结构与时间演化。
Method: 提出 SupraTITO：以肽序列、分子拓扑和周期性几何为条件，学习可迁移的隐式迁移算子 (implicit transfer operators, TITO)，将构型按远长于 MD 积分步的物理时间间隔推进；在二肽基准上训练并测试留出序列与不同浓度。
Result: 在综合二肽基准上，SupraTITO 泛化到留出序列，复现序列依赖的结构与动力学，并在长 rollout 中保持分子完整性；与在相同轨迹数据上训练的直接集合预测 (direct ensemble prediction) 相比，更准确地复现组装结构并解析其时间演化；学到的动力学跨肽浓度泛化，包括训练中未出现的稀释条件。
Conclusion: 可迁移 GenMD 可以扩展到周期性超分子体系的集体动力学，为肽组装之外的相关过程提供建模基础。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Generation Provenance Before Behavior Attribution: Auditing Synthetic Speech Research Objects
papers.abstract_en: Attributing model behavior to synthetic training data requires knowing what produced each training item before estimating what that item caused. A waveform-label pair does not preserve this knowledge. We propose a generation-provenance substrate in which a synthetic research object binds source specification, generated content, waveform, target, fact requirements, quality signals, review lineage, and immutable manifest identity. Producer and selection mechanism determine evidentiary meaning; storage location and variable name do not. We audit this substrate in a private Japanese care-handoff pipeline. A 113-asset review population contains 1.552 hours of synthetic speech across six scenario families; all items have linked audio, transcripts, candidate notes, and fact checklists, but human evidence is selective and source-specific. Two faithful-only manifests are scenario-seed-disjoint and immutably versioned, while exact upstream attribution remains blocked by floating generator aliases, missing per-clip TTS and code stamps, and an unversioned checking prompt. We argue that generation provenance is necessary but not sufficient for behavior attribution: it defines the candidate causal graph and audit units, whereas contributive attribution still requires frozen training runs and intervention or influence evidence. The paper contributes a compact provenance contract, an audit protocol, and a bounded case study for synthetic-data attribution; controlled research access may be offered, but we do not claim causal training-data attribution, clinical validity, or unrestricted public release.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Third NeurIPS Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale: Data Attribution and Provenance. 4 pages, 0 figures, 1 table. An aggregate reproducibility package is available from the authors on request!
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出合成语音研究对象的生成溯源基底 (generation-provenance substrate)，把源规格、生成内容、波形、目标、事实要求、质量信号、评审谱系与不可变 manifest 身份绑定在同一对象上，并在日本照护交接 (care-handoff) 私有管线中审计该基底。审计发现溯源是行为归因的必要非充分条件：它定义候选因果图与审计单元，但上游归因仍被浮动生成器别名、缺失的逐条 TTS 与代码戳记、以及未版本化的检查 prompt 阻断。
Motivation: 把模型行为归因到合成训练数据前，必须先知道每条训练样本由什么产生；而波形-标签对并不保存这一知识，导致行为归因缺少可审计的因果图与审计单元。
Method: 提出生成溯源基底，将源规格、生成内容、波形、目标、事实要求、质量信号、评审谱系与不可变 manifest 身份绑定；产出紧凑的溯源契约 (provenance contract)、审计协议与有界案例研究，并在私有日语照护交接管线中审计，构建两份 faithful-only、场景-种子不相交且不可变版本化的 manifest。
Result: 审计对象为 113 个资产的评审总体，含 1.552 小时合成语音、覆盖六个场景族；所有条目都有关联音频、转写、候选笔记与事实清单，但人工证据是选择性且来源特定的。两份 faithful-only manifest 场景-种子不相交且不可变版本化；精确上游归因被浮动生成器别名、缺失的逐条 TTS 与代码戳记、以及未版本化的检查 prompt 阻断。
Conclusion: 生成溯源对行为归因必要但不充分：它定义候选因果图与审计单元，贡献性归因仍需冻结的训练运行与干预或影响证据；作者明确不主张因果训练数据归因、临床有效性或无限制公开发布。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Minimax Optimal Regret for Causal Logistic Bandits with Counterfactual Fairness
papers.abstract_en: We study causal logistic bandits with counterfactual fairness constraints. The causal structure is given through known factual and counterfactual feature maps that share an unknown logistic reward parameter, but the learner observes only factual rewards. Consequently, the directions determining counterfactual feasibility need not be identifiable from the available feedback. The closest prior analyses either omit a coverage condition or impose a comparatively strong one, and do not establish matching lower bounds. We first show that some coverage condition is necessary: without a coverage-type restriction, factually indistinguishable environments with different optimal fair actions force $Ω(T)$ expected joint loss. Under a weaker full-rank condition on the factual covariance pooled across actions, we identify a target-specific information scale $V_\star$ that measures the difficulty of estimating rewards and counterfactual effects from factual feedback. We construct worst-case families satisfying this condition on which every policy incurs expected joint loss $Ω\left(\left[V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}\right]^{1/3}T^{2/3}\right)$. We also give an explore--then--exploit procedure tuned using $V_\star$ and an adaptive algorithm that does not require its value. Both algorithms achieve $\max\{R_T,V_T\}=\widetilde{O}\left(\left[V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}\right]^{1/3}T^{2/3}+κd/σ_0^2\right)$, where $R_T$ is regret relative to the best fair action and $V_T$ denotes the cumulative stage-wise positive violations. Thus the upper and lower bounds match in their leading dependence on $T$, $V_\star$, and $\min\{\log K,d\}$, up to logarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在因果 logistic bandit 中加入反事实公平约束时，只有事实反馈可用，决定反事实可行性的方向可能不可辨识。作者证明没有 coverage 条件时存在事实不可区分但最优公平动作不同的环境，迫使期望联合损失 Ω(T)；在跨动作事实协方差的较弱满秩条件下，构造 explore-then-exploit 与自适应算法，使 regret 与违反量之和达到与下界匹配的 Õ([V⋆min{logK,d}]^{1/3}T^{2/3}+κd/σ₀²)。
Motivation: 反事实公平约束下决定可行性的方向无法从事实反馈辨识，已有分析要么省略 coverage 条件、要么条件过强，且缺少匹配下界。
Method: 定义跨动作事实协方差满秩条件下目标相关的信息尺度 V⋆；构造满足该条件的最坏情形环境族给出下界；提出用 V⋆ 调参的 explore-then-exploit 过程与一个不需要 V⋆ 值的自适应算法。
Result: 无 coverage 型限制时期望联合损失 Ω(T)；最坏情形族上任何策略的期望联合损失 Ω([V⋆min{logK,d}]^{1/3}T^{2/3})；两个算法均达 max{R_T,V_T}=Õ([V⋆min{logK,d}]^{1/3}T^{2/3}+κd/σ₀²)，上下界在 T、V⋆、min{logK,d} 的主项上仅差对数因子。
Conclusion: 某种 coverage 条件是必要的，且在较弱满秩条件下因果 logistic 公平 bandit 的 minimax regret 可达匹配（至对数因子）。
