papers.title: Action-On-Item Preference Flow: A Shared Event Schema for Predictive and Generative Personalization
papers.abstract_en: A user's movie, news, and dialogue histories differ in their native actions and outputs, yet each interaction supplies evidence that can update user memory. We study whether these histories can train one reusable update mechanism. An action-on-item schema pairs a mapped interaction role with a content embedding, allowing shared update parameters to operate on separate user states. We establish invariance to native relabeling, bounded state changes under item-embedding perturbations, and a pooled-training bound under explicit compatibility conditions. The Multi-Timescale State Hypothesis (MTSH) specifies how this evidence enters, persists, and is consumed; PerTIDE implements it with action gating, three state-space traces, fusion, and command-conditioned readout. On PENS, the same history encoder supports both next-news prediction and personalized headline generation. In a controlled PENS-to-MovieLens experiment, a frozen source-trained core exceeds an identically structured random core by 15.23 MRR points after fitting the same target consumer. On MIND, PerTIDE retains a 4.12-point MRR advantage over a same-input three-branch state-space control. Action, readout, and trace interventions identify complementary contributions to these gains. Together, the theory and experiments support learning history updates across compatible sources and reusing them through predictive and generative consumers.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Author-prepared archival version with expanded discussion and interpretation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 action-on-item 共享事件 schema，把交互角色映射与内容 embedding 配对，使同一套更新参数作用于电影、新闻、对话等不同原生动作的用户状态；理论给出原生重标记不变性、embedding 扰动下的状态变化界与兼容条件下的 pooled-training 界。在 PENS 上同一历史编码器同时支撑下一新闻预测与个性化标题生成，PENS→MovieLens 冻结源训练核心比同结构随机初始化核心高 15.23 MRR 点，MIND 上 PerTIDE 比同输入三分支 state-space 对照保留 4.12 点 MRR 优势。
Motivation: 用户在电影、新闻、对话中的交互原生动作与输出形式各异，各自的记忆更新机制无法复用；需要一个能跨来源训练、再被预测型与生成型消费者共用的更新机制。
Method: action-on-item schema 将映射后的交互角色与内容 embedding 配对，共享更新参数作用于分离的用户状态；Multi-Timescale State Hypothesis (MTSH) 规定证据如何进入、留存与被消费，PerTIDE 以 action gating、三条 state-space trace、fusion 和 command-conditioned readout 实现。配套给出原生重标记不变性、embedding 扰动下的状态变化界与显式兼容条件下的 pooled-training 界。
Result: PENS 上同一历史编码器同时支持下一新闻预测与个性化标题生成；受控 PENS-to-MovieLens 实验中，冻结的源训练核心在拟合同一目标 consumer 后比同结构随机核心高 15.23 MRR 点；MIND 上 PerTIDE 比同输入三分支 state-space 对照保持 4.12 点 MRR 优势；action、readout 与 trace 干预显示这些增益来源互补。
Conclusion: 理论与实验共同支持：跨兼容来源学习历史更新并由预测型与生成型 consumer 复用是可行的，增益由 action gating、readout 与 trace 三者互补贡献。

papers.title: Learning Commute-Time-Preserving World Models for Planning
papers.abstract_en: World models allow agents to plan in latent space by choosing a sequence of actions that most reduces the distance to a given goal state. Thus, planning can benefit from latent representations whose distances mirror commute-times in the environment. The spectral embedding space of the graph Laplacian provides such a representation, if it obeys a specific eigenvalue-dependent scaling. Unfortunately, instantiating the graph Laplacian is intractable in large, continuous environments. Self-supervised learning offers a natural route to such commute-time-preserving embeddings at scale. However, here we show that existing methods, which commonly encourage isotropic representations to prevent representational collapse, tend to degrade the "correct" eigenvalue-dependent scaling, leading to an inaccurate representation of commute times. To address this problem, we introduce Commute-Time-Preserving World Models (CTWMs), combining a latent displacement predictor and a log-determinant regularizer that prevents collapse, which provably recover the correctly scaled Laplacian representation under reversible deterministic dynamics and at the predictor's fixed point. In numerical simulations, CTWM matches or outperforms LeWM, a task-agnostic baseline, on several complex, continuous goal-reaching benchmarks, while using half the parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Commute-Time-Preserving World Model (CTWM)，用潜空间位移预测器加 log-determinant 防坍缩正则，在可逆确定性动力学与预测器不动点处可证明恢复按特征值正确缩放的图拉普拉斯谱嵌入，使潜距离对应环境的 commute time。数值仿真中在多个复杂连续 goal-reaching 基准上匹配或超过 LeWM，参数量只有一半。
Motivation: 世界模型靠潜空间距离做规划，需要距离反映 commute time，但图拉普拉斯在大型连续环境中无法显式构造；现有自监督方法为防表示坍缩而鼓励各向同性表示，反而破坏了正确的特征值缩放，使 commute time 表示失真。
Method: CTWM 组合一个潜空间位移预测器 (latent displacement predictor) 与一个 log-determinant 正则项：前者在不动点处逼近拉普拉斯谱嵌入，后者在不引入各向同性偏置的前提下防止表示坍缩；理论分析限定在可逆确定性动力学与预测器不动点条件下。
Result: 在若干复杂连续 goal-reaching 数值仿真基准上，CTWM 匹配或优于任务无关基线 LeWM，同时参数量约为其一半；并给出在可逆确定性动力学与预测器不动点处可证明恢复正确缩放的拉普拉斯表示的结论。
Conclusion: 防坍缩不必靠各向同性正则：用位移预测加 log-determinant 约束即可保住 commute-time 所需的特征值缩放，并在 goal-reaching 规划中以更少参数达到或超过 LeWM。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: From Redundancy to Minimality: Fixed-Point-Guided Hierarchical Reduction of Learned Piecewise-Linear Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Understanding a nonlinear dynamical system from time series requires not only reproducing its trajectories, but also identifying a simple representation that preserves its essential dynamical structure. Almost-linear recurrent neural networks (AL-RNNs) are piecewise-linear RNNs in which only a subset of units use ReLU nonlinearities, so that nonlinear capacity is explicitly controlled by the number of ReLU units. Their activation patterns define linear regions, represented as symbols, whose observed transitions form a symbolic transition graph. However, directly training AL-RNNs with few ReLU units to realize minimal dynamical representations can be unreliable. We ask whether an AL-RNN with more ReLU units can instead be trained first and systematically reduced to a minimal dynamical representation. We introduce a fixed-point-guided hierarchical reduction procedure that progressively linearizes selected ReLU units, merging neighboring linear regions and graph nodes while preserving distinct symbols containing fixed points (FPs). The resulting reduction tree defines a hierarchy of progressively simpler candidates. Each reduced candidate is initialized from the parent parameters and retrained under guidance from the parent dynamics. We also prove that reproducing $Q$ distinct fixed points requires at least $Q$ FP-containing symbols, providing a certificate of symbol-level minimality when this bound is attained. On the 3-scroll Chua system, direct training with the theoretical minimum of three ReLU units achieves high-fidelity minimal realizations in only 20% of seeds, whereas our learn-reduce-retrain strategy increases the seed-macro success rate to approximately 71% at the same final nonlinear capacity. These results show that redundant nonlinear capacity can serve as a scaffold for discovering and realizing minimal dynamical representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 先训练 ReLU 单元偏多的 almost-linear RNN (AL-RNN)，再用不动点引导的层级归约逐步线性化部分 ReLU 单元、合并相邻线性区域与符号图节点，同时保留含不动点 (FP) 的符号，得到最小动力学表示。在 3-scroll Chua 系统上，直接用理论下限 3 个 ReLU 训练只有 20% 的随机种子成功，而 learn-reduce-retrain 在相同最终非线性容量下把种子宏平均成功率提到约 71%。
Motivation: 直接用极少 ReLU 单元训练最小 AL-RNN 不可靠：非线性容量由 ReLU 单元数显式控制，但少单元训练难以稳定收敛到能复现轨迹并保留动力学结构的最小表示。
Method: 提出 fixed-point-guided hierarchical reduction：按层级逐步线性化选定 ReLU 单元，合并相邻线性区域与 symbolic transition graph 节点，但保留含不动点的不同符号，形成 reduction tree；每个归约候选从父节点参数初始化并在父动力学引导下重训练。同时证明复现 Q 个不同不动点至少需要 Q 个含 FP 的符号，达到该界即给出符号级最小性的 certificate。
Result: 在 3-scroll Chua 系统上，直接用理论最小的 3 个 ReLU 训练仅在 20% 的种子上得到高保真最小实现；learn-reduce-retrain 在相同最终非线性容量下把种子宏平均成功率提高到约 71%。
Conclusion: 冗余的非线性容量可以作为发现并实现最小动力学表示的脚手架：先过参数化再系统归约，比直接按最小容量训练更可靠。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Control for Skill-Based Smart Manufacturing
papers.abstract_en: Factories are shifting toward smaller lot sizes with high product customization, requiring frequent re-programming of flexible and reconfigurable automation systems. LLM-based agents can be deployed in two complementary roles: Offline, they generate deterministic production sequences, reducing programming effort; online, they operate live machines and handle unforeseen runtime faults that static programs cannot anticipate. We propose a solution in which each factory module is paired with a dedicated LLM-based agent and an MCP tool server that exposes the module's skills via OPC UA method calls, with agents coordinating over MQTT and grounded by real-time updates of the factory state. We compare three agent architectures (orchestrator, peer-to-peer, and monolithic) across nine production challenges of increasing complexity in a simulation of a physical six-module hexagonal factory, including silent hardware fault detection. The monolithic and peer-to-peer architectures both achieve the highest mean solve rate (93\%), while the orchestrator uniquely resolves a silent conveyor-belt fault in all ten runs by autonomously rerouting plates around the blocked segment. All architectures exhibit emergent fault-diagnosis behavior without any explicit failure-handling logic, establishing standardized MCP tooling, MQTT-based inter-agent communication, and real-time state injection as a viable and reproducible foundation for LLM-programmed smart manufacturing.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 31st International Conference on Emerging Technologies and Factory Automation (ETFA). 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在六模块六边形工厂仿真中，每个模块配一个 LLM agent 与 MCP 工具服务器（经 OPC UA 调用技能），agent 间用 MQTT 协调并注入实时工厂状态。对比 orchestrator、peer-to-peer、monolithic 三种架构在 9 项递增难度生产挑战上的表现：monolithic 与 peer-to-peer 平均解题率最高 93%，orchestrator 则在 10 次运行中全部自主绕开阻塞段、唯一稳定解决传送带静默故障。
Motivation: 小批量、高定制生产要求频繁重编程柔性可重构自动化系统，静态程序无法应对运行时意外故障，需要在线自主处理故障的 agent 化方案。
Method: 每个工厂模块配专属 LLM agent 与 MCP tool server，通过 OPC UA method call 暴露模块技能；agent 经 MQTT 协调并接收实时工厂状态注入。在物理六模块六边形工厂的仿真中比较 orchestrator、peer-to-peer、monolithic 三种架构，任务为 9 项复杂度递增的生产挑战，含静默硬件故障检测。
Result: monolithic 与 peer-to-peer 平均解题率均为 93%（最高）；orchestrator 在全部 10 次运行中唯一解决传送带静默故障，方式是自主绕开阻塞段重排板件路径。三种架构均在无显式故障处理逻辑的情况下表现出涌现的故障诊断行为。
Conclusion: 标准化 MCP 工具、MQTT agent 通信与实时状态注入可作为 LLM 编程智能制造的可复现基础；架构选择影响故障处理路径，orchestrator 在静默故障重路由上更稳。

papers.title: Degree-Corrected Joint Matrix Factorization for Multilayer Community Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multilayer networks allow the modeling of interactions between the same entities across different contexts, such as temporal observations, varying settings, or interactions of different types. The goal of community detection in multilayer networks is to identify groups of nodes exhibiting similar connectivity patterns, which may vary across layers. We propose a method based on a joint nonnegative symmetric matrix trifactorization for community detection in multilayer networks, where each graph is approximated by a nonnegative symmetric matrix trifactorization. Our approach enforces constraints on the factor matrices so that communities are disjoint and shared across layers, while allowing each layer to have its own connectivity patterns and node degrees. This flexibility enables the model to capture both local and global structural variations across layers. We also develop an algorithm to efficiently solve this problem. We evaluate multilayer community detection methods using the multilayer degree-corrected stochastic block model (MDCBM), a flexible framework for generating realistic multilayer graphs with heterogeneous degrees and varying connectivity patterns. Experiments show that our method reliably detects communities across diverse regimes, whereas existing state-of-the-art approaches are often limited by restrictive structural assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于联合非负对称矩阵三分解 (joint nonnegative symmetric matrix trifactorization) 的多层社区检测方法，对每层图分别做三分解并约束因子矩阵使社区在各层间不相交且共享，同时允许每层保留自己的连通模式与节点度。在多层度修正随机块模型 (MDCBM) 生成的异质度、多变连通模式图上实验，该方法在多种 regime 下稳定检出社区，而现有 SOTA 方法常受制于过强的结构假设。
Motivation: 多层网络中同一组实体在不同层的连通模式与节点度各异，现有社区检测方法往往依赖过强的结构假设，难以同时处理层间共享结构与层内差异。
Method: 对每层图施加非负对称矩阵三分解，约束因子矩阵使社区跨层不相交且共享，同时允许各层有独立连通模式与度分布；并给出高效求解算法。评测用 MDCBM 生成具有异质度与变化连通模式的多层图。
Result: 在 MDCBM 生成的多样 regime 下实验，该方法可靠检出社区，而现有 state-of-the-art 方法常被其限制性结构假设所约束。
Conclusion: 带度修正与层共享约束的联合三分解能在跨层结构差异下稳健检测社区，优于依赖强结构假设的现有方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fold'EM: Direct atomic structure inference from Cryo-EM particles
papers.abstract_en: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become a widely adopted technique for biomolecular structure determination. The conventional cryo-EM computational pipeline first combines many particle images to reconstruct an electrostatic potential (ESP) map and then fits an atomic model to the recovered map. Density reconstruction has high sample complexity, requiring large numbers of particle images and making structure determination high-cost and low-throughput, particularly for heterogeneous samples. Downstream atomic model building, in turn, becomes increasingly difficult as the resolution of the reconstructed map deteriorates. Protein structure prediction models provide strong sequence-derived priors on atomic structure, and experiment-guided approaches can use these priors to recover structures consistent with experimental measurements. Yet, in cryo-EM, such priors are typically integrated only after density reconstruction during atomic model fitting. We introduce Fold'EM, an inference-time framework that combines priors from protein generative models directly with cryo-EM particle images to determine atomic models from a small number of single particle images, bypassing both intermediate density reconstruction and downstream model building against the reconstructed map. Across synthetic and experimental cryo-EM datasets, Fold'EM recovers accurate atomic structures both with known particle orientations and in an ab-initio setting where orientations are inferred jointly with structure. In heterogeneous datasets, Fold'EM further resolves distinct conformational states from mixed particle populations without separately reconstructing a density map and building an atomic model for each state. We believe these results open new avenues for structure determination in the low-sample regime and for characterizing low-population conformational states directly from cryo-EM particles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fold'EM 在推理时把蛋白生成模型的原子结构先验直接与 cryo-EM 单颗粒图像结合，绕过密度重建和对重建图的模型拟合两步，从少量颗粒图像直接输出原子模型。在合成与实验 cryo-EM 数据上，它在已知颗粒朝向和朝向与结构联合推断的 ab-initio 设定下都能恢复准确原子结构，并能从混合颗粒群中直接分辨不同构象态。
Motivation: 常规 cryo-EM 流程先重建静电势 (ESP) 图再拟合原子模型，密度重建样本复杂度高、需要大量颗粒图像，成本高通量低；且分辨率变差时下游建模更难，蛋白结构先验只在重建之后才被引入。
Method: Fold'EM 是一个 inference-time 框架：把蛋白生成模型提供的序列导出原子结构先验与 cryo-EM 颗粒图像直接联合推断，跳过中间密度重建与基于重建图的模型构建；朝向可在已知条件下给定，也可在 ab-initio 设定中与结构联合推断。
Result: 在合成与实验 cryo-EM 数据集上，Fold'EM 在已知颗粒朝向与 ab-initio（朝向联合推断）两种设定下均恢复出准确原子结构；在异质数据集上，无需对每个状态分别重建密度图再建模，即可从混合颗粒群中分辨出不同构象态。
Conclusion: 结构先验应在密度重建之前就与颗粒图像融合，这使低样本量条件下的结构测定和低丰度构象态的直接表征成为可能。

papers.title: Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks for Systems with Multiple Asymptotically Stable Equilibria
papers.abstract_en: Stable port-Hamiltonian neural networks certify asymptotic stability by construction. Yet, their Hamiltonian is a global Lyapunov function with a single global minimum, so they can represent only dynamic systems with {one} attractor. We demonstrate that this excludes even simple systems with energy landscapes forming a double well, and we overcome the restriction by parametrising the Hamiltonian as a {product} of Bregman divergences generated by one input-convex network. We prove that the resulting model is locally Lyapunov stable, that the coexistence of stable equilibria forces additional non-asymptotically-stable equilibria to exist, that all equilibria lie in a bounded region, and under a hyperbolicity assumption that almost-everywhere stability holds. On three systems our approach is able to recover the energy surface characteristics and improve the convergence speed by 1.8$\times$-8.5$\times$.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: AXIOM - Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 端口哈密顿神经网络 (port-Hamiltonian neural network) 的哈密顿量是全局 Lyapunov 函数、只有单一全局极小，因而只能表示单吸引子系统。作者把哈密顿量参数化为单个 input-convex 网络生成的多个 Bregman 散度之积，证明所得模型局部 Lyapunov 稳定、稳定平衡点共存必伴随额外非渐近稳定平衡点、所有平衡点落在有界区域，并在双曲性假设下几乎处处稳定。在三个系统上恢复了能量面特征，收敛速度提升 1.8×–8.5×。
Motivation: 稳定 port-Hamiltonian 神经网络用构造保证渐近稳定，但其哈密顿量作为全局 Lyapunov 函数只有一个全局极小，连双阱 (double well) 这类简单多平衡点动力系统都无法表示。
Method: 将哈密顿量参数化为由单个 input-convex 网络生成的多个 Bregman 散度之积，从而允许能量面出现多个局部极小；配套给出稳定性与平衡点结构的理论证明（局部 Lyapunov 稳定、非渐近稳定平衡点的必然存在、平衡点有界性、双曲性假设下的几乎处处稳定性）。
Result: 在三个系统上恢复了能量面特征，并将收敛速度提升 1.8×–8.5×。
Conclusion: 用 Bregman 散度之积参数化哈密顿量可以突破单吸引子限制，同时保留可证明的稳定性；稳定平衡点共存时必然伴随非渐近稳定平衡点，且全部平衡点位于有界区域。

papers.title: Discrete Wasserstein Flows for One-Step Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new framework for one-step generative modelling on finite state spaces. To extend drifting beyond continuous domains, we use discrete Wasserstein geometry to define a target-relative KL gradient flow over the transitions of a reversible Markov kernel. We realize this probability flow at the particle level through Markov jumps and amortize the resulting transport updates into a latent-conditioned generator, so that the iterative dynamics are required only during training while inference remains one-step. In a controlled setting where the underlying distributions and transport dynamics can be computed exactly, we verify KL dissipation, consistency between the particle dynamics and the probability flow, and the predicted numerical scaling. We further show that a finite-capacity neural generator can track these exact transport targets while retaining one-step generation. These results validate the basic construction and provide a foundation for scaling Discrete Drifting to structured discrete data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Discrete Drifting：在有限状态空间上用离散 Wasserstein 几何定义相对目标分布的 KL 梯度流，作用于可逆 Markov 核的转移上，并在粒子层面用 Markov 跳跃实现，再把传输更新摊销 (amortize) 进 latent-conditioned 生成器，使迭代动力学只在训练阶段使用、推理保持单步。在分布与传输动力学可精确计算的受控设定中验证了 KL 耗散、粒子动力学与概率流的一致性，以及预测的数值标度律；有限容量神经生成器也能跟踪这些精确传输目标并保持单步生成。
Motivation: 把连续域上的漂移 (drifting) 生成式建模推广到离散状态空间：需要一个能在离散几何上定义、且推理时不需要迭代采样的传输框架。
Method: 用离散 Wasserstein 几何在可逆 Markov 核的转移上定义 target-relative KL 梯度流；在粒子层面通过 Markov 跳跃实现该概率流，再把传输更新摊销进一个 latent-conditioned 神经生成器，训练时跑迭代动力学、推理时单步出样本。
Result: 在底层分布与传输动力学可精确计算的受控设定中，验证了 KL 耗散、粒子动力学与概率流的一致性，以及预测的数值标度 (numerical scaling)；并展示有限容量神经生成器能跟踪这些精确传输目标，同时保留单步生成。
Conclusion: 离散 Wasserstein 梯度流加摊销生成器这一基本构造是成立的，可作为把 Discrete Drifting 扩展到结构化离散数据的基础。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: MMVistaReason: Toward Open-Data and Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Open multimodal reasoning models have benefited from large-scale reasoning supervision, yet reliable post-training remains challenging due to uneven data quality, inefficient supervision construction, imbalanced difficulty, and cross-domain interference. We introduce MMVistaReason (MVR), an open-data post-training recipe with three components: (1) broader capability coverage across complementary Analytical and Real-World reasoning groups, emphasizing structured reasoning versus visual perception and spatial grounding; (2) efficient SFT and RL data construction, standardizing heterogeneous open data through staged cleaning and annotation, combining difficulty-aware cascaded teacher distillation with answer-likelihood-based trajectory selection to construct MVR-SFT-528K, and applying scale-specific frontier filtering for MVR-RL-63K; and (3) specialize-then-integrate training, which trains complementary RL experts and consolidates their capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Our analyses reveal a capacity-dependent interaction between supervision difficulty, trajectory quality, and model capacity: smaller students benefit more from selected supervision, while larger students are robust to trajectory variation and mixed-domain interference. Mixed-domain RL introduces benchmark-level negative transfer, whereas MOPD provides consistent capability integration, with the preferred KL direction varying across model scales. Across 15 multimodal benchmarks, MVR-4B achieves an average score of 72.8, outperforming Qwen3.5-9B (Instruct) and MMFineReason-8B while using about 70% fewer samples than MMFineReason. Scaling to 9B improves the average to 74.4, surpassing Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Instruct). Overall, MMVistaReason demonstrates that systematic open-data construction and capacity-aware post-training provide a practical and scalable path toward reliable multimodal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMVistaReason (MVR) 是一套开放数据多模态推理后训练配方：分阶段清洗标注异构开放数据，用难度感知的级联教师蒸馏加答案似然轨迹筛选构造 MVR-SFT-528K，再做规模特定前沿过滤得到 MVR-RL-63K，最后用多教师 on-policy 蒸馏 (MOPD) 整合各 RL 专家。在 15 个多模态基准上 MVR-4B 平均 72.8，超过 Qwen3.5-9B (Instruct) 与 MMFineReason-8B，且样本量比 MMFineReason 少约 70%；扩到 9B 平均升至 74.4，超过 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Instruct)。
Motivation: 开放多模态推理模型的后训练受数据质量不齐、监督构造低效、难度失衡与跨域干扰制约，可靠复现困难。
Method: 三部分配方：Analytical 与 Real-World 两组互补能力覆盖；分阶段清洗标注统一异构开放数据，难度感知级联教师蒸馏加答案似然轨迹选择构成 MVR-SFT-528K，规模特定前沿过滤构成 MVR-RL-63K；specialize-then-integrate 先训互补 RL 专家，再用多教师 on-policy 蒸馏 (MOPD) 合并能力。
Result: 15 个多模态基准上 MVR-4B 平均 72.8，优于 Qwen3.5-9B (Instruct) 与 MMFineReason-8B，样本比 MMFineReason 少约 70%；9B 平均 74.4，超过 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Instruct)。分析显示监督难度、轨迹质量与模型容量存在容量依赖交互：小学生更受益于筛选后的监督，大学生对轨迹变化与混合域干扰更稳健；混合域 RL 引入基准级负迁移，而 MOPD 保持一致的能力整合，偏好的 KL 方向随模型规模变化。
Conclusion: 系统化的开放数据构造加容量感知后训练是通往可靠多模态推理的可扩展路径；混合域 RL 应避免直接混训，改用 MOPD 整合专家能力，KL 方向按模型规模选择。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PACE: Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement for Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents turn generated text into real side effects, so poisoned tool metadata, retrieved pages, memory, and reusable skills can steer the next call. Vetting an artifact before admission does not settle this. A safe variant and a leaking variant can produce the same admission evidence, and a sound gate then cannot relax that site for either. We make that condition precise, which leaves the last boundary a deployment can still act on. We present Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement (PACE), which mediates every tool call immediately before it executes. Path confinement proposes an executable cut of represented influence paths, while capability and effect verification checks schema-defined effects against authority compiled from the authenticated request. We distinguish the certified execution contract from the evaluated configuration, which can restore an authorized call after a proposed block or apply a declared repair. Confinement requires the final action to preserve the certified cut. On eight executable agent-security benchmarks with three target-model families, the evaluated configuration gives strictly lowest attack success in 62 of 79 eligible attack columns and ties in 14; full-benchmark native utility loses at most three points relative to the undefended agent. A complete ablation over 1167 paired cases attributes most security gains to effect verification and refusal control to boundary adaptation. A reduced-scale adaptive search succeeds on 0/30 out-of-authority targets against the defense.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACE 在工具调用即将执行的时刻做来源感知能力管控：路径禁闭 (path confinement) 提出影响路径的可执行割，能力与效果验证把 schema 声明的效果对照由认证请求编译出的权限。在八个可执行 agent 安全基准、三个目标模型家族上，评估配置在 79 个可用攻击列中 62 列取得严格最低攻击成功率、14 列持平，全基准原生效用相对无防御 agent 最多下降 3 分。
Motivation: 工具型 LLM agent 的调用会产生真实副作用，被投毒的工具元数据、检索页面、记忆与可复用技能都能操纵下一次调用；而仅在准入前审查工件无法区分安全变体与泄露变体，因为二者可呈现相同的准入证据。
Method: PACE 在每次工具调用执行前介入：Path confinement 对被表示的影响路径提出可执行割 (executable cut)，capability and effect verification 将 schema 定义的效果与从认证请求编译出的权限比对；区分认证执行契约与评估配置，后者可在拟议阻断后恢复已授权调用或施加声明的修复，且禁闭要求最终动作保持认证割。
Result: 在八个可执行 agent 安全基准、三个目标模型家族上，79 个可用攻击列中 62 列攻击成功率严格最低、14 列持平；全基准原生效用相对无防御 agent 最多损失 3 分。对 1167 个配对案例的完整消融显示安全增益主要来自效果验证，拒绝控制来自边界自适应；缩减规模的自适应搜索对防御在 0/30 个越权目标上成功。

papers.title: Verify Claims, Not Scores: Evidence-Based Verification of Modular Agents
papers.abstract_en: When developers change one component of an agent, such as its controller, a learned model or its verifier, they usually judge the change by an aggregate task score. That score cannot tell whether improvement was attainable, which component lost value, or what the agent's own checks certify. We introduce a claim-specific verification audit for modular agents that plan, act, check and refine. Instead of scoring the agent, the audit scores the evidence: each conclusion is recorded with the evidence behind it, one of four verdicts (supported, unsupported, unresolved or not evaluated) and the boundary within which it holds. Three tools supply that evidence. Oracle policies measure attainable improvement under an explicitly stated action set, so that a low value can be traced to the evaluation rather than to the environment. Replacing one component at a time with a perfect counterpart locates lost value, with null results read as unresolved whenever a downstream component could mask them. A separate test asks whether the verifier's score identifies the quantity it is read as bounding. Applied to a constrained portfolio-allocation agent in a synthetic market with known hidden regimes, the audit shows that the value of perfect regime information depends on the action set used to measure it, that the scenario generator discards most of the regime signal while better local fidelity does not improve decisions, and that the runtime verifier can be bypassed with no visible change in outcomes. The contribution is the protocol and the evidential distinctions it enforces; the empirical findings are specific to the agent and environment studied.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向模块化 agent（规划-行动-检查-精化）的按论断验证审计：不给 agent 打总分，而是给证据打分，每条结论附带其证据、四类判定（supported、unsupported、unresolved、not evaluated）与成立边界。在合成市场已知隐含状态的约束组合配置 agent 上应用后发现：完美状态信息的价值取决于用于度量它的 action set，scenario generator 丢弃了大部分状态信号，且 runtime verifier 可被绕过而结果无可见变化。
Motivation: 开发者改动 agent 的控制器、学习模型或 verifier 时只看聚合任务分数，该分数无法区分改进是否可达、哪个组件损失了价值、以及 agent 自身检查究竟认证了什么。
Method: 审计用三个工具产出证据：oracle policy 在显式声明的 action set 下度量可达改进；逐个组件替换为完美对应件以定位价值损失，当下游组件可能掩盖时把零结果读作 unresolved；另设独立测试检验 verifier 的分数是否确实标识了它被当作上界的那个量。
Result: 在合成市场（隐含状态已知）的约束组合配置 agent 上：完美状态信息的价值随度量所用 action set 而变；scenario generator 丢弃大部分状态信号，而更好的局部保真度并不改善决策；runtime verifier 可被绕过且结果无可见变化。
Conclusion: 贡献是这套协议及其强制的证据区分，而非普适性能结论；作者明确指出实证发现只对所研究的 agent 与环境成立。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Reachability-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Impulse Interplanetary Transfers
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning offers the prospect of a reusable sequential decision-making mechanism for spacecraft trajectory design, motivating policy interfaces that connect learned decisions to the underlying maneuver geometry. This paper develops Reachability Analysis-Informed Reinforcement Learning (RARL) for deterministic multi-impulse interplanetary transfers, placing intermediate waypoint selection at the center of the learned decision process. Local first-order reachability maps bounded velocity perturbations into an ellipsoidal set of next-node positions, within which the policy selects its waypoint. Lambert reconstruction then determines the corresponding maneuver to reach this selected waypoint along a dynamically consistent ballistic arc, coupling learned transfer-geometry selection with classical astrodynamics. A terminal two-impulse reconstruction completes the rendezvous, supported by a linear maneuver-demand assessment used for reward shaping. Numerical studies characterize this interface on a two-body Earth-Mars benchmark. Across three independent training runs, RARL achieves a mean maneuver cost of 10.23 km/s, 1.72% above a validated local sequential convex programming reference. Training over dispersed initial states extends policy reuse across a departure family with fixed target state and transfer duration. Each of the three independently trained multi-state policies completes all 10,000 held-out Monte Carlo departures without impulse-cap violations, compared with a mean feasibility rate of 6.49% for single-state policies. This broader sampled feasibility is accompanied by a 0.61% increase in mean nominal maneuver cost, without further training across departures. These results demonstrate that a reachability-informed decision interface supports benchmark-quality trajectory construction and policy reuse across dispersed departure conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可达性分析引导的强化学习 (RARL)，把中间航点选择放进一阶可达集内，再用 Lambert 重构确定冲量，使学到的几何选择与经典天体力学耦合。在二体地球-火星基准上，三次独立训练的平均机动代价 10.23 km/s，仅比已验证的局部序列凸规划参考高 1.72%；分散初值训练后，多状态策略在 10,000 次留出 Monte Carlo 出发中全部完成且无冲量数超限，而单状态策略平均可行率仅 6.49%。
Motivation: 航天器多冲量轨迹设计中强化学习决策与底层机动几何脱节，学到的策略难以复用到不同出发条件，也难保证动力学一致与可行。
Method: RARL 用局部一阶可达性分析把有界速度扰动映射为下一节点位置的椭球集，策略在该集内选航点；Lambert 重构给出沿动力学一致弹道弧到达该点的机动，末端两冲量重构完成交会，并用线性机动需求评估做 reward shaping。训练在分散初值上进行以支持出发族复用。
Result: 二体地球-火星基准上，三次独立训练平均机动代价 10.23 km/s，比已验证的局部序列凸规划 (sequential convex programming) 参考高 1.72%。三个独立训练的多状态策略各自完成全部 10,000 次留出 Monte Carlo 出发且无冲量数超限，单状态策略平均可行率 6.49%；多状态策略平均名义机动代价仅增加 0.61%，且跨出发无需再训练。
Conclusion: 可达性引导的决策接口可支撑基准质量的轨迹构造，并让策略在分散出发条件下复用，代价是相对单状态策略 0.61% 的名义机动开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust Non-Clairvoyant Scheduling with Classification Models
papers.abstract_en: We study the classical single-machine scheduling problem of minimizing the sum of completion times of jobs in a non-clairvoyant setting, where the processing time of each job remains unknown until its completion. This is a hard problem for which no constant competitive algorithm is possible. Inspired by robust optimization and learning-augmented algorithms, we introduce a novel robustness framework that leverages structural information provided by a classification model to overcome this limitation. Specifically, we assume that jobs are partitioned into classes and we have access to the confusion matrix of the classifier, whose entry $(k,\ell)$ indicates the number of jobs predicted to belong to class~$k$ but that actually belong to class~$\ell$. In this manner, we are able to characterize uncertainty as a set of permutations within each predicted class, rather than as a collection of discrete numerical scenarios, avoiding the computational difficulty of classical robust metrics, such as Min-Max and Min-Max Regret. In addition to these worst-case metrics, we also consider the expected objective over all scenarios. We first propose an optimal non-adaptive strategy that is oblivious with respect to all three robust criteria. We then investigate adaptive and randomized algorithms, showing that they can outperform the optimal non-adaptive strategy when the matrix exhibits particular structural properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在单机、作业处理时间完成前不可知的 sum-of-completion-times 调度中，用分类器混淆矩阵刻画每个预测类内的排列不确定性，绕开 Min-Max/Min-Max Regret 的计算困难。给出对三种鲁棒准则都 oblivious 的最优非自适应策略，并证明当混淆矩阵具备特定结构时，自适应与随机化算法可胜过该最优非自适应策略。
Motivation: 非clairvoyant 的 ΣCj 调度不存在常数 competitive ratio，经典鲁棒度量 Min-Max 与 Min-Max Regret 又有计算困难，需要一种能利用学习器结构信息的替代不确定性刻画。
Method: 把作业按分类器预测分到若干类，用混淆矩阵 (k,ℓ)（预测为 k 实为 ℓ 的作业数）把不确定性定义为每个预测类内部的排列集合，而非离散数值场景；同时考虑三种准则：最坏情形、Min-Max Regret 与全场景期望目标。先构造对三者都 oblivious 的最优非自适应策略，再分析自适应与随机化算法。
Result: 证明该问题不存在常数 competitive ratio；给出对三种鲁棒准则均 oblivious 的最优非自适应策略；并证明当混淆矩阵呈现特定结构时，自适应与随机化算法可优于该最优非自适应策略。
Conclusion: 混淆矩阵提供的类内排列结构足以把非clairvoyant 调度的不确定性变成可处理的鲁棒问题，且在矩阵结构有利时自适应与随机化严格优于最优非自适应方案。

papers.title: CLASP: Continual Low-rank Adapters for Spatially Placed Concepts from One Hypernetwork
papers.abstract_en: Continual personalization of text-to-image diffusion models requires sequentially acquiring new concepts while retaining previously learned ones. However, existing methods either suffer from catastrophic forgetting or rely on storing additional concept-specific parameters and spatial components, causing their parameter footprint to grow with the concept stream. This limits their ability to scale to long sequences of personalization tasks. We propose a rehearsal-free approach that uses a single fixed-size hypernetwork to continually personalize a frozen diffusion model. Instead of expanding the model as new concepts are acquired, the hypernetwork dynamically produces the concept-specific adaptations required for personalization while preserving previously learned concepts. Our framework further integrates spatial control into the personalization process, allowing users to specify where a personalized concept should appear without introducing additional per-concept components. This formulation enables continual personalization with a parameter footprint that remains independent of the number of learned concepts, aside from compact concept representations. Experiments demonstrate strong retention of previously learned concepts and reliable spatial grounding, matching or improving upon existing methods while scaling effectively to long streams of personalization tasks.
papers.comment: 31 pages. Code: https://github.com/genwro-ai/clasp, project page: https://genwro-ai.github.io/clasp
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLASP 用单个固定大小的超网络 (hypernetwork) 为冻结的文本到图像扩散模型动态生成概念专属适配，实现免复习 (rehearsal-free) 的持续个性化，参数量不随概念流增长。框架同时把空间控制并入个性化过程，用户可指定概念出现位置而不引入逐概念组件；实验显示对已学概念保持强、空间定位可靠，在长概念流上可扩展并匹配或改进现有方法。
Motivation: 持续个性化需顺序习得新概念又不遗忘旧概念，现有方法要么灾难性遗忘，要么为每个概念存储额外参数与空间组件，参数足迹随概念流增长，难以扩展到长序列个性化任务。
Method: 用单个固定大小的超网络在冻结扩散模型上持续生成个性化所需的概念专属适配，替代随新概念扩张模型的做法；同时把空间控制整合进个性化流程，仅保留紧凑概念表示 (compact concept representations)，不引入逐概念组件。
Result: 实验展示对先前所学概念的强保持与可靠空间定位，在长个性化任务流上有效扩展，匹配或改进现有方法；参数足迹与已学概念数量无关（除紧凑概念表示外）。
Conclusion: 免复习的固定容量超网络生成式适配，可以在不遗忘的前提下把持续个性化扩展到长概念流，同时保住空间定位能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An ontology for cross-sectoral crisis management: core and public health modules
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents the European Crisis Management Ontology (ECMO), a modular OWL-based ontology intended as a cross-sectoral reference for disaster risk reduction and response. ECMO is designed to be organised as a network of ontological modules. Among the modules, ECMO-CORE captures fundamental crisis management concepts such as hazard, event, exposure, impact, and response measure and uses ontology design patterns and the OWL2 punning technique to resolve ambiguities between hazard types and event manifestations. In addition, domain-specific modules are defined as in the case of the public health module aligned with SNOMED CT and ICD-11. To demonstrate the resource's utility, we used ECMO to represent the data of the Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources system of the Joint Research Centre to generate an end-to-end pipeline that populates an ECMO-compliant knowledge graph from unstructured epidemiological news. Initial results demonstrate that ECMO provides the formal guardrails necessary for consistent and unified knowledge representation and integration. The ontology is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20070268 and is released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出模块化 OWL 本体 ECMO 作为跨部门危机管理的参考框架：ECMO-CORE 用本体设计模式与 OWL2 punning 消歧危险类型与事件表现，公共卫生模块对齐 SNOMED CT 和 ICD-11。用它把 JRC 的 Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources 非结构化流行病学新闻端到端填充成合规知识图谱，初步结果显示其为知识表示与集成提供了形式化约束。
Motivation: 灾害风险 reduction 与响应涉及多部门，危险、事件、暴露、影响、响应等核心概念在不同领域表述不一致，缺少统一的跨部门参考本体来约束知识表示与集成。
Method: 构建模块化网络式 OWL 本体 ECMO：ECMO-CORE 用 ontology design patterns 与 OWL2 punning 处理 hazard 类型和 event 表现的歧义；公共卫生模块与 SNOMED CT、ICD-11 对齐；再用 ECMO 表示 JRC 的 Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources 数据，构建从非结构化流行病学新闻生成 ECMO 合规知识图谱的端到端 pipeline。
Result: 初步结果表明 ECMO 为一致、统一的知识表示与集成提供了必要的形式化约束（formal guardrails），并支撑了从非结构化流行病学新闻到知识图谱的端到端填充流程；本体以 CC BY 4.0 发布于 Zenodo（doi 10.5281/zenodo.20070268）。

papers.title: PPO-HRAP: Proximal Policy Optimization with a Hybrid Regime-Aware Policy for Risk-Controlled Trading
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for trading often struggles to balance upside participation with drawdown control. Profit-only policies can collapse toward passive long exposure on upward-drifting assets, while aggressively risk-penalized rewards can become too defensive during volatile periods. This paper proposes PPO-HRAP, a hybrid regime-aware policy that combines Proximal Policy Optimization with an interpretable regime prior. The agent observes both market features and portfolio-state variables, receives a reward combining portfolio log return, VIX-conditioned drawdown-increase penalty, target-exposure deviation, and turnover cost, and executes a blended action between the PPO actor output and a regime-derived target exposure. On the held-out 2020-2022 SPY test window, PPO-HRAP achieves 27.62% total return, 8.48% annualized return, 0.6447 Sharpe ratio, 0.8588 Sortino ratio, and 0.4592 Calmar ratio, while reducing maximum drawdown from 34.10% for Buy and Hold to 18.47%. Across five SPY seeds, PPO-HRAP remains stable with mean total return $0.2725 \pm 0.0109$ and mean Sharpe ratio $0.6219 \pm 0.0565$. Single-run cross-asset tests on QQQ and DIA further show that the proposed method ranks first on total return and Sharpe ratio for all three reported assets. These results suggest that blending learned actions with a volatility-aware regime prior is a practical way to improve risk-adjusted trading behavior, although the current policy still incurs high turnover and cross-asset robustness beyond SPY remains limited to single-run evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PPO-HRAP 把 PPO 学到的动作与 VIX 条件化的 regime 先验目标敞口做混合，奖励同时含组合对数收益、回撤增量惩罚、目标敞口偏离与换手成本。在 2020–2022 SPY 留出测试窗上总收益 27.62%、Sharpe 0.6447，最大回撤从 Buy and Hold 的 34.10% 降到 18.47%；作者承认换手仍高、SPY 之外只有单次运行证据。
Motivation: 纯收益导向的 RL 交易策略在上行漂移资产上会塌缩成被动做多，而重回撤惩罚的奖励在波动期又过于防守，上行参与与回撤控制难以兼顾。
Method: PPO-HRAP 观测市场特征与组合状态变量，奖励由组合 log return、VIX 条件化的回撤增量惩罚、目标敞口偏离和换手成本组成；执行动作是 PPO actor 输出与 regime 推导目标敞口的混合（blended action），并给出可解释的 regime prior。
Result: 在 2020–2022 SPY 留出测试窗：总收益 27.62%、年化 8.48%、Sharpe 0.6447、Sortino 0.8588、Calmar 0.4592，最大回撤由 Buy and Hold 的 34.10% 降至 18.47%。五个 SPY 随机种子上稳定，平均总收益 0.2725±0.0109、平均 Sharpe 0.6219±0.0565。单次运行的 QQQ 与 DIA 跨资产测试中，该方法在三个资产的总收益与 Sharpe 上均排第一。
Conclusion: 把学习动作与波动率感知的 regime 先验混合是改善风险调整后交易行为的可行做法，但当前策略换手仍高，SPY 之外的跨资产稳健性只有单次运行证据。

papers.title: TRACE: Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure for Multi-Turn Safety
papers.abstract_en: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) often refuse a harmful request but comply once the same goal is spread over several turns. Preference objectives score whole responses to single prompts, so their training loss alone cannot control risk on unseen histories. Our analysis gives sufficient conditions under which suppression at supervised single-turn contexts yields a bound on multi-turn trajectory risk. The bound accounts for coverage, transfer slack, and leakage, and characterizes contraction relative to a base-policy risk budget evaluated on the trained policy's contexts. TRACE (Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure) turns this principle into a token-level objective. On the safe response, each token is weighted by the discounted return of a refusal-attributable advantage. The advantage compares a frozen reference model with its refusal-ablated copy, allowing earlier response tokens to receive credit from later refusal-related evidence. At high-gap positions on rejected responses, TRACE combines the observed token with policy-selected alternatives in the erasure target. A gradient-norm penalty replaces the retain set. Across five open-weight models and seven multi-turn attacks, TRACE gives the lowest attack success rate (ASR) in all 35 model and attack pairs, while the model utility evaluated on MMLU and HellaSwag drop by at most 1\.23 points. Source code can be found in the supplemental material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 把多轮越狱风险压到单轮监督可控制的范围内：先给出单轮抑制推出多轮轨迹风险界的充分条件（含覆盖度、迁移松弛与泄漏项），再据此构造 token 级目标——安全回复按拒绝可归因优势的折扣回报加权，拒绝回复的高间隙位置用观测 token 与策略自选替代 token 构成擦除目标，并以梯度范数惩罚替代保留集。在 5 个开源模型 × 7 种多轮攻击共 35 组配对上取得最低 ASR，MMLU 与 HellaSwag 上的效用损失最多 1.23 分。
Motivation: 偏好目标只对单 prompt 的整段回复打分，其训练损失本身无法约束未见对话历史上的风险；模型常拒绝单条有害请求，却在目标被拆到多轮后照做。
Method: TRACE (Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure)：理论上给出单轮上下文抑制推出多轮轨迹风险界的充分条件，界中含 coverage、transfer slack、leakage，并刻画相对基础策略风险预算的收缩；实现为 token 级目标——安全回复每个 token 按拒绝可归因优势的折扣回报加权，该优势比较冻结参考模型与其拒绝消融 (refusal-ablated) 副本，使早期 token 能拿到后续拒绝证据的信用；拒绝回复的高间隙位置把观测 token 与策略选出的替代 token 一起放进擦除目标，梯度范数惩罚取代保留集。
Result: 在 5 个开源模型与 7 种多轮攻击的全部 35 个模型-攻击配对上，TRACE 的攻击成功率 (ASR) 均为最低；同时在 MMLU 与 HellaSwag 上的模型效用下降最多 1.23 分。
Conclusion: 单轮监督下的抑制在给定覆盖、迁移与泄漏条件下足以约束多轮轨迹风险，且 token 级的归因-擦除目标能在压低多轮 ASR 的同时把通用效用损失控制在 1.23 分以内。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Clifford Sheaf Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Clifford Sheaf Neural Network (CSNN), an equivariant sheaf neural network for geometric graphs that places a Clifford algebra on each stalk of a cellular sheaf and transports multivector features along edges. The canonical choice of restriction map for sheaves with algebra-valued stalks is algebra homomorphism. Adding the constraint of equivariance, the naive choice becomes versor conjugation. However, versor conjugation is expressively weak, so we drop algebra homomorphism and arrive at the K-term sandwich. The resulting sheaf Laplacian is positive semidefinite by construction, needs no versor constraint, and still mixes grades. Our main contribution characterizes the resulting family of restriction maps along three axes: which grades a map couples, how much of the endomorphism space it reaches, and how well it is conditioned. The K-term sandwich spans half of the endomorphism space, and in Cl(3, 0, 0) it corresponds to the maps that commute with the central pseudoscalar. The number of terms controls expressivity. CSNN is the reversion member, a first-order model by construction and the grade-mixing corner of this family, developed as a sheaf construction for graph-level equivariant regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Clifford Sheaf Neural Network (CSNN)：在 cellular sheaf 的每条 stalk 上放 Clifford algebra，沿边传输 multivector 特征，用放弃代数同态约束后的 K-term sandwich 作为 restriction map。所得 sheaf Laplacian 半正定、无需 versor 约束且仍能混合 grades；K-term sandwich 张成一半 endomorphism 空间，在 Cl(3,0,0) 中恰为与中心 pseudoscalar 对易的映射族，项数控制表达力，CSNN 是其中的 reversion 成员。
Motivation: 带代数值 stalk 的 sheaf 其 restriction map 的规范选择是代数同态，加上等变性后退化为 versor conjugation，表达力过弱；需要一个既保持等变与 Laplacian 半正定、又能混合 grades 的图级回归构造。
Method: 在 geometric graph 的 cellular sheaf 上为每条 stalk 赋 Clifford algebra，沿边传输 multivector 特征；放弃代数同态约束、保留等变性，得到 K-term sandwich 作为 restriction map 族，并沿三条轴刻画该族：映射耦合哪些 grades、覆盖 endomorphism 空间的多少、条件数如何。CSNN 取其中的 reversion 成员，作为一阶模型用于 graph-level equivariant regression。
Result: 所得 sheaf Laplacian 按构造半正定，不需要 versor 约束且仍混合 grades；K-term sandwich 张成 endomorphism 空间的一半，在 Cl(3,0,0) 中对应与中心 pseudoscalar 对易的映射；restriction map 的项数控制表达力，CSNN 属于该族的 grade-mixing 角落。
Conclusion: 去掉代数同态、只保留等变性得到的 K-term sandwich 是一个可按 grades 耦合、覆盖度与条件数三轴刻画的 restriction map 家族，其中 reversion 成员足以支撑图级等变回归。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: ProtoFlow: Prototype-Guided Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling has shown strong promise for multivariate time mseries (MTS) forecasting, especially scale to high-dimensional settings. Diffusion-based methods achieve competitive performance but typically require many sampling steps at inference. VAE-based non-iterative forecasting frameworks have therefore emerged as an efficient alternative. Within this line of work, vector quantization (VQ) enables controllable latent space modeling by mapping multivariate series into compact discrete representations. Existing VQ-based forecasting methods, however, typically rely on autoregressive (AR) token generation, which suffers from exposure bias and training-inference mismatch. Flow matching provides an efficient non-autoregressive alternative for latent forecasting, but existing formulations usually initialize transport from a generic Gaussian prior. We instead observe that the trained VQ codebook already captures representative latent prototypes and can thus serve as a more informative prior for flow matching. Based on this insight, we propose ProtoFlow, a forecasting framework that combines vector-quantized autoencoding with Prototype-prior Flow matching. Our method first maps multivariate sequences into a discrete latent space, then constructs a structured prior from the learned codebook, and finally learns a DiT-based rectified flow to transport samples from this prior to future latent representations conditioned on historical observations. By replacing generic noise initialization with a learned prototype prior, ProtoFlow avoids the rollout mismatch of AR token prediction and promotes faster training convergence. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that it consistently achieves superior forecasting performance with efficient inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProtoFlow 用 VQ 码本作为 flow matching 的原型先验替代高斯初始化：先把多变量序列编码进离散潜空间，再由码本构造结构化先验，用 DiT 驱动的 rectified flow 在历史条件下把样本从该先验输运到未来潜表示，从而避开自回归 token 预测的 rollout 失配并加快训练收敛。在基准数据集上取得一致更优的预测性能且推理高效。
Motivation: VQ 类多变量时间序列预测依赖自回归 token 生成，存在 exposure bias 与训练-推理失配；flow matching 虽可非自回归，但通常从通用高斯先验出发，浪费了码本已学到的代表性潜原型。
Method: ProtoFlow = vector-quantized autoencoding + Prototype-prior Flow matching：序列先映射到离散潜空间，由训练好的 codebook 构造结构化先验，再学习一个 DiT 架构的 rectified flow，在历史观测条件下把该先验的样本输运到未来潜表示，替代 AR token 逐步生成与通用噪声初始化。
Result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验中，ProtoFlow 一致取得更优的预测性能，同时保持高效推理；相对通用高斯先验的 flow 与 AR token 预测，训练收敛更快。
Conclusion: 把已训练的 VQ 码本当作 flow matching 的原型先验，可以在不引入自回归 rollout 的前提下提升多变量时间序列预测精度并保持推理效率。

papers.title: Feature Selective Model Collapse in Diffusion Models: Total Replacement versus Fixed-Budget Training
papers.abstract_en: Model collapse arises when generative models are trained on synthetic data produced by earlier models. The phenomenon has attracted considerable attention because of its societal and technical implications. However, previous studies have reached seemingly contradictory conclusions: replacing real data with synthetic data causes collapse (Shumailov et al.), yet accumulating real data alongside synthetic data can prevent it. For diffusion models, we study an intermediate regime typical of finite-budget pipelines: all past datasets and the real data are kept, but each new model is trained on a fixed-size sample from this growing pool, so the real fraction vanishes without any data being removed. Experiments on a 2D spiral dataset as well as the image benchmarks (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10) show that replacement protocol degrades dataset rapidly as in the literature, whereas the fixed budget degrades only partially, sparing some features. A linear-response model of the multi-generational parameter dynamics, analyzed by stochastic recursion, confirms that the two protocols differ: some features will be fragile and lost within a few generations for both protocols, while some will be robust and preserved over practically unbounded horizons under the fixed budget protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在扩散模型的合成数据递归训练中，固定预算采样（每代从不断增长的数据池中抽固定大小样本，真实数据比例趋于零但不删除任何数据）比全量替换真实数据更能延缓 model collapse：2D spiral 与 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10 上替换协议使数据集迅速退化，固定预算只部分退化并保留部分特征。线性响应模型加随机递归分析表明，部分特征在两种协议下都会在几代内丢失，而另一些特征在固定预算下可于实际上无界的代数 horizon 内保持稳健。
Motivation: 既有结论看似矛盾：全量替换真实数据会导致 collapse，而真实数据与合成数据累积共存可避免它。有限预算流水线实际处在两者之间——数据池增长但每代只采固定样本，真实数据比例自然消失，这一中间体制此前缺少刻画。
Method: 研究扩散模型在固定预算协议下的多代训练动力学：保留全部历史数据集与真实数据，每代从增长池中取固定大小样本训练新模型；用线性响应模型描述多代参数动力学，并以随机递归 (stochastic recursion) 分析特征的脆弱性与稳健性，再在 2D spiral 与图像基准上做实验对照全量替换协议。
Result: 在 2D spiral、MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10 上，替换协议使数据集迅速退化（与文献一致），固定预算协议只部分退化并保留部分特征；随机递归分析给出两类特征：有些在两种协议下几代内即丢失，有些在固定预算协议下可于实际上无界的代数 horizon 内保持稳健。
Conclusion: 全量替换与固定预算训练导致的 collapse 程度不同：固定预算不删除数据也能让真实数据比例消失，却只造成部分退化，特征按脆弱/稳健分野决定存续代数。

papers.title: Prediction-powered Neural Architecture Search
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating candidate architectures in neural architecture search (NAS) faces an inherent trade-off: on the one hand, reliable performance labels are limited because training and evaluating architectures is costly; on the other hand, zero-cost proxies (ZCPs) are cheap to compute at large scale but can be noisy. Yet, how to effectively combine these two sources of supervision remains unclear. In this paper, we propose PPNAS, a novel prediction-powered inference (PPI) approach for NAS. PPNAS fuses (1) a small set of architectures with observed performance labels and (2) a large set of architectures with ZCP information. To combine these two sources of supervision, PPNAS exploits the ordinal information provided by ZCPs to construct additional pairwise ranking supervision, while PPI debiases systematic discrepancies between ZCP-based and true performance rankings. We evaluate PPNAS in end-to-end predictor-based NAS, where it achieves state-of-the-art under limited evaluation budgets. To the best of our knowledge, PPNAS is the first prediction-powered approach for label-efficient NAS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PPNAS 用 prediction-powered inference (PPI) 把少量带真实性能标签的架构与大量仅有 zero-cost proxy (ZCP) 的架构融合：利用 ZCP 的序数信息构造额外成对排序监督，同时用 PPI 校正 ZCP 排序与真实性能排序之间的系统性偏差。在端到端 predictor-based NAS 中，PPNAS 在有限评估预算下达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: NAS 中训练评估架构代价高，可靠性能标签稀缺；ZCP 便宜可大规模计算但噪声大，两种监督如何有效结合此前不清楚。
Method: 提出 PPNAS：以 PPI 框架融合小规模带标签架构与大规模 ZCP 架构，借 ZCP 的序数信息构造 pairwise ranking 监督，并对 ZCP 排序与真实排序的系统性差异做去偏，嵌入 end-to-end predictor-based NAS 流程。
Result: 在 end-to-end predictor-based NAS 评测中，PPNAS 在有限评估预算 (limited evaluation budgets) 下取得 state-of-the-art 表现；作者称其为首个 prediction-powered 的 label-efficient NAS 方法。
Conclusion: 把 ZCP 当作带系统偏差的辅助监督并用 PPI 去偏，可以在标签极少时把 NAS 预测器推到 SOTA，即 ZCP 与真实标签的组合优于单靠其一。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EP-Flow: Disordered Crystal Structure Prediction without Site-Level Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have made rapid progress in ordered crystal structure prediction, yet many functional materials are intrinsically disordered, with substitutional mixing, vacancies, or interstitial species controlling their properties. Existing crystal generators either assume deterministic site occupations or require site-level disorder annotations, which are often unavailable when the chemical formula is the primary input. We formulate disordered crystal structure prediction through an Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM), a continuous site-by-species representation that unifies ordered crystals, solid solutions, vacancy disorder, and interstitial occupancy. A valid ODM must satisfy coupled site-wise occupancy, mass-conservation, and non-negativity constraints, placing each sample on a formula-dependent transportation polytope. We propose Entropic Polytope Flow (EP-Flow), a marginal-constrained flow matching framework that canonicalizes heterogeneous polytopes into a shared double-centered space, learns a marginal-preserving flow, and recovers feasible occupancies through a Sinkhorn inverse map. By jointly generating occupancies, fractional coordinates, and lattice parameters, EP-Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance on formula-conditioned disordered CSP benchmarks derived from COD and MPDS, substantially outperforming adapted ordered-crystal generators. Analyses further show that EP-Flow recovers sparse and chemically meaningful local disorder patterns rather than merely matching global composition statistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EP-Flow 把无序晶体结构预测表述为 Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM) 上的运输多面体 (transportation polytope) 采样问题，用边缘约束的 flow matching 在双中心化共享空间中生成占据、分数坐标与晶格参数，再经 Sinkhorn 逆映射还原可行占据。在由 COD 与 MPDS 构建的配方条件无序 CSP 基准上达到 state-of-the-art，明显优于改造后的有序晶体生成器，并恢复出稀疏且化学上有意义的局域无序模式。
Motivation: 现有晶体生成器要么假设确定性位点占据，要么需要位点级无序标注，而实际场景中通常只有化学式作为输入，位点级标注不可得。
Method: 用 ODM 这一连续的位点×物种表示统一有序晶体、固溶体、空位无序与间隙占据，约束为位点归一、质量守恒与非负，使每个样本落在配方依赖的运输多面体上；EP-Flow (Entropic Polytope Flow) 将异构多面体规范化到共享双中心空间，学习保持边缘的 flow matching，再用 Sinkhorn 逆映射恢复可行占据，联合生成占据、分数坐标与晶格参数。
Result: 在由 COD 与 MPDS 派生的配方条件无序 CSP 基准上取得 state-of-the-art，明显优于改造后的有序晶体生成器；分析显示其恢复的是稀疏且化学上有意义的局域无序模式，而非仅匹配全局成分统计。
Conclusion: 把位点占据当作运输多面体上的连续分布并用边缘约束 flow 生成，可以在只有化学式输入、无位点级标注的条件下完成无序晶体结构预测。

papers.title: ARROW: Arbitrary Reconstruction and Tracking of 4D Observations in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic scenes may be captured by a moving camera, multiple video streams, or images taken at different times. These observations reveal complementary aspects of scene geometry and motion, yet bringing them together requires establishing correspondence across viewpoints, capture times, and visibility changes. We introduce ARROW, a feed-forward model that unifies 3D reconstruction and 3D point tracking from arbitrary image sets. At its core is a novel order-invariant querying approach, which allows the association of queries with observations across arbitrary inputs. We show that exposing the model to more diverse sets of inputs during training results in improved task performance. Moreover, the resulting model is capable of generalization to a wider range of tasks including multi-view tracking. Trained with this strategy, ARROW establishes a new state of the art in 3D tracking on WorldTrack and TAPVid-3D and outperforms dedicated multi-view trackers on an adapted RGB-only MVTracker benchmark, while remaining competitive across 3D reconstruction tasks. Code and weights are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARROW 是一个前馈模型，用顺序不变的查询机制 (order-invariant querying) 把任意图像集合上的 3D 重建与 3D 点跟踪统一起来，训练时暴露于更多样输入集合可提升性能并泛化到多视角跟踪。在 3D 跟踪上于 WorldTrack 和 TAPVid-3D 取得新 SOTA，并在改造后的 RGB-only MVTracker benchmark 上超过专用多视角跟踪器，同时在 3D 重建任务上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 动态场景可由移动相机、多路视频流或不同时间拍摄的图像获得，这些观测互补，但跨视角、跨时间与可见性变化建立对应关系困难，重建与跟踪通常由不同专用模型分别处理。
Method: 前馈模型 ARROW 统一 3D 重建与 3D 点跟踪，核心是顺序不变的查询机制，可将查询与任意输入中的观测关联；训练策略是让模型接触更多样化的输入集合。
Result: 在 3D 跟踪上于 WorldTrack 与 TAPVid-3D 建立新 SOTA；在改造后的 RGB-only MVTracker benchmark 上超过专用多视角跟踪器；在 3D 重建任务上保持竞争力；代码与权重公开。
Conclusion: 顺序不变查询加多样化输入训练能让单一前馈模型同时覆盖重建与跟踪并泛化到多视角跟踪，且不牺牲重建任务上的竞争力。

papers.title: DAYJOB: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Professional Work
papers.abstract_en: Professional work often starts with a brief request that leaves the professional to work out what is needed, which documents matter, and whether the request's premise holds. We introduce DAYJOB, a benchmark of 130 tasks built by professionals in healthcare (50) and finance (80). The tasks are estimated to take a professional 13.6 hours on average in healthcare and 16.6 in finance. Each task is a containerized Harbor environment with an expert rubric of binary criteria (median 47.5 and 57.5 per task) that an agentic judge applies to the delivered files, and an attempt passes only if it meets every criterion. Across 30 model configurations from 13 developers, the strongest, Claude Opus 5.5, passes 24.7% of healthcare and 23.9% of finance attempts, and the median configuration passes 0.6% and 2.5%. In case studies, agents accept premises that the record contradicts and carry wrong inputs through otherwise consistent analyses. We release all healthcare tasks, 50 of the 80 finance tasks, the evaluation harness, and the leaderboard.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. An earlier version was accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET) at NeurIPS 2026. Evaluation harness: https://github.com/surge-ai/dayjob
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAYJOB 是一个长时程专业工作基准：130 个由医疗（50）与金融（80）从业者编写的任务，每个任务封装为容器化 Harbor 环境，附带二元判据 rubric，由 agentic judge 对交付文件逐条打分，全部判据满足才算通过。30 个模型配置中最强的 Claude Opus 5.5 通过率仅 24.7%（医疗）与 23.9%（金融），中位配置只有 0.6% 与 2.5%。
Motivation: 真实职业工作往往始于一句简短请求，从业者需自行判断需要什么、哪些文档相关、请求前提是否成立；现有基准难以覆盖这种长时程、前提可能错误的开放式任务。
Method: 由专业人士构建 130 个任务（医疗 50、金融 80），每个任务是容器化 Harbor 环境，配专家二元判据 rubric（每任务中位数分别为 47.5 与 57.5 条），由 agentic judge 对交付文件判定，全部满足才通过；评估 13 家开发者的 30 个模型配置，并做案例研究。
Result: 任务预估专业人员平均耗时 13.6 小时（医疗）与 16.6 小时（金融）。最强配置 Claude Opus 5.5 通过 24.7% 医疗与 23.9% 金融尝试，中位配置分别仅 0.6% 与 2.5%。案例研究中 agent 会接受记录所反驳的前提，并把错误输入带入后续一致的分析。
Conclusion: 当前 agentic 系统在长时程专业任务上仍普遍失败，且主要失败模式之一是不加核验地沿用错误前提；作者开源全部医疗任务、80 个金融任务中的 50 个、评测 harness 与排行榜。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Federated Learning for LLMs over Mobile Networks: Issues and Solutions in the RAN Transport
papers.abstract_en: Federated LLM fine-tuning enables large models to be adapted using private and geographically distributed data at the network edge, creating recurring and deadline-sensitive communication workloads across access and transport networks. This challenge is particularly relevant in mobile RANs, where wireless variability, mobility, and device heterogeneity cause model updates to arrive asynchronously. Although these updates belong to the same learning round and share a common destination and deadline, conventional transport networks treat them as independent device-originated flows, hiding their underlying structure and limiting the ability to efficiently provision transport resources. This mismatch is particularly problematic for optical circuit switching and all-photonics transport, which benefit from predictable and schedulable traffic demands. We argue that future RANs should act as learning-aware traffic shapers by exposing the communication structure of distributed model adaptation to the transport layer. Through in-network aggregation at the gNB, asynchronous UE updates can be transformed into fewer aggregate transfers with bounded size and delivery requirements. Once shaped in this way, federated LLM traffic becomes a suitable candidate for selectively provisioned optical connectivity, where high-capacity paths can be established during aggregate-transfer windows and released between learning rounds. The resulting architecture combines the flexibility of packet-based mobile access with dynamically provisioned optical capacity, illustrating a broader approach for coordinating distributed AI workloads across programmable access and transport networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张让 RAN 充当 learning-aware 流量整形器：把同一联邦学习轮次内、同目的地同截止时间却各自独立的 UE 模型更新，在 gNB 处做 in-network aggregation，压成数量更少、大小与交付时限有界的聚合传输。整形后的联邦 LLM 流量可在聚合传输窗口内按需建立高容量光路、轮次间释放，从而把分组移动接入与动态配置的光传输容量组合起来。
Motivation: 联邦 LLM 微调在边缘产生周期性、截止时间敏感的通信负载，但传统传输网把同一轮次的更新当作彼此独立的设备发起流，隐藏了其结构，难以高效配置传输资源；这对依赖可预测、可调度流量的光电路交换与全光传输尤其不利。
Method: 提出让未来 RAN 暴露分布式模型适配的通信结构给传输层：在 gNB 做 in-network aggregation，把异步 UE 更新转换为更少的有界聚合传输；再据此为联邦 LLM 流量选择性配置光连接，在聚合窗口建立高容量路径、轮次间释放。
Result: 论文给出的是架构性主张与论证：异步 UE 更新经 gNB 聚合后成为数量更少、大小与交付要求有界的传输，使联邦 LLM 流量适合选择性配置的光连接，组合分组移动接入与动态光容量。
Conclusion: 把分布式学习的通信结构暴露给传输层并做 in-network 聚合，是让可预测的光传输资源对接移动网络中联邦 LLM 负载的可行路径。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: STAGE: Subspace-Targeted Affine Generative Erasure for Text-to-3D Models
papers.abstract_en: Concept erasure suppresses a target concept while preserving behavior on unrelated inputs. Existing closed-form methods were designed for 2D image diffusion and assume a single generative pathway, so one edit must cover geometry and texture at once. Native 3D generators, which synthesize structured 3D representations directly rather than by lifting 2D samples, violate this assumption. We show that shape and object concepts must be erased in the structural stage of the pipeline and material concepts in the appearance stage. We therefore formulate erasure in native text-to-3D as a stage-aware editing problem and introduce STAGE, a training-free, closed-form framework. STAGE confines each edit to the low-dimensional subspace spanned by the differences between erase and anchor embeddings, and relaxes the norm-preserving (orthogonal) constraint of prior editors into a least-squares affine correction that maps target activations onto safe anchors subject to a penalty on the displacement of retained prompts. The correction applies to the structural stage, the appearance stage, or both. We find that the stage an edit must reach is determined by concept type. On TRELLIS, the standard open native 3D generator, across 15 shape, material, and object concepts, STAGE reaches 66.7 on a composite score that balances forgetting the target concept against preserving everything else, aggregating CLIP-based semantic and physical metrics, versus 53.2 for the strongest adapted baseline. Code: https://github.com/gmum/STAGE/ Project Page https://gmum.github.io/STAGE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STAGE 把原生 text-to-3D 生成器的概念擦除改写成分阶段问题：形状与物体概念必须在结构阶段擦除，材质概念必须在外观阶段擦除。方法把编辑限制在 erase 与 anchor 嵌入差张成的低维子空间，并把先前编辑器的正交（保范）约束放松为带保留提示位移惩罚的最小二乘仿射修正，训练即免、闭式求解。在 TRELLIS 上跨 15 个形状/材质/物体概念，综合分（平衡目标概念遗忘与其余保持，聚合 CLIP 语义与物理指标）达 66.7，最强适配基线为 53.2。
Motivation: 现有闭式概念擦除方法为 2D 图像扩散设计，假设单一生成通路，一次编辑要同时覆盖几何与纹理；而原生 3D 生成器直接合成结构化 3D 表示、并非从 2D 样本提升而来，该假设失效。
Method: 提出 STAGE：训练即免的闭式框架，把擦除限定在 erase 与 anchor 嵌入之差张成的低维子空间内，将先前编辑器的正交（保范）约束放松为最小二乘仿射修正，把目标激活映射到安全锚点，同时对保留提示的位移加惩罚；该修正可作用于结构阶段、外观阶段或两者。
Result: 在 TRELLIS（标准开源原生 3D 生成器）上，跨 15 个形状、材质与物体概念，STAGE 综合分 66.7（聚合 CLIP 语义与物理指标，权衡目标概念遗忘与其余保持），最强适配基线为 53.2。
Conclusion: 概念类型决定编辑必须到达的阶段：形状与物体概念在结构阶段擦除、材质概念在外观阶段擦除；分阶段的子空间受限仿射修正在原生 text-to-3D 上优于把 2D 单通路假设搬过来的适配基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Continual Learning for 6-DoF Grasp Synthesis via Experience and Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Most current grasp synthesis systems are trained offline and remain fixed during deployment. While this works well when deployment conditions resemble the training data, performance can degrade when robots encounter conditions they have not seen before, such as unfamiliar objects. In this work, we present a continual-learning framework for single-view 6-DoF grasp synthesis for a parallel-jaw gripper in cluttered scenes. Rather than finetuning a large parametric model, our method adapts through memory in a learned embedding space: grasp outcomes update future grasp scores, while optional user demonstrations are recalled and transferred to new scenes as additional candidate grasps. We evaluate our method in simulation and in extensive real-world experiments comprising over 1500 grasp trials. We show that our method matches the performance of existing 6-DoF grasping baselines even before adaptation, improves online on unseen objects from categories absent or underrepresented during training, and supports long-horizon continual learning with limited forgetting. In real-world experiments, our method reaches over 90\% success rates on several challenging object categories after only 50 online grasp attempts. Videos and code at https://giuschio.github.io/cl_grasping/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向平行夹爪单视图 6-DoF 抓取综合的持续学习框架：不微调大参数模型，而是在学习到的嵌入空间里用记忆适配，抓取结果回写后续抓取打分，用户示教被召回并迁移到新场景作为候选抓取。在仿真与超过 1500 次真实抓取试验中，方法在适应前即与现有 6-DoF 抓取基线持平，对训练中缺失或欠代表类别的未见物体在线提升，若干困难类别在仅 50 次在线尝试后达到 90% 以上成功率，且长程持续学习遗忘有限。
Motivation: 抓取综合系统通常离线训练后在部署期固定，遇到训练分布外的新物体等未见条件时性能会退化；直接微调大参数模型代价高。
Method: 针对杂乱场景下平行夹爪的单视图 6-DoF 抓取，提出基于学习嵌入空间中记忆的持续学习框架：抓取结果更新未来的抓取打分，可选的用户示教被召回并迁移为新场景的额外候选抓取，而非微调大参数模型。
Result: 在仿真与超过 1500 次真实抓取试验上评估：适应前即匹配现有 6-DoF 抓取基线性能；对训练中缺失或欠代表类别的未见物体在线改善；支持长程持续学习且遗忘有限；真实实验中若干困难物体类别在仅 50 次在线抓取尝试后成功率达到 90% 以上。
Conclusion: 用嵌入空间记忆而非模型微调做在线适配，可以在不牺牲既有抓取性能的前提下，让抓取系统对未见物体快速达到高成功率并保持长程学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Questionnaire-Guided Disaggregation of Energy Appliance Use for Domestic Smart Meter Data
papers.abstract_en: Ireland's smart metering programme records electricity use at 30-minute resolution, with smart meters installed in over 80\% of households as of late 2025. While this is useful for billing of smart, time-of-use tariffs, it is too coarse to capture use of domestic appliances. We present a label-free disaggregation system that breaks usage data into 9 appliance categories by combining event detection for high-power loads with questionnaire-guided estimation. Our evaluation draws on four datasets: a calibration household with a commercial comparator, two public benchmarks (UK-DALE and REFIT) with per-appliance sub-metering, and a smart meter dataset of more than 4,800 years of use from 2,968 Irish consumers. Compared against two independently developed disaggregation systems our hybrid method combining analysis of usage data with questionnaire results, achieves the lowest whole-decomposition error on all buildings across the datasets, with better month-level performance over 54 paired months ($p<0.001$, Holm-corrected). Our method provides useful advice on a household's energy consumption patterns and advice on how to reduce or shift usage on some appliances in order to reduce costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对爱尔兰 30 分钟分辨率智能电表数据无法分辨家电用电的问题，提出无标签的用电分解系统：高功率负荷事件检测与问卷引导估计结合，把总用电拆成 9 类家电。在 UK-DALE、REFIT 等四个数据集上对比两套独立开发的分解系统，其整体分解误差在所有建筑上最低，54 个配对月份的月度表现更好（p<0.001，Holm 校正）。
Motivation: 爱尔兰智能电表 30 分钟采样虽支撑分时电价计费，但时间粒度太粗，无法分辨单个家电的用电，家庭难以据此调整或转移负荷以降电费。
Method: 混合式无标签分解：对高功率负荷做事件检测，再用问卷结果引导估计，把总用电拆成 9 个家电类别；评测覆盖四个数据集——含商用对照的校准户、带分项计量的公开基准 UK-DALE 与 REFIT、以及 2,968 名爱尔兰用户超过 4,800 年用电记录的智能电表数据集。
Result: 与两套独立开发的分解系统相比，该混合方法在全部数据集的所有建筑上取得最低的整体分解误差；在 54 个配对月份上月度表现更优（p<0.001，Holm 校正）。爱尔兰智能电表截至 2025 年底覆盖超过 80% 家庭，采样分辨率为 30 分钟。
Conclusion: 把用量数据的事件检测与问卷信息结合，可以在无逐电器标签的 30 分钟智能电表数据上做到更准的家电分解，并据此给出削减或转移部分电器用电以降成本的建议。

summary_sections.motivation: 爱尔兰智能电表 30 分钟采样虽支撑分时电价计费，但时间粒度太粗，无法分辨单个家电的用电，家庭难以据此调整或转移负荷以降电费。
summary_sections.method: 混合式无标签分解：对高功率负荷做事件检测，再用问卷结果引导估计，把总用电拆成 9 个家电类别；评测覆盖四个数据集——含商用对照的校准户、带分项计量的公开基准 UK-DALE 与 REFIT、以及 2,968 名爱尔兰用户超过 4,800 年用电记录的智能电表数据集。
summary_sections.result: 与两套独立开发的分解系统相比，该混合方法在全部数据集的所有建筑上取得最低的整体分解误差；在 54 个配对月份上月度表现更优（p<0.001，Holm 校正）。爱尔兰智能电表截至 2025 年底覆盖超过 80% 家庭，采样分辨率为 30 分钟。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把用量数据的事件检测与问卷信息结合，可以在无逐电器标签的 30 分钟智能电表数据上做到更准的家电分解，并据此给出削减或转移部分电器用电以降成本的建议。

papers.title: ITC-MoE: Importance-guided Token-aware Compression for MoE Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible parallel decoding and increased model capacity, but their large number of expert parameters incurs substantial computation and storage costs. Existing low-rank MoE compression methods largely rely on static factorization and fixed rank allocation, which overlook the distinctive properties of MoE DLMs. Specifically, we identify two properties: cross-mode non-uniform redundancy, where parameter redundancy and sensitivity to rank truncation vary across the input, output, and expert modes, and token-wise utilization variation, where hot and cold tokens exhibit distinct spectral characteristics and expert activation patterns. To address these challenges, we propose ITC-MoE, an Importance-guided Token-aware Compression framework for MoE DLMs. ITC-MoE consists of two complementary components. First, Importance-guided Adaptive Tucker Compression (IATC) incorporates activation and gradient importance into expert weight transformation, jointly factorizes expert weights across multiple modes, and adaptively allocates ranks under a fixed parameter budget. Second, Token-aware Compensation and Routing (TCR) applies lightweight low-rank compensation to compression-sensitive hot tokens and restricts the candidate expert set for cold tokens with concentrated routing patterns. By jointly adapting compression capacity and inference execution to both parameter redundancy and token-wise variation, ITC-MoE substantially reduces the computation and storage costs of MoE DLMs while preserving their generation quality. For example, on SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32, ITC-MoE maintains an accuracy of 96.33% on MultiArith under a 30% compression budget, while achieving up to a 7.22x end-to-end speedup. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/ITC-MoE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ITC-MoE 针对 MoE 扩散语言模型 (MoE Diffusion Language Models) 的专家参数冗余，提出重要性引导的自适应 Tucker 分解 (IATC) 与 token 感知的补偿与路由 (TCR)：前者按激活与梯度重要性在多模态上联合分解专家权重并在固定参数预算下自适应分配秩，后者对压缩敏感的 hot token 加低秩补偿、对路由集中的 cold token 收缩候选专家集。在 SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32 上，30% 压缩预算下 MultiArith 精度保持 96.33%，端到端加速最高 7.22x。
Motivation: MoE DLM 的专家参数量大带来计算与存储开销，而现有低秩 MoE 压缩多为静态分解与固定秩分配，忽略跨 input/output/expert 模态的非均匀冗余以及 hot/cold token 的谱特征与专家激活差异。
Method: IATC 把激活与梯度重要性嵌入专家权重变换，跨多个模态联合 Tucker 分解专家权重，并在固定参数预算下自适应分配秩；TCR 对压缩敏感的 hot token 施加轻量低秩补偿，对路由模式集中的 cold token 限制候选专家集，联合调整压缩容量与推理执行。
Result: 在 SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32 上，30% 压缩预算下 MultiArith 精度 96.33%，端到端加速最高 7.22x；代码已开源。
Conclusion: 把压缩容量与推理执行同时适配参数冗余和 token 级差异，可在大幅削减 MoE DLM 计算与存储成本的同时保持生成质量。

papers.title: ODDR: One-Step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in deep learning for shadow removal have significantly enhanced image quality and realism. However, most approaches rely on real-world paired datasets, which are costly to collect and often limited in scene diversity, leading to limited generalization. To address these limitations, we propose One-step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward guidance (ODDR), a new framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity shadow removal without relying on real-world paired supervision. Our method begins with One-step Deshadow Diffusion (ODD), a baseline model trained on synthetic shadow data for efficient one-step shadow-free reconstruction. We further adapt ODD into ODDR using ShadowReward. In contrast to traditional, annotation-heavy approaches, ShadowReward is the first reward model for shadow removal trained entirely without human annotation. It learns to mimic human perceptual judgments by ranking synthetically generated images with controlled degradations, such as texture distortion and boundary artifacts. This reward-guided fine-tuning enables ODDR to close the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Extensive experiments show that ODD achieves strong performance without relying on real-world paired supervision, and ODDR further improves the results, narrowing the gap to fully supervised methods trained on real-world paired data while maintaining higher computational efficiency as a single-step model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ODDR 用合成阴影数据训练单步去阴影扩散 (One-step Deshadow Diffusion, ODD)，再以无人工标注的奖励模型 ShadowReward 做奖励引导微调，缩小合成到真实的域差距。实验显示 ODD 在不依赖真实成对监督下已取得强性能，ODDR 进一步改善结果，逼近用真实成对数据训练的全监督方法，同时保持单步模型的高计算效率。
Motivation: 现有去阴影方法依赖真实成对数据，采集成本高且场景多样性有限，导致泛化受限。
Method: 先在合成阴影数据上训练单步重建基线 ODD；再用 ShadowReward——首个完全无人工标注的去阴影奖励模型——通过给受控退化（纹理扭曲、边界伪影）的合成图排序来模仿人类感知判断，据此做奖励引导微调得到 ODDR。
Result: ODD 在不依赖真实成对监督的设置下取得强性能；ODDR 在其上进一步提升，缩小了与真实成对数据全监督方法的差距，并以单步模型保持更高计算效率。
Conclusion: 合成数据加无人标注的感知奖励引导可以替代真实成对监督做高质量单步去阴影，同时保住推理效率优势。

papers.title: Dyna3: VLM-Guided Training-Free 4D Reconstruction via Depth Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent depth foundation models like Depth Anything 3 (DA3) achieve remarkable multi-view depth estimation but assume static 3D scenes, limiting their applicability to real-world dynamic environments. Existing training-free 4D methods like Easi3R and VGGT4D rely on correspondence-trained backbones whose attention encodes cross-frame matching, a property absent in depth-only models like DA3. We present Dyna3, a training-free framework that extends DA3 for 4D dynamic scene reconstruction without any fine-tuning. Our key insight is that DA3's cross-view features, though trained only for depth consistency, implicitly encode motion-discriminative signals when combined with best-match feature search across frames. Its static surfaces find consistent matches globally, while dynamic objects cannot. We further adopt vision-language models (VLM) to automatically generate scene-specific semantic prompts for SAM 3, enabling precise instance-level segmentation that distinguishes which objects move from what objects exist. For reconstruction, we decouple the scene into a cross-frame aligned static background and per-frame dynamic point clouds. Experiments on four datasets demonstrate that Dyna3 surpasses correspondence-trained methods with +5.5pp J-Mean over state-of-the-art VGGT4D on dynamic object segmentation, while achieving up to 13x faster pose estimation and 3x faster 4D reconstruction with 4 to 8x lower memory. Dyna3 could therefore enable much denser temporal sampling that prior methods cannot support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dyna3 把只做静态场景的深度基础模型 Depth Anything 3 (DA3) 免训练地扩展到动态场景 4D 重建：跨帧 best-match 特征搜索暴露运动信号，VLM 自动生成场景语义提示驱动 SAM 3 做实例级分割，场景拆成跨帧对齐的静态背景与逐帧动态点云。在四个数据集上动态物体分割 J-Mean 比 SOTA 的 VGGT4D 高 +5.5pp，位姿估计最快 13 倍、4D 重建最快 3 倍、显存低 4–8 倍。
Motivation: 深度基础模型（如 DA3）假设静态 3D 场景，无法直接用于真实动态环境；现有免训练 4D 方法（Easi3R、VGGT4D）依赖经过 correspondence 训练的 backbone，其注意力含跨帧匹配能力，而纯深度模型不具备。
Method: 免训练框架 Dyna3：利用 DA3 跨视图特征在跨帧 best-match 搜索下隐含的运动判别性（静态面全局匹配一致、动态物体不一致）；用 VLM 自动生成场景特定语义提示喂给 SAM 3 做实例级分割，区分哪些物体在动；重建时把场景解耦为跨帧对齐的静态背景与逐帧动态点云，全程不微调。
Result: 在四个数据集上，动态物体分割 J-Mean 比 SOTA 的 VGGT4D 高 +5.5pp；位姿估计最快提速 13 倍，4D 重建提速 3 倍，显存降低 4–8 倍。
Conclusion: correspondence 训练并非 4D 重建的必要条件：深度基础模型的跨视图特征配合 best-match 搜索与实例分割即可超越 correspondence-trained 方法，并因效率优势支持更密的时间采样。

papers.title: Model validation in machine learning: A scenario-based guide from hold-out splits to nested group cross-validation in biomedical and applied research
papers.abstract_en: Model validation estimates the performance of a complete learning procedure on new data. However, an invalid split can produce an optimistic and stable result. This tutorial reviews hold-out validation, train/validation/test designs, repeated random subsampling, k-fold and repeated stratified cross-validation, leave-one-out and leave-p-out schemes, group-aware validation, and nested group cross-validation. General machine-learning principles are linked to EEG epochs, paired-eye OCT images, repeated clinical measurements, and multicenter data. Eight controlled scenarios compare flawed and leakage-safe designs: seven use locked confusion matrices with auditable metrics, and one uses a reproducible repeated-study simulation. The scenarios cover global feature selection, normalization leakage, dependent records, center mixing, repeated test-set use, and estimator instability. Bias, variance, metric aggregation, uncertainty, and computational cost are also examined. A data-size matrix, a decision tree, and reporting checklists are provided. Reproducible MATLAB templates and scikit-learn counterparts are included. The results show that no validation method is universally best. The independent unit must match the intended deployment target. Every data-dependent operation must also exclude the observations used for performance estimation.
papers.comment: Tutorial with eight controlled scenarios; includes MATLAB and Python/scikit-learn code listings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇模型验证教程，用八个受控场景对比有泄漏与防泄漏的划分设计，覆盖全局特征选择、归一化泄漏、相关记录、中心混用、测试集重复使用与估计器不稳定。结论是不存在普遍最优的验证方法：独立单元必须与部署目标一致，且所有依赖数据的操作都必须排除用于性能估计的观测。
Motivation: 错误的划分会给出乐观且看似稳定的结果，使模型在新数据上的真实性能被高估；教程要把通用验证原则落到 EEG epochs、配对眼 OCT 图像、重复临床测量与多中心数据这类相关结构真实存在的场景。
Method: 系统梳理 hold-out、train/validation/test、重复随机子采样、k-fold 与重复分层交叉验证、leave-one-out、leave-one-p-out、group-aware 验证与 nested group cross-validation；用八个受控场景对比缺陷设计与防泄漏设计，其中七个使用锁定的混淆矩阵与可审计指标，一个使用可复现的重复研究模拟，并考察偏差、方差、指标聚合、不确定性与计算开销，附数据规模矩阵、决策树、报告清单以及 MATLAB 与 scikit-learn 代码模板。
Result: 八个受控场景覆盖全局特征选择、归一化泄漏、相关记录、中心混用、重复使用测试集与估计器不稳定六类问题；七个场景给出锁定混淆矩阵与可审计指标，一个给出可复现的重复研究模拟；结果显示没有哪种验证方法普遍最优。
Conclusion: 验证设计的判据是独立单元与预期部署目标对齐，并让每个依赖数据的步骤排除用于性能估计的观测；教程以决策树和报告清单给出选择路径。

papers.title: ShelfChange3D: Object-Level 3D Change Detection for Retail Shelf Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Reliable shelf monitoring is an important capability for retail automation, yet existing out-of-stock detection methods mainly operate in image space and lack metric 3D localization for downstream robotic systems. We formulate shelf monitoring as object-level 3D change detection: given two RGB-D observations captured at different times, the goal is to identify changed products and localize each change with a 3D bounding box. To support this task, we introduce ShelfChange3D, comprising 145K synthetic and 5K real-world paired RGB-D observations with object-level 3D change annotations. We further propose ChangeBox, an end-to-end framework that jointly reasons over paired observations and predicts object-level 3D change boxes. To improve localization accuracy, we introduce a geometry-based refinement stage that exploits depth and gravity prior to estimate relative pose and refine predicted boxes. Experiments show that ChangeBox outperforms existing change detection baselines, with further gains from refinement and effective transfer from synthetic to real-world observations.
papers.comment: Our code will be available on our project website at https://zerone0011.github.io/ShelfChange3D/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把货架监控重构为对象级 3D 变化检测：给定两帧不同时刻的 RGB-D 观测，端到端框架 ChangeBox 联合推理并直接输出变化商品的 3D 包围框，再用基于深度与重力先验的几何细化阶段估计相对位姿、修正预测框。配套发布 ShelfChange3D 数据集（145K 合成 + 5K 真实配对 RGB-D，带对象级 3D 变化标注），实验显示 ChangeBox 优于现有变化检测基线，细化阶段带来进一步增益，且从合成到真实观测的迁移有效。
Motivation: 现有缺货检测方法主要在图像空间工作，缺少可供下游机器人系统使用的度量化 3D 定位能力。
Method: 提出 ShelfChange3D 数据集（145K 合成 + 5K 真实配对 RGB-D，含对象级 3D 变化标注）与端到端框架 ChangeBox：对成对观测联合推理并预测对象级 3D 变化框；再加一个几何细化阶段，利用 depth 与 gravity 先验估计相对位姿并修正预测框。
Result: 实验中 ChangeBox 优于现有变化检测基线，加入几何细化阶段后有进一步增益，并且从合成数据到真实观测的迁移有效。
Conclusion: 把货架监控当作对象级 3D 变化检测并配合几何细化，可以在保留度量定位的前提下做缺货检测，且合成数据训练可迁移到真实场景。

papers.title: Trustworthy Data- and ML-Ops for Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics (ITS\&L) has become a cornerstone of the modern social economy, relying heavily on the integration of Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and, more specifically, Machine Learning (ML). This paper provides a comprehensive review of Trustworthy Data and Machine Learning Operations (DataOps and MLOps) in the ITS\&L domain, underscoring their importance in improving efficiency, reliability, and decision-making precision within transportation and logistics services. We begin by identifying gaps in current literature, offering clear context for our contribution. Subsequently, we explore the complexities of DataOps and MLOps, discussing their necessity, key components, available tools, practical insights, and case studies relevant to ITS\&L. Additionally, we address the critical issue of Trustworthiness in AI applications, examining methods and tools designed to strengthen confidence in AI systems - especially in real-world ITS\&L scenarios. The paper concludes with a discussion of persisting challenges and future prospects in this rapidly advancing field, aiming to serve as a vital resource for researchers, industry practitioners, and policy makers. Overall, this work not only establishes a foundational understanding of DataOps and MLOps in ITS\&L but also charts a path for further research and innovation in developing more efficient, sustainable, and trustworthy intelligent transportation and logistics systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于智能交通与物流 (ITS&L) 中可信 DataOps 与 MLOps 的综述：先梳理现有文献缺口，再系统讨论 DataOps/MLOps 的必要性、核心组件、可用工具与案例，并专门考察提升 AI 系统可信度 (trustworthiness) 的方法与工具，最后指出该领域尚存的挑战与未来方向。
Motivation: ITS&L 高度依赖数据与机器学习集成，但现有文献在可信 DataOps/MLOps 上存在缺口，缺少面向该领域的系统性梳理，影响运输与物流服务的效率、可靠性与决策精度。
Method: 综述性工作：先识别当前文献缺口并给出贡献定位，随后分层展开 DataOps 与 MLOps 的必要性、关键组件、可用工具、实践洞见与 ITS&L 相关案例研究，再单独讨论 AI 可信性问题及其方法与工具，尤其面向真实 ITS&L 场景。
Result: 产出为综述与研究路线图：建立 ITS&L 中 DataOps/MLOps 的基础性理解框架，梳理可信 AI 的方法与工具，并总结持续存在的挑战与未来研究方向，面向研究者、产业从业者与政策制定者。
Conclusion: 在 ITS&L 中把 DataOps/MLOps 与可信性工具一起建设，是通向更高效、可持续、可信赖的智能交通与物流系统的路径；论文同时为后续研究与创新划定方向。
Relevance: 4
