papers.title: PickMoment: Continuous-Time Single-Image-to-Video via Learning Deblurring and Blur-to-Video
papers.abstract_en: Motion blur arises from the temporal integration of a continuous sharp signal over a finite exposure window, yet existing learning-based methods sidestep this physical model and predict only the sharp signal itself: most single-image deblurring methods recover a single frame at the exposure center, while blur-to-video methods predict a fixed set of frames. We introduce PickMoment, a continuous-time reformulation that directly learns the interval-mean blur over arbitrary sub-intervals of the exposure with a single deterministic model. Drawing an analogy to MeanFlow's average-velocity formulation, we train the model with three supervisions derived from the blur integral: an empirical reconstruction loss from available subframes, an additivity loss that enforces self-consistency across overlapping sub-intervals, and a sharp-frame loss anchored at the zero-interval limit. A single trained model unifies single-image deblurring, blur-to-video generation, and continuous-time pick-a-moment recovery as different queries to the same network, with no separate training for each task. Our PickMoment achieves state-of-the-art performance among generative-based deblurring methods on GoPro and HIDE while competitive against restoration-based methods on RealBlur, and the highest per-frame fidelity on GoPro-7 blur-to-video, all in a single forward pass without iterative sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PickMoment 把运动模糊重写为连续时间问题：单一确定性模型直接学习曝光窗口内任意子区间的区间均值模糊，用三项源自模糊积分的监督训练，一个网络即可同时充当单图去模糊、blur-to-video 与任意时刻取帧三种查询。在 GoPro 与 HIDE 上达到生成式去模糊方法的 state-of-the-art，在 RealBlur 上与修复式方法相当，并在 GoPro-7 blur-to-video 上取得最高逐帧保真度，全部单次前向、无需迭代采样。
Motivation: 现有学习式方法绕开模糊的物理模型：单图去模糊只重建曝光中心一帧，blur-to-video 只预测固定帧集合，无法对任意子区间或任意时刻做查询。
Method: 类比 MeanFlow 的平均速度形式，训练时用三项由模糊积分导出的监督：来自可用子帧的经验重建损失、强制重叠子区间自洽的 additivity 损失、锚定零区间极限的 sharp-frame 损失；单一确定性模型以不同查询方式统一三种任务，无需分别训练。
Result: 在 GoPro 与 HIDE 上取得生成式 (generative-based) 去模糊方法中的 state-of-the-art，在 RealBlur 上与修复式 (restoration-based) 方法相当；在 GoPro-7 blur-to-video 上取得最高逐帧保真度，且全部结果由单次前向、无迭代采样得到。
Conclusion: 把模糊当作连续时间区间均值来学，一个模型加三项积分监督就能覆盖去模糊、blur-to-video 与 pick-a-moment，不必为每个任务单独训练。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SCOPE-AD: Sequential cost-aware ordinal-belief planning with energy-based models for diagnostic agents
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under heterogeneous test costs and patient burden. Fixed-modality predictors do not jointly decide which test to acquire or when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. We propose SCOPE-AD (Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents) for cost-aware classification of cognitively normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD cases. A mask-aware ordinal model represents uncertainty along the ordered CN--MCI--AD continuum. Retrospective training records provide sampled Bellman targets for an energy-based teacher, whose action distributions are distilled into a Qwen policy. At deployment, the agent selects acquisition or diagnosis actions under availability and budget constraints without access to unacquired values. After each acquisition, the evidence and ordinal belief are updated before the next decision. On ADNI, SCOPE-AD achieves 77.70\% Macro-F1 at an average acquisition cost of \$50.46, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.34 percentage points. Full-modality evaluation raises Macro-F1 by only 1.89 points while increasing acquisition cost by 116.7 times. These results support selective acquisition for cost-effective diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOPE-AD 是一个在异质检查成本与预算约束下交替决定「采哪项检查」与「何时下诊断」的序贯诊断智能体：用 mask-aware 序数模型表示 CN–MCI–AD 连续谱上的不确定性，以能量模型 (EBM) 教师的采样 Bellman 目标蒸馏出 Qwen 策略。在 ADNI 上以平均 $50.46 的采集成本取得 77.70% Macro-F1，比最强基线高 9.34 个百分点；全模态只再涨 1.89 点却让成本增至 116.7 倍，因此选择性采集才是成本有效的诊断路径。
Motivation: AD 诊断要在检查成本与患者负担各异的条件下逐项取证，而固定模态预测器无法联合决定采哪项检查、以及现有证据何时已足够下诊断。
Method: mask-aware 序数模型沿 CN–MCI–AD 有序连续谱表示不确定性；用回顾性训练记录为能量模型教师生成采样 Bellman 目标，再把其动作分布蒸馏进 Qwen 策略；部署时在可得性与预算约束下选择采集或诊断动作，且不能访问未采集检查的数值，每次采集后更新证据与序数信念再决策。
Result: 在 ADNI 上 SCOPE-AD 取得 77.70% Macro-F1，平均采集成本 $50.46，比最强评估基线高 9.34 个百分点；全模态评估仅使 Macro-F1 提高 1.89 点，而采集成本增至 116.7 倍。
Conclusion: 选择性采集能在 AD 诊断中以远低于全模态的成本达到相当甚至更高的分类性能，支持按需取证而非固定模态输入。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Not All Is Lost: Repairing Lossy User Preference States of Personalization Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Personalization encoders compress evolving interaction histories into preference states used to rank items or condition text generation. A task head operating only on this state can miss useful evidence that remains in the frozen encoder's cached representations for individual timesteps. We study this recoverability gap and propose REPAIR, which compares cached representations with the current preference state in a compact learned coordinate space. It resolves corrective evidence over extended history, recent interactions, and localized bursts. It then selects which patterns at which timesteps contribute and adds their aggregate correction to the state before the task head. Encoder-host repair reuses representations from the existing forward computation without re-encoding the history. Across MovieLens, PENS, MIND, and Amazon Reviews 2023, training only REPAIR improves MRR and nDCG@10 for all twelve representative recommendation hosts while both encoder and task head remain frozen. Head-only finetuning of the same hosts yields smaller gains. For example, Mamba4Rec on MovieLens gains 3.96 MRR points, compared with 0.19 from head-only finetuning. Rank and temporal diagnostics support a compact, host-dependent corrective structure. In personalized generation, IMPerSumm improves the two reported weighted PerSEval variants, which assess responsiveness to user preference, by up to 25.23%. These results support post-compression state correction and distinguish the availability of preference evidence from its downstream use.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Author-prepared archival version with expanded discussion and interpretation. 59 pages, including references and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REPAIR 在冻结的个性化编码器与任务头之外，把缓存的逐时刻表征与当前偏好状态在紧凑学习坐标空间中对齐，选择性地把纠正证据加回状态。在 MovieLens、PENS、MIND、Amazon Reviews 2023 上只训练 REPAIR 即提升全部 12 个推荐宿主的 MRR 与 nDCG@10，Mamba4Rec 在 MovieLens 上 MRR 提升 3.96 点，而仅微调任务头只有 0.19 点。
Motivation: 个性化编码器把交互历史压缩成偏好状态后，只吃该状态的任务头会丢掉仍留在冻结编码器逐时刻缓存表征里的可用证据，压缩后的状态与下游实际使用之间存在可恢复性缺口。
Method: REPAIR 在紧凑学习坐标空间中比较缓存表征与当前偏好状态，分别在长历史、近期交互与局部突发三类模式上解析纠正证据，再选择哪些时刻的哪些模式贡献并把聚合纠正加到状态后送入任务头；encoder-host repair 复用已有前向计算的表征，不重新编码历史。
Result: 在 MovieLens、PENS、MIND、Amazon Reviews 2023 上，仅训练 REPAIR（编码器与任务头均冻结）对全部 12 个代表性推荐宿主同时提升 MRR 与 nDCG@10，且增益大于同宿主的仅任务头微调：Mamba4Rec 在 MovieLens 上 MRR 提升 3.96 点，仅微调任务头为 0.19 点；个性化生成中 IMPerSumm 在两个已报告的加权 PerSEval 变体（衡量对用户偏好的响应性）上最高提升 25.23%。
Conclusion: 偏好证据在压缩后仍然存在、只是未被下游使用，因此在状态层面做事后纠正即可恢复；纠正结构是紧凑且依赖宿主的，rank 与时间维度诊断支持这一点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IQS-BO: In-Context Query Selection for Bayesian Optimisation
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian Optimisation (BO) is a powerful framework for the optimisation of expensive black-box functions, but typically requires refitting a surrogate and maximising an acquisition function at every evaluation step. In-context approaches based on Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) amortise part of this cost by pre-training transformers on functions drawn from synthetic priors. PFNs4BO amortises the surrogate but still relies on a numerically maximised acquisition function, while FIBO performs BO fully in-context by sampling optimiser locations from a learned density, which fixes the decision rule and admits no surrogate. Learned acquisition functions score a finite candidate set with a trained network, but, lacking a label for the query, learn the score by reinforcement learning on previously solved tasks. We propose IQS-BO, a PFN that learns the query decision by supervised learning on synthetic priors. In a single forward pass, IQS-BO predicts the probability that each candidate maximises the objective over the set, and we show that the minimiser of its objective is the posterior probability of this event. The model can be pre-trained without a surrogate for fully in-context BO, or take the predictions of a fixed probabilistic surrogate as additional input, amortising only the decision step. Our method proposes queries at a fraction of the cost of acquisition-based methods, while either matching or outperforming standard BO with Gaussian processes (GPs) and available in-context methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. Finally, we propose a mixture prior for pre-training PFNs which combines samples from GPs with functions exhibiting warped inputs, isolated narrow optima, or plateaus that are poorly modeled by stationary kernels common in GP surrogates. We show that pre-training on this prior can lead to improved optimisation performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IQS-BO 用 PFN 以监督学习在合成先验上学查询决策，单次前向直接预测每个候选点为目标最大值的概率，其目标的极小化点等于该事件的后验概率。在合成与真实基准上以远低于采集函数方法的成本提出查询，同时匹配或优于 GP 标准 BO 与已有 in-context 方法；混合先验（GP 样本 + warped inputs、孤立窄峰、平台）预训练可进一步提升优化表现。
Motivation: BO 每步都要重拟合代理并数值最大化采集函数，成本高；已有 in-context 方法要么仍依赖采集函数最大化（PFNs4BO），要么固定决策规则且无代理（FIBO），学习型采集函数还需用强化学习在已解任务上学打分。
Method: IQS-BO 是一个 PFN，在合成先验上以监督学习学查询决策：单次前向预测集合中每个候选为最优点的概率，并证明其目标极小化点即该事件后验概率。可不带代理做 fully in-context BO，也可把固定概率代理的预测作为额外输入、只摊销决策步。另提出预训练混合先验，结合 GP 样本与 warped inputs、孤立窄极值、平台函数。
Result: 在合成与真实基准上，提出查询的成本只是基于采集函数方法的一小部分（a fraction of the cost），且匹配或优于带 GP 的标准 BO 及现有 in-context 方法；在该混合先验上预训练可带来更好的优化表现。
Conclusion: 把 BO 的查询决策当作监督学习的分类问题即可绕过逐步代理拟合与采集函数数值最大化，同时保持竞争力；针对非平稳核难以刻画的函数形态设计预训练先验能进一步改善优化结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Feedback Without the Wait: Piloting a Generative AI Practice Platform in a Large Maths Class
papers.abstract_en: Timely and specific feedback is one of the strongest influences on student learning, yet it is difficult to sustain in large electrical engineering classes where the ratio of students to demonstrators is high and a learner who is stuck may wait days to find out why an approach was wrong. Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) offers a way to scale conversational feedback, but using it to grade assessed work raises trust and accountability concerns, and keeping a human in the loop to assure its judgements reintroduces the very delay that erodes the value of feedback. The result is a tension between the immediacy that makes feedback so impactful and the human oversight that makes it trustworthy. In this work, we set out to resolve that tension in practice by designing and piloting a GenAI practice platform that delivers immediate, scaffolded feedback during self-directed practice. This relocates human oversight from real-time grading to the upfront verification of solutions. Our goal was to understand how students engaged with the tool, how they perceived the value and reliability of its feedback, and what lessons transfer to other engineering subjects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在大型电气工程数学课上试点 GenAI 练习平台，把人工监督从实时评分前移到课前的答案核验，使学生在自主练习时立即获得分步反馈。研究目标是弄清学生如何使用该工具、如何评价反馈的价值与可靠性，以及经验能否迁移到其他工程科目。
Motivation: 大课中学生与助教比例高，卡住的学生可能等数天才知道思路错在哪；用 GenAI 自动评分又带来信任与问责问题，而保留人工复核会重新引入延迟，形成即时性与可信度之间的张力。
Method: 设计并试点一个 GenAI 练习平台，在学生自主练习时提供即时、分步 (scaffolded) 的对话式反馈；人工监督从实时评分改为对标准答案的前置核验 (upfront verification of solutions)。以学生参与情况、对反馈价值与可靠性的感知为研究问题。
Result: 论文报告的是一项设计与试点工作，研究问题是学生如何与工具互动、如何感知其反馈的价值与可靠性，以及经验如何迁移到其他工程科目；摘要给出的是试点目标而非量化指标。
Conclusion: 把人工监督前移到答案核验环节，可以在不牺牲可信度的前提下让练习反馈即时化；作者关注的是参与度、感知可靠性与跨科目可迁移性这三类经验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PROMO: Preference-conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Robots
papers.abstract_en: Quadrupedal locomotion requires balancing conflicting objectives such as command tracking, stability, and energy efficiency, yet conventional reinforcement learning (RL) hardcodes these priorities into a fixed scalar reward at training time. We present PROMO (Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning), a semantic multi-objective approach that makes this trade-off an explicit runtime input to a single locomotion policy. PROMO conditions the policy on deployment facing preferences while keeping embodiment-specific locomotion priors fixed, thereby separating operator intent from reward shaping terms required for viable gait generation. Compared with fixed-objective controllers, multi-objective baselines, and independently trained specialists, PROMO achieves objective specialization and robustness from a single deployable policy. Across 100 sampled preferences in simulation, 67 behaviors are non-dominated under exact Pareto dominance, with a mean preference-objective correlation of 0.843, demonstrating broad Pareto coverage and predictable preference response. The same policy transfers zero-shot to a Unitree Go2, where preference changes alone reduce specific energy by up to 30.4%, position error by 38.7%, and peak body-attitude deviation by 59.0% relative to the balanced preference. These results establish preference-conditioned multi-objective RL as a practical runtime interface for adaptive legged locomotion, extending its role beyond offline Pareto-set construction. Open-source code and videos are available at https://amrmousa.com/promo/.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics. Project website, code, and videos: https://amrmousa.com/promo/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PROMO 把四足机器人 locomotion 的多目标权衡做成运行时输入：策略以操作者偏好为条件，单个策略即可在部署时切换跟踪、稳定与能效的优先级。仿真中采样 100 个偏好有 67 个在精确 Pareto 支配下非支配，偏好-目标平均相关 0.843；零样本迁移到 Unitree Go2 后，仅改偏好相对 balanced 偏好使比能耗最多降 30.4%、位置误差降 38.7%、峰值机体姿态偏差降 59.0%。
Motivation: 常规 RL 把目标优先级在训练时硬编码进固定标量奖励，部署后无法按操作者意图重新权衡跟踪、稳定与能效，只能靠重训或维护多个 specialist 策略。
Method: PROMO (Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning) 是语义式多目标方法：策略以部署时偏好为条件，同时保持 embodiment 特定的 locomotion 先验固定，把操作者意图与生成可行步态所需的 reward shaping 项分离；对照固定目标控制器、多目标基线与独立训练的 specialists。
Result: 仿真中采样 100 个偏好，67 个行为在精确 Pareto 支配下非支配，偏好-目标平均相关 0.843；同一策略零样本迁移到 Unitree Go2，仅改变偏好相对 balanced 偏好使 specific energy 最多降低 30.4%、position error 降低 38.7%、peak body-attitude deviation 降低 59.0%。
Conclusion: 偏好条件化的多目标 RL 可以作为腿式机器人自适应运动的运行时接口，把多目标权衡从离线 Pareto 集构造扩展到部署时在线调节，且单一可部署策略即可兼顾目标特化与鲁棒性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Science Utopia? Closed-Loop LLM Simulation of Academic Research Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: Scientific progress emerges from a longitudinal ecosystem in which researchers, institutions, funding agencies, collaboration networks, and the scientific literature co-evolve. As AI becomes increasingly involved throughout the scientific research cycle, understanding these interconnected and evolving processes becomes increasingly important. We introduce SciUtopia, a persistent, closed-loop LLM-agent simulation framework for studying academic research ecosystems. SciUtopia models interconnected scientific processes such as research-direction choice, collaboration, submission, peer review, resubmission, citation, funding, and researcher attrition, while maintaining evolving states across simulated years. Its configurable institutional mechanisms and information channels provide a controlled testbed for matched counterfactual experiments and targeted interventions. Across 61 simulation worlds, SciUtopia simulates over 40,000 researchers from 8,000 institutions, producing around 400,000 publication decisions and 1.2 million LLM-generated peer reviews. Using these longitudinal simulations, we find that rejection-driven resubmission substantially amplifies reviewer burden beyond population growth alone, cautious exploration balances citation impact with career success and long-term topic diversity, and resource inequality can emerge even without detectable cumulative advantage from narrowly winning early funding. Code is available at https://github.com/Ahren09/ScienceUtopia.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SciUtopia 是一个持久化闭环 LLM-agent 学术生态仿真框架，把选题、合作、投稿、同行评审、重投、引用、资助与研究者流失建模为跨模拟年演化的状态。在 61 个仿真世界、逾 40,000 名研究者与 8,000 家机构上，它产生约 400,000 次投稿决策与 120 万条 LLM 生成的评审意见，发现拒稿驱动的重投使评审负担远超人口增长本身，谨慎探索能兼顾引用影响、职业成功与长期主题多样性，资源不平等可在早期资助险胜未表现出可检测累积优势的情况下仍然出现。
Motivation: 科研进展是研究者、机构、资助方、合作网络与文献共同演化的纵向系统，AI 深度介入科研全流程后，需要可控的反事实实验床来理解这些互联过程如何随时间演化。
Method: SciUtopia 用持久化 LLM-agent 模拟研究方向选择、合作、投稿、同行评审、重投、引用、资助与研究者流失，并在模拟年份间保持演化状态；提供可配置的制度机制与信息通道，用于配对反事实实验与定向干预。
Result: 在 61 个仿真世界中模拟逾 40,000 名研究者、8,000 家机构，产生约 400,000 次投稿决策与 120 万条 LLM 生成的同行评审；纵向仿真显示拒稿驱动的重投显著放大评审负担（超出人口增长本身），谨慎探索平衡引用影响与职业成功及长期主题多样性，资源不平等可在早期资助险胜未检测到累积优势时出现。
Conclusion: 学术生态中的评审负担、主题多样性与资源不平等可由制度机制（拒稿-重投循环、资助门槛）在闭环仿真中被单独操纵并观察其涌现，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Errors in LLM agent executions and their visible consequences can be separated by many steps, making decisive-error localization a matter of understanding both step content and step dependencies. We introduce DeFA, a dependency-guided framework for agent failure attribution. DeFA first combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph spanning the trajectory. It then identifies events that may violate task requirements and traces their sources and subsequent effects to construct a failure propagation graph. Finally, DeFA uses step evidence and the steps' roles in failure propagation to identify the decisive error, responsible agent, and error category. To support long trajectories, DeFA partitions executions into segments and combines the current segment's detailed content with summaries of the other segments, giving local diagnosis access to global execution context. Across Who and When and the Who and When Pro text subset, DeFA achieves the highest responsible-agent and exact step accuracy with all evaluated backbones, and the highest failure-mode accuracy among taxonomy-aligned methods on Pro. Further experiments on image and video trajectories demonstrate its applicability to multimodal failure attribution. Ablations support the contributions of segmentation, the event dependency graph, and the failure propagation graph. Using DeFA's diagnostic feedback for skill evolution in Trace2Skill improves downstream task accuracy by 6-15 percentage points over the native pipeline, showing that the diagnoses can also support agent improvement on subsequent tasks.
papers.comment: DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeFA 用事件依赖图与失败传播图定位 LLM agent 轨迹中的决定性错误，在 Who and When 及其 Pro 文本子集上取得最高的 responsible-agent 与 exact step 准确率，其诊断反馈接入 Trace2Skill 后下游任务准确率提升 6–15 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM agent 执行中的错误与其可见后果往往相隔多步，仅看单步内容无法定位决定性错误，需要同时建模步间依赖。
Method: DeFA 先把协议关系与语义依赖合成覆盖整条轨迹的事件依赖图，再识别可能违反任务要求的事件并回溯其来源与后续影响，构造失败传播图；最后结合步证据与各步在传播中的角色判定决定性错误、责任 agent 与错误类别。长轨迹按段切分，当前段用详细内容、其余段用摘要，兼顾局部诊断与全局上下文。
Result: 在 Who and When 与 Who and When Pro 文本子集上，DeFA 在所有评估 backbone 上均取得最高的 responsible-agent 和 exact step 准确率，并在 Pro 上取得 taxonomy-aligned 方法中最高的 failure-mode 准确率；图像与视频轨迹实验显示其可用于多模态失败归因；消融支持分段、事件依赖图与失败传播图的贡献；诊断反馈用于 Trace2Skill 的 skill evolution 后，下游任务准确率较原生 pipeline 提升 6–15 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把步内容与步依赖一起建模能更准地定位 agent 的决定性错误，且这类诊断可直接转化为下游任务的性能提升。

papers.title: Context-Aware Error Mitigation Orchestration for Hybrid Quantum Reinforcement Learning on NISQ Systems
papers.abstract_en: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) integrates reinforcement learning with parameterized quantum circuits and is a promising approach to combinatorial optimization. On Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices, however, decoherence, gate imperfections, and measurement errors reduce policy quality and make learning less reliable. Existing error mitigation techniques are generally applied as fixed corrections that do not adapt to changing noise conditions or to the evolving state of training. This work presents Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM) as a context-aware orchestration layer of the hybrid quantum-classical training loop that dynamically selects the most suitable mitigation strategy during QRL training. APGEM evaluates Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), Clifford Data Regression (CDR), and Readout Error Mitigation (REM) using policy-level indicators, including quantum-state fidelity, policy entropy, cumulative reward, and approximation ratio, and integrates the selected strategy directly into the reinforcement learning loop. The framework is evaluated on the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), a representative NP-hard problem in urban logistics, under a range of NISQ noise models and noise levels. APGEM consistently outperforms conventional static mitigation methods, reaches approximately 94% of the utility of an oracle strategy, maintains higher quantum-state fidelity as noise increases, and produces more stable learning behaviour throughout training. Ablation studies show that the framework learns context-aware mitigation policies that adapt to different noise environments and circuit execution conditions. These findings demonstrate that integrating adaptive error mitigation into the learning process substantially improves the robustness and reliability of QRL on NISQ hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 APGEM：在混合量子-经典强化学习训练环里，用策略级指标（量子态保真度、策略熵、累计奖励、近似比）在线挑选 ZNE、PEC、CDR、REM 中最合适的误差缓解手段，替代固定缓解。在 CVRP 上跨多种 NISQ 噪声模型与噪声水平，APGEM 稳定优于静态缓解，达到 oracle 策略约 94% 的效用，且噪声升高时量子态保真度更高、训练更平稳。
Motivation: NISQ 器件上的退相干、门误差与测量误差会拉低 QRL 策略质量，而现有缓解手段是固定修正，既不随噪声条件变化，也不随训练状态演化。
Method: APGEM 作为混合量子-经典训练环的上下文感知编排层，用量子态保真度、策略熵、累计奖励、近似比等策略级指标评估 ZNE、PEC、CDR、REM 四种缓解策略，把选中的策略直接接入 RL 训练循环；在 CVRP 上配合消融实验检验其上下文感知的缓解策略学习。
Result: 在 CVRP（NP-hard 城市物流问题）上跨一系列 NISQ 噪声模型与噪声水平，APGEM 一贯优于常规静态缓解方法，达到 oracle 策略约 94% 的效用，噪声增大时保持更高的量子态保真度，训练全程学习行为更稳定；消融研究显示其学到的缓解策略能适配不同噪声环境与线路执行条件。
Conclusion: 把自适应误差缓解嵌入学习过程本身，可显著提升 QRL 在 NISQ 硬件上的鲁棒性与可靠性，而非在训练外做一次性固定修正。

papers.title: Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graphs for Dynamic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Conventional reasoning protocols present a fixed, preselected task, so they cannot test whether an agent propagates relevant updates, preserves unaffected work, or reconstructs a historical task binding. We therefore study \emph{dynamic task routing}, in which an event stream revises task bindings and a system must select the document version valid at each query time before solving it. To study this problem, we repurpose six widely used benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-Pro, MedMCQA, MATH, GPQA, and HumanEval into 31{,}119 dynamic episodes comprising 373{,}428 temporally categorized queries. This setting exposes a central trade-off: recomputing after every event wastes work, whereas unguarded reuse returns stale conclusions. We introduce the Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG), a bounded multi-agent policy that separates deterministic temporal resolution from task reasoning. RIAG caches solutions by immutable document identity, starts each fresh task with two unexposed attempts, and conditionally invokes audit and repair, using at most four calls per document version. On this collection, homogeneous RIAG achieves 54.24\% joint routing-and-answer accuracy at 0.62 calls/query, compared with 32.22\% at 18.00 calls/query for the strongest comparison method; heterogeneous RIAG reaches 49.78\% at 0.63 calls/query.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIAG 把动态任务路由拆成确定性时间解析与任务推理两部分：按不可变文档身份缓存答案，新任务先给两次未曝光尝试，再按需调用 audit 与 repair，每个文档版本最多四次调用。在由 MMLU、MMLU-Pro、MedMCQA、MATH、GPQA、HumanEval 改造成的 31,119 个动态 episode 上，同质 RIAG 联合路由-回答准确率 54.24%、每查询 0.62 次调用，对比最强方法的 32.22%、18.00 次调用。
Motivation: 常规推理协议的任务是固定预选的，无法检验 agent 是否传播相关更新、保留未受影响的工作、或重建历史任务绑定；而事件流不断修订任务绑定时，每次事件都重算浪费算力，无保护复用又会返回过期结论。
Method: 提出 Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG)：把确定性时间解析（选查询时刻有效的文档版本）与任务推理分离；按不可变文档身份缓存解法，新任务先给两次未曝光尝试，再条件性触发 audit 与 repair，每个文档版本最多四次调用。数据集由六个基准改造成 31,119 个动态 episode、373,428 条按时间分类的查询。
Result: 同质 RIAG 联合路由-回答准确率 54.24%，每查询 0.62 次调用；最强对比方法 32.22%、每查询 18.00 次调用。异质 RIAG 达 49.78%、每查询 0.63 次调用。
Conclusion: 把时间解析做成确定性步骤、只在文档版本边界上限制调用次数，可以在动态任务路由上同时拿到更高联合准确率和低一个数量级的调用开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When the Judge Acts: Auditing VLM-Guided Image Selection on Culturally Situated Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly act as judges that pick the best of several generated images, so their choices decide what users see. Such judges are usually validated by score agreement with human ratings, not by the images they return. We audit VLM judges as decision-makers: on 300 culturally situated prompts, we compare the returned image with human ratings the judge never sees and with random choice from the same candidates, and repeat every decision with the candidates reordered. A 4B-parameter judge barely beats random and falls short of a CLIP similarity baseline. It picks the first image shown in 49% of calls (chance: 28%), and reordering changes its choice on 60% of prompts. For this judge, agreement across orders is informative: decisions that survive reordering are much better than random, whereas agreement with a weaker second judge keeps the wrong ones. An 8B judge shows almost no position bias and outperforms CLIP, yet for it the same filter mostly discards good decisions. Agreement helps only when it targets the judge's failure mode, so filters must be re-audited whenever the judge changes. The 4B judge's slight rise in stereotype ratings is no longer detectable after aggregating across orders or with the larger judge.
papers.comment: 25 pages including appendix. Code and project page: https://github.com/seochan99/JudgeActs ; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/seochan99/JudgeActs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 VLM 当作图像选择裁判来审计：在 300 条文化情境 prompt 上，4B 裁判仅略胜随机、不及 CLIP 相似度基线，且 49% 的调用选中首图（随机 28%）、重排候选后 60% 的 prompt 改变选择。跨顺序一致性对 4B 是有效过滤器（保留的决策远好于随机），但对几乎无位置偏好的 8B 反而丢掉好决策，因此过滤器必须随裁判更换重新审计。
Motivation: VLM 裁判决定用户最终看到哪张生成图，但现有验证只看与人类评分的分数一致性，不检查实际返回的图像，也测不出位置偏好这类决策层缺陷。
Method: 在 300 条文化情境 prompt 上，把裁判返回的图与裁判从未见过的人类评分、以及同候选集内的随机选择对比；每次决策都把候选重排后重复一遍，并用跨顺序一致性作为过滤器，另与 CLIP 相似度基线和一个较弱的第二裁判对照。
Result: 4B 裁判仅略胜随机且低于 CLIP 基线；49% 的调用选中第一个展示的图像（随机水平 28%），重排使 60% 的 prompt 改变选择。跨顺序一致的决策远好于随机，而与较弱第二裁判的一致性会保留错误决策。8B 裁判几乎无位置偏好并超过 CLIP，但同一过滤器对其大多丢弃好决策。4B 裁判刻板印象评分的轻微上升，在跨顺序聚合后或换用更大裁判后不再可检出。
Conclusion: 一致性过滤只有在针对该裁判的失败模式时才有效，裁判一换就必须重新审计；单看与人类评分的分数一致性不足以判定裁判好坏。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mixture-Trained Merging for Unified Multi-Objective Models
papers.abstract_en: Unified language models are increasingly expected to combine heterogeneous capabilities, such as mathematics, code, instruction following, and controllable thinking behavior, within a single set of parameters. A common solution is sequential post-training on multiple objectives, but this entangles all objectives along one optimization trajectory and makes the final model highly sensitive to training order, data ratios, schedules, and stopping criteria. Weight-space merging offers a modular alternative, but naive merging of single-objective experts often fails: domain capabilities degrade sharply, or think/non-think modes collapse into one dominant behavior. We attribute both failures to incompatible weight-space geometry: experts trained on single objectives drift to distant regions of parameter space, placing their interpolations outside any shared low-loss basin. We propose Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM), which trains each branch on an objective-biased data mixture rather than a single objective, exposing it to cross-objective interactions and making branches compatible at merge time. MTM uses merged-model evaluations as a low-cost signal for selecting branch mixtures, avoiding expensive data-mixture ablations. The procedure is iterative: each round promotes the base model using globally selected merge coefficients and refines each branch mixture using domain-preferred coefficients under constraints that preserve other objectives. To scale beyond simplex grid search, MTM uses qNEHVI-based multi-objective Bayesian optimization. Across code, mathematics, instruction following, and think/non-think control, MTM outperforms naive merging and preserves behavioral separation where single-objective merging collapses, suggesting that effective unified models require branches trained to be mergeable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MTM 让每个分支在带目标偏置的数据混合上训练而非单一目标，使分支在合并时几何相容；用合并模型评估作为低成本信号迭代挑选混合比例，并以 qNEHVI 多目标贝叶斯优化扩展出单纯形网格搜索。在代码、数学、指令遵循与 think/non-think 控制上，MTM 优于朴素合并，并在单目标合并崩塌处保持行为分离。
Motivation: 顺序多目标后训练把所有目标纠缠在一条优化轨迹上，对训练顺序、数据比例、调度和停止准则高度敏感；而朴素权重空间合并因单目标专家漂移到参数空间远处、插值落在共享低损失盆地之外，导致领域能力骤降或 think/non-think 模式塌缩为单一行为。
Method: Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM)：每个分支用目标偏置的数据混合训练以暴露跨目标交互；以合并模型评估作为低成本信号选择分支混合，避免昂贵的数据混合消融；迭代过程每轮用全局选定的合并系数提升 base model，并在保持其他目标的约束下用领域偏好系数精化各分支混合；用 qNEHVI 多目标贝叶斯优化超越单纯形网格搜索。
Result: 在代码、数学、指令遵循与 think/non-think 控制四类目标上，MTM 优于朴素合并，并在单目标合并发生行为塌缩的场景中保持 think/non-think 行为分离；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 有效的统一模型要求分支本身被训练成可合并的（mergeable），而非事后强行插值单目标专家。

summary_sections.motivation: 顺序多目标后训练把所有目标纠缠在一条优化轨迹上，对训练顺序、数据比例、调度和停止准则高度敏感；而朴素权重空间合并因单目标专家漂移到参数空间远处、插值落在共享低损失盆地之外，导致领域能力骤降或 think/non-think 模式塌缩为单一行为。

papers.title: Learning to Ask: Information Acquisition for SLM-LLM Collaboration, under a budget
papers.abstract_en: Collaboration between a small language model (SLM) and a large language model (LLM) offers an opportunity to combine the efficiency of smaller models with the strong reasoning capabilities of larger ones. Existing approaches primarily frame such collaboration as a computation allocation problem, determining which model should handle each portion of the reasoning process. In black-box API-based settings, however, this paradigm can be inefficient due to coarse-grained delegation or repeated transmission of context across model switches. In this work, we instead formulate SLM-LLM collaboration as an information acquisition problem, under an API budget constraint. The SLM remains the primary reasoner and selectively queries a black-box LLM advisor only when needed, issuing targeted queries rather than delegating the reasoning process itself. To realize this strategy, we develop a three-stage RLVR framework that learns whether to call the advisor, how to formulate useful queries, and how to integrate the collaboration into the reasoning process by jointly refining advisor invocation and information use. Across mathematical reasoning and coding tasks, our approach improves the performance--cost tradeoff over existing collaboration baselines and, in some settings, matches or exceeds oracle problem-level routing. Finally, we show that our strategy can transfer to other advisor model families, without further training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 SLM-LLM 协作从「算力分配」改写为预算约束下的信息获取问题：SLM 作为主推理器，仅在需要时向黑盒 LLM 顾问发起定向查询。三阶段 RLVR 框架联合学习是否调用顾问、如何构造有用查询、如何把协作信息融回推理，在数学推理与编码任务上改善性能-成本权衡，部分设置下匹配或超过 oracle 的题目级路由，且无需再训练即可迁移到其他顾问模型家族。
Motivation: 现有 SLM-LLM 协作把问题当作计算分配，黑盒 API 场景下粗粒度委派或模型切换时反复传输上下文导致效率低下。
Method: 提出三阶段 RLVR 框架：先学是否调用顾问，再学如何构造查询，最后联合优化顾问调用与信息使用，把协作整合进推理过程；SLM 始终是主推理器，只做定向查询而非委派推理。
Result: 在数学推理与编码任务上，性能-成本权衡优于现有协作基线，部分设置下匹配或超过 oracle 的题目级路由；策略可迁移到其他顾问模型家族且无需进一步训练。
Conclusion: 在 API 预算下，把协作当作信息获取而非算力分配，能以更低成本拿到相当或更好的推理表现，且学到的查询策略跨顾问家族通用。

papers.title: Flow Matching Reinforcement for 3D Mesh Generation via Dynamic Homing Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching is central to 3D generation, yet in practice its reinforcement learning (RL) methods are largely adapted from 2D visual generation. Representative DPO-, GRPO-, and NFT-style objectives, when applied to negative trajectories, mainly steer predicted velocities away from the corresponding directions without explicitly specifying a target velocity field toward preferred samples. In 3D generation, constrained by pretrained model capabilities, rollout diversity, and reward-distribution complexity, directly applying these RL methods yields limited gains in geometric quality. We introduce a forward-process RL method \textbf{Dynamic Homing Optimization (DHO)}, which reformulates negative-trajectory optimization as positive-sample attraction-guided dynamic homing. Specifically, Minimum-Cost Attractive Matching (MAM) assigns each negative sample a distinct positive target, and Time-Aware Dynamic Correction (TDC) then redirects its trajectory toward the target using a remaining-time-aware corrective velocity. Building on asynchronous online DHO, we develop \textbf{Flow3D-Pro}, an image-to-3D geometry generation framework. Experiments show that DHO outperforms representative DPO-, GRPO-, and NFT-style objectives in 3D generation, while Flow3D-Pro produces higher-quality 3D geometry than existing mesh generation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 3D flow matching 的前向过程强化学习方法 Dynamic Homing Optimization (DHO)，把负轨迹优化改写为正样本吸引引导的动态归航：MAM 为每个负样本指定一个正目标，TDC 用剩余时间感知的修正速度把轨迹拉向目标。基于异步在线 DHO 构建 image-to-3D 框架 Flow3D-Pro，实验中 DHO 在 3D 生成上优于 DPO、GRPO、NFT 类目标，Flow3D-Pro 生成的 3D 几何质量高于现有 mesh 生成方法。
Motivation: 现有 3D 生成的 RL 方法多从 2D 视觉生成移植，DPO/GRPO/NFT 类目标作用于负轨迹时只把预测速度推离对应方向，不指定指向偏好样本的目标速度场；受预训练模型能力、rollout 多样性与奖励分布复杂性限制，直接套用在几何质量上增益有限。
Method: DHO 属于前向过程 RL：Minimum-Cost Attractive Matching (MAM) 为每个负样本分配一个互异的正目标，Time-Aware Dynamic Correction (TDC) 用剩余时间感知的修正速度将轨迹重定向至该目标。在此之上以异步在线 DHO 搭建 Flow3D-Pro，做 image-to-3D 几何生成。
Result: 实验显示 DHO 在 3D 生成上优于具代表性的 DPO、GRPO、NFT 类目标；Flow3D-Pro 产出的 3D 几何质量高于现有 mesh 生成方法。
Conclusion: 把负轨迹优化改成正样本吸引的动态归航，比单纯推离负方向的 2D 移植 RL 目标更能提升 3D 几何质量。

papers.title: Judgement in the Age of Jev: From Evaluation Scarcity to Evaluation Abundance
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence has reduced the cost of producing plausible symbolic artefacts, leading recent organisation scholarship to identify evaluation and discernment as constraints under conditions of production abundance. This perspective examines a further possibility: that machine evaluation itself becomes inexpensive enough to be deployed routinely and at scale. The investigation is prompted by Jev, TypeSafe AI's specialised model for typed probabilistic decisions. TypeSafe explicitly invokes William Stanley Jevons to argue that lower-cost machine intelligence can unlock previously uneconomic uses. Treating this as a technological provocation rather than an established empirical result, the article formulates a conditional Jevons hypothesis for machine evaluation: sufficiently large reductions in the total marginal cost of usable machine evaluation may increase its organisational consumption where latent demand is substantial and complementary costs do not dominate. The article integrates rebound economics with research on cheap prediction, production abundance, machine evaluation, decision allocation, authority, reliance and Executive Judgement to examine this possible scarcity transition. It distinguishes prediction, machine evaluation, organisational judgement and authorisation as functional activities whose costs need not fall together. Evaluations can share evidence, criteria and errors; scale mis-specified rubrics; operate on representations from which consequential qualifications have disappeared; and change practical decision rights through thresholds and exception routing. The resulting research problem is when cheap machine evaluation substitutes for human evaluative work, when it redistributes or creates demands for judgement, and how it affects the grounds available at consequential organisational commitment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出机器评估的条件性 Jevons 假设：当可用机器评估的总边际成本足够大幅下降、潜在需求充足且互补成本不占主导时，其组织性消费量会上升。它把预测、机器评估、组织判断与授权区分为成本未必同步下降的四类活动，并指出廉价评估会通过阈值与例外路由改变实际决策权。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 使产出符号制品的成本骤降，组织研究已把评估与辨别视为产出丰裕下的约束；本文追问当机器评估本身变得足够便宜并被大规模常规部署时，稀缺性如何转移。
Method: 以 TypeSafe AI 的专用模型 Jev（面向类型化概率决策）为技术挑衅，整合 rebound economics、廉价预测、生产丰裕、机器评估、决策分配、权威与依赖研究，构建条件性 Jevons 假设，并区分预测、机器评估、组织判断与授权四类功能活动。
Result: 定性论断：评估可共享证据、标准与错误，会放大设定不当的 rubric，作用于已丢失关键限定信息的表征，并通过阈值与例外路由改变实际决策权；四类活动的成本不必同步下降。
Conclusion: 核心研究问题是廉价机器评估何时替代人类评估劳动、何时重新分配或创造判断需求，以及它如何影响重大组织承诺时可用的依据。

papers.title: HHR: Hierarchical Hash Retrieval for Efficient LLM Generation
papers.abstract_en: Efficient long-context inference is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet it poses a severe computational bottleneck. Hash-based retrieval offers an efficient alternative by encoding queries and keys into binary codes and using Hamming distance for key selection. However, this leads to a critical mismatch between Hamming distance and attention relevance. Query-Key logits depend jointly on directional similarity and feature magnitudes, whereas hash binarization discards magnitude information, causing both false-positive retrieval of low-logit keys and false-negative omission of high-logit keys. To address these failures, we propose Hierarchical Hash Retrieval (HHR), a coarse-to-fine framework that progressively improves retrieval accuracy through Geometry-Aware Key Routing (GKR) and Learned Hash Projection (LHP). GKR learns a head-wise orthogonal transformation to redistribute feature magnitudes and derive more discriminative page-level logit bounds, enabling effective pruning of low-logit keys while preserving important candidates. LHP then learns a head-wise projection space that aligns Hamming distance with the true Query-Key relevance ranking for fine-grained retrieval. By combining GKR and LHP, HHR suppresses false positives and recovers false negatives, substantially improving the fidelity of hash-based sparse attention. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that HHR achieves superior performance over existing methods. For example, on LongBench, HHR improves the average score by 1.10 points and, at a context length of 128K, achieves up to a 3.30x decoding speedup and a 2.83x end-to-end speedup for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/HHR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HHR 用由粗到细的两级哈希检索修复长上下文 LLM 推理中 Hamming 距离与注意力相关性不匹配的问题：GKR 学逐头正交变换重分配特征幅度以给出页级 logit 界并剪掉低 logit 键，LHP 学逐头投影让 Hamming 距离对齐真实 Query-Key 排序。在 LongBench 上平均分提高 1.10 点，128K 上下文下 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 解码加速最高 3.30x、端到端加速 2.83x。
Motivation: 哈希检索把 query/key 二值化后只留 Hamming 距离，丢掉幅度信息，而 Query-Key logits 同时取决于方向相似度与特征幅度，导致低 logit 键被误检、高 logit 键被漏检，长上下文推理的注意力保真度和计算瓶颈因此同时恶化。
Method: HHR 是 coarse-to-fine 框架：先用 Geometry-Aware Key Routing (GKR) 学习 head-wise 正交变换，重新分布特征幅度并导出更有判别力的页级 logit 界，剪掉低 logit 键同时保住候选；再用 Learned Hash Projection (LHP) 学习 head-wise 投影空间，使 Hamming 距离与真实 Query-Key 相关性排序对齐，做细粒度检索。
Result: 在 LongBench 上 HHR 平均分比现有方法提高 1.10 点；在 128K 上下文长度下，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 解码加速最高 3.30x，端到端加速 2.83x；在多种 LLM 与 benchmark 上整体优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 把幅度信息通过几何路由与学习投影重新注入哈希检索，可以同时抑制假阳性与恢复假阴性，使哈希稀疏注意力在长上下文生成中既保真又高效。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Compact Explicit 4D Representation for Dynamic Scenes
papers.abstract_en: A compact dynamic-scene representation must retain both the surfaces seen over time and the appearance needed to render them from new viewpoints. We present Sparc4D, a feed-forward autoencoder that encodes a monocular video with known cameras into a sparse 4D scene state. Static features are shared across the clip, while spatially anchored temporal slots compress time-varying features. A sparse decoder produces 2D Gaussian surfels, while stored source pixels preserve fine texture through geometric re-projection. The state includes one full source frame and dynamic-region pixels sampled every fourth frame, alongside learned features and sparse occupancy. For a 32-frame MultiCamVideo clip, it averages 0.95M 32-bit-equivalent values on random windows and 0.92M on the first-32 protocol. On first-32, Sparc4D reaches 21.70\,dB, compared with 20.40\,dB for MoVieS. On randomly placed windows, their PSNR scores are comparable. With stored texture disabled, temporal slots compress the time-varying feature state by a median $4.0\times$ and reduce the mean state from 1.04M to 0.42M values, with essentially unchanged target-view reconstruction quality. Without fine-tuning on real data, Sparc4D transfers to DyCheck and Neu3D, where stored texture improves LPIPS while slightly reducing PSNR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sparc4D 是前馈自编码器，把已知相机的单目视频编码成稀疏 4D 场景状态：静态特征全片段共享，空间锚定的 temporal slot 压缩时变特征，稀疏解码器输出 2D Gaussian surfel，并保留源像素做几何重投影以保住纹理。32 帧 MultiCamVideo 上平均只占 0.95M（随机窗口）/0.92M（first-32）个 32-bit 等价值，first-32 PSNR 21.70 dB 高于 MoVieS 的 20.40 dB；关掉存储纹理后时变状态中位压缩 4.0×、均值状态从 1.04M 降到 0.42M，重建质量基本不变。
Motivation: 动态场景表示既要保留随时间出现的表面，又要保留从新视角渲染所需的外观，而现有表示在紧凑性与渲染质量之间难以兼顾。
Method: Sparc4D 用前馈自编码器把已知相机的单目视频编码为稀疏 4D 场景状态：静态特征跨片段共享，空间锚定 temporal slot 压缩时变特征；稀疏解码器生成 2D Gaussian surfel，存储的源像素（一整帧加每四帧采样的动态区域像素）配合几何重投影保留细节纹理，状态还含学习特征与稀疏 occupancy。
Result: 32 帧 MultiCamVideo 片段上平均状态为随机窗口 0.95M、first-32 协议 0.92M 个 32-bit 等价值；first-32 上 PSNR 21.70 dB，MoVieS 为 20.40 dB，随机窗口上两者 PSNR 相当。关闭存储纹理后 temporal slot 将时变特征状态中位压缩 4.0×，均值状态由 1.04M 降至 0.42M，目标视角重建质量基本不变。不做真实数据微调即迁移到 DyCheck 与 Neu3D，存储纹理提升 LPIPS 但略降 PSNR。
Conclusion: 把静态特征共享、时变特征交给锚定 slot、纹理交给可重投影的源像素，可以在保持渲染质量的前提下把 4D 动态场景状态压到百万值量级，并零微调迁移到 DyCheck 与 Neu3D。

papers.title: Supervise What Decides Success: Criterion-Aligned Auxiliary Losses for Latent World-Model Planning
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models plan by scoring candidate action sequences with distances in latent space. However, task success is judged by physical quantities, which we call the success-criterion quantities. In all four latent world models we examine, the end-effector position is encoded in the latent state with an error larger than the success criterion allows. Such a latent state cannot separate successful candidates from failing ones. We propose an auxiliary loss that uses success-criterion quantities as training targets, whereas existing latent world models take them only as inputs. During training, a linear head on the encoder and predictor outputs regresses the success-criterion quantities, and the regression error is added to the training loss. The head is discarded after training, so the model, its cost, and its inputs at test time are unchanged. This loss alone improves the success rate on PushT and cube by 3.5% and 3.4% (absolute), respectively, and both improvements are statistically significant. A success criterion thus specifies what a world model must retain in its latent state, and we show that it can serve directly as a training target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 潜空间世界模型用 latent 距离给候选动作序列打分，但任务成败由物理量判定；作者检查的四个潜世界模型里，末端执行器位置在潜状态中的编码误差都大于成功判据允许的误差，导致潜状态无法区分成功与失败候选。提出以成功判据量为训练目标的辅助损失：在编码器与预测器输出上接线性头回归该量，回归误差并入训练损失，训练后丢弃头，测试时模型、开销与输入不变。PushT 与 cube 成功率分别绝对提升 3.5% 与 3.4%，且均统计显著。
Motivation: 潜空间规划的打分依据与任务实际成功判据不一致：潜状态对成功判据量的编码精度不足以把成功候选和失败候选分开，规划因此受限。
Method: 辅助损失把成功判据量（success-criterion quantities）从仅作输入改为训练目标：训练时在编码器与预测器输出上接线性头回归这些量，回归误差加进训练损失；训练结束后丢弃该头，测试时模型结构、开销与输入保持不变。
Result: 在四个潜世界模型中，末端执行器位置的潜编码误差均大于成功判据允许的误差。仅用该辅助损失，PushT 成功率绝对提升 3.5%，cube 绝对提升 3.4%，两项提升均具统计显著性。
Conclusion: 成功判据直接规定了世界模型必须在潜状态中保留什么，并且可以直接充当训练目标；在不改变测试期模型与开销的前提下即可提升成功率。

papers.title: Have an LLM Write Your Anomaly Detector: Autonomous Discovery of Compact, Interpretable Detectors for Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Time-series anomaly detection trades off predictive accuracy, computational efficiency, and interpretability. We use a large language model not as the detector but as the author of one: an autonomous research loop in which the model repeatedly edits a single short NumPy program under a leakage-free objective, keeping the best-scoring detector it finds. The loop discovers two compact detectors, one for univariate and one for multivariate series, that describe short windows by their local spectral features and compare them with the training-region distribution through a covariance-aware distance. On the TSB-AD benchmark these detectors lead the field across metrics, ahead of the strongest classical, deep, and foundation-model baselines including Time-RCD, yet they train no network and use no GPU, and the multivariate detector is faster than every similarly performing baseline. LLM-driven program search is thus a practical route to accurate, efficient, and transparent detectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 让 LLM 在无泄漏目标下反复改写单个短 NumPy 程序，自主搜索出单变量与多变量两个紧凑时序异常检测器：用局部谱特征描述短窗口，再以协方差感知距离与训练区分布比较。在 TSB-AD 基准上领先 Time-RCD 等经典、深度与基础模型基线，且不训练网络、不用 GPU，多变量版本快于所有同等性能的基线。
Motivation: 时序异常检测需要在预测精度、计算开销与可解释性之间取舍；现有深度与基础模型基线往往要训练网络、依赖 GPU，程序本身也不透明。
Method: 以 LLM 而非模型本身充当检测器作者：在无泄漏 (leakage-free) 目标下自主研究循环中反复编辑同一个短 NumPy 程序，保留得分最好的检测器。最终得到单变量与多变量各一个紧凑检测器，用局部谱特征刻画短窗口，并通过协方差感知距离 (covariance-aware distance) 与训练区分布比较。
Result: 在 TSB-AD 基准上，两个检测器在多项指标上领先最强的经典、深度与基础模型基线（含 Time-RCD）；不训练网络、不使用 GPU，多变量检测器快于每一个性能相当的基线。
Conclusion: LLM 驱动的程序搜索是获得准确、高效且透明的时序异常检测器的可行路径，无需训练网络即可达到领先精度。

papers.title: Reputation, Strategy, and Emotion Effects on Generative AI Cooperation: A Comparison Across Reasoning and Non-Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: As generative AI (Gen AI) systems take on increasingly autonomous roles in economically and socially consequential interactions, understanding their propensity to cooperate -- and the signals that shape this propensity -- has become essential. We examine cooperative behavior in frontier Gen AI models using the iterated prisoner's dilemma, manipulating counterpart reputation (positive, unknown, negative), strategy (extortion vs. generosity), and non-verbal emotional signaling (facial expressions conveying competitive or cooperative appraisals). In a first study with non-reasoning models (Claude 3.5, Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT-4o), cooperation was systematically shaped by all three factors, paralleling patterns long documented in human behavioral research, though models varied substantially in how heavily each factor was weighted. A second study with reasoning models (Claude 4.6, Gemini 3, GPT-5.2) revealed a more concentrated reliance on strategy and reputation, a near-elimination of the Potemkin effect observed in non-reasoning models (evidenced by near-uniform cooperation in a diagnostic harmony game), and a more conditional role for emotion consistent with a hierarchical cue-weighting strategy rather than a simple loss of social sensitivity. Reasoning models also showed heterogeneous end-game behavior, ranging from sustained cooperation to systematic last-round defection effect, revealing model-specific exploitability profiles with direct practical relevance for deployment in negotiation and other multi-round interactions. Together, these findings characterize Gen AI models as increasingly sophisticated, though heterogeneous, social actors, and underscore the practical value of developing standardized cooperation benchmarks to inform the responsible deployment of Gen AI in interactive, socially consequential settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用迭代囚徒困境检验前沿生成式 AI 的合作倾向：操纵对手声誉（正面/未知/负面）、策略（敲诈 vs 慷慨）与非语言情绪信号（面部表情传达竞争或合作评价）。非推理模型（Claude 3.5、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o）的合作被三者系统性塑造且权重因模型而异；推理模型（Claude 4.6、Gemini 3、GPT-5.2）更集中依赖策略与声誉，情绪作用更条件化，末轮行为高度异质。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 在经济与社会后果日益重大的交互中承担更自主的角色，但其合作倾向及塑造该倾向的信号尚缺系统刻画，直接影响谈判等多轮场景的部署风险。
Method: 两项研究均基于迭代囚徒困境 (iterated prisoner's dilemma)，三因素实验操纵：对手声誉（正面/未知/负面）、策略（extortion vs. generosity）、非语言情绪信号（面部表情）；第二项研究另用诊断性 harmony game 检测 Potemkin 效应，并观察末轮行为。
Result: 研究一（Claude 3.5、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o）：合作被声誉、策略、情绪三者系统性塑造，模式与人类行为研究一致，但各因素权重因模型差异显著。研究二（Claude 4.6、Gemini 3、GPT-5.2）：更集中依赖策略与声誉，Potemkin 效应在 harmony game 中近乎消失（合作近乎均匀），情绪作用更条件化，呈分层线索加权；末轮行为从持续合作到系统性末轮背叛不等，暴露模型特异的可利用性差异。
Conclusion: 生成式 AI 模型是日益复杂但高度异质的社会性行动者，推理模型并非丧失社会敏感性而是分层加权线索；作者主张开发标准化合作基准以指导负责任部署。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AutoGUIWorld: Image Generators as Visual World Models for GUI Agent
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents require high-quality interaction trajectories to learn how software environments respond to actions, maintain state, and support multi-step workflows. However, the diversity of available trajectories is constrained by the applications, interface states, and workflows accessible in the underlying environments. Expanding this coverage requires deploying increasingly diverse and complex software, with specialized applications imposing additional installation, configuration, and runtime costs. We introduce AutoGUIWorld, a data generation framework that combines the visual priors of image generators with the task knowledge of a planner to synthesize GUI interaction trajectories without deploying or running the corresponding software environments. AutoGUIWorld samples initial GUI scenes from structured specifications of operating-system context, visual appearance, and interface state, and generates tasks conditioned on those scenes. A planner then specifies atomic actions and their intended visual consequences, while an image generator iteratively edits the current screenshot to produce subsequent observations. Action grounding and transition-level quality filtering yield 79,266 spatially annotated step-level training samples across Ubuntu, Windows, macOS, and Chrome. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoGUIWorld trajectories improves the mean task score on OSWorld from 33.0% to 40.8% and the task success rate on ScienceBoard from 14.0% to 32.2%. These results show that generated trajectories improve GUI-agent performance on real desktop and scientific tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoGUIWorld 用图像生成器的视觉先验加规划器任务知识，在不部署真实软件的前提下合成 GUI 交互轨迹：从操作系统上下文、视觉外观与界面状态的结构化规格采样初始场景并生成任务，规划器给出原子动作及其预期视觉后果，图像生成器迭代编辑截图产生后续观测。经动作定位与转移级质量过滤得到 79,266 条跨 Ubuntu、Windows、macOS、Chrome 的步级样本，微调 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 后 OSWorld 平均任务分从 33.0% 升到 40.8%，ScienceBoard 成功率从 14.0% 升到 32.2%。
Motivation: GUI agent 依赖高质量交互轨迹学习环境对动作的响应与状态演化，但可用轨迹受可访问的应用、界面状态与工作流限制；扩充覆盖需部署日益多样复杂的软件，专用应用还带来安装、配置与运行成本。
Method: 数据生成框架 AutoGUIWorld：从操作系统上下文、视觉外观、界面状态的结构化规格采样初始 GUI 场景，并以该场景为条件生成任务；规划器指定原子动作及其预期视觉后果，图像生成器迭代编辑当前截图得到后续观测；再经动作定位 (action grounding) 与转移级质量过滤产出步级训练样本，用于微调 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B。
Result: 得到 79,266 条带空间标注的步级训练样本，覆盖 Ubuntu、Windows、macOS 与 Chrome；微调 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 后 OSWorld 平均任务分从 33.0% 提升到 40.8%，ScienceBoard 任务成功率从 14.0% 提升到 32.2%。
Conclusion: 图像生成器合成的 GUI 轨迹能在真实桌面与科学任务上提升 GUI agent 表现，即无需运行真实软件环境也能产出可用的训练数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EgoFound3R: End-to-End Egocentric Hand Reconstruction in World Space with Point-Wise Interaction Attributes
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric video has become a primary source of supervision for embodied models, and its value rests on recovering hand motion in world coordinates, which camera motion and hand occlusion make difficult. Existing reconstruction pipelines typically separate hand and scene estimation, leave interaction attributes to separate task-specific models, and invoke several models per video, so no prior reconstruction model estimates these attributes and throughput becomes a practical constraint on large-scale annotation. We therefore introduce EgoFound3R, a unified end-to-end model that estimates world-space hand geometry in a metric scale shared with the scene, and predicts point-wise interaction attributes, including visibility, contact, and distance. The model integrates three designs: (i) structured hand prompts that transfer pretrained geometric priors to world-space hand reconstruction; (ii) an explicit hand representation that decodes hand geometry and interaction attributes; and (iii) a shared-parameter multi-rate design that lowers inference cost. Together, these designs predict hand geometry and point-wise attributes in one pass. On OakInk-v2, TACO, and HOI4D, EgoFound3R reduces the mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 43.2%, 22.4%, and 11.6% over previous methods and predicts point-wise contact and distance alongside the geometry in the same pass, while attaining approximately 6x higher throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoFound3R 把第一人称视频中的手部重建与逐点交互属性（可见性、接触、距离）合并为一个端到端模型，一次前向同时输出世界坐标系下与场景共享度量尺度的手部几何。在 OakInk-v2、TACO、HOI4D 上 MPJPE 相对既有方法分别降低 43.2%、22.4%、11.6%，吞吐量约提升 6 倍。
Motivation: 现有重建流程把手工与场景估计分开、交互属性交给独立任务模型，且每段视频要调用多个模型，导致没有模型能同时估计这些属性，吞吐量成为大规模标注的实际瓶颈。
Method: 三项设计：结构化手部提示 (structured hand prompts) 把预训练几何先验迁移到世界空间手部重建；显式手部表示 (explicit hand representation) 解码手部几何与交互属性；共享参数的多速率设计 (shared-parameter multi-rate) 降低推理成本，从而一次前向同时预测几何与逐点属性。
Result: 在 OakInk-v2、TACO、HOI4D 上 MPJPE 相对先前方法分别降低 43.2%、22.4%、11.6%；同一趟前向同时输出逐点接触与距离属性；吞吐量约提高 6 倍。
Conclusion: 把手部几何与交互属性放进统一端到端模型并共享参数，可以在提升精度的同时把吞吐量拉高约 6 倍，使大规模第一人称视频标注可行。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: When training large language models with reinforcement learning, terminal rewards provide little guidance about which steps matter. Common methods for assigning step credit overlook that work built on uncorrected mistakes is wasted while independent work remains valid. With only a final success/failure reward, every step in a failed episode has zero total future reward, even when it made progress. We propose Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping (DARS), which represents task progress as predicates linked by prerequisite relations and assigns step-level credit over the dependency graph. An annotator marks which predicates each step verifies, invalidates, or repairs. Verified predicates are discounted according to graph distance from the nearest broken prerequisite, while independent predicates are unaffected. Repairs update these weights based on any errors that remain; invalidated predicates need re-verification to regain credit. A fixed potential converts these annotations into signed per-step rewards. A common reward and annotation interface allows DARS to integrate with a range of reasoning and agentic training methods, such as GiGPO and ARPO/AEPO, without changing their rollout strategies or optimizers. Across five task families and models from 1.5B to 8B, DARS improves success by up to 10 points over GiGPO trained with the same budget and harness (ALFWorld), raises the WebShop task score and Search-R1 QA accuracy, complements AEPO's entropy-based training on AIME24/25 with a Python interpreter, and exceeds OmniOPD in controlled tool-free reasoning comparisons at 1.7B and 4B. Ablations show that step-level credit, dependency attenuation, and graph topology each contribute. On ALFWorld, a distilled 8B annotator matches the API annotator, enabling DARS to run efficiently without a frontier judge. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/DARS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出依赖感知奖励塑形 (DARS)：把任务进度表示为带前置依赖的谓词图，按步骤到最近失效前置的距离衰减其信用，独立谓词不受影响，从而让失败回合中真正推进进度的步骤仍拿到正向奖励。在五个任务族、1.5B–8B 模型上，ALFWorld 成功率比同预算同 harness 的 GiGPO 最多高 10 个点，WebShop 分数与 Search-R1 QA 准确率提升，1.7B/4B 无工具推理对比中超过 OmniOPD。
Motivation: 只有终局成功/失败奖励时，失败回合每一步的未来奖励都为零，即使该步确有进展；常见分步信用分配忽略「建立在未纠正错误之上的工作已作废、独立工作仍有效」这一区别。
Method: DARS 用标注者标记每步验证/失效/修复哪些谓词，在依赖图上按到最近断裂前置的图距离折减已验证谓词，独立谓词不折减；修复按残留错误更新权重，失效谓词需重新验证才恢复信用，再用固定势函数 (potential) 把标注转成带符号的逐步奖励。奖励与标注接口统一，可直接接入 GiGPO、ARPO/AEPO 等训练方法而不改 rollout 与优化器。
Result: 五个任务族、模型 1.5B–8B：ALFWorld 上比同预算同 harness 的 GiGPO 成功率最多提高 10 个点；WebShop task score 与 Search-R1 QA 准确率上升；在 AIME24/25 上配合带 Python 解释器的 AEPO（基于熵的训练）起互补作用；无工具受控推理对比中在 1.7B 与 4B 上超过 OmniOPD。消融显示逐步信用、依赖衰减、图拓扑各有贡献；ALFWorld 上蒸馏的 8B 标注模型与 API 标注者持平。
Conclusion: 把步骤信用放在依赖图上、按前置失效距离衰减，能在不改 rollout 与优化器的前提下接入现有 agentic RL 方法并稳定提升成功率；蒸馏标注者可替代前沿模型裁判，使 DARS 高效运行。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Resolving Mixed Single-Photon LiDAR Returns for Foreground-View and Hidden Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Partially transmissive screens and protective covers are common in robotic inspection, but they create mixed LiDAR returns from both the foreground material and the scene behind it. Conventional peak-based LiDAR usually discards weak hidden returns, while single-photon LiDAR records time-resolved histograms that preserve attenuated and overlapping echoes. However, existing transient reconstruction methods typically fit a single scene representation to the measured waveform. Under occlusion, weak or nearby foreground--hidden echoes can form a broad peak or subtle shoulder. Because such waveforms can also be explained by a displaced single surface or a thick density distribution, accurate transient fitting does not necessarily imply correct geometry. We propose a state-aware framework for foreground-view and hidden scene reconstruction from occluded single-photon histograms. For each ray, we estimate local echo evidence, identifying no reliable surface evidence, single-return evidence, or two returns. The inferred echo state routes supervision for a two-head neural field: all rays constrain waveform reconstruction, while reliable anchors provide geometry localization. We also introduce a real paired single-photon LiDAR occlusion dataset with occluded and clean captures at fixed poses. Experiments on a real dataset show improved hidden scene depth and point-cloud accuracy over baselines. Our results demonstrate single-photon layered reconstruction as a practical route for 3D perception through partially transmissive occluders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对半透明遮挡物造成的混合单光子 LiDAR 回波，提出状态感知框架：逐射线判定回波状态（无可靠表面/单回波/双回波），再据此路由双头神经场的监督——全部射线约束波形重建，可靠锚点负责几何定位。在自建的真实配对遮挡数据集上，隐藏场景深度与点云精度相对基线提升。
Motivation: 半透明屏幕与保护罩使 LiDAR 回波混叠前景与后方场景，峰值法丢弃弱隐藏回波，而现有瞬态重建方法把单一场景表示拟合到波形：波形拟合准确并不等于几何正确，位移单表面或厚密度分布可解释同样的宽峰或肩部。
Method: 对每条射线估计局部回波证据，分类为无可靠表面证据、单回波或双回波三种状态；该状态路由双头神经场的监督分配，所有射线约束波形重建，可靠锚点提供几何定位。同时发布真实配对单光子 LiDAR 遮挡数据集，含固定位姿下的遮挡与干净采集。
Result: 在真实数据集上的实验显示，隐藏场景深度与点云精度相对基线均有提升；数据集为固定位姿下遮挡/干净配对采集。
Conclusion: 单光子分层重建（single-photon layered reconstruction）是透过半透明遮挡物做 3D 感知的可行路径，前提是把回波状态判定与几何监督解耦，而非只追求波形拟合精度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Semantic RGB--Depth Based Surgical Skill Assessment in Microscopic Stereo Videos
papers.abstract_en: Objective assessment of microsurgical technical skill is essential for competency-based training and quality assurance, yet existing video-based approaches predominantly rely on RGB images and therefore overlook the 3D spatial relationships that characterize instrument-anatomy interactions. Although stereo operating microscopes provide complementary depth information, conventional stereo matching algorithms can produce sparse and unreliable depth estimates under high-magnification imaging conditions, limiting their use for automated skill assessment. This work presents a semantic RGB-Depth framework for surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. A regression-based depth fusion method combines sparse metric stereo depth with dense monocular depth estimates to generate a dense geometric representation of the surgical scene. This representation is integrated with semantically decomposed RGB streams corresponding to individual surgical instruments and surrounding anatomy. A hierarchical attention architecture jointly encodes these streams to capture discriminative patterns of instrument use and instrument-anatomy interaction across surgeons at different training levels. The framework was evaluated on 33 ex vivo transoral microlaryngeal procedures performed by six surgeons, comprising attending surgeons and surgical residents, using leave-one-surgeon-out cross-validation. The proposed semantic RGB-Depth model achieved an F1 score of 0.938 for skill-level classification, compared with 0.696 for semantic RGB and 0.929 for semantic depth. These results suggest that geometric information can improve automated surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. The learned spatial, temporal, and semantic attention patterns also support qualitative examination of the scene regions, video segments, and semantic streams emphasized by the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出语义 RGB-Depth 微创手术技能评估框架：用回归式深度融合把稀疏 metric 立体深度与稠密单目深度合成稠密几何表示，再与按器械/解剖语义分解的 RGB 流一起送入分层注意力联合编码。在 33 例离体经口声门显微手术、6 名医生的 leave-one-surgeon-out 交叉验证下，技能分级 F1 达 0.938，高于语义 RGB 的 0.696 与语义深度的 0.929。
Motivation: 现有基于视频的手术技能评估主要只用 RGB，丢掉了器械-解剖交互的 3D 空间关系；而高放大倍率下常规立体匹配得到的深度稀疏且不可靠，难以直接用于自动评估。
Method: 回归式深度融合将稀疏 metric 立体深度与稠密单目深度估计合成为稠密场景几何表示，与按单个手术器械及周围解剖语义分解的 RGB 流一起，由分层注意力架构联合编码，捕捉器械使用与器械-解剖交互的判别模式；在 33 例离体经口声门显微手术上用 leave-one-surgeon-out 交叉验证评估。
Result: 语义 RGB-Depth 模型技能分级 F1 为 0.938，语义 RGB 基线为 0.696，语义深度为 0.929；数据为 6 名主治医生与住院医生完成的 33 例离体经口声门显微手术，采用 leave-one-surgeon-out 交叉验证。
Conclusion: 几何（深度）信息能显著提升显微立体视频上的自动手术技能评估，且模型学到的空间、时间与语义注意力模式可对场景区域、视频片段和语义流做定性检查。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Autoregressive Drillhole Modelling Under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive modelling has achieved remarkable success in language and sequence tasks by learning to predict future states from previous observation. Mineral-exploration drillholes provide a natural but largely unexplored setting for this paradigm: as drilling proceeds, lithology is revealed sequentially from shallow to deep, making prediction of deeper strata inherently autoregressive. Existing drillhole modelling, however, is dominated by spatial interpolation and reconstruction, or largely rely on masked modelling, leaving strictly autoregressive prediction largely underexplored. We introduce DrillBench, a benchmark of 49,671 Western Australian drillholes for next-layer prediction and autoregressive stratigraphic generation across a graded transfer spectrum, from local prediction through spatial shift to cross geological province transfer. Benchmarking classical, geostatistical, and neural models reveals a clear \emph{transfer boundary}: spatial and geochemical conditioning provides large local gains but deteriorates sharply under stronger shift, whereas lithology-sequence autoregressive models transfer more robustly. Guided by this finding, we develop a backbone-agnostic recipe combining large-scale pretraining on historical drillholes with spatial retrieval of neighbouring lithology. Retrieval is most effective in weathered cover, when local spatial continuity remains informative, whereas pretraining contributes more strongly in bedrock and under broader geological shift. Together, they retain strong local performance while improving generalisation under spatial and cross-province shift, most markedly on the most distant splits. The benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/yihaoding/drillbench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DrillBench：49,671 个西澳钻孔的下一层岩性预测与自回归地层生成基准，覆盖从本地预测到空间偏移再到跨地质省迁移的分级迁移谱。基准揭示迁移边界：空间与地球化学条件化在本地增益大但在强偏移下急剧退化，岩性序列自回归模型迁移更稳；据此给出的配方是历史钻孔大规模预训练加邻孔岩性空间检索，检索在风化覆盖层最有效，预训练在基岩与更大偏移下贡献更强。
Motivation: 钻孔岩性随深度逐层揭示，本质是自回归预测，但现有钻孔建模以空间插值、重建或掩码建模为主，严格自回归预测几乎未被探索，且缺少衡量跨空间与跨地质省迁移的基准。
Method: 构建 DrillBench（49,671 个西澳钻孔），设置本地预测、空间偏移、跨地质省迁移的分级迁移谱；用经典、地统计与神经模型做基准测试；再提出与骨干无关的配方：历史钻孔大规模预训练 + 邻孔岩性空间检索 (spatial retrieval)。
Result: 基准测试显示清晰的迁移边界：空间与地球化学条件化带来大的本地增益但在更强偏移下急剧退化，岩性序列自回归模型迁移更稳健；预训练与检索结合后在保持本地性能的同时改善空间与跨省迁移下的泛化，在最远的 split 上提升最明显。
Conclusion: 钻孔下一层预测存在迁移边界，条件化特征换泛化、序列自回归换稳健迁移；预训练与邻孔检索按地质环境分工（风化覆盖层靠检索、基岩与大偏移靠预训练）才能同时保住本地精度与远端迁移。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: iSEE: Object Permanence Through Self-Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Object permanence, keeping track of an object's identity and position while it is occluded, is central to video representations that track, predict and plan. Trackers that achieve it learn from boxes, track identities and visibility labels. On the other hand, self-supervised object-centric methods discover objects without labels: through slot attention, it represents a video as slots that bind to objects and follow them across frames. However, these slots are lost under occlusion, making the desired permanence impossible. Reasoning permanence is a hard problem because it requires to detect when an object becomes occluded, re-identify when object reappears, and keep the object's hidden position continuous, using reapperance as the only learning cue. To address this, we propose iSEE, a novel framework that offers all three aforementioned requirements, without any labels whatsoever. We built iSEE using the following three proposed components: (i) Object evidence modelling: a slot's attention, compared with its own past, reveals when its object is hidden. (ii) Appearance-position separation: two slot streams let the appearance be held for re-identification while the position keeps changing. (iii) Permanence from reappearance: a walker follows the hidden object's position, trained only on where the object reappears. On LA-CATER static, iSEE returns a reappearing object to its own slot after 86% of occlusions, against 32% for SlotContrast, and localises it while hidden within 4.1 mAP of the label-trained SoTA RAM. The two streams also allow downstream planning, with the position stream as the action of a world model. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/iSEE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: iSEE 用纯自监督让 slot 表示在遮挡下保持物体恒存：物体证据检测遮挡、外观-位置双流分离、walker 仅以重现位置为监督延续隐藏轨迹。在 LA-CATER static 上，重现后归还原 slot 的比例达 86%（SlotContrast 为 32%），隐藏期定位距标签训练的 SoTA RAM 仅 4.1 mAP。
Motivation: 自监督 slot 注意力在遮挡时会丢失物体，无法做到恒存；而具备恒存的跟踪器依赖框、track id 和可见性标签，标签成本高。
Method: iSEE 三个组件：物体证据建模（slot 注意力与其自身历史比较判定隐藏）、外观-位置分离（双 slot 流分别保持外观用于重识别与更新位置）、Permanence from reappearance（walker 跟随隐藏位置，仅用重现位置训练），全程无标签。
Result: LA-CATER static 上，重现物体归还自身 slot 的比例 86%，对比 SlotContrast 的 32%；隐藏期定位与标签训练 SoTA RAM 相差 4.1 mAP；位置流可作为 world model 的动作用于下游规划。
Conclusion: 仅以重现为学习线索即可同时实现遮挡检测、重识别与隐藏位置连续，无需任何标签；双流设计顺带支持以位置流为动作的规划。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Low-Budget Active Learning through Entropic Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: We consider low-budget active learning, which consists of selecting a limited number of points, the coreset, such that a model can be trained to high accuracy on the selection only. This problem is particularly relevant in contexts where labeling requires costly expert intervention, as in medical applications. We leverage features extracted from a pretrained self-supervised model to represent the data, and perform coreset selection directly in this feature space. In this paper, we use entropic optimal transport, specifically the Sinkhorn divergence, as the coreset selection criterion, which first allows us to get dimension-free sample complexity results, and second admits computationally efficient gradient evaluations. This opens the way to using gradient-based algorithms to rapidly compute solution candidates, further improved by a swap-based local search, with guarantees on the solution quality. Experiments on image benchmarks and medical datasets show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art heuristics in low-budget settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 低预算主动学习中用熵最优传输 (entropic optimal transport) 的 Sinkhorn divergence 作为 coreset 选择准则，在预训练自监督模型的特征空间里直接选点，得到维度无关的样本复杂度与可高效求值的梯度，再用基于梯度的算法加 swap 局部搜索快速求解并带解质量保证。在图像基准与医学数据集上，该方法在低预算设定下超过现有启发式。
Motivation: 标注需专家介入（如医学影像）时预算极小，通用主动学习启发式在低预算下选点质量不足，且在高维特征上样本复杂度随维度恶化。
Method: 用预训练自监督模型提取特征并在该特征空间做 coreset 选择；准则是 Sinkhorn divergence，其梯度求值计算高效，先用基于梯度的算法生成候选解，再用 swap-based 局部搜索改进，并给出解质量保证。
Result: 在图像基准与医学数据集上，低预算设定下超过 state-of-the-art 启发式；理论结果为维度无关的样本复杂度以及带保证的解质量。
Conclusion: 把熵最优传输作为低预算 coreset 准则，可同时换来维度无关的样本复杂度、可微的高效求解路径和实证上的低预算优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Federated Agent Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in private environments and accumulate valuable experience from task execution, tool use, feedback, and local knowledge. Yet such experience is distributed across organizations and cannot be directly shared because of privacy and proprietary constraints. Conventional federated learning is insufficient for this setting, as agent capabilities extend beyond model parameters to memory, tools, rewards, skills, and structured knowledge. In this paper, we formulate \textbf{Federated Agent Optimization (FAO)}, which studies how distributed agents can collaboratively improve through controlled information exchange while keeping raw data, complete trajectories, and private knowledge local. We define FAO as a multi-objective problem balancing agent utility, privacy leakage, and communication cost, and organize its optimization space across policy, memory, tool use, reward, and structured knowledge and skills. We further characterize how private experience can be abstracted, protected, aggregated, and adapted into transferable capabilities, providing a unified view of how agents can benefit from one another without direct experience sharing. Finally, we identify the key challenges of FAO and outline several promising directions for future research toward trustworthy federated agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Federated Agent Optimization (FAO)：把跨组织 LLM agent 的经验协同改进形式化为多目标优化问题，在效用、隐私泄露与通信开销之间权衡，且原始数据、完整轨迹与私有知识始终留在本地。优化空间被划分为 policy、memory、tool use、reward、结构化知识与技能五个维度，私有经验经抽象、保护、聚合后转成可迁移能力。
Motivation: LLM agent 在私有环境中积累的任务执行、工具使用与本地知识经验分散在各组织，隐私与产权约束使其无法直接共享；传统联邦学习只处理模型参数，覆盖不了 memory、tools、rewards、skills 等 agent 能力维度。
Method: 将 FAO 定义为在 agent 效用、隐私泄露、通信开销之间的多目标优化问题；优化空间按 policy、memory、tool use、reward、结构化知识与技能组织；给出私有经验从抽象、保护、聚合到适配为可迁移能力的刻画。
Result: 这是一篇问题形式化与框架论文：给出 FAO 的多目标定义、五维优化空间划分，以及私有经验抽象—保护—聚合—适配的统一视图，并列出关键挑战与若干未来研究方向。
Conclusion: agent 间可以在不直接共享经验的前提下互相受益，前提是把经验交换建模为受控的多目标优化而非参数平均；可信联邦 agent 系统仍待后续工作落实。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Counterfactual Generation via Flow Matching: Coupling-Sensitive End-to-End Rates
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual generation seeks to sample outcomes under a hypothetical intervention or decision using observational data collected under the factual assignment mechanism. We develop a flow-matching approach that combines a sample-split, doubly robust training objective with a learned coupling between observed source outcomes and target outcomes drawn from a fitted conditional outcome model. To enable finite-step generation, we leverage a score-corrected stochastic sampler based on a Gaussian-smoothed interpolation. Our main theoretical contribution is a coupling-sensitive KL bound for constant-step Euler discretization: the error is controlled by moments of the source--target displacement under the chosen coupling, rather than by global uniform regularity of the velocity field, and has near-linear dependence on the ambient dimension. We also establish finite-sample non-parametric guarantees for the learned velocity and score fields when both the conditional outcome model and the source-target coupling are estimated from data. These bounds separate approximation, coupling-replacement, nuisance-estimation, generalization, and Monte Carlo errors and, combined with the sampler analysis, yield an end-to-end guarantee for counterfactual generation. Experiments on synthetic and semi-synthetic image benchmarks support the coupling-dependent theory and show that, at finite discretization budgets, the stochastic sampler can outperform the corresponding deterministic ODE sampler.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 flow matching 做反事实生成：以样本分割的双重稳健 (doubly robust) 目标训练速度场，并在观测源结果与条件结果模型采样的目标结果之间学一个 coupling。主理论结果是常步长 Euler 离散的 coupling 敏感 KL 界——误差由所选 coupling 下源-目标位移的矩控制，而非速度场的全局一致正则性，且对环境维度近线性依赖；合成与半合成图像基准上该理论与实验一致，在有限离散预算下随机采样器可胜过对应确定性 ODE 采样器。
Motivation: 反事实生成要在事实分配机制下的观测数据中采样干预后的结果，而基于 ODE 的生成器误差通常依赖速度场的全局一致正则性，这一假设在高维下过强，也掩盖了源-目标耦合选择本身对误差的作用。
Method: 训练侧用样本分割的双重稳健目标，结合从拟合条件结果模型抽取的目标结果与观测源结果之间学到的 coupling；生成侧用基于 Gaussian-smoothed interpolation 的 score-corrected 随机采样器实现有限步生成，并对常步长 Euler 离散做误差分析。
Result: 给出 coupling 敏感的常步长 Euler KL 界，误差由源-目标位移矩控制、对环境维度近线性；为学到的速度场与 score 场建立有限样本非参数保证，将误差分解为 approximation、coupling-replacement、nuisance-estimation、generalization 与 Monte Carlo 五项，与采样器分析合成为端到端保证。合成与半合成图像基准实验支持 coupling 依赖的理论，并显示有限离散预算下随机采样器可优于对应确定性 ODE 采样器。
Conclusion: 反事实生成的离散误差应由 coupling 下的位移矩而非速度场全局正则性来刻画，且在有限步预算下随机采样器相对确定性 ODE 采样器有优势。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: FlashBack: Knowing When to Remember in Streaming Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Streaming vision-language models must process continuously growing video streams under a bounded compute budget, creating a persistent tension between real-time perception and long-term memory. Retrieving historical information provides a natural remedy, yet historical recall is not uniformly beneficial: unnecessary history may introduce irrelevant context into current reasoning and interfere with native real-time perception. Effective streaming memory should therefore address not only what to remember, but also when and how to access it. To this end, we introduce FlashBack, a training-free framework for selective, multi-level memory in streaming vision-language models. Before retrieving history, FlashBack draws on the semantic understanding of the frozen streaming VLM to infer whether a query calls for historical evidence. This assessment determines whether inference remains on the Native trajectory or invokes an isolated Recall trajectory. The Recall trajectory combines recent context with retrieved long-term memory through a query-local Side-KV pathway, preserving local temporal continuity without modifying the persistent Native state. We instantiate FlashBack on StreamingVLM and Mage-VL-4B and evaluate it on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench. The results show improvements on several long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks while largely preserving real-time perception, with performance competitive with strong training-based streaming methods despite requiring no additional training. Our code will be announced later.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlashBack 是面向流式视觉-语言模型的免训练选择性记忆框架：先用冻结流式 VLM 的语义理解判断当前 query 是否真的需要历史证据，再决定留在 Native 轨迹还是启用隔离的 Recall 轨迹，通过 query-local Side-KV 注入检索到的长期记忆而不改动持久 Native 状态。在 StreamingVLM 与 Mage-VL-4B 上于 OVO-Bench 和 StreamingBench 评测，多项长时程与记忆依赖任务提升，同时基本保住实时感知性能，无需额外训练即可与强训练型流式方法竞争。
Motivation: 流式 VLM 必须在有限算力预算下处理持续增长的视频流，实时感知与长期记忆存在持久张力；而历史召回并非总是有益，无关历史会污染当前推理并干扰原生实时感知。
Method: 免训练的多层级选择性记忆框架 FlashBack：检索前先借助冻结流式 VLM 的语义理解评估 query 是否需要历史证据，据此选择 Native 轨迹或隔离的 Recall 轨迹；Recall 轨迹将近期上下文与检索到的长期记忆经 query-local Side-KV 通路合并，保持局部时间连续性且不修改持久 Native 状态。实例化于 StreamingVLM 和 Mage-VL-4B。
Result: 在 OVO-Bench 与 StreamingBench 上，多项长时程与记忆依赖任务取得提升，同时大体保持实时感知能力；在无需任何额外训练的情况下，性能与强训练型流式方法相当。
Conclusion: 流式记忆的关键不只是记什么，还包括何时访问历史：按 query 需要与否分流到隔离 Recall 轨迹，可在不训练、不破坏实时感知的前提下换来长时程记忆能力。

papers.title: Color Independent Word Segmentation From Transcribed Bangla Passages
papers.abstract_en: An optical character recognition(OCR) system can scan paper and extract text, making people's jobs easier. While numerous OCR systems are accessible in the software sector, finding a dependable equivalent solution for Bangla is tough. When it comes to handwritten texts, the case is even more rare. The first fundamental step to any OCR is to segment words from text images. If this stage fails, the total OCR's performance will be poor no matter how promising the later stages perform. This research aims to segment words in a handwritten Bangla text image. This research can be implemented on any smartphone-captured image, irrespective of the color and type of paper and ink. Furthermore, as smartphone-captured images can create shadow interferences, the custom dataset built for this research is created in such a way that every possible obstacle that can be faced is included. For 7374 words, a total of 7278 bounding boxes are generated, which have recall of 90.60 %, precision of 91.80 %, and F1-score of 91.20 %. The system can be further improved with nested operations on bounding boxes containing several words or by adjusting the adaptive thresholding and dilation filter sizes to a more precise level.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 6th International Conference on Electrical Information and Communication Technology (EICT)
papers.journal_ref: 2023 6th International Conference on Electrical Information and Communication Technology (EICT), 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向手写孟加拉语 OCR 的词分割：对手机拍摄、含阴影与任意纸墨颜色的图像做颜色无关的预处理与自适应阈值、膨胀滤波，输出词级 bounding box。在自建数据集 7374 个词上生成 7278 个框，recall 90.60%、precision 91.80%、F1 91.20%。
Motivation: 孟加拉语 OCR 可靠方案稀缺，手写场景更少；词分割是 OCR 第一步，一旦失败后续环节再好整体性能也差，且手机拍摄图像存在颜色与阴影干扰。
Method: 在自建的含各类干扰（阴影、不同纸墨颜色）的手机拍摄手写孟加拉语数据集上做颜色无关的词分割，使用自适应阈值与膨胀滤波生成 bounding box；数据集覆盖 7374 个词。
Result: 7374 个词上生成 7278 个 bounding box，recall 90.60%、precision 91.80%、F1-score 91.20%。
Conclusion: 颜色无关的阈值与形态学流程可在含阴影的手机图像上完成手写孟加拉语词分割；作者指出可对含多词的框做嵌套操作、或更精细地调整自适应阈值与膨胀滤波尺寸来进一步改进。

papers.title: When Does Exercise-Specific Joint Selection Help? An Audit of Evaluation and Control Design
papers.abstract_en: Exercise-specific joint selection can improve skeleton-based correctness classification, but what does that gain establish? We audit 1,057 repetitions from ten REHAB24-6 subjects, separating evaluation aggregation, subset structure, and temporal representation. The manual-subset kNN gain changes from 0.055 for pooled out-of-fold AUROC to 0.020 for equal-weight within-person AUROC; both paired intervals include zero. Among 1,000 dimension-matched random maps, 14 match or exceed the manual pooled result, versus 145 when bilateral structure and trunk inclusion are also matched. RBF-SVM retains a positive within-person gain, whereas logistic regression and a random-convolution comparator have negative point gains under that estimand. Sequence-order and paired-seed controls further qualify the interpretation. This exploratory audit shows why joint-selection claims require explicit estimands and structurally appropriate controls; it does not establish a new algorithm or clinical benefit.
papers.comment: Exploratory offline audit of subject-disjoint skeleton-based exercise correctness evaluation; 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对基于骨架的运动正确性分类中「动作特异关节选择带来增益」这一说法做审计：在 1,057 次重复、REHAB24-6 十名受试者（subject-disjoint）上，手工关节子集的 kNN 增益随评估口径变化——pooled out-of-fold AUROC 口径为 0.055，改为等权 within-person AUROC 后降到 0.020，且两个配对区间都含零。1,000 个维度匹配的随机映射中有 14 个追平或超过手工 pooled 结果，若同时匹配双侧结构与躯干包含则升至 145 个；RBF-SVM 在 within-person 口径下仍保持正增益，而 logistic 回归与随机卷积对照的点估计为负。结论是关节选择类主张必须写明 estimand 并配结构匹配的对照。
Motivation: 骨架动作分类里常把「为某动作挑选关节子集带来性能提升」当作方法贡献，但增益可能来自评估聚合方式、子集结构或时序表示，而非关节选择本身，审计要把这三者拆开。
Method: 在 REHAB24-6 的 1,057 次重复、十名受试者上做 subject-disjoint 的离线审计，把评估聚合、子集结构、时序表示分开控制；比较 pooled out-of-fold AUROC 与等权 within-person AUROC 两种 estimand，用 1,000 个维度匹配随机关节映射（并加入匹配双侧结构与躯干包含的版本）作对照，另设序列顺序与配对随机种子控制，分类器覆盖 kNN、RBF-SVM、logistic 回归与随机卷积对照。
Result: 手工子集 kNN 增益在 pooled out-of-fold AUROC 下为 0.055，在等权 within-person AUROC 下为 0.020，两个配对区间均含零；1,000 个维度匹配随机映射中 14 个追平或超过手工 pooled 结果，匹配双侧结构与躯干包含后为 145 个；within-person 口径下 RBF-SVM 增益为正，logistic 回归与随机卷积对照的点增益为负。
Conclusion: 关节选择的收益依赖于所选 estimand 与对照的结构匹配程度，因此这类主张必须显式声明 estimand 并使用结构上合适的对照；该审计为探索性工作，不建立新算法或临床获益。

papers.title: ReCast: Contract-Preserving Protection for Fixed-Interface Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Remote multimodal models offer strong numerical reasoning capabilities over charts and speech, but sending private inputs risks exposing sensitive content. Text-only sanitization cannot directly satisfy fixed media interfaces, while identity anonymization leaves the underlying task content exposed. We introduce ReCast, an agentic plug-in framework that replaces source-specific content while preserving task-relevant relations and the required input modality. ReCast locally converts inputs into a shared textual evidence-query record, jointly rewrites entities and topics with a distilled 4B model, and substitutes values through a locally invertible, role-aware numerical map. A reconstruction agent generates and validates the required media from the protected record. The remote solver returns a program whose protected operands are restored locally before execution. On 4,000 held-out ChartQA and NMSQA examples, ReCast achieves 75.10% accuracy, retaining 92.43% of unprotected remote accuracy, while a model-based audit flags source-content leakage in 7.95% of solver-bound requests. It outperforms all evaluated local baselines, preserving the benefit of remote reasoning while reducing source-content exposure under existing media interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReCast 是一个本地插件式框架，把图表与语音输入改写成共享的 evidence-query 记录，用蒸馏的 4B 模型重写实体与主题、用局部可逆的角色感知数值映射替换数值，再由重建 agent 生成符合固定媒体接口的输入，远端返回的程序在本地还原受保护操作数后执行。在 4,000 条 ChartQA 与 NMSQA 留出样本上准确率 75.10%，保留未保护远端推理准确率的 92.43%，模型审计仅在 7.95% 的 solver 请求中判定源内容泄漏。
Motivation: 把私有图表与语音发给远端多模态模型会暴露敏感内容：纯文本净化无法满足固定媒体接口，身份匿名化又保留了任务内容本身。
Method: ReCast 在本地把输入转成共享的文本 evidence-query 记录，用蒸馏的 4B 模型联合重写实体与主题，通过局部可逆、角色感知的数值映射替换数值；重建 agent 从受保护记录生成并校验所需媒体，远端 solver 返回的程序在本地还原受保护操作数后再执行。
Result: 在 4,000 条 held-out ChartQA 与 NMSQA 样本上准确率 75.10%，保留未保护远端准确率的 92.43%；基于模型的审计在 7.95% 的 solver-bound 请求中判定存在源内容泄漏；在全部被评估的本地基线上更优。
Conclusion: 在不改动现有媒体接口的前提下，替换源内容并保留任务关系可以兼顾远端推理收益与源内容暴露的降低。
