papers.title: Fully Online Decentralized Learning in Stochastic Games with Unknown Independent Chains
papers.abstract_en: We consider stochastic games with independent controlled chains and unknown transition kernels, where players observe only their local states and realized payoffs. We develop a fully online, decentralized, and uncoordinated mirror-descent algorithm that operates in the dual space of occupancy measures for approximating stationary Nash equilibrium (NE) policies. The algorithm uses a single transition/reward sample at every primitive time step, relies only on local information, and requires neither coverage of the joint state space nor synchronized episodes. Under uniform-ergodicity and finite-coverage assumptions, we show that, with high probability, the time-averaged fixed-comparator regret decays at the canonical $O(T^{-1/2})$ rate, up to logarithmic factors and polynomial dependence on the game parameters. In particular, the complexity depends on the cover times of the individual local state spaces rather than the product state space, avoiding exponential dependence on the number of players and the sizes of the joint state and action spaces. The resulting finite-time regret bound further yields an approximate coarse-correlated-equilibrium guarantee, which is natural for arbitrary reward functions since computing a stationary $ε$-NE is PPAD-hard in this setting. Under an additional global variational-stability condition, we show that the same fully online algorithm converges asymptotically in the last iterate to a stationary $ε$-NE. Our results provide a fully online and scalable learning framework for stochastic games with unknown independent chains. The algorithm can also be viewed as a primal-dual framework for Markov games that exploits the independence and local structure of the players' controlled transition chains.

TL;DR: 在各玩家受控链独立、转移核未知且只能观测本地状态与已实现收益的随机博弈中，提出完全在线、去中心化、无需协调的镜面下降算法，在占据测度 (occupancy measure) 对偶空间逼近平稳 Nash 均衡策略。每步只用一条转移/奖励样本、只依赖本地信息，无需覆盖联合状态空间或同步回合；在一致遍历性与有限覆盖假设下，时间平均固定比较器 regret 以高概率按 O(T^{-1/2}) 速率衰减（差对数因子与参数多项式因子），复杂度取决于各本地状态空间的 cover time 而非联合状态空间，避免对玩家数与联合状态/动作空间规模的指数依赖。
Motivation: 随机博弈中转移核未知且玩家只能看到本地信息时，联合状态空间的覆盖与同步回合要求使学习复杂度随玩家数指数增长；而该设定下计算平稳 ε-NE 本身是 PPAD-hard 的。
Method: 完全在线、去中心化、无协调的 mirror-descent 算法，运行在占据测度的对偶空间；每个原始时间步只消耗一条转移/奖励样本，仅用本地信息，不要求联合状态空间覆盖或同步回合。有限时间 regret 界进一步导出近似 coarse-correlated-equilibrium 保证；在额外的全局变分稳定性 (global variational-stability) 条件下，同一算法的 last iterate 渐近收敛到平稳 ε-NE。

papers.title: Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting: Training-Free Negation Understanding for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the strong performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a wide range of visual question answering (VQA) tasks, these models consistently struggle to understand negation and produce incorrect answers when questions involve negated clauses. To address this limitation, we propose Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting (\textbf{SSP}), a training-free, in-context learning method that improves VLM negation understanding capabilities without any parameter updates. Given a negation question, our method first abstracts the underlying question structure into a skeleton, retrieves a small set of same-skeleton questions from a lightweight question pool, then prompts the VLM to analyze their shared negation pattern and synthesize a single-sentence answering strategy. The skeleton and strategy are prepended to the test sample to guide the model correctly tackle the negation problems. Experiments on multiple negation VQA benchmarks show that SSP achieves state-of-the-art performance on negation-focused VQA tasks while remaining computationally efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting (SSP)：把否定问句抽象成问题骨架 (skeleton)，从轻量问题池检索同骨架问句，让 VLM 归纳共享否定模式并合成一句答题策略，拼接到测试样本前。训练-free、不更新参数，在多个否定 VQA 基准上达到 state-of-the-art 且计算开销低。
Motivation: VLM 在常规 VQA 上表现强，但一旦问句含否定从句就持续答错，且现有做法多需参数更新。
Method: SSP 是 in-context learning 方法：先抽取问句结构为 skeleton，从轻量 question pool 检索同 skeleton 的少量问句，提示 VLM 分析其共同否定模式并生成单句 answering strategy，再把 skeleton 与 strategy 前置到测试样本；全程不更新参数。
Result: 在多个 negation VQA 基准上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，并保持计算高效；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 否定理解的短板可以用结构抽象加策略合成的免训练提示补齐，无需微调 VLM 参数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Temporally-Resolved Token Attribution Reveals the Generation Dynamics of Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: This work presents Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients (DLIG), a token attribution method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that extends Integrated Gradients (IG~\cite{sundararajan2017axiomatic}) to arbitrary layers and denoising steps. DLIG attributes a DLM's progressive commitment to a self-generated or fixed completion for an input prompt. We establish direct correspondences between DLIG and the IG axioms of completeness, implementation invariance, linearity, and symmetry preservation. As a lightweight complement to interventional analysis, DLIG provides an inexpensive first check of mechanistic hypotheses across the denoising trajectory. We demonstrate this on word-sense disambiguation, multi-hop graph reasoning, and sentence infilling, revealing how DLMs draw on inputs across positions, layers, and denoising steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients (DLIG)，把 Integrated Gradients 扩展到扩散语言模型的任意层与任意去噪步，用于归因模型对自生成或固定补全的渐进承诺。在词义消歧、多跳图推理与句子填空三个任务上展示其可追踪位置、层与去噪步维度上的输入依赖。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型的生成过程横跨多个去噪步与层，缺少一种能沿去噪轨迹做逐 token 归因的轻量工具，机理假设只能依赖昂贵的干预分析。
Method: DLIG 将 Integrated Gradients 扩展到任意层与去噪步，对 DLM 面向自生成或固定补全的渐进承诺做 token 级归因，并证明其满足 IG 的 completeness、implementation invariance、linearity 与 symmetry preservation 四条公理，作为干预分析的低成本补充。
Result: 在词义消歧、多跳图推理与句子填空三个任务上展示 DLIG，揭示 DLM 如何跨位置、层与去噪步利用输入；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: DLIG 可作为机理假设的低成本首轮检查，沿去噪轨迹定位 DLM 在哪些位置、层和步骤依赖输入。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking the Information Bottleneck: Structured Decomposition under Label-Induced Partitions
papers.abstract_en: Standard information bottleneck (IB) regularization constrains representations via a single scalar I(Z;X), implicitlytreating all information as homogeneous. However, a single global compression control couples label-relevant structurewith residual within-condition variation, rather than regulating their allocation independently, allowing nuisanceinformation to persist in learned representations. For example, in medical imaging applications, residual variation oftenstems from acquisition conditions, background factors, or subject-specific appearance. This issue becomes particularlypronounced in data-limited settings, where models tend to overfit such variation, hindering generalization. While existingregularization methods can stabilize training, control capacity, or shape representation geometry, they do not explicitlyseparate nuisance-like variation from task-supporting structure. To address this limitation, we revisit IB from a structuredperspective based on a label-induced partition, where condition-level structure and within-condition information playdistinct roles. This leads to a dual-bottleneck formulation: a standard KL term controls global information capacity, while aconditional KL term targets within-condition information. We show that the conditional KL admits an exact decompositioninto a within-condition information term and a prior-mismatch term, explaining its alignment with the design objective.With a simplex-structured conditional prior, the method provides controllable latent geometry and integrates seamlesslyinto existing pipelines. Experiments on classification and segmentation show the clearest gains in low-data classificationand consistent improvements across dense prediction benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 标准信息瓶颈用单一标量 I(Z;X) 做全局压缩，把标签相关结构与条件内残余变化耦合在一起，导致采集条件、背景等干扰信息留在表征里。作者提出双瓶颈：全局 KL 控容量，条件 KL 专门压条件内信息，且条件 KL 可精确分解为条件内信息项与先验失配项；配合单纯形结构条件先验，在低数据分类上增益最明显，稠密预测基准上稳定改善。
Motivation: 单一全局压缩控制无法独立调节标签相关结构与条件内残余变化，数据受限时模型会过拟合采集条件、背景、个体外观这类干扰变异，损害泛化。
Method: 基于标签诱导划分 (label-induced partition) 重构 IB，得到双瓶颈 (dual-bottleneck)：标准 KL 控制全局信息容量，条件 KL 针对条件内信息；证明条件 KL 可精确分解为条件内信息项与先验失配项，并引入单纯形结构 (simplex-structured) 条件先验以控制隐空间几何，可直接嵌入现有训练流程。
Result: 在分类与分割实验中，低数据分类场景增益最明显，稠密预测基准上取得一致改善。
Conclusion: 把压缩拆成全局容量与条件内信息两条独立通道，才能把干扰变异与任务支撑结构分开调控，且该分解与设计目标严格对齐、可即插即用。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CAGE-NAS: Certified Functional Descent for Efficient Model Growth
papers.abstract_en: The progressive growth of neural networks requires deciding when the current representation remains sufficient for optimization and when it should be expanded. CAGE-NAS formulates this decision in function space through an admissibility criterion on approximations of the functional gradient. As long as a representation enables a certified Functional Gradient Descent step, the architecture remains fixed; when the criterion fails, a function-preserving expansion is applied and the resulting representation is evaluated again. As the main instance, we study the family induced by the tangent space, using a regularized projection of the functional gradient. In a controlled setting with exact certification, CAGE-NAS produces architectures positioned above the 99.8th performance percentile by held-out RMSE among all admissible alternatives within the same parameter budget, without enumerating them during the growth trajectory.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at AXIOM 2026: Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning (NeurIPS 2026 Workshop)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAGE-NAS 把神经网络何时扩张的决策放到函数空间：只要当前表示还能通过函数梯度下降的可认证 (certified) 步骤就保持架构不变，判据失效时才做保函数的扩张并重新评估。在带精确认证的受控设定下，其在同参数预算内按留出 RMSE 位于全部可选架构的 99.8 百分位以上，且增长轨迹中不枚举这些候选。
Motivation: 渐进式网络生长需要判断当前表示对优化是否已足够，而这一判断通常缺少可认证的准则，只能靠枚举候选架构来比较。
Method: 在函数空间上对函数梯度的近似给出可采纳性 (admissibility) 判据，作为是否扩张的准则；主实例取由切空间 (tangent space) 诱导的函数族，用正则化的函数梯度投影；判据通过则架构固定，失败则执行保函数扩张并重新评估新表示。
Result: 在带精确认证的受控设定中，CAGE-NAS 产出的架构按留出 RMSE 在同参数预算内全部可采纳备选中位于 99.8 百分位以上，且增长过程中不枚举这些备选。
Conclusion: 函数梯度的可认证性可以作为架构扩张的停止/触发准则，在不枚举候选的前提下把增长轨迹导向高性能架构。

papers.title: Learning Rate Transfer for Hybrid Transformer-SSM Architectures
papers.abstract_en: We study learning rate (LR) scaling for hybrid architectures combining Transformer and State-Space Model (SSM) blocks, a class adopted by several recent production language models. In particular, we focus on the gap between the theoretical scaling rules derived for SSMs under zero-order-hold (ZOH) discretization at infinite width with growing state size, and the field-standard practical implementations using simplified-ZOH Mamba at fixed state size. Surprisingly, in this practical regime hybrid architectures achieve a near-zero LR transfer gap across widths 256-2048 and depths 4-32 up to billion-parameter scale using only the original $μ$P prescription, even though SSM operations fall outside its Tensor Programs representability conditions and every parameterization we test fails the standard coordinate-check diagnostic of $μ$P correctness. We attribute this to a two-condition decomposition of LR transfer in hybrid architectures: a global update-to-weight invariance, enforced by $μ$P's initialization and LR scaling; and a local per-component balance, provided by AdamW's per-parameter normalization. Our observations show that the optimal LR is invariant to width up to 8$\times$, that this width invariance holds across depth, sequence length, batch size, and Transformer-to-SSM ratio, and that it transfers to Nemotron-H, a production hybrid outside our custom architecture set. We hope these findings fill the gap between theoretical scaling rules and practical hybrid implementations, and stimulate further research toward bridging it.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 在自建的混合架构集合上系统改变宽度 (256–2048)、深度 (4–32)、序列长度、batch size 与 Transformer-to-SSM 比例，用原始 μP 参数化测 LR 迁移间隙，并做 coordinate-check 诊断；再把结论外推到生产模型 Nemotron-H。分析框架是把 LR 迁移分解为 μP 保证的全局 update-to-weight 不变性与 AdamW 逐参数归一化提供的局部逐组件平衡。

papers.title: Detect, Explain, Interpret: An End-to-End Benchmark for Time Series Anomaly Detection, Explainability and Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Time Series Anomaly Detection has received increasing attention, driven by the growing availability of complex time series data. This surge has led to the development of numerous detection methods, as well as a variety of benchmarks aimed at thoroughly evaluating their performance. However, most existing detectors remain largely agnostic to domain context, overlooking explainability and interpretability. One of the main reasons for this gap is that current benchmarks primarily focus on detection accuracy, and only few of them evaluate spatial explainability. Moreover, no benchmark currently provides sufficiently rich semantic annotations to support the generation of human-understandable interpretations of anomalies. To address these limitations, we introduce SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection benchmark), a fully annotated benchmark composed of 215 multivariate, high-dimensional time series collected from real-world distributed cloud storage systems operated by Scality. The proposed dataset includes rich contextual information, covering three families of anomalies with varying degrees of severity. As further contribution, we provide a foundation for future work by evaluating baseline methods for Detection, Explainability, and Interpretability, covering all stages of a TSAD pipeline. For Detection, we benchmark a wide range of existing anomaly detectors, testing their effectiveness on the proposed real-world dataset. Then, we consider explainability by evaluating whether measuring the contribution of each dimension in the generated anomaly score can provide accurate anomaly attributions. Finally, for interpretability, we investigate the effectiveness of frozen LLM baselines in localizing and interpreting anomalies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SHAD（Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection benchmark）：215 条来自 Scality 分布式云存储系统的真实多变量高维时间序列，带三类异常、不同严重度与丰富语义标注，并把 Detection、Explainability、Interpretability 三阶段放进同一评测管线，用维度贡献度做异常归因、用冻结 LLM 做异常定位与解释。
Motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测 (TSAD) 基准大多只测检测精度、少数才评空间可解释性，且缺少支撑人类可读异常解释的语义标注，检测器普遍对领域上下文无感知。
Method: 发布 SHAD 基准：215 条真实多变量高维序列，覆盖三类异常与不同严重度，附上下文语义标注；评测覆盖整条 TSAD 管线——先跑大量现有异常检测器，再检验各维度对异常分数的贡献能否给出准确归因，最后测试冻结 LLM 基线做异常定位与解释。
Result: 数据集含 215 条多变量高维时间序列，来自 Scality 真实分布式云存储系统，标注三类异常及不同严重度；评测覆盖 Detection、Explainability、Interpretability 三个阶段的基线方法。
Conclusion: 把语义标注与解释、归因评测纳入同一基准，可让 TSAD 评测从单纯检测精度扩展到整条管线的可解释性。

papers.title: CineMR: Tool-Integrated Vision-Language Reasoning for Quantitative Cardiac MRI Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), including cine imaging, is a reference standard for the noninvasive assessment of cardiac morphology and ventricular function. Cine CMR interpretation integrates qualitative visual assessment with quantitative measurements of ventricular volumes, ejection fraction, myocardial mass, wall thickness, and regional wall motion. Current medical vision-language models (VLMs) cannot reliably derive quantitative measurements from multidimensional cine images without analysis tools. We present CineMR, a tool-augmented VLM that invokes cardiac image-analysis tools and integrates their outputs into interleaved reasoning for quantitative CMR assessment. We also construct a multi-cohort visual question answering benchmark covering quantitative metric extraction, multiclass diagnosis, and differential diagnosis, together with tools for segmentation, phase selection, volumetry, morphometry, and regional wall motion analysis. CineMR is trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-interaction traces followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with conditional tool-use rewards. On the multi-cohort cine CMR benchmark, CineMR achieves 35.9% pass@1 and 58.9% pass@4, compared with 1.5% pass@1 for the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone and 0.0% and 7.0% pass@1 for LLaVA-Med v1.5 and MedGemma-4B, respectively. Correct tool invocation reaches 99.8% after GRPO, up from 78.9% after SFT. Live tool outputs improve ventricular measurement accuracy by 20.4--23.7% over direct model predictions, and removing all tools reduces pass@1 from 35.9% to 27.9%. These results highlight the importance of reliable tool use for quantitative cine CMR reasoning and support CineMR as a promising approach for assistive cardiac image assessment. Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR.
papers.comment: Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CineMR 是一个工具增强的医学 VLM：调用分割、时相选择、容积、形态与室壁运动分析工具，把工具输出嵌进交错推理中做 cine CMR 定量判读。在多队列 cine CMR VQA 基准上 pass@1 达 35.9%（pass@4 58.9%），而 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干仅 1.5%；GRPO 后工具调用正确率从 SFT 后的 78.9% 升到 99.8%，去掉全部工具则 pass@1 从 35.9% 跌到 27.9%。
Motivation: 现有医学 VLM 无法在没有分析工具的情况下从多维 cine 图像中可靠导出定量测量值，而定量 CMR 判读恰恰依赖容积、射血分数、心肌质量等数值。
Method: CineMR 由工具调用与交错推理组成：先用工具交互轨迹做监督微调 (SFT)，再用带条件工具使用奖励的 GRPO 训练；配套构建覆盖定量指标提取、多类诊断与鉴别诊断的多队列 VQA 基准，并提供分割、时相选择、容积、形态与室壁运动分析工具。
Result: 多队列 cine CMR 基准上 CineMR pass@1 35.9%、pass@4 58.9%，对比 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干 1.5% pass@1、LLaVA-Med v1.5 0.0%、MedGemma-4B 7.0% pass@1；工具调用正确率 GRPO 后 99.8%（SFT 后 78.9%）；实时工具输出比直接模型预测将心室测量精度提高 20.4–23.7%；移除全部工具后 pass@1 由 35.9% 降至 27.9%。
Conclusion: 可靠的工具使用是定量 cine CMR 推理的关键，工具增强的 VLM 可作为辅助性心脏影像评估方案；代码、基准与模型权重已开源。

papers.title: Persistent Depth Ordering amid Shifting Block-Bypass Responses in Language Model Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Layer interventions are widely used to probe the internal organization of language models, yet most analyses examine a single training checkpoint even though model representations and computations evolve throughout pretraining. This leaves open which depth-dependent intervention responses reflect persistent organization and which are transient consequences of training. We study this question using single-block identity bypass on fixed teacher-forced contexts across five released trajectories and 11 model-domain combinations. We find that block-bypass responses retain recognizable depth ordering while their magnitudes redistribute: nearby checkpoints preserve stronger rank correspondence than distant ones, and large changes concentrate at positions that recur across text samples and transfer across evaluation domains. Controlled experiments further show that changes in the natural bypass effect cannot be reduced to a single downstream sensitivity: in replicated Pythia runs, local missing-update magnitude grows while the pooled matched downstream response decreases, whereas OLMo-2 7B exhibits a different balance. These matched responses also depend on perturbation strength and direction, without identifying targeted compensation. Together, our results show that longitudinal layer sensitivity is structured but not static, and that single-checkpoint intervention responses should be interpreted in the context of how the underlying perturbation pathway evolves during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在五个公开预训练轨迹、11 个模型-领域组合上，用固定 teacher-forced 上下文的单块恒等旁路 (single-block identity bypass) 做纵向层干预，发现旁路响应的深度排序在训练中保持可辨认，但幅值会重新分配：相邻 checkpoint 的秩对应强于相隔较远者，大幅变化集中在跨文本样本复现、且能跨评估领域迁移的位置。Pythia 复跑中局部 missing-update 幅度上升而 pooled matched 下游响应下降，OLMo-2 7B 则呈不同配比；响应还依赖扰动强度与方向，未识别出定向补偿。作者主张单 checkpoint 的层敏感度解读必须放进扰动通路随训练演化的背景里。
Motivation: 层干预分析大多只看单个训练 checkpoint，无法区分哪些深度依赖的干预响应反映持久的模型组织、哪些只是训练过程中的瞬态现象。
Method: 在固定 teacher-forced 上下文上施加单块恒等旁路 (single-block identity bypass)，跨五个公开预训练轨迹与 11 个模型-领域组合做纵向比较；辅以受控实验，把自然旁路效应拆成局部 missing-update 幅度与 pooled matched 下游响应两条通道，并改变扰动强度与方向。
Result: 旁路响应保留可辨认的深度排序而幅值重新分配：相邻 checkpoint 秩对应强于远距离 checkpoint，大幅变化集中于跨文本样本复现并跨评估领域迁移的位置。Pythia 复跑中局部 missing-update 幅度增大、pooled matched 下游响应减小，OLMo-2 7B 呈现不同的平衡；匹配响应依赖扰动强度与方向，且未识别出定向补偿 (targeted compensation)。
Conclusion: 纵向层敏感度是结构化但非静态的，单 checkpoint 的干预响应必须结合扰动通路在训练中的演化来解读。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PhysicsLENS: Diagnosing Physical Property Blindness in Video Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: Reliable video world models could provide scalable predictive environments for robot learning, planning, and evaluation. However, generated robot videos can violate physical principles and complete tasks through physically implausible behavior, limiting their reliability for robot learning and planning. Current video-generation benchmarks exclude physics that are inherently hidden by visuals (e.g., weight, viscosity, friction). Due to this, video models are evaluated on the fidelity of physics, not the underlying accuracy of physics. We introduce PhysicsLENS, a dataset and benchmark for evaluating plausibility of physical properties grounded in robotics. PhysicsLENS uses matched scenario pairs that hold the same conditioning frame and task, while varying underlying physics in the scene description. Scenarios are curated from public robot video sources and annotated across seven physical domains: collision, gravity, momentum, friction, deformation, fluid, and causality. We evaluate across four video generation models, producing over 400 human-annotated labels. Results show that plausible-looking videos often ignore the stated property (34 of 47), and that stating the property lowers plausibility only slightly and not significantly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysicsLENS 用同一条件帧与任务、只改场景描述中物理属性的配对场景，检验视频生成模型是否真的遵循被视觉隐藏的物理量（重量、黏度、摩擦）。在 4 个视频生成模型、400 余条人工标注上，看似合理的视频有 34/47 忽略了所声明的属性，且在描述中写明该属性只让合理性略降、不显著。
Motivation: 机器人视频世界模型会用物理上不合理的方式完成任务，而现有视频基准只评可见物理的保真度，忽略了重量、黏度、摩擦这类被画面隐藏的属性，导致模型对底层物理的准确性无从检验。
Method: 构建 PhysicsLENS 数据集与基准：从公开机器人视频源整理配对场景，保持条件帧与任务一致、仅改变场景描述中的底层物理；按 collision、gravity、momentum、friction、deformation、fluid、causality 七个物理域标注，并对 4 个视频生成模型产出超过 400 条人工标注标签。
Result: 在 4 个视频生成模型、400 余条人工标注下，看似合理的视频中 34/47 忽略了所声明的物理属性；在描述中写明该属性仅使合理性略微下降，且下降不显著。
Conclusion: 视频生成模型的物理合理性外观与对被声明物理属性的遵循是两回事，仅靠视觉可信度不足以支撑机器人学习与规划用途。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.tldr: PhysicsLENS 用同一条件帧与任务、只改场景描述中物理属性的配对场景，检验视频生成模型是否真的遵循被视觉隐藏的物理量（重量、黏度、摩擦）。在 4 个视频生成模型、400 余条人工标注上，看似合理的视频有 34/47 忽略了所声明的属性，且在描述中写明该属性只让合理性略降、不显著。

papers.title: Looping Beyond Twice: A Scalable Recipe for Looped Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers introduce recurrent depth as a new scaling axis for LLMs: by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks, they increase effective depth without increasing parameter count. However, the benefits of looping remain unclear for large MoE LLMs under FLOPs-matched comparisons. The main reason is that the gains from additional iterations diminish quickly and can even turn into degradation, so the extra FLOPs spent on looping yield little substantial improvement. Consequently, prior work typically settles on two loops. We identify two main obstacles to scaling looped MoE. First, looping inherits and amplifies the curse of depth: hidden-state variance grows with each iteration as residual updates accumulate, which destabilizes deep recurrence and causes representations to drift. Second, looped MoE suffers from expert selection collapse: routers repeatedly select the same experts across loops, so extra iterations add computation without adding computational diversity. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose LOOM, built on a single principle: each loop should contribute new computation while keeping the recurrent state stable. LOOM stabilizes recurrence by scaling residual updates to bound variance growth and re-injecting the input embedding at every loop, and diversifies it through per-loop routers that engage different experts and a Looping Residual that carries earlier outputs forward. Experiments across 100M-1.7B models show stable scaling to 9-12 loops. Under near-iso-FLOP, the 700M model performs best at 5 loops, reducing perplexity from 18.36 to 16.54 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 38.84% to 39.53% over the non-looped baseline. Without FLOP matching, the 1.7B model trained on 60B tokens peaks at 9 loops, reducing perplexity from 9.62 to 7.77 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 42.4% to 47.7%. Code is available https://github.com/hed-ucas/LOOM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LOOM 诊断出 looped MoE 难以超过 2 次循环的两个原因——残差累积导致隐状态方差增长、router 在各循环反复选同一批专家——并用缩放残差更新、每循环重注入输入 embedding、per-loop router 与 Looping Residual 解决。100M–1.7B 模型稳定扩到 9–12 次循环：近 iso-FLOP 下 700M 在 5 循环时困惑度 18.36→16.54、零样本平均准确率 38.84%→39.53%；不匹配 FLOP 时 1.7B（60B tokens）在 9 循环达峰，困惑度 9.62→7.77、零样本 42.4%→47.7%。
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 把重复使用共享块当作新的扩展轴，但在 FLOPs 对齐的比较下，大 MoE LLM 的循环收益很快衰减甚至转为退化，先前工作通常止步于 2 次循环。
Method: LOOM 遵循单一原则：每次循环既贡献新计算又保持循环状态稳定。具体为缩放残差更新以约束方差增长、每循环重新注入输入 embedding、per-loop router 让不同循环激活不同专家，以及把先前输出向前传递的 Looping Residual。
Result: 在 100M–1.7B 模型上稳定扩展到 9–12 次循环。近 iso-FLOP 下 700M 最优为 5 循环，困惑度 18.36→16.54，零样本平均准确率 38.84%→39.53%（相对非循环基线）；不做 FLOP 匹配时 1.7B 在 60B tokens 上 9 循环达峰，困惑度 9.62→7.77，零样本准确率 42.4%→47.7%。
Conclusion: 循环次数超过 2 的收益取决于同时稳定循环状态与打破专家选择塌缩；按此设计，looped MoE 可在近 iso-FLOP 下扩到 5 循环、在不匹配 FLOP 时扩到 9 循环并取得困惑度与零样本准确率的双重提升。

papers.title: When Is Deletion Ordering Tractable? From Update Dynamics to Permutation Structure
papers.abstract_en: Given a fixed set of pending deletion requests, retraining from scratch after each request is prohibitive, so a prescribed request-wise policy processes them sequentially. The resulting terminal model can depend on their order. Rather than prescribing an ordering rule, we study the permutation objective induced by the fixed policy and ask when it admits simpler structure. We identify two independent reductions: position additivity represents the objective by request--position costs, reducing optimization to assignment and, with a shared positional profile, sorting; suffix localization removes dependence on the distant prefix while retaining interactions among the surviving requests. Under shared affine updates, we characterize the quadratic interactions that obstruct additivity, prove the reductions' independence, and show that suffix-conditioned assignment improves the approximation rate from O(p^L) toO(p^(2L)). Experiments recover both structures in executed objectives. A controlled damped-Newton sweep shows that stronger contraction shifts the objective toward shorter, more suffix-specific dependence, while two full-network policies exhibit distinct positional and within-suffix structure. Structures identified from compact execution sets also predict unseen orders. These results frame deletion ordering as identifying the computational structure induced by the executed updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把机器学习中的删除请求排序问题形式化为给定更新策略所诱导的置换目标，识别出两个独立的结构化归约：position additivity 将目标写成请求-位置代价从而化为 assignment（共享位置轮廓时化为 sorting），suffix localization 消除对远前缀的依赖。在 shared affine updates 下刻画阻碍可加性的二次交互，证明两归约独立，并把 suffix-conditioned assignment 的近似率从 O(p^L) 提升到 O(p^(2L))。
Motivation: 对固定删除请求集逐条按策略顺序处理时，终端模型依赖请求顺序，而逐条从头重训代价过高；直接规定排序规则缺乏对目标本身结构的刻画。
Method: 研究固定策略诱导的置换目标而非规定排序规则：给出 position additivity 与 suffix localization 两个独立归约，在 shared affine updates 下刻画破坏可加性的二次交互并证明归约独立性；用受控 damped-Newton 扫描与两个全网络策略做实验验证。
Result: suffix-conditioned assignment 的近似率由 O(p^L) 改进至 O(p^(2L))；实验中两种结构在被执行目标里被复现，damped-Newton 扫描显示更强收缩使目标转向更短、更 suffix-specific 的依赖，两个全网络策略呈现不同的位置结构与 suffix 内结构；在紧凑执行集上识别出的结构能预测未见顺序。
Conclusion: 删除排序的可解性取决于被执行更新所诱导的计算结构，而非排序规则本身；收缩强度与策略类型决定目标呈现位置型还是 suffix 内型依赖。

papers.title: OptimusMesh: Compact Autoregressive Mesh Generation from Point Clouds via Sparse Latent Pivots
papers.abstract_en: Generating compact and geometrically faithful 3D meshes directly from point clouds remains a fundamental challenge. Point clouds are unordered and sparse, whereas meshes exhibit irregular structure and varying topology. As a result, many existing approaches rely on implicit representations followed by surface extraction or reconstruction. Although effective, these pipelines can produce dense or over-smoothed meshes, often requiring computationally expensive post-processing and simplification. We present OptimusMesh, a framework for direct compact triangle mesh generation from point clouds using sparse latent pivot conditioning. Our key idea is to compress $2{,}048$ oriented input points into only $16$ sparse latent pivots, reducing the geometric conditioning set by $128\times$. These pivots provide a compact structural representation shared across a two-stage autoregressive framework that first generates mesh vertices and then predicts triangular faces conditioned on the generated vertices and the same pivots. Compared with the evaluated recent point-cloud-conditioned autoregressive methods, which use $257$ decoder-conditioning tokens, OptimusMesh uses only $16$, yielding a $16.1\times$ shorter conditioning sequence. Experiments show that OptimusMesh produces the most compact outputs among the compared recent autoregressive methods, using $25.7\%$--$94.1\%$ fewer faces while maintaining competitive geometric fidelity and distributional quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OptimusMesh 把 2048 个带方向的点压缩成 16 个稀疏 latent pivot，作为两阶段自回归框架的共享条件，先生成顶点再预测三角面。相比使用 257 个 decoder-conditioning token 的近期点云条件自回归方法，条件序列缩短 16.1 倍，输出面数减少 25.7%–94.1%，同时保持有竞争力的几何保真度与分布质量。
Motivation: 点云无序稀疏而网格结构不规则、拓扑多变，现有隐式表示加表面提取的流程会产生过密或过平滑的网格，还需昂贵的后处理与简化。
Method: 用稀疏 latent pivot conditioning 做直接紧凑三角网格生成：把 2048 个 oriented input points 压成 16 个 sparse latent pivots（几何条件集缩小 128 倍），两阶段自回归先生成 mesh vertices，再以已生成顶点和同一组 pivots 为条件预测 triangular faces。
Result: 条件 token 从 257 降到 16，条件序列缩短 16.1 倍；在与近期点云条件自回归方法的对比中输出最紧凑，面数减少 25.7%–94.1%，几何保真度与分布质量保持有竞争力。
Conclusion: 稀疏 pivot 条件足以替代密集点云条件，直接生成紧凑且保真的三角网格，省去隐式重建后的简化步骤。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Distributionally Robust Adaptation of Tabular Foundation Models under Subpopulation Shift
papers.abstract_en: Despite strong mean accuracy, tabular foundation models (TFMs) can perform poorly on underrepresented groups under subpopulation shift, where group proportions change between training and deployment. We propose DR-TFM, a parameter-efficient distributionally robust adaptation framework that requires no true group annotations. DR-TFM adjusts attention to labeled context examples by fine-tuning an existing query scaling network or adding and training one, while keeping all other parameters fixed. We instantiate the framework with two robust objectives using estimated groups or source conditional distributions derived from training data. For TabPFN-3, adaptation updates only 0.016% of the pretrained model's parameters. Across five tabular benchmarks, DR-TFM achieves substantially higher average worst-group accuracy than pretrained TFMs and the compared robust baselines without true group annotations, while maintaining competitive mean group accuracy. DR-TFM also improves average worst-group accuracy on ACS Income and across four additional TFMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DR-TFM 用参数高效方式把表格基础模型 (TFM) 适配到子群体偏移 (subpopulation shift)：只微调已有的 query scaling 网络（或新增并训练一个），其余参数全部冻结，且不需要真实群体标签。在五个表格基准上，它相对预训练 TFM 与所比较的鲁棒基线取得明显更高的平均最差群体准确率，同时保持有竞争力的平均群体准确率。
Motivation: 表格基础模型平均准确率虽高，但训练与部署之间群体比例变化时，代表性不足的子群体表现会明显变差；现有鲁棒方法往往依赖真实群体标注。
Method: DR-TFM 框架只微调 attention 对标注上下文示例的 query scaling 网络（已有则微调、没有则新增并训练），其余参数固定；用从训练数据得到的估计群体或源条件分布实例化两个鲁棒目标，全程无需真实群体标注。
Result: 对 TabPFN-3 的适配只更新预训练模型 0.016% 的参数；在五个表格基准上，平均最差群体准确率大幅高于预训练 TFM 与所比较的鲁棒基线，平均群体准确率保持有竞争力；在 ACS Income 上同样提升平均最差群体准确率，并在另外四个 TFM 上复现该提升。
Conclusion: 在子群体偏移下，只调 query scaling 这一极小参数子集（0.016%）配合无需群体标注的鲁棒目标，就能显著抬高最差群体准确率而不牺牲平均群体准确率。

papers.title: Classical Hardness of Learning Functions of Hamiltonians
papers.abstract_en: Morohoshi, Nakayama, Manabe, and Mitarai proposed a physically motivated quantum machine learning problem in which the goal is to predict quantities of the form $\operatorname{Tr}[f(H)ρ]$ from classical descriptions of a Hamiltonian $H$ and a quantum state $ρ$, where $f$ is an unknown function. We call this problem Hamiltonian function learning in this paper. They constructed an efficient quantum learning algorithm under suitable conditions, while leaving a rigorous proof of average-case classical hardness open. In this paper, we rigorously prove the average-case classical hardness for two distribution-specific Hamiltonian function learning problems for $f_{\cos,π}(λ)=\cos(πλ)$ and $f_{\exp,β}(λ)=e^{-βλ}$ discussed in the paper of Morohoshi et al. under the assumption of the average-case hardness of factoring random RSA moduli. More specifically, we show that an efficient classical randomized learner under squared loss whose output hypotheses are evaluable in classical polynomial time for either problem would yield a classical randomized polynomial-time algorithm for factoring random RSA moduli.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 Hamiltonian function learning 的经典平均情形困难性：对 f_cos(λ)=cos(πλ) 与 f_exp(λ)=e^{-βλ} 两类问题，在随机 RSA 模数分解平均情形困难的假设下，任何平方损失下、假设可在经典多项式时间求值的经典随机学习器，都会导出随机 RSA 模数分解的经典随机多项式时间算法。
Motivation: Morohoshi 等人提出的 Hamiltonian function learning（从 H 与 ρ 的经典描述预测 Tr[f(H)ρ]）已有高效量子学习算法，但其经典平均情形困难性缺少严格证明。
Method: 针对 Morohoshi 等人讨论的两个分布特定问题 f_cos,π(λ)=cos(πλ) 与 f_exp,β(λ)=e^{-βλ}，在随机 RSA 模数分解平均情形困难的假设下做归约：把经典随机学习器（平方损失、输出假设可经典多项式时间求值）转成分解随机 RSA 模数的经典随机多项式时间算法。
Result: 在随机 RSA 模数分解平均情形困难假设下，对 f_cos,π 与 f_exp,β 两个问题，任一高效经典随机学习器（平方损失、输出假设可经典多项式时间求值）都会给出分解随机 RSA 模数的经典随机多项式时间算法，从而证明这两个问题的平均情形经典困难性。
Conclusion: Morohoshi 等人留下的经典平均情形困难性缺口在上述分解假设下被严格补上，且结论是分布特定的、限于这两个 f 与平方损失设定。

papers.title: ReSolve: Reusing Candidate Reasoning through Selective Generative Moderation
papers.abstract_en: Sampling multiple solutions spends computation on intermediate deductions and unfinished arguments as well as final answers. We introduce ReSolve, a training-free inference procedure that reuses this candidate reasoning through selective generative moderation. An answer-distribution controller invokes a model to examine existing derivations when candidates disagree or lack a parseable answer, then incorporates the generated solution into a bounded loop. Under Hybrid scoring on 130 competition-mathematics problems evaluated with two independently sampled candidate pools, ReSolve obtains 100 and 99 correct answers, compared with 91 and 92 for voting over the same four candidates, with no correct-to-incorrect changes relative to that vote in either pool. Eight-sample self-consistency obtains 94 and 96 correct answers while consuming substantially more tokens; ReSolve uses 46.3% and 47.2% fewer tokens in the two evaluations. A controlled ablation removes visible derivations while retaining answer keys, vote counts, and the per-state output-cap rule, reducing accuracy from 100 to 93 correct despite increasing computation. Selective and always-on Uniform moderation both solve 97 problems, while selectivity reduces moderation tokens by approximately 54% and total pipeline tokens by 6.2%. These results support candidate reasoning as reusable inference computation. They do not establish an accuracy advantage over additional sampling or a distinct benefit from specialized route instructions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReSolve 是一种免训练的推理过程复用机制：当多个采样候选的答案不一致或无法解析出答案时，由答案分布控制器 (answer-distribution controller) 调用模型审查已有推导并把新解纳入有界循环。在 130 道竞赛数学题上，对同一组四个候选，Hybrid 打分得 100/99 题，投票为 91/92；八样本 self-consistency 得 94/96 但 token 消耗高得多，ReSolve 少用 46.3% 和 47.2% 的 token。
Motivation: 多次采样把大量算力花在中间推导、未完成论证和最终答案上，这些候选推理在投票后即被丢弃；作者要论证候选推理本身是可复用的推理计算。
Method: 免训练推理流程：答案分布控制器在候选分歧或缺少可解析答案时调用模型审查已有推导，把生成的解并入有界循环；保留答案键、投票计数与每状态输出 token 上限 (per-state output cap)，并对比 selective 与 always-on Uniform 两种 moderation 策略。
Result: 在 130 道竞赛数学题、两个独立采样候选池上，Hybrid scoring 得 100 和 99 题正确，同组四候选投票为 91 和 92，且相对投票无一题由对变错；八样本 self-consistency 得 94 和 96 题但 token 明显更多，ReSolve 分别少用 46.3% 与 47.2% token。去掉可见推导（保留答案键、投票计数与输出上限）后正确数从 100 降到 93，尽管计算量增加；selective 与 always-on Uniform moderation 均解出 97 题，selectivity 使 moderation token 减少约 54%、全流程 token 减少 6.2%。
Conclusion: 候选推理可作为可复用的推理计算：选择性 moderation 在不增加 token 的前提下把四候选投票的正确数抬高约 9 题，且无由对变错；但作者明确指出这些结果并未确立相对额外采样的精度优势，也未证明专门路由指令的独立收益。

papers.title: Auditing Action Settlement in LLM Agent Environments: Order, Progress, and Replay
papers.abstract_en: Concurrent actions in large language model (LLM) agent environments require arbitration even when each proposal is individually valid. We implement a typed snapshot-settlement contract and audit three distinct properties: order sensitivity, useful progress, and replay consistency. Five settlement policies are tested in 28,800 exhaustive permutation trials and 2,160 scripted multistep episodes. Joint policies are spatially order-invariant conditional on fixed priorities, yet conservative rejection completes only 31.25% of agents in a six-agent doorway task versus 90.28% for random tickets; the paired improvement is 59.03 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval: 50.00-68.06). All policies preserve the tested spatial constraints, and priority arbitration still misses the independent small-instance optimum. A separate full-state journal audit exactly replays 156 checkpoints and rejects 1,332 constructed corruptions with a retained terminal anchor. The evidence concerns execution semantics, not human realism or long-run fairness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM agent 环境中并发动作的仲裁问题，提出带类型的 snapshot-settlement 契约，并审计顺序敏感性、有效推进与回放一致性三项性质。在 28,800 次穷举排列试验与 2,160 段脚本化多步 episode 中，保守拒绝策略在六 agent 门道任务里只完成 31.25% 的 agent，而随机票据策略达 90.28%，配对提升 59.03 个百分点（95% bootstrap 区间 50.00–68.06）。
Motivation: LLM agent 环境中并发提交的动作即使各自合法也需仲裁，但顺序敏感、是否真正推进任务、以及回放能否复现这三件事此前缺少可审计的判定契约。
Method: 实现带类型的 snapshot-settlement 契约，定义顺序敏感性、有效推进、回放一致性三项审计；测试五种 settlement 策略，在 28,800 次穷举排列试验与 2,160 段脚本化多步 episode 上运行，另用全状态 journal 审计做精确回放并注入构造损坏。
Result: 联合策略在固定优先级下空间顺序不变；保守拒绝在六 agent 门道任务完成率 31.25%，随机票据 90.28%，配对提升 59.03 个百分点（95% bootstrap 区间 50.00–68.06）；所有策略保持被测空间约束，但优先级仲裁仍错过独立的小规模最优解；journal 审计精确回放 156 个 checkpoint 并拒绝 1,332 个构造损坏。
Conclusion: 作者主张该证据只关乎执行语义，不涉及人类真实性或长期公平性；保守仲裁在推进率上代价显著，且优先级仲裁不保证最优。

papers.title: The RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Intracranial aneurysm rupture is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, yet aneurysm detection remains challenging, particularly for small lesions and on routine non-angiographic imaging examinations. To support the development and evaluation of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms for intracranial aneurysm detection and localization, the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), in collaboration with the American Society of Neuroradiology (ASNR), the Society of Neurointerventional Surgery (SNIS), and the European Society of Neuroradiology (ESNR), curated the RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset. Developed for the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge, RSNA-ICA is a large, publicly available, expert-annotated dataset comprising 7202 CTA, MRA, and MRI series from 4278 adult patients collected across 21 institutions in 12 countries spanning five continents. The dataset includes 2566 CTA, 2166 MRA, and 2470 MRI series from patients with and without intracranial saccular aneurysms, providing substantial geographic and imaging diversity. Expert annotations indicate both aneurysm presence and location, and 178 series additionally include three-dimensional segmentations of challenge-defined vascular locations. RSNA-ICA was used to develop and evaluate algorithms in the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge. Of the 7202 image series, 5041 are publicly available through MIRA (https://mira.rsna.org/dataset/7), while the remainder were used for challenge public and private test sets. The dataset is freely available to the research community for noncommercial use and provides a comprehensive resource for advancing AI-based aneurysm detection across both angiographic and routine neuroimaging examinations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RSNA-ICA 是为 2025 RSNA 颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛构建的公开专家标注数据集，含 7202 例 CTA/MRA/MRI 序列、来自 12 国 21 家机构的 4278 名成人患者，标注动脉瘤有无与位置，其中 178 例另带三维血管分区分割。7202 例中 5041 例经 MIRA 公开，其余留作挑战公开与私有测试集，供非商业研究使用。
Motivation: 颅内动脉瘤破裂致高致残致死率，而小病灶及常规非血管造影检查上的检出仍然困难，缺少大规模、跨机构、带专家标注的公开数据来训练和评测 AI 检出与定位算法。
Method: 由 RSNA 联合 ASNR、SNIS、ESNR 共同整理，覆盖 CTA、MRA、MRI 三种模态；专家标注给出动脉瘤存在与否与位置，178 例额外提供挑战赛定义的血管位置三维分割；数据按挑战赛公开/私有测试集切分，5041 例经 MIRA 平台公开。
Result: 数据集共 7202 例序列、4278 名成人患者、21 家机构、12 个国家、五大洲；模态构成为 2566 例 CTA、2166 例 MRA、2470 例 MRI；178 例含三维分割；7202 例中 5041 例公开，其余用于 2025 RSNA 颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛的公开与私有测试集。
Conclusion: RSNA-ICA 以跨地域、跨模态的规模与专家标注，成为覆盖血管造影与常规神经影像两类检查的动脉瘤 AI 检出资源，非商业研究可自由获取使用。

papers.title: Open Vocabulary Word Recognition From Transcribed Bangla Texts
papers.abstract_en: An optical character recognition (OCR) can scan a paper and extract text using technology, making people's jobs easier. While various OCR systems are available in the software industry, finding a reliable equivalent solution for Bangla takes much work. When it comes to handwritten texts, the situation is much more unusual. Recognizing words from word images is the most critical stage in any OCR process. It is the second stage after segmenting words from text pictures. If this stage fails, the overall performance of the OCR will be poor, regardless of how well the other phases perform. This study aims to recognize words using deep learning in a handwritten Bangla word image. Three object detection models, SSD with MobileNetV2, Faster R-CNN with InceptionResNetV2, and an ensemble model of these two, have been used to train and test handwritten word images. A modified Non-Maximum Suppression has been introduced to enhance the effectiveness of the models' results. A customized dataset of 9841 handwritten Bangla word images has been compiled, featuring diverse handwriting styles from various individuals. All three models' performances have been checked against the test dataset, and the ensemble model has been the most impressive, with an F1-score of 92.61%. Also, at the word level, the ensemble model correctly recognizes 96.12% of the words to some extent. The system can be further improved by introducing a post-processing phase to correct errors generated by the system.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 26th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT). Code: https://github.com/FaiasPromit/Optical-Character-Recognition-From-Handwritten-Bangla-Texts
papers.journal_ref: 2023 26th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT), Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对手写孟加拉语 (Bangla) 词图识别，用 SSD-MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN-InceptionResNetV2 及二者集成三个目标检测模型训练测试，并引入改进的 Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS)。在自建 9841 张手写孟加拉词图数据集上，集成模型 F1 达 92.61%，词级上 96.12% 的词被正确识别到一定程度。
Motivation: OCR 软件产业中可靠的孟加拉语方案稀缺，手写场景更困难；词识别是分割之后的关键环节，一旦失败整体 OCR 性能就会崩掉。
Method: 用三个目标检测模型——SSD with MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN with InceptionResNetV2，以及两者的 ensemble——对手写词图进行训练与测试，并提出改进的 Non-Maximum Suppression 提升结果有效性；数据为自建的 9841 张多书写风格手写孟加拉词图。
Result: 在测试集上集成模型表现最佳，F1-score 92.61%；词级上集成模型正确识别 96.12% 的词（to some extent）。
Conclusion: 集成两个检测器加改进 NMS 是手写孟加拉词识别的最优配置，作者建议后续加入后处理阶段纠正系统产生的错误。

papers.title: Does Scaling Reinforcement Learning Really Require More Training?
papers.abstract_en: Scaling reasoning typically spends more compute on reinforcement learning (RL) or on inference. We show that a completed RL training history can yield policies stronger than the checkpoints visited by its optimizer. We call this policy-space scaling: expanding the deployable policy set accessible from a fixed RL history, without extending training or increasing per-query inference computation. We instantiate it with SURGE (Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion). SURGE combines two checkpoints from the same RL run: a high-accuracy anchor and a competitive donor that generates shorter responses. It expresses both checkpoints as changes from their shared initialization, then spectrally decomposes the anchor's update to retain its dominant component and incorporate the donor's complementary component. With a fixed target for how much of the anchor update to retain, SURGE determines the block size from the weights without testing candidate policies. We evaluate two 1.5B mathematical-reasoning histories, DeepSeek and Nemotron, and one 7B coding history, OLMo. SURGE improves benchmark-average accuracy over both input checkpoints while using fewer reasoning tokens than the anchor. It reaches 54.17% on DeepSeek AIME24 against a measured native maximum of 50.83%, and 83.7% on OLMo HumanEval+ against 82.8%. These gains exceed the observed training curves. Geometric controls support the importance of RL-update structure beyond weight displacement or token reduction alone. Each constructed model runs as a single policy. Our findings identify stored RL history as a reusable scaling resource: the capability available from a training run need not end at its best checkpoint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SURGE 从同一次 RL 训练历史中取两个 checkpoint（高精度 anchor 与生成更短回复的 donor），把二者相对共享初始化的更新做谱分解，保留 anchor 主成分并融合 donor 补充成分，从而在不延长训练、不增加单次推理计算的前提下扩大可部署策略集。在 1.5B 数学推理历史 DeepSeek 上 AIME24 达 54.17%（原生最高 50.83%），7B 编码历史 OLMo 上 HumanEval+ 达 83.7%（82.8%），且推理 token 更少。
Motivation: 扩展推理能力通常要追加 RL 训练算力或推理算力；已有 RL 训练历史中是否存在未被利用的、超出最优 checkpoint 的策略能力，尚无直接手段挖出。
Method: SURGE（Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion）取同一次 RL run 的 anchor 与 donor 两个 checkpoint，表达为相对共享初始化的更新差，对 anchor 更新做谱分解保留主成分并纳入 donor 的互补成分；在固定保留比例下由权重本身决定 block size，无需测试候选策略。
Result: 在两个 1.5B 数学推理历史（DeepSeek、Nemotron）与一个 7B 编码历史（OLMo）上，SURGE 的基准平均准确率高于两个输入 checkpoint 且比 anchor 用更少 reasoning token：DeepSeek AIME24 54.17% 对原生最高 50.83%，OLMo HumanEval+ 83.7% 对 82.8%；增益超过所观察到的训练曲线，几何对照支持 RL 更新结构本身（而非仅权重位移或 token 减少）的作用。
Conclusion: 已存的 RL 训练历史可作为可复用的扩展资源：一次训练所能带来的能力不必止于其最佳 checkpoint，且构造出的模型是单一可部署策略。

papers.title: Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can produce economic policy responses that sound reasonable, but this does not show that their actions are consistent with economic dynamics. We test this by placing an instruction-tuned language model inside six Snowdrop-backed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) simulators. At each turn, the model observes the economy and a change in economic discourse, selects a bounded policy action, and receives the next simulated state and an economic reward. We implement a common Python interface for repeated rollouts, persistent shocks, state cloning, and rolling-horizon simulation. This setting creates a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. Policy effects may appear several quarters after an action is taken. PPO has a learned value function that can propagate delayed reward to earlier tokens through generalized advantage estimation. GRPO has no learned value function and instead assigns a group-relative advantage from complete rollout returns. It therefore cannot distinguish which earlier turn caused the outcome; if every rollout receives the same return, the normalized advantage is zero. We use PPO as the primary method and GRPO as a matched critic-free baseline. The experiments also test directional semantic signals, reward horizon, trajectory warm starts, cross-simulator transfer, and historically anchored pandemic and monetary-policy shocks. The objective is to judge policy actions by their simulated economic consequences rather than by plausible language alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把指令微调 LLM 放进六个 Snowdrop 支撑的 DSGE 仿真器中做经济政策生成，每轮观察经济状态与话语变化、选择有界的政策动作并获得奖励。作者主张 PPO 的价值函数配合 GAE 能把延迟数个季度的回报传回早期 token，而 GRPO 这类无 critic 方法在整条 rollout 同回报时归一化优势为零，无法归因到具体哪一轮动作。
Motivation: LLM 生成的经济政策听起来合理但未必与经济动力学一致；政策效果滞后数个季度，构成典型的长时程 credit assignment 问题，无价值函数的方法难以把结果归因到早期动作。
Method: 在六个 Snowdrop-backed DSGE 仿真器中运行指令微调 LLM，实现统一 Python 接口支持重复 rollout、持久冲击、状态克隆与 rolling-horizon 仿真；以 PPO（价值函数 + generalized advantage estimation）为主方法，GRPO（组相对优势、无 critic）为匹配基线，并测试方向性语义信号、reward horizon、轨迹热启动、跨仿真器迁移以及历史锚定的疫情与货币政策冲击。
Result: 摘要给出的是机制性论证：GRPO 在所有 rollout 获得相同回报时归一化优势为零，无法区分是哪一轮早期动作导致结果；PPO 通过 GAE 将延迟回报传播回早期 token。实验维度包括六个 DSGE 仿真器、reward horizon、跨仿真器迁移与疫情/货币政策冲击，摘要未列出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 按模拟出的经济后果而非语言合理性来评判政策动作，需要能传播延迟奖励的价值函数；无 critic 的组相对优势方法在长时程经济政策任务上存在归因盲区。

papers.title: Latent Information Sharing for Accelerating Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is a communication-efficient distributed learning paradigm. However, client drift remains one of the most critical challenges, hindering the efficient training of a global model. In this study, we propose a novel latent information sharing scheme that directly mitigates data heterogeneity across clients. Our theoretical and empirical results show that sharing a small amount of hidden-layer activations significantly improves training efficiency while preserving convergence guarantees and data privacy. Furthermore, we compare our method with existing FL approaches designed to address client drift, including FedProx, SCAFFOLD, FedPVR, FedProto, and SplitFed, and demonstrate superior model accuracy under a fixed round budget without incurring excessive communication overhead. Overall, this work presents a promising new knowledge aggregation scheme and provides a comprehensive analysis of the impact of activation sharing on federated optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联邦学习中客户端漂移源于数据异质性，本文提出隐层激活共享方案：各客户端只上传少量 hidden-layer activations 来直接对齐客户端分布，而非只交换模型更新。理论与实验显示该方案在保持收敛保证与数据隐私的同时提升训练效率，在固定通信轮数下相对 FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedPVR、FedProto、SplitFed 取得更高模型精度且不增加过多通信开销。
Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端本地数据分布不一致导致 client drift，使全局模型训练效率下降，现有针对漂移的方案在固定轮数预算下精度与通信开销难以兼顾。
Method: 提出 latent information sharing：在联邦训练中跨客户端共享少量隐层激活，直接缓解客户端间数据异质性；与 FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedPVR、FedProto、SplitFed 等处理 client drift 的方法在固定轮数预算下对比，并给出收敛保证与隐私方面的理论分析。
Result: 理论与实验结果表明共享少量隐层激活即可显著提升训练效率，同时保留收敛保证与数据隐私；在固定轮数预算下模型精度优于 FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedPVR、FedProto、SplitFed，且不带来过高通信开销。
Conclusion: 以少量激活共享作为新的知识聚合方式，可以在不牺牲收敛与隐私的前提下缓解 client drift，是联邦优化中比单纯模型更新交换更有效的异质性处理路径。

papers.title: CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300. These results establish cortical alignment as a learnable and anatomically grounded routing mechanism from heterogeneous EEG montages to pretrained foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CortexBridge 是一个轻量 adapter，把 EEG 特征与电极坐标、脑图谱 (atlas) 坐标结合，将任意导联排列映射到共享的皮层隐空间，再送入冻结的 EEG foundation model。在 MOABB 的五个 BCI 数据集、三个冻结基座模型上共 15 项评测中 13 项提升，balanced accuracy 平均增益 EEGPT 0.80%、LaBraM 0.70%、CBraMod 3.26%，12 类 SSVEP 上最高增益 13.02%。
Motivation: EEG foundation model 多用固定通道词表或有限导联集预训练，电极布局一变迁移就困难，需要把异构 montage 对齐到统一表示。
Method: 轻量 adapter 融合 EEG 特征与电极坐标及 atlas 坐标，把任意 montage 映射到共享 cortical latent space；在三个冻结 foundation model（EEGPT、LaBraM、CBraMod）上评测，数据为 MOABB 的五个 BCI 数据集。
Result: 15 项评测中 13 项提升；balanced accuracy 平均增益 EEGPT 0.80%、LaBraM 0.70%、CBraMod 3.26%；12 类 SSVEP 分类最高增益 13.02%。学到的 atlas 表示呈任务相关空间模式：SSVEP 在 Yeo Visual network 上比听觉 P300 更集中。
Conclusion: 皮层对齐是一种可学习且有解剖依据的路由机制，可把异构 EEG montage 接到预训练 foundation model 上。

papers.title: AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers
papers.abstract_en: Designing high-performance microwave absorbers requires specialized expertise in electromagnetic theory, materials science and simulation programming, and entails time-consuming optimization. Here, we present AbsorbEvo, an agentic framework for autonomous inverse design that translates natural-language performance objectives into designs verified by full-wave simulations. Its candidate evolution strategy integrates language reasoning, physics-based prediction and historical feedback. A large language model proposes the directions and magnitudes of parameter adjustments based on task objectives and computational history. The system combines directed increments with global sampling to generate candidates and uses a low-cost predictive model as a physics prior to rank them. Only high-ranking designs undergo full-wave simulation. Results passing physical validity checks are used to evaluate performance and guide subsequent search. Experience from training tasks is further distilled into textual skills, which are independently validated before use in new tasks. Under identical proposal budgets on held-out AbsorbBench-36 tasks, AbsorbEvo achieved a task success rate of 79.17%, versus 25.00% for a generic agent and 12.50% for random search. Its mean best coverage was 0.7816, compared with 0.6434 and 0.6448, respectively. By integrating language reasoning and physics-based feedback into design decisions, AbsorbEvo provides a methodological foundation for natural-language-driven autonomous inverse design of microwave absorbers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AbsorbEvo 把自然语言性能目标转成经全波仿真验证的微波吸波体设计：LLM 依据任务目标与计算历史提出参数调整方向和幅度，定向增量与全局采样结合生成候选，用低成本预测模型作物理先验排序，仅高排名设计进入全波仿真，通过物理有效性检查的结果再反哺搜索，并把训练任务经验蒸馏为经独立验证的文本技能。在相同提案预算下，held-out 的 AbsorbBench-36 任务上任务成功率 79.17%，对比通用 agent 25.00%、随机搜索 12.50%；平均最优 coverage 0.7816 对比 0.6434 与 0.6448。
Motivation: 高性能微波吸波体设计依赖电磁理论、材料科学与仿真编程的专门经验，优化过程耗时；需要把自然语言目标自动转成经全波仿真验证的设计。
Method: Agentic 逆向设计框架：LLM 基于任务目标与计算历史给出参数调整方向与幅度，定向增量加全局采样生成候选；低成本预测模型作为物理先验排序，仅高排名候选跑全波仿真，通过物理有效性检查的结果用于评估性能并引导后续搜索；训练任务经验蒸馏为文本技能，独立验证后用于新任务。
Result: 在相同提案预算下，held-out AbsorbBench-36 任务上 AbsorbEvo 任务成功率 79.17%，通用 agent 25.00%，随机搜索 12.50%；平均最优 coverage 0.7816，对比 0.6434 与 0.6448。

papers.title: Madeleine: Learning Involuntary Recall for Conversational Memory from Simulated Lives
papers.abstract_en: A long-term conversational assistant must recall the right memory at the right moment, yet the memory that matters most is often not similar to what the user says now. Current systems recover such associations by letting an LLM reason at write or read time, at a cost of hundreds to over a thousand LLM calls per memory bank and up to several thousand context tokens per query. We argue that association is a learnable relevance: the pointwise mutual information of memories under how human lives unfold. We introduce Madeleine, which learns amortized association: offline, an LLM life simulator writes simulated lives, whose cue-trigger pairs teach a query encoder a residual association on top of frozen similarity; online, it calls no LLM and plugs into any vector memory by replacing only the query encoder. On LoCoMo-Plus under the official protocol, Madeleine (I) reaches 66.6 when plugged into HyperMem, the highest among all systems evaluated under this protocol; (II) used alone, reaches the score of HyperMem as released (52.4 vs. 52.9) with zero LLM calls and about 1/21 of its answer context; and (III) lifts T-Mem by 26.2 points, significantly outperforms the same untrained backbone inside both systems, and leaves ordinary QA intact on the 4B backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Madeleine 把对话记忆的关联检索当作可学习的相关性（记忆间在人类生活展开方式下的点互信息），离线用 LLM 生活模拟器生成 simulated lives 的 cue-trigger 对训练查询编码器，在冻结相似度之上学残差关联，线上零 LLM 调用。在 LoCoMo-Plus 官方协议下：插入 HyperMem 得 66.6（该协议最高），单独使用以 52.4 对 52.9 追平 HyperMem 发布版但零 LLM 调用、答案上下文约为其 1/21，并把 T-Mem 提升 26.2 分。
Motivation: 长期对话助手最该被唤起的记忆往往与用户当前说法不相似，现有系统靠 LLM 在写入或读取时推理来补关联，代价是每个记忆库数百到一千多次 LLM 调用、每次查询至多数千 context token。
Method: 离线阶段由 LLM life simulator 写出 simulated lives，从中抽取 cue-trigger 对，训练一个查询编码器在冻结相似度之上学残差关联（amortized association）；在线阶段不调用 LLM，只替换向量记忆系统中的查询编码器即可接入任意 vector memory。
Result: LoCoMo-Plus 官方协议下：插入 HyperMem 得 66.6，为该协议下所有被评估系统最高；单独使用得 52.4，对 HyperMem 发布版 52.9，且零 LLM 调用、答案上下文约为其 1/21；使 T-Mem 提升 26.2 分；在 4B backbone 上显著优于两个系统内部相同的未训练 backbone，且不损害普通 QA。
Conclusion: 记忆关联可以离线学成一个可摊销的查询编码器，从而把 LLM 推理从检索路径上移走：零 LLM 调用即可接近强基线水平，并显著抬升弱 backbone。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond State-of-the-Art: Standardising Environmental Impact Metrics for AI Research
papers.abstract_en: As the capabilities and ubiquity of Large Language Models (LLMs) grow, so does their environmental footprint. Despite calls for responsible AI, the machine learning community lacks standardised practices for carbon accounting. Our automated literature review of the 5,285 papers accepted to NeurIPS 2025 reveals that reporting of environmental impact is nearly non-existent. To catalyse a shift toward sustainable AI, we define standardised sustainability metrics for evaluating model training efficiency, accompanied by simple heuristics to estimate the carbon cost of LLM inference. We implement these metrics in carbonbenchmark, a drop-in software solution for tracking and reporting emissions. Finally, to combat the pursuit of marginal accuracy gains at disproportionate environmental costs, we formalise the `Smallest Model that Achieves the Job' (SMAJ), a framework which challenges the field to prioritise computational efficiency and environmental accountability alongside traditional `State-of-the-Art' (SotA) accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 NeurIPS 2025 接收的 5,285 篇论文做自动化文献审查，发现环境影响报告几乎不存在；据此定义标准化可持续性指标与 LLM 推理碳成本估算启发式，落地为 carbonbenchmark 软件，并提出 SMAJ（Smallest Model that Achieves the Job）框架，主张以最小够用模型取代单纯追逐 SotA 精度。
Motivation: 机器学习界缺乏标准化碳核算实践，模型环境足迹随 LLM 普及增长，而精度提升常以不成比例的环境代价换取。
Method: 对 NeurIPS 2025 全部 5,285 篇接收论文做自动化文献审查以统计环境影响报告情况；定义评估训练效率的标准化可持续性指标与估算 LLM 推理碳成本的启发式规则，实现为可直接接入的 carbonbenchmark 软件；并形式化 SMAJ 框架。
Result: 5,285 篇 NeurIPS 2025 接收论文中环境影响报告几乎不存在；产出标准化训练效率指标、推理碳成本估算启发式、carbonbenchmark 追踪与报告排放工具，以及 SMAJ 框架。
Conclusion: AI 研究应把计算效率与环境问责同 SotA 精度并列，用统一指标和工具追踪排放，并优先选用完成任务的最小模型。

papers.title: Affine-Aligned Atlas for Canonical Gaussian Construction in Video Representation
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian splatting has recently emerged as an efficient representation for images and videos due to its explicit structure and fast rendering capability. Existing Gaussian-based video representations often decompose a video into canonical Gaussians and temporal deformation. However, when a video contains large global motion such as camera movement, the canonical representation may become misaligned with individual frames, increasing the burden on the temporal deformation model. In this paper, we propose an affine-atlas canonical Gaussian representation, which constructs canonical Gaussians in a larger affine-aligned atlas space. Frame-wise affine transforms absorb global motion before canonical Gaussian construction, reducing the gap between the canonical representation and target frames. Since the proposed method only modifies the canonical construction stage, it can be integrated into existing canonical-Gaussian-based methods with negligible additional parameter cost. Experiments show that our method improves reconstruction quality especially for sequences with large camera motion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对视频 Gaussian splatting 中相机大幅全局运动导致 canonical 表示与各帧错位、加重时序形变模型负担的问题，提出 affine-atlas canonical Gaussian 表示：先用逐帧 affine 变换吸收全局运动，再在更大的 affine-aligned atlas 空间中构建 canonical Gaussians。该方法只改 canonical 构建阶段，可插入现有 canonical-Gaussian 方法，额外参数开销可忽略，并在含大幅相机运动的序列上提升重建质量。
Motivation: 现有 canonical Gaussians + 时序形变的视频分解在相机大幅运动时 canonical 表示与单帧错位，把对齐负担全压给时序形变模型。
Method: 在 canonical 构建前加入逐帧 affine 变换吸收全局运动，再于更大的 affine-aligned atlas 空间中构建 canonical Gaussians；只修改 canonical 构建阶段，可集成到已有 canonical-Gaussian 方法，参数开销可忽略。
Result: 实验显示该方法提升重建质量，且在含大幅相机运动的序列上改善尤其明显。
Conclusion: 把全局运动的吸收前移到 affine 对齐的 atlas 空间，可以缩小 canonical 表示与目标帧的差距，从而减轻时序形变模型负担。

papers.title: How Much Can Language Models Gain from Test-Time Computation?
papers.abstract_en: How much can test-time computation improve a language model, and at what cost? Test-time scaling is widely proposed as a substitute for larger models, but existing comparisons mostly evaluate one domain at a time and rarely charge selection to the budget. We introduce SELF-POT, a benchmark and evaluation framework that measures the test-time potential of a model across competition mathematics, competitive programming, and agentic workflows. SELF-POT separates candidate coverage from final accuracy on static tasks, tracks correctness transitions under revision, and measures protocol completion alongside task success in agentic environments. Under a unified budget rule, it compares Direct inference with parallel sampling and self-revision under fixed multiples of the Direct budget, and charges every model call, including selection and critique, in dollars. This design supports two kinds of comparison: the gain a model obtains from additional inference, and a lower-cost model with additional inference against a stronger model. Across five low-cost reasoning models on 350 sealed tasks, with Claude Opus 5.5 Direct as the reference, the returns depend on the domain, the selection rule, and failure handling. When we replay the retained programming candidate pools, public-example selection raises correct submissions from 376 to 453 of 500 scheduled cells while saving 12-49% of logical API cost across models, and simply retaining an available candidate when judging fails recovers 61 submissions at unchanged cost. On identical mathematics pools, judging with fallback yields 186 correct submissions versus 182 for voting, while voting saves 12-21% of logical API cost. These controlled replays show how selection and failure handling change the gains realized from the same generated candidates, and they quantify the marginal value of a model judge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出测试时计算基准 SELF-POT，在竞赛数学、竞赛编程与 agentic 工作流三域统一按美元计费（含选择与批判调用），比较 Direct、并行采样与自修订。在 5 个低成本推理模型、350 道密封题上：编程域公开样例选择把正确提交从 376/500 提到 453/500 并省 12–49% 逻辑 API 成本，判分失败时保留候选可零成本挽回 61 次提交；数学域带兜底的判分 186 正确对 voting 182，而 voting 省 12–21% 成本。
Motivation: 测试时扩展被当作换更大模型的替代方案，但现有对比多一次只评一个域，且几乎不把选择与批判的调用计入预算，导致“增益”与“成本”不可比。
Method: SELF-POT 把候选覆盖与最终准确率在静态任务上分离，追踪修订下的正确性翻转，并在 agentic 环境同时记录协议完成与任务成功；统一预算规则下以 Direct 预算的固定倍数比较 Direct、并行采样与自修订，每次模型调用按美元计费。以 Claude Opus 5.5 Direct 为参考，覆盖 5 个低成本推理模型与 350 道密封题，并对保留的候选池做受控重放。
Result: 编程域重放中公开样例选择使 500 个计划单元的正确提交由 376 升至 453，同时节省 12–49% 逻辑 API 成本；判分失败时保留可用候选在成本不变下挽回 61 次提交。相同数学候选池上，带兜底的判分得 186 个正确提交，voting 为 182，而 voting 节省 12–21% 逻辑 API 成本。
Conclusion: 测试时增益取决于域、选择规则与失败处理：同一份生成候选下，选择与兜底策略即可改变实现的收益，模型判分的边际价值可被单独量化，且成本必须连同选择与批判一起计费。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MASkillBlender: Decentralized Whole-Body Coordination for Multi-Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Skill Blending
papers.abstract_en: Coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation is promising yet challenging due to high-dimensional whole-body control, decentralized decision making, and scalability. While recent reinforcement learning methods have improved single-humanoid whole-body control, extending them to the multi-humanoid setting remains nontrivial and often requires substantial reward engineering or task-specific design. We propose MASkillBlender, a general multi-agent reinforcement learning framework to achieve decentralized multi-humanoid whole-body coordination. By learning a shared decentralized high-level policy over reusable pre-trained single-humanoid skills, MASkillBlender enables coordinated behaviors using only task-level rewards, without requiring task-specific motion references. To improve learning efficiency, we further introduce a permutation-based data augmentation strategy for homogeneous multi-humanoid systems, and theoretically show that the permuted samples preserve the policy-gradient direction of the original samples under the homogeneous Markov game formulation. We evaluate MASkillBlender on multiple multi-humanoid coordination tasks across two humanoid embodiments. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently achieves strong task performance and enables coordinated behaviors across different tasks and humanoid embodiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MASkillBlender 用共享的去中心化高层策略在预训练单人形技能之上做技能混合 (skill blending)，仅靠任务级奖励即可实现多个人形机器人的全身协调，无需任务专属动作参考。置换式数据增强在同构 Markov 博弈下被证明保持原样本的策略梯度方向，仿真中在两种人形本体的多个协调任务上均取得强任务表现。
Motivation: 多机器人人形 loco-manipulation 面对高维全身控制、去中心化决策与可扩展性三重困难；现有单人形 RL 方法推广到多机器人时往往需要大量奖励工程或任务专属设计。
Method: 提出多智能体强化学习框架 MASkillBlender：在可复用的预训练单人形技能之上学习一个共享的去中心化高层策略，只用任务级奖励训练；并引入针对同构多机器人系统的置换式数据增强 (permutation-based data augmentation)，理论上证明置换样本在同构 Markov 博弈表述下保持原样本的策略梯度方向。
Result: 在两种人形本体 (embodiments) 上的多个多机器人协调任务中进行仿真评估，结果显示该框架持续取得强任务表现，并在不同任务与不同人形本体间实现协调行为。

papers.title: MVDG: Efficient Multi-view 3D Disambiguation on Unconstrained Real-World Images
papers.abstract_en: Illusory matches between distinct yet visually similar 3D surfaces--doppelgangers--remain a fundamental obstacle for large-scale, in-the-wild 3D reconstruction and visual localization. Prior work mitigates this issue with pairwise classifiers, but this design limits multi-view contextual reasoning and incurs O(n^2) inference complexity for downstream structure-from-motion (SfM). We present MVDG, a scalable multi-view disambiguation framework built on the 3D foundation model VGGT, which jointly reasons over an arbitrary number of multiview images. By incorporating 3D-aware multi-view features, our method reduces dependence on pairwise comparisons by encoding and decoding views in a single pass. We further observe that direct multi-view fine-tuning of VGGT can be unstable under noisy supervision; motivated by label ambiguity in Doppelgangers, we construct a pseudo-pairwise training set from AerialMegaDepth and show that fine-tuning on sampled subsets yields stable optimization and strong generalization to held-out scenes. Finally, because full SfM evaluation (even with faster pipelines such as GLOMAP) remains expensive, we process a pseudo-pairwise dataset for efficient validation; we derive a predictive relationship between regular SfM metrics and the classification accuracy on this pseudo-pairwise test. Experiments show that our method achieves comparable pairwise accuracy while improving both SfM accuracy and inference speed over baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MVDG 用 3D 基础模型 VGGT 做多视图联合推理，一次性编码解码任意数量图像来消除 doppelganger 式的相似表面误匹配，把成对分类器的 O(n^2) 推理降为单次前向。在 AerialMegaDepth 构造的伪成对训练集上按子集微调可稳定优化并泛化到留出场景，最终在保持可比成对精度的同时提升 SfM 精度与推理速度。
Motivation: 视觉相似但几何不同的 3D 表面会造成 illusory matches，阻碍大规模 in-the-wild 3D 重建与视觉定位；既有成对分类器无法做多视图上下文推理，且给下游 SfM 带来 O(n^2) 推理复杂度。
Method: 构建基于 VGGT 的多视图消歧框架，注入 3D-aware 多视图特征，单次前向完成编码与解码以减少成对比较依赖；针对直接多视图微调在噪声监督下不稳定的问题，从 AerialMegaDepth 构造伪成对训练集，并在采样子集上微调；另推导常规 SfM 指标与伪成对测试分类精度之间的预测关系，用伪成对数据集替代昂贵的完整 SfM 评测（含 GLOMAP 这类较快管线）做高效验证。
Result: 实验显示该方法取得与基线可比的成对分类精度，同时在 SfM 精度与推理速度上均优于基线；采样子集微调带来稳定优化并在留出场景上表现出强泛化。
Conclusion: 多视图联合推理加伪成对监督可以在不牺牲成对精度的前提下同时改善 SfM 精度与速度，且伪成对测试精度可用来预测真实 SfM 指标，从而绕开昂贵的完整评测。

papers.title: YouRA: A Persistent-State Architecture for Evidence-Traceable Autonomous Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end research agents can now produce complete scientific papers, yet manuscript claims often diverge from executed experiments. This gap is structural: research state, failure histories, and claim-evidence alignment are not maintained as persistent, verifiable state across long-horizon pipelines. We present YouRA (Your Research Agent), an architecture for stateful, evidence-traceable autonomous research. YouRA preserves research state, execution evidence, and failure history across the research trajectory by integrating three components: a Verification State Architecture (VSA) that tracks hypotheses, gates, and evidence pointers; an Independent Controller that turns state and reflection records into lifecycle, recovery, and debate/review control while separating control from execution; and Stateful Reflection that logs failures as structured lessons and routes recovery through bounded repair, redesign, or reset. On MLR-Bench's predefined ten-task end-to-end subset, YouRA improves over both MLR-Agent and AI Scientist V2 on scalar Overall across all three matched backbones. An automated diagnostic using MLR-Bench's hallucination taxonomy reports intersection/union counts for four fact-based failure types, and data-provenance diagnostic shows more real-data-based outputs. Ablating each of the four components (the VSA, the Independent Controller, MCP tool access, and reflection-guided recovery) supports their separable contributions. Removing either core-state component drops YouRA below the full system. Code: https://github.com/PrayPrey/Your-Research-Agent.
papers.comment: Accepted to the AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference. 21 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: YouRA 把研究状态、执行证据与失败历史作为可验证的持久状态维护，在 MLR-Bench 预定义的十任务端到端子集上，其 Overall 标量分在三种匹配 backbone 上均同时超过 MLR-Agent 与 AI Scientist V2；自动化诊断显示基于真实数据的产出更多，四个组件的消融支持各自可分离的贡献，去掉任一核心状态组件都会使性能跌回完整系统之下。
Motivation: 端到端研究 agent 已能产出完整论文，但稿件主张常与实际执行的实验脱节，因为研究状态、失败历史与主张-证据对齐在长程流水线中没有作为持久、可验证的状态被维护。
Method: YouRA 由三部分组成：Verification State Architecture (VSA) 跟踪假设、门控与证据指针；Independent Controller 把状态与反思记录转成生命周期、恢复与辩论/评审控制，将控制与执行分离；Stateful Reflection 把失败记为结构化教训，并经有界修复、重设计或重置三条路径路由恢复。评测用 MLR-Bench 的十任务端到端子集，配三种匹配 backbone，并对 VSA、Independent Controller、MCP 工具访问、反思引导恢复四个组件分别做消融。
Result: 在 MLR-Bench 预定义十任务端到端子集上，YouRA 的 Overall 标量分在三种匹配 backbone 上全部同时优于 MLR-Agent 与 AI Scientist V2；基于 MLR-Bench 幻觉分类法的自动诊断给出四类事实性失败的交集/并集计数，数据溯源诊断显示更多基于真实数据的产出；四组件消融支持可分离贡献，移除任一核心状态组件使 YouRA 低于完整系统。
Conclusion: 把研究状态、执行证据与失败历史持久化并让控制与执行分离，是让自主研究 agent 的主张与已执行实验对齐的关键，且核心状态组件不可拆。

papers.title: Dataset Identity, Not Novelty: The Source of an Inflated OOD Detection Gain
papers.abstract_en: A post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detector reads the activations of a trained classifier and returns a score. It fits that score on in-distribution data, and the benchmarks that evaluate it supply a second piece of OOD data for the fitting itself. Some detectors tune a constant on it. Others fit a direction in feature space or train a flexible combiner and report the number that it reaches as the gain that is still available. Every such fit is validated on held-out samples of the same OOD dataset. That check rules out memorizing individual images. It says nothing about a fit that has instead learned which dataset it is looking at, and a direction that recognizes one OOD dataset rather than novelty passes it perfectly. The detector that a practitioner installs meets OOD data from a source that nobody fitted it on, so the difference decides what the reported number is worth. We measure it by holding out the whole OOD dataset rather than a sample of it, and we call that gap the inflation. We read it across a range of combiners on ImageNet and CIFAR-100 backbones. Most of the gain that the usual protocol reports turns out to be dataset identity rather than novelty. The size of the fit does not move what survives, so the effect is not ordinary overfitting. The share depends instead on whether the input exposes class identity, and two controls that vary that property alone separate the inflation on every backbone of both benchmarks. A closed form accounts for the effect and computes it from the fitting rows, so a practitioner can tell which fits will inflate without running the hold-out protocol. One of these fits survives, namely the single constant that the field already picks on a designated validation dataset. Anything above it reports a gain that the hold-out protocol does not return, and on one benchmark what survives falls while what is reported climbs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 后 OOD 检测器在基准提供的 OOD 数据上调参，再用同一 OOD 数据集的留出样本验证，导致报告的增益大多来自数据集身份而非新颖性。作者改为整份 OOD 数据集留出（称为 inflation）来度量该差距：在 ImageNet 与 CIFAR-100 backbone 上，多数 combiner 的增益在此协议下消失，只有在指定验证集上选的单个常数能存活；且在一个基准上存活值下降而报告值上升。
Motivation: OOD 检测基准既提供拟合用的 OOD 数据又提供验证样本，留出样本只能排除记忆单张图片，无法排除拟合学到“这是哪个数据集”，而实际部署时遇到的 OOD 来自未被拟合的来源，这直接决定报告数字的价值。
Method: 以整份 OOD 数据集留出（而非样本留出）替代常规验证协议，量化二者之差并命名为 inflation；在 ImageNet 与 CIFAR-100 backbone 上跨多种 combiner 测量，并用两个只改变“输入是否暴露类别身份”的对照实验分离该效应，另给出一个由拟合行直接计算 inflation 的闭式解。
Result: 常规协议报告的增益大部分被证实为数据集身份而非新颖性；拟合规模变化不改变存活部分，说明不是普通过拟合；两个只改变类别身份暴露的对照在两个基准的每个 backbone 上都分离出 inflation；闭式解可从拟合行算出 inflation；只有在指定验证集上选的单个常数存活，在其中一个基准上存活值下降而报告值上升。
Conclusion: 超出“在指定验证集上选的单个常数”的任何 OOD 检测增益，都是留出整数据集协议不会返还的增益；实践者可用闭式解在不跑留出协议的情况下判断哪些拟合会通胀。

papers.title: Explaining El Niño Forecasts with the Average Gradient Outer Product
papers.abstract_en: An important and unresolved problem in the physical sciences is explaining the predictions made by neural networks. Several explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods have been proposed to address this problem, including gradient XAI, Integrated Gradients, and GradientSHAP. We evaluate the baseline XAI methods according to four scores: sensitivity (XAI patterns strongly affect predictions), attribution (XAI patterns reproduce the change in prediction relative to a baseline), robustness (XAI patterns remain stable for nearby inputs), and coherence (XAI patterns are spatially smooth). We also introduce a new method, average gradient outer product (AGOP) XAI, that uses global gradient information to identify an important direction for a specific input. We apply XAI to neural network predictions of the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) based on data from the Zebiak-Cane model. AGOP XAI achieves the highest attribution, robustness, and coherence scores in the architecture and lead-time comparisons reported here. Its sensitivity is surpassed by gradient XAI, which is maximally sensitive by definition. Beyond diagnosing neural-network behavior, AGOP XAI can generate candidate hypotheses about physical mechanisms. The method highlights an equatorial thermocline-depth signal consistent with recharge oscillator physics, together with a southeastern-Pacific lobe that may be specific to the Zebiak-Cane model. Finally, we test the physical relevance of AGOP using optimized perturbations that move the Zebiak-Cane model along AGOP explanation coordinates. Such perturbations can suppress the selected extreme events or, from a near-neutral ensemble, generate strong El Niño or La Niña events 10 months later.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 12 figures, 1 table. Software: https://github.com/rjwebber/agop-xai/releases/tag/v1.0.0. Processed data, trained models, and reproducibility artifacts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23053004
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出平均梯度外积 (average gradient outer product, AGOP) 可解释性方法，用全局梯度信息为单个输入定位重要方向，并在 Zebiak-Cane 模型的 ENSO 神经网络预测上与 gradient XAI、Integrated Gradients、GradientSHAP 对比。AGOP 在 attribution、robustness、coherence 三项得分上最高，仅 sensitivity 逊于按定义最敏感的 gradient XAI；其解释指向与 recharge oscillator 物理一致的赤道温跃层深度信号，沿 AGOP 方向的优化扰动可在 10 个月后抑制已选极端事件或从近中性集合生成强 El Niño/La Niña。
Motivation: 神经网络在物理科学中的预测难以解释，现有 gradient XAI、Integrated Gradients、GradientSHAP 缺乏统一的多维度评价，且解释是否对应真实物理机制未经检验。
Method: 提出 AGOP XAI，用全局梯度信息构造针对特定输入的重要方向；按 sensitivity、attribution、robustness、coherence 四项得分评估包括 gradient XAI、Integrated Gradients、GradientSHAP 在内的基线，并做架构与提前期 (lead-time) 对比；再用优化扰动沿 AGOP 解释坐标驱动 Zebiak-Cane 模型，检验解释的物理相关性。
Result: AGOP 在所报告的架构与提前期对比中取得最高的 attribution、robustness、coherence 得分，sensitivity 则被按定义最大化敏感的 gradient XAI 超过。解释突出与 recharge oscillator 物理一致的赤道温跃层深度信号，以及一个可能为 Zebiak-Cane 模型特有的东南太平洋瓣。沿 AGOP 解释坐标的优化扰动可抑制所选极端事件，或从近中性集合在 10 个月后生成强 El Niño 或 La Niña。
Conclusion: AGOP 的解释不仅刻画神经网络行为，还能生成关于物理机制的候选假设；其坐标方向对应可实际驱动 Zebiak-Cane 模型状态转变的物理扰动方向。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: OrbitTAMP: Grounding Language Models for Task and Motion Planning in Spacecraft Rendezvous
papers.abstract_en: Spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) are currently planned through an expertise-intensive process in which engineers translate high-level operational intent into safe, dynamically feasible trajectories, creating a bottleneck to scalable operations. Large language model (LLM)-based agents could offer an intuitive interface for this process, although their outputs are not inherently grounded in orbital dynamics, operational constraints, or the structure of admissible spacecraft maneuvers. To exploit their semantic reasoning while ensuring the generated plan's physical validity, this paper presents a hierarchical framework for spacecraft task-and-motion planning (TAMP) that grounds LLM reasoning in a graph of reusable behaviors and domain-specific planning modules. Within this framework, a pretrained LLM maps a natural-language command to a partial mission specification. The associated planners then resolve unspecified decisions within the admissible operational space. Finally, trajectory optimization converts the completed mission specification into a dynamically feasible trajectory. Numerical experiments demonstrate that this architecture substantially improves intent recovery over direct LLM generation, achieving 98% exact recovery of partial mission specifications across all evaluated splits when backed by frontier LLMs. Additional test-time-compute experiments show that, for a compact 9B model, verifier-guided revision increases exact recovery from 75% to 88%, while broader behavior-plan search independently improves selection among admissible trajectory realizations. Overall, these results establish a scalable and auditable foundation for language-driven agentic planning of spacecraft RPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OrbitTAMP 把航天器交会与近距离操作 (RPO) 的任务-运动规划 (TAMP) 做成分层框架：预训练 LLM 将自然语言指令转成部分任务规格，可复用行为图与领域规划模块补全未指定决策，轨迹优化再输出动力学可行轨迹。在全部评估划分上，frontier LLM 支撑时部分任务规格精确恢复率达 98%，远高于直接 LLM 生成；9B 紧凑模型上验证器引导修订把精确恢复率从 75% 提到 88%。
Motivation: RPO 计划目前依赖工程师把高层作战意图手工翻译成安全且动力学可行的轨迹，形成可扩展运营的瓶颈；LLM 智能体虽提供自然语言接口，其输出却不天然锚定轨道动力学、操作约束与合法机动结构。
Method: 分层 TAMP 框架：预训练 LLM 把自然语言指令映射为部分任务规格 (partial mission specification)，配套领域规划器在可容许操作空间内补全未指定决策，最后由轨迹优化器把完整规格转成动力学可行轨迹；推理侧另做验证器引导修订与行为计划搜索 (behavior-plan search) 的 test-time-compute 实验。
Result: 在全部评估划分上，frontier LLM 支撑的部分任务规格精确恢复率 (exact recovery) 达 98%，显著高于直接 LLM 生成；9B 紧凑模型上验证器引导修订使精确恢复率从 75% 提升到 88%，更广的行为计划搜索则独立改善在可容许轨迹实现之间的选择。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 的语义推理接到行为图与领域规划器上，可在保持物理有效性与可审计性的同时，让语言驱动的 RPO 智能体规划规模化；test-time-compute 是补足小模型意图恢复能力的有效杠杆。
