papers.title: Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video generation models are increasingly being explored as world simulators for embodied planning and learning. To do so effectively, these models must not only generate visually appealing frames, but also predict how environments dynamically evolve when executing goal-directed actions. While evaluating these capabilities is crucial, existing benchmarks focus mainly on single short actions or step-by-step instructions. This leaves multi-step physical reasoning underexplored, especially in egocentric video generation that requires planning to simulate proper execution to accomplish high-level goals by carrying out multiple real-world manipulations. We introduce Ego2Act, a goal-directed benchmark featuring 2,640 videos from 110 real-world tasks across day-to-day settings, varying object clutter and multi-step complexity. Given an initial scene image and a high-level goal, Ego2Act evaluates whether video generation models can produce realistic egocentric videos of a hand manipulating objects to carry out the task. To support scalable evaluation, we also introduce Ego2ActJudge, a reference-free evaluation pipeline that achieves better task completion and physics plausibility evaluation alignment with human consensus compared to relevant baselines. Our findings reveal that models' generated simulations often skip or partially execute steps, leaving later steps missing dependent states, which leads to unfulfilled goal. Furthermore, models consistently fail at fine-grained physical dynamics, particularly during complex object manipulation and persistent world modeling. We hope Ego2Act provides a rigorous testbed for advancing video models toward physically plausible, goal-directed simulation.
papers.comment: Preprint. 51 pages, 19 figures, 23 tables. Code, dataset and project website linked in the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ego2Act 是面向目标导向操作的 egocentric 视频生成基准，含 2,640 段视频、覆盖 110 项真实任务与不同杂乱度/多步复杂度；给定初始场景图与高层目标，评测模型能否生成手部完成任务的第一视角视频。配套的免参考评测管线 Ego2ActJudge 在任务完成与物理合理性上与人类共识的对齐优于相关基线。主要发现是模型常跳过或只执行部分步骤，导致后续步骤缺少依赖状态、目标无法达成，且在复杂物体操作与持续世界建模上系统性失败。
Motivation: 现有视频生成基准多聚焦单个短动作或逐步指令，egocentric 场景下需要规划并模拟多步真实操作以达成高层目标的多步物理推理几乎未被覆盖。
Method: 构建 Ego2Act 基准：2,640 段视频、110 项日常任务，变化物体杂乱度与多步复杂度；输入初始场景图像与高层目标，评测生成的手部操作第一视角视频。提出免参考评测管线 Ego2ActJudge，用于任务完成与物理合理性打分。
Result: Ego2Act 含 2,640 段视频、110 项真实任务；Ego2ActJudge 在任务完成与物理合理性上对齐人类共识的程度优于相关基线。模型生成的模拟常跳过或部分执行步骤，使后续步骤缺失依赖状态并导致目标未达成，且在复杂物体操作与持续世界建模的细粒度物理动态上一致失败。
Conclusion: 现有视频生成模型尚不能可靠地做多步、物理合理的目标导向模拟，Ego2Act 被定位为推动视频模型走向该能力的测试床。

papers.title: Polylogarithmic Sparsity of Randomly Reweighted NPMLEs for Gaussian Mixtures
papers.abstract_en: The nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator (NPMLE) of a Gaussian location mixture maximizes the likelihood over the infinite-dimensional space of mixing distributions. The maximizing mixing distribution can be nonunique, and the classical bound on its number of atoms grows linearly with the sample size $n$. We show that a vanishingly small random perturbation of the likelihood yields exact polylogarithmic sparsity. The resulting randomly reweighted NPMLE maximizes a weighted likelihood whose independent weights, taken to be Gamma in our analysis, concentrate around one as $n$ grows. With high probability, it is unique, has $O\{(\log n/\log\log n)^d+\log n\}$ atoms in dimension $d$, nearly maximizes the ordinary likelihood, and estimates the mixture density at a Hellinger rate that is parametric up to logarithmic factors. This sparsity holds for the estimator itself, not for an approximation of it, and requires no support penalty. The proof rests on an effective-dimension principle for positive kernel mixtures: low-dimensional variation of the fitted values controls the support of every extreme point of the set of maximizers. Numerical illustrations verify that the reweighted NPMLE has Hellinger risk and support size comparable to those of the ordinary NPMLE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对高斯位置混合的 NPMLE 施加一个随 n 消失的 Gamma 随机重加权，使极大化点以高概率唯一，并把支撑原子数从随样本量 n 线性降到 O((log n/log log n)^d + log n) 的多对数稀疏，且这是估计量本身的性质而非近似、无需支撑惩罚。数值示例显示重加权 NPMLE 的 Hellinger 风险与支撑规模与普通 NPMLE 相当。
Motivation: 高斯位置混合的 NPMLE 极大化点可能不唯一，且经典界给出的原子数随样本量 n 线性增长，估计量支撑过大不利于解释与计算。
Method: 在似然上乘以独立 Gamma 权重（均值为 1、随 n 集中于 1）得到随机重加权 NPMLE；证明依赖正核混合的有效维数原理：拟合值的低维变化控制极大化集合中每个极值点的支撑。
Result: 以高概率极大化点唯一、原子数为 O((log n/log log n)^d + log n)（维度 d）、几乎极大化普通似然、混合密度估计达到只差对数因子的参数 Hellinger 速率；数值示例中重加权 NPMLE 的 Hellinger 风险与支撑规模与普通 NPMLE 相当。
Conclusion: 极小的随机扰动即可把 NPMLE 的线性原子界压到多对数稀疏，且无需任何支撑惩罚项。

papers.title: Improving Math Reasoning through Value-guided Informative Search
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Recent work introduces search into RLVR rollouts to increase trajectory diversity, but diversity alone does not ensure that the search-induced rollout policy improves upon the current policy. To address this gap, we propose APIVIS, a training-time framework that adapts finite-budget Gumbel search to chunk-level mathematical reasoning. APIVIS combines direct and searched responses within each rollout group, allowing improvements found by search to produce informative relative rewards. It further applies selective supervision to search-improved tokens, preserving a learning signal when uniform group rewards render GRPO ineffective. We show that exact value-guided selection improves the expected verifier reward at each searched state and that this guarantee extends to the complete rollout policy, with a corresponding approximate guarantee under bounded value-estimation error. Experiments on widely recognized mathematical reasoning benchmarks and different model scales demonstrate substantial improvements over competitive search-based methods, validating the effectiveness of APIVIS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: APIVIS 把有限预算的 Gumbel 搜索嵌入 RLVR rollout：同一组内混入直接响应与搜索响应，使搜索带来的改进转化为有信息量的相对奖励，并对搜索改进的 token 施加选择性监督，避免均匀组奖励让 GRPO 失去梯度。理论上精确 value-guided 选择在每个被搜状态上提升期望验证器奖励，并可推广到完整 rollout 策略，在 value 估计有界误差下给出近似保证。
Motivation: RLVR 中引入搜索能增加轨迹多样性，但多样性本身不保证 rollout 策略优于当前策略；且均匀组奖励会让 GRPO 拿不到学习信号。
Method: APIVIS 是训练期框架：把有限预算 Gumbel 搜索适配到 chunk 级数学推理，rollout 组内混合直接与搜索得到的响应以产生 informative relative rewards，只对 search-improved token 做选择性监督；并给出 value-guided 选择的期望奖励保证及其在有界 value 估计误差下的近似版本。
Result: 在多个被广泛认可的数学推理 benchmark 和不同模型规模上，APIVIS 相对有竞争力的 search-based 方法有显著提升（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 让搜索改进进入相对奖励并只监督被搜索改进的 token，可以在保持学习信号的同时把搜索收益转成策略改进，且该改进有 value-guided 的理论保证。

papers.title: Jev-IDS: System One Models for Network Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning Network Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) depend on substantial labeled datasets and task-specific training, whereas Large Language Models (LLMs) detection can analyze flow records directly but incurs higher inference cost and latency, with less constrained outputs. This paper presents JEV-IDS, an open experimental general NIDS based on the Jev System One Model (SOM) to detect zero day intrusions Under label scarcity. JEV-IDS serializes one flow per request and asks JEV two questions: a binary attack probability and a finite-choice traffic category. Our results show that, at k=1, JEV was 4.8 times faster and 3.8 times cheaper than GPT-5.6 Luna, with 1.5 times higher novel-attack recall; it also produced 15 times fewer false alarms than a low-data Random Forest. Across 5,400 decisions on a 300-flow NSL-KDD pilot split, JEV achieved F1-Score 0.859, precision 0.941, recall 0.790, and novel-attack recall 0.838. Increasing k to 2 reduced its F1-Score to 0.839.

papers.title: GLoC-EHR: Evidence-Cited Clinical Reasoning over Global Context and Local EHR Events
papers.abstract_en: Structured electronic health records (EHRs) contain a patient's clinical trajectory as a sequence of clinical codes. Answering clinical questions from such records requires both the context of the whole trajectory and the specific events that support the answer. We introduce GLoC-EHR, a multimodal language model that reads a contextual encoding of the record through a fixed-size global memory of the trajectory and a local memory of selected events. The model learns to generate hospital-course summaries from the global memory and descriptions of masked concepts from the local memory, aligning both with clinical text. It is then trained to cite evidence before answering, through rationale fine-tuning followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO) with rewards for correct answers and record-supported evidence. On three MIMIC-IV outcome tasks, GLoC-EHR attains the highest macro AUROC among the compared models when it answers directly, whereas zero-shot LLMs reading the serialized record fall far behind. With evidence-cited reasoning, it stays close to its direct multi-task counterpart in macro AUROC, and the evidence terms of the objective reduce unsupported evidence at a similar macro AUROC. The local memory adds distinct supported findings, particularly under strict matching, without a detectable change in macro AUROC. Without retraining, GLoC-EHR transfers to EHRSHOT on par with EHR-BERT and answers two unseen laboratory questions better than zero-shot prompting of its own backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLoC-EHR 用固定大小的全局记忆读整条病程、局部记忆读被选中的具体事件，先对齐医院病程摘要与被掩码概念描述，再做先引证据后回答的 rationale fine-tuning 加 GRPO（奖励正确答案与有病历支撑的证据）。在 MIMIC-IV 三项结局任务上，直接作答时 macro AUROC 为对比模型最高，零样本 LLM 读序列化病历远落后；带证据引用时 AUROC 仍接近直接多任务版本，证据项目标在相近 AUROC 下减少无支撑证据。
Motivation: 从 EHR 回答临床问题既要整条轨迹的全局上下文，又要支撑答案的具体事件；零样本 LLM 直接读序列化病历在结局任务上表现差，且生成的答案常缺少病历支撑的证据。
Method: 多模态语言模型以固定大小 global memory 编码整条轨迹、local memory 编码选中事件；训练分两阶段——先生成 global memory 的医院病程摘要与 local memory 的被掩码概念描述并与临床文本对齐，再做 rationale fine-tuning 后接 GRPO，奖励为正确答案与 record-supported evidence。
Result: MIMIC-IV 三项结局任务上，直接作答时 macro AUROC 在对比模型中最高，零样本 LLM 读序列化病历远低于此；带证据引用推理时 macro AUROC 与直接多任务版本接近，objective 的证据项在相近 macro AUROC 下减少 unsupported evidence；local memory 在严格匹配下补充了独立的 supported findings，macro AUROC 无可检测变化；不重训迁移到 EHRSHOT 时与 EHR-BERT 相当，两道未见化验问题上优于对自身 backbone 的零样本提示。
Conclusion: 先引证据后作答的训练可以在几乎不损失 macro AUROC 的前提下压低无支撑证据，局部记忆的增益体现在严格匹配下的独立有支撑发现而非 AUROC；模型可零重训迁移到 EHRSHOT。

papers.title: Overcoming Kernel Redundancy for Scaling Logic Gate Networks
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable logic gate networks, which operate using only logic gates, have recently attracted attention as an efficient alternative to conventional neural networks. However, despite their efficiency, the scaling behavior of logic gate networks remains underexplored. By contrast, scaling model capacity is a central design principle in deep neural networks and typically leads to improved performance. This discrepancy raises a key question: Can similar scaling benefits also be achieved in logic gate networks? In this work, we focus on width as a primary scaling axis and conduct a systematic analysis of its behavior in logic gate networks. We observe that naive width scaling often introduces redundancy among logic kernels, limiting the effective use of additional kernels and leading to performance saturation. To address this limitation, we propose a dynamic logic kernel framework that reorganizes kernel utilization by promoting specialization across kernel groups. This enables the network to better utilize increased width via input-dependent kernel routing, while ensuring that both routing and computation are implemented entirely with gate-level Boolean operations at inference time. We further find that kernel redundancy is most pronounced at the first gate level, motivating an early-stage dynamic logic kernel strategy that concentrates adaptation at this level. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves kernel utilization and increases kernel diversity, leading to higher accuracy with improved parameter efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 可微逻辑门网络 (differentiable logic gate networks) 沿宽度扩展时，朴素加宽会让 logic kernel 之间冗余、性能饱和；作者提出动态 logic kernel 框架，按 kernel 组促进特化并做输入依赖的路由，且路由与计算在推理时全部由门级布尔运算实现。冗余在第一层门级最严重，因此动态策略集中在该层，实验显示 kernel 利用率与多样性提高，准确率上升且参数效率更优。
Motivation: 深度神经网络靠扩大容量持续获益，而逻辑门网络的 scaling 行为研究不足：朴素宽度扩展引入 kernel 冗余，新增 kernel 用不上，性能趋于饱和。
Method: 以宽度为主要扩展轴做系统分析；提出动态 logic kernel 框架，通过 kernel 组间特化与输入依赖的 kernel 路由重组 kernel 利用，路由和计算在推理时全部用门级布尔运算完成；因冗余在第一 gate level 最突出，采用早期阶段的动态 logic kernel 策略，把自适应集中在该层。
Result: 实验结果表明该方法提高 kernel 利用率与 kernel 多样性，在更优参数效率下取得更高准确率；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 逻辑门网络的宽度扩展要靠动态、按输入路由的 kernel 特化来兑现容量收益，且自适应应集中在冗余最严重的第一 gate level。

papers.title: JoinGR: Learning to Traverse Join Graphs for Table Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Retrieving the right tables is a prerequisite for Text-to-SQL over realistic databases. Dense table retrievers rank schema elements independently, but this ignores a key source of evidence: some required tables are not mentioned in the question and become identifiable only through their join relationships to already relevant tables. We introduce JOINGR, a join-aware table retrieval method that treats the database join graph as the retrieval space. Columns are represented as graph nodes, while intra-table and foreign-key relationships are represented as typed edges. Given a question, JOINGR selects semantically similar anchor tables, traverses join edges with a query-conditioned scorer, and aggregates the resulting edge deposits into table scores. The scorer is a lightweight MLP on top of frozen query, node, and edge embeddings, trained with a pairwise margin loss over gold tables. On BIRD and Spider datasets, JOINGR is competitive with the strongest retrieval baselines. On BEAVER, a challenging enterprise benchmark with multi-hop table requirements, JOINGR substantially improves recall over dense retrieval and re-ranking baselines. Cross-domain experiments show that the learned scorer transfers across benchmarks, indicating that the method captures reusable joingraph traversal behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JOINGR 把数据库 join graph 当作检索空间来做 Text-to-SQL 的表检索：列作为节点、表内与外键关系作为带类型边，先选语义相近的锚表，再用查询条件化的打分器沿 join 边遍历并把边上的证据聚合为表得分。在 BIRD 与 Spider 上与最强检索基线相当，在多跳表需求的 BEAVER 企业基准上显著提升召回，且学到的打分器可跨基准迁移。
Motivation: Text-to-SQL 需要先检索出正确的表，但稠密表检索器独立给 schema 元素打分，忽略了问题中未直接提到、只能通过 join 关系推断出的必需表。
Method: 把 join graph 作为检索空间：列建为图节点，表内与外键关系建为带类型边；给定问题先选语义相似的锚表，用查询条件化的打分器遍历 join 边，再把边上的证据 (edge deposits) 聚合成表得分。打分器是冻结的查询、节点、边嵌入之上的轻量 MLP，用针对 gold 表的 pairwise margin loss 训练。
Result: 在 BIRD 与 Spider 上与最强检索基线相当；在多跳表需求的 BEAVER 企业基准上，召回相比稠密检索与重排序基线大幅提升；跨域实验显示学到的打分器可跨基准迁移。
Conclusion: 把 join 关系显式纳入检索空间能补上稠密检索漏掉的隐式必需表，且学到的 join graph 遍历行为是可跨域复用的。

papers.title: Kernelized Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering provides a simple, training-free mechanism for controlling attributes of generative models such as sentiment, style, and helpfulness. However, standard approaches such as Difference-in-Means apply a single input-independent steering vector across all activations, limiting expressivity and ignoring the local geometry of the activation space. We propose Kernelized Activation Steering (KAS), a unifying framework that lifts activation steering into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. KAS formulates steering as an optimization problem expressed purely via kernel evaluations, yielding an implicit, activation-dependent steering score without constructing explicit feature maps. Unlike DiM, KAS induces locally adaptive steering: each activation is modified according to its relative position with respect to source and target reference sets, producing a nonlinear steering field over the representation space. Importantly, DiM is recovered as a special case under a linear kernel, while richer kernels enable geometry-aware interventions. Across standard activation steering tasks, including jailbreaking LLMs and image style control, KAS outperforms or is on par with the existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kernelized Activation Steering (KAS) 把激活引导 (activation steering) 提升到再生核希尔伯特空间 (RKHS)，用纯核评估的优化问题给出隐式、依赖激活的引导分数，使每个激活按其相对 source/target 参考集的位置被局部自适应地修改，形成表示空间上的非线性引导场；线性核下退化为 Difference-in-Means。在含 LLM 越狱与图像风格控制的标准引导任务上，KAS 优于或持平现有方法。
Motivation: 标准 Difference-in-Means (DiM) 对所有激活施加同一个与输入无关的引导向量，表达力受限，且忽略激活空间的局部几何。
Method: KAS 将引导表述为仅用核评估表达的优化问题，不构造显式特征映射，得到隐式且依赖激活的 steering score；每个激活依据其相对 source 与 target 参考集的位置被修改，线性核下精确恢复 DiM，更丰富的核实现几何感知干预。
Result: 在标准激活引导任务上，包括对 LLM 的越狱 (jailbreaking) 与图像风格控制，KAS 优于或与现有方法持平；线性核情形下 KAS 退化为 Difference-in-Means。
Conclusion: 把激活引导写成 RKHS 中的核优化，可以用依赖激活的非线性引导场取代单一全局引导向量，同时把 DiM 作为线性核特例统一进来。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MOMAT: Mixture of Multiple Atlases for Low-Power Jailbreak Defense of Quantized LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Quantized large language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices for their low latency and energy efficiency. However, model quantization weakens alignment safeguards, leaving qLLMs (quantized large language models) highly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. To address this challenge, we present MOMAT (Mixture of Multiple Atlases), a hardware-enhanced safety framework that combines structured knowledge retrieval with low-power defense acceleration. Each atlas represents a semantic cluster of harmful or benign sample sets and policy templates, enabling domain-localized Retrieval-Augmented Generation guarding that mitigates the curse of dimensionality and the resulting semantic sparsity problem in large, heterogeneous safety databases. MOMAT retrieves top-$k$ similarity features from all atlases for each prompt and evaluates them using a lightweight MoE (Mixture of Experts) detector, while a CiM (Compute-in-Memory)-accelerated similarity engine performs fast, low-power atlas-local retrieval. MOMAT's CiM-based retrieval accelerates a 100-query batch from 15,052.44 ms to 3,207.21 ns (a $4.69 \times 10^6\times$ speedup) and reduces energy from $8.1 \times 10^7$ $μ$J to 3.32 $μ$J, yielding an approximately $2.5 \times 10^5\times$ energy reduction over DRAM-based (Raspberry Pi) baselines. Red-team evaluations across standard benchmarks show that MOMAT matches the defense performance of state-of-the-art methods while avoiding benign overkill and providing substantial efficiency gains, demonstrating that CiM-based modular defenses can make edge-deployed qLLMs both safer and more energy-efficient. We will release the full 223.2k-sample dataset to foster future research.

papers.title: HierGF: Hierarchical Gaussian Fields via Geometry-perception Message Passing for Sparse-view 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Sparse view 3D reconstruction is an important and common scenario in multimedia applications, such as augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR) content creation, cultural heritage digitization, and certain robotic applications, where only a limited number of randomly captured views may be available. However, sparse views contain only limited 3D information, posing two major challenges:1) too few images are available for matching, making it difficult to build multi-view consistency; 2) insufficient view coverage leads to a lack of information in under-sampled regions, resulting in missing parts of object structure. Existing methods mostly still rely on limited reprojection errors and regularization terms, which are prone to overfitting to a single view and inconsistent appearances across views. In geometrically under-sampled regions, they often rely on heuristic density control, lacking reliable guidance and often resulting in blurring and structural holes.To address these issues, this paper proposes Hierarchical Gaussian Fields (HierGF), which revisits sparse-view reconstruction from a hierarchical geometry-perception perspective and converts limited observations into reliable self-generated supervision beyond fixed priors and heuristic density control. In particular, we transform coarse 3D geometric information and additional 2D generative priors into structured pseudo-supervision through a two-stage geometry-perception backbone network, thereby enhancing multi-view consistency with very few input views. In addition, we introduce a learnable confidence network to guide gradients toward cross-view consistent content, and a geometrically consistent densification module to improve the reconstruction of multi-view alignment and under-sampled regions.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HierGF 把稀疏视角下的粗 3D 几何与 2D 生成先验经两阶段 geometry-perception 主干转成结构化伪监督，替代固定先验与启发式密度控制，并用可学习置信网络引导梯度、几何一致稠密化补全欠采样区域，从而在极少输入视角下提升跨视角一致性并减少结构空洞。
Motivation: 稀疏视角下可匹配图像太少、视角覆盖不足，导致多视角一致性难建立、欠采样区域缺结构；现有方法依赖重投影误差与启发式密度控制，易过拟合单视角、出现模糊与结构空洞。
Method: 两阶段 geometry-perception 主干网络把粗 3D 几何信息与 2D 生成先验转为结构化伪监督；可学习置信网络 (confidence network) 引导梯度流向跨视角一致内容；几何一致稠密化模块 (geometrically consistent densification) 改善多视角对齐与欠采样区域重建。
Result: 论文提出 HierGF 框架及其伪监督、置信网络与稠密化模块，用于稀疏视角 3D 重建，以增强极少输入视角下的多视角一致性并改善欠采样区域结构恢复。
Conclusion: 稀疏视角重建应从层级 geometry-perception 视角把有限观测转成自生成监督，而非依赖固定先验与启发式密度控制。

papers.title: Capturing In-Context Learning Dynamics with Task Operators
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to perform new tasks from demonstrations without weight updates. However, every ICL inference requires processing the full set of examples, resulting in inefficient deployments, and how ICL works mechanistically is not fully understood. Prior work compresses ICL into fixed activation vectors extracted from specific layers or positions, but these input-independent interventions fail on complex tasks where the output depends on fine-grained interactions with the input. By analyzing the ICL forward pass, we show that each attention head's output is an affine transformation of its context-masked counterpart, and that the parameters of this transformation are empirically stable across samples for a given task. Building on this, we introduce Task Operator (TO), which replays this transformation as an analytically derived update to the attention output projection. Across lexical, algorithmic, and reasoning tasks, TO achieves the best overall performance among prior methods and substantially narrows the gap between zero-shot inference and ICL. We further show that the extracted knowledge concentrates in a task-specific sparse circuit across layers and positions, and that averaging operators from disjoint demonstration batches enables effective many-shot scaling without expanding the context window. Our code is available at https://github.com/gzxiong/task_operator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Task Operator (TO) 把 ICL 中每个注意力头的输出刻画为 context-masked 对应项的仿射变换，且该变换参数对给定任务在样本间经验稳定，据此把示例集预提取为可复用的算子，推理时以解析更新直接作用于注意力输出投影。在 lexical、algorithmic、reasoning 三类任务上，TO 在既有压缩方法中总体表现最佳，显著缩小 zero-shot 与完整 ICL 的差距；对不相交示例批次的算子取平均即可在不扩上下文窗口下实现 many-shot 扩展。
Motivation: 每次 ICL 推理都要重放全部示例，部署低效；而既有方法把 ICL 压成与输入无关的固定激活向量，在输出依赖细粒度输入交互的复杂任务上失效。
Method: 先分析 ICL 前向：证明每个注意力头输出是其 context-masked 版本的仿射变换，且变换参数对同一任务跨样本经验稳定；Task Operator (TO) 将该变换作为解析推导的更新回放到注意力输出投影上，把示例知识预提取为算子，推理时复用。
Result: 在 lexical、algorithmic、reasoning 任务上，TO 在先前压缩方法中取得最佳总体表现，并大幅缩小 zero-shot 与 ICL 的差距；发现知识集中于跨层跨位置的任务特定稀疏 circuit；对不相交示例批次的算子取平均可实现有效的 many-shot 扩展而不扩大上下文窗口。
Conclusion: ICL 的任务知识可被表示为输入无关、可平均的注意力仿射算子，因此压缩 ICL 不必牺牲对输入的细粒度依赖，且 many-shot 可通过算子平均而非扩上下文实现。

papers.title: Towards Subject Consistency over Dynamic Subject Sets in Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: We argue that as video generation extends to longer durations, subject consistency should be evaluated over \textit{dynamic subject sets}. We therefore introduce \textbf{DynSC-Eval}, an evaluation framework that dynamically tracks eligible subjects throughout their visible lifespans and measures local continuity and global identity preservation using six complementary object-level metrics, with explicit detection of inconsistency events. To validate its effectiveness, we design synthetic experiments that actively inject inconsistency events, demonstrating both the sensitivity of DynSC-Eval and the limitations of existing metrics. Evaluations of diverse models on 5s, 15s, and 60s video generation further reveal substantial subject consistency differences that are obscured by conventional metrics. Beyond evaluation, we construct rewards from DynSC-Eval and apply DiffusionNFT post-training in an autonomous-driving testbed. On 5s generation, our approach reduces the six inconsistency metrics by an average of 13.82\% for Wan-2.1-1.3B and 5.66\% for SANA-2B, with improvements also observed on the I2V model ReSim. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. We then extend generation to 10s and 30s through curriculum learning and show that consistency optimization remains effective while largely preserving other capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DynSC-Eval：把长视频的主体一致性改在动态主体集合上评估，按主体可见生命周期追踪六个对象级指标并显式检测不一致事件。用其构造奖励做 DiffusionNFT 后训练，5s 生成上六个不一致指标对 Wan-2.1-1.3B 平均降 13.82%、对 SANA-2B 降 5.66%，I2V 模型 ReSim 也有改善。
Motivation: 视频生成时长变长后，主体会进出画面，固定主体集合的传统指标掩盖了主体消失、重现时的不一致，5s、15s、60s 上的真实差异被遮蔽。
Method: DynSC-Eval 动态追踪每个主体的可见生命周期，用六个互补的对象级指标度量局部连续性与全局身份保持，并显式检测不一致事件；再由该评估构造奖励，用 DiffusionNFT 做后训练，并以课程学习把生成扩展到 10s 和 30s。
Result: 注入不一致事件的合成实验显示 DynSC-Eval 对事件敏感而现有指标存在局限；在 5s、15s、60s 上评测多个模型，揭示传统指标掩盖的主体一致性差异。后训练在 5s 上使六个不一致指标平均下降 13.82%（Wan-2.1-1.3B）与 5.66%（SANA-2B），ReSim 这一 I2V 模型也有改善；课程学习扩展到 10s、30s 后一致性优化仍有效且大体保持其他能力。
Conclusion: 主体一致性应在动态主体集合上度量，并可直接当作奖励用于后训练；在自动驾驶测试平台上，该奖励在延长到 30s 的课程学习中仍能压低不一致事件而不明显牺牲其他能力。

papers.title: Gradient-Guided Density Peak Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Density peak clustering (DPC) connects each observation to its nearest neighbor of higher density and identifies cluster centers as high-density observations with unusually large nearest neighbor uphill shifts. The resulting uphill paths from observations to cluster centers, however, can be irregular and unstable in low-density regions, making the clustering assignments sensitive to local perturbations and obscuring the population geometry of the DPC graph. In this paper, we introduce \emph{gradient-guided density peak clustering} (GGDPC), which performs a gradient ascent step before each nearest neighbor uphill search. We develop a stability theory that relates the GGDPC graph to the gradient ascent flow of the population density. In particular, we establish consistency of GGDPC under five complementary criteria: recovery of local modes, adjusted Rand index, dendrogram (cluster tree), path length, and waterfall measure. Together, these results provide new statistical, geometric, and topological interpretations of DPC-type clustering algorithms.
papers.comment: 91 pages (27 pages for the main paper), 4 figures, 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出梯度引导密度峰聚类 (GGDPC)：在每次最近邻上坡搜索前先做一步梯度上升，使上坡路径贴合总体密度的梯度流，缓解低密度区路径不规则导致的分配不稳定。理论上在局部模态恢复、调整兰德指数 (ARI)、聚类树、路径长度与 waterfall 测度五个互补准则下证明 GGDPC 的一致性。
Motivation: DPC 中观测到高密度最近邻的上坡路径在低密度区域不规则、不稳定，使聚类分配对局部扰动敏感，也掩盖了 DPC 图的总体几何结构。
Method: GGDPC 在每步最近邻上坡搜索前插入一次梯度上升；建立把 GGDPC 图与总体密度梯度上升流联系起来的稳定性理论，并在五个准则（局部模态恢复、ARI、dendrogram/cluster tree、路径长度、waterfall measure）上给出一致性结果。
Result: 在五个互补准则下建立 GGDPC 的一致性：局部模态恢复、adjusted Rand index、dendrogram (cluster tree)、path length 与 waterfall measure；为 DPC 类算法给出统计、几何与拓扑三类解释。
Conclusion: 先做梯度上升再搜索上坡邻居，可让 DPC 图逼近总体密度的梯度流，从而在多种一致性意义下稳定聚类。

summary_sections.motivation: DPC 中观测到高密度最近邻的上坡路径在低密度区域不规则、不稳定，使聚类分配对局部扰动敏感，也掩盖了 DPC 图的总体几何结构。
summary_sections.method: GGDPC 在每步最近邻上坡搜索前插入一次梯度上升；建立把 GGDPC 图与总体密度梯度上升流联系起来的稳定性理论，并在五个准则（局部模态恢复、ARI、dendrogram/cluster tree、路径长度、waterfall measure）上给出一致性结果。
summary_sections.result: 在五个互补准则下建立 GGDPC 的一致性：局部模态恢复、adjusted Rand index、dendrogram (cluster tree)、path length 与 waterfall measure；为 DPC 类算法给出统计、几何与拓扑三类解释。
summary_sections.conclusion: 先做梯度上升再搜索上坡邻居，可让 DPC 图逼近总体密度的梯度流，从而在多种一致性意义下稳定聚类。

papers.title: Network World Models as Environments for Algorithm Design on Complex Systems
papers.abstract_en: World models, which simulate an environment and predict how it changes under actions, are increasingly used in real-world applications such as robotics. Complex systems call for the same tool because the effect of an action is not immediate. Seeding nodes for a campaign, or immunizing nodes against an epidemic, changes little on its own; what matters is the outcome that unfolds over the steps that follow. Designing an algorithm that selects such actions to maximize expected performance on a task is inherently iterative, and every candidate must be scored by the outcome it produces. Obtaining that outcome has relied on simulation, whose cost becomes a bottleneck when candidates are evaluated over many sampled trajectories. We propose an action-conditioned Network World Model that learns a network's diffusion dynamics under interventions over time, applies each action to the network, and predicts the outcome that follows. It serves as a fast evaluator inside an algorithm design loop in which a coding agent designs and refines executable algorithms using feedback from full rollouts, action-level credit, and counterfactual probes over alternative interventions. Across eight network tasks and five diffusion models, the designed algorithms match or exceed the strongest reported baseline in 138 of 141 settings while enabling up to 14.5 times faster rollouts than Monte Carlo simulation. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出动作条件化的 Network World Model，学习网络扩散动力学在干预下的演化，充当算法设计循环中的快速评估器，让 coding agent 用完整 rollout、动作级 credit 与反事实探针来设计和改进算法。在 8 个网络任务、5 种扩散模型共 141 个设置中，所设计算法在 138 个设置上追平或超过最强已报告基线，rollout 最快比 Monte Carlo 仿真快 14.5 倍。
Motivation: 复杂系统中动作的效果要经过多步才显现，候选算法只能靠仿真打分；在大量采样轨迹上评估候选时，仿真成本成为算法设计循环的瓶颈。
Method: 训练动作条件化的 Network World Model，学习网络在干预下的扩散动力学并预测动作之后的结果；把它嵌入算法设计循环，coding agent 依据完整 rollout 反馈、动作级 credit 与针对替代干预的反事实探针 (counterfactual probes) 迭代设计可执行算法。
Result: 在 8 个网络任务、5 种扩散模型的 141 个设置中，设计出的算法在 138 个设置上追平或超过最强已报告基线；rollout 相对 Monte Carlo 仿真最高加速 14.5 倍。
Conclusion: 用学习到的网络扩散世界模型替代仿真做候选打分，可以在保持算法质量的同时大幅降低算法设计循环的评估成本；代码将在论文接收后发布。

papers.title: Sentence Specificity Scores for Collaborative Technical Documentation: A Domain-Transfer Study
papers.abstract_en: Collaboration depends on shared context, and technical documentation is one way that context persists across people and AI teammates. Specificity, the amount and exactness of detail expressed in language, shapes what information documentation captures and how precisely that information is communicated. This work audits sentence-specificity scoring artifacts on technical documentation and tests whether scores applied only after generation help choose among fixed LLM-generated revisions. Across Wikipedia and three technical-documentation corpora, the fixed general-domain predictor SpeciTeller and the pinned post-publication author-repository implementation of Ko et al.'s target-adapted predictor produce different corpus orders and same-sentence rank agreement from -0.066 to 0.510. Strict filtering and token-length adjustment change these patterns without reconciling them. In the Gemma set, SpeciTeller ranking raises direction-valid selection from 71.7% to 83.3% (+11.7 points; 95% source-case bootstrap interval +1.7 to +21.7); in the GPT-OSS-120B set, SpeciTeller ranking raises direction-valid selection from 51.7% to 56.7% (+5.0 points; 95% source-case bootstrap interval -6.7 to +16.7), and every primary single-score GPT-OSS-120B interval includes zero. These findings tie score interpretation and decision value to the predictor and candidate set.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE 12th International Conference on Collaboration and Internet Computing (CIC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 审计技术文档句子具体性 (sentence specificity) 打分工具的可迁移性：固定通用域预测器 SpeciTeller 与 Ko et al. 目标适配预测器的固定实现给出不同语料排序，同句秩相关仅 -0.066 到 0.510。在 Gemma 候选集上用 SpeciTeller 排序把方向有效选择率从 71.7% 提到 83.3%（+11.7 点，95% bootstrap 区间 +1.7 到 +21.7），在 GPT-OSS-120B 上仅从 51.7% 到 56.7%（+5.0 点，区间 -6.7 到 +16.7 且含零）。结论是打分的解释与决策价值取决于预测器和候选集。
Motivation: 技术文档是跨人与 AI 队友留存共享上下文的载体，但句子具体性分数被当作可跨语料、跨模型复用的通用信号；若不同预测器给出不同排序，事后打分就无法可靠地在固定 LLM 修订候选间做选择。
Method: 在 Wikipedia 与三个技术文档语料上审计打分工具，比较固定通用域预测器 SpeciTeller 与 Ko et al. 目标适配预测器的 pinned 作者仓库实现，做同句秩一致性检验，并加入严格过滤与 token 长度调整两种处理；再用打分对 Gemma 与 GPT-OSS-120B 生成的固定修订候选排序，测方向有效选择率 (direction-valid selection) 与 95% source-case bootstrap 区间。
Result: 两预测器的语料排序不同，同句秩相关范围 -0.066 到 0.510；严格过滤与 token 长度调整改变但不调和这些差异。Gemma 集上 SpeciTeller 排序使方向有效选择从 71.7% 升至 83.3%（+11.7 点，95% 区间 +1.7 到 +21.7）；GPT-OSS-120B 集上从 51.7% 升至 56.7%（+5.0 点，95% 区间 -6.7 到 +16.7），且该模型上所有主分析单分数区间都含零。
Conclusion: 事后具体性打分的解释与决策价值绑定于所选预测器和候选集，不能当作跨域通用的选择依据；在 GPT-OSS-120B 候选上单分数选择的增益不显著。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver
papers.abstract_en: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把聊天机器人在当前轮次之后承诺执行、但其工具与运行时都无法兑现的行为定义为「空承诺」(empty commitment)，其空洞性仅由 agent 配置决定，无需后续轨迹即可判定。基于承诺语义给出三类失败、一个针对工具本可兑现之承诺的锚定条件，以及响应级结果分类，并设计五种逐个增加持久化能力的 follow-up 测量协议。
Motivation: agent 会承诺「明天提醒你」这类当前轮次之后的动作，而其运行时在用户再次输入前根本不会再次执行；这类失败与「违背承诺」不同，可直接由配置判定，但缺少形式化定义与可复现的测量方法。
Method: 在 commitment semantics 之上形式化定义 empty commitment，包含三类失败类型、一个判定工具能否使承诺成真的 anchoring condition，以及响应级 outcome taxonomy；配套测量协议为 follow-up requests 设置五种 setup，每次只增加一个 persistence affordance，并让环境保持隐式或显式说明。
Result: 给出定义层面的三类失败、一个锚定条件与响应级结果分类，以及含五种 setup 的测量协议；arXiv comment 标注全文 4 页、3 张表。
Conclusion: 空承诺是 agent 配置本身的属性而非事后轨迹的结果，因此可以在响应当下判定，并用逐个增加持久化能力的对照设置来测量。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent communication aims to help agents benefit from one another's information. Yet improvements in system performance leave a fundamental ambiguity: do they reflect effective communication, a favorable agent architecture, or simply additional reasoning? Because communication methods are commonly evaluated within the systems they were designed for, these factors are difficult to disentangle. Final accuracy further merges corrected errors and corrupted answers into a single outcome, obscuring how communication changes decisions. We introduce Independent--Communicate--Revise (ICR), a controlled framework that evaluates communication as answer revision following independent reasoning. ICR fixes initial reasoning trajectories, measures correction and preservation conditional on both agents' initial correctness, and uses a no-message revision control to quantify gains beyond additional reasoning. Across four reasoning benchmarks, our audit of textual and latent communication reveals that similar aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behaviors. Compared with transmitting answers alone, full reasoning increases correction while reducing preservation on all four benchmarks, so richer messages amplify beneficial and harmful influence alike. Receiver-policy comparisons on MedQA and GPQA-D further show that a structured verification policy shifts every channel toward greater preservation and lower correction, while its effect on selectivity varies across channels and tasks. These findings challenge treating communication quality as an intrinsic property of a channel. ICR therefore recenters evaluation on selective revision, providing a unified framework for examining how message content and receiver policies jointly produce benefits and harms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ICR（Independent–Communicate–Revise）受控框架，把多智能体通信拆成独立推理后的答案修订来审计：固定初始推理轨迹，在双方初始正确性条件下分别度量 correction 与 preservation，并用无消息修订对照剥离额外推理带来的增益。四个推理基准上，传完整推理比只传答案在全部四个基准都提高 correction、降低 preservation，说明更丰富的消息同时放大有益与有害影响。
Motivation: 多智能体系统性能提升无法区分是通信有效、架构有利还是单纯多了推理；最终准确率把被纠正的错误与被破坏的正确答案混成一个数，掩盖通信如何改变决策。
Method: ICR 固定各智能体的初始推理轨迹，把通信效果定义为独立推理之后的答案修订；在双方初始正确与否的四种条件下分别统计 correction 与 preservation，并设置 no-message 修订对照以量化超出额外推理的收益；审计对象包括 textual 与 latent 两种通信通道，以及接收方策略（含 structured verification policy）。
Result: 在四个推理基准上，相似的聚合准确率可掩盖显著不同的修订行为；与只传答案相比，传完整推理在全部四个基准都提高 correction、降低 preservation。在 MedQA 与 GPQA-D 上，structured verification policy 使所有通道都转向更高 preservation、更低 correction，但其对 selectivity 的影响随通道与任务而变。
Conclusion: 通信质量不是通道的内在属性，而是消息内容与接收方策略共同作用的结果；评估应从最终准确率转向选择性修订（selective revision）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bootstrapping Video Interaction Generation with Synthetic State Transitions
papers.abstract_en: While recent video generative models can synthesize high-fidelity videos, they struggle to portray plausible physical interactions and the resulting state transitions, a critical bottleneck for applications in robotics and VR/AR. To address this, we introduce a framework to generate a scalable synthetic dataset of controllable interactions. Our pipeline leverages a structured taxonomy and state-of-the-art image editing models to create explicit `start' and `end' state images, which serve as visual anchors for the interaction. To generate a seamless video utilizing these anchors, we propose State-Guided Sampling (SGS), a novel sampling technique that mitigates artifacts common in naive conditional generation. Furthermore, we develop and validate a new automated evaluation system that aligns with human judgments to ensure data quality. Experiments show that fine-tuning a base model on our dataset significantly enhances its ability to generate plausible interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对视频生成模型难以表现合理物理交互与状态迁移，提出用结构化分类体系加图像编辑模型批量造出可控交互的合成数据集，以显式 start/end 状态图作为交互锚点，并用 State-Guided Sampling (SGS) 生成连贯视频以抑制朴素条件生成的伪影。配套自动评测系统与人类判断对齐，微调后的基座模型生成合理交互的能力显著提升。
Motivation: 高保真视频生成在物理交互与状态迁移上不自然，制约机器人与 VR/AR 应用；可控交互训练数据稀缺。
Method: 流水线用结构化 taxonomy 加 SOTA 图像编辑模型生成显式 start/end 状态图作为交互锚点；提出 State-Guided Sampling (SGS) 采样技术在锚点间生成无缝视频；另建与人类判断对齐的自动评测系统保证数据质量，并用该数据集微调基座模型。
Result: 在该合成数据集上微调基座模型后，生成合理交互的能力显著增强；自动评测系统经验证与人类判断一致。

papers.title: SLIM: Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing merging coefficients for large language models can require many costly benchmark evaluations. We propose \textbf{Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging (SLIM)}, which constructs a quadratic surrogate of aggregate performance on the coefficient simplex using a classical mixture design. Evaluations of individual experts and equal-weight pairs determine the surrogate with the minimum number of measurements needed to identify a general quadratic on this domain. SLIM then optimizes the surrogate without further target-metric evaluations. Experiments on two model architectures demonstrate accurate prediction of unseen multi-expert mixtures and competitive merge performance under limited evaluation budgets. Matched-budget comparisons show that structured evaluation points improve prediction fidelity over random designs, including those using regularized fitting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SLIM 用经典混合设计 (mixture design) 在合并系数单纯形上构造聚合性能的二次代理模型，只需评估单个专家与等权两两配对即可确定该二次型所需的最少测量数，之后直接在代理上优化、不再调用目标指标。在两种模型架构上，结构化评估点对未见多专家混合的预测精度高于随机设计（含带正则的拟合），且在有限评估预算下合并性能具有竞争力。
Motivation: 大语言模型权重合并需要在系数单纯形上搜索，而每次候选系数都要跑一次昂贵的基准评测，随机采样在有限预算下对性能面的拟合效率低。
Method: SLIM (Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging)：用 mixture design 选取评估点，仅评测单个专家与等权专家对，以最少测量数确定单纯形上的一般二次代理模型；随后在代理上优化合并系数，全程不再进行目标指标评测。
Result: 在两种模型架构上，SLIM 能准确预测未见的多专家混合，并在有限评测预算下取得有竞争力的合并性能；匹配预算的对比显示结构化评估点的预测保真度高于随机设计，也高于使用正则化拟合的随机设计。
Conclusion: 在合并系数搜索中，用结构化 mixture design 换取二次代理的可辨识性，比在同等预算下随机采样更省评测且预测更准。

papers.title: Posterior sampling by source-space MCMC via prior-based few-step transport maps
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian inference increasingly uses informative but implicit priors represented only by samples, such as historical ensembles, simulator outputs, and pretrained generative models. The same computational problem appears in the test-time guidance task (generalized Bayes), where an explicit positive weight, e.g., an exponentiated reward, tilts an implicit prior. We develop a framework for source-space generalized Bayesian inference that combines inexpensive few-step prior transports with posterior stability guarantees. Specifically, we represent the prior using a one- or few-step improved MeanFlow (iMF) map and perform posterior sampling in its Gaussian source space. We establish Wasserstein error bounds between the exact and learned posteriors in terms of the joint population iMF and auxiliary-velocity loss, decomposed into training suboptimality and model-class approximation error. In the iMF source space, we adopt parallel tempering with preconditioned Crank-Nicolson updates and introduce a hybrid variant that incorporates split Hamiltonian Monte Carlo to improve sampling efficiency. Synthetic experiments show that the proposed framework can approximate posterior distributions accurately and efficiently, while CLIP-guided ImageNet experiments demonstrate its ability to steer a pretrained iMF image prior toward text-specified preferences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出源空间广义贝叶斯推断框架：用一步或少步 improved MeanFlow (iMF) 映射表示隐式先验，在其高斯源空间里做后验采样，并给出精确后验与学习后验之间的 Wasserstein 误差界。合成实验显示后验近似准确高效，CLIP 引导的 ImageNet 实验表明可把预训练 iMF 图像先验转向文本指定偏好。
Motivation: 历史集合、模拟器输出、预训练生成模型等隐式先验只有样本没有密度，贝叶斯推断与测试时引导 (generalized Bayes) 都难以在其上直接采样后验。
Method: 用一步或少步 iMF 映射把隐式先验压到高斯源空间，在源空间用 parallel tempering 加 preconditioned Crank-Nicolson 更新采样，并提出融合 split Hamiltonian Monte Carlo 的混合变体；误差界按 iMF 与辅助速度 (auxiliary-velocity) 损失分解为训练次优项与模型类逼近误差。
Result: 建立了精确后验与学习后验之间以联合总体 iMF 损失和辅助速度损失表示的 Wasserstein 误差界；合成实验中框架能准确高效地近似后验分布，CLIP 引导的 ImageNet 实验中可将预训练 iMF 图像先验转向文本指定偏好。
Conclusion: 少步先验传输加源空间 MCMC 能在带后验稳定性保证的前提下处理只有样本的隐式先验，并可用于测试时引导预训练生成模型。

papers.title: Optimal Transport Reweighting for Robust Learning under Spurious Correlations and Label Noise
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models often suffer performance degradation under subpopulation shift, particularly when spurious correlations cause models to rely on shortcut features that fail to generalize across subgroups. A recent line of work mitigates this issue by using loss-based signals to identify informative samples, but these signals can become severely distorted under label noise: mislabeled samples may also incur large losses and contaminate subsequent reweighting or retraining. Despite its practical importance, this intersection remains largely underexplored. We propose POTER, a reweighting framework based on optimal transport that derives sample importance from the transport geometry between the training distribution and a reference distribution constructed from limited validation group annotations. By measuring alignment at the individual-sample level rather than relying on loss, POTER downweights mislabeled or strongly bias-aligned samples while assigning higher importance to samples better aligned with the reference distribution. In addition, POTER requires only a single ERM training stage, moving beyond the retraining paradigm common in recent work. Across standard benchmarks and noisy-label settings, POTER achieves state-of-the-art worst-group accuracy, including cases where label corruption is concentrated within minority subgroups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: POTER 用最优传输几何而非 loss 来定样本权重：把训练分布与由少量验证组标注构造的参考分布做传输，按个体样本对齐程度降权被错标或强偏置对齐的样本，只保留单次 ERM 训练阶段。在标准基准与含噪标签设定下取得 state-of-the-art 的最差组准确率 (worst-group accuracy)，包括标签损坏集中在少数子群的情形。
Motivation: 子群体偏移下模型依赖虚假相关 (spurious correlation) 的捷径特征；基于 loss 的样本筛选在标签噪声下失效——被错标的样本同样高 loss，会污染后续重加权或重训练。
Method: POTER：以训练分布与参考分布（由有限的验证集 group 标注构造）之间的最优传输 (optimal transport) 几何推导样本重要性，在个体样本层面度量对齐而非依赖 loss；据此降权错标与强偏置对齐样本、提升与参考分布对齐样本的权重，且只需单次 ERM 训练阶段，无需近期工作的重训练范式。
Result: 在标准基准与 noisy-label 设定下达到 state-of-the-art 的 worst-group accuracy，涵盖标签损坏集中于少数子群的情形。
Conclusion: 以传输几何替代 loss 信号可在标签噪声与子群体偏移同时存在时稳健地做样本重加权，且把多阶段重训练简化为单次 ERM。

papers.title: It Takes Workflows to Evolve Better Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Tackling complex real-world tasks can exceed the capabilities of a single large language model (LLM), motivating the use of multi-agent workflows that coordinate specialized agents to work together on these tasks. Recent methods train LLMs to construct better workflows from execution outcomes, but they optimize only the workflow generator, while the other agents that build or execute each workflow remain fixed even though every outcome depends on all of them. However, extending training beyond the generator is challenging: the agents are coupled, and a workflow's outcome is a single sparse score that cannot tell which agent causes a failure. We propose FloWright, which leverages the workflow as a harness to optimize workflows. By introducing a hierarchical, structure-aware reward paradigm, FloWright enables one role to self-evolve and two or more roles to co-evolve, with no additional models, labels, or executions. Considering the limitation that workflows are commonly trained and evaluated on data that a single agent can already handle, we further propose DataWright, an adaptive data hardening approach that converts existing datasets into workflow-level tasks with increased difficulty. Across document, slide, chart, code, math, and finance tasks, small open models trained with FloWright achieve improved performance by up to $+7.41\%$, with co-evolving ($+5.03\%$) more roles gaining more than optimizing one of them alone ($+2.83\%$). Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/FloWright/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FloWright 把 workflow 本身当作 harness 来优化其中所有角色，用分层、结构感知的奖励让单角色自进化、多角色共同进化，且不引入额外模型、标签或执行；再用 DataWright 把单智能体已能处理的数据集改造成更难的 workflow 级任务。在文档、幻灯片、图表、代码、数学、金融任务上，小开源模型最高提升 +7.41%，多角色共同进化 (+5.03%) 超过只优化单个角色 (+2.83%)。
Motivation: 现有方法只训练 workflow 生成器，构建与执行 workflow 的其他 agent 保持固定，而结果取决于全部 agent；且各角色耦合、单一稀疏分数无法归因失败来源。
Method: FloWright 以 workflow 为 harness，提出分层结构感知奖励范式，支持单角色自进化与两角色以上共同进化，无需额外模型、标签或执行；DataWright 做自适应数据加难 (adaptive data hardening)，把现有数据集转成 workflow 级任务。
Result: 在 document、slide、chart、code、math、finance 六类任务上，用 FloWright 训练的小开源模型性能最高提升 +7.41%；共同进化多个角色 +5.03%，高于仅优化其中一个角色的 +2.83%。
Conclusion: 把训练范围从 workflow 生成器扩展到全部角色能带来更大增益，多角色共同进化比单角色优化更有效，配套的数据加难用于让训练任务真正落在 workflow 能力区间上。

papers.title: Groundability, Not Scale Alone: When Weak Reviewers Can Audit Strong Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents can return plausible patches that omit required behavior. These failures are hard to review because long traces and confident summaries often hide what was missed. We ask when a nominally weaker reviewer can reliably decide whether a patch solves its issue. We study 411 execution-labeled traces from three agents and 101 controlled cases. On 154 GPT-5.4 traces, structured but unchecked evidence raises both defect catch and over-rejection. We then provide official execution evidence as an upper-bound diagnostic. After choosing and freezing one of two formats per reviewer, five of six reviewers improve both rates on 122 held-out traces; two classify every trace correctly. Reviewer size is not a consistent predictor of quality. Because official tests are unavailable in deployment, we also evaluate a frozen cascade with patch-caused static errors and generated tests that first fail on the unpatched repository. On 121 scored held-out GPT-5.4 traces and 59 Gemini traces, its coverage is 0.89 and 0.86, risk is 0.33 and 0.26, catch is 0.76 and 0.80, and over-rejection is 0.66 and 0.67. Most false rejections occur when unresolved cases reach the reviewer. Official execution evidence shows the potential of weak review when decisive checks are available. Producing equally reliable checks without official tests remains the main bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在缺少官方测试的部署条件下，弱审查者能否可靠判定补丁是否解决了 issue，取决于证据是否可核验 (groundability) 而非模型规模。冻结审查格式并提供官方执行证据后，6 个审查者中 5 个在 122 条留出轨迹上同时提高缺陷捕获率与过度拒绝率，2 个全对；审查者规模与质量无一致关系。
Motivation: 编码代理常返回看似合理却遗漏必需行为的补丁，长轨迹与自信摘要掩盖了遗漏，使弱审查者难以判定补丁是否真正解决 issue。
Method: 研究 411 条带执行标签的轨迹（来自三个代理）与 101 个受控案例；对每个审查者在两种格式中选定并冻结一种，先用官方执行证据作上界诊断，再评估一个冻结级联：补丁引发的静态错误加上生成的测试（须先在未打补丁仓库上失败）。
Result: 在 154 条 GPT-5.4 轨迹上，结构化但未经核验的证据同时提高缺陷捕获与过度拒绝；提供官方执行证据后，6 个审查者中 5 个在 122 条留出轨迹上两项指标同时改善，2 个全部分类正确，审查者规模不是质量的一致预测因子。冻结级联在 121 条留出 GPT-5.4 轨迹与 59 条 Gemini 轨迹上 coverage 分别为 0.89 与 0.86，risk 为 0.33 与 0.26，catch 为 0.76 与 0.80，over-rejection 为 0.66 与 0.67；多数假拒绝发生在未决案例被送交审查者时。
Conclusion: 官方执行证据表明只要提供决定性检查，弱审查是可行的；在没有官方测试时生成同等可靠的检查仍是主要瓶颈。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 在缺少官方测试的部署条件下，弱审查者能否可靠判定补丁是否解决了 issue，取决于证据是否可核验 (groundability) 而非模型规模。冻结审查格式并提供官方执行证据后，6 个审查者中 5 个在 122 条留出轨迹上同时提高缺陷捕获率与过度拒绝率，2 个全对；审查者规模与质量无一致关系。
summary_sections.motivation: 编码代理常返回看似合理却遗漏必需行为的补丁，长轨迹与自信摘要掩盖了遗漏，使弱审查者难以判定补丁是否真正解决 issue。
summary_sections.method: 研究 411 条带执行标签的轨迹（来自三个代理）与 101 个受控案例；对每个审查者在两种格式中选定并冻结一种，先用官方执行证据作上界诊断，再评估一个冻结级联：补丁引发的静态错误加上生成的测试（须先在未打补丁仓库上失败）。

papers.title: Towards Automatic Video Annotation with ASH: Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking and Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Memory-attention-based Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) methods have demonstrated strong zero-shot tracking capability, yet their substantial memory requirements confine them to short video clips and their single-prompt inference design makes multi-category open-vocabulary tracking computationally prohibitive. This work introduces two contributions toward fully automated tracking annotation of arbitrary video. The Generalized Presence Token (GPT) reformulates SAM3's inference pipeline to process N text prompts simultaneously via virtual prompt batching, reducing image encoding cost from O(N) to O(1) with no modifications to any learned component. The Annotation and Segmentation Handler (ASH) extends any memory-attention VIS tracker to sequences of arbitrary length through overlapping temporal chunks with IoU-based inter-chunk identity matching, requiring no dataset-specific training. Instantiated on SAM3, the resulting pipeline -- SAM3-ASH -- achieves state-of-the-art HOTA on MOTS20 under fully zero-shot conditions and remains competitive with trained specialists across seven additional benchmarks, while peak GPU memory consumption stays below 25 GB, establishing a practical baseline for scalable, training-free automated video annotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ASH 与 Generalized Presence Token (GPT) 两件套，把 SAM3 的视频实例分割改造成可处理任意长度视频、可同时吃 N 条文本提示的零样本标注流水线：GPT 用虚拟提示批处理把图像编码开销从 O(N) 降到 O(1)，ASH 用重叠时间块加 IoU 跨块身份匹配扩展任意长度序列。SAM3-ASH 在 MOTS20 上取得 SOTA HOTA 且完全零样本，峰值显存低于 25 GB。
Motivation: 基于 memory-attention 的 VIS 虽有零样本跟踪能力，但显存开销大、只能处理短视频片段，且单提示推理使多类别开放词汇跟踪计算上不可行。
Method: GPT 重构 SAM3 推理管线，通过虚拟提示批处理一次处理 N 条文本提示，不改动任何学习组件；ASH 以重叠时间块加 IoU 跨块身份匹配把任意 memory-attention VIS tracker 扩展到任意长度序列，无需数据集特定训练，二者在 SAM3 上实例化为 SAM3-ASH。

Conclusion: 无需训练的零样本流水线可作为可扩展自动视频标注的实用基线，同时突破短视频长度与多类别提示的算力限制。

papers.title: FutureWorlds: Learning Robotic World Models from Alternative Futures
papers.abstract_en: Robotic world models predict action-conditioned future scenes, providing a foundation for understanding action outcomes. However, turning alternative predictions into useful learning signals remains challenging: similar candidates limit informative quality comparisons, while diverging trajectories require persistent maintenance of their individual histories. We introduce FutureWorlds, a framework that unifies candidate construction, history maintenance, and learning from relative quality. Built on a multimodal discrete autoregressive model, FutureWorlds uses diverse beam search during reinforcement learning to construct candidate futures that balance confidence and diversity. Candidate-specific bounded memory preserves scene states and ensures that generation and policy scoring use matching histories. We further propose MemSPO (Memory-Conditioned Search-Guided Policy Optimization), which converts video trajectory rewards into group-relative advantages to optimize the world model. On RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa, FutureWorlds reduces LPIPS for 32-frame predictions by 14.78%, 20.84%, and 9.12%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. Under fixed evaluation configurations, only 200 MemSPO updates further improve generation quality and support continued prediction beyond the training horizon. Memory ablations, decoding sensitivity analysis, and optical-flow evaluation show that these gains extend beyond visual quality to more accurate motion prediction and more consistent object states. Project page and code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds.
papers.comment: 32 pages, including references and appendix. Code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FutureWorlds 把候选未来构造、候选专属历史维护与相对质量学习统一进一个多模态离散自回归世界模型：用多样性 beam search 在强化学习中生成兼顾置信与多样的候选未来，用有界记忆保存各候选的场景状态，再用 MemSPO 把视频轨迹奖励转成组相对优势来优化模型。在 RT-1、BridgeV2、RoboCasa 上，32 帧预测的 LPIPS 相对各数据集最强基线分别下降 14.78%、20.84%、9.12%；固定评测配置下仅 200 次 MemSPO 更新即可进一步提升生成质量并支持超出训练时域的持续预测。
Motivation: 机器人世界模型能预测动作条件下的未来场景，但把多个备选预测变成有效学习信号很难：候选彼此相似时质量比较信息量不足，轨迹一旦分叉又需要长期各自维护历史。
Method: FutureWorlds 基于多模态离散自回归模型，统一候选构造、历史维护与相对质量学习：强化学习阶段用多样性 beam search 生成平衡置信度与多样性的候选未来；候选专属有界记忆 (candidate-specific bounded memory) 保存场景状态，保证生成与策略打分使用匹配的历史；MemSPO (Memory-Conditioned Search-Guided Policy Optimization) 将视频轨迹奖励转为组相对优势 (group-relative advantages) 来优化世界模型。
Result: 在 RT-1、BridgeV2、RoboCasa 上，32 帧预测的 LPIPS 相对各数据集最强基线分别降低 14.78%、20.84%、9.12%；固定评测配置下仅 200 次 MemSPO 更新进一步提升生成质量，并支持超出训练时域的持续预测。记忆消融、解码敏感性分析与光流评测显示，收益不止于视觉质量，还包括更准确的运动预测与更一致的物体状态。
Conclusion: 作者主张：把候选未来的历史显式维护起来、并用组相对优势从轨迹奖励中学习，能让机器人世界模型在有限更新步数内同时改善生成质量、运动预测与跨时域持续生成。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 InFlowOp：用一个无需标签的代价函数同时给多智能体工作流的每个决策定价，权衡智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配度及其运行成本，在执行前双向决定任务分解粒度与智能体分配，执行中用同一代价选择最便宜的纠错动作。配套发布需要超越单智能体能力的协调基准 Braid；在多个领域与骨干模型上，InFlowOp 比单智能体基线最高提升 +11.97%，其中流内优化贡献 +9.64%。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体工作流的构建决策（分解多细、每个子任务交给谁、何时新建专家智能体）必须在运行前定下，而子任务成败要跑完才知道；定位故障通常需要参考答案、评分结果或训练好的评估器，修复又得整条工作流重跑、重搜或重训，代价高昂。
Method: InFlowOp 定义一个 label-free 代价，把智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配程度和该智能体的运行开销一起加权；据此在执行前双向确定任务分解粒度与智能体分配（而非套固定模板），执行中用同一代价挑最便宜的纠错动作。同时提出基准 Braid，任务要求多智能体协调才能完成、超出单智能体能力。
Result: 在多个领域与多种骨干模型上，InFlowOp 相对单智能体基线最高提升 +11.97%，其中 in-flow optimization 带来 +9.64%。
Conclusion: 把工作流构建与运行中的每个决策放进同一个无需标签的代价里统一定价，可以在不依赖参考答案或评分器的情况下改进多智能体工作流，且纠错只需最便宜的一步而非整条重跑。

papers.title: Initial condition recovery in nonlinear damped viscous photoacoustic tomography using a convolutional neural network-guided gradient-free optimization framework
papers.abstract_en: Photoacoustic tomography (PAT) is a hybrid imaging modality that combines high optical contrast with high ultrasonic resolution for biomedical imaging applications. In this work, we investigate the inverse problem of recovering the initial pressure distribution from boundary measurements in the presence of nonlinear acoustic propagation and viscous attenuation effects. To model these phenomena more accurately, we consider a nonlinear damped viscoelastic wave equation incorporating spatially varying sound speed, temporal attenuation, and nonlinear propagation mechanisms. We first establish the well-posedness of the corresponding forward problem using a Galerkin approximation combined with energy estimates and a fixed-point argument. For the inverse problem, we derive existence, uniqueness, and local uniqueness results under suitable assumptions through a harmonic extension reduction, spectral Laplace transform techniques, and observability estimates. To numerically reconstruct the initial pressure field, we develop a hybrid reconstruction framework that combines a convolutional neural network (CNN) with a gradient-free optimization strategy based on the sequential quadratic Hamiltonian (SQH) method derived from Pontryagin's maximum principle. The CNN is used to generate an informative initial guess, while the SQH framework enforces the governing PDE dynamics during the reconstruction process. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed hybrid strategy significantly improves reconstruction quality, contrast, and robustness compared to standalone time-reversal and CNN-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在含非线性传播与黏性衰减的光声层析 (PAT) 反问题中，用 CNN 给出初值猜测，再由基于 Pontryagin 极大原理导出的序列二次 Hamiltonian (SQH) 无梯度优化在重建过程中强制非线性阻尼波动 PDE 约束。数值实验显示该混合策略在重建质量、对比度与鲁棒性上显著优于单独的 time-reversal 与单独 CNN 方法。
Motivation: PAT 中同时存在非线性声传播、黏性衰减与空间变声速时，从边界测量反演初始压力分布是不适定的非线性反问题，纯物理反演或纯数据驱动方法都难以稳定恢复。
Method: 先用 Galerkin 逼近加能量估计与不动点论证建立正问题适定性，再经调和延拓、谱 Laplace 变换与可观测性估计给出反问题的存在唯一与局部唯一性；数值上以 CNN 生成信息性初值猜测，SQH 无梯度优化在迭代中强制 governing PDE 动力学。
Result: 数值实验中，CNN+SQH 混合方案在重建质量、对比度与鲁棒性上均显著优于单独 time-reversal 与单独 CNN 重建；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 让学习模型只负责初值、由基于极大原理的无梯度优化守住 PDE 约束，可在非线性阻尼波动模型下更稳地反演 PAT 初始压力场。

papers.title: From Discovery to Decision: Finite-Budget Recoverability in LLM Voting
papers.abstract_en: Voting over multiple LLM responses is a common primitive in test-time scaling and ensemble inference. Collecting more responses can expand the candidate pool and increase the chance that a correct answer is discovered. Under a fixed call budget, a discovered answer still needs to accumulate enough support within the remaining calls to become the final plurality winner, creating a discovery-to-decision gap. In this work, we characterize this gap through the realized vote state and remaining call budget. We derive a sharp recoverability threshold and show that, as sampling proceeds, the observed candidate set can only expand while the set of reachable endpoint winners can only contract, inducing a candidate-level conversion window. Under a specified iid response law, the same state yields exact finite-horizon endpoint probabilities. We further show that merging wrong-answer identities preserves single-call correctness and cannot improve plurality accuracy, and that the effect of redistributing wrong-answer probability depends on the realized vote state. Singleton reachability yields a gold-free exact locking certificate. For a known answer universe, its first trigger is the earliest prefix at which all admissible continuations yield the same fixed-budget output. Empirically, most discovered-but-unselected correct answers lose reachability only after discovery. In a controlled Word16 study, input permutation improves raw-plurality accuracy by 21.1 points with essentially unchanged single-call correctness. Exact locking saves 28-30% of calls at a 16-call budget while preserving every fixed-budget output.

papers.title: VASC: Value-Aware Sparse Attention with Cross-Layer Memory for Efficient 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D vision models such as VGGT have achieved remarkable progress, unifying camera estimation and dense scene reconstruction in a single pass. However, their quadratic global attention makes long image sequences expensive, while existing sparse methods may favor highly attended yet value-redundant regions. To address these limitations, we introduce VASC, a training-free sparse attention method combining value-aware block selection and execution-aware cross-layer memory. Our value-aware block selection integrates pooled query--key relevance with neighboring value contrast, reducing redundancy while preserving query-relevant and distinctive content. Cross-layer memory tracks unserved demand across layers and updates this state according to actual execution, enabling previously underserved blocks to compete under a fixed computation budget. Experiments on 7Scenes and NeuralRGB-D with VGGT and $π^3$ demonstrate improved pose estimation and reconstruction quality compared with FasterVGGT, together with up to $2.29\times$ faster inference than dense VGGT. Code is available at https://github.com/kosakayamahoo-design/VASC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VASC 是面向 VGGT 类前馈 3D 重建模型的免训练稀疏注意力，用 value-aware block selection 在池化 query-key 相关性上叠加邻域 value 对比以去冗余，再用 execution-aware cross-layer memory 按实际执行跟踪各层未被服务的需求，让先前欠服务的 block 在固定计算预算下参与竞争。在 7Scenes 与 NeuralRGB-D 上配合 VGGT 和 π³，位姿估计与重建质量优于 FasterVGGT，推理最高比稠密 VGGT 加速 2.29×。
Motivation: VGGT 等单次前馈 3D 模型的全局注意力是二次复杂度，长图像序列代价高；已有稀疏注意力又偏向被高度关注但 value 冗余的区域，牺牲了区分性内容。
Method: 免训练 (training-free) 稀疏注意力 VASC：value-aware block selection 融合池化 query-key 相关性与邻域 value 对比，保留 query 相关且有区分度的块；execution-aware cross-layer memory 跨层记录未被服务的需求并按实际执行更新状态，在固定计算预算下重新分配块的入选机会。
Result: 在 7Scenes 和 NeuralRGB-D 上以 VGGT 与 π³ 为骨干，位姿估计与重建质量相比 FasterVGGT 提升，推理最高比稠密 VGGT 快 2.29×。
Conclusion: 在固定计算预算下按 value 区分度与跨层执行状态选块，可以在免训练前提下同时保住 3D 重建质量并显著降低长序列注意力开销。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Watch Your Speech: Text-aware Video-to-Speech Synthesis with Textual Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Video-to-speech synthesis aims to generate natural-sounding speech from silent talking-face videos while ensuring phonetic accuracy. A fundamental challenge in this task is the inherent one-to-many mapping problem, where visual dynamics often lack sufficient information to uniquely determine the corresponding utterance. To address this, we propose Watch Your Speech (WYS), a video-to-speech synthesis framework that incorporates textual conditioning as an explicit linguistic cue to mitigate visual ambiguity. Our framework features an attention-based embedding fusion module that synergistically integrates textual context with video sequences, coupled with a conditional flow matching objective for high-fidelity speech generation. Extensive experiments on the LRS2 and LRS3 datasets demonstrate that WYS achieves superior performance, establishing new state-of-the-art results in audio-visual synchronization (LSE-C/D) while maintaining highly competitive textual accuracy (WER). Subjective evaluations further confirm that our model generates speech with near-human naturalness, validating the effectiveness of textual conditioning in content-controlled video-to-speech synthesis. Project page: https://github.com/gunwoo5034/Watch-your-Speech
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 无声说话人脸视频到语音合成 (video-to-speech) 存在一对多映射，视觉动态不足以唯一确定说话内容。WYS 把文本作为显式语言线索注入：注意力嵌入融合模块把文本上下文与视频序列融合，配合条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 生成高保真语音，在 LRS2 与 LRS3 上取得音画同步 (LSE-C/D) 的新 SOTA，同时保持有竞争力的 WER，主观评测显示接近人声自然度。
Motivation: 无声说话人脸视频到语音合成中，视觉动态往往缺少唯一确定对应语句的信息，一对多映射导致语音内容与音画同步难以同时保证。
Method: 提出 Watch Your Speech (WYS)：以文本作为显式语言线索缓解视觉歧义，用注意力式嵌入融合模块 (attention-based embedding fusion) 协同整合文本上下文与视频序列，并以条件流匹配目标 (conditional flow matching objective) 生成高保真语音。
Result: 在 LRS2 与 LRS3 数据集上取得音画同步指标 LSE-C/D 的新 SOTA，同时保持有竞争力的文本准确率 (WER)；主观评测显示生成语音达到接近人声的自然度。
Conclusion: 文本条件化能有效缓解内容受控视频到语音合成中的视觉歧义，在不牺牲文本准确率的前提下提升音画同步与自然度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Answer Confidence: A Controlled Audit of Self-Knowledge in a Black-Box Decision Model
papers.abstract_en: Decision models return probabilities intended for routing, abstention and automated action. Calibration makes those probabilities useful on average, but does not establish whether low confidence reflects chance or missing knowledge, nor whether confidence falls when a model moves beyond what it knows. We audit this distinction in Jev, a decision model, with over 15 public datasets and 6 generated task families, with paired interventions that vary the information supplied for a fixed item. Jev's confidence is calibrated on familiar closed-choice tasks but fails as an indicator of missing knowledge: with no answer-relevant information it assigns up to 0.80 to a salient option, and on news beyond an observed knowledge boundary it exceeds accuracy by 0.21--0.33, a gap that recalibration on earlier months does not close. Targeted yes/no questions give sharper readouts of the case: whether an outcome is settled (AUROC 1.00) and whether the evidence suffices (0.95, against 0.85 for confidence on the same items). Asking whether Jev knows the answer appears to flag fabricated entities and post-boundary news (0.91), but with realistic names or with dates removed it shows no advantage over answer uncertainty. Black-box knowledge audits therefore need explicit controls for surface cues. Code: https://github.com/Syntheme/beyond-answer-confidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对黑盒决策模型 Jev 做受控自知审计：配对干预改变同一题目的输入信息，发现置信度在熟悉闭合选择任务上校准良好，却不能指示缺失知识——无相关信息时仍给显著选项 0.80，知识边界之后的新闻上超出准确率 0.21–0.33。改用针对性 yes/no 问题读数更锐利（结果是否已定 AUROC 1.00、证据是否充分 0.95，对比同题置信度 0.85），但去掉日期或换成常见人名后，
Motivation: 校准只保证概率平均可用，无法区分低置信是运气差还是模型缺知识，也无法保证模型越出知识边界时置信度下降；对路由、弃答和自动执行的决策模型，这直接决定能否信任其置信度。
Method: 在黑盒决策模型 Jev 上做受控审计：覆盖 15+ 公开数据集与 6 个生成任务族，用配对干预对同一题目改变所提供的信息量；另用针对性 yes/no 问题（结果是否已定、证据是否充分）作为读数，并与同题 answer confidence 比较 AUROC，还检验在早期月份上重新校准能否弥合差距。
Result: Jev 在熟悉闭合选择任务上校准良好，但无任何答案相关信息时给显著选项的概率高达 0.80；在超出观测知识边界的新闻上置信度超出准确率 0.21–0.33，用早期月份重新校准无法弥合。yes/no 读数：结果是否已定 AUROC 1.00，证据是否充分 0.95（同题置信度 0.85）；识别虚构实体与边界后新闻达 0.91，但用真实常见名字或去掉日期后相对 answer uncertainty 无优势。
Conclusion: 置信度不是缺失知识的可靠指标，黑盒自知审计必须显式控制表面线索（人名、日期），否则 yes/no 探针的高读数可能只是在抓 cue。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Tolerance-Based Fairness Auditing: Violation Certification and Sensitivity Screening
papers.abstract_en: As artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed, algorithmic unfairness has raised growing concerns and intensified demands for transparent fairness auditing. In practice, the tolerable degree of algorithmic unfairness depends on the specific legal, ethical, or application context. Given a prespecified tolerance threshold, an important statistical question is how to determine whether a group disparity exceeds the allowable tolerance across different auditing objectives. To address this problem, we develop a unified tolerance-based fairness auditing framework for two complementary auditing objectives: violation certification, which prioritizes control of false violation declarations, and sensitivity screening, which prioritizes reducing missed violations. For the first objective, we develop a constrained empirical likelihood test for formal settings that uses least-favorable-point calibration and can be combined with false flagging rate control for simultaneous subgroup auditing. For the second objective, we develop split empirical likelihood and adjusted split empirical likelihood tests using an adaptive boundary-proxy principle for early-warning settings. Numerical experiments show the distinct error-control--sensitivity trade-offs of these procedures. A COMPAS analysis illustrates the framework in predictive fairness auditing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于容差阈值的公平性审计框架，把「群体差异是否超出可容忍范围」变成统计检验：违规认证用受约束经验似然检验配合最不利点校准，控制误报违规率；敏感性筛查用分裂经验似然与调整版分裂经验似然，按自适应边界代理原则做早期预警。数值实验显示两类程序呈现不同的误差控制—敏感性权衡，COMPAS 数据分析演示了预测公平性审计。
Motivation: 算法不公平的可容忍程度随法律、伦理与应用场景变化，给定预设容差阈值后，如何判定群体差异是否越界缺乏统一的统计检验框架，且误报与漏报两类审计目标需要不同的错误控制取舍。
Method: 框架含两个互补目标：违规认证采用受约束经验似然 (constrained empirical likelihood) 检验，用最不利点 (least-favorable-point) 校准，并可结合误报率控制 (false flagging rate control) 做子群同时审计；敏感性筛查采用分裂经验似然 (split empirical likelihood) 与调整分裂经验似然检验，基于自适应边界代理 (adaptive boundary-proxy) 原则服务于早期预警场景。
Result: 数值实验展示了各检验在误差控制与敏感性之间的不同权衡；COMPAS 数据分析用于说明该框架在预测公平性审计中的应用。
Conclusion: 给定容差阈值后，违规认证与敏感性筛查应作为两个互补目标分别用相应的经验似然检验来实现，二者取不同的错误控制—敏感性折中。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 给定容差阈值后，违规认证与敏感性筛查应作为两个互补目标分别用相应的经验似然检验来实现，二者取不同的错误控制—敏感性折中。

papers.title: What Can Analogy Tell Us About Artificial Consciousness?
papers.abstract_en: Who or what is conscious? Because subjective experience is directly accessible only in the first person, judgments about consciousness in other entities depend partly on analogy. Historically, such inferences have focused on nonhuman animals, but advances in artificial intelligence have raised the possibility of conscious AI. Here we develop a causal framework for evaluating such evidential analogies. The key distinction is between similarities in factors plausibly involved in generating consciousness and similarities in downstream behavioural or cognitive effects. Our framework weights source-target similarity by causal relevance while allowing for unknown causes, disabling differences and alternative routes to consciousness. Applied to biological systems, it explains why analogical support generally weakens with increasing causal distance from humans. Applied to contemporary AI, it suggests that behavioural similarity provides only limited evidence for consciousness because relevant causal correspondences remain poorly established. The framework also clarifies what evidence would strengthen claims of artificial consciousness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出评估意识证据类比的因果框架：按因果相关性给源-目标相似度加权，区分生成意识的因果因素相似与下游行为/认知效果相似，并允许未知原因、致废差异与替代通路。用于当代 AI 时，该框架判定行为相似只能提供很有限的意识证据，因为相关因果对应关系仍远未确立。
Motivation: 主观体验只能第一人称直接获取，对他者意识的判断依赖类比；AI 进展使有意识 AI 成为可能，但缺少区分真正因果相似与表面行为相似的评价标准。
Method: 构建一个因果类比框架：以因果相关性对源-目标相似度加权，同时纳入未知原因、disabling differences（致废差异）与替代意识通路；先应用于生物系统，再应用于当代 AI。
Result: 应用于生物系统时，框架解释了类比支持为何随与人类因果距离增大而减弱；应用于当代 AI，得出行为相似仅提供有限意识证据的定性结论。
Conclusion: 意识归属的类比证据必须按因果距离加权，行为层面的相似不足以支撑人工意识主张，除非补上可确立的因果对应。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Calibration-risk routing for controlled world-model adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can exploit simulated experience, but a simulator-to-target shift creates a model-selection problem: correcting the simulator and fitting the target directly can each fail under limited target data. We introduce the Model-Corrected World Model (MC-WM), which separates initial target data into disjoint fit, selection, and calibration partitions and deploys the family with lower standardized calibration risk. A learned confidence signal and deterministic validity predicates weight one-step imagined policy updates without rewriting physical rewards. We evaluate 540 unique reported run cells across three controlled Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact (MuJoCo) shifts; one exact-routing cell was repeated after a pre-deployment artifact gate, giving 541 completed executions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MC-WM 在模拟器到目标域偏移下把初始目标数据切成互不重叠的 fit、selection、calibration 三份，按标准化校准风险 (calibration risk) 路由到风险更低的模型族，而不是直接修正模拟器或直接拟合目标域。在三个 MuJoCo Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact 偏移上共完成 541 次执行（540 个唯一报告 run cell，其中一个 exact-routing cell 在预部署 artifact gate 后重跑）。
Motivation: MBRL 依赖模拟经验，但模拟器与目标域之间存在偏移，形成模型选择问题：在目标数据有限时，修正模拟器与直接拟合目标域两条路各自都可能失败。
Method: MC-WM 把初始目标数据划分为互不重叠的 fit、selection、calibration 三份，按标准化校准风险部署风险更低的模型族；用一个学习到的置信信号与确定性 validity predicates 给单步想象策略更新加权，且不改写物理 reward。
Result: 在三个受控 MuJoCo Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact 偏移上评测 540 个唯一报告 run cell，其中一个 exact-routing cell 在预部署 artifact gate 后重跑，共 541 次完成的执行。
Conclusion: 在目标数据有限的模拟器偏移场景下，按校准风险在模型族之间路由、并用置信信号与 validity 约束加权想象更新，是比单独修正模拟器或直接拟合目标域更稳的适配路径。

papers.title: Evaluating LLM-Generated Preference Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as probabilistic generators for simulation, synthetic data generation, and decision support in settings where real-world data are unavailable. Yet, the structure and reliability of the distributions they produce remain understudied. Here, we systematically analyze LLM-generated distributions of preferences for air travel, restaurants, and consumer products. Encouragingly, all models considered in our analysis exhibit self-coherence, with the most probable outcomes stabilizing rapidly under repeated sampling. At the same time, we observe substantial discordance across both model families and scales, with little consensus even among their most probable outcomes. These patterns hold across nine open-weight models, three choice domains, and show robustness under temperature changes, greedy decoding, and perturbations of prompt and ordering. Our findings indicate that outcomes are influenced more by the choice of model than by the wording of the prompt, challenging the common assumption that sufficiently capable LLMs produce similar preference distributions when used as stand-ins for survey respondents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统分析 LLM 生成的偏好分布（航空旅行、餐厅、消费品三个选择域），发现所有模型都自洽——最可能结果在重复采样下迅速稳定，但不同模型家族与规模之间高度不一致，最可能结果也几乎无共识。结论是结果更多由选哪个模型决定而非提示词措辞，挑战了“足够强的 LLM 可互换充当问卷受访者”这一常见假设。
Motivation: 在缺乏真实数据的场景中 LLM 被当作概率生成器用于模拟与决策支持，但其输出分布的结构与可靠性研究不足；若不同模型给出的偏好分布不可互换，用 LLM 替代问卷受访者就会引入模型选择偏差。
Method: 对九个开源权重模型在三个选择域（航空旅行、餐厅、消费品）上重复采样，构建 LLM 生成的偏好分布，并检验温度变化、贪心解码 (greedy decoding) 以及提示词与选项顺序扰动下的稳健性，比较模型家族、模型规模与提示措辞对分布的影响。
Result: 所有被分析模型都表现出自洽性 (self-coherence)，最可能结果在重复采样下迅速稳定；同时模型家族与规模之间存在显著不一致 (discordance)，即便最可能结果也几乎无共识。上述模式在九个开源权重模型、三个选择域上成立，并在温度变化、贪心解码、提示词与顺序扰动下保持稳健。
Conclusion: LLM 偏好分布的差异主要由模型选择而非提示措辞驱动，因此不能默认不同强模型会给出相似的偏好分布并可互换充当受访者。

papers.title: Distilling Directional Verification
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation aims to transfer the factual knowledge of large language models to smaller models for efficient deployment. Yet a teacher may recall a relation in one direction while failing to generate the answer in the reverse direction. Distillation from its generated answers can therefore propagate this directional limitation to the student. The same teacher can nevertheless recognize such an answer by scoring the relation in the direction it knows. We introduce directional label distillation, in which frozen teachers score candidate answers in that known direction and the best-scoring candidate becomes the student's training target. On facts about parents and their children, known-direction scoring yields more accurate labels than scoring the requested direction, even after tuned corrections for name priors. With prior-corrected scores, the better direction depends on the facts rather than the template, and reverses on mined facts whose notable entity is the parent rather than the child. With the evaluated children's forward facts withheld, students trained on known-direction labels improve open-ended accuracy on their trained queries by 13 to 15 points over students trained on prior-corrected reverse labels. After generated answers are matched to a fixed name list by lexical similarity, students reproduce nearly all selected labels. Their accuracy largely follows label quality. The label advantage holds on unscreened queries and when candidates are retrieved without inserting correct answers. Our findings show that directional verification mitigates the transfer of errors from teacher-generated answers to students by providing more accurate training targets. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/directional-verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 知识蒸馏中教师可能只在关系的一个方向上记得答案，直接用其生成答案做蒸馏会把这种方向性错误传给学生。提出 directional label distillation：冻结教师在已知方向上给候选答案打分，取最高分候选作为学生训练目标；在亲子关系事实上，按已知方向打分比按请求方向打分给出更准的标签，学生在保留前向事实的设定下开放域准确率比用先验校正反向标签训练高 13 到 15 个百分点。
Motivation: 教师可能在一个方向上能识别关系、反向却生成不出答案，从其生成答案蒸馏会把这一方向性局限直接传给学生，导致训练目标本身带噪。
Method: directional label distillation：冻结教师在已知方向上对候选答案打分，最高分候选作为学生训练目标；候选经词表相似度匹配到固定名单，并对 name prior 做校正；评测在父母与子女的事实（亲子关系）上进行，含保留儿童前向事实、未筛选查询与不插入正确答案的检索候选等设定。
Result: 已知方向打分给出的标签比请求方向打分更准，即便对 name prior 做调优校正后仍成立；先验校正后更优方向取决于事实而非模板，在显著实体为父母而非子女的挖掘事实上方向反转；保留儿童前向事实后，用已知方向标签训练的学生在其训练查询上的开放域准确率比用先验校正反向标签训练的学生高 13 到 15 个百分点；候选经词表相似度匹配到固定名单后，学生几乎复现全部所选标签，其准确率主要跟随标签质量；标签优势在未筛选查询与不插入正确答案的检索候选下仍保持。
Conclusion: 方向性验证通过提供更准的训练目标，缓解了教师生成答案中的误差向学生的传递；学生的准确率主要由标签质量决定。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reliability-aware short-term roll prediction for unmanned surface vehicles via multi-task learning and adaptive centralization
papers.abstract_en: Reliable roll prediction of unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) is essential for ensuring navi?gational safety and enhancing autonomous decision-making. While existing studies primarily focus on improving prediction accuracy, the quantification of prediction reliability remains insufficiently addressed. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a reliability-aware prediction paradigm that integrates confidence assessment into the predictive pipeline. The architecture utilizes a multi-task learning structure where a shared feature extraction backbone feeds into dual heads: a regression head for precise roll prediction and a quantification head for confidence scoring. This configuration provides accurate prediction and corresponding confidence for risk?sensitive downstream tasks. In addition, an adaptive centralization strategy tailored for short?term real-time roll prediction is introduced to improve model generalization under varying operational conditions. Experiments conducted on a real-sea dataset demonstrate that the proposed method effectively quantifies the reliability of prediction results and maintains superior generalization under varying conditions, offering significant potential for practical engineering applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对无人艇 (USV) 短时横摇 (roll) 预测只追求精度、不量化可靠性的问题，提出可靠性感知范式：共享特征骨干接回归头与置信度量化头的多任务学习结构，并加入面向短时实时预测的自适应中心化 (adaptive centralization) 策略。在真实海况数据集上，该方法能有效量化预测结果的可靠性，并在多变工况下保持更好的泛化。
Motivation: 现有横摇预测研究主要提升精度，对预测可靠性的量化不足，而风险敏感的下游决策需要精度与置信度配套。
Method: 多任务学习结构：共享特征提取骨干分出双头，回归头输出横摇预测，量化头输出置信度评分；另引入针对短时实时横摇预测的自适应中心化策略，以提升模型在不同工况下的泛化能力。
Result: 在真实海况数据集 (real-sea dataset) 上的实验表明，该方法能有效量化预测结果的可靠性，并在多变工况下保持更优的泛化表现。
Conclusion: 把置信度量化与预测本身一起建模，加上面向实时短时预测的自适应中心化，可让 USV 横摇预测同时具备精度与可用于风险敏感决策的可靠性度量。
Relevance: 4
