papers.title: ByteTraX: Enhancing the ByteTrack Architecture with Optimised Thresholding
papers.abstract_en: The ByteTrack algorithm is a widely used and computationally efficient multi-object tracking architecture. Its core innovation lies in the combination of lenient bounding box associations with tracklet similarity matching to robustly deal with object occlusions. However, this strategy is nevertheless vulnerable to erroneous track reclassification and identity switching, as detection confidence scores dictate association priority. To address this, I present a simple enhancement of the ByteTrack architecture--named ByteTraX--that optimises track continuity via a single unified matching threshold, while penalising identity switches through stringent track initiation criteria. This approach achieves consistently improved performance across a range of diverse benchmarks including GMOT-40, LC-MOT, SportsMOT, TeamTrack, DAMUNT, and DeepSea-MOT, while simultaneously increasing processing speed by >10%. Specifically, results demonstrate a >40% reduction in identity switches, accompanied by mean increases in HOTA of 3.6, IDF1 of 5.6, and FPS of 6.3. As such, adoption of the ByteTraX algorithm has the potential to substantially enhance tracking performance over the ByteTrack baseline, while retaining the efficiency needed for real-time deployment. To facilitate usage, I provide the source code, integration functionality for the YOLO family of object detection models, and deployment instructions via an open source repository.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ByteTraX 用单一统一匹配阈值替代 ByteTrack 的分段置信度策略，并以严格的轨迹初始化准则惩罚身份切换，在 GMOT-40、LC-MOT、SportsMOT、TeamTrack、DAMUNT、DeepSea-MOT 上一致提升多目标跟踪性能：身份切换减少 >40%，HOTA 平均 +3.6、IDF1 +5.6、FPS +6.3（处理速度提升 >10%），同时保留实时部署所需效率。
Motivation: ByteTrack 靠宽松框关联加轨迹相似度匹配处理遮挡，但关联优先级由检测置信度分数决定，容易出现错误的轨迹重分类与身份切换 (identity switch)。
Method: 提出 ByteTraX：用一个统一的匹配阈值优化轨迹连续性，并用严格的轨迹初始化准则惩罚身份切换；提供开源代码、YOLO 系列检测器的集成接口与部署说明。
Result: 在 GMOT-40、LC-MOT、SportsMOT、TeamTrack、DAMUNT、DeepSea-MOT 上身份切换减少 >40%，HOTA 平均提高 3.6，IDF1 平均提高 5.6，FPS 平均提高 6.3，处理速度提升 >10%，相对 ByteTrack 基线一致改善。
Conclusion: 把关联阈值统一并收紧轨迹初始化，可以在不牺牲实时效率的前提下显著降低身份切换、提升 ByteTrack 类跟踪器的 HOTA 与 IDF1。

summary_sections.result: 在 GMOT-40、LC-MOT、SportsMOT、TeamTrack、DAMUNT、DeepSea-MOT 上身份切换减少 >40%，HOTA 平均提高 3.6，IDF1 平均提高 5.6，FPS 平均提高 6.3，处理速度提升 >10%，相对 ByteTrack 基线一致改善。

papers.title: A Proposed Rubric for Evaluating Expressed Clinical Reasoning in Large Language Model Responses
papers.abstract_en: We propose a rubric for assessing expressed clinical reasoning in model responses, drawing on three bodies of work: medical education assessment frameworks (ART, SCT, Key Feature Problems and OSCE); clinical LLM benchmarks (MedR-Bench, HealthBench, TIMER-Bench, DR. BENCH, PrIME-LLM and PatientSafeBench); and general LLM reasoning evaluation research, including the Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility taxonomy, FaithCoT-Bench and C2-Faith. We use groundedness as a clinically oriented adaptation of the taxonomy's factuality category. The rubric brings these concepts together in a multidimensional framework for scoring free-text responses to gold-standard clinical vignettes. It includes provisional behavioural anchors, applicability rules and a separate flag for case-specific safety-critical errors. General-domain frameworks inform its design but are not treated as validated clinical instruments. The rubric does not replace case-specific reference criteria or the task-specific metrics of existing benchmarks. It has not yet been tested for inter-rater reliability, construct validity or clinical utility. Its immediate purpose is to make evaluation decisions explicit and open to scrutiny before empirical testing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套用于给 LLM 自由文本临床推理作答打分的多维评分 rubric，整合医学教育评估框架（ART、SCT、Key Feature Problems、OSCE）、临床 LLM 基准（MedR-Bench、HealthBench、TIMER-Bench、DR. BENCH、PrIME-LLM、PatientSafeBench）与通用推理评测研究（Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility 分类、FaithCoT-Bench、C2-Faith），并把 factuality 改写为临床取向的 groundedness。rubric 含暂定行为锚点、适用规则和病例特异性安全关键错误的独立标记，其当前目的是让评测决策在实证检验前显式、可审查。
Motivation: 临床 LLM 推理评测缺少统一、可审查的打分框架：现有基准各用任务特异指标，医学教育评估框架与通用推理评测分类尚未被整合为可对自由文本作答打分的临床工具。
Method: 从三类文献（医学教育评估框架 ART/SCT/Key Feature Problems/OSCE、六个临床 LLM 基准、通用推理评测的 Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility 分类与 FaithCoT-Bench/C2-Faith）抽取概念，合成对金标准临床病例 (clinical vignettes) 自由文本作答的多维打分框架；含暂定行为锚点、适用规则、病例特异性安全关键错误独立标记，并将 factuality 适配为 groundedness。
Result: 产出为提出的 rubric 本身及其设计约束：通用领域框架仅作设计参考、不视为已验证的临床工具；不替代病例特异参考标准或既有基准的任务特异指标；尚未做评分者间信度、构念效度或临床效用检验。
Conclusion: 作者主张在实证检验之前先让评测决策显式、可审查，即该 rubric 是待验证的框架而非已验证的临床评测工具。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Texture Space Material Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: We present a method for generating high quality materials for 3D objects entirely in texture space. We finetune a video diffusion transformer for text-guided material generation, multi-view material generation, and material upscaling. Our key insight is to use the known projection from image space to texture space, enabling the diffusion process to generalize across arbitrary geometries and texture parameterizations. This approach also avoids the view consistency issues inherent in video and multi-view diffusion models. Because texture space is two dimensional, we can reuse the strong priors of pretrained video diffusion models. We apply our method to high quality material reconstruction from posed photos captured under unknown lighting, as well as to text- and image guided material generation. Our method can scale to high resolutions (8K), 100+ input views, and neural material representations. In quantitative and qualitative evaluations we show state-of-the-art results for material generation and reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在纹理空间而非图像空间做材质扩散生成：微调视频 diffusion transformer，利用已知的图像空间到纹理空间投影，把多视角材质生成、文本引导生成与材质上采样统一到 2D 纹理域，从而跨任意几何与纹理参数化泛化，并规避视频/多视角扩散的视角一致性问题。方法可扩展到 8K 分辨率、100+ 输入视角与神经材质表示，作者称在材质生成与重建上取得 state-of-the-art 结果。
Motivation: 视频与多视角扩散模型直接生成材质时存在视角一致性问题，且难以跨不同几何与纹理参数化泛化；图像空间生成也难以直接得到高质量、可平铺的材质表示。
Method: 微调一个视频 diffusion transformer (DiT)，任务涵盖文本引导材质生成、多视角材质生成与材质上采样；核心是复用图像空间到纹理空间的已知投影，把扩散过程放到二维纹理空间，从而复用预训练视频扩散模型的强先验。应用包括从未知光照下拍摄的 posed photos 重建高质量材质，以及文本与图像引导的材质生成。
Result: 在材质生成与重建的定量与定性评估中取得 state-of-the-art 结果；方法可扩展到 8K 分辨率、100+ 输入视角以及神经材质表示。
Conclusion: 把扩散过程放到纹理空间并复用图像到纹理的投影，是让预训练视频扩散先验跨任意几何与纹理参数化生成材质、同时避开视角不一致的可行路径。

papers.title: Codebook-Guided Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Structurally Heterogeneous Features
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a teacher modality to a student modality. Existing feature-level alignment methods typically assume that teacher and student features reside in structurally alignable representation spaces. However, this assumption does not hold when cross-modal features are structurally heterogeneous and lack clear unit-level correspondence, such as 2D spatial visual grids and 1D temporal audio sequences, thereby limiting the applicability of feature-level alignment. To address this challenge, we propose a cross-modal distillation framework that enables effective knowledge transfer across structurally heterogeneous feature spaces via a vector-quantized codebook. Specifically, teacher features are abstracted into a set of vector-form codes regardless of their original feature structure, and the selected codes serve as concept-level anchors for student learning. Code selection is guided by both task relevance and student compatibility, allowing the student to receive transferable teacher knowledge without requiring direct unit-level feature alignment. Experimental results across diverse cross-modal distillation scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on classification and semantic segmentation tasks.
papers.comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于向量量化 codebook 的跨模态知识蒸馏框架，把教师特征抽象成与原始结构无关的向量码，用被选中的码作为概念级锚点指导学生，选择同时由任务相关性和学生兼容性决定，从而绕开 2D 空间网格与 1D 时序之间必须逐单元对齐的前提。在分类与语义分割两类跨模态蒸馏场景中验证有效。
Motivation: 现有特征级跨模态蒸馏假设教师与学生特征处在可对齐的表示空间，而 2D 视觉网格与 1D 音频序列这类结构异质特征缺乏清晰的单元级对应，使该假设失效、特征级对齐方法难以适用。
Method: 提出 codebook 引导的跨模态蒸馏框架：先用向量量化 (vector quantization) 把教师特征抽象为一组向量形式的码，不论其原始结构；再按任务相关性与学生兼容性挑选码，作为学生学习的概念级锚点，无需直接的单元级特征对齐。
Result: 在多种跨模态蒸馏场景下，该框架在分类 (classification) 与语义分割 (semantic segmentation) 任务上展示了有效性。
Conclusion: 结构异质的跨模态特征可以通过共享的向量码空间传递知识，概念级锚点可替代逐单元的特征对齐。

papers.title: SafeVantage: Vantage-Aware Memory for Reliable Embodied Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Reliable embodied decisions under partial observability require informative observations and sufficient supporting evidence. However, semantic scores alone do not reveal which viewpoints justify a claim or where additional evidence should be acquired. We introduce SafeVantage, a vantage-aware semantic memory and active acquisition framework that retains each claim's supporting views, camera poses, and estimated target location, keeping positive support distinct from search coverage. A learned candidate-observability model uses claim-grounded geometry to predict target visibility at reachable viewpoints. These predictions guide view selection through expected reduction in terminal decision loss, accounting for travel cost and geometrically distinct corroboration. A calibrated head then combines support, spatial consistency, and coverage to produce Yes, No, or Abstain decisions. We evaluate SafeVantage on a category-presence benchmark spanning 232 unseen ProcTHOR houses and 7,424 paired episodes per method and action budget. Compared with validation-selected equal-budget baselines, SafeVantage achieves macro-F1 gains of 24.7% and 12.0% at eight and twelve actions, respectively, with lower risk and higher answer rates at both budgets and 31.7% less travel at eight actions. Equal-input HM3D experiments show lower selective risk under fixed observations, while controlled ScanNet interventions show that restoring supporting views improves downstream VLM answers. Ablations further support the contribution of candidate observability to decision quality and acquisition efficiency. Results demonstrate the value of claim-level viewpoint evidence for connecting semantic memory, active acquisition, and reliable decision-making. Code is available at https://safevantage.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeVantage 把每条主张的支撑视角、相机位姿与目标估计位置存进语义记忆，并用候选可观测性模型预测可达视角下的目标可见性，再按终端决策损失的期望下降（兼顾行进代价与几何上互异的佐证）选择下一步观测。在 232 个未见 ProcTHOR 房屋、每方法每动作预算 7,424 对 episode 的类别存在性基准上，8 与 12 动作预算下 macro-F1 分别提升 24.7% 与 12.0%，8 动作时行进距离减少 31.7%。
Motivation: 部分可观测下的具身决策只靠语义分数无法判断哪些视角真正支撑某条主张、也不知该去哪里补证据，导致支持与搜索覆盖混在一起、决策不可靠。
Method: SafeVantage 由三部分组成：保留主张支撑视角/相机位姿/目标位置的视角感知语义记忆（区分正支撑与搜索覆盖）；基于主张接地几何的候选可观测性模型预测可达视角的目标可见性，并以终端决策损失期望下降（含行进代价与几何互异佐证）引导视角选择；校准头融合支撑、空间一致性与覆盖输出 Yes/No/Abstain。
Result: 在 232 个未见 ProcTHOR 房屋、7,424 对 episode/方法/动作预算的类别存在性基准上，相对验证集选定的等预算基线，8 与 12 动作预算下 macro-F1 分别提升 24.7% 与 12.0%，两个预算下风险更低、回答率更高，8 动作时行进距离少 31.7%。等输入 HM3D 实验中固定观测下选择性风险更低；受控 ScanNet 干预显示恢复支撑视角可改善下游 VLM 回答；消融支持候选可观测性对决策质量与采集效率的贡献。
Conclusion: 主张级的视角证据能把语义记忆、主动采集与可靠决策连起来，在固定观测与干预条件下都降低选择性风险，候选可观测性是决策质量与采集效率的关键来源。

papers.title: Less Supervision, Better Generalization: Weakly Supervised Fake Region Localization in Diffusion-Edited Images
papers.abstract_en: Localizing AI-edited regions is essential for interpretable forensic analysis, but remains challenging due to subtle and spatially distributed artifacts that are misaligned with semantic or object boundaries. Existing approaches rely on pixel-level supervision from controlled editing pipelines, which is difficult to scale and can introduce misleading signals: artifacts frequently extend beyond annotated regions, while out-of-mask pixels are treated as authentic. This limits models' ability to capture transferable evidence and generalize across generators and datasets. To address these issues, we propose ReGFLoW, a Reconstruction-Guided Fake Localization framework under Weak supervision, which is the first weakly supervised approach for diffusion-edited fake region localization. ReGFLoW requires only real/fake labels at the image level and uses diffusion reconstruction errors as dense spatial guidance to inject them into both feature and score spaces. Furthermore, by artifact-centric multiple instance learning, ReGFLoW utilizes localized diffusion evidence without relying on semantic-affinity or boundary-based pseudo-mask priors. Extensive experiments show competitive cross-generator localization, while ReGFLoW outperforms all evaluated fully supervised baselines when evaluation includes both partially edited and fully synthetic images and in cross-dataset tests, without target-domain adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReGFLoW 用图像级 real/fake 标签做扩散编辑区域定位，把扩散重建误差作为稠密空间证据注入特征空间与分数空间，再用 artifact-centric 多实例学习 (MIL) 聚合局部证据。在同时含部分编辑与全合成图像的评测以及跨数据集测试中，它在无需目标域自适应的条件下超过所有被评估的全监督基线。
Motivation: 现有扩散编辑定位依赖受控编辑管线的像素级掩码，难以扩展；且伪影常越出标注范围、掩码外像素被当作真图，学到的证据难跨生成器与数据集迁移。
Method: ReGFLoW（Reconstruction-Guided Fake Localization under Weak supervision）只需图像级 real/fake 标签：以扩散重建误差作为稠密空间引导，同时注入特征空间与分数空间；再用 artifact-centric 多实例学习利用局部扩散证据，不依赖语义亲和或边界类伪掩码先验。
Result: 在跨生成器定位上表现有竞争力；当评测同时包含部分编辑与全合成图像、以及跨数据集测试时，超过全部被评估的全监督基线，且不做目标域自适应。
Conclusion: 弱监督加扩散重建证据即可在跨生成器、跨数据集的编辑定位上胜过全监督，说明像素级掩码监督并非必需，甚至带来误导信号。

papers.title: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow policies can model complex behaviors in offline reinforcement learning (RL). However, penalizing their KL divergence from the behavior policy can discourage actions having high critic values with low behavior density. Directly refining behavior proposals may be an alternative, yet Gaussian or deterministic editors limit expressiveness to represent multiple separated modes for the same proposal. In this work, we introduce Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows (PReFlow), a policy extraction method combining critic-based proposal selection with a conditional refinement flow. To optimize proposal selection and refinement together, we formulate a KL-regularized objective whose optimum induces a Gibbs policy over final actions under a Gaussian-smoothed behavior prior. The refinement flow can represent multiple high value modes, while a proposal-centered Gaussian reference regulates large action changes. This Gaussian reference further enables us to make use of simulation-free, closed form adjoint matching targets from sampled endpoints and critic gradients, yielding a single velocity regression loss without a backward adjoint solve. On 50 OGBench tasks, PReFlow achieves competitive offline performance and the highest aggregate score among the compared methods after online fine-tuning, reaching 91\% after 500K environment steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PReFlow 把 critic 引导的 proposal 选择与条件 refinement flow 结合，用于离线强化学习的策略提取：KL 正则目标的最优解是在高斯平滑行为先验下的 Gibbs 策略，proposal 中心的高斯参考既允许同一 proposal 表示多个高价值动作模态，又限制动作大幅偏移。在 50 个 OGBench 任务上取得有竞争力的离线性能，且在线微调 500K 环境步后聚合分数达到 91%，为对比方法中最高。
Motivation: 对 diffusion/flow 策略施加相对行为策略的 KL 惩罚会压制 critic 值高但行为密度低的动作；而直接精修行为 proposal 时，高斯或确定性编辑器无法表达同一 proposal 对应的多个分离模态。
Method: PReFlow 由 critic-based proposal 选择与 proposal 条件的 refinement flow 组成，二者通过一个 KL 正则目标联合优化，其最优解诱导出高斯平滑行为先验下的 Gibbs 策略；以 proposal 中心的高斯参考约束大动作改动，并利用该高斯参考从采样端点与 critic 梯度得到 simulation-free 的闭式 adjoint matching 目标，最终化为单一 velocity regression 损失，无需反向 adjoint 求解。
Result: 在 50 个 OGBench 任务上，PReFlow 取得有竞争力的离线性能；在线微调后聚合分数在对比方法中最高，500K 环境步时达到 91%。
Conclusion: 把 proposal 选择与精修放进同一个 KL 正则目标、并用高斯参考换取闭式匹配目标，可以在离线 RL 策略提取中同时保留多模态高价值动作并控制动作偏移。

papers.title: CANTO: CAD-Native Transformer Operators for AI-Aided Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Modern engineering systems, from automobiles to aircraft, are designed by using precise, continuous parametric computer-aided design (CAD) models. Evaluating design changes through numerical simulation requires meshing the continuous geometry, a computationally expensive and often brittle process that can require manual intervention and replaces the continuous representation with a discrete approximation. Most neural surrogates accelerate the simulation, but inherit this representation gap by relying on meshes, point clouds, voxels, or other sampled approximations of geometry. We introduce CANTO, a transformer neural operator that maps directly from continuous CAD geometry to physical fields, without meshing the input geometry. We develop a theoretical framework for learning operators from geometric manifolds to function spaces of physical fields, representing geometry through sequences of parametric patches. CANTO instantiates this framework by directly tokenizing non-uniform rational B-spline (NURBS) patches from their control points, knot vectors, and weights, and predicts continuous surface and volume fields at arbitrary query locations. We evaluate CANTO on four automotive and aircraft aerodynamics industry benchmarks: AhmedML, WindsorML, DrivAerML, and HiLiftAeroML. CANTO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on most evaluated surface and volume prediction tasks, including a 19.8% reduction in surface-pressure relative $L_2$ error compared with AB-UPT on HiLiftAeroML. Differentiability with respect to CAD parameters further enables gradient-based inverse design of designs. On AhmedML, CANTO identifies designs with 4.4 to 20.4% lower drag than the best dataset designs satisfying the same volume and lift constraints, with the improvements verified using the same CFD setup used to generate the original dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CANTO 是一个直接吃连续 CAD 几何的 transformer neural operator：把 NURBS patch 按控制点、节点矢量和权重直接 tokenize，在任意查询点输出连续表面与体积物理场，完全跳过网格化。在 AhmedML、WindsorML、DrivAerML、HiLiftAeroML 四个汽车与飞机气动工业基准上，多数表面/体积预测任务达到 state-of-the-art，HiLiftAeroML 表面压力相对 L2 误差较 AB-UPT 降低 19.8%；在 AhmedML 上给出满足体积与升力约束、阻力比数据集最优设计低 4.4%–20.4% 的逆设计结果。
Motivation: 工程仿真必须先把连续参数化 CAD 几何网格化，这一步计算昂贵、脆弱且需人工介入，同时把连续表示替换成离散近似；多数神经代理模型依赖网格、点云或体素，继承了这一表示鸿沟。
Method: 提出 CANTO：一个 transformer neural operator，建立从几何流形到物理场函数空间的学习框架，用参数化 patch 序列表示几何；具体做法是直接从控制点、knot vector 与权重 tokenize 非均匀有理 B 样条 (NURBS) patch，在任意查询位置预测连续表面与体积场；对 CAD 参数可微，从而支持基于梯度的逆设计。
Result: 在 AhmedML、WindsorML、DrivAerML、HiLiftAeroML 四个汽车/飞机气动工业基准上，多数表面与体积预测任务达到 state-of-the-art 精度，其中 HiLiftAeroML 表面压力相对 L2 误差较 AB-UPT 降低 19.8%。在 AhmedML 上，CANTO 找到的设计在满足相同体积与升力约束下，比数据集内最优设计阻力低 4.4% 至 20.4%，且改进用生成原数据集的同一套 CFD 设置验证。
Conclusion: 跳过网格化、直接从连续 CAD 参数化几何学习算子是可行的，既能在气动场预测上取得 SOTA 精度，又能靠对 CAD 参数的可微性把代理模型直接接进梯度式逆设计流程。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: NesTok: Nested Self-Aligned 1D Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: One-dimensional (1D) variable-length visual tokenizers enable adaptive compression by varying the number of tokens, allowing downstream autoregressive (AR) models to flexibly trade off generation quality against computational cost using a single tokenizer. However, existing approaches based on nested dropout often fail to fully exploit the representational capacity of the tokenizer, resulting in suboptimal performance in both image reconstruction and generation. In this work, we introduce NesTok, a nested self-alignment framework tailored to dynamic visual tokenizers. NesTok introduces cross-length training, which jointly optimizes reconstruction across token lengths while using the full-length sequence to guide shorter counterparts, enabling shorter token sequences to approach the reconstruction quality of full-length sequences. On ImageNet, NesTok improves substantially over standard training and achieves an rFID score of 0.98. On downstream image generation, it achieves the state-of-the-art gFID score of 1.46 on ImageNet 256$\times$256 among existing variable-length autoregressive image generation methods. Code will be available at https://github.com/Jiawei804/NesTok.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NesTok 用跨长度训练 (cross-length training) 让可变长度 1D 视觉 tokenizer 在各 token 长度上联合优化重建，并以全长序列作为短序列的对齐目标，使短序列逼近全长重建质量。在 ImageNet 上 rFID 达 0.98，下游 ImageNet 256×256 可变长度自回归生成取得现有方法中最好的 gFID 1.46。
Motivation: 基于 nested dropout 的可变长度 tokenizer 未能用尽表示能力，图像重建与生成两头都次优，压缩率与生成质量的取舍被卡在较低水平。
Method: 提出嵌套自对齐框架 NesTok：核心是 cross-length training，同一 tokenizer 在多个 token 长度上联合优化重建损失，并用全长序列的表示引导较短序列，使单个 tokenizer 支持下游自回归模型按 token 数弹性权衡质量与算力。
Result: 在 ImageNet 上 rFID 达 0.98，明显优于标准训练；下游图像生成在 ImageNet 256×256 上取得 gFID 1.46，为现有可变长度自回归图像生成方法中的 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 让全长序列监督短序列的嵌套自对齐，可把可变长度 tokenizer 的重建与生成同时推到更好水平，一个 tokenizer 即可支撑质量与算力的弹性取舍。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Where Predictive Supervision Goes Shapes What VLA Policies Learn
papers.abstract_en: Future prediction is increasingly used to improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies, based on the premise that anticipating scene evolution encourages representations useful for control. However, forecast quality alone does not establish that a policy has learned a better representation for action. This distinction matters under distribution shift, where successful control depends on preserving spatial state and likely scene change beyond familiar configurations. We study what determines whether predictive supervision improves the visual representation used by a VLA policy. Through controlled comparisons with matched target constructions, prediction horizons, and training conditions, we find that different prediction interfaces produce markedly different forecasts and visual representations, including in the spatial, dynamics, and action information that transfers beyond familiar scenes. We trace these differences to how predictive errors shape the policy's visual stream. Consistent with this controlled finding, VLA policies trained with more direct, scene-matched future supervision show stronger robustness under simulated and physical distribution shifts. Together, our results frame future prediction as a representation-learning design problem whose value for control depends on whether its supervision reaches the representations through which the policy acts.
papers.comment: 38 pages (9 pages main text + appendix), 13 figures, 21 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA 策略中的未来预测监督，其价值取决于预测接口是否把监督送到策略实际用于动作的视觉表征上：在目标构造、预测时长与训练条件全部配平的对照中，不同预测接口产生明显不同的预测质量与视觉表征，且在空间、动态与动作信息上向陌生场景的迁移程度不同。监督更直接、与场景匹配的未来预测训练出的策略，在模拟与真实分布偏移下鲁棒性更强。
Motivation: 未来预测被广泛用于改进 VLA 策略，但预测质量好并不等于策略学到了更好的动作表征；在分布偏移下控制成败取决于能否保住空间状态与场景变化信息，这一区分此前缺少受控证据。
Method: 做受控对照研究：配平目标构造 (matched target constructions)、预测时长 (prediction horizons) 与训练条件，只改变预测接口 (prediction interface)，比较不同接口产出的预测与视觉表征，并追踪预测误差如何塑造策略的视觉流 (visual stream)。
Result: 不同预测接口产生明显不同的预测与视觉表征，包括在空间、动态与动作信息上向熟悉场景之外迁移的差异；采用更直接、场景匹配的未来监督训练的 VLA 策略，在模拟与物理分布偏移下表现出更强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 未来预测应被当作表征学习设计问题：其对控制的价值取决于监督是否经由策略动作所依赖的那条表征通路起作用，而不取决于预测本身的质量。

papers.title: What Makes High-Magnification Knowledge Transferable? A Study of Cross-Resolution Distillation in Whole-Slide Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Cross-resolution knowledge distillation aims to improve low-magnification whole- slide analysis by transferring high-magnification representations, yet the conditions for useful transfer remain unclear. We develop a decomposition-based analysis of teacher access, representation loss, and model excess, motivating three questions: whether (a) teacher targets help the task, (b) low-magnification students can predict them, and (c) slide models benefit from those predictions. We investigate them through controlled experiments across ten pathology cohorts spanning classifi- cation, grading, and survival prediction. In the main comparison, providing teacher regional means alongside native low-magnification features improves downstream performance in all ten cohorts. Direct prediction achieves lower reconstruction error than residual prediction, yet the predicted features underrepresent variation in the teacher targets. Moreover, better reconstruction does not consistently improve downstream scores, and retaining native features changes performance even when the predicted teacher features are held fixed. Together, these findings expose a gap between reconstructing teacher representations and realizing their downstream value. They challenge the sufficiency of reconstruction error as a measure of cross-resolution transfer and provide a diagnostic framework for examining where that transfer breaks down. Future distillation designs must account for both what students can predict and how slide models use those predictions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在全切片病理 (WSI) 跨分辨率蒸馏中，把高倍教师的区域均值作为额外目标喂给低倍学生，可在全部十个病理队列上提升分类、分级与生存预测的下游表现。直接预测比残差预测重建误差更低，但预测特征低估教师目标的变异，且重建误差更低并不稳定换来下游分数更高——重建教师表征与其下游价值之间存在缺口。
Motivation: 跨分辨率蒸馏何时真正有用一直缺少判定条件：教师目标是否对任务有益、低倍学生能否预测、切片模型能否用上这些预测，三者此前未被分开检验。
Method: 提出基于分解的分析框架，把迁移拆成 teacher access、representation loss 与 model excess 三个可检验问题；在十个病理队列上做受控实验，覆盖分类、分级与生存预测，对比提供教师区域均值与原生低倍特征、直接预测与残差预测，并在固定预测特征时单独改变原生特征的保留。
Result: 在全部十个队列中，教师区域均值与原生低倍特征联用均提升下游表现；直接预测的重建误差低于残差预测，但预测特征系统性低估教师目标变异；重建误差更低并不一致地提高下游分数；固定预测教师特征、仅改变原生特征保留方式也会改变性能。
Conclusion: 重建误差不足以度量跨分辨率迁移的价值，未来蒸馏设计必须同时考虑学生能预测什么以及切片模型如何使用这些预测；该分解框架可用于定位迁移在何处失效。

papers.title: Proofs Without Nominals: Gödel's Ontological Argument, its Shallow Embedding, and the Open Questions of the Monatshefte Notes
papers.abstract_en: The shallow embedding of higher-order modal logic in classical higher-order logic, used in Benzmüller and Scott's Notes on Gödel's and Scott's variants of the ontological argument (2025), reaches beyond the modal object language of the arguments: its property quantifiers range over terms that may also express nominals and satisfaction operators of hybrid logic, and a proof using one proves a theorem of the embedding that need not be one of the modal logic. That the framework affords this is not new, and whether a result is one of the modal logic can be settled in two ways: by replaying it in an explicit proof calculus, done by hand for chosen theorems, or by analysing the proofs the embedding itself produces, done here mechanically, for every result at once. Every statement the Notes prove has a proof inside the object language: 294 written out by hand and machine-checked, none using a nominal. The proofs the Notes themselves give instantiate no nominal either; what the detector flags there are terms a prover substituted. The three questions the Notes leave open are settled too, without nominals, but the conjunction axiom has to be emended: generalised in the Notes to Gödel's "any number of summands", it covers the conjunction of no properties, and of one; the empty one alone settles all three, and the two together yield what a separate axiom of Gödel's is for. This article restricts the conjunction axiom to at least two different conjuncts, the reading Gödel's footnote suggests, and the questions are settled again, by proofs that turn on the argument rather than a degenerate instance. The restriction holds of the object language only: with a nominal the axioms make the accessibility relation the identity and the readings coincide. Every theorem is verified in Isabelle/HOL and independently in Lean 4; the countermodels are Nitpick's, certified by the build.
papers.comment: 28 pages. Version 2 also settles the possibilist and mixed-quantifier copies: all ten open statements of the dataset. Ancillary files: Isabelle/HOL and Lean 4 sources of every theorem, 16 Isabelle sessions on readings of the conjunction axiom with Lean counterparts, 72 Nitpick searches as checked expect annotations, both hybrid-witness detectors with reports, five audit sessions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文把 Gödel 本体论论证浅嵌入 (shallow embedding) 中的高阶模态逻辑证明逐条机械化审计：Notes 中 294 条手写并机器检查的定理全部在对象语言内有证明，且没有一条使用 nominal。三个遗留问题在修正合取公理（限制为至少两个不同合取项）后仍被无 nominal 地解决；带 nominal 时公理会把可达关系压成恒等，使各读法重合。
Motivation: 浅嵌入的性质量词可以取到 hybrid logic 的 nominal 与满足算子，因而嵌入层的定理未必是模态对象语言的定理；此前只能靠人工在显式证明演算中重放个别定理来判定归属。
Method: 对嵌入自身产生的全部证明做机械分析而非逐条人工重放：用检测器扫描每条证明是否引入 nominal，并在 Isabelle/HOL 与 Lean 4 中独立验证每个定理，用 Nitpick 生成并由构建认证反模型；配套 16 个 Isabelle 会话考察合取公理的不同读法、72 次 Nitpick 搜索、两个 hybrid-witness 检测器与五个审计会话。
Result: Notes 证明的每条陈述在对象语言内都有证明，共 294 条手写并机器检查，无一使用 nominal；Notes 自身给出的证明也不实例化 nominal，检测器标记的是 prover 替换进来的项。三个遗留问题在修正合取公理后全部解决：空合取单独即可解决三问，空合取与单元素合取合起来对应 Gödel 另一条公理的作用；限制到至少两个不同合取项后三问再次由依赖论证本身（而非退化实例）的证明解决。
Conclusion: 合取公理的限制只作用于对象语言：一旦允许 nominal，公理就把可达关系变成恒等，各读法随之重合，因此无 nominal 的证明才是模态逻辑本身的定理。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Early Learning Shapes Later Directions Of Representation Change In Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Representations continually change as a network learns new tasks. We ask whether early representational changes naturally form a geometric structure that continues to shape later learning. We identify a low-dimensional subspace of early representation drift, which we call a scaffold, and test whether it is reused across subsequent tasks. Across four pretrained visual encoders and two datasets, later representational changes consistently favor this early-defined subspace over matched random alternatives. This reuse is history-dependent: when networks experience different early tasks but identical later training inputs, each network preferentially reuses the scaffold induced by its own learning history. The same preference appears in individual optimizer updates, even though the network's dominant local response directions shift away from the original scaffold. Finally, constraining motion within the scaffold slows new-task acquisition more than matched random constraints, while effects on old-task retention are less consistent. In summary, these results suggest that early experience leaves a persistent geometric imprint on how neural networks adapt to future tasks.Code is available at https://github.com/YuantaoDeng/latent-scaffold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把早期表征漂移的低维子空间称为 scaffold，发现后续任务的表征变化系统性地偏向这个早期定义的子空间而非等维随机子空间，且这种复用依赖学习历史：早期任务不同、后期输入相同的网络各自复用自己的 scaffold。把运动限制在 scaffold 内会比随机约束更慢地拖慢新任务习得，说明早期经验给网络适应未来任务留下持久的几何印记。
Motivation: 持续学习中表征随任务不断变化，但早期变化是否自发形成几何结构并持续约束后期学习尚不清楚；若成立，这将解释网络适应新任务的方式为何依赖其学习历史。
Method: 在四个预训练视觉编码器与两个数据集上识别早期表征漂移的低维 scaffold 子空间，用等维随机子空间作对照，检验后续任务的表征变化方向、单个 optimizer 更新的局部响应方向是否偏向该子空间，并施加 scaffold 内约束与随机约束对比新任务习得与旧任务保持。
Result: 四个预训练视觉编码器、两个数据集上，后期表征变化一致偏向早期定义的 scaffold 而非匹配的随机子空间；复用具有历史依赖性，早期任务不同但后期输入相同的网络各自偏向自身历史诱导的 scaffold；单个 optimizer 更新中同样出现该偏好，尽管网络主导的局部响应方向已偏离原 scaffold；在 scaffold 内施加约束比匹配的随机约束更显著减慢新任务习得，而对旧任务保持的影响较不一致。
Conclusion: 早期学习经验通过一个可复用的低维几何 scaffold 持久地塑造网络后续的表征变化方向，且该约束对新任务习得的代价大于对旧任务保持的代价。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Triangular Resampling for Long-Horizon Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Triangular Resampling (TR), a post-training method for mitigating long-horizon error accumulation in motion diffusion models. Built on FloodDiffusion's triangular denoising schedule, TR addresses the mismatch between ground-truth-derived training windows and model-generated inference states. Replacing only completed motion history leaves this mismatch unresolved in partially denoised states within the active window. TR therefore extends rollout-based training to these states, using ground-truth clamping to limit excessive drift. For each replayed sample, TR draws one denoising threshold, shared across latent positions and replay updates, and replays multi-step triangular denoising without gradient tracking. After each update, states below the threshold are replaced with noise-matched ground truth, while those at or above it retain model predictions. The resulting latent window enters the standard training update. This rollout construction supports both supervised training (TR) and distribution matching (TR-DMD). On 120-second motion generation from HumanML3D test prompts, TR and TR-DMD achieve state-of-the-art FID AUC within their respective non-DMD and DMD comparison groups. Supervised TR reduces FID AUC by 40.9% and FID degradation slope by 55.3% relative to matched post-training without replay.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Triangular Resampling (TR)，一种针对运动扩散模型长时程误差累积的后训练方法：基于 FloodDiffusion 的三角去噪调度，把 rollout 训练扩展到活动窗口内部分去噪的状态，并用 ground-truth clamping 抑制漂移。在 HumanML3D 测试提示的 120 秒运动生成上，TR 与 TR-DMD 在各自非 DMD 与 DMD 对比组内取得 SOTA FID AUC；相对无 replay 的匹配后训练，监督式 TR 把 FID AUC 降低 40.9%、FID 退化斜率降低 55.3%。
Motivation: 运动扩散模型做长时程生成时误差会随 rollout 累积：训练窗口来自真实数据，推理状态却是模型自己生成的，两者分布不匹配；只替换已完成的运动历史无法解决活动窗口内部分去噪状态的偏差。
Method: TR 建立在 FloodDiffusion 的三角去噪调度上，把基于 rollout 的训练扩展到活动窗口内的部分去噪状态，并用 ground-truth clamping 限制过度漂移。每个 replay 样本抽取一个去噪阈值（在 latent 位置与 replay 更新之间共享），无梯度地重放多步三角去噪；更新后低于阈值的状态被替换为噪声匹配的 ground truth，达到或高于阈值的保留模型预测，得到的 latent 窗口再进入标准训练更新。该构造同时支持监督训练 (TR) 与分布匹配 (TR-DMD)。
Result: 在 HumanML3D 测试提示的 120 秒运动生成上，TR 与 TR-DMD 分别在各自非 DMD 与 DMD 对比组内取得 state-of-the-art FID AUC；相对匹配的无 replay 后训练，监督式 TR 使 FID AUC 降低 40.9%，FID 退化斜率降低 55.3%。
Conclusion: 长时程运动扩散的误差累积主要来自训练窗口与生成状态的失配，把 replay 与 ground-truth clamping 推广到部分去噪状态即可在 120 秒尺度上显著压低 FID 退化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Unbiased Top-$k$ Estimation for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) is becoming an important component of large language model (LLM) post-training for transferring the reasoning capability of a strong teacher LLM to a weaker student LLM. OPD trains the student by minimizing the reverse KL divergence between the teacher and the student via rollouts generated by the student's policy. However, estimating the gradient of the reverse KL divergence in OPD remains a challenge. Using only the sampled token from the student-generated rollout is computationally cheap but provides limited distributional supervision, which will degrade accuracy. In addition, using the full vocabulary provides complete distributional supervision but is computationally expensive. Therefore, recent works propose Top-$k$ OPD (TK-OPD) that use selected top-$k$ tokens, which provides richer distributional supervision than sampled-token estimation at substantially lower computational cost than full-vocabulary estimation. Unfortunately, using only the selected top-$k$ tokens induces bias, leading to accuracy degradation, as the probability mass outside the selected top-$k$ tokens is discarded. To address the bias of TK-OPD, we propose Tail-Corrected Top-$k$ On-Policy Distillation (TT-OPD). It preserves the advantages of TK-OPD, including rich distributional supervision and low computational cost, while providing an unbiased estimator of the gradient of the reverse KL divergence. The key insight of TT-OPD is to use not only the selected top-$k$ tokens, but also the sampled token from the student-generated rollout, thereby recovering the discarded probability mass in expectation, avoiding the bias. Experimental results demonstrate that TT-OPD significantly outperforms other tested OPD variants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Top-k on-policy distillation 因丢弃 top-k 之外的概率质量而使 reverse KL 梯度估计有偏、精度下降；TT-OPD 在选中的 top-k token 之外再加入学生 rollout 中实际采样的 token，期望上恢复被丢弃的质量，从而得到无偏估计，同时保留 TK-OPD 的分布监督与低计算成本。实验中 TT-OPD 显著优于所测的其他 OPD 变体。
Motivation: OPD 用学生 rollout 上的 reverse KL 把强教师推理能力蒸馏给弱学生，但其梯度估计两难：只用采样 token 便宜却监督信号稀疏、掉精度；用全词表监督完整却计算昂贵。Top-k 折中方案又因丢弃 top-k 之外的概率质量引入偏差。
Method: 提出 Tail-Corrected Top-k On-Policy Distillation (TT-OPD)：在 TK-OPD 选中的 top-k token 基础上，额外纳入学生自生成 rollout 中实际采样的 token，用该尾部样本在期望意义上补回被截断的概率质量，构造 reverse KL 梯度的无偏估计，同时维持 TK-OPD 的丰富分布监督与低计算开销。
Result: 实验结果显示 TT-OPD 显著优于其他被测试的 OPD 变体（摘要未给出具体数值、数据集或基线名称）。
Conclusion: 把截断的 top-k 项与 rollout 采样 token 结合做尾部修正，可以在不牺牲计算效率的前提下消除 TK-OPD 的梯度偏差，是 OPD 中更优的估计方案。

papers.title: Jev in Medicine: A Benchmark Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Jev is a non-generative "System One" model that assigns probabilities to predefined answer options and cannot answer outside them. Its accuracy and calibration on medical question-answering and case-based diagnostic-reasoning tasks are unknown. We evaluated Jev 1.13 on four medical benchmarks: MetaMedQA, PubMedQA, DiagnosisArena-MCQ and the NEJM Case Challenges. GPT-6 Sol, with (medium) and without reasoning, was the reference. The primary outcome was top-1 accuracy; key secondary outcomes were calibration, selective prediction and recognition of unanswerable questions. All 8,469 requests returned a valid answer. Jev's accuracy was similar to that of GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning on PubMedQA (78.4% vs 78.2%;), lower on MetaMedQA (74.8% vs 82.7%) and much lower on DiagnosisArena-MCQ (59.8% vs 82.4%;) and the NEJM cases (61.8% vs 82.4%). On MetaMedQA, Jev's probabilities were the best calibrated (expected calibration error 0.063 vs 0.146), and its answers with a probability of at least 0.9 (52.9% of questions) were 93.4% accurate, but GPT-6 Sol was as accurate when it accepted a similar proportion of questions. On DiagnosisArena-MCQ, Jev's probabilities discriminated poorly (AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768). Of the 162 questions whose correct answer was "I don't know or cannot answer", Jev chose that option for 10.5% (GPT-6 Sol, 8.6%). Median latency was 0.27-0.31 s; all 2,823 items cost USD 0.08. Jev was fast and inexpensive, and its accuracy was similar to that of a frontier LLM on research abstracts but lower on examination questions and much lower on complex diagnostic cases. Task-specific validation is required before clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Jev 1.13 这个非生成式 System One 模型在四个医学基准上被评测：PubMedQA top-1 准确率 78.4% 与 GPT-6 Sol 中等推理（78.2%）相当，但 MetaMedQA 74.8% vs 82.7%、DiagnosisArena-MCQ 59.8% vs 82.4%、NEJM 病例 61.8% vs 82.4% 明显落后。其概率在 MetaMedQA 上校准最好（ECE 0.063 vs 0.146），但在 DiagnosisArena-MCQ 上判别力差（AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768）；作者结论是临床使用前必须做任务特定验证。
Motivation: Jev 只能对预定义选项赋概率、不能越出选项作答，其在医学问答与病例诊断推理任务上的准确率与校准表现此前未知。
Method: 评测 Jev 1.13 于四个医学基准 MetaMedQA、PubMedQA、DiagnosisArena-MCQ 与 NEJM Case Challenges，以 GPT-6 Sol（带与不带 medium reasoning）为参照；主要终点为 top-1 准确率，次要终点为校准、选择性预测与对不可回答问题的识别，共 8,469 次请求。
Result: 全部 8,469 次请求均返回有效答案。准确率：PubMedQA 78.4% vs GPT-6 Sol 78.2%，MetaMedQA 74.8% vs 82.7%，DiagnosisArena-MCQ 59.8% vs 82.4%，NEJM 病例 61.8% vs 82.4%。MetaMedQA 上 Jev 校准最好（ECE 0.063 vs 0.146），概率≥0.9 的题目占 52.9%、准确率 93.4%，但 GPT-6 Sol 接受相近比例时同样准确；DiagnosisArena-MCQ 上 AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768。162 道正确答案为“不知道/无法回答”的题中，Jev 选该选项 10.5%（GPT-6 Sol 8.6%）。中位延迟 0.27–0.31 s，2,823 项成本合计 USD 0.08。
Conclusion: Jev 快且便宜，在研究摘要类任务（PubMedQA）上与前沿 LLM 相当，但在考试题与复杂诊断病例上明显更弱，临床使用前需任务特定验证。

papers.title: Learning to Sell: Reinforcement Learning for Strategic Large Language Model Agents in Multi-Product Markets
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous large language model (LLM) agents operating in multi-product markets must make sequential decisions under information asymmetry and resource constraints. We develop a machine learning approach for training such agents to act effectively as sellers in a multi-item bargaining environment, where a seller concurrently negotiates a catalog of substitutable assets across a pool of independent buyers. Buyers hold private, heterogeneous valuations across products, and each can purchase at most one item. Facing limits on total communication turns, the seller must dynamically match buyers with the most profitable products considering their private valuations, while strategically allocating its limited interaction budget toward combinations of greater potential value. We formalize this problem as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process using a structured, four-part message protocol that maps natural language into a parsable and regulated decision space. Using this formalization, we design a post-training method using Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). To evaluate this framework, we construct a multidimensional metric suite that quantifies constraint adherence, seller surplus extraction, and allocation quality. Our trained seller agent learns to match limited inventory to buyers more effectively, matching or outperforming trillion-parameter frontier models in both seller surplus extraction and buyer-product allocation quality. Finally, these learned strategies generalize robustly to unseen market structures, correlated valuation distributions, and price ranges not encountered during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多商品议价卖家形式化为带四段式消息协议的 POMDP，用 RLVR 后训练 LLM 卖家智能体，在总对话轮数受限下同时决定给哪个买家推哪个可替代商品。训练后的智能体在卖方剩余提取与买家-商品分配质量上匹配或超过万亿参数前沿模型，并能泛化到未见过的市场结构、相关估值分布与价格区间。
Motivation: LLM 智能体在信息不对称与通信预算受限的多商品市场中做序贯决策时，缺少把自然语言谈判约束进可验证决策空间并按可核查奖励训练的框架。
Method: 将多商品议价形式化为 POMDP，用结构化的四段式消息协议把自然语言映射为可解析、受约束的决策空间；在此形式化上设计基于 Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) 的后训练方法，并构建量化约束遵守、卖方剩余提取与分配质量的多维指标套件。
Result: 训练出的卖家智能体在卖方剩余提取与买家-商品分配质量两项指标上匹配或超过万亿参数前沿模型；策略泛化到训练中未见的市场结构、相关估值分布与价格区间。
Conclusion: 在受约束的多商品谈判中，用可验证奖励做 RL 后训练能让较小的 LLM 智能体学会在通信预算内分配库存与谈判轮次，且策略可迁移到未见过的市场条件。

papers.title: FloodDiffusion 2: Efficient and Path Controllable Streaming Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present FloodDiffusion 2 (FD2), an efficient and controllable framework that builds upon FloodDiffusion (FD1), a state-of-the-art streaming motion generation model. While FD1 produces plausible motion, it suffers from low efficiency and limited controllability, as its attention design requires repeated computation over the entire history, and it lacks precise trajectory control for real-world applications. To address these limitations and improve generation quality, FD2 introduces three advances. First, Partial Attention makes finalized history representations independent of the active window, enabling KV-cached inference and shared-history packing for efficient training. Second, we establish a necessary-and-sufficient Bregman criterion for regression losses to preserve diffusion's conditional-mean velocity field. This criterion guides an FK-induced quadratic loss that incorporates motion geometry without online FK evaluation. Third, FD2 introduces precise path conditioning to control the character's root trajectory while preserving natural body motion. Experiments show that FD2 reduces training computation by 4.6$\times$ and accelerates denoising by 11.29$\times$, reaching 2.303 ms per update on long sequences. Alongside these efficiency gains, FD2 improves motion quality over FD1 and achieves state-of-the-art FID scores among streaming methods, with 0.048 on SEED and 0.053 on HumanML3D.
papers.comment: 27 pages. Updated author affiliations and corresponding-author information. Code: https://github.com/AlayaLab/FloodDiffusion2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FloodDiffusion 2 (FD2) 是流式人体动作生成框架，用 Partial Attention 让已定稿历史表征与活动窗口解耦，从而支持 KV 缓存推理与共享历史打包；并给出回归损失保持扩散条件均值速度场的充要 Bregman 判据，据此设计免在线 FK 计算的 FK 诱导二次损失，再加入精确路径条件控制角色根轨迹。训练计算量降 4.6×，去噪加速 11.29×（长序列单步 2.303 ms），FID 在 SEED 上 0.048、HumanML3D 上 0.053，为流式方法中 SOTA。
Motivation: FD1 虽能生成合理动作，但注意力需对整段历史反复计算导致效率低，且缺乏精确轨迹控制，难以用于真实场景。
Method: FD2 三项设计：Partial Attention 使已定稿历史表征独立于活动窗口，支持 KV-cached 推理与 shared-history packing 训练；证明回归损失保持扩散条件均值速度场的充要 Bregman 判据，并据此构造引入动作几何的 FK 诱导二次损失（无需在线 FK 计算）；加入精确 path conditioning 控制角色根轨迹同时保留自然身体动作。
Result: 训练计算量减少 4.6×，去噪加速 11.29×，长序列每步更新 2.303 ms；动作质量优于 FD1，流式方法中 FID 达 SOTA：SEED 0.048，HumanML3D 0.053。
Conclusion: 让历史表征与活动窗口解耦可同时换来 KV 缓存推理与训练打包的效率收益，而 Bregman 判据指明的损失设计能在不引入在线 FK 的前提下保住扩散速度场并提升动作质量与路径可控性。

papers.title: What Does a Skill Actually Do? Estimands and Evaluation Validity for Tool and Skill Use in LLM Agents: A Critical Review
papers.abstract_en: Reported improvements from tools and reusable skills in large language model agents refer to different comparisons. This critical narrative review examines what these evaluations estimate and which conclusions their designs support. The review checks the roles of one hundred cited papers and extracts focal evaluation designs in detail from thirty-five studies. Targeted readings of thirty-five additional published or accepted studies broaden coverage of tool creation, memory, interactive benchmarks, reliability, and risk. Designs are characterized by treatment contrast, target population, outcome, budget constraint, summary measure, and identification assumptions. Analytic decompositions and counterexamples show that pairing runs on the same task does not itself identify an invocation effect when evaluation conditions on a trigger within the treated run. Paired gain and regression counts describe discordance under the coupling protocol rather than the share of tasks whose expected outcomes worsen. Total effects of deploying a module answer a different question from efficiency under a common budget. Comparisons across studies distinguish curated skill provision from retriever replacement, task populations from triggered subsets, and preparation costs from marginal usage costs. Publication status and reading depth are recorded. The review provides a methodological synthesis and a reporting checklist to help align claims about tools and skills with the comparisons their evaluation designs support.
papers.comment: 50 pages; critical narrative review. Expanded literature coverage and study-level evidence tables; clarified evaluation estimands and methodological analyses; revised figures and text
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于 LLM agent 工具与可复用 skill 评估有效性的批判性综述：把评估设计拆成处理对比、目标总体、结果、预算约束、汇总度量与识别假设六个维度，用解析分解与反例证明若干常见对比并不识别它们声称的效应。核心结论是，同一任务上的配对运行若在处理组内以触发条件 (trigger) 为条件，本身不能识别调用效应；配对增益/回归计数只描述耦合协议下的不一致，而非期望结果变差的任务占比。
Motivation: 工具与 skill 给 LLM agent 带来的“提升”在不同论文里指代不同对比，读者无法判断某个数字支持哪种结论，跨研究比较尤其容易把不同总体、不同成本口径的数字混为一谈。
Method: 批判性叙述综述：核查 100 篇被引论文的角色，从 35 项研究中详细抽取评估设计，另对 35 项已发表或已接收研究做定向阅读以覆盖工具创建、记忆、交互式基准、可靠性与风险；用处理对比、目标总体、结果、预算约束、汇总度量、识别假设刻画设计，并给出解析分解与反例。
Result: 综述覆盖 100 篇被引论文、35 项详细抽取设计的研究与 35 项定向阅读研究；给出的反例表明配对运行在以触发为条件时不识别调用效应，配对增益与回归计数只刻画耦合协议下的不一致，部署模块的总效应与共同预算下的效率是不同问题。
Conclusion: 关于工具与 skill 的论断必须与其评估设计实际支持的对比对齐；作者据此给出一套报告清单，并记录各研究的发表状态与阅读深度。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 这是一篇关于 LLM agent 工具与可复用 skill 评估有效性的批判性综述：把评估设计拆成处理对比、目标总体、结果、预算约束、汇总度量与识别假设六个维度，用解析分解与反例证明若干常见对比并不识别它们声称的效应。核心结论是，同一任务上的配对运行若在处理组内以触发条件 (trigger) 为条件，本身不能识别调用效应；配对增益/回归计数只描述耦合协议下的不一致，而非期望结果变差的任务占比。
summary_sections.motivation: 工具与 skill 给 LLM agent 带来的“提升”在不同论文里指代不同对比，读者无法判断某个数字支持哪种结论，跨研究比较尤其容易把不同总体、不同成本口径的数字混为一谈。

papers.title: Not Too Hard, Not Too Easy: Learning from Intermediate States for LLM Structured Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: A common principle of effective learning is to practice material that is neither already mastered nor too difficult to permit progress. We ask how to apply this principle to structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and maze solving. In these tasks, a model can repeatedly revise an incomplete or incorrect candidate solution until it satisfies the problem's constraints. The intermediate candidate solutions along this trajectory provide natural training examples: some are already solved, some cannot yet be repaired by the model, and others lie at its current frontier of achievable progress. We therefore investigate whether pretrained language models can learn to revise such states and whether training on states at this frontier improves reasoning more broadly. To achieve this, we couple a pretrained language-model backbone with a recurrent updater that repeatedly revises an explicit solution state, using the same parameters at every update step. We further introduce Frontier-Oriented Curation Using Self-trajectories (FOCUS), which selects training states from trajectories generated by the current model. FOCUS measures how much the model improves each state within a fixed number of recurrent updates and prioritizes states from which it can make substantial progress. With Qwen3-1.7B, FOCUS achieves 64.4% exact solve accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme and 91.1% on Maze-Hard, with similar gains observed across five Qwen and Llama backbones spanning 1.7B to 8B parameters. We further observe zero-shot transfer in the adapted LLM to mathematical reasoning and code execution, even when the recurrent updater is disabled and no downstream fine-tuning is performed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FOCUS（Frontier-Oriented Curation Using Self-trajectories）：用语言模型骨干加共享参数的循环更新器反复修订显式解状态，只挑模型在固定步数内能取得实质进展的“前沿”中间状态做训练。Qwen3-1.7B 上 Sudoku-Extreme 精确解题率达 64.4%、Maze-Hard 达 91.1%，且在五个 1.7B–8B 的 Qwen/Llama 骨干上均有提升，并零样本迁移到数学推理与代码执行。
Motivation: 结构化推理任务（数独、迷宫）中模型会反复修订候选解，但已会的和修不动的状态都不适合训练；如何系统挑选处于当前能力前沿的中间状态作为训练样本尚不清楚。
Method: 将预训练语言模型骨干与循环更新器 (recurrent updater) 耦合，每步用同一组参数反复修订显式解状态；FOCUS 从当前模型自生成轨迹中选状态，度量模型在固定次数循环更新内对该状态的改进量，优先选取能取得大幅进展的状态作为训练样本。
Result: Qwen3-1.7B + FOCUS 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上取得 64.4% exact solve accuracy，在 Maze-Hard 上取得 91.1%；在五个 Qwen 与 Llama 骨干（1.7B 至 8B 参数）上观察到相似增益；适配后的 LLM 在关闭循环更新器且不做下游微调的情况下，仍对数学推理与代码执行呈现 zero-shot transfer。
Conclusion: 在模型可修复的前沿中间状态上训练，能同时提升结构化推理本身并外溢到数学与代码任务，且不依赖推理时的循环更新器。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning Social Navigation from Internet Videos in the Policy State Space
papers.abstract_en: Training robust social-navigation policies requires simulators with diverse scene layouts, terrain, and human motion, but constructing such environments and specifying pedestrian behavior is costly. We propose an efficient pipeline that converts ordinary monocular walking videos directly into closed-loop social-navigation training environments in the policy's state space. Our key observation is that local social navigation primarily depends on two types of information: where the robot can traverse and how nearby pedestrians move. We therefore represent the static scene as a metric traversability map, which can be rigidly transformed under counterfactual robot motion, while directly replaying the pedestrian trajectories recovered from the video over time. This abstraction allows us to define the forward dynamics directly in the policy's state space and efficiently simulate counterfactual robot states without reconstructing or rendering photorealistic observations. The resulting policy achieves 81.2% success in the independent Arena benchmark, compared with 75.0% for the strongest baseline, and succeeds in 19/20 real-robot trials without policy fine-tuning. Project page: https://jiaming.im/VideoSocNav
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把普通单目行走视频直接转成策略状态空间里的闭环社交导航训练环境：静态场景编码为可随反事实机器人运动刚体变换的度量可通行图，行人轨迹从视频恢复后按时间直接回放，从而在不重建或渲染照片级观测的前提下定义前向动力学。训练出的策略在独立 Arena benchmark 上成功率 81.2%（最强基线 75.0%），实机 20 次试验成功 19 次且无需微调。
Motivation: 社交导航策略训练依赖场景布局、地形与行人运动多样的模拟器，而搭建这类环境并指定行人行为成本高昂。
Method: 流水线将单目行走视频转为策略状态空间的闭环训练环境：静态场景表示为度量可通行图 (metric traversability map)，可在反事实机器人运动下刚体变换；行人轨迹从视频恢复后按时间回放；由此直接在策略状态空间定义前向动力学并高效模拟反事实机器人状态，无需重建或渲染照片级观测。
Result: 在独立 Arena benchmark 上策略成功率 81.2%，最强基线为 75.0%；实机试验 20 次成功 19 次，且未做策略微调。
Conclusion: 可通行图加行人轨迹回放这一状态空间抽象，足以从互联网视频造出可训练社交导航策略的闭环环境，得到的策略能零微调迁移到实机。

papers.title: Convergent Plug-and-Play Image Restoration with Annealed Noise Levels
papers.abstract_en: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods solve imaging inverse problems by incorporating deep denoisers into iterative optimization algorithms. Although practical implementations often decrease the denoiser noise level $σ$ along iterations, most existing convergence analyses assume a fixed denoiser. In this work, we establish convergence guarantees for a broad family of Plug-and-Play algorithms with annealed noise level, spanning deterministic methods (RED--GD and PnP--PGD) and stochastic methods (SNORE, equivariant RED, and a variant of PnP--Flow). For each method, we identify an explicit, nonconvex objective associated with the terminal denoising level and prove asymptotic stationarity of the iterates with respect to this objective. Our analysis does not prescribe any decay rate for the noise schedule, and our assumptions cover both learned gradient-step denoisers and exact MMSE denoisers. Overall, our theoretical results bridge the gap between existing PnP convergence theory and the decreasing-denoising practices used by state-of-the-art image restoration methods. We empirically demonstrate the benefits of such schedules and illustrate the predicted convergence behavior on several imaging inverse problems, including inpainting, super-resolution, demosaicing and tomography.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为噪声水平 σ 沿迭代退火 (annealed) 的 Plug-and-Play 图像复原算法建立收敛保证：对 RED-GD、PnP-PGD、SNORE、equivariant RED 与 PnP-Flow 变体，各自给出与终端去噪水平对应的显式非凸目标，并证明迭代序列对该目标渐近驻定。分析不规定任何噪声衰减速率，同时覆盖 learned gradient-step denoisers 与 exact MMSE denoisers，并在 inpainting、super-resolution、demosaicing、tomography 上展示退火调度的收益与预测的收敛行为。
Motivation: 实际 PnP 实现普遍沿迭代降低去噪器噪声水平 σ，但现有收敛分析几乎都假设固定去噪器，理论与 SOTA 图像复原实践之间存在缺口。
Method: 对一族 PnP 算法（确定性 RED-GD、PnP-PGD 与随机 SNORE、equivariant RED、PnP-Flow 变体）在退火噪声水平下，为每种方法构造与终端去噪水平关联的显式非凸目标，证明迭代对该目标的渐近驻定性；假设同时适用于 learned gradient-step denoisers 与 exact MMSE denoisers，且不对噪声调度的衰减速率作任何规定。
Result: 给出一族退火 PnP 方法的收敛定理（渐近驻定，无衰减速率约束），并在多个成像逆问题上实证展示退火调度的收益与理论预测的收敛行为，任务包括 inpainting、super-resolution、demosaicing 与 tomography。
Conclusion: 退火噪声水平的 PnP 算法可以拥有与固定去噪器理论对齐的收敛保证，从而把现有 PnP 收敛理论与图像复原实践中递减去噪的做法衔接起来。

papers.title: Fewer Tokens, More Self-Teaching: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Extreme Visual Token Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Visual token reduction is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but performance deteriorates rapidly under extremely low token budgets. Existing work has explored both visual-token selection and training-based adaptation to reduced visual inputs. We take a step further by asking how a heavily compressed MLLM should learn from the states induced by its own generations. This setting naturally calls for on-policy self-distillation: a heavily compressed model is supervised on the states induced by its own generations, while its full-token counterpart serves as an information-rich teacher. Based on this insight, we propose LT-OPD, a training framework for extreme visual-token reduction. The student rolls out responses with only a small fraction of visual tokens, and a frozen full-token copy of the same MLLM provides distributional supervision along these student-generated trajectories. To stabilize on-policy learning when visual evidence is severely limited, we further introduce a budget-level curriculum that progressively decreases the token budget during training. Across nine benchmarks on Qwen3.5-4B, LT-OPD raises average retained performance under 5% visual-token retention from 68.6% to 82.3%, outperforming training-free, training-based, and reinforcement-learning baselines at the same budget. The gains transfer consistently to Qwen3.5-9B, GLM-4.6V-9B, and LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B. LT-OPD also reduces KV-cache usage by 85.2% and prefill FLOPs by 85.4% without additional inference overhead, demonstrating that on-policy learning can substantially recover capabilities lost to extreme visual-token reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LT-OPD 让只保留极少量视觉 token 的 MLLM 用自己生成的回答做 on-policy 自蒸馏，由冻结的全 token 同模型在学生生成轨迹上提供分布监督，并用逐步降低 token 预算的 budget-level curriculum 稳定训练。在 Qwen3.5-4B 的九个 benchmark 上，5% 视觉 token 保留率的平均保持性能从 68.6% 提到 82.3%，同时 KV-cache 用量降 85.2%、prefill FLOPs 降 85.4%。
Motivation: 视觉 token 削减能加速 MLLM，但在极低 token 预算下性能迅速恶化；现有选择式与训练适配方法都未回答压缩模型应如何从自身生成状态中学习。
Method: LT-OPD 训练框架：学生只用少量视觉 token rollout 回答，冻结的全 token 同模型副本沿学生生成轨迹提供分布级监督（on-policy self-distillation）；训练中引入 budget-level curriculum，逐步下调 token 预算以稳定视觉证据严重受限时的 on-policy 学习。
Result: Qwen3.5-4B 上九个 benchmark 平均保持性能在 5% 视觉 token 保留率下由 68.6% 升至 82.3%，在同预算下超过 training-free、training-based 与强化学习基线；增益迁移到 Qwen3.5-9B、GLM-4.6V-9B、LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B；KV-cache 用量减少 85.2%，prefill FLOPs 减少 85.4%，无额外推理开销。
Conclusion: on-policy 自蒸馏加预算课程能大幅回收极端视觉 token 削减损失的多模态能力，且不增加推理开销，可跨多个 MLLM 主干迁移。

papers.title: Devol-ONE: One Autoregressive Mixture of Transformers to Unify Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Action (VLA) models condition actions directly on current visual and language context, without an explicit account of how the scene evolves under candidate actions. World Action Models (WAM) attempt to address this limitation by predicting future states, but existing designs keep prediction and policy learning architecturally separate, connecting them only through the predicted output, whether through pixel space video generation or a latent forecasting module trained independently of the policy. We present Devol-ONE, a Mixture of Transformers architecture that unifies vision language understanding, latent world dynamics prediction, and action generation within a single autoregressive framework. Instead of encoding vision language tokens once and feeding them to the action expert, Devol-ONE runs autoregressive prediction jointly across a vision language stream and a V-JEPA pretrained dynamics stream, attending to the vision language key-value cache at every layer to forecast future latent states under language guidance. The action expert is in turn shaped continuously by semantic reasoning and predicted physical dynamics rather than by a fixed representation computed in advance. Extensive experiments are conducted on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RoboTwin2.0 along with real-world evaluation on Flexiv single-arm and dual-arm setups. Ablation studies show the effectiveness of dynamic stream prediction and layer-wise unified attention to validate our model architectural coherency.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: DOHF: Online Diffusion Fine-tuning with Doob's $h$-transform Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Reward-based diffusion fine-tuning faces practical challenges when desirable outcomes are rare or conditioning corrections are costly to estimate. In this work, we propose Diffusion Online $h$-guidance Fine-tuning (DOHF), which turns Doob's $h$-transform into a practical online training algorithm. DOHF assigns optimality weights to generated samples, estimates the normalized local correction $\nabla\log h$ under the current rollout policy, and distills it directly into the generative model. Theoretically, we characterize the population-optimal DiffusionNFT update as well as the various classfier free guidance methods through a unified $h$-transform perspective. Methodologically, our framework accommodates black-box and non-differentiable rewards without additional network evaluations. We further show improved alignments under three empirical scenarios. Our work demonstrates how adapting probabilistic conditioning through inexpensive estimation and iterative distillation can improve generative learning across statistical sampling and visual generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DOHF 把 Doob's h-transform 变成可在线执行的扩散微调算法：给生成样本赋 optimality 权重，在当前 rollout 策略下估计归一化局部修正 ∇log h，并直接蒸馏进生成模型。它支持黑盒、不可微奖励且不需额外网络评估，在统计采样与视觉生成三类场景中展示对齐改善。
Motivation: 基于奖励的扩散微调在理想结果稀少、或条件修正代价高昂时难以落地：奖励信号难估、需要可微且反复调用网络。
Method: Diffusion Online h-guidance Fine-tuning (DOHF)：对生成样本赋 optimality 权重，在当前 rollout 策略下估计归一化局部修正 ∇log h，再迭代蒸馏进生成模型；理论上用统一的 h-transform 视角刻画 population-optimal DiffusionNFT 更新与各类 classifier free guidance 方法。
Result: 在三个实证场景中展示改进的对齐 (improved alignments)；框架可容纳黑盒与不可微奖励，且无需额外网络评估。
Conclusion: 通过廉价估计与迭代蒸馏来调制概率条件，可以改善统计采样与视觉生成中的生成学习；h-transform 提供了统一理解 DiffusionNFT 与 classifier free guidance 的视角。

papers.title: Group recovery after trimming, and level-free flagging, in robust clusterwise regression
papers.abstract_en: Trimming methods for robust clusterwise regression discard a fixed fraction of the data. Too low a level breaks the fit; too generous a level can trim away a small group. We first propose a group-recovery step that can follow any trimming or flagging method: it searches the discarded units for a line, tests whether those near it form a peak rather than a band, and restores the line as a group when the likelihood of Gaussian groups plus uniform noise improves by a margin like that of the Bayesian information criterion. In simulations it repaired the failures of a generous TCLUST-REG level with unequal groups, but not with three or four groups. The second proposal, ESF (exact-subsample flagging), is a flagging procedure without a trimming level: it solves the clusterwise least-squares problem exactly on small subsamples, flags units far from the best fit, and draws later subsamples from the rest. Two constants stand in for the level: a subsample size, set from a lower bound on the smallest group proportion, and a cap on the flagged set. It is meant for data about whose contamination nothing is known: TCLUST-REG at the fixed level 0.30, followed by reweighting and the recovery step, was as accurate as ESF on average up to a fifth of outliers, and higher levels were more accurate beyond. The flagged fraction estimates the contamination only when the errors are close to Gaussian. On taxi fares with known tariffs, ESF found both in every sample.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 2 figures; supplementary material (54 pages) as an ancillary file. Version 2 is a rewritten paper with a new title. Code and raw results: https://github.com/sorujov/eesp, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23046086
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对稳健分组回归 (robust clusterwise regression) 中截断水平 (trimming level) 难选的问题，提出两步：可接在任意截断/标记方法后的 group-recovery 步骤，以及无需截断水平的 ESF (exact-subsample flagging)。模拟中 recovery 修复了宽松 TCLUST-REG 水平在不等大分组下的失败（三或四个分组时无效）；TCLUST-REG 固定水平 0.30 加 reweighting 与 recovery 在离群比例不超过约五分之一时平均精度与 ESF 相当，更高水平在超过该比例后更准。
Motivation: 截断水平取低会破坏拟合，取高会把小组整体剪掉；对污染程度未知的数据缺少不依赖该水平的分组回归方法。
Method: group-recovery 步骤在被丢弃单元中搜索一条直线，检验其邻近点是否构成峰 (peak) 而非带 (band)，当高斯分组加均匀噪声的似然改善达到类似 BIC 的边际时把该线恢复为分组。ESF 在小子样本上精确求解 clusterwise 最小二乘，标记远离最优拟合的单元，后续子样本从剩余部分抽取；用两个常数替代水平：由最小分组比例下界设定的子样本量，以及被标记集合的上限。
Result: 模拟中 recovery 修复了宽松 TCLUST-REG 水平在不等大分组下的失败，但在三或四个分组时不成功；TCLUST-REG 固定水平 0.30 加 reweighting 与 recovery 在离群比例不超过五分之一时平均精度与 ESF 相当，更高水平在超过该比例后更准确；被标记比例仅在误差接近高斯时估计污染；在已知费率的出租车车费数据上，ESF 每次采样都找出两条费率。
Conclusion: 截断水平可用恢复步骤与基于子样本的标记来替代，但 recovery 依赖分组数与规模结构，被标记比例只在近高斯误差下才是污染的有效估计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Amadeus: When Models of People Meet
papers.abstract_en: With the constant advancements in AI, one possibility is to model agents after humans and, in turn, use these agents to carry out synthetic interactions. Such models could be used to predict interactions between their real counterparts, or potentially interactions at larger scales. In this paper, we test a more controlled version of this question through chess. We use 8 elite chess players, seal their direct pairwise games, learn each player independently using different methods, and then compose the resulting models on the withheld dyads. To evaluate the generated interactions, we use two measurements: opening-family total variation distance and win-draw-loss (WDL) total variation distance. M1 primarily improves WDL fidelity while producing smaller opening-family improvements, whereas M2 produces much larger opening-family improvements while having little effect on WDL-TV. For opening-family behaviour under M2, the correct assignment of the eight learned player identities also gives the closest match among all $8! = 40{,}320$ possible assignments. These results show that at least some properties of previously unseen interactions can be recovered from independently learned individuals. The partial recovery observed here may reflect limitations of the current individual modelling methods rather than a fundamental limit on compositional interaction recovery. An additional post-hoc method that combines the two mechanisms improves both measurements, suggesting that recovery across these behavioural properties is not necessarily mutually exclusive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用国际象棋做受控实验：封存 8 名精英棋手的两两对局，各自独立学出个体模型，再在留出的配对上组合，检验未见交互能否被恢复。M1 主要改善 WDL 总变差距离 (WDL-TV)，M2 大幅改善开局族 TV 而对 WDL-TV 几乎无影响；M2 下 8 个已学身份的正确指派在 8! = 40,320 种排列中最接近真实，事后组合两种机制可同时改善两项指标。
Motivation: 把人类建成模型后做合成交互，能否外推到未观测的真实交互（含更大规模）尚不清楚；本文用棋局这一可控场景检验该问题。
Method: 取 8 名精英棋手，封存其直接两两对局，用不同方法各自独立学习每个棋手的模型，再在留出的配对 (dyads) 上组合这些模型；用开局族总变差距离与胜负平 (WDL) 总变差距离两项指标评估生成交互，并比较 8! = 40,320 种身份指派。
Result: M1 主要提升 WDL 保真度、开局族改善较小；M2 开局族改善大得多而对 WDL-TV 影响很小；M2 下正确的八身份指派在全部 40,320 种可能指派中最接近真实；事后结合两种机制的方法同时改善两项指标。
Conclusion: 至少部分未见交互性质可从独立学习的个体模型中恢复；当前的部分恢复可能源于个体建模方法的局限，而非组合式交互恢复的根本极限，且两类行为性质的恢复并不互斥。

papers.title: A Living Benchmark for Information Retrieval from Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based clinical assistants are increasingly being integrated into electronic health record (EHR) systems, transforming how clinicians retrieve and synthesize information from patient records. Their safety and utility depend on rigorous evaluation, yet existing benchmarks are manually curated, costly to update, and rapidly become obsolete with evolving technological advancements. We present a scalable framework that automatically generates question--answer pairs from longitudinal EHR notes. Nineteen clinicians validate the benchmark generator, producing the Benchmark for Retrieving Information in EHRs (BRIE), a continuously maintainable evaluation dataset. Across nine LLMs and five inference strategies, state-of-the-art systems frequently omit clinically important information, particularly for questions requiring synthesis across multiple documents and encounters. Because the generator itself is validated, BRIE supports evaluations that static benchmarks cannot, including the generation of multiple answers that reflect variation in clinician reasoning for robust performance assessment and continuously refreshing benchmark content to guard against leakage. Our results demonstrate that scalable benchmark generation enables rigorous, up-to-date evaluation of clinical LLMs as they are deployed in rapidly evolving healthcare settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可自动从纵向 EHR 病历生成问答对的框架，经 19 位临床医生验证后产出可持续维护的基准 BRIE。在 9 个 LLM 与 5 种推理策略上，前沿系统经常遗漏临床关键信息，尤其是需要跨多次就诊、多份文档综合的问题。
Motivation: 临床 LLM 助手的安全性依赖评测，但现有基准靠人工标注、更新昂贵，且随技术迭代迅速过时。
Method: 可扩展框架从纵向 EHR 病历自动生成问答对，由 19 位临床医生验证生成器，产出可持续维护的 BRIE 数据集；因生成器本身经过验证，可生成反映临床推理差异的多个答案并持续刷新内容以防泄漏。
Result: 在 9 个 LLM 与 5 种推理策略的评测中，state-of-the-art 系统频繁遗漏临床重要信息，跨文档与跨就诊的综合类问题尤其突出。
Conclusion: 经验证的可扩展基准生成能支撑静态基准做不到的持续更新与多答案稳健评测，使临床 LLM 评测跟上快速演进的部署环境。

papers.title: When Fancy Eviction Fails: Rethinking Cache Replacement For LLM Prefix Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Long-running LLM applications repeatedly send growing context, making prefix caching critical for reducing prefill cost. Yet prefix-cache behavior under agentic workloads remains poorly understood. We study production traces from two companies and evaluate 14 eviction algorithms across HBM-constrained and large memory-pool settings. Despite a large gap to Belady, sophisticated policies designed for traditional caches provide little benefit over LRU. The reason is structural: prefix reuse is dominated by the regular pacing of active sessions, making recency unusually predictive. Prefix caching nevertheless introduces new challenges, including heavy-tailed session footprints and highly variable miss costs as attention computation grows with sequence length. We introduce the compute-savings ratio and two offline oracles to quantify these effects. Our results show that effective prefix-cache management should retain recency as its foundation while selectively adding quick demotion for one-hit prefixes, compute-aware partial eviction for expensive misses, and capacity-dependent eviction granularity. We will release the traces and simulator to support future research.

TL;DR: 在两家公司的生产 trace 上评测 14 种前缀缓存淘汰算法，发现面向传统缓存的复杂策略相对 LRU 几乎无增益，因为活跃会话的规则节奏使 recency 异常可预测。作者据此主张：前缀缓存管理应以 recency 为基础，再选择性加入一次性前缀快速降级、按计算代价的部分淘汰，以及随容量变化的淘汰粒度。
Motivation: 长运行 LLM 应用反复发送不断增长的上下文，前缀缓存 (prefix cache) 决定 prefill 成本，但其在 agentic 负载下的行为缺乏理解，传统缓存的高级淘汰策略是否适用并不清楚。

Result: 复杂策略相对 LRU 收益很小，尽管与 Belady 仍有很大差距；recency 因活跃会话的规则节奏而异常有预测力。将发布 trace 与 simulator。
Conclusion: 前缀缓存管理应保留 recency 作为基础，再叠加一次性前缀快速降级、计算感知的部分淘汰与容量相关的淘汰粒度。

papers.title: Pheno-GS: Phenoscape-scale Geodesic Sinkhorn
papers.abstract_en: High-throughput single-cell data is now collected across large patient cohorts. Understanding patient-level heterogeneity from cellular-level data motivates phenoscaping: embedding each single-cell distribution as a "datapoint," with distances given by optimal transport (OT). Computing geometry-aware OT at this scale, between all pairs of patient datasets, remains an open challenge, since existing methods either rely on Euclidean ground metrics that distort manifold structure or fail under sparse, unevenly sampled, or large-scale data. We present \textbf{Pheno-GS} (Phenoscape-scale Geodesic Sinkhorn), which computes accurate, scalable geodesic transport distances under noisy, unbalanced, large-scale settings via three components: ($1$) graph connectivity regularization for well-defined geodesics on sparse/disconnected manifolds; ($2$) an unbalanced OT formulation via KL marginal penalties; and ($3$) a batched matrix algorithm computing all pairwise distances in one heat diffusion (over $200 \times$ faster than Geodesic Sinkhorn for $500$ distributions). We validate Pheno-GS on synthetic benchmarks and a CyTOF perturbation dataset.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version accepted at IEEE MLSP 2026; notation corrections to mathematical typesetting
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Pheno-GS 把每个单细胞分布当作一个数据点做 phenoscape 级最优传输 (OT) 距离计算，在稀疏、非平衡、大规模条件下给出几何感知的测地传输距离。三个组件协同：图连通性正则保证稀疏/不连通流形上测地线良定义，KL 边缘罚项给出非平衡 OT，批量矩阵算法用一次热扩散算出全部成对距离，500 个分布时比 Geodesic Sinkhorn 快 200 倍以上。
Motivation: 大队列单细胞数据需要在患者级分布之间算几何感知 OT 距离，但现有方法要么用欧氏 ground metric 扭曲流形结构，要么在稀疏、非均匀采样或大规模数据上失效。
Method: Pheno-GS 由三部分组成：图连通性正则化 (graph connectivity regularization) 使稀疏/不连通流形上的测地线良定义；用 KL 边缘罚项构造非平衡 OT (unbalanced OT)；批量矩阵算法在一次热扩散 (heat diffusion) 中算出所有成对距离。
Result: 在合成基准与 CyTOF 扰动数据集上验证；500 个分布时批量热扩散算法比 Geodesic Sinkhorn 快 200 倍以上。
Conclusion: 把连通性正则、非平衡 OT 与批量热扩散合在一起，可以在噪声、非平衡、大规模单细胞数据上算出可扩展的测地传输距离。

papers.title: Transfer Learning with Conformalized Quantile Regression for Solar PV Forecasting Under Load-Shedding-Driven Data Scarcity
papers.abstract_en: Solar photovoltaic (PV) forecasting in regions affected by load shedding is challenging because reliable historical observations are scarce. This study proposes a transfer learning framework combined with Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR) to improve PV power forecasting and provide reliable uncertainty estimates under severe data scarcity. A source-domain PV dataset from Alice Springs, Australia, is used to pretrain a temporal forecasting model, which is then adapted to simulated Bangladesh PV data representing different levels of historical availability. Experimental results show that transfer learning reduces RMSE by up to 23.7% when only one month of target-domain data is available and by 13.7% with three months of data. The proposed Transfer Learning plus CQR framework achieves 94.3% empirical coverage with three months of target data while producing prediction intervals that are 14% narrower than those obtained without transfer learning. These results demonstrate that combining transfer learning with conformal uncertainty quantification can improve both point forecasting accuracy and uncertainty reliability when target-domain PV data are severely limited.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 1st International Conference on Next-Generation Electrical & Electronics, Computer Systems, and Technologies (iCONEECT 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在限电（load shedding）导致历史观测稀缺的地区，用 Alice Springs 的 PV 数据预训练时序模型再迁移到孟加拉国模拟 PV 数据，并叠加 Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR) 给出预测区间。目标域只有 1 个月数据时迁移学习把 RMSE 最多降低 23.7%，3 个月时降低 13.7%；3 个月数据下框架达到 94.3% 经验覆盖率，且区间比不迁移时窄 14%。
Motivation: 限电地区可靠历史 PV 观测稀缺，直接训练时序预测模型数据不足，点预报精度与不确定性区间都不可靠。
Method: 迁移学习 + CQR：用源域 Alice Springs (Australia) PV 数据集预训练时序预测模型，再适配到代表不同历史数据量的孟加拉国模拟 PV 数据；CQR 在其上生成保形分位数预测区间。
Result: 目标域仅 1 个月数据时迁移学习使 RMSE 最多下降 23.7%，3 个月数据时下降 13.7%；迁移 + CQR 在 3 个月目标数据下经验覆盖率达 94.3%，预测区间比无迁移学习的版本窄 14%。
Conclusion: 在目标域 PV 数据严重受限时，源域预训练与保形不确定性量化结合可同时改善点预报精度和区间可靠性。

papers.title: Signed Graph Pre-Training and Prompt Learning
papers.abstract_en: Signed graphs arise in trust--distrust networks, financial correlation systems, biological interaction graphs, and many other domains in which edges can be positive or negative and may also be directed. While signed graph neural networks have improved task-specific learning, graph transfer learning on signed graphs remains underdeveloped. In this paper, we introduce TopoSIGN, a pioneer topology-guided graph pre-training and prompt learning framework for signed graphs. TopoSIGN combines a structural encoder built on the magnetic signed Laplacian with a novel persistent-homology branch that summarizes signed topology through Dowker-complex persistence images. The fused embeddings are then transferred to a prompt learning function. Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the efficacy of TopoSIGN in extracting useful structural information in signed graphs, as well as the adaptability and flexibility of the proposed general framework.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 3 figures, Accepted to Learning on Graphs Conference (LoG 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoSIGN 是面向符号图 (signed graph) 的拓扑引导预训练与提示学习框架：用基于 magnetic signed Laplacian 的结构编码器加持久同调分支（Dowker 复形持久图像）融合嵌入，再接入 prompt learning 做迁移。合成与真实数据集上的实验表明该框架能提取符号图中有用的结构信息，并具备适应性与灵活性。
Motivation: 符号图（信任-不信任网络、金融相关系统、生物互作图）上已有符号图神经网络多为任务专用学习，符号图上的图迁移学习 (graph transfer learning) 仍不发达。
Method: TopoSIGN 由三部分组成：基于 magnetic signed Laplacian 的结构编码器；新增的持久同调分支，用 Dowker 复形的 persistence image 概括符号拓扑；两者融合后的嵌入输入 prompt learning 函数完成迁移。
Result: 在合成与真实数据集上的实验结果显示，TopoSIGN 能有效提取符号图中的结构信息，并体现该通用框架的适应性与灵活性；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把谱结构编码与符号拓扑的持久同调表征结合再做提示学习，是符号图迁移学习可行的通用框架路径。

papers.title: On Emergent Capabilities and Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuned checkpoints and adapters now fill public repositories, and the most common operation applied to these artifacts is model merging: arithmetic on their weights that assembles capabilities cheaply. We ask what this operation does to emergent capabilities: behaviors an artifact carries that were never an explicit training target. Studying two independent testbeds (activation oracles and emergent-misaligned models) across three model families, we find that the answer is threefold. First, merging preserves an emergent capability that both parents carry: merging two misaligned checkpoints retains most of their broad misalignment across the whole mixing range. Second, merging cannot create an emergent capability that is superadditive in its parents: no weighted merge of two single-task oracles reaches the jointly-trained oracle's auditing ability. Third, when only one parent carries the capability, merging dilutes it faster than the trained capability that accompanies it: the gap is significant in most settings. In short, emergent behaviors of an artifact do not compose the way its trained capability does.
papers.comment: main paper has 8 pages, 5 figures, and 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在激活 oracle 与 emergent-misalignment 两个独立测试床上、跨三个模型家族，检验权重合并 (model merging) 对涌现能力 (emergent capabilities) 的作用：双方都具备的能力在全混合范围内大体保留，超可加的能力无法由任何加权合并产生，仅单方具备的能力比伴随的训练能力稀释得更快。结论是涌现行为不按训练能力的方式组合。
Motivation: 公共仓库中微调权重与 adapter 的最常见操作是合并，但合并对那些从未作为显式训练目标的涌现行为有何影响尚不清楚，这关系到能否靠廉价权重算术拼装能力。
Method: 在两个独立测试床——activation oracles 与 emergent-misaligned models——上、跨三个模型家族，对单任务 oracle 与联合训练 oracle、以及两个失准 checkpoint 做加权权重合并，比较合并产物与父本、与联合训练参照的涌现能力差异。
Result: 合并保留双方都有的涌现能力：两个失准 checkpoint 合并在整个混合范围内保留其大部分广泛失准；合并无法产生在父本中超可加的能力：任何单任务 oracle 的加权合并都达不到联合训练 oracle 的 auditing 能力；仅一方具备该能力时，合并稀释它快于伴随的训练能力，且差距在多数设置下显著。
Conclusion: 涌现行为不以训练能力的方式组合：合并能搬运已有涌现能力、不能合成超可加的涌现能力，且单方持有的能力在合并中损耗更快。

papers.title: Video-STLayout Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, pre-training has become fundamental to learning effective video representations, enabling strong transfer to downstream tasks. A popular framework in pre-training involves aligning features of a video encoder with that of another modality, for example, language or audio. We introduce Video-STLayout pre-training, a novel strategy for obtaining rich video representations informed by spatio-temporal layout of object bounding boxes. Object layouts can easily be obtained by applying an off-the-shelf object detector on the video frames. Our method uses a contrastive loss to align video features with the layout features from a trained layout encoder. We show the effectiveness of our approach in the task of activity recognition in complex scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Video-STLayout 预训练策略：用现成目标检测器从视频帧提取目标边界框的时空布局 (spatio-temporal layout)，以对比损失 (contrastive loss) 将视频特征与布局编码器输出的布局特征对齐，从而获得受布局信息增强的视频表征。该方法在复杂场景活动识别 (activity recognition) 任务上展示了有效性。
Motivation: 视频预训练常把视觉特征与语言或音频对齐，但边界框这类由现成检测器即可免费获得的时空布局信息尚未被用作对齐目标，复杂场景下的活动识别因此缺少这一监督来源。
Method: 对视频帧运行现成目标检测器得到目标边界框的时空布局，训练一个布局编码器编码该布局；预训练时用对比损失对齐视频编码器特征与布局特征，得到布局增强的视频表征，再迁移到活动识别。
Result: 方法的有效性在复杂场景的活动识别任务上得到展示；摘要给出的是定性结论，未附具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 以现成检测器产出的时空布局作为对比对齐的第二模态，是获取富视频表征并迁移到复杂场景活动识别的可行预训练策略。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 对视频帧运行现成目标检测器得到目标边界框的时空布局，训练一个布局编码器编码该布局；预训练时用对比损失对齐视频编码器特征与布局特征，得到布局增强的视频表征，再迁移到活动识别。
summary_sections.result: 方法的有效性在复杂场景的活动识别任务上得到展示；摘要给出的是定性结论，未附具体指标数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 以现成检测器产出的时空布局作为对比对齐的第二模态，是获取富视频表征并迁移到复杂场景活动识别的可行预训练策略。

papers.title: LumoTree: Path-Parallel Speculative Verification for Hybrid Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Tree speculative decoding for hybrid language models must preserve one coherent continuation across recurrent, convolution, and attention state. We present LumoTree, a verifier that executes recurrent paths in parallel, reuses state tiles within each path, and coordinates native recurrent replay, convolution-history gathering, and attention-cache remapping through a shared logical tree. Fused candidate selection, GPU-resident acceptance, and grouped split-K attention support the verification cycle. Component experiments show exact candidate-selection parity and recurrent agreement within paired error bounds. An exploratory Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 deployment on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10) records 25.63 pooled tokens/s on ten SWE-bench Verified Astropy tasks. The results characterize component-level numerical agreement and coding-agent deployment; complete-model continuation and controlled application speedups remain open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LumoTree 是面向混合语言模型（循环、卷积、注意力三类状态并存）的树投机解码验证器，通过共享逻辑树协调原生循环重放、卷积历史收集与注意力缓存重映射，并在每条路径内并行执行循环、复用状态分块。组件实验给出候选选择的精确一致性与配对误差界内的循环一致；在单机 NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10) 上的 Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 探索性部署于 10 个 SWE-bench Verified Astropy 任务记录 25.63 pooled tokens/s。
Motivation: 树投机解码在混合语言模型上必须让循环、卷积、注意力三类状态保持同一条连贯续写，而三者的状态结构互异，验证阶段难以并行且容易失配。
Method: 验证器按路径并行执行循环计算并在路径内复用状态分块，用共享逻辑树协调原生循环重放、卷积历史收集与注意力缓存重映射；配合融合候选选择、GPU 常驻接受判定与 grouped split-K attention 支撑验证循环。
Result: 组件实验显示候选选择精确一致 (exact candidate-selection parity)，循环结果在配对误差界内一致；探索性 Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 部署在单台 NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10) 上，于 10 个 SWE-bench Verified Astropy 任务记录 25.63 pooled tokens/s。
Conclusion: 组件级数值一致性与编码智能体部署已被刻画，完整模型的续写一致性与受控的应用级加速仍是开放问题。
