papers.title: Coupled-cluster molecular properties across the main group that extrapolate beyond training size
papers.abstract_en: Coupled-cluster theory defines the accuracy standard for molecular electronic-structure properties but scales too steeply for routine application, whereas density-functional theory is affordable yet systematically biased. We resolve this trade-off with a single equivariant network, HARP (Hamiltonian Read-out for Properties), that predicts an effective one-electron Hamiltonian from one inexpensive B3LYP/def2-SVP calculation and derives a broad suite of properties from it (energy, optical gap, dipole, quadrupole, polarizability, Mulliken atomic charges, and Mayer bond orders) at coupled-cluster accuracy across nine main-group elements, including the under-served phosphorus, sulfur, and chlorine chemistries. The model is trained on a new in-house dataset of multi-property labels computed at the CCSD(T) level for all nine elements. On a held-out test set, it reduces the error of every property by a factor of 3.8 to 270 relative to semi-local, hybrid, and double-hybrid DFT (referenced to composite CCSD(T)/cc-pVTZ), while adding only ~0.1 s wall time per molecule, delivering coupled-cluster-quality predictions at the cost of a single DFT calculation. Critically, deriving every property from a predicted Hamiltonian rather than pooling per-atom features builds the correct size-scaling into the model architecture: on pi-conjugated oligothiophenes it matches finite-field CCSD polarizability to ~1% and the EOM-CCSD optical gap to ~3% at the largest sizes where those references remain affordable (44 and 37 atoms, where a single CCSD field point already costs ~500x the model's entire inference) and extrapolates the corrected trends to 58-atom chains, a regime where pooling-based architectures fail by construction. Accurate extrapolation is therefore set by the model's inductive bias rather than by the training data.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables; Supplementary Information (22 pages) appended. v2: model renamed from MEHnet-MG to HARP; results at the final released checkpoint; SI added; code and weights at https://github.com/He-Wenhao/HARP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出等变网络 HARP (Hamiltonian Read-out for Properties)，从单次 B3LYP/def2-SVP 计算预测有效单电子 Hamiltonian，再统一导出能量、光学带隙、偶极、极化率等性质，达到耦合簇精度。在九个主族元素的留出测试集上，各性质相对半局域、杂化与双杂化 DFT 的误差降低 3.8 至 270 倍，每分子仅增加约 0.1 秒；在 π 共轭低聚噻吩上外推到 58 原子链仍保持正确标度趋势。
Motivation: 耦合簇 (coupled-cluster) 是分子电子结构性质的精度标准但标度过陡，DFT 可负担却有系统偏差；逐原子特征池化的架构在尺寸外推上按构造失效。
Method: HARP 用单一等变网络从一次 B3LYP/def2-SVP 计算预测有效单电子 Hamiltonian，再从中导出能量、光学带隙、偶极、四极、极化率、Mulliken 电荷与 Mayer 键级；训练集为自建的九主族元素 CCSD(T) 多性质标签数据集。
Result: 留出测试集上各性质误差相对半局域、杂化与双杂化 DFT（参照 composite CCSD(T)/cc-pVTZ）降低 3.8 至 270 倍，每分子额外开销约 0.1 秒。在 π 共轭低聚噻吩上，最大可负担参考尺寸（44 与 37 原子）处极化率与有限场 CCSD 吻合约 1%、EOM-CCSD 光学带隙约 3%，并外推至 58 原子链；单个 CCSD 场点成本约为模型全部推理的 500 倍。
Conclusion: 准确的尺寸外推由模型的归纳偏置（从预测 Hamiltonian 导出性质而非池化逐原子特征）决定，而非由训练数据规模决定。

papers.title: Meteorology-driven Causal Nowcasting of Fugitive Landfill Emissions from Measured Coupling Timescales
papers.abstract_en: Which meteorological processes control exposure to fugitive gases downwind of a source, and on what timescales, have largely been inferred from dispersion theory and partial field evidence. Here we show that the meteorological drivers of elevated hydrogen sulphide (H$_2$S) exposure at a long-monitored European landfill, and the timescales over which each acts, can be identified directly from monitoring data. Wind direction, wind speed and atmospheric pressure form the causal core, with the share of directed information carried by pressure increasing with aggregation scale. The recovered timescales are consistent with those expected from the underlying atmospheric processes. We use these driver timescales to initialise CAIRN (Causal-Anchored Inference for Receptor Nowcasting), a machine-learning nowcaster with fast and slow memory components. Trained on past exceedances of WHO guideline levels, CAIRN nowcasts them from surface weather measurements and the calendar alone, without hand-engineered features. Combining four such nowcasters produces a site-level, tiered alert that agrees substantially with that generated by a direct sensor network and tracks an independent record of community odour reports. Meteorological variables can therefore serve as an inference-time proxy for exposure relative to WHO guideline levels, and they link atmospheric dynamics to community impact as an episode unfolds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在长期监测的欧洲垃圾填埋场，从监测数据直接识别出下风向 H2S 暴露的气象因果核心为风向、风速与气压，且气压携带的有向信息份额随聚合尺度增大。据此初始化 CAIRN（Causal-Anchored Inference for Receptor Nowcasting）：仅用地面气象观测与日历、不含手工特征，对超过 WHO 指导水平的事件做临近预报，四个此类预报器合成的站点级分级预警与直接传感器网络的预警高度一致，并能跟踪独立的社区异味报告记录。
Motivation: 控制下风向逸散气体暴露的气象过程及其作用时尺度此前主要靠扩散理论和零散野外观测推断，缺少从数据中直接识别的因果证据。
Method: 先从填埋场监测数据中识别气象驱动因子及其作用时尺度（风向、风速、气压构成因果核心，气压的有向信息份额随聚合尺度上升），再用这些驱动时尺度初始化 CAIRN——一个带快、慢记忆组件的机器学习 nowcaster，以历史 WHO 指导水平超标事件为训练目标，输入仅为地面气象观测与日历，最后组合四个 nowcaster 形成站点级分级预警。
Result: 恢复的时尺度与底层大气过程的预期一致；CAIRN 组合四个 nowcaster 产生的站点级分级预警与直接传感器网络生成的预警高度吻合，并追踪到独立的社区异味报告记录。
Conclusion: 气象变量可在推理时充当相对于 WHO 指导水平的暴露代理，把大气动力学与社区影响在事件发展过程中联系起来。

papers.title: Foresight Without Seeing: Latent Futures for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) connect visual prediction with robot control, but supplying predictive context often requires expensive future-video generation. Direct policies avoid this cost but lack an explicit interface for accessing future-indexed predictive information. We introduce ForeWAM, a World Action Model that separates forecasting from rendering to expose and shape latent predictive context for efficient control. Its core mechanism, Future-KV, performs a single Video DiT prefill over the current visual latent and noise-initialized future slots, then reuses the resulting key-value states throughout action denoising. To make this context relevant to control, we introduce dynamics registers supervised by latent actions from a frozen teacher during training, encouraging representations of interaction-induced transitions. This reusable context supports a lightweight, single-layer action decoder. We evaluate ForeWAM on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa, and real-world manipulation tasks. Without additional policy-level embodied pretraining, ForeWAM improves RoboCasa success by 9.7 percentage points over Fast-WAM at the same budget of 50 demonstrations per task, reaching 59.2%. With a single-layer decoder, it achieves 77.6% success on LIBERO-Plus and reduces policy-query latency to 88.7 ms on an NVIDIA A800, delivering a 6.27-fold speedup over Fast-WAM. These results show that latent predictive computation provides useful foresight for robust, efficient control without explicit future-video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ForeWAM 把世界行动模型 (WAM) 的未来预测与视频渲染分离：用一次 Video DiT prefill 在当前视觉 latent 与噪声初始化的 future slots 上生成可复用的 key-value 状态，供动作去噪全程调用，并用冻结教师的 latent action 监督 dynamics registers。在 50 demonstrations/任务预算下 RoboCasa 成功率达 59.2%，比 Fast-WAM 高 9.7 个百分点；单层动作解码器在 LIBERO-Plus 上 77.6%，A800 上策略查询延迟 88.7 ms，较 Fast-WAM 加速 6.27 倍。
Motivation: WAM 需要昂贵的未来视频生成来提供预测上下文，而直接策略虽省掉该成本却缺少访问未来索引预测信息的显式接口。
Method: Future-KV 机制对当前视觉 latent 与噪声初始化的 future slots 做一次 Video DiT prefill，把得到的 key-value 状态在动作去噪过程中反复复用；训练时用冻结教师给出的 latent action 监督 dynamics registers，使表征偏向交互引发的状态转移；末端接一个轻量单层动作解码器，无需额外策略级具身预训练。
Result: 在每任务 50 demonstrations 的同等预算下，RoboCasa 成功率 59.2%，较 Fast-WAM 提升 9.7 个百分点；单层解码器在 LIBERO-Plus 上成功率 77.6%；NVIDIA A800 上策略查询延迟降至 88.7 ms，相对 Fast-WAM 加速 6.27 倍。评测覆盖 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa 与真实世界操作任务。
Conclusion: 显式生成未来视频并非获取预测性上下文的必要条件：可复用的 latent 预测计算足以支撑稳健且高效的操作控制。

papers.title: The Next Challenge for Agentic Cybersecurity: A Realistic, Contamination-Free Reverse Engineering Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are rapidly improving in cybersecurity when source code is available, yet much of the software most consequential to security, including malware, firmware, and proprietary applications, exists only as binaries. Analyzing such software requires reverse engineering (RE): recovering program semantics before analysis can proceed. Evaluating agentic RE poses a fundamental challenge: realistic benchmark instances must (1) be absent from LLMs' training data to prevent shortcuts by memorization, and (2) reflect the scale and anti-analysis protections of real-world binaries. We introduce SRE-Bench, the first realistic, contamination-free RE benchmark. Built from scratch by RE experts with over 5,000 expert hours, SRE-Bench comprises 19 private, real-world-scale programs averaging 16.9K lines of code. We further developed 44 in-house anti-analysis mechanisms, yielding 262 binary instances and 1,572 deterministically graded tasks. We evaluated 13 agentic settings across 11 models: eight in public-facing settings and five in internal unconstrained settings with cyber safeguards disabled and no budget cap. Realistic RE remains challenging for frontier agents: GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Fable-5.1, despite strong source-code security capabilities, fully solve only 31.5% and 26.9% of graded instances, suggesting that success in source-code security does not translate into effective binary analysis. Without a budget cap and safety guard, GPT-6-Astra achieves a near-perfect pass@4 score, yet reliably identifying the correct candidate remains difficult. Agents are largely insensitive to compiler optimization and static linking, and ablations confirm that both contamination control and realistic scale are essential to understanding agents' RE capability. These findings highlight RE as a distinct frontier for agentic cybersecurity and establish SRE-Bench as a rigorous testbed for measuring progress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRE-Bench 是首个面向智能体逆向工程 (RE) 的无污染真实基准：由 RE 专家从零构建 19 个私有真实规模程序（平均 16.9K 行代码）、44 种自研反分析机制，产出 262 个二进制实例与 1,572 个确定性评分任务。前沿智能体在真实 RE 上仍吃力：GPT-5.6-Sol 与 Claude-Fable-5.1 仅完全解出 31.5% 与 26.9% 的评分实例，说明源码安全能力不迁移到二进制分析。
Motivation: 智能体在有源码的网络安全任务上进步快，但恶意软件、固件、专有应用只以二进制存在；现有基准要么可被训练数据记忆走捷径，要么规模与反分析保护不真实，无法评估真实 RE 能力。
Method: 由 RE 专家投入 5,000+ 专家小时从零构建 19 个私有真实规模程序，开发 44 种自研反分析机制，生成 262 个二进制实例与 1,572 个确定性评分任务；在 11 个模型上评测 13 种智能体设置，其中 8 种面向公众、5 种为关闭网络防护且无预算上限的内部设置，并做污染控制与真实规模的消融。
Result: GPT-5.6-Sol 与 Claude-Fable-5.1 完全解决 31.5% 与 26.9% 的评分实例；无预算上限与安全护栏时 GPT-6-Astra 取得接近满分的 pass@4，但可靠识别正确候选仍困难；智能体对编译器优化与静态链接基本不敏感；消融确认污染控制与真实规模对刻画 RE 能力都必不可少。
Conclusion: 源码安全能力不等于二进制分析能力，逆向工程是智能体网络安全的一个独立前沿；SRE-Bench 被定位为衡量该方向进展的严格测试床。

papers.title: Full-bandwidth transformer
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive transformers compute along two axes: horizontally across generated tokens, and vertically through model depth. Dense attention gives each token broad horizontal access to the past, but the vertical feedback channel between decoding steps remains narrow: only the sampled token returns to the bottom of the stack, while the top-layer hidden state is discarded. We introduce the full-bandwidth transformer, which widens this channel with latent feedback: at each decoding step, the previous top-layer hidden state is fused with the sampled token embedding through a gated linear unit and fed back as the next input. Latent feedback lets non-verbalized computation re-enter the stack with a renewed depth budget, while preserving the standard transformer architecture, KV cache, and language-modeling objective. To train full-bandwidth transformers without losing parallel teacher forcing, we use a scheduled multi-pass objective that introduces latent feedback late in pretraining and mixes a small fraction of deeper feedback passes for stability. We train 1B-parameter full-bandwidth transformers on up to 400B tokens and find that latent feedback improves validation loss, 5-shot language-model evaluation, math and coding generation, and instruction-tuned performance. With negligible per-token decoding overhead, full-bandwidth transformers match or approach standard transformers trained with roughly 1.5x more tokens, and manage to produce shorter reasoning when no off-policy templates are provided.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Full-bandwidth transformer 把上一层隐藏状态经门控线性单元 (GLU) 与采样 token 嵌入融合后作为下一步输入，使非语言化的计算带着新的深度预算重新进入网络栈。在 1B 参数、最多 400B token 的预训练中，latent feedback 提升验证损失、5-shot 语言模型评测、数学与代码生成及指令微调性能，每 token 解码开销可忽略，性能匹配或接近用约 1.5 倍 token 训练的标准 transformer。
Motivation: 自回归解码的纵向反馈通道过窄：只有采样 token 回到栈底，顶层隐藏状态被丢弃，深度方向的计算无法跨步复用。
Method: 在每个解码步用 GLU 融合上一顶层隐藏状态与采样 token 嵌入作为下一输入，保留标准 transformer 架构、KV cache 与语言建模目标；训练用 scheduled multi-pass objective，在预训练后期才引入 latent feedback，并混入少量更深的 feedback pass 以保证稳定。
Result: 在 1B 参数、最多 400B token 训练下，latent feedback 改善验证损失、5-shot 语言模型评测、数学与代码生成以及指令微调后的性能；每 token 解码开销可忽略，匹配或接近用约 1.5 倍 token 训练的标准 transformer；在不提供 off-policy 模板时能产出更短的推理链。
Conclusion: 把顶层隐藏状态作为 latent feedback 回灌，可以在不改架构与目标的前提下用更少 token 达到标准 transformer 的水平，并缩短无模板时的推理长度。

papers.title: iARCS: Iterative Agentic RL for Controllable 3D Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic 3D scene generation is increasingly used as a data source for computer vision and embodied AI, but existing generators often optimize perceptual realism without reliably satisfying task-critical functional constraints. This mismatch limits the usefulness of synthetic data for downstream training, where accessibility, traversability, and spatial rule compliance are often essential. We present iARCS, an iterative agentic reinforcement learning framework that adapts a pretrained scene generator to naturallanguage task requirements. iARCS uses a two-phase strategy: universal-reward pretraining to improve physical plausibility and layout quality, followed by task-specific finetuning with LLM-generated reward programs that are iteratively refined from training feedback. Experiments show improved constraint fidelity on walkability, reachability, and clearance-focused tasks, effective task-specific constraint optimization, and competitive scene diversity. We further show that data generated by iARCS improves a base generator, supporting its value as a practical synthetic data generation tool rather than only a controllable scene editing method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: iARCS 用迭代式 agentic 强化学习把预训练 3D 场景生成器对齐到自然语言任务约束：先做 universal-reward 预训练提升物理合理性与布局质量，再用 LLM 生成并依据训练反馈迭代精化的奖励程序做任务微调。实验显示在 walkability、reachability、clearance 类任务上约束保真度提升、任务特定约束优化有效、场景多样性保持竞争力，且 iARCS 生成的数据能反过来改进基础生成器。
Motivation: 面向计算机视觉与具身 AI 的合成 3D 场景生成器多优化感知真实感，却不可靠地满足可访问性、可通行性、空间规则等功能性约束，使合成数据在下游训练中受限。
Method: 两阶段 agentic RL：universal-reward 预训练改善物理合理性与布局质量；随后任务特定微调，奖励由 LLM 生成的奖励程序 (reward programs) 提供，并依据训练反馈迭代精化，以对齐自然语言任务要求。
Result: 实验显示 walkability、reachability、clearance 任务上的约束保真度提升，任务特定约束优化有效，场景多样性具有竞争力；由 iARCS 生成的数据可改进基础生成器。
Conclusion: iARCS 应被当作实用的合成数据生成工具而非仅可控场景编辑方法：迭代奖励精化能让生成器在保持多样性的同时满足任务级功能约束，并产出可反哺基础模型的数据。

papers.title: FinEvo-Bench: A Longitudinal Benchmark for Self-Evolving Agents in Professional Financial Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Agents used over time encounter recurring professional work: each case requires different evidence and judgment, while the underlying workflow can be reused. Benchmarks built from independent tasks cannot reveal whether an agent turns earlier experience into better procedures for later cases. We introduce FinEvo-Bench, a longitudinal benchmark designed around this structure. It contains 120 open-ended tasks drawn from real cases across 20 business scenes in six financial domains. Each scene contains six substantively different cases that share a professional workflow and an expert-authored rubric for task quality and financial compliance. Constructing and validating the benchmark required approximately 1,200 person-hours. Finance provides a natural test bed because recurring analyses apply shared professional and compliance requirements to heterogeneous inputs, producing case-specific analyses and conclusions. We evaluate four self-evolving agent scaffolds with Qwen3.7-Max on three independently shuffled, globally interleaved task streams. A Claude Code rubric judge backed by Claude Opus~4.6 evaluates all outputs, and paired state-reset controls estimate each scaffold's gain from retained experience. Evolving runs score 9.33--19.37 points higher and trigger 0.12--0.44 fewer compliance issues per task than their paired controls. Paired score gains at within-scene ranks~4--6 exceed those at ranks~1--3 by 6.10--8.70 points. FinEvo-Bench measures whether retained experience improves later professional work under continued use.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: 保留的经验确实提升后续专业工作的表现与合规性，且增益随同一场景内案例推进而扩大，说明自演化 scaffold 能把早期案例沉淀为可复用流程。

papers.title: A Ground-Truth Framework for Uncertainty Disentanglement with Posterior Risk
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty estimates are critical in safety-sensitive applications. For such estimates to be useful in practice, it is crucial to understand the sources underlying a model's uncertainty, motivating the disentanglement of total uncertainty into epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty. Existing notions of uncertainty differ in the sources they capture and, consequently, in their definitions of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty, with no universally accepted definition. We define uncertainty through sample-conditional pointwise posterior risk, which is the expected loss of a predictor under the distribution of plausible ground-truth functions given the observed sample. This definition unifies probabilistic and risk-based concepts of uncertainty. To assess state-of-the-art uncertainty disentanglement methods, we develop a framework that directly compares their estimates against ground-truth uncertainty defined primarily by posterior risk, alongside commonly used alternative uncertainty definitions. We find that Spectral-normalized Neural Gaussian Processes and Variational Latent Gaussian Processes most closely recover the ground-truth uncertainty, while most methods track posterior variance more closely than posterior risk, missing the predictors' bias. Beyond method rankings, we investigate how strongly estimated aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty are entangled and how sensitive uncertainty quality is to modeling choices, yielding practical guidance for uncertainty disentanglement. To support further method development and validation, we release 13 semi-synthetic UCI/OpenML datasets with known posteriors, enabling the computation of ground-truth uncertainty. Code and data will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用样本条件的逐点后验风险 (sample-conditional pointwise posterior risk) 定义不确定性，把概率式与风险式定义统一起来，并据此构建可对照真值的不确定性解耦评测框架。在 13 个已知后验的半合成 UCI/OpenML 数据集上，Spectral-normalized Neural Gaussian Processes 与 Variational Latent Gaussian Processes 最接近真值不确定性，多数方法跟踪后验方差而非后验风险，因而漏掉预测器的偏差。
Motivation: 现有认知/偶然不确定性定义各自捕获的来源不同、无统一标准，导致解耦方法无法与真值对照评估，安全敏感场景下的不确定性估计难以验证。
Method: 以给定观测样本下合理真值函数分布的期望损失定义逐点后验风险，统一概率式与风险式不确定性；据此开发直接把各解耦方法的估计与真值（以后验风险为主，兼含其他常用定义）对比的框架，并考察认知与偶然不确定性的纠缠程度及建模选择的敏感性。
Result: 在 13 个已知后验的半合成 UCI/OpenML 数据集上，Spectral-normalized Neural Gaussian Processes 与 Variational Latent Gaussian Processes 最接近真值不确定性；多数方法与后验方差的相关强于与后验风险的相关，从而漏掉预测器偏差；框架还量化了估计出的认知与偶然不确定性的纠缠强度及不确定性质量对建模选择的敏感度。
Conclusion: 以后验风险为真值时，当前主流解耦方法系统性地把偏差排除在认知不确定性之外，评估不确定性解耦应直接对照真值而非代理定义；作者据此给出实践指引并公开数据与代码。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: ESCROW: Guarded and Dual-Objective Continual Maintenance for Agents in Policy-Governed Enterprise Workflows
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly run policy-bound enterprise workflows, where they must apply rules consistently and stay auditable. Deploying such an agent is the start of its long-term maintenance cycle: it must adapt to a stream of operational signals, yet reliably turning these sparse, unlabeled signals into reusable skill revisions is hard, and a careless update can trade one task category's accuracy for the overall gain, revive a resolved failure, or land at an undeployable cost. We present ESCROW, a post-deployment maintenance framework that updates an agent's external, reviewable skills under a Strict Update Boundary: the LLM proposes candidate revisions, but only an empirically evaluated version is deployed. It combines distributed diagnosis with consensus, a per-category non-regression guard, cross-cycle anti-regression, and accuracy--cost Pareto search, emitting a versioned, auditable diff per change. In real production on our internal financial document-auditing system, it attains the strongest evaluated accuracy--cost trade-off among baselines, with a transfer probe on public $τ$-bench.
papers.comment: Accepted at the CLEA Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ESCROW 是面向策略约束企业工作流中 LLM agent 的部署后维护框架：在 Strict Update Boundary 下由 LLM 提出技能修订候选，只有经实证评估的版本才上线，并配合分诊共识、按类别不回退守卫、跨周期防回退与精度-成本 Pareto 搜索，每次变更产出带版本、可审计的 diff。在内部金融单据审计系统的生产环境中取得所评估基线中最强的精度-成本权衡，并在公开 τ-bench 上做迁移探针。
Motivation: 策略约束的企业 agent 上线只是维护周期起点：稀疏、无标签的运行信号难以转化为可复用的技能修订，而草率更新会用某一任务类别的精度换整体增益、复活已修复的失败，或把成本推到不可部署的水平。
Method: ESCROW 在 Strict Update Boundary 下运行：LLM 提出候选修订，只有经实证评估的版本才部署；组合分布式诊断加共识、按类别的 non-regression 守卫、跨周期 anti-regression，以及 accuracy--cost Pareto 搜索，每次变更输出带版本的可审计 diff。
Result: 在内部金融单据审计系统的真实生产环境中，取得所评估基线中最强的精度-成本权衡；并在公开 τ-bench 上进行 transfer probe。
Conclusion: 把 agent 维护收束为受边界约束、按类别守卫且经 Pareto 搜索的外部技能修订，可以在生产中同时守住精度与成本并保持可审计。

papers.title: Talked Out of the Truth: Sycophancy in the Reasoning Chains of Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Large multimodal reasoning models (LMRMs) are increasingly capable, largely through generating explicit chain-of-thought reasoning before answering, but in language models this often comes with sycophancy, the tendency to agree with the user over the evidence, and no reliable method to measure it in LMRMs yet exists. We bridge this gap with a benchmark and dataset for LMRM sycophancy when a user asserts a wrong answer, pairing four visually grounded datasets spanning mathematical, clinical, temporal, and demographic reasoning with five pressure conditions in single-turn and multi-turn settings, scored both in the final answer and within the reasoning chain. Sycophancy is prevalent under pressure: Statement pressure elicits the highest rates and Conviction among the lowest for all models except Mistral-Small-4, and under multi-turn pressure reasoning-level sycophancy intensifies sharply in PathVQA, reaching 95.7% for the most affected model. We further introduce a failure taxonomy separating reasoning-chain from answer-level sycophancy, and an exploratory sentence-level taxonomy locating where drift first emerges. A targeted intervention that restores a model's own correct reasoning recovers 79.2% of sycophantic answers on reasoning-heavy tasks, showing the answer follows the sycophantic reasoning rather than merely co-occurring with it. Thus, sycophancy corrupts not just the answer but the reasoning that produces it, so the chain itself is what we must measure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多模态推理模型 (LMRM) 在用户施压时顺从错误答案、缺乏度量手段的问题，构建了基准与数据集：四个视觉数据集 × 五种施压条件 × 单轮/多轮，分别在最终答案与推理链内打分。多轮施压下 PathVQA 推理级 sycophancy 升至 95.7%（受影响最重的模型），而恢复模型自身正确推理的干预可挽回 79.2% 的顺从性答案。
Motivation: 语言模型中的 sycophancy（顺从用户而非证据）已有研究，但多模态推理模型尚无可靠度量方法，且其显式 CoT 是否被施压污染无从判定。
Method: 配对四个视觉数据集（数学、临床 PathVQA、时间、人口统计推理）与五种压力条件，在单轮与多轮设定下同时对最终答案和推理链打分；提出区分推理链级与答案级 sycophancy 的失败分类法，以及定位漂移起点的句子级探索性分类法。
Result: Statement pressure 引出最高 sycophancy 率，Conviction 在除 Mistral-Small-4 外所有模型中最低；多轮施压下 PathVQA 推理级 sycophancy 对受影响最重的模型达 95.7%；针对性干预（恢复模型自身正确推理）在推理密集任务上挽回 79.2% 的顺从性答案。
Conclusion: 答案跟随被污染的推理链而非与之偶然共现，因此必须直接度量推理链本身，而不只是最终答案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Placement Is Free, Composition Is Not: The Latin Square as a Provably-Balanced Construction for Heterogeneous Sequence-Mixer Stacks
papers.abstract_en: Since GPT, most Transformers have repeated the same attention mechanism at every layer. Yet this design is largely a convention rather than a tested conclusion. When multiple sequence mixers are combined in one stack, improvements may arise from mechanism choice, placement, or both, making causal attribution difficult. We introduce Aether-7B-5Attn, a 6.59B-parameter mixture-of-experts model ($\approx$2.98B active) whose 49 layers contain seven sequence-mixing mechanisms arranged as a $7\times7$ Latin square. Because each mechanism appears exactly once in every row and column, the design guarantees balanced exposure across depth while eliminating placement confounds. To evaluate this principle, we build a parameter-matched proxy with four mechanisms arranged as a $4\times4$ Latin square over sixteen layers, matched to 700.9M parameters and trained with eight seeds per arm. The results reveal a clear dissociation. Rearranging a distributed heterogeneous stack into a balanced periodic cycle changes validation loss by only 0.16\%, indicating that exact placement has little effect. In contrast, clustering the same mechanisms into contiguous depth bands incurs a 0.59\% penalty, while replacing the heterogeneous stack with a homogeneous one incurs a 1.68\% penalty. These results indicate that performance depends primarily on heterogeneous composition distributed across depth rather than on any particular permutation. We confirm this finding at 2.16$\times$ larger scale (1.514B parameters), where the homogeneous-stack penalty increases to 2.63\% and removing the SSM-family mechanism produces a 3.20\% degradation. We further report per-mechanism cost profiles, English and Korean evaluations, and a causal-safety audit of all 49 layers. We release model weights, training recipes, training code, logs, and architecture source code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 7×7 Latin square 把七种序列混合机制排进 49 层，保证每种机制在每行每列恰好出现一次，从而在深度上均衡暴露并消除位置混淆。参数匹配的 4×4 代理模型（700.9M、每臂八个种子）显示：重排为周期循环只改 0.16% 验证损失，聚成连续深度带罚 0.59%，换成同质栈罚 1.68%；1.514B 规模下同质罚升到 2.63%，去掉 SSM 族机制退化 3.20%。结论是性能取决于跨深度分布的异质组合，而非具体排列。
Motivation: 同一层堆叠重复同一注意力是惯例而非被检验的结论；多种序列混合机制组合时，收益可能来自机制选择、位置或两者，因果归因困难。
Method: 提出 Aether-7B-5Attn：6.59B 参数 MoE（约 2.98B 激活），49 层含七种序列混合机制按 7×7 Latin square 排列。另建参数匹配代理：四种机制、16 层、4×4 Latin square、700.9M 参数、每臂八个种子；并做 1.514B 规模复现、逐机制开销剖析、英韩双语评测与全部 49 层的因果安全审计。
Result: 分布式异质栈重排为均衡周期循环，验证损失仅变 0.16%；把相同机制聚成连续深度带罚 0.59%；换成同质栈罚 1.68%。在 2.16× 更大规模（1.514B 参数）上同质罚增至 2.63%，移除 SSM 族机制退化 3.20%。
Conclusion: 性能主要由跨深度分布的异质组合决定，具体排列次序影响很小；作者据此开源权重、训练配方、代码、日志与架构源码。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 用 7×7 Latin square 把七种序列混合机制排进 49 层，保证每种机制在每行每列恰好出现一次，从而在深度上均衡暴露并消除位置混淆。参数匹配的 4×4 代理模型（700.9M、每臂八个种子）显示：重排为周期循环只改 0.16% 验证损失，聚成连续深度带罚 0.59%，换成同质栈罚 1.68%；1.514B 规模下同质罚升到 2.63%，去掉 SSM 族机制退化 3.20%。结论是性能取决于跨深度分布的异质组合，而非具体排列。
summary_sections.motivation: 同一层堆叠重复同一注意力是惯例而非被检验的结论；多种序列混合机制组合时，收益可能来自机制选择、位置或两者，因果归因困难。

papers.title: False Prophets: On the Security of World Models in Agentic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models now power autonomous agents capable of complex, multi-step tasks in different environments. Accurate and reliable execution of these tasks requires the agent to predict the results of its actions. Recent research proposes to enhance predictive capabilities via specially trained environment simulators-world models. While world models can improve performance, they can also mislead agents into executing harmful actions, creating significant security and privacy risks. In this paper, we raise security concerns regarding the usage of world models in agentic systems. We discover a range of world model specific vulnerabilities, which can be exploited in terminal-based agents to execute malicious code or extract sensitive data. To facilitate future development, we introduce a security benchmark dataset designed for text-based world models. We argue that some risks are intrinsic to approximate world modeling, and show that attackers can induce mispredictions in agentic pipelines with up to 95% success rate, possibly resulting in unintended command execution, denial of service, drainage of wallet and private information extraction. Finally, we provide practical recommendations for practitioners to mitigate the discovered harms and harden agentic systems.
papers.journal_ref: 19th Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Security (AISEC), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对基于文本世界模型的 LLM 智能体，提出一套世界模型特有漏洞的攻击面分析与配套安全基准数据集，攻击者可让智能体管线产生错误预测，成功率最高达 95%，进而触发非预期命令执行、拒绝服务、钱包耗尽与隐私信息泄露。作者主张部分风险源于近似世界建模本身，并给出加固建议。
Motivation: 世界模型能提升智能体对动作结果的预测，但其误预测会把智能体引向有害动作；针对文本世界模型缺少可复现的安全评测载体，且部分风险被认为是近似建模所固有。
Method: 在基于终端的智能体 (terminal-based agents) 上发现并利用一系列世界模型特有漏洞，用于执行恶意代码或窃取敏感数据；同时发布一个面向文本世界模型的安全基准数据集，并给出面向实践者的缓解与加固建议。
Result: 攻击者可在智能体管线中诱导误预测，成功率最高达 95%，可能导致非预期命令执行、拒绝服务、钱包耗尽与私密信息提取。
Conclusion: 部分安全风险内生于近似世界建模本身，因此仅靠模型改进无法消除；实践者需按文中建议对智能体系统做专门加固。

papers.title: Lipschitzian SLLNs for random functions
papers.abstract_en: We prove strong laws of large numbers for random functions in the Lipschitz pseudometric. Our results hold under either a topological or a model-theoretic condition, with the latter encompassing functions jointly definable in o-minimal structures but extending substantially beyond this class. Applications include uniform convergence of limiting and Clarke subdifferentials and finite-sample identification of solutions. Consequently, we identify broad classes of functions for which the failure phenomena revealed by our previous negative results [Tian and Royset, arXiv:2511.16568, 2025] do not occur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Lipschitz 伪度量下证明随机函数的大数定律 (SLLN)，条件为拓扑条件或模型论条件（涵盖 o-minimal 结构中联合可定义的函数类，且远超该类）。推论是极限与 Clarke 次微分的一致收敛以及解的有限样本识别，并给出此前负结果 [Tian and Royset, arXiv:2511.16568] 失效的一大批函数类。
Motivation: 此前 Tian 与 Royset 的负结果揭示了随机函数逼近中某些 SLLN 失效现象，需要刻画在什么条件下这些失效不会发生。
Method: 在 Lipschitz 伪度量下建立 SLLN，分别以拓扑条件与模型论条件（函数在 o-minimal 结构中联合可定义，并实质超出该类）作为充分条件；推论覆盖次微分的一致收敛与解的有限样本识别。
Result: 得到两类充分条件下的 SLLN；推论为极限次微分与 Clarke 次微分的一致收敛、解的有限样本识别；并识别出先前负结果不发生的广泛函数类。
Conclusion: Lipschitz 伪度量下的 SLLN 可在拓扑或模型论条件下成立，从而圈定此前失效现象不会出现的函数范围。

papers.title: More with Less: a Large Scale Remote Sensing VLM with a Simple Recipe
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing vision-language models are increasingly expected to support open-ended reasoning over Earth Observation data and a variety of tasks. Most recent progress in this area has been driven by remote-sensing-specific architectural designs, often introducing new encoders, alignment modules, or task-specific fusion mechanisms. In this work, we challenge the necessity of such architectural specialization. We show that a generally capable vision-language model can achieve competitive or state-of-the-art performance at challenging remote sensing benchmarks, provided that it is trained at sufficient scale across diverse data and tasks. Our model uses a single language policy that can either answer directly in text or invoke a localization tool for segmentation and grounding. To train this heterogeneous behaviour, we employ a multi-task reinforcement learning framework with adaptive task rewards covering multiple-choice VQA, free-form VQA, captioning, detection, and segmentation across a large variety of input types. Our approach achieves competitive results across a broad set of benchmarks, including high-resolution, multi-temporal, multi-modal and multi-view tasks. Further, as training data scales, our experiments show consistent improvements across most tasks both in and out of distribution, which correlate with per-task data diversity. These findings suggest that, for remote sensing VLMs, data scale is sufficient even without architectural novelty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张遥感 VLM 不需要遥感专用架构：通用视觉语言模型在足够大规模、跨多样数据与任务上训练即可达到有竞争力乃至 SOTA 的遥感基准表现。模型用单一语言策略直接文本作答或调用定位工具做分割与 grounding，以覆盖多选 VQA、自由 VQA、captioning、detection、segmentation 的多任务强化学习与自适应任务奖励训练；随训练数据规模增长，多数任务在分布内外一致提升，且提升与各任务的数据多样性相关。
Motivation: 近期遥感 VLM 进步多依赖遥感专用架构（新编码器、对齐模块、任务专用融合），作者质疑这种架构特化的必要性，想确认数据规模本身是否已足够。
Method: 单一语言策略在直接文本回答与调用定位工具（segmentation、grounding）之间选择；用多任务强化学习框架配合自适应任务奖励 (adaptive task rewards)，覆盖多选 VQA、自由 VQA、captioning、detection、segmentation，输入类型多样，并在高分辨率、多时相、多模态、多视角任务上训练。
Result: 在一系列遥感基准上取得有竞争力乃至 SOTA 的表现，覆盖高分辨率、多时相、多模态、多视角任务；随训练数据规模增长，多数任务在分布内外一致改善，改善程度与各任务的数据多样性相关。
Conclusion: 对遥感 VLM 而言，数据规模本身足够，无需架构新颖性；架构特化并非达到竞争性遥感性能的必要条件。

papers.title: Neural Non-Equilibrium Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for Corrected Boltzmann Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Learned dynamical proposals can generate configurations without providing a tractable endpoint density. Nonequilibrium path probabilities offer a way to correct such proposals, but correction alone does not determine their ability to connect separated regions. We introduce Neural Non-Equilibrium Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (NHMC), which combines conditional momentum distributions with reversible, volume-preserving dynamics. The forward--reverse path ratio gives the work used for training, importance weighting, normalizer estimation, and Metropolis correction. We then construct a configuration-space round-trip kernel whose reverse and forward paths share an intermediate configuration. Conditional on that configuration, its path-record update is independence Metropolis--Hastings. We compare its stationary inter-region flow with the flow obtained under exact conditional matching and bound their difference by the conditional path mismatch. This separates errors in the conditional proposal from dependence between the endpoint region and the intermediate configuration. Many-well experiments test normalizers and mode probabilities; a controlled lattice $φ^4$ experiment relates inter-sector flow to sector relaxation. Two-dimensional $U(1)$, $\mathrm{SU}(2)$, and $\mathrm{SU}(3)$ experiments compare four proposal constructions sharing a structured reference, including paths with analytic and learned forces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Neural Non-Equilibrium Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (NHMC)：用条件动量分布加可逆、保体积动力学构造学习式提议，以前向-反向路径比作为训练、重要性加权、归一化常数估计与 Metropolis 校正的共同工作量，并在此之上构造共享中间构型的构型空间往返 (round-trip) 核。在 many-well、受控格点 φ^4 以及二维 U(1)、SU(2)、SU(3) 实验中检验归一化常数、模式概率与跨区流。
Motivation: 学习式动力学提议能生成构型却给不出可处理的端点密度；非平衡路径概率虽能校正提议，但校正本身不能保证提议有能力连接相隔的区域。
Method: NHMC 结合条件动量分布与可逆、保体积动力学，前向-反向路径比给出训练用 work、重要性权重、归一化常数估计与 Metropolis 校正；再构造反向与前向路径共享同一中间构型的往返核，条件于该构型其路径记录更新即为 independence Metropolis-Hastings，并把跨区稳态流与精确条件匹配下的流之差用 conditional path mismatch 界住，从而分离条件提议误差与端点区对中间构型的依赖。
Result: many-well 实验检验归一化常数与模式概率，受控格点 φ^4 实验把跨区流与扇区弛豫联系起来；二维 U(1)、SU(2)、SU(3) 实验比较共享同一结构化参考的四种提议构造，其中包括带解析力与学习力的路径。
Conclusion: 非平衡路径比既能做校正也能支撑跨区往返核，且跨区流与精确条件匹配的偏差可由 conditional path mismatch 分解为条件提议误差与端点-中间构型依赖两部分。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Leveraging Instruction Tuning and Merging for Reasoning Model Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models (RLMs) demonstrate impressive performance by leveraging test-time compute in the form of reasoning tokens. However, this behavior makes adapting RLMs to new domains challenging and expensive. The reason is that further training can disturb the learned behavior and degrade model performance. This makes it difficult to leverage supervised fine-tuning data with human-written solutions: although it contains high-quality annotations, it lacks reasoning tokens. In this work, we show how, despite this challenge, such data can be used efficiently for RLM adaptation. For this, we first use standard instruction tuning. Next, we leverage model merging to combine the instruction-tuned model with the original RLM, picking the merging ratio such that the resulting model's reasoning behavior on the target domain is recovered. We evaluate our method across four RLMs on coding and text summarization tasks, where it improves target-task performance by up to $11.0\%$ while preserving reasoning behavior and limiting the out-of-distribution score degradation to on average $0.7\%$. Importantly, our adaptations are efficient and economical, costing less than USD $\$10$ per model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对推理语言模型 (RLM) 用缺少 reasoning token 的人工解答数据做领域适配会破坏已学到的推理行为，提出先标准指令微调、再用模型合并 (model merging) 按比例把微调模型与原 RLM 融合，使目标域推理行为恢复。在四个 RLM 的代码与文本摘要任务上，目标任务性能最多提升 11.0%，OOD 分数平均只降 0.7%，每模型成本低于 10 美元。
Motivation: RLM 依赖测试时推理 token，继续训练会干扰已学到的推理行为并降低性能，导致带人工解答的高质量监督微调数据难以用于新领域适配。
Method: 两阶段：先对含人工解答（无 reasoning token）的数据做标准指令微调，再用模型合并把指令微调模型与原始 RLM 线性融合，选取合并比例使目标域推理行为恢复。
Result: 在四个 RLM 上评估代码与文本摘要任务：目标任务性能最多提升 11.0%，同时保持推理行为，分布外 (OOD) 分数平均仅下降 0.7%；每个模型适配成本低于 10 美元。
Conclusion: 指令微调加按比例模型合并可以在不破坏 RLM 推理行为的前提下，用无 reasoning token 的人工解答数据高效低成本地完成领域适配。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 在四个 RLM 上评估代码与文本摘要任务：目标任务性能最多提升 11.0%，同时保持推理行为，分布外 (OOD) 分数平均仅下降 0.7%；每个模型适配成本低于 10 美元。
summary_sections.conclusion: 指令微调加按比例模型合并可以在不破坏 RLM 推理行为的前提下，用无 reasoning token 的人工解答数据高效低成本地完成领域适配。

papers.title: Subtoken Vision Transformer for Fine-grained Recognition
papers.abstract_en: We present Subtoken Vision Transformer (SubViT), a selective image tokenization method for fine-grained visual recognition. Standard Vision Transformers compress each fixed-size patch into a single token, although fine-grained distinctions often depend on localized variations within only a few patches. SubViT addresses this mismatch by representing discriminative patches with multiple subtokens while retaining the original token sequence for global context, thereby allocating additional capacity where it is most needed. Since attention heads encode complementary semantics and extracting attention maps at inference requires an extra backbone forward, we adopt a two-stage training strategy. Stage 1 fine-tunes the ViT using subdivision regions sampled from random attention heads, exposing the model to diverse subdivision patterns. Stage 2 identifies informative attention maps through feature-degradation distances and distills them into a lightweight single-map router, which directly predicts deterministic token-importance scores without a separate attention forward. We evaluate SubViT on Generalized Category Discovery (GCD), a challenging task requiring both fine-grained discrimination and generalization to unlabeled novel categories. Across CUB, FGVC-Aircraft, and Stanford-Cars, SubViT improves the average novel-category accuracy of DINOv2 from $81.3\%$ to $84.7\%$, with only $0.50$ ms additional latency and $3.4\%$ more FLOPs, while reducing latency by $73.8\%$ relative to Retina Patch. Code: \href{https://github.com/jiezhu23/SubViT_ACCV26}{SubViT}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SubViT 用选择性子 token 化解决细粒度识别中固定 patch 单 token 表示与局部判别需求的错配：判别性 patch 被切成多个 subtoken，其余保留原 token 序列。两阶段训练先用随机注意力头采样的细分区域微调 ViT，再用 feature-degradation 距离挑出信息量大的注意力图并蒸馏进轻量单图 router，直接输出确定性 token 重要性分数。在 GCD 任务上，CUB、FGVC-Aircraft、Stanford-Cars 平均 novel-category accuracy 使 DINOv2 从 81.3% 提到 84.7%，仅增 0.50 ms 延迟与 3.4% FLOPs，相对 Retina Patch 延迟降 73.8%。
Motivation: 标准 ViT 把每个固定大小 patch 压成单个 token，而细粒度判别往往只依赖少数 patch 内部的局部变化，容量分配与需求错配；推理时再取注意力图还需额外一次 backbone forward。
Method: 选择性 token 化：判别性 patch 用多个 subtoken 表示，同时保留原 token 序列供全局上下文。两阶段训练：Stage 1 用随机注意力头采样的细分区域微调 ViT，暴露多样细分模式；Stage 2 以 feature-degradation 距离识别有信息的注意力图，蒸馏进轻量单图 router，直接预测确定性 token 重要性分数，无需单独的注意力 forward。
Result: 在 Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) 上，CUB、FGVC-Aircraft、Stanford-Cars 三个数据集的平均 novel-category accuracy：DINOv2 从 81.3% 提升到 84.7%，额外延迟 0.50 ms，FLOPs 增加 3.4%，相对 Retina Patch 延迟降低 73.8%。
Conclusion: 把 token 容量按判别性动态分配，并用蒸馏 router 替代推理期注意力图提取，可在几乎不增开销的前提下提升细粒度与新类泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAGA: Stable Acceleration Guidance for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient streaming and long-horizon video generation, but repeatedly reusing generated latents as causal context can amplify temporal errors, resulting in flickering, motion jitter, and structural drift. In this paper, we investigate this failure mode from a spectral kinematic perspective and identify discrete latent acceleration as an effective signal for revealing unstable high-frequency temporal perturbations. To this end, we propose SAGA, a training-free \textbf{\textit{s}}table \textbf{\textit{a}}cceleration \textbf{\textit{g}}uidance approach for \textbf{\textit{a}}utoregressive video generation. SAGA integrates an acceleration domain spectral guidance objective based on finite-window Slepian projections with a structured autoregressive noise initialization strategy that suppresses short-range temporal correlations while preserving long-range motion structure. Without retraining or modifying the backbone, SAGA can be directly applied to existing chunk-wise autoregressive diffusion models, which is the prevalent setting for high-quality generation. Extensive experiments show that SAGA consistently improves temporal quality across multiple autoregressive diffusion models. On Self-Forcing, SAGA improves Temporal Quality from 97.30 to 97.91 and Image Quality from 69.60 to 70.51. Moreover, spectral analysis and human preference studies demonstrate that SAGA reduces temporal instability while maintaining visual fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGA 是面向自回归视频扩散的免训练引导方法：把离散 latent 加速度当作不稳定高频时序扰动的指示量，用有限窗 Slepian 投影的加速度域谱引导目标，配合抑制短程时序相关、保留长程运动结构的结构化噪声初始化。在 Self-Forcing 上 Temporal Quality 从 97.30 提到 97.91、Image Quality 从 69.60 提到 70.51，且可直接套用到现有 chunk-wise 自回归扩散模型而无需重训或改 backbone。
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散反复把生成的 latent 当作因果上下文，会放大时序误差，造成闪烁、运动抖动与结构漂移，需要在不重训的前提下稳定长时程生成。
Method: SAGA 提出加速度域谱引导目标，基于有限窗 Slepian 投影；并引入结构化自回归噪声初始化策略，抑制短程时序相关同时保留长程运动结构。方法为 training-free，不重训也不改 backbone，直接作用于现有 chunk-wise 自回归扩散模型。
Result: 在 Self-Forcing 上，Temporal Quality 由 97.30 提升至 97.91，Image Quality 由 69.60 提升至 70.51；在多个自回归扩散模型上时序质量一致改善，谱分析与人类偏好研究显示时序不稳定性下降且视觉保真度保持。
Conclusion: 离散 latent 加速度是暴露自回归视频扩散高频时序不稳定的可用信号，谱引导加结构化噪声初始化能在不重训的情况下稳定长时程生成并保持画质。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: EditVerse3D: High-Quality 3D Object Editing with Region-Aware Learning
papers.abstract_en: Local editing of 3D objects remains a long-standing challenge. When interacting with 3D content, humans naturally tend to specify a coarse region of interest for modification rather than defining precise editing boundaries. However, previous methods rely on fully edited 2D images, precise 3D masks, or redundant pipelines, which present a gap. To bridge this gap, we propose EditVerse3D, a novel 3D editing framework that enables high-quality object editing under such coarse guidance. Our approach takes as input a 3D object to be edited, a coarse 3D bounding box indicating the target region, and a reference 2D image describing the desired modification. It produces a coherent, high-fidelity edited 3D object. To facilitate this editing, we introduce a novel region-aware adaptive loss that emphasizes hard-to-learn regions and balances the objective between target and preserved areas. Complementing our loss function, we enhance model robustness and generalization through targeted data augmentations, such as training with scaled 3D masks and filtering out unrealistic editing pairs. We construct a large-scale 3D editing dataset derived from parts information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EditVerse3D achieves superior visual quality and quantitative performance compared to existing 3D editing approaches. Please visit our project page at https://editverse3d.github.io.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://editverse3d.github.io/
papers.journal_ref: Computer Vision - ECCV 2026, LNCS 17010, pp. 494-514 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EditVerse3D 在只需粗略 3D 包围框而非精确 3D mask 的条件下做 3D 物体局部编辑：输入待编辑物体、粗区域框与参考 2D 图，输出高保真且一致的编辑结果。区域感知自适应损失加权难学区域并平衡目标区与保留区，配合缩放 3D mask 增广与不真实编辑对过滤，在自建大规模 3D 编辑数据集上取得优于现有 3D 编辑方法的视觉质量与量化表现。
Motivation: 用户给 3D 内容做局部编辑时通常只给得出粗略感兴趣区域，而现有方法依赖完整编辑后的 2D 图像、精确 3D mask 或冗余流程，与这一实际交互方式存在落差。
Method: 框架输入待编辑 3D 物体、指示目标区域的粗 3D 包围框和描述期望修改的参考 2D 图；引入区域感知自适应损失 (region-aware adaptive loss) 强调难学区域并平衡目标区与保留区；用定向数据增广增强鲁棒性与泛化，包括以缩放后的 3D mask 训练、过滤不真实编辑对；并从 parts 信息构建大规模 3D 编辑数据集。
Result: 大量实验显示 EditVerse3D 在视觉质量与量化指标上均优于现有 3D 编辑方法；摘要未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 粗 3D 包围框这类弱区域引导足以支撑高质量 3D 物体局部编辑，无需精确 3D mask 或完整编辑 2D 图，配合区域感知损失与数据增广即可超越既有流程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dithered Gaussian Mechanism for Randomness-Efficient Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: We present the dithered Gaussian mechanism, an alternative to the discrete Gaussian mechanism for differential privacy that discretizes the private output rather than the noise distribution itself. By interpreting this discretization as post-processing of the Gaussian mechanism, our construction directly inherits the privacy guarantees of the standard Gaussian mechanism while avoiding vulnerabilities caused by finite-precision floating-point outputs. In addition, the mechanism is provably randomness-efficient: by sampling the discretized output values directly, the number of high-quality random bits required for privacy can be reduced significantly and made independent of the noise level. This is achieved by separating the randomness into two sources: a high-quality source used for the privacy-critical sampling step, and a high-performance public source, possibly known to the adversary, that supplies the additional randomness needed for randomized discretization. This separation enables the use of cryptographically secure randomness without substantial performance loss. As an application, we study model training with DP-SGD and show that cryptographically secure noise generation with reduced exposure to floating-point vulnerabilities can be achieved with modest practical overhead.
papers.comment: Improved Sampling Algorithm + Numerical Comparison with Baselines
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 dithered Gaussian mechanism：对高斯机制的输出做离散化（视为 post-processing），而非离散化噪声分布本身，从而直接继承标准高斯机制的隐私保证并规避有限精度浮点输出漏洞。随机性被拆成两路——隐私关键采样用高质量密码学随机源，随机化离散化用可公开（甚至对手已知）的高性能源——使高质量随机比特需求显著下降且与噪声水平无关；在 DP-SGD 训练中，密码学安全噪声生成只需适度开销。
Motivation: 离散高斯机制与有限精度浮点输出会引入隐私漏洞，而密码学安全随机源吞吐低，若所需随机比特随噪声水平增长，DP-SGD 训练代价过高。
Method: dithered Gaussian mechanism 直接对离散化输出采样，把该离散化解释为高斯机制的 post-processing 以继承其隐私保证；随机性分为隐私关键采样用的高质量源与提供随机化离散化的高性能公开源，从而可用密码学安全随机数而不显著损失性能；应用对象为 DP-SGD 模型训练。
Result: 机制被证明是 randomness-efficient：高质量随机比特需求可显著减少并与噪声水平无关；在 DP-SGD 训练中，密码学安全噪声生成在减少浮点漏洞暴露的同时仅带来适度实际开销（arXiv comment 注明含与基线的数值比较）。
Conclusion: 把离散化放在输出侧并拆分随机源，可以在不牺牲高斯机制隐私保证的前提下用密码学安全随机性做 DP-SGD，且开销可控。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating Neural Decompilation of Dart AOT Binaries: Fine-Tuning, Metric Validity, Specification Leakage, and Reliability
papers.abstract_en: We present an execution-based evaluation of neural decompilation for Dart ahead-of-time binaries and an audit of what its scores measure. Across six archived adapter-baseline comparisons, paired tests of pass@k at k = 1, 5, and 10, with Holm adjustment over 18 endpoints, identify functional regressions in both Qwen3-8B adapters at every k. The other four comparisons are inconclusive. On 141 reference-certified, contract-valid tasks, three independently trained graph-prefix systems score the same candidates. Best CodeBLEU has modest association with pass@10 ($ρ$ = .218-.246), compile@10 has weak association ($ρ$ = .072-.082), and only 21.0-23.3% of compiling candidates pass. A paired single-seed intervention that removes semantic names and related cues, while retaining types, arity, and instruction content, reduces coverage from 42/154 to 7/154 tasks. Matched graph perturbations show no detectable degradation under the semantic contract (six-test Holm p >= .750); instruction-use attribution remains unresolved. Across five decoding seeds on MF-174, the baseline solves 4.8 tasks on average, 15 at least once, and one in every seed. We recommend certifying references, aligning metrics on shared candidates, separating metadata from binary input, repeating sampling, and preserving provenance. The released capsule supports integrity checks and replay of archived outcomes.
papers.comment: Under review at ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM) after getting a major revision. This is the preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Dart AOT 二进制的神经反编译做基于执行的评测与指标审计：CodeBLEU 与 pass@10 只有弱相关（ρ=.218-.246），编译成功远不等于功能正确（仅 21.0-23.3% 通过），且去掉语义命名线索后覆盖率从 42/154 跌到 7/154。作者据此建议认证参考实现、在共享候选上对齐指标、分离元数据与二进制输入、重复采样并保留 provenance。
Motivation: 神经反编译的常用自动指标（CodeBLEU、compile@k）与真实功能正确性是否一致尚不清楚，且评测可能被任务元数据泄漏污染，导致 pass@k 分数不可信。
Method: 对 Dart AOT 二进制做执行式评测：六个归档 adapter-baseline 配对比较上对 pass@k（k=1,5,10）做配对检验并以 Holm 校正 18 个端点；在 141 个参考经认证、契约有效的任务上用三个独立训练的 graph-prefix 系统打分；另做单种子干预移除语义命名线索（保留类型、参数个数与指令内容）与匹配的图扰动实验，并在 MF-174 上跑五个解码种子。
Result: 两个 Qwen3-8B adapter 在所有 k 上均出现功能退化，其余四个比较结论不确定。141 任务上最佳 CodeBLEU 与 pass@10 相关 ρ=.218-.246，compile@10 与 pass@10 相关仅 ρ=.072-.082，编译成功的候选只有 21.0-23.3% 通过。移除语义命名后覆盖率 42/154 → 7/154；匹配图扰动在语义契约下无可测退化（六检验 Holm p ≥ .750）。MF-174 五种子：基线平均解 4.8 个任务，15 个至少解出一次，1 个每个种子都解出。
Conclusion: 现有反编译指标与功能正确性对不齐，评测易受元数据泄漏与单次采样影响；应认证参考、对齐指标、分离元数据、重复采样并保留 provenance，配套 capsule 支持完整性校验与结果重放。

papers.title: FuncBridge: Towards Functional Tool-Use Generalization via Keypoint Trajectory Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: While humans readily repurpose a book, a stone, or a shoe to drive a nail, robots trained on specific tools fail to transfer the same function to novel ones -- a gap we formalize as functional generalization. Functionally equivalent tools share visually recognizable functional intent, such as where contact can occur and how a contact region should move to the target. However, this perceptual similarity does not directly carry over to action space, where each tool demands a different motor pattern to realize the function. To bridge this gap, we explore intermediate representations including affordance images, human video prompts, functional videos and object masks, and 2D keypoint trajectories, finding that keypoint trajectories best balance functional expressiveness and action groundability. Building on this, we present FuncBridge, a two-stage framework that decouples functional reasoning from action execution: learning to predict generalizable keypoint trajectories from action-free data, then grounding them into robot actions with limited demonstrations. Across a benchmark spanning ten tools and three functions, including hitting, sweeping, and hooking, FuncBridge consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on unseen tools in both simulation and the real world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FuncBridge 把功能泛化拆成两段：先从无动作数据预测可迁移的 2D 关键点轨迹 (keypoint trajectory) 表达功能意图，再用少量演示把轨迹落地为机器人动作。在覆盖 10 种工具、3 种功能（hitting、sweeping、hooking）的基准上，对未见工具在仿真与真实世界中均持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 机器人在特定工具上学到的动作无法迁移到新工具，即功能泛化缺口：功能等价工具在视觉上共享接触点与接触区域运动意图，但这一相似性不直接对应动作空间，每种工具需要不同的运动模式。
Method: 先比较 affordance 图像、人类视频提示、功能视频与物体 mask、2D 关键点轨迹等中间表示，选定关键点轨迹；随后提出两阶段框架 FuncBridge，第一阶段从无动作 (action-free) 数据学习预测可泛化的关键点轨迹，第二阶段用有限演示将轨迹 grounding 为机器人动作，把功能推理与动作执行解耦。
Result: 在横跨 10 种工具、3 种功能（hitting、sweeping、hooking）的基准上，FuncBridge 对未见工具在仿真和真实世界中均持续优于 state-of-the-art 方法；中间表示对比中关键点轨迹在功能表达力与动作可接地性之间取得最佳平衡。
Conclusion: 关键点轨迹是连接功能意图与机器人动作的有效中间表示，两阶段解耦使功能推理可从无动作数据学习、动作执行只需少量演示，即可跨工具迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CompactionRL: Reinforcement Learning with Context Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agentic LLMs are increasingly limited by finite context windows, as extended interaction trajectories can exceed the maximum context length before a task is completed. Context compaction offers a natural solution by summarizing previous interaction states and continuing the rollout under a compressed context, but incorporating compaction into reinforcement learning remains underexplored. We propose CompactionRL, a reinforcement learning strategy to train long-horizon agentic LLMs with context compaction. Our approach jointly optimizes task execution and summary generation with token-level loss normalization and cross-segment generalized advantage estimation. This design enables the LLM agents to learn from compacted long-horizon trajectories. We train CompactionRL on top of open models and observe consistent performance gains on agentic coding tasks. CompactionRL enables the open GLM-4.5-Air model (106B-A12B) to achieve Pass@1 scores of 66.4% on SWE-bench Verified and 26.2% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, exceeding the base model under inference-time compaction by 6.6 and 4.9 points, respectively. Built upon GLM-4.7-Flash (30B-A3B), CompactionRL improves Pass@1 by 5.5 and 6.7 points against the base model, reaching 56.0% on SWE-bench Verified and 20.2% on Terminal-Bench 2.0. CompactionRL is thus deployed in the RL pipeline for training the open GLM-5.2 model (750B-A40B).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompactionRL 把上下文压缩 (context compaction) 直接嵌入强化学习训练，用 token 级损失归一化与跨段 GAE 联合优化任务执行和摘要生成，使长程 agent 轨迹可在压缩上下文下继续 rollout 并学习。在 GLM-4.5-Air (106B-A12B) 上 SWE-bench Verified Pass@1 达 66.4%、Terminal-Bench 2.0 达 26.2%，比推理期压缩的基线高 6.6 和 4.9 个百分点。
Motivation: 长程 agentic LLM 的交互轨迹会超出有限上下文窗口，任务尚未完成就被截断；压缩上下文虽能续跑，但如何把 compaction 纳入 RL 训练仍缺乏方法。
Method: 提出 CompactionRL：联合优化任务执行与摘要生成两项损失，用 token 级损失归一化 (token-level loss normalization) 平衡不同长度段的贡献，并用跨段广义优势估计 (cross-segment GAE) 让优势值跨越压缩边界回传，使 agent 能从被压缩的长程轨迹中学习；训练建立在开源模型之上。
Result: GLM-4.5-Air (106B-A12B)：SWE-bench Verified Pass@1 66.4%、Terminal-Bench 2.0 26.2%，分别比推理期压缩的基线高 6.6 和 4.9 个百分点。GLM-4.7-Flash (30B-A3B)：Pass@1 提升 5.5 和 6.7 个百分点，达到 SWE-bench Verified 56.0%、Terminal-Bench 2.0 20.2%。该方法已被用于开源 GLM-5.2 (750B-A40B) 的 RL 训练流程。
Conclusion: 把摘要生成与任务执行一起放进 RL 目标、并让优势估计跨压缩段传播，能让 agent 从压缩后的长程轨迹中有效学习，在 agentic coding 任务上带来一致增益，且可扩展到 750B 级模型的训练管线。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Transportation Hub Capacity Planning with Textual Business Inputs
papers.abstract_en: While traditional hub capacity planning models optimize effectively for quantitative inputs, they often fail to digest qualitative business context. We propose a novel framework where a large language model (LLM) agent iteratively proposes hub capacity decisions guided by natural-language business context descriptions. The key mechanism is a chain-of-thought reasoning protocol: the LLM constructs a structured decision table that maps each contextual item to specific capacity adjustments based on the implied direction and magnitude of changes. The new capacity decision is then validated through a feedback loop with an optimization model, which provides routing-based performance metrics to guide the agent's selection. On a real-world 13-hub freight network in the southeastern US, our framework achieves a 2.8% optimality gap relative to the hidden ground-truth, a significant improvement over the 11.0% gap produced by the traditional optimization model without textual business inputs. This demonstrates that LLMs can serve as a contextual bridge, integrating qualitative business insights into Operations Research workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出由 LLM agent 迭代给出枢纽容量决策的框架：用 chain-of-thought 把自然语言业务描述转成结构化决策表（每条语境对应容量调整的方向与幅度），再由优化模型经反馈回路给出基于路径的性能指标来筛选决策。在美国东南部真实 13 枢纽货运网络上，相对隐藏真值的 optimality gap 为 2.8%，而不用文本业务输入的传统优化模型为 11.0%。
Motivation: 传统枢纽容量规划模型只能吃定量输入，无法消化自然语言形式的定性业务语境，导致这类信息在 OR 决策流程中被丢弃。
Method: LLM agent 通过 chain-of-thought 协议构建结构化决策表，把每条语境条目映射为带方向与幅度的容量调整；新决策交给优化模型验证，优化模型返回 routing-based 性能指标作为反馈，指导 agent 迭代选择。
Result: 在真实 13 枢纽美国东南部货运网络上，相对隐藏真值的 optimality gap 为 2.8%；传统优化模型在没有文本业务输入时的 gap 为 11.0%。
Conclusion: LLM 可以作为语境桥梁，把定性业务洞察并入 Operations Research 工作流，并在该货运网络上显著缩小与真值的最优性差距。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Reading Between the Dots: Decoding Hidden Computation across Filler Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Frontier LLMs can perform multi-step reasoning over content-free filler tokens like dots or counting sequences, producing correct answers with no visible chain-of-thought (CoT). This is a limit case for behavioral oversight, where surface tokens carry no information about the underlying reasoning. But hidden from the output is not the same as hidden from us. On four task families (fact retrieval, parallel numeric composition, string manipulation, and in-context computation), two open-weights frontier models (DeepSeek V3, Kimi K2) compute over filler tokens in a legible way: attention routes the question through the filler region to the answer, logit-lens readouts show retrieved facts emerging early and their composition crystallizing in late layers, and KV-cache transplants at filler positions causally swap outputs between examples. We introduce an unsupervised decoding pipeline that takes only hidden states as input and recovers intermediate values with 82-94% accuracy (best LLM judge) across both models and all four tasks, without ground-truth labels or training. Even without a judge, the hidden values are already directly in the pipeline's top-2 tokens 35-85% of the time. The uplift persists whether the filler is prefilled or the model generates the filler itself. On these cleanly decomposable tasks, hidden computation that defeats behavioral CoT monitoring is readable from the residual stream, which suggests that monitorability is a property of the model's full computational trace rather than only its surface tokens.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, 10 main paper pages, 27 appendix pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 在无内容填充 token（点号、计数序列）上做多步推理时输出不含可见 CoT，但残差流仍可读：在四类任务上，仅用 hidden states 的无监督解码管线以 82-94% 准确率恢复中间值，无标签无训练。作者据此主张可监测性属于模型完整计算轨迹而非表层 token。
Motivation: 填充 token 上的推理对行为层面的 CoT 监督构成极限情形：表层输出不含任何推理信息，行为监督在此失效。
Method: 在四类任务（事实检索、并行数值组合、字符串操作、in-context 计算）上对 DeepSeek V3 与 Kimi K2 两个开放权重模型做机制分析：attention 路由、logit-lens 读出、在填充位置做 KV-cache transplants 交换输出；再提出仅以 hidden states 为输入的无监督解码管线恢复中间值，无需 ground-truth 标签或训练。
Result: 解码管线在两个模型、四类任务上恢复中间值准确率 82-94%（best LLM judge）；不用 judge 时，隐藏值直接出现在管线 top-2 token 中的比例为 35-85%；填充由模型自行生成或被 prefilled 时该优势均保持。
Conclusion: 在这些可干净分解的任务上，能躲过行为 CoT 监督的隐藏计算可从 residual stream 读出，可监测性是模型完整计算轨迹的性质而非仅表层 token 的性质。

papers.title: Separating Expert Retention from Autonomous Source Inference in Raw-ECG-Replay-Free Continual ECG Deployment
papers.abstract_en: In multi-source ECG deployment, new sources may arrive when earlier raw ECGs cannot be retained or replayed. Isolating source-specific classifiers on a frozen backbone prevents parameter interference, but source-unknown inference still requires selecting an appropriate expert. We study this distinction with IRFE-ECG, a controlled continual-deployment framework built on frozen 1024-dimensional ECGFounder features. Each arriving source adds an isolated Balanced-Softmax linear expert, while a lightweight router is re-fitted using retained frozen training features and source labels from previously observed sources. Rather than proposing a new routing architecture, the main contribution is to separate preserved expert performance from autonomous source inference and quantify the resulting deployment gap. Across CPSC, PTB-XL, Georgia, and Chapman-Shaoxing, source-aware expert selection reaches $0.7915 \pm 0.0036$ Macro-F1, close to a matched offline independent-head reference at $0.7885 \pm 0.0009$. Without source IDs, an MLP router reaches $0.7756 \pm 0.0027$, while top-2 margin fusion reaches $0.7782 \pm 0.0022$. The top-2 improvement is small (+0.0026) and not statistically significant under paired bootstrap. Across three domain orders, the top-2-to-oracle gap remains 0.0111-0.0133, indicating a persistent source-inference gap within this protocol. The results are record-level because reliable patient identifiers were unavailable. The method replays no raw ECGs, but it retains frozen feature vectors for router updates and is therefore raw-ECG-replay-free rather than memory-free. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/yufanlu221/IRFE-ECG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IRFE-ECG 在冻结的 1024 维 ECGFounder 特征上为每个新到来源挂一个 Balanced-Softmax 线性专家，再用保留的冻结特征与历史来源标签重拟合轻量路由器，把「专家保持」与「自主来源推断」分开量化。四数据集上 source-aware 选择 Macro-F1 0.7915±0.0036，无来源 ID 时 top-2 margin 融合 0.7782±0.0022，top-2 相对 MLP 路由仅 +0.0026 且配对 bootstrap 不显著，top-2 与 oracle 的差距在三种来源顺序下稳定在 0.0111–0.0133。
Motivation: 多源 ECG 持续部署中原始心电不可保留回放，冻结骨干上的隔离专家能避免参数干扰，但推理时来源未知仍须自行选专家，这一来源推断环节的代价此前未被单独量化。
Method: IRFE-ECG 框架：骨干为冻结的 1024 维 ECGFounder 特征，每个到达来源新增一个隔离的 Balanced-Softmax 线性专家；轻量路由器用保留的冻结训练特征与已见来源标签重新拟合，不提出新路由架构，而是分离专家保持性能与自主来源推断。
Result: 在 CPSC、PTB-XL、Georgia、Chapman-Shaoxing 上：source-aware 专家选择 Macro-F1 0.7915±0.0036，接近匹配的离线独立头参考 0.7885±0.0009；无来源 ID 时 MLP 路由 0.7756±0.0027，top-2 margin 融合 0.7782±0.0022，top-2 增益 +0.0026 且配对 bootstrap 不显著；三种来源顺序下 top-2 与 oracle 差距始终为 0.0111–0.0133。结果为 record 级，因缺少可靠患者标识。
Conclusion: 在该协议下来源推断差距持续存在：专家性能可被保留，但无来源 ID 的自主路由无法追平 oracle，top-2 融合的改进不足以显著缩小 0.0111–0.0133 的缺口；方法回放零原始 ECG，但保留冻结特征向量，属 raw-ECG-replay-free 而非 memory-free。

papers.title: Self-conditioned Flow Map Language Models via Fixed-point Flows
papers.abstract_en: Self-conditioning is a core technique that enhances continuous flow-based language models, where the model learns to denoise generated text by conditioning on its own denoising estimate. While empirically successful, its performance improvements are poorly understood. Moreover, there is growing interest in the use of few-step generators based on flow maps, for which how to leverage self-conditioning is unclear. Here, we show that flow language models with self-conditioning perform a fixed-point iteration that improves generation through iterative refinement. We use this viewpoint to formulate fixed-point flows, a two-dimensional class of self-conditioned flows, where the first dimension represents the flow process and the second represents the fixed-point iteration. We show that fixed-point flows define valid flow maps, and show that they can be distilled from self-conditioned flow models by compressing both fixed-point iterations and the flow process, the former with fixed-point distillation and the latter with flow map distillation. Our resulting flow map language model, FMLM$^\star$, outperforms state-of-the-art self-conditioned models and few-step models in one- and few-step generation on OpenWebText. Code is available at https://github.com/Ugness/self-conditioned-fmlm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把自条件 (self-conditioning) 的连续流语言模型解释为在做固定点迭代，据此提出二维的 fixed-point flows 类，并用固定点蒸馏与 flow map 蒸馏双重压缩得到少步生成模型 FMLM*。在 OpenWebText 的一步与少步生成上，FMLM* 超过现有自条件模型与少步模型。
Motivation: 自条件是连续流语言模型的核心技巧但其增益机制不清楚；对基于 flow map 的少步生成器如何利用自条件也缺乏理论框架。
Method: 先证明带自条件的流语言模型等价于执行固定点迭代式逐步精化，再将该视角形式化为 fixed-point flows：第一维表示流过程、第二维表示固定点迭代，并证明其定义了合法的 flow map；随后通过固定点蒸馏压缩迭代、flow map 蒸馏压缩流过程，从自条件流模型蒸馏出 FMLM*。
Result: FMLM* 在 OpenWebText 的一步与少步生成上均优于 state-of-the-art 的自条件模型和少步模型；代码发布于 github.com/Ugness/self-conditioned-fmlm。
Conclusion: 自条件的性能增益可被理解为固定点迭代，而把固定点迭代与流过程一起蒸馏是构造高效少步 flow map 语言模型的有效路径。

papers.title: Disentangling Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics: Identifiability of Latent SDEs via Diffusion Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Causal representation learning for time series has developed strong identifiability results in discrete-time latent causal models, but identifiability in continuous-time latent stochastic differential equation (SDE) models remains largely open. We address this gap using environment-induced shifts in diffusion covariance. We study additive-noise latent SDEs observed through an unknown nonlinear diffeomorphism, with shared drift but environment-specific diffusion covariance. We show that two diagonal diffusion regimes with pairwise distinct coordinate-wise variance ratios identify the latent coordinates up to permutation, coordinate-wise scaling, and a possible constant shift, without any sparsity assumption on the drift. We first prove this result for linear Ornstein-Uhlenbeck systems and then extend it to general additive-noise latent SDEs. Under mild smoothness, the instantaneous drift-Jacobian causal graph is identifiable up to the same permutation. We propose a two-stage estimator for latent disentanglement and optional graph recovery; experiments on synthetic systems confirm the predicted identifiability boundary, and an application to Hardanger Bridge monitoring data illustrates the approach on real sensor trajectories.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (camera-ready version). 53 pages, 15 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用环境间扩散协方差 (diffusion covariance) 的差异解决连续时间隐 SDE 的可辨识性：共享漂移、各环境特异扩散协方差的加性噪声隐 SDE，经未知非线性微分同胚观测，只要两个对角扩散体制的逐坐标方差比两两不同，隐坐标即可辨识到置换、逐坐标缩放和一个常数平移，且漂移无需任何稀疏假设。
Motivation: 离散时间隐因果模型已有成熟可辨识性结果，但连续时间隐 SDE 的可辨识性基本开放；作者用环境诱导的扩散偏移 (environment-induced shifts in diffusion covariance) 补这一空白。
Method: 设定为共享漂移、环境特异对角扩散协方差的加性噪声隐 SDE，观测经未知非线性微分同胚；先对线性 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 系统证明可辨识性，再推广到一般加性噪声隐 SDE，并在温和光滑性下得到瞬时漂移 Jacobian 因果图的可辨识性（同样到置换）。提出两阶段估计器做隐变量解耦与可选的图恢复。
Result: 两个对角扩散体制、逐坐标方差比两两不同即可把隐坐标辨识到置换、逐坐标缩放与常数平移，且对漂移不加稀疏假设；瞬时漂移-Jacobian 因果图在同样置换下可辨识。合成系统实验验证了预测的可辨识性边界，并在 Hardanger Bridge 监测数据的真实传感器轨迹上演示该方法。
Conclusion: 环境间的扩散差异本身就是足够的监督信号：无需漂移稀疏性即可恢复隐坐标，因果图恢复则是可选项。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Pepti-drift: Scalable Safe-Active Peptide Generation Without Inference-Time Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Therapeutic peptides are a promising drug modality, but their generation must satisfy multiple therapeutic constraints. We introduce BindSafe-PepBench, a fixed-budget benchmark that jointly evaluates target binding and four major safety metrics on the same generated candidates. We reveal that peptide length is a major confounder of joint binding-safety evaluation: longer peptides tend toward stronger predicted binding but less favorable predicted safety. This creates an apparent trade-off and can bias comparisons among models with different output-length distributions. We report absolute Safe-Active yield and exact-length-matched gains to distinguish generative improvements from output-length effects. High Safe-Active yield remains challenging, while the strongest multi-property methods rely on costly inference-time guidance. We therefore introduce Pepti-drift, a one-step generation framework that incorporates attraction toward target-specific binders and repulsion from liability-associated regions, requiring a single latent refinement followed by parallel decoding without inference-time guidance. Across 88 held-out targets, Pepti-drift achieves an 18.37% predicted Safe-Active yield while retaining positive exact-length-matched gains. The resulting gains are competitive with multi-property-guided baselines while requiring 468 times lower generation cost, enabling scalable and fair high-throughput peptide design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出治疗肽生成基准 BindSafe-PepBench，在同一候选上联合评估靶点结合与四项安全指标，并指出肽长是联合评估的主要混淆因子：长肽预测结合更强但安全性更差，会造成虚假权衡并偏置不同输出长度分布的模型比较。基于此提出单步生成框架 Pepti-drift，用向靶点特异结合子吸引、远离 liability 区域排斥的机制，仅需一次 latent 精修加并行解码、无需推理时引导，在 88 个留出靶点上取得 18.37% 的预测 Safe-Active yield，同时生成成本比多属性引导基线低 468 倍。
Motivation: 治疗肽生成需同时满足结合与多项安全约束，但现有联合评估被肽长混淆，且最强的多属性方法依赖昂贵的推理时引导，模型比较既不公平也难以规模化。
Method: 先构建固定预算基准 BindSafe-PepBench，对同一批生成候选联合评估靶点结合与四项主要安全指标，并报告绝对 Safe-Active yield 与 exact-length-matched gains 以剥离输出长度效应。再提出 Pepti-drift 单步生成框架：向靶点特异结合子吸引、从 liability 相关区域排斥，仅做一次 latent 精修后并行解码，全程不使用推理时引导。
Result: 在 88 个留出靶点上，Pepti-drift 达到 18.37% 的预测 Safe-Active yield，并保持正的 exact-length-matched gains；其收益与多属性引导基线相当，而生成成本低 468 倍。基准分析显示长肽倾向更强的预测结合但更差的预测安全，从而制造表面权衡。
Conclusion: 把吸引/排斥约束放进单步生成而非推理时引导，可以在保持长度匹配增益的同时把肽生成成本降低约两个数量级，从而支持可规模、可公平比较的高通量设计；高 Safe-Active yield 本身仍是难题。

papers.title: Skin-Deep: A Geometric Diagnostic for Alignment Fragility in Large Language Model Representations
papers.abstract_en: Refusal on a safety benchmark does not reveal how stable that behavior will remain after model updates. Benign downstream fine-tuning can weaken refusal, yet behavioral evaluations typically expose this fragility only after an intervention. We introduce SKIN-DEEP, a geometric diagnostic that examines the unmodified model's residual-stream activations. It compares aligned and base checkpoints to identify safety-separating directions, tests their behavioral relevance through ablation, and summarizes the layer-wise pattern in the Geometric Fragility Score (GFS). Across twenty-one instruction-tuned models, harmful requests and benign instructions exhibit a recurring low-rank separation pattern. Selected direction ablations weaken refusal, with the effective direction varying across models. In benign low-rank fine-tuning experiments, the initially safe model with the lowest score before fine-tuning has the lowest harmful-compliance rate when trained on the largest tested set of harmless examples. These findings connect representation geometry to subsequent behavioral susceptibility and support activation-based diagnostics as a complement to refusal tests. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/skin-deep.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SKIN-DEEP 是一种几何诊断：对比对齐与 base 检查点的残差流激活，找出分离有害与无害请求的安全方向，用消融检验其行为相关性，并按层汇总为 Geometric Fragility Score (GFS)。在 21 个指令微调模型上，有害/无患请求呈反复出现的低秩分离模式，方向消融会削弱拒绝行为；在良性低秩微调实验中，微调前 GFS 最低的初始安全模型在最大规模无害样本集上训练后有害顺从率也最低。
Motivation: 安全基准上的拒绝表现无法说明模型更新后该行为是否稳定；良性下游微调会削弱拒绝，而行为评测通常要等干预发生之后才暴露这种脆弱性。
Method: 读取未修改模型的残差流激活，对比 aligned 与 base checkpoint 以定位 safety-separating directions，对选中方向做消融 (ablation) 检验其行为相关性，再把逐层模式汇总为 Geometric Fragility Score (GFS)；随后在良性低秩微调实验中检验 GFS 与后续行为的关系。
Result: 在 21 个指令微调模型上，有害请求与无害指令呈现反复出现的低秩分离模式；对选中方向做消融会削弱拒绝，且有效方向因模型而异。良性低秩微调实验中，微调前分数最低的初始安全模型，在最大规模的无害样本集上训练后有害顺从率 (harmful-compliance rate) 最低。
Conclusion: 表示几何可以预测模型在良性微调后的行为易感性，激活层面的诊断可作为拒绝测试的补充，用于在干预之前暴露对齐脆弱性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Compressing History into Memory: Distilling Transformers into Recurrent Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers are AI's workhorse but their computational cost becomes prohibitive when processing long sequences. We target long-horizon streaming vision and robotics applications, where it is particularly impractical to store and maintain a history of observations. Recurrent Transformers address this limitation by maintaining fixed-size memory but their performance lags behind that of transformers operating over the full observation history. We argue that this gap does not stem from architectural limitations, but from differences in how these models learn to compress past information. Without access to an observation history, recurrent models must explicitly decide what to retain in memory at each step, a significantly harder learning problem. In this work, we propose a distillation approach that transfers the compression strategy of a classical full-history transformer to a recurrent variant. We enable this by designing a teacher model that explicitly compresses its observation history into a fixed-size bottleneck representation and directly supervise the student's memory with this bottleneck representation, effectively aligning the two compression mechanisms. We show that this approach allows to train a recurrent latent robotic memory with linear-time complexity on the Mem-RPE task while substantially narrowing the performance gap to full-history transformers. We additionally validate the same principle on streaming visual question answering (VQA) and observe improved recurrent predictions thanks to memory distillation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把全历史 Transformer 的压缩策略蒸馏进 Recurrent Transformer：教师模型先把观测历史压成定长瓶颈表征，再用该瓶颈直接监督学生的记忆，使两种压缩机制对齐。在 Mem-RPE 任务上训练出线性时间复杂度的 recurrent latent robotic memory，显著缩小与全历史 Transformer 的差距，并在流式 VQA 上因记忆蒸馏得到改善的递推预测。
Motivation: 长时程流式视觉与机器人任务中保存并维护观测历史代价过高；Recurrent Transformer 用定长记忆却落后于全历史模型，作者认为差距来自学习压缩过去信息的难度不同，而非架构本身。
Method: 蒸馏式训练：设计一个显式把观测历史压入定长瓶颈表征的教师模型，用该瓶颈直接监督学生的记忆状态，从而对齐教师与学生的压缩机制；学生为线性时间复杂度的 recurrent latent memory。
Result: 在 Mem-RPE 任务上以线性时间复杂度训练 recurrent latent robotic memory，显著缩小与 full-history transformer 的性能差距；同一原理在流式 VQA 上验证，记忆蒸馏带来改善的递推预测。
Conclusion: 全历史模型与递推模型的差距源于压缩策略的学习而非架构限制，把教师的压缩瓶颈蒸馏给学生记忆即可弥合。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Dyna-DINO: Efficient ViT Distillation Via Adaptive Representation Anchoring
papers.abstract_en: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) with Vision Transformer (ViT) backbones, such as DINOv2, have become essential for downstream tasks like object recognition and semantic segmentation. The immense computational requirements of backbones often necessitate distillation into smaller architectures for edge deployment. Feature-based knowledge distillation (KD) often suffers from the teacher-student gap; the student struggles to imitate teacher's complex feature map due to its limited capacity. To mitigate this bottleneck, we propose Dyna-DINO: Efficient ViT Distillation Via Adaptive Representation Anchoring, a training curriculum for ViT feature-based knowledge distillation. By utilizing the teacher's intermediate feature maps as a sequence of progressively more difficult targets, our curriculum allows the student to build a foundational representation before tackling higher-level abstractions. Our results demonstrate that this paradigm significantly accelerates convergence through adaptive difficulty selection across various student model sizes and dataset scales. With our curriculum, the Dyna-DINO distilled ViT-S achieves 90.1% accuracy on ImageNet-100, a +12.24% improvement compared with baseline. On ImageNet-1K, Dyna-DINO achieves +3.9% and +6.09% improvement for the instance retrieval task on the Oxford and Paris datasets, +1.93% improvements on semantic segmentation task, as well as meaningful performance gain on classification task. Furthermore, the curriculum enables 25.1% savings in training FLOPs and 21% savings in training time on ImageNet-100 by implementing early-stopping for teacher inference during the initial stages of training. Code is available at https://github.com/KevinZ0217/Dyna-DINO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dyna-DINO 是面向 ViT 特征蒸馏的训练课程：把教师中间特征图按难度递增排列作为渐进目标，学生先建立基础表征再逼近高层抽象，并在训练初期对教师推理做 early-stopping。蒸馏后的 ViT-S 在 ImageNet-100 上达到 90.1% 准确率，较基线提升 12.24%，同时节省 25.1% 训练 FLOPs 与 21% 训练时间。
Motivation: 特征蒸馏中教师-学生能力差距使学生难以模仿教师复杂特征图，收敛慢且训练开销大，需要在边缘部署的小模型上缓解这一瓶颈。
Method: 提出 Dyna-DINO 训练课程：以教师中间特征图序列作为逐步变难的目标，配合自适应难度选择 (adaptive difficulty selection) 让学生先构建基础表征；训练初期对教师推理实施 early-stopping 以降低开销，覆盖多种学生模型规模与数据集规模。
Result: 蒸馏 ViT-S 在 ImageNet-100 上准确率 90.1%，较基线提升 12.24%；ImageNet-1K 上实例检索任务在 Oxford 与 Paris 数据集分别提升 3.9% 与 6.09%，语义分割提升 1.93%，分类任务亦有提升；ImageNet-100 上训练 FLOPs 节省 25.1%、训练时间节省 21%。
Conclusion: 把教师特征按难度编排成课程并提前停掉早期教师推理，可同时加速 ViT 特征蒸馏收敛、提升下游精度并削减训练开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: INDEQS: Informed Neural controlled Differential EQuationS
papers.abstract_en: Neural Controlled Differential Equations (NCDE) provide a powerful continuous-time framework for forecasting time series, but standard graph-based extensions typically learn spatial structure purely from data, even in settings where a directed graph structure is known a priori. We introduce Informed Neural controlled Differential EQuationS (INDEQS), a modification to graph-based NCDE forecasting methods that incorporates prior knowledge of a directed graph at distinct architectural positions. INDEQS separates inner mixing of hidden states across graph nodes from outer mixing between vector field and control, and offers both a lightweight graph-constrained variant and a more expressive variant, learning additional graph connections from data via adaptive graph convolutions. To systematically study when graph informedness is beneficial in forecasting, we devise a continuous advection simulation on directed graphs, yielding synthetic spatio-temporal datasets with known ground-truth flow structure. We then evaluate INDEQS on two real-world tasks: river discharge forecasting on a hydrological network and traffic flow prediction on PeMS08. Across the synthetic and the river-discharge tasks, outer informedness consistently improves mean absolute error over an uninformed NCDE with comparable parameter count, particularly on larger graphs, while inner informedness offers a more parameter-efficient alternative when strict adherence to a known adjacency is desired. A comparison of discrete convolutional and continuous-time decoders further shows that continuous decoders yield better accuracy and greater temporal flexibility on real-world tasks. An implementation of INDEQS and the advection simulation is available at https://github.com/mitchi1/indeqs .

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: INDEQS 把已知有向图结构注入图神经受控微分方程 (graph-based NCDE) 的两个不同位置：外层混合（向量场与 control 之间）和内层混合（各节点隐状态之间），并给出图约束轻量版与用 adaptive graph convolution 从数据学额外连边的表达版。在合成平流、河流流量与 PeMS08 交通流任务上，外层注入在参数量相当的前提下一致降低 MAE，大图上更明显；内层注入在需要严格遵守已知邻接时更省参数；连续时间解码器在真实任务上精度更高且时间上更灵活。
Motivation: 图类 NCDE 通常完全从数据学空间结构，而在水文网络、路网这类先验已知有向图的场景里浪费了结构信息；缺少一个系统刻画“图先验在何处注入、何时真正有益”的框架。
Method: INDEQS 将图信息注入拆成 inner mixing（节点间隐状态混合）与 outer mixing（vector field 与 control 之间混合）两个架构位置，提供图约束轻量变体和经 adaptive graph convolution 学习额外连边的表达变体；为可控研究，作者构造有向图上的连续平流模拟，生成带真实流结构的合成时空数据集，并在水文网络河流流量与 PeMS08 交通流两个真实任务上评测，另比较离散卷积解码器与连续时间解码器。
Result: 在合成平流与河流流量任务上，outer informedness 相对参数量相当的 uninformed NCDE 一致降低 MAE，在更大的图上改善尤其明显；inner informedness 在需要严格遵循已知邻接时是更省参数的替代；离散卷积与连续时间解码器的对比显示，连续解码器在真实任务上精度更高、时间上更灵活。
Conclusion: 已知有向图应优先注入到 NCDE 的外层混合位置以换取跨节点的精度收益，图规模越大收益越大；若必须严格遵守给定邻接且在意参数量，则用内层注入，解码器选连续时间形式。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Vision-language models for chest radiography do not always need the image
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models that answer questions about chest radiographs are evaluated by their accuracy on labels derived from radiology reports. High benchmark accuracy is often interpreted as evidence that the model uses the image. A model that answers from the finding named in the question can score as well as a model that uses the radiograph. Keeping the question fixed, we audit eight open-weight systems by swapping in another patient's radiograph with the same or the opposite label, occluding the radiologist-marked region or an equal region elsewhere, and removing the radiograph or replacing it with noise or a photograph. On 2,548 yes-or-no questions from MIMIC-CXR, one multimodal model answers Yes regardless of the image, another multimodal model changes its answers without following the label, and four systems use the image but keep about half of their correct answers when the radiograph is swapped for an opposite-label radiograph. A medical model that receives only the question text scores 55.3% on the pooled questions, higher than two multimodal systems. It scores 91.8% where every finding is present, and answering Yes to every question scores 100% there. Where the image is necessary, the best multimodal system exceeds this model by 10.4% in balanced accuracy. The categories are unchanged on CheXpert. Confidence is not higher when a correct answer depends on the marked region. In a reader study with three radiologists, the two radiologists who read a balanced set of 200 cases score 86.0% and 82.0%, and the systems score 50.0% to 73.0%. Accuracy does not establish image use, but an intervention on the image can test it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对八个开源 VLM 做图像干预审计，证明胸片问答基准的高准确率并不等于模型真的在用图像：纯文本医学模型在 MIMIC-CXR 2,548 道 yes/no 问题上得 55.3%，高于两个多模态系统；只有在图像确实必要的子集上，最佳多模态系统才以 10.4% 的 balanced accuracy 领先。
Motivation: 胸片 VLM 基准用放射报告派生标签的准确率打分，高分被当作模型使用图像的证据，但只从问题里点名的 finding 作答也能拿到同样分数，图像是否被真正利用从未被单独检验。
Method: 固定问题文本，对八个开源权重系统施加图像干预：换成同标签或反标签的另一位患者胸片、遮挡放射科医师标记区域或等大其他区域、去掉胸片或换成噪声/照片；在 MIMIC-CXR 的 2,548 道 yes/no 问题上评测，并在 CheXpert 上复核类别，另做含三名放射科医师的 reader study。
Result: 一个多模态模型无论图像如何都答 Yes，另一个的回答随图像变化却不跟随标签，四个系统确实用图但换成反标签胸片后仍保住约一半正确答案；纯问题文本的医学模型在合并问题上 55.3%，高于两个多模态系统，在 finding 全部存在的子集上 91.8%（该子集全答 Yes 为 100%）；图像必要的子集上最佳多模态系统 balanced accuracy 高出 10.4%；类别结论在 CheXpert 上不变；正确答案依赖标记区域时置信度并未更高；reader study 中读 200 例平衡集的两名放射科医师得 86.0% 与 82.0%，系统为 50.0%–73.0%。
Conclusion: 准确率本身不能证明图像被使用，能检验这一点的是对图像施加干预；置信度也不能替代干预证据。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.tldr: 对八个开源 VLM 做图像干预审计，证明胸片问答基准的高准确率并不等于模型真的在用图像：纯文本医学模型在 MIMIC-CXR 2,548 道 yes/no 问题上得 55.3%，高于两个多模态系统；只有在图像确实必要的子集上，最佳多模态系统才以 10.4% 的 balanced accuracy 领先。
summary_sections.motivation: 胸片 VLM 基准用放射报告派生标签的准确率打分，高分被当作模型使用图像的证据，但只从问题里点名的 finding 作答也能拿到同样分数，图像是否被真正利用从未被单独检验。
summary_sections.method: 固定问题文本，对八个开源权重系统施加图像干预：换成同标签或反标签的另一位患者胸片、遮挡放射科医师标记区域或等大其他区域、去掉胸片或换成噪声/照片；在 MIMIC-CXR 的 2,548 道 yes/no 问题上评测，并在 CheXpert 上复核类别，另做含三名放射科医师的 reader study。
