papers.title: Principled Design of Diffusion-based Optimizers for Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Score-based diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art performance for inverse problems, but their practical deployment is hindered by long inference times and cumbersome hyperparameter tuning. While pretrained diffusion models can be reused across tasks without retraining, inference-time hyperparameters such as the noise schedule and posterior sampling weights typically require ad-hoc adjustment for each problem setup. We propose principled reparameterizations that induce invariances, allowing the same hyperparameters to be reused across multiple problems without re-tuning. In addition, building on the RED-diff framework, which reformulates posterior sampling as an optimization problem, we further develop the OptDiff pipeline. OptDiff provides a simplified tuning framework that facilitates the integration of convex optimization tools to accelerate inference. Experiments on image reconstruction, deblurring, and super-resolution show substantial speedups and improved image quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 score-based diffusion 求解逆问题时推理慢、超参需逐任务手调的问题，提出使超参跨问题不变的重参数化，并在 RED-diff 把后验采样改写为优化问题的基础上构建 OptDiff 管线，接入凸优化工具加速推理。在图像重建、去模糊与超分辨率实验中取得显著加速与图像质量提升。
Motivation: 预训练扩散模型可跨任务复用，但噪声调度与后验采样权重等推理期超参仍需针对每个问题 ad-hoc 调整，推理时间长，阻碍实际部署。
Method: 提出诱导不变性的超参重参数化，使同一组超参可跨多个问题复用而不必重调；并基于把后验采样重构为优化问题的 RED-diff 框架发展 OptDiff 管线，简化调参流程并便于接入凸优化工具加速推理。
Result: 在图像重建、去模糊 (deblurring) 与超分辨率 (super-resolution) 三类逆问题实验中取得显著加速 (substantial speedups) 与图像质量提升。
Conclusion: 通过不变性重参数化加优化式后验采样管线，扩散逆问题求解可以少调参、快推理且质量更好。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 提出诱导不变性的超参重参数化，使同一组超参可跨多个问题复用而不必重调；并基于把后验采样重构为优化问题的 RED-diff 框架发展 OptDiff 管线，简化调参流程并便于接入凸优化工具加速推理。
summary_sections.result: 在图像重建、去模糊 (deblurring) 与超分辨率 (super-resolution) 三类逆问题实验中取得显著加速 (substantial speedups) 与图像质量提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过不变性重参数化加优化式后验采样管线，扩散逆问题求解可以少调参、快推理且质量更好。

papers.title: DynGhost: Temporally-Modelled Transformer for Dynamic Ghost Imagings
papers.abstract_en: Ghost imaging reconstructs spatial information from a single-pixel bucket detector by correlating structured illumination patterns with scalar intensity measurements. While deep learning approaches have achieved promising results on static scenes, two critical limitations remain unaddressed: existing architectures fail to exploit temporal coherence across frames, leaving dynamic ghost imaging largely unsolved, and they assume additive Gaussian noise models that do not reflect the true Poissonian statistics of real single-photon hardware. We present DynGhost (Dynamic Ghost Imaging Transformer), a transformer architecture that addresses both limitations through alternating spatial and temporal attention blocks. Our quantum-aware training framework, based on physically accurate detector simulations (SNSPDs, SPADs, SiPMs) and Anscombe variance-stabilizing normalization, resolves the distribution shift that causes classical models to fail under realistic hardware constraints. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that DynGhost outperforms both traditional reconstruction methods and existing deep learning architectures, with particular gains in dynamic and photon-starved settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynGhost 用交替的空间与时间注意力块建模帧间时间相关性，并以 SNSPD、SPAD、SiPM 探测器物理仿真加 Anscombe 方差稳定化归一化处理单光子硬件的泊松统计，解决动态鬼成像 (dynamic ghost imaging) 在真实硬件下失效的问题。在多个基准上超过传统重建方法与已有深度学习架构，优势在动态场景与光子饥饿条件下最明显。
Motivation: 现有深度学习鬼成像架构不利用帧间时间相关性，动态场景基本无解；同时假设加性高斯噪声，与真实单光子探测器的泊松统计不符，导致模型在真实硬件约束下失效。
Method: 提出 DynGhost (Dynamic Ghost Imaging Transformer)，由交替的空间注意力与时间注意力块组成；训练框架基于物理精确的探测器仿真（SNSPDs、SPAD、SiPMs）并采用 Anscombe 方差稳定化归一化，以消除经典模型与真实硬件之间的分布偏移。
Result: 在多个基准上的实验中，DynGhost 同时超过传统重建方法与已有深度学习架构，且在动态场景和光子饥饿 (photon-starved) 设置下增益尤为突出。
Conclusion: 把时间相关性建模与符合探测器泊松统计的量子感知训练结合起来，是让鬼成像在动态、低光子数真实硬件上可用的关键。

papers.title: dFlowGRPO: Rate-Aware Policy Optimization for Discrete Flow Models
papers.abstract_en: Discrete flow models (DFMs) are a class of flexible generative models for generating discrete data, and diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can be viewed as a special case with a specific choice of a mixture path and a masked source distribution. While several recent works have explored reinforcement learning for dLLMs, its application to more general discrete flow models remains underexplored. In this work, we present discrete Flow-GRPO (dFlowGRPO), a unified reinforcement learning framework for discrete flow models that supports a broad family of probability paths and non-masked source distributions. We derive the full trajectory probability for DFMs and formulate the denoising process as a Markov decision process, enabling dFlowGRPO to incorporate information from both the associated conditional transition rates and the posterior model during reinforcement learning. We apply dFlowGRPO to FUDOKI, a recent multimodal discrete flow model, and evaluate it on both image generation and multimodal understanding tasks. Empirical results show that dFlowGRPO outperforms existing GRPO-type methods for dLLMs on text-to-image generation tasks and achieves performance competitive with continuous flow-based models trained using Flow-GRPO, while also demonstrating strong capabilities on understanding tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: dFlowGRPO 把 GRPO 类强化学习从 diffusion LLM 推广到一般离散流模型 (discrete flow models)：推导 DFM 的完整轨迹概率并把去噪过程写成 MDP，训练时同时利用条件转移率 (conditional transition rates) 与后验模型信息，支持广泛概率路径与非掩码源分布。在多模态离散流模型 FUDOKI 上，文生图任务超过面向 dLLM 的现有 GRPO 方法，性能与用 Flow-GRPO 训练的连续流模型相当，理解任务也表现强劲。
Motivation: 已有 RL 工作基本只针对 diffusion LLM 这一特例（特定 mixture path 加掩码源分布），对具有更广概率路径与非掩码源分布的一般离散流模型如何做 RL 仍被忽视。
Method: 推导 DFM 的完整轨迹概率，将去噪过程形式化为马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP)，使策略优化能同时纳入条件转移率与后验模型；框架统一支持一大类概率路径和非掩码源分布，并应用于多模态离散流模型 FUDOKI。
Result: 在 FUDOKI 上评测文生图与多模态理解任务：文生图超过现有面向 dLLM 的 GRPO 型方法，性能与用 Flow-GRPO 训练的连续流模型相当，理解任务同样展现强能力。
Conclusion: 把轨迹概率与转移率显式写进 MDP 后，GRPO 式 RL 可以脱离 dLLM 特例推广到一般离散流模型，并在文生图上追平连续流的 Flow-GRPO。

papers.title: SkillLens: Adaptive Multi-Granularity Skill Reuse for Cost-Efficient LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Skill libraries have become a practical way for LLM agents to reuse procedural experience across tasks. However, existing systems typically treat skills as flat, single-resolution prompt blocks. This creates a tension between relevance and cost: injecting coarse skills can introduce irrelevant or misleading context, while rewriting entire skills is expensive and often unnecessary. We propose SkillLens, a hierarchical skill-evolution framework that organizes skills into a four-layer graph of policies, strategies, procedures, and primitives, and retrieves them at mixed granularity. Given a task, SkillLens first retrieves semantically relevant skill seeds, expands them through degree-corrected random walk over the skill graph, and then uses a verifier to decide whether each visited unit should be accepted, decomposed, rewritten, or skipped. This enables the agent to reuse compatible subskills directly while adapting only locally mismatched components. To improve the system over time, SkillLens further refines multi-granularity skills and verifier in order to improve its routing decisions. We provide theoretical analysis showing that mixed-granularity adaptation incurs sublinear cost under sparse mismatch assumptions and that the evolutionary update rule monotonically improves the validation objective until a local optimum. Across MuLocbench and ALFWorld, SkillLens consistently improves over strong skill-based baselines, achieving up to a 6.31 percentage-point Acc@1 gain for bug localization and raising agent success rate from 45.00% to 51.31%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillLens 把 LLM agent 的技能库从扁平 prompt 块改成四层技能图（policies/strategies/procedures/primitives），按混合粒度检索复用：先取语义相关种子，经度修正随机游走扩展，再由 verifier 决定每个单元接受、分解、改写或跳过。在 MuLocbench 与 ALFWorld 上，bug 定位 Acc@1 最多提升 6.31 个百分点，agent 成功率从 45.00% 升到 51.31%。
Motivation: 现有技能库把技能当作单一分辨率的 prompt 块，注入粗粒度技能会带来无关或误导上下文，而整体重写技能成本高且常无必要，相关性与成本之间存在张力。
Method: 构建四层技能图并支持混合粒度检索：先检索语义相关技能种子，用度修正随机游走 (degree-corrected random walk) 在技能图上扩展，再由 verifier 对访问到的单元做接受/分解/改写/跳过决策；同时持续精化多粒度技能与 verifier 以改进路由。附带理论分析：稀疏失配假设下混合粒度适配代价为次线性，进化更新规则使验证目标单调提升至局部最优。
Result: 在 MuLocbench 与 ALFWorld 上一致优于强技能基线：bug 定位 Acc@1 最多提升 6.31 个百分点，agent 成功率从 45.00% 提高到 51.31%。
Conclusion: 按失配位置做局部多粒度复用，比整块注入或整体重写技能更省成本且更有效；理论保证代价次线性且更新单调改进至局部最优。

papers.title: Your Language Model is Its Own Critic: Reinforcement Learning with Value Estimation from Actor's Internal States
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for Large Reasoning Models rests on variance reduction, which requires both a reliable baseline and high prompt diversity within each training batch. This is especially difficult in multi-domain training for general reasoning models, where prompts from different tasks induce highly diverse gradient signals. Existing approaches fall short in different ways: GRPO estimates its baseline as the group mean over rollouts from the same prompt, so an accurate baseline leaves fewer distinct prompts in the batch, while PPO avoids this trade-off by training a policy scale critic, roughly doubling the cost of training. We introduce POISE (Policy Optimization with Internal State Value Estimation), a reinforcement learning algorithm that turns the model's internal states into a value model. A lightweight probe reads the signals already computed during the forward pass to predict the baseline, and is trained online alongside the policy. To preserve gradient unbiasedness, we introduce a cross-rollout construction that predicts each rollout's value from an independent rollout's internal states. On Qwen3-4B and OLMo3-7B-Instruct-DPO across a six-domain verifiable-reward corpus, POISE outperforms other RLVR baselines while achieving more stable training. Moreover, the probe matches a separate LLM-scale value model, generalizes to various tasks, and remains accurate as the policy scales. By leveraging the model's internal representations, POISE enables stable policy optimization.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026; Project Page: https://elijah0430.github.io/poise/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: POISE 用一个轻量 probe 直接读取前向传播中已有的内部状态来预测 RLVR 的 baseline，并用 cross-rollout 构造（用另一条 rollout 的内部状态预测本条 rollout 的值）保证梯度无偏。在 Qwen3-4B 与 OLMo3-7B-Instruct-DPO、六个可验证奖励领域的语料上，POISE 优于其他 RLVR 基线且训练更稳定，probe 达到独立 LLM 级 value model 的水平并随策略扩展保持准确。
Motivation: RLVR 的方差削减同时需要可靠 baseline 和批内 prompt 多样性：GRPO 用同 prompt 的组均值当 baseline，准确的 baseline 会挤掉批内不同 prompt 的数量；PPO 避开这一取舍但要训练 policy-scale critic，训练成本约翻倍。多领域通用推理训练中不同任务的 prompt 梯度信号高度多样，使这一矛盾更尖锐。
Method: POISE（Policy Optimization with Internal State Value Estimation）把模型内部状态当作 value model：轻量 probe 读取前向过程中已算好的信号来预测 baseline，并与策略在线联合训练；为保持梯度无偏，采用 cross-rollout 构造，用一条独立 rollout 的内部状态预测另一条 rollout 的值。
Result: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 OLMo3-7B-Instruct-DPO、六领域可验证奖励语料上，POISE 优于其他 RLVR 基线且训练更稳定；probe 与独立的 LLM 级 value model 表现相当，能泛化到多种任务，并在策略规模增大时保持准确。
Conclusion: 利用模型自身内部表征即可替代独立 critic，同时拿到可靠 baseline、批内 prompt 多样性和更低训练开销，使策略优化更稳定。

papers.title: LensVLM: Selective Context Expansion for Compressed Visual Representation of Text
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) offer the exciting possibility of processing text as rendered images, bypassing the need for tokenizing the text into long token sequences. Since VLM image encoders map fixed-size images to a fixed number of visual tokens, varying rendering resolution provides a fine-grained compression knob. However, accuracy deteriorates quickly as compression increases: characters shrink below the vision encoder's effective resolution, making them indistinguishable. To address this, we propose LensVLM, an inference framework and post-training recipe that enables VLMs to scan compressed images, then selectively expand only the relevant images to their uncompressed form via learned tools. Building on Qwen3.5-9B-Base, LensVLM maintains accuracy comparable to the full-text upper bound at 4.3$\times$ effective compression and outperforms retrieval-based, text- and visual-compression baselines up to 10.1$\times$ effective compression across seven text QA benchmarks. LensVLM also generalizes to multimodal document and code understanding tasks, with the accuracy gain over baselines growing as compression increases. Our analysis validates this approach: training makes visual compression robust to rendering choices, and as compression grows the model increasingly relies on expanded content rather than unreliable visual reading. The analysis also yields practical tool-choice guidance: text expansion is preferable for rendered text, while high-resolution image expansion suits native documents whose layout cues carry task-relevant information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LensVLM 是一个推理框架加后训练方案：让 VLM 先看压缩渲染的文本图像，再用学到的工具只把相关部分展开回未压缩形式。基于 Qwen3.5-9B-Base，在 4.3× 有效压缩下保持与全文本上界相当的准确率，最高在 10.1× 有效压缩下超过检索式与文本/视觉压缩基线，覆盖七个文本 QA 基准。工具选择上，渲染文本优先文本展开，版面线索承载任务信息的原生文档用高分辨率图像展开。
Motivation: 把文本渲染成图像可绕开长 token 序列，但图像编码器把固定尺寸图映射为固定数量视觉 token，压缩一高字符就低于视觉编码器有效分辨率而不可辨认，准确率迅速下降。
Method: LensVLM 由推理框架与后训练配方组成：模型先扫描压缩图像，再通过学到的工具选择性地把相关图像展开为未压缩形式；渲染分辨率作为压缩旋钮，基座为 Qwen3.5-9B-Base。
Result: 在七个文本 QA 基准上，4.3× 有效压缩时准确率与全文本上界相当，最高在 10.1× 有效压缩下优于检索式、文本压缩与视觉压缩基线；在多模态文档与代码理解任务上同样泛化，且随压缩增大相对基线的准确率增益变大。分析显示训练使视觉压缩对渲染选择更稳健，压缩越大模型越依赖展开内容而非不可靠的视觉读取。
Conclusion: 选择性上下文展开能在大幅压缩下保住 VLM 文本理解准确率，且压缩越高展开越关键；工具选择按内容类型分流——渲染文本用文本展开，版面有信息量的原生文档用高分辨率图像展开。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification in Forecast Comparisons
papers.abstract_en: Skill scores, which measure the relative improvement of a forecasting method over a benchmark via consistent scoring functions and proper scoring rules, are a standard tool in forecast evaluation, yet their sampling uncertainty is rarely rigorously quantified. With modern forecasting applications being increasingly multivariate and involving evaluations across multiple horizons, variables, spatial locations, and forecasting methods, standard tools like the pairwise Diebold-Mariano forecast accuracy test or pointwise confidence intervals fail to account for the multiple comparison problem, leading to inflated Type I error rates and invalid joint inference. To address the lack of a coherent, statistically rigorous framework for quantifying uncertainty across these multi-dimensional evaluation problems, we introduce simultaneous confidence bands for expected scores and skill scores. Our framework provides a versatile tool for joint inference that is applicable to any forecast type from mean and quantile to full distributional forecasts. We develop a bootstrap implementation and show that our bands are valid under multivariate extensions of the classical Diebold-Mariano assumptions. We demonstrate the practical utility of the approach in two case studies by quantifying the benefits of time-varying parameter models for macroeconomic forecasting, and by comparing data-driven and physics-based models in probabilistic weather forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出预报技巧评分 (skill score) 的同时置信带 (simultaneous confidence bands)，在多变量、多预报时次、多变量、多空间点、多方法的比较中做联合推断，替代逐点置信区间与成对 Diebold-Mariano 检验。该框架适用于均值、分位数到完整分布预报，bootstrap 实现的置信带在经典 Diebold-Mariano 假设的多变量推广下有效，并在宏观经济与天气概率预报两个案例中演示。
Motivation: 现代预报评估横跨多个时次、变量、空间点与方法，成对 Diebold-Mariano 检验和逐点置信区间无法处理多重比较问题，导致 Type I error 膨胀、联合推断失效；而 skill score 的采样不确定性很少被严格量化。
Method: 为期望评分与技巧评分构造同时置信带，覆盖任意预报类型（均值、分位数、完整分布预报）；给出 bootstrap 实现，并证明其在经典 Diebold-Mariano 假设的多变量推广下有效。
Result: 在两个案例中演示：用时间变化参数模型做宏观经济预报的收益量化，以及数据驱动与物理模型在概率天气预报 (probabilistic weather forecasting) 上的比较。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 多重比较下的预报比较需要联合推断框架，同时置信带可作为跨时次、变量、空间点与方法的通用不确定性量化工具。

papers.title: VIDA: A Dataset for Visually Dependent Ambiguity in Multimodal Machine Translation
papers.abstract_en: Ambiguity resolution is a key challenge in multimodal machine translation (MMT), where models must genuinely leverage visual input to map an ambiguous expression to its intended meaning. Although prior work has proposed disambiguation-oriented benchmarks probing the role of vision, we observe that existing benchmarks remain limited by task-format mismatch, narrow ambiguity coverage, or insufficient visual-dependency validation. Moreover, existing ambiguity evaluations are not well suited to diverse ambiguity types in open-ended translation. To address these limitations, we present VIDA (Visually-Dependent Ambiguity), a dataset of 2,500 carefully curated instances in which resolving an annotated source span requires visual evidence. We further propose Disambiguation-Centric Metrics that use an LLM-as-a-judge classifier to verify whether annotated ambiguous expressions are resolved correctly at the span level. Evaluations with stronger recent LVLMs show that visual disambiguation remains challenging. Using chain-of-thought supervised fine-tuning as a diagnostic setting, we observe stronger out-of-distribution disambiguation than with SFT, with robust gains on collective-noun ambiguities and model-dependent gains on sentence-level ambiguities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIDA 提出面向多模态机器翻译 (MMT) 的视觉依赖歧义数据集，含 2,500 个必须依赖视觉证据才能消解标注源语言片段的样本，并配套 Disambiguation-Centric Metrics，用 LLM-as-a-judge 分类器在 span 级判定歧义是否被正确消解。近期强 LVLM 评测显示视觉消歧仍困难；以 chain-of-thought 监督微调 (CoT SFT) 作诊断设置时，其分布外消歧强于普通 SFT，集体名词歧义增益稳健，句子级歧义增益依模型而异。
Motivation: 现有面向消歧的视觉 MMT 基准受限于任务形式不匹配、歧义类型覆盖窄、视觉依赖性验证不足，且不适配开放式翻译中多样的歧义类型。
Method: 构建 VIDA 数据集：2,500 个精挑实例，每个实例的标注源语言 span 必须借助视觉证据才能消解；提出 Disambiguation-Centric Metrics，用 LLM-as-a-judge 分类器在 span 级验证歧义是否被正确消解；评测近期强 LVLM，并以 chain-of-thought 监督微调 (CoT SFT) 作为诊断设置与普通 SFT 对比。
Result: 数据集规模 2,500 个实例；近期强 LVLM 评测显示视觉消歧仍具挑战；CoT SFT 相比普通 SFT 表现出更强的分布外 (out-of-distribution) 消歧能力，其中集体名词歧义 (collective-noun ambiguities) 增益稳健，句子级歧义增益依模型而异。
Conclusion: 视觉依赖歧义是当前 LVLM 在 MMT 中仍未解决的短板，而以 chain-of-thought 微调可改善分布外消歧，且效果按歧义类型（集体名词 vs 句子级）分化。

papers.title: Domain-Adapted Small Language Models for Reliable Clinical Triage
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and consistent Emergency Severity Index (ESI) assignment remains a persistent challenge in emergency departments, where highly variable free-text triage documentation contributes to mistriage and workflow inefficiencies. This study evaluates whether open-source small language models (SLMs) can serve as reliable, privacy-preserving decision-support tools for clinical triage. We systematically compared multiple SLMs across diverse prompting pipelines and found that clinical vignettes, concise summaries of triage narratives, yielded the most accurate predictions. The SLM, Qwen2.5-7B, demonstrated the strongest balance of accuracy, stability, and computational efficiency. Through large-scale domain adaptation using expert-curated and silver-standard pediatric triage data, fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B models substantially reduced discordance and clinically significant errors, outperforming all baseline SLMs and advanced proprietary large language models (LLMs, e.g., GPT-4o). These findings highlight the feasibility of institution-specific SLMs for reliable, privacy-preserving ESI decision support and underscore the importance of targeted fine-tuning over more complex inference strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在急诊分诊场景下，把 Qwen2.5-7B 用专家标注与 silver-standard 儿科分诊数据做领域微调，可显著降低 ESI 分级不一致与临床显著错误，在准确率、稳定性与算力开销上优于全部基线 SLM 及 GPT-4o 等专有大模型。结论是：面向机构的隐私保护分诊决策支持应优先做针对性微调，而非堆更复杂的推理策略。
Motivation: 急诊自由文本分诊记录高度不一致，导致 ESI 分级错误与流程低效；通用大模型既不保证准确也不便在机构内私有部署。
Method: 系统比较多个开源 SLM 与多种 prompt 流水线，选出以临床 vignette（分诊叙述的精简摘要）为输入的方案；再用专家整理与 silver-standard 儿科分诊数据对 Qwen2.5-7B 做大规模领域微调，与基线 SLM 和 GPT-4o 等专有 LLM 对比。
Result: 临床 vignette 形式的输入取得最高预测准确率；Qwen2.5-7B 在准确率、稳定性与计算效率上平衡最强；微调后的 Qwen2.5-7B 显著降低不一致率与临床显著错误，优于所有基线 SLM 及 GPT-4o 等专有 LLM。
Conclusion: 机构自有的小型模型配合针对性微调足以支撑可靠、隐私保护的 ESI 分诊决策，微调比更复杂的推理策略更关键。

papers.title: The material life cycle of Koobor: separating coherent organization from potential-vorticity evolution in a wildfire-generated stratospheric vortex
papers.abstract_en: Pyro-cumulonimbus convection associated with extreme wildfires can generate long-lived stratospheric vortices, yet their material coherence and life cycle remain poorly characterized. We apply geodesic vortex detection to winds from reanalysis to identify objectively defined (observer-independent) material boundaries of \emph{Koobor}, generated by the 2019--2020 Australian bushfires. These boundaries are closed material curves that undergo uniform finite-time tangential stretching and resist filamentation. We reconstruct their evolution across isentropic levels. Material coherence develops upward from 590~K, reaches maximum persistence at 690~K, and becomes progressively shorter-lived at higher levels. At 690~K, the reconstructed birth-to-death interval is approximately 40~days, while overlapping detections across levels define a nearly 60-day envelope. Analysis of potential vorticity (PV) within and around these material boundaries reveals a distinct dynamical evolution: the material boundary forms before strong PV isolation develops, a compact PV core emerges during the mature phase, and PV isolation weakens as material coherence approaches its demise. Strong PV isolation is concentrated at intermediate levels, whereas at 850~K material coherence occurs without a comparably well-defined PV core. These results provide an objective material description of the birth, vertical development, and decay of a wildfire-generated stratospheric vortex and show that material organization precedes the development of its strongest PV signature, which subsequently intensifies and weakens over the lifetime of the coherent vortex.
papers.comment: Improved version of an earlier manuscript submitted to NPG, with a substantially revised treatment of material coherence and the addition of potential-vorticity analysis. The revised manuscript will be submitted to JGR: Atmospheres. Comments welcome!
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用测地线涡旋识别 (geodesic vortex detection) 从再分析风场中客观提取 2019–2020 澳洲山火生成的平流层涡旋 Koobor 的物质边界，发现物质相干性先于位涡 (PV) 隔离出现：边界在 590 K 自下而上发展，690 K 持久性最强（出生到消亡约 40 天，跨等熵面重叠检测给出近 60 天包络），而强 PV 核在成熟期才形成、随相干性消亡而减弱，850 K 上有物质相干却无清晰 PV 核。
Motivation: 野火生成的平流层涡旋寿命长，但其物质相干性 (material coherence) 与生命周期此前缺少客观、与观测者无关的刻画，物质组织与位涡演化的关系也不清楚。
Method: 对再分析风场施加测地线涡旋识别，得到由均匀有限时间拉伸、抗丝化 (resist filamentation) 的闭合物质曲线构成的边界，并沿多个等熵面重建其演化；再对比边界内外的位涡 (PV) 结构，追踪物质边界与 PV 隔离的先后关系。
Result: 物质相干自 590 K 向上发展，在 690 K 持久性最强，更高层逐渐缩短；690 K 上出生到消亡约 40 天，跨等熵面重叠检测给出近 60 天包络。PV 分析显示物质边界先于强 PV 隔离形成，成熟期出现紧致 PV 核，相干性接近消亡时 PV 隔离减弱；强 PV 隔离集中在中层，850 K 上有物质相干但无同等清晰的 PV 核。
Conclusion: Koobor 的物质组织先于其最强 PV 特征的发展，PV 核随后在相干涡旋生命周期内增强再减弱，因此物质边界与位涡隔离是可分离的两个演化维度。
Relevance: 41

papers.title: Multicalibration for Unbiased Model-Based Prevalence Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Estimating the prevalence of a category in a population using imperfect measurement devices (diagnostic tests, classifiers, or large language models) is fundamental to science, public health, and online trust and safety. Standard approaches correct for known device error rates but assume these rates remain stable across populations. We show this assumption fails under covariate shift and that multicalibration, which enforces calibration conditional on the input features rather than just on average, is sufficient for unbiased prevalence estimation under such shift. Standard calibration and quantification methods fail to provide this guarantee. Our work connects recent theoretical work on fairness to a longstanding measurement problem spanning nearly all academic disciplines. A simulation confirms that standard methods exhibit bias growing with shift magnitude, while a multicalibrated estimator maintains near-zero bias. While we focus the discussion mostly on LLMs, our theoretical results apply to any classification model. Two empirical applications -- estimating employment prevalence across U.S. states using the American Community Survey, and classifying political texts across four countries using an LLM -- demonstrate that multicalibration substantially reduces bias in practice, while highlighting that calibration data should cover the key feature dimensions along which target populations may differ.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 标准流行率估计只按平均校准设备错误率，一旦目标总体沿特征维度发生协变量偏移，错误率不再稳定，估计即产生随偏移量增长的偏差。

papers.title: SWE-chat: Coding Agent Interactions From Real Users in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are being adopted at scale, yet we lack empirical evidence on how people actually use them and how much of their output is useful in practice. We present SWE-chat, the first large-scale dataset of real coding agent sessions collected from open-source developers in the wild. The dataset currently contains almost 18,000 sessions, comprising more than 229,000 user prompts and 2 million agent tool calls. SWE-chat is a living dataset; our collection pipeline automatically and continually discovers and processes sessions from public repositories. Leveraging SWE-chat, we provide an initial empirical characterization of real-world coding agent usage and failure modes. We find that coding patterns are bimodal: in 41% of sessions, agents author virtually all committed code ("vibe coding"), while in 25%, humans write all code themselves. Despite rapidly improving capabilities, coding agents remain inefficient in natural settings. Only 59% of all agent-produced code survives into user commits, and agent-written code introduces more security vulnerabilities than code authored by humans. Furthermore, users push back against agent outputs - through corrections, failure reports, and interruptions - in 50% of all turns. By capturing complete interaction traces with human vs. agent code authorship attribution, SWE-chat provides an empirical foundation for moving beyond curated benchmarks towards an evidence-based understanding of how AI agents perform in real developer workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-chat 是首个从开源开发者真实使用场景采集的大规模编码 agent 会话数据集，约 18,000 个会话、229,000+ 条用户 prompt、200 万次 agent 工具调用，并带人写/agent 写代码归属标注。使用模式呈双峰：41% 会话中 agent 几乎写完全部提交代码（vibe coding），25% 中人全手写；仅 59% 的 agent 生成代码存活到用户提交，且 agent 写的代码引入的安全漏洞多于人写代码，50% 的轮次中用户会以纠错、失败报告或打断方式回推。
Motivation: 编码 agent 已被大规模采用，但缺少真实使用场景下的经验证据：人们实际怎么用、产出中有多少真正可用、失败模式是什么，而已有评估主要依赖 curated benchmark。
Method: 构建 SWE-chat：一条自动且持续运行的采集管线，从公开仓库发现并处理真实编码 agent 会话，形成 living dataset；每条 trace 记录完整交互并标注代码由人还是 agent 撰写，随后在此之上做使用模式与失败模式的实证刻画。
Result: 数据集约 18,000 个会话、229,000+ 用户 prompt、200 万次 agent 工具调用；41% 会话 agent 写了几乎全部提交代码，25% 会话人写全部代码；仅 59% 的 agent 生成代码存活到用户提交；agent 写的代码比人写代码引入更多安全漏洞；50% 的轮次中用户对 agent 输出做出回推（纠错、失败报告、打断）。
Conclusion: 真实开发者工作流中的编码 agent 使用呈双峰分化且效率偏低，产出存活率与安全性都不足，需要从 curated benchmark 转向基于真实交互 trace 的证据化评估。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning from the Near Future: Temporal Self-Distillation for RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a core post-training recipe for reasoning models, yet pure on-policy learning can be inefficient when useful trajectories are difficult to discover or exploration narrows. Existing self-guided approaches largely reuse capability already available to the current or earlier learner. We instead ask whether learning can also make use of capabilities that emerge later in training: can a model learn from its own future self? We introduce temporal self-distillation, in which a policy receives guidance from a stronger later checkpoint of itself. We hypothesize that the most useful temporal teacher need not be the strongest one: a teacher must provide sufficiently new capability while remaining compatible enough for that capability to be readily transferred, motivating a near-future regime. We study this principle through two complementary mechanisms. Near-Future Policy Optimization (NPO) performs off-policy behavioral transfer using verified future-self trajectories, while Near-Future Policy Distillation (NPD) performs on-policy token-level transfer on learner-generated trajectories. We further introduce AutoNPO, which adaptively determines when temporal guidance is useful and how far to roll back, turning future-self guidance into a repeated self-bootstrap process. Across eight image-text benchmarks, NPO improves GRPO from 60.25 to 62.84 and AutoNPO reaches 63.15, with consistent gains on text-only and video reasoning. Under NPD, a near-future teacher reaches 63.23 after continued RL versus 61.92 with a far-future teacher, despite lower immediate post-distillation performance. Together, these results suggest that effective temporal self-distillation depends not simply on teacher strength, but on a balance between newly acquired capability and learner compatibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出时间自蒸馏 (temporal self-distillation)：RLVR 训练中的策略从自己更晚的 checkpoint 取引导，而非复用当前或早期能力。两个机制——Near-Future Policy Optimization (NPO) 用已验证的未来自身轨迹做离策略行为迁移，Near-Future Policy Distillation (NPD) 在学习者生成轨迹上做同策略 token 级迁移——加上自适应决定何时引导、回滚多远的 AutoNPO。八个图文基准上 GRPO 从 60.25 提到 62.84，AutoNPO 达 63.15；近未来教师在持续 RL 后 63.23，高于远未来教师的 61.92，说明有效引导取决于新获能力与学习者兼容性的平衡，而非教师越强越好。
Motivation: RLVR 纯 on-policy 学习在有用轨迹难发现或探索收窄时低效；现有自引导方法只复用当前或早期学习者已有的能力，训练后期才涌现的能力未被利用。
Method: NPO 用已验证的未来自身轨迹做离策略行为迁移；NPD 在学习者自己生成的轨迹上做同策略 token 级蒸馏，教师为更晚的 checkpoint；AutoNPO 自适应判定时间引导何时有用以及回滚多远，把未来自身引导变成反复自举过程。
Result: 八个图文基准上 NPO 把 GRPO 从 60.25 提升到 62.84，AutoNPO 达到 63.15，文本与视频推理上增益一致；NPD 下近未来教师在持续 RL 后达到 63.23，远未来教师为 61.92，尽管近未来教师蒸馏后的即时性能更低。
Conclusion: 时间自蒸馏的效果不取决于教师绝对强度，而取决于新获能力与学习者兼容性的平衡，因此近未来（而非最强）教师是更有效的引导来源。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Verbal tics in frontier language models: A critical review of current releases, research evidence, and public discussion
papers.abstract_en: Repeated praise, canned reassurance, familiar contrasts, and conspicuous vocabulary are recurring subjects in discussions of large language models. Their interpretation depends on context: a conventional phrase may be useful, while a fluent answer may reinforce a false belief. This critical review examines linguistic habits and sycophancy across eight developer families: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, ByteDance, Moonshot AI, DeepSeek, and Xiaomi. We verify current public offerings against official release and API documentation, with an evidence cutoff of 1 October 2026. We synthesize research on lexical overrepresentation, stylistic variation, social warmth, and agreement, alongside benchmark methods and dated English and Chinese public discussions. The research reviewed documents recurring linguistic patterns and agreement that distorts judgment; comparable measurements of the newest releases are sparse in the retrieved set. Current user reports include both complaints and improved writing, with experiences varying by task and prompting. We propose separate measures of recurrence, contextual appropriateness, and belief distortion, with precise service records and language-specific annotation. This framework makes claims about writing quality and conversational reliability testable as model services change.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Substantially revised as a critical review; evidence updated to 1 October 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于前沿 LLM「口头禅」（verbal tics）与谄媚 (sycophancy) 的批判性综述，覆盖 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、xAI、ByteDance、Moonshot AI、DeepSeek、Xiaomi 八个开发者家族，证据截止 2026 年 10 月 1 日。综述指出被研究文献记录了反复出现的语言模式与扭曲判断的附和行为，但对最新版本的可比测量在检索集合中很稀疏；作者提出把复发性、语境适当性、信念扭曲分开度量，并配合精确服务记录与按语言标注，使写作质量与对话可靠性的主张随服务更新仍可检验。
Motivation: LLM 的重复套话与附和行为在公开讨论中被大量抱怨，但研究证据分散在词汇过度代表、风格变异、社会温暖与顺从等方向，且对最新发布版本缺乏可比测量，导致关于写作质量与对话可靠性的主张无法随模型服务迭代被检验。
Method: 以官方发布与 API 文档核对当前公开产品（证据截止 2026-10-01），综合词汇过度代表、风格变异、社会温暖与顺从的研究，以及 benchmark 方法和有日期的中英文公开讨论；提出三类分开的度量：复发性 (recurrence)、语境适当性 (contextual appropriateness)、信念扭曲 (belief distortion)，并要求精确服务记录与按语言的标注。
Result: 综述覆盖八个开发者家族的当前公开产品；所综合的研究记录了反复出现的语言模式与会扭曲判断的附和行为，而检索集合中针对最新版本的可比测量很稀疏；当前用户报告同时包含抱怨与写作改善的反馈，且体验随任务与提示方式而异。
Conclusion: 把复发性、语境适当性与信念扭曲拆成独立度量并绑定服务记录与语言标注，才能让关于写作质量和对话可靠性的主张在模型服务持续更新时保持可检验。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Back into Plato's Cave: Examining Cross-modal Representational Convergence at Scale
papers.abstract_en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that neural networks trained on different modalities (e.g., text and images) converge toward a shared representation of reality. If true, this has significant implications for whether modality choice matters at all. In this paper, we show that the evidence for this claim is substantially weaker than subsequent work suggests. The mutual $k$-nearest-neighbor metric used on 1024 text-image pairs in the original study captures only coarse structure. To keep the alignment from collapsing as one scales up the data, $k$ has to grow proportionally, undercutting the argument for fine-grained representational convergence. The reported increase in alignment with language model strength saturates for recent models. Moreover, the one-to-one text-image pairing favors alignment, while alignment decreases with non-bijective data. We further find that image and text representations indeed share coarse semantic structure, but neither stronger language models nor richer captions yield fine-grained alignment. Thus, multimodal representations share coarse structure without evidence of convergence to a shared representation -- arguably, full representational convergence would require fine-grained alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Platonic Representation Hypothesis（多模态表征趋同）的证据做规模复检：原研究的 mutual k-NN 度量只捕捉粗粒度结构，且 k 必须随数据量成比例增长才能避免对齐崩塌，从而削弱细粒度趋同的论据。图像与文本表征确实共享粗语义结构，但更强的语言模型与更丰富的 caption 都不带来细粒度对齐，且非双射数据会降低对齐。
Motivation: Platonic Representation Hypothesis 被后续工作当作已确立结论引用，但其核心证据来自仅 1024 对图文的 mutual k-NN 度量，规模扩大后该度量是否仍支撑细粒度表征趋同存疑。
Method: 复检原研究的 mutual k-NN 对齐度量在数据规模扩大时的行为（k 需成比例增长以维持对齐），并检验语言模型强度、caption 丰富度以及一对一图文配对与非双射数据对齐度的影响。
Result: 原研究证据基于 1024 对图文；对齐随语言模型强度上升的报告在近期模型上出现饱和；一对一图文配对有利于对齐，非双射数据下对齐下降；更强语言模型与更丰富 caption 均未带来细粒度对齐。

papers.title: AEGIS: Anchor-Enforced Gradient Isolation for Knowledge-Preserving Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for robotic manipulation introduces a fundamental stability-plasticity dilemma: continuous flow-matching action experts backpropagate concentrated, low-rank regression gradients into transformer backbones trained on high-dimensional cross-entropy objectives. This cross-modal gradient asymmetry rapidly degrades pre-trained visual reasoning. Existing solutions either disconnect continuous gradient flow via stop-gradients or constrain updates via LoRA, which restricts update rank but remains directionally blind to semantic corruption; both typically rely on mixed-batch VQA co-training, doubling training compute. We introduce AEGIS (Anchor-Enforced Gradient Isolation System), a buffer-free, layer-wise orthogonal gradient projection framework enabling continuous flow-matching fine-tuning while isolating pre-trained representations from destructive parameter updates. Prior to training, AEGIS estimates per-layer Gaussian activation statistics from pre-training data as a static reference anchor. During fine-tuning, a closed-form Wasserstein-2 transport penalty generates an anchor-restoration gradient through the active computation graph. A sequential dual-backward pass applies layer-wise Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization, projecting task gradients onto the orthogonal complement of the restoration vector during directional conflict. We establish an exact energy preservation bound for layer-wise orthogonal projection, showing that AEGIS sheds only 0.62% of gradient energy empirically while halting cumulative feature drift. On PaliGemma2-3B fine-tuned on the LIBERO manipulation benchmark, AEGIS fully preserves pre-trained Visual Question Answering performance and baseline holdout loss while matching continuous action convergence, without replay buffers, teacher models, or co-training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AEGIS 用逐层正交梯度投影隔离 VLM 微调中的破坏性更新：训练前从预训练数据估每层高斯激活统计作静态锚点，微调时用闭式 Wasserstein-2 惩罚生成锚点恢复梯度，再经顺序双反向传播做 Gram-Schmidt 正交化，把任务梯度投到恢复向量的正交补上。在 PaliGemma2-3B + LIBERO 上经验梯度能量损失仅 0.62%，完全保住预训练 VQA 性能与基线 holdout loss，同时匹配连续动作收敛，无需 replay buffer、teacher model 或 VQA 混合训练。
Motivation: 连续 flow-matching 动作专家把低秩回归梯度反传进用高维交叉熵训练的 transformer 主干，这种跨模态梯度不对称会快速破坏预训练视觉推理；现有 stop-gradient 与 LoRA 方案要么切断梯度流、要么只限更新秩而对语义损坏方向不敏感，且多依赖混批 VQA 共训使训练算力翻倍。
Method: AEGIS 是无 buffer 的逐层正交梯度投影框架：训练前从预训练数据估计每层高斯激活统计作为静态锚点；微调中由闭式 Wasserstein-2 transport 惩罚经活跃计算图生成锚点恢复梯度；顺序双反向传播 (sequential dual-backward pass) 对任务梯度与恢复向量做逐层 Gram-Schmidt 正交化，仅在方向冲突时把任务梯度投到正交补。作者还给出逐层正交投影的能量保持精确界。
Result: 在 PaliGemma2-3B 于 LIBERO 操纵基准的微调上，AEGIS 经验上仅损失 0.62% 梯度能量并阻断累积特征漂移；完全保留预训练 Visual Question Answering 性能与基线 holdout loss，同时匹配连续动作收敛，且不使用 replay buffer、teacher model 或共训数据。
Conclusion: 作者主张：把任务梯度对锚点恢复向量做逐层正交投影，可以在不切断连续梯度、不加 VQA 共训的前提下保住 VLM 预训练能力并维持动作学习收敛，从而绕开稳定性—可塑性权衡。

papers.title: Multi-User mmWave Beam and Rate Adaptation via Combinatorial Satisficing Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study downlink beam and rate adaptation in a multi-user mmWave MISO system where multiple base stations (BSs), each using analog beamforming from finite codebooks, serve multiple single-antenna user equipments (UEs) with a unique beam per UE and discrete data transmission rates. BSs learn about transmission success based on ACK/NACK feedback. To encode service goals, we introduce a satisficing throughput threshold $τ_r$ and cast joint beam and rate adaptation as a combinatorial semi-bandit over beam-rate tuples. Within this framework, we propose SAT-CTS, a lightweight, threshold-aware policy that blends conservative confidence estimates with posterior sampling, steering learning toward meeting $τ_r$ rather than merely maximizing. Our main theoretical contribution provides the first finite-time regret bounds for combinatorial semi-bandits with satisficing objective: when $τ_r$ is realizable, we upper bound the cumulative satisficing regret to the target with a time-independent constant, and when $τ_r$ is non-realizable, we show that SAT-CTS incurs only a finite expected transient outside committed CTS rounds, after which its regret is governed by the sum of the regret contributions of restarted CTS rounds, yielding an $O((\log T)^2)$ standard regret bound. On the practical side, we evaluate the performance via cumulative satisficing regret to $τ_r$ alongside standard regret and fairness. Experiments with time-varying sparse multipath channels show that SAT-CTS consistently reduces satisficing regret and maintains competitive standard regret, while achieving favorable average throughput and fairness across users, indicating that feedback-efficient learning can equitably allocate beams and rates to meet QoS targets without channel state knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多基站 mmWave MISO 下行中，把波束与离散速率联合选择建模为 beam-rate 元组上的组合 semi-bandit，并引入满足型吞吐阈值 τ_r，提出 SAT-CTS：保守置信估计与后验采样结合，把学习目标从最大化转向达标。τ_r 可实现时累积满足型 regret 被压到与时间无关的常数，不可实现时标准 regret 为 O((log T)^2)；时变稀疏多径实验中其满足型 regret 持续更低，同时保持有竞争力的标准 regret、平均吞吐与用户公平性。
Motivation: 多基站模拟波束赋形下，每个 UE 只能分配唯一波束且速率离散，基站仅靠 ACK/NACK 反馈学习；传统最大化型 bandit 追求吞吐最大化，无法直接对准给定的 QoS 阈值目标，也缺少达标导向的有限时间 regret 理论。
Method: 将联合波束与速率自适应建模为 beam-rate 元组上的组合 semi-bandit，定义满足型吞吐阈值 τ_r；提出 SAT-CTS 策略，把保守置信估计与 posterior sampling 融合，只在达标导向的 CTS rounds 中推进学习，并给出可实现与不可实现两种情形的有限时间 regret 分析。
Result: 理论界：τ_r 可实现时累积满足型 regret 上界为与时间无关的常数；不可实现时仅有有限的期望瞬态，之后标准 regret 为 O((log T)^2)。在时变稀疏多径信道实验中，SAT-CTS 持续降低满足型 regret，同时保持有竞争力的标准 regret，并在平均吞吐与用户间公平性上表现良好。
Conclusion: 在无信道状态信息、仅靠 ACK/NACK 反馈的多用户 mmWave 场景中，面向阈值而非最大化的学习可以公平地分配波束与速率并达成 QoS 目标，且反馈开销可控。

papers.title: From Order to Distribution: An Exact Operator Framework for Forgetting in Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: A central challenge in continual learning is forgetting: the loss of performance on previously learned tasks after learning new ones. Prior theory has analyzed forgetting under random orderings of fixed task collections in overparameterized linear regression. We shift the focus from task order to task distribution, asking how its structure determines forgetting. In the linear setting with a shared solution, i.i.d. task sampling, and sequential exact fitting, we derive an exact operator identity expressing historical forgetting directly in terms of the task distribution. Building on this identity, we establish an exponential decay guarantee for expected historical forgetting under every fixed task distribution in finite dimensions, characterize its asymptotic behavior, and relate decay to the distribution's coverage of observable directions. For an individual learned task, we show that subsequent tasks can collectively support recovery without exact revisits. We derive a lower bound on recovery time and construct a task distribution attaining its inverse-coverage scaling.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 3 figures. Revised analysis and proofs; new fixed-operator comparisons and recovery results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在共享解、i.i.d. 任务采样与逐任务精确拟合的线性设定下，把持续学习的历史遗忘从任务顺序改写为任务分布的精确算子恒等式：有限维下任意固定任务分布的期望历史遗忘都指数衰减，衰减快慢由分布对可观测方向的覆盖度决定。对单个已学任务，后续任务即使从不精确重访也能集体恢复，且恢复时间存在下界，作者构造的任务分布达到该下界的逆覆盖标度。
Motivation: 既有持续学习遗忘理论固定任务集合、只分析随机任务顺序在过参数化线性回归中的表现，忽略了任务分布本身的结构如何决定遗忘。
Method: 在共享解、i.i.d. 任务采样、逐任务精确拟合的线性模型中，推导把历史遗忘直接表达为任务分布的精确算子恒等式 (exact operator identity)，并据此分析期望遗忘的衰减与单任务恢复时间下界。
Result: 有限维下任意固定任务分布的期望历史遗忘都满足指数衰减保证，并给出其渐近行为；衰减与分布对可观测方向的覆盖度相关；对单个任务推出恢复时间下界，并构造出达到逆覆盖 (inverse-coverage) 标度的任务分布。
Conclusion: 遗忘由任务分布对可观测方向的覆盖决定而非任务顺序，且不精确重访的后续任务可集体支持恢复，恢复时间按逆覆盖标度走。

papers.title: Exponential quantum advantage in processing massive classical data
papers.abstract_en: Broadly applicable quantum advantage, particularly in classical data processing and machine learning, has been a fundamental open problem. In this work, we prove that a small quantum computer of polylogarithmic size can perform large-scale classification and dimension reduction on massive classical data by processing samples on the fly, whereas any classical machine achieving the same prediction performance requires exponentially larger size. Furthermore, classical machines that are exponentially larger yet below the required size need superpolynomially more samples and time. We provide evidence for these quantum advantages in real-world applications, including single-cell RNA sequencing and movie review sentiment analysis, demonstrating four to six orders of magnitude reduction in size with fewer than 60 logical qubits. These quantum advantages are enabled by quantum oracle sketching, an algorithm for accessing the classical world in quantum superposition using only random classical data samples. Combined with classical shadows, our algorithm circumvents the data loading and readout bottleneck to construct succinct classical models from massive classical data, a task provably impossible for any classical machine that is not exponentially larger than the quantum machine. These quantum advantages persist even when classical machines are granted unlimited time or if BPP = BQP, and rely only on the correctness of quantum mechanics. Together, our results establish machine learning on classical data as a broad and natural domain of quantum advantage and a fundamental test of quantum mechanics at the complexity frontier.
papers.comment: 169 pages, including 10 pages of main text and 13 figures. Code available at https://github.com/haimengzhao/quantum-oracle-sketching
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明对数多项式规模的小量子计算机可用 quantum oracle sketching 在叠加态中按需访问经典样本，完成大规模分类与降维，而达到同等预测性能的经典机器需要指数级规模；在单细胞 RNA 测序与影评情感分析上给出少于 60 个逻辑量子比特、规模缩小四到六个数量级的证据。
Motivation: 广泛适用的量子优势，尤其在经典数据处理与机器学习领域，长期是未解问题；经典数据加载与读出瓶颈使量子机难以从海量经典数据中构建简洁模型。
Method: 核心是 quantum oracle sketching：仅用随机经典数据样本在量子叠加中访问经典世界；结合 classical shadows 绕开数据加载与读出瓶颈，从海量经典数据构建简洁经典模型，用于分类与降维。
Result: 证明 polylog 规模量子机可完成大规模分类与降维，同等预测性能的经典机需指数级更大规模；低于所需规模的更大经典机需超多项式更多样本与时间。真实应用证据包括单细胞 RNA 测序与影评情感分析，规模缩小四到六个数量级，用少于 60 个逻辑量子比特。
Conclusion: 经典数据上的机器学习是广泛且自然的量子优势领域，也是复杂性前沿上对量子力学本身的根本检验；优势在经典机获得无限时间或 BPP = BQP 时仍成立，仅依赖量子力学正确性。

summary_sections.result: 证明 polylog 规模量子机可完成大规模分类与降维，同等预测性能的经典机需指数级更大规模；低于所需规模的更大经典机需超多项式更多样本与时间。真实应用证据包括单细胞 RNA 测序与影评情感分析，规模缩小四到六个数量级，用少于 60 个逻辑量子比特。
summary_sections.conclusion: 经典数据上的机器学习是广泛且自然的量子优势领域，也是复杂性前沿上对量子力学本身的根本检验；优势在经典机获得无限时间或 BPP = BQP 时仍成立，仅依赖量子力学正确性。

papers.title: What Does a Sharing Question Add? Auditing LLM Survey Scores for Misinformation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating misinformation requires distinguishing whether readers believe content from whether they would share it. Asking large language models (LLMs) both questions yields two scores, but does the sharing answer contribute information beyond the credibility answer? We audit eight model versions on 290 synthetic misinformation articles, using 1,256 paired survey responses with 317 participant identifiers as an external validity criterion. An initial reversal motivates the audit: every model's raw sharing score predicts mean human sharing less accurately than its credibility score. This ordering changes after offset correction, so it does not by itself diagnose missing information. We instead distinguish score reconstructability, persistence across elicitation formats, and incremental human validity. Credibility predicts 30.8-72.5% of model-sharing variation relative to a held-out constant baseline; remaining sharing differences correlate at 0.61-0.75 across question-order and separate-question conditions. Yet adding model sharing to human and model credibility yields only -0.25% to +0.69% error reduction with fixed regression, with all exploratory intervals crossing zero. Flexible prediction and format changes do not establish an improvement. Sharing answers therefore contain structured variation beyond the observed credibility score, without established incremental validity for human sharing in these data. The findings motivate validating the contribution of each elicited outcome, beyond inspecting score differences or agreement across prompts.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Substantially revised and retitled from "When Direct Prediction Fails: Evidence from LLM-Based Misinformation Risk Evaluation". Reanalyzes the same dataset with new calibration, score-reconstruction and cross-format residual analyses, and expanded incremental-validity tests. Revises the interpretation of the original score comparison
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 LLM 做虚假信息问卷评分的审计显示：sharing 问题确实带来超出 credibility 分数的结构化变异——残差在不同提问顺序与分题条件下相关 0.61–0.75——但把它加进预测人类 sharing 的回归，误差只降 -0.25% 到 +0.69%，且探索性区间全部跨零。结论是 sharing 回答在这些数据上没有已确立的增量效度，不能只看分数差异或跨 prompt 一致性就断言第二个问题有用。
Motivation: 虚假信息评估要区分读者是否相信内容与是否愿意转发，LLM 问卷常同时问两个问题，但 sharing 回答是否在 credibility 回答之外携带信息并无检验；仅比较原始分数排序会被 offset 偏差误导。
Method: 审计 8 个模型版本在 290 篇合成虚假信息文章上的评分，以 1,256 份配对问卷回答、317 个受试者标识作为外部效度标准；先做 offset 校正，再区分分数可重构性 (score reconstructability)、跨提问格式的持续性、以及对人类 sharing 的增量效度三类检验，并做固定回归与灵活预测的增量有效性分析。
Result: 原始 sharing 分数预测人类平均 sharing 均不如 credibility 分数，offset 校正后该排序反转；credibility 可解释模型 sharing 变异的 30.8–72.5%（相对留出常数基线）；残差在提问顺序与分题条件下相关 0.61–0.75；在人类与模型 credibility 之上加入模型 sharing 仅带来 -0.25% 到 +0.69% 的误差下降，探索性区间全部跨零。
Conclusion: sharing 回答包含超出已观测 credibility 分数的结构化变异，但在这些数据上未建立对人类 sharing 的增量效度；应逐项验证每个被引出结果的贡献，而不是只看分数差异或跨 prompt 一致性。

papers.title: Optimal Centered Active Excitation in Linear System Identification
papers.abstract_en: We propose an active learning algorithm for linear system identification with optimal centered noise excitation. Notably, our algorithm, based on ordinary least squares and semidefinite programming, attains the minimal sample complexity while allowing for efficient computation of an estimate of a system matrix. More specifically, we first establish lower bounds of the sample complexity for any active learning algorithm to attain the prescribed accuracy and confidence levels. Next, we derive a sample complexity upper bound of the proposed algorithm, which matches the lower bound for any algorithm up to universal factors. Our tight bounds are easy to interpret and explicitly show their dependence on the system parameters such as the state dimension.
papers.comment: 11 pages, Accepted to the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出线性系统辨识的主动激励算法，用最优居中噪声 (optimal centered noise excitation) 配合最小二乘与半定规划，达到样本复杂度下界（仅差常数因子），且计算高效。
Motivation: 主动学习做线性系统辨识时，激励设计与样本复杂度之间缺少紧的上下界刻画，难以判断给定精度与置信度下最少需要多少数据。
Method: 算法基于普通最小二乘 (ordinary least squares) 与半定规划 (semidefinite programming) 设计最优居中噪声激励；先对任意主动学习算法推导达到给定精度与置信度的样本复杂度下界，再给出本算法的上界。
Result: 所提算法的样本复杂度上界与任意算法的下界在通用常数因子内匹配；界为紧界，显式依赖系统参数（如状态维度），并可高效计算系统矩阵估计。
Conclusion: 线性系统辨识的主动激励存在可高效达到的最优样本复杂度，其紧界直接以状态维度等系统参数表达。

papers.title: On the instability of some upward propagating, exact, nonlinear mountain waves
papers.abstract_en: Using the short-wavelength instability method, we investigate the linear instability of an exact solution describing upward-propagating mountain waves, derived in A.~Constantin, \emph{J. Phys. A: Math. Theor.} (2023), for a dry and adiabatic compressible flow. Within this approach, the stability problem reduces to the analysis of a system of ordinary differential equations with periodic coefficients along the fluid trajectories, which we study by means of Floquet theory. We show that the Floquet multipliers are of the form $\{1,μ,μ^{-1}\}$, the multiplier $1$ being associated with the conservation of potential vorticity, so that stability is decided by a single discriminant, which coincides with that of a Hill equation. For neutral stratification the flow is unstable whenever the wave steepness exceeds the critical value $\frac{1}{3}$, while a weakly stable stratification lowers this threshold to $\frac{1}{3}-\frac{4}{9}ν^2+O(ν^4)$, $ν$ being the ratio between the Brunt--Väisälä frequency and the orbital frequency of the air parcels. The instability is a subharmonic parametric resonance. Since the solution is given in Lagrangian coordinates, these results identify an unstable region in the upper part of the laminar layer, beneath the tropopause, where the wave is steepest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Constantin (2023) 给出的干绝热可压缩流上行山地波精确解，用短波长不稳定方法加 Floquet 理论判定其线性稳定性：中性层结下波陡超过 1/3 即不稳定，弱稳定层结把阈值降到 1/3 − (4/9)ν² + O(ν⁴)，失稳形式为亚谐参量共振，位置在层流层上部、对流层顶下方波最陡处。
Motivation: 上行山地波的精确非线性解已有，但其线性稳定性未知；需要在拉格朗日坐标下判定该层流何时失稳，以及失稳发生在层流层的哪一段。
Method: 采用短波长不稳定方法，把稳定性问题化为沿流体轨迹、具周期系数的常微分方程组，再用 Floquet 理论分析；证明 Floquet 乘子形如 {1, μ, μ⁻¹}，乘子 1 对应位涡守恒，稳定性归结为单个判别式（与 Hill 方程判别式一致），其中 ν 为 Brunt–Väisälä 频率与气团轨道频率之比。
Result: 中性层结下，波陡超过临界值 1/3 时流动不稳定；弱稳定层结把阈值降为 1/3 − (4/9)ν² + O(ν⁴)；失稳为亚谐参量共振 (subharmonic parametric resonance)，不稳定区位于波最陡的层流层上部、对流层顶之下。
Conclusion: 该上行山地波精确解在波陡足够大时必然失稳，且失稳阈值随弱稳定层结降低，失稳位置由拉格朗日坐标下的波陡分布直接确定。

papers.title: Understanding Latent Diffusability via Fisher Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models often degrade in latent spaces, yet the formal causes remain poorly understood. We quantify latent-space diffusability via the rate of change of the Minimum Mean Squared Error (MMSE) along the diffusion trajectory. Our framework decomposes this MMSE rate into contributions from Fisher Information (FI) and Fisher Information Rate (FIR). We show that isometric embeddings preserve intrinsic FI and establish quantitative intrinsic-FI bounds for a broader class of bi-Lipschitz encoders with controlled weak volume distortion, whereas FIR is governed by the interplay between encoder and data geometries. Our analysis separates four geometric contributions in local stability bounds for Gaussian-smoothed FIR: dimensional compression, tangential distortion, high-frequency encoder curvature, and curvature of data manifold. Experiments across diverse autoencoding architectures provide qualitative support for the geometric mechanisms identified by the theory and show that empirical FI and FIR track several measures of generation quality and latent-space geometry in the settings tested. We establish FI and FIR as a comprehensive analytical framework for understanding latent diffusability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Fisher 几何刻画潜空间可扩散性：把 MMSE 沿扩散轨迹的变化率分解为 Fisher Information (FI) 与 Fisher Information Rate (FIR) 两部分，证明等距嵌入保持内蕴 FI、并对受控弱体积畸变的 bi-Lipschitz 编码器给出内蕴 FI 界。局部稳定性界把 FIR 拆成维度压缩、切向畸变、高频编码器曲率、数据流形曲率四项；实验显示经验 FI/FIR 与生成质量和潜空间几何的多种度量相关。
Motivation: 扩散模型在潜空间中常出现性能退化，但其形式化成因尚不清楚，缺少可量化潜空间可扩散性 (diffusability) 的分析框架。
Method: 以 MMSE 沿扩散轨迹的变化率为可扩散性度量，将其分解为 Fisher Information 与 Fisher Information Rate 的贡献；对高斯平滑后的 FIR 推导含四项几何来源的局部稳定性界，并在多种 autoencoding 架构上做实验检验这些几何机制。
Result: 证明等距嵌入保持内蕴 FI，并对带受控弱体积畸变的 bi-Lipschitz 编码器建立定量内蕴 FI 界；FIR 由编码器几何与数据几何的相互作用决定。实验在多种 autoencoding 架构上为理论机制提供定性支持，并显示经验 FI 与 FIR 跟踪所测设置下生成质量与潜空间几何的多种度量。
Conclusion: FI 与 FIR 构成理解潜空间可扩散性的完整分析框架：维度压缩、切向畸变、编码器曲率与数据流形曲率共同决定潜空间中的扩散退化。

papers.title: High Volatility and Action Bias Distinguish LLMs from Humans in Group Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Humans exhibit remarkable abilities to coordinate in groups. As large language models (LLMs) become more capable, it remains an open question whether they can demonstrate comparable adaptive coordination and whether they use the same strategies as humans. To better understand this, we compare LLM and human performance on a common-interest game with imperfect monitoring: Group Binary Search. In this $n$-player game, participants need to coordinate their actions to achieve a common objective. Players independently submit numerical values in an effort to collectively sum to a randomly assigned target number. Without direct communication, they rely on group feedback to iteratively adjust their submissions until they reach the target number. Our findings show that, unlike humans who adapt and stabilize their behavior over time, LLMs often fail to improve across games and exhibit excessive switching, which impairs group convergence. Moreover, richer feedback (e.g., numerical error magnitude) benefits humans substantially but has small effects on LLMs. Finally, we show that GRPO can be effective in reducing the excessive switching. Taken together, by grounding the analysis in human baselines and mechanism-level metrics, including reactivity scaling, switching dynamics, and learning across games, we point to differences in human and LLM groups and provide a behaviorally grounded diagnostic for closing the coordination gap.
papers.comment: 47 pages. Accepted at COLM 2026; revised version including GRPO fine-tuning experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在共同利益、观测不完全的 Group Binary Search 博弈中，LLM 群体相比人类表现出更高的行为波动与动作偏好 (action bias)：跨局不改进、频繁切换动作，损害群体收敛；更丰富的反馈（如数值误差幅度）对人类收益大、对 LLM 影响小，而 GRPO 微调可有效减少过度切换。
Motivation: LLM 能力增强后，是否具备与人类相当的自适应群体协调能力、是否采用相同策略仍是开放问题；需要在无直接沟通、依赖群体反馈的场景下与人类基线对照。
Method: 以 n 人共同利益博弈 Group Binary Search 为共同任务：参与者各自提交数值、使总和逼近随机目标，仅靠群体反馈迭代调整；用机制级指标（reactivity scaling、switching dynamics、跨局学习）对比 LLM 与人类，并加入 GRPO 微调实验。
Result: 人类随时间适应并稳定行为，LLM 跨局常无改进且过度切换、损害群体收敛；数值误差幅度这类更丰富反馈显著惠及人类而对 LLM 作用很小；GRPO 微调能有效减少过度切换。
Conclusion: 以人类基线加机制级指标可以给出诊断 LLM 协调差距的行为学工具，缩小差距需针对过度切换与反馈利用不足做干预（如 GRPO）。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 人类随时间适应并稳定行为，LLM 跨局常无改进且过度切换、损害群体收敛；数值误差幅度这类更丰富反馈显著惠及人类而对 LLM 作用很小；GRPO 微调能有效减少过度切换。
summary_sections.conclusion: 以人类基线加机制级指标可以给出诊断 LLM 协调差距的行为学工具，缩小差距需针对过度切换与反馈利用不足做干预（如 GRPO）。

papers.title: GenGait: A Transformer-Based Model for Human Gait Anomaly Detection and Normative Twin Generation
papers.abstract_en: Gait analysis provides an objective characterization of locomotor function and is widely used to support diagnosis and rehabilitation monitoring across neurological and orthopedic disorders. Deep learning has been increasingly applied to this domain, yet most approaches rely on supervised classifiers trained on disease-labeled data, limiting generalization to heterogeneous pathological presentations. The methodological objective of this work is to develop a label-free framework for joint-level anomaly detection and kinematic correction based on a Transformer masked autoencoder trained exclusively on normative gait sequences from 150 adults, acquired with a markerless multi-camera motion-capture system. At inference, a two-pass procedure is applied to potentially pathological input sequences: first, it estimates joint inconsistency scores by occluding individual joints and measuring deviations from the learned normative prior. Then, it withholds the flagged joints from the encoder input and reconstructs the full skeleton from the remaining spatiotemporal context, yielding corrected kinematic trajectories at the flagged positions. The validation objective is to assess whether the framework preserves unseen normative gait and reduces angular deviation in simulated abnormal gait patterns. In this proof-of-concept evaluation, data from 10 held-out normative participants, who performed seven simulated abnormal gait patterns, showed a significant reduction in angular deviation across all analyzed joints with large effect sizes, and preservation of normative kinematics. The proposed approach enables interpretable, subject-specific localization of joints that are inconsistent with learned normative gait patterns and generation of an individualized normative reconstruction without requiring disease labels. Video is available at https://youtu.be/Rcm3jqR5pN4.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. Preprint submitted to a journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenGait 用仅在 150 名成人正常步态序列上训练的 Transformer masked autoencoder，做无疾病标签的关节级异常检测与运动学纠正：先逐关节遮挡测其与正常先验的偏离打分，再把被标记关节从编码器输入中剔除、由其余时空上下文重建骨架。在 10 名留出正常受试者、7 种模拟异常步态模式的 proof-of-concept 评估中，所有分析关节的角偏差显著下降且效应量大，同时正常运动学得以保留。
Motivation: 现有深度学习步态分析多依赖疾病标注的监督分类器，难以泛化到异质的病理表现；需要不依赖疾病标签、能定位到具体关节并给出纠正轨迹的框架。
Method: 以 Transformer masked autoencoder 仅在 150 名成人的正常步态序列（markerless 多相机动作捕捉）上训练正常先验；推理时两遍处理：第一遍逐关节遮挡并测量偏离得到关节不一致分数，第二遍把被标记关节从编码器输入中剔除、用剩余时空上下文重建完整骨架，输出被标记位置的纠正运动学轨迹。
Result: 在 10 名留出正常受试者执行的 7 种模拟异常步态模式上，所有分析关节的角偏差均显著下降且效应量大（large effect sizes），同时未见的正常步态运动学得到保留。
Conclusion: 无需疾病标签即可对与正常步态模式不一致的关节做可解释的个体化定位，并生成个体化的正常重建；该评估为 proof-of-concept，使用的是模拟异常步态。

papers.title: On Learning Spatial Structure from Pre-Beamforming Per-Antenna Range-Doppler Radar Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Automotive radar perception pipelines commonly construct angle-domain representations via beamforming before applying learning-based models. This work instead investigates a representational question: can meaningful spatial structure be learned directly from pre-beamforming per-antenna range-Doppler (RD) measurements? Experiments are conducted on a 6-TX x 8-RX (48 virtual antennas) commodity automotive radar employing an A/B chirp-sequence frequency-modulated continuous-wave (CS-FMCW) transmit scheme, in which the effective transmit aperture varies between chirps (single-TX vs multi-TX), enabling controlled analyses of chirp-dependent transmit configurations. We operate on pre-beamforming per-antenna RD tensors using a dual-chirp shared-weight encoder trained in an end-to-end, fully data-driven manner, and evaluate spatial recoverability using bird's-eye-view (BEV) occupancy as a geometric probe rather than a performance-driven objective. Supervision is visibility-aware and cross-modal, derived from LiDAR with explicit modeling of the radar field-of-view and occlusion-aware LiDAR observability via ray-based visibility. Through analyses of signal properties, transmit configurations (A-only, B-only, and A+B), receive aperture, and range-Doppler structure, together with physics-aligned baselines, we investigate the factors influencing spatial recoverability. The results indicate that meaningful spatial structure is recoverable from pre-beamforming per-antenna RD tensors under the studied A/B CS-FMCW radar configuration through learned spatial mixing, without relying on hand-crafted signal-processing stages.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 汽车雷达感知通常先做 beamforming 再喂学习模型，本文改为直接从 pre-beamforming 的 per-antenna range-Doppler 张量学空间结构：用 dual-chirp shared-weight 编码器端到端训练，以 LiDAR 交叉模态、遮挡感知的 BEV occupancy 作几何探针。结果表明在所研究的 A/B CS-FMCW 配置下，靠学习到的空间混合即可从 per-antenna RD 张量恢复有意义的空间结构，无需手工信号处理环节。
Motivation: 汽车雷达管线把 angle-domain 表示固定在 beamforming 之后，学习模型只能消费手工构造的特征；本文要回答的是 pre-beamforming per-antenna RD 测量本身是否携带可学习的空间结构这一表征问题。
Method: 在 6-TX x 8-RX（48 虚拟天线）商用汽车雷达上，用 A/B chirp-sequence FMCW 发射（有效发射孔径随 chirp 在单 TX 与多 TX 间变化），对 pre-beamforming per-antenna RD 张量用 dual-chirp shared-weight 编码器端到端全数据驱动训练；监督为 visibility-aware 跨模态标签，由 LiDAR 经 ray-based visibility 建模雷达视场与遮挡可观测性得到 BEV occupancy，作为几何探针而非性能目标；分析覆盖信号特性、发射配置（A-only、B-only、A+B）、接收孔径与 range-Doppler 结构，并配 physics-aligned 基线。
Result: 在所研究的 A/B CS-FMCW 雷达配置下，per-antenna RD 张量中的空间结构可通过学习到的空间混合恢复，不依赖手工信号处理阶段；实验系统地考察了 A-only、B-only、A+B 三种发射配置、接收孔径与 RD 结构对空间可恢复性的影响，并与 physics-aligned 基线对照。
Conclusion: beamforming 不是把角度信息交给学习模型的必要前置步骤：在该 A/B CS-FMCW 配置下，直接从 pre-beamforming per-antenna RD 数据学空间混合即可恢复 BEV 几何结构。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: The Hitchhikers Guide to Rubric Quality Understanding and Enrichment
papers.abstract_en: Rubrics distill notions of expert quality and measure agent performance. However, the quality of rubrics themselves have not been systematically measured and are often left to downstream performance.We import apparatuses from measurement theory built for exactly this: quantitative signals based on the rubric's content, and introduce the RubrIc-Failure Taxonomy (RIFT), of nine possible ways a rubric fails, organized under reliability and content validity. Every mode leaves a distinct signature. To show the signals track failure causally, we seed 720 corruptions, injecting each RIFT mode into clean rubrics at known severity levels. A linear probe over the signals identifies which mode was injected at $75.0\%$ accuracy, beating $56.7\%$ for a frontier model asked to name the failure directly. Surprisingly across GDPval and Terminal-Bench, 10 of 48 expert-authored rubrics weight their criteria backwards, putting more of the score on requirements an expert panel judged less essential. This means a response can fail what matters most and still be graded well. This paper serves as a comprehensive guide on how to understand failure modes in rubrics and create better versions using quality signals, causal experiments, and provides a taxonomy with its rules and examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把测量理论的质量指标移植到 rubric 本身，提出九类 rubric 失效的分类法 RIFT（分属信度与内容效度），并用 720 个人工注入、已知严重度的失效验证指标能因果追踪失效模式：线性探针识别注入模式的准确率达 75.0%，高于让 frontier 模型直接命名失效的 56.7%。在 GDPval 与 Terminal-Bench 上，48 份专家撰写的 rubric 中有 10 份权重方向写反，把分值压在专家面板认为较不关键的要求上，导致答错重点仍可得高分。
Motivation: rubric 被用来衡量 agent 表现，但 rubric 自身的质量从未被系统度量，通常只能靠下游表现间接推断；权重写反时评分与真实重要性脱节，专家 rubric 也会给出误导性分数。
Method: 从测量理论引入基于 rubric 内容的定量质量信号，提出 RubrIc-Failure Taxonomy (RIFT)：九种失效模式归入信度与内容效度两类，每种模式留下可分辨的信号特征。因果验证方式是向干净 rubric 注入 720 个已知模式与严重度的 corruption，再用线性探针读取信号。
Result: 线性探针在 720 个注入 corruption 上识别被注入模式的准确率为 75.0%，对照 frontier 模型直接命名失效为 56.7%。GDPval 与 Terminal-Bench 上 48 份专家 rubric 中有 10 份权重方向颠倒，把更多分值分配给专家面板判定较不 essential 的要求。
Conclusion: rubric 失效有可测的信号签名，质量信号加因果注入实验可以定位是哪一类失效，而不必依赖下游表现；专家撰写的 rubric 也会系统性地把权重放错位置。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Detecting Multi-Agent Collusion Through Multi-Agent Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems, they introduce risks of covert coordination that may evade standard forms of human oversight. While linear probes on model activations have shown promise for detecting deception in single-agent settings, collusion is inherently a multi-agent phenomenon, and the use of internal representations for detecting collusion between agents remains unexplored. We introduce NARCBench, a benchmark for evaluating collusion detection under environment distribution shift, and propose five probing techniques that aggregate per-agent deception scores to classify scenarios at the group level, evaluated across four open-weight models (Qwen3-32B, Llama-3.1-70B, DeepSeek-R1 32B, GPT-OSS-20B) and six probe architectures. We frame this as a distributed anomaly detection problem, identifying three collusion signatures that map onto distinct anomaly types and detection paradigms. Every model reaches 1.00 AUROC in-distribution; on our strongest model (Llama-3.1-70B), our five probing techniques achieve 0.73 to 0.93 AUROC when transferred zero-shot to structurally different multi-agent scenarios and 0.99 to 1.00 on a steganographic blackjack card-counting task, with detection performance scaling with model capability. We find that no single probing technique dominates across all collusion types, consistent with the framework's prediction that different anomaly types require different detection paradigms. This work takes a step toward multi-agent interpretability: extending white-box inspection from single models to multi-agent contexts, where detection requires aggregating signals across agents. These results suggest that model internals provide a complementary signal to text-level monitoring for detecting multi-agent collusion. Code and data available at https://github.com/aaronrose227/narcbench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 NARCBench，用于在环境分布偏移下评测多智能体合谋检测，并给出五种把单智能体欺骗探针分数聚合到群体层面的探针技术。四个开源模型在分布内均达 1.00 AUROC；最强模型 Llama-3.1-70B 上五种技术零样本迁移到结构不同的场景为 0.73–0.93 AUROC，隐写 blackjack 数牌任务为 0.99–1.00，且无单一技术在所有合谋类型上占优。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统中的隐蔽协同可绕过人类监督，而线性探针的欺骗检测只在单智能体场景验证过，合谋作为多智能体现象缺少基于内部表示的检测手段。
Method: 构建 NARCBench 基准，把合谋检测形式化为分布式异常检测，识别三种对应不同异常类型与检测范式的合谋签名；提出五种聚合各智能体欺骗分数的群体级探针技术，在四个开源模型（Qwen3-32B、Llama-3.1-70B、DeepSeek-R1 32B、GPT-OSS-20B）与六种探针架构上评测。
Result: 所有模型分布内 AUROC 均为 1.00；Llama-3.1-70B 上五种探针技术零样本迁移到结构不同的多智能体场景 AUROC 0.73–0.93，隐写 blackjack 数牌任务 0.99–1.00，检测性能随模型能力提升；无单一技术在全部合谋类型上占优。
Conclusion: 模型内部表示为多智能体合谋检测提供了文本级监控之外的互补信号，且不同异常类型需要不同检测范式，白盒检查应从单模型扩展到跨智能体信号聚合。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Real-time Appearance-based Gaze Estimation for Open Domains
papers.abstract_en: Appearance-based gaze estimation (AGE) has achieved remarkable performance in constrained settings, yet we reveal a significant generalization gap where existing AGE models often fail in practical, unconstrained scenarios, particularly those involving facial wearables and poor lighting conditions. We attribute this failure to two core factors: limited image diversity and inconsistent label fidelity across different datasets, especially along the pitch axis. To address these, we propose a robust AGE framework that enhances generalization without requiring additional human-annotated data. First, we expand the image manifold via an ensemble of augmentation techniques, including synthesis of eyeglasses, masks, and varied lighting. Second, to mitigate the impact of anisotropic inter-dataset label deviation, we reformulate gaze regression as a multi-task learning problem, incorporating multi-view supervised contrastive (SupCon) learning, discretized label classification, and eye-region segmentation as auxiliary objectives. To rigorously validate our approach, we curate new benchmark datasets designed to evaluate gaze robustness under challenging conditions, a dimension largely overlooked by existing evaluation protocols. Our MobileNet-based lightweight model achieves generalization performance competitive with the state-of-the-art (SOTA) UniGaze-H, while utilizing less than 1\% of its parameters, enabling high-fidelity, real-time gaze tracking on mobile devices.

Method: 先用增强集成（合成眼镜、口罩、不同光照）扩展图像流形；再把凝视回归重构为多任务学习，联合多视角监督对比学习 (SupCon)、离散化标签分类与眼区分割作为辅助目标；并自建面向困难条件的凝视鲁棒性基准数据集，主干为 MobileNet 轻量模型。

Conclusion: 不引入额外人工标注，靠数据增强与多任务辅助目标即可弥合 AGE 的泛化鸿沟，且轻量模型足以达到与大模型竞争的鲁棒凝视估计。

papers.title: Casewise and Cellwise Robust Tensor-on-Tensor Regression
papers.abstract_en: Tensor-on-tensor regression is an important tool for the analysis of tensor data, aiming to predict a set of response tensors from a corresponding set of predictor tensors. However, standard tensor-on-tensor regression is sensitive to outliers, which may be present in both the response and the predictor. It can be affected by casewise outliers, which are observations that deviate from the bulk of the data, as well as by cellwise outliers, which are individual anomalous cells within the tensors. The latter are particularly common due to the typically large number of cells in tensor data. This paper introduces a novel robust tensor-on-tensor regression method, named ROTOT, that can handle both types of outliers simultaneously, and can cope with missing values as well. This method uses a single loss function to reduce the influence of both casewise and cellwise outliers in the response. The outliers in the predictor are handled using a robust Multilinear Principal Component Analysis method. Graphical diagnostic tools are also proposed to visualize the different types of detected outliers. The performance of ROTOT is evaluated through extensive simulations and further illustrated using the Labeled Faces in the Wild dataset, where ROTOT is applied to predict facial attributes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ROTOT：用单一损失同时抑制响应中的 casewise 与 cellwise 离群点，预测张量侧的离群点交给稳健多线性 PCA 处理，并支持缺失值。在大量模拟与 Labeled Faces in the Wild 人脸属性预测中验证其可用性。
Motivation: 标准 tensor-on-tensor 回归对离群点敏感，而张量单元格数量庞大使 cellwise 离群点尤为常见，且响应与预测张量两侧都可能被污染。
Method: ROTOT 用单一损失函数同时降低响应中 casewise 与 cellwise 离群点的影响，并可处理缺失值；预测张量中的离群点由稳健 Multilinear PCA 方法处理，另配套图形化诊断工具可视化检测到的不同类型离群点。
Result: 通过大量模拟评估性能，并在 Labeled Faces in the Wild 数据集上预测人脸属性作为实例展示。
Conclusion: 单一稳健损失配合稳健多线性 PCA 可同时应对两类离群点与缺失值，使 tensor-on-tensor 回归在含污染张量数据上可用。

papers.title: Image-Domain Poisson-Perturbation Robustness of NCCT Slice Classification
papers.abstract_en: Image-domain Poisson perturbation may alter normalized NCCT appearance and downstream models. We evaluated classification of ischemic core/penumbra-bearing non-contrast CT (NCCT) slices under five simulated settings. The source cohort was CPAISD (112 hyperacute ischemic stroke patients); the test partition contained 10 patients and 809 slices. First, a fixed-checkpoint audit compared direct ResNet-18 classification (P1) with residual U-Net denoising followed by the classifier (P2). P1 average precision (AP) ranged from 0.694 to 0.901, whereas P2 AP ranged from 0.509 to 0.797 (substantially lower at settings 10-40). The fixed 0.5 threshold had 0-12.8% sensitivity for P1 and 0% for P2. Second, a prospectively locked de novo experiment compared direct noisy classification (DNC), joint denoising-classification (JDC-0), and the same joint model with privileged training-only lesion-boundary supervision (JDC-B). Across-setting mean AP was 0.861 +/- 0.028 for DNC, 0.840 +/- 0.038 for JDC-0, and 0.856 +/- 0.031 for JDC-B. Hierarchical paired-bootstrap differences were -0.021 (95% CI -0.063 to 0.019) for JDC-0 minus DNC, 0.016 (-0.019 to 0.054) for JDC-B minus JDC-0, and -0.005 (-0.041 to 0.026) for JDC-B minus DNC; none excluded zero. A frozen stress test on the 52-patient AISD partition also showed limited transportability. Thus, ordinary joint training did not demonstrate a classification benefit, and the boundary term recovered part of its point-estimate loss without a statistically supported advantage. Image fidelity, ranking, calibration, and clinical utility must be evaluated separately. This study does not validate acquired low-dose, portable, or cone-beam CT, nor patient-level stroke diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CPAISD 超急性缺血性卒中 NCCT 切片上，图像域 Poisson 扰动会改变归一化外观并影响下游分类：固定检查点下直接 ResNet-18 (P1) 的 AP 为 0.694–0.901，先用 residual U-Net 去噪再分类 (P2) 降至 0.509–0.797（设置 10–40 尤其低）。前瞻锁定的联合训练 (JDC-0/JDC-B) 相对直接含噪分类 (DNC) 的 AP 差异均不显著，说明普通联合训练未带来分类收益。
Motivation: Poison 扰动可能改变 NCCT 的归一化外观并影响下游模型，而去噪前置管线与联合训练是否真能提升缺血核心/半暗带切片分类缺乏受控检验。
Method: 在 CPAISD（112 例超急性缺血性卒中，测试分区 10 例 809 切片）上做五种模拟扰动设置的两阶段实验：固定检查点对比直接 ResNet-18 分类 (P1) 与 residual U-Net 去噪后分类 (P2)；再前瞻锁定对比直接含噪分类 (DNC)、联合去噪-分类 (JDC-0) 与加入特权训练期病灶边界监督的 JDC-B，用层级配对 bootstrap 比较 AP 差异。
Result: P1 AP 0.694–0.901，P2 AP 0.509–0.797（设置 10–40 明显更低）；固定 0.5 阈值下 P1 灵敏度 0–12.8%，P2 为 0%。跨设置平均 AP：DNC 0.861±0.028，JDC-0 0.840±0.038，JDC-B 0.856±0.031；配对 bootstrap 差异 JDC-0−DNC −0.021（95% CI −0.063 至 0.019）、JDC-B−JDC-0 0.016（−0.019 至 0.054）、JDC-B−DNC −0.005（−0.041 至 0.026），均含零。52 例 AISD 分区的冻结压力测试同样显示可迁移性有限。
Conclusion: 普通联合训练未证明分类收益，边界监督项只补回部分点估计损失且无统计支持的优势；图像保真度、排序、校准与临床效用必须分开评估，本研究不验证真实低剂量/便携/锥形束 CT 或患者级卒中诊断。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Clinical Note Bloat Reduction for Efficient LLM Use
papers.abstract_en: Background: Clinical notes contain extensive duplicated text from templates, copy-paste, and auto-populated fields ("note bloat"), diluting clinical signal, limiting longitudinal context, and increasing large language model (LLM) costs. Methods: TRACE removes note bloat using note-level EHR metadata to identify templated and copied content, with frequency-based de-duplication when metadata are unavailable. We evaluated TRACE using blinded physician span review and gold-standard templated-text annotations across four cohorts spanning liver transplant, obstetrics, and inpatient populations at multiple health systems (5.3M notes). We compared zero-shot LLMs and embedding-based classifiers using original and TRACE-processed notes for 20 information extraction tasks and prediction of 5-year survival, postpartum hemorrhage, and 30-day readmission. Results: Only 0.3-6.6% of removed text was flagged as author-generated; TRACE captured 86% of annotated templated characters. Information extraction F1 differences averaged by cohort ranged from -0.009 to +0.004; task-specific prediction F1 differences ranged from -0.011 to +0.018. Among 1,000 randomly sampled Stanford Health Care patients, TRACE reduced chart text by 47.3% (742.7M characters), averaging 220,167 fewer tokens per patient. Using 2024 encounter volumes at a large tertiary academic center and one query per encounter, projected three-year net savings ranged from $1.00M to $13.58M across evaluated model pricing schemes, including initial and annual TRACE processing costs. Conclusion: TRACE substantially reduces clinical note redundancy while preserving information extraction and prediction performance. Underused EHR metadata can reduce LLM inference costs, expand usable longitudinal context, and support scalable clinical AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 用 EHR 元数据识别模板与复制粘贴文本、元数据缺失时退化为基于频率的去重，把临床文书冗余砍掉近一半而不掉任务性能。在 5.3M 份文书、四个队列上，被删文本仅 0.3–6.6% 属作者原创，覆盖 86% 标注模板字符；Stanford 1,000 名患者文书量降 47.3%（742.7M 字符），人均少 220,167 token，按 2024 年就诊量推算三年净省 $1.00M–$13.58M。
Motivation: 模板、复制粘贴和自动填充字段让临床文书膨胀，稀释临床信号、压缩纵向上下文窗口，并直接推高 LLM 推理成本。
Method: TRACE 优先用 note 级 EHR 元数据定位模板与复制内容，元数据不可用时改用基于频率的去重；用盲法医师 span 审阅与金标准模板文本标注在肝移植、产科、住院四个队列（多个医疗系统、5.3M 份文书）上评测，并对比原始与 TRACE 处理后文书喂给 zero-shot LLM 与 embedding 分类器，覆盖 20 项信息抽取任务及 5 年生存、产后出血、30 天再入院预测。
Result: 被删文本中仅 0.3–6.6% 被判为作者原创，TRACE 捕获 86% 的标注模板字符；按队列平均的信息抽取 F1 差异在 -0.009 到 +0.004，任务级预测 F1 差异在 -0.011 到 +0.018。Stanford Health Care 随机抽样 1,000 名患者文书文本减少 47.3%（742.7M 字符），人均少 220,167 token；按大型三级学术中心 2024 年就诊量、每次就诊一次查询推算，含 TRACE 初始与年度处理成本后三年净节省 $1.00M 至 $13.58M（随所评估模型定价方案而变）。
Conclusion: 临床文书冗余可以在基本不损失信息抽取与预测性能的前提下大幅削减，未被充分利用的 EHR 元数据是降低 LLM 推理成本、扩展可用纵向上下文的直接杠杆。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: EgoForge: Goal-Directed Egocentric World Simulator
papers.abstract_en: Generative world models have shown promise for simulating dynamic environments, yet egocentric video remains challenging due to rapid viewpoint changes, frequent hand-object interactions, and goal-directed procedures whose evolution depends on latent human intent. Existing approaches either focus on hand-centric instructional synthesis with limited scene evolution, perform static view translation without modeling action dynamics, or rely on dense supervision, such as camera trajectories, long video prefixes, and synchronized multi-camera capture. In this work, we introduce EgoForge, an egocentric goal-directed world simulator that generates coherent, first-person video rollouts from minimal static inputs: a single egocentric image, a high-level instruction, and an optional auxiliary exocentric view. To improve intent alignment and temporal coherence, we introduce GRAFT, a trajectory-level diffusion refinement method that uses positive and negative rollout distributions, derived from goal, temporal, scene-consistency, and perceptual rewards, to steer the diffusion velocity field toward coherent, goal-complete egocentric simulations. Extensive experiments show EgoForge achieves consistent gains in semantic alignment, geometric stability, and motion fidelity over strong baselines, and performs robustly in real-world smart-glasses experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoForge 从单张第一人称图像加高层指令（可选外部视角）生成目标导向的连贯第一人称视频推演，用轨迹级扩散精修 GRAFT 借助正负 rollout 分布与目标、时序、场景一致性、感知奖励引导扩散速度场。实验显示其在语义对齐、几何稳定性、运动保真上相对强基线一致提升，并在真实智能眼镜实验中表现稳健。
Motivation: 第一人称视频生成受快速视角变化、频繁手-物体交互和依赖潜在人类意图的目标流程制约；现有方法要么只做手部指令合成且场景演化有限，要么只做静态视角转换不建模动作动态，要么依赖相机轨迹、长视频前缀、同步多机位等稠密监督。
Method: EgoForge 输入单张 egocentric 图像、高层指令与可选辅助 exocentric 视图；核心为 GRAFT 轨迹级扩散精修，用由 goal、temporal、scene-consistency、perceptual 四类奖励导出的正负 rollout 分布去引导 diffusion velocity field，使生成朝目标完成且时序连贯。
Result: 在语义对齐 (semantic alignment)、几何稳定性 (geometric stability)、运动保真 (motion fidelity) 三项上相对强基线取得一致增益，并在真实世界 smart-glasses 实验中表现稳健。
Conclusion: 极少的静态输入（单图加指令）足以支撑目标导向的第一人称世界模拟，轨迹级奖励引导的扩散精修是对齐意图与保持时序连贯的有效手段。

papers.title: Man and machine: artificial intelligence and judicial decision making
papers.abstract_en: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into judicial decision making -- particularly in pretrial, sentencing, and parole contexts -- has generated a substantial and rapidly growing literature. Across computer science, economics, law, criminology, and psychology, researchers have examined the reliability, fairness, and real-world effects of AI-assisted decision making. Yet this literature remains fragmented, and differences in assumptions, concepts, and research priorities make it difficult to assess what is actually known. Using criminal justice risk assessment as a focal case, this article makes two contributions. First, we develop a conceptual framework that distinguishes and relates three central questions: (1) the predictive validity of automated risk assessment tools; (2) how algorithmic risk assessments compare with human predictions (AI-versus-Human); and (3) how algorithmic recommendations affect judges' decisions (AI-plus-Human). Second, we use this framework to synthesize the empirical evidence addressing each of these questions. Our review identifies important limitations in existing research on predictive validity, as well as substantial gaps in understanding how judges respond to AI advice and how those responses vary across individuals and decision-making environments. The available evidence suggests that AI decision aids have, so far, had at most modest effects on pretrial and sentencing decisions. We conclude that further research is needed to understand how judges make decisions in noisy informational environments and under what conditions AI tools can produce meaningful improvements in judicial decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以刑事司法风险评估为焦点，把 AI 司法决策研究拆成三个问题：自动风险评估的预测效度、算法与人的预测比较 (AI-versus-Human)、算法建议对法官决定的影响 (AI-plus-Human)，并据此整合跨学科实证证据。现有证据显示 AI 决策辅助迄今对审前与量刑决定至多只有温和影响。
Motivation: AI 进入审前、量刑、假释决策的文献分散在计算机科学、经济学、法学、犯罪学与心理学，假设、概念与研究优先级不一致，难以判断究竟已知什么。
Method: 提出一个区分并关联三类问题（预测效度、AI-versus-Human、AI-plus-Human）的概念框架，再用该框架对每个问题的实证证据做综述综合，以刑事司法风险评估为核心案例。
Result: 综述发现现有预测效度研究存在重要局限，对法官如何回应 AI 建议及其在个体与决策环境间差异的理解存在明显缺口；可得证据表明 AI 决策辅助迄今对审前与量刑决定至多只有温和影响 (modest effects)。
Conclusion: 要判断 AI 工具何时能真正改善司法决策，需先理解法官在含噪信息环境中如何做决定；作者据此主张进一步研究这一条件问题。
