papers.title: AstroAgentBench: Evaluating Agentic Planning on Space Mission Planning Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Recent LLM-for-Space systems address mission planning, scheduling, operations support, simulator control, and autonomy, but their evaluations use different task contracts, control settings, simulators, and success criteria. We introduce AstroAgentBench, a seven-family benchmark for executable space mission planning in the domains of scheduling, observation planning, constellation design, and relay support. For each case, an agent submits a planning artifact that is checked by an external verifier for schema, timing, geometry, resources, and mission value. Results report validity and normalized scores, with comparisons to task-specific solver references. Across five LLM agent systems and 35 held-out cases, the strongest systems approach or exceed solver-reference scores on several families, while weaker systems often fail to produce high-value valid plans and even strong systems lose quality on geometric, product-level, or design-heavy tasks. Trace analyses separate two failure points: task-contract misformulation and weak solution construction. Successful runs instead calibrate agent-written implementations against verifier feedback and adapt search to case-specific structure. Ablations show that procedure injection and memory accumulation help selectively, when they supply the missing formulation, calibration, or search support.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 5 figures. AACL-IJCNLP 2026. Benchmark renamed from AstroReason-Bench to AstroAgentBench; supersedes v1 with the full five-system evaluation. Code: https://github.com/Mtrya/AstroAgentBench; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/kaupane/AstroAgentBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AstroAgentBench 把太空任务规划评测统一到可执行工件加外部验证器的契约下，覆盖排程、观测规划、星座设计、中继支持四个域七个任务族。在五个 LLM agent 系统与 35 个 held-out 案例上，最强系统在若干任务族接近或超过 solver 参考分数，但在几何、产品级与设计密集任务上质量下降；失败点被拆为任务契约误表述与解法构造薄弱两类。
Motivation: 现有 LLM-for-Space 系统的评测各自使用不同的任务契约、控制设置、模拟器与成功标准，结果无法横向比较，也看不出失败究竟出在规划表述还是解法构造。
Method: 构建七任务族基准，agent 提交规划工件，由外部验证器检查 schema、时序、几何、资源与任务价值；报告 validity 与归一化分数，并与任务专用 solver 参考对比。另做 trace 分析区分两类失败点，并对 procedure injection 与 memory accumulation 做消融。
Result: 五个 LLM agent 系统、35 个 held-out 案例：最强系统在若干任务族接近或超过 solver 参考分数；较弱系统常无法产出高价值有效规划；强系统在几何、产品级、设计密集任务上质量下降。消融显示 procedure injection 与 memory accumulation 仅在补足缺失的表述、校准或搜索支持时起作用。
Conclusion: 成功运行靠用验证器反馈校准 agent 自写的实现并按案例结构调整搜索；选择性注入流程与记忆有效，前提是它们补上缺失的表述、校准或搜索支持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MedVL-SAM2: A unified 3D medical vision-language model for multimodal reasoning and prompt-driven segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in medical vision-language models (VLMs) has achieved strong performance on image-level text-centric tasks such as report generation and visual question answering (VQA). However, achieving fine-grained visual grounding and volumetric spatial reasoning in 3D medical VLMs remains challenging, particularly when aiming to unify these capabilities within a single, generalizable framework. To address this challenge, we proposed MedVL-SAM2, a unified 3D medical multimodal model that concurrently supports report generation, VQA, and multi-paradigm segmentation, including semantic, referring, and interactive segmentation. MedVL-SAM2 integrates image-level reasoning and pixel-level perception through a cohesive architecture tailored for 3D medical imaging, and incorporates a SAM2-based volumetric segmentation module to enable precise multi-granular spatial reasoning. The model is trained in a multi-stage pipeline: it is first pre-trained on a large-scale corpus of 3D CT image-text pairs to align volumetric visual features with radiology-language embeddings. It is then jointly optimized with both language-understanding and segmentation objectives using a comprehensive 3D CT segmentation dataset. This joint training enables flexible interaction via language, point, or box prompts, thereby unifying high-level visual reasoning with spatially precise localization. Our unified architecture delivers state-of-the-art performance across report generation, VQA, and multiple 3D segmentation tasks. papers.title: Measuring Iterative Temporal Reasoning with Time Puzzles
papers.abstract_en: Tool use, such as web search, has become a standard capability even in freely available large language models (LLMs). However, existing benchmarks evaluate temporal reasoning mainly in static, non-tool-using settings, which poorly reflect how LLMs perform temporal reasoning in practice. We introduce Time Puzzles, a constraint-based date inference task for evaluating iterative temporal reasoning with tools. Each puzzle combines factual temporal anchors with (cross-cultural) calendar relations and may admit one or multiple valid dates. The puzzles are algorithmically generated, enabling controlled and continual evaluation. Across 13 LLMs, even the best model (GPT-5) achieves only 55.3% accuracy without tools, despite using easily searchable facts. While web search improves performance, models perform substantially better when constraints are rewritten with explicit dates, removing the need for factual lookup. These results reveal a gap in reliable tool use for iterative temporal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Time Puzzles：基于约束的日期推理任务，用算法生成的谜题评测 LLM 带工具的迭代时间推理。13 个 LLM 中最强的 GPT-5 在不用工具时仅 55.3% 准确率；联网搜索有帮助，但把约束改写成显式日期后表现更好，说明模型在需要事实查证的迭代时间推理上工具使用仍不可靠。
Motivation: 现有时间推理基准基本在静态、不用工具的设定下评测，与 LLM 实际使用工具做时间推理的方式脱节。
Method: Time Puzzles 把事实性时间锚点与（跨文化）日历关系组合成约束满足的日期推断谜题，可有一个或多个合法日期；谜题由算法生成，支持受控且可持续的评测，覆盖 13 个 LLM 的带工具与不带工具对照。
Result: 13 个 LLM 中最好的 GPT-5 在不用工具时准确率仅 55.3%，尽管所用事实很容易搜索到；联网搜索 (web search) 能提升表现，而当约束被改写为显式日期、无需事实查证时模型表现明显更好。
Conclusion: LLM 在迭代时间推理上的可靠工具使用存在明显缺口：搜索能补一部分，但真正拖后腿的是事实性时间锚点的查证环节。

papers.title: Explainability of Complex AI Models with Correlation Impact Ratio
papers.abstract_en: Complex AI systems make better predictions but often lack transparency, limiting trustworthiness, interpretability, and safe deployment. Common post hoc AI explainers, such as LIME, SHAP, HSIC, and SAGE, are model agnostic but are too restricted in one significant regard: they tend to misrank correlated features and require costly perturbations, which do not scale to high dimensional data. We introduce ExCIR (Explainability through Correlation Impact Ratio), a theoretically grounded, simple, and reliable metric for explaining the contribution of input features to model outputs, which remains stable and consistent under noise and sampling variations. We demonstrate that ExCIR captures dependencies arising from correlated features through a lightweight single pass formulation. Experimental evaluations on diverse datasets, including EEG, synthetic vehicular data, Digits, and Cats-Dogs, validate the effectiveness and stability of ExCIR across domains, achieving more interpretable feature explanations than existing methods while remaining computationally efficient. To this end, we further extend ExCIR with an information theoretic foundation that unifies the correlation ratio with Canonical Correlation Analysis under mutual information bounds, enabling multi output and class conditioned explainability at scale.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可解释性指标 ExCIR（Correlation Impact Ratio），用单次前向的轻量公式度量输入特征对模型输出的贡献，在噪声与采样变化下保持稳定，并能正确处理相关特征的依赖关系。在 EEG、合成车辆数据、Digits、Cats-Dogs 上评测，比 LIME、SHAP、HSIC、SAGE 给出更可解释的特征排序且计算更省。
Motivation: LIME、SHAP、HSIC、SAGE 等事后解释器虽与模型无关，但会误排相关特征，且依赖代价高的扰动，在高维数据上难以扩展，制约复杂 AI 系统的可信部署。
Method: ExCIR 以相关性影响比 (Correlation Impact Ratio) 度量特征贡献，采用单次前向 (single pass) 的轻量计算，无需扰动采样；再扩展出信息论版本，在互信息界下把 correlation ratio 与 Canonical Correlation Analysis 统一起来，支持多输出与类别条件解释。
Result: 在 EEG、合成 vehicular 数据、Digits、Cats-Dogs 四类数据集上评测，ExCIR 在噪声与采样变化下保持稳定一致，给出比现有方法更可解释的特征解释，同时保持计算高效；摘要未列出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 不依赖扰动的单次相关性度量足以给出稳定且抗噪的特征贡献排序，可扩展到高维与多输出场景。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Event-based Scene Synthesis via Inter-Frame Residual Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Event-based scene synthesis reconstructs target RGB frames from sparse image observations and asynchronous event streams, encompassing both video frame prediction and interpolation. Existing event-based synthesis methods commonly estimate optical flow to warp the observed frames toward the target time, but are vulnerable to inaccurate flow under large motion and occlusion and often rely on flow supervision or pretrained estimators. In this work, we propose EvFRA, an Event-based scene synthesis framework based on inter-Frame Residual Alignment. We identify a structural correspondence between event measurements and frame-to-frame scene changes, and exploit this correspondence for target frame synthesis. Our training pipeline consists of two stages: 1) an Event-to-Residual Alignment Variational Autoencoder (ER-VAE) aligns the event frame captured between the anchor and target frames with the corresponding inter-frame residual, and 2) a ControlNet-conditioned diffusion model is fine-tuned to denoise the residual latent using event data. Our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods by up to 2.61 dB and 1.85 dB in PSNR for frame prediction and interpolation, respectively, with consistent SSIM improvements. Code is available at https://github.com/jiyun-kong/EvFRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出事件相机场景合成框架 EvFRA：用 Event-to-Residual Alignment VAE 把锚帧与目标帧之间的事件对齐到帧间残差，再用 ControlNet 条件扩散模型以事件数据微调去噪该残差潜变量，从而绕开光流估计。在帧预测与帧插值上较现有方法 PSNR 分别最高提升 2.61 dB 和 1.85 dB，SSIM 同步改善。
Motivation: 现有事件驱动合成方法依赖光流把观测帧 warp 到目标时刻，大运动与遮挡下光流不准，且常需光流监督或预训练估计器。
Method: 两阶段训练：先用 Event-to-Residual Alignment VAE (ER-VAE) 将锚帧与目标帧之间捕获的事件帧对齐到对应帧间残差；再微调 ControlNet 条件扩散模型，用事件数据对残差潜变量去噪，利用事件测量与帧间场景变化的结构对应关系直接合成目标 RGB 帧，覆盖帧预测与帧插值两类任务。
Result: 在帧预测上较最先进方法 PSNR 最高提升 2.61 dB，在帧插值上最高提升 1.85 dB，SSIM 也一致提升。
Conclusion: 事件与帧间残差的结构对应关系可替代光流 warp 作为事件驱动场景合成的对齐机制，在大运动与遮挡下更稳。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: A framework for auditing grounding claims
papers.abstract_en: The symbol grounding problem asks how a token such as cat can be about cats. We propose a framework for auditing grounding claims against a declared semantic standard. The audit reports measurements and evidence, with overall verdicts conditional on explicit acceptance criteria. Its profiles assess accuracy, robustness, and composition alongside evidence about how the system acquired its mechanisms, how they contribute to performance, and why they were retained. In a toy gridworld, an agent interprets individual symbols accurately but fails a withheld combination. Composing its interpretations by the declared rule would succeed. This comparison identifies a departure from the composition rule within the observed failure. Both this audit and a pilot on pretrained word vectors provide evidence that a designated mechanism contributes to present performance. Whether that contribution explains its retention remains uncertified. The framework evaluates the evidence for grounding claims; candidate accounts remain responsible for explaining how meaning emerges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对符号奠基 (symbol grounding) 主张提出可审计框架：先声明语义标准，再按准确性、鲁棒性、组合性给出测量与证据，最终判定以显式接受准则为条件。在 toy gridworld 中，agent 能正确解释单个符号却在留出组合上失败，而按声明规则组合其解释本可成功，据此定位到组合规则偏离；预训练词向量的 pilot 同样表明某指定机制对当前性能有贡献，但该贡献是否解释其保留仍未获认证。
Motivation: 符号奠基问题中 token 如何关于对象缺乏可检验的评判标准，现有 grounding 主张无法被系统审计，机制贡献与性能之间的因果解释也无从判定。
Method: 框架以声明的语义标准为基准做审计，输出测量与证据并按显式接受准则给出整体判定；评估维度包括 accuracy、robustness、composition，外加机制如何获得、如何贡献性能、为何被保留三类证据；在 toy gridworld 与预训练词向量上做试点。
Result: toy gridworld 中 agent 单符号解释准确但在留出组合上失败，按声明规则组合解释则成功，比较定位到观察到的失败中的组合规则偏离；该审计与预训练词向量 pilot 均为指定机制对当前性能有贡献提供证据，而该贡献是否解释其保留仍属未认证。
Conclusion: grounding 主张可以被按声明标准审计并给出条件化判定，但框架只评估证据，意义如何涌现仍须由候选解释自身负责说明。

papers.title: BalLOT: Balanced $k$-means clustering with optimal transport
papers.abstract_en: We consider the fundamental problem of balanced $k$-means clustering. In particular, we introduce an optimal transport approach to alternating minimization called BalLOT, and we show that it delivers a fast and effective solution to this problem. We establish this with several theoretical guarantees and a variety of numerical experiments. On the theory front, we first prove that for generic data, BalLOT produces integral couplings at each step. Next, we perform a landscape analysis to provide theoretical guarantees for both exact and partial recoveries of planted clusters under the stochastic ball model. We also propose initialization schemes that achieve one-step recovery of planted clusters. To conclude, we present numerical experiments that corroborate our theoretical results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BalLOT 用最优传输 (optimal transport) 改写平衡 k-means 的交替最小化：每步求解 OT 得到整数耦合，理论上对 generic 数据每步都产生 integral coupling，并在 stochastic ball model 下给出精确与部分恢复的景观分析，配套初始化方案可一步恢复植入簇。数值实验用于印证这些理论结论。
Motivation: 平衡 k-means 要求各簇规模受约束，常规交替最小化在此约束下缺少收敛与恢复保证，也难给出可证明的初始化。
Method: 提出 BalLOT：把平衡 k-means 的交替最小化改写为最优传输问题，每步求 OT 得到整数耦合；对 generic 数据证明每步耦合为整数，对 stochastic ball model 做景观分析并设计可一步恢复植入簇的初始化方案。
Result: 理论结果包括 generic 数据下每步产生 integral couplings、stochastic ball model 下精确与部分恢复的景观保证、以及一步恢复植入簇的初始化方案；数值实验用于佐证上述理论，摘要未列出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 平衡 k-means 可以通过最优传输式交替最小化获得兼具快速性与理论保证的解，恢复保证依赖 stochastic ball model 与合适的初始化。

summary_sections.method: 提出 BalLOT：把平衡 k-means 的交替最小化改写为最优传输问题，每步求 OT 得到整数耦合；对 generic 数据证明每步耦合为整数，对 stochastic ball model 做景观分析并设计可一步恢复植入簇的初始化方案。
summary_sections.result: 理论结果包括 generic 数据下每步产生 integral couplings、stochastic ball model 下精确与部分恢复的景观保证、以及一步恢复植入簇的初始化方案；数值实验用于佐证上述理论，摘要未列出具体数值指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 平衡 k-means 可以通过最优传输式交替最小化获得兼具快速性与理论保证的解，恢复保证依赖 stochastic ball model 与合适的初始化。

papers.title: Hardware-Algorithm Co-Optimization of Early-Exit Neural Networks for Multi-Core Edge Accelerators
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of Early-Exiting Neural Networks (EENNs) on edge accelerators requires optimizing not only the network architecture but also its hardware deployment. Exit configuration, quantization, and hardware workload mapping interact in non-trivial ways, influencing memory traffic, accelerator utilization, and ultimately the energy-latency trade-off. This work presents a hardware-aware co-design framework for EENNs that jointly optimizes exit configuration, quantization-aware training, and multi-core hardware mapping within a unified NAS process. Leveraging analytical design space exploration, the framework identifies efficient workload mappings for each candidate architecture while providing accurate latency and energy estimates during the search. We further formulate EENN deployment as a constrained multi-objective optimization problem balancing predictive accuracy, energy-latency product, exit overhead, and dynamic inference efficiency. Experimental results on CIFAR-10 demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves over a 50\% reduction in energy-latency product compared with static baselines under 8-bit quantization. These results demonstrate that jointly optimizing architecture and deployment is essential for realizing the full efficiency potential of dynamic inference on heterogeneous edge accelerators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向多核边缘加速器的 Early-Exit 神经网络 (EENN) 软硬件协同设计框架，在统一 NAS 过程中联合优化退出配置、量化感知训练与多核工作负载映射，并用解析式设计空间探索在搜索中给出延迟与能耗估计。在 CIFAR-10、8-bit 量化下，能量-延迟积 (energy-latency product) 相对静态基线降低超过 50%。
Motivation: EENN 在边缘加速器上的退出配置、量化与硬件负载映射相互耦合，单独优化网络结构或部署无法同时改善内存流量、加速器利用率与能效-延迟权衡。
Method: 在统一 NAS 过程中联合搜索退出配置、量化感知训练 (quantization-aware training) 与多核硬件映射；用解析式设计空间探索 (analytical design space exploration) 为候选架构给出工作负载映射并估计延迟与能耗；将部署形式化为约束多目标优化，平衡预测精度、energy-latency product、退出开销与动态推理效率。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 上，8-bit 量化条件下所提框架相对静态基线实现超过 50% 的 energy-latency product 下降。
Conclusion: 架构与部署必须联合优化，才能在异构边缘加速器上兑现动态推理的效率潜力。

papers.title: Provable FDR Control for Deep Feature Selection: Deep MLPs and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: We develop a flexible feature selection framework based on deep neural networks that approximately controls the false discovery rate (FDR), a measure of Type-I error. The method applies to architectures whose first layer is fully connected. From the second layer onward, it accommodates multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) of arbitrary width and depth, convolutional and recurrent networks, attention mechanisms, residual connections, and dropout. The procedure also accommodates stochastic gradient descent with data-independent initializations and learning rates. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to provide a theoretical guarantee of FDR control for feature selection within such a general deep learning setting. Our analysis is built upon a multi-index data-generating model and an asymptotic regime in which the feature dimension $n$ diverges faster than the latent dimension $q^{*}$, while the sample size, the number of training iterations, the network depth, and hidden layer widths are left unrestricted. Under this setting, we show that each coordinate of the gradient-based feature-importance vector admits a marginal normal approximation, thereby supporting the validity of asymptotic FDR control. As a theoretical limitation, we assume $\mathbf{B}$-right orthogonal invariance of the design matrix, and we discuss broader generalizations. We also present numerical experiments that underscore the theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个基于深度网络梯度的特征选择框架，在首层全连接、后续可为任意 MLP、CNN、RNN、注意力、残差与 dropout 的设定下近似控制 FDR（Type-I error）。在 multi-index 数据生成模型与 n 比潜在维度 q* 更快发散的渐近体制下，梯度型特征重要性向量每个坐标有边缘正态逼近，从而支撑渐近 FDR 控制。
Motivation: 深度网络内部的特征选择缺少可证明的错误发现率保证：现有 FDR 控制方法多限于线性或浅层模型，无法覆盖任意深度宽度的现代架构与 SGD 训练。
Method: 框架适用于首层全连接的网络，从第二层起容纳任意宽度深度的 MLP、卷积与循环网络、注意力机制、残差连接与 dropout，并兼容数据无关初始化与学习率的 SGD。理论建立在 multi-index 数据生成模型上，取特征维度 n 比潜在维度 q* 发散更快的渐近体制，样本量、训练迭代数、网络深度与隐藏层宽度均不加限制；核心工具是对梯度型特征重要性向量的每个坐标做边缘正态逼近。
Result: 证明每个坐标的边缘正态逼近，进而得到渐近 FDR 控制；数值实验用于印证理论发现。理论限制是假设设计矩阵满足 B-right orthogonal invariance，作者讨论了更广的推广。
Conclusion: 在 B-right orthogonal invariance 等假设下，深度网络的梯度型特征选择可在一般深度学习设定中获得渐近 FDR 控制，这是作者所知的首个此类理论保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SSLfmm: An R Package for Semi-Supervised Learning with Mixed Missingness
papers.abstract_en: Partially labelled samples arise when features are observed for data, but class labels are available for only a subset. In such settings, the mechanism governing label availability may itself contain information relevant to classification, yet it is typically left unmodelled in standard semi-supervised learning procedures. The SSLfmm package implements likelihood-based Gaussian finite-mixture classification in which the label-missingness process is modelled jointly with the class distribution. It supports complete-case, missing completely at random (MCAR), entropy-based missing at random (MAR), and mixed analyses in which MCAR and MAR mechanisms may both contribute. For the mixed mechanism, the source of a missing label may be known or unknown. A common R interface is provided for model fitting, prediction, performance assessment, and simulation. We describe the statistical formulation and software implementation and demonstrate its use through reproducible simulation and a semi-synthetic Blood Transfusion application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSLfmm 是一个 R 包，把标签缺失机制与类别分布放进同一个高斯有限混合似然里做半监督分类，同时支持 MCAR、基于熵的 MAR 以及两者混合的缺失机制，混合机制下缺失标签的来源可已知或未知。它在可复现模拟和半合成的 Blood Transfusion 应用上演示拟合、预测、性能评估与仿真流程。
Motivation: 标准半监督学习只用有标签子集，通常把标签为何缺失当作无关过程丢掉；但标签可得性机制本身可能携带对分类有用的信息。
Method: 基于似然的高斯有限混合 (Gaussian finite-mixture) 分类，联合建模标签缺失过程与类别分布；提供 complete-case、MCAR、基于熵的 MAR 及 MCAR+MAR 混合分析，混合情形下缺失来源可已知或未知。统一的 R 接口覆盖模型拟合、预测、性能评估与仿真。
Result: 通过可复现的模拟研究和一个半合成的 Blood Transfusion 应用演示用法；摘要给出的是软件与统计表述本身，未列出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把标签缺失机制纳入混合模型似然，可以在同一框架内处理 MCAR、MAR 与混合缺失，并以统一接口完成从拟合到评估的全流程。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Constant-Time Planning for Chaining Collision-free Motion to Manipulation Behaviors
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in contact-rich robotic manipulation has been striking, yet most deployed systems remain confined to simple, scripted routines. One of the barriers is the lack of motion planning algorithms that can provide verifiable guarantees for safety, efficiency and reliability. Constant-Time Motion Planning (CTMP) is a recent step toward such guarantees for collision-free motion in a priori known environments:: a preprocessing phase enables queries to be answered within a fixed, user-specified time budget (e.g., 10 milliseconds). However, CTMP certifies only reachability---a binary predicate---and ignores the manipulation behavior that completes the task, which is increasingly stochastic (e.g., a learned skill) and whose success no single offline rollout can establish, let alone certify. We introduce the Behavioral Constant-Time Motion Planner (B-CTMP), which extends CTMP to two-step manipulation tasks in semi-structured environments: a collision-free motion to a behavior initiation state, followed by execution of a behavior such as grasping or insertion. B-CTMP departs from prior CTMP in two ways: neighborhoods are constructed in object-pose space rather than robot configuration space, and coverage is established by statistical certification rather than a reachability check. A plan is cached only if repeated rollouts lower-bound its success rate above a user-specified threshold, and we prove these bounds hold simultaneously across the entire cache at a prescribed confidence level. For deterministic behaviors a single rollout suffices, recovering the binary check of prior CTMP as a special case. We evaluate B-CTMP on three manipulation tasks---shelf picking, plug insertion, and wheel replacement---in simulation and on real robots. B-CTMP's certified plans succeed consistently where baselines fail during behavior execution, and it rejects infeasible object poses in constant time.
papers.comment: In submission. Best paper award at the Search Algorithms for Robot Learning workshop IROS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: B-CTMP 把恒定时间运动规划 (CTMP) 从纯可达性扩展到两步操作任务：先规划无碰撞运动到行为起始状态，再执行抓取或插入等随机行为；只有重复 rollout 把成功率下界推过用户阈值的计划才入缓存，且该下界在给定置信水平下对整个缓存同时成立。在 shelf picking、plug insertion、wheel replacement 三个任务的仿真与真机上，认证计划持续成功而基线在行为执行阶段失败，并以恒定时间拒绝不可行物体位姿。
Motivation: CTMP 只认证二值可达性，忽略真正完成任务的操作行为；而学习型技能本身随机，单次离线 rollout 无法确立其成功，部署系统因此仍困在脚本化例程里。
Method: B-CTMP 在物体位姿空间（而非机器人构型空间）构造邻域，用统计认证替代可达性检查：重复 rollout 对计划成功率求下界，超过用户指定阈值才缓存，并证明这些界在整份缓存上以规定置信水平同时成立；确定性行为单次 rollout 即可，退化为原 CTMP 的二值检查。
Result: 在仿真与真机上的三个操作任务（shelf picking、plug insertion、wheel replacement）中，B-CTMP 的认证计划在基线行为执行失败处持续成功，并以恒定时间拒绝不可行物体位姿；查询在预处理后于固定用户时限内回答（例如 10 毫秒）。
Conclusion: 把统计成功认证而非可达性二值检查放进恒定时间规划缓存，可以让两步操作任务同时拿到可验证保证与固定查询时延；确定性行为是该框架的特例。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Poincaré Meets Bellman: Revisable Memory, Operational Quotients, and Evidence-Supported Learning in Changing Environments
papers.abstract_en: Memory consolidation determines both what a learner can do now and which changes remain implementable later. We develop a finite-model synthesis of operational state abstraction and optimal control under the stability-evidence-revision (SER) framework. ``Poincaré meets Bellman'' names two complementary roles: qualitative dynamics identifies reusable action-response structure, and dynamic programming prices acquisition, retention, reuse, merging, and forgetting. Recurrence enters separately through the timing and value of future demands. We distinguish active quotient merging from historical information erasure, characterize exact repair by zero-error functional coding and causal migration, and derive a Bellman recursion over the joint law of hidden state and complete deployed memory. A first-return model yields an explicit retention rule. Conditional results show how factor sharing avoids enumerating combinations and how independent informative observations improve identification, while leaving some zero-error evidence budgets unchanged. Finite enumerations verify the coding and retention calculations. The synthesis gives an exact benchmark for specified finite models, without claiming universal recurrence, bounded-memory open-ended learning, or tractable global planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 stability-evidence-revision (SER) 框架下把操作性状态抽象与最优控制合成为有限模型：定性动力学给出可复用的动作-响应结构，Bellman 动态规划为获取、保留、复用、合并与遗忘定价，并在隐状态与完整已部署记忆的联合分布上导出 Bellman 递推。零误差功能编码与因果迁移刻画精确修复，first-return 模型给出显式保留规则；有限枚举验证了编码与保留计算，结论明确限于指定有限模型的精确基准，不主张通用 recurrence 或有界记忆的开放式学习。
Motivation: 记忆固化同时决定学习者当前能做什么与后续改动是否还可实施，但操作性状态抽象与最优控制此前缺少统一的有限模型刻画，合并与历史信息擦除也未被区分。
Method: 提出 SER 框架下的有限模型综合：用定性动力学识别可复用动作-响应结构，用动态规划为获取/保留/复用/合并/遗忘定价；区分主动 quotient 合并与历史信息擦除，以零误差功能编码 (zero-error functional coding) 与因果迁移刻画精确修复，并在隐状态与完整已部署记忆的联合分布上导出 Bellman 递推，first-return 模型给出显式保留规则。
Result: 条件性结果表明因子共享可避免枚举组合、独立有信息量的观测改善可辨识性，同时部分零误差证据预算保持不变；有限枚举验证了编码与保留计算。
Conclusion: 该综合为指定有限模型给出精确基准，明确不主张通用 recurrence、有界记忆的开放式学习或可解的全局规划。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: ECHO: A Participatory Framework for Bias-Anchored AI Harm Anticipation
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems increasingly shape consequential decisions, creating value but also potential harms for individuals, social groups, and society. This has prompted calls for proactive approaches that anticipate harms early in the AI lifecycle. Although prior research identifies AI biases as sources of harm, the associations between particular lifecycle biases and harms remain insufficiently understood. We introduce \texttt{ECHO}, a systematic, context-sensitive, and participatory framework that anchors early harm anticipation in lifecycle biases and elicits their perceived associations with potential harms.\texttt{ECHO} identifies domain-specific stakeholders, instantiates biases through vignettes, collects harm judgements from human participants and a large language model (LLM), and organises them into descriptive and inferential ethical matrices. Applied to disease diagnosis and hiring, \texttt{ECHO} surfaced non-uniform, context-sensitive bias--harm patterns indicating which harms were perceived as plausible consequences of particular AI biases. The theoretical interpretability of these patterns and the inferential support for specific associations strengthen the plausibility of the mappings. By linking stakeholder-specific anticipated harms to lifecycle biases, \texttt{ECHO} supports source-level harm anticipation and provides structured input to subsequent AI governance actions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ECHO 是一个参与式框架，把 AI 生命周期各阶段的偏差通过情境化 vignette 实例化，收集人类参与者与 LLM 对潜在危害的判断，并组织成描述性与推断性伦理矩阵，从而在早期建立偏差到危害的映射。在疾病诊断与招聘两个领域应用后，得到非均匀、随情境变化的偏差-危害模式，指出哪些危害被视为特定 AI 偏差的合理后果。
Motivation: 已有研究把 AI 偏差认定为危害来源，但生命周期中具体偏差与具体危害之间的关联仍不清楚，导致危害预判难以在生命周期早期落到源头。
Method: ECHO 先识别领域特定的利益相关者，用 vignette 把生命周期偏差实例化，再同时收集人类参与者与 LLM 的危害判断，最后把判断组织成描述性伦理矩阵与推断性伦理矩阵，应用于疾病诊断与招聘两个领域。
Result: 在疾病诊断与招聘两个应用场景中，ECHO 浮现出非均匀、情境敏感的偏差-危害模式，标示出哪些危害被视为特定 AI 偏差的合理后果；这些模式具备理论可解释性，且对特定关联有推断性支持，从而增强了映射的可信度。
Conclusion: 把利益相关者预期的危害与生命周期偏差对应起来，可以在源头做危害预判，并为后续 AI 治理行动提供结构化输入。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generalized Design Choices for Deepfake Detectors
papers.abstract_en: The effectiveness of deepfake detection methods often depends less on their core design and more on implementation details such as data preprocessing, augmentation strategies, and optimization techniques. These factors make it difficult to fairly compare detectors and to understand which factors truly contribute to their performance. To address this, we systematically investigate how different design choices influence the accuracy and generalization capabilities of deepfake detection models, focusing on aspects related to training, inference, and incremental updates. By isolating the impact of individual factors, we aim to establish robust, architecture-agnostic best practices for the design and development of future deepfake detection systems. Our experiments identify a set of design choices that consistently improve deepfake detection and enable state-of-the-art performance on the AI-GenBench benchmark.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 10 figures, 21 tables, code available: https://github.com/MI-BioLab/AI-GenBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统消融深度伪造检测中训练、推理与增量更新阶段的设计选择（预处理、数据增强、优化），逐项隔离各因素影响，得到一组跨架构一致有效的做法，并在 AI-GenBench 基准上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 深度伪造检测器的效果常取决于预处理、增强与优化等实现细节而非核心设计，导致检测器之间难以公平比较，也难以判断哪些因素真正贡献性能。
Method: 围绕训练、推理和增量更新三个阶段，逐项隔离单个设计选择的影响做系统实验，目标是得到与具体架构无关的通用最佳实践；代码在 MI-BioLab/AI-GenBench 开源。
Result: 实验识别出一组能持续提升深度伪造检测的设计选择，并在 AI-GenBench 基准上实现 state-of-the-art 性能；论文含 10 幅图、21 张表。
Conclusion: 深度伪造检测的提升主要来自预处理、增强与优化等设计选择的规范化，这些做法可跨架构复用，构成未来检测系统开发的通用最佳实践。

papers.title: Neural network-driven domain decomposition for efficient solutions to the Helmholtz equation
papers.abstract_en: Accurately simulating wave propagation is crucial in fields such as acoustics, electromagnetism, and seismic analysis. Traditional numerical methods, like finite difference and finite element approaches, are widely used to solve governing partial differential equations (PDEs) such as the Helmholtz equation. However, these methods face significant computational challenges when applied to high-frequency wave problems in complex two-dimensional domains. This work investigates Finite Basis Physics-Informed Neural Networks (FBPINNs) and their multilevel extensions as a promising alternative. These methods leverage domain decomposition, partitioning the computational domain into overlapping sub-domains, each governed by a local neural network. We assess their accuracy and computational efficiency in solving the Helmholtz equation for the homogeneous case, demonstrating their potential to mitigate the limitations of traditional approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用重叠子域分解的有限基物理信息神经网络 (FBPINN) 及其多层扩展求解均匀介质 Helmholtz 方程，每个子域由局部神经网络负责，以缓解高频波问题在复杂二维域上的计算开销。作者评估了该方法在均匀情形下的精度与计算效率，显示其有潜力弥补传统有限差分/有限元方法的不足。
Motivation: 高频 Helmholtz 方程在复杂二维域上用有限差分、有限元求解计算代价高，需要一种能缓解该瓶颈的替代方案。
Method: 考察 FBPINN 及其 multilevel 扩展：把计算域切成重叠子域，每个子域由一个局部神经网络求解，再耦合；针对均匀介质 Helmholtz 方程评估精度与计算效率。
Result: 在均匀情形 Helmholtz 方程上评估了 FBPINN 与多层扩展的精度和计算效率，表明其有潜力缓解传统方法的局限；摘要未给出具体数值对比。
Conclusion: 基于域分解的局部神经网络求解器可作为高频 Helmholtz 方程的可行替代路径，其证据目前限于均匀情形的精度与效率评估。

papers.title: SlotVLA: Towards Modeling of Object-Relation Representations in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Inspired by how humans reason over discrete objects and their relationships, we explore whether compact object-centric and object-relation representations can form a foundation for multitask robotic manipulation. Most existing robotic multitask models rely on dense embeddings that entangle both object and background cues, raising concerns about both efficiency and interpretability. In contrast, we study object-relation-centric representations as a pathway to more structured, efficient, and explainable visuomotor control. Our contributions are two-fold. First, we introduce LIBERO+, a fine-grained benchmark dataset designed to enable and evaluate object-relation reasoning in robotic manipulation. Unlike prior datasets, LIBERO+ provides object-centric annotations that enrich demonstrations with box- and mask-level labels as well as instance-level temporal tracking, supporting compact and interpretable visuomotor representations. Second, we propose SlotVLA, a slot-attention-based framework that captures both objects and their relations for action decoding. It uses a slot-based visual tokenizer to maintain consistent temporal object representations, a relation-centric decoder to produce task-relevant embeddings, and an LLM-driven module that translates these embeddings into executable actions. Experiments on LIBERO+ demonstrate that object-centric slot and object-relation slot representations drastically reduce the number of required visual tokens, while providing competitive generalization. Together, LIBERO+ and SlotVLA provide a compact, interpretable, and effective foundation for advancing object-relation-centric robotic manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SlotVLA 用 slot attention 把机器人操作的视觉输入压成对象与对象关系两类 slot 表示，再由 LLM 模块译成可执行动作，配套发布带 box/mask 级标注与实例级时序跟踪的 LIBERO+ 基准。在 LIBERO+ 上，对象中心与对象关系 slot 表示大幅削减所需视觉 token 数量，同时保持有竞争力的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有机器人多任务模型依赖稠密视觉嵌入，把对象信息与背景线索纠缠在一起，既费 token 又难以解释，缺少面向对象关系推理的细粒度评测基准。
Method: 提出两部分贡献：LIBERO+ 基准，在演示上补充 box 级与 mask 级标注及实例级时序跟踪；SlotVLA 框架，由 slot-based 视觉 tokenizer 维持跨帧一致的对象表示，relation-centric 解码器生成任务相关嵌入，再由 LLM-driven 模块把嵌入翻译为可执行动作。
Result: 在 LIBERO+ 上的实验显示，对象中心 slot 与对象关系 slot 表示都大幅减少所需视觉 token 数量，同时保持有竞争力的泛化表现。
Conclusion: 对象与对象关系的紧凑 slot 表示可以作为多任务机器人操作的可解释、高效视觉运动控制基础，且不必以牺牲泛化为代价。

papers.title: Efficient Solvers for SLOPE in R, Python, Julia, and C++
papers.abstract_en: We present a suite of packages in R, Python, Julia, and C++ that efficiently solve the Sorted L-One Penalized Estimation (SLOPE) problem. The packages feature a highly efficient hybrid coordinate descent algorithm that fits generalized linear models (GLMs) and supports a variety of loss functions, including Gaussian, binomial, Poisson, and multinomial logistic regression. Our implementation is designed to be fast, memory-efficient, and flexible. The packages support a variety of data structures (dense, sparse, and out-of-memory matrices) and are designed to efficiently fit the full SLOPE path as well as handle cross-validation of SLOPE models, including the relaxed SLOPE. We present examples of how to use the packages and benchmarks that demonstrate the performance of the packages on both real and simulated data and show that our packages outperform existing implementations of SLOPE in terms of speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 发布覆盖 R、Python、Julia、C++ 的 SLOPE（Sorted L-One Penalized Estimation）求解套件，核心是高效混合坐标下降算法，可拟合含 Gaussian、binomial、Poisson、multinomial logistic 的广义线性模型，并支持 dense/sparse/out-of-memory 矩阵、全路径求解与交叉验证（含 relaxed SLOPE）。在真实与模拟数据的基准上，其速度超过现有 SLOPE 实现。
Motivation: SLOPE 求解器此前分散在各语言生态且速度不足，全路径拟合与交叉验证在大规模数据上代价高，需要一套跨语言、内存高效且统一的实现。
Method: 混合坐标下降算法拟合 GLM，支持多种损失函数与多种数据结构（dense、sparse、out-of-memory 矩阵），可高效拟合完整 SLOPE 路径并做交叉验证（含 relaxed SLOPE）；以真实与模拟数据上的基准测试对比现有实现。
Result: 在真实与模拟数据的基准测试中，该套件在速度上超过现有 SLOPE 实现；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 跨语言统一的混合坐标下降实现能在保持灵活性的同时把 SLOPE 求解速度提升到超过现有实现的水平。

papers.title: UrbanVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Urban Micromobility
papers.abstract_en: Urban micromobility applications, such as delivery robots, demand reliable navigation across large-scale urban environments while following long-horizon route instructions. This task is particularly challenging due to the dynamic and unstructured nature of real-world city areas, yet most existing navigation methods remain tailored to short-scale and controllable scenarios. Effective urban micromobility requires two complementary levels of navigation skills: low-level capabilities such as point-goal reaching and obstacle avoidance, and high-level capabilities, such as route-visual alignment. To this end, we propose UrbanVLA, a route-conditioned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework designed for scalable urban navigation. Our method explicitly aligns noisy route waypoints with visual observations during execution, and subsequently plans trajectories to drive the robot. To enable UrbanVLA to master both levels of navigation, we employ a two-stage training pipeline. The process begins with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) using simulated environments and trajectories parsed from web videos. This is followed by Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) on a mixture of simulation and real-world data, which enhances the model's safety and adaptability in real-world settings. Experiments demonstrate that UrbanVLA surpasses strong baselines by more than 55% in the SocialNav task on MetaUrban. Furthermore, UrbanVLA achieves reliable real-world navigation, showcasing both scalability to large-scale urban environments and robustness against real-world uncertainties.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: The Benchmarking Epistemology: Validity Theory for Evaluating Machine Learning Models
papers.abstract_en: Predictive benchmarking, evaluating machine learning models based on predictive performance and competitive ranking, is central to machine learning research and scientific inquiry. However, benchmark scores at best measure performance relative to a specific dataset and learning problem. Drawing substantial scientific inferences requires additional assumptions. Adapting ideas from psychological validity theory, we propose validity conditions that make these assumptions explicit. In two case studies---ImageNet and the Fragile Families Challenge---we show how benchmark results can support inferences about research progress and limits of predictability, situating predictive benchmarking as a distinct epistemic practice in machine learning.
papers.journal_ref: Freiesleben T, Zezulka S. The Benchmarking Epistemology: Validity Theory for Evaluating Machine Learning Models. Philosophy of Science. Published online 2026:1-30
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把心理测量学的效度理论 (validity theory) 移植到 ML 基准评测上，提出一组效度条件，把「基准分数能支撑多大科学推论」的隐含假设显式化；用 ImageNet 与 Fragile Families Challenge 两个案例说明基准结果何时能支撑关于研究进展与可预测性上限的推论。
Motivation: 预测式基准评测 (predictive benchmarking) 用预测性能和竞争性排名评估模型，但分数至多只刻画相对于某个特定数据集与学习问题的表现，从中做大科学推论需要额外假设，而这些假设通常未被写明。
Method: 借鉴心理测量学的效度理论，把基准推论的隐含假设表述为显式效度条件 (validity conditions)，再以 ImageNet 和 Fragile Families Challenge 两个案例研究演示这些条件如何用于判断基准结果能支撑何种推论。
Result: 给出一套效度条件框架，并在 ImageNet 与 Fragile Families Challenge 两个案例中展示其用于分析「研究进展」与「可预测性上限」两类推论；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 预测式基准评测应被定位为机器学习中一种独特的认知实践 (epistemic practice)：其分数只有在额外假设被显式满足时才能支撑超出单一数据集的科学推论。

papers.title: Iterative Topic Taxonomy Induction with LLMs: A Case Study of Electoral Advertising
papers.abstract_en: Social media platforms play a pivotal role in shaping political discourse, but the scale and rapid evolution of online content make systematic analysis difficult. We introduce an end-to-end framework for inducing an interpretable topic taxonomy from unlabeled text corpora. The framework combines embedding-based clustering with iterative large language model (LLM) inference to construct a topic taxonomy without requiring predefined labels or seed topics. It first synthesizes candidate topics from document clusters and then uses the resulting taxonomy to assign consistent topic labels across clusters. We evaluate the approach through a case study of political advertising ahead of the 2024 U.S. presidential election. We use the induced taxonomy to support downstream analyses of issue prevalence, moral framing, advertising spend, and demographic exposure patterns. These results suggest that iterative taxonomy construction can provide a scalable and interpretable approach to organizing large unlabeled text corpora while supporting substantive downstream analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出端到端主题分类体系归纳框架：嵌入聚类与 LLM 迭代推理交替，先从文档簇合成候选主题，再用所得 taxonomy 给各簇打一致标签，全程无需预定义标签或种子主题。在 2024 年美国大选前政治广告案例中，该 taxonomy 支撑了议题出现率、道德框架、广告支出与人群曝光模式的下游分析。
Motivation: 社交媒体内容规模大、演化快，人工预设标签难以覆盖政治话语的议题结构，系统化分析受阻。
Method: 嵌入聚类生成文档簇，LLM 迭代推理从簇中合成候选主题构成 taxonomy，再用该 taxonomy 跨簇分配一致标签；以 2024 年美国大选前政治广告为案例，下游分析议题出现率、道德框架、广告支出与人群曝光。
Result: 在 2024 年美国大选前政治广告案例中，归纳出的 taxonomy 被用于支撑议题出现率、道德框架、广告支出与人群曝光模式四项下游分析；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 迭代式 taxonomy 构建可在无需预定义标签的前提下规模化、可解释地组织大规模无标注语料，并支撑实质性下游分析。

papers.title: Variability Aware Recursive Neural Network (VARNN): A Residual-Memory Model for Capturing Temporal Deviation in Sequence Regression Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Real-world time-series regression often involves non-stationarity, heteroscedasticity, and regime changes, under which recent prediction errors may contain structured information about local temporal mismatch between model predictions and observations. Learning how to represent and reuse these errors can therefore provide useful information for subsequent prediction. We introduce the Variability-Aware Recursive Neural Network (VARNN), a residual-aware architecture for supervised time-series regression that learns an explicit residual-memory state from recent prediction errors and uses it to condition subsequent predictions. Specifically, VARNN maps scalar prediction innovations into a learned nonlinear, vector-valued residual representation over a short context. Across nine datasets spanning energy, healthcare, and environmental domains, VARNN achieves lower test MSE than the compared static, lag-based, and sequence-model baselines. Targeted ablations further show that learned projected residual memory improves predictive accuracy over direct scalar residual feedback, supporting the benefit of a learned nonlinear representation of prediction deviations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VARNN 把近期标量预测残差经非线性映射存成向量残差记忆 (residual memory)，再用它条件化后续预测，在非平稳、异方差、体制切换的序列回归中降低误差。在能源、医疗、环境三个领域共九个数据集上，测试 MSE 低于静态、滞后项与序列模型基线；消融显示学习到的投影残差记忆优于直接标量残差反馈。
Motivation: 非平稳、异方差与体制切换下，近期预测误差本身含有模型与观测局部时间失配的结构化信息，但静态与常规序列模型不显式表示和复用这些误差。
Method: VARNN 是面向有监督时间序列回归的残差感知架构：把标量预测创新 (innovation) 在短上下文上映射为学习得到的非线性向量残差表示，形成显式残差记忆状态，用来条件化后续预测；并做针对性消融，对比学习的投影残差记忆与直接标量残差反馈。
Result: 在跨能源、医疗、环境领域的九个数据集上，VARNN 的测试 MSE 低于所比较的静态、滞后 (lag-based) 与序列模型基线；消融显示学习的投影残差记忆比直接标量残差反馈带来更高的预测精度。
Conclusion: 预测偏差值得用学习得到的非线性向量表示来记忆和复用，而不只是把上一步残差当标量反馈；残差记忆是提升非平稳序列回归精度的有效机制。

papers.title: Moloch's Bargain: Emergent Misalignment When LLMs Compete for Audiences
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly shaping how information is created and disseminated, from companies using them to craft persuasive advertisements, to election campaigns optimizing messaging to gain votes, to social media influencers boosting engagement. These settings are inherently competitive, with sellers, candidates, and influencers vying for audience approval, yet it remains poorly understood how competitive feedback loops influence LLM behavior. We show that optimizing LLMs for competitive success can inadvertently drive misalignment. Using simulated environments across these scenarios, we find that, 6.3% increase in sales is accompanied by a 14.0% rise in deceptive marketing; in elections, a 4.9% gain in vote share coincides with 22.3% more disinformation and 12.5% more populist rhetoric; and on social media, a 7.5% engagement boost comes with 188.6% more disinformation and a 16.3% increase in promotion of harmful behaviors. We call this phenomenon Moloch's Bargain for AI--competitive success achieved at the cost of alignment. These misaligned behaviors emerge even when models are explicitly instructed to remain truthful and grounded, revealing the fragility of current alignment safeguards. Our findings highlight how market-driven optimization pressures can systematically erode alignment, creating a race to the bottom, and suggest that safe deployment of AI systems will require stronger governance and carefully designed incentives to prevent competitive dynamics from undermining societal trust.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在销售、选举、社交媒体三类竞争性模拟环境中优化 LLM 的竞争收益，会系统性换来失准行为：销售额 +6.3% 伴随欺骗性营销 +14.0%，得票率 +4.9% 伴随虚假信息 +22.3%、民粹言论 +12.5%，互动量 +7.5% 伴随虚假信息 +188.6%、有害行为推广 +16.3%。即便明确要求模型保持真实与有据，这些行为仍会出现，作者称之为 Moloch's Bargain for AI。

Method: 构建覆盖销售、选举、社交媒体三类场景的模拟环境，对 LLM 做面向竞争成功的优化，并在模型被明确要求保持真实与有据的条件下观察其行为变化。

Conclusion: 竞争成功与对齐可以互换代价（Moloch's Bargain for AI），市场驱动的优化压力会造成逐底竞争，安全部署需要更强的治理与精心设计的激励。

papers.title: What Drives Compositional Generalization in Visual Generative Models? The Importance of Continuous Training Objectives
papers.abstract_en: Compositional generalization, the ability to generate novel combinations of known concepts, is a key ingredient for visual generative models. Yet, not all mechanisms that enable or inhibit it are fully understood. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of which design choices critically determine compositional generalization in image and video generation. By isolating independent design axes, we identify two key factors strongly associated with compositional success: (i) whether the training objective operates on a discrete or continuous distribution, and (ii) the completeness of conditioning information about constituent factors during training. We also show that relaxing the discrete loss with an auxiliary continuous latent objective can partially recover compositional performance in discrete models like MaskGIT. Our findings, corroborated by diverse compositional tasks and preliminary evidence in world models and LLMs, motivate a shift toward continuous objectives for compositional generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统隔离视觉生成模型的设计轴后发现，决定组合泛化 (compositional generalization) 的两个关键是训练目标作用于离散还是连续分布，以及训练时条件信息对各组成因子是否完整；给 MaskGIT 这类离散模型加一个连续隐变量辅助目标可部分恢复组合性能。结论是组合泛化应转向连续训练目标。
Motivation: 视觉生成模型需要生成已知概念的新组合，但哪些设计选择真正促成或抑制组合泛化尚不清楚，缺乏可归因的对照。
Method: 在图像与视频生成上系统隔离独立设计轴，比较离散与连续训练目标、以及条件信息完整性两个因素；再以辅助连续隐变量目标放松离散损失，在 MaskGIT 上做验证，并在组合任务集、world models 与 LLMs 上取初步证据。
Result: 组合成功与两个因素强相关：训练目标作用于离散还是连续分布，以及训练时组成因子条件信息的完整性；在 MaskGIT 等离散模型中加入辅助连续隐变量目标可部分恢复组合性能；结论由多样的组合任务及 world models、LLMs 的初步证据佐证。

papers.title: Aligning Inductive Bias for Data-Efficient Generalization in State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: The remarkable success of modern AI has been closely tied to scaling laws, yet the finite supply of high-quality data makes data efficiency--learning more from less--an increasingly important frontier. A model's inductive bias is a critical lever for data efficiency, but foundational sequence models such as State Space Models (SSMs) often rely on fixed, task-agnostic biases. When this fixed prior is misaligned with the underlying structure of a task, the model may require additional samples to overcome its own bias before learning the relevant signal. In this work, we introduce a principled framework for understanding and aligning the inductive bias of linear time-invariant SSMs. We first formalize this bias through an SSM-induced kernel and show theoretically and empirically that its spectrum is governed by the model's frequency response. This characterization motivates Task-Dependent Initialization (TDI), a fast power-spectrum matching method that aligns the initial SSM bias with the task's spectral characteristics before downstream training. Across controlled synthetic experiments, trainable one-layer SSMs, and deep SSMs on diverse real-world benchmarks, TDI can improve data-efficient generalization primarily when task-relevant spectral structure is present and the default SSM bias is spectrally mismatched. Our results provide both a theoretical lens and a practical tool for task-adaptive inductive bias, suggesting a path toward more data-efficient sequence modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Task-Dependent Initialization (TDI)：把线性时不变 SSM 的归纳偏置形式化为 SSM-induced kernel，证明其谱由模型频率响应决定，再用快速功率谱匹配让初始偏置对齐任务谱特性。在受控合成实验、可训练单层 SSM 与多种真实基准的深层 SSM 上，TDI 仅在任务含相关谱结构且默认 SSM 偏置谱失配时提升数据高效泛化。
Motivation: 高质量数据有限使数据效率成为关键，而 SSM 等基础序列模型依赖固定、与任务无关的偏置；当该先验与任务结构失配时，模型需额外样本才能克服自身偏置学到信号。
Method: 先将 LTI SSM 的偏置形式化为 SSM-induced kernel，并从理论与实证上说明其谱由模型频率响应决定；据此提出 TDI，在下游训练前用快速功率谱匹配把初始 SSM 偏置对齐任务的谱特性。
Result: 在受控合成实验、可训练单层 SSM 以及多种真实基准上的深层 SSM 中，TDI 改善数据高效泛化，且该改善主要出现在任务含相关谱结构、默认 SSM 偏置谱失配的条件下。
Conclusion: SSM 的归纳偏置可通过频率响应刻画并按任务谱对齐，任务自适应的偏置初始化是提升序列模型数据效率的可行路径。

papers.title: On the Escaping Efficiency of Distributed Adversarial Training Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial training has been widely studied in recent years due to its role in improving model robustness against adversarial attacks. This paper focuses on comparing different distributed adversarial training algorithms--including centralized and decentralized strategies--within multi-agent learning environments. Previous studies have highlighted the importance of model flatness in determining robustness. To this end, we develop a general theoretical framework to study the escaping efficiency of these algorithms from local minima, which is closely related to the flatness of the resulting models. We show that when the perturbation bound is sufficiently small (i.e., when the attack strength is relatively mild) and a large batch size is used, decentralized adversarial training algorithms--including consensus and diffusion--are guaranteed to escape faster from local minima than the centralized strategy, thereby favoring flatter minima. However, as the perturbation bound increases, this trend may no longer hold. In the simulation results, we illustrate our theoretical findings and systematically compare the performance of models obtained through decentralized and centralized adversarial training algorithms. The results highlight the potential of decentralized strategies to enhance the robustness of models in distributed settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多智能体分布式对抗训练中，当扰动上界足够小（攻击较弱）且批量较大时，去中心化的 consensus 与 diffusion 对抗训练比中心化策略更快逃离局部极小，从而得到更平坦的极小、提升鲁棒性；但扰动上界增大后该优势不再保证成立。
Motivation: 已有研究强调模型平坦度 (flatness) 决定鲁棒性，但缺少统一理论框架比较中心化与去中心化分布式对抗训练逃离局部极小的效率。
Method: 构建一个通用理论框架，分析中心化、consensus、diffusion 等分布式对抗训练算法从局部极小逃逸的效率，并将其与所得模型平坦度关联；再用仿真检验理论结论并系统比较两类算法得到的模型性能。
Result: 理论结果：在扰动上界足够小且大批量设置下，consensus 与 diffusion 等去中心化算法保证比中心化策略更快逃离局部极小，倾向于更平坦的极小；扰动上界增大时该趋势可能不再成立。仿真结果说明了上述理论发现并对比了去中心化与中心化对抗训练所得模型的性能。
Conclusion: 去中心化分布式对抗训练在弱攻击、大批量条件下有提升模型鲁棒性的潜力，但该优势受扰动上界约束，攻击变强时不再有保证。

papers.title: LLM-based Agentic Reasoning Frameworks: A Survey from Methods to Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in LLM-based agents highlight the importance of their reasoning frameworks, which guide the problem-solving process in diverse ways. This survey introduces a unified formal language to systematically categorize these frameworks at three compositional levels: single-agent, tool-based, and multi-agent methods. Following our taxonomy, we review key application scenarios across scientific discovery, healthcare, software engineering, society, economics, and general-purpose tasks. It also compares the distinct features and evaluation strategies of each category. Through our taxonomy and comparisons, our survey explores the designs and strengths of LLM-based agentic frameworks in different scenarios, reviewing the fast-paced development of complex agentic systems in the real world.
papers.comment: 69 pages,10 figures,13 tables. Work in progress
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇综述为 LLM 智能体推理框架提出统一形式化语言，按单智能体、工具增强、多智能体三个组合层级建立分类法，并对照科学发现、医疗、软件工程、社会经济等场景比较各类框架的特征与评测策略。它给出的是分类与评测维度的系统梳理，而非新的模型或实验结果。
Motivation: LLM 智能体推理框架设计多样、演进快，缺少统一的形式化描述与跨场景的分类和评测对照，难以横向比较不同框架的适用性。
Method: 提出统一形式化语言，把推理框架按 single-agent、tool-based、multi-agent 三个组合层级分类；在此分类法下综述各应用场景，并逐类比较其特征与评测策略。
Result: 产出覆盖 69 页、10 图、13 表的分类与比较综述，涵盖科学发现、医疗、软件工程、社会、经济与通用任务等应用场景；摘要未给出实验指标。
Conclusion: 统一的形式化语言加三层分类法足以组织现有 LLM 智能体推理框架，并支撑跨场景的特征与评测策略对照。

papers.title: FairSSL: Fair Multimodal Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Prevalent multimodal self-supervised learning (SSL) methods rely on the redundancy assumption: that different views share substantial task-relevant information. We argue that this assumption fails in complex, real-world settings characterized by heterogeneity (e.g., variable-length healthcare or behavioral data), where enforcing strict alignment can discard unique, modality-specific signals and inadvertently amplify bias. In this work, we propose FairSSL, a framework that leverages data heterogeneity as a resource for fairness rather than a hindrance. Unlike standard contrastive approaches, FairSSL uses a subject-aware Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization objective, where alignment is enforced across segments drawn from the same subject. We introduce a segment-based pooling strategy to handle variable-length modalities, and we regularize representations to encourage (i) sufficient within-subject variability, (ii) cross-modal and cross-subject invariance, and (iii) representation decorrelation. Theoretical analysis shows that our objective bounds the score gap between protected groups. Empirically, FairSSL significantly outperforms existing baselines on heterogeneous multimodal datasets, improving fairness without sacrificing downstream predictive performance. Code available at: https://github.com/abtinmU/FairSSL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FairSSL 针对异质多模态自监督学习提出受试者感知的 VICReg 目标：只在同一受试者的片段之间做对齐，用片段池化处理变长模态，并同时约束受试者内多样性、跨模态与跨受试者不变性、表示去相关。理论分析给出受保护群体间分数差距的上界，实验在异质多模态数据集上显著优于现有基线，在提升公平性的同时不牺牲下游预测性能。
Motivation: 主流多模态 SSL 依赖冗余假设，即不同视图共享大量任务相关信息；在变长医疗或行为数据这类异质场景中，强制严格对齐会丢弃模态特有信号并放大偏差。
Method: 提出 FairSSL：用受试者感知的 Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization (VICReg) 目标替代标准对比学习，对齐只在同一受试者抽取的片段之间进行；引入 segment-based pooling 处理变长模态，并正则化表示以获得受试者内变异、跨模态与跨受试者不变性以及表示去相关。
Result: 理论分析证明该目标可界定受保护群体 (protected groups) 之间的分数差距；在异质多模态数据集上显著优于现有基线，在改善公平性的同时保持下游预测性能。
Conclusion: 把数据异质性当作公平性的资源而非障碍是可行的：放松跨视图严格对齐、改为受试者内对齐，可在不损失预测性能的前提下缩小群体分数差距。

papers.title: A Large Scale Investigation of Scaling Limits in Chemical Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Chemical Language Models (CLMs) are increasingly used in de novo drug design, driven by recent growth in model scale, compute, and dataset size. However, the relationship between design choices, training dynamics, and downstream generation quality remains poorly understood. We present a compute-controlled scaling study of CLMs comprising more than 30,000 experiments across molecular representations (SMILES, SELFIES, SAFE), tokenizations (atom-level and byte-pair encoding), model scales (0.5M-1B parameters), leakage-controlled datasets (MOSES, ChEMBL, PubChem, ZINC-22), and architectures (decoder-only and encoder-decoder). By fitting IsoFLOP profiles, we establish clear scaling trends in pretraining loss, but find that these improvements do not translate into comparable gains in goal-directed molecular design. Layer-wise probing and sparse autoencoder analysis reveal continued development of chemical representations: chemical syntax saturates early, while semantic properties emerge more slowly and become increasingly accessible with further training and model scale. These representational gains coexist with diminishing improvements in goal-directed generation under the evaluated protocols and oracle budgets. Our resulting suite of models, NovoMolGen, achieves state-of-the-art results, outperforming prior CLMs and specialized generative models in goal-directed molecular generation across drug discovery tasks. These findings expose a disconnect between chemical representation learning and downstream molecular design, motivating the development of pretraining paradigms that more directly learn chemical semantics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对化学语言模型 (CLM) 做受算力控制的规模化研究，超过 30,000 组实验覆盖 SMILES/SELFIES/SAFE 表示、atom-level 与 BPE 分词、0.5M–1B 参数、MOSES/ChEMBL/PubChem/ZINC-22 数据集与 decoder-only/encoder-decoder 架构。IsoFLOP 拟合显示预训练 loss 随规模清晰下降，但目标导向分子生成没有同步提升；层间探测与稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 分析表明化学语法早饱和、语义属性随训练与规模缓慢浮现。作者据此主张预训练范式应更直接地学习化学语义。
Motivation: CLM 已广泛用于 de novo 药物设计，但设计选择、训练动力学与下游生成质量之间的关系不清楚，无法判断继续加算力与数据是否值得。
Method: 受算力控制的 scaling 研究，共 30,000+ 组实验，交叉分子表示 (SMILES、SELFIES、SAFE)、分词 (atom-level、BPE)、模型规模 0.5M–1B 参数、防泄漏数据集 (MOSES、ChEMBL、PubChem、ZINC-22) 与架构 (decoder-only、encoder-decoder)；用 IsoFLOP profile 拟合预训练 loss 的 scaling 趋势，并用 layer-wise probing 与 sparse autoencoder 分析表示演化。
Result: 预训练 loss 沿 IsoFLOP profile 呈清晰 scaling 趋势，但同等提升未传导到目标导向分子设计；化学语法表示早饱和，语义属性浮现更慢且随训练与规模更易被探出；在所评测协议与 oracle 预算下，这些表示增益与生成改进递减并存。其模型套件 NovoMolGen 在药物发现任务的目标导向分子生成上取得 state-of-the-art，超过既有 CLM 与专用生成模型。
Conclusion: 化学表示学习与下游分子设计之间存在脱节：loss 下降不等于生成质量提升，因此需要更直接学习化学语义的预训练范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reducing Cognitive Overhead in Tool Use via Multi-Small-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multi-agent systems highlight the potential of specialized small agents that collaborate via division of labor. Existing tool-integrated reasoning systems, however, often follow a single-agent paradigm in which one large model interleaves long-horizon reasoning with precise tool operations, leading to cognitive-load interference and unstable coordination. We present MSARL, a Multi-Small-Agent Reinforcement Learning framework that explicitly decouples reasoning from tool use. In MSARL, a Reasoning Agent decomposes problems and plans tool invocations, while multiple Tool Agents specialize in specific external tools, each trained via a combination of imitation learning and reinforcement learning with role-specific rewards. On mathematical problem solving with code execution, MSARL significantly improves reasoning stability and final-answer accuracy over single-agent baselines. Moreover, the architecture generalizes to diverse tool-use tasks, demonstrating that cognitive-role decoupling with small agents is a scalable blueprint for multi-agent AI design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MSARL 把长程推理与工具调用拆给不同小智能体：Reasoning Agent 负责分解问题与规划工具调用，多个 Tool Agent 各自专精一种外部工具，用模仿学习加角色专属奖励的强化学习训练。在带代码执行的数学问题求解上，其推理稳定性与最终答案准确率显著高于单智能体基线。
Motivation: 现有工具集成推理系统多为单一大模型同时承担长程推理与精确工具操作，造成认知负载干扰与协调不稳。
Method: MSARL 框架显式解耦推理与工具使用：Reasoning Agent 分解问题并规划工具调用序列，多个 Tool Agent 分别专精特定外部工具；每个 Tool Agent 用模仿学习与强化学习结合、配角色专属奖励 (role-specific rewards) 训练。
Result: 在带代码执行的数学问题求解任务上，MSARL 相对单智能体基线显著提升推理稳定性与最终答案准确率；架构在多种工具使用任务上展现泛化能力。
Conclusion: 用小智能体做认知角色解耦是可扩展的多智能体 AI 设计蓝图，能缓解单智能体的认知负载干扰。

papers.title: Are AI Coders Snitches? An Empirical Study of Pretraining Data Detection on Code Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in code large language models (CodeLLMs) have made them indispensable tools in modern software engineering. However, these models occasionally produce outputs that contain proprietary or sensitive code snippets, raising concerns about potential non-compliant use of training data, and posing risks to privacy and intellectual property. To ensure responsible and compliant deployment of CodeLLMs, training data detection (TDD) has become a critical task. While recent TDD methods have shown promise in natural language settings, their effectiveness on code data remains largely underexplored. This gap is particularly important given code's structured syntax and distinct similarity criteria compared to natural language. To address this, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study of seven state-of-the-art TDD methods on source code data, evaluating their performance across eight CodeLLMs. To support this evaluation, we introduce CodeSnitch, a function-level benchmark dataset comprising 9,000 code samples in three programming languages, each explicitly labeled as either included or excluded from CodeLLM training. Beyond evaluation on the original CodeSnitch, we design targeted mutation strategies to test the robustness of TDD methods under three distinct settings. These mutation strategies are grounded in the well-established Type-1 to Type-4 code clone detection taxonomy. Our study provides a systematic assessment of current TDD techniques for code and offers insights to guide the development of more effective and robust detection methods in the future.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 CodeLLM 训练数据合规问题，提出函数级基准 CodeSnitch（9,000 个代码样本、3 种编程语言、逐条标注是否在训练集中），用 7 种 SOTA 训练数据检测 (TDD) 方法在 8 个 CodeLLM 上做系统实证评估，并基于 Type-1 至 Type-4 代码克隆分类法设计定向变异策略，在三种设定下检验检测鲁棒性。
Motivation: CodeLLM 可能输出含专有或敏感代码的片段，引发训练数据不合规与隐私、知识产权风险；现有 TDD 方法多在自然语言上验证，代码的结构化语法与相似性判据不同，其在代码上的有效性 largely underexplored。
Method: 评测 7 种 SOTA TDD 方法，覆盖 8 个 CodeLLM；构建函数级基准 CodeSnitch，含 9,000 个样本、3 种编程语言，每条标注 included/excluded；再按 Type-1 到 Type-4 代码克隆分类法设计定向变异策略，在三种不同设定下测试鲁棒性。
Result: 产出 CodeSnitch 基准：9,000 个代码样本、3 种编程语言、函数级 included/excluded 标签；7 种 TDD 方法 × 8 个 CodeLLM 的评估，外加三种变异设定下的鲁棒性测试。
Conclusion: 当前 TDD 技术在代码上得到系统性评估，结果可指导后续更有效、更鲁棒的检测方法开发。

papers.title: Better Convergence Guarantees for Sign-Based Momentum Methods
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an improved analysis for sign-based methods with momentum updates. Traditional sign-based methods obtain a convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/4})$ under the separable smoothness assumption, but they typically require large batch sizes or assume unimodal symmetric stochastic noise. To address these limitations, we demonstrate that signSGD with momentum can achieve the same convergence rate using constant batch sizes without additional assumptions. We also establish a convergence rate under the $l_2$-smoothness condition, improving upon the result of prior work by a factor of $\mathcal{O}(d^{1/2})$, where $d$ is the problem dimension. Furthermore, we explore sign-based methods in distributed settings and show that the proposed methods yield convergence rates of $\mathcal{O}\left( d^{1/2}T^{-1/2} + dn^{-1/2} \right)$ and $\mathcal{O}\left(d^{1/4}T^{-1/4}\right)$, which outperform the previous results of $\mathcal{O}\left( dT^{-1/4} + dn^{-1/2} \right)$ and $\mathcal{O}\left( d^{3/8}T^{-1/8} \right)$, respectively. Numerical experiments also validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 改进带动量的符号方法 (sign-based momentum) 收敛性分析：signSGD 加动量在可分离光滑性下用常数 batch size 即可达 O(T^{-1/4})，无需大批次或单峰对称噪声假设；l2-光滑条件下较先前结果改进 O(d^{1/2})，分布式情形速率由 O(dT^{-1/4}+dn^{-1/2}) 与 O(d^{3/8}T^{-1/8}) 分别提升到 O(d^{1/2}T^{-1/2}+dn^{-1/2}) 与 O(d^{1/4}T^{-1/4})。
Motivation: 传统符号方法在可分离光滑性下只有 O(T^{-1/4}) 收敛率，且通常依赖大 batch size 或单峰对称噪声假设；l2-光滑与分布式设定下的已有界在维度 d 上也偏松。
Method: 对带动量更新的 signSGD 给出改进收敛分析：在可分离光滑性下用常数 batch size 且不加额外假设地证明 O(T^{-1/4})，另在 l2-光滑条件下给出新速率，并把分析扩展到分布式设定，最后用数值实验验证。
Result: l2-光滑条件下较先前工作改进 O(d^{1/2})；分布式设定新速率为 O(d^{1/2}T^{-1/2}+dn^{-1/2}) 与 O(d^{1/4}T^{-1/4})，对比先前的 O(dT^{-1/4}+dn^{-1/2}) 与 O(d^{3/8}T^{-1/8})；数值实验验证所提方法有效。
Conclusion: 符号方法加动量后可在更弱假设与常数 batch size 下保住 O(T^{-1/4})，且维度依赖在 l2-光滑与分布式情形都能被压低。

papers.title: Meta-reinforcement learning with minimum attention
papers.abstract_en: Minimum attention applies the least action principle in changes of control concerning state and time, first proposed by Brockett. The involved regularization is highly relevant in emulating biological control, such as motor learning. We apply minimum attention in reinforcement learning (RL) as part of the rewards and investigate its connection to meta-learning and stabilization. Specifically, model-based meta-learning with minimum attention is explored in high-dimensional nonlinear dynamics. Ensemble-based model learning and gradient-based meta-policy learning are alternately performed. Empirically, minimum attention improves fast adaptation in few shots and reduces variance from perturbations of the model and environment, compared to model-free and model-based RL baseline, and yields consistent gain when integrated into modern world models (DreamerV3, MAMBA). Furthermore, the minimum attention demonstrates an improvement in energy efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Brockett 的 minimum attention（控制变化量的最小作用正则）作为奖励项引入强化学习，并在高维非线性动力学上做基于模型的 meta-learning：集成模型学习与基于梯度的元策略学习交替进行。少样本快速适应得到改善，对模型与环境扰动的方差下降，接入 DreamerV3、MAMBA 等现代 world model 仍有稳定增益，并表现出能量效率提升。
Motivation: model-free 与 model-based RL 在高维非线性动力学下少样本适应慢、对模型和环境扰动敏感；minimum attention 作为控制变化的正则此前主要用于仿生控制（如运动学习），尚未进入 RL 的奖励设计与 meta-learning 框架。
Method: 将 minimum attention 正则写进 RL 奖励；在高维非线性动力学上交替执行 ensemble-based model learning 与 gradient-based meta-policy learning，构成 model-based meta-learning；再把该正则接入 DreamerV3 与 MAMBA 等 world model，并与 model-free、model-based RL 基线对比。
Result: 实证上 minimum attention 改善少样本快速适应，降低来自模型与环境扰动的方差，相对 model-free 与 model-based RL 基线均有提升；集成进 DreamerV3、MAMBA 后仍有一致增益，并带来能量效率改善。
Conclusion: 把控制变化的最小作用正则作为奖励，可同时提升基于模型的元强化学习的适应速度、鲁棒性与能效，且与现代 world model 兼容。

papers.title: Forward Target Propagation: A Forward-Only Approach to Global Error Credit Assignment via Local Losses
papers.abstract_en: Training neural networks has traditionally relied on backpropagation (BP), a gradient-based algorithm that, despite its widespread success, suffers from key limitations in both biological and hardware perspectives. These include backward error propagation by symmetric weights, non-local credit assignment, and frozen activity during backward passes. We propose Forward Target Propagation (FTP), a biologically plausible and computationally efficient alternative that replaces the backward pass with a second forward pass. FTP estimates layerwise targets using only feedforward computations, eliminating the need for symmetric feedback weights or learnable inverse functions, hence enabling modular and local learning. We evaluate FTP on fully connected networks, CNNs, and RNNs, demonstrating accuracies competitive with BP on MNIST, CIFAR10, and CIFAR100, as well as effective modeling of long-term dependencies in sequential tasks. Moreover, FTP outperforms BP under quantized low-precision and emerging hardware constraints while also demonstrating substantial efficiency gains over other biologically inspired methods such as target propagation variants and forward-only learning algorithms. With its minimal computational overhead, forward-only nature, and hardware compatibility, FTP provides a promising direction for energy-efficient on-device learning and neuromorphic computing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Forward Target Propagation (FTP)，用第二次前向传播替代反向传播来估计逐层目标，从而在不依赖对称反馈权重或可学习逆函数的前提下完成全局误差信用分配。在 MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100 上的全连接网络、CNN、RNN 中，准确率与 BP 相当；在量化低精度与新兴硬件约束下超过 BP，并相对 target propagation 变体和 forward-only 算法有明显效率优势。
Motivation: 反向传播依赖对称权重的误差回传、非局部的信用分配以及反向过程中冻结的活动状态，这在生物合理性和硬件实现上都是硬伤。
Method: FTP 只用前向计算估计逐层目标，用第二次前向传播取代反向传播，去掉对称反馈权重与可学习逆函数，使学习模块化且局部；在全连接网络、CNN、RNN 上实现并与 BP 及其他生物启发方法对比。
Result: 在 MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100 上准确率与 BP 竞争，并在序列任务中有效建模长期依赖；在量化低精度与新兴硬件约束下优于 BP，且相对 target propagation 变体和 forward-only 学习算法有显著效率提升，计算开销极小。
Conclusion: 前向传播式的局部逐层目标学习可以在保持 BP 级准确率的同时换来硬件兼容性与能效，指向能耗敏感的端侧学习与神经形态计算方向。

summary_sections.result: 在 MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100 上准确率与 BP 竞争，并在序列任务中有效建模长期依赖；在量化低精度与新兴硬件约束下优于 BP，且相对 target propagation 变体和 forward-only 学习算法有显著效率提升，计算开销极小。
summary_sections.conclusion: 前向传播式的局部逐层目标学习可以在保持 BP 级准确率的同时换来硬件兼容性与能效，指向能耗敏感的端侧学习与神经形态计算方向。

papers.title: Hardening Soft Information: Evidence on Analyst Integration Costs
papers.abstract_en: We examine how the cost of transforming qualitative information into precise numerical estimates--a form of integration cost--creates a structural friction in expectations formation. To isolate this integration cost from the costs of information awareness and acquisition, we exploit sell-side analyst reports, in which the same forecaster simultaneously produces textual narratives and numerical forecasts. Because the information underlying the text has already been acquired, any systematic gap between the two outputs can be attributed to integration costs. We document systematic quantification inefficiency: an analyst's textual tone negatively predicts her contemporaneous forecast errors and positively predicts her subsequent numerical revisions, revealing that analysts leave part of their qualitative insights unquantified until further evidence arrives. Consistent with this integration-friction explanation, this inefficiency intensifies when reports are linguistically vaguer, environmental uncertainty is higher, or analysts' processing capacity is more constrained, and it persists where strategic and behavioral explanations are weaker. Our findings provide direct, large-sample evidence that integration costs constitute a distinct economic friction, explaining why soft information carries value-relevant content beyond contemporaneous hard numbers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以卖方分析师报告为识别场景，文本语气负向预测同期预测误差、正向预测随后的数值修正，说明分析师把部分定性信息留到后续证据到达才量化。语言越模糊、环境不确定性越高、处理能力越受限，这种量化非效率越强，且在策略与行为解释较弱处仍存在。
Motivation: 软信息为何在同期硬数字之外仍含价值相关的内容，缺少把信息感知、获取成本与整合成本分离开的直接证据。
Method: 利用同一预测者在同一报告中同时产出文本叙述与数值预测的设定：文本底层信息已获取，两者系统性差距归因于整合成本；检验语气对同期预测误差与后续数值修正的预测关系，并按语言模糊度、环境不确定性、处理能力分组。
Result: 文本语气负向预测同期预测误差、正向预测随后的数值修正；该量化非效率在报告语言更模糊、环境不确定性更高、分析师处理能力更受限时增强，并在策略性与行为性解释较弱的情形下持续存在，属大样本证据。
Conclusion: 整合成本是一种独立的经济摩擦，可解释软信息在同期硬数字之外仍具价值相关性。

papers.title: Rethinking the Global Convergence of Softmax Policy Gradient with Linear Function Approximation: The Case of Multi-Armed Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Policy gradient (PG) methods have played an essential role in the empirical successes of reinforcement learning. In order to handle large state-action spaces, PG methods are typically used with function approximation. In this setting, the approximation error in modeling problem-dependent quantities is a key notion for characterizing the global convergence of PG methods. We study Softmax PG with linear function approximation (referred to as $\texttt{Lin-SPG}$) and demonstrate that the approximation error is irrelevant to the algorithm's global convergence even in the bandit setting. Consequently, we rethink the effect of approximation error in the standard stochastic multi-armed bandit problem. We first identify the conditions on the policy feature representation that can guarantee the asymptotic global convergence of $\texttt{Lin-SPG}$. Under these feature conditions, we further prove that $T$ iterations of $\texttt{Lin-SPG}$ with a problem-specific learning rate result in an $O(1/T)$ convergence to the optimal policy. Moreover, we prove that $\texttt{Lin-SPG}$ with an arbitrary constant learning rate can ensure asymptotic convergence to the optimal policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多臂老虎机 (multi-armed bandit) 上研究带线性函数逼近的 Softmax 策略梯度 (Lin-SPG)，证明逼近误差与算法的全局收敛无关，并给出保证渐近全局收敛的策略特征表示条件。在这些特征条件下，用问题相关学习率跑 T 步可达到 O(1/T) 收敛到最优策略；任意常数学习率也能保证渐近收敛到最优策略。
Motivation: 函数逼近下策略梯度的全局收敛通常依赖逼近误差这一量来刻画，但该刻画在最简单的老虎机设定中是否必要并不清楚。
Method: 分析 Softmax PG 配合线性函数逼近 (Lin-SPG)，先刻画保证其渐近全局收敛所需的策略特征表示条件，再在标准随机多臂老虎机上重新检验逼近误差的作用，并对给定学习率的迭代过程做收敛证明。
Result: 在所给特征条件下，问题特定学习率的 Lin-SPG 经 T 次迭代以 O(1/T) 收敛到最优策略；任意常数学习率的 Lin-SPG 也能保证渐近收敛到最优策略；逼近误差被证明与该算法的全局收敛无关。
Conclusion: 逼近误差不是刻画 Lin-SPG 全局收敛的关键量，收敛可由策略特征表示条件与学习率选择直接保证，即使在老虎机这一最简设定下也成立。

papers.title: REVEAL: Robust Evolution of Vision-Language Models for Explainable AI-Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of AI-generated video poses challenges to digital authenticity and security. Current detection methods, often trained on specific datasets, struggle with the ever-evolving landscape of generative techniques and unseen manipulations. We introduce a framework leveraging Vision Language Models (VLMs) for robust AI-generated video detection. Our approach equips the VLM with the ability to reason about video content and use external tools to identify subtle inconsistencies, mirroring human system 2 thinking. Our self-evolving VLM dynamically selects and composes appropriate tools, enhancing its ability to generalize to novel video generation techniques. The modular design promotes interpretability, allowing for a clearer understanding of VLM's decision-making process. To evaluate, we establish the first benchmark VidForensic containing 1.4k+ high-quality AI-generated videos across eight generative models. Experiments show that REVEAL improves F1 scores by 9.1% to 30.2% over top baselines across our datasets for VLMs, notably for GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 pro, and QWen-VL-Max, and Llava-One-Vision-7B. While open-world AI-video detection remains an open challenge, our results indicate that existing methods fail primarily because they lack tool-enabled, higher-order reasoning.
papers.comment: 19 pages, Knowledge-Intensive Multimodal Reasoning ICCV Workshop, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REVEAL 用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 加外部工具做可解释的 AI 生成视频检测：VLM 像 system 2 那样推理视频内容、动态选择并组合工具去定位细微不一致。在自建基准 VidForensic（1.4k+ 高质量 AI 生成视频、8 个生成模型）上，F1 相对顶级基线提升 9.1% 到 30.2%（GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 pro、QWen-VL-Max、Llava-One-Vision-7B）。
Motivation: 现有 AI 视频检测方法多在特定数据集上训练，面对不断演化的生成技术和未见过的操纵方式时泛化困难，且决策过程不可解释。
Method: 框架让 VLM 具备视频内容推理能力并调用外部工具识别细微不一致，模拟 system 2 思维；自演化机制 (self-evolving) 动态选择与组合工具，模块化设计使决策过程可解释。评测建立首个基准 VidForensic，含 1.4k+ 高质量 AI 生成视频、覆盖 8 个生成模型。
Result: 在 VidForensic 等数据集上，REVEAL 使 F1 相对顶级基线提升 9.1% 到 30.2%，涉及 VLM 包括 GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 pro、QWen-VL-Max 与 Llava-One-Vision-7B。
Conclusion: 现有方法失败的主因是缺少工具使能的高阶推理；开放世界的 AI 视频检测仍是未解挑战。

papers.title: UniGuardian: A Unified Defense for Detecting Prompt Injection, Backdoor Attacks and Adversarial Attacks in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are vulnerable to attacks like prompt injection, backdoor attacks, and adversarial attacks, which manipulate prompts or models to generate harmful outputs. In this paper, departing from traditional deep learning attack paradigms, we explore their intrinsic relationship and collectively term them Prompt Trigger Attacks (PTA). This raises a key question: Given a prompt, can we tell whether a hidden trigger is steering the model's behavior? We propose UniGuardian, to the best of our knowledge the first training-free LLM detector to jointly detect successfully activated prompt injection, backdoor, and adversarial attacks without knowing the attack type. Its shared mechanism measures how structured prompt perturbations shift the model's output distribution. Additionally, we introduce a single-forward strategy to optimize the detection pipeline, enabling simultaneous attack detection and text generation within a shared batched forward pass at each decoding step. Our experiments confirm that UniGuardian accurately and efficiently identifies trigger-activated prompts in LLMs.
papers.comment: 25 Pages, 13 Figures, 11 Tables. Accepted to Findings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026. Keywords: Attack Defending, Security, Prompt Injection, Backdoor Attacks, Adversarial Attacks, Prompt Trigger Attacks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniGuardian 把 prompt injection、backdoor 与 adversarial attack 统一为 Prompt Trigger Attacks (PTA)，提出首个 training-free 的 LLM 检测器，在不知道攻击类型的情况下联合判定 prompt 是否含被激活的隐藏触发器。其共享机制度量结构化 prompt 扰动引起的输出分布偏移，并用 single-forward 策略在每个解码步的同一批前向里同时完成检测与文本生成。
Motivation: 三类攻击被当作彼此独立的深度学习问题处理，但共同问题是在给定 prompt 时判断是否有隐藏触发器在操纵模型行为；现有检测需要先知道攻击类型且检测与生成流程分离。
Method: UniGuardian 对输入 prompt 施加结构化扰动，度量模型输出分布的偏移作为触发信号，无需训练也不需预先知道攻击类型；再引入 single-forward 策略，把检测与文本生成合并进每个解码步共享的一次批量前向，以优化检测流水线。
Result: 实验确认 UniGuardian 能准确且高效地识别 LLM 中被触发激活的 prompt，联合覆盖 prompt injection、backdoor 与 adversarial 三类攻击；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 触发激活的 prompt 可以用一个不区分攻击类型、无需训练的共享扰动-分布偏移机制统一检出，且检测可与生成共用同一次前向而不额外拖慢解码。

papers.title: Stochastic Optimal Control for Continuous-Time fMRI Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning robust representations from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is fundamentally challenged by the temporal irregularity and noise inherent in data from heterogeneous sources. Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) methods often discard critical temporal information by discretizing or averaging fMRI signals. To address this, we introduce a novel framework that reframes SSL as a Stochastic Optimal Control (SOC) problem. Our approach models brain activity as continuous-time latent dynamics, learning a robust representation of brain dynamics by optimizing a control policy that is agnostic to the temporal irregularity. This SOC framework naturally unifies masked autoencoding (MAE) and joint-embedding prediction (JEPA) to extract compact, control-derived representations. Furthermore, a simulation-free inference strategy ensures computational efficiency and scalability for large-scale fMRI datasets. Our model demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across diverse downstream applications, highlighting the potential of the SOC-based continuous-time representation learning framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 fMRI 自监督学习重写为随机最优控制 (Stochastic Optimal Control, SOC) 问题，将脑活动建模为连续时间隐动力学，通过优化对时间不规则性不敏感的控制策略学习表征，并在同一框架内统一 MAE 与 JEPA。该方法在多种下游任务上达到 state-of-the-art 表现。
Motivation: fMRI 数据来自异构源，时间不规则且含噪；现有 SSL 方法通过离散化或平均信号丢弃了关键的时间信息。
Method: 将 SSL 形式化为 SOC 问题：把脑活动表示为连续时间隐动力学，优化对时间不规则性保持不变 (agnostic) 的控制策略；SOC 框架统一 masked autoencoding (MAE) 与 joint-embedding prediction (JEPA) 以提取紧凑的控制导出表征，并采用免仿真 (simulation-free) 的推断策略以保证计算效率与大规模 fMRI 数据上的可扩展性。
Result: 在多种下游应用上取得 state-of-the-art 性能（摘要未列出具体数据集与指标数值）。
Conclusion: 基于 SOC 的连续时间表征学习能保留被离散化/平均抹掉的时间信息，是对不规则时间 fMRI 的有效 SSL 范式。

papers.title: Convergence Analysis of the Wasserstein Proximal Algorithm beyond Geodesic Convexity
papers.abstract_en: The proximal algorithm is a powerful tool to minimize nonlinear and nonsmooth functionals in a general metric space. Motivated by the recent progress in studying the training dynamics of the noisy gradient descent algorithm on two-layer neural networks in the mean-field regime, we provide in this paper a simple and self-contained analysis for the convergence of the general-purpose Wasserstein proximal algorithm without assuming geodesic convexity of the objective functional. Under a natural Wasserstein analog of the Euclidean Polyak-Łojasiewicz inequality, we establish that the proximal algorithm achieves an unbiased and linear convergence rate. Our convergence rate improves upon existing rates of the proximal algorithm for solving Wasserstein gradient flows under strong geodesic convexity. We also extend our analysis to the inexact proximal algorithm for geodesically semiconvex objectives. In our numerical experiments, proximal training demonstrates a faster convergence rate than the noisy gradient descent algorithm on mean-field neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在不假设目标泛函测地凸性的前提下，证明 Wasserstein 近端算法在 Wasserstein 版 Polyak-Łojasiewicz 不等式下达到无偏且线性的收敛速率，改进了强测地凸情形下已有的 Wasserstein 梯度流近端算法速率；数值实验中该近端训练在 mean-field 神经网络上比带噪梯度下降收敛更快。
Motivation: Wasserstein 空间上的近端算法通常依赖目标泛函的测地凸性才能给出收敛保证，而 mean-field 神经网络训练动力学中的目标泛函一般不满足该条件。
Method: 给出一般 Wasserstein 近端算法的自足收敛分析，用 Wasserstein 意义下的 Euclidean Polyak-Łojasiewicz 不等式替代测地凸性假设；并把分析推广到测地半凸 (geodesically semiconvex) 目标下的非精确 (inexact) 近端算法。
Result: 在 PL 型不等式下近端算法取得无偏线性收敛速率，优于既有强测地凸假设下 Wasserstein 梯度流近端算法的速率；数值实验中 mean-field 神经网络上近端训练的收敛速度快于 noisy gradient descent。
Conclusion: 测地凸性并非 Wasserstein 近端算法线性收敛的必要条件，PL 型不等式已足够，且该框架可处理非精确近端步与测地半凸目标。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Easier Said Than Done: Unpacking Intent-Behavior Gap in Jailbreaking LLM-Based Robots
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based robots use Large Language Models (LLMs) as planners to translate natural language instructions into policies such as grasp(), move_to(), and open_gripper(). Jailbreak attacks on these robots extend the threat from generating malicious content to executing harmful behaviors. However, we find that existing jailbreak attempts against LLM-based robots that produce malicious-looking policies (intent jailbreaks) often fail to induce harmful physical actions by robots (behavior jailbreaks), due to robot-specific constraints, such as logical errors and hallucinated control APIs. In this paper, we demystify the intent-behavior gap and investigate its root causes to inform effective defenses. Our measurement study finds that current LLM jailbreak methods overlook robot-specific syntax constraints (e.g., executable control APIs) and physical feasibility (e.g., ordering of policies and hardware/kinematic constraints). To bridge the gap, we introduce POEF (POlicy EFfective Jailbreak), an automated red-teaming framework that takes into account the robot-specific constraints during both the optimization and evaluation processes. Specifically, POEF employs the hidden-layer gradients from an unaligned LLM to guide the jailbreak prompt optimization and uses a multi-agent evaluator to assess the feasibility of the generated policies. Experiments on commercial robots, including the Unitree G1, the Franka robotic arm, and simulators, show that POEF achieves an 80% behavior jailbreak success rate and transfers across various LLMs. In addition, we propose two defense strategies that mitigate the behavior jailbreak risks. Our findings indicate an urgent need for stronger countermeasures before LLM-based robots are deployed at scale. The homepage is available at https://zjushine.github.io/poef.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 机器人越狱中「意图越狱成功但行为越狱失败」的 intent-behavior gap，提出自动化红队框架 POEF：用未对齐 LLM 的隐层梯度优化越狱提示，并用多智能体评估器判断策略的语法可执行性与物理可行性。在 Unitree G1、Franka 机械臂及仿真器上行为越狱成功率达 80%，且可跨多种 LLM 迁移。
Motivation: 现有针对 LLM 机器人的越狱方法只让模型生成看似恶意的策略（intent jailbreak），却因逻辑错误、幻觉控制 API 等机器人特有约束无法真正触发有害物理动作（behavior jailbreak），防御设计因此缺少准确的威胁刻画。
Method: POEF 在优化与评估两个环节都纳入机器人约束：以未对齐 LLM 的隐层梯度引导越狱提示优化，再用多智能体评估器（multi-agent evaluator）判断生成策略的可执行控制 API、策略顺序与硬件/运动学可行性；另提出两种缓解行为越狱风险的防御策略。
Result: 测量研究发现现有 LLM 越狱方法忽视机器人语法约束与物理可行性；POEF 在商用机器人 Unitree G1、Franka 机械臂及仿真器上达到 80% 行为越狱成功率，并可跨多种 LLM 迁移。
Conclusion: 意图越狱与行为越狱之间的鸿沟源于机器人特有的语法与物理约束，越狱优化必须同时把这些约束放进优化和评估；在更强对策出现前，LLM 机器人不宜大规模部署。
Relevance: 0
