papers.title: Right In-Place (RiP) Convolution: A Simple, General, and Near-Optimal Strategy for Memory-Efficient CNN Inference
papers.abstract_en: Activation memory, not compute, limits CNN inference on constrained hardware such as microcontrollers. Direct in-place convolution removes the dual-buffer cost, but the memory-optimal formulation of Gural and Murmann assumes valid padding, unit stride, unit dilation, and odd square kernels, and needs a non-sequential traversal costing $2\times$ inference time in transposes. We identify two regimes in which their published closed form does not hold: (1) an under-allocation of exactly $(k-1)C_{in} \bmod (C_{out}-C_{in})$ scalars, active on every convolutional layer of their own deployed network and manifesting as a silent corruption of still-live input; (2) an unbounded overestimate, up to $2{,}432\times$, once the critical leg leaves the output grid. We correct both and generalize to arbitrary stride, dilation, padding, and rectangular kernels. We then propose Right In-Place (RiP) convolution, a bit-identical operation in which every layer reads its input right-aligned in a shared workspace and writes its output left-aligned from index zero. The debt is piecewise affine in the output pixel index, so evaluating its breakpoints in $O(1)$ yields the minimum safe gap without enumerating the output grid, with row-major access preserved. Across $10{,}000$ random layers RiP produced no corruption, and across 84 convolutional layers from 25 architectures it matches the herringbone workspace exactly on 58 and within 5% on 81, using 24.8% less memory than dual buffering on average. Written into TinyEngine's kernels and deployed to a Raspberry Pi Pico 1 and Pico 2, it cuts peak activation memory across eleven MCUNet models by 12.5 to 33.3% at unchanged cycle counts and bit-identical outputs, raising the number of models that fit the Pico 1's 256 KB SRAM from six to nine.
papers.comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Global South in AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RiP 卷积让每层输入右对齐读入共享 workspace、输出从 0 左对齐写出，用 O(1) 求分段仿射断点得到最小安全间隔，保持 row-major 访问且输出 bit-identical。在 84 层/25 架构上 workspace 与 herringbone 完全一致 58 层、5% 以内 81 层，平均比双缓冲省 24.8% 内存；写入 TinyEngine 部署到 Pico 1/2 后，11 个 MCUNet 模型峰值激活内存降 12.5–33.3%，cycle 数不变，Pico 1 的 256 KB SRAM 能装下的模型从 6 个增至 9 个。
Motivation: MCU 上限制 CNN 推理的是激活内存而非算力；Gural–Murmann 的内存最优 in-place 卷积闭式解只在 valid padding、单位 stride/dilation、奇数方形核下成立，且需要非顺序遍历、带来 2× 转置开销。
Method: 先指出并修正原闭式解的两类失效：每层少分配 (k-1)C_in mod (C_out-C_in) 个标量导致仍存活输入被静默破坏，以及关键腿离开输出网格时高估可达 2,432×；再推广到任意 stride、dilation、padding 与矩形核。随后提出 RiP 卷积：输入右对齐、输出左对齐共享 workspace，债务关于输出像素下标分段仿射，O(1) 求断点即得最小安全间隔，并写入 TinyEngine kernel 部署到 Raspberry Pi Pico 1/2。
Result: 10,000 个随机层 RiP 无损坏；84 个卷积层/25 个架构中 58 层 workspace 与 herringbone 完全一致、81 层在 5% 以内，平均比双缓冲少用 24.8% 内存。部署到 Pico 1 与 Pico 2 后，11 个 MCUNet 模型峰值激活内存下降 12.5% 至 33.3%，cycle 数不变、输出 bit-identical，Pico 1 的 256 KB SRAM 可容纳模型数从 6 增至 9。
Conclusion: 修正后的内存下界加 RiP 的右对齐/左对齐布局，能在不牺牲 bit-identical 输出与 row-major 访问的前提下逼近内存最优，把 MCU 上能装下的模型数量直接抬高。

papers.title: Worse Together: How Performance Breaks Down in Multi-User Multi-Agent Teams
papers.abstract_en: People are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, and those agents are increasingly encountering other people's agents over shared resources such as a codebase, a calendar, or a budget. When each agent acts for a different user with different goals, coordination often fails, and the group ends up worse off than if a single agent had acted for everyone. We study this multi-user, multi-agent setting across five frontier models and 77 scenarios in four environments: an API key environment in which agents share a compute budget, a clinic in which they share a calendar, a personal assistant environment in which they share a group order or booking, and a merge queue in which they share a release cutoff. In each scenario, we compare a single agent that serves every user (a coordinator) to a team in which each agent serves one user, with and without a communication channel between the agents. Teams deliver worse group outcomes than the coordinator in every environment: without a channel, they completely collapse in two environments, and even with one, coordination overhead creates substantial gaps. For example, in the personal assistant environment, the coordinator fulfills a targeted user request about twice as often as teams. We identify distinct behaviors associated with this poor group-level performance, including stalling as teams grow, overriding each other's actions, and fabricating claims. We find effective but environment-specific mitigations, such as a team lead, explicit procedural instructions, and a platform check that makes an agent read its peers' messages before committing. We will release the API key, clinic, and personal assistant environments as MAMUBench, comprising 74 scenarios for evaluating multi-user, multi-agent coordination.
papers.comment: 63 pages, 22 Figures, 10 Tables, Code: https://github.com/safety-research/MAMUBench (will be released after review)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在共享资源的多用户多智能体场景中，每个用户各派一个 agent 的团队在全部四个环境里都比单一 coordinator 给出更差的群体结果：无通信通道时在两个环境中完全崩溃，即使有通道，协调开销仍造成明显差距；个人助理环境中 coordinator 满足目标请求的频率约为团队的两倍。作者建议用 team lead、明确流程指令、以及提交前先读同伴消息的平台检查这类环境特定缓解手段。
Motivation: 当每个 agent 代表不同用户、争夺同一份代码库、日历或预算等共享资源时，协调经常失败，群体结果反而不如单个 agent 代表所有人行动；这一多用户多智能体设定缺少系统评测。
Method: 在四个环境（共享算力预算的 API key、共享日历的 clinic、共享团购或预订的个人助理、共享发布截止时间的 merge queue）共 77 个场景、五个 frontier 模型上，对比服务所有用户的单一 coordinator 与每个 agent 服务一个用户的团队，团队分有/无 agent 间通信通道两种配置。
Result: 团队在每个环境中的群体结果都劣于 coordinator：无通道时在两个环境中完全崩溃，有通道时协调开销仍造成显著差距；个人助理环境中 coordinator 满足目标用户请求的频率约为团队的两倍。识别出的劣质行为包括随团队规模增大而 stalling、互相覆盖对方动作、以及编造说法 (fabricating claims)。
Conclusion: 多用户多智能体团队在共享资源下系统性劣于单一 coordinator，缓解手段（team lead、显式流程指令、提交前读同伴消息的平台检查）有效但依赖具体环境；作者将发布含 74 个场景的 MAMUBench（API key、clinic、个人助理三个环境）用于评测多用户多智能体协调。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Discrete Annotation, Continuous Preference: Rethinking Supervision for Accurate and Generalizable Aesthetic Image Cropping
papers.abstract_en: Aesthetic image cropping aims to identify the optimal crop of an image in terms of aesthetics and composition. While supervision based on annotated data is fundamental, the field has been hindered by a long-standing problem: existing datasets suffer from (1) human subjectivity and (2) rigid discreteness confined to fixed sampling grids. These flawed annotations not only limit the accuracy and generalization of trained models but also severely distort fair evaluation. To overcome this, we propose to model human cropping preference as a multi-peaked, continuous, and sharp field over the crop space. We introduce the Continuous Preference Field (CPF), which recovers a dense preference landscape from discrete annotations through (1) peak clustering, (2) off-lattice refinement, (3) negative shaping, and (4) field assembly. Based on this, we train CPIC, a VLM-based cropping model optimized via GRPO with the CPF reward, which overcomes template collapse, achieving state-of-the-art performance and exceptional out-of-domain generalization. Finally, to resolve the long-standing benchmark evaluation crisis, we introduce CPICD, a comprehensive recalibration of existing ground-truth boxes. By leveraging the CPF to correct grid-bound artifacts across mainstream benchmarks, CPICD establishes a rigorous and reliable foundation for future cropping research. Extensive experiments and user studies demonstrate the superiority of our CPF, CPIC, and CPICD. Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC.
papers.comment: Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 美学图像裁剪的标注既含主观性又被固定采样网格锁死，作者把人类裁剪偏好建模为裁剪空间上多峰、连续且尖锐的连续偏好场 (Continuous Preference Field, CPF)，用峰值聚类、离格细化、负样本塑形与场组装从离散标注恢复稠密偏好。基于 CPF 奖励以 GRPO 训练 VLM 裁剪模型 CPIC，克服模板坍缩并达到 SOTA 与强域外泛化；同时用 CPF 校正主流基准的网格伪影，产出重标定的 CPICD。
Motivation: 现有裁剪数据集存在人类主观性与固定采样网格导致的刚性离散两大缺陷，既限制模型精度与泛化，也严重扭曲评测的公平性。
Method: 提出 CPF：通过峰值聚类 (peak clustering)、离格细化 (off-lattice refinement)、负样本塑形 (negative shaping) 与场组装 (field assembly) 四步从离散标注恢复稠密偏好场；再以 CPF 为奖励用 GRPO 训练基于 VLM 的裁剪模型 CPIC；最后用 CPF 校正主流基准的真值框，得到 CPICD。
Result: CPIC 达到 state-of-the-art 并展现出色的域外泛化，且克服了模板坍缩 (template collapse)；CPF、CPIC、CPICD 三者均通过大量实验与用户研究验证其优越性。
Conclusion: 把离散裁剪标注重构为连续多峰偏好场，可同时改善裁剪模型的准确性、泛化能力与基准评测的可靠性，CPICD 为后续裁剪研究提供更严格的评测基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Task Mixtures to Specialized Experts
papers.abstract_en: In collaborative foundation model fine-tuning, client data is rarely homogeneous. Instead, clients typically possess unknown mixtures of distinct data distributions, or tasks. Conventional federated learning primarily addresses heterogeneity across clients without explicitly resolving latent task mixtures within each client. We study this setting as compound heterogeneity, where data is heterogeneous both across and within clients. We study adaptation over a common frozen representation and show that, when tasks share the same feature geometry, the optimal model for a client's task mixture under squared loss is a convex combination of the optimal models for its underlying tasks. Thus, a single locally trained model represents the client's overall task mixture, while individual inputs may be drawn from different underlying task distributions. This motivates routing inputs to specialized experts, and we show that, when the task optima form a simplex, task-aligned routing achieves lower risk than any single adapted model for genuinely mixed clients. With access to a small set of task-labeled public samples, we derive a convex program to recover task experts and match them to their corresponding tasks. Our routing analysis shows that effective specialization requires input-dependent expert selection aligned with each client's task mixture. Motivated by this analysis, we propose FedSEE. Across our experiments, FedSEE avoids the negative transfer observed in the evaluated baselines and improves performance by 2.9 points overall and 3.7 points for the worst-served quartile.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在联邦微调中把客户端内部的隐含任务混合 (compound heterogeneity) 显式拆开：当各任务共享同一特征几何时，平方损失下客户端混合任务的最优模型是各任务最优模型的凸组合，因此应按输入路由到专门专家而非让单一模型承担全部混合。基于此提出 FedSEE，用少量任务标注的公共样本经凸规划恢复任务专家并匹配任务，实验中避免了基线的负迁移，整体提升 2.9 分、最差四分位提升 3.7 分。
Motivation: 传统联邦学习只处理客户端之间的异构，不处理每个客户端内部的潜在任务混合；单一本地模型承担混合任务会产生负迁移。
Method: 在共同冻结表示上分析：证明平方损失下混合任务最优模型为各任务最优模型的凸组合，且当任务最优解构成单纯形时任务对齐路由的风险低于任何单一适配模型；再用少量任务标注公共样本推导凸规划恢复任务专家并匹配任务，据此提出 FedSEE 的输入依赖式专家选择。
Result: FedSEE 在所评估实验中避免了基线上的负迁移，整体性能提升 2.9 分，最差服务四分位 (worst-served quartile) 提升 3.7 分。
Conclusion: 有效 specialization 必须是与每个客户端任务混合对齐的输入依赖式专家选择，而不是每客户端一个模型；理论给出凸组合与单纯形条件下的路由风险优势。

papers.title: Query-efficient winner prediction in district-based elections
papers.abstract_en: In a district-based election, N voters are partitioned into k districts, and each voter votes for one of m candidates. Each district elects a winner using the plurality rule (i.e. the candidate getting the largest number of votes is declared the winner, breaking ties as per some fixed rule), and the overall winner is determined by applying plurality to the district winners; we assume that there is a unique winner amongst the district winners. The margin of victory of such an election is the minimum number of votes that must be altered so that the current winner ceases to be the unique district winner. We study the problem of predicting the winner of a district-based election in the query complexity model, where one has query access to individual votes. The objective is to minimise the number of queries. This setting captures exit polling, where queries correspond to interviewing voters, and is closely related to problems in query complexity and property testing. Assuming that the margin of victory of the election is at least eps N, Dey, Kar and Sanyal (AAMAS 2023) gave algorithms for the case of two candidates with error probability del and query complexity tilde{O}(1/eps^6 log^2 1/del), which improves to tilde{O}(1/eps^4 log^2 1/del) under the additional assumption that district populations are balanced. Our main result is an adaptive randomised algorithm that, for an arbitrary district-based election and any error parameter del, with probability at least 1-del, predicts the winner correctly using tilde{O}(1/eps^2 log m/del log 1/del) queries. In particular, we improve the bounds of Dey et al. for arbitrary district populations and extend their results to any number of candidates. Furthermore, for constantly many candidates, our algorithm nearly matches a lower bound of Omega(1/eps^2 log 1/del) on the query complexity that holds even for two candidates and a single district.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在选民按选区划分、各区与全国均按 plurality 计票的选举中，用查询复杂度模型做获胜者预测（对应 exit polling 的抽样访问）。假设胜差至少为 eps N，给出自适应随机算法，以至少 1-δ 的概率用约 Õ(1/ε²·log m/δ·log 1/δ) 次查询正确预测获胜者，优于 Dey 等 (AAMAS 2023) 的 Õ(1/ε⁶ log²1/δ)（平衡人口下 Õ(1/ε⁴ log²1/δ)），候选人数常数时接近 Ω(1/ε² log 1/δ) 下界。
Motivation: Dey、Kar、Sanyal (AAMAS 2023) 的选区选举获胜者预测只处理两个候选，且查询复杂度对胜差参数 ε 依赖高达 1/ε⁶（人口平衡时 1/ε⁴），任意人口分布与多候选情形未覆盖。
Method: 在查询复杂度模型中对单张选票做查询访问，以最小化查询数；给出一个自适应随机算法 (adaptive randomised algorithm)，在胜差 ≥ εN、错误参数 δ 下以概率 ≥1-δ 输出唯一区级获胜者，并与既有两候选算法及单选区两候选下界比较。
Result: 任意选区划分与任意候选数下查询复杂度为 Õ(1/ε²·log m/δ·log 1/δ)，以概率 ≥1-δ 预测正确；相较 Dey et al. 的 Õ(1/ε⁶ log²1/δ)（平衡人口 Õ(1/ε⁴ log²1/δ)）在任意人口下改进并推广到任意候选数；候选数为常数时接近 Ω(1/ε² log 1/δ) 下界，该下界对两候选单选区即成立。
Conclusion: 选区选举的获胜者预测在查询复杂度上可做到对 ε 依赖为 1/ε²，且对任意人口分布与多候选成立；常数候选时该上界几乎匹配下界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gestalt: Large Multimodal Interplay Model
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose Gestalt, a new paradigm of large multimodal model built around multimodal interplay. Despite rapid advances, large multimodal models are reaching a bottleneck: existing approaches focus primarily on accommodating additional modalities while overlooking the distinct characteristics of each modality and the relations among them. Motivated by the multistage property of human multisensory perception, we propose a multimodal interplay pyramid that organizes multimodal modeling as a progression from modality-specific processing, through cross-modal alignment, to deeper multimodal integration. Guided by this pyramid, Gestalt adopts a unified discrete diffusion framework and an interplay-partitioned architecture, with learnable interplay tokens mediating cross-modal exchange and integration. The pyramid also structures its data organization and training strategy. Strong performance across image generation, multimodal understanding, and text-only evaluation shows that Gestalt significantly improves cross-modal integration while preserving modality-specific information, effectively harnessing the strengths of diffusion-based multimodal models and offering a promising path toward unified multimodal intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Gestalt 提出以多模态交互为核心的统一多模态模型范式：用交互金字塔把建模分为模态内处理、跨模态对齐、多模态融合三级，配统一离散扩散框架与交互分区架构，可学习的 interplay token 负责跨模态交换。在图像生成、多模态理解与纯文本评测上均表现强劲，称在保留各模态特有信息的同时显著增强跨模态整合。
Motivation: 现有大模态模型主要在不断接入更多模态，却忽略各模态自身特性及其相互关系，导致跨模态整合遇到瓶颈。
Method: 以受人类多阶段多感觉知觉启发的 multimodal interplay pyramid 组织建模：从 modality-specific processing 经 cross-modal alignment 到深层 multimodal integration；据此采用统一离散扩散 (unified discrete diffusion) 框架与 interplay-partitioned 架构，用可学习 interplay token 中介跨模态交换与整合，金字塔同时约束数据组织与训练策略。
Result: 在图像生成、多模态理解与纯文本评测三类任务上均取得强劲表现，作者称显著改善跨模态整合并保留模态特有信息；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 以交互金字塔分层组织的离散扩散多模态模型，可同时兼顾跨模态整合与模态特有信息，是通向统一多模态智能的一条有前景路径。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Make Sparse Rewards Count: Density-Aware Reward Aggregation for Multi-Reward RL
papers.abstract_en: Multi-reward reinforcement learning trains large language models to satisfy multiple behavioral objectives simultaneously. Reward-wise normalization, as used in GDPO, preserves reward-specific relative information within rollout groups, but different objectives can still exhibit uneven learning progress. We study this behavior through advantage energy, the sum of a reward's squared advantages over a batch. Under idealized GDPO normalization, we show that this energy is proportional to active-group density: the fraction of rollout groups in which the reward provides nonzero relative advantages. This reveals a residual batch-level signal imbalance and provides a basis for calibrating reward contributions. Based on this relation, we propose Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA). We derive an inverse-square-root density correction that gives greater weight to signals from less frequently active rewards. DARA computes its weights from each rollout batch, adapting to changes in reward activity throughout training without modifying the underlying policy optimization objective. Experiments on tool calling and mathematical reasoning show that DARA learns the targeted behaviors faster than GDPO, reaching high format compliance in up to 26% fewer training steps on tool calling and near-saturated length compliance in up to 65% fewer steps on mathematical reasoning, while remaining competitive in final performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhaihaotian/DARA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多奖励 RL 中各目标的奖励激活密度不同会导致 batch 级信号失衡，DARA 用逆平方根密度校正给低激活奖励更大权重。在工具调用与数学推理上，DARA 达到高格式合规所需训练步数最多减少 26%，长度合规最多减少 65%。
Motivation: GDPO 的逐奖励归一化保留了组内相对信息，但不同目标的学习进度不均，batch 级信号仍失衡，稀疏奖励的贡献被低估。
Method: 提出 Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA)：定义 advantage energy（一个奖励在 batch 上平方优势之和），证明在理想 GDPO 归一化下它正比于 active-group density（奖励提供非零相对优势的 rollout 组比例），据此推导逆平方根密度校正，权重按每个 rollout batch 实时计算，不改动底层策略优化目标。
Result: 工具调用任务上达到高格式合规最多用 26% 更少训练步数；数学推理上长度合规接近饱和最多用 65% 更少步数；最终性能与 GDPO 相当。
Conclusion: 按奖励激活密度校准各奖励贡献，可在不改优化目标的前提下加快多奖励 RL 的目标行为学习，同时保持最终性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FORTE: Adaptive Scoring and Exact Keyframe Selection for Long-Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Query-aware keyframe selection enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process long videos using only a small set of question-relevant frames. Existing score-based methods, however, typically search within a fixed, uniformly sampled candidate pool, preventing evidence outside this pool from ever being selected. Given a limited relevance-scoring budget, the key challenge is to allocate evaluations adaptively to promising frames while continuing to explore underrepresented temporal regions. We introduce FORTE, a training-free framework that addresses this challenge through two stages: adaptive relevance scoring and global keyframe optimization. Starting from sparse, uniformly distributed observations, our efficient Gaussian-process relevance predictor estimates relevance for unscored frames, exploiting temporal locality and the approximately banded kernel structure to reduce the core computation from cubic to linear time in the number of frames for fixed bandwidth. The scoring stage then selects which frames to score next by balancing predicted relevance with temporal coverage, prioritizing promising regions while also exploring less-represented parts of the video. The optimization stage selects the final keyframes by maximizing an objective that jointly captures measured relevance and temporal coverage. We derive an exact algorithm that leverages the logarithmic coverage structure to identify the optimal subset of the scored candidate pool in time linear in the pool size, for a fixed final-frame budget. Experiments on four long-video question-answering benchmarks show that FORTE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the compared selectors under every tested scoring budget. Further evaluations demonstrate its consistent effectiveness across different relevance scorers and downstream MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FORTE 是面向长视频问答 (long-video QA) 的免训练关键帧选择框架：用高斯过程 (Gaussian-process) 相关性预测器在稀疏均匀采样后自适应决定下一步给哪些帧打分，兼顾预测相关性与时间覆盖，再用一个精确算法在已打分候选池中选出最优关键帧子集。在四个长视频问答基准上，FORTE 在所有测试打分预算下都取得所比较选择器中最高的平均准确率。
Motivation: 现有基于打分的关键帧方法只能在固定均匀采样候选池内搜索，池外证据永远选不出来；在有限打分预算下，需要把评估自适应分配给有希望的帧，同时继续探索时间上欠代表的区域。
Method: 两阶段免训练框架：自适应相关性打分阶段用高效高斯过程相关性预测器估计未打分帧的相关性，利用时间局部性与近似带状 (banded) 核结构，把固定带宽下的核心计算从关于帧数的三次降为线性；打分选择在预测相关性与时间覆盖间权衡。优化阶段最大化同时刻画实测相关性与时间覆盖的目标，并利用对数覆盖结构给出精确算法，在固定最终帧预算下以关于候选池大小线性时间找到最优子集。
Result: 在四个长视频问答基准上，FORTE 在每一档测试打分预算下都取得所比较选择器中最高的平均准确率；进一步评测显示其在不同相关性打分器与不同下游 MLLM 上均保持一致有效性。复杂度上，相关性预测核心计算由三次降为线性（固定带宽），最优子集搜索为关于候选池大小的线性时间（固定帧预算）。
Conclusion: 在有限打分预算下，把评估自适应分配给有希望的帧并同时保证时间覆盖，再配合精确的子集优化，能在长视频问答中稳定优于固定均匀候选池的选择器，且不依赖特定打分器或 MLLM。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Interpreting Reasoning of Large Language Models via Partial Information Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved substantial improvements in solving complex mathematical problems, but often produce lengthy, repetitive, or erroneous reasoning trajectories. In this work, we introduce a new interpretability framework, SLIDER, to evaluate the quality of the reasoning process. SLIDER leverages an emerging body of work from information theory called Partial Information Decomposition to disentangle the information about the final answer between two consecutive reasoning steps into non-negative components: unique information (in preceding steps or current step), redundant information, and synergistic information. Building on this decomposition, we propose the *Step-wise Repetitive Reasoning Index (Step-RRI)*, a theoretically grounded measure that assesses whether the answer-relevant information in the current step $S_i$ is predominantly redundant with the past steps $S_{<i}$, relative to its unique and synergistic contributions. To evaluate the effectiveness of Step-RRI in detecting repetitiveness, we apply SLIDER to the redundancy class of the PRMBench dataset where Step-RRI improves step-level redundancy identification accuracy by over $10$ points compared to embedding-similarity and information-gain baselines. Next, we define *Trajectory-RRI*, an aggregate measure of repetitiveness for an individual reasoning trajectory. To demonstrate its practical relevance, we show that average Trajectory-RRI strongly correlates with actual reasoning length across QwQ-32B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, and GPT-4.1, motivating its use as a signal for improving reasoning efficiency. Finally, we introduce *Trajectory-RRI-guided data selection for fine-tuning*, demonstrating that selecting training data based on Trajectory-RRI can improve a fine-tuned model's reasoning efficiency while largely preserving its task performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于部分信息分解 (Partial Information Decomposition) 的可解释性框架 SLIDER，把相邻两步推理中关于最终答案的信息拆成 unique、redundant、synergistic 三个非负分量，并据此定义 Step-RRI 与 Trajectory-RRI 度量推理重复性。在 PRMBench 冗余类上 Step-RRI 的步级冗余识别准确率比 embedding-similarity 与 information-gain 基线高出 10 个点以上；平均 Trajectory-RRI 与 QwQ-32B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B、GPT-4.1 的实际推理长度强相关，用它筛选微调数据可在基本保持任务性能的同时提升推理效率。
Motivation: 大型推理模型 (LRM) 解数学题时会产出冗长、重复或错误的推理轨迹，缺少一个理论上可依据的步级重复性度量来定位并削减这类冗余。
Method: SLIDER 用 PID 把当前步 S_i 相对前序步 S_{<i} 关于答案的信息分解为 unique、redundant、synergistic 分量；Step-RRI 判断当前步答案相关信息是否以冗余为主，Trajectory-RRI 聚合成整条轨迹的重复性，并进一步用于 Trajectory-RRI-guided data selection 做微调数据筛选。
Result: 在 PRMBench 数据集的 redundancy 类上，Step-RRI 的步级冗余识别准确率比 embedding-similarity 与 information-gain 基线提高 10 个点以上；平均 Trajectory-RRI 与 QwQ-32B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B、GPT-4.1 的实际推理长度强相关；按 Trajectory-RRI 选数据微调可提升推理效率且基本保持任务性能。
Conclusion: 推理重复性可以由 PID 分解出的冗余占比来度量，Trajectory-RRI 既反映轨迹长度，也可直接充当提升推理效率的数据筛选信号。

papers.title: Scaling Collider Event Generation with Residual-Quantized Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Full detector simulation and reconstruction of collider events are projected to become major bottlenecks at the High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider, motivating the development of fast, ML-based surrogates. At the same time, LLMs have driven fast progress in generative discrete modeling: autoregressive transformers trained on tokenized data now represent the state of the art across a range of generative tasks. We extend the discrete modeling paradigm by introducing a particle-level generative model trained on residual-quantized full-event data. We demonstrate the ability of this model family to perform conditional generation from detector-stable particles; we study its scaling behavior across a range of dataset and model sizes, characterize the effects of repeated data exposure and demonstrate that token-level loss systematically predicts downstream physical fidelity. These results provide an empirical framework for scalable collider full-event generation based on residual-quantized representations.
papers.comment: 10 pages + 11 pages of appendices, 12 figures, 10 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把对撞机整事例生成改写成残差量化 (residual-quantized) 离散 token 序列，用自回归 Transformer 做粒子级生成，可从探测器稳定粒子做条件生成。研究给出该模型族在数据集与模型规模上的 scaling 行为，并显示 token 级损失能系统性预测下游物理保真度。
Motivation: HL-LHC 上全探测器模拟与重建被预判为主要瓶颈，需要快速的 ML 替代模型；同时 LLM 已证明自回归离散生成在多类任务上是最先进范式，但尚未用于对撞机整事例的粒子级生成。
Method: 对粒子级整事例数据做残差量化得到离散 token，训练自回归 Transformer 生成该 token 序列；支持以探测器稳定粒子为条件的条件生成，并系统改变数据集与模型规模研究 scaling，考察重复数据暴露 (repeated data exposure) 的影响。
Result: 展示该模型族可从探测器稳定粒子执行条件生成；给出跨一系列数据集与模型规模的 scaling 行为刻画；表征重复数据暴露的效应；并证明 token 级损失能系统性预测下游物理保真度。
Conclusion: 残差量化表示加自回归离散建模可作为可扩展的对撞机整事例生成的经验框架，token 级损失可当作物理保真度的代理指标。

papers.title: Emergent Unfaithfulness: How Alignment Training Causes Language Models to Silently Override Task Faithfulness
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are characterized by three key properties: capability, alignment, and faithfulness. Prior work studies the tradeoffs between capability and alignment, and between capability and faithfulness, but a third tension remains underexplored: the alignment-faithfulness conflict. We show that aligned models systematically deviate from their inputs on unsafe or sensitive content without disclosing the modification, a failure mode we call alignment-induced unfaithfulness (AIU). Unlike capability-driven unfaithfulness, which comes from errors in knowledge or reasoning, this is induced by post-training mechanisms that override adherence to the input. We introduce FaithConflict, a controlled dataset isolating both conflicts, and two complementary taxonomies: behavioral (B1-B8) and chain-of-thought reasoning (C0-C6). Across models, AIU increases with scale and more sharply than capability-driven unfaithfulness, a reverse scaling law; intermediate checkpoints show it is amplified during post-training, with DPO the stage at which the gap both grows most and becomes least visible. Prompting-based mitigation does not resolve it, revealing a capability-alignment-faithfulness trilemma in the design and evaluation of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 alignment-induced unfaithfulness (AIU)：对齐后的模型在不安全或敏感内容上系统性偏离输入且不披露修改。AIU 随模型规模上升且比 capability-driven unfaithfulness 更陡（reverse scaling law），DPO 阶段差距扩大且最难察觉，prompting 缓解无效。
Motivation: 既有工作只考察 capability–alignment 与 capability–faithfulness 两组权衡，alignment–faithfulness 冲突这一第三组张力缺乏受控研究。
Method: 引入受控数据集 FaithConflict，隔离 alignment 与 capability 两类冲突；配套两套分类体系：行为层面 B1–B8 与思维链推理层面 C0–C6，跨模型比较 AIU 与 capability-driven unfaithfulness，并追踪中间 checkpoint 的 post-training 演化。
Result: AIU 随模型规模增大且比 capability-driven unfaithfulness 增长更陡，呈 reverse scaling law；中间 checkpoint 显示 AIU 在 post-training 中被放大，DPO 是差距增长最大且最不易被察觉的阶段；prompting-based mitigation 无法消除 AIU。
Conclusion: 对齐训练本身会压制对输入的忠实遵循，形成 capability–alignment–faithfulness 三难困境，LLM 设计与评测必须同时处理三者。

papers.title: Attention Kernels for Learning Maps Between Heavy-Tailed Measures
papers.abstract_en: Operator learning on probability measures can be accomplished with transformers. For measures with polynomial tails, the exponential weighting in softmax can make the corresponding measure-level attention integrals diverge. This motivates replacing the exponential with slower-growing functions. We construct two benchmarks for operator learning on measures with closed-form targets. We use these benchmarks to study attention kernel growth and data transformation in post-norm transformers. Without data transformation, the softmax models exhibit ensemble collapse on both heavy-tailed benchmarks, while the three slower-growing kernels avoid collapse. Symlog preprocessing allows softmax to avoid collapse on the matrix inverse task but not on the sheared swap task. On the Gaussian control, all four kernels perform similarly. We also examine how sample size affects the sensitivity of empirical energy and Wasserstein distances to tail differences. These results support slower-growing attention kernels as an effective design choice for post-norm transformers learning from heavy-tailed ensembles.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 17 figures, accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多项式尾分布上做算子学习时，softmax 的指数加权会让 measure 级 attention 积分发散，改用增长更慢的 attention kernel 可避免 ensemble collapse。在两个闭式目标的重尾基准上，三个慢增长 kernel 均不塌缩，而 softmax 无数据变换时在两个任务上都塌缩；symlog 预处理只在 matrix inverse 上救回 softmax，在 sheared swap 上仍塌缩；Gaussian 对照上四种 kernel 表现相当。
Motivation: 对概率测度做 operator learning 时，多项式尾会使 softmax 指数权重下的 attention 积分发散，post-norm transformer 因此在重尾 ensemble 上出现 ensemble collapse，需要判定 kernel 增长与数据变换各自的作用。
Method: 构造两个目标闭式的测度算子学习基准（matrix inverse 与 sheared swap），在 post-norm transformer 中对比 softmax 与三种增长更慢的 attention kernel，并测试 symlog 预处理；另设 Gaussian 对照，并考察样本量对经验 energy 与 Wasserstein 距离刻画尾部差异的敏感性影响。
Result: 无数据变换时 softmax 在两个重尾基准上均出现 ensemble collapse，三个慢增长 kernel 均避免塌缩；symlog 预处理使 softmax 在 matrix inverse 上避免塌缩但在 sheared swap 上不能；Gaussian 对照上四种 kernel 表现相近；并给出样本量对经验 energy 与 Wasserstein 距离尾部敏感性的影响。
Conclusion: 对从重尾 ensemble 学习的 post-norm transformer，采用增长更慢的 attention kernel 是有效设计选择，数据变换只能部分替代。

papers.title: Beyond Affine Transformations: A Soft Dominance Layer for Coordinate-Wise Neural Computation
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a preliminary study of an alternative to the affine transformation underlying conventional neural-network layers. In the proposed Soft Dominance Layer, each output unit compares input coordinates with a learnable reference vector and aggregates smooth inequality responses. A sigmoid relaxation makes the comparisons differentiable, while a sharpness parameter $α$ controls their transition toward hard threshold decisions. The aim is to examine the trainability and direct threshold interpretation of this primitive, not to claim a replacement for affine layers. In single-run MNIST experiments, the highest observed Soft Dominance accuracy is $0.9061$ without annealing and $0.9173$ with annealing, compared with $0.9827$ for the MLP baseline. These descriptive results do not establish reliable configuration rankings or a statistically supported annealing benefit. Learned reference vectors exhibit spatial structure, providing qualitative evidence of structured learning. Repeated-seed experiments and broader datasets are required to assess robustness and practical relevance beyond this proof of concept.

papers.title: Can LLMs Reason Over Long Horizons? An Empirical Evaluation of Context Strategies for Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal clinical reasoning requires large language models (LLMs) to identify and integrate relevant evidence distributed across extended patient histories. Although long-context models can process increasingly large amounts of information, providing more history does not necessarily make relevant evidence more accessible or improve reasoning. We compare five context strategies (Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, and Hybrid) on MedLoCoMo across four open-weight LLMs, examining answer correctness, robustness to query-evidence distance, and abstention on questions with unsupported premises. Episodic and Hybrid generally achieve the strongest overall accuracy, while Recent Context degrades most as supporting evidence becomes more distant; Episodic and Hybrid maintain the highest accuracy at long distances. Analysis of adversarial questions further shows that strong performance on answerable questions does not necessarily translate to successful abstention when the available history does not support the requested conclusion. These findings show that reliable longitudinal reasoning depends not only on how much history an LLM can access, but critically on how relevant evidence is selected and presented for reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MedLoCoMo 纵向临床推理基准上比较五种上下文策略（Full、Recent、Episodic、Semantic、Hybrid），Episodic 与 Hybrid 总体准确率最高，且在支撑证据距离变远时保持最高准确率；Recent 随证据变远退化最严重。对抗性问题上，可答问题的高准确率并不转化为对无支撑前提的正确弃答。
Motivation: 长上下文模型能装下更多病史，但堆更多历史并不让关键证据更易被检索到，纵向临床推理的可靠性取决于证据如何被选择与呈现。
Method: 在 MedLoCoMo 上对比五种上下文策略（Full、Recent、Episodic、Semantic、Hybrid），用四个 open-weight LLM，考察答案正确性、对 query-evidence 距离的鲁棒性，以及在前提无支撑问题上的弃答 (abstention) 表现，并分析对抗性问题。
Result: Episodic 与 Hybrid 总体准确率最强；Recent Context 随支撑证据距离变远退化最严重，而 Episodic 与 Hybrid 在长距离上保持最高准确率；对抗性问题显示可答问题上的强表现不必然带来对无支撑结论的正确弃答。
Conclusion: 纵向推理可靠性不只取决于 LLM 能访问多少历史，更关键在于相关证据如何被选择并呈现给推理过程。

papers.title: PhysVista: Benchmarking Physical Intelligence in VLMs via a Perception-Reasoning-Assessment Loop
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, yet whether they truly capture the physical consistency underlying real-world dynamics remains unclear. Existing benchmark paradigms often suffer from fragmented evaluation, focusing on isolated cognitive stages while overlooking the inherent synergy between perception, reasoning, and physical judgment. The lack of a holistic perspective limits the ability to diagnose whether VLMs can reliably evaluate the physical authenticity of emerging generative models. To address these issues, we introduce PhysVista, a benchmark designed to evaluate physical intelligence in VLMs through a closed cognitive loop framework inspired by the human seeing-reasoning-assessment process. PhysVista restores this loop by jointly evaluating physical state perception, physical dynamics reasoning, and physical plausibility assessment. It further distinguishes event-level reasoning and scale-level reasoning to enable fine-grained analysis of physical understanding. In addition, PhysVista incorporates both real-world and AI-generated videos, allowing evaluation across diverse domains and emerging generative scenarios. Extensive experiments across a diverse set of VLMs reveal substantial limitations in physical reasoning and plausibility assessment, highlighting a persistent gap between visual recognition and genuine physical understanding, and pointing toward more principled designs for physically grounded multimodal intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysVista 是一个把物理状态感知、物理动力学推理、物理合理性评估串成闭环的 VLM 物理智能基准，并区分事件级推理与尺度级推理，同时纳入真实视频与 AI 生成视频。在多种 VLM 上的实验显示其物理推理与合理性评估存在明显短板，视觉识别与真正物理理解之间存在持续差距。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 基准把感知、推理、物理判断割裂评测，无法诊断 VLM 能否可靠评估生成模型输出的物理真实性。
Method: 提出 PhysVista，仿照人类看-推理-评估的闭环认知框架，联合评测物理状态感知、物理动力学推理与物理合理性评估，并细分为事件级推理与尺度级推理；数据同时覆盖真实世界视频与 AI 生成视频，跨多种领域与生成场景。
Result: 在一组多样的 VLM 上的广泛实验揭示其在物理推理与合理性评估上的显著局限，视觉识别与真正物理理解之间存在持续差距。
Conclusion: VLM 的视觉识别能力尚未转化为可靠的物理理解，物理智能评测需要感知-推理-评估的闭环而非孤立阶段评测。

papers.title: Redundancy Meets Synergy: Dependency-aware Expert Selection for MoE via Submodular Optimization
papers.abstract_en: While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models effectively scale model capacity through sparse activation, their deployment is often bottlenecked by prohibitive memory requirements. Extracting a compact subset of experts presents a promising solution. However, existing expert selection heuristics predominantly rely on Top-k ranking, which isolates the evaluation of individual experts and ignores the intricate inter-expert dependencies introduced by the MoE gating network. In this paper, we propose DS-MoE, a theoretically grounded framework that redefines expert selection via difference-of-submodular (DS) optimization. By analyzing the second-order Taylor expansion of the loss degradation, we reveal functional duality within expert combinations: redundancy (where experts encode overlapping representations) and synergy (where experts provide complementary error cancellation). To navigate this duality, we mathematically decouple redundancy reduction from synergy maximization by formulating the selection objective as a DS function. Furthermore, we devise a tailored majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm with provable monotonicity guarantees to efficiently identify the optimal expert subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DS-MoE effectively preserves indispensable expert combinations, achieving superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DS-MoE 用差分次模 (difference-of-submodular, DS) 优化替代 Top-k 排序来做 MoE 专家子集压缩：由损失退化的二阶 Taylor 展开发现专家组合存在冗余与协同的对偶性，并把降冗余与最大化协同解耦成 DS 目标，用带单调性保证的 MM 算法求最优子集。实验显示该方法保住不可替代的专家组合，性能优于 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: MoE 稀疏激活扩容量但部署受显存限制，压缩专家子集是出路；现有 Top-k 排序启发式孤立评估单个专家，忽略 gating 网络引入的专家间依赖。
Method: 对损失退化做二阶 Taylor 展开，识别专家组合的冗余（表征重叠）与协同（互补误差抵消）对偶；将选择目标形式化为 DS 函数，解耦降冗余与最大化协同；设计带可证单调性的 majorization-minimization (MM) 算法求最优专家子集。
Result: 大量实验表明 DS-MoE 有效保留不可替代的专家组合，性能优于最先进基线（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 专家选择应建模专家间依赖而非逐个 Top-k 排序，DS 目标加 MM 求解可在压缩专家的同时保住组合性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: No One Architecture Fits All: A Cross-Environment Evaluation of Hierarchical Red Team Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous red team agents increasingly stress-test AI-enabled cyber defenses by planning strategy and executing multistage attacks. Reinforcement learning (RL) and large language models (LLMs) offer complementary mechanisms for the planning and execution such agents require, and prior work has combined them in hybrid hierarchies. Yet a given architecture is typically developed and evaluated within a single environment, leaving open whether an observed advantage reflects a generally stronger decision mechanism or merely alignment with a particular setting. We address this gap with a controlled cross-environment comparison of two homogeneous hierarchical red team architectures: an RL planner with an RL executor (RL+RL) and an LLM planner with an LLM executor (LLM+LLM). We evaluate both against expert autonomous defenders in CybORG CAGE-4 and in Cyberwheel at two network scales, across 18 configurations under one unified disruption metric. We find a pronounced environment-dependent inversion. RL+RL wins the compact, densely rewarded CAGE-4 (78.5% disruption success versus 18.0% for the strongest LLM configuration) and the 100-host Cyberwheel network (81.0% versus 50.5%), while a pretrained cybersecurity LLM agent wins the larger, escalation-gated 1010-host Cyberwheel network (55.0% versus 0.0% for RL). A kill-chain analysis explains the inversion through architecture-specific bottlenecks that aggregate success rates conceal.In the 1010-host Cyberwheel network, RL discovers and compromises hosts but stalls at privilege escalation, whereas in CAGE-4, LLM agents obtain privileged access but rarely convert it into operational impact. These results indicate that conclusions drawn in a single environment may not generalize, and that hybrid planner-executor designs should be motivated by specific failure modes rather than the assumption that one architecture is universally preferable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CybORG CAGE-4 与 Cyberwheel 两种网络规模、共 18 个配置下对比同构分层红队架构 RL+RL 与 LLM+LLM，发现优势随环境反转：紧凑且奖励密集的 CAGE-4 上 RL+RL 打断成功率 78.5% 对最强 LLM 配置 18.0%，100 主机 Cyberwheel 上 81.0% 对 50.5%，而 1010 主机、升级受门控的网络上预训练网络安全 LLM 取得 55.0% 对 RL 的 0.0%。作者主张混合 planner-executor 设计应由具体失败模式驱动，而非默认某一架构普遍更优。
Motivation: 红队智能体架构通常只在单一环境中开发与评测，观察到的优势无法区分是决策机制更强还是仅仅契合该设定，跨环境可推广性存疑。
Method: 受控对比两种同构分层架构——RL 规划 + RL 执行 (RL+RL) 与 LLM 规划 + LLM 执行 (LLM+LLM)，在 CybORG CAGE-4 和两种网络规模的 Cyberwheel 中对抗专家自主防御者，共 18 个配置，统一用一个 disruption 指标衡量，并做 kill-chain 分析定位架构特有瓶颈。
Result: CAGE-4 上 RL+RL 打断成功率 78.5% 对最强 LLM 配置 18.0%；100 主机 Cyberwheel 上 81.0% 对 50.5%；1010 主机 Cyberwheel 上预训练网络安全 LLM 55.0% 对 RL 0.0%。kill-chain 分析显示 1010 主机网络中 RL 能发现并攻陷主机却卡在权限提升，CAGE-4 中 LLM 智能体拿到特权访问却很少转化为作战影响。
Conclusion: 单一环境得出的架构结论不可外推；混合 planner-executor 设计应针对具体失败模式来选，而非假定某架构普遍更优。

papers.title: Evaluating Hybrid Quantum-Classical Models for Reduced-Order Brain Deformation Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate hybrid quantum-classical machine learning for the reduced-order prediction of spatiotemporal brain deformation fields. To mitigate the computational intractability of high-dimensional displacement fields, we employ Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) to project the data into a compact latent space. Within this framework, we formulate two distinct learning objectives: static temporal-to-latent regression and autoregressive latent state forecasting. We systematically benchmark compact classical baselines against both minimal and enhanced hybrid quantum architectures. Our results demonstrate that classical networks provide the strongest baselines in the present setting. For static regression, a classical POD-MLP outperforms all evaluated quantum variants, although an enhanced Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) substantially improves upon a minimal VQC baseline. For temporal forecasting, a classical POD-LSTM delivers superior predictive accuracy and statistical robustness compared to an enhanced Quantum LSTM (QLSTM) across varying history windows and random initializations. Overall, this study establishes reduced-order physical field learning as a rigorous testbed for near-term QML, highlighting that while hybrid enhancements successfully recover expressivity in weak quantum circuits, classical architectures retain a definitive advantage in both fidelity and stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 POD 降阶的脑形变时空场预测上系统对比混合量子-经典模型，结论是经典网络在当前设定下全面占优：静态回归中 POD-MLP 胜过全部量子变体，时序预报中 POD-LSTM 在不同历史窗口与随机初始化下都比增强版 Quantum LSTM 更准更稳。增强型 VQC 相对最小 VQC 有明显提升，说明混合增强确实能补回弱量子电路的表达力，但不足以翻盘。
Motivation: 高维位移场直接学习计算上不可行，需要降阶；同时近端量子机器学习 (near-term QML) 缺少在真实物理场预测任务上与强经典基线的严格对照。
Method: 先用 Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) 把位移场投影到紧凑潜空间，再设两类学习目标：静态的 time-to-latent 回归与自回归潜状态预报。对比紧凑经典基线（POD-MLP、POD-LSTM）与最小版和增强版混合量子架构（minimal/enhanced VQC、Quantum LSTM），并跨不同历史窗口与多次随机初始化做基准测试。
Result: 静态回归中 POD-MLP 优于所有被评估的量子变体，增强版 VQC 相对最小 VQC 有实质提升；时序预报中 POD-LSTM 在 varying history windows 和 random initializations 下相对增强版 QLSTM 具有更高的预测精度与统计稳健性。
Conclusion: 经典架构在保真度与稳定性上对混合量子模型保持明确优势；混合增强能恢复弱量子电路的表达力，而降阶物理场学习可作为近端 QML 的严格测试床。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Generative Modeling of Stochastic Dynamics for Long-Time Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Exact stochastic equations for non-equilibrium dynamics are rarely accessible. We show that the long-time evolution of stochastic dynamics can be predicted from configuration pairs at a fixed short time lag, without knowledge of the equation of motion. Generative diffusion models learn the finite-time transition kernel from these pairs, and iterating it propagates the dynamics far beyond the training lag. For two-dimensional Model B, the diffusive dynamics of a conserved order parameter, the learned kernels reproduce dynamic critical scaling and self-similar $t^{1/3}$ coarsening. Agreement with direct simulations persists on lattices twice the largest training size and for initial ensembles absent from training. For driven colloids in a periodic optical potential, ten minutes of measured trajectories suffice to predict the particle current and mean passage time over the next twenty minutes within experimental uncertainty. Short-time observations thus contain the information needed to predict emergent non-equilibrium dynamics at much longer times.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用生成式扩散模型从固定短时滞的构型对中学习有限时转移核，反复迭代该核即可在不知运动方程的情况下把随机动力学外推到远超训练时滞的长时间。二维 Model B 上复现动态临界标度与 t^{1/3} 自相似粗化，在两倍于最大训练尺寸的格点和训练未见的初始系综上仍与直接模拟一致；驱动胶体实验中仅用 10 分钟实测轨迹即可预测其后 20 分钟的粒子流与平均穿越时间，误差在实验不确定度内。
Motivation: 非平衡随机动力学的精确方程通常不可得，而长时间演化又不能靠短时观测直接外推；需要一种不依赖运动方程、只用短时滞数据的长时预测途径。
Method: 以固定短时滞的构型对为训练数据，用生成式扩散模型 (generative diffusion model) 学习有限时转移核，再通过迭代该核传播动力学；测试对象为守恒序参量扩散的二维 Model B 与周期光势中的驱动胶体。
Result: 二维 Model B 上学习到的核复现动态临界标度与 t^{1/3} 自相似粗化，且在两倍于最大训练尺寸的格点及训练中不存在的初始系综上仍与直接模拟吻合；驱动胶体中用 10 分钟实测轨迹预测其后 20 分钟的粒子流 (particle current) 与平均穿越时间 (mean passage time)，结果落在实验不确定度内。
Conclusion: 短时观测本身包含预测远长时间涌现非平衡动力学所需的信息，转移核式生成建模可绕开对方程的依赖完成长时外推。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Geometry-Dependent Bounds for Online Non-Monotone DR-Submodular Maximization
papers.abstract_en: We study adversarial online maximization of nonnegative, non-monotone DR-submodular functions over compact convex down-closed sets. A learner commits each action before observing its objective and competes with the best fixed action in hindsight. We prove a comparator-uniform first-order inequality that gives coefficient $4/9$, improving the online $0.401$ benchmark, with one gradient query and one projection per round and $O(\sqrt T)$ expected approximate regret. If $ζ{\bf 1} \in K\subseteq[0,1]^d$, the coefficient improves to $\underlineα(ζ)=\tfrac12-(1-2ζ)_+^2/[2(3-2ζ)^2]$. The proof is a direct ordered-coordinate argument with an objective-independent rational action. Conversely, a three-group symmetry-gap construction yields an offline oracle upper bound $β_*=0.470438681380894\ldots$ at $ζ=0$, even with exact value and full-gradient responses. A parameterized extension and exact finite-instance bounds define an upper function for every $ζ$. The lower and upper bounds match at $1/2$ for $ζ\ge1/2$, and show that the optimal deficit from $1/2$ is $Θ((1/2-ζ)^2)$ as $ζ\uparrow1/2$. For coefficient-revealed polynomials we obtain $1/2$ for quadratics and a geometry-dependent cubic coefficient starting at $8/17$, including $0.49$ at $ζ=1/5$. A constant objective sequence yields an offline $(4/9-\varepsilon)$ approximation with polynomially many first-order queries on the cube and projections, without requiring a supplied positive lower bound on the optimum. We also give nonanticipating adaptive-adversary and value-feedback guarantees, including $O(T^{3/4})$ regret with one noisy value per round.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在对抗性在线设定下最大化非负非单调 DR-submodular 函数，证明比较器一致的一阶不等式，得到 4/9 的近似系数（优于在线 0.401 基准），每轮仅需一次梯度查询与一次投影，期望近似遗憾为 O(√T)。当下界 ζ≥1/2 时上下界在 1/2 处吻合，且最优偏离量为 Θ((1/2-ζ)²)。
Motivation: 在线非单调 DR-submodular 最大化中，单梯度查询、单投影的算法所能达到的近似系数缺少与几何参数 ζ 相关的紧上下界，已有在线基准为 0.401。
Method: 证明比较器一致的一阶不等式，用有序坐标论证与与目标无关的有理性动作；对 ζ1∈K⊆[0,1]^d 给出系数 α(ζ)=1/2-(1-2ζ)₊²/[2(3-2ζ)²]；用三组对称性 gap 构造离线 oracle 上界，并给出参数化扩展与有限实例精确界。
Result: 在线系数 4/9（优于 0.401），每轮一次梯度查询与一次投影，期望近似遗憾 O(√T)；ζ=0 时离线 oracle 上界 β*=0.470438681380894…；上下界在 ζ≥1/2 时于 1/2 处吻合，最优偏离为 Θ((1/2-ζ)²)；系数已知多项式中二次函数得 1/2，三次从 8/17 起、ζ=1/5 时为 0.49；值反馈下遗憾 O(T^{3/4})。
Conclusion: 4/9 是单梯度单投影在线算法可证的系数，且 1/2 在 ζ≥1/2 时可达；几何参数 ζ 决定最优系数相对 1/2 的二次型亏损。

papers.title: Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window
papers.abstract_en: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Memorizon 让流式世界模型在重复到访同一地点时保持渲染一致：训练样本可覆盖任意长的时间跨度，但只在最后 k 个 chunk 上打分，每个被打分的 chunk 按相机共视 (co-visibility) 检索自己的 top-K latent，合并成大小上限为 kK 的共享 bank，序列长度因此不随跨度增长。相对滑动窗口基线，检索在每个 split 上都提升 revisit consistency，跨度长到能覆盖每次回访的首次到访再提升 24% 到 30%（代价是画质下降），更长则无益；跨度从 100 s 增到 400 s 只让单步时间增加 12%。
Motivation: 流式世界模型要跨重复到访监督一致性，样本需覆盖两次访问之间长达分钟的跨度，而全跨度稠密 attention 是二次代价，长跨度监督因此昂贵。
Method: 训练样本跨越任意长度但只在最后 k 个 chunk 上计分；被计分 chunk 不对历史做 tokenize，而是按相机共视检索各自 top-K latent，所有请求的并集构成共享 bank，容量上限 kK，最短跨度时退化为常规训练。加入 bank 只让单步成本一次性上升，之后跨度变长几乎不再增加开销。
Result: 跨度从 100 s 到 400 s 单步时间只增加 12%；相对滑动窗口基线，检索在每个 split 上都提高 revisit consistency，跨度长到能触及每次回访的首次到访时再增加 24% 到 30%，同时画质有一定损失，超过该跨度后继续加长不再有帮助；用另一 episode 填充 bank 会使 revisit correlation 下降 83%。
Conclusion: 监督需要长跨度而 attention 不需要，二者可以解耦：靠检索共享的 bounded bank 就能拿到长跨度监督的一致性收益，且模型确实在使用检索到的内容，跨度只需长到覆盖首次到访即可。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Random Recursive Models
papers.abstract_en: Recursive models create computational depth through parameter reuse, offering a parameter-efficient alternative to increasing model size. However, most recursive models repeatedly apply one learned transformation or a prescribed sequence of transformations, restricting computation to a fixed layer order. We introduce the Random Recursive Model (RRM), which maintains a pool of $L$ learned layers and performs $T$ recursive steps by sampling one layer independently with replacement for each example and step. This enables flexible layer reuse while retaining the parameter efficiency of recurrence. We evaluate RRM on challenging reasoning tasks, where it matches or exceeds the baselines, often with 50-75 % fewer parameters. RRM can vary its depth at inference, including beyond that seen during training, without retraining or adding parameters, improving tasks that benefit from deeper iterative computation. RRM also supports Monte Carlo inference and probabilistic test-time scaling, both of which improve performance without retraining. These insights may open new directions in neural network architecture design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Random Recursive Model (RRM)：维护 L 个可学习层池，每步按例独立有放回采样一层执行 T 次递归，从而在保留循环参数效率的同时让层复用顺序可变。在有挑战的推理任务上匹配或超过基线，参数量少 50–75%；推理深度可超出训练时所见而不重训不加参，Monte Carlo 推理与概率式 test-time scaling 均能进一步提升性能。
Motivation: 现有递归模型反复施加同一个学到的变换或固定变换序列，层序被写死，计算深度只能靠堆参数换，难以在推理时灵活加深。
Method: RRM 维护 L 个学习层组成的池，做 T 步递归时对每个样本、每一步独立有放回地采样一层来执行，实现层的灵活复用；推理阶段可改变深度，并支持 Monte Carlo 推理与概率式 test-time scaling，两者都不需重训。
Result: 在有挑战的推理任务上，RRM 匹配或超过基线，且常以少 50–75% 的参数量达成；推理深度可超出训练所见而不重训、不加参数，对受益于更深迭代计算的任务有提升；Monte Carlo 推理与概率式 test-time scaling 均在不重训的前提下改善性能。
Conclusion: 随机层采样让递归模型在参数量大幅缩减的同时保持竞争力，并把推理时加深与 test-time scaling 变成无需重训的免费能力，为网络架构设计提供了新方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: RRM 维护 L 个学习层组成的池，做 T 步递归时对每个样本、每一步独立有放回地采样一层来执行，实现层的灵活复用；推理阶段可改变深度，并支持 Monte Carlo 推理与概率式 test-time scaling，两者都不需重训。
summary_sections.result: 在有挑战的推理任务上，RRM 匹配或超过基线，且常以少 50–75% 的参数量达成；推理深度可超出训练所见而不重训、不加参数，对受益于更深迭代计算的任务有提升；Monte Carlo 推理与概率式 test-time scaling 均在不重训的前提下改善性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 随机层采样让递归模型在参数量大幅缩减的同时保持竞争力，并把推理时加深与 test-time scaling 变成无需重训的免费能力，为网络架构设计提供了新方向。

papers.title: Multi-agent Auditory Scene Analysis: Improved Localization Speed and Robustness by Multi-beamformed Speech Quality Feedback
papers.abstract_en: A real-time auditory scene analyzer (ASA) aims to carry out the tasks of locating, separating and classifying the sound sources present in a given acoustic environment. Recently, an effort has been made into modelling an ASA as a multi-agent system, with each one of its agents performing one of the aforementioned tasks and communicating their results to the rest of their peer agents. These communication routes are used as feedback loops to fix local errors at a global level, providing robustness while reducing local complexity. An example of the benefits of this approach is the optimization of speech quality by correcting in real-time the estimated location of the speech source of interest. However, their optimization speed has been shown to be considerably slow. One possible reason is that it solely relies on a series of single quality estimations (provided by a reference-free quality estimator model) that vary considerably from one window to the next, which results in a difficult search space to optimize. In this work, a new optimization mechanism is proposed that instead relies on a series of sets of quality estimations over a range of locations, providing a clearer view of the search space, simplifying its optimization. The proposed ASA now has a considerably smaller optimization time, is more accurate, and is more stable when being evaluated in real-life acoustic scenarios to correct higher levels of localization errors, all while being less complex than previous efforts. The only trade-off is that there is an increase in the response time of the quality estimation agent, but the complete ASA is still able to run in real-time. The performance shown in this work again shows the benefits of modelling an ASA as a multi-agent system.
papers.comment: Submitted to Autonomous Agents and Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把听觉场景分析 (ASA) 建成多智能体系统后，用多波束成形的语音质量反馈替代单点质量估计来实时修正声源定位：新机制在一组位置上批量给出质量估计，搜索空间更清晰。结果是优化时间明显缩短、精度与稳定性提升，能纠正更高等级的定位误差且整体复杂度更低，代价是质量估计智能体响应时间变长，但整套 ASA 仍可实时运行。
Motivation: 多智能体 ASA 靠质量反馈回路在全局修正局部定位误差，但其优化速度此前被证明相当慢，原因是只依赖参考无关质量估计器给出的单次估计、逐窗波动大，搜索空间难以优化。
Method: 提出新的优化机制：不再用单个质量估计，而是对一段位置范围给出成组的质量估计集合，从而更清楚地呈现搜索空间、简化优化；各智能体仍通过通信回路实时修正语音声源位置。
Result: 在真实声学场景评估中，优化时间显著减小，精度与稳定性提高，可纠正更高等级的定位误差，且整体复杂度低于此前工作；唯一权衡是质量估计智能体响应时间增加，完整 ASA 仍保持实时运行。
Conclusion: 以成组的多波束质量估计替代单点估计，能让多智能体 ASA 的定位修正又快又稳且更简单，实时性得以保留；这再次印证把 ASA 建模为多智能体系统的好处。

papers.title: Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Image Regression Models with Application to an Inertial Confinement Fusion Emulator
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification is critical in scientific machine learning, where black-box, image-based models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings. In many such applications, model outputs inform costly decisions, yet most methods provide only point estimates without quantifying predictive uncertainty. This challenge is compounded by the limited accessibility and interpretability of model internals, making it difficult to assess reliability across different regions of the input space. As a result, there is a growing need for methods that can provide input-dependent uncertainty estimates to guide both model development and downstream experimentation. To address this need, we propose Adaptive Conformal Prediction using Nearest Neighbors (ACPNN), an input-adaptive conformal framework for image regression. ACPNN leverages information from neighboring samples to produce locally adaptive uncertainty estimates while maintaining low computational cost. The neighborhood structure is defined using a scaled distance metric learned via a Gaussian Process with an automatic relevance determination (ARD) kernel. We demonstrate the effectiveness of ACPNN on a diffusion model for emulating inertial confinement fusion (ICF) simulations, showing that it achieves reliable and adaptive uncertainty quantification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ACPNN（Adaptive Conformal Prediction using Nearest Neighbors）：面向图像回归的输入自适应 conformal 预测框架，用带 ARD 核的 Gaussian Process 学习缩放距离度量来定义邻域，借邻居样本给出局部自适应的不确定性区间且计算开销低。在用于惯性约束聚变 (ICF) 仿真的 diffusion model emulator 上演示，得到可靠且随输入自适应的不确定性量化。
Motivation: 科学机器学习中基于图像的黑盒模型进入高风险决策场景，但多数方法只给点估计、不量化预测不确定性，模型内部又难以访问和解释，无法判断输入空间不同区域的可靠性。
Method: ACPNN 是面向图像回归的输入自适应 conformal 框架：邻域结构由缩放距离度量定义，该度量用带 automatic relevance determination (ARD) 核的 Gaussian Process 学习，再利用邻居样本构造局部自适应的不确定性估计，并保持低计算成本。
Result: 在用于 emulation ICF 仿真的 diffusion model 上演示 ACPNN，实现可靠且自适应的不确定性量化；摘要给出的是定性结论，无具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 借学习到的邻域结构做输入自适应 conformal 预测，可以在图像回归黑盒模型上给出随输入变化、计算代价低的预测不确定性区间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Science or Slop?: Benchmarking and Mitigating Scientific Slop in AI-Generated Papers
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated content, often called AI slop, is increasingly common everywhere, particularly in academia. Slop in AI-generated scientific papers, however, has more complex patterns that cannot be easily detected by existing token-based AI detectors. Each part of such a paper looks plausible while the scientific reasoning that connects the parts breaks down, which can mislead how readers assess the work. We benchmark these failures as scientific slop through six measures across Structure, Argument, and Artifacts. We construct SciSlopBench with 390 AI-generated papers, mostly in computer science but spanning the life, social, and natural sciences, each paired with a human-written paper matched by research problem and contribution type. Our measures identify the AI paper in each pair with 85.9% accuracy, compared with 68.7% for Binoculars. Higher scientific slop accompanies lower ICLR ratings and distinguishes rejected from accepted papers above chance in every year from 2017 to 2025. Reducing these patterns, however, is not as simple as directly optimizing the measures. We therefore propose SciSlopHarness, a harness-level framework that guides a fixed LLM to revise slop only where the experiment records support the change. While standard revisions leave residual slop and direct slop-aware prompting triggers reward hacking, SciSlopHarness reduces the remaining AI-human gap by 63% over the strongest revision baseline without requiring human reference targets. Overall, we demonstrate that AI-generated scientific papers leave fundamental traces in their global reasoning, and that responsible mitigation demands strict evidentiary grounding rather than mere prose refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SciSlopBench 用 Structure、Argument、Artifacts 三类共六项指标衡量 AI 生成论文中各部分看似合理但推理链断裂的 scientific slop，在 390 篇 AI 论文与配对人写论文上识别 AI 文达 85.9% 准确率（Binoculars 68.7%）。slop 越重 ICLR 评分越低，2017–2025 每年都能区分拒稿与录用；SciSlopHarness 只在实验记录支持处改写，把残余 AI-人差距比最强改写基线再降 63%。
Motivation: AI 生成论文的 slop 不体现在 token 层面，而是各部分看似合理、连接它们的科学推理却断裂，现有基于 token 的 AI 检测器难以捕捉，会误导读者对工作的判断。
Method: 提出六项覆盖 Structure、Argument、Artifacts 的度量，构建 SciSlopBench：390 篇 AI 生成论文（多为计算机科学，也涵盖生命、社会科学与自然科学），每篇配一篇研究问题与贡献类型相同的人写论文。缓解侧提出 SciSlopHarness，一个 harness 级框架，引导固定 LLM 仅在实验记录支持该修改处改写 slop。
Result: 六项度量在配对中识别 AI 论文的准确率为 85.9%，对比 Binoculars 的 68.7%；slop 越高 ICLR 评分越低，且在 2017 至 2025 每一年都能高于随机水平区分拒稿与录用论文。SciSlopHarness 相比最强改写基线把残余 AI-人差距减少 63%，且不需要人写参考目标；标准改写留下残余 slop，直接的 slop-aware prompting 触发 reward hacking。
Conclusion: AI 生成论文在其全局推理中留下根本性痕迹，负责任的缓解必须严格锚定实验证据，而非仅做文字润色。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ontology-Based Contextual AI Evaluations (OB-CAIE) Methodology
papers.abstract_en: The ontology-based contextual AI evaluation (OB-CAIE) methodology was developed to address a lack of scientific rigor that arises from unclear testing coverage, to balance human expertise and automations, and to address a lack of reproducibility of AI evaluation testing environments. OB-CAIE strengthens the current state of AI evaluations by addressing the first step in the scientific method by clearly defining what will be tested. Two ontologies represent the tractable problem space in the OB-CAIE methodology: the Domain-Specific Ontology (DSO) and the Evaluation Process Ontology (EPO). The DSO is the what; the EPO is the how. An OB-CAIE problem space can be used for one or multiple AI evaluations. The OB-CAIE methodology allows for human judgment at specific points, in scientifically grounded ways, and in complex subject areas where human feedback is genuinely irreducible or machine irreplaceable. A key advantage of the OB-CAIE methodology is that failure points can be traced, visualized and analyzed within the canonical OB-CAIE methodology problem space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OB-CAIE 用两个本体——领域本体 (DSO) 定义测什么、评估过程本体 (EPO) 定义怎么测——把 AI 评估的测试覆盖、人工判断点与失败点追溯统一到一个可复用的问题空间中，以解决测试覆盖不清与评估环境不可复现的问题。
Motivation: AI 评估缺乏科学严谨性：测试覆盖范围不清、人工与自动化难以平衡、评估测试环境不可复现。
Method: 构建 DSO（问题空间的 what）与 EPO（how）两个本体，一个 OB-CAIE 问题空间可服务一次或多次 AI 评估；在人工反馈不可替代的环节保留有科学依据的人工判断点，失败点可在该问题空间内被追溯、可视化与分析。
Result: 提出 OB-CAIE 方法论本身，含 DSO 与 EPO 两个本体、可复用问题空间、以及失败点追溯与可视化能力；论文为 17 页、2 图。
Conclusion: 把评估的 what 与 how 显式本体化，可先明确测什么再谈结果，从而支撑可复现的 AI 评估并让失败点可追溯。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rules Amortize, Pairings Don't: Linguistic Structure Determines What Latent Task Representations Can Replace In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) can be amortized into latent objects (task vectors, function vectors, context vectors) that recover few-shot behavior at zero-shot inference cost, but recent theory shows a static vector acts as a single synthetic demonstration and must fail on high-rank mappings such as word-level bijections. We ask a linguistic version of this question: which linguistic operations can be amortized out of the prompt? We train a 2.6M-parameter network that reads the geometry of a few-shot support set (centroid, principal subspace, spectrum, computed once and cached) and produces an input-conditioned additive update to the query's residual stream at a mid-depth layer of a frozen GPT-2-large/XL. Across eight inflectional directions and one lexical relation, under a canonical split that bars inverted-pair leakage between directions, three regimes emerge. On forward inflection, where 10-shot ICL is strong (0.67-0.89) and extracted task vectors collapse (<=0.06), the transform matches ICL at strictly zero-shot per-query cost. On lemmatization directions, which frozen GPT-2 can execute but 10 demonstrations systematically fail to convey (ICL 0.13-0.48 at 1.5B), the transform is not capped by ICL at all: it reaches 0.78-0.92, up to +72 points over ICL (past to present: 0.85 vs. 0.13). On arbitrary pairings (antonymy) every amortizer plateaus near half of ICL at every scale, capacity, and seed tested. Controls show the support manifold acts as a causally necessary task fingerprint: wrong-task manifolds collapse accuracy to <=0.06, query-only variants cannot disambiguate tasks sharing an input space, and leave-one-task-out transfer is zero. Productive rules amortize into latent task representations, sometimes better than prompting can convey them; memorized pairings do not.
papers.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models (LP4FM). 5 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文检验哪些语言操作能被摊销 (amortize) 进潜任务表示：训练一个 2.6M 参数网络读取 few-shot 支持集几何（质心、主子空间、谱），对冻结 GPT-2-large/XL 中层残差流做输入条件的加性更新。屈折正向变换上该变换以严格零样本成本追平 10-shot ICL（0.67–0.89），词形还原上反超 ICL 至多 72 个百分点（0.78–0.92），而反义词这类记忆配对在所有规模、容量、种子下都停在 ICL 的约一半。
Motivation: ICL 可被摊销成静态任务向量，但理论显示静态向量等价于单条合成示例，在高秩映射上必然失败；本文改问语言学版本：哪些语言操作能从 prompt 中摊销出去。
Method: 训练 2.6M 参数网络，输入为 few-shot 支持集的几何量（质心、主子空间、谱，算一次即缓存），输出对冻结 GPT-2-large/XL 中层残差流的输入条件加性更新；在八个屈折方向加一个词汇关系上评测，采用禁止方向间倒置对泄漏的 canonical split，并做错误任务流形、query-only 变体与 leave-one-task-out 迁移对照。
Result: 正向屈折上 10-shot ICL 为 0.67–0.89 而抽取的任务向量塌到 ≤0.06，该变换以零样本成本追平 ICL；词形还原方向上冻结 GPT-2 能执行但 10 条示例无法传达（1.5B 下 ICL 0.13–0.48），变换达 0.78–0.92，最多高出 ICL 72 个百分点（过去时到现时：0.85 vs 0.13）；反义词配对上所有摊销器停在 ICL 的约一半。错误任务流形使精度塌到 ≤0.06，query-only 变体无法区分共享输入空间的任务，leave-one-task-out 迁移为零。
Conclusion: 可产出的规则能摊销进潜任务表示，有时还优于 prompt 所能传达的效果；记忆性配对不能，支持集流形是因果上必要的任务指纹。

papers.title: Same Scene, Different Task: Skill Alignment for Compositional Generalization in VLAs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often struggle to generalize to skill combinations absent from their fine-tuning demonstrations, even when every constituent skill has been demonstrated. We focus on a vision shortcut as one failure mode: during fine-tuning, visual observations can serve as a proxy for the instruction, so a policy may execute a demonstrated combination associated with similar observations rather than the instructed combination. This motivates training with counterfactual pairs formed by holding a demonstration observation fixed while changing the instruction to specify an undemonstrated combination. These pairs, however, lack corresponding demonstrated action targets. Crucially, the currently required skill has already been demonstrated, but actions from those executions cannot serve as direct targets because the same skill can require different actions across observations. We propose CRAFT, which transfers supervision from demonstrated executions of the required skill to counterfactual pairs using skill representations that can be reused across executions of the same skill. Across three VLA models and two simulation benchmarks, CRAFT improves success on undemonstrated combinations while maintaining high success on demonstrated ones; it also improves compositional generalization on a real robot. Project website: https://taegeunyang.github.io/craft/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRAFT 针对 VLA 在未演示技能组合上的组合泛化失败，把视觉捷径归因于观测可替代指令，用固定观测、改指令构造反事实对，并通过可跨执行复用的技能表征把已演示执行的监督迁移过去。在三个 VLA 模型与两个仿真基准上，未演示组合的成功率提升且已演示组合保持高成功率，并在真实机器人上改善组合泛化。
Motivation: VLA 微调时视觉观测会充当指令的代理，策略于是执行与相似观测关联的已演示组合而非指令指定的组合，导致每个技能都见过、组合却没见过时失败。
Method: 构造反事实对：固定演示观测、改写指令以指定未演示组合；这些对缺少动作目标，CRAFT 用可跨同一技能不同执行复用的技能表征，把已演示执行的监督迁移到反事实对上。
Result: 在三个 VLA 模型和两个仿真基准上，未演示组合成功率提升，同时已演示组合保持高成功率；组合泛化在真实机器人上也得到改善。
Conclusion: 视觉捷径是组合泛化失败的一个可修复来源：用技能表征迁移监督即可在不牺牲已演示技能的前提下覆盖未演示组合。

papers.title: SimplexUQ: An Evaluation Framework and Benchmark for Conformal Uncertainty on Simplex-Valued Predictions
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage, but a single calibration threshold can still spread that coverage unevenly, over-covering easy regions and under-covering hard ones. SimplexUQ is, to our knowledge, the first benchmark and reproducible protocol for measuring this allocation problem on simplex-valued predictions; it compares existing conformal wrappers rather than proposing a new one. Its task suite, SimplexTasks-12, combines six controlled synthetic regimes with six frozen-predictor real tasks spanning class probabilities, topic mixtures, spectral abundances, cell-type fractions, age distributions, and emotion mixtures. Each comparison fixes the predictor, score, and response-free stratification map, varies only the wrapper, and reports marginal coverage, worst-stratum coverage, max disparity, and within-task radius and compute. Global calibration can look valid while failing badly: on CIFAR-10 it attains 0.900 marginal coverage but only 0.542 in the worst entropy stratum, and Mondrian calibration raises that stratum to 0.886 while reducing max disparity from 0.358 to 0.022. No wrapper dominates, however. Under smooth synthetic heterogeneity, several repairs are competitive; fixed-map analyses show that rankings depend on the evaluation groups and protocol; and in a 12-task comparison, Mondrian has lower disparity on its single target partition for all 12 tasks, whereas BatchMVP has lower disparity over overlapping groups on five. These are empirical comparisons, not new coverage guarantees. A controlled predictor-bias sweep shows that removing predictor bias only partly reduces global-threshold disparity. We release task cards, result provenance, permitted derived arrays, and rebuild instructions, and treat wrapper selection as a diagnostic comparison rather than a universal ranking.
papers.comment: Preprint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/liangyou03/SimplexUQ and https://huggingface.co/datasets/liangyou03/SimplexTasks-12-data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimplexUQ 是首个针对 simplex 值预测的 conformal 不确定性分配评测基准与可复现协议，只比较现有 conformal wrapper 而不提出新方法。全局校准可表面达标却在困难分层严重欠覆盖：CIFAR-10 上边际覆盖 0.900，但最差熵分层仅 0.542；Mondrian 校准把该分层提到 0.886，max disparity 从 0.358 降到 0.022。没有单一 wrapper 普遍占优，作者据此把 wrapper 选择当作诊断性比较而非普适排名。
Motivation: Conformal prediction 只保证边际覆盖，单一校准阈值会把覆盖不均地摊到各区域——容易区过覆盖、困难区欠覆盖；对 simplex 值预测（类别概率、主题混合、光谱丰度等）这一分配问题此前缺少统一的测量基准与可复现协议。
Method: 构建任务套件 SimplexTasks-12：六个受控合成 regime 加六个冻结预测器的真实任务（类别概率、主题混合、光谱丰度、细胞类型比例、年龄分布、情绪混合）。每次比较固定预测器、评分与 response-free 分层映射，只改 wrapper，报告边际覆盖、最差分层覆盖、max disparity、任务内半径与计算量；另做受控的 predictor-bias 扫描。
Result: CIFAR-10 上全局校准边际覆盖 0.900，最差熵分层仅 0.542；Mondrian 把该分层提到 0.886，max disparity 从 0.358 降到 0.022。12 任务对比中，Mondrian 在其单一目标划分上 12/12 任务 disparity 更低，BatchMVP 在重叠分组上 5 个任务 disparity 更低；平滑合成异质性下多种修复方案竞争力相当。移除 predictor bias 只能部分降低全局阈值的 disparity。
Conclusion: 全局校准的边际有效性可能掩盖严重的分层欠覆盖，wrapper 排名依赖于评测分组与协议，因此 wrapper 选择应作为诊断性比较而非普适排名；这些是经验比较，不构成新的覆盖保证。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: One-Step Generative Modeling via Training Dynamics Action
papers.abstract_en: One-step generative models construct a static generator through iterative training-time transport. Existing transport objectives primarily assess distributional motion, although a neural generator needs to realize the requested sample displacements jointly through shared parameter updates. The training-time construction raises the question: \emph{once training becomes the iterative process that constructs the final one-step map, what to optimize: the next distributional move, or the route by which the finite generator learns the final map?} To address the question, we introduce \textbf{T}raining \textbf{D}ynamics \textbf{A}ction (\textbf{TDAction}), which selects transport targets according to local shared-parameter realization cost while retaining a prescribed level of distributional progress. We formulate the cost as a soft-terminal control problem and derive a closed-form Batch Tangent Action-to-Go value that accounts for parameter effort and terminal mismatch. The criterion captures cross-sample interactions omitted by independent pairwise costs; under isotropic mobility, the criterion agrees with quadratic Euclidean assignment for deterministic balanced couplings. Randomized tangent probes provide a low-rank implementation that constructs shared detached targets without adding an inference-time trajectory. Controlled studies examine the relationship between generator geometry, transport selection, and realized local action. On ImageNet $256\times256$, TDAction attains an FID below $1.1$ without distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TDAction 把一步生成模型的训练本身当作构造最终映射的迭代过程，按共享参数实现成本选择传输目标，同时保持给定的分布推进量。该成本被写成软终端控制问题，导出闭式 Batch Tangent Action-to-Go 值，兼顾参数努力与终端失配，并用随机 tangent 探针做低秩实现。在 ImageNet 256×256 上，TDAction 不用蒸馏即达到 FID 低于 1.1。
Motivation: 现有传输目标只评估分布层面的移动，而神经生成器必须通过共享参数更新联合实现样本位移，忽略了跨样本相互作用与参数实现代价。
Method: 提出 Training Dynamics Action (TDAction)：按局部共享参数实现成本选择传输目标并保留规定的分布推进量；将成本表述为软终端控制问题，推导闭式 Batch Tangent Action-to-Go 值（含参数努力与终端失配）；在各向同性 mobility 下该准则与确定性平衡耦合的二次 Euclidean assignment 一致；用随机 tangent 探针构造共享的 detached 目标，实现为低秩形式且不引入推理期轨迹。
Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，TDAction 不经蒸馏达到 FID 低于 1.1；另有受控研究考察生成器几何、传输选择与实现的局部 action 之间的关系。
Conclusion: 一步生成模型的训练目标应同时计入分布推进与共享参数的实现成本，按该准则选传输目标可在无蒸馏条件下把 FID 压到 1.1 以下。

papers.title: Fractional Laplace Neural Operators: Exact Architectures, an Expressivity Frontier at Criticality, and Certified Stability for Memory-Driven Network Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators learn maps between function spaces, while hereditary network dynamics are described by Volterra resolvents with non-rational Laplace symbols. We introduce a fractional Laplace neural operator (fLNO) that embeds this structure in the learned map. For commuting excitation--Laplacian pairs, one block graph-spectral layer represents the full linear Volterra solution operator exactly. We establish an expressivity frontier for finite rational realizations: they approximate fractional memory geometrically on compact frequency windows, but cannot reproduce the non-integer critical asymptotics generated by a branch point, and on the half-line the best rational rate is root-exponential. The same theory yields trainable parametrizations that enforce a prescribed stability margin by construction, and a graphon-transfer theorem separates genuine operator consistency from parameter sharing. In a common-data benchmark, positive rational operators can match or exceed fLNO accuracy on finite horizons, whereas in controlled near-critical experiments fLNO recovers the branching coordinate more faithfully with far fewer parameters; unconstrained rational fits can cross the stability boundary, while certified parametrizations cannot. A four-parameter spectral law transfers without retraining from graphs of size 48 to 192 with 0.51--0.62% relative error. Applications to Chilean aftershock sequences and to renewal models for Chile and 21 Italian regions illustrate structured inference with explicit uncertainty. The contribution is an operator-learning architecture in which exact memory structure, physical coordinates and stability guarantees coexist with competitive accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分数阶 Laplace 神经算子 (fLNO)，把 Volterra 预解的非有理 Laplace 符号直接嵌入学习到的算子：在交换的激发–Laplacian 对下，单个 graph-spectral block 即可精确表示整条线性 Volterra 解算子。有限阶有理逼近在紧频率窗上只能几何收敛、无法复现分支点产生的非整数临界渐近，半直线上最优有理速率仅为根指数；fLNO 在受控近临界实验中以远少参数更忠实地恢复分支坐标，且其参数化按构造保证稳定裕度，而无约束有理拟合可能越过稳定边界。四参数谱律免重训从 48 节点图迁移到 192 节点，相对误差 0.51–0.62%。
Motivation: 记忆驱动的网络动力学由非有理 Laplace 符号的 Volterra 预解描述，而常规神经算子与有限阶有理实现无法表达分支点带来的非整数临界渐近，且无约束拟合可能失去稳定性。
Method: fLNO 把分数阶 Laplace 结构嵌入学习映射：对交换的激发–Laplacian 对，用单个 graph-spectral 层精确表示线性 Volterra 解算子；理论部分给出有限有理实现的表达力前沿与半直线上根指数最优速率，并导出按构造强制给定稳定裕度的可训练参数化，以及区分真正算子一致性与参数共享的 graphon-transfer 定理。
Result: 共同数据基准上，正有理算子在有限时域上可匹敌或超过 fLNO 精度；受控近临界实验中 fLNO 以远少参数更忠实地恢复分支坐标，无约束有理拟合会越过稳定边界而认证参数化不会。四参数谱律从 48 节点图免重训迁移到 192 节点，相对误差 0.51–0.62%。应用于智利余震序列与智利及意大利 21 个区域的更新模型 (renewal models)，给出带显式不确定性的结构化推断。
Conclusion: 把精确记忆结构、物理坐标与稳定性保证放进同一算子学习架构，可以在保持竞争力精度的同时提供可认证的稳定与迁移；有理实现在有限时域精度上仍有竞争力，但无法跨越临界渐近这一表达力前沿。
Relevance: 34

summary_sections.tldr: 提出分数阶 Laplace 神经算子 (fLNO)，把 Volterra 预解的非有理 Laplace 符号直接嵌入学习到的算子：在交换的激发–Laplacian 对下，单个 graph-spectral block 即可精确表示整条线性 Volterra 解算子。有限阶有理逼近在紧频率窗上只能几何收敛、无法复现分支点产生的非整数临界渐近，半直线上最优有理速率仅为根指数；fLNO 在受控近临界实验中以远少参数更忠实地恢复分支坐标，且其参数化按构造保证稳定裕度，而无约束有理拟合可能越过稳定边界。四参数谱律免重训从 48 节点图迁移到 192 节点，相对误差 0.51–0.62%。

papers.title: Before Agents Decide: Epistemic Action in LLM-Based Systems
papers.abstract_en: Before a difficult decision, people often act simply to understand the situation better. We turn an object to see another side, place alternatives next to each other, or change one condition and observe what happens. These actions may not complete the task, but they improve the evidence needed for the next choice. LLM-based agents can search and explore, yet agent design gives less attention to an earlier question: is the available evidence ready for the decision? Sometimes necessary evidence is missing. In other cases, the evidence is present but its form hides what matters, or the comparison needed to judge it does not yet exist. Cognitive science calls actions that improve the basis for a later choice epistemic actions. We bring this idea to LLM-based agents and distinguish three modes: acquiring missing evidence, transforming available evidence, and probing a system to create a revealing response. We use the term epistemic scaffolding for the interfaces, tools, and environments that make these actions possible and auditable. This paper argues that agent design must address how decision-ready evidence is produced.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory (FAST) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把认知科学中的 epistemic action（为改善后续选择依据而做的动作）引入 LLM agent，区分三种模式：获取缺失证据、变换已有证据、探测系统以产生有揭示性的响应，并提出 epistemic scaffolding 指支撑这些动作且可审计的接口、工具与环境。核心论断是 agent 设计必须先回答证据是否已为决策就绪，再谈决策本身。
Motivation: LLM agent 已能搜索与探索，但设计上缺少一个前置问题：当前证据是否足以支撑决策——证据缺失、形式掩盖关键信息、或判断所需的比较尚不存在时，直接决策会失败。
Method: 以认知科学的 epistemic action 概念为框架，把 agent 的前置动作形式化为三类模式（获取、变换、探测），并定义 epistemic scaffolding 作为使这些动作可执行且可审计的接口、工具与环境；本文为立场/理论论文（FAST Workshop, NeurIPS 2026）。
Result: 给出三模式分类与 epistemic scaffolding 概念的论证性结果：证据不足的三种形态（缺失、形式掩盖、比较缺失）分别对应获取、变换、探测三类动作；摘要未含实验数字。
Conclusion: agent 设计必须把「如何生产决策就绪的证据」作为一等公民问题，而非只优化决策与执行环节。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Denoising Surface: Modeling and Predicting Inference Cost for Diffusion LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: As diffusion large language models (dLLMs) become more capable, they are moving from research settings to real-world \textit{serving}, where request management (such as scheduling and resource allocation) relies on accurate estimation of per-request inference cost. However, common cost proxies fall short for dLLMs: output length ignores that one forward pass can unmask multiple tokens, and denoising-step count ignores the \textit{heterogeneous} per-step costs. We observe that the block-autoregressive generation mechanism induces a two-dimensional execution structure over output blocks and within-block denoising steps, whereas these proxies collapse it into a scalar, discarding information essential for characterizing the cost. Motivated by this insight, we propose the Denoising Workload Surface (DWS), which preserves this two-dimensional block-step structure as a probability surface to weight the heterogeneous per-step costs. We then design a coarse-to-fine training scheme that enables a lightweight prompt-only predictor to accurately predict the complex DWS. This predictor runs efficiently even on a single CPU core, avoiding GPU contention with the serving model. Since DWS decouples request-dependent execution behavior from deployment-specific cost factors, the predictor transfers across hardware configurations without retraining. In \textit{real-world} serving experiments, DWS reduces cost-prediction error by up to $2.50\times$ over scalar-based predictors, while the DWS-guided shortest-job-first scheduler reduces end-to-end latency by up to $1.92\times$ for online chatbots.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 diffusion LLM (dLLM) 在线服务中请求级推理成本估计不准的问题，提出 Denoising Workload Surface (DWS)，把 block-autoregressive 生成的输出块×块内去噪步二维执行结构保留为概率面，用它加权异构的每步成本，再用 coarse-to-fine 训练得到只吃 prompt 的轻量预测器。真实服务实验中 DWS 将成本预测误差最多降低 2.50×，DWS 引导的 shortest-job-first 调度把在线聊天机器人的端到端延迟最多降低 1.92×。
Motivation: dLLM 从研究走向真实 serving，调度与资源分配依赖准确的单请求推理成本估计；但输出长度忽略一次 forward 可解码多个 token，去噪步数忽略每步成本异构，两者都把二维执行结构压成标量而丢失关键信息。
Method: 提出 Denoising Workload Surface (DWS)，以概率面形式保留输出块与块内去噪步的二维结构来加权异构每步成本；再设计 coarse-to-fine 训练方案，训练一个轻量 prompt-only 预测器预测 DWS，该预测器可在单 CPU 核上运行以避免与服务模型争用 GPU；由于 DWS 解耦请求相关执行行为与部署相关成本因子，预测器跨硬件配置迁移无需重训练。
Result: 在真实 serving 实验中，DWS 相比基于标量的预测器将成本预测误差最多降低 2.50×；DWS 引导的 shortest-job-first 调度器把在线聊天机器人端到端延迟最多降低 1.92×。
Conclusion: 把 dLLM 成本建模为保留 block-step 二维结构的概率面而非标量代理，可在不占 GPU 的前提下支撑更准的请求级成本预测与调度，且预测器可跨硬件复用。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Heteroskedastic Canonical Polyadic Tensor Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: When minimizing the squared-error loss, the popular CP decomposition can be interpreted as parameter inference in a Gaussian model with a low-rank mean tensor and constant variance across the tensor entries. We introduce heteroskedastic-CP (HCP), which models entrywise variability with a non-constant, low-rank precision tensor, and develop an alternating block-coordinate ascent method to recover both the low-rank mean and precision tensors from noisy observations. Our procedure is computationally competitive, with the same leading-order factor-update complexity as CP-ALS. We demonstrate HCP on synthetic experiments and an EEG application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 CP 分解重新解释为低秩均值、方差恒定的高斯参数推断后，提出 heteroskedastic-CP (HCP)：用低秩精度张量逐条目建模异方差，并用交替块坐标上升同时恢复均值与精度张量。其主导阶因子更新复杂度与 CP-ALS 相同，在合成实验与 EEG 应用上演示。
Motivation: 平方误差下的标准 CP 分解等价于假设张量每个条目方差恒定的高斯模型，无法表示观测噪声随条目变化的异方差数据。
Method: HCP 用低秩精度张量 (precision tensor) 建模逐条目方差，配一个低秩均值张量；求解用交替块坐标上升 (alternating block-coordinate ascent) 同时恢复两个张量，因子更新的主导阶复杂度与 CP-ALS 一致。
Result: 在合成实验与 EEG 应用上演示 HCP；计算开销与 CP-ALS 具有相同的主导阶因子更新复杂度。
Conclusion: 把异方差显式建模为低秩精度张量，可以在不增加主导阶计算成本的前提下扩展 CP 分解的噪声模型。
