papers.title: Gumbel Straight Flow: Distilling Autoregressive Models into One-step Flow Maps
papers.abstract_en: We present Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF), a continuous flow map language model that leverages the noise-data coupling of a pretrained autoregressive language (AR) model. We theoretically demonstrate that the coupling between Gumbel noise and one-hot token sequences induced by an autoregressive model yields non-intersecting linear paths connecting the noise to the sequence representations. To further enhance high-quality few-step path sampling, we use a flow map semigroup objective where the tangent (velocity) condition is guided directly by the AR teacher. Across various benchmarks, including pretraining and downstream tasks, GSF can outperform current few-step language generation baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF) 把预训练自回归 (AR) 语言模型蒸馏成单步 flow map：利用 AR 诱导的 Gumbel 噪声与 one-hot token 序列耦合，理论上得到连接噪声与序列表示的不相交直线路径，并用 AR 教师直接引导切向速度条件的 flow map 半群目标做少步采样。在预训练与下游任务等多个基准上，GSF 超越当前少步语言生成基线。
Motivation: 少步/单步生成式语言模型的路径质量受限：从噪声到序列表示的路径若相交，少步采样难以保证质量，且缺少来自教师模型的直接引导。
Method: GSF 是连续 flow map 语言模型，复用预训练 AR 模型的 noise-data coupling；理论部分证明 AR 诱导的 Gumbel 噪声与 one-hot token 序列之间的耦合产生不相交的线性路径；训练用 flow map semigroup objective，其切向（速度）条件由 AR 教师直接引导，以支持高质量少步路径采样。
Result: 在包括预训练与下游任务在内的多个基准上，GSF 超越当前少步语言生成 (few-step language generation) 基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 借助 AR 教师的 Gumbel 耦合与半群目标，连续 flow map 可以被蒸馏成在少步设置下更强的语言生成模型。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Score the Update, Not the Token: Descent-Aligned Routing for Combinatorial LoRA Experts
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-LoRA-experts methods raise the capacity of low-rank adaptation by routing each token to a few low-rank experts. Nearly all of them tie one input-side factor to one output-side factor per expert, and nearly all of them route by scoring the token: the router picks experts without seeing what any of them would write. We argue that the router should score the update. To first order, adding an expert's update to a layer output lowers the loss by the inner product between that update and the negative loss gradient at the output. This usefulness is quadratic in the token, so a router that is linear in the token sees only the part of it that runs through the token mean, and routers that rank experts by the norm of their own activations never see the output factor. If each expert is split into a reader (down-projection) and a writer (up-projection), the usefulness of every reader--writer pair becomes an inner product in the shared rank-$r$ space, and all $N_AN_B$ pairs can be scored from $N_A+N_B$ vectors. We build VANE on this identity. A low-rank compass predicts the descent direction of each token. VANE scores every pair by the alignment between its update and the compass without forming any update, activates the top-$k$ pairs with additive gates, and gives every pair its exact first-order router gradient. On single-domain commonsense reasoning and a four-domain multi-task mixture with Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, VANE attains the best average among twelve PEFT and MoE-LoRA baselines, by 0.9--1.1 and 1.3--1.5 points respectively, with less than half the trainable parameters of an 8-expert MoE-LoRA. Its router scores also track the measured usefulness of experts far more closely than token routers do.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VANE 把 MoE-LoRA 的路由对象从 token 换成更新本身：用一个低秩 compass 预测每个 token 的下降方向，按各 reader–writer 对的更新与该方向的对齐度打分，再以加性门控激活 top-k 对。在 Llama-3.2-3B 与 Llama-3.1-8B 的单域常识推理和四域多任务混合上，VANE 在 12 个 PEFT 与 MoE-LoRA 基线中取得最佳平均，分别领先 0.9–1.1 与 1.3–1.5 分，可训练参数不到 8-expert MoE-LoRA 的一半。
Motivation: 现有 MoE-LoRA 路由按 token 打分，看不到各专家实际会写出什么更新；而一阶上专家更新对损失的降低量是更新与负损失梯度的内积，对 token 是二次的，线性 token 路由和按激活范数排序的路由都会漏掉输出因子。
Method: 把每个专家拆成 reader（down-projection）与 writer（up-projection），使所有 N_A×N_B 对的有用性化为共享 rank-r 空间中的内积，只需 N_A+N_B 个向量即可全部打分。低秩 compass 预测每个 token 的下降方向，VANE 据此对每对打分而不实际构造更新，用加性门控激活 top-k 对，并给每对精确的一阶路由梯度。
Result: 在单域常识推理上，VANE 在 12 个 PEFT 与 MoE-LoRA 基线中平均最优，领先 0.9–1.1 分；在四域多任务混合上领先 1.3–1.5 分，两者均基于 Llama-3.2-3B 与 Llama-3.1-8B。可训练参数少于 8-expert MoE-LoRA 的一半，其路由分数与实测专家有用性的吻合度显著高于 token 路由。

papers.title: EurekaBench: Measuring Agentic Ability to Discover New Scientific Insights
papers.abstract_en: When Isaac Newton discovered the law of gravitation, he did so through an iterative process of analyzing observed data such as planetary patterns, finding the underlying mechanisms by describing patterns in mathematical equations, and refining his theory against the Moon's orbit, revealing the startling insight that the same force governs both falling apples and orbiting planets. Would it be possible for AI agents to make similar discoveries? To measure this ability, we introduce EurekaBench, a cross-domain benchmark that tests AI agents' ability to conduct long-horizon experiments and discover mechanisms that explain observations. We evaluate these mechanisms by the scientific insights that can be derived from them. EurekaBench contains an expert-verified set of 26 long-horizon tasks across neuroscience, computer science, chemistry, astrophysics, geophysics, and plasma physics, with a total of 306 scientific insights that the discovered mechanisms are expected to support. Our evaluation framework tests three axes of scientific discovery: agents' ability to follow known scientific constraints, the predictive accuracy of the discovered mechanisms, and whether these mechanisms yield scientific insights or inform future research. Our results show that current AI agents often overly fixate on predictive accuracy optimization, surpassing human scientists, while falling substantially short in deriving scientific insights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EurekaBench 是一个跨领域基准，用 26 个长程实验任务和 306 条专家核验的科学洞见，衡量 AI agent 能否像牛顿那样从数据中发现解释观测的机制，并按机制所支持的洞见来打分。结果显示当前 agent 在预测精度上常过度优化、甚至超过人类科学家，但在推导科学洞见上差距明显。
Motivation: 现有 agent 评测多停留在预测精度，无法衡量 agent 能否完成长程实验、发现机制并从中提炼可解释的科学洞见，而这才是科学发现能力的核心。
Method: 构建专家核验的 EurekaBench，含 26 个跨 neuroscience、computer science、chemistry、astrophysics、geophysics、plasma physics 的长程任务，共 306 条机制应支持的科学洞见；评测框架沿三条轴打分：遵循已知科学约束、发现机制的预测精度、机制能否产出洞见或指导后续研究。
Result: 基准含 26 个长程任务、306 条科学洞见，覆盖六个领域；评测显示当前 AI agent 在预测精度上常过度优化并超过人类科学家，但在推导科学洞见方面大幅落后。
Conclusion: 当前 AI agent 的短板不在拟合预测，而在于从发现的机制中推导科学洞见，评测应把洞见产出与预测精度分开衡量。

papers.title: ScaffoldM3C: A Multimodal Sequential Monte Carlo Framework for Generative Stable Construction Planning
papers.abstract_en: Autonomously constructing physically realizable 3D structures remains a significant challenge due to combinatorial action spaces, interchangeable components, equifinal assembly sequences, and strict stability requirements during construction. State-of-the-art methods fine-tune large language models for text-based generative construction. However, these approaches do not allow for Multimodal (text, image, sketch) conditioning, overlook the practical role of scaffolding for stabilizing intermediate structures, and suffer from slow inference speeds. Therefore, we formulate construction as a probabilistic next-block generation task with multiple potential assembly actions and multiple potential task conditioning modalities. Concurrently, we explicitly consider the utility of scaffolding by introducing an auxiliary scaffold block token. We present Scaffold Multimodal Monte Carlo (ScaffoldM3C), a multimodal, lightweight, auto-regressive model for stable block-based construction, that proposes a set of next-step candidate blocks. Leveraging these candidates, we utilize Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to maintain a population of possible assembly sequences, allowing us to consider multiple, potentially different, assembly directions simultaneously. We train our multimodal architecture by extending the StableText2Brick dataset to contain image conditioning prompts and scaffold-stabilized build sequences. ScaffoldM3C is 4x smaller than competing baselines, yielding a 5x to 20x speedup during inference, while achieving comparable construction quality to state-of-the-art methods and higher overall stability. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through simulations and real-world robot assembly demonstrations.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics and Learning (T-RL) and is currently under review. Project Page: https://stanfordmsl.github.io/ScaffoldM3C/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ScaffoldM3C 把 3D 结构建造建模为带多模态条件（文本、图像、草图）的下一积木块概率生成任务，用自回归轻量模型给出候选块，再用 Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) 维持装配序列种群并行探索多条装配方向，同时引入辅助 scaffold block token 显式建模脚手架对中间结构的稳定作用。在扩展的 StableText2Brick 数据集（加入图像条件 prompt 与脚手架稳定序列）上训练，模型比竞争基线小 4 倍、推理加速 5–20 倍，建造质量与 SOTA 相当且整体稳定性更高，并通过仿真与真实机器人装配演示验证。
Motivation: 现有方法用微调 LLM 做文本生成式建造，不支持多模态条件、忽略脚手架稳定中间结构的实际作用，且推理慢。
Method: 将建造表述为概率性下一积木块生成（多个候选装配动作、多种任务条件模态），自回归轻量多模态模型提出候选块集合，SMC 维护装配序列种群同时考虑多条可能不同的装配方向；引入辅助 scaffold block token 表征脚手架效用。训练数据为扩展的 StableText2Brick，新增图像条件 prompt 与脚手架稳定建造序列。
Result: ScaffoldM3C 比竞争基线小 4 倍，推理加速 5–20 倍，建造质量与 SOTA 方法相当且整体稳定性更高；效果通过仿真与真实机器人装配演示展示。
Conclusion: 多模态条件生成加 SMC 序列搜索、并显式建模脚手架，可以在更小模型和更快推理下实现可物理实现且更稳定的块结构建造。

papers.title: PixelDense: Dense Prediction as Representation Alignment for Pixel Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Representation alignment (REPA) accelerates diffusion transformer training, but its alignment targets are almost exclusively semantic encoders such as DINOv2 and CLIP. Recent analysis points to spatial structure, not global semantics, as the carrier of the alignment effect, yet dense-prediction foundation models trained to predict that structure remain overlooked as REPA targets. In pixel-space diffusion, SAM2, Depth Anything v2, and Metric3D v2 each outperform the DINOv2-only GenEval baseline, with the two geometric teachers leading the segmentation teacher. A flat sum of all four teachers, however, lands below the best single geometric teacher, as semantic and geometric gradients compete for one denoiser projection. We introduce PixelDense, which routes DINOv2 and SAM2 through a semantic projection stream, routes Depth Anything v2 and Metric3D v2 through a geometric projection stream, and adds a weight-space orthogonality penalty that keeps the two streams in disjoint subspaces. All four teachers are frozen during training and dropped at inference. Applied to PixelGen and DeCo with a single recipe, PixelDense improves GenEval, DPG-Bench, and HPS v2.1, raises PixelGen-XXL's GenEval Overall from 0.7927 to 0.8093, and beats every single-teacher and unfactored multi-teacher variant. In partial-noise reconstruction, independent panoptic, depth, and surface-normal probes show up to 53.1% PQ gain and 36.0% depth AbsRel reduction at $τ=0.5$ across COCO and Flickr30K. From random initialization, PixelDense also reaches the baseline's peak GenEval 1.23x faster. In SDEdit editing on PIE-Bench, PixelDense keeps more of the source background and layout at every edit strength, raising background PSNR by up to 2.2 dB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PixelDense 把 REPA 的对齐目标从语义编码器扩展到稠密预测模型：DINOv2 与 SAM2 走语义投影流，Depth Anything v2 与 Metric3D v2 走几何投影流，再加权重空间正交惩罚让两流占据不相交子空间。四教师全部冻结、推理时丢弃，PixelGen-XXL 的 GenEval Overall 从 0.7927 升到 0.8093，且比所有单教师与未分解多教师变体都好，达到基线峰值 GenEval 快 1.23 倍。
Motivation: REPA 的对齐目标几乎只有 DINOv2、CLIP 这类语义编码器，而近期分析指出起作用的是空间结构而非全局语义；稠密预测基础模型能预测这种结构却被忽视。直接把四个教师平铺相加会因语义与几何梯度争夺同一个 denoiser 投影而低于最好的单个几何教师。
Method: PixelDense 设计双投影流：语义流接 DINOv2 与 SAM2，几何流接 Depth Anything v2 与 Metric3D v2，并施加权重空间正交惩罚 (weight-space orthogonality penalty) 约束两流落在不相交子空间。四个教师训练全程冻结、推理时移除，同一套 recipe 同时用于 PixelGen 与 DeCo。
Result: 在 PixelGen 与 DeCo 上统一提升 GenEval、DPG-Bench 与 HPS v2.1；PixelGen-XXL 的 GenEval Overall 由 0.7927 升至 0.8093，超过全部单教师与未分解多教师变体。部分噪声重建下，COCO 与 Flickr30K 上的 panoptic、depth、surface-normal 探针在 τ=0.5 时最高获得 53.1% PQ 提升与 36.0% depth AbsRel 下降；从随机初始化达到基线峰值 GenEval 快 1.23 倍；PIE-Bench SDEdit 编辑中背景 PSNR 最多提高 2.2 dB。
Conclusion: 把 REPA 的对齐目标换成稠密预测教师并按语义/几何分投影流加正交约束，能在像素空间扩散上同时加快训练、提高生成评测分数并保留更强的可探测空间结构。

papers.title: AIR-LLM: Broadcasting AI Weights over Radio for Memory-Free Edge LLM Inference via RF Computing
papers.abstract_en: Next-generation large language models (LLMs) are expanding from the cloud to ubiquitous edge devices. However, edge devices typically either lack the memory to store increasingly large LLM weights or, even with enough memory, spend unaffordable energy on loading the weights. This raises our question: can an edge device run an LLM without storing or loading its weights, but receive them over the air and consume them on the fly? Inspired by wireless broadcasting, we present AIR-LLM, an LLM inference architecture for edge devices, which is composed of: (i) a central radio (e.g., 5G base stations) that broadcasts the LLM weights into the air, and (ii) the edge user that receives the weights and completes the general matrix-vector multiplication (GEMV) of LLM inference directly in the radio frequency (RF) domain using RF mixers. To further shorten the airtime, AIR-LLM exploits MIMO spatial multiplexing and proposes an energy-efficient precoder-postcoder pair on the edge to calibrate its own wireless channel. Since the central radio stays user-unaware, AIR-LLM is user-scalable so that one broadcast serves unlimited users within its coverage. We implement AIR-LLM on the NVIDIA Sionna ray-traced channels of two real-world urban scenes and the profiling of a real RF mixer. With a WikiText-2 perplexity degradation of 4.0% on LLaMA-3.1-8B, AIR-LLM saves the energy by 157.7x/40.4x against the FP16 and weight-only quantization baselines; with 20 users, its airtime is 104.1x/26.0x shorter, respectively.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 12 figures, 6 tables. Appendix: 12 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIR-LLM 让边缘设备不存不加载 LLM 权重，由基站广播权重、边缘用 RF mixer 在射频域直接完成 GEMV 推理，并用 MIMO 空分复用加 precoder-postcoder 对自校准信道。在 NVIDIA Sionna 两个真实城市场景的射线追踪信道与真实 RF mixer profiling 上，LLaMA-3.1-8B 的 WikiText-2 perplexity 仅退化 4.0%，能耗比 FP16/仅权重量化基线省 157.7x/40.4x，20 用户时空口缩短 104.1x/26.0x。
Motivation: 边缘设备要么没有足够内存存放不断增大的 LLM 权重，要么即便有内存也要为加载权重付出难以承受的能耗。
Method: 中心电台（如 5G 基站）无线广播 LLM 权重，边缘用户用 RF mixer 在射频域直接完成推理所需的 GEMV；为缩短空口时间，引入 MIMO 空分复用并提出边缘侧 energy-efficient precoder-postcoder 对来校准自身信道。中心电台不感知用户，一次广播可服务覆盖内无限用户。
Result: 在 NVIDIA Sionna 射线追踪的两个真实城市场景与真实 RF mixer profiling 上实现：LLaMA-3.1-8B 的 WikiText-2 perplexity 退化 4.0%；能耗相对 FP16 与仅权重量化基线分别节省 157.7x 与 40.4x；20 用户时空口时间分别缩短 104.1x 与 26.0x。
Conclusion: 把权重分发与 GEMV 计算都搬到无线广播和射频域，可以在几乎不损失模型质量的前提下让边缘设备免存储、免加载地跑 LLM，并因中心电台 user-unaware 而天然用户可扩展。

papers.title: PACT: End-to-End Learning of Human Pose, Contacts, and Forces from Video
papers.abstract_en: Human motion, environmental contacts, and interaction forces are governed by common physical laws, yet existing approaches typically separate visual pose reconstruction from contact and force estimation. This separation limits joint reasoning and can propagate errors between stages. We introduce PACT, an end-to-end model that jointly learns to estimate human pose, contacts and contact forces from monocular video. Our approach augments a human reconstruction foundation model with learnable contact-force tokens and a temporal transformer that integrates visual features with world-space motion. Joint prediction heads refine human poses and estimate contacts and forces, while physics-based supervision encourages consistency between the reconstructed motion and interaction forces. To address the scarcity of force annotations, we develop a data annotation pipeline that combines contact labeling with physics-based motion and force optimization, producing training supervision from synthetic and real-world videos. We also introduce a real-world climbing benchmark ForceWall with climbing videos and corresponding ground-truth contact forces obtained from the force sensors. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art contact and force estimation, outperforming staged reconstruction approaches and generalizing to interactions beyond the training distribution. These results support end-to-end joint learning as an effective approach to recovering human motion and physical interactions from video.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACT 把人体姿态、接触与接触力从分阶段流程合并为单目视频端到端联合估计：在人体重建基础模型上加可学习的 contact-force token 与时序 transformer，用物理一致性监督约束重建运动与交互力。在自建的真实攀岩基准 ForceWall（力传感器提供接触力真值）上达到 SOTA 的接触与力估计，优于分阶段重建方法并泛化到训练分布之外的交互。
Motivation: 现有方法把视觉姿态重建与接触、力估计拆成两段，阶段间误差会向后传播，且力标注稀缺使力估计难以训练。
Method: 在人体重建基础模型上引入可学习的 contact-force token 与时序 transformer，融合视觉特征与世界坐标系运动；联合预测头同时细化姿态并估计接触与力，物理监督约束重建运动与交互力一致。数据侧用结合接触标注与基于物理的运动/力优化的标注管线，从合成与真实视频生成监督。
Result: 实验展示 SOTA 的接触与力估计，优于分阶段重建方法，并泛化到训练分布之外的交互；评测使用新提出的 ForceWall 真实攀岩基准，其接触力真值来自力传感器。
Conclusion: 端到端联合学习是从视频恢复人体运动与物理交互的有效路径，可替代先重建再估计力的分阶段方案。

papers.title: Frozen Scenes, Shifting Winners: Configuration Fragility in Text-to-3D Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Can a text-to-3D leaderboard change when every generated scene stays fixed? We audit this question for rendered-image evaluation, where camera settings and caption wording become part of the measurement protocol. Across 300 frozen scenes from six generators, we vary eight render and caption factors for 19 alignment evaluators plus one perceptual-quality control, then test four targeted scene degradations. Peak configuration variance exceeds between-generator variance for 17/19 alignment evaluators, with prompt-bootstrap lower bounds above 1 for 11/19. Rankings are more stable than scores, yet 18/19 evaluators change their point-estimate winner under some configuration. Pairwise protocol margin envelopes show which comparisons keep their direction across the tested settings. Selected pairs have opposite pointwise intervals, but no reversal survives simultaneous inference over the full search. Thus the observed winner changes are descriptive, not confirmed changes in generator superiority. Sensitivity remains separate: no evaluator, even the prompt-free control, exceeds 67% tie-adjusted directional discrimination on layout scrambling, which is diagnostic rather than human-validated ground truth. The audit separates score stability, decision uncertainty, and targeted sensitivity, and recommends reporting (generator, score, card ID) with protocol-dependent comparisons and selection-aware uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 text-to-3D 渲染图评测做配置脆弱性审计：固定 300 个生成场景，只变 8 个渲染与 caption 因素，19 个对齐评测器中 17 个的配置方差峰值超过生成器间方差，18 个在某种配置下更换点估计赢家。成对比较在同时推断下无一出现真正反转，因此赢家更替是描述性的，不代表生成器优劣改变；作者建议报告 (generator, score, card ID) 并标注协议依赖与选择感知不确定性。
Motivation: text-to-3D 排行榜把相机设置与 caption 措辞当成测量协议的一部分，但配置选择带来的分数与赢家波动从未被系统审计，榜单结论可能随协议而非生成器质量变化。
Method: 在 6 个生成器的 300 个冻结场景上，变动 8 个渲染与 caption 因素，评测 19 个对齐评测器外加 1 个无 prompt 的感知质量对照，并施加 4 种定向场景退化；用 prompt-bootstrap 下界、成对协议边际包络 (pairwise protocol margin envelopes) 与同时推断检验赢家更替。
Result: 17/19 对齐评测器的配置方差峰值超过生成器间方差，11/19 的 prompt-bootstrap 下界大于 1；18/19 评测器在某些配置下改变点估计赢家。选定比较的点态区间方向相反，但在全搜索同时推断下无一反转存活。定向退化上无任何评测器（含无 prompt 对照）的方向判别力超过 67%（tie-adjusted，layout scrambling）。
Conclusion: 观测到的赢家更替是描述性的、未被确认的生成器优劣变化；分数稳定性、决策不确定性与定向敏感性应分开报告，比较需标注协议依赖并给出选择感知不确定性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Exact information accounting for SGD methods
papers.abstract_en: As an alternative to the standard geometric analyses, we give an exact, information-theoretic analysis of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants. We show that a preconditioned SGD step is the posterior-mean update of a Gaussian Bayes model, and that its one-step regret splits into an intrinsic-time cost and a change in comparator information. The split extends to an identity for the objective itself. Convex convergence, strict-saddle-point escape, the link between flatness and generalization, the standard learning-rate schedules, adaptive optimizers, and the noisy, momentum, heavy-tailed, and gradient-free variants of SGD each correspond to a term or a special case of this identity. We measure its terms on synthetic and real training runs. On real networks it attributes the slack of classical convergence bounds to the terms their derivations drop and separates optimizers that reach the same training loss. That separation follows the number and consistency of their steps. Its relation to which of them generalizes better differs between networks. For gradient-free SGD the identity determines how a curvature preconditioner should enter the update. The sharpness-based generalization certificate it yields, with a data-independent isotropic prior, is vacuous at network scale unless the curvature spectrum is nearly flat across all parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 SGD 及其变体重写为精确的信息论记账：预条件 SGD 步就是高斯 Bayes 模型的后验均值更新，单步 regret 分解为 intrinsic-time 代价与 comparator 信息变化之差，目标函数本身也满足同一恒等式。该恒等式统一了凸收敛、逃逸 strict saddle、平坦度与泛化、学习率调度、自适应优化器以及 noisy/momentum/heavy-tailed/gradient-free 变体；在真实网络上它把经典收敛界的松弛归因到被推导丢掉的项，并区分了训练损失相同但步数与一致性不同的优化器。
Motivation: 标准几何式 SGD 分析把不同变体和优化器拆成互不相通的证明，经典收敛界松弛来源不明，平坦度/锐度泛化证书在真实网络规模上是否有效也缺少统一判据。
Method: 给出 SGD 及变体的信息论精确分析：证明预条件 SGD 步等价于高斯 Bayes 模型的后验均值更新，将单步 regret 分解为 intrinsic-time 代价与 comparator 信息变化，并把该分解推广为目标函数的恒等式；在合成与真实训练运行上测量恒等式各分量，对 gradient-free SGD 用恒等式确定曲率预条件器进入更新的方式。
Result: 在真实网络上，恒等式把经典收敛界的松弛归因到其推导中被丢弃的项，并分开训练损失相同的不同优化器，分离源于其步数与一致性；哪个优化器泛化更好与网络有关。锐度泛化证书在数据无关各向同性先验下于网络规模上是空的 (vacuous)，除非曲率谱在所有参数上近乎平坦。
Conclusion: SGD 的几何现象可由一条信息论恒等式统一记账，优化器的差异由步数与一致性而非训练损失决定；锐度类泛化证书要成立需曲率谱在全参数上近乎平坦。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: One pool, many targets: a conservation layer and what archival data can identify
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise guide--transcript scores do not enforce conservation of a finite guide-loaded RISC pool when they are interpreted independently as occupancies. We formulate a differentiable scalar equilibrium layer: one conservation equation with a unique positive root and exact implicit gradients. It yields a redistribution theorem, a qualified high-resource limit, an analysis of the retrieval approximation, and a conditional rank-invariance result: within one construct at one dose, rankings by fractional occupancy cannot distinguish equilibrium from independent scoring. We therefore audit the two experiments that proposition leaves open, dose and cross-context, on archival off-target data. Corrected thermodynamic affinities associate weakly with measured repression in the direction a working predictor requires, but a paired permutation test and a construct-cluster bootstrap do not establish added predictive value from the coupling: what survives their differing permutation-null baselines is \GapNet{}, a descriptive \GapNetOverSE{} of the equilibrium association's cluster standard error. The dose fits are heterogeneous and frequently violate the model-implied exponent constraint, which is superlinear rather than sublinear, so these data do not identify the competition parameter. A saturable compression of the competitor set holds both accuracy targets on held-out guide families but is not faster at the size measured. The contribution is a reusable conservation operator and the experimental information needed to test it. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/shadi97kh/One-Pool-Many-Targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 guide–transcript 成对打分把有限 RISC 池的占有率当独立量处理的问题，提出一个可微的标量平衡层：单一守恒方程、唯一正根、精确隐式梯度，由此得到重分配定理与条件性秩不变结论——同一构建体同一剂量下，按分数占有率排序无法区分平衡模型与独立打分。在档案 off-target 数据上审计剂量与跨情境两个检验：校正热力学亲和力与实测 repression 弱相关且方向符合可用预测器要求，但配对置换检验与构建体聚类 bootstrap 均未确立耦合带来的额外预测价值。
Motivation: 成对 guide–transcript 分数被独立当作占有率解释时，不满足有限 guide-loaded RISC 池的守恒约束，导致剂量与跨情境两个可检验命题悬而未决。
Method: 构造一个可微标量平衡层：一条守恒方程、唯一正根、精确隐式梯度，导出重分配定理、带条件的高资源极限、检索近似分析与条件秩不变结果；随后在档案 off-target 数据上做剂量拟合与跨情境审计，用配对置换检验和构建体聚类 bootstrap 评估耦合的预测价值，并给出 competitor 集合的可饱和压缩。
Result: 校正热力学亲和力与实测 repression 弱相关且方向为正向预测所需；配对置换检验与构建体聚类 bootstrap 未确立耦合的额外预测价值，跨不同置换零基线存活的是 GapNet 及其平衡关联聚类标准误的 GapNetOverSE 描述。剂量拟合异质且频繁违反模型隐含指数约束（该指数为超线性而非亚线性），故这些数据无法识别 competition 参数。可饱和的 competitor 集合压缩在留出 guide 家族上同时保住两个 accuracy 目标，但在所测规模上并不更快。
Conclusion: 贡献是一个可复用的守恒算子以及检验它所需的实验信息；档案剂量数据不足以识别 competition 参数，跨情境的额外预测价值也未被确立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JevSpawn: Adaptive Agentic Inference through Compositional Action Spaces
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents generate intermediate reasoning and actions token by token, making extended interactions slow and computationally expensive. Jev-style models offer fast probabilistic predictions over finite fields, but require those fields to be specified in advance. This requirement limits autonomous task solving, where the available actions must be derived from natural language instructions and adapted through interaction. We introduce JevSpawn, a compositional policy that connects natural language task specifications to finite probabilistic exploration. Parallel action spawning is coupled with feedback driven branch selection, representation revision, and recovery from retained alternatives. Shared action structure and model prefixes reduce repeated generation and context computation without additional training. Evaluations on eight benchmark tasks against seven agent baselines and a TypeSafe Jev variant establish JevSpawn as a promising approach to structured agentic inference, with improved task performance and faster navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JevSpawn 把自然语言任务指令组合成有限动作空间，用并行动作生成加反馈驱动的分支选择、表示修订与保留备选的回退，让 Jev 式快速概率预测模型无需预先指定字段即可做自主任务求解。共享动作结构与模型前缀省掉重复生成和上下文计算，无需额外训练；在八个基准任务上对七个 agent 基线和一个 TypeSafe Jev 变体的评测显示任务性能提升、导航更快。
Motivation: LLM agent 逐 token 生成中间推理与动作，长交互慢且算力开销大；Jev 式模型虽能在有限域上快速概率预测，却要求域事先给定，而自主任务的可用动作必须从自然语言指令中推导并随交互调整。
Method: 提出组合式策略 JevSpawn：并行动作生成 (parallel action spawning) 与反馈驱动的分支选择、表示修订、从保留备选中回退相耦合；共享动作结构与模型前缀减少重复生成和上下文计算，训练无需额外数据。
Result: 在八个基准任务上对七个 agent 基线和一个 TypeSafe Jev 变体进行评测，JevSpawn 在任务性能与导航速度上均有提升。
Conclusion: 把自然语言任务规格组合成有限概率探索，可在不加训练的前提下让 Jev 式快速预测模型用于结构化 agentic inference。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Every Batch Is Its Own Validation Set: Leave-One-Out Gradient Matching for Online Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Online batch selection fine-tunes a language model on the most useful part of each candidate batch. Selectors that match the gradient of the candidate batch are attractive because they need no held-out data, yet they rarely beat training on the whole batch. We show why. In-sample gradient matching uses every example as part of its own target, so its objective credits each example with its own gradient noise. This is the covariance penalty that makes training error optimistic, now sitting on the diagonal of the gradient Gram matrix: it steers selection toward the noisiest examples and makes the full batch the best solution the objective can reach. The fix costs nothing. For each example, the other candidates form an independent sample of the data distribution, so removing the diagonal turns the matching objective into an unbiased estimate of the update's error with respect to the population gradient. The minimizer of this leave-one-out objective weights examples by their gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and whenever per-example SNR is heterogeneous enough, half of a batch yields a lower-error update than the whole batch; we give the exact condition. We build \method{} on this principle. It computes the Gram matrix in the metric of the Adam preconditioner during the ordinary backward pass, selects a weighted subset greedily with a $(1-e^{-γ})$ guarantee, and uses no held-out data. Across four fine-tuning tasks and seven backbones from 1.5B to 8B parameters, LOOM improves on full-batch training by 2.3 and 2.4 points on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, exceeds every in-sample gradient matcher by 2.4 points and the validation-guided GREATS and OPUS by 1.6--2.0, and selects injected label noise at under a fifth of its base rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线批选择中，样本内梯度匹配把每个样本自己的梯度噪声记为目标，导致选择偏向最噪样本并把全批当成最优解。去掉 Gram 矩阵对角线（leave-one-out）后目标成为对总体梯度误差的无偏估计，其最优解按梯度信噪比 (SNR) 加权；LOOM 在 Adam 预条件度量下于反向传播中计算 Gram 矩阵并贪心选子集，在 4 项微调任务、7 个 1.5B–8B backbone 上比全批训练在 Llama-3.1-8B 与 Qwen2.5-7B 上分别高 2.3 与 2.4 分。
Motivation: 基于梯度匹配的在线样本选择不需要留出数据，却几乎从不优于全批训练；本文指出症结在于样本内目标把每个样本自身的梯度噪声计入，形成位于梯度 Gram 矩阵对角线上的协方差惩罚。
Method: LOOM：在普通反向传播中于 Adam 预条件度量下计算梯度 Gram 矩阵，去掉对角线得到 leave-one-out 匹配目标（对总体梯度误差的无偏估计），再以带 (1-e^{-γ}) 保证的贪心方式选出加权子集，全程不用留出数据；理论给出半批优于全批的精确条件。
Result: 在 4 项微调任务、7 个 1.5B–8B backbone 上：LOOM 相对全批训练在 Llama-3.1-8B 上提升 2.3 分、Qwen2.5-7B 上提升 2.4 分；比所有样本内梯度匹配器高 2.4 分，比留出数据引导的 GREATS 与 OPUS 高 1.6–2.0 分；对注入的标签噪声，其被选中率不足基础比例的五分之一。
Conclusion: 去掉梯度 Gram 矩阵对角线即可把在线选择目标从偏向噪声样本转为按梯度 SNR 加权，因此在 SNR 足够异质时半批能产生比全批更低误差的更新，且无需留出数据。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: How AI Agents Discover Scientific Equations: From Hydrotope Rediscovery to New Water-Wave Amplitudes
papers.abstract_en: We study how AI agents discover and validate scientific formulas using a controlled case study of the hydrotope, a recently discovered geometric formula that combines the different polynomial pieces of nonlinear surface-wave scattering into one global expression. This problem is deceptively difficult: simple formulas can hold within individual frequency regions, but the global result must identify their boundaries and combine exponentially many potentially active terms. We reconstruct how the formula was originally discovered through human--agent collaboration and analyze 18 single-prompt rediscovery runs under no hint and two forms of human guidance: a false hint representing an incorrect prior and a true hint representing domain-informed insight. Only four recover the formula across all kinematic chambers (i.e., regions in which a single polynomial form applies), while most unsuccessful runs find correct chamber polynomials but fail to combine them or test their full domain. Conventional and LLM-assisted symbolic regression and standard machine-learning regressors likewise fail to recover the global formula in our experiments. Guided by these failure modes, we test a PI$+$two-student workflow in which a coordinating lead agent assigns complementary analytic and numerical tasks to two research agents and independently evaluates their results. The PI$+$two-student team successfully rediscovers the complete hydrotope formula, while the same workflow applied to the harder three negative wavenumber problem discovers a new independent verified analytic expression for the six-point amplitude $A_6$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以水波散射的 hydrotope 公式为受控案例，检验 AI agent 能否发现并验证跨多个 kinematic chamber 的全局解析式：18 次单 prompt 重发现仅 4 次在全部 chamber 上成功，符号回归与常规 ML 回归器全部失败；改用 PI+two-student 多 agent 工作流后完整重发现 hydrotope，并对更难的三点负波数问题给出新的六点振幅 A6 独立验证解析式。
Motivation: 全局公式必须识别各频段区域 (chamber) 的边界并组合指数多的潜在项，单 agent 与常规符号回归在分段正确但全局拼接失败处系统性崩掉，需要可复现的发现流程。
Method: 重建原始人机协作发现过程，做 18 次单 prompt 重发现实验，设无提示、错误提示 (false hint)、真实领域提示 (true hint) 三种引导；对照 conventional 与 LLM-assisted symbolic regression 及标准 ML 回归器；再测试 PI+two-student 工作流，由 PI 协调 agent 分派解析与数值任务给两个研究 agent 并独立评估其结果。
Result: 18 次单 prompt 运行中仅 4 次在所有 kinematic chambers 上恢复公式，多数失败运行给出正确的 chamber 多项式但无法组合或检验完整定义域；conventional 与 LLM-assisted symbolic regression 及标准 ML 回归器在实验中均未恢复全局公式；PI+two-student 团队成功重发现完整 hydrotope 公式，并对更难的 three negative wavenumber 问题给出六点振幅 A6 的新的独立验证解析式。
Conclusion: 分段正确不等于全局正确，跨 agent 分工加独立评估是让 AI agent 交付经验证全局公式的可行路径，且该流程能外推到更难问题产出新表达式。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: XOR-Trellis: Ultra-Low-Complexity Dequantization and Curvature-Aware Hadamard-Free LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Trellis-coded quantization enables high-dimensional compression of large language model (LLM) weights at ultra-low bit widths without the exponentially large codebooks required by conventional vector quantization. Practical deployment, however, presents two challenges: reconstructing compressed weights at sufficient parallel throughput to avoid making dequantization an inference bottleneck, and maintaining quantization accuracy without costly incoherence transformations. We address these challenges with two complementary techniques. First, we introduce an ultra-low-complexity trellis dequantizer that uses a structured, hardware-efficient state-to-value mapping while preserving diverse reconstruction choices for trellis search. Second, we reformulate discrete trellis path optimization with a curvature-aware objective that reflects model sensitivity directly in the original coordinate space. Together, these techniques enable high-quality ultra-low-bit trellis quantization with inexpensive, highly parallel runtime reconstruction and without relying on Hadamard-based incoherence processing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XOR-Trellis 针对超低比特 Trellis 编码量化提出两项技术：硬件高效的 state-to-value 结构化反量化映射，以及在原始坐标空间内直接反映模型敏感度的曲率感知路径目标，从而免去 Hadamard 非相干变换。目标是让反量化不成为推理瓶颈，同时保住超低比特权重量化精度。
Motivation: Trellis 编码量化能在超低比特下压缩 LLM 权重，但部署时反量化吞吐不足会拖慢推理，而维持精度通常要付出昂贵的非相干变换（如 Hadamard）代价。
Method: 其一为超低复杂度 Trellis 反量化器，用结构化、硬件友好的 state-to-value 映射，同时保留多样的重建候选供 trellis 搜索；其二把离散 Trellis 路径优化改写为曲率感知目标，在原始坐标空间直接体现模型敏感度，替代基于 Hadamard 的非相干处理。
Result: 摘要给出的是定性主张：两项技术共同实现高质量超低比特 Trellis 量化，运行时重建成本低且高度并行，且不依赖 Hadamard 非相干处理。
Conclusion: 反量化的硬件映射设计与量化目标的曲率感知化可以同时解决吞吐与精度两个部署瓶颈，无需引入非相干变换。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ChainLoRA: Geometry-Preserving Task Vector Merging for Continual Learning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Continual parameter-efficient fine-tuning for large language models (LLMs) must balance retention of previously acquired knowledge, adaptation to new tasks, and strict parameter budgets. We present \textbf{ChainLoRA}, a replay-free continual merging framework built on chain-updated task-vector geometry. From a parameter-merging perspective, we formulate a geometric view of forgetting through a measurable interaction between task updates, separating directional overlap from coefficient coupling. Building on this view, ChainLoRA combines chain-updated training with post-stream adaptive SVD merging. During training, initialization and a one-sided orthogonality proxy use only the last carrier, keeping their historical-state footprint and regularization overhead constant as the task stream grows. At merging time, Adaptive SVD extracts a shared carrier and aligns it to the latest task through Procrustes adaptation. Our theoretical analysis shows that Procrustes adaptation facilitates geometric approximate separation of shared and task-specific components. The one-sided proxy further bounds inter-task interference. An effective-rank penalty additionally promotes efficient utilization of the task subspace during continual learning. Experiments show that ChainLoRA achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated replay-free methods on the Large and SuperNI benchmarks, while remaining competitive on Standard CL and attaining almost the closest average scores to the evaluated replay-based method across all three benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChainLoRA 是免回放 (replay-free) 的持续学习参数合并框架，把遗忘拆成方向重叠与系数耦合两个可测部分，用链式更新训练加流后自适应 SVD 合并：Procrustes 适应把共享载体对齐到最新任务，单侧正交代理约束任务间干扰，有效秩惩罚提升任务子空间利用率。在 Large、SuperNI、Standard CL 三个基准上，它在所评估的免回放方法中达到 SOTA，并在三个基准上都接近所评估回放方法的平均分。
Motivation: LLM 的持续参数高效微调要同时保住旧知识、适配新任务并守住严格参数预算，而免回放合并里任务更新的方向重叠与系数耦合会共同造成遗忘。
Method: 链式更新训练中初始化与单侧正交代理只用最后一个载体，使历史状态开销与正则开销不随任务流增长；合并时 Adaptive SVD 抽出共享载体并经 Procrustes 适应对齐到最新任务，另有有效秩惩罚促进任务子空间的高效利用。理论分析给出 Procrustes 适应促成共享与任务特有成分的几何近似分离，单侧代理给出任务间干扰的界。
Result: 在 Large 与 SuperNI 基准上，ChainLoRA 在所评估的免回放方法中取得 SOTA；在 Standard CL 上保持竞争力；三个基准上的平均分都几乎最接近所评估的回放方法。
Conclusion: 免回放的链式任务向量几何合并可以在严格参数预算下逼近回放方法的持续学习表现，几何分离与干扰界为其提供了理论支撑。

summary_sections.method: 链式更新训练中初始化与单侧正交代理只用最后一个载体，使历史状态开销与正则开销不随任务流增长；合并时 Adaptive SVD 抽出共享载体并经 Procrustes 适应对齐到最新任务，另有有效秩惩罚促进任务子空间的高效利用。理论分析给出 Procrustes 适应促成共享与任务特有成分的几何近似分离，单侧代理给出任务间干扰的界。
summary_sections.result: 在 Large 与 SuperNI 基准上，ChainLoRA 在所评估的免回放方法中取得 SOTA；在 Standard CL 上保持竞争力；三个基准上的平均分都几乎最接近所评估的回放方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 免回放的链式任务向量几何合并可以在严格参数预算下逼近回放方法的持续学习表现，几何分离与干扰界为其提供了理论支撑。

papers.title: Memetic Trojans: Social Contagions as Carriers of Adversarial Payloads in Agent Networks
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous large language model (LLM) agents increasingly interact in network environments where adversarial content can propagate between agents. Known attacks include agent worms, which spread through self-replicating prompt injections or configuration compromises. We introduce \emph{memetic trojans}, a distinct class of network-mediated attack that exploits agents' tendencies to retransmit and amplify content. Unlike agent worms, whose propagation is adversarially induced, memetic trojans exploit \emph{endogenous} transmission by embedding adversarial payloads in \emph{social contagions}: content agents have internal reasons to share. As part of our work, we extract social contagions from Moltbook, a social media platform for LLM agents. Controlled transmission experiments reveal large differences in virality: the most effective contagion is retransmitted in approximately 50\% of subsequent agent posts and upvoted at 2.5x the average post's rate. Its memetic trojan counterpart largely inherits these properties. Monte Carlo attack simulations show that memetic trojans amplify expected exposure by up to 3.19x. Network structure and amplification mechanisms strongly shape propagation, producing heavy-tailed outcomes with near network-wide exposure. These results identify endogenous social transmission as a distinct security vulnerability in multi-agent systems. Because propagation does not require agents to follow malicious retransmission instructions, defenses focused on prompt-injection detection or preventing agent compromise cannot alone prevent memetic trojan propagation. Securing large-scale agent ecosystems may require network-level defenses that account for how agent preferences, recommendation mechanisms, and network topology amplify adversarial payloads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 memetic trojan：把对抗载荷嵌入 LLM agent 本就愿意转发的 social contagion 中，靠内生转发而非自复制指令传播。从 Moltbook 提取的最强 contagion 在后续 agent 帖子中被转发率约 50%、点赞率为平均帖的 2.5 倍，其 trojan 版本基本继承这些性质；Monte Carlo 攻击模拟显示期望暴露最多放大 3.19 倍，且传播呈重尾、可接近全网暴露。
Motivation: LLM agent 网络中已有 agent worm 依赖诱导式转发或配置篡改传播，但 agent 因自身偏好而主动分享的内容尚未被视为攻击载体，现有针对 prompt injection 检测的防御对此无效。
Method: 从 LLM agent 社交平台 Moltbook 中提取 social contagion，构造其 memetic trojan 对应物；开展受控传播实验测量转发率与点赞率，再用 Monte Carlo 攻击模拟考察网络结构与放大机制对传播的影响。
Result: 最强 contagion 在后续 agent 帖子中被转发约 50%，点赞率为平均帖的 2.5 倍，其 trojan 版本基本继承该性质；Monte Carlo 模拟中 memetic trojan 使期望暴露最多放大 3.19 倍，传播结果呈重尾分布并可接近全网暴露。
Conclusion: 内生社交传播本身构成多智能体系统的一类独立安全漏洞，仅靠 prompt-injection 检测或阻止 agent 被篡改不足以阻断其传播，需要考虑 agent 偏好、推荐机制与网络拓扑如何放大载荷的网络级防御。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: IrekoGPT: Turning Structured Pruning into Post-Hoc Slimmable LLMs
papers.abstract_en: We introduce IrekoGPT, a post-hoc method for converting pretrained LLMs into slimmable models whose width can be adjusted at inference time. Building on SliceGPT, we retain its projection matrices without pruning them, allowing a single model to expose nested subnetworks at different widths. We improve robustness by calibrating each layer across multiple compression ratios, and correct downstream linear layers through gradient-free ridge regression. Across Llama and Qwen models, preliminary results show improvements over naive PCA-based slimming, with the largest gains at high compression. Code is available at https://github.com/aimagelab/IrekoGPT
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "AXIOM: Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning". 8 pages, 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IrekoGPT 把结构化剪枝改造成事后可调宽度的 slimmable LLM：保留 SliceGPT 的投影矩阵不剪，使单一模型暴露嵌套子网络，并用多压缩比逐层校准加无梯度 ridge 回归修正下游线性层。在 Llama 与 Qwen 上的初步结果显示其优于朴素 PCA 式瘦身，高压缩比下增益最大。
Motivation: SliceGPT 类结构化剪枝一次剪定、推理时宽度固定，且下游线性层在剪枝后失配；需要让预训练 LLM 在推理期按宽度灵活收缩而不重训。
Method: 基于 SliceGPT 但不剪投影矩阵，从而暴露不同宽度的嵌套子网络；每层在多个压缩比上做校准以提升鲁棒性，并用无梯度的 ridge 回归修正下游线性层。
Result: 在 Llama 与 Qwen 模型上，初步结果相对朴素 PCA 式瘦身有改进，且增益在高压缩比下最大；代码发布于 github.com/aimagelab/IrekoGPT。
Conclusion: 保留投影矩阵加多压缩比校准与 ridge 修正，可把结构化剪枝转成推理期可调宽度的事后 slimmable 模型，高压缩区间收益最明显。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Code That Works, Environments That Don't: Measuring Environment Reproducibility in AI-Generated Software
papers.abstract_en: Code generation has emerged as a central capability of large language models, with coding agents now able to produce functionally correct software projects from natural language prompts. However, functional correctness alone does not capture a critical dimension of generation quality: environment specification, defined as the accurate identification of the dependencies required to execute generated code, is equally critical. We develop an agent protocol for environment specification and introduce a three-layer framework comprising declared, runtime-installed, and necessary-and-sufficient dependencies to systematically assess coding agents for environment specification. Using this protocol, we evaluate the extent to which coding agents systematically misspecify software environment dependencies and how this misspecification varies across three agents, four languages, and fifty programming tasks. Our results show that current coding agents exhibit systematic generalization failures along this dimension, producing dependency specifications that are inconsistent, redundant, or incomplete in ways that functional tests do not detect. Across agents, dependency set agreement is as low as 7% for identical tasks, and newer agents show no meaningful improvement, suggesting the failure is not resolved by scale or recency. The largest divergence occurs between the declared and runtime dependency layers, implicating environment priors learned from the models' training distributions as the primary driver. Our findings establish environment specification as a distinct, measurable axis of code generation quality that current benchmarks do not capture, and motivate training objectives and evaluation protocols that jointly optimize for functional correctness and environmental portability.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 8 figures. Manuscript prepared for AAAI Journal, AI Magazine Special Issue
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出环境规格 (environment specification) 作为代码生成质量的独立可测维度：用三层依赖框架（declared、runtime-installed、necessary-and-sufficient）评估 coding agent 在 3 个 agent、4 种语言、50 个编程任务上的依赖声明。同一任务上依赖集一致率最低仅 7%，且新 agent 无明显改善，最大分歧出现在 declared 与 runtime 两层之间。
Motivation: 功能正确性测试无法发现依赖声明不一致、冗余或缺失，生成代码在换环境后跑不起来，而现有基准只测功能正确性。
Method: 设计 environment specification 的 agent 协议与三层依赖框架（declared / runtime-installed / necessary-and-sufficient），据此在 3 个 coding agent、4 种编程语言、50 个任务上系统评估依赖误设。
Result: 同一任务上跨 agent 的 dependency set agreement 低至 7%；更新的 agent 无有意义提升；分歧最大的是 declared 与 runtime 依赖层之间；误设表现为不一致、冗余、缺失且功能测试检测不到。
Conclusion: 环境规格是当前基准未覆盖的独立质量轴，失败源于训练分布中学到的 environment priors，不能靠模型规模或新近性解决，需要同时优化功能正确性与环境可移植性的训练目标和评测协议。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Target-Dependent Limits of Causal Repair: A Leading-Log Frontier in a Gaussian Model
papers.abstract_en: Knowing how much a causal predictor could improve need not reveal the gain of the repair actually learned. We quantify this gap in a scalar Gaussian causal experiment with known intervention geometry: auxiliary data identify effect magnitude up to bounded contamination, while diagnostics identify direction. The target is the squared-loss gain of the realized trained repair relative to a fitted reference. Jointly optimizing the learner and assessor under uniform learning MSE $η$ avoids the trivial solution of making no repair. At the usual $1/k$ learning scale, every feasible learner incurs a $k^{-2}$ assessment floor, even when oracle potential is estimable at a faster rate. In the magnitude-rich regime, we characterize a sharp leading-log frontier: the assessment exponent is $\min{\ell_k,2kη_k/U}$ to first relative order, where $\ell_k=\log(1/(k^2E_k))$ and $E_k$ is auxiliary precision. A diagnostic-abstention rule attains this exponent with unknown nuisance parameters. We also bound the critical allowance window and transfer the frontier to adaptive sampling by exact Gaussian simulation. Finite-grid experiments distinguish sign-tail suppression from total MSE and expose conservative finite-budget behavior. The result isolates how the assessment target changes information requirements in this experiment; it is not a general causal identifiability claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在标量高斯因果实验中，实际学到的修复 (repair) 相对拟合参考的平方损失增益，其可评估精度存在硬下界：学习尺度为 1/k 时每个可行 learner 都要付出 k^{-2} 的评估下界，即使 oracle 潜力能以更快速率估计。在 magnitude-rich 区制下导出 leading-log 前沿，评估指数为 min{ℓ_k, 2kη_k/U}（ℓ_k=log(1/(k²E_k))），并给出在未知干扰参数下达到该指数的 diagnostic-abstention 规则。
Motivation: 知道因果预测器的潜在改进幅度，并不等于能评估实际训练出的修复的真实增益；两者之间的差距在有已知干预几何时缺少定量刻画。
Method: 构造带已知干预几何的标量高斯因果实验：辅助数据在有界污染下识别效应幅度，诊断 (diagnostics) 识别方向；在统一学习 MSE η 下联合优化 learner 与 assessor 以避开“不做修复”的平凡解，并用精确高斯模拟把前沿迁移到自适应采样。
Result: 在 1/k 学习尺度下每个可行 learner 产生 k^{-2} 评估下界，即使 oracle 潜力可更快估计；magnitude-rich 区制的评估指数为 min{ℓ_k, 2kη_k/U}（一阶相对阶，ℓ_k=log(1/(k²E_k))，E_k 为辅助精度），并界定了 critical allowance window。有限网格实验区分了 sign-tail 抑制与总 MSE，并暴露保守的有限预算行为。
Conclusion: 该实验中评估目标本身改变了信息需求，assessment 指数受学习误差与辅助精度共同限制；作者明确说明这不是一般的因果可识别性主张。

papers.title: The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation
papers.abstract_en: Massive activations, residual-stream coordinates with magnitudes far larger than typical activations, are associated with attention sinks in transformers, but how their scale is regulated during training remains incompletely understood. Combining training-trajectory analyses and controlled interventions, we trace their emergence, growth, and consolidation. Sink-carrying channels vary across random seeds but stabilize early within each run. Over longer training, surrounding channels erode and the sink concentrates onto a few redundant carriers. Across ablations, gradient attenuation follows the sink token's collective root-mean-square magnitude rather than any single channel, making collective scale central to understanding their effects. Our central result is that weight decay causally controls the turnover of global activation scale. In controlled continuations, removing decay near the peak allows this scale to keep rising, whereas retaining it produces decline even at constant learning rate. We develop a balance model for the rise and peak of massive-activation magnitude, in which AdamW-preconditioned growth opposes weight decay. Sweeping the decay coefficient $λ$ shifts peak timing approximately log-linearly and yields peak magnitudes scaling approximately as $λ^{-1/2}$, consistent with this balance. Optimizer measurements further show that preconditioning sustains the large-channel cohort against decay even when raw maintaining forces are too small to do so. Together, these findings connect the observed life cycle to scale-regulating training dynamics and establish weight decay as a training-time lever on activation magnitude.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文追踪 Transformer 中 massive activation（残差流中幅值远大于常规的坐标）的生命周期：sink 所在通道随随机种子不同但早期即稳定，随后周围通道被侵蚀、sink 集中到少数冗余载体上。核心论断是 weight decay 因果性地控制全局激活尺度的周转——在峰值附近移除 decay 使尺度继续上升，保留则即使学习率不变也下降；扫 decay 系数 λ 使峰值时刻近似 log-linear 移动、峰值幅值近似按 λ^{-1/2} 标度。
Motivation: massive activation 与 attention sink 现象相关，但训练过程中其尺度如何被调控尚不清楚；梯度衰减究竟由单通道还是集体量决定也未有定论。
Method: 结合训练轨迹分析与受控干预（ablation、在峰值附近移除或保留 decay 的 controlled continuations），并提出一个平衡模型：AdamW 预条件带来的增长与 weight decay 相对抗，据此预测峰值行为；同时测量 optimizer 预条件对大通道群的维持作用。
Result: sink 承载通道随随机种子变化但单次运行内早期稳定；梯度衰减跟随 sink token 的集体 RMS 幅值而非任一单通道；移除 decay 使全局激活尺度持续上升，保留则在恒定学习率下转为下降；扫 λ 使峰值时刻近似 log-linear 移动，峰值幅值近似按 λ^{-1/2} 标度，与平衡模型一致；预条件在原始维持力过小的情况下仍维持大通道群。
Conclusion: weight decay 是训练期调控激活幅值的因果性杠杆，massive activation 的兴起—达峰—巩固生命周期由 AdamW 预条件增长与 weight decay 的平衡所支配，且起作用的是集体尺度而非单通道。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 论文追踪 Transformer 中 massive activation（残差流中幅值远大于常规的坐标）的生命周期：sink 所在通道随随机种子不同但早期即稳定，随后周围通道被侵蚀、sink 集中到少数冗余载体上。核心论断是 weight decay 因果性地控制全局激活尺度的周转——在峰值附近移除 decay 使尺度继续上升，保留则即使学习率不变也下降；扫 decay 系数 λ 使峰值时刻近似 log-linear 移动、峰值幅值近似按 λ^{-1/2} 标度。

summary_sections.method: 结合训练轨迹分析与受控干预（ablation、在峰值附近移除或保留 decay 的 controlled continuations），并提出一个平衡模型：AdamW 预条件带来的增长与 weight decay 相对抗，据此预测峰值行为；同时测量 optimizer 预条件对大通道群的维持作用。
summary_sections.result: sink 承载通道随随机种子变化但单次运行内早期稳定；梯度衰减跟随 sink token 的集体 RMS 幅值而非任一单通道；移除 decay 使全局激活尺度持续上升，保留则在恒定学习率下转为下降；扫 λ 使峰值时刻近似 log-linear 移动，峰值幅值近似按 λ^{-1/2} 标度，与平衡模型一致；预条件在原始维持力过小的情况下仍维持大通道群。

papers.title: Learning to Cover Locally: Graph Neural Combinatorial Optimization under a Hard Information Horizon
papers.abstract_en: Neural combinatorial optimization typically assumes a centralized solver that reads the whole instance. We study the opposite: combinatorial optimization under a hard information horizon, where every node commits to its share of a global solution seeing only its $k$-hop neighborhood, and those commitments must compose into a globally feasible solution. We formalize this as local set cover and instantiate it on weighted multipoint relay (MPR) selection, the NP-hard 2-hop covering problem of the Optimized Link State Routing Protocol version 2 (OLSRv2) routing protocol (RFC~7181), whose horizon is imposed by the protocol, not chosen by the modeler. We prove two results. Any deterministic selector whose horizon is one hop short must either fail coverage or land a factor $Δ$ from optimal, and an $L$-layer graph neural network (GNN) read out at the deciding node is exactly an $L$-hop selector, so capacity cannot buy back radius. Conversely, at the horizon a \ac{GNN} of depth $O(Δ)$ reproduces the RFC~7181 covering greedy, and at width $O(c_{\max}Δ)$ its metric-aware weighted analogue, inheriting the $(1+\lnΔ_2)$-approximation in both cases. Empirically, a 3-layer \ac{GATv2} with a coverage-completing decoder, behavior-cloned from the CP-SAT optimum, reaches $\text{cost}/\text{opt}=1.030\pm0.001$ against greedy's $1.138$, closing $79.1\%$ of the gap at $100\%$ coverage. Restricting the same learner to one hop, on identical instances with the same decoder and demonstrations, collapses it to $1.344$, far worse than greedy. Two transfer checks target real-world networks. OLSRv2's unmodified selection code matches our cardinality greedy on $200/200$ unit-cost instances, and on $40{,}308$ instances of real battalion mobility the frozen model closes $48\%$ of the gap at full coverage. The information horizon, not the model capacity, is the most significant variable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在硬信息视界 (hard information horizon) 下做组合优化：每个节点只能看 k-跳邻域就提交对全局解的份额，且这些份额必须拼成全局可行解。证明视界差一跳时任何确定性选择器要么覆盖失败、要么离最优差 Δ 因子，而 L 层 GNN 恰好是 L-跳选择器，容量买不回半径；在协议给定的视界上深度 O(Δ) 的 GNN 可复现 RFC 7181 贪心并继承 (1+lnΔ₂) 近似。3 层 GATv2 加覆盖补全解码器在 100% 覆盖下 cost/opt=1.030±0.001（贪心 1.138），同模型压到一跳则崩到 1.344。
Motivation: 神经组合优化默认集中式求解器读取整个实例，但 OLSRv2 的 MPR 选择被协议强制只能看 2 跳，视界由协议而非建模者决定；需要判定视界本身而非模型容量如何决定解质量。
Method: 把问题形式化为局部集合覆盖 (local set cover)，落到 OLSRv2 (RFC 7181) 的加权 MPR 选择这一 NP-hard 2 跳覆盖问题；证明两条界（差一跳的 Δ 因子下界、L 层 GNN 等价于 L-跳选择器），并构造深度 O(Δ)、宽度 O(c_max·Δ) 的 GNN 复现 RFC 7181 覆盖贪心及其度量感知加权版本；实验用 3 层 GATv2 加覆盖补全解码器，从 CP-SAT 最优解做行为克隆 (behavior cloning)。
Result: 3 层 GATv2 在 100% 覆盖下 cost/opt=1.030±0.001，贪心为 1.138，闭合 79.1% 的差距；同一学习器限制到一跳、同实例同解码器同示范下退化到 1.344，远差于贪心。OLSRv2 未修改的选择代码在 200/200 单位代价实例上与作者的基数贪心一致；在 40,308 个真实营级机动实例上，冻结模型在全覆盖下闭合 48% 的差距。
Conclusion: 信息视界而非模型容量是最关键变量：容量无法把半径买回来，只有把视界放到协议给定的跳数上，学习型选择器才能超过贪心。

papers.title: Scores That Hold, Benchmarks That Leak: Measuring Dataset Contamination in Public Brain-Tumor MRI Classification
papers.abstract_en: Automated classification of brain tumors from MRI is a heavily published application of deep learning in medical imaging, with reported accuracies on public benchmarks routinely exceeding 98%. However, accuracy does not capture a critical dimension of benchmark quality: dataset integrity, defined as the independence of test from training data at the image, patient, and acquisition-source levels. We introduce a three-layer contamination framework comprising duplicate, patient, and source-label leakage to assess the public corpora on which this literature rests. We audit the three most widely used corpora against a chest-radiograph negative control and quantify each layer's effect on measured performance across nine architectures and three evaluation conditions. Contamination is severe at every layer: 28.8% of the dominant corpus's official test split has a near-twin in its own training split, a second corpus leaks 22.3% of its test images byte-identically, 95.5% of traceable test images share a patient with training, and file-header features containing no anatomy separate tumor from no-tumor at 0.959 balanced accuracy, at parity with fine-tuned ResNet backbones. The unexpected result is that removing every identified leaked test image leaves balanced accuracy essentially unchanged: stable performance after deduplication does not establish benchmark integrity. Our findings establish dataset integrity as a distinct, measurable axis of benchmark quality that a stable leaderboard cannot certify. For biomedical research, reported accuracy on these corpora alone does not establish that a model has learned to recognize tumors rather than exploit dataset-specific cues. We release the contaminated-file lists, recovered patient identifiers, and deduplicated splits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出三层数据集污染框架（重复图像、患者、来源标签泄漏），审计三个最常用的脑肿瘤 MRI 公开语料：主导语料官方测试集 28.8% 在训练集有近重复，另一语料 22.3% 测试图像逐字节泄漏，95.5% 可追溯测试图像与训练共享患者，仅凭文件头特征即可达 0.959 balanced accuracy，与微调 ResNet 相当。关键反直觉结果是剔除全部已识别泄漏测试图像后 balanced accuracy 基本不变——去重后分数稳定不能证明基准完整。
Motivation: 脑肿瘤 MRI 公开基准上准确率普遍报超 98%，但准确率不反映测试集在图像、患者、采集来源三个层级上是否独立于训练集，导致排行榜分数无法证明模型学到的是肿瘤本身。
Method: 构建三层污染框架：duplicate（近重复/逐字节重复）、patient（患者身份共享）、source-label（文件头等来源标签泄漏）；对三个最常用语料做审计，并以一张胸片语料作负对照；在九种架构与三种评估条件下量化每层对测量性能的影响，同时用不含解剖信息的文件头特征做对照分类。
Result: 主导语料官方测试集 28.8% 存在训练集近重复；第二语料 22.3% 测试图像逐字节泄漏；95.5% 可追溯测试图像与训练共享患者；文件头特征区分肿瘤/非肿瘤达 0.959 balanced accuracy，与微调 ResNet 主干持平；剔除全部已识别泄漏测试图像后 balanced accuracy 基本不变。
Conclusion: 数据集完整性是基准质量的一个独立可测维度，稳定的排行榜无法为其背书；仅凭这些语料的已报准确率不能证明模型学会了识别肿瘤而非利用数据集特异线索。作者公开污染文件清单、恢复的患者标识与去重划分。

papers.title: Transferable Graph Metanetworks
papers.abstract_en: A weight space network (or metanetwork) takes the weights of another neural network as input and predicts properties of it. Most prior work trains such models on input networks of one or a few fixed sizes and evaluates them in-distribution. The few attempts at out-of-distribution size generalization remain limited in scope and have achieved only modest success. Consequently, the potential efficiency gains of training on small networks and evaluating on much larger ones remain largely unrealized. We propose Transferable Graph Metanetworks, which extend the graph metanetwork paradigm with a set of modifications that make performance transferable across input networks of different widths. The modifications follow two principles: invariance to the ways in which networks of different widths represent the same function, and continuity, such that weights representing similar functions receive similar predictions. We further study whether size generalization is possible for input networks trained independently from random initialization. Empirically, our modifications significantly improve size generalization on every task we consider. Performance is strongest on input networks trained under the maximal-update parameterization ($μ$P), where it remains robust up to $42\times$ the training width. Theoretically, we explain these observations with infinite-width limit theory: we prove size-generalization guarantees for our model on $μ$P-trained inputs, and explain why it can fail under other parameterizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Transferable Graph Metanetworks，让 weight space network 在不同宽度的输入网络之间迁移预测：以「同一函数的不同宽度表示应给出不变预测」和「相似函数给出相似预测」两条原则改造图元网络。在 μP 参数化训练的输入网络上表现最强，宽度可外推到训练宽度的 42 倍，并由无限宽极限理论给出 μP 下的 size-generalization 保证、解释其他参数化下失效的原因。
Motivation: 既有 weight space network 多在固定一两种网络规模上训练并做分布内评估，少数 OOD 尺寸泛化尝试范围窄、收益有限，导致「小网络训练、大网络评估」的效率潜力基本未兑现。
Method: 在图 metanetwork 框架上加入两类改造：对不同宽度表示同一函数的方式保持不变性，以及对相似函数保持预测连续性；并研究从随机初始化独立训练的输入网络能否实现尺寸泛化，用无限宽极限理论为 μP 参数化输入推导 size-generalization 保证。
Result: 所考虑的每项任务上尺寸泛化都显著提升；在 μP 参数化训练的输入网络上性能最强，可稳健外推到训练宽度的 42 倍；理论上证明了 μP 输入的尺寸泛化保证，并解释其他参数化下可能失败。
Conclusion: 尺寸泛化在 μP 参数化输入上可实现且有理论保证，换用其他参数化则可能失效；不变性与连续性两条原则是让图 metanetwork 跨宽度迁移的关键。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CommunityKV: Efficient Long-Context Decoding via Graph Partitioning
papers.abstract_en: Scaling Transformers to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of self-attention and the linear growth of key-value cache memory transfer. Sparse attention mitigates this by retrieving only relevant tokens, but current approaches either require large-scale training or, within the training-free regime, rely on semantically coarse heuristics or expensive clustering that is difficult to update efficiently during decoding. We introduce CommunityKV, a framework that formulates sparse attention as a community detection problem. CommunityKV constructs a token graph from the $QK^T$ scores already computed during standard prefill, and partitions the graph into communities to enable retrieval of semantically coherent token groups. A local update rule assigns newly generated tokens to communities in constant time, enabling sparse retrieval throughout streaming decoding without global re-partitioning. We evaluate CommunityKV on Qwen3 and Llama-3.1 models across three long-context benchmarks. With one graph per query head, CommunityKV delivers up to $1.25\times$ the end-to-end generation throughput of dense attention, while query-group graph aggregation yields up to $1.71\times$ with comparable accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CommunityKV 把稀疏注意力重构为社区发现问题：用 prefill 阶段已算好的 QK^T 分数建 token 图并划分社区，新生成 token 由局部规则常数时间归入社区，从而在流式解码中无需全局重划分即可持续稀疏检索。在 Qwen3 与 Llama-3.1 的三个长上下文基准上，每查询头一张图时端到端生成吞吐最高达稠密注意力的 1.25×，查询组聚合图最高 1.71× 且精度相当。
Motivation: 长上下文受自注意力二次代价与 KV cache 内存传输线性增长制约；免训练稀疏注意力要么依赖语义粗糙的启发式，要么依赖解码期间难以高效更新的昂贵聚类。
Method: 从标准 prefill 中已计算的 QK^T 分数构建 token 图，用社区划分得到语义连贯的 token 组供稀疏检索；新 token 用局部更新规则常数时间分配到社区，支持流式解码。支持每查询头一张图与查询组图聚合两种粒度。
Result: 在 Qwen3 和 Llama-3.1 上、三个长上下文基准评测：每查询头一张图时端到端生成吞吐最高为稠密注意力的 1.25×；查询组图聚合最高 1.71×，且精度相当 (comparable accuracy)。
Conclusion: 把稀疏注意力当作社区检测问题，可在免训练、无需全局重划分的前提下，用已有 QK^T 分数换取显著的长上下文解码吞吐提升。

papers.title: Source Identification Is Not Fitness Testing: Measuring the Limits of Synthetic-Data Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Repeated training on model-generated data can degrade later models. One possible response is to use provenance when deciding which generated examples to reuse. We test both how reliably that provenance can be recovered and whether it helps identify better training data. Using financial-risk text, we first identify the source of generated passages and then repeat the test after rewriting them. Generator attribution is 98.7% accurate on the original passages but falls to 53.1% after paraphrasing and 29.0% after style rewriting. Generated-versus-human detection remains close to perfect against the tested human comparison set. We then compare two ways of selecting generated examples over three rounds of generation and retraining. One uses source information. The other uses a score from a separate reference model. The two rules select different examples, but the planned comparison does not detect a stable difference in the degradation of the resulting models. The results show that identifying where data came from and identifying which data are useful for training are separate problems. The experiment therefore separates source identity, criterion-facing selection, and recursive training outcome: neither the provenance score nor the tested criterion-facing proxy is established as sufficient for future recursive behaviour.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在金融风险文本上检验合成数据溯源能否指导数据复用：生成器归属在原文上准确率 98.7%，改写后降到 53.1%，风格重写后仅 29.0%；而按溯源分数与按参考模型分数两种选择规则在三轮生成-重训中选出不同样本，却未检出模型退化程度的稳定差异。结论是识别数据来源与识别哪些数据有用是两个独立问题。
Motivation: 重复使用模型生成数据会拖累后续模型训练，业界想靠溯源 (provenance) 决定复用哪些样本，但溯源可靠性与其是否真能挑出更好的训练数据从未被分开检验。
Method: 在金融风险文本上分两步：先对生成段落做生成器归属 (generator attribution)，再在改写与风格重写后重测；随后用两种样本选择规则做三轮生成与重训对比，一条用来源信息，一条用独立参考模型给出的分数。
Result: 原文段落生成器归属准确率 98.7%，paraphrasing 后降至 53.1%，style rewriting 后降至 29.0%；生成 vs 人类判别在所测人类对照集上接近完美。三轮生成-重训中两种规则选出不同样本，但计划的对比未检出最终模型退化的稳定差异。
Conclusion: 来源身份、面向准则的选择与递归训练结果必须分开处理：溯源分数和所测的面向准则代理都不足以保证未来的递归行为，识别来源不等于识别有用数据。

papers.title: Benchmarking Prompt Optimization of Large Language Models With Chess
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating large language models becomes increasingly challenging as their capabilities advance: benchmarks can saturate, public test sets risk contamination, and assessing harder tasks can require expensive grading or execution infrastructure. These challenges are amplified in automatic prompt optimization (APO), where evaluation is repeated throughout the search for better prompts. Studying APO therefore requires a benchmark that is cheap and deterministic to score, hard enough to leave room for improvement, and renewable as models evolve. We introduce a chess benchmark built from 1,118 Lichess puzzles to study APO for frozen LLMs: we optimize their prompts without updating their model weights. Chess combines inexpensive exact-match scoring, engine-based evaluation of alternative moves, and a renewable supply of problems with adjustable difficulty. Unlike evaluations that report only success on isolated test items, the benchmark also connects puzzle-solving gains to short game-play rollouts within the same domain. We use it to evaluate six APO algorithms on eight target models, measuring not only baseline strength but also how much each model responds to optimization and whether optimized prompts transfer across models and to game play. Chess is thus a well-suited benchmark for APO: it is (i) challenging, as even the strongest evaluated model, Gemini 3.5 Flash (used as the meta-model), solves only about 55\% of puzzles; (ii) discriminative, revealing gains, unchanged performance, and regressions across methods and models; (iii) renewable, with fresh puzzles to reduce contamination risk and adjustable difficulty to maintain headroom as models improve; and (iv) affordable, as the complete study runs for around \$800. We release the puzzles, optimization and evaluation code, and dataset-renewal scripts (https://github.com/imec-ailabs/Automatic-Prompt-Optimization-with-Chess).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 1,118 道 Lichess 棋谜的自动提示优化 (APO) 基准，用精确匹配与引擎评估给冻结 LLM 的提示打分，并把谜题增益连到同域短局对弈 rollout。用它评测 6 个 APO 算法、8 个目标模型：最强的 Gemini 3.5 Flash（作 meta-model）也只解出约 55% 谜题，方法间出现提升、持平与回退，整项研究成本约 800 美元。
Motivation: LLM 评测面临基准饱和、测试集污染与评分昂贵的问题，在 APO 中每次搜索都要反复评测，放大了成本；需要一个便宜、确定性打分、难度足够且可随模型更新而补充新题的基准。
Method: 从 Lichess 收集 1,118 道棋谜构建基准，对冻结 LLM 只优化提示、不更新权重；用 exact-match 打分并借助引擎评估替代着法，同时把谜题解出率与同域短局对弈 rollout 关联，评测 6 个 APO 算法在 8 个目标模型上的基线强度、优化响应度与提示跨模型/跨对弈迁移。
Result: 最强被评模型 Gemini 3.5 Flash（作为 meta-model）仅解出约 55% 谜题；6 个 APO 算法在 8 个模型上呈现提升、持平与回退三类结果；完整研究运行成本约 800 美元；发布谜题、优化与评测代码及数据集更新脚本。
Conclusion: 国际象棋谜题因打分便宜确定、难度可调且可补充新题，适合作为冻结 LLM 的 APO 基准，既能留出提升空间又能降低污染风险。

papers.title: Do Better Scores Mean Better Physics? Physics-Grounded Explanations for Sim2Real Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning surrogates accelerate physical simulation, but lower prediction error need not coincide with lower error in physically relevant flow statistics. We examine this question for flow around a NACA4418 airfoil using paired computational-fluid-dynamics simulations and experimental particle-image-velocimetry measurements. A mean-preserving input intervention removes velocity fluctuations from selected regions of observed flow histories. Across four neural operators, removing fluctuations from the most energetic 10% of valid observed cells changes forecasts more than equal-area random removal. Because the masks are not matched for removed fluctuation energy, this contrast measures sensitivity, not independent evidence of physical importance. Separately, a CNO has lower velocity-field error but substantially higher two-component fluctuation-energy error than the reference on both analysis subsets. An output attenuation stress test also demonstrates disagreement between benchmark errors and domain-summed fluctuation energy. These single-benchmark results motivate reporting complementary physical diagnostics alongside aggregate prediction scores; they do not establish counterfactual physical correctness.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 XAI4Science Workshop, Tiny Paper Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 NACA4418 翼型绕流的 CFD 与 PIV 配对数据上，预测误差更低的神经算子（CNO）在速度场误差更低的同时，两分量脉动能量误差显著高于参考模型，说明聚合分数与物理统计量误差可以背离。对观测流历史做均值保持的输入干预，移除能量最高 10% 有效单元的脉动比等面积随机移除改变预报更多，但因掩膜未匹配被移除的脉动能量，这只度量敏感性而非物理重要性的独立证据。作者主张在报告聚合预测分数之外同时给出互补的物理诊断量。
Motivation: 机器学习代理加速物理仿真，但更低的预测误差未必对应更低的物理相关流统计量误差；单一聚合分数无法暴露这种背离。
Method: 在 NACA4418 翼型绕流上配对 CFD 模拟与实验 PIV 测量，构造均值保持的输入干预（从选定区域的观测流历史中移除速度脉动），在四个神经算子上比较移除最活跃 10% 有效单元与等面积随机移除的预报变化；另对 CNO 做输出衰减压力测试 (output attenuation stress test)。
Result: 移除最活跃 10% 有效观测单元的脉动比等面积随机移除对预报影响更大（四个神经算子上一致）；CNO 速度场误差更低但两分量脉动能量误差在两个分析子集上都显著高于参考模型；输出衰减压力测试同样显示基准误差与域求和脉动能量不一致。
Conclusion: 单一基准上的聚合预测分数不足以判定物理正确性，应与互补的物理诊断量一起报告；这些单基准结果不构成反事实物理正确性的证据。

papers.title: From Image Latent Space to Fuzzy Rules: Interpretable Analysis of Gastrointestinal Foundation Model
authors: Dimitris K. Iakovidis (1) ((1) Department of Computer Science and Biomedical Informatics
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models pretrained on large-scale datasets demonstrate strong transferability to medical imaging tasks. However, understanding how their latent representations encode clinically relevant information remains an open challenge in safety-critical domains. This study proposes a prototype-based fuzzy-rule framework that interprets the patch-level features produced by the inner layers of pretrained foundation models, without any fine-tuning. Class-specific prototypes are learned by clustering in the feature space, yielding compact visual patterns. Patch features are then expressed as prototype similarities and classified by fuzzy rules with linguistic IF-THEN conditions that are human readable. The framework is applied across the final two blocks of ViT-S/16 backbones pretrained on ImageNet-1K and GastroNet-5M, and benchmarked against k-nearest neighbours, kernel SVM, and linear probing under identical frozen features, on wireless capsule endoscopy classification, gastrointestinal endoscopy classification, and colonic polyp segmentation. The experimental analysis shows that the proposed method, without backbone fine-tuning, reaches accuracy comparable to these black-box classifiers, and that domain-specific pretraining yields features that are both discriminative and symbolically compressible. Because the resulting rules are extracted from real data and expressed in interpretable terms, they are further used as an instrument to investigate synthetic medical images, providing a human-readable account of which real prototypes and rules a generator reproduces or fails to reproduce, localising where a synthetic image departs from real tissue rather than summarising it with a single score. The framework thus offers a transparent, depth-resolved view of how foundation models organise clinically relevant structure, together with a practical downstream use of the extracted rules.
papers.comment: Accepted at the excv, ECCV 2026 Workshops. 17 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出原型-模糊规则框架，把冻结的 ViT-S/16 foundation model 内层 patch 特征直接转成人类可读的 IF-THEN 规则，无需微调。在无线胶囊内镜、胃肠内镜分类与结肠息肉分割上，其准确率与 kNN、核 SVM、线性探针相当，且 GastroNet-5M 预训练得到的特征既具判别性又可符号压缩；抽出的规则还能定位合成医学图像在何处偏离真实组织。
Motivation: Foundation model 的潜空间如何编码临床相关信息在安全攸关的医学影像领域仍是开放问题，黑盒分类器虽准确却无法给出可读解释。
Method: 在冻结特征上对类内特征聚类学得 class-specific prototypes，把 patch 特征表示为与原型的相似度，再用带语言化 IF-THEN 条件的模糊规则分类；作用于 ImageNet-1K 与 GastroNet-5M 预训练的 ViT-S/16 最后两个 block，并与 kNN、kernel SVM、线性探针在相同冻结特征下对比。
Result: 在无线胶囊内镜分类、胃肠内镜分类与结肠息肉分割三个任务上，不微调 backbone 的该方法准确率与 kNN、核 SVM、线性探针相当；领域特定预训练 (GastroNet-5M) 产出的特征兼具判别性与符号可压缩性。规则被进一步用于检视合成医学图像，逐条给出生成器复现或遗漏了哪些真实原型与规则，定位合成图像偏离真实组织的位置。
Conclusion: 冻结 foundation model 的内层特征可以被原型与模糊规则透明地、按深度分层地解读，且不牺牲分类准确率；抽出的规则可作为检验合成医学图像的可读工具，而非单一分数。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: EchoPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Pruning via Virtual Context Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: KV cache pruning reduces long-context inference memory usage by evicting less important key-value pairs. KVzip estimates importance through context reconstruction: prompting a model to repeat the context chunk by chunk. This achieves strong compression quality at the cost of additional forward passes. Learned approximations reduce this cost but require model-specific training. We analyze how KVzip identifies important cached information and show how to approximate its reconstruction scores using information already computed during prefill. These findings motivate EchoPress, a training-free method that approximates reconstruction attention using queries and keys from standard prefill. For each request, it reconstructs only the first chunk to calibrate importance scores for the remaining context. Experiments on LongBench and RULER with Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct show that EchoPress matches KVzip in task accuracy across eviction ratios from 50% to 90%, while reducing compression overhead by a factor of 1.7-19.6 and total prefill time by a factor of up to 2.9. Code is available at https://github.com/ljwljwljwljw/kvpress/tree/echo-press.

Method: 先分析 KVzip 如何定位关键缓存信息，再用标准 prefill 中已算出的 query 与 key 近似其重建分数；每次请求只重建第一个 chunk，据此校准剩余上下文的重要性分数，全程免训练。

papers.title: VANDAM: Viewing a nucleotide sequence with DNA molecular priors
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs) rely on a DNA-as-a-string paradigm that employs masked token prediction objectives for pretraining. However, this abstraction does not explicitly model the biochemical, structural, and physical properties essential to biological function. Many molecular properties can be estimated from sequence using established biophysical models, so their utility lies not in providing an independent modality, but in introducing priors that training objectives can explicitly exploit. We introduce VANDAM, a framework that extends the training of GFMs with DNA molecular priors. In self-supervised training, VANDAM predicts regional molecular properties from pooled representations. When functional labels are available and can reward retaining molecular priors, local features are additionally injected at the input. VANDAM consistently improves downstream performance across four architecture families and nine held-out genomic tasks by complementing token-based objectives. Probing experiments further demonstrate that the use of molecular priors generalizes to other unseen molecular properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VANDAM 把 DNA 分子性质先验接入基因组基础模型 (GFM) 的训练：自监督阶段从池化表征预测区域分子性质，有功能标签时再把局部特征注入输入。在四个架构家族、九个留出基因组任务上一致提升下游表现，探针实验显示分子先验可泛化到未见过的分子性质。
Motivation: 现有 GFM 用 DNA-as-a-string 的掩码 token 预测预训练，未显式建模决定生物功能的生化、结构与物理性质；而这些性质本可由既有生物物理模型从序列估计，却未被训练目标利用。
Method: VANDAM 在 GFM 训练上叠加 DNA 分子先验：自监督训练中从池化表征预测区域分子性质作为附加目标；当存在能奖励保留分子先验的功能标签时，再把局部特征注入模型输入，与 token 目标互补。
Result: 在四个架构家族 (architecture families) 和九个留出基因组任务 (held-out genomic tasks) 上一致改善下游表现；探针 (probing) 实验证明分子先验的使用可泛化到其他未见过的分子性质。
Conclusion: 分子性质不必作为独立模态，而应作为训练目标显式利用的先验；与 token 目标互补即可跨架构、跨任务提升 GFM，并迁移到未见性质。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RACE: Residual-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Neighbor-Rich Time-Series Foundation Model Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) perform strongly across forecasting tasks, but their per-series inference is ill-suited to neighbor-rich forecasting, where each query has access to related but nonidentical historical series. Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) and Web/cloud workloads exemplify this setting: CGM trajectories share physiological patterns but vary across individuals, devices, and conditions, while Web/cloud workloads combine common operating regimes with non-stationarity, heavy tails, and bursts. These histories share useful structure, yet neighbors are not equally relevant. Existing methods either fine-tune TSFMs for each target domain, incurring additional costs and offering limited transferability across backbones, or append retrieved series without verifying whether they support the current forecast. The key challenges are conflicting residual evidence from neighboring series and residual patterns that vary across TSFMs and forecasting tasks. We formulate test-time neighborhood scaling: using same-domain neighbor evidence without modifying the backbone. We propose RACE (Residual-Aware Correction of Forecasting Errors), a two-stage framework for using historical neighbors. We first retrieve query-compatible neighbors, align their residuals to the query scale, and aggregate coherent evidence into the training-free RACE-TF correction. Full RACE then uses a lightweight, domain-specific Gate to determine when applying the correction is beneficial, with a reusable training workflow across TSFM backbones. Across four TSFMs, RACE improves all three domain-aggregate metrics on both primary domains, with the largest gains on high-error queries. Within each domain, a Gate trained on one TSFM transfers to other backbones without adaptation, and the resulting pipeline improves all 72 cross-backbone metric comparisons over the matched frozen targets.
papers.comment: 25 pages including references and appendices; 8 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RACE 把时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 的逐序列推理改成测试时邻域缩放：检索与查询兼容的同域邻居、把其残差对齐到查询尺度并聚合为免训练的 RACE-TF 修正，再用轻量 Gate 决定是否施加该修正。在 CGM 与 Web/云负载两个领域、四个 TSFM 上，RACE 在两个主领域的三项领域聚合指标全部提升，高误差查询增益最大；Gate 跨骨干零适应迁移，72 项跨骨干指标比较全部优于匹配的冻结目标。
Motivation: TSFM 的逐序列推理用不上同域但非同一的历史序列；现有做法要么逐域微调（成本高且跨骨干迁移差），要么直接拼接检索序列而不验证其是否支撑当前预测，导致邻居残差证据相互冲突。
Method: 两阶段框架：先检索 query-compatible 邻居、将其残差对齐到查询尺度并聚合为免训练的 RACE-TF 修正；再由轻量、领域特定的 Gate 判断何时施加修正，Gate 训练流程可跨 TSFM 骨干复用，全程不修改骨干。
Result: 在四个 TSFM 上，RACE 于 CGM 与 Web/云负载两个主领域的全部三项领域聚合指标均提升，高误差查询增益最大；在单个领域内，用一个 TSFM 训练的 Gate 无需适配即可迁移到其他骨干，最终管线在全部 72 项跨骨干指标比较中优于匹配的冻结目标。
Conclusion: 不改骨干、只在测试时按残差证据缩放邻居信息，就能稳定改进 TSFM 在邻域丰富场景的预测，且修正与 Gate 都可跨骨干复用。

papers.title: The Conflict Between Logic and Memory: Learning Higher-Order Interactions in Shallow MLPs
papers.abstract_en: A network can fit its training examples while failing to recover the rule that generated their labels. We examine this separation in single-hidden-layer multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), using synthetic tasks that control interaction order and the presence of nuisance inputs. We establish elementary benchmark properties: pure parity contains no predictive lower-order marginals, admits an exact Bayes posterior, and can be represented on clean latent inputs by a width-$k$ ReLU network. Experiments then identify distinct optimization outcomes. In a matched order-2--4 sweep, SGD, Adam, and Muon all reach 100\% peak test accuracy at order two; at order three they reach 96.25\%, 50.87\%, and 76.82\%, respectively, while Muon reaches 99.21\% at order four. In a separate mixed-order task, freezing only the first-layer weights connected to independent nuisance inputs raises AdamW's epoch-10 accuracy from 44.73\% to 95.07\%. Removing the same inputs only at test time raises it to 48.38\%. Thus, nuisance-weight learning changes the training outcome beyond its immediate effect on prediction. Bias interventions expose a connection between target symmetry and shallow ReLU representations. In a compact signal-only regime, both SGD and Muon learn orders five through eight, with higher SGD peak accuracy at orders nine through eleven. Together, the results show how optimization and nuisance learning constrain the higher-order rules realized by a shallow network.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在单隐层 MLP 上用可控交互阶数与干扰输入 (nuisance inputs) 的合成任务，区分“拟合训练集”与“恢复生成规则”。阶数 2 时 SGD/Adam/Muon 峰值测试准确率均达 100%，阶数 3 分别为 96.25%/50.87%/76.82%，阶数 4 时 Muon 达 99.21%；仅冻结连接独立干扰输入的首层权重，把 AdamW 第 10 轮准确率从 44.73% 提到 95.07%，而只在测试时移除这些输入仅到 48.38%。
Motivation: 网络能拟合训练样本却未必恢复生成标签的规则；需要在可控交互阶数与干扰输入的合成任务上，弄清优化器与干扰权重学习如何限制浅层网络实现的高阶规则。
Method: 用单隐层 MLP 在合成 parity 任务上做实验，任务可控交互阶数并可注入独立干扰输入；先确立基准性质（pure parity 无可预测的低阶边际、有精确 Bayes 后验、干净潜变量上可被宽度 k 的 ReLU 网络表示），再做 order-2--4 的 SGD/Adam/Muon 对照扫描、混合阶任务中的首层权重冻结与测试期移除干预，以及偏置 (bias) 干预；另设仅信号的紧凑体制下测 order 5--11。
Result: order-2 时 SGD、Adam、Muon 峰值测试准确率均 100%；order-3 分别为 96.25%、50.87%、76.82%；order-4 时 Muon 达 99.21%。混合阶任务中，仅冻结连接独立干扰输入的首层权重使 AdamW epoch-10 准确率从 44.73% 升至 95.07%，仅在测试时移除同样输入只升至 48.38%。信号紧凑体制下 SGD 与 Muon 都学到 order 5--8，order 9--11 上 SGD 峰值准确率更高。
Conclusion: 干扰权重的学习会改变训练结果本身，而不只是即时预测效果；优化器选择与干扰学习共同约束浅层网络最终实现的高阶规则，且该约束随交互阶数与偏置所对应的目标对称性变化。

papers.title: Representation Transitions Reveal Emerging Safety Risks in Multi-Turn LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn attacks on agentic systems can compose individually permissible actions into harmful outcomes, challenging defenses that assess actions or states in isolation. We show that such attacks leave a detectable signature in the agent's internal representations: harmful behavior emerges as an accumulated representation transition across context updates, whose triggering context can be identified from the same signal. We further find that naive aggregation is confounded by benign representation drift, as a contrastive safety direction need not assign zero to benign transitions. We address this by denoising the direction, anchoring benign traffic at zero and removing its leading variation directions, with no runtime cost. These findings motivate DART, a runtime framework that detects and attributes representation shifts and intervenes with targeted reminders. Across six models and two multi-turn benchmarks, DART reduces attack success from 84% to 25% on MT-AgentRisk, catching every attack at a mean false-alarm rate of 12%, and from 97% to 52% on ASEval, at costs in benign non-refusal of 8% and 0%, respectively. On MT-AgentRisk, it outperforms ToolShield, the state-of-the-art multi-turn defense, on all six models: under the same protocol, ToolShield reaches only 55%. Denoising is critical: on ASEval, the undenoised monitor catches only 7%-40% of attacks, while the denoised monitor catches 60%-85%. The same monitor covers single-turn indirect injection without modification and adds only 0.14-0.56 s overhead per monitored step without requiring an auxiliary model, making it a lightweight complement to computation-heavy speculative defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多轮 agent 攻击会在内部表征上留下可检测的累积式表征跃迁 (representation transition)，DART 用去噪后的对比安全方向在运行时检测并归因该跃迁，再插入定向提醒。在六个模型与两个多轮基准上，MT-AgentRisk 攻击成功率从 84% 降到 25%（ToolShield 同协议仅 55%），ASEval 从 97% 降到 52%，平均误报率 12%。
Motivation: 多轮攻击把各自合规的动作组合成有害结果，逐动作或逐状态的孤立评估抓不住；而直接聚合表征方向会被良性漂移混淆，因为对比安全方向对良性跃迁未必输出零。
Method: DART 运行时框架：从跨上下文更新累积的表征跃迁中检测并归因触发上下文，对安全方向做去噪——把良性流量锚定在零并去除其主要变化方向——再施加定向提醒，无额外运行时代价，也不需辅助模型。
Result: 六个模型、两个多轮基准：MT-AgentRisk 攻击成功率 84%→25%，全攻击捕获、平均误报率 12%，良性不拒答代价 8%；ASEval 97%→52%，良性不拒答代价 0%。同协议下 ToolShield 仅达 55%，DART 在全部六个模型上领先。去噪是关键：ASEval 上未去噪监控仅捕获 7%-40% 攻击，去噪后 60%-85%。同一监控器无需修改即可覆盖单轮间接注入，每步开销 0.14-0.56 秒。
Conclusion: 多轮有害行为在表征层面表现为可检测的累积跃迁，去噪后的表征监控能以极低开销把它变成运行时防御，是计算密集型推测式防御的轻量补充。
Relevance: 1
