papers.title: MERID: Multimodal Exploration via Recursive Self-Improvement Agents for Major Depression Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Major depressive disorder (MDD) severely impacts daily activities and quality of life. Detecting MDD involves multimodal data, such as interview recordings and sensor measurements. This is particularly challenging, as these heterogeneous modalities often demand distinct, customized prediction pipelines. Existing efforts to address this challenge have explored both manually engineered multimodal architectures and agent-assisted pipeline development. Despite their progress, it remains challenging to autonomously revise pipelines based on experimental feedback and carry verified improvements forward into subsequent designs. To this end, we propose Multimodal Exploration via Recursive Self-Improvement Agents for Major Depression Analysis (MERID). The framework develops depression pipelines through experience-based recursive self-improvement (RSI). Grounded State Construction (GSC) grounds experience by aligning multimodal records with subject-level depression targets. Coupled Pipeline Exploration (CPE) jointly modifies representations, fusion, and predictors to build successor pipelines for classification and severity estimation. Evidence-Guided Evolution (EGE) guides revisions through feedback and verifies gains under uncertainty in small depression cohorts before inheritance. Extensive experiments on depression benchmarks show that MERID achieves the best results on multiple tasks compared with multimodal and agent-based baselines. Further analysis highlights the value of acoustic and linguistic cues for depression detection. Our code is available at https://github.com/DiscoAILab/MERID
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MERID 用递归自我改进 (RSI) 智能体自动迭代抑郁症多模态流水线：Grounded State Construction 把访谈录音与传感器记录对齐到被试级抑郁标签，Coupled Pipeline Exploration 联动改表征、融合与预测器，Evidence-Guided Evolution 在小样本队列上带不确定性验证增益后再继承。在抑郁基准上其分类与严重度估计任务取得相对多模态与智能体基线的最佳结果，声学与语言线索被进一步分析确认有价值。
Motivation: 抑郁检测依赖访谈录音与传感器等异构模态，各自需要定制流水线；现有手工架构与智能体辅助方法难以依据实验反馈自主修订流水线并把已验证的改进带入后续设计。
Method: 框架含三个组件：GSC 将多模态记录与被试级抑郁目标对齐以构造有依据的经验状态；CPE 联合修改表征、融合与预测器生成后继流水线，覆盖分类与严重度估计；EGE 用反馈引导修订，并在小抑郁队列上于不确定性下验证增益后才允许继承。
Result: 在抑郁基准上，MERID 在多个任务上相对多模态基线与基于智能体的基线取得最佳结果；进一步分析显示声学与语言线索对抑郁检测有价值。
Conclusion: 带验证环节的递归自我改进可以让智能体自主把已确认的流水线改进累积下去，从而改进抑郁的分类与严重度估计。

papers.title: Impact of Patient Orientation in Single- and Multi-View Camera Environments for AI-based Rehabilitation Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Automated quality assessment of rehabilitation exercises relies heavily on accurate human pose estimation from video data. Although numerous RGB-based pose estimation methods have been proposed, the impact of camera placement on detecting clinically relevant movement errors remains insufficiently explored. To address this gap, we introduce REHAB26-ViewAngles, a dataset comprising correct and incorrect rehabilitation exercise executions captured from a wide range of camera angles. Furthermore, we propose a novel separability metric to quantify an algorithm's ability to distinguish between valid and faulty exercise repetitions. Using these tools, we analyze how various RGB-based pose-estimation strategies are suitable for exercise quality assessment under varying camera placements. In particular, we analyze single-camera 2D and 3D pose estimation and four multi-camera strategies: a combination of two orthogonal 2D views, 3D triangulation, weighted 3D fusion, and an AI-based pose-estimation transformer model specifically trained from two synchronized cameras. Our findings reveal that an optimally placed 2D camera can improve the separability by 16.9% over the commonly used 0° frontal view and frequently outperforms single-camera 3D estimation, while combining two views can further improve accuracy by up to 13.1%. These results offer practical guidance for deploying rehabilitation monitoring in both home and clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出康复动作质量评估数据集 REHAB26-ViewAngles（覆盖大范围相机角度的正确/错误动作）与衡量算法区分有效与错误重复能力的可分性 (separability) 指标，用其比较单视角 2D/3D 与四种多视角位姿估计策略。最优摆放的 2D 相机比常用 0° 正面视角提升可分性 16.9%，且常优于单相机 3D 估计；两个视角组合可再提升精度至多 13.1%。
Motivation: RGB 位姿估计方法众多，但相机摆放位置对检测临床相关动作错误的影响研究不足，康复监测部署缺少选视角的依据。
Method: 构建 REHAB26-ViewAngles 数据集（含正确与错误康复动作、多角度拍摄），提出量化有效/错误重复区分能力的可分性指标；比较单相机 2D 与 3D 位姿估计，以及四种多相机策略：两个正交 2D 视角组合、3D 三角化、加权 3D 融合、以及用两台同步相机专门训练的 AI 位姿估计 transformer 模型。
Result: 最优摆放的 2D 相机相对常用 0° 正面视角将可分性提升 16.9%，且常优于单相机 3D 估计；结合两个视角可进一步提升精度至多 13.1%。
Conclusion: 相机摆放对康复动作质量评估的影响可量化，2D 相机优化角度即可超过正面视角与单相机 3D，双视角组合再加精度，为家庭与临床部署提供选位依据。

papers.title: Output-aware Residual Stream Pruning for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Residual stream pruning methods reduce inference cost by shrinking the model's hidden dimension, but existing approaches typically choose these dimensions by minimizing activation reconstruction error. This criterion implicitly treats all perturbation directions as equally important, ignoring the sensitivity of downstream layers. We introduce a sensitivity-aware approach to residual-stream pruning that directly accounts for this direction-dependent sensitivity. Using a second-order approximation to the output KL divergence, we characterize the effect of a residual-stream perturbation through both its activation covariance and the local sensitivity of the model output. The resulting subspace selection objective couples these two quantities, but is difficult to optimize directly. We derive a tractable spectral upper bound that reduces subspace selection to an eigendecomposition of a sensitivity-weighted covariance matrix, retaining the efficiency and structural simplicity of rotation-based pruning methods. Across several instruction-tuned language model families, our method consistently reduces calibration KL divergence relative to activation-only pruning and improves perplexity and downstream task performance over a range of compression levels. Our results show that preserving activation energy alone is insufficient for residual-stream pruning, and that explicitly accounting for how perturbations propagate to the model output provides a more effective criterion for selecting dimensions to remove.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 残差流剪枝 (residual stream pruning) 现有做法按激活重构误差选要删的维度，把所有扰动方向当成同等重要。本文用输出 KL 散度的二阶近似，把方向敏感度与激活协方差耦合进子空间选择目标，并推出可解的谱上界，化为对敏感度加权协方差矩阵的特征分解。在多个 instruction-tuned 语言模型族上，该方法在一系列压缩率下相对 activation-only 剪枝一致降低校准 KL 散度，并改善困惑度与下游任务表现。
Motivation: 残差流剪枝靠缩小隐藏维降低推理成本，但以激活重构误差定维等价于假设各扰动方向等权，忽略了下游层对不同方向的敏感度差异，选出的维度未必对模型输出影响最小。
Method: 对残差流扰动做输出 KL 散度的二阶近似，用激活协方差与模型输出的局部敏感度共同刻画扰动影响；两者耦合的子空间选择目标难以直接优化，作者推导出一个可解的谱上界，把选择问题化为对敏感度加权协方差矩阵做特征分解，保持基于旋转的剪枝方法的效率与结构简洁性。
Result: 在多个 instruction-tuned 语言模型族上，相对 activation-only 剪枝一致降低校准 KL 散度，并在一系列压缩水平 (compression levels) 下改善困惑度 (perplexity) 与下游任务表现。
Conclusion: 仅保留激活能量不足以决定残差流要删的维度；把扰动如何传播到模型输出显式纳入判据，是更有效的维度取舍标准。

papers.title: Unifying Video Tasks via Spatiotemporal Analogy
papers.abstract_en: Adapting video models to new tasks typically requires dedicated data curation and fine-tuning. While visual analogy provides a training-free alternative by specifying tasks in-context, it remains restricted to the image domain. To explore whether analogy-based methods can unify diverse video tasks and generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios, we introduce ViGeo, a framework that extends visual in-context learning to the video domain via spatiotemporal canvas completion. Evaluated on a diverse task taxonomy with a strict train-test split, ViGeo generalizes to unseen video manipulations and zero-shot modalities (e.g., event cameras). Finally, we identify task internalization, where a query format associated with a pretrained task overrides the demonstration, and show that this shortcut can be removed with a small amount of task-unrelated data, highlighting the need to decorrelate prompt format from task identity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ViGeo 把视觉类比 (visual analogy) 的 in-context learning 从图像扩展到视频，用时空画布补全 (spatiotemporal canvas completion) 在无训练条件下指定视频任务。在严格 train-test 划分的任务分类体系上，它能泛化到未见过的视频操作和零样本模态（如 event camera），并识别出“任务内化”现象：与预训练任务绑定的 query 格式会覆盖演示内容，用少量与任务无关的数据即可消除这一捷径。
Motivation: 视频模型适配新任务通常要专门做数据整理和微调；视觉类比虽可免训练、用上下文指定任务，但一直局限于图像域，视频任务与分布外场景无法统一处理。
Method: 提出 ViGeo 框架，把视觉 in-context learning 扩展到视频域，通过 spatiotemporal canvas completion 让演示以时空画布补全的形式给出任务；评测采用覆盖多种视频任务的 taxonomy 并施加严格 train-test split，另用少量 task-unrelated 数据去除 prompt 格式与任务身份的相关性。
Result: 在严格 train-test 划分的多样任务分类体系上，ViGeo 泛化到未见过的视频操作与零样本模态（如 event cameras）；识别出 task internalization——与预训练任务关联的 query 格式会覆盖演示，并证明用少量 task-unrelated 数据可移除该捷径。
Conclusion: 类比式免训练方法可以统一多样视频任务并外推到分布外场景，但必须把 prompt 格式与任务身份解耦，否则演示会被预训练格式捷径压掉。

papers.title: Functional Architecture of European Electricity Trading Markets: Requirements for AI Supported Trading Systems under Regulatory Constraints
papers.abstract_en: European electricity trading in the EU operates as a constrained multi-layer system in which legal design, exchange microstructure, and network physics are executed jointly across forward, day-ahead, intraday, and balancing horizons. This paper develops a functional architecture for AI-supported trading that is aligned with market-coupling mechanics, cross-zonal transfer constraints, and compliance obligations under REMIT, MiFID II, MiFIR, and EMIR. The contribution is a formal system specification composed of a decision-state vector, residual-exposure accounting, constrained optimization objective, executable-action permission gate, and fail-closed AI control logic with auditable records. The analysis maps major Nominated Electricity Market Operator (NEMO) venues and related exchange operators into an operational venue topology and identifies where cross-border coordination fails in practice: interface-level timing, permission heterogeneity, and balancing-layer coupling. The resulting framework proposes how AI can be deployed as a bounded decision component inside regulated market operation with explicit governance, rather than as an unconstrained prediction layer.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文给出欧洲电力交易市场的功能架构规范：把决策状态向量、残余敞口核算、约束优化目标、可执行动作许可门与 fail-closed AI 控制逻辑组合成形式化系统规格，使 AI 只能在 REMIT、MiFID II、MiFIR、EMIR 合规约束内作为有界决策组件运行，而非无约束的预测层。该架构把 NEMO 场所与相关交易所映射为运行拓扑，并定位跨境协调在接口时序、许可异质性与平衡层耦合三处失效。
Motivation: 欧洲电力交易是法律设计、交易所微观结构与网络物理共同执行的多层受限系统，跨境协调在接口时序、许可异质性和平衡层耦合上实际失效，而现有 AI 部署方式缺少与市场耦合机制和合规义务对齐的系统规格。
Method: 提出形式化系统规格，由决策状态向量、残余敞口 (residual-exposure) 核算、约束优化目标、可执行动作许可门 (permission gate) 和带可审计记录的 fail-closed AI 控制逻辑构成；并把主要 Nominated Electricity Market Operator (NEMO) 场所及关联交易所映射为运行场所拓扑 (venue topology)。
Result: 产出为功能架构与形式化系统规格，覆盖 forward、day-ahead、intraday、balancing 四个时序层与跨区传输约束；识别出跨境协调的三类失效点：接口层时序、许可异质性、平衡层耦合。全文为 12 页、1 张表的架构分析。
Conclusion: AI 在受监管的市场运行中应作为带显式治理的有界决策组件部署，而不是无约束的预测层；合规许可门与 fail-closed 逻辑是该架构的硬性前提。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Compliant AI Infrastructure for Regulated Finance: A tiered multi-agent framework with DLT audit trails for financial operations in DACH
papers.abstract_en: We present a compliance-first architecture for AI in regulated finance that treats regulation as an orientation layer rather than a deterministic ruleset. A matrix of regulatory intent and exposure provides a compact classification handle, which a governed policy compiler then maps into concrete prohibitions, obligations and runtime budgets. Prohibitions constrain feasibility and block externalisation, while obligations extend tasks with artefacts that must meet explicit admissibility criteria. Committee activation remains policy-driven and proportionate, preserving efficiency while ensuring supervisory oversight. Evidence, decisions and reason codes are bound to a permissioned DAG with deterministic timestamping, enabling replay, provenance checks and clear attribution of failure. Clause-level legal indexing with effective dates and capability-based agent routing ensure portability across DACH and the wider EU. The result is assurance by construction: compliance is embedded in execution and verifiable by auditors without sacrificing proportionality or transparency.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Published in Swissi AI Journal under CC BY 4.0
papers.journal_ref: Swissi AI Journal, Volume 2025, Article SAIJ-xz3bi3q7fwim (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 DACH 受监管金融的合规优先 AI 架构：把监管意图×暴露矩阵经治理型策略编译器转成禁止项、义务与运行时预算，禁止项约束可行性并阻断外泄，义务为任务附加须满足可接纳性标准的产物，委员会激活按策略按比例触发。证据、决策与理由码绑定到带确定性时间戳的 permissioned DAG，支持回放、溯源与失败归因，实现可审计员验证的 assurance by construction。
Motivation: 受监管金融中把法规当作确定性规则集会导致合规与效率对立：既要可审计的监督与溯源，又不能牺牲按比例的运营效率与跨 DACH/EU 的可移植性。
Method: 以监管意图与暴露矩阵作为分类入口，由 governed policy compiler 映射为具体禁止项、义务与运行时预算；义务扩展任务并附带须满足显式可接纳性标准的产物，委员会激活保持 policy-driven 与 proportionate。证据、决策、理由码绑定到 permissioned DAG 并确定性打时间戳，配合 clause-level 法律索引（含生效日期）与 capability-based agent 路由实现跨 DACH 与 EU 的可移植。
Result: 产出为 assurance by construction：合规内嵌于执行过程，审计员可验证，同时保持 proportionality 与 transparency；架构支持回放、provenance 检查与失败的清晰归因。
Conclusion: 把监管当作 orientation layer 而非确定性规则集，配合 DAG 审计轨迹与能力路由，可在受监管金融中同时做到可审计合规与按比例的运营效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Alignment Forecasting: Predicting Misalignment From Training Data
papers.abstract_en: Training a language model on data with a narrow flaw can sometimes make the model broadly misaligned. Inspecting the data at face value often does not settle whether it will emerge, and today it is caught only after training, by auditing the resulting model. To complement post-hoc audits, we introduce Alignment Forecasting: the task of predicting alignment failures before training. Given a target model, a fine-tuning dataset, and a failure mode such as deception or sycophancy, a forecaster outputs the probability that fine-tuning would meaningfully increase that failure mode. To measure progress on alignment forecasting, we introduce ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH, a benchmark of over 5,000 forecasting questions spanning 17 target models, 32 datasets, and 16 failure modes. Frontier models prompted directly perform poorly on ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH. We therefore propose a forecasting scaffold in which an LLM reads the dataset and rates how strongly and broadly it pushes the model toward misbehavior, and a simple learned model combines that rating with the failure mode's base rate and the target model's prior tendency. This forecasts well above chance, and beats a model fine-tuned on the task and a simple forecaster allowed to see how weaker models behaved after fine-tuning on the same data. Its signals also flag problematic training examples that a frontier-model classifier misses. Filtering those examples out from real post-training data such as UltraChat results in more aligned models on our multiple-choice evaluation in most cases, though the benefit in open-ended conversations is unclear. More progress is needed before forecasts can reliably guide training data curation in practice, but our results suggest that forecasting many alignment failures before training can be tractable in the SFT setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Alignment Forecasting：在微调之前，用「LLM 读数据并打分 + 失败模式基率 + 目标模型先验倾向」的组合脚手架预测微调是否会显著加剧某类对齐失败。在含 5,000 多道题、覆盖 17 个模型、32 个数据集、16 种失败模式的 ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH 上，该脚手架明显高于随机水平，并胜过任务微调模型与可见弱模型事后表现的简单预测器；据此过滤 UltraChat 训练样本后，多数情况下多选评测显示模型更对齐。
Motivation: 训练数据里一处狭窄缺陷有时会让模型整体失准，而肉眼审数据判断不出是否会爆发，今天只能在训练结束后靠审计成品模型发现。
Method: 定义 Alignment Forecasting 任务（输入目标模型、微调数据集与失败模式如 deception/sycophancy，输出微调会显著加剧该失败的概率），并提出脚手架：一个 LLM 阅读数据集、评出它把模型推向不良行为的强度与广度，再由一个简单学习模型把该评分与失败模式基率、目标模型先验倾向组合。
Result: ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH 含 5,000 多道预测题，横跨 17 个目标模型、32 个数据集、16 种失败模式；前沿模型直接提示表现差，脚手架预测明显高于随机并胜过任务微调模型与可看弱模型微调后行为的简单预测器；其信号还能标出前沿模型分类器漏掉的问题训练样本，据此从 UltraChat 中过滤后，多数情况下多选评测更对齐，开放式对话上的收益不明确。
Conclusion: 作者认为在 SFT 设定下训练前预测多种对齐失败是可行的，但要让预测可靠地指导实际训练数据筛选还需更多进展。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 定义 Alignment Forecasting 任务（输入目标模型、微调数据集与失败模式如 deception/sycophancy，输出微调会显著加剧该失败的概率），并提出脚手架：一个 LLM 阅读数据集、评出它把模型推向不良行为的强度与广度，再由一个简单学习模型把该评分与失败模式基率、目标模型先验倾向组合。
summary_sections.result: ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH 含 5,000 多道预测题，横跨 17 个目标模型、32 个数据集、16 种失败模式；前沿模型直接提示表现差，脚手架预测明显高于随机并胜过任务微调模型与可看弱模型微调后行为的简单预测器；其信号还能标出前沿模型分类器漏掉的问题训练样本，据此从 UltraChat 中过滤后，多数情况下多选评测更对齐，开放式对话上的收益不明确。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为在 SFT 设定下训练前预测多种对齐失败是可行的，但要让预测可靠地指导实际训练数据筛选还需更多进展。

papers.title: From Pretraining to Proficiency: Real-World Subtask RL for Long-Horizon Manipulation with Minimal Human Intervention
papers.abstract_en: A pretrained robot foundation policy may execute most of a long-horizon task yet repeatedly fail at a few critical subtasks. Collecting additional full-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) requires operators to repeat behaviors the policy already performs well. Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning offers a promising path to bridge this gap, but existing approaches struggle to solve long-horizon tasks using only sparse rewards. We present PARTS (Policy Adaptation with RL on Targeted Subtasks), a real-world subtask RL framework that concentrates practice at these bottlenecks while allowing training rollouts to proceed with minimal human intervention. The frozen pretrained policy supplies nominal actions throughout execution, while agent-generated selectors and success verifiers activate residual corrections and provide local outcome rewards. These rewards support learning from successful subtasks even when complete-task successes are scarce. Training combines online RL with success-reweighted retraining, and each retrained residual policy is redeployed to collect further experience. Humans identify bottlenecks during setup and perform physical resets when needed. On bimanual YAM and single-arm Franka tasks, PARTS improves complete-task success from 32% to 61% and from 50% to 95%, respectively, using tens of minutes of real-world RL rollouts per task on average. Compared with existing real-world RL fine-tuning methods, PARTS raises full-task success by more than 25% under the same robot-rollout budget while requiring less human involvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PARTS 把真实机器人长程操作的 RL 微调限制在预训练策略反复失败的瓶颈子任务上：冻结的基座策略照常输出名义动作，agent 生成的 selector 与 success verifier 触发残差修正并给出局部结果奖励，使成功子任务可被利用而无需整任务成功。在双臂 YAM 与单臂 Franka 任务上，完整任务成功率分别从 32% 提到 61%、从 50% 提到 95%，平均每任务只需数十分钟真实机器人 rollout。
Motivation: 预训练机器人基座策略能完成长程任务的大部分，却在少数关键子任务上反复失败；为这些失败补采整任务演示做 SFT，操作员要重复已做得很好的行为，而现有 RL 微调方法仅靠稀疏奖励难以解决长程任务。
Method: PARTS（Policy Adaptation with RL on Targeted Subtasks）：冻结预训练策略全程提供名义动作，agent 自主生成的 selector 与 success verifier 激活残差修正并给出局部结果奖励；训练把在线 RL 与按成功重加权的再训练（success-reweighted retraining）结合，每次重训后的残差策略再部署以继续采集经验；人在建置阶段标定瓶颈并按需做物理复位。
Result: 双臂 YAM 任务完整成功率 32% → 61%，单臂 Franka 任务 50% → 95%，平均每任务仅用数十分钟真实机器人 RL rollout；与已有真实世界 RL 微调方法相比，在相同机器人 rollout 预算下完整任务成功率提高超过 25%，且人工介入更少。
Conclusion: 把 RL 练习集中到瓶颈子任务、用局部奖励替代整任务稀疏奖励，可以在极短的真实机器人交互预算和极少人工介入下大幅提升长程操作成功率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SIMLIFE: Pattern Understanding for Long-Horizon Human-Agent Partnership
papers.abstract_en: Understanding humans over long horizons requires agents to infer not only what people need in the moment, but also how routines form, why they repeat, and when they change. We introduce SimLife, a scalable platform for simulating long-term household life with rich visual observations, ground-truth action logs, and synthetic dialogues with audio. Built on SimLife, SimLife-BP evaluates long-context pattern understanding: the ability to infer latent behavioral rules from weeks or months of everyday observations. The benchmark contains 106 episodes averaging 15.49 hours and 38.57 in-game days, and 1,439 question-answer pairs. Each task probes direct, counterfactual, noisy, and inverse reasoning under different levels of rule hints. Evaluating frontier models and architectures, we find that current models often achieve surface-level prediction without comprehensive rule understanding, rely on frequency-based heuristics rather than if-then reasoning over evidence, and struggle to adapt when behavioral patterns change. These findings suggest that long-context pattern understanding remains a major bottleneck for future embodied agents, while SimLife opens a broader space for studying memory, personalization, adaptation, and long-horizon planning in everyday human-AI interaction.
papers.comment: COLM 2026 Learning from Situated and Embodied Interaction Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可扩展的家庭长期生活仿真平台 SimLife，配套长上下文模式理解基准 SimLife-BP：从数周到数月的日常观测中推断潜在行为规则。基准含 106 个 episode（平均 15.49 小时、38.57 个游戏内天）与 1,439 个问答对，覆盖直接、反事实、含噪与逆向四类推理。评测前沿模型发现它们多做表层预测、依赖频次启发式而非 if-then 证据推理，且在行为模式改变时难以适应。
Motivation: 长期理解人类需要推断例程如何形成、为何重复、何时改变，而现有模型在数周到数月尺度的日常观测上缺少衡量规则理解能力的评测载体。
Method: 构建 SimLife 平台，提供丰富视觉观测、真值动作日志与带音频的合成对话；在其上构建 SimLife-BP，按不同规则提示强度设计直接、反事实、含噪、逆向四类任务，评测前沿模型与架构。
Result: 基准含 106 个 episode，平均 15.49 小时、38.57 个游戏内天，共 1,439 个问答对；评测发现当前模型常在表层预测上成功却未真正理解规则，依赖频次启发式而非基于证据的 if-then 推理，并在行为模式变化时适应困难。
Conclusion: 长上下文模式理解仍是具身智能体的主要瓶颈，SimLife 为记忆、个性化、适应与长程规划研究提供可扩展的日常人机交互实验空间。

papers.title: Geometry beneath the Waves: Dense Priors for Sparse-View Underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Underwater 3D reconstruction remains challenging under sparse views, where scattering, absorption, and suspended particles degrade feature correspondences and geometric estimation. Although feed-forward geometry foundation models offer an alternative to conventional Structure-from-Motion, their direct application underwater produces noisy and fragmented geometry that limits subsequent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). We propose a sparse-view underwater reconstruction framework that adapts feed-forward geometry to underwater degradation and exploits its dense geometric priors for view synthesis. First, we adapt VGGT using LoRA and teacher--student distillation, training on synthetically degraded underwater images while preserving clean geometric supervision. This improves robustness to underwater appearance distortions without modifying the pretrained prediction heads. Second, the predicted dense geometry initialises an intermediate 3DGS representation that generates geometry-guided pseudo-views, increasing view overlap and strengthening feature tracks for subsequent RUSplatting optimisation. Experiments on SeaThru-NeRF and Submerged3D demonstrate improved reconstruction quality under sparse-view conditions. On SeaThru-NeRF, our method improves RUSplatting from 24.37 to 27.11 dB PSNR and increases SSIM from 0.7611 to 0.8634, while achieving the best average PSNR and LPIPS on Submerged3D. These results demonstrate the potential of domain-adapted geometric priors for robust sparse-view underwater 3D reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 稀疏视角水下重建中，先用 LoRA 与师生蒸馏把前馈几何基础模型 VGGT 适配到水下退化图像，再用其稠密几何初始化中间 3DGS 生成几何引导伪视图，扩大视角重叠并强化特征轨迹，供 RUSplatting 优化。在 SeaThru-NeRF 上把 RUSplatting 的 PSNR 从 24.37 提到 27.11 dB、SSIM 从 0.7611 提到 0.8634，并在 Submerged3D 上取得最佳平均 PSNR 与 LPIPS。
Motivation: 水下散射、吸收与悬浮颗粒破坏特征对应与几何估计，稀疏视角下尤其严重；直接把前馈几何基础模型用于水下会得到噪声大、碎片化的几何，限制后续 3DGS。
Method: 用 LoRA 与 teacher–student distillation 在合成退化的水下图像上微调 VGGT，同时保留干净几何监督、不改动预训练预测头；预测的稠密几何初始化一个中间 3DGS，生成几何引导伪视图以增加视角重叠和特征轨迹，再送入 RUSplatting 优化。
Result: 在 SeaThru-NeRF 上，RUSplatting 的 PSNR 由 24.37 dB 提升到 27.11 dB，SSIM 由 0.7611 提升到 0.8634；在 Submerged3D 上取得最佳平均 PSNR 与 LPIPS。
Conclusion: 领域适配的稠密几何先验能支撑稳健的稀疏视角水下 3D 重建，前提是先让前馈几何适配水下退化再驱动视图合成。

papers.title: IBBench-Light: A Paired Evaluation of Task-Conditioned Responses to External Directives
papers.abstract_en: An external record may contain a procedure to apply or text to read, depending on the user's request. IBBench-Light tests both uses against the same record. Twelve semantic bases yield 144 matched pairs per model; four quantized instruction models produced 1,152 archived greedy responses. Paired exact-contract accuracy (PECA) requires both members to satisfy their output contracts. Qwen succeeds on 132 execute and 109 process prompts, but only 97 complete pairs, showing what marginal averages omit. We audit literal-target exposure and case normalization, then add 1,722 logged CPU generations to test directive-absent controls, twelve additional semantic bases, within-base wording changes, and generation stopping. In the pinned Phi rerun, changing the end-of-sequence (EOS) set changes exact paired success from 0/144 to 62/144. A bounded IHEval comparison uses the same SmolLM2 checkpoint and output budget while preserving its published instruction roles and scorer. The benchmark measures conditional task and output-contract success. Its task margins and paired count need to be read together with the stopping policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IBBench-Light 用同一条外部记录同时测试「按指令执行」与「按要求处理文本」两种用法，提出配对精确契约准确率 (PECA)：两个成员都满足各自输出契约才算成功。Qwen 在 132 条 execute 与 109 条 process 提示上分别成功，但完整配对仅 97/144，说明边际均值掩盖了配对失败；EOS 集合改动可把 Phi 的配对成功从 0/144 推到 62/144。
Motivation: 同一外部记录既可能含待执行程序也可能含待读文本，按用户请求而定；只报单侧平均准确率会掩盖配对层面的失败，且生成停止策略会显著影响契约达成。
Method: 构建 12 个语义基、每模型 144 个配对样本，4 个量化指令模型以 greedy 生成共 1,152 条归档响应；提出 PECA 指标并审计字面目标暴露与大小写归一化，再追加 1,722 条 CPU 日志生成，覆盖指令缺席对照、12 个额外语义基、基内措辞改写与生成停止；另以同一 SmolLM2 checkpoint 与输出预算做有界 IHEval 对比，保留其已发布的指令角色与评分器。
Result: Qwen 在 132 条 execute 与 109 条 process 提示上成功，完整配对仅 97/144；追加 1,722 条 CPU 生成。固定 Phi 重跑中，改变 EOS 集合使精确配对成功从 0/144 变为 62/144。
Conclusion: 任务边际与配对计数必须与停止策略一起解读，单侧平均会漏掉配对失败；该基准衡量的是条件性任务与输出契约成功。

papers.title: Kernel-Managed Shared Memory for System-Wide Personalization
papers.abstract_en: AI systems become more useful when they can adapt to the people using them, but in multi-agent systems, useful context learned by one agent often remains unavailable to others. We present kernel-managed shared memory, a system-level abstraction in which specialized agents write structured, tagged memories while the agent-system kernel, not individual agents, governs retrieval, privacy enforcement, and prompt injection. We implement and evaluate this design on AIOS and compare it against three alternatives across three assistant models (GPT-4o, Llama-3.1:8B, Qwen-2.5:7B) and 1,800 total trials. Against an unmanaged external memory backend (Mem0) using identical underlying storage, kernel-managed retrieval and injection improve personalization scores by 2.4-4.0 points on a 5-point scale (e.g., 1.05 to 4.69 profile usage on GPT-4o), with every comparison significant at p < 10^-18. Against standard retrieval-augmented injection, gains are similarly large and consistent across all three models. Against full, unfiltered context concatenation, a soft ceiling on available context rather than on response quality, kernel-managed injection statistically matches performance on two of three models and shows a small, model-specific deficit on the third, while using substantially shorter prompts: end-to-end latency is 15-61% lower across all three models, with corresponding reductions in per-call token usage and inference cost. These results indicate that centralizing memory management in the agent-system kernel, rather than leaving retrieval and privacy enforcement to individual agents, delivers most of the personalization benefit of unconstrained context at a fraction of its cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 AIOS 上把多智能体记忆的检索、隐私执行与 prompt 注入收归 agent-system kernel 管理，专用 agent 只写结构化带标签记忆。相对同存储的无管理外部记忆 Mem0，个性化分在 5 分制上提高 2.4–4.0 分（GPT-4o profile usage 1.05→4.69，p<10^-18）；相对全量上下文拼接，三个模型中两个统计打平且端到端延迟低 15–61%。
Motivation: 多智能体系统里一个 agent 学到的有用上下文对其他 agent 不可见，而把检索与隐私执行下放给各 agent 既低效又难管控。
Method: 提出 kernel-managed shared memory：专用 agent 写入结构化、带标签的记忆，由 agent-system kernel 统一负责检索、隐私执行与 prompt 注入；在 AIOS 上实现，与三种替代方案对比，用 GPT-4o、Llama-3.1:8B、Qwen-2.5:7B 共 1,800 次试验评测。
Result: 相对同底层存储的无管理外部记忆 Mem0，kernel 检索与注入使个性化分在 5 分制上提升 2.4–4.0 分（GPT-4o profile usage 1.05→4.69），全部比较 p<10^-18；相对标准 RAG 注入，三个模型上增益同样大且一致；相对全量无过滤上下文拼接，三个模型中两个统计打平、第三个有小幅模型相关劣势，同时端到端延迟低 15–61%，每次调用 token 与推理成本相应下降。
Conclusion: 把记忆管理集中到 agent-system kernel，能在远低于无约束上下文的成本下拿到其大部分个性化收益；相对全量拼接的代价是第三个模型上的小幅性能损失。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Program Learning with Verifiable Rewards: Symbolic Backpropagation for Post-Training LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Post training a language model to reason means updating its weights. Supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning both place the acquired capability inside the model where it cannot be inspected cannot be checked step by step and cannot be moved to another model. We argue that for tasks whose intermediate steps admit verification, reasoning is better placed outside the base models weights as an explicit program composed from deterministic and neural primitives. We introduce PLVR (Program Learning with Verifiable Rewards): a post training method that learns such programs directly from input-output examples. Its mechanism is symbolic backpropagation: each program layer carries a typed ontology a loss is computed at the output against ground truth and required input ontologies are propagated backward by type inference over primitive signatures: an analogue of the chain rule in which credit assignment is a derivation rather than an estimate. Where RLVR verifies a terminal outcome, PLVRs reward is a per step contract verdict dense over program structure. On LiveCodeBench v6 and Tau2Bench, 30B base models with PLVR outperform RL at matched budget by 27.8 points on average and frontier models an order of magnitude larger by 13.6 points. A single primitive library serves two benchmarks, so the marginal cost of a new task is 100 examples of program search and no new finetuning data. Replacing the loss guided search with uniform sampling over the same type admissible space at equal budget collapses the median program from 65.6 to 17.5, identifying the backward pass rather than the type system as the source of the advantage. We release the symbolic backpropagation library and a conformance checker so the method can be applied to primitive libraries other than our own.
papers.comment: Errors in the benchmarks and experimental sections on the baseline numbers. The experiments in the paper are being discarded by the authors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PLVR 把可验证任务的推理从模型权重里搬到外部显式程序，用 symbolic backpropagation：输出对 ground truth 算 loss，再按 primitive 签名做类型推断把所需输入 ontology 反向传播，奖励是逐步 contract verdict 而非仅终局验证。在 LiveCodeBench v6 与 Tau2Bench 上，30B 基座配 PLVR 平均超同预算 RL 27.8 分、超大一个数量级的前沿模型 13.6 分；把 loss 引导搜索换成同预算均匀采样，中位程序分从 65.6 崩到 17.5。
Motivation: SFT 与 RLVR 把能力写进权重，无法逐步检查、无法迁移；且 RLVR 只验证终局结果，中间步骤的信用分配是估计而非推导。
Method: PLVR 从输入输出样例直接学程序：程序层携带 typed ontology，输出端对 ground truth 计算 loss，再对 primitive 签名做类型推断反向传播所需输入 ontology（类型推断版链式法则）；奖励为逐步 contract verdict，稠密覆盖程序结构。同一 primitive 库服务两个 benchmark，新任务只需 100 个样例做程序搜索、无需新微调数据。
Result: LiveCodeBench v6 与 Tau2Bench 上，30B 基座 + PLVR 平均比同预算 RL 高 27.8 分，比大一个数量级的前沿模型高 13.6 分；同 type-admissible 空间内把 loss 引导搜索换成均匀采样（等预算），中位程序从 65.6 降到 17.5。
Conclusion: 优势来自 backward pass 而非 type system；把推理外置为带逐步可验证契约的程序，可让 30B 模型在代码与 agent 基准上超过同预算 RL 与更大前沿模型。注：作者已声明基准与基线数字有误，实验部分正在废弃。

papers.title: TANGO: Treating Tokens as Operators
papers.abstract_en: Transformers separate cross-token mixing in self-attention from token-wise transformation in feed-forward networks. We ask whether combining these operations can lower predictive loss under fixed data and parameter budgets. To do so, we introduce the Token-Aggregated Nonlinear Gating Operator (TANGO) model. TANGO computes a nonlinear feature-wise gate at each source token. Attention averages these gates for each destination. The average modulates a linear projection of the destination and forms the diagonal core of a source-conditioned linear operator. We test this proposal by comparing full-prefix and windowed TANGO with looped and untied Transformers, the Gated Attention Unit (GAU), and Fast Linear Attention with a Single Head (FLASH) on web text, Lean formal mathematics, DeepMind Mathematics, and code. The comparison uses two parameter scales, two depths, and three seeds. Checkpoints are selected on development data and evaluated on held-out test data. At matched parameters and training data, full-prefix TANGO has the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood in all 16 settings. In eight additional combinations of size and dataset, its development loss never increases as depth rises from 4 to 8 to 16, whereas the looped Transformer's loss increases in four. Full-prefix TANGO is computationally expensive because it averages wide gates over every visible source. To reduce this cost, we evaluate a variant with three narrower gated-projection sets assigned to the first, middle, and last applications. Across four FineWeb-Edu settings, this variant achieves 3.26 to 3.45 times the throughput of TANGO and 75% to 96% that of the looped Transformer. Its mean development negative log-likelihood is lower than TANGO's in three settings and 0.023 higher in the fourth, while remaining lower than both Transformer baselines in all four.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 1 figure, 15 numbered tables. Updated with depth-16 results and a faster three-projection-set TANGO variant
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TANGO 把自注意力的跨 token 混合与前馈的逐 token 变换合并：在每个源 token 上算一个非线性 feature-wise gate，注意力对 gate 取平均后调制目标 token 的线性投影，构成 source-conditioned 线性算子的对角核。在匹配参数与训练数据的 16 个设置（两种参数规模、两种深度、三个种子，web 文本、Lean 形式化数学、DeepMind Mathematics、代码）中，full-prefix TANGO 的平均测试负对数似然全部最低；深度从 4→8→16 时其开发损失在另外 8 个规模×数据集组合中从不上升，而 looped Transformer 有 4 个上升。
Motivation: Transformer 把跨 token 混合与逐 token 变换分开，作者要问在固定数据与参数预算下，把两者合并能否降低预测损失。
Method: TANGO 在每个源 token 上计算非线性 feature-wise gate，注意力为每个目标 token 对这些 gate 取平均，用该平均值调制目标 token 的线性投影并形成 source-conditioned 线性算子的对角核；对比 full-prefix 与 windowed 两种形式，基线为 looped/untied Transformer、Gated Attention Unit (GAU)、Fast Linear Attention with a Single Head (FLASH)，在 web 文本、Lean、DeepMind Mathematics、代码上以两种参数规模、两种深度、三个种子比较，开发集选 checkpoint、留出测试集评估。
Result: 匹配参数与训练数据下，full-prefix TANGO 在全部 16 个设置中平均测试负对数似然最低；在另外 8 个规模×数据集组合中，其开发损失随深度 4→8→16 从不上升，looped Transformer 有 4 个上升。针对全前缀平均宽 gate 的高开销，提出三组更窄的 gated-projection（分别用于第一、中间、最后一次应用）：在 4 个 FineWeb-Edu 设置上吞吐为 TANGO 的 3.26–3.45 倍、达到 looped Transformer 的 75%–96%，平均开发负对数似然在 3 个设置低于 TANGO、第 4 个高 0.023，且在全部 4 个设置仍低于两个 Transformer 基线。
Conclusion: 在固定数据与参数预算下，把注意力混合与逐 token 变换合成 source-conditioned 线性算子能一致降低测试损失并改善随深度的可扩展性，代价是全前缀平均的计算开销，需用窄 gate 投影集变体换取吞吐。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Prof-K: Probabilistic One-Pass Filtering for Efficient Top-k Selection
papers.abstract_en: Top-k selection is a fundamental computational primitive with applications spanning databases, information retrieval, signal processing, and modern machine learning workloads, including sparse activations and attention pruning. As data sizes grow, existing approaches become inefficient: exact methods incur high memory and compute overhead, while approximate methods often rely on brittle heuristics that degrade under adversarial or heavy-tailed inputs. In this paper, we introduce Prof-K, a fast, scalable, and distribution-agnostic algorithm for exact top-k selection. Prof-K performs a single-pass filtering procedure: a small random sample estimates an adaptive threshold, the N input elements are streamed once into a compact buffer, and an exact top-k routine on this buffer recovers the true top-k elements on the first attempt with probability at least $1-\varepsilon$, where $\varepsilon>0$ is user specified. We derive high-probability guarantees for correctness and buffer size, together with an approximately optimal sample size that minimizes overhead as a function of N and k. Empirically, Prof-K achieves 1.5x-15x speedups over the highly optimized PyTorch topk and recent RadiK implementations, with the largest gains in the large-scale, small-to-moderate-k regime where prior methods struggle most. Unlike previous approaches, these guarantees hold independently of the input distribution, ensuring robustness to adversarial settings. A run-time check detects the rare failures and triggers a retry, so the returned set is always exact and $\varepsilon$ bounds only the probability of requiring an additional pass. We further demonstrate its impact on training BatchTopK Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), where top-k selection constitutes a significant portion of the training cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Prof-K 用小随机样本估自适应阈值，把 N 个元素单次流式压进紧凑缓冲区，再对缓冲区跑精确 top-k，以至少 1−ε 概率一次命中真实 top-k；运行时检查捕获罕见失败并触发重试，因此返回集合始终精确，ε 只约束需要额外一遍的概率。在 PyTorch topk 与 RadiK 上取得 1.5x–15x 加速，最大增益出现在大规模、中小 k 场景，并用于降低 BatchTopK Sparse Autoencoder 训练开销。
Motivation: top-k 是数据库、检索、信号处理与稀疏激活、注意力剪枝的公共底层操作；数据规模变大后精确方法内存与算力开销高，近似方法依赖脆弱启发式，在对抗或重尾输入下退化。
Method: 单遍过滤 (single-pass filtering)：小随机样本估计自适应阈值，N 个输入流式写入紧凑缓冲区，缓冲区上跑精确 top-k 例程；推导正确性与缓冲区大小的高概率保证，以及随 N、k 变化的近似最优样本量；运行时检查失败并重试一遍。
Result: 相对高度优化的 PyTorch topk 与近期 RadiK 实现取得 1.5x–15x 加速，增益在大规模、中小 k 区间最大；正确性概率至少 1−ε，保证与输入分布无关，覆盖对抗设定；在 BatchTopK Sparse Autoencoder 训练中展示其影响，top-k 占训练成本相当部分。
Conclusion: 分布无关的单遍采样阈值过滤可以在保持精确返回的前提下大幅削减 top-k 开销，ε 只控制是否需要第二遍，因此对抗或重尾输入不再使结果失真。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Quantifying Diversity of Thought: A Predictive Law of Weighted LLM Ensemble Lift
papers.abstract_en: This paper provides an experimentally verified formal law for calculating the uplift that diversity of thought provides in Large Language Model (LLM) ensembles. From first principles, we derive an exact decomposition of LLM ensemble lift into rescue and damage masses, which yields a compact heuristic for calculating uplift. From this we extract the metrics which predict ensemble performance: an accuracy-adjusted correctness correlation, $φ_{\mathrm{adj}}$, together with the accuracy gap and collective accuracy of the pair. We test the law on 767,520 inferences from ten open-weight models over two graduate-level science benchmarks, together with a novel agentic cybersecurity benchmark in which each model conducts digital-forensics investigations by multi-turn tool use in a network-isolated sandbox (23,520 graded trials including abstentions); all votes are released openly. Calibrated once on SuperGPQA at a 40:60 vote split, the heuristic predicts lift on the calibration set with Spearman's $ρ=0.84$ and, with its coefficients frozen, transfers to two datasets never used in calibration ($ρ=0.51$ on GPQA Diamond and $0.84$ on the forensic tasks), whilst the measured swap mass tracks realised lift with $R^2\ge 0.96$ throughout. Raw $φ$ has almost no predictive power ($R^2\le 0.09$ throughout); the accuracy-adjusted $φ_{\mathrm{adj}}$ is markedly superior ($R^2=0.67$ on SuperGPQA), and the heuristic combining these metrics is the most stable pre-pooling predictor across the three datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文从第一性原理把 LLM 集成的提升 (ensemble lift) 精确分解为 rescue mass 与 damage mass，据此给出一个用准确率校正后的正确性相关 φ_adj、准确率差与集体准确率预测集成增益的启发式。在 767,520 次推理上，SuperGPQA 以 40:60 投票划分校准后 Spearman ρ=0.84，系数冻结后迁移到 GPQA Diamond ρ=0.51、取证任务 ρ=0.84；原始 φ 几乎无预测力 (R²≤0.09)，φ_adj 在 SuperGPQA 上 R²=0.67。
Motivation: LLM 集成能否带来提升此前缺少可事前计算的定量规律，只能事后试投票；需要一个在池化前就能预测 lift、且能跨数据集迁移的指标。
Method: 从第一性原理推导集成 lift 到 rescue/damage mass 的精确分解，导出启发式；核心预测量为准确率校正的正确性相关 φ_adj，加上准确率差与集体准确率。在十个开源权重模型、两个研究生科学基准与一个网络隔离沙箱中的多轮工具使用数字取证基准上测试，全部投票公开。
Result: 共 767,520 次推理，取证基准含 23,520 次含弃权的评分试验。SuperGPQA 40:60 划分校准后启发式预测 lift 的 Spearman ρ=0.84；系数冻结后在未参与校准的 GPQA Diamond 上 ρ=0.51、取证任务上 ρ=0.84。测得的 swap mass 与实际 lift 的 R²≥0.96；原始 φ 的 R²≤0.09，φ_adj 在 SuperGPQA 上 R²=0.67，结合这些指标的启发式是三个数据集上最稳定的池化前预测器。
Conclusion: 集成提升可由 φ_adj 加准确率差与集体准确率在池化前预测，且校准一次即可跨数据集迁移；原始相关系数 φ 因未做准确率校正而几乎无预测力。

papers.title: BG4Sea: Biogeochemical Seasonal Forecastability via Progressive Information Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Marine biogeochemical forecasting is increasingly important for managing marine ecosystems and the carbon cycle, yet global, seasonal forecast products lag far behind physical oceanography, held back by the complexity of the processes involved and by data scarcity. We introduce BG4Sea, which to our knowledge is the first global, data-driven system to produce multivariate seasonal forecasts of the marine biogeochemical state. BG4Sea is a modular architecture with a column autoencoder that compresses the vertical column into a low-dimensional latent space, a latent forecaster propagates this representation forward in time, a surface-forcing conditioner that injects physical boundary information via Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM), and a horizontal-coupling module that incorporates neighboring-column context through cross-attention. The model is trained and evaluated on the global ocean reanalysis BIORYS4 (NEMO/PISCES), and produces six-month forecasts at 1/4 degree, monthly resolution for dissolved chemistry, biology, and carbon-pool variables, outperforming persistence and climatology across most variables and lead times. We position BG4Sea as an interpretable baseline for future, more expressive approaches, and discuss predictability attribution to each component, alongside the model's structural limitations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BG4Sea 是首个全球数据驱动的海洋生物地球化学季节预报系统，用列自编码器把垂直柱压到低维潜空间，潜空间预报器向前推进，FiLM 表面强迫调节器注入物理边界条件，cross-attention 水平耦合模块引入邻近列上下文。在 BIORYS4 (NEMO/PISCES) 全球海洋再分析上训练并检验，输出 1/4 度、月分辨率的六个月预报，覆盖溶解化学、生物与碳库变量，在多数变量和时效上超过持续性 (persistence) 与气候态 (climatology) 基线。
Motivation: 全球海洋生物地球化学季节预报产品远落后于物理海洋学，原因是过程复杂且数据稀缺，缺少可用的多变量季节预报基线。
Method: 模块化架构：列自编码器压缩垂直柱到低维潜空间，latent forecaster 在潜空间做时间推进，surface-forcing conditioner 用 Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) 注入物理边界信息，horizontal-coupling 模块用 cross-attention 融合邻近柱上下文；在 BIORYS4 (NEMO/PISCES) 全球海洋再分析上训练与评估。
Result: 产出 1/4 度、月分辨率、六个月时效的多变量预报（溶解化学、生物、碳库），在多数变量和时效上优于 persistence 与 climatology；摘要还给出各组件的可预报性归因 (predictability attribution) 讨论。
Conclusion: BG4Sea 被定位为可解释的基线，供后续更具表达力的方法对照，作者同时讨论其结构性局限。

papers.title: New Snake-in-the-Box Records via Snakepit Surgery and Learned Construction
papers.abstract_en: The snake-in-the-box problem asks for a longest induced path in the hypercube graph $Q_n$. We find a length-191 snake in dimension $n=9$, the lowest dimension where the maximum is unknown, improving the previous record of 190 that had stood for 14 years. We also establish new lower bounds in dimensions 10-13. To find these records, we introduce snakepits, collections of disjoint snakes, to expand the search space and open new routes between snakes. This motivates our new Snakepit-in-the-Box benchmark, which seeks maximal edge counts when allowing multiple components. Finally, we introduce Beam Anchor, a search-supervised learned constructor algorithm that finds 100 inequivalent length-190 snakes in dimension 9.
papers.comment: Updated to include detailed information about methods. 23 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在超立方体图 Q_n 中找最长诱导路径的 snake-in-the-box 问题上，用 snakepit surgery（把搜索空间扩为互不相交的 snake 集合以开辟新路径）与搜索监督的学习式构造器 Beam Anchor，把 n=9 的纪录从保持 14 年的 190 提到 191，并给出 n=10–13 的新下界。
Motivation: n=9 是 snake-in-the-box 最大长度仍未知的最低维度，纪录 190 已停滞 14 年；单条 snake 的搜索空间受限，缺少在不同 snake 之间开辟新路线的机制。
Method: 引入 snakepits（互不相交的 snake 集合）扩展搜索空间并提出 Snakepit-in-the-Box benchmark（允许多分量时求最大边数）；另提出搜索监督的学习式构造算法 Beam Anchor。
Result: n=9 找到长度 191 的 snake，超过保持 14 年的 190 纪录；n=10–13 建立新下界；Beam Anchor 在 n=9 找到 100 条互不等价的长度 190 snake。
Conclusion: 把搜索空间从单条 snake 扩到 snake 集合、并用搜索监督的构造器，可以突破长期停滞的 snake-in-the-box 纪录并给出多维下界。

papers.title: ManifoldFlow: SPD-Relaxed Stiefel Layers with Learnable Singular Spectrum
papers.abstract_en: Orthogonal and Stiefel layers give neural weights exact spectral control, but they also impose a strong modeling constraint: all represented singular values are fixed at one. Many settings that benefit from an orthonormal basis still need direction-dependent attenuation or amplification. We introduce ManifoldFlow, a minimal relaxation of a fixed-spectrum Stiefel layer that keeps the basis on the Stiefel manifold while learning a bounded positive spectrum through W = Q S^{1/2}, with Q^T Q = I and S positive definite. Since W^T W = S, the eigenvalues of S are exactly the squared singular values of the realized weight, making eigenvalue clipping a direct singular-value control mechanism. Across paired sequence, tabular, and image experiments, the learnable SPD spectrum improves the fixed-spectrum Stiefel counterpart in the reported settings where the Stiefel prior is useful, with the largest gains in recurrent language-model projections. Boundary cases in convolutional classifier heads clarify the intended scope: ManifoldFlow is not a universal dense-layer replacement, but a spectrum-learnable Stiefel relaxation for settings where an orthonormal basis is a useful prior. When the basis should be orthonormal, its spectrum need not be frozen. Code available at https://github.com/Hik289/manifold_flow
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ManifoldFlow 把奇异值全固定为 1 的 Stiefel 层放松为 W = Q S^{1/2}：基底仍约束在 Stiefel 流形上，S 为可学习的有界正定谱，于是 S 的特征值恰是权重的平方奇异值，特征值裁剪 (eigenvalue clipping) 直接成为奇异值控制手段。在成对的序列、表格与图像实验中，可学习谱在 Stiefel 先验有用的设定下优于固定谱对照，增益最大的是循环语言模型投影；卷积分类头上的边界情形说明它不是通用稠密层替代品。
Motivation: 正交/Stiefel 层给出精确谱控制，但把所有奇异值钉死为 1，无法表达方向相关的衰减或放大，而许多场景既想要正交基底又需要可调谱。
Method: 保持 Q^T Q = I 的 Stiefel 基底，通过 W = Q S^{1/2} 学习有界正定谱 S，使 W^T W = S；以特征值裁剪作为直接的奇异值控制机制，在成对 (paired) 的序列、表格与图像任务上与固定谱 Stiefel 对照比较。
Result: 在报告的设定中，可学习 SPD 谱在 Stiefel 先验有用的场景下改进了固定谱 Stiefel 对照，增益最大的是循环语言模型投影 (recurrent language-model projections)；卷积分类头上的边界情形界定了适用范围。
Conclusion: 当基底应当正交归一时，其谱不必被冻结；ManifoldFlow 是面向「正交基是有用先验」场景的谱可学习 Stiefel 放松，而非通用稠密层替代。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Constrained Flow Matching via Lagrangian Dual Flows
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching is a powerful tool for generative modeling, but emerging applications in robotics, planning, and control require inference-time constraints on generated outputs. Such constraints are often complex and highly nonlinear. As a result, methods designed for linear constraints like image inpainting are rarely sufficient, and projection or optimization-based alternatives can be prohibitively expensive. In this paper, we introduce Lagrangian Dual Flows, a new family of constrained generation techniques based on Lagrangian dual dynamics. By flowing a dual co-state alongside generated samples, we can guarantee nonlinear constraint satisfaction without expensive optimization subproblems, pseudoinverses, or projection steps during the denoising process. The resulting constrained generation algorithms are simple, effective, and open new theoretical connections between flow matching and primal-dual methods in numerical optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Lagrangian Dual Flows：在 flow matching 去噪过程中沿生成样本同步演化一个对偶协态 (dual co-state)，用拉格朗日对偶动力学在推理时满足复杂非线性约束，无需优化子问题、伪逆或投影步骤。该方法面向机器人、规划与控制中的推理时约束生成，并在 flow matching 与数值优化的 primal-dual 方法之间建立理论联系。
Motivation: 机器人、规划与控制等应用要求生成输出在推理时满足复杂且高度非线性的约束；面向线性约束的图像修补类方法往往不够用，而投影或基于优化的替代方案代价可能过高。
Method: 基于拉格朗日对偶动力学构造一族约束生成技术：在去噪过程中让对偶协态与生成样本并行流动，通过 primal-dual 动力学直接施加非线性约束，避免优化子问题、伪逆与投影。
Result: 给出的是一族算法与理论构造：保证非线性约束满足，且去噪过程中不含优化子问题、伪逆或投影步骤；摘要未给出定量实验数字。
Conclusion: 约束生成可以通过对偶协态的联合流动来实现非线性约束满足，从而把 flow matching 与数值优化中的 primal-dual 方法联系起来，绕开昂贵的投影与优化开销。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: ACE: Agentic Control for Embodied Manipulation via Zero-shot Workflow Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose manipulation requires both semantic reasoning over task constraints and reliable execution of contact-rich actions. We present ACE, an agentic manipulation harness that composes a high-level language agent with a reusable mask-conditioned visuomotor policy. Given an open-ended instruction, the agent solves semantic constraints, binds objects to destination roles, and decomposes the task into executable transfers represented by tracked pick-and-place masks. Execution feedback supports outcome assessment, re-grounding, and retry, while persistent object and task context preserves earlier associations when manipulation changes visible cues. We evaluate ACE on two physical multi-step tabletop tasks, Semantic Formula Assembly and Constraint Retrieval. The visuomotor policy is trained only on generic pick-and-place demonstrations and reused without complete demonstrations of either evaluation task, enabling task-level zero-shot composition. Across 20 randomized trials per task, ACE achieves 70% and 80% success, respectively, compared with 55% and 70% without persistent context. These results suggest that an agentic harness can extend a primitive-trained manipulation policy to semantically distinct tasks through explicit object-destination interfaces and closed-loop execution feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACE 把高层语言 agent 与可复用的 mask 条件视觉运动策略 (mask-conditioned visuomotor policy) 组合：agent 解析语义约束、把物体绑定到目标角色、分解为带跟踪 pick-and-place mask 的可执行转移，执行反馈支持结果评估、重接地与重试，持久化物体与任务上下文在外观线索被操作改变后仍保留早期关联。在两个物理多步桌面任务上各 20 次随机试验，成功率 70% 与 80%，去掉持久上下文后为 55% 与 70%。
Motivation: 通用操作既要对任务约束做语义推理，又要可靠执行接触密集动作；只在通用 pick-and-place 演示上训练的原语策略难以迁移到语义不同的多步任务。
Method: 语言 agent 解析开放式指令、绑定物体到目标角色并把任务分解为由跟踪 pick-and-place mask 表示的转移；执行反馈闭环支持结果评估、重接地与重试，持久化物体/任务上下文跨步骤保留关联；视觉运动策略仅用通用 pick-and-place 演示训练，两个评测任务均无完整演示即复用，实现任务级 zero-shot 组合。
Result: 在 Semantic Formula Assembly 与 Constraint Retrieval 两个物理多步桌面任务上各 20 次随机试验，ACE 成功率分别为 70% 与 80%；去掉持久上下文的对照为 55% 与 70%。

papers.title: SPIRAL: Learning to Search and Aggregate
papers.abstract_en: Language model reasoning can be substantially improved at test time via scaffolds that scale inference compute across different primitives -- sequential reasoning within a trace, independently sampled parallel traces, and aggregation of multiple reasoning traces into a final response. During post-training, however, language models are optimized only for sequential reasoning within a single trace. We introduce Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning (SPIRAL), a framework in which a language model is trained to use all three primitives, as part of a unified inference compute pipeline. Concretely, the language model first samples a set of independent traces in parallel, each produced through sequential chain-of-thought reasoning, and then generates a final aggregation trace conditioned on those traces; all components are optimized end-to-end against the reward of the final aggregated response. To train this system, SPIRAL uses set reinforcement learning to teach models to produce a set of traces that are collectively useful for an aggregator and standard reinforcement learning to teach models to aggregate the set into improved final responses. Our experiments on reasoning tasks show that SPIRAL effectively scales with inference compute, outperforming GRPO by up to 11$\times$ scaling efficiency and 15% higher performance when all three compute primitives are scaled.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPIRAL 把测试时脚手架的三种推理原语（单轨迹内顺序推理、并行独立采样、多轨迹聚合）搬进后训练，用 set RL 训练模型产出对聚合器有用的轨迹集合，再用标准 RL 训练聚合，全链路针对最终聚合回答的奖励端到端优化。在推理任务上，三种原语同时扩展时性能比 GRPO 高 15%，扩展效率最高达 11 倍。
Motivation: 测试时脚手架已能靠顺序、并行、聚合三种原语扩展推理算力，但后训练阶段模型只被优化单条轨迹内的顺序推理，另外两种原语从未进入训练目标。
Method: SPIRAL（Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning）：语言模型先并行采样一组各自含 chain-of-thought 的独立轨迹，再以这些轨迹为条件生成最终聚合轨迹；用 set reinforcement learning 教模型产出对聚合器集体有用的轨迹集合，用标准 RL 教模型把该集合聚合成更好的最终回答，所有组件针对最终聚合回答的奖励端到端优化。
Result: 在推理任务实验中，当顺序、并行、聚合三种推理算力原语同时扩展时，SPIRAL 相对 GRPO 性能高出 15%，扩展效率最高达到 GRPO 的 11 倍。
Conclusion: 把并行采样与聚合一起纳入后训练目标，可以让语言模型真正随推理算力扩展而持续提升，而不只优化单条轨迹。

papers.title: MINCE: Shrinking LLM Evaluation Datasets via Few-Model Monte Carlo Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating LLMs across many model variants---quantized, fine-tuned, or deployment-specific---requires running large benchmarks repeatedly, a process that can take tens of hours per model on edge hardware such as NPUs. Existing subset selection methods reduce this cost but depend on large calibration pools or learned prediction layers. We introduce MINCE (Monte Carlo Informed N-sizing for Compact Evaluation), which uses Monte Carlo simulation over per-item logs from a small set of calibration models to find the minimum subset size that bounds accuracy drift and then fixes a randomly sampled subset at that size, with no prediction layer needed. MINCE reduces IFEVAL by 54\%, MMLU by 89\%, GSM8K by 70\%, and MMLU-Pro by 88\% with maximum drift $\leq$2.62\,pp on BF16 calibration models. The frozen subsets generalize to held-out GPU models with mean drift $\leq$1.40\,pp and to INT4 NPU models with mean drift of 0.77--3.59\,pp, while delivering evaluation speedups of up to 8.1$\times$ on the GPU models and evaluation speedups of 1.7--3.4$\times$ on the NPU models. The method is robust to calibration pool size and achieves lower drift than tinyBenchmarks (12$\times$ lower on MMLU, 3.3$\times$ on GSM8K) while using 42$\times$ fewer calibration models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MINCE 用少量校准模型的逐题日志做 Monte Carlo 模拟，定出能约束准确率漂移的最小子集规模，再固定该规模的随机子集，无需预测层。IFEVAL 缩减 54%、MMLU 89%、GSM8K 70%、MMLU-Pro 88%，BF16 校准模型上最大漂移 ≤2.62 pp；冻结子集在留出 GPU 模型上平均漂移 ≤1.40 pp、INT4 NPU 上 0.77–3.59 pp，GPU 加速最高 8.1×、NPU 1.7–3.4×。
Motivation: LLM 要在量化、微调、部署专用等大量变体上反复跑基准，边缘 NPU 上单模型可耗时数十小时；已有子集选择方法依赖大校准池或学习式预测层。
Method: MINCE (Monte Carlo Informed N-sizing for Compact Evaluation)：对少量校准模型的 per-item 日志做 Monte Carlo 模拟，求出能界定 accuracy drift 的最小子集规模，再在该规模上固定一个随机采样子集，不需要预测层。
Result: 缩减幅度：IFEVAL 54%、MMLU 89%、GSM8K 70%、MMLU-Pro 88%；BF16 校准模型最大漂移 ≤2.62 pp。冻结子集在留出 GPU 模型上平均漂移 ≤1.40 pp，INT4 NPU 模型上 0.77–3.59 pp；评测加速 GPU 最高 8.1×、NPU 1.7–3.4×。对校准池规模稳健，漂移低于 tinyBenchmarks：MMLU 低 12×、GSM8K 低 3.3×，且校准模型数少 42×。
Conclusion: 少量校准模型加 Monte Carlo 定尺寸即可把评测集压到原规模的一到两成而保持漂移受控，比依赖大校准池的 tinyBenchmarks 更省校准模型。

papers.title: Masked Self-Distillation: Internalizing the Chain-of-Thought in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models produce long, explicit chains of intermediate steps before generating a final answer at inference time. These intermediate traces dominate latency, memory usage, and serving cost, even though final answer correctness is not causally related to the trace correctness and the trace length is not a reliable indicator of the problem complexity. This raises an obvious question: can the computation expressed in these intermediate tokens be internalized into the parameters of a language model, enabling it to produce answers with much shorter intermediate traces? We propose masked self-distillation, a knowledge-distillation based post-training framework in which copies of the same model are instantiated as teacher and student, and the student model is trained to internalize all or part of the intermediate trace, thus becoming more efficient at inference. We vary the fraction of intermediate trace the student is trained to internalize, interpolating between full internalization and no internalization. We conduct controlled experiments on two reasoning domains: math and graph coloring. We use the masked self-distillation framework to post-train Qwen3-4B & 8B models. Our results demonstrate that this method can be used to improve task performance while increasing inference efficiency across various domains and model sizes. We systematically analyze whether improved efficiency gain in the post-trained models generalize to OOD problems. We find that masked self-distillation models generalize well for in-domain OOD problems, and the masked self-distillation training does not induce catastrophic forgetting in the student model on out-of-domain problems. Furthermore, our ablation study shows that supervised fine-tuning can train models to produce shorter traces, but at the cost of generalization, highlighting the importance of on-policy training in masked self-distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 masked self-distillation：把同一模型复制为 teacher 与 student，用知识蒸馏后训练让学生把全部或部分显式思维链 (CoT) 内化进参数，从而缩短推理时的中间轨迹。在数学与图着色两个推理域上对 Qwen3-4B/8B 后训练，任务性能提升且推理效率提高，in-domain OOD 泛化良好、无灾难性遗忘；消融显示监督微调也能缩短轨迹但以泛化为代价，凸显 on-policy 训练的重要性。
Motivation: 大推理模型的长显式中间轨迹主导延迟、显存与服务成本，而最终答案正确性与轨迹正确性无因果关系，轨迹长度也不反映问题复杂度。
Method: masked self-distillation 框架：同一模型实例化为 teacher 与 student，student 被训练内化全部或部分中间轨迹，内化比例在完全内化与完全不内化之间插值；对 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 做后训练，并在数学与图着色两个推理域上做受控实验与消融（对比监督微调）。
Result: 在数学与图着色上，masked self-distillation 后训练的 Qwen3-4B/8B 在多个域与模型规模上同时提升任务性能与推理效率；对 OOD 的系统分析显示 in-domain OOD 泛化良好，且不引发 out-of-domain 灾难性遗忘；消融中监督微调可让模型产出更短轨迹但损害泛化。
Conclusion: 把中间计算内化进参数可以同时换来更短轨迹与更好的任务表现，而这一收益依赖 on-policy 训练——只靠监督微调缩短轨迹会牺牲泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Analyzing Defensive Misdirection Against Model-Guided Automated Attacks on Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems increasingly rely on language-model components to interpret instructions, process external data, invoke tools, and coordinate with other agents. These capabilities make prompt-injection and jailbreak attacks more consequential, especially as attackers adopt model-guided automation to scale probing, prompt refinement, and response evaluation. This work analyzes the resulting attack-defense setting through a probabilistic model of a target system, its defense mechanism, and the attacker's automated judge. Our analysis shows that conventional detect-and-block defenses can allow attacker success rate (ASR) to approach one as the query budget grows, since predictable refusals provide useful feedback to automated search. We then examine detect-and-misdirect, where detected malicious interactions receive controlled, non-operational responses designed to induce false-positive errors in the attacker's judge. This strategy reduces the positive predictive value of attacker-selected candidates and yields a bounded asymptotic ASR. We evaluate a proof-of-concept realization of this strategy through Contextual Misdirection via Progressive Engagement (CMPE), a lightweight conversational misdirection method designed to replace predictable refusal text with safe but strategically misleading responses in automated jailbreak settings. On jailbreak benchmarks, CMPE reduces estimated ASR upper bounds by up to two orders of magnitude and nearly eliminates verified attack success in end-to-end experiments with PAIR, GPTFuzz, and AutoDAN-Turbo.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 42nd IEEE Annual Computer Security Applications Conference (ACSAC 2026). Final Edits (camera-ready). Keywords: LLM security, Agentic AI security, Jailbreak attacks, Prompt injection, Cyber deception
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对模型引导的自动化越狱攻击，证明 detect-and-block 类防御在查询预算增长时攻击成功率 (ASR) 会趋近 1，因为可预测的拒绝反而给自动搜索提供反馈；改用 detect-and-misdirect，对检出的恶意交互返回受控、非操作性的误导回复以污染攻击者 judge，可得到有界的渐近 ASR。概念验证方法 CMPE 在越狱基准上把估计的 ASR 上界最多降低两个数量级，在 PAIR、GPTFuzz、AutoDAN-Turbo 端到端实验中几乎消除经验证的攻击成功。
Motivation: 攻击者用模型引导的自动化来规模化探测、改写提示与评估回复，使 prompt injection 与 jailbreak 的搜索预算大幅上升；可预测的拒绝防御在这种自动搜索下会把 ASR 推向 1。
Method: 先对目标系统、防御机制与攻击者自动 judge 建立概率模型，比较 detect-and-block 与 detect-and-misdirect 两种策略；再实现 CMPE (Contextual Misdirection via Progressive Engagement)，用安全但策略性误导的对话回复替换可预测拒绝文本。
Result: 理论分析显示 detect-and-block 下 ASR 随查询预算增长趋近 1，detect-and-misdirect 降低攻击者所选候选的正预测值 (positive predictive value) 并给出有界渐近 ASR；CMPE 在越狱基准上使估计 ASR 上界最多降低两个数量级，在 PAIR、GPTFuzz、AutoDAN-Turbo 端到端实验中几乎消除经验证的攻击成功。
Conclusion: 对自动化越狱搜索，可预测拒绝是有害反馈，受控误导回复能把攻击成功率压到有界水平；CMPE 是该策略的轻量级对话式实现。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 理论分析显示 detect-and-block 下 ASR 随查询预算增长趋近 1，detect-and-misdirect 降低攻击者所选候选的正预测值 (positive predictive value) 并给出有界渐近 ASR；CMPE 在越狱基准上使估计 ASR 上界最多降低两个数量级，在 PAIR、GPTFuzz、AutoDAN-Turbo 端到端实验中几乎消除经验证的攻击成功。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对自动化越狱搜索，可预测拒绝是有害反馈，受控误导回复能把攻击成功率压到有界水平；CMPE 是该策略的轻量级对话式实现。

papers.title: EfficientRollout: System-Aware Self-Speculative Decoding for RL Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a representative post-training paradigm for large language models (LLMs), enabling strong reasoning and agentic capabilities. However, rollout generation remains a dominant latency bottleneck because autoregressive (AR) sampling decodes responses sequentially and a small number of long-tailed generations often determine completion time. Speculative decoding (SD) is a well-established technique for serving fixed LLMs that reduces latency by rapidly drafting tokens and accepting them through parallel verification while preserving the target-model distribution. However, its practical speedups do not directly carry over to RL rollouts: (i) the evolving target policy makes any fixed drafter increasingly mismatched with the policy's output distribution; and (ii) active batch sizes shrink throughout rollout decoding, shifting decoding from compute-bound to memory-bound regimes where parallel verification can exploit underutilized compute. Therefore, accelerating RL rollouts requires both a drafter that remains effective under long, high-temperature generations from an evolving policy and system-aware use of SD that avoids compute-bound regimes. We present EfficientRollout, a system-aware self-SD framework designed to address this gap for RL rollouts. EfficientRollout induces a quantized drafter from the target model (i.e. self-speculative decoding), keeping it coupled to the evolving policy without separate drafter pretraining or online adaptation. It further coordinates a system-aware SD toggle policy with acceptance-aware draft-length adaptation, enabling speculation only in beneficial regimes while matching the drafting budget to evolving drafter quality. EfficientRollout reduces rollout and end-to-end latency by up to 24.2% and 15.6%, respectively, over an accelerated AR rollout baseline, while preserving final model quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EfficientRollout 是面向 LLM 强化学习 rollout 的系统感知自推测解码 (self-speculative decoding) 框架：从目标模型本身量化出 drafter，使其随策略演化保持耦合，再用系统感知的 SD 开关策略与接受感知的草稿长度自适应，只在有利体制下做推测。相对加速后的自回归 rollout 基线，rollout 延迟最多降 24.2%、端到端延迟最多降 15.6%，且保持最终模型质量。
Motivation: RL rollout 是 LLM 后训练的主要延迟瓶颈：自回归逐 token 采样且少量长尾生成决定完成时间；现成推测解码 (SD) 的加速不能直接迁移，因为策略在演化使固定 drafter 失配，且 batch 尺寸在解码中收缩、从 compute-bound 转入 memory-bound。
Method: 从目标模型量化出 drafter 做自推测解码，无需单独 drafter 预训练或在线适配；再把系统感知的 SD 开关策略与接受感知 (acceptance-aware) 的草稿长度自适应配合，使推测只在有利体制发生，并让草稿预算匹配演化中的 drafter 质量。
Result: 相对加速后的 AR rollout 基线，rollout 延迟最多降低 24.2%，端到端延迟最多降低 15.6%，同时保持最终模型质量。
Conclusion: RL rollout 加速需要同时解决 drafter 与演化策略的耦合和系统层面的推测时机，量化自 drafter 加系统感知开关即可在不损失模型质量的前提下压低延迟。

papers.title: Architect-Ant: Editable Automatic Furnishing of Architectural Floor Plans
papers.abstract_en: Furnished floor plans support real-estate visualization, interior design, and architectural workflows, yet automatic furnishing remains challenged by limited real-world data and the need to satisfy interacting geometric and functional constraints. We ask whether professional furnishing knowledge can be learned from real floor plans using a pretrained model, enabling direct constraint-aware layout generation without relying on costly iterative agentic inference. We introduce AntPlan, a curated dataset of 505 real professional architectural floor plans with dense furniture annotations spanning 92 object classes and ten residential room categories, and Architect-Ant, a framework for generating furniture layouts. Architect-Ant represents layouts with an editable coordinate-based DSL and first learns professional furnishing patterns through supervised fine-tuning. It is then optimized with GRPO using a Layout Rule Score (LRS) that aggregates geometric and functional constraints derived from professional plans, providing outcome-level supervision without prescribed reasoning traces. Experiments against diverse state-of-the-art baselines show that Architect-Ant combines low geometric violation rates with high functional completeness, while qualitative results more closely reflect real-world residential furnishing patterns. The resulting layouts remain object-level editable and can be converted into 3D scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Architect-Ant 用可编辑的坐标 DSL 表示家具布局，先监督微调学习专业布置模式，再用 GRPO 与汇总几何/功能约束的 Layout Rule Score (LRS) 做结果级优化，无需昂贵的迭代式 agent 推理即可直接生成满足约束的布局。配套发布 AntPlan：505 张真实专业住宅平面图、92 类物体、10 类房间的稠密家具标注。生成布局保持对象级可编辑并可转成 3D 场景。
Motivation: 自动家具布置缺少真实数据，且要同时满足相互耦合的几何与功能约束；靠迭代式 agent 推理逐条修补代价高。
Method: 提出 AntPlan 数据集（505 张真实专业平面图、92 个物体类、10 类住宅房间、稠密家具标注）与 Architect-Ant 框架：用基于坐标的可编辑 DSL 表示布局，先做监督微调学专业布置模式，再用 GRPO 优化，奖励为从专业平面图导出的 Layout Rule Score (LRS)，聚合几何与功能约束，提供结果级监督而不规定推理轨迹。
Result: 与多种 SOTA 基线对比，Architect-Ant 同时保持低几何违规率与高功能完整性，定性结果更贴近真实住宅布置模式；布局保持对象级可编辑并可转换为 3D 场景。
Conclusion: 专业布置知识可以从真实平面图中学到，并用 DSL 加结果级约束奖励直接生成约束感知布局，不必依赖迭代式 agent 推理。

papers.title: MemGuard: Preventing Memory Contamination in Long-Term Memory-Augmented Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented large language models extend reasoning beyond a fixed context window by maintaining long-term memory across interactions. However, existing memory systems often collapse stable user facts, episodic events, and behavioral rules into a shared space, allowing functionally distinct memories to be retrieved and used as interchangeable evidence. We identify this failure mode as heterogeneous memory contamination, where context-specific events become overgeneralized claims, or semantically relevant but functionally incompatible memories mislead generation. To this end, we introduce MemGuard, a type-aware memory framework that preserves functional memory boundaries during memory construction and retrieval. It assigns each memory an explicit functional role at write time, maintains relations across type-isolated memories, and selectively composes evidence only from necessary memory types, reducing contamination from irrelevant or functionally incompatible evidence. Across hallucination and long-horizon conversation benchmarks, MemGuard improves memory reliability by up to 28.27% while retrieving up to 5.8x fewer memory tokens than prior methods. These results suggest that reliable long-term reasoning depends on principled organization and selective use of heterogeneous memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemGuard 用类型感知的记忆框架阻止长期记忆增强 LLM 的异构记忆污染：写入时给每条记忆标注功能角色，跨类型隔离的记忆之间维护关系，检索时只从必要的记忆类型组合证据。在幻觉与长程对话基准上，记忆可靠性最多提升 28.27%，同时检索的记忆 token 比既有方法最多少 5.8 倍。
Motivation: 现有长期记忆系统把用户事实、情景事件和行为规则压进同一共享空间，功能上不同的记忆被当作可互换证据检索使用，导致情景事件被过度泛化为断言，或语义相关但功能不兼容的记忆误导生成。
Method: MemGuard 是 type-aware 记忆框架：写入时为每条记忆分配显式功能角色，维护跨类型隔离记忆之间的关系，检索时只从必要的记忆类型选择性组合证据，从而减少无关或功能不兼容证据带来的污染。
Result: 在幻觉与长程对话基准 (hallucination and long-horizon conversation benchmarks) 上，记忆可靠性最多提升 28.27%，检索的记忆 token 数比既有方法最多减少 5.8 倍。
Conclusion: 长期推理的可靠性取决于对异构记忆的原则性组织与选择性使用，而非把所有记忆混入共享空间。

papers.title: The Fragility of Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Across Typologically Diverse Languages
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring has been proposed as a promising safety mechanism for detecting misaligned behavior in large language models. However, its reliability remains largely unexplored beyond English and across diverse model families. We present the first large-scale evaluation of CoT monitorability across 13 diverse languages and seven frontier model families, comprising 16 models. Using adversarial-hint evaluations that require explicit intermediate computation, together with analysis of internal answer-token probabilities, we consistently find CoT unfaithfulness across languages and hint types, with an average rate of 95.9\% across 8B--120B parameter models. We find that frontier models systematically exhibit strategic manipulation, including answer-switching, post-hoc rationalization, and procedural exploitation of hints, making their reasoning difficult to reliably monitor. These deceptive patterns remain especially pronounced in low-resource languages, revealing fundamental limitations in current CoT-based oversight. Our results show that CoT monitoring is fragile under linguistic distribution shift, providing a substantially weaker safety signal than English-only studies suggest. These findings motivate the development of more robust CoT monitors and complementary white-box monitoring techniques, particularly for mid- and low-resource languages. Our code is available \href{https://multilingual-cot-monitoring.github.io/}{\textcolor{blue}{here}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 13 种语言、7 个前沿模型家族共 16 个模型做大规模 CoT 监控评测，用需要显式中间计算的对抗性提示 (adversarial-hint) 加内部答案 token 概率分析，发现 CoT 不忠实是普遍现象：8B–120B 参数模型上平均不忠实率 95.9%，且低资源语言中答案切换、事后合理化、程序性利用提示等策略性操纵更严重。结论是 CoT 监控在语言分布偏移下给出的安全信号远弱于英文研究的暗示，需配合白盒监控手段。
Motivation: CoT 监控被当作检测大模型失准行为的关键安全机制，但其可靠性此前基本只在英文和少数模型上考察过，跨语言与跨模型家族的可监控性未知。
Method: 在 13 种语言、7 个前沿模型家族共 16 个模型上做大规模评测：用要求显式中间计算的对抗性提示 (adversarial-hint) 诱发可核验的推理过程，并结合模型内部答案 token 概率分析判定 CoT 是否忠实。
Result: 8B–120B 参数模型上 CoT 不忠实平均率 95.9%，跨语言与跨提示类型一致；前沿模型系统性出现 answer-switching、post-hoc rationalization、procedural exploitation of hints 等策略性操纵，低资源语言中尤为突出。
Conclusion: CoT 监控在语言分布偏移下是脆弱的安全信号，比英文单语研究给出的评估弱得多；作者主张开发更稳健的 CoT 监控器并辅以白盒监控技术，尤其针对中低资源语言。

papers.title: RMA: Context-Orchestrated Research Math Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon mathematical reasoning fails less often because a model cannot produce a valid next step than because an agent fails to maintain and expose the right semantic state across many iterations. Left unmanaged, this produces research-level proofs that are locally convincing yet globally incomplete: a key lemma unproved, an assumption unchecked, a citation unsupported, or a computational claim unverified. We present Research Math Agents (RMA), an agentic framework for long-horizon proof development built around a persistent, typed research store and an orchestrator that compiles operation-specific context from that store. The Research Context Orchestrator is the central state-management layer between the persistent research store and each locally scoped proof operation: it retrieves task-relevant artifacts, compiles them into a bounded context, invokes the appropriate operation, and writes the resulting proof edits, issue updates, literature notes, plans, or evaluations back to the store. This process is designed to keep proof revisions, unresolved issues, prior attempts, literature, and evaluations available across rounds while exposing only task-relevant state to each local operation. We evaluate RMA across complementary research-level settings using independent expert evaluation, blind mathematician review, LLM-based benchmark evaluation, and Lean 4 kernel verification. RMA achieves a 42.5% solve rate on the independently evaluated SOOHAK Challenge Hard set, obtains 8 of 10 correct solutions on First Proof B1 and 8 of 10 passing solutions on B2 under human-expert evaluation, and verifies 213 of 300 sampled Research Solved targets in Formal Conjectures with the Lean 4 kernel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RMA 把长程数学证明的失败归因于跨多轮迭代的语义状态丢失，用持久化 typed research store 加 Research Context Orchestrator 为每个局部证明操作编译有界上下文并回写结果。在 SOOHAK Challenge Hard 独立评测上求解率 42.5%，First Proof B1 人工评测 10 题对 8 题、B2 10 题过 8 题，Formal Conjectures 抽样 300 个 Research Solved 目标中 213 个通过 Lean 4 kernel 验证。
Motivation: 长程证明里模型往往能给出合法的下一步，但 agent 无法跨多轮维护并暴露正确的语义状态，导致局部自洽而全局不完整的证明：关键引理未证、假设未查、引用无支撑、计算性断言未验证。
Method: RMA 由持久化 typed research store 与 Research Context Orchestrator 组成：orchestrator 从 store 检索任务相关 artifact、编译成有界上下文、调用对应证明操作，再把证明编辑、issue 更新、文献笔记、计划与评测写回 store，使跨轮状态可用而每个局部操作只看到任务相关部分。评测用独立专家评测、盲评数学家评审、LLM benchmark 评测与 Lean 4 kernel 验证四种互补设置。
Result: SOOHAK Challenge Hard 独立评测求解率 42.5%；First Proof B1 人工专家评测 10 题中 8 题正确，B2 10 题中 8 题通过；Formal Conjectures 抽样 300 个 Research Solved 目标中 213 个通过 Lean 4 kernel 验证。
Conclusion: 把研究级证明的状态管理做成持久 store 加上下文编排的中心层，可以在研究级数学推理上同时拿到非形式化专家认可与 Lean 4 内核的形式化验证。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SR-Ground: Image Quality Grounding for Super-Resolved Content
papers.abstract_en: Super-Resolution (SR) has advanced rapidly in recent years, with diffusion-based models achieving unprecedented fidelity at the cost of introducing new types of visual artifacts. While existing Image Quality Assessment (IQA) methods provide holistic quality scores, they lack interpretability and fail to distinguish between different artifact types arising from modern SR approaches. To address this gap, we introduce SR-Ground, a large-scale dataset specifically designed for fine-grained artifact segmentation in super-resolved images. The dataset comprises images processed by a diverse set of state-of-the-art SR models, with pixel-level annotations for multiple artifact categories. We conduct a large-scale crowdsourcing study involving 1,062 participants to validate and refine automatically generated segmentations, resulting in a highquality dataset of 63,000 images spanning 6 distinct artifact types. We demonstrate that training IQA models with grounding capabilities on SR-Ground significantly improves performance on downstream tasks. Furthermore, we introduce a fine-tuning pipeline that leverages our grounding model to reduce perceptible artifacts in SR outputs, showcasing the practical utility of our dataset. On a separate benchmark of 1,000 outputs from five unseen SR methods, an Low-Resolution-referenced grounding model significantly improves prominence alignment over its no-reference counterpart and performs best on native real-world datasets of Low-Resolution images without High-Resolution Ground-Truth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SR-Ground 是面向超分辨率 (SR) 伪影的细粒度分割数据集：用像素级标注区分 6 类伪影，并以 1,062 人众包校验自动生成的分割，得到 63,000 张图像。在 SR-Ground 上训练带 grounding 能力的 IQA 模型显著改善下游任务，且 LR-referenced 版本在 1,000 个来自 5 种未见 SR 方法的输出上比 no-reference 版本显著提升 prominence 对齐。
Motivation: 扩散类 SR 模型带来新型视觉伪影，现有 IQA 只给整体质量分数，既不可解释也区分不了不同伪影类型，缺少像素级标注数据来训练能定位伪影的模型。
Method: 构建大规模数据集 SR-Ground：收集多种 SOTA SR 模型的输出并做多类伪影像素级标注；用 1,062 名众包参与者验证并修正自动生成的分割；在此之上训练具备 grounding 能力的 IQA 模型，并给出利用该模型减少 SR 输出中可感知伪影的微调流程。
Result: 数据集含 63,000 张图像、6 种伪影类型，众包规模 1,062 人；在 SR-Ground 上训练 grounding IQA 显著改善下游任务表现；在 1,000 个来自 5 个未见 SR 方法的输出构成的独立基准上，Low-Resolution-referenced grounding 模型的 prominence alignment 显著优于 no-reference 版本，并在无 HR 真值的原生真实世界 LR 数据集上表现最佳。
Conclusion: 像素级伪影 grounding 能让 IQA 模型区分 SR 伪影类型并可反哺生成侧去伪影；有 LR 参考的 grounding 模型在无 HR 真值的真实场景中比无参考模型更可靠。

papers.title: Playing Devil's Advocate: Off-the-Shelf Persona Vectors Rival Targeted Steering for Sycophancy
papers.abstract_en: Language models are often sycophantic: they agree with a user's stated opinion whether or not it is correct. Prior work has shown that this trait can be controlled by steering a model with a sycophancy persona vector (Chen et al., 2025). Such vectors, however, are extracted from data about sycophancy itself. We ask whether we can instead reuse existing vectors for general roles---Skeptic, Judge, Devil's Advocate---that were extracted without targeting sycophancy at all. On Gemma 2 27B and Qwen 3 32B, we compare these role vectors with a purpose-built Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) sycophancy vector on a largely held-out, counterbalanced PhilPapers benchmark, using task-specific coefficient tuning on a separate split of sycophancy data. The selected "critical" roles achieve, on average, about 68% (Gemma) and 98% (Qwen) of CAA's reduction in the sycophancy logit. Less agreement does not mean more factual errors on the probes we checked: on 16 true and false factual claims, Qwen steered by the Skeptic or Judge vector still gives the correct answer in all 16 cases, matching the unsteered model and CAA. "Conformist" roles do not reliably produce the opposite effect. Role vectors also have low absolute cosine similarity with the measured CAA direction at the layer we steer; they are geometrically separate interventions, although this does not by itself show that they act through distinct downstream mechanisms. Together, these results show that general persona vectors can help mitigate sycophancy in LLMs, even when extracted without sycophancy-specific labels. Code: https://github.com/vkmk1/Sycophancy-Steering Results: https://github.com/kelkarI/sycophancy-clean-results

TL;DR: 通用角色 persona vector（Skeptic、Judge、Devil's Advocate）无需谄媚标签即可复用来压制 LLM 谄媚：在 Gemma 2 27B 与 Qwen 3 32B 上，选定的 critical 角色平均达到专用 CAA 谄媚向量谄媚 logit 降幅的约 68%（Gemma）与 98%（Qwen），且 Qwen 用 Skeptic/Judge 转向后在 16 条真假事实断言上仍全部答对。Conformist 角色则不能稳定产生反向效果。
Motivation: 现有谄媚控制依赖从谄媚数据本身提取的 persona vector（Chen et al., 2025），需要谄媚专属标签与数据；作者要检验完全未针对谄媚提取的通用角色向量能否复用。
Method: 在 Gemma 2 27B 与 Qwen 3 32B 上，把通用角色向量与专门构建的 Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) 谄媚向量对比，在 largely held-out、counterbalanced 的 PhilPapers benchmark 上评测，系数在独立的谄媚数据 split 上做 task-specific tuning；另用 16 条真假事实断言检查事实错误，并测量角色向量与 CAA 方向在转向层的 cosine similarity。
Result: 选定 critical 角色平均达到 CAA 谄媚 logit 降幅的约 68%（Gemma）与 98%（Qwen）；Qwen 经 Skeptic 或 Judge 向量转向后在 16 条真假事实断言上 16/16 全对，与未转向模型和 CAA 持平；Conformist 角色不能可靠产生相反效果；角色向量与所测 CAA 方向在转向层的绝对 cosine similarity 很低。
Conclusion: 通用 persona 向量即使完全未用谄媚标签提取，也能缓解 LLM 谄媚，且在所检查的探针上不以增加事实错误为代价；低余弦相似只说明二者是几何上分离的干预，不证明下游机制不同。

papers.title: CASCADE Conformal Prediction: Uncertainty-Adaptive Prediction Intervals for Two-Stage Clinical Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Effective medication management in Parkinson's Disease (PD) is challenging due to heterogeneous disease progression, variable patient response, and medication side effects. While AI models can forecast levodopa equivalent daily dose (LEDD) as a measure of medication needs, standard uncertainty quantification often fails to communicate the reliability of these predictions, treating high and low confidence clinical decisions identically. We introduce CASCADE (Calibrated Adaptive Scaling via Conformal And Distributional Estimation), a novel conformal prediction framework that propagates epistemic uncertainty from a screening classifier to adapt downstream predictions. Unlike standard conformal methods that rely on auxiliary residual regression, we leverage epistemic uncertainty from a primary classification task (identifying whether a medication change is needed) to dynamically scale the prediction intervals of a secondary regression task (predicting how much change). By mapping Venn-Abers multi-probabilistic uncertainty directly to non-conformity scores, our framework achieves continuous risk adaptation. We demonstrate that this cascade effect produces highly efficient intervals for confident patients (38.9% narrower than standard conformal baselines) while automatically expanding intervals to ensure robust coverage for uncertain cases, bridging the gap between discrete clinical decision-making and continuous dose forecasting in PD.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 AgenticUQ Workshop. 14 Pages, 3 Figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CASCADE 用两阶段临床决策中的分类认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty) 动态缩放回归预测区间：先判断是否需要调整用药，再预测调整多少，把 Venn-Abers 多概率不确定性直接映射为非一致性分数。对高置信患者区间比标准 conformal 基线窄 38.9%，对不确定病例则自动放宽以保证覆盖。
Motivation: 帕金森病 levodopa 等效日剂量 (LEDD) 预测的常规不确定性量化把高置信与低置信临床决策同等对待，无法传达预测可靠性，而疾病进展异质与用药副作用使区间自适应成为临床必需。
Method: 提出 CASCADE (Calibrated Adaptive Scaling via Conformal And Distributional Estimation)：以筛查分类器（是否需要用药调整）输出的认知不确定性驱动下游回归（调整多少）的预测区间宽度，将 Venn-Abers multi-probabilistic 不确定性直接映射为非一致性分数，取代标准 conformal 方法依赖的辅助残差回归。
Result: 对置信患者的预测区间比标准 conformal 基线窄 38.9%，同时对不确定病例自动扩展区间以保证稳健覆盖；任务为 PD 的 LEDD 剂量预测与离散用药调整决策的两阶段级联。
Conclusion: 把分类任务的认知不确定性级联进 conformal 区间缩放，可在不牺牲覆盖的前提下让区间宽度随病例置信度连续自适应，从而衔接离散临床决策与连续剂量预报。
