papers.title: PMF-CL: Pareto-Minimal-Forgetting Continual Learner for Conflicting Tasks
papers.abstract_en: In the literature, many continual learning (CL) algorithms have been proposed to address the issue of catastrophic forgetting in ML models (i.e., learning new tasks leads to the loss of performance on previously learned tasks). Although all CL approaches use some form of memory to retain information about past tasks, a grounded understanding of what information needs to be stored to minimize catastrophic forgetting remains elusive. Recently, it has been recognized that under the strong assumption of the existence of a common global minimizer over all tasks, catastrophic forgetting can be completely avoided. However, in practice, tasks rarely have a common global minimizer, and a certain amount of forgetting is inevitable. In this paper, we propose a foundational reframing of CL as balancing conflicting tasks in hindsight from a multi-task learning (MTL) perspective. The approach is based on finding Pareto-optimal solutions, i.e., the solutions which, by definition, minimally forget the previous tasks in the Pareto sense. We derive a Pareto-minimal-forgetting CL (PMF-CL) algorithm for linear and basis-function regression. Our algorithm naturally extends to loss functions with quadratic upper bounds around their minimizers, despite consuming only a static memory footprint of $O(d^2)$ for $d$ model parameters, independent of the number of sequentially occurring tasks $T$. In the quadratic-loss setting, we obtain exact hindsight Pareto-optimal guarantees on forgetting. In the quadratic-upper-bound setting, forgetting is provably bounded, with the tightness of the forgetting bound being directly determined by the tightness of the quadratic bound on the loss function. Our numerical results validate our theoretical claims of convergence to the Pareto-optimal solution, and demonstrate that we consistently out-perform prior empirical methods while occupying lesser memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PMF-CL 把持续学习 (continual learning) 重构为多任务视角下冲突任务的 hindsight 权衡，通过求 Pareto 最优解使遗忘在 Pareto 意义上最小。对线性与基函数回归给出算法，静态内存 O(d²) 与任务数 T 无关；二次损失下获得精确的 hindsight Pareto 最优遗忘保证，二次上界损失下遗忘可证有界且界紧度由上界紧度决定。数值结果验证了收敛到 Pareto 最优解，并在更少内存下持续优于已有经验方法。
Motivation: 现有 CL 算法都用某种记忆保留旧任务信息，但究竟该存什么才能最小化灾难性遗忘缺乏 grounded 理解；而“存在所有任务公共全局最小点”这一强假设在实践中几乎不成立，遗忘不可避免。
Method: 从多任务学习 视角把 CL 重述为 hindsight 下冲突任务的平衡，求 Pareto 最优解；为线性与基函数回归推导出 PMF-CL 算法，可推广到在各自最小点附近具有二次上界的损失函数，静态内存占用 O(d²)（d 为参数量），与顺序到来的任务数 T 无关。
Result: 二次损失设定下获得关于遗忘的精确 hindsight Pareto 最优保证；二次上界设定下遗忘可证有界，界紧度直接由损失的二次上界紧度决定。数值结果验证了收敛到 Pareto 最优解的理论主张，并显示该方法在占用更少内存的情况下持续优于已有经验方法。
Conclusion: 把 CL 视为冲突任务的 Pareto 权衡，可以在 O(d²) 的固定内存下给出可证的最小遗忘保证，且不必依赖各任务存在公共全局最小点的假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BARRIER: Bounded Activation Regions for Robust Information Erasure
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted concepts from a trained model while preserving the rest of its knowledge. Central challenge of this setting is that effective and robust erasure requires extensive parameter updates, which can unintentionally alter representations that should be retained. As a result, existing methods often trade erasure strength for preservation, due to the lack of formal guarantees on the protection of neutral concepts. To address this, we propose BARRIER (Bounded Activation Regions for Robust Information Erasure), a method that enables more intensive unlearning by driving updates within an identified activation space control region, where target erasure can be performed with limited collateral degradation. Using interval arithmetic, we obtain a closed-form bound on the worst-case representation change over protected regions and use it as a knowledge preservation objective. We provide a formal analysis of this protection and its effect on the functional drift. BARRIER is principled, architecture-agnostic, and compatible with existing erasure objectives. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that BARRIER achieves competitive performance across classification and generative settings, including notable gains in some cases, while maintaining strong robustness against adversarial recovery attacks. Our code is available at https://github.com/OneAndZero24/BARRIER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BARRIER 用区间算术 (interval arithmetic) 给出受保护区域上最坏情况表示变化的闭式界，把更新约束在激活空间控制区内，从而在更强遗忘的同时保住中性概念。在分类与生成两类设定中达到有竞争力的遗忘表现，并对对抗恢复攻击保持强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 机器遗忘 (machine unlearning) 要有效擦除目标概念往往需要大幅参数更新，会连带破坏本应保留的表示；现有方法因缺少对中性概念保护的形式化保证，只能在擦除强度与知识保留之间取舍。
Method: 提出 BARRIER：先识别激活空间控制区域，把参数更新驱动到该区域内；用区间算术推导受保护区域上最坏情况表示变化的闭式界，并将其作为知识保留目标，同时给出该保护与功能漂移 (functional drift) 的形式化分析。方法与具体架构无关，可叠加到既有擦除目标上。
Result: 在分类与生成两类设定的实证评估中取得有竞争力的擦除表现，部分情形有明显增益，同时对对抗恢复攻击 (adversarial recovery attacks) 保持强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 给知识保留加上可计算的闭式界，就能在不牺牲鲁棒性的前提下加大遗忘强度，摆脱擦除强度与保留之间的取舍。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: REALM: Retrospective Encoder Alignment for LFP Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Spike activity has been the dominant neural signal for behavior decoding because its high spatiotemporal resolution supports accurate decoding. However, as intracortical brain-computer interfaces (iBCIs) move toward higher channel counts and wireless operation, the high sampling rates required to record spikes create substantial power and bandwidth demands. Local field potentials (LFPs) offer complementary advantages, including greater long-term stability, lower energy consumption, and lower bandwidth requirements. However, LFP-based decoders often achieve lower accuracy and rely on non-causal architectures that cannot be used directly for real-time deployment. We propose REALM, a retrospective knowledge distillation (RKD) framework for causal LFP behavior decoding. Inspired by offline-to-online distillation in speech recognition, REALM transfers non-causal representational knowledge from a pretrained, multi-session bidirectional LFP teacher to a causal student model. We first pretrain a bidirectional Mamba-2 teacher across multiple recording sessions using continuous masked autoencoding (CMAE), and then distill its representation into a compact causal student using a combined objective of representation alignment and autoencoding. REALM achieves the highest mean accuracy among the compared decoders in both label-free and fine-tuned pipelines, with statistically significant improvements over each baseline, including the state-of-the-art CrossModalDistill. It does so using LFPs alone throughout pretraining, distillation, and decoding, with less than half the parameters of CrossModalDistill's published student and one-tenth of its pretraining time. These results show that a causal LFP-only model can achieve decoding accuracy competitive with a non-causal multi-modal model, offering a practical and scalable approach for next-generation wireless and implantable iBCIs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REALM 用回顾式知识蒸馏 (retrospective knowledge distillation) 把多会话双向 LFP 教师的非因果表征压进因果学生，实现仅用 LFP 的实时行为解码。在 label-free 与 fine-tuned 两条流程中均取得所比较解码器的最高平均准确率，且相对各基线（含 CrossModalDistill）统计显著，参数量不到 CrossModalDistill 已发表学生的二分之一、预训练时间为其十分之一。
Motivation: iBCI 通道数与无线化推高了 spike 记录的功耗与带宽压力；LFP 更稳定省电，但其解码器准确率偏低且多依赖非因果架构，无法直接实时部署。
Method: 先用连续掩码自编码 (CMAE) 跨多个记录会话预训练一个双向 Mamba-2 教师，再以表征对齐与自编码的组合目标把其表征蒸馏进紧凑的因果学生；蒸馏思路借鉴语音识别的 offline-to-online distillation，全程只用 LFP。
Result: 在 label-free 与 fine-tuned 两条流程中，REALM 的平均准确率均高于所比较的全部解码器，相对每个基线（含 state-of-the-art 的 CrossModalDistill）均有统计显著提升；参数量少于 CrossModalDistill 已发表学生的二分之一，预训练时间为其十分之一，且预训练、蒸馏与解码全程仅用 LFP。
Conclusion: 因果的纯 LFP 模型可以达到与非因果多模态模型竞争的解码准确率，为下一代无线与植入式 iBCI 提供可扩展的实时方案。

papers.title: Do Vision Transformers Need All-to-All Attention? Global Communication Through Elastic Learned Cores
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) learn rich visual-semantic representations through all-to-all self-attention among patch tokens. However, this design implicitly assumes that direct pairwise patch interactions are necessary for effective representation learning. In this work, we challenge this assumption and show that representations supporting both global recognition and dense prediction can be learned without direct patch-to-patch interaction. We propose VECA (Visual Elastic-Core Attention), a vision transformer with core-periphery structured attention mediated by a small set of learned cores. Patch tokens exchange global information exclusively through these cores, while the full set of dense patches are preserved and iteratively updated across layers. This reduces attention complexity from $O(N^2)$ to $O(N)$, linear in the number of patches $N$ for a fixed core budget $C$. Unlike prior latent-token cross-attention architectures, VECA facilitates sparse global communication without compressing the spatial representation itself. Nested training along the core axis further enables a single model to elastically trade off computation and accuracy at inference time without retraining. Across image classification and dense prediction tasks, VECA remains competitive with full-attention backbones and outperforms the evaluated linear-complexity alternatives on most benchmarks. Moreover, without explicit supervision, these cores develop semantically organized structures that support object-label transfer across video frames. These results show that effective visual representations can be learned without direct all-to-all patch interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VECA (Visual Elastic-Core Attention) 用一组可学习的 core token 作为中介，让 patch 只经 core 交换全局信息，把注意力复杂度从 O(N²) 降到 O(N)，同时保留全部 dense patch 并逐层更新。在图像分类与 dense prediction 任务上与全注意力 backbone 竞争，并在多数基准上超过所评测的线性复杂度替代方案；core 在无显式监督下形成语义组织结构，可跨视频帧做 object-label transfer。
Motivation: ViT 的 all-to-all self-attention 默认每对 patch 都需直接交互，带来 O(N²) 开销；本文质疑这一假设，目标是在不直接 patch-to-patch 交互的前提下仍学到支撑全局识别与 dense prediction 的表示。
Method: 提出 core-periphery 结构化注意力：patch token 仅通过少量 learned cores（固定 core 沿轴的 budget C）交换全局信息，dense patch 集合被完整保留并跨层迭代更新；与 latent-token cross-attention 不同，不压缩空间表示本身。沿 core 轴做 nested training，使单一模型可在推理时弹性价算力与精度而无需重训练。
Result: 注意力复杂度由 O(N²) 降为 O(N)（对固定 core budget C 关于 patch 数 N 线性）；在图像分类与 dense prediction 上与全注意力 backbone 保持竞争，并在多数基准上优于所评测的线性复杂度替代方案；无显式监督时 core 发展出语义组织结构，支持跨视频帧的 object-label transfer。
Conclusion: 有效的视觉表示可以在没有直接 all-to-all patch 交互的情况下学到，全局通信可由小规模 learned cores 承担；nested core 训练让单模型在推理时按需权衡算力与精度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ConQuR: Corner Aligned Activation Quantization via Optimized Rotations for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are costly to deploy due to their large memory footprint and high inference cost. Weight-activation quantization can reduce these costs, but low-bit activation quantization remains difficult because activation outliers induce large quantization error. Recent rotation-based methods address this by applying orthogonal transformations that redistribute activation magnitude across dimensions, but existing approaches either require expensive end-to-end rotation training or rely on stored activation corpora, introducing significant compute or storage overhead. We propose a lightweight post-training rotation calibration method for LLM activation quantization. Our method learns orthogonal rotations that align normalized activations with the corners of an inscribed hypercube, encouraging activation energy to be distributed more evenly across dimensions. This objective admits an efficient closed-form update via the orthogonal Procrustes problem, avoiding gradient-based optimization over the orthogonal group. We further introduce an online calibration procedure that updates rotations as calibration samples are processed, eliminating the need to store activations on disk and allowing rotations to adapt to quantized activation distributions during calibration. Experiments on Llama-2 and Llama-3 models from 3B to 70B parameters show that our method achieves competitive or improved performance across perplexity benchmarks and common sense reasoning tasks while avoiding both costly end-to-end training and large offline activation storage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConQuR 用正交 Procrustes 闭式解学习把归一化激活对齐到内接超立方体顶角的旋转，使激活能量在各维度上更均匀分布，并在处理校准样本时在线更新旋转。在 Llama-2 与 Llama-3 的 3B–70B 模型上，该方法在困惑度与常识推理任务上达到竞争性或更优表现，同时避开端到端旋转训练与离线激活存储。
Motivation: 低比特激活量化因激活离群值导致量化误差大；已有旋转方法要么需要昂贵的端到端旋转训练，要么依赖存储的激活语料，带来计算或存储开销。
Method: 提出轻量的训练后旋转校准方法：学习正交旋转使归一化激活对齐到内接超立方体的角点，该目标通过正交 Procrustes 问题得到闭式更新，无需在正交群上做梯度优化；并加入在线校准流程，边处理校准样本边更新旋转，使其适应量化后的激活分布。
Result: 在 Llama-2 与 Llama-3、参数量 3B 到 70B 的模型上，困惑度基准与常识推理任务中达到竞争性或更优表现，同时避免了端到端旋转训练与大规模离线激活存储。
Conclusion: 闭式 Procrustes 旋转加在线校准可以在不训练、不存激活的前提下把激活量化误差压到与现有旋转方法相当或更好的水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Retrieval from Within: An Intrinsic Capability of Attention-Based Models
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically treats retrieval and generation as separate systems. We ask whether an attention-based encoder-decoder can instead retrieve directly from its own internal representations. We introduce INTRA (INTrinsic Retrieval via Attention), a framework where decoder attention queries score pre-encoded evidence chunks that are then directly reused as context for generation. By construction, INTRA unifies retrieval and generation, eliminating the retriever-generator mismatch typical of RAG pipelines. This design also amortizes context encoding by reusing precomputed encoder states across queries. On question-answering benchmarks, INTRA outperforms strong engineered retrieval pipelines on both evidence recall and end-to-end answer quality. Our results demonstrate that attention-based models already possess a retrieval mechanism that can be elicited, rather than added as an external module.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: INTRA (INTrinsic Retrieval via Attention) 让 encoder-decoder 的 decoder 注意力查询直接对预编码的证据块打分，并把选中的块原样复用为生成上下文，从而把检索与生成合为一个模型。在问答基准上，它在证据召回和端到端答案质量两方面都超过强工程化检索流水线，同时靠复用预计算 encoder 状态摊薄上下文编码开销。
Motivation: RAG 把检索器和生成器拆成两套系统，检索到的证据与生成器实际吃的上下文之间存在 retriever-generator mismatch，且每个查询都要重新编码上下文。
Method: INTRA 框架：encoder 先把证据块编码存好，decoder 的注意力查询直接对这些内部表征打分，选中的块不经过外部检索器就作为生成上下文复用；跨查询共享预计算 encoder 状态以摊销编码成本。
Result: 在问答基准上，INTRA 在证据召回 (evidence recall) 与端到端答案质量两方面均超过强工程化检索流水线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 注意力模型内部本就带有检索机制，可以被激发出来取代外挂检索模块，同时消除检索-生成失配并摊薄上下文编码成本。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Augmented Equivariant Mesh Networks for Anatomical Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Anatomical mesh segmentation requires models that operate directly on irregular surface geometry while remaining robust to changes in coordinate pose across meshes of varying resolution. Existing task-specific mesh and point-cloud methods are not equivariant, and can degrade sharply under test-time perturbation, for example dropping by 28-30 IoU points on 3D-IOSSeg at $40^\circ$ rotation even with matched training augmentation. We present EAMS, an Equivariant Anatomical Mesh Segmentor built on Equivariant Mesh Neural Networks (EMNN), and evaluate it in four dataset settings across three clinical application areas, spanning edge-, vertex-, and face-level supervision. We combine intrinsic mesh descriptors with anatomy-aware priors, including PCA-derived frames for dental arches and liver surfaces, and augment message passing to provide lightweight global context. Across intracranial aneurysm and intraoral segmentation, EAMS variants are competitive with specialized baselines on unperturbed inputs while remaining stable under geometric perturbations, and on liver surfaces they expose a favorable trade-off between canonical-pose accuracy and rotation robustness. These results show that a lightweight ($<2$M parameters) equivariant framework can deliver robust anatomical mesh segmentation across diverse label types.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EAMS（Equivariant Anatomical Mesh Segmentor），基于 Equivariant Mesh Neural Networks (EMNN)，把内蕴 mesh 描述子与解剖先验（牙弓/肝表面的 PCA 派生坐标系）结合并增强 message passing 引入轻量全局上下文，在四个数据集设置、三个临床任务上做等变解剖 mesh 分割。非等变方法在 40° 旋转下于 3D-IOSSeg 上掉 28–30 IoU 点，EAMS 在未扰动输入上与专用基线相当，同时在几何扰动下保持稳定，参数量低于 2M。
Motivation: 现有 mesh 与点云分割方法不具备等变性，即使训练时加了匹配的增强，测试时坐标姿态变化仍会让精度骤降（3D-IOSSeg 在 40° 旋转下掉 28–30 IoU 点），而解剖 mesh 分辨率各异、姿态不定。
Method: EAMS 构建在 EMNN 之上，将内蕴 mesh 描述子与解剖感知先验（牙弓和肝表面的 PCA 派生坐标系）组合，并增强 message passing 以提供轻量全局上下文；在跨三个临床应用领域的四个数据集设置上评测，覆盖边、顶点、面三种监督层级。
Result: 非等变基线在 3D-IOSSeg 上 40° 旋转即使有匹配训练增强仍下降 28–30 IoU 点；EAMS 在颅内动脉瘤与口内分割上，未扰动输入与专用基线相当且在几何扰动下保持稳定；在肝表面上呈现标准姿态精度与旋转鲁棒性的有利折中；模型参数量 <2M。
Conclusion: 轻量级（<2M 参数）等变框架足以在多种标签类型上实现稳健的解剖 mesh 分割，等变性带来的扰动稳定性不必以牺牲未扰动精度为代价。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Compute Aligned Training: Optimizing for Test Time Inference
papers.abstract_en: Scaling test-time compute has emerged as a powerful mechanism for enhancing Large Language Model (LLM) performance. However, standard post-training paradigms, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), optimize the likelihood of individual samples under a base policy, creating a misalignment with test time procedures that rely on aggregated or filtered outputs. In this work, we propose Compute Aligned Training, which aligns training objectives with test-time strategies. By conceptualizing inference strategies as operators on the base policy, we derive new loss functions that maximize performance when said strategies are applied. We instantiate such loss functions for SFT and RL across common test time strategies. Finally, we provide empirical evidence that this training method substantially improves test time scaling over standard training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Compute Aligned Training：把测试时推理策略（聚合、过滤等）形式化为作用在 base policy 上的算子，据此反推出在该策略施加后性能最优的训练损失，替代 SFT/RL 只优化单样本似然的做法。作者为 SFT 与 RL 各实例化了对应损失，并给出实证证据表明该训练方法相比标准训练显著改善测试时算力扩展 (test-time scaling)。
Motivation: SFT 与 RL 的标准后训练目标优化 base policy 下单个样本的似然，而测试时推理依赖聚合或过滤后的输出，两者目标错位，导致扩大测试时算力的收益受限。
Method: 把推理策略概念化为 base policy 上的算子，从该视角推导在策略施加后最大化性能的新损失函数，并分别针对 SFT 与 RL、覆盖常见测试时策略（如聚合与过滤类）给出具体实例化形式。
Result: 实证结果显示该训练方法相比标准训练 (standard training) 显著提升测试时算力扩展效果；摘要以实证证据形式给出结论，未列出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 训练目标应与测试时推理策略对齐，而非只优化单样本似然，这样才能在扩大测试时算力时获得更好的性能增长。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Rewind-IL: Online Failure Detection and State Respawning for Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Imitation learning has enabled robots to acquire complex visuomotor manipulation skills from demonstrations, but deployment failures remain a major obstacle, especially for long-horizon action-chunked policies. Once execution drifts off the demonstration manifold, these policies often continue producing locally plausible actions without recovering from the failure. Existing runtime monitors either require failure data, over-trigger under benign feature drift, or stop at failure detection without providing a recovery mechanism. We present Rewind-IL, a training-free online safeguard framework for generative action-chunked imitation policies. Rewind-IL combines a zero-shot failure detector based on Temporal Inter-chunk Discrepancy Estimate (TIDE), calibrated with split conformal prediction, with a state-respawning mechanism that returns the robot to a semantically verified safe intermediate state. Offline, a vision-language model identifies recovery checkpoints in demonstrations, and the frozen policy encoder is used to construct a compact checkpoint feature database. Online, Rewind-IL monitors self-consistency in overlapping action chunks, tracks similarity to the checkpoint library, and, upon failure, rewinds execution to the latest verified safe state before restarting inference from a clean policy state. Experiments on real-world and simulated long-horizon manipulation tasks, including transfer to flow-matching action-chunked policies, demonstrate that policy-internal consistency coupled with semantically grounded respawning offers a practical route to improved reliability in imitation learning. Supplemental materials are available at https://sjay05.github.io/rewind-il
papers.comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Project page at https://sjay05.github.io/rewind-il
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, 2026 (Early Access), pp. 1-8
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Rewind-IL 是面向生成式动作分块 (action-chunked) 模仿学习策略的免训练在线保障框架：用基于时序分块间差异估计 (TIDE) 的零样本失败检测器配合 split conformal prediction 标定，检测到失败后把机器人回滚到经语义验证的中间安全状态再重启推理。在真实与仿真的长时程操作任务上（含迁移到 flow-matching 策略），策略内部一致性加语义锚定的状态重生可提升模仿学习部署可靠性。
Motivation: 长时程动作分块策略一旦偏离演示流形就持续输出局部合理但已失败的动作；现有运行时监控器要么需要失败数据、要么在良性特征漂移下误触发、要么只停在检测而无恢复手段。
Method: 离线阶段用 vision-language model 在演示中识别恢复检查点，并用冻结的策略编码器构建紧凑的检查点特征库；在线阶段监控重叠动作分块的自一致性 (TIDE)、跟踪与检查点库的相似度，检测器用 split conformal prediction 标定，失败时回滚到最近的已验证安全状态再从干净策略状态重启推理。整个框架免训练。
Result: 在真实世界与仿真的长时程操作任务上验证，并迁移到 flow-matching 动作分块策略；摘要以定性方式呈现结果，未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 策略内部一致性结合语义锚定的状态重生，是提升模仿学习部署可靠性的一条实用路径，且无需为监控器收集失败数据或重训策略。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HUANet: Hard-Constrained Unrolled ADMM for Constrained Convex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents HUANet, a constrained deep neural network architecture that unrolls the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) into a trainable neural network for accelerating parametric constrained convex optimization. Existing end-to-end learning methods operate as black-box mappings from parameters to solutions, often without explicitly incorporating optimality principles or guaranteeing constraint satisfaction. To address these limitations, HUANet embeds a hard-constrained neural network within each unrolled ADMM iteration, where a differentiable correction stage enforces the affine equalities of the primal subproblem. Furthermore, we incorporate first-order optimality conditions into a self-supervised training loss to promote the convergence of the proposed unrolled algorithm. Extensive numerical experiments for benchmark optimization problems and a control application demonstrate and validate the effectiveness of HUANet in accelerating constrained convex optimization solving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HUANet 把 ADMM 展开成可训练网络来加速参数化约束凸优化，在每个展开迭代内嵌入硬约束网络，用可微校正阶段强制满足原问题子问题的仿射等式，并把一阶最优性条件写进自监督训练损失以促进收敛。在基准优化问题与一个控制应用的数值实验中验证了其加速约束凸优化求解的有效性。
Motivation: 现有端到端求解方法是参数到解的黑箱映射，既不显式嵌入最优性原理，也不保证约束满足，导致约束凸优化的求解加速缺乏可行性保证。
Method: 将 ADMM 交替方向乘子法展开为可训练神经网络；每个展开迭代内嵌入硬约束神经网络，其可微校正阶段强制满足原问题子问题的仿射等式约束；同时把一阶最优性条件 (first-order optimality conditions) 纳入自监督训练损失。
Result: 在基准优化问题与一个控制应用上的大量数值实验中，HUANet 展示并验证了加速约束凸优化求解的有效性（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 把硬约束校正与最优性条件损失嵌入展开的 ADMM，可在保持约束满足的前提下加速参数化约束凸优化求解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Frequency-aware decomposition learning for sensorless wrench estimation in vibration-rich robotic contact
papers.abstract_en: Force and torque (F/T) sensors enable contact-aware control by providing reactive feedback, but they are often fragile and expensive. To overcome these limitations, sensorless methods estimate F/T or wrench solely from robot proprioception, and have shown success in slow interaction tasks such as grasping. However, their low-pass characteristics limit the estimation of high-frequency signals, which are critical in rapid-contact tasks such as grinding. Communication delays can also make their estimates outdated during deployment, but few methods address this directly. To bridge these gaps, we propose a Frequency-aware Decomposition Network (FDN) to estimate vibration-rich wrench in a sensorless, multi-step-ahead manner. Considering higher-frequency stochasticity, FDN spectrally decomposes the wrench horizon into a low-frequency trend and a high-frequency residual, and estimates each by pointwise regression and a learned conditional distribution, respectively. The frequency-aware layers impose band decomposition priors on the outputs and adaptively enhance frequency amplitudes of the inputs. FDN requires neither an identified robot model nor an F/T sensor during estimation. On real-world grinding data from our 6-DoF hydraulic manipulator, FDN reduces high-frequency amplitude error by up to 47% over the baselines under assumed time delays and maintains competitive low-frequency pointwise accuracy, while the baselines fail to balance these two. We also find multi-step-ahead estimation feasible, with FDN estimating a 1,000 ms horizon within 11 ms on a single CPU thread. Ablation studies further support our design choices. In an exploratory study, transferring wrench dynamics learned from an open-source everyday manipulation dataset reduces low-frequency error by 8%, while high-frequency dynamics appear domain-specific.
papers.comment: revised. 27 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables. Code: https://github.com/leehyeonbeen/FDN Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23026020
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Frequency-aware Decomposition Network (FDN)，在无 F/T 传感器、无辨识机器人模型的条件下，把振动丰富的 wrench 序列按频谱拆成低频趋势（点式回归）与高频残差（学习条件分布），并做多步提前估计以对抗通信延迟。在 6-DoF 液压机械臂的真实打磨数据上，假定时延下高频幅度误差较基线最多降低 47%，同时保持有竞争力的低频点式精度，而基线无法兼顾两者；1,000 ms 预测视界在单 CPU 线程上 11 ms 内完成。
Motivation: 基于本体感受的无传感器 wrench 估计呈低通特性，抓取等慢交互够用，但打磨这类快速接触的高频信号估不出来；通信延迟又会让部署时的估计过期，现有方法很少直接处理。
Method: FDN 对 wrench 时间视界做频谱分解，低频趋势用点式回归、高频残差用学习得到的条件分布估计；frequency-aware 层对输出施加频带分解先验并自适应增强输入的频率幅度，以多步提前方式输出，估计阶段既不需辨识机器人模型也不需 F/T 传感器。
Result: 在 6-DoF 液压机械臂的真实打磨数据上，假定时延下高频幅度误差较基线最多降低 47%，低频点式精度保持竞争力，而基线无法平衡这两项；1,000 ms 视界在单 CPU 线程 11 ms 内估计完成。消融支持各设计选择；从开源日常操作数据集迁移 wrench 动力学使低频误差降低 8%，高频动力学则呈领域特异性。
Conclusion: 把 wrench 按频带分开建模并做多步提前估计，可以在无传感器、含时延的快速接触任务中同时保住高频幅度与低频精度；低频动力学可跨数据集迁移，高频动力学是领域特有的。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 把 wrench 按频带分开建模并做多步提前估计，可以在无传感器、含时延的快速接触任务中同时保住高频幅度与低频精度；低频动力学可跨数据集迁移，高频动力学是领域特有的。

papers.title: Spatial Atlas: Compute-Grounded Reasoning for Spatial-Aware Research Agent Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: We describe compute-grounded reasoning (CGR), a design pattern in which code computes selected sub-problems from explicit intermediate representations before a language model answers. Spatial Atlas implements CGR as an Agent2Agent (A2A) server with a spatial question-answering handler and a machine-learning engineering handler. The spatial handler asks a language model to extract a scene graph, and code then fills in missing distances and checks the extracted safety rules. A separate benchmark driver can also run a strict metric bridge. It computes the gap for horizontal-gap questions from segmentation masks and a reconstructed point map, and it passes that gap to the answering model as a fact. The bridge returns a fixed unavailable answer when an evidence check fails, and it never falls back to model-estimated coordinates. The ML-engineering handler generates pipeline code, parses validation scores, and caps the number of repair and refinement passes. Its code execution is off by default. The repository also provides four run modes that can write label-free journals, a shuffled-image control mapping, and journal validators that reject label-bearing fields. We report one private label-free operational run in which four paths each wrote eight prediction rows with zero retries. Labels stayed sealed, and no score was computed, so this run establishes operational integrity only. We report no FieldWorkArena result because the benchmark data were not accessible. We also omit every performance, latency, and resource-use number that lacks a reproducible run artifact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spatial Atlas 把 compute-grounded reasoning (CGR) 做成 Agent2Agent (A2A) 服务：先由代码从显式中间表示算出子问题（场景图补距离、分割掩码与点云重建算水平间隙）再交给语言模型作答，证据校验失败时返回固定 unavailable 而不回退到模型估计坐标。唯一一次私有无标签运行中四条路径各写 8 行预测、零重试，仅确立运行完整性。
Motivation: 空间问答与 ML 工程 agent 依赖模型自行估算坐标与分数，缺少可复现的计算锚点与证据校验，导致答案不可审计。
Method: CGR 设计模式：空间 handler 让 LLM 抽取场景图，代码补齐缺失距离并核验安全规则；独立 benchmark driver 执行 strict metric bridge，从分割掩码与重建点图算水平间隙并作为事实传给作答模型，证据检查失败即返回固定 unavailable；ML-engineering handler 生成 pipeline 代码、解析验证分数并限制修复轮数（默认关闭代码执行），另含四种运行模式、label-free journal 与拒绝含标签字段的 validator。
Result: 一次私有 label-free 运行：四条路径各写 8 行预测、零重试，标签保持封存且未计算分数，仅确立 operational integrity；未报告 FieldWorkArena 结果（benchmark 数据不可访问），并省略一切缺少可复现运行工件的性能、延迟与资源数字。
Conclusion: 把可核验的计算放在模型作答之前、失败时返回固定 unavailable 而非模型估算，可在无标签运行中保证运行完整性；但该运行不构成任何性能结论。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Model Merging via Data-Free Covariance Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Model merging provides a way of cheaply combining individual models to produce a model that inherits each individual's capabilities. While some merging methods can approach the performance of multitask training, they are often heuristically motivated and lack theoretical justification. A principled alternative is to pose model merging as a layer-wise optimization problem that directly minimizes interference between tasks. However, this formulation requires estimating per-layer covariance matrices from data, which may not be available when performing merging. In contrast, many of the heuristically-motivated methods do not require auxiliary data, making them practically advantageous. In this work, we revisit the interference minimization framework and show that, under certain conditions, covariance matrices can be estimated directly from difference matrices, eliminating the need for data while also reducing computational costs. We validate our approach across vision and language benchmarks on models ranging from 86M parameters to 7B parameters, outperforming previous data-free state-of-the-art merging methods
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把模型合并 (model merging) 的逐层干扰最小化问题改写为无需数据的形式：在一定条件下，逐层协方差矩阵可直接由权重差分矩阵 (difference matrices) 估计，从而去掉对辅助数据的依赖并降低计算开销。在视觉与语言基准、86M 到 7B 参数模型上验证，超过此前的 data-free 合并方法。
Motivation: 以逐层优化直接最小化任务间干扰的合并框架更有理论依据，但需要从数据估计逐层协方差，而实际合并场景往往拿不到数据；启发式方法虽免数据却缺少理论支撑。
Method: 重访干扰最小化框架，证明在特定条件下协方差矩阵可由权重差分矩阵直接估计，替代基于数据的估计，得到 data-free 的逐层合并求解，同时降低计算成本。
Result: 在视觉与语言基准上验证，覆盖 86M 到 7B 参数规模的模型，性能超过此前 data-free 的 state-of-the-art 合并方法。
Conclusion: 数据依赖是逐层干扰最小化合并的可去除前提：用差分矩阵估计协方差即可在无辅助数据时保持该框架的优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Notes on Forré's Notion of Conditional Independence and Causal Calculus for Continuous Variables
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Forré (arXiv:2104.11547, 2021) introduced transitional conditional independence, a notion of conditional independence that provides a unified framework for both random and non-stochastic variables. The original paper establishes a strong global Markov property connecting transitional conditional independencies with suitable graphical separation criteria for directed mixed graphs with input nodes (iDMGs), together with a version of causal calculus for iDMGs in a general measure-theoretic setting. These notes aim to further illustrate the motivations behind this framework and its connections to the literature, highlight certain subtlies in the general measure-theoretic causal calculus, and extend the "one-line" formulation of the ID algorithm of Richardson et al. (Ann. Statist. 51(1):334--361, 2023) to the general measure-theoretic setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于过渡条件独立 (transitional conditional independence) 与因果演算的数学笔记：澄清 Forré 框架在一般测度论设定下的动机与细微之处，并把 Richardson 等人 (Ann. Statist. 2023) 的 ID 算法“一行式”表述推广到一般测度论设定。核心对象是带输入节点的有向混合图 (iDMG) 上的全局 Markov 性质与因果演算。
Motivation: Forré 2021 提出的过渡条件独立统一了随机与非随机变量，其原始论文在一般测度论设定下给出 iDMG 的强全局 Markov 性质与因果演算，但该框架的动机、与既有文献的联系以及测度论因果演算中的细节尚需进一步阐释。
Method: 笔记做三件事：阐释 Forré 框架的动机及其与相关文献的联系；指出一般测度论因果演算中的若干细微之处 (subtleties)；将 Richardson 等人 (Ann. Statist. 51(1):334–361, 2023) 的 ID 算法“一行式”表述扩展到一般测度论设定。
Result: 给出 ID 算法在一般测度论设定下的一行式表述，并梳理过渡条件独立与 iDMG 图形分离准则之间的强全局 Markov 性质；摘要未含实验或数值结果。
Conclusion: 过渡条件独立与 iDMG 因果演算可在一般测度论层面统一表述，ID 算法的简洁形式也能推广到该设定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRACE: A Multi-Agent System for Autonomous Physical Reasoning for Seismology
papers.abstract_en: Modern seismic networks resolve earthquake sequences in unprecedented detail, yet explaining how large earthquakes emerge from evolving fault systems remains difficult. We introduce TRACE, a seismology-guided artificial intelligence agent that plans and executes workflows while preserving auditable evidence chains from observations to physical interpretation. We evaluated TRACE through 104 benchmark tasks and two complementary earthquake sequences. For the well-studied 2019 Ridgecrest sequence, TRACE constructed a high-resolution catalog from continuous waveforms and retrospectively recovered delayed cascading activation between the Mw 6.4 and Mw 7.1 earthquakes without a prescribed target interpretation. In the less-understood 2025-2026 Sanriku sequence off northeastern Japan, TRACE developed a testable interpretation of progressive destabilization within a segmented megathrust. Its synthesis linked coupled seismic-aseismic activation around the MJ 6.9 sequence and subsequent persistent, spatially segmented shallow-interface activity to a megathrust patch that lay between regions of past large coseismic slip and later hosted the MJ 7.7 rupture. These results open a path from seismic observations to testable physical insight.
papers.comment: 24 pages for main text and 60 pages for appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 是一个地震学引导的多智能体 AI 代理，自主规划并执行从连续波形到物理解释的工作流，同时保留可审计的证据链。在 104 项基准任务和两个地震序列上检验：对 2019 Ridgecrest 序列从连续波形构建高分辨率目录，并在无预设目标解释的情况下回溯出 Mw 6.4 与 Mw 7.1 之间的延迟级联激活；对 2025–2026 三陆序列给出分段俯冲带渐进失稳的可检验解释。
Motivation: 现代地震台网已能高分辨率解析地震序列，但从演化断层系统中解释大震如何孕育仍然困难，人工解释难以在观测与物理解释之间保留可追溯的证据链。
Method: TRACE 作为地震学引导的 AI 代理，规划并执行多步工作流，把观测到物理解释的每一步保留为可审计证据链；在 104 项基准任务上检验，并应用于两个互补地震序列：2019 Ridgecrest 与 2025–2026 日本东北外海三陆序列。
Result: 在 104 项基准任务和两个地震序列上检验；对 2019 Ridgecrest 序列从连续波形构建高分辨率目录，无需预设目标解释即回溯出 Mw 6.4 与 Mw 7.1 之间的延迟级联激活；对 2025–2026 三陆序列，将 MJ 6.9 序列周边耦合的地震-滑动激活与随后持续的、空间分段的浅部界面活动，联接到一个位于历史大震同震滑移区之间、后又发生 MJ 7.7 破裂的俯冲带 patch。
Conclusion: 作者认为自主、可审计的 AI 代理能从地震观测直接走到可检验的物理解识，为大震孕育过程的解释打开一条新路径。

papers.title: Extending SSMs with the Exponentially Weighted Signature
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the exponentially weighted signature (EWS), a continuous-time model that computes iterated integrals of a path, where each increment is weighted by the matrix exponential of a learnable generator over elapsed clock time. We prove that it solves a linear controlled differential equation, keeps the group-like structure and the universality of the signature, and satisfies a modified Chen identity, enabling a parallel scan. At depth one the EWS is a state-space model (SSM), and we map linear time-invariant SSMs, Mamba channels and Mamba-$2$ heads to it in closed form. The EWS extends SSMs through an arbitrary matrix generator, a clock that generalises the step size to causal functionals of the input, and higher truncation depths that are non-linear in the path within a single layer. Empirically, the EWS achieves the highest average accuracy and rank on six long time-series classification datasets, where depth generally helps. Learned clocks prove necessary for state tracking on formal language tasks, and at depth one, the EWS matches or exceeds competing SSMs on regression and forecasting with far fewer parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出指数加权签名 (exponentially weighted signature, EWS)：路径增量按可学习生成元在流逝时钟时间上的矩阵指数加权，深度一时退化为 state-space model，并把 LTI SSM、Mamba channels 与 Mamba-2 heads 以闭式形式映射进来。在六个长时间序列分类数据集上取得最高平均精度与排名，深度通常有益；形式语言状态跟踪任务上学习时钟是必需的，深度一时在回归与 forecasting 上以远少参数匹配或超过竞争 SSM。
Motivation: SSM 的线性时不变结构与固定步长限制了对因果时间重参数化的表达能力，签名方法虽有 universality 但缺少与 SSM 的直接对应和并行扫描实现。
Method: EWS 作为连续时间模型计算路径的 iterated integrals，每个增量按可学习生成元的矩阵指数加权；证明其求解线性 controlled differential equation、保持 group-like 结构与 signature 的 universality，并满足修正的 Chen identity，从而支持 parallel scan。扩展点包括任意矩阵生成元、把步长推广为输入因果函数的时钟，以及单层内对路径非线性的更高截断深度。
Result: 在六个长时间序列分类数据集上取得最高平均精度与排名，且深度通常带来提升；形式语言任务上学习时钟对 state tracking 是必需的；深度一时在回归与 forecasting 上以远少于竞争 SSM 的参数量匹配或超过它们。
Conclusion: EWS 把 SSM 统一进签名框架，用任意矩阵生成元、可学习时钟与更高截断深度扩展 SSM，同时保留并行扫描与闭式 SSM/Mamba 对应。

summary_sections.method: EWS 作为连续时间模型计算路径的 iterated integrals，每个增量按可学习生成元的矩阵指数加权；证明其求解线性 controlled differential equation、保持 group-like 结构与 signature 的 universality，并满足修正的 Chen identity，从而支持 parallel scan。扩展点包括任意矩阵生成元、把步长推广为输入因果函数的时钟，以及单层内对路径非线性的更高截断深度。
summary_sections.result: 在六个长时间序列分类数据集上取得最高平均精度与排名，且深度通常带来提升；形式语言任务上学习时钟对 state tracking 是必需的；深度一时在回归与 forecasting 上以远少于竞争 SSM 的参数量匹配或超过它们。
summary_sections.conclusion: EWS 把 SSM 统一进签名框架，用任意矩阵生成元、可学习时钟与更高截断深度扩展 SSM，同时保留并行扫描与闭式 SSM/Mamba 对应。

papers.title: Large Reward Models: Generalizable Online Robot Reward Generation with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown strong potential for improving robotic manipulation policies, yet its practical use remains bottlenecked by the difficulty of specifying reward functions that are both semantically meaningful and reusable across tasks. In this paper, we propose Large Reward Models (LRMs), a framework that adapts foundation VLMs into frame-level reward generators for robot policy refinement. We specialize a state-of-the-art VLM on a multi-source dataset spanning real-world robot trajectories, human-object interactions, and simulated manipulation environments. Unlike prior approaches that mainly evaluate trajectories post-hoc, LRMs expose multiple reward interfaces from visual observations: progress estimation, task completion, and temporal contrastive comparison. Starting from an imitation-learned policy, we use these VLM-derived rewards to guide PPO refinement on held-out long-horizon manipulation tasks. Our experiments show that LRM progress rewards provide the strongest non-privileged online refinement signal, improving the IL baseline and narrowing the gap to privileged environment rewards. We further deploy progress rewards for progress-weighted behavioral cloning on four real-world manipulation tasks spanning two robot platforms, improving over SFT on all four tasks. These results suggest that modality-specific specialization of foundation VLMs can provide practical visual reward signals for both simulated policy refinement and physical robot self-improvement without hand-coded task rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把基础 VLM 特化成帧级奖励生成器 (Large Reward Models, LRM)，从视觉观测直接产出 progress、task completion、temporal contrastive 三类奖励接口，用它替代手工奖励做机器人策略在线精炼。progress 奖励是最强的非特权在线精炼信号，能改进模仿学习基线并缩小与特权环境奖励的差距；在两个机器人平台的四项真实操作任务上，progress 加权行为克隆全部优于 SFT。
Motivation: RL 提升操作策略的瓶颈在于奖励函数既要有语义、又要跨任务复用，而手工设计或事后轨迹评估难以同时满足在线精炼与真实部署。
Method: 将 SOTA VLM 在多源数据（真实机器人轨迹、人-物交互、仿真操作环境）上特化为帧级奖励生成器，暴露 progress estimation、task completion、temporal contrastive comparison 三种视觉奖励接口；从模仿学习策略出发，用这些奖励做 PPO 精炼，并将 progress 奖励用于 progress 加权行为克隆。
Result: LRM progress 奖励给出最强的非特权在线精炼信号，改进 IL 基线并缩小与特权环境奖励的差距；progress 加权行为克隆在两个机器人平台的四项真实操作任务上全部优于 SFT。

papers.title: Tool Use Reduces Depth-Induced Collapse in OOD Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Humans can apply ideas learned in one context to substantially different situations. We call this process of searching for and constructing novel recombinations of learned relationships to solve new problems \textit{out-of-distribution (OOD) reasoning}. The capacity for large language models (LLMs) to support OOD reasoning underpins proposals for generally intelligent systems. However, this property is challenging to measure because most problems admit many decompositions, some involving shallow subproblems and others involving subproblems that may have been memorized from the training data. This makes it difficult to determine how much compositional reasoning a model must actually perform. Uncertainty about training distributions, how to measure a datapoint's distance from a training distribution, and the exponential number of ways to decompose most tasks make it intractable to robustly measure any modern LLM's OOD-reasoning capacity on standard natural-language tasks. In this work, we introduce a benchmark in which a model progressively solves a Boolean circuit over $GF(2)$ from data. This benchmark is both minimal, isolating OOD reasoning from these confounding factors, and general, as any computable function can be represented as a sufficiently large $GF(2)$ polynomial. We find that standalone models' next-step accuracy collapses as depth grows. In contrast, tool use through the synthesis and execution of code prevents this collapse in both small and frontier LLMs. These results indicate that synthesizing tools play a crucial role in supporting OOD reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一个在 GF(2) 上逐步求解布尔电路的 OOD 推理基准，隔离了任务分解与记忆混淆。发现独立模型的 next-step accuracy 随电路深度增长而崩溃，而通过合成并执行代码使用工具，在小模型和前沿 LLM 上都能阻止这种崩溃。
Motivation: OOD 推理难以度量：多数任务有多种分解方式，部分子问题可能已被训练数据记忆，加上训练分布未知与分解方式指数增长，使标准自然语言任务上无法稳健测量现代 LLM 的组合推理能力。
Method: 构造一个从数据逐步求解 GF(2) 上布尔电路的基准，既最小化（隔离 OOD 推理与混淆因素）又通用（任何可计算函数都可表示为足够大的 GF(2) 多项式）；对比独立求解与通过合成并执行代码进行工具使用两种设置。
Result: 独立模型的 next-step accuracy 随深度增长而崩溃；工具使用（合成并执行代码）在小模型和前沿 LLM 上都阻止了这一崩溃。
Conclusion: 合成工具在支撑 OOD 推理中起关键作用，深度诱导的崩溃可通过代码执行类工具使用得到缓解。

papers.title: AdaptManip: Learning Adaptive Whole-Body Object Lifting and Delivery with Online Recurrent State Estimation
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Adaptive Whole-body Loco-Manipulation, AdaptManip, a fully autonomous framework for humanoid robots to perform integrated navigation, object lifting, and delivery. Unlike prior imitation learning-based approaches that rely on human demonstrations and are often brittle to disturbances, AdaptManip aims to train a robust loco-manipulation policy via reinforcement learning without human demonstrations or teleoperation data. The proposed framework consists of three coupled components: (1) a recurrent object state estimator that tracks the manipulated object in real time under limited field-of-view and occlusions; (2) a whole-body base policy for robust locomotion with residual manipulation control for stable object lifting and delivery; and (3) a LiDAR-based robot global position estimator that provides drift-robust localization. All components are trained in simulation using reinforcement learning and deployed on real hardware in a zero-shot manner. Experimental results show that AdaptManip significantly outperforms baseline methods, including imitation learning-based approaches, in adaptability and overall success rate, while the learned estimator keeps tracking the object when visual observations are intermittent. We further demonstrate fully autonomous real-world navigation, object lifting, and delivery on a humanoid robot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaptManip 是人形机器人全身 loco-manipulation 框架，用强化学习在仿真中联合训练循环物体状态估计器、带残差操作控制的全身运动基策略与 LiDAR 全局定位，零样本部署到实机。在适应性与总体成功率上显著优于含模仿学习在内的基线，视觉间断时估计器仍能持续跟踪物体，并完成真实世界的自主导航、搬起与投送。
Motivation: 既有的人形机器人操作策略依赖人类示教或遥操作数据，对扰动脆弱，且受限视野与遮挡下物体状态难以持续跟踪。
Method: 三个耦合组件全部用 RL 在仿真中训练后零样本上实机：循环物体状态估计器在有限视野与遮挡下实时跟踪被操作物体；全身基策略负责鲁棒运动并叠加残差操作控制以稳定搬起与投送；基于 LiDAR 的机器人全局位置估计器提供抗漂移定位。
Result: 实验显示 AdaptManip 在 adaptability 与 overall success rate 上显著优于包括模仿学习方法在内的基线；学习得到的估计器在视觉观测间断时仍保持对物体的跟踪；并在人形机器人上完成完全自主的真实世界导航、物体搬起与投送。
Conclusion: 不依赖人类示教或遥操作、纯仿真 RL 训练的 loco-manipulation 策略可以零样本部署到实机，并在扰动与视觉间断下保持成功率。

papers.title: MGSM-Pro: A Simple Strategy for Robust Multilingual Mathematical Reasoning Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning. However, benchmark development for multilingual evaluation has lagged behind English in both difficulty and recency. Recently, GSM-Symbolic showed a strong evidence of high variance when models are evaluated on different instantiations of the same question; however, the evaluation was conducted only in English. In this paper, we introduce MGSM-Pro, an extension of MGSM dataset with GSM-Symbolic approach. Our dataset provides five instantiations per MGSM question by varying names, digits and irrelevant context. Evaluations across nine languages reveal that many low-resource languages suffer large performance drops when tested on digit instantiations different from those in the original test set. We further find that models robustness in HRL setting do not necessarily translate to LRL. Moreover, proprietary models, such as Gemini 2.5 Flash and GPT-4.1 are less robust to digit, whereas Gemini 3.0 Pro is more robust. Among open models, GPT-OSS 120B and DeepSeek v3 show stronger robustness. Based on these findings, we recommend evaluating each problem using at least five digit-varying instantiations to obtain a more robust and realistic assessment of math reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 GSM-Symbolic 的实例化扰动方法搬到多语言 MGSM 上，提出 MGSM-Pro：每题生成五个变体，改动人名、数字与无关上下文。九种语言评测显示低资源语言在数字变体上性能大幅下降，且高资源语言上的鲁棒性不迁移到低资源语言；作者据此建议每题至少用五个数字变体评测。
Motivation: 多语言数学推理基准在难度与新鲜度上落后于英文，且已有评测只在英文里检验同一问题不同实例化的高方差，低资源语言的鲁棒性缺口无从判断。
Method: 以 MGSM 数据集为基础、套用 GSM-Symbolic 的扰动方式构造 MGSM-Pro，每道 MGSM 题给出五个实例化，分别改变人名、数字和无关上下文；在九种语言上对模型做评测，并区分高资源 (HRL) 与低资源 (LRL) 设置。
Result: 九种语言的评测显示，许多低资源语言在与原测试集不同的数字实例化上出现大幅性能下降；高资源语言设置下的鲁棒性不必然迁移到低资源语言。专有模型中 Gemini 2.5 Flash 与 GPT-4.1 对数字扰动较不鲁棒，Gemini 3.0 Pro 更鲁棒；开源模型中 GPT-OSS 120B 与 DeepSeek v3 鲁棒性更强。
Conclusion: 单实例化的 MGSM 分数会高估模型的多语言数学推理能力，每道题至少用五个数字变体评测才能得到更稳健、更真实的评估。

papers.title: Causal-Aware Tabular GANs with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Existing tabular data generation methods primarily focus on matching statistical distributions between real and synthetic data, often overlooking the preservation of underlying causal relationships. As a result, generated samples may appear realistic while failing to maintain the causal structure required for reliable downstream analysis. We propose CA-GAN, a causal-aware generative framework for tabular data synthesis that explicitly incorporates causal knowledge into both the training and generation processes. CA-GAN first extracts a causal graph from real data to provide structural prior knowledge, then employs a graph-conditioned Conditional WGAN-GP whose sub-generators model variables according to their causal dependencies. More importantly, we introduce a reinforcement learning-based objective that treats causal graph discrepancy between real and synthetic data as a reward signal, enabling causal consistency to become an explicit optimization target during training rather than an implicit consequence of sampling order. Extensive experiments on 14 synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that CA-GAN consistently outperforms seven state-of-the-art baselines in causal preservation while achieving strong downstream utility, privacy preservation, and data quality. These results show that CA-GAN provides an effective and practical solution for generating high-quality synthetic tabular data that better respects underlying causal mechanisms.
papers.comment: Accepted at Asian Conference on Machine Learning (ACML) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CA-GAN 在表格数据合成中把因果图作为显式优化目标：先从真实数据抽取因果图作结构先验，再用图条件的 Conditional WGAN-GP 按因果依赖分变量生成，并以强化学习奖励最小化真实与合成数据的因果图差异。在 14 个合成与真实数据集上，其因果保持性一致优于七个 SOTA 基线，同时下游效用、隐私保护与数据质量也保持强表现。
Motivation: 现有表格生成方法只对齐真实与合成数据的统计分布，忽略底层因果关系，导致样本看似真实却破坏因果结构，无法支撑可靠的下游分析。
Method: CA-GAN 分三步：从真实数据抽取因果图作为结构先验；用 graph-conditioned Conditional WGAN-GP，子生成器按变量的因果依赖建模；引入基于强化学习的目标，把真实与合成数据间的因果图差异 (causal graph discrepancy) 作为 reward，使因果一致性成为训练期的显式优化目标而非采样顺序的副产物。
Result: 在 14 个合成与真实数据集上，CA-GAN 在因果保持 (causal preservation) 指标上一致优于七个 SOTA 基线，同时在下游效用、隐私保护和数据质量上取得强表现。
Conclusion: 把因果知识同时注入训练与生成、并用 RL 奖励直接优化因果图一致性，是生成高质量且尊重底层因果机制的合成表格数据的有效实用方案。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: CA-GAN 分三步：从真实数据抽取因果图作为结构先验；用 graph-conditioned Conditional WGAN-GP，子生成器按变量的因果依赖建模；引入基于强化学习的目标，把真实与合成数据间的因果图差异 (causal graph discrepancy) 作为 reward，使因果一致性成为训练期的显式优化目标而非采样顺序的副产物。
summary_sections.result: 在 14 个合成与真实数据集上，CA-GAN 在因果保持 (causal preservation) 指标上一致优于七个 SOTA 基线，同时在下游效用、隐私保护和数据质量上取得强表现。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把因果知识同时注入训练与生成、并用 RL 奖励直接优化因果图一致性，是生成高质量且尊重底层因果机制的合成表格数据的有效实用方案。

papers.title: Deep Symmetric Autoencoders from the Eckart-Young-Schmidt Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Deep autoencoders have become a fundamental tool in various machine learning applications, ranging from dimensionality reduction and reduced order modeling of partial differential equations to anomaly detection and neural machine translation. Despite their empirical success, a solid theoretical foundation for their expressiveness remains elusive, particularly when compared to classical projection-based techniques. In this work, we aim to take a step forward in this direction by presenting a comprehensive analysis of what we refer to as symmetric autoencoders, a broad class of deep learning architectures that have surfaced frequently in the recent literature. Specifically, we introduce a formal distinction between different classes of symmetric architectures, analyzing their strengths and limitations from a mathematical perspective. For instance, we show that the reconstruction error of symmetric autoencoders with orthonormality constraints can be understood by leveraging the well-renowned Eckart-Young-Schmidt (EYS) theorem. As a byproduct of our analysis, we end up developing the EYS initialization strategy for symmetric autoencoders, which is based on an iterated application of the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). To validate our findings, we conduct a series of numerical experiments where we benchmark our proposal against conventional deep autoencoders, discussing the importance of model design and initialization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从 Eckart-Young-Schmidt (EYS) 定理出发分析对称自编码器 (symmetric autoencoders) 的重构误差，据此提出基于迭代 SVD 的 EYS 初始化策略。数值实验将其与常规深度自编码器对比，说明模型设计与初始化对表达能力的关键作用。
Motivation: 深度自编码器虽在降维、PDE 降阶建模、异常检测等任务上经验成功，但相比经典投影技术仍缺乏坚实的表达力理论基础，尤其对文献中频繁出现的对称架构缺少统一的数学刻画。
Method: 形式化区分不同类别的对称自编码器架构，从数学上分析其强弱与局限；对带正交性约束 (orthonormality constraints) 的对称自编码器，用 Eckart-Young-Schmidt 定理刻画重构误差，并由此导出基于反复执行 SVD 的 EYS 初始化策略；最后通过数值实验与常规深度自编码器对比。
Result: 证明带正交约束的对称自编码器重构误差可由 EYS 定理理解，并产出 EYS 初始化策略；数值实验中将该初始化方案与常规深度自编码器做基准对比，讨论模型设计与初始化的重要性（摘要未列出具体数值指标）。
Conclusion: 对称自编码器的表达力可借经典奇异值分解理论加以界定，SVD 式初始化是把这一理论落到训练实践的直接手段。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: In Dialogue with Intelligence: Toward Insightful Co-Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Dialogue with a large language model can lead a person to insight: a sudden change in how they understand a problem. This perspective asks how model activity relates to insight as a dialogue unfolds. I propose that part of the intelligence expressed in dialogue arises from two interacting recurrences: each generated token becomes context for the next, and each response returns through the person, whose interpretation and new observations reshape what the model receives. Within this loop, the model's contribution shifts between modes, from echoing familiar formulations to offering a framing that opens a new direction for the person to develop. These modes may correspond to distinguishable patterns of model activity. A memory "spine" that selects which context is carried forward could elicit productive patterns again while the ideas themselves change. Public records of human-model dialogue, activity recorded from open-weight models and tools from computational neuroscience make these proposals testable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 cs.AI/cs.HC 视角论文，主张人机对话中的洞察 (insight) 来自两层递归的耦合：每个生成 token 成为下一个 token 的上下文，而模型的每条回应又经由人的解读与新观察回流、重塑模型输入。作者提出模型贡献在回声式复述与开启新方向的框架之间切换，且这些模式可能对应可区分的模型活动模式；用一个选择保留哪些上下文的 memory "spine" 可在观点本身变化时反复诱发高产模式。
Motivation: 对话中人的洞察如何产生缺少可检验的机制解释：模型活动与洞察之间的关系在对话展开过程中如何演变，目前没有被刻画。
Method: 提出双递归 (two interacting recurrences) 框架：token 级自回归上下文 + 经由人的解释回流；把模型贡献划分为从回声式复述到提供新框架的多种模式，并设想一个 memory "spine" 选择携带哪些上下文前传。检验路径是公开人机对话记录、开放权重模型的活动记录，以及计算神经科学工具。
Result: 论文为视角/提案性质，给出的可检验对象是：模型活动模式可能与对话中的不同贡献模式一一对应，且 memory spine 可重复诱发高产模式；可用公开对话记录、开放权重模型活动与计算神经科学工具检验。
Conclusion: 对话中的智能部分可归因于 token 递归与人的回流这两层递归的交互，模型活动模式因此是可测量、可复现的干预对象。

papers.title: COLORA: Efficient Fine-Tuning for Convolutional Models with a Study Case on Optical Coherence Tomography Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: We introduce CoLoRA (Convolutional Low-Rank Adaptation), a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for convolutional neural networks (CNNs). CoLoRA extends LoRA to convolutional layers by decomposing kernel updates into lightweight depthwise and pointwise components. This design reduces the number of trainable convolutional-update parameters by over 80\% compared with full convolutional fine-tuning, while allowing the learned updates to be merged into the pretrained convolutional kernels, thereby preserving the original model size and inference complexity. Experiments on MedMNIST datasets, particularly OCTMNISTv2, demonstrate that CoLoRA applied to VGG16 and ResNet50 achieves competitive classification performance while substantially reducing the number of trainable parameters. Comparisons with transfer learning, adapters, BitFit, and convolutional LoRA variants further characterize the trade-offs among predictive performance, trainable parameters, and training cost. Additional experiments on CIFAR-100 and Cats vs. Dogs provide preliminary evidence that the proposed adaptation strategy also transfers to non-medical image-classification tasks. Peak GPU-memory measurements further show that parameter efficiency does not translate directly into proportional training-memory savings, with memory consumption depending strongly on the placement of the adapted convolutional layers. Overall, CoLoRA provides a parameter-efficient and deployment-efficient alternative to full fine-tuning for convolutional models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoLoRA 把 LoRA 的低秩分解搬到 CNN 卷积核更新上，拆成轻量 depthwise 与 pointwise 两支，可训练卷积更新参数比全卷积微调减少 80% 以上，且学到的更新能合并回预训练卷积核，不改变模型大小与推理复杂度。在 MedMNIST（尤其 OCTMNISTv2）上用于 VGG16 与 ResNet50 取得有竞争力的分类表现；峰值 GPU 显存并不随参数量等比下降，而强烈依赖被适配卷积层的位置。
Motivation: CNN 全量微调卷积层参数多、部署时需额外保存适配权重，而现有参数高效微调方法主要面向 Transformer；同时参数效率与训练显存节省并不等价，需要在预测性能、可训练参数与训练成本之间给出权衡。
Method: 提出 CoLoRA (Convolutional Low-Rank Adaptation)：把卷积核更新分解为轻量 depthwise 与 pointwise 分量，训练后可合并进预训练卷积核；在 MedMNIST（含 OCTMNISTv2）、CIFAR-100、Cats vs. Dogs 上，对 VGG16 与 ResNet50 与 transfer learning、adapters、BitFit 及卷积 LoRA 变体对比，并测量峰值 GPU 显存。
Result: 可训练卷积更新参数较全卷积微调减少 80% 以上；在 MedMNIST（尤其 OCTMNISTv2）上 CoLoRA 用于 VGG16 与 ResNet50 达到有竞争力的分类性能；CIFAR-100 与 Cats vs. Dogs 提供了向非医学图像分类迁移的初步证据；峰值 GPU 显存显示参数效率不直接转化为等比例的训练显存节省，显存消耗强烈依赖被适配卷积层的放置位置。
Conclusion: CoLoRA 是卷积模型在参数与部署两侧都优于全量微调的替代方案，但参数效率不等于显存效率，适配层位置是显存开销的决定因素。

papers.title: MMMG: a Comprehensive and Reliable Benchmark for Multitask Multimodal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Automatically evaluating multimodal generation presents a significant challenge, as automated metrics often struggle to align with human evaluation, especially for complex tasks that involve multiple modalities. We present MMMG, the first benchmark to bring the verifiable-task paradigm to multimodal generation, spanning 4 modality combinations (image, audio, interleaved text and image, interleaved text and audio). As few multimodal outputs can be checked by programs alone, MMMG targets tasks that are either verifiable or near-verifiable: by providing references, and constraining model judges with explicit rubrics. We keep tasks challenging for generation models while enabling reliable automatic evaluation through a combination of models and programs. MMMG encompasses 55 tasks (including 31 newly developed ones), each with a carefully designed evaluation pipeline, and 1288 instructions to systematically assess reasoning, controllability, and other key capabilities of multimodal generation models. Extensive validation demonstrates that MMMG is highly aligned with human judgment, achieving an average agreement of 94.4%. Benchmarking results on 29 models reveal that even though the state-of-the-art model, GPT Image, achieves 70.7% accuracy for image generation, it falls short on interleaved generation. Furthermore, results suggest considerable improvement space in audio generation, highlighting an important future direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMMG 把可验证任务范式首次搬进多模态生成评测，覆盖 4 种模态组合、55 个任务（31 个新开发）与 1288 条指令，用参考答案加显式 rubric 约束模型判分。与人工判断平均一致率达 94.4%；29 个模型中最强的 GPT Image 图像生成准确率 70.7%，但在交错生成上明显不足，音频生成改进空间大。
Motivation: 自动指标难以与人工评价对齐，尤其在涉及图像、音频与交错文本的复杂多模态生成任务上，缺乏可靠且可程序化核验的评测基准。
Method: 面向可验证或近可验证任务：提供参考输出，并用显式 rubric 约束模型判分，结合模型与程序构成每个任务的评测流水线；覆盖图像、音频、图文交错、文本音频交错 4 种模态组合，评测推理与可控性等能力。
Result: 与人工判断平均一致率 94.4%；在 29 个模型的基准测试中，SOTA 模型 GPT Image 图像生成准确率 70.7%，但在交错生成上表现不足；音频生成结果显示明显改进空间。
Conclusion: 以参考加 rubric 约束的可验证评测能把多模态生成评测做到与人工高度一致，同时暴露出现有模型在交错生成与音频生成上的短板。

papers.title: WaLLM -- Understanding Use and Engagement with a General-Purpose LLM on WhatsApp
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) chatbots are increasingly reaching users through messaging platforms (e.g. WhatsApp). However, these systems remain largely proprietary and opaque, while academic research has focused on narrow, domain-specific assistants. This leaves open questions about how people use general-purpose LLMs and how such systems should be designed. To address this gap, we developed WaLLM, a general-purpose LLM chatbot, and deployed it on WhatsApp as a design probe to study open-ended AI use in the wild. Our findings show that health and well-being accounted for the largest proportion of queries, suggesting that users turned to WaLLM for advice and information. Engagement features varied in their adoption and associated patterns of use: proactive communication supported the service's visibility and correlated with higher user activity, while communal lists facilitated content discovery. We report how these features were adapted to WhatsApp's affordances and discuss implications for designing general-purpose LLM services over messaging platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WaLLM 是部署在 WhatsApp 上的通用 LLM 聊天机器人，作为 design probe 用于观察真实环境中的开放式 AI 使用。健康与福祉类查询占比最高；主动推送 (proactive communication) 提升服务可见度并与更高用户活跃度相关，公共列表 (communal lists) 促进内容发现。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 聊天系统多为专有且不透明，学术研究又集中于窄领域垂直助手，因此人们如何在日常消息平台上使用通用 LLM、这类系统该如何设计仍是空白。
Method: 自行开发通用 LLM 聊天机器人 WaLLM 并部署到 WhatsApp，作为 design probe 收集真实使用数据；考察健康咨询等查询分布，并对比主动通信与公共列表两类参与度功能的采用情况及其与使用模式的关联，同时报告这些功能如何适配 WhatsApp 的平台特性。
Result: 健康与福祉 (health and well-being) 占查询的最大比例；主动通信与更高的用户活跃度相关，公共列表促进内容发现；两类参与度功能的采用度及其关联使用模式各不相同。
Conclusion: 在消息平台上提供通用 LLM 服务时，主动推送类功能能带动活跃度、公共列表能带动内容发现，设计应围绕 WhatsApp 的平台 affordance 来适配这些功能。

summary_sections.method: 自行开发通用 LLM 聊天机器人 WaLLM 并部署到 WhatsApp，作为 design probe 收集真实使用数据；考察健康咨询等查询分布，并对比主动通信与公共列表两类参与度功能的采用情况及其与使用模式的关联，同时报告这些功能如何适配 WhatsApp 的平台特性。
summary_sections.result: 健康与福祉 (health and well-being) 占查询的最大比例；主动通信与更高的用户活跃度相关，公共列表促进内容发现；两类参与度功能的采用度及其关联使用模式各不相同。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在消息平台上提供通用 LLM 服务时，主动推送类功能能带动活跃度、公共列表能带动内容发现，设计应围绕 WhatsApp 的平台 affordance 来适配这些功能。

papers.title: Structured-Noise Masked Modeling for Video, Audio and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: Masked modeling has emerged as a robust self-supervised learning framework. However, most methods rely on random masking, which disregards the structural properties of different data modalities. To align with the spatiotemporal and spectral characteristics of video and audio data, we introduce a structured noise-based masking approach. By filtering white noise into different color noise distributions, we generate structured masks that capture modality-specific patterns without requiring handcrafted heuristics or access to the data. Our approach enhances masked video and audio modeling frameworks without any additional computational cost. Experiments show that structured noise masking consistently outperforms random masking, underscoring the value of modality-aware masking strategies for representation learning.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出结构化噪声掩码 (structured noise masking)：把白噪声滤波成不同颜色的噪声分布来生成掩码，使掩码贴合视频与音频的时空和谱结构，无需手工启发式或访问数据本身。在视频与音频掩码建模框架上，结构化掩码一致优于随机掩码，且不增加额外计算开销。
Motivation: 掩码自监督学习普遍用随机掩码，忽略了不同模态的结构属性，视频与音频的时空、谱特性因此未被掩码策略利用。
Method: 将白噪声滤波为多种颜色噪声分布（color noise distributions），据此生成结构化掩码，嵌入现有掩码视频与音频建模框架；掩码生成不需手工启发式，也不需访问数据。
Result: 实验显示结构化噪声掩码在视频与音频掩码建模上一致优于随机掩码，且不带来额外计算开销。
Conclusion: 掩码策略应当是模态感知的：按时空与谱结构设计掩码比随机掩码更有利于表征学习，且代价可忽略。

papers.title: Multi-Sensor Fusion for UAV Classification Based on Feature Maps of Image and Radar Data
authors: Dimitrios Tzovaras (1) ((1) Centre for Research and Technology Hellas
papers.abstract_en: The cost, flexibility, and efficiency of modern UAVs make them attractive across many applications, but their proliferation has driven a rising number of malicious or accidental incidents, making UAV detection and classification mechanisms essential. Individual sensing modalities each present complementary limitations, and existing detection systems typically rely on a single sensor or fuse modalities only at the decision level, leaving the feature-level fusion of heterogeneous image and radar detectors largely unexplored. We propose a deep neural network that fuses high-level features extracted from the individual object-detection and classification models of thermal, optronic, and radar sensors. A CNN-based architecture combines the three modalities by stacking the thermal and optronic image features along the channel axis prior to fusion with the radar features. Evaluated on a real-world multi-sensor dataset, the proposed three-modality fusion model attains an F1-score of 0.95, compared to 0.93 for the dual-modality (thermal-optronic) configuration and 0.91 for the best-performing single-sensor (thermal) baseline, confirming that fusing complementary sensor features yields measurable gains in UAV classification performance.

papers.title: Adaptive and oblivious statistical adversaries are equivalent
papers.abstract_en: We resolve a fundamental question about the ability to perform a statistical task, such as learning, when an adversary corrupts the sample. Such adversaries are specified by the types of corruption they can make and their level of knowledge about the sample. The latter distinguishes between sample-adaptive adversaries which know the contents of the sample when choosing the corruption, and sample-oblivious adversaries, which do not. We prove that for all types of corruptions, sample-adaptive and sample-oblivious adversaries are \emph{equivalent} up to polynomial factors in the sample size. This resolves the main open question introduced by [BLMT22] and further explored in [CHL+23]. Specifically, consider any algorithm $A$ that solves a statistical task even when a sample-oblivious adversary corrupts its input. We show that there is an algorithm $A'$ that solves the same task when the corresponding sample-adaptive adversary corrupts its input. The construction of $A'$ is simple and maintains the computational efficiency of $A$: It requests a polynomially larger sample than $A$ uses and then runs $A$ on a uniformly random subsample.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明在任意污染类型下，知道样本内容的 sample-adaptive 对抗者与不知道样本内容的 sample-oblivious 对抗者在统计任务上等价，代价仅为样本量的多项式因子。构造的算法 A' 只需向 A 请求多项式更大的样本、再在其均匀随机子样本上运行 A，且保持 A 的计算效率。
Motivation: 对抗污染下统计任务的可学性取决于对抗者的知识类型，此前 sample-adaptive 与 sample-oblivious 两类模型的关系是 [BLMT22] 提出、[CHL+23] 进一步探讨的主要公开问题。
Method: 对任意能抵御 sample-oblivious 污染的算法 A，构造对应的 A'：向 A 索取多项式放大的样本量，然后在均匀随机子样本上运行 A，从而抵御相应的 sample-adaptive 对抗者；结论对所有污染类型成立。
Result: 证明 sample-adaptive 与 sample-oblivious 对抗者对所有污染类型等价，样本量差距至多为多项式因子；A' 保持 A 的计算效率。
Conclusion: 对抗者是否知道样本内容并不改变统计任务的可学性本质，只需多项式样本开销即可互相模拟，解决了 [BLMT22] 留下的主要公开问题。

papers.title: Exploiting Exogenous Structure for Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study a structured class of Markov Decision Processes, known as Exo-MDPs, in which the state space is partitioned into exogenous and endogenous components. Exogenous states evolve stochastically, independent of the agent's actions, while endogenous states evolve deterministically based on both state components and actions. Exo-MDPs capture many operations research settings, including inventory control, resource management, and ride-sharing. Our first contribution is structural: we establish a representational equivalence between discrete MDPs, Exo-MDPs, and discrete linear mixture MDPs. Our second contribution is statistical. We characterize the minimax regret of learning in Exo-MDPs when the effective dimension r is small relative to the endogenous state and action spaces. When the exogenous states are unobserved, we prove matching upper and lower regret bounds of order $Θ(Hr \sqrt{K})$ over $K$ episodes of horizon $H$, where $r$ is the effective dimension of the Exo-MDP. When exogenous states are observed, the minimax regret improves to $Θ(H\sqrt{ r K})$, revealing a $Θ(\sqrt{r})$ statistical gap due to observation of the exogenous states. These results show that Exo-MDPs decouple sample complexity from action space and endogenous state space. We validate these insights with experiments on inventory control and resource allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究外生结构 MDP（Exo-MDP）：状态分为外生与内生两部分，外生部分独立于动作随机演化，内生部分由两部分状态与动作确定性演化。证明离散 MDP、Exo-MDP 与离散线性混合 MDP 之间存在表示等价；当有效维度 r 相对内生状态与动作空间较小时，外生状态不可观测时 minimax regret 为 Θ(Hr√K)，可观测时改进为 Θ(H√(rK))，两者相差 Θ(√r)。
Motivation: 库存控制、资源管理、打车调度等运筹场景中，状态含与动作无关的外生分量，通用 MDP 学习的样本复杂度随动作空间与内生状态空间增长，未利用该结构。
Method: 定义 Exo-MDP 类并建立其与离散 MDP、离散线性混合 MDP 的表示等价；在有效维度 r 小于内生状态与动作空间的条件下，分别对外生状态可观测与不可观测两种情形推导 regret 上下界，并在库存控制与资源分配上做实验验证。
Result: 外生状态不可观测时，K 个回合、视野 H 下的 minimax regret 匹配上界与下界 Θ(Hr√K)；可观测时改进为 Θ(H√(rK))，即观测外生状态带来 Θ(√r) 的统计差距。结果表明样本复杂度与动作空间和内生状态空间解耦，并在库存控制与资源分配实验中验证。
Conclusion: 利用外生结构可把 Exo-MDP 的学习样本复杂度从动作空间与内生状态空间中解耦，而观测外生状态进一步带来 √r 级的 regret 改进。

papers.title: VITA: A Multi-Source Vicinal Transfer Augmentation Method for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Invariance to diverse types of image corruption, such as noise, blurring, or colour shifts, is essential to establish robust models in computer vision. Data augmentation has been the major approach in improving the robustness against common corruptions. However, the samples produced by popular augmentation strategies deviate significantly from the underlying data manifold. As a result, performance is skewed toward certain types of corruption. To address this issue, we propose a multi-source vicinal transfer augmentation (VITA) method for generating diverse on-manifold samples. The proposed VITA consists of two complementary parts: tangent transfer and integration of multi-source vicinal samples. The tangent transfer creates initial augmented samples for improving corruption robustness. The integration employs a generative model to characterize the underlying manifold built by vicinal samples, facilitating the generation of on-manifold samples. Our proposed VITA significantly outperforms the current state-of-the-art augmentation methods, demonstrated in extensive experiments on corruption benchmarks. Code: https://github.com/MinghuiChen43/VITA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VITA 提出多源邻域迁移增强 (multi-source vicinal transfer augmentation)，用 tangent transfer 先生成初始增强样本，再用生成模型刻画邻域样本构成的数据流形并从中采样，得到流形上的多样样本。在 corruption benchmark 上显著优于现有最先进增强方法，缓解了性能偏向特定 corruption 类型的问题。
Motivation: 主流数据增强产生的样本明显偏离底层数据流形，导致模型对噪声、模糊、色彩偏移等 corruption 的鲁棒性偏向少数类型。
Method: VITA 含两个互补部分：tangent transfer 生成初始增强样本以提升 corruption 鲁棒性；integration 用生成模型刻画邻域样本 (vicinal samples) 构成的流形，从中生成 on-manifold 样本。
Result: 在 corruption benchmarks 上的大量实验中显著优于当前最先进增强方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把增强样本拉回数据流形可以纠正鲁棒性在不同 corruption 类型上的偏斜，VITA 的两阶段设计（tangent transfer + 生成式流形采样）是达成该目标的路径。

papers.title: Vmem-$φ$: Low-Compute Out-of-Distribution Detection in Spiking Neural Networks from Membrane-Potential Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient approach to processing event-camera data, yet out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging in this setting. Existing OOD detection methods often depend on model outputs or computational components that are unavailable in object detection SNNs or are poorly suited to low-compute deployment. To that effect, we show that the subthreshold membrane potential \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) provides a useful internal signal for detecting distribution shifts. Simple per-channel statistics derived from these membrane dynamics enable OOD detection. To evaluate this approach, we introduce Gen1-C, an event-camera corruption benchmark developed upon the Prophesee Gen1 automotive detection dataset, containing six sensor-motivated histogram-level stress tests at five severity levels. We further propose the Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD), a corruption-blind method that operates on membrane-potential statistics. At the highest corruption severity, MDD achieves an AUROC of more than 0.88 on five of the six corruptions using only a bounded 64-frame observation window. Notably, the remaining corruption is also the one that has the smallest effect on the underlying detector. These results show that the temporal membrane-potential dynamics can provide an effective and low-cost signal for OOD detection in SNN-based event perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在事件相机目标检测 SNN 中，用亚阈值膜电位 Vmem(t) 的逐通道统计量做分布偏移检测，提出 corruption-blind 的 Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD)。在自建的 Gen1-C 基准（基于 Prophesee Gen1，6 种传感器激励的直方图级扰动 × 5 个严重度）最高严重度下，MDD 仅用有界 64 帧观测窗即在 6 种扰动中的 5 种取得 AUROC > 0.88。
Motivation: 事件相机 SNN 的 OOD 检测困难：现有方法依赖模型输出或计算组件，而这些在目标检测 SNN 中不可得，或不适合低算力部署。
Method: 从亚阈值膜电位时间序列提取简单逐通道统计量作为分布偏移信号；提出 Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD)，直接在膜电位统计量上运行、对 corruption 类型盲；并构建 Gen1-C 基准，含 6 种传感器激励的直方图级压力测试与 5 个严重度等级，基于 Prophesee Gen1 汽车检测数据集。
Result: 最高 corruption 严重度下，MDD 在 6 种扰动中的 5 种上 AUROC > 0.88，观测窗为有界 64 帧；剩下的第 6 种扰动同时也是对底层检测器影响最小的那一种。
Conclusion: 膜电位的时间动态本身即可作为 SNN 事件感知中低开销 OOD 检测的有效信号，无需依赖模型输出；扰动对检测器影响越小，该信号越难检出分布偏移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Fault-Tolerant Budget Conservation in Distributed Multi-Agent Delegation
papers.abstract_en: Resource limits are becoming an authorization boundary for AI agents that delegate work across concurrent and failure-prone workers. Parent-child allocation constraints, affine objects, and distributed escrow do not by themselves prevent overspend when replies are lost, effects complete after timeout, messages repeat, branches partition, or DAG joins alias one lineage. We formalize fault-tolerant budget conservation for distributed multi-agent delegation. Budgets are quantized resource vectors represented by exclusive escrow credits that move through a delegation DAG. Before dispatch, a branch converts credit into an operation reservation bound to lineage, epoch, normalized effect, maximum charge, receiver, and idempotency key. It persists a signed dispatch permit with quarantine; the gateway verifies that permit before first acceptance. Uncertain effects remain charged until authenticated settlement, a fenced authoritative no-effect proof, or permanent retirement. We prove ownership partition, ledger and effect conservation, descendant non-amplification, at-most-once settlement, late-completion safety, and partition confinement under explicit mediation, durability, authentication, normalization, and gateway assumptions. An indistinguishability result shows that partition-local availability requires exclusive preallocation. Bounded TLA+ checking, an independent JavaScript explorer, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments exercise the declared scope and detect timeout-refund and historical-certificate-validation mutants. The mechanism preserves the issued budget bound across the evaluated crash, retry, duplicate, partition, join, and late-completion schedules.
papers.comment: 67 pages, 3 figures, 17 tables, 4 algorithms, and 3 listings. Includes formal proofs, bounded model checking, mutation analysis, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把资源预算当作 AI agent 分布式委托中的授权边界，用独占 escrow 信用在委托 DAG 上流动、派发前绑定 lineage/epoch/幂等键的操作预留与签名派发许可，证明在崩溃、重试、重复、分区、join、迟到完成等调度下预算上界守恒。不可区分性结果表明分区本地可用性必须以独占预分配为代价。
Motivation: 父-子分配约束、affine 对象与分布式 escrow 本身无法防止回复丢失、超时后生效、消息重复、分支分区或 DAG join 别名同一 lineage 时的超支。
Method: 预算表示为量化的资源向量，以独占 escrow 信用沿委托 DAG 流动；派发前分支把信用转为绑定 lineage、epoch、归一化 effect、最大扣费、接收方与幂等键的操作预留，并持久化带隔离的签名派发许可，由网关在首次接受前校验；不确定 effect 在认证结算、fenced 权威无效应证明或永久退休前保持扣费。证明涵盖所有权划分、账本与 effect 守恒、后代不放大、至多一次结算、迟到完成安全与分区约束。
Result: 在崩溃注入的双进程 SQLite 实验与有界 TLA+ 检查、独立 JavaScript explorer 中，机制在所评估的崩溃、重试、重复、分区、join 与迟到完成调度上保持已发放预算上界；并检出 timeout-refund 与历史证书校验两类变异体 (mutant)。论文含形式化证明、有界模型检查、变异分析，67 页、17 张表、4 个算法。
Conclusion: 在显式的中介、持久化、认证、归一化与网关假设下，escrow 信用加签名派发许可足以保证分布式多 agent 委托的预算守恒；而分区本地可用性必须用独占预分配换取。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Removing the NEEDLE in the Haystack: Backdoor Removal in LLMs via Weight Orthogonalisation
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor attacks can be implanted in Large Language Models (LLMs) during training, causing unwanted behaviour when a trigger appears in the input. Existing backdoor defences for LLMs attempt to remove the backdoor but inadvertently shift the model's output distribution to benign prompts, which can result in degraded model performance and safety. We propose NEEDLE, a training-free method for targeted backdoor removal. Once a trigger has been identified, our method estimates a backdoor direction and a refusal subspace through activation vectors, then applies sequential weight orthogonalisation to suppress the backdoor while preventing changes in refusal-related representations. NEEDLE requires neither a clean reference model nor the original poisoned training data. Evaluation is conducted across multiple model families and attack types. NEEDLE achieves the lowest mean Attack Success Rate (ASR) among the evaluated defences, including 0% on challenging code injection attacks, while resulting in the lowest KL divergence and minimal changes in capability and safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NEEDLE 是一种免训练的 LLM 后门移除方法：在触发器已知后，用激活向量估计后门方向与 refusal 子空间，再做序列化权重正交化 (sequential weight orthogonalisation)，在压制后门的同时保持 refusal 相关表示不变。在多个模型家族与攻击类型上，它取得所评估防御中最低的平均攻击成功率 (ASR)，对困难的代码注入攻击达 0%，同时 KL 散度最低、能力与安全指标变化最小。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 后门防御在移除后门时会把良性提示下的输出分布整体推偏，导致模型性能与安全性下降；且常依赖干净参考模型或原始中毒训练数据。
Method: 触发器识别后，先由激活向量估计后门方向与 refusal 子空间，再对该模型施加序列化权重正交化，抑制后门方向同时约束 refusal 表示不被改动；全程免训练，不需要干净参考模型或中毒数据。
Result: 在多个模型家族与攻击类型上，NEEDLE 的平均 ASR 为所评估防御中最低，代码注入攻击上达到 0%；同时 KL 散度最低，能力与安全指标变化极小。
Conclusion: 只对已识别的后门方向做权重正交化、并显式保护 refusal 子空间，可以在不重训、不需干净参考的前提下移除后门而不牺牲良性行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations: Conserving Authority across Replacement, Forking, and Rollback
papers.abstract_en: Self-modifying AI agents can replace, fork, and roll back identity-bearing software while descendants remain executable. Per-successor authorization does not constrain the resulting population: siblings may duplicate quotas, combine permissions, survive ancestor cuts, or overlap predecessors during promotion. We define authorization succession, which conserves authority across the active frontier of a single-parent generation forest. Our external protocol binds each generation to a manifest, root, unique parent, complete lineage, and fresh population sequence. Separate invariants bound root-lifetime consumption and current population exposure. A staged reservation freezes predecessor residual authority during replacement, while a partitioning fork validates the complete child family. Each commit atomically fences the predecessor and activates successors. Ancestor cuts invalidate dependent descendants; rollback creates a fresh generation without restoring spent authority; and a new root requires an independent grant. Under complete mediation, authenticated records, sound effect abstraction, durable monotone state, and complete lineage accounting, we prove population-safe succession, fork conservation, revocation closure, atomic handoff, rollback non-reminting, and exclusion of self-certification. An executable evaluation covers 32 registered decisions through direct-call and mailbox mappings (64/64 replays; 28 allows, 36 denies). An independent checker accepts all 64 original traces and rejects 28/28 semantic mutants; 12/12 profile invariants, 16/16 crash cuts, and 32/32 contender schedules pass. Two external adapters reproduce all 32 decisions around measured OurArk and Darwin Godel Machine mutations, including fresh-process restart, atomic succession, and predecessor rejection. The results establish authorization succession for registered protected effects.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 1 figure, 11 tables, and 1 algorithm; includes formal proofs and external runtime adapter evidence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 authorization succession：把自修改 AI agent 群体的替换、分叉、回滚绑定到 manifest、根、唯一父代、完整 lineage 与全新 population sequence 的外部协议，使权限在活跃前沿上守恒而非随后代复制。在 32 个注册决策上 64/64 重放一致（28 允许、36 拒绝），独立检查器接受全部 64 条原始 trace 并拒绝 28/28 语义变异体，两个外部 adapter 复现了 OurArk 与 Darwin Godel Machine 变异周围的全部 32 个决策。
Motivation: 逐个后继授权无法约束自修改 agent 形成的群体：兄弟节点可复制配额、合并权限、在祖先被切断后继续存活，或在晋升期与前代重叠。
Method: 外部协议将每一代绑定到 manifest、root、唯一 parent、完整 lineage 与全新 population sequence；用两条不变量分别约束 root 生命周期消耗与当前群体暴露，配合替换期的 staged reservation（冻结前代残余权限）、partitioning fork 校验整个子族，以及每次 commit 原子性地 fence 前代并激活后继。
Result: 可执行评测覆盖 32 个注册决策，经 direct-call 与 mailbox 映射得到 64/64 次重放一致（28 允许、36 拒绝）；独立检查器接受全部 64 条原始 trace 并拒绝 28/28 个语义变异体，12/12 profile 不变量、16/16 crash cut、32/32 contender 调度全部通过；两个外部 adapter 围绕实测 OurArk 与 Darwin Godel Machine 变异复现全部 32 个决策，含 fresh-process restart、atomic succession 与 predecessor rejection。
Conclusion: 在 complete mediation、认证记录、可靠 effect 抽象、durable monotone state 与完整 lineage 记账的假设下，可证明群体安全的 succession、fork 守恒、撤销闭合、原子交接、回滚不重铸权限并排除自认证；结论适用于已注册的 protected effects。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmarking System One decision models against trained classifiers and language models for automated decision gates
papers.abstract_en: Software that hands branching decisions to a model needs a declared option and a probability it can threshold. Typed decision models, also called System One models, return such probabilities without generating text, while supervised classifiers and generative language models are the established alternatives. Under matched conditions, one harness sends eight decision-model checkpoints from six families, including the hosted model Jev, and two generative comparators the same semantic requests, and scores supervised and zero-shot classifiers on the same workflow, intent and social-science items. The ranking of the model classes depends on the conditions. With the task's own labels, small trained classifiers are the most accurate on intents and not significantly different from the best decision models on workflows. Without labels, every decision model except the encoder-based checkpoints exceeds a zero-shot entailment classifier on workflows and intents. Read through option-key likelihoods, a larger generative model is level with Jev on workflows and intents and accepts more workflow decisions at five percent risk, and fine-tuned decision checkpoints gain intent accuracy over their untuned backbones. Stored temperatures fitted on few options raise calibration error with many options, and a held-out threshold for five percent in-scope risk still lets Jev accept 0.310 of out-of-scope requests. Swapping yes and no flips 50.5 answers per hundred for Jev, while fine-tuned checkpoints cut their backbones' social-science flips. An intent-trained first stage escalating to Jev matches its accuracy at 0.43 of its cost at full graphics-processor utilization. The results yield condition-dependent design rules for automated decision gates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在匹配条件下对比八个多族决策模型 checkpoint（含托管模型 Jev）、两个生成式对照与监督/零样本分类器，发现模型类别排名随条件反转：有任务标签时小型监督分类器在 intent 上最准，无标签时除 encoder 系 checkpoint 外所有决策模型都超过零样本蕴含分类器。Jev 在 5% 风险阈值下仍接受 0.310 的 out-of-scope 请求，交换 yes/no 会翻转每百题 50.5 个回答；intent 训练的一阶段再升级到 Jev 可在 0.43 成本下匹配其精度。
Motivation: 自动决策门 (automated decision gate) 需要模型给出可阈值化的概率而非生成文本，但 System One 决策模型、监督分类器与语言模型三类方案在不同条件下谁更准、更稳、更省缺少统一对照。
Method: 在同一 harness 下向八个决策模型 checkpoint（六个家族，含托管模型 Jev）与两个生成式对照发送相同语义请求，并在同一 workflow、intent 与社会科学题目上评测监督与零样本分类器；通过 option-key likelihood 读取概率，比较有/无任务标签两种条件，并测试 5% in-scope 风险的 held-out 阈值与 yes/no 交换扰动。
Result: 有标签时小型监督分类器在 intents 上最准确，与最佳决策模型在 workflows 上无显著差异；无标签时除 encoder 系 checkpoint 外所有决策模型在 workflows 与 intents 上超过零样本蕴含分类器。更大的生成式模型在 workflows 与 intents 上与 Jev 持平，并在 5% 风险下接受更多 workflow 决策；微调后的决策 checkpoint intent 精度高于未微调 backbone。少选项拟合的存储温度在多选项下抬高校准误差；5% 阈值下 Jev 仍接受 0.310 的 out-of-scope 请求；交换 yes/no 使 Jev 每百题翻转 50.5 个回答，微调 checkpoint 的社会科学翻转少于其 backbone。intent 训练的一阶段升级到 Jev 在满 GPU 利用率下以 0.43 的成本匹配其精度。
Conclusion: 模型类别排名取决于条件，作者据此给出面向自动决策门的条件依赖设计规则：有标签用小型监督分类器，无标签用决策模型，成本敏感场景用 intent 一阶段加 Jev 升级。
Relevance: 0
